jobs.title: Chief Director: Education Human Resource Management
jobs.summary: Chief Director position overseeing education human resource management, including planning, performance management, school evaluation, and labour relations within the Department of Basic Education.
jobs.requirements: The applicants must be in a possession of a qualification at NQF Level 7 as recognised by SAQA in Education or Social Science; 5 years’ experience at a senior managerial level; Experience in Education Planning, Education Human Resources or Education Labour Relations, which is supported by extensive knowledge of and experience in the education sector and training system planning, Policy funding and implementation in Education Human Resources System, Human Resource policy and Condition of Services Development; Understanding processes regarding Human Resources and in provincial education departments; Strong writing and communication skills as well as computer skills; Managing a team of people; A postgraduate qualification in the fields mentioned above will be an added advantage. Core Competencies: Strategic Capacity and Leadership; People Management and Empowerment; Financial Management and Change Management. The candidate must be confident, trustworthy, accurate, adaptable and diplomatic.
jobs.duties: The candidate will be in charge of the Chief Directorate, which comprises the Directorates: Education, Human Resource Planning, Provisioning and Monitoring; Education Performance Management and Development; Whole School Evaluation; Education Labour Relations Management and Conditions of Service; The successful candidate will be responsible for serving the entire sector and will be expected to lead and manage a team of people, working in close collaboration with other branches in the Department of Basic Education, other state departments, and the provincial departments; Ensuring effective and efficient labour relations; Analysing and reporting on human resources requirements and capacity; Developing a teacher recruitment strategy and system; Assessing the effective utilisation and teachers at schools, revamping the post allocation system by reducing class size at school; Developing and implementing the Human Resource Management Information System, as well as improving the effectiveness of the teacher performance system, as part of the integrated quality management performance evaluation and development of educators and improving the quality of teaching and learning in South African.
jobs.enquiries: Ms N Monyela Tel No: (012) 357 3294/ Mr M Segowa Tel No: (012) 357 4291
jobs.applications: Submitted via post to: Private Bag X895, Pretoria, 0001 or hand-deliver to: The Department of Basic Education, 222 Struben Street, Pretoria or you can email your application Sechele.O@dbe.gov.za/Monyela.N@dbe.gov.za/Segowa.M@dbe.gov.za/Ku malo.N@dbe.gov.za. Please visit the Department of Education’s website at www.education.gov.za
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on the most recently approved Z83 Application for Employment Form, obtainable from the DBE Website or any Public Service Department/Webpage. Use of the old Z83 Form will result in disqualification. The Z83 must be completed in full and page 2 duly signed. A clear indication of the post and reference number that is being applied for must be indicated on your Z83. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application but must submit the Z83 with a detailed Curriculum Vitae (only). Certified copies of qualifications and other relevant documents will be requested from shortlisted candidates on or before the day of the interview. Successful candidates will be subjected to Personnel Suitability Checks (criminal record, citizenship & financial/asset record checks, qualification and employment verification including social media profiles). Appointment is subject to positive results of the security clearance process. The successful candidate will be required to sign an annual performance agreement and, where applicable, annually disclose his/her financial interests. All applicants are required to declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest, to disclose memberships of Boards and directorships that they may be associated with. Applicants who do not comply with the requirements outlined above will not be considered. A Pre-entry Certificate for the Senior Management Service (SMS) (Nyukela Certificate) is required for all SMS appointments; the full details of the outlined requirements and course information       can      be     sourced       by      following     the     link https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course-SMS-pre-entry programme. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Hoofdirekteur: Onderwys Menslike Hulpbronbestuur
af.summary: Hoofdirekteurspos wat toesig hou oor onderwys menslike hulpbronbestuur, insluitend beplanning, prestasiebestuur, skoolevaluering en arbeidsverhoudinge binne die Department of Basic Education.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet 'n kwalifikasie op NQF Level 7 hê soos deur SAQA erken in Onderwys of Sosiale Wetenskappe; 5 years' ervaring op 'n senior bestuursvlak; Ervaring in Onderwysbeplanning, Onderwys Menslike Hulpbronne of Onderwys Arbeidsverhoudinge, wat gesteun word deur uitgebreide kennis van en ervaring in die onderwyssektor en opleidingstelselbeplanning, Beleidsbefondsing en implementering in Onderwys Menslike Hulpbronstelsel, Menslike hulpbronbeleid en Diensvoorwaarde-ontwikkeling; Begrip van prosesse rakende Menslike Hulpbronne en in provinsiale onderwysdepartemente; Sterk skryf- en kommunikasievaardighede asook rekenaarvaardighede; Bestuur van 'n span mense; 'n Nagraadse kwalifikasie in bogenoemde velde sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Kernbevoegdhede: Strategiese kapasiteit en leierskap; Mensebestuur en bemagtiging; Finansiële bestuur en Veranderingsbestuur. Die kandidaat moet selfversekerd, betroubaar, akkuraat, aanpasbaar en diplomatiek wees.
af.duties: Die kandidaat sal verantwoordelik wees vir die Hoofdirektoraat, wat bestaan uit die Direktorate: Onderwys, Menslike Hulpbronbeplanning, Voorsiening en Monitering; Onderwys Prestasiebestuur en -ontwikkeling; Heelskoolevaluering; Onderwys Arbeidsverhoudingsbestuur en Diensvoorwaardes; Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal verantwoordelik wees om die hele sektor te bedien en sal verwag word om 'n span mense te lei en te bestuur, in noue samewerking met ander takke in die Department of Basic Education, ander staatsdepartemente, en die provinsiale departemente; Verseker van doeltreffende en doeltrekkende arbeidsverhoudinge; Analiseer en verslag doen oor menslike hulpbronvereistes en -kapasiteit; Ontwikkel 'n onderwyserwerwingstrategie en -stelsel; Beoordeel die doeltreffende benutting van onderwysers by skole, herontwerp die postoekenningstelsel deur klassegrootte by skole te verminder; Ontwikkel en implementeer die Menslike Hulpbronbestuur Inligtingstelsel, asook verbeter die doeltreffendheid van die onderwyserprestasiestelsel, as deel van die geïntegreerde gehaltebestuur van prestasie-evaluering en ontwikkeling van opvoeders en verbeter die gehalte van onderrig en leer in South African.

zu.title: Umlawuli Omkhulu: Ukuphathwa Kwabasebenzi Emfundweni
zu.summary: Isikhundla somlawuli omkhulu esibhekele ukuphathwa kwabasebenzi emfundweni, okuhlanganza ukuhlela, ukuphathwa kwenkokhelo, ukulinganiswa kwezikole, nobudlelwano babasebenzi ngaphakathi kwe-Department of Basic Education.
zu.requirements: Abafaka izicelo kumele babe nokuqeqeshwa kwesikhundla se-NQF Level 7 njengoba kuqashwa yi-SAQA kwe-Education noma i-Social Science; 5 years' experience at a senior managerial level; Okuhlangenwe nakho kokuHlela Imfundo, Abasebenzi BeMfundo noma Ubudlelwano Befunda phakathi kwemfundo, okusekelwe ulwazi olujulile noluhlangenwe nakho kwingxenye yemfundo kanye nokuhlela isistimu yokuqeqesha, Inqubomgomo yokuxhasa kanye nokusetshenziswa kwayo kwiSistimu Yabasebenzi BeMfundo, umthethosisekelo wabasebenzi kanye Nokusungulwa Kwezimo Zokusebenza; Ukuqonda izinqubo ezithinta abasebenzi kumaphoyinti emfundo esifundazweni; Izindlela ezinhle zokubhala nokuxhumana kanye nokusebenzisa ikhompyutha; Ukuphatha iqembu labantu; Iqeqesho lesikhundla esiphezulu kumikhakha echaziwe ngenhla kuzobe ngunconco. Ikhono Elikhulu: Ikhono Lokubamba Iqhaza Nobuholi; Ukuphathwa Kolwazi Ngabantu NokuBaniksa Amandla; Ukuphathwa Kwemali Kwezinguquko. Umjekidi kumele abe nokuzethemba, ethembekayo, oneqiniso, oguqukayo onesidingo sobudlelwano obuhle.
zu.duties: Umjekidi uzobe engcupheni yeChief Directorate, ehlanganisa iDirectorates: Education, Human Resource Planning, Provisioning and Monitoring; Education Performance Management and Development; Whole School Evaluation; Education Labour Relations Management and Conditions of Service; Umjekidi ophumelelayo uzobe nesibopho sokukhonza ingxenye yonke futhi kulindeleke ukuba ahole aphathe iqembu labantu, asebenze eduze nezinye izingxenye kwi-Department of Basic Education, eminye iminyango kahulumeni, kanye namaphoyinti; Ukuqinisekisa ubudlelwano obulempumelelo obusebenzayo; Ukuhlaziya nokubika ngemithesho yabasebenzi kanye namandla; Ukuthuthukisa inqubo kanye nesisitimu yokubamba abesiphofu; Ukulinganisa ukusetshenziswa kanye nabesiphofu ezikoleni, ukulungisa kabusha isistimu yokubekwa kwamaphoyinti ngokunciphisa usayizi weklasi esikoleni; Ukuthuthukisa nokusetshenziswa kweSistimu Yokuphathwa Kolwazi Ngabasebenzi, kanye nokuthuthukisa ukusebenza kweqiniso lesistimu yenkokhelo yobesiphofu, njengengxenye yokuqeqeshwa ngenhloso yokuphathwa kokulinganiswa nokuthuthukiswa kwabesiphofu nokuthuthukisa izinga lokufundisa nokufunda e-South African.

xh.summary: Isithuba sokuba ngumntu ophethe ibamba kwaye ulawule ukulawula abasebenzi abantu kwimfundo, kuquka uqeqesho, ukulawula ukusebenza, ukuncoma iikholeji, nendlela zokusebenza ngaphakathi kwesebe lemfundo yesisiseko.
xh.requirements: Abafaki isicelo kufuneka babe nesatifikethi kwiNqanaba le-7 le-NQF njengokuqatshwa yi-SAQA kwiMfundo okanye ezeNzululwazi ezeNtsha; 5 iminyaka yamava elinganqopho loku lawula; Amanqaku kuQqeqesho lweMfundo, Abasebenzi abantu beMfundo okanye uLawulo lweNtsebenziswano kuMfundo, axhaswa lulwazi olunzulu namava kummandla wemfundo nokuqeqesha inkqubo yokucwangcisa, iNkqazo neNkqubo yokusingathwa kwiNkqubo yabaSebenzi abaBantu beMfundo, iNkqazo yabaSebenzi abaBantu nokuPhuhliswa kweemiQathango yokuSebenza; Ukuqonda iinkqubo ezimalunga nabaSebenzi abaBantu nakumasebe wemfundo amazantsi ephondo; Amandla aphezulu okubhala nokuThetha nabantu njengoko kunjalo nokuSebenzisa iKhompyutha; UkuLawula iqela labantu; Isatifikethi sokungena kwizikolo nasezindawini ezishiwnwe ngasentla kuya kuba lusondelweni olukhoyo. Amandla aBalulekileyo: Amandla eQondo kokuKhokela nokuLawula abaBantu; uLawulo lweMali noLawulo loTshintsho. af.title: Direkteur: Psigososiale Ondersteuning
af.summary: Direkteur van Psigososiale Ondersteuning by die Department of Basic Education in Pretoria, wat 'n NQF Level 7-kwalifikasie en vyf jaar se bestuurservaring vereis.
af.requirements: Die aansoeker moet oor 'n kwalifikasie beskik op NQF Level 7 soos deur SAQA erken in Psigologie, Maatskaplike Werk en Gesondheidswetenskap; 5 jaar se ervaring op 'n Midde- of Seniorbestuursvlak; Ervaring in die ontwerp en bestuur van psigososiale ondersteuningsprogramme; Ervaring in monitering en evaluering; 'n Begrip van huidige onderwys- en/of skoolgesondheidsbeleid en -tendense; Sterk kommunikasievaardighede (verbale en geskrewe kommunikasie); Sterk interpersoonlike en netwerkvaardighede; Iemand wat op eie initiatief kan begin werk en beide onafhanklik en in 'n span goed kan funksioneer; Vermoë om doeltreffend met amptenare op alle vlakke van regering en sleutelbelanghebbendes te skakel; Vermoë om onafhanklik en as deel van 'n span te werk; Sterk konseptuele en strategiese leierskapsvaardighede; Prosesbevoegdhede: Kennisbestuursbevoegdheid; Diensleweringsinnovisebevoegdheid; Probleemoplossing en ontledingsbevoegdheid; Kliëntoriëntasie en kliëntefokus en kommunikasievaardighede; Kernbevoegdheid: Strategiese vermoë en leierskapsbevoegdheid; Program- en projekbestuursbevoegdheid; Finansiële bestuursbevoegdheid; Personeelsbestuur en bemagtigingsbevoegdheid; Vermoë om kommunikasie, innovasie en kreatiwiteit te bevorder; Geldige bestuurderslisensie; Bereidwilligheid om uitgebreid te reis.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal verantwoordelik wees vir die bestuur en ondersteuning van psigososiale ondersteuningsamptenare in die Departement; Die ontwikkeling en instandhouding van beleide en programme wat daarop gemik is om die psigososiale welwees van leerders en opvoeders in skole te verseker en die bestuur van die Direktoraat se begroting; Die bestuur en ondersteuning van psigososiale ondersteuningsamptenare op Nasionale, Provinciale en Distrikvlak; Skakeling en samewerking met Provincial Education Departments, National Government Department, Universiteite, Navorsingsorganisasies asook NRO's en Siviele Organisasies; Die monitering, bestuur en evaluering van beleide, strategieë en programme wat die psigososiale welwees van skoolgemeenskappe bevorder en in stand hou; Verteenwoordiging van die Direktoraat beide intern en extern soos vereis; Skakeling met projekfondskeerders waar van toepassing; Die bestuur van interne en eksterne vennootskappe.

zu.title: Umengamele: Ukusekelwa Ngokomqondo Nangokomzimba
zu.summary: Umengamele Wokusekelwa Ngokomqondo Nangokomzimba eDepartment of Basic Education ePretoria, ofuna iziqu ze-NQF Level 7 naneminyaka emihlanu yomhlalaphi ekuqaleni kwabaphathi.
zu.requirements: Umfunxywa kumele abe neziqu ezinga le-NQF Level 7 njengoba kuhlonishwa yi-SAQA kwiPsychology, Social Work neHealth Science; 5 iminyaka yamava ezingeni lokuphathi ephakathi noma eliphezulu; Amava ekwakheni nasekuphatheni imiklamo Yokusekelwa Ngokomqondo Nangokomzimba; Amava ekubukeleni nokuhlola; Ukuqonda izinqubomgomo zokuhlela nezinto ezivezwayo zamanje zemfundo futhi noma kwezempi zesikole; Amakhono okuxhumana aqinile (ukuxhumana okwenziwa ngomlomo nokubhalwayo); Amakhono okuxhumana nabantu nokwakha uxhumo oluhle aqinile; Umuntu oqala ngokwakhe osebenza kahle eyedwa kanye nasekuqoqweni komsebenzi; Ikono lokuxhumana ngempumelelo nabasebenzisi kuzo zonke izinga kahulumeni nabalulekile abahlanganyele; Ikono lokusebenza eyedwa futhi njengengxenye yeqembu; Amakhono okuqonda amasu nokuba ngumholi wesibopho aqinile; Ikhono Lesipesheli: Ikhono lokuphathwa kolwazi; Ikhono lokusungula okusha ekukhiqizeni konakele; Ikhono lokuxazula izinkinga nokuhlaziya; Ukuqondisa ikhasimendi nokugqamisa ukuzincoma kwabathengi namakhono okuxhumana; Ikhono eliyisisekelo: Ikhono lemsi nokuba ngumholi; Ikhono lokuphathwa kwemiklamo namaphrojekthi; Ikhono lokuphathwa kwezimali; Ikhono lokuphathwa kwabantu nokubakhuzisa; Ikono lokuqhubisa ukuxhumana, okusha nokudala; Ilayisense yokushayela elisebenzayo; Ukuzithoba ukwaziswa ukuhamba kakhudwana.
zu.duties: Umuntu okhethwe uzobe nesibopho sokuphatha nokusekela abasebenzi bokuqinisekisa ukusekelwa ngokomqondo nangokomzimba eMnyangweni; Ukuthuthukisa nokugcina izinqubomgomo namakamu ahlose ukuqinisekisa ukuphilile ngokomqondo nangokomzimba kwabafundi nabaphathi ezikoleni nokuphatha ibhajethi leDirectorate; Ukuphatha nokusekela abasebenzi bokuqinisekisa ukusekelwa ngokomqondo nangokomzimba ezingeni leNasional, ePhondo naseSifundeni; Ukuxhumana nokusebenzisana nePhondo Lemfundo, Umnyango Kahulumeni Wezwe, Amayunivesithi, Abasebenzisa Ocwaningo kanye nama-NGO nalawo Abahlangenwe nayo iNhlangano Yabathuli; Ukubuka, ukuphatha nokuqinisekisa izinqubomgomo, amasu namakamu akhuthaza nokugcina ukuphilile ngokomqondo nangokomzimba kwezimo zomphakathi zesikole; Ukumela iDirectorate ngaphakathi nangaphandle njengoba kudingeka; Ukuxhumana nabaxhasi bemiklamo lapho kufanele khona; Ukuphatha ubudlelwano ngaphakathi nangaphandle.

xh.title: Umphathi: Inkxaso yeNkxaso yeNtlalo-kuqonda

jobs.notes: Term of office will be for a period of five (5) years or as may be determined by the Minister in line with Section 74 (7) of the Correctional Services Act, Act 111 of 1998. Call for applications to serve as members of the correctional supervision and parole board the Minister of Correctional Services in terms of Section 74 of the Correctional Services Act, Act 111 of 1998 invite interested and suitable candidates to apply for an opportunity to serve as members of the Correctional Supervision and Parole Board. The Parole Board is an independent body whose main aim is to protect the public by risk assessing offenders to decide whether they can be safely released into the community. The main role of a Chair (and Vice in the chairs absence) is decision making. Decision making in light of a number of factors, that is:- rights of the offender (as far as the right to be considered in light of relevant legislation), calculation of the minimum detention period, understanding of criminal justice value chain, court papers, sentencing remarks, copy of the judgment, copy of the warrant of detention, case law, SAP 69 and 62, understanding the various reports by the DCS professionals, understanding of the rehabilitation process, risk assessment, victim/community empathy, public safety etc. Applicants who have retired from the Public Service with a specific determination that they cannot be re- appointed or have been declared medically unfit will not be considered. Term of office will be for a period of five (5) years or as may be determined by the Minister in line with Section 74 (7) of the Correctional Services Act, Act 111 of 1998. Applications: Applications must be submitted on the Z83 form (Public Service application form) obtainable from any Public Service department and must be completed in full. Only a detailed CV should be attached to your application form. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies not older than 6 months of qualifications and other related documents on or before the day of the interview. Applicants must note that further checks will be conducted once they are shortlisted and that their appointment is subject to positive outcomes on these checks, which include security clearance, security vetting, qualification verification and criminal records verification. Interested candidates should submit complete applications clearly reflecting the designation and applicable reference number to the relevant addresses as reflected below: OTHER POSTS

zu.title: Umsibi weNkomfa
zu.summary: Izikhundla zomsibi weNkomfa eBhodini lezeZinkambiso zokuLungisa ezifundeni eziningi, ezidinga izifundo ezingunya lwa-7 kuma-NQF kanye neminyaka emihlanu yohlelo lokuphatha ezinkambisweni zobulungiswa bezecalane noma ema-social sciences.
zu.requirements: Isifundo esihlonziphekile nesifanelekile esingunya lwa-7 kuma-NQF nakuyiphi indlela eka Criminal Justice, i-Social Sciences noma okuhlobene kuyo. Uhlu olungenayo lweminyaka eyi-5 ngaphambi kokuhlela noma ukuthatha izinqumo. Ulwazi olubonakalayo kanye nethonya lokwenza izinqumo ezisekelwe ezibonweni ngokusebenza, ukuqabelana iziqiniseko nezibonakaliso, ukuhlaziya nokulinganisa inani elikhulu lwolwazi oludidiyile kanye nokubona izindaba ezibalulekile, ngemikhawu emide futhi usebenza ngokugqugquzela kwakho. Inkulu yokuzimela ekucabeni kanye nesigqibo esihle, ngethonya lokwenza izinqumo ezisekelwe ezibonakalisweni ezibhalwe ngokunembile. Amahloni amahle wokusebenza nabantu: ithonya lokuthola inhlonipho kanye nokuze naye ukudibana ngokuxhumana okusebenzayo kanye nethonya – ngokuzethemba ukuphikisa izinkolelo lapho kudingeka, ukusebenza ngobunye bese uyaxazulula izink分歧 ukufika kumaphethini ahle. Amahloni amahle okuxhumana, okubhaliwe nokuikhulumayo: ithonya lokuxhumanisela ngokuzwela kanye nangokuphumelela ngabantu abahlukene, ukushintsha indlela yakho njengoba kudingeka kanye nokuhlonipha abanye, ukulalela ngokuqinile bese uhlola izimpendulo ukuba buthe izindaba. Amandla amahle okubhala: ithonya lokubhala imibhalo emihle ebalula izibonakaliso ngokusekela isinqumo noma indawo yokuphakamisa. Amazinga aphakeme obuntu bokuziphendulela komuntu ngamunye kanye nezinhlobo zokuziphatha, njengokuzibophezela kakhulu ekwenzini ngokufanele, ukulingana nomyombo wokusekela izakhamuzi ezinganamanzi noma umphakathi ngokusebenzela izinto ezihle. Amazinga aphakeme okuphatha isikhathi, ukuhlela nokuphatha, kanye nokuzimisela kakhulu komuntu ngamunye ngokuziphendulela nokuziphendulela kokuziphendulela kwakho. Izibonakaliso zolwazi nganoma yisiphi isikhathi sezinkambiso zocala kanye nokuqonda ukubaluleka kobono bomphathi wecala. Ulwazi ngaphambilini kokuhlela noma esikhundleni sokuthatha izinqumo.
zu.duties: Izinkinga: Hlaziya futhi uhlolo ulwazi ukwazi ukubona ukubungozi nokuyingozi okuqhubekayo ecenyesini lelona qiniso lecala, lapho ulwazi lungelelwa kwezinye izindlela ezihlanganisa izibhalo zesiginala nezephepha, izibhalo zesiginala kanye nezibonakaliso ezinikezelwa ezinsalezweni ezikhulumayo. Sebenzisa ulwazi kanye nokuqcabha ezicweni zabo boni bamacala ukwazi ukuthi bengakukhululeka ukubakhulule emphakathini, kanye nokubeka izikhalo lapho ukukhululwa kubonakala kufanelekile. Qaphela izicimi zamacala ukwazi ukuqinisekisa ubungozi. Sebenzisana ngobunye nabanye amalunga eParole Board ukwazi ukwenza izinquma ngolwazi olutholakalayo, kanye nokunikeza okubhalwe ngokufingqa futhi kuhlelelwe ngamaphethini ahambisanayo ekufikelweni esinqumweni noma esiphakamisweni. Siza ukubhalwa kwemibhalo, bhala izifinyezo kanye nezinqumo ezinesizathu. Yiba ngumsibi osebenzayo weParole Board uma umela kona ezinsalezweni noma kunoma iyipho enye indaba. Siza amaphethini okuphatha ahlobene nokuqalelela izinsalezo, izinsalezo kanye nokususwa/ukukhanselwa, imfundo yomphakathi mayelana neParole, futhi siza ukumema ophathi bamacala ezinsalezweni, kuhlanganise nokuhamba enkantolo njengomphumela wecala leboni bamacala.

xh.title: Usihlalo
xh.summary: Izithuba zesihlalo kwiBhodi lweeNkonzo zokuLungisa ekuwohlokeni ngamandlela ambalwa, efuna izifundo ezikwingaqa le-7 le-NQF namava eminyaka emihlanu yolawulo kwinkqubo yocalulo kwezobunyuli nasezobuntu.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esivunyelweyo nesifanelekileyo esikwingaqa le-7 le-NQF naliphi na icandelo lenkqubo yocalulo kwezobunyuli, ezobuntu okanye ezinxulumene nayo. Ulwazi lwangaphambili lweminyaka eyi-5 ebekulawulo okanye esikhundleni sokwenza izigqibo. Ulwazi olubonakaliseyo namandla okwenza izigqibo ezisekelwe kubungqina ezisebenzayo, ukuqikelela iingcumbu nobufakela, ukuhlalutya nokuqonda ngokuchanekileyo isixa elikhulu lenkcazelo ezintsonzileyo nokubonisa iingcumbu ezibalulekileyo, ngexesha elifingqiweyo nangokuqonda okwakho. Ukuzimela kengqondo nokugqiba ngokuchanekileyo, nando ncedo lokwenza izigqibo ezisekelwe kubungqina ezibhalwe ngokuchanekileyo. Amakhono amanqwethe omanyano nabantu: amandla okufumana inhlonipho nogcino lobuhlobo ngamakhono othetha uthethe athandayo – nethemba lokupikisa iimvakalelo apho kufuneka, ukusebenza kunye nabanye nokusombulula iingxaki ukuze kufikelelwe kwizigqibo ezichanekileyo. Amakhono othetha uthethe anqwethe, alobhalwayo alomyayo: amandla okuthetha uthethe ngokuzingelwa nokusebenza nomntu ngamnye onobuninzi obuhlukeneyo, ushintsha indlela yakho njengoko kufuneka unika abanye inhlonipho, ukumamela ngokuzimisela nokugqiba iimpendulo ukuze uphando iingcumbu. Amakhono obhalwayo anqwethe: amandla okubhala iingxelo ezilungiselelweyo ezingqamana ubungqina ngokusekelwa isigqibo okanye isimemo. Izinga eliphezulu kakhulu lobuzinziswa boluntu nobuntu, njengokuzimisela okuzinikileyo ekulinganeni, ukulingana nengozi yokuxhasa uluntu olubanzi okanye ilungelo lomphakathi ngempumelelo yakho. Amakhono aphakamileyo okulawula ixesha, lolungiselelo lolawulo nololawulo lo msecule, kunye nokuqonda okuzinikileyo nokuzimisela ukuziphucela ngokwamakhono obuchwepheshe. Ubungqina bolwazi kuyo nayiphi na ingxenye yenkqubo yocalulo kwezobunyuli nokuqonda ukubaluleka kokuqonda umbono womntu ofunyanwe iseenzo. Ulwazi lwangaphambili kulawulo okanya esikhundleni sokwenza izigqibo.
xh.duties: Izibophezelo: Hlalutya ukuqonda ngokuchanekileyo inkcazelo ukuze ubone imingcipheko ephila okanye ingozzi kwicala lomohluleki oyedwa, apho inkcazelo inokuvela kumthombo ohlukeneyo kuquka amaxwebhu elektroniki neyephepha, izihlobo zamanqaku elektroniki nobungqina obunikwa kuzincoko ezomileyo. Sebenzisa ulwazi nokuqondo kumacala abohluleki ukuze ugqibe ukuba banako na ukukhululwa ngokhuselekileyo kumphakathi baze bacwe iimeko apho ukukhululwa kufanelekileyo. Qwalasela ukuva kweecalaukuze kuqwalaselwe imingcipheko. Sebenza ngokubambana namalungu omanye abaphila ukuze kugqibwe ngobungqina obukhoyo baza kunikezwa ingxelo emfutshane egqithisweyo yeenkcumbu ezibalulekileyo ekufikeleleni kwesigqibo okanye isimemo. Yenze ingxelo yokuvelisa iingxelo, bhala iingxelo nezigqibo ezinomvuzo. Yeba ngumthunywa osebenzayo weBhodi yoKukhululwa xa umela kuncoko okanye naliphi na isiganeko. Yenza imisebenzi yolawulo edibaniswa nokuveliswa kuncoko, iincoko nokurhoxiswa okanye ukurhaswa, imfundo yomphakathi ngekoluro nokukhululwa, kwaye yenze imibutho yeenkomfa kwiincoko, kuquka nokuza enkundleni ngenxa yesetyhulo ngabohluleki.

af.title: Ondervorsitter
af.summary: Ondervorsitterposisies op die Korrektiewe Dienste-paroolraad oor veelvuldige streke, wat 'n NQF-vlak 7-kwalifikasie en drie jaar se toesigervaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Erkende en toepaslike NQF-vlak 7-kwalifikasie in enige Strafregplegingsveld, Sosiale Wetenskappe of verwant. Bewese 3 jaar toesigrol of gemeenskapsleierskapservaring asook aktiewe betrokkenheid by gemeenskapsgebaseerde strukture. Toewyding aan 'n korrupsie-vrye administrasie. 'n Goeie standing binne die gemeenskap met uitgebreide lewenservaring. Bewese spesiale belangstelling in die Strafregstelsel.
af.duties: Verantwoordelikhede: Vergaderings voor sit in die afwesigheid van die Voorsitter. Dokumente onderteken in die afweisigheid van die Voorsitter. Deelneem aan die analise en evaluering van inligting om deurlopende risiko/gevaarlikheid in 'n individuele oortreder se saak te identifiseer, waar inligting uit 'n verskeidenheid bronne kan kom, insluitend elektroniese, papierdokumente, elektroniese opdaterings en getuienis tydens mondelinge verhore. Kennis en oordeel toepas op oortreders se sake om te besluit of h veilig in die gemeenskap vrygelaat kan word en toepaslike voorwaardes aanbeveel waar vrylating toepaslik is. Deelneem aan die verhoor van sake om risiko te beoordeel terwyl samewerkend gewerk word aan oordele oor die beskikbare getuienis en 'n beknopte en gestruktureerde opsomming van relevante faktore formuleer om te help met die neem van 'n besluit of aanbeveling. Deelneem aan verslagskryf, help met die opstel van volwasse opsommings en help die Voorsitter met die aanbeveling van 'n besluit. 'n Effektiewe ambassadeur wees vir die Paroolraad wanneer dit verteenwoordig word by verhore of enige ander gebeurtenis.

zu.title: Isekela somongameli
zu.summary: Izikhundla seseKela sekhupele ekusebenzeleni kwezokulungisa abaphulele umthetho kumabanqa amaningi, kudingeka iziqu ze-NQF level 7 kanye neminyaka emithathu yohlelo olusesikhathini sokubhekwa abantu.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezibonakalisiwe nezifanele ze-NQF level 7 kunoma yisiphi isikhathi sezobugebengu, Izayensi Zomphakathi noma ezihlobene. Ubufakazi beminyaka eyi-3 yohlelo lokubheka abantu noma isipho sokuholisa impilo yomphakathi kanye nokubandakanyeka ezakhiwo ezisekwe emphakathini. Ukuzinikela ekuphathweni okungalungi. Isimo esihle emphakathini kanye nolwazi olude olwenziwe ngokuphila. Ukutshela ngokuthakazelwa okukhaliphe ezintweni zalo Mugqa Wokulunga Izenzo Ezingcolile.
zu.duties: Imisebenzi: Hola izinkompho ezingekho uMongameli. Sayina amaphepha ezingekho uMongameli. Thatha inxaxheba kwentlontlolo yamaphuzu nemibiko yokuhlolwa kolwazi ukuze bathole isibopho esihlale sikhona isengozi yokwesaba ecaleni lomuntu ophulele umthetho, lapho ulwazi lungavela kuzo zoke izindawo, kuhlanganise nezinto, amaphepha, okuqala ngokuqinisekiswa kwama-electronic kanye neziphakamiso ezinikezwa ezinkomphweni. Faka ulwazi nokuqonda izinto ezingcolile ecaleni labo baphulele umthetho ukuze kuthathwe isinqumo sokuthi bangakwazi na ukuphuma bageze empumalanga emphakathini baphakamise izinto ezifanele lapho bekhululekile ukuba baphume. Thatha inxaxheba ekuqedeni izinkomba ukuze kuhlolwe ubungozi ngenkathi usebenza nomuntu oqonde kanzima ekwenzeni isibopho ngolwazi olutholakalayo uze uhlolele isifanekiso esifushane nesihle ngokwezinto ezihlobene ukusiza ekuthathweni kwenqumbo noma isiphakamiso. Thatha inxaxheba ekubhaliwe amabiko, size usize ekwakheni okubhalwe ngokuhlakaniphwa siseke uMongameli ekuphakamiseni isinqumbo. Yiba umelaphi othembekile kwelesi Sapho Sekhephu lapho umela kwezinkompho noma kwenye imikhosi.

xh.title: Isikhulu esingesonye somyalezo
xh.summary: Izithuba zesikhulu esingesonye somyalezo kwiqela labakhululeweyo ngesibo sikawonke-wonke kwi-Correctional Services kumandlela amaninzi, kufuneka nayo i-NQF level 7 qualification kunye neminyaka mitatu yamava okuziphatha.
xh.requirements: I-NQF level 7 qualification eqaqisiweyo nelifanelekileyo kwinaluphi na icandelo le-Criminal Justice, i-Social Sciences okanye ezinxulumene nalo. I-3 years eqinisekisiweyo yelungelo lokuziphatha okanye amava obuqhwe obumphathi koluntu njengoko kunokubandakanya unxibelelwano olusebenzayo kumakakqhuba ebasisoluntu. Zinikezelelo kulawulo olungenasiphithiphithi. Ugqibo oluhle loluntu elunesipilinge esibanzi empongweni. Ukukhangeleka ngokwenene ngomdla owodwa kwi-Criminal Justice System.
xh.duties: Iziseko: Ukulawula iindibano kwixesha alikho i-Chairperson. Ukusayina amaxwebhu kwixesha alikho i-Chairperson. Ukuthabatha inxaxheba kwahlulwa nokuhlola ulwazi ukuze kugqitywe ubungozi obuqhubekayo/ingozi kumacala abantu basetyhini ngamanye, apho ulwazi lungeza luvela kumthombo ochasene naye, kuquka i-electronic, amaxwebhu ephepha, izihlaziyo ze-electronic kunye nembeko evela kwindibano ezentlombe. Ukusebenzisa ulwazi nokuqamba isigqibo kumacala abantu basetyhini ukuze kugqitywe ukuba banokhululwa ngokhuselekileyo koluntu balulele nokuze kuqatshelwe iimeko ezifanelekileyo apho ukhululeko lufanelekileyo. Ukuthabatha inxaxheba kwendibano yamacala ukuze kuqatshwe ubungozi ngelixa usebenza ngokubambisana ekwenzeni isigqibo malunga nembeko efumanekayo nokwenza inkcazelo emfutshane enoludwelwano lwemiba ephathwayo ukuze kuncedwe ekufikiseni isigqibo okanye indizuu. Ukuthabatha inxaxheba ekubhaliweyo iingxelo, ukunceda ekwakhiweni kwezinkcazelo ezinamava nakuncedwa i-Chairperson ekululekeni isigqibo. Ukuba ngxamlegumba osebenzayo we-Parole Board xa umela iqela kwindibano okanye nanayiphi na enye into.

af.title: Gemeenskapslid
af.summary: Gemeenskapslede word gesoek om op paroolrade in die Eastern Cape te dien, om besluitnemingverhore by te woon en oortreders se herintegrasie te fasiliteer.
af.requirements: Erkende graad of nasionale diploma in een van die volgende velde: Kriminele Justisie, Gemeenskapsontwikkeling, Sosiale Wetenskap, Polisiëring of Menseregte-verwante veld. 5 jaar se ervaring in gemeenskapsontwikkelingswerk en/of Kriminele Justisie. Vorige ervaring in 'n besluitnemende hoedanigheid sal voordelig wees. Gepensioneerde professionele persone word aangemoedig om aansoek te doen. Bevoegdhede en Attribute: Kommunikasie. Kliëntoriëntasie en kliëntfokus. Probleemoplossing en analise. Besluitneming. Integriteit en eerlikheid. Konfidensialiteit. Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudings. Begrip van die Paroolraadstelsel.
af.duties: Verantwoordelikhede: Die suksesvolle kandidate sal verantwoordelik wees om by te woon en deel te neem aan die besluitnemende rol in Paroolraadverhore. Tree op as 'n fasiliteerder van gemeenskapsherintegrasie namens oortreders. Beskerm die belange van die gemeenskap, oortreders en die staat. Verseker objektiewe en billike toepassing van die vrylatingsbeleid. Voer ad-hoc take uit soos deur die Raad bepaal. Verseker konfidensialiteit ten opsigte van Paroolraadvergaderings, besluite en dokumentasie.

zu.title: Ilungu Lomphakathi
zu.summary: Kufunwa amalungu omphakathi ukuba asebenze kumabhodi e-parole e-Eastern Cape, abambe iqhaza kuzinkulungwanane zokuthatha izinqumo futhi abaseze ukubuyiselwa kwabaphulele umthetho emphakathini.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezeqashiswayo noma idiploma yezwe emunyeni wezinye lezi zinkomba: Criminal Justice, Community Development, Social Science, Policing noma Human Rights. Uzinge onyakeni ongu-5 emsebenzini wokuthuthukisa umphakathi noma ku-Criminal Justice. Okwedlule ukuba nokuhlanganyela ekuthathweni kwezinqumo kuzoba yinzuzo. Abaphethe abasesehlulekile bayakhuthazwa ukuba bafake izicelo. Amandla nezici: Ukuxhumana. Ukuqondiswa iklayenti nokuqwa yiklayenti. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya. Ukuthatha izinqumo. Ukuzithoba nokwethembeka. Ukugcina imfihlo. Izimo ezinhle zokuxhumana nabantu. Ukuqonda Isimiso Se-Parole Board.
zu.duties: Izinkinga: Abathole isikhundla bazobekwa isibopho sokubuya bahambe bambe iqhaza ekuthathweni kwezinqumo kuzinkulungwanane ze-Parole Board. Basebenze njengabahlinzeki bokubuyiswa kwabaphulele umthetho emphakathini. Bavikele izinto zomphakathi, abaphulele umthetho kanye nombuso. Baqinisekise ukusetshenziswa ngokulingana nangokufanele kwenkambiso yokukhululwa. Bafeze imisebenzi ehlukile njengoba kufunwa nguBhodi. Baqinisekise ukugcinwa kwemfihlo mayelana nezinkumiso ze-Parole Board, izinqumo namadokhumenti.

xh.title: Ilungu lomphakathi
xh.summary: Kufunwa amalungu omphakathi ukuba akhonze kumabala e-parole e-Eastern Cape, athathe inxaxheba kwiintlanganiswa ezithatha izigqibo alise inkqubo yokubuyiswa kolwetyala kwindalo.
xh.requirements: I-degree evaliwe okanye i-diploma yeziko laseburhulumente kwenye yale minyango ilandelayo: i-Criminal Justice, i-Community Development, i-Social Science, i-Policing okanye i-Human Rights. Unyaka wama-5 wamava omnzimba wokusebenza kukuhlala koluntu kwaye/okanye kwi-Criminal Justice. Ukuba namava ngaphambili enkqubweni yokuthatha izigqibo kuya kuba lusizo. Amaprofetyala abuyile kumakhaya akhuthazwa ukuba bafake izicelo. Ikhono nemiqondo: Unxibelelwano. Uqwalaselo kumxhasi nokuqwalasela abathengi. Ukuxazulula iingxaki nokuhlalutywa. Ukuthatha izigqibo. Integriti nokwaz’ukunyanzelisa. Imfihlelo. Ubudlelwane obuhle phakathi kwabantu. Ukuqonda iNkqubo yeBhodi ye-Parole.
xh.duties: Izibophezelo: Baqaphi abazuweyo baya kubizwa ngokubakho khona bathathe inxaxheba enkundleni yokuthatha izigqibo kwiNtlanganiswa zeBhodi ye-Parole. Bakhuse njengabancedisi bokuvela kwentlalo kolwetyala kwicala labagwevi. Bakhuse ngokubazisa iintshiseleko zophando, ulwetyala kunda apethele nombuso. Banqolele netyola yokuziphendulula kumgaqo-sikhululo olinganayo. Benze imizebenzo yesilongo esichukuthwa yiBhodi. Baqiniseze ukubaluleka kolwazi kwiNtlanga zebhodi ye-Parole, izigqibo namaxwebhu.

af.duties: Verifieer en belyn die Nasionale APP met die Provinsiale APP en die Arbeidsentrum se werksplan met betrekking tot die departement se beleid- en beplanningsdoeleindes. Verifieer en ontwikkel die Provinsiale inligtingsverslae. Bestuur die ontleding van die provinsiale prestasie-inligting om die impak op die arbeidsmark te bepaal. Hou toesig oor die bestuur van die provinsiale hulpbronsentrum/biblioteek. Bestuur al die hulpbronne van die Sub-eenheid.

zu.title: Umdeki Wezinqopha: Ulwazi Nemibhalo Yesebenzo Esethunyini
zu.summary: Phatha ukubika ngolwazi nemibhalo yesebenzo esethunyinikahle le-Limpopo, okudinga iziqu ezifanele neminyaka emine yomhlalapholile.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zeminyaka emithathu (3) ezifanele kwi-Public Administration/Public Management/Monitoring and Evaluation noma i-Advance Diploma in Monitoring and Evaluation ezingeni le-NQF Level 6 njengoba kuqashelwa yi-SAQA. Umlahlapholile weminyaka emine (4) wokusebenza ko-Performance Management/Statistics Services/Monitoring and Evaluation okuyiminyaka emithathu (3) okusebenza ezingeni lo-Officer/Senior Officer. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi: Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations nemithetho ehlobene, Labour Legislation nemigomo ehlobene, Imigomo ka-Batho Pele, Amaphakheji wesofthiwe ze-Statistics ne-Database, Ukusebenza kwe-Del Labour Centres ne-Business Units kanye namandla omlando wesebenzo esethunyini. Amakhono: Ukuphatha ngokuvamile, Ukuphatha amaphrojekthi, Ukuxhumana, Ukwazi kumakhomphyutha, Ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, Ukuba ngumholi, Ukuhlaziya idatha, Ukuhlola, Ukuba nokubanga okusha.
zu.duties: Qinisekisa futhi ulinganise i-National APP ne-Provincial APP nendlela yokusebenza ye-Labour Centre maqondana nenqubomgomo nehlelo loMnyango. Qinisekisa futhi wakhe imibhalo yolwazi yesifunda. Phatha ukuhlaziya kolwazi lokusebenza kwesifunda ukuze kutholwe umthelela osebenzini esethunyini. Qaphela ukuphathwa kwesikhungo samathuluzi/esalayiburari yesifunda. Phatha onke amathuluzi e-Sub-Unit.

xh.title: Umncedisi weNkulu: Ulwazi lwesixhobo sabasebenzi & izibalo
xh.summary: Phatha ukugqithisa kolwazi lwesixhobo sabasebenzi nabezibalo kwisebe lase Limpopo, kufuneka nesiqinisekiso esifanelekileyo nenyanga ezininzi zobugcisa.
xh.requirements: Isiqinisekiso seminyaka emithathu (3) esifanelekileyo kwiZiko loLuntu / ekuphathweni koLuntu / ekulawulweni nokuqwalasela / iDiploma ePhakamileyo ekulawulweni nokuqwalasela kwiNqanaba le-6 le-NQF njengokuqatshiweyo yi-SAQA. Ubugcisa beminyaka emine (4) bokusebenza ekulawulweni nokuqwalasela iMisebenzi / iinkonzo zeZibalo / ekulawulweni nokuqwalasela, apho kwiminyaka emithathu (3) ukusebenza kwinqanaba lomphathi / oMphathi oPhakamileyo. Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba eseleyo. Ulwazi: uMthetho woLuntu, iMithetho yoLuntu nemigaqo edibene nayo, uMthetho wokuBakwaBasebenzi namagqabantshishi ohamba naye, iMigaqo kaBatho Pele, amaphakheji weZibalo neDatabase software, ukusebenza kweZiko loBasebenzi kwiDel nakuManyano weShishini nolunxweme lokuhamba kwesixhobo sabasebenzi. Amakhono: ukulawula ngokubanzi, ukulawula iProjekthi, uNxibelelwano, ukwazi ukusebenzisa iKhompyutha, uNhlobo nobunye, uBukhosi bukaBaphathi, ukuHlalutya iData, ukuHlalutya,okuQamba.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa ukuqwalasela i-APP yaseQongqothweni kwi-APP yePhondo neNdlela yokusebenza yeZiko loBasebenzi malunga nenjongo yamagqabantshishi nokucingwa kwoSebe. Qinisekisa aze akhuphe iingxelo zeLwazi zePhondo. Phatha ukuhlalutya kolwazi lwemisebenzi yephondo ukwazi ukubona ukusilela okanye ukuphumelela kwesixhobo sabasebenzi. Qwalasela ukulawulwa kwesikhululo seempahla zephondo / umtya-ncwadi wolwazi. Lawula zonke iimpahla zoMtya oMncinci weNgcaciso.

jobs.title: Principal Inspector: Electrical Engineering
jobs.summary: Principal Inspector for Electrical Engineering at the Department of Employment and Labour's Free State Provincial Office, requiring a National Diploma or degree in Electrical Engineering and four years of relevant experience.
jobs.requirements: Three (3) year National Diploma (NQF6)/ undergraduate Bachelor Degree (NQF7) in Electrical Engineering. Four (4) years functional experience in Electrical services. Valid driver’s licence (B). Knowledge: Departmental policies and procedures. Batho Pele Principles. Public Service Act and Regulations. OHS Act and Regulations. OHSAS. OHS standards. OHS Management System. Skills: Facilitation. Planning and Organising. Computer literacy. Interpersonal. Problem Solving. Communication (Verbal & Written). Innovative. Analytical. Research. Project management.
jobs.duties: Provide inputs into the development of Electrical Engineering Policies and ensure the implementation of OHS Strategy for the Department of Employment and Labour (DoL) in terms of OHS Legislation. Conduct complex inspections for Electrical Engineering regularly as per OHS programme. Conduct technical research on the latest trends of Electrical Engineering in terms of Occupational health and safety. Provide support for enforcement action, including preparation of reports for legal proceedings.

af.title: Hoofinspekteur: Elektrotegniese Ingenieurswese
af.summary: Hoofinspekteur vir Elektrotegniese Ingenieurswese by die Department of Employment and Labour se Free State Provisiale Kantoor, wat 'n Nasionale Diploma of graad in Elektrotegniese Ingenieurswese en vier jaar se relevante ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Drie (3) jaar Nasionale Diploma (NQF6)/ voorgraadse Bachelorsgraad (NQF7) in Elektrotegniese Ingenieurswese. Vier (4) jaar funksionele ervaring in Elektriese dienste. Geldige bestuurslisensie (B). Kennis: Departementele beleide en prosedures. Batho Pele-beginsels. Public Service Act en Regulasies. OHS Act en Regulasies. OHSAS. OHS-standaarde. OHS-bestuurstelsel. Vaardighede: Fasilitering. Beplanning en organiserings. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Interpersoonlik. Probleemoplossing. Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik). Innoverend. Analities. Navorsing. Projekbestuur.
af.duties: Verskaf insette vir die ontwikkeling van Elektrotegniese Ingenieurswesebeleide en verseker die implementering van OHS-strategie vir die Department of Employment and Labour (DoL) ooreenkomstig OHS-wetgewing. Voer gereeld komplekse inspeksies vir Elektrotegniese Ingenieurswese uit volgens die OHS-program. Voer tegniese navorsing uit oor die nuutste tendense in Elektrotegniese Ingenieurswese met betrekking tot beroepsgesondheid en -veiligheid. Verskaf ondersteuning vir afdwingaksies, insluitend die voorbereiding van verslae vir regsgedinge.

zu.title: Isiphathi Esinhle: Engineering Yombane
zu.summary: Isiphathi Esinhle se-Engineering Yombane eKantolo Lezifundazwe le-Department of Employment and Labour esikhungweni sezifundazwe i-Free State, sifuna i-National Diploma noma iziqu i-degree ku-Electrical Engineering nob unyaka beminyaka emine (4) wokuhlola okuhlobene.
zu.requirements: I-National Diploma (NQF6) yeminyaka emithathu (3)/ i-undergraduate Bachelor Degree (NQF7) ku-Electrical Engineering. Unyaka beminyaka emine (4) wokuhlola kwezinsiza zombane. Ilayisensi yomshayeli ekugunyaziwe (B). Ulwazi: Izinqubomgomo nezinqubo zomnyango. Izimiso ze-Batho Pele. i-Public Service Act kanye Nemithetho. i-OHS Act kanye Nemithetho. i-OHSAS. Izilinganiso ze-OHS. Isistimu Yokuqondanisa i-OHS. Amandla: Ukumatasa. Ukucubungula Nokuhlela. Ukusebenzisana kwekhompyutha. Ukuxhumana nabantu. Ukuxazulula izinkinga. Ukuthumela imiyalezo (Ngomlomo nangokubhaliwe). Ukubusiswa. Ukuhlola. Ukuphatha imiklamo.
zu.duties: Nika izinto ezizokwenziwa ekwakhiweni kwezinqubomgomo ze-Electrical Engineering qiniseka ukusetshenziswa kwenqubo ye-OHS yomnyango i-Department of Employment and Labour (DoL) ngokomthetho we-OHS. Yenza okuhlola okuyinkimbinkimbi kwe-Electrical Engineering njalo njengakuqondiswa uhlelo lwe-OHS. Yenza ucwaningo oluchwayo ngezintambo ezisha ezingu-Electrical Engineering ngokwezempo zempilo nokuphepha kwabasebenzi. Nikela ngokwesekela ekwenzeni isinyathelo sokuphoqa umthetho, okubandakanya ukulungiselela umbiko wezindaba zomthetho.

xh.title: IsiNdlul’ eSikhulu: Inzululwazi kwiZibanezo-mpilo
xh.summary: IsiNdlul’ eSikhulu seZobuNzululwazi bokuQhatha iMisinga ekuSebenzweni nasemandla oMsebenzi kwiSebe laseMandla oBasebenzi neLebhu, eKomkhulu leSizwe sase Free State, sifuna izidanga zobuNkululeko-bugcisa, okanye iSidanga sobuNkululeko-bugcisa kwiiZibanezo-mpilo, kunye neminyaka emine yamava ahambelanayo nesithuba.
xh.requirements: Izidanga zobuNkululeko-bugcisa (NQF6) zeminyaka emithathu (3)/ iSidanga sobuNkululeko-bugcisa seNqanaba leBachelor (NQF7) kwiiZibanezo-mpilo. Iminyaka emine (4) yamava asebenzayo kwiinkonzo ezihambelanayo neeZibanezo-mpilo. Ilayisensi yokushayela (B) esemthethweni. Ulwazi: Iindlela zokuqhuba nemigaqo yesebe. Imigaqo yeBatho Pele. uMthetho woMsebenzi woLuntu neMigaqo yawo. uMthetho we-OHS neMigaqo zawo. I-OHSAS. Iizinga ze-OHS. Inkqubo yoLawulo lwe-OHS. Amandla: Ukuncedisa abanye. Ukuqamba iNdlela nokuhlela. Ukuba namandla ekusebenziseni iKhompyutha. Ukuba namandla oqhagamshelwano namanye. Indlela yokuzisombulula iNgxaki. Unxibelelwano (ngokuThetha nokuBhala). Ukuzimisela. Ukuhlalutywa. Uphando. Ulawulo lweProjekthi.
xh.duties: Nika izimvo ekwakhiweni kweMigaqo yeNzululwazi ekwiZibanezo-mpilo ukuqinisekisa ukusebenza kwenkqubo ye-OHS kwiSebe laseMandla oBasebenzi neLebhu (DoL) ngokomthetho we-OHS. Yenza iMpimo yokuhlolwa ekubunzimeni kweNzululwazi ekwiZibanezo-mpilo njalo njengoko kuchazwe kwinkqubo ye-OHS. Yenza uphando lobuchwepheshe kumathrendi amasha eNzululwazi ekwiZibanezo-mpilo ngokomthetho wezoMpilo nokhuseleko emsebenzini. Nikela inkxaso ekwenzeni isigqibo esinyanzelwa ngumthetho, kuquka ukuqulunqa iingxelo zokuza emgceni omthethweni.

af.title: Voorsieningsklerk
af.summary: Voorsieningsklerk benodig by die Department of Employment and Labour Limpopo Provincial Office, wat Graad 12 met handelsvakke vereis.
af.requirements: Matrikulasie/Graad 12 met geslaagde Handelsvakke (Besigheidsbestuur, Ekonomie en Rekenkunde) of 'n gelykwaardige sertifikaat. Kennis: Openbare diens finansiële bestuur, Voorsieningskettingraamwerk, Logis-stelsel, Wet op Bevoorkeurlike Aanbestedingsbeleid, Departementele beleide en prosedures. Vaardighede: Kliëntgerigtheid en kliëntfokus, Rekenaarvaardigheid, Voorlegging, Analitiese, Kommunikatiewe, Numerieke. PLIGTE Verskaf kontrak- en aanbestedingsbestuurssteun in ooreenstemming met ontwikkelde relevante voorskrifte. Administreer oop en geslote aanbestedingsprosesse in ooreenstemming met SCM-beleide en Tesourie-regulasies. Skaf goedere en dienste aan in ooreenstemming met relevante voorskrifte in die Provinsie. Verskaf voorraadbestuurssteun om doeltreffendheid en effektiwiteit in die Provinsie te verseker. Verskaf batesbestuurssteun om aan departementele beleide te voldoen.

zu.title: Iklekhi lokunikezela
zu.summary: Kudingeka iklekhi lokunikezela e-Department of Employment and Labour Limpopo Provincial Office, kudinga ibanga le-12 ezifundweni zezentengiselwano.
zu.requirements: Ibanga le-12 kumabanga aphansi noma isitifikedi esilinganayo ezifundweni zezentengiselwano (Business Management, Economics and Accounting). Ulwazi: Public Service Financial Management, Supply Chain Framework, Logis System, Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act, nemigomo noma izinqubo zomnyango. Amakhono: Ukugxila kumthengi, Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, Ukubonisa, Ukuhlaziya, Unxibelelwano, Izibalo. IMISEBENI Nikeza ngokwesekwa ekuphathweni kwezinkontileka nokuqashwa ukuze kuvisisane nemithetho ekushiweyo. Phatha inqubo yokuqashwa kuvulekile nokuvaliwe ngokuhambisana nemigomo ye-SCM kanye ne-Treasury Regulations. Thenga izimpahla nankonzo ngokuhambisana nemithetho ekushiweyo esifundazweni. Nikeza ngokwesekwa ekuphathweni kwezimpahla ukuze kuqiniseke ukusebenza ngempumelelo nangokusebenza kahle esifundazweni. Nikeza ngokwesekwa ekuphathweni kwempahla ukuze kuhambisane nemigomo yomnyango.

xh.title: Iclerki yokuNika izinto eziyimfuneko
xh.summary: Kufuneka iclerki yokuNika izinto eziyimfuneko kwiSebe lezoMsebenzi nokuSebenzela iLimpopo Provincial Office, ifuna ibangi lesi-12 een subjects ezizezorhwebo.
xh.requirements: iMatriculation/ibangi lesi-12 nge subject zorhwebo ezigqithisweyo (uLawulo lweShishini, izoQoqosho ne-Akhwounting) okanye isatifikate esilinganayo. ULwazi: uLawulo lweMali koMsebenzi kaLuntu, iNkqubo yeSupply Chain, iNkqubo yeLogis, iPreferential Procurement Policy Framework Act, iNgqungquthela namalungiselelo eSebe. Amakhono: uQwalaselo lweKhasimendi nokuQwalasela iKhasimendi, uKwazi kwiKhompyutha, iSazuzo, uQwalaselo, uNxibelelwano, ukubala. IMISEBENZI Yonke inkxaso yolawulo loQhagamshelo nemiThetho esemthethweni kwaye ihambelane namagqabantshi aqulunqwe malunga nayo. Lawula iinkqubo zoQhagamshelo ezivuliweyo nokuvaliweyo ngokwemiGaqo ye-SCM namagqabantshi zeTreasury. Thenga izinto nesebenzo ngokwamagqabantshi asemthethweni kwiphondo. Yinkxaso yolawulo lwesiphithiphithi ukuqinisekisa ukusebenza ngokufanelekileyo nangempumelelo kwiphondo. Yinkxaso yolawulo lwempahla ukuze ihambelane nemiGaqo yesebe.

af.summary: Personnelklerk benodig by die Free State provinsiale kantoor om werwing, diensvoorwaardes en prestasie-administrasie te bestuur, wat 'n Graad 12-sertifise vereis met geen vroeëre ervaring nie.
af.requirements: Graad 12-sertifiseer of gelykwaardig. Geen ervaring vereis nie. Kennis: PERSAL, HR-inligtingsbestuurstelsels, kennis van registerpligte, -praktyke asook die vermoë om data vas te lê en rekenaar te bedryf, werkende kennis en begrip van die wetgewende raamwerk wat die Openbare Diens beheer, kennis van bergings- en ontrekkingsprosedures in terme van die werksomgewing, begrip van die werk in die register. Vaardighede: Kommunikasie, Rekenaarvaardigheid, Innovatief/Kreatief, Voorlegging, Verslagskrywing, Tydbestuur, Organisasie en beplanning, Probleemoplossing.
af.duties: Implementeer personeeladministrasiepraktyke (Werwing en Keuring). Implementeer diensvoorwaardes (Verlof, Behuising, Medies, Besering op diens, Langediens-erkenning, Oortyd, Hervlugging, Pensioen, Toelaes, PILIR of ensovoorts). Fasiliteer prestasiebestuursfunksie. Hanteer personeeladministrasie-navrae.

zu.title: Iklekhi Lezinsiza Zabantu: Izolobolelo Lezinsiza Zabantu
zu.summary: Kudingeka iklekhi lezinsiza zabantu esikhungweni sifundazwe sa Free State ukuphatha ukubuyisa abantu basebenzi, izimo zokusebenza kanye nolawulo lokuqhuba ngemvelo, kudingwa isitifiketi se-Grade 12 esingenabo oluvo oludlule.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Grade 12 noma esilinganayo. Akukho oluvo oludingekayo. Ulwazi: PERSAL, izinhlelo zolwazi lwe-HR, ulwazi ngemisebenzi yerejista, izinqubo kanye namosho wokungena idatha nokusebenza ngesikhompiyutha, ulwazi olusebenzayo nokuqonda umthethosisekelo obusa iNkonzo Kazwelonke, ulwazi lwenqubo yokugcina nokubuyisa idatha ngaphakathi kwenkonzo, ukuqonda umsebenzi werejista. Amakhono: Ukuxhumana, Ukusebenza ngesikhompiyutha, Ukubumbeka/Okudala, Okubonwayo, Ukubhala imibiko, Ukulawula isikhathi, Ukuhlela nokuhlela, Ukuxazulula izinkinga.
zu.duties: Ukuqasha izinqubo zolawulo lwezinsiza zabantu (Ukubuyisa nokukhetha abantu basebenzi). Ukusebenzisa izimo zokusebenza (Ukuyekwa ukusebenza, Izindlu, Izokwelapha, Ukulimala ngaphakathi kokusebenza, Ukuqashelwa ukukwenza isikhathi eside, Isikhathi esengeziwe, Ukuhamba nendawo, Imali yokuhlala ekhaya lomothula iminyaka yokusebenza, Izimali ezezelwayo, PILIR njll). Ukwenza lula umsebenzi wolawulo lokuqhuba ngemvelo. Ukuphendula imibuzo yokulawulo kwezinsiza zabantu.

xh.title: Mongezi weZabolula Lomthetho: Ulawulo lweZabolula Lomthetho
xh.summary: Kufunekwa umongezi wezabolula lomthetho kwindawo yolawulo yesixeko sase Free State ukulawula ukumiswa kwabasebenzi, iimeko zomsebenzi nolawulo lwenkonzo, kufuneka abe necertificate ye Grade 12 ngaphandle kokungazange azisebenze.
xh.requirements: Icertificate ye Grade 12 okanye into elingana nayo. Akukho mfundo yemisebenzi efunekayo. Ulwazi: PERSAL, iinkqubo zonolwazi lwe HR, ulwazi ngemisebenzi yeregistry, iindlela zokuqhelisa njengokunokuba nangamandla okugcina idatha nokusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ulwazi lokusebenza nokuqonda umthetho ophatha inkonzo kaRhu, ulwazi lwezinqubo zokugcina nokukhupha idatha ngokubhekiselele kwendawo yokusebenza, ukuqonda umsebenzi osebenzwa kwiregistry. Amandla: Unxibelelwano, ukusebenza ngekhompyutha, okutsha/okudalayo, iPEH, ukubhala ipeport, ulawulo lwexesha, ukuqamba nokuCwangcisa, ukuzalisa iingxaki.
xh.duties: Zalisa iindlela zolawulo lwezabolula lomthetho (Ukumiswa nokukhethwa). Zalisa iimeko zomsebenzi (Ivaca, Iindlu, Iyigcina, Ikuqhubekile ngomsebenzi, Ikuqwalaselwe iNkonzo, Ixesha elidlulileyo, Ukutshintsha indawo, Imali yokuhlawulelwa iminyaka, Iimali ezingezantsi, PILIR okanye njl). Qhuba umsebenzi wolawulo lwenkonzo. Phendula imibuzo yolawulo lwezabolula lomthetho.

jobs.title: Director: Forestry Scientific & Technical Services
jobs.department: Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment
jobs.closing_date_text: 31 August 2026, 16:00. No late application will be accepted OTHER POSTS
jobs.summary: Director position to manage forestry research, development, innovation, and national norms for sustainable forest management within the Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment.
jobs.requirements: An undergraduate qualification in Forestry or relevant qualification (NQF7) within the related field as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of five (5) years’ experience at a middle/senior management level. Experience in Research and Forestry Management or related field. Successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-entry Programme as endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG) must be submitted prior to appointment. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Extensive knowledge of the National Forestry Act, 84 of 1998 (NFA), the National Veld & Forestry Fire Act, 101 of 1998 (NVFFA) and the Management of State Forests Act, 128 of 1992. Understanding of law enforcement legislation and relevant regulations. Understanding and knowledge of spatial and non-spatial information systems. Knowledge and understanding of relevant national legislation and international agreements and commitments including their impact. Knowledge and understanding of international laws, agreements, and commitments pertaining to Forestry Management. Leadership Management. Programme and Project Management. Knowledge Management. People Management and Empowerment. Financial Management. Sound Research, Analytical, Organising, Planning, and Presentation skills. Interpersonal Skills. Computer literacy. Good communication skills (Verbal and written). Ability to work with difficult persons and to resolve conflict. Ability to work under pressure and long hours.
jobs.duties: Manage forestry research, development, and innovation in the sector. Ensure that the research function keeps up with the world trends. Manages the research function and funding. Manage the development of national norms and standards for sustainable forest management. Manage the development of principles, criteria, Indicators, and Standards for Sustainable Forest Management (SFM). Ensure provision of scientific forest management guidelines, best practices, and assistance to the Branch and broader forestry sector. Manage the provision of specialist technical advice and support to the Branch and other relevant stakeholders. Manage the provision of forestry subject inputs towards integrated environmental management. Facilitate and monitor the implementation, maintenance, and improvement of sustainable forestry management business processes. Provision of strategic forestry information and knowledge to support policy development and decision- making. Ensure compliance with the national and international forestry reporting requirements. Coordinate and manage spatial and non-spatial information gathering, processing, and analysis. Co-ordinate regional Geographical Information Systems (GIS) and processes for gathering data and mapping. Maintain a comprehensive GIS database for the region with maps and environmental data. Oversee the development of GIS reports, for further action.
jobs.applications: All applications to be submitted online on the following link: https://erecruitment.environment.gov.za/
jobs.notes: Interested applicants must submit their applications via the above link. Applicant must ensure that they complete all sections on the online Z83 and attached a detailed CV with at least three (3) contactable references. Failure to complete or disclose all required information will automatically disqualify the applicant. No late applications will be accepted. Shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications, identity document and driver’s license on or before the day of the interview. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). The National Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer. Preference may be given to appointable applicants from the underrepresented designated groups in terms of the Department’s equity plan. Persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply. Correspondence will be limited to successful candidates only. Short-listed candidates will be subjected to screening and security vetting to determine their suitability for employment, including but not limited to: Criminal records; Citizenship status; Credit worthiness; Previous employment (reference checks); and Qualification verification. Short-listed candidates will be expected to avail themselves at the Department’s convenience. Entry level requirements for SMS posts: In terms of the Directive on Compulsory Capacity Development, Mandatory Training Days & Minimum Entry Requirements for SMS that was introduced on 1 April 2015, a requirement for all applicants for SMS posts from 1 April 2020 is a successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme as endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG) prior to appointment. The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into SMS and the full details can be obtained by following the below link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entryprogramme. Furthermore, Shortlisted candidates must provide proof of successful completion of the course. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Following the interview and technical passement for all SMS posts, the Selection Panel will recommend candidates to attend a generic managerial competency assessment in compliance with the DPSA Directive on the implementation of competency-based assessments. Persons appointed will be subjected to a security clearance, the signing of performance agreement and employment contract. The Department reserves the right not to make an appointment. If you have not been contacted within three 3 months after the closing date of the advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. By submitting the employment application form, you agree and consent in terms of Section 11(1) of the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA), 2013 (Act 4 of 2013), for your personal information which you provide to the DFFE to being processed by the department and its employees, agents, Cabinet committees, and subcontractors for recruitment purposes, in accordance with the POPIA of 2013.

af.title: Direkteur: Forestry Scientific & Technical Services
af.summary: Direkteurspos om bosbounavorsing, -ontwikkeling, -innovasie en nasionale norme vir volhoubare bosbestuur binne die Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment te bestuur.
af.requirements: ‘n Voorgraadse kwalifikasie in Bosbou of ‘n relevante kwalifikasie (NQF7) binne die verwante veld soos deur SAQA erken. ‘n Minimum van vyf (5) jaar se ervaring op ‘n middel-/seniorbestuursvlak. Ervaring in Navorsing en Bosbou-bestuur of ‘n verwante veld. Suksonvolle voltooiing van die Senior Management Pre-entry Programme soos deur die National School of Government (NSG) bekragtig moet voor aanstelling ingedien word. Alle gekese kandidate, insluitend SMS, moet twee voor-toetrede assessorings onderneem. Een moet ‘n praktiese oefening wees, en die ander moet ‘n Integriteit (Etiese Gedrag)-assessering wees. Alle gekese kandidate vir SMS-poste sal aan ‘n tegniese oefening en onderhoud onderwerp word. Na die tegniese oefening en onderhoud sal ‘n maksimum van drie (3) SMS-kandidate psigometriese assesserings ondergaan om kognitiewe vermoëns, gedragsvoorkeure, emosionele intelligensie en integriteit te assessor. Uitgebreide kennis van die National Forestry Act, 84 of 1998 (NFA), die National Veld & Forestry Fire Act, 101 of 1998 (NVFFA) en die Management of State Forests Act, 128 of 1992. Begrip van wetstoepassingswetgewing en relevante regulasies. Begrip en kennis van ruimtelike en nie-ruimtelike inligtingstelsels. Kennis en begrip van relevante nasionale wetgewing en internasionale ooreenkomste en verbintenis, insluitend hul impak. Kennis en begrip van internasionale wette, ooreenkomste en verbintenisse rakende Bosbou-bestuur. Leierskapsbestuur. Program- en projekbestuur. Kennisbestuur. Personeelsbestuur en bemagtiging. Finansiële bestuur. Degte navorsings, analitiese, organiseerende, beplannings- en aanbiedingsvaardighede. Interpersoonlike vaardighede. Rekenaargeletterdheid. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede (mondelings en skriftelik). Vermoë om met moeilike persone te werk en konflik op te los. Vermoë om onder druk en lang ure te werk.
af.duties: Bestuur bosbounavorsing, -ontwikkeling en -innovasie in die sektor. Verseker dat die navorsingsfunksie tred hou met wêreldtendense. Bestuur die navorsingsfunksie en befondsing. Bestuur die ontwikkeling van nasionale norme en standaarde vir volhoubare bosbestuur. Bestuur die ontwikkeling van beginsels, kriteria, aanwysers en standaarde vir volhoubare bosbestuur (SFM). Verseker voorsiening van wetenskaplike bosbestuursriglyne, beste praktyke en bystand aan die Tak en breër bosbousektor. Bestuur die voorsiening van spesialistiese tegniese advies en ondersteuning aan die Tak en ander relevante belanghebbendes. Bestuur die voorsiening van bosbou-onderwerpinsette tot geïntegreerde omgewingsbestuur. Fassiliteer en monitor die implementering, instandhouding en verbetering van volhoubare bosbestuursakeprosesse. Voorsiening van strategiese bosbou-inligting en -kennis ter ondersteuning van beleidsontwikkeling en besluitneming. Verseker nakoming van die nasionale en internasionale bosbourapporteringsvereistes. Koördineer en bestuur ruimtelike en nie-ruimtelike inligtingsversameling, -verwerking en -analise. Koördineer streek- Geographical Information Systems (GIS) en prosesse vir die versameling van data en kartering. Onderhou ‘n omvattende GIS-databasis vir die streek met kaarte en omgewingsdata. Hou toesig oor die ontwikkeling van GIS-verslae, vir verdere optrede.

zu.title: Umlawuli: Izinkonzo Zesayensi Nobuchwepheshe Zemihlahlandlela
zu.summary: Isikhundla somlawuli sokuphatha ucwaningo, intuthuko, okusha, kanye namagugu amazwe okuphathwa kwemihlahlandlela ngokuzinza ngaphakathi kwesikhungo i-Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zesikhathi esingaphansi kweziqu eziphakeme kweziqu ezingunhlaka noma iziqu ezihambisana naleyo (NQF7) ngaphakathi kwendawo ehlobene njengokuqashwa yi-SAQA. Ukwazi okuncane kweminyaka eyihlanu (5) kokusebenza ezingeni lokubusa okuphakathi/okuphezulu. Okuhlotshaniswe ukusebenza ku-Cwaningo nokuphathwa kweMihlahlandlela noma endaweni ephathelene nayo. Ukugqitsha ngempumelelo i-Senior Management Pre-entry Programme njengoba kukhonjiwe i-National School of Government (NSG) kufanele kuthunyelwe ngaphambi kokwenzwa komsebenzi. Bonke abagqanyiswa baye phambili, okuhlanganisa ne-SMS, bazokwenza okuhlolwayo kokungena kabusha okuyisibili. Okunye kumele kube umzamo osebenzayo, okunye kumele kub ukuhlolwa kokuziphatha (I-Ethical Conduct Assessment). Bonke abagqanyiswa baye phambili izikhundla be-SMS bazohlolwa ngomzamo obuchwepheshe kanye nenterview. Emva komzamo obuchwepheshe nenterview, abagqanyiswa baye phambili be-SMS abangaba yisikhathi esingaphezulu kweyisithupha (3) bazokwenza izivivinyo ze-psychometric ukukhalipha amakhono okucabanga, izinketho zokuziphatha, ukuqonda izinkinga zomzwelo, nokuziphatha okuhle. Ukwazi okujulile ngo-National Forestry Act, 84 of 1998 (NFA), i-National Veld & Forestry Fire Act, 101 of 1998 (NVFFA) ne-Management of State Forests Act, 128 of 1992. Ukuqonda umthetho wokuqinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kolimi kanye nemithetho ohlobene nayo. Ukuqonda nokwazi izinhlelo zamagagasi kanye nezinhlelo ezingamagagasi. Ukwazi nokuqonda umthetho kazwelonke ohlobene nokubambisana namazwe kanye nezibopho okuhlanganisa nomthelela wawo. Ukwazi nokuqonda umthetho wamazwe, izibopho, nezithembiso ezihlobene nokuphathwa kweMihlahlandlela. Ukuphatha ukuholwa. Ukuphatha imihlwahla kanye namaphrojekthi. Ukuphatha ulwazi. Ukuphatha abantu nakubakhushulelwa amandla. Ukuphatha imali. Amakhono okucwaninga, okuhlaziya, okuhlela, okucwangcisa, kanye nokubonisa kahle. Amakhono okuxhumana nabantu. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amakhono okuxhumana kahle (Okwenziwa ngomlomo nangokubhaliwe). Ikhono lokusebenza nabantu abanzima nokuqeda izinxaxhi. Ikhono lokusebenza ngokucindezelwa kanye nesikhathi eside.
zu.duties: Phatha ucwaningo, intuthuko, nokudala okusha emkhakazini wemihlahlandlela. Qinisekisa ukuthi umsebenzi wocwaningo uhamba phambili nezimpawu zomhlaba. Uphatha umsebenzi wocwaningo kanye nemali ekelwe ocwaningweni. Phatha ukuthuthukiswa kwamagugu kanye nemingqango kazwelonke yokuphathwa kwemihlahlandlela ngokuzinza. Phatha ukuthuthukiswa kweziphithiphithi, izindlela zokuqinisekisa izidingo, izinkomba, kanye nezindinganiso zokuphathwa kwe-Sustainable Forest Management (SFM). Qinisekisa ukunikelwa kwezinkombandlela zesayensi zokuphathwa kweMihlahlandlela, izindlela ezinhle kakhulu, kanye nensiza ekusebenzeni kwe-Branch nasekuhlotshaneni okubanzi emkhakazini wemihlahlandlela. Phatha ukunikela ngeluleko lezobuchwepheshe elibhekene nzima kanye nensiza ku-Branch nakwezinye izinhlangano eziphathelene nokuthinta. Phatha ukunikelwa ngeminikelo yemihlahlandlela ekwakhiweni kokuphathwa kwendawo ehlukaniswe ngokukhanya. Siza futhi ulawule ukusetshenziswa, ukugcinwa, nokuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo zokuphathwa kwezohwebo zokuphathwa kwemihlahlandlela. Ukunikelwa kolwazi lwemihlahlandlela olubanzi nesibalulekile ukweseka ukuthuthukiswa kwezinqumo mayelana namapholisi nokuthatha izinqumo. Qinisekisa ukuthi uhambisana nezidingo zokubika ngemihlahlandlela kazwelonke nakwamanye amazwe. Hlephuze futhi ulawule ukuqoqa, ukucubungula, kanye nokuqoqa ulwazi lwamagagasi kanye nalungalona. Hlephuze izinhlelo ze-Geographical Information Systems (GIS) zomhlaba kanye nenqubo yokuqoqa idatha kanye nokuqoqa imaphu. Gcina umtapo wedata i-GIS ohambisana nawo wonke umkhakha weGIS ngesifundo ngeminikelo nemaphu. Lawula ukwakhiwa kwezibalo ze-GIS, ukuze kuthathwe izinyathelo ezilandelayo.

xh.title: Um lawuli: Iinkonzo zeSayensi namaBuchule zo Balo lwamahlathi
xh.summary: Isithuba somlawuli sokulawula uphando, nophuhliso, iingqibezi-mvela, namagama angazisiwo emizweni yonke ukwenzela ulondolozo oluqhubekayo lwamahlathi ngaphakathi kwiSebe le Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esingaphantsi kwesidanga sematasa kwisiqendu se Forestry okanye isifundo esinxulumeneyo (NQF7) ngaphakathi kwandlela exulumene nayo njengokuqatshwa yi SAQA. Isipilingcamvo esingaphantsi kweminyaka emihlanu (5) kwinqanaba lokuLawulwa phakathi/phezulu. Isipilingcamvo kuphando nokuLawulwa kwamahlathi okanye kummandla onxulumene nayo. Ukugqiba ngempumelelo inkqubo yokungena ngaphambi kweNqanaba eliphezulu loLawulo njengokuqinisekiswa yi National School of Government (NSG) kufuneka kuthunyelwe ngaphambi kokuba kubekwe umntu. Onke amagosa akethiweyo, kuquka naba SMS, kuya kwenza amanqaku amabini okuqinisekisa ngaphambi kokungenwa. Elinye kufuneka libe yilmsebenzi yamavolo, kwaye elinye libe yokuqinisekisa ukuziphatha ngokuthe ngqo (Intetho yeNgqikithi). Onke amagosa akethiweyo kumawonke amagosa esithuba sika SMS kuya kwabelwa ngomsebenzi wobuchule nomthethonqubo. Emva komsebenzi wobuchule nomthethonqubo, amagosa amaxima athathu (3) aka SMS kuya kugqithisa kumanqaku okulinganisa isimo sengqondo ukulinganisa ukusebenza kwengqondo, izinto eziqhutshwa ngumoya, ukuqonda iimvakalelo, nokuqinisekisa ngokuthe ngqo. Ulwazi olubanzi malunga ne National Forestry Act, 84 of 1998 (NFA), i National Veld & Forestry Fire Act, 101 of 1998 (NVFFA) naku Management of State Forests Act, 128 of 1992. Ukuqonda umthetho wokuqweqisa kwaye kuqweqiswe ngomyalelo namagunya ahambelana nawo. Ukuqonda nokwazi iinkqubo zolwazi ngamabala eendawo nangaphandle kwawo. Ulwazi nokuqonda umthetho weqawe nokuxabana kwamazwe ngamazwe neminqweno ehambelana nayo kubandakanya nempembelelo yawo. Ulwazi nokuqonda imithetho yamazwe ngamazwe, iinkqubo zeminqweno, namagunya ahambelana nokulawulwa kwamahlathi. UkuLawulwa kobuKhosi. UkuLawulwa kwenkqubo namaPhando. UkuLawulwa kolwazi. UkuLawulwa koluntu nabantu nokunika amandla. UkuLawulwa kweMali. Iakhoni zokuPhanda, zokuHlola, zokuCwangcisa, zokuQamba nokuMela ezilumkileyo. Amabali phakathi kwabantu. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa iKhompyutha. Amakhono amabali alungileyo (Ngomlomo nakubhalwe). Ukuba namandla okusebenza nabantu abanzima nokuyisombulula ingxabano. Ukuba namandla okusebenza ngwena kwaye ixesha elide.
xh.duties: Lawula uphando, uphuhliso, nokuqamba okutsha kwamahlathi kwicala. Qinisekisa ukuba inkqubo yophando ihamba ngokwemiba yehlabathi. Iyilawula inkqubo yophando nemali efuneka kuyo. Lawula uphuhliso lwemigama yonke namazinga okugcina ulondolozo oluqhubekayo lwamahlathi. Lawula uphuhliso lweemvisiswano, iindlela zokuqwalasela, izalathisi, namazinga okuGcina ulondolozo oluqhubekayo lwamahlathi (SFM). Qinisekisa ukunikwa kweekh Commission zesayensi zokulawula amahlathi, iindlela ezilungileyo zokwenza izinto, nencoko eluncedayo kuCandelo nakuwo onke amacala amahlathi. Lawula ukunikwa kweenkcazelo zobuchule ezinceda kunye nokuXhaswa kwiCandelo nakumanye abantu abanomdla. Lawula ukunikwa kweziphozo zamahlathi ukuyisa kwinkqubo yokulawulwa kwemvelo ephuhliweyo. Yenza umhlelo kwaye ulandele isiphithiphithi sokuzisebenzisa, ukulondoloza, nokuphucula iinkqubo zoshishino zokulawula amahlathi ngokuchanekileyo nokwenzeka ngokulondolozo. Ukunikwa kolwazi lwezicwangciso zamahlathi nolwazi olubonisa ukuba inkqubo yokuqamba umthetho nokuthatha iigqibo ithembile. Qinisekisa ukumiselwa kwemithetho yophando nokuvela kumanqaku okubika ngamahlathi esizwe nangamazwe ngamazwe. Lawula intlanganiso yolwazi ngamabala nakungamabala, ukuqhutywa, nokuqwalaselwa kwalo. Lawula iinkqubo ze Geographical Information Systems (GIS) ezilawulo iindawo nokuvela kolwazi nemaphu emabala. Yigcine inkqubo efumaneka konke kunye nemaphu nolwazi ngemvelo yelo ndawo. Qwalasela uphuhliso lweinkcazelo ze GIS ukuze zenzeke izinto ezithe kratya.

jobs.title: Senior Specialist: Green House GAS Reporting - Industrial
jobs.department: Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment
jobs.closing_date_text: 31 August 2026, 16:00. No late application will be accepted
jobs.summary: Senior specialist needed to verify and review company-level greenhouse gas reports for carbon tax validation in the industrial and waste sectors.
jobs.requirements: Master’s Degree (NQF9) in Chemical Engineering, Natural or Environmental Sciences or relevant qualification as recognised by SAQA. Five (5) years’ experience in the relevant field. Knowledge of environmental and development issues (globally, regionally, locally). Good understanding and knowledge of emission and sequestration processes, as well as sources and sinks in the respective sectors. Programme and Project Management. Knowledge of industrial processes and their related greenhouse gas emissions. Ability to conduct greenhouse gas emission reviews. Understanding of South Africa’s greenhouse gas emission profile and climate change mitigation. Extensive knowledge of climate change mitigation issues, including legal and policy frameworks and other barriers, the economics and technical requirements of low carbon development. Ability to conduct research, gather and analyse information. Knowledge of atmospheric chemistry and industry process applications. Data collection and analysis. Modelling and coordination. Good communication (written and spoken), analytical, organisational and report writing skills. Information Management. Sense of responsibility and loyalty.
jobs.duties: Conduct Report Verification for Carbon Tax. Conduct technical verification and review of company-level GHG reports to support carbon tax validation processes for the IPPU and Waste. Assess the completeness, accuracy, and methodological appropriateness of emissions data submitted by regulated entities. Evaluate verification statements and independent assessor reports to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements. Collaborate with relevant authorities to ensure alignment between reported emissions, carbon tax submissions, and national inventory data. Provide Technical Leadership and Inventory Management for the Industrial Processes Product Use and Waste Sectors. Lead the development, compilation, and enhancement of Green House Gas inventories for the IPPU and Waste sectors in accordance with IPCC guidelines and UNFCCC reporting requirements. Oversee methodological selection, emission factor development, and activity data management to ensure scientific robustness. Support the allocation of carbon budgets for companies in the IPPU sector. Support the development of regulations for the management of synthetic greenhouse gases. Conduct Green House Gas emissions scenario modelling and analysis. Support the development and application of emissions projection models for the IPPU and Waste sectors to inform national mitigation pathways. Analyse baseline and alternative emissions scenarios to assess the potential impact of policies, regulations, and technological interventions. Collaborate with modelling teams, research institutions, and policy units to ensure consistency between inventory data and projections. Conduct research studies and implement funding initiatives. Guide and coordinate research studies aimed at improving emissions estimation, emission factors, mitigation options, and data systems for the IPPU and Waste sectors. Identify priority research needs to address inventory uncertainties, verification challenges, and modelling gaps. Support the mobilisation, allocation, and management of funding for sector-specific research and analytical studies. Review and integrate research outputs into national inventories, modelling frameworks, and policy processes. Enhance data systems and drive continuous improvement. Support the enhancement of GHG data management, reporting, and verification systems. Promote integration between inventory databases, modelling tools, and regulatory reporting platforms. Monitor international best practice and recommend innovations to strengthen inventory, verification, and modelling systems.
