af.title: Senior Spesialis: Kweekhuisgasverslagdoening - Nywerheid
af.summary: Senior spesialis benodig om maatskappyvlak-kweekhuisgasverslae te verifieer en te hersien vir koolstofbelastingvalidasie in die nywerheids- en afvalsektore.
af.requirements: Meestersgraad (NQF9) in Chemiese Ingenieurswese, Natuur- of Omgigewingswetenskappe of relevante kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken. Vyf (5) jaar se ondervinding in die relevante veld. Kennis van omgewings- en ontwikkelingskwessies (wêreldwyd, streeks, plaaslik). Goeie begrip en kennis van emissie- en sekwestringsprosesse, asook bronne en putte in die onderskeie sektore. Program- en projekbestuur. Kennis van nywerheidsprosesse en hul verwante kweekhuisgasemissies. Vermoë om kweekhuisgasemissiehersienings uit te voer. Begrip van Suid-Afrika se kweekhuisgasemissieprofiel en klimaatsveranderingsmitigasie. Uitgebreide kennis van klimaatsveranderingsmitigasiekwessies, insluitend regs- en beleidsraamwerke en ander struikelblokke, die ekonomie en tegniese vereistes van lae-koolstofontwikkeling. Vermoë om navorsing te doen, inligting in te samel en te ontleed. Kennis van atmosferiese chemie en nywerheidsproses-toepassings. Data-insameling en -ontleding. Modellering en koördinasie. Goeie kommunikasie (skriftelik en mondelings), analitiese, organisatoriese en verslagdoeningsvaardighede. Inligtingsbestuur. Sin van verantwoordelikheid en lojaliteit.
af.duties: Voer verslagverifikasie vir koolstofbelasting uit. Voer tegniese verifikasie en hersiening van maatskappyvlak-kweekhuisgasverslae uit ter ondersteuning van koolstofbelastingvalidasieprosesse vir die IPPU en Afval. Beoordeel die volledigheid, akkuraatheid en metodologiese geskiktheid van emissiedata wat deur gereguleerde entiteite ingedien is. Evalueer verifikasiestate en onafhanklike beoordelaarsverslae om nakoming van regulasievereistes te verseker. Werk saam met relevante owerhede om belyning tussen gerapporteerde emissies, koolstofbelastingindienings en nasionale voorraaddata te verseker. Verskaf tegniese leierskap en voorraadbestuur vir die Nywerheidsprosesse-produkgebruik- en Afvalsektore. Lei die ontwikkeling, samestelling en verbetering van kweekhuisgasvoorrade vir die IPPU- en Afvalsektore in ooreenstemming met IPCC-riglyne en UNFCCC-verslagdoeningsvereistes. Hou toesig oor metodologiese keuse, emissiefaktorontwikkeling en aktiwiteitsdatabestuur om wetenskaplike robuustheid te verseker. Ondersteun die toekenning van koolstofbegrotings vir maatskappye in die IPPU-sektor. Ondersteun die ontwikkeling van regulasies vir die bestuur van sintetiese kweekhuisgasse. Voer kweekhuisgasemissie-scenariomodellering en -ontleding uit. Ondersteun die ontwikkeling en toepassing van emissieprojeksiemodelle vir die IPPU- en Afvalsektore om nasionale mitigasiepatrone in te lig. Ontleed basislyn- en alternatiewe emissiescenario's om die potensiële impak van beleide, regulasies en tegnologiese ingrypings te assesseer. Werk saam met modelleringspanne, navorsingsinstellings en beleidseenhede om konsekwentheid tussen voorraaddatal en projeksies te verseker. Voer navorsingstudies uit en implementeer befondsingsinisiatiewe. Lei en koördineer navorsingstudies wat gemik is op die verbetering van emissieskattings, emissiefaktore, mitigasie-opsies en datastelsels vir die IPPU- en Afvalsektore. Identifiseer prioriteitsnavorsingsbehoeftes om voorraadonsekerhede, verifikasie-uitdagings en modelleringsgaping aan te spreek. Ondersteun die mobilisering, toekenning en bestuur van befondsing vir sektor-spesifieke navorsing en analitiese studies. Hersien en integreer navorsingsuitsette in nasionale voorrade, modelleringsraamwerke en beleidsprosesse. Verbeter datastelsels en dryf deurlopende verbetering. Ondersteun die verbetering van kweekhuisgasdatabestuur, -verslagdoening en -verifikasiestelsels. Bevorder integrasie tussen voorraaddatabasisse, modelleringsnutsmiddels en regulatiewe verslagdoeningsplatforms. Monitor internasionale beste praktyk en beveel innovasies aan om voorraad-, verifikasie- en modelleringsstelsels te versterk.

zu.title: Ochwepheshe Omkhulu: Ukubika Igesi Yendlu Esiluhlaza - Imbonini
zu.summary: Kudingeka ochwepheshe omkhulu ukugunyaza futhi ahloliswe imibiko yegesi yendlu esiluhlaza nganani yinkampani ukuze kuqinisekiswe intela yekhabhoni emkhakheni wembonini kanye nasalokhu okuyizingodo.
zu.requirements: I-Master's Degree (NQF9) ku-Chemical Engineering, kwezemvelo noma i-Natural noma i-Environmental Sciences noma iziqu ezihambisana nalezi njengoba zivotwa yi-SAQA. U-Experience eminyaka emihlanu (5) kuleyo mikhakha. Ulwazi ngemibuzo yezemvelo nentuthuko (kwelize, esifundeni, endaweni). Ukuqonda okuhle nokwazi izinqubo zokukhishwa kwamakhulu kanye nokweswa, kanye namaphuzu nezinkulishi emikhakheni ehambisana nalokho. Imphathi yohlelo namaprojekthi. Ulwazi lwezinqubo zembonini namakhulu egesi yendlu esiluhlaza ahambisana nazo. Ikhono lokwenza ukuhlola amakhulu egesi yendlu esiluhlaza. Ukuqonda iprofayela wamakhulu egesi yendlu esiluhlaza e-South Africa kanye nenzuzo ekushintshweni kwesimo sezulu. Ulwazi olubanzi ngemibuzo yenzuzo ekushintshweni kwesimo sezulu, okuhlanganisa uhlaka lomthetho nenenqubo kanye nezinye izithiyo, amaphayiphu nobuchwepheshe bezidingo zentuthuko enekhabhoni ephansi. Ikhono lokwenza ucwaningo, ukuqoqa futhi ukuhlaziya ulwazi. Ulwazi lwekhemistri yomoya kanye nezinhlelo zemboni. Ukuqoqa ukuhlaziya amaphayiphu. Ukuqopha futhi ukuhlanganisa. Amaphayiphu okuxhumana (abhalwe noku khulunywa), ukuhlaziya, ukuhlela kanye namaphayiphu okubika. Imphathi yolwazi. Indikimba yobunxaxhi nobuhlakaniphwa.
zu.duties: Yenza ukuhlola imibiko ukunikela ngenqwaba yekhabhoni. Yenza ukuhlola ubuchwepheshe futhi uhlole imibiko yamakhulu egesi yendlu esiluhlaza nganani yinkampani ukuxhasa izinqubo zokuqinisekisa intela yekhabhoni i-IPPU kanye nasalokhu okuyizingodo. Hlola ukugqama, ukulula nokuhambisana kwenqubo yedatha yamakhulu ehambisana yizinhlaka ezilawulwayo. Hlaza izinkomba zokuqinisekisa kanye namaphayiphu ahlolayo azimele ukuze uqinisekise ukulandela izidingo zezinhlaka ezilawulayo. Sebenzisana nezinye izinhlaka ezibalulekile ukugcina ukuhambisana kwamakhulu abikwayo, ukunikela ngenqwaba yekhabhoni, nedatha yezinto yesizwe. Nikeza ubuqhawe bezobuchwepheshe kanye nezinto ezibalulekile ukulawula izinto esezingeni lemithombo emikhakheni yezinhlelo zemboni yokusebenzisa imikhiqizo kanye nasalokhu okuyizingodo. Bumba, hlanganisa futhi wenze izinto ezintsha zohlu lwamakhulu egesi yendlu esiluhlaza i-IPPU kanye nasalokhu okuyizingodo ngokuhambisana nezinhlelo zokuqondisa ze-IPCC kanye nezidingo zokubika ze-UNFCCC. Qapha ukukhethwa kwenqubo, ukudala amaphayiphu amakhulu, kanye nokulawula idatha yokusebenza ukuze kuqinisekiswe okuqinile okusesandleni. Xhasa ukunikezelwa kwezimali zekhabhoni kumakhompani kumkhakha i-IPPU. Xhasa ukudalwa kwezinto zomthetho zokulawula amakhulu egesi yendlu esiluhlaza okuyizenzo. Yenza ukumodela nokuhlaziya amaphayiphu amakhulu egesi yendlu esiluhlaza. Xhasa ukudalwa nokusebenzisa amaphayiphu wokubika amakhulu kumakhakha i-IPPU kanye nasalokhu okuyizingodo ukuleta izindlela zokukhishwa kwezesizwe. Hlaziya amaphayiphu asuka kumongo nezinye izinketho zamakhulu ukuhlola imiphumela yezinto ezithile, umthetho, kanye nezinye izinto zobuchwepheshe. Sebenzisana namaqembu okumodela, izikhungo zocwaningo, kanye namayunithi enqubo ukugcina ukuhambisana phakathi kwedatha yezinto nesikhathi esizoyohlola. Yenza izifundo zocwaningo futhi usebenzise izinhlelo zokusiza ngezezimali. Hola futhi uhlanganise izifundo zocwaningo ezihlose ukwenza ukuthi amakhulu abikwe ngokugqamile, amaphayiphu amakhulu, izinketho zokukhishwa, futhi uhlelo lwedatha lungcono kumakhakha i-IPPU kanye nasalokhu okuyizingodo. Funa okubalulekile kwesidingo socwaningo ukulungisa ukungaqiniseki kwizinto ezibalulekile, izinselele zokuqinisekisa, kanye nezikhala zokumodela. Xhasa ukuhlanganisa, ukunikezelwa, kanye nokulawula izimali zocwaningo ngemikhakha ethile kanye nezifundo zokuhlaziya. Hlola futhi uhlanganise imiphumela yocwaningo kuzinto zesizwe, uhlaka lokumodela, kanye nenqubo. Yenza izinto ezintsha kuhlelo lwedatha futhi uqonde ukwenza izinto ngokuphazima. Xhasa ukwenza kuhle kokuphatha, ukubika nokutholakala kwedatha ye-GHG. Khuthaza ukuhlanganisa phakathi kwezinto ezibalulekile kwedatha yokubika, amaphayiphu okumodela, kanye nendawo yezinto zomthetho zokubika. Qapha izinto ezinhle kakhulu emhlabeni wonke futhi uncoma izinto ezintsha ukugcina kuhle kuhlelo lwezinto ezibalulekile, ukuqinisekisa kanye nokumodela.

xh.title: Ummeleli Ophakamileyo: Ukuchaza i-Green House GAS - Ezentlalo
xh.summary: Kufuneka kubekho ummeleli ophakamileyo onokuqinisekisa nokuphonononga iimveliso ze-greenhouse gas kwinqanaba lenkampani ukuqinisekisa irhafu yekhabhoni kwiiindawo ezingezizo zolawulo nase kumhlama.
xh.requirements: Masters Degree (NQF9) kwi-Chemical Engineering, Natural or Environmental Sciences okanye izifundo ezifanelekileyo njengoko zivunywa yi-SAQA. Five (5) iminyaka yamava kwinkundla ehambelana nayo. Ulwazi ngemiba ezemohlweyo nentluko (kwihlabathi jikelele, ngasentshona, kwakhona ngasemzini). Ukuqonda okulungileyo nolwazi ngokuqhubeka kokukhutshwa nokubanjwa kweekhabhoni, kunye neento ezikhutsha neezo zibamba kwindawo ngasinye. Ulawulo lweenkqubo namaprojekthi. Ulwazi ngokuqhubeka kwezoshishino kunye nokukhutshwa kweekhabhoni ehambelana noko. Ulawulo lokwenza iinococo zokukhutshwa kweekhabhoni. Ukuqonda isimo sokukhutshwa kweekhabhoni eSouth Africa nendlela yokunciphisa iinguquko zemozulu. Ulwazi olubanzi kwimiba yokunciphisa iinguquko zemozulu, kuquka iinkqubo zomthetho nenqaku, nokunye okuthintelayo, izezoqoqosho neemfuno ezobuchwepheshe zophuhliso olungekho ngenani elikhulu lekhabhoni. Ulawulo lokwenza uphando,okuqokelela nokuhlalutya iinkcukacha. Ulwazi ngamachiza okukhanya olongamo lemozulu nokuqhubeka kweshishino. Ukuqokelela nokuqokelela iinkcukacha. Ukuqamba iinkqubo nokuhlanganisa izinto. Ulwazi lokunxibelelwana (okubhaliweyo nokuthethwayo), ukuhlalutya, ukuqamba izinhlobo nokuqamba iimveliso. Ulawulo lwesaziso. Imo yokuzimela nokuthembeka.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa ukwenza iinococo ngeRhafu yeKhabhoni. Qinisekisa ngobuchwephesha kuphondo nokuqinisekisa iimveliso ze-GHG kwinqanaba lenkampani ukuze axhasa iinkqubo zokuqinisekisa irhafu yekhabhoni kwi-IPPU nakuMhlama. Linganisa ukugqitywa, ukuchaneka, nendlela efanelekileyo yemisebenzi yemiba ekhutshwayo equkwe ziiNkampani ezilawulwayo. Hlola iinkcazelo zokuqinisekisa iinococo ezingezanto zocingo kunye neemveliso zokuqinisekisa ezizezelwe ukuqinisekisa ukuthobela iimfuno ezilawulwayo. Sebenzisana namagunyazi ahambelana nayo ukuqinisekisa ukubambelekela phakathi kokukhutshwa okubikiweyo, okunikelwa phantsi kwerekhafu yekhabhoni, nolwazi lwesizwe. Nikezela nokuqonda ngobuchwephesha kwaye ulawule iNkqubo yeSizwe yamaxabiso eziNgubo zemiba yeNkqubo yamashishino, nokuSebenzisa iNkqubo kaRhafu yamaxabiso eziNgubo nemiba yeMhlama. Qhuba ukuphuhlisa, ukuqamba nokupucuka kweNkqubo yeNkqubo ye-GHG kumaxabiso eziNgubo nemiba yeMhlama ngokwemigaqo ye-IPPC nokuqinisekisa iimfuno zoRhwepheshe leNyango lezeMfundo yeNyango yeNyango i-UNFCCC. Qinisekisa ukukhethwa kwemigaqo, ukuphuhlisa imigaqo yamandla okukhutsha nokuqokelela iinkcukacha zemisebenzi ukuze kuqiniseke ukuba ngokobuchwepheshe kuye kubengcono. Xhasa ukunikela iisaphulethi zekhabhoni kumashishino kumaxabiso eziNgubo. Xhasa ukuphuhlisa imigaqo yolawulo lweekhabhoni ezenziwe ngesandla. Qamba iinkqubo zokuqhuba amaxabiso eziNgubo neenkqubo zokuqhuba iinkqubo zokuqonda nokuhlalutya. Xhasa ukuphuhlisa nokusebenzisa iinkqubo zokuqonda amaxabiso eziNgubo nokuSebenzisa amaxabiso eziNgubo nokuQonda amaxabiso eziNgubo eMhlama ukwazisa iindlela zokunciphisa iingozi zesizwe. Hlola amaxabiso angasemva neendlela zokwenza amaxabiso ngeendlela ezahlukeneyo ukuze kubonwe ukuba ngowuphi na umphumela wemigaqo, iMigaqo, neendlela ezahlukeneyo ezisezobuchwephesha. Sebenzisana neenqatha zokuqamba iinkqubo, iindawo zophando, kunye namagunyazi ukuze kugcinwe ukubambelekela phakathi kolwazi olukunqwenela ukuba lulongamo nemiba ekhutshwayo. Yenza iingcaphephe zophando kwaye uqwalasele iinkqubo ezisebenzisa imali. Qonda kwaye uhlanganise iingcaphephe zophando ezenziwa ngaphandle ukuze kusetyenziswe kwizitudi ezenziwayo zokuqinisekisa nokupucuka kwemiba ekhutshwayo nakuMhlama. Balula iingcaphephe ezingekanqunywa ukuqinisekisa ukubambelekela kolwazi ekubekweni kweNkqubo, ukulinganiselwa kokugqibeleleyo, iinkqubo ezicetywayo kunye neendlela ezisebenzayo. Xhasa ukwenza iinkqubo, ukubeka iinkqubo kunye nokuqamba iinkqubo zokulawula iimali zophando kunye neengcaphephe zophando. Qinisekisa nokubeka iingcaphephe zophando ezikwindawo yazo ukuze zibe ngaphezulu. Phucula iinkqubo zolwazi kwaye uqhube ukuphucula ngokuqhubekayo. Xhasa ukuphucula iNkqubo yeNkqubo ye-GHG yokulawula iNcukacha ezingekabikho, ukwenza iNkqubo nokusebenzisa iinkqubo ezikumaphephu ebali. Yisa phambili ukusebenzisa phakathi kolwazi olufunekileyo kwiBhanki yamagama, amathuluzi amakhulu kakhulu, nokuqamba amaphephu ebali ngokwemigaqo esemthethweni. Qaphela amaphepha amakhulu kakhulu kunye nokuqinisekisa ukuphucula amaphepha ebali.

af.title: Senior Spesialis: Green House GAS-verslaggewing – Energie
af.summary: Senior spesialisrol wat kweekhuisgasverslae vir koolstofbelasting verifieer, wat 'n meestergraad en vyf jaar se relevante ervaring in omgewings- of chemiese ingenieurswese vereis.
af.requirements: Meestergraad (NQF 9) in Chemiese Ingenieurswese, Natuur- of Omgewingswetenskappe of 'n relevante kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken. Vyf (5) jaar se ervaring in die relevante veld. Kennis van omgewings- en ontwikkelingskwessies (wêreldwyd, streeks, lokaal). Goeie begrip en kennis van emissie- en sekwestrasieprosesse, asook bronne en putte in die onderskeie sektore. Program- en projekbestuur. Kennis van industriële prosesse en hul verwante kweekhuisgasemissies. Vermoë om kweekhuisgasemissie-oorsigte uit te voer. Begrip van Suid-Afrika se kweekhuisgasemissieprofiel en klimaatsveranderingsmitigasie. Uitgebreide kennis van klimaatsveranderingsmitigasiekwessies, insluitend regs- en beleidraamwerke en ander hindernisse, die ekonomie en tegniese vereistes van lae-koolstofontwikkeling. Vermoë om navorsing te doen, inligting in te samel en te ontleed. Kennis van atmosferiese chemie en nywerheidsprocestoepassings. Data-insameling en -ontleding. Modellering en koördinering. Goeie kommunikasie (skriftelik en mondeling), analitiese, organisatoriese en verslagskryfvaardighede. Inligtingsbestuur. Sin van verantwoordelikheid en lojaliteit.
af.duties: Voer verslagverifikasi vir koolstofbelasting uit. Voer tegniese verifikasie en oorsig van maatskappyvlak-GHG-verslae uit ter ondersteuning van koolstofbelastingsvalidasieprosesse vir die IPPU en Afval. Beoordeel die volledigheid, akkuraatheid en metodologiese geskiktheid van emissiedata wat deur gereguleerde entiteite ingedien is. Evalueer verifikasiestate en onafhanklike beoordelaarverslae om nakoming van regulasievereistes te verseker. Werk saam met relevante owerhede om belyning tussen gerapporteerde emissies, koolstofbelasting voorleggings en nasionale voorraaddata te verseker. Verskaf tegniese leierskap en voorraadbestuur vir die energiesektore. Lei die ontwikkeling, samestelling en verbetering van GHG-voorrade vir die Energie in ooreenstemming met IPCC-riglyne en UNFCCC-verslaggewingsvereistes. Hou toesig oor metodologiese seleksie, emissiefaktorontwikkeling en aktiwiteitsdatabestuur om wetenskaplike robuustheid te verseker. Ondersteun die toekenning van koolstofbegrotings vir maatskappye in die energiesektor. Ondersteun die ontwikkeling van GHG-emissierekenings. Voer kweekhuisgasemissie-scenariomodellering en -ontleding uit. Ondersteun die ontwikkeling en toepassing van emissieprojeksiemodelle vir die energiesektore om nasionale mitigasiepatrone in te lig. Ontleed basislyn- en alternatiewe emissiescenario's om die potensiële impak van beleide, regulasies en tegnologiese ingrypings te beoordeel. Werk saam met modelleringspanne, navorsingsinstellings en beleidseenhede om konsekwentheid tussen voorraaddata en projeksies te verseker. Voer navorsingstudies uit en implementeer befondsingsinisiatiewe. Lei en koördineer navorsingstudies wat gemik is op die verbetering van emissieskattings, emissiefaktore, mitigasieopsies en datasiesteme vir die energiesektore. Identifiseer prioriteitsnavorsingsbehoeftes om voorraadonsekerhede, verifikasie-uitdagings en modelleringsgapings aan te spreek. Ondersteun die mobilisering, toekenning en bestuur van befondsing vir sektor-spesifieke navorsings- en analitiese studies. Hersien en integreer navorsingsuitsette in nasionale voorrade, modelleringsraamwerke en beleidsprosesse. Verbeter datasiesteme en dryf deurlopende verbetering. Ondersteun die verbetering van GHG-databestuur, -verslaggewing en -verifikasiestelsels vir die energiesektor. Bevorder integrasie tussen voorraaddatabasisse, modelleringsnutsgoed en regulatoriese verslaggewingsplatforms. Monitor internasionale beste praktyke en beveel innovasies aan om voorraad-, verifikasie- en modelleringsstelsels te versterk.

zu.title: Ochwepheshe Omkhule: Okushicilelwayo Kwegesi Egreenhouse - Amandla
zu.summary: Isikhundla somchwepheshe omkhulelwe ukuqinisekisa okushicilelwayo kwegesi yegreenhouse yesikweletu sekhabhoni, esidinga iziqu zeMaster's kanye neminyaka emihlanu yeziphiqezo ezihambisana nawo enkohlakalweni kwemvelo noma ubunjiniyela bamakhemikhali.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zeMaster's Degree (NQF 9) ku-Chemical Engineering, Natural noma Environmental Sciences noma iziqu ezihambisana nalokho njengoba zithathwa ngokungabaza yi-SAQA. Iminyaka eyihlanu (5) yesiphiqezo emkhakheni ohambisanayo. Ulwazi ngemibuzo yemvelo nentuthuko (kwethe ithembe liye, kule minyaka yonkana, futhi kule ndawo). Ukuqonda kahle nokwazi inqubo yokukhishwa kwemithumbla kanye nokweswa kwemithumbla, kanye nemithombo kanye namageje emikhakheni ehambisanayo. Ulawulo lwezinhlelo kanye nezinhlelo. Ulwazi lweminqubo yezimbona kanye nokuqwashelwa kwabo okukhulu okukhuluma nge-greenhouse gas. Isikhathi sokuhlola okukhulunywa nge-greenhouse gas. Ukuqonda iphrofayela yokuqwashelwa kwamagazi ye-South Africa kanye nethuba lokulwa nokushintshwa kwesimo sezulu. Ulwazi olunzima ngemibuzo yokweswa kwesimo sezulu, okuhlanganisa izindlela zomthetho kanye nezinhlelo zesimo kanye nezinye izinselelo, amandla emali kanye nezidingo zezobuchwepheshe zentuthuko ezingachithi khwalithi. Isikhathi sokwenza ucwaningo, ukuthola nokuxazula ulwazi. Ulwazi lwekhemistriledloonga kanye nokuqashwa kokulandelwa kweminqubo yezimbona. Ukuthola kanye nokuhlaziya imininingwane. Ukulinganisa kanye nokuqondanisa. Amaphuzu abaluleke ahle ekuxhumeni (okubhaliwe kanye nezwi elikhulunywayo), ekuhlaziyeni, ekulawulweni kanye nokubhaliwe emibikweni. Ukuphatha ulwazi. Indima yokubekezela kanye nozwano.
zu.duties: Yenza ukuqinisekiswa kombiko wekhabhoni tex. Yenza ukuqinisekisa ngamandla kanye nokuqhuba ukutholwa kwemibiko ye-GHG ngamazinga enkampani ukuze ukusekele kuminqubo yokuqinisekisa ikhabhoni tex ye-IPPU kanye namaSoki. Xazula ukuqedelelwa, ukuqondile, kanye nezimo zokulingana komthetho emininingwaneni yegesi ethunyelwa izinhlangano eziphathelwe umthetho. Hlola izinkulumo zokuqinisekisa kanye nemibiko yabaxazuli abangakhulumi ukugcina ukuhambisana nezidingo zomthetho. Sebenzisana namaphephandaba aphathelene nokuqinisekisa ukuhambisana phakathi kwamagesi abikwe, okuhunyushiwe ngekhaphoni tex, kanye nemininingwane yezwe. Nikeza isiqondiso esisesikhundini sobuchwepheshe kanye nokuLawulwa Kwebhali lwe-Amandla. Qonda ukuthuthukiswa, okuhlanganisiwe, nokukhuliswa kwemibiko ye-GHG yamandla ngokuhambisana nezindlela ze-IPCC kanye nezidingo zokubika ze-UNFCCC. Qaphela ukukethwa kweminingwane, ukuthuthukiswa kwesilinganisi sokukhishwa kwamagesi, kanye nokuphatha imininingwane yemininingwane ukuze kugcinwe ubuchwepheshe esikoleni. Sekela ukwabiwa kwezibalo zekhabhoni tamkhampuni zamandla enkampani. Sekela ukuthuthukiswa kwezikhwelo zamagesi e-GHG. Yenza ukulinganisa kwayesenzo lwaso nokuhlaziya imicimu yamagesi e-Green House. Sekela ukuthuthukiswa nokusetshenziswa kwamamodeli okubukiswa kwamagesi kwamandla okwazisa izindlela zokweswa zezwe. Hlaziya iplani yokutholakala kwezinye izimo zamagesi ukuze kuhloliswe umphumela ongaba khona wenqubomgomo, imithetho, kanye nokupekula kobuchwepheshe. Sebenzisana namaqembu okulinganisa, izikhungo zocwaningo, kanye namayunithi enqubomgomo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhambisana phakathi kwemininingwane yebhali kanye nokubukiswa. Yenza izifundo zocwaningo kanye nokuphatha izinkalo zokuphathelwa nemali. Hola futhi uqondanise izifundo zocwaningo eziqondiswe ekwenzeni kuba yilula ekuqashweni kwamagesi, izilinganiso zamagesi, izinketho zokweswa, kanye nezinhlelo zeminingwane kwamandla. Thola izidingo zocwaningo eziphambili ukuze kuhlongakwe imibuzo yebhali, izinselelo zokuqinisekisa, kanye nezikhala zokulinganisa. Sekela ukwethula, ukwaba, nokuLawula imali yokucwaninga nokuhlaziya okukhethekile komkhakha. Hlaziya futhi uhlanganise imiphumela yocwaningo emibhalweni yezwe, emapulatifomu okulinganisa, kanye nemithele yenqubomgomo. Thuthukisa izinhlelo zeminingwane futhi uqonde ukuqhubela phambili ngokuqhubekayo. Sekela ukuthuthukiswa kokulawula, ukubika, kanye nokuqinisekisa iminingwane ye-GHG komkhakha wamandla. Khuthaza ukuhlanganisa phakathi kwezakhwazi zemibhalo, amathuluzi okulinganisa, kanye namapulatifomu okubika komthetho. Londa izinhlela ezinhle zethe ithembe liye futhi uphakamise izinto ezintsha ukuze kugcwalaliswe amasistemu okubuka, ukuqinisekisa, kanye nokulinganisa.

xh.title: Umntu Ophakamileyo Ochwepheshe: Ukubika kweGazi eliluhlaza iNgcambu – I-Energy
xh.summary: Isithuba somntu ophakamileyo ochwepheshe sokucinga iingxelo zegazi eliluhlaza ngenkaphamko yomsi ohamba phambili, sidinga izidanga ze-Master's kunye neminye emihlanu (5) yamava ahambelanayo kwunjinelo yemveliso okanye yamachiza.
xh.requirements: Isidanga se-Master's Degree (NQF 9) kwi-Chemical Engineering, i-Natural okanye i-Environmental Sciences okanye nelifundo elihambelanayo njengoko livunywa yi-SAQA. Iminyaka emihlanu (5) yamava kwinkalo ehambelanayo. Ulwazi ngemiba yemvelo nentlulongo (kwihlabathi jikelele, ngamazwe, ngasemzini). Ukuqonda okulungeleyo nolwazi ngokuqhuba nokubamba iindidi zomsi ohamba phambili, njengoko kunjalo nakuvela amachapho kunye nokuba yamachapho kumanqanaba ahambelanayo. Ulawulo lweenkqubo kunye noLawulo lweProjekhthi. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yamashishini kunye nomsi ohamba phambili ovela kuyo. Ikakhulu lokubakwayo ukwenza ukucinga ngeemissions zomsi ohamba phambili. Ukuqonda iprofayile yemissions zomsi ohamba phambili e-South Africa kunye nokunciphisa iinguquko zemozulu. Ulwazi olubanzi ngemiba yokunciphisa iinguquko zemozulu, kuquka iinkqubo zomthetho nemigaqo kunye nezithintelo ezizezinye, uthotho loqoqosho kunye neemfuno ezisezantsi zolwazi lobuchwepheshe ekwakhiweni okusezantsi komsi ohamba phambili. Ikakhulu lokubakwayo ukwenza uphononongo, ukuqokelela nokuhlola ulwazi. Ulwazi ngekhemistri yomoya kunye nokusetyenziswa kweenkqubo zemashishini. Ukuqokelela nokuhlola idatha. Ukuyila inkqubo nokuqamba unako. Amaphawu amnini okuthetha nokubhala, ukuhlola, ukuqamba kunye nokubhala iingxelo. Ulawulo lolwazi. Isazela kunye nokuzinikela.
xh.duties: Yenza ukuqinisekisa kweNgxelo ngenkaphamko yomsi ohamba phambili. Yenza ukuqinisekisa ngokobuchwepheshe nokuqinisekisa iingxelo ze-GHG ezikumanqanaba ekhaya kwishishini ngenjongo yokuxhasa iinkqubo zokuqinisekisa inkaphamko yomsi ohamba phambili kwi-IPPU kunye nokuYeya. Hlola ukugqibelela, ukuchaneka, kunye nokufaneleka kweendlela zedatha yomsi ohamba phambili ezenziwe ziinkqubo ezilawulwayo. Linganisa iingxelo zokuqinisekisa nezixhobo ezizimeleyo zokuqinisekisa ngenjongo yokwenza iqondo lokuzithoba kumfuno wokulawula. Sebenzisana namagunya ahambelanayo ngenjongo yokwenza iqondo phakathi kwomsi ohamba phambili obikiweyo, iziphulu zenkaphamko yomsi, kunye nedatha yembekiselwa sikawonke-wonke. Yela isiKhokelo ngeBuchwepheshe kunye noLawulo lweNkunzi yolwazi kumanqanaba e-Energy. Qhatha ukuphuhliswa, ukuqokelelwa, nokuphuculwa kweenkunzi zolwazi ze-GHG kwi-Energy ngokwemigaqo ye-IPCC kunye neemfuno zokubika ze-UNFCCC. Qaphela ukukhethwa kweendlela, ukuphuhliswa kweefektha zomsi ohamba phambili, kunye nolawulo lwedatha yokusebenza ngenjongo yokuqinisekisa ukuzinza kwezenzululwazi. Xhasa ukwabiwa kweemaleko zomsi ohamba phambili zamashishini kumanqanaba e-Energy. Xhasa ukuphuhliswa kweedatha zemali zomsi ohamba phambili. Yenza ukuyila nokuhlola imeko yomsi ohamba phambili ohamba phambili. Xhasa ukuphuhliswa nokusetyenziswa kweekhowudhi zokuqikelela umsi ohamba phambili kumanqanaba e-Energy ngenjongo yokulungiselela iindlela zokunciphisa umsi ohamba phambili e-Wonke-wonke. Hlola imeko yokuqala kunye nezinye iimeko ezahlukeneyo zomsi ohamba phambili ngenjongo yokulinganisa amandla okuba khona okuchukumisayo kwemigaqo, iinkqubo zolawulo, kunye neenkqubo zobuchwepheshe. Sebenzisana namaqela okuyila iinkqubo, iisikhululo zophononongo, kunye namayunithi wemigaqo ngenjongo yokwenza iqondo phakathi kwedatha yembekiselwa kunye neenkqubo zokuqikelela. Yenza izifundo zophononongo kunye nokuphuhliswa kweekhampasi zemali. Qondisa nokuqamba izifundo zophononongo ezikhokela ekuphuculeni ukuqikelela umsi ohamba phambili, iifaktha zomsi ohamba phambili, iinketho zokunciphisa umsi, kunye neenkqubo zedatha kumanqanaba e-Energy. Phawula iimfuno eziphambili zophononongo ngenjongo yokusombulula ukungagqibeki kwenkunzi yolwazi, iingcinga zokuqinisekisa, kunye namathuba okuyila iinkqubo. Xhasa ukwenza amandla, ukwabiwa, kunye nolawulo lwemali ngophononongo oluchaphazelekayo ngeenkalo ezithile kunye nezifundo zokuqonda. Cinga nokucrefa iziphumo zophononongo kwinkunzi yolwazi yowonke-wonke, iinkqubo zokuyila, kunye neenkqubo zemigaqo. Phucula iinkqubo zedatha uze uzobe ukuphucula ngokuya phambili. Xhasa ukuphuculwa kolawulo lwedatha ye-GHG, ukubika, kunye neenkqubo zokuqinisekisa kwinkalo yamandla. Khuthaza ukudityaniswa phakathi kwedatha yembekiselwa, izixhobo zokuyila, kunye nezixhobo zokubika ngokwemigaqo. Qaphela iinkqubo ezilungileyo kwihlabathi jikelele uze ziphakamise iindlela entsha zokuzinza iinkunzi yolwazi, ukuqinisekisa, kunye neenkqubo zokuyila.

jobs.title: Senior Specialist: Land USE, Land USE Change and Forestry
jobs.department: Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment
jobs.centre: Pretoria REQUIREMENT    :   Master’s Degree (NQF 9) in Forestry or Natural Resource Sciences, Environmental Management or Sciences or relevant qualification as recognised by SAQA. Five (5) years’ experience in the relevant field. Knowledge of environmental and development issues (globally, regionally, locally). Excellent understanding and knowledge of emission and sequestration processes, as well as sources and sinks in the respective sectors. Programme and Project Management. Knowledge of Land-use and land-cover platforms. Understanding of South Africa’s greenhouse gas emission profile and climate change mitigation. Knowledge of Climate change mitigation issues, including legal and policy frameworks, economics and technical aspects of low-carbon development, and carbon finance. Ability to conduct research, gather and analyse information. Data collection and analysis. Modelling and coordination. Good communication (written and spoken), analytical, organisational and report writing skills. Information Management. Sense of responsibility and loyalty.
jobs.closing_date_text: 31 August 2026, 16:00. No late application will be accepted
jobs.summary: Senior specialist role compiling the national LULUCF greenhouse gas inventory, requiring a master's degree and five years' relevant experience.
jobs.duties: Compile Land Use, Land Use Change and Forestry Inventory. Lead the compilation and annual review of the LULUCF component of South Africa’s National Greenhouse Gas (GHG) Inventory. Identify data and information requirements for LULUCF emissions estimation. Collect, collate, and validate data for the Forest and Other Land Use (FOLU) sector. Conduct QA/QC processes and ensure data integrity and methodological consistency. Compile LULUCF emission inventory reports and implement GHG improvement programmes. Review Carbon Sequestration. Review sequestration submissions from GHG reporting entities for Carbon Tax compliance. Conduct research to identify other activities that need to be subjected to carbon sequestration under the carbon tax. Oversee the independent verification scheme for carbon sequestration. Collaborate with the forestry and pulp and paper industry to improve transparency in reporting by third-party timber growers. Manage Land Mapping and Data Systems. Set up and operationalise a land-mapping platform to support sustainable LULUCF emissions compilation. Develop and maintain land-use change datasets and land-use change matrices. Analyse mitigation actions using geospatial and land-use data. Strengthen digital systems that support LULUCF monitoring, reporting and verification (MRV). Provide Governance and Reporting Support. Support implementation of the Climate Change Act, specifically as it relates to LULUCF and land-based emissions. Contribute to domestic and international reporting, including Biennial Transparency Reports (BTRs), National Communications, and other UNFCCC submissions. Support the development and operationalisation of standards and guidelines for the FOLU sector.

af.title: Senior Spesialis: Land USE, Land USE Change and Forestry
af.summary: Senior spesialispos wat die nasionale LULUCF-kweekhuisgas-inventaris opstel, 'n meestersgraad en vyf jaar se relevante ervaring vereis.
af.duties: Stel die Land Use, Land Use Change and Forestry-inventaris op. Lei die opstelling en jaarlikse hersiening van die LULUCF-komponent van South Africa se Nasionale Kweekhuisgas- (GHG) inventaris. Identifiseer data- en inligtingsvereistes vir LULUCF-emissieskatting. Versamel, kollasioneer en valideer data vir die Forest and Other Land Use- (FOLU) sektor. Voer QA/QC-prosesse uit en verseker data-integriteit en metodologiese konsekwentheid. Stel LULUCF-emissie-inventarisverslae op en implementeer GHG-verbeteringsprogramme. Hersien Koolstofsekwestrasie. Hersien sekwestrasie-voorleggings van GHG-rapporteringsentiteite vir Carbon Tax-nakoming. Doen navorsing om ander aktiwiteite te identifiseer wat vir koolstofsekwestrasie onder die koolstofbelasting in aanmerking moet kom. Hou toesig oor die onafhanklike verifikasieskema vir koolstofsekwestrasie. Werk saam met die bosbou- en pulpen papierbedryf om deursigtigheid in verslagdoening deur derdeparty-houtkwekers te verbeter. Bestuur Landkartering en Datastelsels. Stel 'n landkarteringsplatform op en opereer dit om volhoubare LULUCF-emissiekompilering te ondersteun. Ontwikkel en onderhou landgebruikverandering-datasette en landgebruikverandering-matryse. Analiseer mitigasie-aksies met behulp van geospatiale en landgebruikdata. Versterk digitale stelsels wat LULUCF-monitering, verslagdoening en verifikasie (MRV) ondersteun. Verskaf Bestuurs- en Verslagdoeningsondersteuning. Ondersteun die implementering van die Climate Change Act, spesifiek soos dit verband hou met LULUCF en landgebaseerde emissies. Dra by tot plaaslike en internasionale verslagdoening, insluitend Biennial Transparency Reports (BTRs), National Communications en ander UNFCCC-voorleggings. Ondersteun die ontwikkeling en operasionele instelling van standaarde en riglyne vir die FOLU-sektor.

zu.title: Ochwepheshe Ophakeme: Ukusetshenziswa Kwemvelo, Ukushintshwa Kokusetshenziswa Kwemvelo Nezahlule
zu.summary: Isikhundla sochwepheshe ophakeme sokuhlela inhlelo yamazwe ngamazwe yamagesi ayinhlobo ye-LULUCF, esifuna iziqu ze-master's kanye neminyaka emihlanu yohlaka lokusebenza oluhambisanayo.
zu.duties: Hlela Inhlelo Yokusetshenziswa Kwemvelo, Ukushintshwa Kokusetshenziswa Kwemvelo Nezahlule. Hola ukuhlelwa kanye nenhloloye ngonyaka yenxenye ye-LULUCF ye-National Greenhouse Gas (GHG) Inventory yaseSouth Africa. Hlazi imininingwane nezidingo zolwazi wokuqagela ukukhishwa kwamagesi ye-LULUCF. Qoqa, hlanganisa futhi qinisekisa imininingwane yenxulumo ye-Forest and Other Land Use (FOLU). Yenza izinqubo ze-QA/QC futhi qinisekise ukuzinza kwemininingwane kanye nokuhambisana kwezindlela. Hlela imibiko yenhlelo yamagesi ayikhishwayo ye-LULUCF futhi yenza izinhlela zokuthuthukisa i-GHG. Hlola Ukubambwa KweKhabhoni. Hlola okuhlolwayo kokubamba ikhabhoni okuthunyelwe izikhulu ezibika i-GHG ngenjongo yokuzilandela inketho yekhabhoni. Yenza ucwaningo ukuze kutholakale eminye imisebenzi okufanele ibe ngokusuka ekubambeni ikhabhoni ngaphansi kwenketho yekhabhoni. Qapha isimu yokuhlola okuzimele yokubamba ikhabhoni. Sebenzisana nenxulume yezahlule kanye noshizi wamaphephaoshizi ukuthuthukisa ukucace emibikweni abalimi besithathu bamapulangwe. Phatha Ukumiswa Kwemibhalo Nemitholophaladi Yemvelo. Saka futhienze sisebenze ipulatifomu lokuqamba imibhalo yemvelo elisekela ukuhlelwa kwamagesi aholekayo e-LULUCF. Yakha futhi zigcine imininingwane yokushintshwa kokusetshenziswa kwemvelo kanye namamukshe wokushintshwa kokusetshenziswa kwemvelo. Chaza izinyathelo zokunciphisa ukukhishwa kwamagesi kusetshenziswa imininingwane yendawo kanye nalomcwetshwa wemibhalo yemvelo. Qinisa izimiso ezingamakhomphyutha ezigxile ekuqaphekeni, ekuqaphekeni kwezimibiko nasekuqaphekeni okungavivinywa (MRV) kwe-LULUCF. Nika usizo ezindabeni zokuphatha nokubika. Sekela ukuqaliswa kwe-Climate Change Act, ikakhulukazi lapho kuhlobene ne-LULUCF namagesi asuka emhlabathini. Yisisekelo ekubikweni kwemaphakathi nakwamanye amazwe, okuhlanganisa imibiko ye-Biennial Transparency Reports (BTRs), National Communications, nezinye izibiko ze-UNFCCC. Sekela ukwakhiwa kanye nekuqaliswa kwemigomo nezinqubo zenxulumo ye-FOLU.

xh.title: Umbelelwane Ophakamileyo: Ukusetyenziswa Kolwandle, Utshintsho Lokusetyenziswa Kolwandle noMthi
xh.summary: Inkundla yombelelwane ophakamileyo ekwakheni uluhlu lwesizwe lwegaz lekhaya le-LULUCF, ifuna isidanga se-master's kunye neminye emihlanu yamava ahambelanayo.
xh.duties: Hlanganisa Uluhlu lokuSetyenziswa koLwandle, uTshintsho loKusetyenziswa koLwandle noMthi. Qhuba ukuhlanganiswa nokuphonononga ngamnye kwelungu le-LULUCF koluhlu lwesiZwe sase-South Africa leGaz leKhaya (GHG). Ngenisa iimfuno zedata nenkcazelo efunekayo ukulinganisa iinkkcukacha ze-LULUCF. Qokelela, hlanganisa, uqinisekise idata yommandla we-Forest and Other Land Use (FOLU). Qhuba iinkqubo ze-QA/QC uze uqinisekise ukuzinza kwedata nokuhambelana kwendlela. Hlanganisa iingxelo zoluhlu lweenkcukacha ze-LULUCF uze usebenzise iinkqubo zophuculo lwe-GHG. Phonononga ukuQokelelwa koMthwamzilo. Phonononga izibhalo zokuqokelelwa komthwamzilo ezivela kumanikeli bengxelo ze-GHG ngokwokuhanjiswa koMthwamzilo wotywala. Qhuba uphando ukuze uzibe ezinye izentla ezifuna ukuqokelelwa komthwamzilo ngaphantsi komthwamzilo wotywala. Lawula inkqubo yokuzinza ngokwayo yokulinganisa ukuqokelelwa komthwamzilo. Sebenzisana noshishino lomthi, lwephepha nolwamaphepha ukuphucula ukucaca ekwenziweni kwengxelo ngabeluni bamaxa abathathi ngxelo. Lawula ukuQhagara kolwandle noNnqubo zeData. Misela uze uyisebenzise inkqaba yokumapu kolwandle ukuxhasa ukuhlanganiswa kweekcukacha ze-LULUCF ezizinzo. Phepha uze ulondoloze iiseti zedata zotshintsho lokusetyenziswa kolwandle kunye namathirixi otshintsho lokusetyenziswa kolwandle. Hlaziisa izenzo zokunciphisa (mitigation) zisetyenziswa idatha yendawo (geospatial) nolwandle. Phucula iinkqubo zesikrini ezixhasa okuqwalaselwa, iingxelo nokuqinisekisa (MRV) kwe-LULUCF. Nikela ngoNxaxhiwookuLawula nokuBika. Xhasa ukusebenzisa iMthetho yeTshintsho loBhalo, ngokukodwa njengoko ihambelana ne-LULUCF namba kwekhaya. Qhubele ekubikeni ekhaya nakwilizwe lonke, kuquka iingxelo zeBiennial Transparency Reports (BTRs), iNgxelo yaseZwe, nenezinye izibhalo ze-UNFCCC. Xhasa ukuphucwa nokusebenzisa iinkqubo nemikhawulelo yommandla we-FOLU.

jobs.title: Senior Specialist: Carbon TAX and Emissions Trading
jobs.department: Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment
jobs.closing_date_text: 31 August 2026, 16:00. No late application will be accepted
jobs.summary: Oversee the implementation and administration of the Carbon Tax, coordinating with SARS on verification processes and carbon budget compliance.
jobs.requirements: Master’s Degree (NQF 9) in Chemical Engineering, Natural or Environmental Sciences or relevant qualification as recognized by SAQA. Five (5) years’ experience in the relevant field. Knowledge of environmental and development issues (globally, regionally, locally). Good understanding of emissions estimation methodologies for industrial processes. Ability to conduct research. Knowledge of independent verification processes. Programme and Project Management. Knowledge of carbon tax legislation, GHG reporting. Data collection and analysis. Knowledge of corporate GHG reporting frameworks, GHG Protocol, Corporate Accounting and reporting standards, GRI Standards. Good analytical and mathematical competency. Knowledge of Climate change mitigation issues, including legal and policy frameworks, economics and technical aspects of low-carbon development, and carbon finance. Ability to gather and analyse information. Modelling and coordination. Good communication (written and spoken), analytical, organisational and report writing skills. Information Management. Sense of responsibility and loyalty.
jobs.duties: Oversee the implementation and administration of the Carbon Tax. Coordinate with SARS for carbon tax verification processes. Work with SARS to ensure the Carbon Tax- Carbon Budget compliance accounting system is working efficiently and errors are avoided. Facilitate workshops and consultations to improve reporting quality and compliance. Represent the department in intergovernmental and technical forums on GHG reporting and carbon tax. Manage and implement data validation and verification procedures. Oversee the reviews of GHG emissions reports submitted by regulated entities. Validate data accuracy against prescribed methodologies under the Climate Change Act and Carbon Tax Act. Oversee the Identification discrepancies and initiate corrective actions with data providers. Prepare verification reports for internal use and for SARS to support carbon tax liability assessments. Prepare an annual report on the state of carbon tax/trading emissions accounting containing recommendations for continuous improvement. Implement Quality Assurance and Quality Control measures within data systems. Design and implement robust Quality Assurance/Quality Control protocols for emissions data. Conduct periodic audits of data systems and reporting processes. Train internal teams and external stakeholders on QA/QC standards. Develop Emission Methodologies. Guide the development, refinement, and implementation of emissions reporting methodologies, tools, and sector- specific approaches for regulated activities. Provide technical guidance and clarification to industry on emissions estimation methods, data quality requirements, and reporting obligations. Strengthen emissions reporting frameworks while maintaining regulatory integrity. Periodically review the validation and verification guidelines for GHG emissions reporting, carbon budgets and mitigation plans.

af.title: Senior Spesialis: Koolstofbelasting en Emisshandel
af.summary: Hou toesig oor die implementering en administrasie van die Koolstofbelasting, in samewerking met SARS oor verifikasieprosesse en koolstofbegrotingsnakoming.
af.requirements: Meestergraad (NQF 9) in Chemiese Ingenieurswese, Natuur- of Omgigingswetenskappe of 'n relevante kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken. Vyf (5) jaar se ervaring in die relevante veld. Kennis van omgewings- en ontwikkelingsvraagstukke (globaal, streeks, lokaal). Goeie begrip van emissieskatmetodes vir nywerheidsprosesse. Vermoë om navorsing te doen. Kennis van onafhanklike verifikasieprosesse. Program- en projektbestuur. Kennis van koolstofbelastingwetgewing, GHG-verslagdoening. Dataversameling en -analise. Kennis van korporatiewe GHG-verslagdoeningsraamwerke, GHG-protokol, Korporatiewe Rekeningkunde en verslagdoeningsstandaarde, GRI-standaarde. Goeie analitiese en wiskundige bevoegdheid. Kennis van klimaatsverandering-mitigasiekwessies, insluitend regs- en beleidsraamwerke, ekonomiese en tegniese aspekte van lae-koolstofontwikkeling, en koolstoffinansiering. Vermoë om inligting te versamel en te ontleed. Modellering en koördinasie. Goeie kommunikasie (skriftelik en mondelings), analitiese, organisatoriese en verslagdoeningsvaardighede. Inligtingsbestuur. Sin van verantwoordelikheid en lojaliteit.
af.duties: Hou toesig oor die implementering en administrasie van die Koolstofbelasting. Koördineer met SARS vir koolstofbelastingverifikasieprosesse. Werk met SARS om te verseker dat die Koolstofbelasting-Koolstofbegroting-nakomingsrekeningkundige stelsel doeltreffend werk en foute vermy word. Fasiliteer werkswinkels en konsultasies om verslagdoeningsgehalte en nakoming te verbeter. Verteenwoordig die departement in intergoewermentele en tegniese forums oor GHG-verslagdoening en koolstofbelasting. Bestuur en implementeer datavalidering- en verifikasieprosedures. Hou toesig oor die hersiening van GHG-emissieverslae wat deur gereguleerde entiteite ingedien word. Valideer datanauwkurigheid teenoor voorgeskrewe metodes onder die Climate Change Act en Carbon Tax Act. Hou toesig oor die identifisering van diskrepansies en inisieer korrigerende optrede met dataverskaffers. Berei verifikasieverslae voor vir interne gebruik en vir SARS om koolstofbelastingaanspreeklikheidsassesserings te ondersteun. Berei 'n jaarlikse verslag oor die stand van koolstofbelasting/emisshandel-rekeningkunde voor wat aanbevelings vir deurlopende verbetering bevat. Implementeer Kwaliteitsversekerings- en Kwaliteitsbeheermaatreëls binne datastelsels. Ontwerp en implementeer robuuste Kwaliteitsversekerings/Kwaliteitsbeheer-protokolle vir emissiedata. Voer periodieke oudits van datastelsels en verslagdoeningsprosesse uit. Lei interne spanne en eksterne belanghebbendes op oor KV/KB-standaarde. Ontwikkel Emissie-metodes. Lei die ontwikkeling, verfyning en implementering van emissieverslagdoeningsmetodes, instrumente en sektor-spesifieke benaderings vir gereguleerde aktiwiteite. Verskaf tegniese leiding en opheldering aan die nywerheid oor emissieskatmetodes, datakwaliteitsvereistes en verslagdoeningsverpligtinge. Versterk emissieverslagdoeningsraamwerke terwyl regulatoriese integriteit gehandhaaf word. Hersien periodiek die validerings- en verifikasieriglyne vir GHG-emissieverslagdoening, koolstofbegrotings en mitigasieplanne.

zu.title: Owesethu Ophakeme: Itheksi Yekhabhoni NokuHweba Ngokukhishwa Kwemitha Eyingozi
zu.summary: Qapha ukusetshenziswa kanye nokuqashwa kweTheksi Yekhabhoni, ukusebenzisana neSARS ekwenzeni inqubo yokugcina ukutholakala kwezinto kanye nokuhambisana nezidingo zekhabhoni ezingabizi kakhulu.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zeMaster's Degree (NQF 9) kuChemical Engineering, Natural or Environmental Sciences noma iziqu ezifanele njengokuqashwa yiSAQA. Uphethe iminyaka eyihlanu (5) wesipiliyoni emkhakheni ohambisanayo. Ulwazi ngezinkinga zemvelo nentuthuko (kuzwe lonke, esifundeni, endaweni). Ukuqonda kahle izindlela zokulinganisa ukukhishwa kwemitha eyingozi ezinkampanini ezinkulu. Ikono lokwenza ucwaningo. Ulwazi ngokuhamba kwemikhuba yokugcina ukutholakala kwezinto okuzimele. Ukulawula uhlelo kanye nokuqashwa kwamaphrojekthi. Ulwazi ngemithetho yethensi yekhabhoni, ukubika kweGHG. Ukuqoqwa kanye nokuhlaziya idatha. Ulwazi ngezinhlelo zokubika zeGHG zamakampani, iGHG Protocol, izindinganiso zokubalwa kwezimali nokubika kwamakhonikathi, izindinganiso zeGRI. Ikholo lokuhlaziya nokubala izibalo ngokugcizelela. Ulwazi ngezinkinga zokunciphisa ukushintshwa kwesimo sezulu, okuhlanganisa izinhlelo zomthetho kanye nenqubo yomthetho, amabhange nezindaba eziphathelene nokuthuthukiswa okusemphezulu kwesibalo esinguzuba, kanye nentela yekhabhoni. Ikholo lokuqoqa nokuhlaziya imininingwane. Ukumisa izibonelo kanye nokuqoqisa. Amakhono wokuxhumana (okubhalwayo nokukhulunwayo), ukuhlaziya, ukulawula kanye nokubika. Ukulawula imininingwane. Inzwelo eziqhenywa kwayo kulo ovela kuyo kanye nobuhlobo obuhle.
zu.duties: Qapha ukusetshenziswa kanye nokuqashwa kweTheksi Yekhabhoni. Sebenzisana neSARS kumakhono okuhlola ukutholakala kwethensi yekhabhoni. Sebenzisana neSARS ukuze kuqiniseke ukuthi uhlelo lokuphathwa kwamaphaphu wekhabhoni lusebenza ngempumelelo futhi kugwemenwe amaphutha. Lula imikhosi yokuqeqesha kanye nemibuzo ukuze kube khona ukwenza ngcono ukubika kanye nokuhambisana nomthetho. Mela umnyango emikhosini kahulumeni wesifunda kanye nasemikhosini yamakhono ngokubika kweGHG kanye nethensi yekhabhoni. Lawula futhi usebenzise izindlela zokuqinisekiswa kanye nokugcina ukutholakala kwezinto. Qapha ukuhlolwa kwemibiko yokukhishwa kweGHG ethunyelwe yizinkampani eziyisigcushwa. Qinisekisa ukuthi imininingwane iyiqiniso ngokuhambisana nezindlela ezimisiwe ngaphansi koMthetho Wokushintsha Isimo Sezulu noMthetho WeTheksi Yekhabhoni. Qapha ukutholakala kwezinto ezingahambisani bese uqala izinyathelo zokulungisa abanikela imininingwane. Lungiselela imibiko yokugcina ukutholakala kwezinto yokusetshenziswa ngaphakathi kanye neyokuNqunywa kweSARS ukuze kusekelwe ukuqashwa kokubelethwa kuthensi yekhabhoni. Lungiselela umbiko wonyaka wentela yesimo sokuqashwa kwezimali zethensi yekhabhoni noma ukuhweba ngokukhishwa kwezinto okuhlanganisa izincomo zokwenza ngcono ngokuqhubekayo. Sebenzisa izinyathelo Zokuqinisekisa Ikhwalithi Nokulawula Ikhwalithi ngaphakathi kwezinhlelo zeminingwane. Hlola futhi usebenzise izinkambiso ezibambe iqhaza zokuqinisekisa khwalithi/ezokulawula khwalithi ezibambe iqhaza ngemininingwane yokukhishwa kwezinto. Yenza izivivinyo ezitholakala ngasikhathi samininingwane ngokwemvelo kwesistimu yemininingwane kanye nokuqhubwa kombiko. Qeqesha amaqembu angaphakathi nangaphandle kwezindinganiso zeQA/QC. Kha futhi uhlele izindlela zokuqashwa kwemininingwane. Qondisa ukwakhiwa, ukuhlaziywa, kanye nokusetshenziswa kwezindlela zokubika ukukhishwa kwemitha ezingozi, amathuluzi, kanye nezindlela ezihambisana nothisi wemisebenzi kumabhizinisi lawo alawulwayo. Nikeza inqondohle yokuhlela ibhizinisi ngokusemthethweni kwezindlela zokulinganisa ukukhishwa kwezinto, izidingo zekhwalithi yemininingwane, kanye nezibopho zombiko. Phuhlisa izinhlelo zokubika ukukhishwa kwemitha ezingozi ngokugcizelela ulwongo olusemthethweni. Hlola ngasikhathi sasinke izinkambiso zokuqinisekiswa nokugcina ukutholakala kwemininingwane ngokubika kokukhishwa kweGHG, amaphaphu wekhabhoni kanye nokuqashwa kwamaphulo okuNquma ukushintsha ukutholakala kwezinto ezikharayo.

xh.title: Umchwathi oPhakamileyo: I-Rhafu yeKhabhon nokuThengiswa kweZithuthi
xh.summary: Qhobosela ukusebenza nokuqulunqwa kweRhafu yeKhabhon, udibanise neSARS kwiinkqubo zokuqinisekisa nokuthobela imigca yejikelezo lekhabhon.
xh.requirements: Iza kuba nezidanga zeMasters (NQF 9) kwiNzululwazi woBuchwepheshe beMakhowala, eeZenzululwazi eZeNdalo okanye ezeNdalo iseeNyanga, okanye isidanga esifanelekileyo njengoko sivunywe yiSAQA. Ziiyure ezintlanu (5) zemisebenzi kwinkundla echwepherezileyo. Ulwazi ngemiba yokutsha ngokwendalo nentlhabolho (emazwe aphesheya, ngakwela candelo, nakwindawo). Ukuqonda kakuhle iindlela zokuqikelela izithuthi kwiinkqubo zoshishino. Ukuba nako ukwenza ucandelo-lwazi. Ulwazi ngeenkqubo zokuqinisekisa ngazodwa. Ukuqulunqwa kweNkqubo nokoQulunqwa lweeProjekthi. Ulwazi ngomthetho werhafu yekhabhon, nokubika kweGHG. Ukuqokelela nokuqonda iingcombolo. Ulwazi ngeenkqubo zokubika iGHG kamanyano, iNkqubo yeGHG, iNkqubo yoKubala nokubika ngokumalunga namakampani, neeNqila zeGRI. Ukuba nako okuphakamileyo lokuhlola ngeesayensi nakumanani. Ulwazi ngeemba zokuthomalalisa iinguquko ezimothe weather, kuquka iinkqubo zomthetho nezeplani, amazoqoqo kuneendlela ezikumgangatho ophezulu wokuhlaziya iindawo ezinentsubethongo encinci yekhabhon, nokuwhothiswa kwekhabhon. Ukuba nako ukuqokelela nokuqonda iingcombolo. Ukuqulunqa iindlela zokusebenza kwaye uqwalasele. Amakhono amampompo aphilayo (okubhaliweyo nokuwethula), ukuhlola, ukuqulunqa iinkqubo, nakubika. Ukuqulunqwa kweeNkcukacha. Inkcubeko yokubathathela ixanduva nokuqina.
xh.duties: Qhobosela ukusebenza nokuqulunqwa kweRhafu yekhabhon. Udibanise neSARS ngenkqubo yokuqinisekisa irhafu yekhabhon. Sebenza neSARS ukuqinisekisa ukuba inkqubo yokubala ukuthobela iRhafu yeKhabhon - umGca oJikelezo weKhabhon isebenza ngempumelelo kwaye zithintelwe iimpazamo. Yenza iindiba zamazwi nokupepelela ukuphucula umgangatho wokubika nokuwathobela. Mela isebi kwinkundla zolawulo lwesihlwele kuneendawo zohlaziyo ngeendaba zokubika iGHG neRhafu yekhabhon. Yolisa kwaye usebenzise iinkqubo zokuqinisekisa nokusetyenziswa kweingcombolo. Qhobosela ukuhlola iingxelo zezithuthi zeGHG ezithunyelwa ziinkampani ezilawulwayo. Qinisekisa ukuchaneka kweedatha ngokwale nkqubo echaziweyo phantsi koMthetho woTshintsho lweZimo yoBwilili noMthetho weRhafu yeKhabhon. Qhobosela ukuchonga iingxaki ezikhoyo kwaye uqalise iinyAMEKO zokulungisa kunye nabathunyeli beedatha. Lungiselela iingxelo zokuqinisekisa eziza kusetyenziswa ngaphakathi nakuSARS ukuxhasa iintlolingqangi zorhafu yekhabhon. Lungiselela ingxelo yonyaka ngemo yokubala irhafu yekhabhon/okuthengiswa kwezithuthi equkene iingcebo zokuqhubeka ngokuphucula. Sebenzisa iinkqubo zoQinisekiso loMganga oPhezulu nokuLawulwa kokuQinisekisa ngaphakathi kweenkqubo zeedatha. Yila kwaye usebenzise iinkqubo zoQinisekiso loMganga oPhezulu/uLawulwa kokuQinisekisa ezomeleleyo zezeedatha zezithuthi. Yenza ukuhlolwa kwexesha nexesha kweenkqubo zeedatha nokuzelelwa kweenkqubo zokubika. Qeqesha iindawo ezisebenza ngaphakathi kwaye nabanye bashukumiswayo ngamalungiselelo oQA/QC. Yila iindlela zokuqikelela izithuthi. Qondisa ukuyila, ukucoca nokusebenzisa iindlela zokubika izithuthi, izixhobo, nokuqwalasela ngokwendalo yamashishini kwiinkqubo ezilawulwayo. Nikezela isixhobo sokukhokela nokucacisa kumashishini ngeendlela zokuqikelela izithuthi, iimfuno zobunyani beedatha, nemiba yokuzeba. Phucula iinkqubo zokubika izithuthi ngelixa uqhubeka uligcina unyanyiso lwesihlwele lwomthetho. Hlola ngoncedo lwexesha nalexesha iindlela zokuqinisekisa nokusetyenziswa kolwazi lokubika izithuthi zeGHG, imigca yamakhaya yekhabhon, neplani ezithomalalisayo.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Forestry Transfer
jobs.department: Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment
jobs.closing_date_text: 31 August 2026, 16:00. No late application will be accepted
jobs.summary: Deputy Director needed to manage state forest transfer models and frameworks, requiring a National Diploma in Forestry and five years' relevant experience.
jobs.requirements: National Diploma (NQF6) in Forestry or relevant qualification within the related field as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of five (5) years’ experience in Forestry or related field of which three (3) years should be at an entry/junior managerial level (Assistant Director level or equivalent). All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Extensive knowledge of National Forest Act 1998 (Act 84 of 1998), National Veld and Forest Fire Act 1998 (Act 101 0f 1998), NEMA, NEMBA, Protected Areas, Land Reform Legislations and other Environmental legislations including Public Finance Regulations, Public Service Regulations, and PFMA. Knowledge of Forestry and Environmental Management Sector. Knowledge of Enumeration for collection of data. Knowledge of Project Management and Financial Management. People Management and Leadership skills. Planning and Organizing skills. Facilitation and Negotiation skills. Excellent Communication skills (verbal, presentation, awareness raising and report writing). Ability to work with difficult persons and to resolve conflict. Ability to work independently and efficiently under pressure. A valid driving license and willing to travel.

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Oordrag van Bosbou
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur benodig om oordragmodelle en raamwerke vir staatsbosbou te bestuur, met 'n Nasionale Diploma in Bosbou en vyf jaar se relevante ervaring as vereiste.
af.requirements: Nasionale Diploma (NQF6) in Bosbou of 'n relevante kwalifikasie binne die verwante veld soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van vyf (5) jaar se ervaring in Bosbou of 'n verwante veld waarvan drie (3) jaar op 'n toetrede/junior bestuursvlak (Assistentdirekteur-vlak of gelykwaardig) moet wees. Alle kortlyskandidate, insluitend SMS, sal twee voor-toetredingsassessering onderneem. Een moet 'n praktiese oefening wees, en die ander moet 'n Integriteitsassessering (Etiese Gedrag) wees. Uitgebreide kennis van National Forest Act 1998 (Act 84 of 1998), National Veld and Forest Fire Act 1998 (Act 101 0f 1998), NEMA, NEMBA, Protected Areas, Land Reform Legislations en ander omgewingswetgewing insluitend Public Finance Regulations, Public Service Regulations, en PFMA. Kennis van die Bosbou- en Omgewingsbestuursektor. Kennis van data-insameling. Kennis van Projekbestuur en Finansiële Bestuur. Mensebestuurs- en leierskapsvaardighede. Beplannings- en organisasievaardighede. Fasiliterings- en onderhandelingsvaardighede. Uitstekende Kommunikasievaardighede (mondelings, aanbiedings, bewusmaking en verslagskrywing). Vermoë om met moeilike persone te werk en konflik op te los. Vermoë om onafhanklik en doeltreffend onder druk te werk. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie en bereid om te reis.
af.duties: Ontwikkel en hersien oordragmodelle, raamwerke, riglyne en instrumente vir staatsbosbou. Fasiliteer die implementering van die bosbouoordragraamwerk. Fasiliteer skikking-ondersteuning na afloop van die oordrag van staatsbosbou. Identifiseer sleutelbelanghebbendes oor die oordragooreenkoms. Mobiliseer befondsing namens begunstigdes. Ontwikkel en onderhandel die afsluiting van bosbouoordragooreenkomste. Raadpleeg interne en eksterne belanghebbendes rakende oordrag-aangeleenthede. Verkry 'n regsopinie oor die oordragooreenkoms. Ontwikkel raamwerke en riglyne vir skikking-ondersteuning na afloop.

zu.title: Umehluleli: Ukudluliswa Kwezihlahla
zu.summary: Kudingeka umehluleli ophathe izinhlelo nobusobezinhlelo bokudlulisa izihlahla zombuso, okudinga i-National Diploma kwezihlahla kanye neminyaka emihlanu yohlelo lokusebenza ohlwini lwemisebenzi ehlobene.
zu.requirements: I-National Diploma (NQF6) kwezihlahla noma izifundo ezihlobene endaweni ehlobene njengoba kuhlonzwe yi-SAQA. Kubalulekile iminyaka emihlanu (5) yohlelo lokusebenza kwezihlahla noma endaweni ehlobene lapho kusuka kuyo iminyaka emithathu (3) kumele ibe ngazinga lokuphatha okungemuva kokuqala (izinga lika-Assistant Director noma okulingana nalo). Bonke abagqoki abafakiwe ohlwini, okuhlanganisa i-SMS, bazokwenza ukulinganisa okubili okungeniswa ngaphambi kokungena. Okunye kumele kubhe uyilo olusebenzayo, nokunye kumele kubhe Ukulinganisa Ukuziphatha (Isenzo Esokuziphatha). Ulwazi olubanzi nge-National Forest Act 1998 (Act 84 of 1998), i-National Veld and Forest Fire Act 1998 (Act 101 0f 1998), i-NEMA, i-NEMBA, izindawo ezivikelwe, umthetho wezokulungula izwe kanye nomthetho wemvelo okuhlanganisa imithetho yezezimali yomphakathi, imithetho yesevisi yomphakatha, kanye ne-PFMA. Ulwazi ngesigaba sezihlahla kanye nokuphathwa kwemvelo. Ulwazi ngokubala ukuze kuqoqwe ulwazi. Ulwazi ngokuphatha amaphrojekthi kanye nokuphatha izimali. Amakhono okuphatha abantu nokuhaniswa nendima. Amakhono okuhlela nokuhlela. Amakhono okukhuthaza nokuxoxa. Amakhono okukhuluma kahle (okukhulumayo, okwethula, okuphakamisa ukuqonda nokubhala imibiko). Ikhono lokusebenza nabantu abanzima kanye nokuqamba izixazululo ezinkaningweni. Ikhono lokusebenza ngabodwa ngenkani ngaphansi kwenkulu. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile kanye nesithakazelo sokuhamba.
zu.duties: Buka ngokuningi futhi uhlaziye izinhlelo zokudluliswa kwezihlahla zombuso, izakhiwo, izindlela nokuthuthukisa. Phakamisa ukuqashelwa izinhlelo zokudluliswa kwezihlahla zombuso. Phakamisa ukwesekwa ngemva kokuxazulula mayelana nokudluliswa kwezihlahla zombuso. Hlaba abahlotshaniswa abalulekile mayelana nesivumelwano sokudluliswa. Hlela izimali ngokomthetho ngaleso sikhathi isidingo ngenkathalo yezibusiso bakho. Buka ngokuningi futhi uxoxe ngokuqedela izivumelwano sokudluliswa kwezihlahla. Xoxa nabahlotshaniswa bongaphakathi nangaphandle ngokudluliswa. Thola izaziso zomthetho mayelana nesivumelwano sokudluliswa. Hlela izinhlelo nobusobezinhlelo bokuweseka ngemva kokuxazulula.

xh.title: Under-Director: Ukuhanjiswa kweSihlahla
xh.summary: Kufunekwa under-director ukulawula iimodeli nemiqathango yokudluliselwa kwesihlahla sikaRhulumende, kwaye kufuneka abe neNational Diploma kwiForestry kunye neminye emihlanu yamava ahambelanayo.
xh.requirements: National Diploma (NQF6) kwiForestry okanye ngesiphanga ahambelanayo kule ndawo njengoko samkelwe yiSAQA. Kufuneka abe nobuncinane beminye emihlanu (5) yamava kwiForestry okanye kummandla ongumxelwe, apho kuthi kwaleminye emithathu (3) kufuneka abe kwinqanaba elingasentla elingananto/nelingentloko yabaphathi (iAssistant Director level okanye elingenaryo). Bonke abagqokiweyo, kuquka neSMS, kuya kwenza iziphimo ezimbini zangaphambi kongeno. Esinye kufuneka sibe ngumzobo wokwenza ngesandla, esinye ke sibe sisiphimo sokuziphatha (sokuziphathisa). Ukuqonda okubanzi koMthetho weSihlahla seSizwe ka-1998 (Act 84 ka-1998), uMthetho weMilo nokuQhotsa kwesihlahla seSizwe ka-1998 (Act 101 ka-1998), iNEMA, iNEMBA, iindawo ezingenwa mntu, ooMthetho boLungiso lomHlaba naboMthetho abanye boBume bomHlaba kuquuka nezithintelo zeZimali zoLuntu, izithintelo zoQoqosho loLuntu, nepFMA. Ukuqonda uMmandla weSihlahla nokuLawulwa kweNdalo. Ukuqonda ukuBala ngokusityelela iinkcukacha ngokusetyenziswa kolwazi. Ukuqonda ukuLawulwa kweeNkqubo zeMisebenzi nokuLawulwa kweZimali. Ulwazi lokuLawula abantu noKulunga. Ulwazi loCocizo nokuhlela. Ulwazi loBomi bokuncedisa nokuxoxisana. Ulwazi olubalaseleyo lokuthetha (ngomlomo, ngokubonisa, ngokuvusa ingqondo, nangokubhala iingxelo). Ukwazi ukusebenza nabantu abanzima nokusombulula iingxabano. Ukwazi ukusebenza yedwa nangempumelelo ngaphantsi komfutho. Ilayisense yokushayela esemthethweni nokugqitha ngaphandle.
xh.duties: Ukuphuhlisisa nokuhlengahlengisa iimodeli, imiqathango, izikhokelo nezixhobo zokudluliselwa kwesihlahla sikaRhulumende. Ukuncedisa ekusebenzeni komqathango wokudluliselwa kwesihlahla. Ukuncedisa inkxaso emva kokuzinza ngokwakudluliselwa kwesihlahla sikaRhulumende. Ukuqonda abo bamele ukuchasana kumqathano wokudluliselwa. Ukudityanisa nemali ematshaleni yobenefite Ukuphuhlisisa nokuxoxa ukugqiba komqathano wokudluliselwa kwesihlahla. Ukubonisana nabalawuli bangaphakathi nabangaphandle ngemiba yokudluliselwa. Ukufumana izimvo ezisemthethweni ngomqathano wokudluliselwa. Ukuphuhlisisa imiqathano nezikhokelo zenkxaso emva kokuzinza.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Ethics and Fraud Prevention
jobs.department: Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment
jobs.closing_date_text: 31 August 2026, 16:00. No late application will be accepted
jobs.summary: Deputy Director role in Ethics and Fraud Prevention at the Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment in Pretoria, requiring a National Diploma and five years' experience.
jobs.requirements: National Diploma (NQF 6) in Forensic Investigations, Auditing, Law, Risk Management or relevant qualification as recognised by SAQA. Accreditation or Membership with Association of Certified Fraud Examiners (ACFE) or Institute of Commercial Forensic Practitioner (ICFP). Five (5) years’ experience in Forensic Investigation and Fraud Prevention or relevant field of which three (3) years should be at an entry/ junior managerial level (Assistant Director level or equivalent). Technical knowledge in the application of fraud risk management concepts and principles. Knowledge and Understanding of the concepts of Control and Corporate Governance. Knowledge and understanding of Anti- Fraud and corruption standards and procedures. Risk management standards (Fraud risk) and procedures. Financial policies and related legislation: PFMA and Treasury Regulations; Fraud prevention policies and related legislation: Public Service Anti-Corruption Strategy; Prevention and Combating of Corrupt Activities Act, 2004; Protected Disclosure Act, 2000. In-depth knowledge of the business of the institution and government operations. Good understanding of business processes as well as previous experience in the initiation, development and implementation thereof on fraud risk management. Good understanding and working knowledge of IT systems. Prior experience in workshop facilitation and the ability to liaise at various levels of an organisation. Able to analyse, compare and interpret information and make appropriate recommendations. Methodical and logical when analysing information. Public Service and Departmental procedures and prescripts. Investigative skills, ability to apply fraud prevention, detection and consequence management skills. Computer Literacy. Excellent written, inclusive of report writing and verbal skill, excellent facilitation, presentation and communication skill. Able to negotiate in a spirit of co-operation and collaboration, problem-solving skill and people management. Ability to gather and analyse information. Ability to develop and apply policies ability to work individually and in team. Good interpersonal relations skills. Creativity and initiative, ability to work under extreme pressure and ability to work long hours voluntarily. Ability to work with difficult persons and to resolve conflict. Character beyond reproach, articulate, sense of responsibility and loyalty.
jobs.duties: Conduct investigations on fraud and corruption allegations. Effective and efficient development and review of fraud management frameworks: Fraud risk management, ethics Management, provide a compliance, advisory and facilitation role in the Department’s management of ethics.

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Etiek en Bedrogvoorkoming
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur-pos in Etiek en Bedrogvoorkoming by die Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment in Pretoria, waarvoor 'n Nasionale Diploma en vyf jaar se ondervinding vereis word.
af.requirements: Nasionale Diploma (NQF 6) in Forensiese Ondersoeke, Oudit, Reg, Risikobestuur of 'n relevante kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken. Akkreditasie of Lidmaatskap by die Association of Certified Fraud Examiners (ACFE) of Institute of Commercial Forensic Practitioner (ICFP). Vyf (5) jaar se ondervinding in Forensiese Ondersoeke en Bedrogvoorkoming of 'n relevante veld waarvan drie (3) jaar op 'n intree-/junior bestuursvlak (Adjunkdirekteur-vlak of gelykwaardig) moet wees. Tegniese kennis van die toepassing van bedrog-risikobestuurskonsepte en -beginsels. Kennis en begrip van die konsepte van Beheer en Korporatiewe Bestuur. Kennis en begrip van Anti-Bedrog- en korrupsiestandaarde en -prosedures. Risikobestuurstandaarde (Bedrogrisiko) en -prosedures. Finansiële beleide en verwante wetgewing: PFMA en Tesourie-regulasies; Bedrogvoorkomingsbeleid en verwante wetgewing: Openbare Diens Antikorrupsie-strategie; Prevention and Combating of Corrupt Activities Act, 2004; Protected Disclosure Act, 2000. Diepgaande kennis van die besigheid van die instelling en regeringsbedrywighede. Goeie begrip van besigheidsprosesse asook vorige ondervinding in die inisiering, ontwikkeling en implementering daarvan op bedrog-risikobestuur. Goeie begrip en werkskennis van IT-stelsels. Vorige ondervinding in werkswinkelfasilitering en die vermoë om op verskeie vlakke van 'n organisasie te skakel. In staat om inligting te ontleed, te vergelyk en te interpreteer en toepaslike aanbevelings te doen. Metodies en logies wanneer inligting ontleed word. Openbare Diens en departementele prosedures en voorskrifte. Ondersoekvaardighede, vermoë om bedrogvoorkoming, opsporing en gevolgbestuursvaardighede toe te pas. Rekenaargeletterdheid. Uitstekende skriftelike vaardighede, insluitend verslagskryf en mondelinge vaardighede, uitstekende fasiliterings-, voorleggings- en kommunikasievaardighede. In staat om in 'n gees van samewerking en samenwerking te onderhandel, probleemoplossingsvaardighede en mensebestuur. Vermoë om inligting in te samel en te ontleed. Vermoë om beleide te ontwikkel en toe te pas, vermoë om individueel en in 'n span te werk. Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudingsvaardighede. Kreatiwiteit en inisiatief, vermoë om onder uiterste druk te werk en vermoë om vrywillig lang ure te werk. Vermoë om met moeilike persone te werk en konflik op te los. Vlekkelose karakter, welsprekend, sin vir verantwoordelikheid en lojaliteit.
af.duties: Voer ondersoeke oor bedrog- en korrupsie-aantygings uit. Doeltreffende en doeltroue ontwikkeling en hersiening van bedrogbestuursraamwerke: Bedrog-risikobestuur, Etiekbestuur, verskaf 'n nakomings-, advisering- en fasiliteringsrol in die departement se bestuur van etiek.

zu.title: Isikhulu Esiphezulu Esibuselayo: Izokulingana Nokuthibela Ukwenza Amaqhaku
zu.summary: Isikhundla sikaIsikhulu Esiphezulu Esibuselayo kwezokulingana Nokuthibela Ukwenza Amaqhaku eDipalimende Yezihlahla, Zentlanzi Nendalo ePretoria, esidinga iDiploma Yezwe kanye neminyaka emihlanu yamava.
zu.requirements: iDiploma Yezwe (NQF 6) kwezokuhlolwa kamacala, ukuhlolwa kwezimali, izomthetho, ukuphathwa kwezingozi noma iziqu ezifanele njengoba zihlonzwa yi-SAQA. Ukuqashelwa okungenhle noma ukuba yilungu kwe-Association of Certified Fraud Examiners (ACFE) noma i-Institute of Commercial Forensic Practitioner (ICFP). Iminyaka emihlanu (5) yamava ek ukuhololwa kwamacala nokuthibela ukwenza amaqhaku noma enkundla ehlobene lapho eminyaka emithathu (3) kufanele ibe ezinga lomphathi ongena/nomncintiswano (izinga likaMsizi Wezikhundla noma elilingana). Ulwazi lokusebenza mayelana nezimiso zokuphathwa kwezingozi zokwenza amaqhaku. Ulwazi nokuqonda kwezimiso zokuLawula nokuPhatha inkampani. Ulwazi nokuqonda ngamagunya nokuthibela ukuqhakamba nokwenza amaqhaku kanye nendlela ezenziwa ngayo. Amagunya okuphathwa kwezingozi (ingozi yokwenza amaqhaku) kanye nendlela. Izinqubomgomo zezimali nomthetho ohlobene: i-PFMA kanye Nemiyalo yeHhoveli Lezimali; Izinqubomgomo zokuthibela ukwenza amaqhaku nomthetho ohlobene: Inqubomgomo Yokuthibela Ukuqhakamba Kwenkonzo Yomphakathi; uMthetho Wokuthibela Nokulwa Nemisebenzi Yokwenza Amakhakhamba, 2004; uMthetho Wokuvikelwa Kokwaziswa, 2000. Ulwazi olujulile ngomsebenzi wesikhungo kanye nokuqhuba komphakathi. Ukuqonda kahle inqubo yomsebenzi kanye namava oedlule ekuqaliseni, ekuqumbeni futhi ekusebenziseni ukuphathwa kwezingozi zokwenza amaqhaku. Ukuqonda kahle nolwazi lokusebenza lwamaphrocessi we-IT. Amava adlule ekulekeleleni amaworkshop kanye nethuba lokuxhumana ezingeni ehlukene zinhlangano. Ukukwazi ukuhlaziya, ukuqhathanisa nokutolikela ulwazi bese ukwenza izincomo ezifanele. Ukuhleleka nokuhamba kweqiniso lapho kuhlaziywa ulwazi. Inqubo kanye Nemiyalo Yenkonzo Yomphakathi NayoMnyango. Amakhono e investigation, isikhathi eside sokusebenzisa ukuthibela amaqhaku, ukutholakala kanye namakhono okuphathwa kwemiphumela. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa Ikhompyutha. Amakhono amahle okubhala, okubandakanya ukubhala iireport kanye nethuba lokukhuluma, amakhono amahle ekulekelela, okubonisa nokukhulumisana. Ukukwazi ukuxoxisana ngomoya wokubambana nokusebenza ndawonye, amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga nokuphatha abantu. Ithuba lokuthola ukuhlaziya ulwazi. Ithuba lokuba nokuziphatha kabantu njalo lisebenzise izinhlelo ukusebenza eyedwa kanye nalamanye. Amakhono amahle e relation relations. Ukuzibonisa kanye nethuba lokungena, isikhathi eside sokusebenza ngaphezulu kobuningi bamandla bese uyazithanda ukusebenza amahora amade. Ukukwazi ukusebenza ngabantu abanzima kanye nokuxazulula izinkinga. Ubesimilo esingenaphutha, ukukwazi ukukhuluma kahle, isizungu kanye nobuhlobo.
zu.duties: Ukuhlola ngamacala okuthiwa enziwe amakhakhamba. Ukuthuthukiswa kwemiklamo yokuqinisekiswa kwentela ngokuphumelelayo kanye nokuqinisekiswa kwentela: ukuphathwa kwezingozi zokuqhakamba, ukuphathwa kokuziphatha okuqinisekisiwe, ukunikeza inqubo yokuhambisana, inqubo efoluleyo inikeza izincomo ezifanele ezinhle ekuqhubeni kwentela kwentela ekweniwe amakhakhamba.

xh.title: Isekela Monguli: Amazolo Amafutshane Nokuthintela Ukukrushwa kwamahlulelo
xh.summary: Isithuba sikaSekela Monguli kumazolo amafutshane nokuthintela ukukrushwa kwamahlulelo kwisebe Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment ePretoria, elifuna iNational Diploma neminyaka emi-5 yamava.
xh.requirements: iNational Diploma (NQF 6) kwiForensic Investigations, iAuditing, uMthetho, uLawulo loMngcipheko okanye nesiqinisekiso esichanekileyo njengoko sivunywe yiSAQA. Ukuvunywa okanye uBulungu kwiAssociation of Certified Fraud Examiners (ACFE) okanye iInstitute of Commercial Forensic Practitioner (ICFP). Iminyaka emihlanu (5) yamava kwiForensic Investigation nokuthintela ukukrushwa kwamahlulelo okanye kwelinye icandelo, apho iminyaka emithathu (3) kufuneka ibengowomazinga ongumphathi wokuqala/omncinci (kwinqanaba likaMncedisi weNgcali okanye elilingana nalo). Ulwazi lobuchule ekusebenziseni iinkqubo nemigaqo yolawulo lomngcipheko wokukrushwa kwamahlulelo. Ulwazi nokuQonda iinkqubo zoLawulo loMgcina nokuBusa koluntu. Ulwazi nokuqonda amagqabantshintshi, iimigaqo nendlela zokuSebenza ezithintela nokulwa nokukrushwa kwamahlulelo nokrongamhlahlo. Iimigaqo yolawulo lomngcipheko (wokukrushwa kwamahlulelo) nendlela zokuqamba ngazo. iMigaqo yeMali nomthetho oqhagamshelana nayo: iPFMA neTreasury Regulations; imigaqo yokuthintela ukukrushwa kwamahlulelo nomthetho oqhagamshelana nayo: iPublic Service Anti-Corruption Strategy; iPrevention and Combating of Corrupt Activities Act, 2004; iProtected Disclosure Act, 2000. Ulwazi olujulileyo ngoshishino lwesikhosi oluqalwayo nangendlela elusebenza ngayo urhulumente. Ukuqonda kakuhle iinkqubo zoshishino nangaphezalo, namava angaphambili ekuqaliseni, ekuqhutywa nasekusetyenzisweni kwezo nkqubo kulawulo lomngcipheko wokukrushwa kwamahlulelo. Ukuqonda kakuhle nokusebenza ngokwexesha elifanelekileyo ngezithunywa ze-CF. Ulwazi ngaphambili ekukhuliseni amaza aphakathi kwabantu nako ukuba namandla okuthetha nabo kumazinga awo onke wesikhosi oluqalwayo. Ukuba namandla woluhlola, ukuqamba ngokomzekeliso nokutolika ulwazi nokuvelisa izindululo ezifanelekileyo. Ukuba ngumntu onendlela esolululona nakulawula iingcingxa xa ehluza ulwazi. Iinkqubo nemigaqo yeDweliso-lwazi lokuSebenza nesebe. Amaphawu okuphanda, amandla okusebenzisa ukuthintela ikrusho, ukuzifumanisa nokuqwalasela iindlela ezithintela nazo, namandla okuphatha iinkqubo. Ukuziphilisa ngekhompyutha. Ubuchule obubalaseleyo kobhaliweyo, obubandakanya ukubhala iingxelo nobu-tetha bubuchule, ubukhonyezise babukhulu, ekuhoneliseni, nokuzonxibelelana nabantu bubukhulu. Amandla okuxoxa ngokomzekeliso othembisayo kwaye uhlanganyele, namandla ekusombulula iingxaki nakuLawulweni labantu. Amandla okuqokelela nokuqwalasela ulwazi. Amandla ekwakheni nasekusebenziseni imigaqo nemandla okusebenza kodwa nakuqela. Amandla amabele okubamba ubudlelwane obuhle nabantu. Ukuzisilela nokuzinikela, amandla okusebenza ngenkxakumbi yexesha namandla okusebenza iiyure ezinde ngokuzithandela. Amandla okusebenza nabantu abanzima nako ukusombulula iingxaki. Ubulungisa obungathandabuzekiyo, ukuchazwa kakuhle, inkxaso yokuziphathisa nokuthembeka.
xh.duties: Kuqwalaselwe amacala okukrushwa kwamahlulelo nokukhawuleza kumava. Ukuphuhliswa okusebenzayo nakugqibelele nokuphinda kuqwalaselwe iinkqubo zolawulo lokuqwalasela amacala; uLawulo lomngcipheko wokukrushwa kwamahlulelo, uLawulo lwamazolo amafutshane, ukubonelela ngomdla wokulawula ngokomthetho, ukunika isiPhakamiso nendima yokubalasela ekulawulweni kwamanyuzela eSebe.

Ulwazi mayelana nokuqondiswa okuqhubekayo/ukuhlelwa, ukuhlelwa kwebhizinisi, umbhalo wezibalo, ukubhala okuyisikhungo nokuthuthukiswa kwezinqubo. Indlela ephambili yokuhlola ngesikhathi kuhambiswe nokuqedela imigomo ngephutha lokuhlola okuncane. Inzwelo yokumathulela nokuthembeka.
zu.duties: Qinisekisa ukunikelwa kokuphathwa kwenhlangano-ngqangi yamazwe ngaphandle komnyango, ukuxhumana kolungiselelano kwamazwe ngaphandle kanye nokuphathwa nokusatshalaliswa kolwazi.
