zu.title: USekela-Mkhulu: Ekuqondweni Kobunkampani
zu.summary: USekela-Mkhulu wekuQondiswa Kobunkampani eDepartment of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment ePretoria, ofuna i-National Diploma namafinyela eminyaka emihlanu yohlu oluhambisana nesikhundla.
zu.requirements: I-National Diploma (NQF6) kwi-Management Services/Operations Management/Industrial Psychology noma izifundo ezihambisana nalokhu njengoba zivunyelwe yi-SAQA. Ubufakazi bokube ngaphezulu kweminyaka emihlanu (5) ohlinzekweni ngenqubomgomo yokuqondwa kobunkampani noma inkambu ehambisana nalokhu, lapho kuleminyaka emithathu (3) kufanele kube ngazinga eliphansi/elingangeni ngamasela e-abaphathi (izinga luka-Assistant Director noma elilingana nalokho). Ukwazi izimiso nezinqumo zokuqondwa kobunkampani. Ukuphathwa kwenqubomgomo yokuhlela. Ukuqonda ukuphathwa kwabasebenzi nemithetho ye-OD kanye nezinhlelo zokulawula. Ukwazi isistimu yokulinganisa nokuqamba izikhundla kanye nenqubo yokulinganisa izikhundla. I-Public Finance Management Act kanye nezinqumo ze-Treasury. Ikono lokuthuthukisa nokusebenzisa izinqubomgomo. Ukuphathwa kwamaphrojekthi noshintsho. Isistimu yokuphathwa kokusebenza kanye nokumiswa kwemikhakha yamabhizinisi. Ikono lokuthola nokuqagela ulwazi. Amakhono obuciko bokuphenya, ukuhlaziya, ukuhlela, ukucubungula nokwenza imiboniso. Amakhono amahle okuxoxa (ngomlomo nangokubhala) nokuhlobana nabantu. Ikono lokusebenza ngokucindezelayo nangamahora amade.
zu.duties: Ukuphathwa kokuhambisana kobunkampani kanye nokugcinwa komsungulo nesakhiwo. Ukubuyekeza futhi uthuthukise isakhiwo sobunkampani esibonakaliswe ngokuningi. Ukuqhuba ucwaningo nokufunda yonke imibhalo esemthethweni ehlobene nalokhu ukuze kuqedele umbhalo wesakhiwo sobunkampani. Ukuphatha futhi ulawule inqubo yokulinganisa izikhundla kanye nezinkcazelo zomsebenzi. Ukwenza kube lula futhi ucofa ukulinganisa izikhundla ngokuhambisana noMhlahlandlela Wonyaka ne-Operation Plan. Ukwenza kube lulu ukubekwa nokugaduzwa kwamalungu amaphaneli we-JE. Ukuthuthukisa futhi uhambise i-JE plan ukuze uqiniseke ukuthi kubalulekile ukulinganisa izikhundla (ezingenabantu, ezidalwe kusanda). Ukwenza kube lula ukuthuthukiswa kwezinkcazelo zomsebenzi. Ukuthuthukisa futhi ubuyekeze inqubomgomo ye-JE noma kunini na lapho kudingeka khona. Ucwaningo, izinkingaxoxo kanye nokulinganisela nama-Departments amanye. Ukuqiniseka kokwenza kube lula nokuhambisanisa ukumiswa kwemikhakha yamabhizinisi kanye nenqubomgomo yokusebenza evamile. Ukuphathwa kokumiswa kwemikhakha yamabhizinisi yonke imisebenzi. Ukuthuthukisa izinqubomgomo zokusebenza evamile yonke imisebenzi. Ukwenza kube lulu futhi ucofe ukungenelela kokuphathwa koshintsho. Ukwenza kube lulu amawokshophu okuphathwa koshintsho bonke abathintekayo. Ukwenza kube lulu ukushintshelwa, ukuhambisana kanye nokubekwa kwabasebenzi ngenxa yoshintsho esakhiweni. Ukwenza kube lulu ukusetshenziswa kokuqondwa Kokusebenza Kobunkampani kanye nokusetshenziswa kwenqubomgomo yomsebenzi. Ukwenza kube lulu ukwabelana kolwazi bonke abathintekayo.

xh.title: iPhini leMongameli: Ukuzinza kweNtsapho
xh.summary: iPhini leMongameli ekuzinzeni kweNtsapho kwiSebe lezoHlazo, loWedyulo nemiLambo egcinwa ePretoria, lifuna iDiploma yesiZwe neminyaka mihlanu yamava ahambelana nalo msebenzi.
xh.requirements: iDiploma yesiZwe (NQF6) kwiNkonzo zoLawulo/uLawulo lweMisebenzi/Amaphsikholoji eNhlanganisweni okanye isifanekiso esihambelana noko esamkelwa yiSAQA. Iminyaka emithandathu (5) yamava ekuzinzeni kweNtsapho okanye kummandla ohambelana nayo, apho kubakho iminyaka emithathu (3) kufuneka ibengendlela yokuqala/yesigqeba esingaphantsi (izinga lomLawuli oncedisayo okanye esilinganayo). Ulwazi ngemigaqo nendlela ezisetyenziswayo ekuzinzeni kweNtsapho. uLawulo lokuCwangcisa ngokobuChule. Ukuqonda uLawulo lweMisebenzi yabaNtu kunye neMigaqo ekuzinzeni kweNtsapho nendlela ezilawulwayo. Ulwazi ngendlela yokulinganisa nokuhlela amagunya emisebenzi nendlela yokulinganisa imisebenzi. uMthetho woLawulo lweMali kaRhulumente nemiQathango yeSikolo saseNdlu yoLwazi. Amandla okuphepha nokusebenzisa iMigaqo. uLawulo lweProjekthi nokuTshintsha. inkqubo yoLawulo lweMisebenzi nokuqonda iinkqubo zoshishino. Amandla okuqokelela nokuhlalutya ulwazi. Amandla aphezulu ephononlongo, ekuhlalutyeni, ekuqokeleleni, ekuqwalaselweni nakubonakaliso. Amandla aphezulu ekunxibelelaneni (ngomlomo nangokubhaliweyo) nakunxibelelwano nabantu. Amandla okusebenza ngxamiseko ngeyure ezide.
xh.duties: Lawula ukulungelelana kweNtsapho nokugcina isimilo nesakhiwo. Phononlonga kuphehle uMthendereko ochazwe kakuhle wesakhiwo. Yenza uphononlongo uze ufunde onke amaxwebhu afunekayo oMtsetfo ukuze uxhobe iinguqu ekuqwalaselweni kwesakhiwo. Lawula uze ulawule ukulinganiswa kweMisebenzi nokuqokelelwa kolwazi olunika isiqondiso ngolugawulwa komsebenzi. Yenza kuqhatwe kukalwe imisebenzi ngokweCwangciso lonyaka nemisebenzi yoMnyango. Yenza kube lula kwaye uqwalasele ukugcinwa nokuziswa kolwazi kubalawuli. Yenza amaqela abasebenzi abakalayo abanolwazi abanikelo athathwe ngokulungelelana. Pejhula uze ulungelelanise uCwangciso lokulinganisa imisebenzi uze uqiniseke ukuba kubalulekile ukuba kulinganiswe izithuba (ezize, ezintsha). Yenza kube lula ukuphephu ulwazi ngolusebenzayo. Pejhula uze uphononlonge uCwangciso lokulinganisa imisebenzi xa kuyimfuneko. Yenza uphononlongo, iinterviwu nokuqwalasela ngezinye iziBe. Qinisekisa ukwenziwa kakuhle kweMisebenzi yoshishino nokuqwalaselwa kolwazi osetyenziswayo. Lawula iMisebenzi yoshishino yonke imisebenzi. Pejhula iMigaqo esetyenziswayo yonke imisebenzi. Yenza kube lula kwaye uqwalasele ukulungelelana nokuTshintsha kwentsapho. Yenza kube lula amaza okuTshintsha onke abantu abathintekayo. Yenza kube lulu kuye kwafakwa, kuqwalaselwe kubekwe abasebenzi ngenxa yeesakhiwo ezitshintshile. Yenza kube lula kusetyenziswe uVavanyo lokulungelelana kweNtsapho nokuSetyenziswa kweCwangciso. Yenza kube lula ukusasazwa kolwazi kubo onke abantu abathintekayo.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Performance Management
jobs.department: Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment
jobs.closing_date_text: 31 August 2026, 16:00. No late application will be accepted.
jobs.summary: Deputy Director managing PMDS processes and performance agreements for SMS and non-SMS staff in the Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment.
jobs.requirements: National Diploma (NQF6) in Human Resource Management or relevant qualification as recognized by SAQA. A minimum of five (5) years’ experience in Human Resource Management with specific reference to Performance Management, of which three (3) years should be at an entry/junior managerial level (Assistant Director level or equivalent), PERSAL certificate and a valid Driver’s license will serve as an added advantage. Computer literacy Skills that would include a good working knowledge of Microsoft Office products, especially Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, SharePoint, MS Forms, OneDrive, MS Teams and Word. Knowledge of SMS handbook, Public Service Regulation as amended, Public Service Act as amended, Collective Agreements, DPSA directives and other Human Resource Prescripts. Knowledge of administrative procedures, and project management. Good communication skills (verbal and written). Experience in PERSAL system. Knowledge of Financial Administration skills, Supervisory skills, Planning and organizing, Communication skills both verbal and written, and problem-solving skills, Presentation skills, Accuracy, thoroughness, and ability to detect errors, Ability to prioritize and meet deadlines, good working interpersonal skills, Customer service orientation, and flexibility. Ability to work under pressure, Ability to delegate, Ability to establish controls and monitor tasks. Ability to work with difficult persons and to resolve conflict. Willingness to travel. Sense of responsibility, loyalty and honesty.
jobs.duties: Manage and facilitate the PMDS processes of submission of Performance Agreements, Mid-term assessments, Annual assessments and probation reports for both members of Senior Management Service (SMS) and non-SMS. Ensure quality assurance of SMS and non-SMS Performance Agreements, Mid-term assessments, Annual assessments and probation reports. Administer SMS and non-SMS moderation processes, manage databases, implementations on PERSAL, and appoint committees. Effective facilitation of the implementation of the incentive framework and collective agreements, including OSD and non-OSD. Ensure that awareness and training sessions on PMDS are conducted. Manage the administration of the PMDS online system and other digital platforms. Ensure accurate data capturing, reporting, and provide reports to Management. Manage dispute resolution or disagreement processes emanating from Performance Agreements, Mid-term assessment, Annual assessment, and probation reports. Provide technical advice to stakeholders and management.
jobs.applications: All applications to be submitted online on the following link: https://erecruitment.environment.gov.za/
jobs.notes: Interested applicants must submit their applications via the above link. Applicant must ensure that they complete all sections on the online Z83 and attached a detailed CV with at least three (3) contactable references. Failure to complete or disclose all required information will automatically disqualify the applicant. No late applications will be accepted. Shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications, identity document and driver’s license on or before the day of the interview. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). The National Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer. Preference may be given to appointable applicants from the underrepresented designated groups in terms of the Department’s equity plan. Persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply. Correspondence will be limited to successful candidates only. Short-listed candidates will be subjected to screening and security vetting to determine their suitability for employment, including but not limited to: Criminal records; Citizenship status; Credit worthiness; Previous employment (reference checks); and Qualification verification. Short-listed candidates will be expected to avail themselves at the Department’s convenience. Entry level requirements for SMS posts: In terms of the Directive on Compulsory Capacity Development, Mandatory Training Days & Minimum Entry Requirements for SMS that was introduced on 1 April 2015, a requirement for all applicants for SMS posts from 1 April 2020 is a successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme as endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG) prior to appointment. The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into SMS and the full details can be obtained by following the below link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entryprogramme. Furthermore, Shortlisted candidates must provide proof of successful completion of the course. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Following the interview and technical passement for all SMS posts, the Selection Panel will recommend candidates to attend a generic managerial competency assessment in compliance with the DPSA Directive on the implementation of competency-based assessments. Persons appointed will be subjected to a security clearance, the signing of performance agreement and employment contract. The Department reserves the right not to make an appointment. If you have not been contacted within three 3 months after the closing date of the advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. By submitting the employment application form, you agree and consent in terms of Section 11(1) of the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA), 2013 (Act 4 of 2013), for your personal information which you provide to the DFFE to being processed by the department and its employees, agents, Cabinet committees, and subcontractors for recruitment purposes, in accordance with the POPIA of 2013.

af.title: Onderdirekteur: Prestasiebestuur
af.summary: Onderdirekteur wat PMDS-prosesse en prestasieooreenkomste vir SMS- en nie-SMS-personeel in die Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment bestuur.
af.requirements: Nasionale Diploma (NQF6) in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur of relevante kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van vyf (5) jaar se ervaring in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur met spesifieke verwysing na Prestasiebestuur, waarvan drie (3) jaar op 'n instap/junior bestuursvlak (Assistentdirekteur-vlak of gelykwaardig) moet wees, PERSAL-sertifikaat en 'n geldige bestuurslisensie sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Rekenaarvaardigheidvaardighede wat 'n goeie werkskennis van Microsoft Office-produkte insluit, veral Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, SharePoint, MS Forms, OneDrive, MS Teams en Word. Kennis van SMS-handboek, Openbare Diensregulasies soos gewysig, Openbare Dienswet soos gewysig, Kollektiewe Ooreenkomste, DPSA-riglyne en ander Menslike Hulpbron-voorskryfte. Kennis van administratiewe prosedures en projekbestuur. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede (mondeling en skriftelik). Ervaring in die PERSAL-stelsel. Kennis van Finansiële Administrasie-vaardighede, Toesighoudende vaardighede, Beplanning en organisering, Kommunikasievaardighede beide mondeling en skriftelik, en probleemoplossingsvaardighede, Aanbiedingsvaardighede, Akkuraatheid, deeglikheid en vermoë om foute op te spoor, Vermoë om prioriteite te stel en sperdatums na te kom, goeie werksinterpersoonlike vaardighede, Kliëntediensgerigtheid en buigsaamheid. Vermoë om onder druk te werk, Vermoë om te delegueer, Vermoë om kontroles in te stel en take te monitor. Vermoë om met moeilike persone te werk en konflik op te los. Bereidwilligheid om te reis. Sin van verantwoordelikheid, lojaliteit en eerlikheid.
af.duties: Bestuur en fasiliteer die PMDS-prosesse van indiening van Prestasieooreenkomste, Midtermyn-evaluerings, Jaarlikse evaluerings en proefverslae vir beide lede van Senior Management Service (SMS) en nie-SMS. Verseker kwaliteitsversekering van SMS- en nie-SMS-Prestasieooreenkomste, Midtermyn-evaluerings, Jaarlikse evaluerings en proefverslae. Administreer SMS- en nie-SMS-modereringsprosesse, bestuur databasisse, implementasies op PERSAL, en stel komitees aan. Effektiewe fasilitering van die implementering van die aansporingsraamwerk en kollektiewe ooreenkomste, insluitend OSD en nie-OSD. Verseker dat bewustheids- en opleidingsessies oor PMDS uitgevoer word. Bestuur die administrasie van die aanlyn PMDS-stelsel en ander digitale platforms. Verseker akkurate datavaslegging, verslagdoening, en verskaf verslae aan Bestuur. Bestuur geskillebeslegting of meningsverskilprosesse wat voortspruit uit Prestasieooreenkomste, Midtermyn-evaluerings, Jaarlikse evaluerings en proefverslae. Verskaf tegniese advies aan belanghebbendes en bestuur.

zu.title: Umphathi Ohambisana: Ukuphathwa Kokusebenza
zu.summary: Umphathi Ohambisana ophatha inqubo ye-PMDS nemiyalezohlelo yokusebenza yabasebenzi be-SMS kanye nalabo abangeyona i-SMS enkampanini i-Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment.
zu.requirements: I-Diploma Yezwe (NQF6) kuHuman Resource Management noma izifundo ezifanele njengokuqatshwa yi-SAQA. Uzuvo oluncane lweminyaka eyihlanu (5) kuHuman Resource Management ngokubhekise lokhu kuKuphathwa Kokusebenza, lapho kufanele kube seminyakeni emithathu (3) okuyizinga lokuphatha okungenele/okuncane (izinga lomPhathi oMsiza noma okulingana nalo), isitifiketi se-PERSAL kanye nelayisensi yokushayisa evumelekile kuzoba yinzuzo. Amakhono okusebenza ngemikhumbi ahambisana nalolu lwazi oluhle lokusebenza ngemikhiqizo ye-Microsoft Office, ikakhulukazi i-Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, SharePoint, MS Forms, OneDrive, MS Teams kanye ne-Word. Ulwazi ngesincwadi sohlelo lwe-SMS, i-Public Service Regulation njengokulungisiwe, i-Public Service Act njengokulungisiwe, ama-Collective Agreements, imiyalo ye-DPSA kanye nezinye izincwadi ze-Human Resource. Ulwazi ngemikhuba yolawulo, kanye nokuphatha imiklamo. Amakhono ohlakaniphi okuxhumana (okuthethwayo nokubhaliwe). Uzuvo kusistimu ye-PERSAL. Ulwazi kumakhono oLawulo Lwezimali, amakhono okubuka abantu, ukucubungula futhi uhlele, amakhono okuxhumana kokubili okuthethwayo nokubhaliwe, namakhono okuxazulula izinkinga, amakhono okwethula, ukunembile, ukuphathwa okuzingqaya, kanye nenking Yokuhlola amaphutha. Ikhono lokubeka izinto ezibalulekile futhi uhlangabezane namadethu, amakhono amahle okusebenza nabantu, ukuba oreyente kwinkonzo yabathengi, kanye nokuqina. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwezingcindezi, ikhono lokwabelana, ikhono lokumisa izilawuli futhi uphathe imisebenzi. Ikhono lokusebenza nabantu abeka nzima futhi ukuxazulula izinkinga. Ukuzithoba ukuhamba. Indikima yobunombolo, ukuzinikela kanye nokuqotho.
zu.duties: Ukuphatha futhi wenze kwenzeke inqubo ye-PMDS yokungenisa Iminyalezo Yokusebenza, ukuhlola okwenziwa phakathi konyaka, ukuhlola okwenziwa ngonyaka kanye nemibiko yesikhathi sokuzama kokungena kubasebenzi abayilunga le-Senior Management Service (SMS) nalabo abangeyona i-SMS. Qinisekisa ukutholwa kwekhwalithi yamaminyalezo Yokusebenza e-SMS kanye nalabo abangeyona i-SMS, ukukhethwa phakathi konyaka, ukukhethwa ngonyaka, kanye nemibiko yesikhathi sokuzama kokungena. Phatha imikhuba yokukhethwa i-SMS kanye nalabo abangeyona i-SMS, phatha izinto ezigcinwayo, ukusebenzisa kwi-PERSAL, futhi qokele amakomidi. Yenza kwenzeke ngempumelelo ukusetshenziswa kwesakhelo sezinkokhelo kanye namaminyekele, okuhlanganisa i-OSD nalokungeyona i-OSD. Qinisekisa ukuba kwenzike izinkulumo-mfhaza nakulezi zinsuku zokufundela ngokuqonda nge-PMDS. Phatha ukuqashelwa kwesistimu ye-PMDS usebenzisa inthanethi kanye nezinye izinkundla zamakhompyutha. Qinisekisa ukutholwa kolwazi olunembile, ukwenza imibiko, futhi uhlinzeke ngemibiko kuBaphathi. Phatha ukuxazulula izingxabhano noma inqubo yokungavumelani evela Kumiyalelo Yokusebenza, ukuhlola phakathi konyaka, ukuhlola ngonyaka, kanye nemibiko yesikhathi sokuzama kokungena. Nikeza izeluleko ezibhekise emandleni kubantu abathintekayo kanye kuBaphathi.

xh.title: Umlawuli ongusihlalo weNyanga: uLawulo loMsebenzi oLungileyo
xh.summary: Umlawuli ongusihlalo weNyanga ulawula iinkqubo ze-PMDS nemiqathango yokusebenza ngokomsebenzi oLungileyo kubasebenzi be-SMS nabo abangeyiyo eKwindla lezoKuLima, ukuZingela nokuThathwa kweZinto eZiZingisa kwindalo.
xh.requirements: I-National Diploma (NQF6) kuLawulo lweZiseko zeZabantu okanye izifundo ezifanelekileyo njengoko zivunywe yi-SAQA. Uqoqosho lweminye emithandathu (5) yeminyaka yamava kulawulo lweZiseko zeZabantu enomdla okukodwa kuLawulo loMsebenzi oLungileyo, apho kwiminyaka emithathu (3) kufuneka ibe kwinqanaba elingansizi lomlawuli (iNqanaba loMlawuli oMncinci okanye elingako), isthifikethda ye-PERSAL nelayisensi yokushayela evakalayo kuya kuba lumsa olongezelelekileyo. Amaxabiso eKhompyutha aquka ulwazi oluhle olusebenzayo ngemimaxhoba ye-Microsoft Office, ngokukodwa i-Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, SharePoint, MS Forms, OneDrive, MS Teams ne-Word. Ulwazi ngencwadi yokuQondisa i-SMS, uMthetho weQela laBantu baseZikwelini njengoko ulungisiwe, uMthetho wokuQondisa iQela laBantu baseZikwelini njengoko ulungisiwe, izivumelwano zeQela, iimiyalelo ze-DPSA nezinye iNkqubo zoLawulo lweZiseko zeZabantu. Ulwazi ngeenqubo zolawulo, nolawulo lophulo. Amakhono amabalulwe axelweyo (enomlomo nangokubhalwayo). Amaxa eNkqubo ye-PERSAL. Amakhono oLawulo lweMali, amakhono oQaphelo olungumyalezo, uLungiselelo nokuHlelwa, amakhono eNkululeko anomlomo nangokubhalwayo, nakhono okusombulula iingxaki, amakhono okuVezwa ngaphambili, uQiniseko, uVakalelwe, nakhono okuBona iimpazamo, ukuBeka ngokuQondileyo nokuVela ngexesha, amakhono amabalulwe ngokusebenza nabantu, iNkqubo yokuKhululeka kubathengi, nokuLungelelana. Ukuba nakho ukusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo, ukuNika abanye umsebenzi, ukuMiswa kweekhonthroli nokuJonga imisebenzi. Ukuba nakho ukusebenza nabantu abanzima nokuSombulula iingxabano. uKuzithanda ukuHamba. uMvakalelo woxanduva, inyanisekileyo nokuQinisekisa.
xh.duties: Lawula futhi usebenze ngeenkqubo ze-PMDS zokuNgenisa iiMiqathango yokuSebenza, ukuQondanisa kwaphakathi koNyaka, ukuQondanisa konyaka nemibiko yokuQondanisa ukuba ngumsebenzi oQalayo yakuwo onke amalungu eQela loLawulo oPhakamileyo (SMS) nangalawo abangeyiyo. Qinisekisa ukhathazo lokhoyo loMqathango we-SMS nangalawo abangeyiyo, ukuQondanisa kwaphakathi koNyaka, ukuQondanisa koNyaka nemibiko yokuQondanisa ukuba ngumsebenzi oQalayo. Lawula iinkqubo zokuThathwa kwexabiso le-SMS nangalawo abangeyiyo, lawula iisiseko zezaKhathi ezikwiKhompyutha, ukusebenzisa i-PERSAL, futhi uMise iikomiti. Usebenza ngamandla ekusebenzeni kweNkqubo yokuKhuthaza nezivumelwano zeQela, kuquka i-OSD nangalawo abangeyiyo. Qinisekisa ukuba kukho iinkqubo zokuQonda nokuQondisa ngohambo lwe-PMDS. Lawula uLawulo lweNkqubo ye-PMDS kwiNkqubo yeKhompyutha nasezinye iindlela ezisebenza ngeKhompyutha. Qinisekisa ukuBhalwa kolwazi ngokuchanekileyo, ukuVakalisa, futhi unike iimBiko kuLawulo. Lawula iinkqubo zokuSombulula iingxabano okanye ezingavumelani evela kumQathango wokuSebenza, ukuQondanisa kwaphakathi koNyaka, ukuQondanisa konyaka, nemibiko yokuQondanisa ukuba ngumsebenzi oQalayo. Nikeza icebo elingumchithi kubathathi nxaxheba nakuLawulo.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Collective Bargaining, Negotiation and
jobs.department: Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment
jobs.closing_date_text: 31 August 2026, 16:00. No late application will be accepted
jobs.summary: Deputy Director responsible for managing collective bargaining processes and representing the Department at the Departmental Bargaining Chamber in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: National Diploma (NQF6) in Labour Relations or relevant qualification as recognized by SAQA. A minimum of five (5) years’ experience in collective bargaining / labour relations of which three (3) years should be at an entry / junior managerial level (Assistant Director level or equivalent). Knowledge of Labour Relations Act. Knowledge and understanding of project management, financial management and change management. People management and empowerment. Understanding HR policies, processes and procedures. Knowledge of Labour Relations processes. Good interpersonal relations, stakeholder engagement and research skills. Problem Solving and analysis. Good interpersonal relations skills. Ability to gather and analyse information. Ability to collect and interpret information and reports. Ability to develop, interpret, and apply policies. Ability to work with difficult people and to resolve conflicts Ability to work individually and in team.
jobs.duties: Manage and represent at the Departmental Bargaining Chamber and provide support. Manage and coordinate collective bargaining processes. Coordinate DBC meetings and represent the department. Ensure participation of Unions on Departmental committees. Facilitate negotiations on behalf of the Department to ensure effective and compliant outcomes. Presenting proposals and establishing ground rules. Bargaining by exchanging offers and counteroffers, often involving "good faith" negotiations. Ensure implementation of agreements emerging from bargaining structures. Manage and facilitate capacity-building (workshops and training) initiatives on employee relations matters to enhance organizational capability and ensure effective application of Labour relations policies and practice. Identify gaps and provide advice on the required development. Manage the coordination of workshops on employee relations processes and ensure stakeholders are engaged on course content. Provide employee relations advisory services to management and staff, ensuring informed decision-making and compliance with relevant policies, procedures, and Labour legislation. Support and advise managers in the drafting and issuance of intention and warning letters, ensuring compliance with labour legislation, policies, and procedural fairness. Advise Managers and supervisors on management of discipline in the workplace especially progressive discipline. Provide guidance on disciplinary, grievance, incapacity, and dispute resolution processes. Review and recommend appropriate actions in complex employee relations cases. Provide expert input on organizational policies to ensure compliance with labour laws and best practices.

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Kollektiewe Onderhandeling, Onderhandeling en
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur verantwoordelik vir die bestuur van kollektiewe onderhandelingsprosesse en die verteenwoordiging van die Departement by die Departementele Onderhandelingskamer in Pretoria.
af.requirements: Nasionale Diploma (NQF6) in Arbeidsverhoudinge of relevante kwalifikasie soos erken deur SAQA. 'n Minimum van vyf (5) jaar se ervaring in kollektiewe onderhandeling / arbeidsverhoudinge waarvan drie (3) jaar op 'n toegangspoort / junior bestuursvlak (Adjunkdirekteur-vlak of gelykwaardig) moet wees. Kennis van die Arbeidsverhoudingewet. Kennis en begrip van projekbestuur, finansiële bestuur en veranderingbestuur. Mensebestuur en bemagtiging. Begrip van HR-beleide, prosesse en prosedures. Kennis van Arbeidsverhoudingeprosesse. Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudinge, belanghebbende-betrokkenheid en navorsingsvaardighede. Probleemoplossing en ontleding. Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudingsvaardighede. Vermoë om inligting in te samel en te ontleed. Vermoë om inligting en verslae in te samel en te vertolk. Vermoë om beleide te ontwikkel, te vertolk en toe te pas. Vermoë om met moeilike mense te werk en konflikte op te los. Vermoë om individueel en in 'n span te werk.
af.duties: Bestuur en verteenwoordig by die Departementele Onderhandelingskamer en verskaf ondersteuning. Bestuur en koördineer kollektiewe onderhandelingsprosesse. Koördineer DBC-vergaderings en verteenwoordig die departement. Verseker deelname van Vakbonde aan Departementele komitees. Fasiliteer onderhandelings namens die Departement om effektiewe en voldoenende uitkomste te verseker. Voorstelle voorlê en grondreëls vasstel. Onderhandel deur aanbiede en teenaanbiede uit te ruil, wat dikwels "goeie trou"-onderhandelings behels. Verseker implementering van ooreenkomste wat uit onderhandelingsstrukture voortvloei. Bestuur en fasiliteer kapasiteitsbou- (werkswinkels en opleiding) inisiatiewe oor werknemersverhoudingsake om organisatoriese vermoë te verbeter en effektiewe toepassing van Arbeidsverhoudingebeleide en -praktyk te verseker. Identifiseer gapings en verskaf advies oor die vereiste ontwikkeling. Bestuur die koördinering van werkswinkels oor werknemersverhoudingsprosesse en verseker dat belanghebbendes by kursusinhoud betrokke raak. Verskaf werknemersverhoudings-adviesdienste aan bestuur en personeel, wat ingeligte besluitneming en voldoening aan relevante beleide, prosedures en Arbeidswetgewing verseker. Ondersteun en adviseer bestuurders by die opstel en uitreik van voorneme- en waarskuwingsbriewe, wat voldoening aan arbeidswetgewing, beleide en prosedurele billikheid verseker. Adviseer Bestuurders en toesighouers oor die bestuur van dissipline in die werkplek, veral progressiewe dissipline. Verskaf leiding oor dissiplinêre, klagte-, onbevoegdheids- en geskiloplossingsprosesse. Hersien en beveel toepaslike optrede aan in komplekse werknemersverhoudingsake. Verskaf kundige insette oor organisatoriese beleide om voldoening aan arbeidswette en beste praktyke te verseker.

zu.title: Onojulephutha: Collective Bargaining, Negotiation and
zu.summary: Onojulephutha onenjongo yokuphatha izinqubo zokuxoxisana ngokuhlelekile kanye nokumela umnyango e-Departmental Bargaining Chamber e-Pretoria.
zu.requirements: I-National Diploma (NQF6) ku-Labour Relations noma izifundo ezihambisana nayo njengoba ezwa u-SAQA. Ukuze kube okungenani iminyaka eyisihlanu (5) semisebenzi kukuxoxisana ngokuhlelekile / kumabango abasebenzi, okuyilapho iminyaka eyithathu (3) kufanele ibe esikhundleni sokungena / sokuba ngumphathi oshaqekile (izinga lika-Assistant Director noma okulingana nalokho). Ukuqonda i-Labour Relations Act. Ulwazi kanye nokuqonda ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo, ukuphathwa kwezimali kanye nokuphathwa kokushintsha. Ukuphathwa kwabantu kanye nokukhuliswa kwabo. Ukuqonda izinqubomgomo ze-HR, izinqubo kanye nemithetho. Ulwazi lwezinqubo zo-Labour Relations. Ubuhlobo obuhle phakathi kwabantu, ukuxhumana nabathintekayo kanye namakhono okupenya. Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuqeqesha ulwazi. Amakhono obuhlobo obuhle phakathi kwabantu. Ikono lokuthola kanye nokuqeqesha ulwazi. Ikono lokuqoqa kanye nokutshazamisa ulwazi kanye namabhuku. Ikono lokuthuthukisa, ukutshazamisa, futhi kusebenzise izinqubomgomo. Ikono lokusebenza nabantu abanzima kanye nokuxazulula izinkinga. Ikono lokusebenza wedwa nakube ngaphakathi kwethimba.
zu.duties: Phatha futhi umele e-Departmental Bargaining Chamber futhi unikeze inkaselo. Phatha futhi uhlanganise izinqubo zokuxoxisana ngokuhlelekile. Hlanganisa izingxoxo ze-DBC futhi umele umnyango. Qinisekisa ukuthathana kwabasebenzi ngokwamalunga kwabasebenzi emakomidi omnyango. Yenza izingxoxo ngenkosi yomnyango ukuze kuqinisekiswe iziphumelelo ezisebenzayo nezihambisana nomthetho. Yezincomo futhi usungale imithetho esisekelo. Xoxa ngokushintshanisa izincomo nokuphikisana nazo, okuvame ukuhilela izingxoxo 'zekulethwe ngokwethembeka'. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwemithetho ephuma ezinhlelweni zokuxoxisana. Phatha futhi wenze izinhlela zokwakha amandla (amaseminari nokugqiliza) ezindabeni zomabango abasebenzi ukuze kuthuthuke ikhono lenhlangano futhi kuqinisekiswe ukusetshenziswa okusebenzayo kwezinqubomgomo nokwenzeka komabango abasebenzi. Hlola izikhala futhi unikezezeluleko ngokuthuthuka okudingekayo. Phatha ukuhlanganiswa kwamaseminari ezinqubo zomabango abasebenzi futhi qinisekisa ukuthi abathintekayo bakhona kokuqukethwe kwesifundo. Nikeze izinkonzo zokweluleka ngomabango abasebenzi abaphathi kanye nabasebenzi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthathwa kwezinqumo eziqondile nokuhambisana nezinqubomgomo, izinqubo, kanye nomthetho wabasebenzi. Sekela futhi weluleke abaphathi ekubhalweni nokukhipheni amagama wokwazisa nokuleisa, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhambisana nomthetho wabasebenzi, izinqubomgomo, kanye nokulingana kwezinqubo. Weluleke abaphathi kanye nabaphathi bamazinga ngokuphathwa kwezigameko kumsebenzi ikakhulukazi isigameko esithuthukayo. Nikeza isiqondiswa ezinqubweni zokulalelwa izigameko, izikhalazo, ukungakwazi, kanye nokuxazulula izingxabano. Hlola futhi ushole izinyathelo ezifanele ezimeni ezinzima zamabango abasebenzi. Nikeza imibono yengcweti ezinhlelweni zenhlangano ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhambisana nomthetho wabasebenzi kanye nezindlela ezinhle kakhulu.

xh.title: Isekela Mongameli: Izingqumbo Zokusebenza Ngokudibana, Ukuxoxwa Ngemigaqo Nokunye
xh.summary: Isekela Mongameli oqhubekayo noyilo lweenkqubo zokusebenza ngokudibana nokumela iNkundla yesebe kwiSikhululo Sokuxoxwa ngokuSebenza sesebe ePretoria.
xh.requirements: I-National Diploma (NQF6) kumakhedule wokuQashwa kwabasebenzi okanye izifundo ezifanelekileyo njengoko ziqatshwa yi-SAQA. Okungaphezulu kweminyaka emihlanu (5) yamava kwinkqubo yokusebenza ngokudibana / kwimiba yokurhoxiswa kwabasebenzi apho iminyaka emithathu (3) inokuba ngumnqamlelo onqanaba lokungena / umphathi osezantsi (inqanaba lomncedisi womphathi okanye elinganayo). Ulwazi ngoMthetho wokuQashwa kwabasebenzi. Ulwazi nokuqonda lolawulo lweenkqubo, lolawulo lweemali noluguqulo. Ulawulo lwabantu nokuzincedisa. Ukuqonda iinkqubo, iinkqubo neenkqubo ze-HR. Ulwazi lweenkqubo zobudlelwane bokusebenza. Ubudlelwane obuhle phakathi kwabantu, ukuzibandakanya nabathathi-nxaxheba namakhono aphando. Ukuxelela iingxaki kwaye uhlengahlengise iingcombolo. Amakhono obudlelwane obuhle phakathi kwabantu. Ukuba nolwazi ngokuqokelela nokuhlengahlengisa iinkcukacha. Ukuba nolwazi ngokuqokelela nokutolika iinkcukacha neengxelo. Ukuyila, ukutolika, nokuvelisa iinkqubo. Ukusebenza nabantu ababucayi nokuqitha iingxabano. Ukusebenza ngabanye nakuqela.
xh.duties: Yiba ngumlawuli kwaye umele esikhululweni sokuxoxwa ngokuSebenza sesebe uze unikeze inkxaso. Yiba ngumlawuli kwaye ulungelelanise iinkqubo zokusebenza ngokudibana. Lungelelanisa iindibano ze-DBC kwaye umele isebе. Qinisekisa ukuzibandakanya kweziqeqesha kumagatya osebe. Qinisekisa ukuxoxwa ngemigaqo ngokomgaqo weSebe ukuze kuqinisekiswe iziphumo ezisebenzayo nezigqibeleleyo. Sentsula iingcakuiso kwaye uske imigaqo esiseko. Ukuxoxwa ngokutshintshana kwesicelo nezinye iingxelo, ngoko konke kuquka "ukuxoxwa ngokuzithembileyo". Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa kweenkqubo ezivela kumagatya amaxoxwayo. Yiba ngumlawuli kwaye lungelelanise inkqubo yokuphucula ikhono (iindibano nokuqeqesha) kumazomgama wabasebenzi ukuze kuphuculwe ulwazi lentshi yoshishino ukuqinisekisa izicelo ngokusebenza ezisebenzayo nemigaqo yolawulo yokuQashwa kwabasebenzi nokuqhelanisa. Zibo iingxaki nze unikeze inkxaso kulwazi oludingekayo kwilwa lwentshi. Lungelelanise iindibano kulwa lwabasebenzi ze ziqhube ukuqinisekisa ukuba abathathi-nxaxheba baxoxwe ngokuqaliswa kolwazi. Sika inkxaso ngokwamazomgama wabasebenzi kubaphathi nabasebenzi, ukuqinisekisa ukuthathwa kwezigqibo ezikwaziboni nokuqinisekisa ulandelo lomthetho neenkqubo ezifanelekileyo. Nika inkxaso kwaye ze ixhase abaphathi ekuyili nokusuka iincwadana ezisesinyeni nokuqwalasela, nokuqinisekisa ulandelo lomthetho, imigaqo nolungelo olulandelwayo. Ze ixhase abaphathi kwaye zibe nolwazi olufanelekileyo ngolawulo bokuziphatha ekusebenzeni, ngakumbi ukuqeqesha ukuziphatha. Ze inikeze inkxaso kumazomgama oqeqeshe, iingxelo, ukungasakhondo nokusombulula iingxabano. Qwalasela kwaye ze ixatise izigqibo ezifanelekileyo ezindabeni zentshi. Sika inkxaso egqithisileyo kwimigaqo yolawulo entshi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ulandelo ngokomthetho wokuQashwa kwabasebenzi nangokwemigaqo ehlobo.

jobs.department: Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment

jobs.summary: Deputy Director needed in Pretoria to coordinate employee health and wellness programmes, requiring a relevant degree, professional registration, and five years of experience.
jobs.requirements: A Bachelor’s Degree in Psychology / Social Sciences (NQF7) or relevant qualification as recognized by SAQA. Registration with Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as Counsellor or Psychologist or South African Council for Social Service Professions (SACSSP) as a Social Worker. A minimum of five (5) years’ experience in Employee health and wellness of which three (3) years should be at an entry/junior managerial level (Assistant Director Level or equivalent). Computer literate. Ability to gather and analyse information. Ability to develop and apply policies. Ability to work with difficult people and to resolve conflicts. Sense of responsibility and loyalty. Initiative and creativity.

Coordinate the implementation of assessment, counselling and referral services to all vulnerable employees. Analyse individual and group needs to identify psycho- social risks and recommend interventions and action plans. Coordinate the implementation of managerial training and other related life skills training for employees. Coordinate the annual review of wellness management policies. Coordinate the implementation of HIV and TB management programmes. Coordinate the implementation of Health and Productivity Management programmes. Coordinate the implementation of Health screens of employees. Coordinate the implementation of various health awareness and education activities according to the wellness schedule and health calendar. Coordinate the compilation of Employee Health and Wellness reports, manage the appointment, a of the and management and all processes relating to external EHW service providers.

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Werknemer- en Gesondheidswelsyn
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur benodig in Pretoria om werknemergesondheids- en welsynsprogramme te koördineer, met 'n relevante graad, professionele registrasie en vyf jaar se ervaring as vereistes.
af.requirements: 'n Baccalaureusgraad in Sielkunde / Sosiale Wetenskappe (NQF7) of 'n relevante kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken. Registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as Berader of Sielkundige of by die South African Council for Social Service Professions (SACSSP) as Maatskaplike Werker. 'n Minimum van vyf (5) jaar se ervaring in werknemergesondheid en welsyn, waarvan drie (3) jaar op 'n intree/junior bestuursvlak (Assistentdirekteurvlak of gelykwaardig) moet wees. Kennis en begrip van projbestuur. Kennis van EAPA SA-standaarde, DPSA EHW-raamwerk en beleide, gesondheids- en gedragsrisiko's in die werkplek, HIV/AIDS Nasionale Strategiese Plan, HR-praktyke en prosedures. Kennis van die Public Finance Management Act en Treasury Regulations. Kennis van Openbare Diens- en departementele prosedures en voorskrifte. Sketer beplannings- en organisasievaardighede, goeie kommunikasievaardighede, interpersoonlike vaardighede, leierskap- en bestuursvaardighede, koördineringsvaardighede, gevorderde beradingsvaardighede en gevorderde EAP-vaardighede. Sin van verantwoordelikheid en lojaliteit. Inisiatief en kreatiwiteit.
af.duties: Koördineer die implementering van welsynsbestuursprogramme. Implementeer die strategiese raamwerk vir Gesondheid en Welsyn. Koördineer die implementering van assesserings-, beradings- en verwysingsdienste aan alle kwesbare werknemers. Ontleed individuele en groepbehoeftes om psigososiale risiko's te identifiseer en ingrypings en aksieplanne aan te beveel. Koördineer die implementering van bestuursopleiding en ander verwante lewensvaardigheidsopleiding vir werknemers. Koördineer die jaarlikse hersiening van welsynsbestuursbeleide. Koördineer die implementering van HIV- en TB-bestuursprogramme. Koördineer die implementering van Gesondheids- en Produktiwiteitsbestuursprogramme. Koördineer die implementering van gesondheidsondersoeke van werknemers. Koördineer die implementering van verskeie gesondheidsbewustheids- en opvoedingsaktiwiteite volgens die welsynskedule en gesondheidskalender. Koördineer die opstel van Werknemergesondheids- en Welsynsverslae, bestuur die aanstelling, bestuur en alle prosesse rakende externe EHW-diensverskaffers.

zu.title: Isikhulu Esiphethe: Ukuthuthukiswa Kwabasebenzi Nenzuzo Yezempilo
zu.summary: Kudingeka isikhulu esiphethe ePretoria ukuba sinciphise Izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi nenzuzo yezempilo, kudinga iziqu ezifanele, ukubhalisa ngobungcweti, namashumi eminyaka emihlanu wethuba.
zu.requirements: I-Degree ye-Bachelor eNQF7 kwi-Psychology / Social Sciences noma iziqu ezifanele njengokuhlonishwa yi-SAQA. Ukubhalisa ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengoba ngu-Counsellor noma i-Psychologist noma i-South African Council for Social Service Professions (SACSSP) njengengumsebenzi wezezenhlalakahle. Okungenani ihlelo leminyaka eyisikhombisa (7) yethuba kwi-Employee health and wellness lapho kuleyo minyaka emithathu (3) kufanele ibe ngazinga elingaphakeme noma elinganeni labaphathi (Assistant Director Level noma okulingana nalo). Ulwazi futhi ukuqonda i-Project Management. Ulwazi lwemigingo ye-EAPA SA standards, i-DPSA EHW framework kanye namapholisi, Izengo zezempilo noluziphathe endaweni yokusebenza, i-HIV/AIDS National Strategic Plan, izindlela namapholisi we-HR. Ulwazi lwe-Public Finance Management Act kanye ne-Treasury Regulations. Ulwazi lokuqonda izinqubo namapholisi we-Public Service kanye nowoMnyango. Ubuciko bokuhlela futhi ukuhlela kahle amasu, amakhono okuxhumana kahle, amakhono abantu, amakhono obuholi nobuphathi, amakhono okulungelelanisa, amakhono obusosizi obuthuthukile kanye namakhono we-EAP athuthukile. Ukuba nokwazi ngokwenza ngesigaxa. Ikono lokuthola futhi ukuqondanisa ulwazi. Ikono lokuthuthukisa futhi ukusebenzisa amapholisi. Ikono lokusebenza nabantu abenkinga futhi ukuxazulula izingxabano. Ubuqotho ngemibalabala kanye nobuqotho. Ukuzimisela nokudala okusha.
zu.duties: Baluleka ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zokuphathwa kwezenzuzo. Hlela i-framework yesimo sokulwa nengculaza ukuba sisetshenziswe. Baluleka ukuthi kusebenze izinsizakalo zokuqola, ukweluleka kanye nokuthumela kubasebenzi abasondelene nengozizi. Hlaziya izidingo zomuntu siqu kanye namaqembu ukuze kutholwe izengo ezenhlalo nengqondo bese kuphakanyiswa izindlela zokuxazulula kanye namaphulo enza. Baluleka ukuthi kusetshenziswe ukuqeqeshwa kwabaphathi nokunye ukuqeqeshwa ngamakhono okuphila kubasebenzi. Baluleka ukwenziwa kokuqoka ngamadlula unyaka kwezinhlelo zokuphathwa kwezenzuzo. Baluleka ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zokuphathwa kwe-HIV kanye ne-TB. Baluleka ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zokuphathwa kwezempilo kanye nokuphumelelisa. Baluleka ukwenziwa kweziquo ezibhekene nempilo yabasebenzi. Baluleka ukwenza izinhlelo ezihlukene zokukhuthaza izempilo nokufundisa ngokwe-schedule yenzuzo noma ikhalenda yezempilo. Baluleka ukuqoqwa kwezibika ze-Employee Health and Wellness, ukuphatha ukumiswa, ukuphathi kanye nazo yonke izinqubo ezihlobene nabahlinzeki bezinsizakalo be-EHW bangaqondile.

xh.title: Isekela-Mnomabo: Ulondolozo Lwabasebenzi Nempilo
xh.summary: Kufuneka isekela-mnomabo ePretoria ukuze ahlohlise izinkqubo zempilo nentlalutle lomsebenzi, kwaye kufuneka abe nedayimu elifanelekileyo, abhaliswe njengomsebenzi wekhondo, aneminyaka emihlanu yamava.
xh.requirements: Kufuneka ibe ne-Degree ye-Bachelor ePsychology / Izenzululwazi Zezentlalo (NQF7) okanye nelifanelekileyo elivunywa yi-SAQA. Kufuneka abhalise kwi-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengengumcebisi okanye njengengengcali yeziqukwelimo okanye kwi-South African Council for Social Service Professions (SACSSP) njengengumsebenzi wentlalo. Kufuneka abe nobuncwane beminyaka emihlanu (5) yamava kulondolozo lwempilo nentlalutle lomsebenzi, apho kwakuyo iminyaka mithathu (3) kufuneka ibe kwinqanaba elingenisa/belingaphakathi lobulungu (iinqanaba losekela-mnomabo okanye elilingana nalo. Ulwazi nokuqonda iProject Management. Ulwazi lwemilinganiselo ye-EAPA SA, nokuqonda iinkqubo namagunya e-DPSA EHW, iingozi zempilo nentlithe yekhondo kwindawo yokusebenza, iHIV/AIDS National Strategic Plan, iinkqubo nendlela zokwenza izinto ze-HR. Ulwazi lwe-Public Finance Management Act nemiGalelo yeTreasury. Ulwazi lweenkqubo namagunya eSebe loNtikamiso. Indlela elungileyo yokucwangisa nokuqamba izinto, amakhono amabalulu ekulawulana, amakhono obundlwini obukhulu, amakhano onke, nobukhosi obukhulu, amakhano ekuhambelaneni, amakhano obuNtsomi obuphambili, kwaye nemisebenzi yokuncedisa abantu engowona msebenzi opheleleyo nakwabanye abantu abanomsebenzi omkhulu. Ulwazi lwekhalikhuletha. Ulwazi lokuthwala nokuseta ulwazi. Ulwazi lokubumba nokuvelisa kwaye wasebenzise amagunya. Ulwazi lwekhalikhuletha ekuqonda abantu kwaye uxazimule iingozi ezithile. Inkathalo nobuhambelani bokwenza izinto ngokufanelekileyo. Intsebenzo nemigaqo netyala elityala.
xh.duties: Yiba nabavelisi bokuhambisa iinkqubo zokulawula nokuqonda ngokuqinisekileyo. Qhubeza ukuqatshelwa kwengqiqo yokulawula ulondolozo. Hlela nokuqatshelwa koluntu ngezicelo ezikhoyo nakwelinye ilizwe. Hlola ukuqonda kokuphila komntu ngamnye nokuqonda kwemigaqo yamagunya nokuqhubekelela phambili. Qhubeza ukuqonda kokubakho kokwenza amagunya omsebenzi nokuzilolonga iinkqubo ezizeza ulwazi oluqhelekileyo. Hlela ukuphonononga kwamnye unyaka kolondolozo lweNtloko nokuqonda nokuqonda. Qhubeza ukwenziwa kweekhophu zokuthengisa kwaye kubekwe iinkqubo zokulawula i-HIV ne-TB. Qhubeza iinkqubo zokulawula impilo nokuqonda ngokubaluleka kweenkqubo zokulungiselela. Qhubeza ukwenza iinkqubo zokuvavanya imidlalo yokuphila komsebenzi. Qhubeza ukwenziwa kwezinye izinto ezithile ezinempilo kwaye zinolwazi nokuqatshelwa kolwazi ngokulandelwa kwesishwakuqonda nangokwamanye amava. Hlola nokuqonda kwesishwakuqonda sokubakho nokusetyenziswa koluntu nokuqonda ngokukhaladi kwesikolo sama-Sixhosa.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Service Conditions and Benefits

jobs.summary: Assistant Director position managing service conditions and benefits, including leave, allowances and PILIR, requiring an HR diploma or degree with three years' relevant experience.
jobs.requirements: National Diploma/Degree (NQF6) in Human Resources Management or equivalent qualification within the relevant field. A minimum of three (3) years’ experience in Service Conditions and Benefits. Experience in managing Policy on Incapacity Leave and ill - Health Retirement (PILIR) and experience in managing service termination process. Understanding of the Human Resource Management Legislations and regulatory framework. Knowledge and understanding of Public Service procedures and prescripts. Knowledge of Public Finance Management Act and Treasury Regulations. Knowledge of HR practice & procedures. Knowledge of administrative procedures, project management and personnel management. Good communication skills (verbal and written). Good interpersonal skills, Supervisory and change management skills. Knowledge of policy development and implementation. Sound research, analytical, organising, planning, presentation coordination and stakeholder liaison skills. Experience in PERSAL system (certificates will be an added advantage). Ability to work under pressure and adhere to strict deadlines.
jobs.duties: Manage and monitor the implementation of service benefits and conditions such as leave allowances, resettlement, medical assistance, and long service recognition in line with relevant prescripts. Ensure the successful implementation of policies on matters related to human resource management to adhere to the relevant prescripts/legislation. Conduct information sharing sessions on service benefits and conditions. Manage the performance of other remunerative work outside the public service and financial disclosures. Manage Policy on Incapacity Leave and Ill- Health Retirement (PILIR). Manage the implementation service termination process and exit interviews.

af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Diensvoorwaardes en Voordele
af.summary: Assistentdirekteurposisie wat diensvoorwaardes en voordele bestuur, insluitend verlof, toelaes en PILIR, waarvoor 'n HR-diploma of -graad met drie jaar se relevante ervaring vereis word.
af.requirements: Nasionale Diploma/Graad (NQF6) in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur of ekwivalente kwalifikasie binne die relevante veld. 'n Minimum van drie (3) jaar se ervaring in Diensvoorwaardes en Voordele. Ervaring in die bestuur van Beleid oor Onvermoënsverlof en Gesondheidsverwante Vroëre Uittrede (PILIR) en ervaring in die bestuur van die diensbeëindigingsproses. Begrip van die Menslike Hulpbronbestuurswetgewing en regulatoriese raamwerk. Kennis en begrip van Openbare Diens prosedures en voorskrifte. Kennis van die Openbare Finansiesbestuurswet en Tesourie-regulasies. Kennis van HR-praktyk en -prosedures. Kennis van administratiewe prosedures, projekbestuur en personeelbestuur. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede (mondelings en skriftelik). Goeie interpersoonlike vaardighede, toesig- en veranderingbestuursvaardighede. Kennis van beleidsontwikkeling en -implementering. Deeglike navorsings-, analitiese, organisatoriese, beplannings, aanbiedingskoördinasie- en belanghebbendekommunikasievaardighede. Ervaring in die PERSAL-stelsel (sertifikate sal 'n voordeel wees). Vermoë om onder druk te werk en streng sperdatums na te kom.
af.duties: Bestuur en monitor die implementering van diensvoordele en -voorwaardes soos verloftoelaes, hervestiging, mediese bystand en erkenning van lang diens in ooreenstemming met relevante voorskrifte. Verseker die suksesvolle implementering van beleid oor aangeleenthede wat verband hou met menslike hulpbronbestuur om aan die relevante voorskrifte/wetgewing te voldoen. Voer inligtingsdelingsessies oor diensvoordele en -voorwaardes uit. Bestuur die verrigting van ander besoldigende werk buite die openbare diens en finansiële openbaarmakings. Bestuur Beleid oor Onvermoënsverlof en Gesondheidsverwante Vroëre Uittrede (PILIR). Bestuur die implementering van die diensbeëindigingsproses en uitgangsonderhoude.

zu.title: Usomlungisi: Izimo Zokusebenza Nezinzuzo
zu.summary: Isikhundla sosomlungisi sokuphathwa kwezimo zokusebenza nezinzuzo, okuhlanganisa ilayivu, izimali ezedluliselwe, kanye ne-PILIR, sifuna idiploma noma iziqu ze-HR ezindebe zinyakathelo elingana nasetathathu isikhathi esingaphezu kweminyaka emithathu sokuqashelwa ngemisebenzi ehambisana nalokho.
zu.requirements: I-Diploma yezizwe/Iziqu (NQF6) ekuPhathweni Kwamathuluzi Omuntu noma iziqu ezingalingana nalokho kumkhakha ohambisana nalokho. Isikhathi esingaphansi kweminyaka emithathu (3) sokuqashelwa ngemisebenzi kwezimo Zokusebenza Nezinzuzo. Okuhlelwako ekuphatheni iNqubomgomo yoHlelo lokwehluleka Kokusebenza Ngenxa Yokugula nokuhlelwa kweHhovisi Eliyinhloko kuze kuthi umuntu ahlale khona ekhaya kanzima noma ashiye umsebenzi ngempilo yakhe engaphilanga kahle (PILIR) kanye nokuqashelwa ngemisebenzi ekuphatheni inqubo yokupheliswa kokusebenza. Ukuqonda kokuqashwa komthetho wokuqashwa kwamathuluzi omuntu kanye nendikimba yomthetho nokulawulwa kwawo. Ulwazi nokuqonda kwezindlela ezingaba yisibonelo zomsebenzi kahulumeni kanye nemibhalo epathwa ngamaphoyisa. Ulwazi ngomthetho wokuqashwa kwemali kahulumeni kanye nemithetho yokuqashwa kwemali evela kwindlu yamalu. Ulwazi ngokuqashwa kwamathuluzi omuntu kwezindlela zokwenza imisebenzi. Ulwazi lwezindlela zokuphatha imisebenzi, ukulawula amaphrojekthi kanye nokuphatha abantu. Amakhono okuxhumana kahle (okuqashwa ngesandiso kanye nokubhaliwe). Amakhono okuxhumana kahle nabantu, amakhono okulawula abantu kanye namakhono okushintsha izinto. Ulwazi ngokuthuthukiswa nokusetshenziswa kwenqubomgomo. Amakhono okuhlola, ukuhlaziya, ukuhlela, ukweluleka ngokwakho, ukuqashwa kwemisebenzi kanye nokuxhumanana nabaluleki. Okuhlelwako ekusebenzeni ngesistimu ye-PERSAL (izitifiketi zizobe zithathwa njengenani elingeza okuhle). Isikhundla sokusebenza ngaphansi kwengcindezelo kanye nokubambelela esikhathini esibekiwe sokuphela kokuqashwa imisebenzi.
zu.duties: Phatha kanye nokubuka ukusetshenziswa kwezinzuzo nezimo zokusebenza njengokuthi izimali zelayivu, ukufuduka, usizo lwezempilo, kanye nokuqashelwa kwesikhathi eside ngokuvumelana nemibhalo epathwa ngamaphoyisa. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa ngempumelelo kwezinqubomgomo kwezinto ezihlobene nokuphathwa kwamathuluzi omuntu ukuze kuhambisane nemibhalo/umthetho ohambisana nalokho. Yenza izikhathi zokwabelana ngolwazi ngezinzuzo nezimo zokusebenza. Phatha ukwenziwa kwemisebenzi eminye ekhokhelwayo engaphandle komsebenzi kahulumeni kanye nokuvezwa okuphathwa ngemali. Phatha iNqubomgomo yoHlelo lokwehluleka Kokusebenza Ngenxa Yokugula nokuhlelwa kweHhovisi Eliyinhloko kuze kuthi umuntu ahlale khona ekhaya kanzima noma ashiye umsebenzi ngempilo yakhe engaphilanga kahle (PILIR). Phatha ukusetshenziswa kwenqubo yokupheliswa kokusebenza kanye nezinkinga zokuphela kokusebenza.

xh.title: Umphathi oNcedisayo: Iimeko zeNkonzo neenzuzo
xh.summary: Isithuba somPhathi oNcedisayo sophatha iimeko zenkonzo neenzuzo, kuquka iinkhathi zokuphumla, imali ethintelwe nakwi-PILIR, kufuneka idiploma okanye isidanga se-HRineminyaka mithathu yamava ahambelanayo.
xh.requirements: National Diploma/Degree (NQF6) kwakuPhathwa koBuntu bemisebenzi okanye isifa esilinganayo kwikhondo elicandelayo. Ubuncinane beminyaka mithathu (3) yamava kwiimeko zeNkonzo neenzuzo. Ulwazi lokuphatha iNqumlelwano malunga neNkhathi yoKuphumla ngenxa yokungabi nampilo nokuPhuma emsebenzini ngenxa yokungaphili (PILIR) nolwazi lokuphatha inkqubo yokuphelisa inkonzo. Ukuqonda iMithetho yoPhatho lweBantu neNkqubo yolawulo. Ulwazi nokuqonda iinkqubo namagunya oLwazi kuLwazi kuLuntu. Ulwazi loMthetho woPhatho lweMali yoLuntu nemiQathango yeTreasury. Ulwazi lwenkqubo namaxanduva oPhatho lweBantu. Ulwazi lweenkqubo zolawulo, uphatho lweeprojekthi nolawulo lwabantu. Amabalo amabalawuni okuthetha nabani (ngomlomo nakubhalwe). Amabawu abantu abahanahanisana nabo, amabawu okulawula abantu nokuguqula inkqabo. Ulwazi lwenkqubo yokuqamba nokuphumeza iingqungquthela. Amabawu okuphanda, ukuhlalutya, ukuqamba, iplani nokuhambelaniswa namabaledi. Amava kwindlela yamagunya emisebenzi (amatifiketi aya kuba ngaphezulu kakhulu). Isakhono sokusebenza ngowehlo nokuqwalasela iinkqubo ezibalulekileyo zeSouth Africa.
xh.duties: Phatha ukuqwalasela nokuphumeza iinkonzo ezinzuzo nemiqathango yazo njengokuphuma kwamahlelo okuzinza, indlela yokubuyela endlwini, incedo yezempilo nokwamkelwa kweminyaka yamava ngokweMithetho ngokwemigaqo efanayo. Qinisekisa ukuphumeza ngempumelelo iingqungquthela malunga nemiqathango ecaleni kolawulo oluhambelanayo oluQondene noBuntu bekuthathwa ngokwemigaqo efanayo. Qhube imibhalo egqithisa ulwazi malunga neenzuzo nemiqathazo yenkonzo. Phatha ukwenza okunye ukusebenza okuhambelana nokuzinza kwenkonzo yangaphandle kwaye uqwalasele imali yexabiso. Phatha iNqumlelwano yeNkhathi yoKuphumla ngenxa yokungabi nampilo nokuPhuma emsebenzini ngenxa yokungaphili (PILIR). Phatha ukuphumeza inkqubo yokuphelisa inkonzo nokugqithiswa kwabasebenzi abasuka kwindlela yokusebenza.

af.title: Mediese Ordonnans: Gough Island
af.summary: Verskaf mediese behandeling, klein tandheelkundige en x-straaldiens aan ekspedisiespanlede op afgeleë Gough Island, insluitend voorraadbestuur en verslagdoening.
af.requirements: Nasionale Diploma / Graad in Verpleegkunde/ Sertifikaat in Operasionele Noodhulpbeoefenaar of equivalente relevante kwalifikasie. Aansoekers moet by die HPCSA (Health Professions Council of South Africa) of SANC (South African Nursing Council) geregistreer wees. 3-5 jaar relevante ervaring vereis. Ervaring in landelike of afgeleë geneeskunde. Kennis van Acute Trauma Life Support en ACLS Acute Cardiac Life Support. Kennis van verpleegsorgprosesse en prosedures, verpleegstatutes en ander relevante regsraamwerk soos die Nursing Act, Health Act, Occupational Health & Safety Act, Patient Rights Charter Act, Public Service Regulations Act en Labour Relations Act. Moet leierskapsvaardighede, besluitneming, probleemoplossing, interpersoonlike vaardighede en rekenaarvaardighede in basiese programme hê. Die ampshouer moet in staat wees om onafhanklik met minimale ondersteuning onder uiterste druk en sonder toesig te werk. Die ampshouer moet goeie mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede hê en die vermoë om in 'n span te werk.
af.duties: Die ampshouer sal verantwoordelik wees vir die verskaffing van mediese behandeling aan alle spanlede tydens die ekspedisie en verseker dat die werk volgens die omvang van praktykregulasies is. Onderneem klein tandheelkundige en x-strale wanneer nodig. Berei verslae voor, doen voorraadopnames van kos en medisyne. Bestee onderdele en toerusting en doen ander algemene nie-tegniese pligte wat deur ekspedisielede uitgevoer word. Verseker dat kos volgens die mediese wette gestoor word deur hoë standaarde van kos/ higiëne/ huishoudelike/ linne- en kleedrolle te handhaaf. Verskaf ondersteuning aan spanleier vir koördinering en opleiding vir die redding en ontruimings/ noodprosedures vir die eiland asook in 'n sosiale rol om medespanlede te motiveer en aan te moedig.

zu.title: Umsebenzi Wezokwelapha: Gough Island
zu.summary: Nika unakekelo lwezokwelapha, amasevisi amancane ezinyo kanye namasevisi e-x-ray kwabaningi beqembu lokuhamba ibanga elikude i-Gough Island, okuhlanganisa nokuphathwa kwokusabalalisa izimpahla nokubika.
zu.requirements: I-Diploma Yezwe / I-Degree eBuchosheni / Isitifiketi sokuba ngumuntu osebenza ngokwelapha izipha ezingozini noma izifundo ezihambisana naleso ezifunekayo. Abafaki izicelo kufanele babhalise kwi-HPCSA (Health Professions Council of South Africa) noma i-SANC (South African Nursing Council.) Zidingwa iminyaka engu-3-5 yamava ahambisana nalokhu. Amanywa amava ezokwelapha ezindaweni zasemakhaya noma ezikude. Amanywa ulwazi nge-Acute Trauma Life Support kanye ne-ACLS Acute Cardiac Life Support. Amanywa ulwazi ngemigudu namaphrothokholo okunakekelwa kwezokwelapha, umthetho wokwelapha kanye nezinye izakhiwo zomthetho ezihambisana nalokhu njengomthetho we-Nursing Act, i-Health Act, i-Occupational Health & Safety Act, i-Patient Rights Charter Act, i-Public Service Regulations Act kanye ne-Labour Relations Act. Kufanele abe namakhono okuholo, ukwenza izinqumo, ukuxazulula izinkinga, amakhono okuxhumana nabantu kanye namakhono ekhompyutha kwimihlahlandlela eveyikho. Lowo othathe isikhundla kufanele akwazi ukusebenza eyedwa ngenkethelo encane yokwesekwa ngaphansi kwengcindezi enkulu futhi ngaphandle kolawulo. Lowo othathe isikhundla kufanele abe namakhono amahle okukhuluma nokubhaliwe kanye nokuqasha ukusebenza eqenjini.
zu.duties: Lowo othathe isikhundla uzobe necibolo lokunika unakekelo lwesokwelapha kubo bonke abanamelingeqembu ngesikhathi sokuhamba ibanga futhi aqiniseke ukuthi umsebenzi uyenzeka ngokusho komthetho wobusingathi bomkhakha. Akha amasevisi amancane ezinyo kanye ne-x-ray lapho kudingeka khona. Lungiselela umbhalo wokubika, wenze ukubala kolunye ukudla nemithi. Oda izingxenye ezilondoloziwayo nezinye izimpahla futhi wenze eminye imisebenzi evamile engokuchwepheshe eyenziwa bamalungu eqembu lokuhamba ibanga. Qinisekisa ukuthi ukudla kugcinwa ngokusho komthetho wezokwelapha ngokugcina izinga eliphezulu kokudla / ukuhlanzeka / ukunakekelwa kwendlu / ukuhlinzekwa kwegumbi kanye nemisebenzi yokushongela. Nikeza inkxaso kumholi weqembu ukuze uhlole futhi aqeqeshe ngemigudu yesipholo nokususwa kwabantu / izinhlela zezipha ezingozini zesiqhingi kanye nendima yomphakathi ukuze agqugquzele futhi akhuthaze ongamlungu eqembu.

xh.title: Umsebenzi Wezolimo Wezempilo: Gough Island
xh.summary: Nika unyango lwezempilo, iinkonzo ezincinci zamazipho nokutyhilwa kwangaphakathi kumalungu eqela lohambo kwindawo ekude i-Gough Island, kuquka nolawulo lwesitokhwe nokubika.
xh.requirements: I-National Diploma / Degree kwiNursing/ i-Certificate kwi-Operational Emergency Care Practitioner okanye isifanekiso esifanelekileyo esingekho ngaphantsi kwamabala. Abafakeli kufuneka babesolvable kwi-HPCSA (Health Professions Council of South Africa) okanye i-SANC (South African Nursing Council.) Kufuneka kube nokugqithiswa kwamava eminyaka 3-5 edibana nalo msebenzi. Amandla kwindawo eziyinkampu okanye kwezonyango ezikude. Ulwazi nge-Acute Trauma Life Support naku-ACLS Acute Cardiac Life Support. Ulwazi ngemigaqo nendlela zokunyangeka kwezempilo, imithetho yezibonelelo ezinywayo nolunye ugqibo lwemithetho olufana no-Nursing Act, Health Act, Occupational Health & Safety Act, Patient Rights Charter Act, Public Service Regulations Act no-Labour Relations Act. Kufuneka kube nokuhlakanipha ekubukeni, ekwenzeni iigqibo, ekusombululeni iingxaki, ekuhambelana nabantu nasekusebenziseni iikhompyutha kwiinkqubo ezisekelo. Umntu ogqithiweyo kufuneksi athi kwaye asenak ukusebenza yedwa ngaphandle kongcedo luncinci ngaphantsi koxinzelelo olumandla angathathanga naluphi na olunye. Umntu ogqithiweyo kufuneksi athi kwaye abe nokubamba amazwi kakuhle ngesityhilelo nokubhala, kwaye athi kwaye asenak ukusebenza eqeleni.
xh.duties: Umntu ogqithiweyo uya kuba ngumnyathi wokunika unyango lwezempilo kuwo wonke amalungu eqela ngexesha lohambo, kwaye aqinisekise ukuba umsebenzi uyenzwa ngokweemfunzo zomgaqo wenkqubo. Yenza iindidi ezincinci zamazipho namaxatsho angena ngaphakathi xa kuyimfuneko. Lungiseela iingxelo, wenze ukubala kwesitokhwe kokutya nemithi. Odole iziqeshana nezixhobo kwaye wenze eminye imisebenzi eqhelekileyo engenangcalo ezenzwa ngamalungu eqela lohambo. Qinisekisa ukuba ukutya kugcinwa ngokwemithetho yezempilo ngokugcina amanqanaba aphakamileyo kumsebenzi wokutya/ indlela yokuhlala/ umsebenzi wendlu/ iindwana kunye nomsebenzi wokulungisa iimpahla. Nikela ngokuxhasa kumongameli weqela ukuqamba nokuqeqesha ngeendlela zokusindisa nokuqhuba iindwendwe/ iinkqubo ezingoziwoo zehagu zejikelezo kunye nakwindima yoxhaso lokunika amandla nokuqhawuka kwabanye amalungu eqela.

jobs.department: Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment

jobs.summary: Assistant Director needed to manage greenhouse gas emissions systems, providing end-user support, troubleshooting, and maintaining documentation in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: National Diploma (NQF6) in Information Technology or relevant qualification as recognised by SAQA. Three (3) years’ experience in the relevant field. Knowledge of information management techniques, methodologies, systems and the latest technologies. Excellent understanding of data management principles. Project management. Experience in Google Apps, spatial databases, programming and mapping technology, and utilizing cloud-based servers (Amazon, Google). Ability to gather and analyse information. Knowledge of scientific, engineering and IT fields. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to work under pressure. Good IT skills in networking (internet connection, routing and switching) SQL Databases, and XML/ JSON. Good communication (written and spoken), analytical, organisational and report writing skills. Information Management. Sense of responsibility and loyalty.
jobs.duties: Provide End User Support and Training. Troubleshoot and resolve hardware and software issues. Create and maintain documentation for systems, configurations, and procedures. Develop and implement incident response plans. Ensure System Availability and Reliability. Implement and maintain monitoring solutions to detect and address potential issues proactively. Respond promptly to system outages and other critical incidents. Collaborate with the IT security team to establish and enforce information security measures. Provide system Development and Maintenance Support. Engage with service providers for support, and maintenance of systems. Implement and maintain automation tools and scripts to streamline repetitive tasks. Identify and address system performance bottlenecks. Provide Information Management services and Data Analysis. Establish and maintain a records management system. Ensure proper documentation, retention, and archiving of records. Collaborate with climate change or GHG inventory experts to derive insights from organizational data. Develop and generate reports to support decision-making processes.

af.title: Assistente-direkteur: GHG-emissiebestuurstelsels
af.summary: Assistente-direkteur benodig om kweekhuisgas-emissiestelsels te bestuur, met eindgebruikerondersteuning, probleemoplossing en die instandhouding van dokumentasie in Pretoria.
af.requirements: Nasionale Diploma (NQF6) in Inligtingstegnologie of 'n relevante kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken. Drie (3) jaar se ervaring in die relevante veld. Kennis van inligtingsbestuurstegnieke, metodologieë, stelsels en die nuutste tegnologieë. Uitstekende begrip van databestuurbeginsele. Projektbestuur. Ervaring in Google Apps, ruimtelike databasisse, programmering en karteringstegnologie, en die gebruik van wolkgebaseerde bedieners (Amazon, Google). Vermoë om inligting in te samel en te analiseer. Kennis van wetenskaplike, ingenieurs- en IT-velde. Sterke analitiese en probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Vermoë om onder druk te werk. Goeie IT-vaardighede in netwerking (internetverbinding, rotering en skakeling) SQL-databasisse, en XML/JSON. Goeie kommunikasie (geskrewe en gesproke), analitiese, organisatoriese en verslagskryfvaardighede. Inligtingsbestuur. Sin van verantwoordelikheid en lojaliteit.
af.duties: Verskaf eindgebruikerondersteuning en opleiding. Los hardeware- en sagtewareprobleme op. Skep en onderhou dokumentasie vir stelsels, konfigurasies en prosedures. Ontwikkel en implementeer voorvalreaksieplanne. Verseker stelselbeskikbaarheid en betroubaarheid. Implementeer en onderhou moniteringsoplossings om moontlike probleme proaktief te identifiseer en aan te spreek. Reageer onmiddellik op stelselonderbrekings en ander kritieke voorvalle. Werk saam met die IT-veiligheidspan om inligtingsveiligheidsmaatreëls in te stel en af te dwing. Verskaf stelselontwikkelings- en instandhoudingsondersteuning. Skakel met diensverskaffers vir ondersteuning en instandhouding van stelsels. Implementeer en onderhou outomatiseringsgereedskap en skripte om herhalende take te stroomlyn. Identifiseer en spreek stelselprestasieknelpunte aan. Verskaf inligtingsbestuursdienste en data-analise. Stel 'n rekordbestuurstelsel in en onderhou dit. Verseker behoorlike dokumentasie, behoud en argivering van rekords. Werk saam met klimaatsverandering- of GHG-inventariskenners om insigte uit organisatoriese data te put. Ontwikkel en genereer verslae om besluitnemingsprosesse te ondersteun.

zu.title: Assistant Director: GHG Emissions Management Systems
zu.summary: Kudingeka i-Assistant Director ukuphatha amasistimu okukhishwa kwesikhuthazindalo, ukunika inkxaso abasebenzisi abaphelayo, ukuxazulula izinxaki, nokulondoloza imibalo ePretoria.
zu.requirements: I-Diploma Yesizwe (NQF6) kwiTecnoloji yolwazi noma noma yikuphi na ifikwatsheni okukwaziyo i-SAQA. Iyiminyaka emithathu (3) yamava kumkhakha ohlobene. Ulwazi ngobuchwepheshe bokuphathwa kwelwazi, izindlela zokwenza izinto, amasistimu, nobuchwepheshe besikhathi sakamuva. Ukuqonda okuhle ngemigiqatho yokuphathwa kwemininingwane. Ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo. Amava kwi-Google Apps, iisiseko sedatha yesikhala, ukulungiselela uhlelo nobuchwepheshe bemaphu, kanye nokusebenzisa iiserver ezisekwe kufu (i-Amazon, i-Google). Ikhono lokuthuthwa nokuhlaziya ulwazi. Ulwazi kumikhakha yesayensi, ubuchwepheshe bekwakhakhiwo ne-IT. Amakhono anamandla okuhlaziya nokuxazulula izinkinga. Ikhono lokusebenza phantsi kwengcinezelo. Amakhono amahle e-IT kusakhiwo sesixhobo (uxhumaniso lwe-intanethi, ukulungiselela indlela nokushintsha) ii-Database ze-SQL, ne-XML/JSON. Amakhono amahle okunxibelelanisana (elukiweyo nokuqhathaniswa), akuhlaziyo, aphathweni, kanye noku bhala imibiko.
zu.duties: Nika abasebenzisi abaphelayo inkxaso noqeqesho. Xazulula izinxaki zehardwe nezesoftwe. Dala futhi ulondoloze umlando wesistimu, izilungiselelo, nezinqubo. Cashisa futhi usebenzise izinqubo zokupendula iziphoqi. Qinisekisa ukutholakala nokusebenza kahle kwesistimu. Sebenzisa futhi ulondoloze izixazululo zokuqapha ukuze kutholakale futhi kulungiswe ngokushesha izinkinga ezingaba khona. Phendula ngokushesha kwesistimu engasebenzi kanye nezinye iziphoqi eziyingozi. Bambisane nethimba lokuvikeleka kwelwazi le-IT ukuze miswe futhi qinisekiswe izinyathelo zokuvikeleka kwelwazi. Nikezela ng inkxaso yokuqhuba nokulondoloza kwesistimu. Nxibelelane nabahlinzeki bezinsiza ukuze kufakwe inkxaso nokulondoloza kwenziwe kumasistimu. Sebenzisa futhi ulondoloze izithulusi zokuzenzakalela namaskripthi ukuze kwehliswe umthwalo wemisebenzi ephindaphindwayo. Hlakanipha futhi ulungise izinkimbinkimbi zokusebenza kwesistimu. Nikezela ngamasevisi eYokuphathwa Kwelwazi nokuHlaziya Imininingwane. Misela futhi ulondoloze isistimu yokuphathwa kwemibhalo. Qinisekisa ukulondolozwa okufanele, ukugcinwa, kanye nokulondoloza kwemibhalo. Bambisane nabachwepheshe beshintsho lesimo sezulu noma isitoko se-GHG ukuze kutholwe ukuqonda okusuka kwimininingwane yenhlangano. Cashisa futhi ukhiqize imibiko ukuze ixhase inqubo yokuthatha izinqumo.

xh.title: Usomlawuli ongancedwa: Iinkqubo zoLawulo lokuKhutshwa kweGaz eshiya ubushushu (GHG Emissions Management Systems)
xh.summary: Kufuneka uSomlawuli ongancedwa ukulawula iinkqubo zokukhutshwa kwegaz eshiya ubushushu, ukunika inkxaso kubasebenzisi, ukulungisa iziphene, noku gcina umbhalo ngenxaku ePretoria.
xh.requirements: I-National Diploma (NQF6) kwi-Information Technology okanye ngesifundo esifanelekileyo njengoko sivunyiwe yi-SAQA. Ixesha lemisebenzi leminyaka emithathu (3) kundawo echanekileyo. Ulwazi ngeendlela zolawulo lwexabiso ngenxaku, iindlela, iinkqubo kunye nobuchwepheshe obutsha. Ukuqonda kakuhle ngemigaqo yolawulo lwexabiso ngenxaku. Ulawulo lwamaprojekthi. Iminikelo yokusebenza kwi-Google Apps, iziseko zexabiso ngenxaku ezibukiweyo, iinkqubo zokubhala ikhowudi, kunye nobuchwepheshe bokuzoba umapu, nokusebenzisa iiseva ezisekumafu (Amazon, Google). Ikhono lokuthatha nokucreda ixabiso ngenxaku ngokubanzi. Ulwazi kumabango esayensi, injiniyela kunye ne-IT. Ikhono elinamandla lokuhlola nokuqonda nobuchwepheshe bokuzibulala iingxaki. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphantsi kwengcinezelo. Ikhono elilungileyo le-IT kumathafa okudibanisa ulwazi (ukudibanisa intanethi, ukuthumela nokuqhubela phambili i-SQL Databases, kunye ne-XML/JSON. Ikhono elilungileyo lokunxibelelana (elibhaliweyo nelithethwayo), lekucreda nokuqonda umbhalo wengxelo ngokubanzi. Ulawulo lwexabiso ngenxaku nangobuqwengqweni. Inkundla yokuzithwala ngokwemisebenzi nengqwalasela.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso nakhuselo abasebenzisi. Xelela nolungisa iingxaki zohlelo kumsebenzi wekhompyutha nakwenkqubo yekhompyutha. Yila zigcine ixabiso ngenxaku nengxelo ngeenkqubo ezichanekileyo. Yila nikelo yomsebenzi wokulawula nokuqwalasela inkqubo yekhompyutha. Qinisekisa ukuba inkqubo iyafikeleleka nasebenza ngokwemigaqo. Yila nokuqwalasela indlela yokubeka izixhobo ezijongisisa ukufumanisa nokuqwalasela iingxaki. Phendula ngokukhawuleza xa kusilela inkqubo nakwezinye iingxaki ezibalulekileyo. Sebenzisana nesebe lokhuseleko lwe-IT ukumisa nokuqinisekisa izigqibo zokhuseleko lweNkcazelo ngokubanzi. Nika inkxaso kuyilo lweenkqubo nakulawulo lokuqwalasela iinkqubo. Nxibelela nabahlinzeki besebenzi ngenkxaso nakulawulo lweenkqubo. Yila nokuqwalasela iindlela ezenza umsebenzi ngokuzenzekelayo nokuqwalasela inkqubo ekhawulezayo. Zingela nolungisa iingxaki ezithintelisa inkqubo ukuba isebenze ngokukhawuleza. Nika ulawulo lweNkcazelo ngokubanzi nokuqwalasela ixabiso ngenxaku. Misela nigcindle inkqubo yolawulo lweenkcukacha. Qinisekisa ukuba zikho iinkcukacha ezichanekileyo, noku zicatshulwe nengeniso yeenkcukacha ngokubanzi. Sebenzisana neengcali zokutshintsha kwesimo sezulu okanye abahloli be-GHG ukukhupha iingcamango kwixabiso ngenxaku elibhalwe ngokubanzi. Yila nikela iingxelo ezakunceda ukwenza izigqibo.

Obtain BAS report to determine monthly expenditure status. Prepare monthly expenditure report and submit it to management. Arrange petty cash when needed. Provide inventory support services. Maintain the directorate’s asset register. Update the register when new office equipment is acquired.

af.title: Senior Administratiewe Beampte
af.summary: Senior Administratiewe Beampte benodig in Pretoria om verkryging, kantooradministrasie en LOGIS-aanvrae vir die Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment te bestuur.
af.requirements: Nasionale Diploma (NQF6) in Openbare Bestuur/Kantoordbestuur of tersykhikwalifikasie binne die verwante veld soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van twee (2) jaar ervaring in kantoorbestuur en administrasie. Kennis van administratiewe en verkrygingsprosedures. Begrip van Openbare Diens-prosedures en voorskrifte soos die Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Tesourie-regulasies en ander verwante voorskrifte. Kennis van LOGIS en BAS. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Beplannings- en organisasievaardighede, kommunikasievaardighede, luister- en skryfvaardighede en interpersoonlike verhoudingsvaardighede. Uitstekende kennis van MS Office, Word, Excel en PowerPoint. Vermoë om sigblaaie op te stel en begroting voor te berei. Vermoë om verslae op te stel. Vermoë om inligting in te samel en te ontleed. Vermoë om individueel en in 'n span te werk.
af.duties: Lewer hoofgebruikersdienste. Verkry goedere en dienste vir die Hoofdirektoraat en fasiliteer die verkryging van die skryfbehoeftes. Stel aanvraagvorms (Log2) op vir goedere en dienste. Vang die aanvraag op LOGIS. Verseker dat bestellingsnommers met toonkettingbestuur gevolg word. Lewer logistieke ondersteuningsdienste. Bespreek sale vir vergaderings en werkswinkels. Administreer reëreling en hanteer reisclaim. Verskaf administratiewe ondersteuningsdienste. Rëel vergaderings. Berei dokumente voor vir werkswinkels/opleidingsessies en vergaderings. Bestuur van die liasseringsysteem. Lewer finansiële ondersteuningsdienste. Stel begrotingsigblad op. Verkry BAS-verslag om maandelikse bestedingsstatus te bepaal. Berei maandelikse bestedingsverslag voor en stel dit aan bestuur voor. Rëel kleingeld wanneer nodig. Verskaf voorraadondersteuningsdienste. Onderhou die direktoraat se bate register. Dateer die register op wanneer nuwe kantoor toerusting aangekoop word.

zu.title: Umphathi Omkhulu Wezobulungiswa
zu.summary: Kudingeka Umphathi Omkhulu Wezobulungiswa ePretoria ukuphatha ukuthenga, ukulawulwa kwezinhlelo zolunğu kanye nezidingo ze-LOGIS kwi-Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment.
zu.requirements: I-Diploma Yezwe (NQF6) kwi-Public Management/Office management noma izifundo ezihlobene kuleyo ndawo njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA. Ukwazi okuncane kweminyaka emibili (2) kokuqashwa kwezinhlelo zolunğu kanye nezobulungiswa. Ukuqonda izinqubo zezobulungiswa kanye nezokuthenga. Ukuqonda izinqubo kanye nemithetho ye-Public Service njengoba kwenziwa i-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), i-Treasury Regulations kanye namanye amathuluzi ahlobene lokho. Ukuqonda i-LOGIS kanye ne-BAS. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amakhono eplani kanye nohlelo, amakhono okuxoxa, ukuzwa kanye nokubhala ngalokho okuhlobene nabantu. Ukuyiqonda ngokugqamile i-MS Office, i-Word, i-Excel kanye ne-PowerPoint. Ikhono lokwakha amaspredshithi kanye nokulungiselela isabeloimali. Ikhono lokuhlanganisa umbiko. Ikhono lokuqoqa kanye nekuhlaziya ulwazi. Ikhono lokusebenza wedwa nangesikweletu.
zu.duties: Nikela ngemisebenzi eyinhloko yomsebenzisi. Thenga impahla kanye nensebenzo ku-Chief Directorate futhi ukwazi ukuqasha izinto ezidingekayo. Hlanganisa amafomu wezidingo (Log2) ukuthenga impahla nensebenzo. Faka izidingo ku-LOGIS. Qinisekisa ukuthi inombolo yalokho okuthengiwe kulandelwa ku-supply chain management. Nikela ngemisebenzi ebalulekile yokuqashwa kwendawo. Thatha izindawo zamameetings kanye nabayekela imikhankaso. Lawula izinhlelo zokuhamba kanye nokulawula izikhalo zokuhamba. Nikela ngemisebenzi ebalulekile yolawulo. Hlela imikhosi. Lungiselela amadokhula ukuyekela imikhankaso/ukufundisa imikhosi kanye namameetings. Lawula uhlelo lwamafayela. Nikela ngemisebenzi ebalulekile yemali. Hlanganisa isabeloimali ngamaspredshithi. Thola umbiko we-BAS ukuze ubone ukuthi kuyakhokhelwa kanjani nyanga zonke. Lungiselela umbiko wemali evela nyanga zonke bese uwunikeza abaphathi. Hlela imali encane uma kudingeka. Nikela ngemisebenzi ebalulekile yezimpahla. Gcina irekhodi lempahla yawo wonke umnyango. Buyekeza irekhodi uma kutholakala ithuluzi elisha lezinhlelo zolunğu.

xh.title: Isiphathiswa Esiphezulu Sokulawula
xh.summary: Kufuneka isiphathiswa esiphezulu sokulawula ePretoria esiza kulawula inkqubo yokuthenga, ukulawula ofisi kunye neemfuno ze-LOGIS kwisebe lezoBhalo-nqwala, eZolimo kunye nezeNdalo.
xh.requirements: Kufuneka ibe ne-National Diploma (NQF6) kwiPublic Management/Office management okanye izifundo ezifanayo kule ndawo njengoko zivunywa yi-SAQA. Kufuneka abe nobugazi obungingamva leminyaka emibini (2) bokusebenza kulawulo lofisi nolawulo. Kufuneka azazi iinkqubo zolawulo kunye nezokuthenga. Kufuneka aqonde iinkqubo zemithetho yesebe likarhulumente kunye nemigaqo njengoMthetho woLawulo weMali likarhulumente (PFMA), iimGaqo zeTreasury kunye nezinye iimigaqo ezinxulumene nayo. Kufuneka azazi i-LOGIS kunye ne-BAS. Kufuneka azikwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Kufuneka anamakhono okulungisa nokuhlela, amakhono onxibelelwano, amakhono okulalela nokubhala kunye namakhono obudlelwano nabantu. Kufuneka azibe ngolwazi olubalaseleyo kwi-MS Office, i-Word, i-Excel kunye ne-PowerPoint. Kufuneka akwazi ukulungiza amaspredshithi nokulungisa isxeji. Kufuneka akwazi ukulungiza iingxelo. Kufuneka akwaziokuqokelela kunye nokuqwalasela ulwazi. Kufuneka akwazi ukusebenza ngamnye nakwijoni.
xh.duties: Kufuneka anike iinkonzo eziphambili kumsebenzisi. Kuthenge izinto nesebezinkonzo kulo waka-mphathi we-Cirectorate aze alawule ukuthengwa kweekhwatha zofisi. Kufuneka alungise iifomu zeemfuno (Log2) ezimala neezinto nekonzo. Kufuneka afake iimfuno kwi-LOGIS. Kufuneka aqinisekise ukuba inani leodolo lalandelwa ngokulawulelwa kwendodaniso yokunikezela. Kufuneka anike iinkonzo zokuxhasa ngokwezilogistics. Kufuneka abhuke iindawo zokubambela iintlanganiso kunye nezikhululo. Kufunze alawule izicwangciso zokuhamba aze alawule iindikitha zokuhamba. Kufuneka anike iinkonzo zokuxhasa kulawulo. Kufuneka ahlele iintlanganiso. Kufuneka alungise amaxwebhu okuzikhuliso/ziqendu zokuqeqesha kunye neentlanganiso. Kufuneka alawule inkqubo yokugcina amaxwebhu. Kufuneka anike iinkonzo zokuxhasa ngemali. Kufuneka alungise ispjredshithi yesixhiji. Kufuneka afumane ingxelo ye-BAS ukumisela isimo yokuhlawuleka kwenyanga. Kufuneka alungise ingxelo yokuhlawuleka kwenyanga ayinike abaphathi. Kufuneka alungise imali encinci xa kufuneka. Kufuneka anike iinkonzo zokuxhasa ngezempahla. Kufuneka agcine irejista yempahla yowaka-mphathi. Kufuneka ahlohlule irejista xa kufakwa impahla entsha yofisi.

jobs.title: Office Administrator III
jobs.department: Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment
jobs.closing_date_text: 31 August 2026, 16:00. No late application will be accepted
jobs.summary: Provide secretarial and administrative support to the DDG's office, managing the diary and consolidating reports at the Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: National Diploma (NQF6) in Public Management / Office management or relevant qualification within the related field as recognized by SAQA. A minimum of two (2) years’ experience in office management and administration. Knowledge of administrative and procurement procedures. Understanding of public Service procedures and prescripts such as Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Treasury Regulations and other related prescripts. Knowledge of LOGIS and BAS. Computer literacy. Planning and organizing skills, communication skills, listening and writing skills and interpersonal relations skills. Ability to compile spreadsheets and prepare budget. Ability to compile reports. Ability to gather and analyse information. Ability to work individually and in team.
jobs.duties: Render secretarial support to the DDG’s office. Effectively manage the diary of the DDG. Provide administrative support to the DDG’s Office. Provide support with consolidation and alignment of monthly reports, Parliamentary Questions, referrals, quarterly reports, or any ad-hoc requests for inputs. Receive and distribute documents. Consolidate and submit claims. Administer leave. Provide document management support in the DDG’s Office. Provide support with distribution of documents to relevant destinations. Draft internal and external memos, submissions and presentations. Manage incoming and outgoing documents. Render logistical support services. Coordinate travelling arrangements for the DDG. Submit advance request to Finance when required. Coordinate logistical arrangements for the meetings/workshop. Provide client liaison support services. Undertake proper screening of calls and management of e-mails. Provide information regarding departmental policies/strategies.
