af.title: Kantooradministrateur III
af.summary: Verskaf sekretariële en administratiewe ondersteuning aan die DDG se kantoor, bestuur die dagboek en konsolideer verslae by die Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment in Pretoria.
af.requirements: Nasionale Diploma (NQF6) in Openbare Bestuur / Kantoorbestuur of 'n relevante kwalifikasie binne die verwante veld soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van twee (2) jaar se ervaring in kantoorbestuur en administrasie. Kennis van administratiewe enverkrygingsprosedures. Begrip van Openbare Diens-prosedures en voorskrifte soos die Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Treasury Regulations en ander verwante voorskrifte. Kennis van LOGIS en BAS. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Beplannings- en organisasievaardighede, kommunikasievaardighede, luister- en skryfvaardighede en vaardighede in interpersoonlike verhoudinge. Vermoë om sigblaaie op te stel en begrotings voor te berei. Vermoë om verslae op te stel. Vermoë om inligting in te samel en te ontleed. Vermoë om individueel en in 'n span te werk.
af.duties: Verskaf sekretariële ondersteuning aan die DDG se kantoor. Bestuur die dagboek van die DDG doeltreffend. Verskaf administratiewe ondersteuning aan die DDG se kantoor. Verskaf ondersteuning met die konsolidasie en belyning van maandelikse verslae, Parlementêre Vrae, verwysings, kwartaalverslae, of enige ad hoc versoeke vir insette. Ontvang en versprei dokumente. Konsolideer en dien eise in. Administreer verlof. Verskaf dokumentbestuursondersteuning in die DDG se kantoor. Verskaf ondersteuning met die verspreiding van dokumente na relevante bestemmings. Opstel van interne en eksterne memo's, voorleggings en aanbiedings. Bestuur inkomende en uitgaande dokumente. Verskaf logistieke ondersteuningsdienste. Koördineer reëlings vir reis vir die DDG. Dien vooruit-versoeke by Finansies in wanneer nodig. Koördineer logistieke reëlings vir die vergaderings/werkswinkel. Verskaf kliëntlasondersteuningsdienste. Onderneem behoorlike sifting van oproepe en bestuur van e-posse. Verskaf inligting rakende departementele beleide/strategieë.

zu.title: Umqondisi Wezohlelo III
zu.summary: Nikela ngesekelo lezokwazisele nezohlelo ehhovisi le-DDG, uphathe ikhalenda uze uhlanganise imibiko kwi-Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment e-Pretoria.
zu.requirements: I-National Diploma (NQF6) ku-Public Management / Office management noma izifundo ezihambisana nale mininingwane njengokuhlonishwa yi-SAQA. Okungenani amawonu amabili (2) okuhlangeneyo ekuphathweni kwehhovisi nezohlelo. Ulwazi ngemikhuba yezokuphathwa nokuthenga. Ukuqonda imikhuba nemiyalo yeNkonzo Yomphakathi njengo-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), i-Treasury Regulations neminye imiyalo ehlobene. Ulwazi nge-LOGIS ne-BAS. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ikhono lokuhlela nokuhlela izinto, ikhono lokuxhumana, ikhono lokulalela nokubhala kanye namakhono obudlelwano abantu. Ikhono lokwakha amaspredshithi nalokulungiselela isabelomali. Ikhono lokuhlanganisa imibiko. Ikhonookuqoqauhlalelwlwazi. Ikhono lokusebenza wedwa nakube ngqoqo.
zu.duties: Nikela ngesekelo lezokwazisele ehhovisi le-DDG. Phatha ikhalenda ye-DDG ngempumelelo. Nikeza isekelo lezohlelo ehhovisi le-DDG. Nikeza isekelo ngokuhlanganisa nokuhambisa eminye imibiko yanyanga zonke, imibuzo yePhalamende, okuthunyelwe, imibiko yesikhashana, noma nanoma yisiphi isicelo esingahlukanisile. Yamukela uhlakanyele amafa. Hlanganisa unike izinkulumo zokukhokha. Phatha ilivu. Nikeza isekelo lokuphathwa kwamafa ehhovisi le-DDG. Nikeza isekelo ngokuhlakanywa kwamafa esikhundleni esifanele. Bhala amamemu angaphakathi nangaphandle, okuhlakanyelwe nezethulo. Phatha amafa angena naphuma. Nikeza izinkonzo zokusekela ngokuhamba kwezinto. Hlela izinhlela zokuhamba ze-DDG. Thumela isicelo sokuqashela kwezimali uma kudingeka. Hlela izinhlela zokuhamba kwezinto ezihlotshaniswa nemihlangano/umsebenzi wezikhungo. Nikeza izinkonzo zesekelo lokuxhumana nakilayentshi. Yenza ukuhlola okufanele kwezikhalo nokuphathwa kwamaimilomu. Nikeza ulwazi ngemigomo/amasu omnyango.

xh.title: Um lawuli weOfisi III
xh.summary: Nika inkxaso yonobumba kunye nolawulo kwi-ofisi kaDDG, ulawule idayari uze uqhube iingxelo kwiSebe lezeNdalo, leZohlolwo kunye nokuTiya ePretoria.
xh.requirements: I-National Diploma (NQF6) kwi-Public Management / Office management okanye izifundo ezifanelekileyo kwinkundla enxulumeneyo njengoko ezaziwa yi-SAQA. Amava amabalwa (2) eminyaka kulawulo lwe-ofisi nolawulo. Ulwazi ngemigaqo yolawulo nengenyango. Kuqonda imigaqo yesebe likarhulumente kunye nemigaqo elawula urhuluntambe njengePublic Finance Management Act (PFMA), iTreasury Regulations, nakweminye imigaqo enxulumene nayo. Ulwazi nge-LOGIS kunye ne-BAS. Ukusebenza ngokugqithileyo kwekhompyutha. Ikhono lokucwangcisa nokuqamba, amakhono okunxibelelanayo, amakhono okulalela nokubhala kunye namakhono obudlelwane babantu. Ikhono lokwakha amaspredshithi nalungiselela umgangatho wemali. Ikhono lokuqamba iingxelo. Ikhono lokugcina ulwazi kwaye uluhlole. Ikhono lokusebenza ngamnye nakwiqela.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso yonobumba kwi-ofisi kaDDG. Lawula ngokufanelekileyo idayari kaDDG. Nika inkxaso yolawulo kwi-Ofisi kaDDG. Nika inkxaso ngokuqhubelela phambili nokumisela iingxelo zenyanga, iimbuzo zeParliament, izinto ezithunyelwa, iingxelo zexesha, okanye nayiphi na icelo elifuna imveliso. Yamkela kwaye uluhambise amaxwebhu. Qhubelela phambili uze uhambise iimfanelo. Lawula i-arhente. Nika inkxako yolawulo lwamaxwebhu kwi-Ofisi kaDDG. Nika inkxaso ngokuhambisa amaxwebhu kwiziphumeleko ezifanelekileyo. Bhala imemo yangaphakathi nangaphandle, amasireto kunye nemiboniso. Lawula amaxwebhu angena naphuma. Nika inkxaso yezemizila. Lungiselela ngokulungiselelwa kokuhamba kukaDDG. Thumela isicelo sentslawulo kwiFinance xa kufuneka. Lungiselela ngokwemizimila iintlanganiso/izindlu zemfundo. Nika inkxaso kwizinkonzo zophatho labathengi. Yenza ukuhlola okuchanekileyo kweefowuni nolawulo le-imeyile. Nikezela ngolwazi ngemigaqo/amasu esebe.

af.title: Senior Arbeidsverhoudingspraktisyn: Kasbestuur
af.summary: Senior Arbeidsverhoudingspraktisyn benodig in Pretoria om LV-sake te bestuur en na te speur, 'n kasbestuurstelsel te ontwikkel, en disiplinêre en klagteprosesse te fasiliteer.
af.requirements: Nasionale Diploma (NQF6) in Arbeidsverhoudings of relevante kwalifikasie soos erken deur SAQA. 'n Minimum van twee (2) jaar se ondervinding in kas- en nakomstigheidsbestuur of relevante veld. PERSAL-inleidingssertifikaat. Kennis van werknemerverhoudinge. Kennis van Openbare Diens-wetgewing en resolusies. Kennis van disiplinêre kode en prosedures, klagteprosedure, bemiddeling en arbitrasie. Kennis en begrip van relevante beleide en prosedures. Kommunikasievaardighede (skriftelik en mondelings), beplannings- en organisasievaardighede, verslagskryfvaardighede, koördinasievaardighede, konflikoplossingsvaardighede, interpretasie en toepassing van wetgewing, beleide en resolusies, program- en projekbestuursvaardighede en rekenaargeletterdheid. Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudingsvaardighede. Vermoë om inligting en verslae in te samel en te interpreteer. Vermoë om inligting in te samel en te ontleed. Vermoë om relevante wetgewing, regulasies, resolusies en beleide te interpreteer en toe te pas. Vermoë om onder druk te werk en met minimale toesig te werk. Vermoë om onafhanklik en in 'n span te werk.
af.duties: Bestuur en speur alle Arbeidsverhoudings-sake na. Ontwikkel en onderhou die Arbeidsverhoudings-kasbestuurstelsel. Sifting van alle ontvangste sake. Dokumentvoorbereiding en verspreiding van kasdokumente. Ontvang klagtes en skakel met relevante belanghebbendes. Fasiliteer en bestuur Arbeidsverhoudings-onderhoude. Verskaf administrasie en bestuursverslagnakomstigheid. Werk saam met kswerkers om doeltreffende dokumentbestuur te verseker. Doen ontleding op relevante metrieke soos gedefinieer deur Bestuur en berei maandelikse/kwartaal-/jaarlikse nakomstigheidsverslae voor. Verseker dat alle klagte-, wangedrag- en geskil-sake op PERSAL vasgelê word. Fasiliteer die implementering van klagteregulasies en -prosedures.

zu.title: Umphathi Ohlukaniswa Nemisebenzi Oholayo: Ukuphathwa Kwezicala
zu.summary: Kudingeka Umphathi Ohlukaniswa Nemisebenzi Oholayo ePretoria ukuphatha nokulandela izicala ze-LR, ukuthuthukisa isistimu yokuphathwa kwezicala, nokuqhuba izinqubo zokukeya nokudluliswa kwezikhalazo.
zu.requirements: I-Diploma Yezwe (NQF6) kwezamaQhumo Kabantu noma iziqu ezihambisana nalezo ezemukelwe yi-SAQA. Ukwaziswa okungenani kweminyaka emibili (2) kokusebenza ekuphathweni kwezicala nokuhambisana nomthetho noma esigabeni esihambisana nalelo. Isitifikedi esingenisa i-PERSAL. Ulwazi ngobaqashi nezinhlobonhlobo zabo. Ulwazi ngomthetho wezabakhidikhulu nezinqumo zikahulumeni. Ulwazi ngokhiye wokulalelwa kwezono nemiqulu yayo, inqubo yezikhalazo, ukumiswa kwezinkinga nezinkantolo zomsebenzi. Ulwazi nokuqonda imikhuba nemiqulu ehambisana nayo. Amakhono okuxhumana (okuqashiwe nokukhulunywa), amakhono okuhlela nokuhlela imisebenzi, amakhono okubhala imibiko, amakhono okuhlanganisa izinto, amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga, amakhono okutolikwa nokusebenzisa umthetho, imikhuba nezinqumo, amakhono okuphatha izinhlelo nezinhlela zenkambu kanye nokwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha. Amakhono amahle ohlobano nabantu. Ikono lokuthola nokutolika ulwazi nemibiko. Ikono lokuqoqa nokuhlaziya ulwazi. Ikono lokutolikwa nokusebenzisa umthetho, imithetho, izinqumo kanye namapholisi. Ikono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwengcindezi nangaphansi kokuboniswa okulingene. Ikono lokusebenza ngodwa nasesiqhemeni.
zu.duties: Qaphaza ngemizuzu yonke izicala zezenza lao. Thuthukisa ulondolaza isistimu yokuphathwa kwezicala. Ukubuka konke okutholiwe kwezicala. Lungeza imibhalo yokulungiselelwa nokusatshalaliswa kwamafa. Thola izikhalazo uchumisane nalabo abathintekayo. Qhuba uphathwe izincoko zamabonakude ezicaleni. Nikeza isikhathi sokubhala imibiko yokuphathwa nokuhambisana. Sebenzisana nabaphathi bezicala ukuze kuqhubeke imibhalo ngempumelelo. Hlela ukuhlaziya izibalo ezibalulekile njengoba kumisiwe ngabaphathi bese uhlela imibiko yokuhambisana yamnye.nyanga / nyanga zonke / minyaka yonke. Qinisekisa ukuthi zonke izikhalazo, izono ezingezinhle nemicu yezinkinga zibhaliswe kwi-PERSAL. Qhuba ukusetshenziswa kwemithetho yezikhalazo nezinqubo zayo.

xh.title: Umpractitioner Omkhulu wezobudlelwane basebenzini: ULawulo lweziMveliso
xh.summary: Kufuneka uMpractitioner Omkhulu wezobudlelwane basebenzini ePretoria ukulawula nokulandelela iimveliso ze-LR, ukuphuhelisa inkqubo yelawulo leemveliso, nokukhokela iinkqubo zolusizo nesiganeko.
xh.requirements: I-National Diploma (NQF6) kwezobudlelwane basebenzini okanye isifanekiso esifanelekile njengoko kuqatywa yi-SAQA. Amava amabini (2) ubuncinane kulawulo leemveliso nokuqwalaselwa okanye indawo enjalo. Isatifikethi esingenisa i-PERSAL. Ulwazi ngobudlelwane basebenzini. Ulwazi ngomthetho nezigqibo zeNkonzo kaZwelonke. Ulwazi ngomthetho wokusiza izigqibo nendlela ezisetyenziswayo, indlela yesiganeko, ukuxhatshazwa kolwazi lolwazi, nokuqatshulwa kweenkomfa nengxoxo. Ulwazi nokuqonda iingqibo nendlela ezifanelekileyo. Amakhono okunxibelelwana (okubhaliweyo nokuthethwayo), amakhono okuceba nokuhlela, amakhono okubhala iingxelo, amakhono olungiselelo, amakhono okusombulula iingxabano, ukuhunyusha nokusebenzisa umthetho, iingqibo nezigqibo, amakhono olawulo lwenkqubo neprojekthi nokusebenzisa ikhompuyutha. Amakhono amabalweyo obudlelwane nabantu. Ikhono lokuthatha nokuhunyusha iinkcukacha nemiqulu. Ikhono lokuthatha nokuhlalutya iinkcukacha. Ikhono lokuhunyusha nokusebenzisa umthetho ofanelekileyo, iimigaqo, izigqibo neengqibo. Ikhono lokusebenza ngxese nasekuqwalaselweni okulinganisiweyo. Ikhono lokusebenza bodwa nakwiqukumbelo.
xh.duties: Lawula nokulandelela zonke iimveliso zobudlelwane basebenzini. Phuhelisa nigcina inkqubo yelawulo leemveliso zobudlelwane basebenzini. Ukuqwalaselwa kwezazizo ezizele ezifunyenweyo. Ulungiselelo lwamaxwebu nokusasazaamaxwebu eemveliso. Amkele iingxaka unxibelelane nabathintekayo abafanelekileyo. Khokela ulawule uphando lobudlelwane basebenzini. Nikezela ngolawulo nemiyalezo yomthetho wokulawula. Sebenza ngokubambisana nabasebenzi beemveliso ukuze kuqiniseke ukulawula amaxwebu kakuhle. Yenza uhlalutyo kumlinganiselo ofanelekileyo njengoko kuchaziwe ngokuLawula uze ulungiselele imiyalezo yokulawula ngenyanga/kwitafula/kumnyaka. Qinisekisa ukuba zonke iingxaka zesiganeko, ukuziphatha okungalunganga nokuqhutshwa kolwazi lolwazi zibhaliswa kwi-PERSAL. Khokela ukusebenzisa iingqibo nendlela zesiganeko.

jobs.summary: Senior Human Resource Practitioner focused on executive development and coaching coordination within the Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment in Pretoria.

A minimum of two (2) years’ proven experience in the field of Human Resources Management, with a specific focus on Human Resources Development. Experience in facilitating training and the development opportunities for staff. Good understanding and functional knowledge of the Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations, Public Finance Management Act and Treasury Regulations. Understanding of Human Resource Management legislation and regulatory frameworks. Good communication (verbal and written), stakeholder liaison, organising and planning skills. Good analytical thinking, innovation, and creative skills. Good computer literacy and use of standard packages. Ability to work long hours and under pressure. Ability to work independently and in a team. Ability to interpret policies and directives on HR matters. Skills in formulating and writing reports. Ability to plan and organise the activities of the division.
jobs.duties: Coordinate and implement executive coaching for managers. Facilitate the development of coaching database. Coordinate Bid Evaluation Committee meetings. Communicate with service providers. Coordinate and implement executive development learning interventions for senior manager. Coordinate and implement executive development programmes and ad-hoc training for senior managers. Coordinate and implement learning network sessions for MMS & SMS and for level 4-10. Coordinate the Departments learning network sessions for MMS and SMS members and for level 8 and below. Coordinate and implement the induction for SMS. Coordinate and facilitate the orientation of the department. Coordinate the registration of new entrants with School of Governments. af.title: Senior Menslike Hulpbronpraktisyn: Uitvoerend
af.summary: Senior Menslike Hulpbronpraktisyn wat op uitvoerende ontwikkeling en die koördinering van afrigting binne die Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment in Pretoria fokus.
af.requirements: Nasionale Diploma (NQF6) in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur/Ontwikkeling of 'n relevante kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van twee (2) jaar se bewese ervaring in die veld van Menslike Hulpbronbestuur, met 'n spesifieke fokus op Menslike Hulpbronontwikkeling. Ervaring in die facilitering van opleiding en ontwikkelingsgeleenthede vir personeel. Goeie begrip en funksionele kennis van die Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations, Public Finance Management Act en Treasury Regulations. Begrip van Menslike Hulpbronbestuurwetgewing en regulerende raamwerke. Goeie kommunikasie (mondeling en skriftelik), belanghebbende skakeling, organisasie- en beplanningsvaardighede. Goeie analitiese dink, innovering en kreatiewe vaardighede. Goeie rekenaarvaardigheid en gebruik van standaardprogramme. Vermoë om lang ure en onder druk te werk. Vermoë om onafhanklik en in 'n span te werk. Vermoë om beleid en richtlyne oor HR-aangeleenthede te interpreteer. Vaardighede in die opstel en skryf van verslae. Vermoë om die aktiwiteite van die afdeling te beplan en te organiseer.
af.duties: Koördineer en implementeer uitvoerende afrigting vir bestuurders. Fasiliteer die ontwikkeling van 'n afrigtingsdatabasis. Koördineer Bid Evaluation Committee-vergaderings. Kommunikeer met diensverskaffers. Koördineer en implementeer uitvoerende ontwikkelingsleerintervensies vir senior bestuurders. Koördineer en implementeer uitvoerende ontwikkelingsprogramme en ad hoc-opleiding vir senior bestuurders. Koördineer en implementeer leernetwerksessies vir MMS & SMS en vir vlak 4-10. Koördineer die departement se leernetwerksessies vir MMS- en SMS-lede en vir vlak 8 en laer. Koördineer en implementeer die inducting vir SMS. Koördineer en fasiliteer die oriëntasie van die departement. Koördineer die registrasie van nuwe toetreders by School of Governments. Koördineer die navrae van belanghebbendes (intern en ekstern).

zu.title: Umkhulu Wesebenza Nabantu: Abaphathi
zu.summary: Umkhulu ovela kwisikhundla sokusebenza nabantu: othole iziqu ezibalulekile ekuthuthukisweni kwabaphathi kanye nokunqandanisa ukholwa ngaphakathi koMnyango Wezihlahla, Izinhlanzi kanye Namaphilelo e-Pretoria.
zu.requirements: I-Diploma yezwe (NQF6) kokuqashwa nokuphathwa kwezinsiza zabantu / nokuthuthukiswa kwazo noma iziqu ezihambisana naleso esaziwayo yi-SAQA. Okungenani amashumi amabili (2) eminyaka yesipiliyoni esiqinisekisiwe enkambisini yokuqashwa nokuphathwa kwezinsiza zabantu, ngokugqamisa ukuthuthukiswa kwalezo zinsiza. Isipiliyono sokuthuthukisa ukuzenzela nemikhiqizo yokuthuthukisa ithuba labasebenzi. Ukuqonda okuhle kanye nolwazi olusebenzayo ngoMthetho Wezinkonzo Zikahulumeni, Izindlela Zomthetho Wezinkonzo Zikahulumeni, uMthetho Wokuqashwa kweMali Kahulumeni kanye Nezindlela Zezimali ZoHlabele. Ukuqonda umthetho nemigomo yokuphathwa kwezinsiza zabantu. Amakhono okuxhumana kahle (okwenziwayo nokubhalwayo), ukuxhumana nabalingani, ukuhlelela nokuhlela. Ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya, ukubumba into entsha kanye namakhono okudala. Ukusebenzisana kahle nwegumbi lekhomputha kanye nokusetshenziswa kwemihlane yalo. Ukukwazi ukusebenza isikhathi eside futhi ngaphansi koxanduva olunzima. Ukukwazi ukusebenza ngokuzimele futhi ngaphakathi kwesiqembu. Ukukwazi ukuchaza imigomo nemiyalelo ngemithwalo yokuphathwa kwezinsiza zabantu. Amakhono okwakha nokubhala imibiko. Ukukwazi ukuhlela nokuhlelela imisebenzi yesection.
zu.duties: Nqandanise futhi usebenzise ukholwa ababusi abakhokhelwe ngamaphoyinti kubaphathi. Yenza isikhathi esihle sokuthuthukiswa kwesisekelo sedatha yalabo abakholelwa ngamaphoyinti. Nqandanise izingqungquthela zikomkhulu lokuhlola izindlela zokuthola izinsiza. Thintana nabahlinzeki bezinsiza. Nqandanise futhi usebenzise okufundwayo mayelana nokuthuthukiswa kwabaphathi abaphakeme. Nqandanise futhi usebenzise amaphulo nokugcinelwa okungalawuleki komthetho kokuthuthukiswa kwabaphathi abaphakeme. Nqandanise futhi usebenzise izikhathi zokufundisana ngokuvumelana nabalingani kuma-MMS ne-SMS kanye nalabo abasingathini 4-10. Nqandanise futhi usebenzise izikhathi zokufundisana zomnyango kubahlali be-MMS ne-SMS nakulabo abasingathini 8 nangaphansi. Nqandanise futhi usebenzise ukuhlahliswa kwengqondo ngokuzinikela kule ministry. Nqandanise futhi usebenzise ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi emphakathini omtsha nabafundi bezikole zohulumeni. Nqandanise futhi usebenzise izibhekelelo ezivela kubalingani (abangaphakathi nakwezangaphandle).

xh.title: UmPhathi Omkhulu wokuZinza koMntu: oBungeni
xh.summary: UmPhathi Omkhulu wokuZinza koMntu oqhelisayo kukuphuhliswa koBungeni nokuqhubeleka phambili kolwazi olusekwe kwiiSicelo zezeMveliso kunye nokuQhagamshela emZingxenyeni zeSiphakathi ePretoria.
xh.requirements: National Diploma (NQF6) kuHuman Resource Management/Development okanye isiqinisekiso esichanekileyo njengoko sivunyiwe yiSAQA. Amava amabalulekileyo eminyaka emibini (2) abonakalisiweyo kwinkalo yoQhagamshelwano lweZemigaqo, ngqondweni ekuphuhlisweni koQhagamshelwano lweZemigaqo. Amava ekukhokeleleni ekuqeqeshweni nakuqhagamshelweni iithuba lokuphuhliswa kubasebenzi. Ukuqonda okuhle nolwazi olusebenzayo lwePublic Service Act, iPublic Service Regulations, iPublic Finance Management Act kunye neTreasury Regulations. Ukuqonda komthetho wolawulo loQhagamshelwano lweZemigaqo nemithetho yomgaqo. Amakhono amatsha okuqamba, okubeka iindaba, okubonisana nabathintekayo, ukuqamba iindaba kunye nokuqamba izicwangciso. Ukuqonda okuhle ngokucinga ngokusesikweni, ukutsha iqhinga, kunye namakhono omdala. Ulwazi oluhle ngokusebenzisa iikhompyutha nokusetyenziswa kweekhompyutha ezikumgangatho osingqayiweyo. Ulwazi lokusebenza iiveki ezide kunye nangxwaka. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngamnye nakuqela. Ulwazi lokuphawula imigaqo nezikhokelo kwiindaba zeHR. Amakhono okwenza nokubhala iingxelo. Ulwazi lwokucwangcisa nokuhlela iimisebenzi yecandelo.
xh.duties: Qhagamshela nokusebenzisa uqeqesho oBungeni oBakhulu bakhamela. Khokela ukuqhubeka phambili kweNdatabase yeZemigaqo. Qhagamshela iindibano zeBID Evaluation Committee. Qhagamshelana neZigqibo zenkxaso ezinika iinkonzo. Qhagamshela nokusebenzisa ukuphuhliswa kolwazi oBungeni oBakhulu kwabaphathi abakhulu. Qhagamshela nokusebenzisa iinkqubo zokuQeqeshwa oBungeni oBakhulu nakuqeqesho nako nangoko kwabaphathi abakhulu. Qhagamshela nokusebenzisa iindibano zenkqubo yolwazi kubantu abangabo kumaMMS noSMS nangemandla 4-10. Qhagamshela nokusebenzisa iindibano zenkqubo yolwazi koQhagamshelwano lweSiphakathi kubantu abangabo kumaMMS noSMS nangamandla 8 nangaphantsi. Qhagamshela nokusebenzisa ukuQeqeshwa kubantu abangatshanga kwiSMS. Qhagamshela nokukhokela iNkqubo yokuQhakuliswa kolwazi ngokwesebe. Qhagamshela ukuBhaliswa kwezinja ezitsha kwiNkundla yoQeqesho lulwazi. Qhagamshela iimfuno zophando ezivela kubathintekayo (abangaphakathi nabangaphandle).

af.title: Organisasie-ontwikkelingspraktisyn
af.summary: Verskaf organisasie-ontwikkelingsondersteuning insluitend werkevaluering, ontwikkeling van posbeskrywings en belanghebbende-koördinasie by die Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment in Pretoria.
af.requirements: Nasionale Diploma (NQF6) in Bestuursdienste/Bedryfsbestuur/Bedryfsielkunde of 'n relevante kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken. Een (1) jaar ervaring in Organisasie-ontwikkeling of 'n relevante veld. PERSAL-inleidelingsertifikaat en die Compensate-Evaluate-stelsel sal 'n voordeel wees. Kennis van en vermoë om Direktorate Menslike Hulpbronne, riglyne en voorskrifte te interpreteer, veral rakende organisasie-ontwerp en werkevaluering. Begrip van werkstudie/organisasie-ontwerp, werkevaluasieprosesse, besigheidsproseskartering en veranderingbestuur. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede (mondelings en skriftelik). Goeie interpersoonlike, deeglike navorsings-, analitiese, organiserings-, beplannings-, aanbiedings-, koördinerings- en belanghebbende-liaisonvaardighede. Rekenaarvaardigheid op pakette soos Microsoft Word, Excel en PowerPoint is noodsaaklik. Vermoë om lang ure en onder druk te werk. Vermoë om onafhanklik en in 'n span te werk.
af.duties: Verskaf ondersteuning by organisasie-ontwikkelingsondersoeke. Voer voorlopige analise op bestaande funksies uit. Koördineer vergaderings met belanghebbendes. Verskaf werkevalueringondersteuning en stel posbeskrywings op. Voer werkevalueringondersoeke uit. Ontwikkel en fasiliteer die hersiening van posbeskrywings. Onderhou die posbeskrywingsdatabasis. Verskaf ondersteuning vir besigheidsproseskartering. Verskaf ondersteuning by die ontwikkeling van standaard bedryfsprosedures. Verskaf ondersteuning by veranderingbestuurintervensies in ooreenstemming met OO-ondersoeke. Verskaf ondersteuning by die koördinering van veranderingbestuurswerkswinkels vir alle geraakte belanghebbendes. Verskaf ondersteuning by die migrasie, passing en plasing van personeel as gevolg van struktuur- en werkevalueringveranderinge. Verskaf administratiewe ondersteuning vir die WE- en OO-funksies. Fasiliteer logistieke reëlings vir vergaderings. Verskaf sekretariaatondersteuning aan vergaderings.

zu.requirements: I-Diploma Yezwe (NQF6) kumasevisi Okuphathwa/Okuphathwa Kwezinsiza/Kobuchwepheshe Bezimboni noma izifundo ezihambisanayo njengoba kugunyazwe yi-SAQA. Ulwazi nokuhlola imiyalo, iziqondiso nemibhalo yamathambo e-abasebenzini ikakhulukazi mayelana nokwakhiwa kwenhlangano nokuqonda imisebenzi. Ukuqonda isifundo somsebenzi/ukwakhiwa kwenhlangano, izinqubo zokuqonda imisebenzi, ukumapa kwenqubo yebhizinisi, nokuphathwa koshintsho. Amakhono okuxhumana amahle (okukhulunywayo nokubhalwayo). zu.duties: Nikela ngesixhaso ekuphenweni ngentuthuko yenhlangano. Yenza ukuhlaziya okokuqala kwemisebenzi ekhona. Hlanganisa izehlulelo nabahlanganyeli. Nikela ngesixhaso kokuhlola imisebenzi futhi uhlele incazelo yemisebenzi. Yenza uphenyo lokuhlola imisebenzi. Buthaza futhi uhole ukubuyekezwa kwencazelo yemisebenzi. Gcina isizindalwazi sencazelo yemisebenzi. Nikela ngesixhaso ekumapweni kwenqubo yebhizinisi. Nikela ngesixhaso ekuthuthukisweni kwezinqubo ezisebenzayo ezijwayelekile. Nikela ngesixhaso ekungeniseni izinhlelo zokuphathwa koshintsho ngokuvumelana nophenyo lwe-OD. Nikela ngesixhaso ekuhlanganisweni kwezinkomfa zokuphathwa koshintsho kwabo bonke abahlanganyeli abathintekayo. Nikela ngesixhaso ekudluliseni, ekuqondaniseni nasekubekeni abasebenzi njengesiphumma sezinguquko esakhiweni nasekuhloleni imisebenzi. Nikela ngesixhaso sokuphathwa kwezindaba kumisebenzi ye-JE ne-OD. Hlela izinhlelo zokuhamba kwezomphathwa eziyokulezi izehlulelo. Nikela ngesixhaso sobunhloli kulezo izehlulelo.

Ulwazi lokuphonononga nokutolika iimiyalelo, iinkqubo zemithetho yolawulo yabaSebenzi, iinkqubo ezilawula iindlela ezisetyenziswa ngokukodwa malunga nokwakhiwa kweNHlangano nokuqwalaselwa kwemisebenzi. Ukuqonda iindlela zokuphonononga umsebenzi/ukwakhiwa kwenhlangano, iinkqubo zokuqwalaselwa imisebenzi, ukuqamba iinkqubo zeshishini, nokulawula iinguquko. Amakhono amabalulekileyo othetha nobhalo. Nika inkxaso kwindlela yokutshata, ukubaluleka nokubeka abasebenzi phakathi kwamasheya ngenxa yenguquko ezingenisa iindlela ezitsha zemisebenzi. Nika inkxaso ngemisebenzi yeqela le-January ne-Disemba elawula iinkqubo zokuqwalaselwa kwemisebenzi. Lungelelanisa iindibano phakathi kwamagumbi okuqala kwabasebenzi boqobo lwe-December. Nika inkxaso ngemisebenzi eqhutywa nguMphathi wedibase ye-January ukuze ancedise ekubekeni iinkqubo ezilawulayo zabasebenzi base-December.

One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Following the interview and technical passement for all SMS posts, the Selection Panel will recommend candidates to attend a generic managerial competency assessment in compliance with the DPSA Directive on the implementation of competency-based assessments. Persons appointed will be subjected to a security clearance, the signing of a performance agreement and an employment contract. The Department reserves the right not to make an appointment. If you have not been contacted within three 3 months after the closing date of the advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. By submitting the employment application form, you agree and consent in terms of Section 11(1) of the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA), 2013 (Act 4 of 2013), for your personal information which you provide to the DFFE to being processed by the department and its employees, agents, Cabinet committees, and subcontractors for recruitment purposes, in accordance with the POPIA of 2013.

af.title: Huishoudingsbestuurder
af.summary: Skoonmaak en onderhoud van kantore, raadsale en kombuise in Pretoria of QwaQwa, waarvoor 'n Grade 9- of ABET Level 2-sertifikaat vereis word.
af.requirements: Grade 9- of ABET Level 2-sertifikaat. Ervaring in die lewer van skoonmaakdienste sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Begrip van een van die amptelike tale wat in die Departement gebruik word. Vermoë om individueel en in 'n span te werk. Vereiste vaardighede: Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudinge, Kommunikasie, Degelike organisasie- en beplanningsvaardighede. 'n Sin van verantwoordelikheid en lojaliteit hê. Vermoë om vrywillig lang ure te werk.
af.duties: Verskaf skoonmaakdiens in die departement, Skoonmaak van kantore, raadsale, kombuise en gange, Skoonmaak van die rekenaar drukker en kabinette, Verskaf ondersteuning vir vergaderings in die departement, was koppies en vul waterbottels, verwyder afval en gooi dit in die hoofvullisblik, hanteer skoonmaakmateriaal, gebruik die skoonmaakmateriaal en toerusting op die voorgeskrewe wyse, berei tee en water vir vergaderings voor, verwyder en was koppies na die vergadering, onderhou en werk voorraadvlakke by. Hou voorraad (bestek, erdewerk, skoonmaaktoerusting, hervul drank) lys en vlakke van bestek en erdewerk by. Ontvang en pak voorraad, en rapporteer foute, verlies en breek van gereedskap/toerusting.

zu.title: Umphathi Wezokucoza Indawo
zu.summary: Hlaza futhi ugcinise izofisi, amagumbi ezinkulumo namakhashi ePretoria noma eQwaQwa, kudingeka isitifikedi seGrade 9 noma i-ABET Level 2.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi seGrade 9 noma i-ABET Level 2. Ukuba namava ekunikezeni izinsiza zokuhlanza kuzoba yinzuzo eyengeziwe. Ukuqonda elinye lezilimi ezisemthethweni ezisetshenziswa kulo Mnyango. Ukukwazi ukusebenza wedwa nangohlelo. Izikhulu ezidingekayo: Ubuhlobo obuhle phakathi kwabantu, Ukuxhumana, Ukuhlela okuhle, namakhono ekuqambeni izinhlelo. Ukuba nomuzwa wobuleme nokuzithoba. Ukukwazi ukusebenza amahora amude ngokuzithandela.
zu.duties: Nikela ngenkonzo yokuhlanza kulo Mnyango. Ukuhlanza izofisi, amagumbi ezinkulumo, ikhishi, namahlandla. Hlanza isishoshovu sesikhwama somyalezo wekhompyutha namakhaphethi. Nikeza inkxaso yokuhlangana kulo Mnyango, ukuhlaza izinkomishi negalela amabhotela amanzi, ukususa izinkozo futhi uzibekwe kusibinki esikhulu, ukuphatha izinto zokuhlanza, ukusebenzisa izinto zokuhlanza nempahla ngendlela ebaluliwe, kulungise itiye namanzi okuhlangene, susa futhi uhlaze izinkomishi emva kokuhlangene, gcina futhi uvuse izilinganiso zempahla. Gcina uhlu lwempahla (izinkathi, izitsha, impahla yokuhlanza, ugcwalise iziphuzo) nezilinganiso zezinkathi nezitsha. Thola futhi ufake impahla, futhi umike iziphazamiso, ukulahleka, nobukuqamuka kwempahla/emsiningi.

xh.title: Gqokeza kwaye ulondoloze iofisi, igumbi lembiko namaqhikithi, nangaphezulu kwezindlu zokutya. Ukugcina ikhaya elicocekileyo nasendlini yamagqabi.
xh.summary: Cocekisa kwaye ulondoloze iofisi, amagumbi ebhodi nezinkhopho ePretoria noma eQwaQwa, kufuneka unesiqiniseko seGraji 9 okanye isatifikedi ye-ABET Level 2.
xh.requirements: Isatifikedi seGrade 9 okanye i-ABET Level 2. Amava ekuboneleleni ngesevisi yokucocwa kuya kuba lusizo. Kuqonde elinye iilwimi ezisemthethweni ezisetyenziswa kwiSebe. Ukwazi ukusebenza wedwa nakwindyambo. Ikhono elidingekayo: Ubudlelwane obuhle nabantu, Unxibelelwano, Ulungiselelo oluhle, kunye nakhono eplani. Kubekho ngamandla okuzibophelela nokuthembeka. Ukwazi ukusebenza iiyure ezinde ngokuzithandela.
xh.duties: Bonezela isevisi yokucoca kwisebe, Ukucocekisa iofisi, amagumbi ebhodi, izinkhopho, kunye neendlela, Cocisa iikhompyutha, iiprinta nakwiikhabhathi, Bonezela inkxaso kwindibano kwisebe, ukuhlamba iikomishi kwaye uzalaze iibhodlela zamaza, ukuqhosha irhwebo kwaye uligcobe kwibhedi enkulu yokurhweba, ukuphatha izinto zokucoca, ukusebenzisa izinto zokucoca nempahla ngendlela echanekileyo, ulungelelanise itiye namanza kwindibano, ukuqhosha kwaye uhlambe iikomishi emva kwindibano, ulondoloze kwaye uvuse izigqibo zemithungo. Gcina imithungo (izixhobo zokutya, izitya, izixhobo zokucoca, ukuqengqelela iziselo) uludwe kunye namakhaka ezixhobo zokutya neezitya. Yamkela kwaye ufake imithungo, kwaye uchaze iingxaki, ukulahleka, kunye nokutshatyalwa kwezixhobo/impahla.

jobs.title: Chief Financial Officer
jobs.salary_text: R1 554 696 per annum (Level 14), (an all-inclusive package), of which 70% will be basic salary and 30% may be structured according to an individual’s needs.
jobs.summary: Chief Financial Officer at the Government Communications and Information System in Pretoria, requiring a bachelor's degree and five years' senior management experience in financial management.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate bachelor’s degree NQF level 7 as recognised by SAQA in the field of Financial Management with a minimum of Five (5) years’ experience at Senior Management Service level in financial management environment. Advanced financial analytical skills and innovativeness. Strong financial management, asset management and supply chain management acumen (SCM). Strong managerial and communication skills (written and verbal). Thorough knowledge of Financial Management and Supply Chain Management Prescripts in the Public Service.
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will be responsible for the provision of sound financial, supply chain management to enable Departmental Management to make informed decisions. He/she will ensure an effective budget (MTEF adjusted and compiled), and the preparation of interim financial and unquafied annual financial statements. Maintaining an effective Supply Management System. Ensuring proper maintenance of systems of internal control, cash management, liabilities management and expenditure and revenue management. Identifying, managing and implementing risk and risk mitigation plans for the achievement of GCIS objectives. Furthermore, the incumbent will ensure overall management and control of the Chief-Directorate, Financial Management. Providing strategic advice to the Department in respect of Financial Management. Overseeing the budgeting and expenditure monitoring processes. Presenting the monthly financial reports to the Budget Committee and the Executive Committee. Ensuring the timeous submission of the Government Communication and Information System’s financial documentation to the National Treasury. Providing professional financial advice to the line function managers. Ensuring full compliance to the PFMA, SCM Regulations, Treasury Regulations and all the relevant Acts relating to Auxiliary Services. The applicant must have Strong Financial and Human Resource Management skills. Ability to identify and review strategic risks, oversee and manage the implementation of mitigation plans. Participate in the audit planning process and manage responses to audit queries. Ensure implementation of audit recommendations as outlined in the intervention/action plans. In-depth knowledge of policy formulation, implementation and monitoring. Process Competencies: Knowledge Management, Service Delivery Innovation, Problem Solving and Analysis, Client Orientation and Customer Focus, Communication. Competencies: Strategic leadership and capability; Financial management; Risk management; Corporate governance; Extensive knowledge of the Government Communication Policy; the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa of 1996; the Public Service Act of 1994 and Regulations; Public Administration Management Act of 2014; the Public Finance Management Act of 1999; and other relevant prescripts applicable in the communication sector, in the Public Service and for the entities reporting to the GCIS. Must have a valid driver’s license.
jobs.applications: Applicants must submit their applications via the link http://erecruitment.gcis.gov.za or hand deliver applications to Tshedimosetso House, 1035 cnr Francis Baard & Festival streets, Hatfield, Pretoria.
jobs.notes: It is a prerequisite for candidates to have the Nyukela Public Service SMS Pre- Entry Programme certificate to be eligible for appointment. For further details, please click on the following link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training- course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. For more information regarding the course, visit the NSG website: www.thensg.gov.za. The successful candidate must disclose to the Minister particulars of all registrable financial interests and sign the employment contract within one month from the date of assumption of duty as well as sign a performance agreement with the Director-General within three months from the date of assumption of duty and obtain a Top-Secret security clearance. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Please detail courses passed in the CV as per the academic transcript. Note: Suitably qualified People with disabilities will be given preference regardless of Race or Gender. Applicants with disabilities are encouraged to apply. The old prescribed application or employment form Z83 was withdrawn with effect from 31 December 2020. As per the Government Gazette No: 43872, any applicant who submits an application on or after 1 January 2021 must do so on the new prescribed Z83 form, obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.gov.za/documents. Failure to submit an application on the new prescribed Z83 form will lead to disqualification. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application but must submit the fully completed and signed Z83 form and a detailed curriculum vitae. Communication regarding submission of certified copies of qualifications and other relevant documents will be limited to shortlisted candidates. Therefore, only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified documents on or before the day of the interview, following communication from the department. Should you be in possession of a foreign qualification, it must be accompanied by an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Applicants who do not comply with the above- mentioned requirements, as well as applications received late, will not be considered. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. The successful candidate must disclose to the DG particulars of all registrable financial interests, sign a performance agreement and employment contract with the DG within three months from the date of assumption of duty and obtain a top-secret security clearance. All appointments are subject to the verification of educational qualifications, previous experience, citizenship, reference checks and security vetting. The department reserves the right to fill or not to fill the vacant post. The successful candidates will enter into an employment contract with the GCIS that will be reviewed based on performance expiration. By submitting the employment application form, you agree and consent in terms of section 11 (1) of the Protection of Personal Information Act, 2013 (POPIA), for your personal information which you provide to the Government Communication and Information System (“GCIS”) being processed by the GCIS and its employees, agents, cabinet committees, and sub-contractors for recruitment purposes, in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Hoof-finansiele beampte
af.summary: Hoof-finansiele beampte by die Government Communications and Information System in Pretoria, wat 'n bachelorsgraad en vyf jaar se senior bestuurservaring in finansiële bestuur vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike bachelorsgraad NQF vlak 7 soos deur SAQA erken op die gebied van Finansiële Bestuur met 'n minimum van Vyf (5) jaar se ervaring op Senior Management Service-vlak in 'n finansiële bestuursomgewing. Gevorderde finansiële analitiese vaardighede en vernuf. Sterk finansiële bestuur, batebestuur en verskaffingskettingbestuursinisiatief (SCM). Sterk bestuurs- en kommunikasievaardighede (skriftelik en mondelings). Deeglike kennis van Finansiële Bestuur en Verskaffingskettingbestuursvoorskrifte in die Publieke Diens.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal verantwoordelik wees vir die voorsiening van deeglike finansiële, verskaffingskettingbestuur om Departementele Bestuur in staat te stel om ingeligte besluite te neem. Hy/sy sal 'n doeltreffende begroting (MTEF aangepas en saamgestel) verseker, en die voorbereiding van tussentydse finansiële en ongekwalifiseerde jaarlikse finansiële state. Onderhou 'n doeltreffende Verskaffingsbestuurstelsel. Verseker behoorlike instandhouding van stelsels van interne beheer, kontantbestuur, lastebestuur en bestuursuitgawes en inkomste. Identifisering, bestuur en implementering van risiko en risikobeperkingsplanne vir die bereiking van GCIS-doelwitte. Verder sal die ampsdraer verseker dat daar algehele bestuur en beheer van die Hoof-Direktoraat, Finansiële Bestuur is. Verskaf strategiese advies aan die Departement ten opsigte van Finansiële Bestuur. Toesig hou oor die begrotings- en uitgawemoniteringsprosesse. Voorlê van die maandelikse finansiële verslae aan die Begrotingskomitee en die Uitvoerende Komitee. Verseker die tydige indiening van die Government Communication and Information System se finansiële dokumentasie by die Nasionale Tesourie. Verskaf professionele finansiële advies aan die lynfunksiebestuurders. Verseker volle nakoming van die PFMA, SCM-regulasies, Tesourie-regulasies en alle tersaaklike Wette wat op Hulpdienste betrekking het. Die aansoeker moet Sterk Finansiële en Menslike Hulpbronbestuursvaardighede hê. Vermoë om strategiese risiko's te identifiseer en te hersien, toesig te hou oor en die implementering van beperkingsplanne te bestuur. Neem deel aan die ouditbeplanningsproses en bestuur antwoorde op ouditvrae. Verseker implementering van ouditaanbevelings soos uiteengesit in die intervensie/aksieplanne. Diepgaande kennis van beleidsformulering, implementering en monitering. Prosesbevoegdhede: Kennisbestuur, Dienslewering-inovasie, Probleemoplossing en analise, Kliëntoriëntasie en Kliëntfokus, Kommunikasie. Bevoegdhede: Strategiese leierskap en vermoë; Finansiële bestuur; Risikobestuur; Korporatiewe bestuur; Uitgebreide kennis van die Regeringskommunikasiebeleid; die Grondwet van die Republiek van Suid-Afrika van 1996; die Publieke Dienswet van 1994 en Regulasies; Publieke Bestuurswet van 2014; die Publieke Finansiesbestuurswet van 1999; en ander tersaaklike voorskrifte wat van toepassing is in die kommunisiesektor, in die Publieke Diens en vir die entiteite wat aan die GCIS verslag doen. Moet 'n geldige bestuurslisensie hê.

zu.title: Umphathi Wezimali Oyinhloko
zu.summary: Umphathi Wezimali Oyinhloko e-Government Communications and Information System e-Pretoria, ofuna iziqu ze-bachelor's degree namava eminyaka emihlanu yokuphatha abaphathi abaphezulu kokuqashwa kwemali.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanele ze-bachelor's degree NQF level 7 njengoba zivunywe yi-SAQA emkhakheni we-Financial Management nobuncwane beminyaka engu-Five (5) wokuba ngumsebenzi ezingeni le-Senior Management Service emkhakheni we-financial management. Amakhono aphezulu okuhlaziya imali ngokwesibonelo nobuhlakani. Ukuqonda okuqinile kokuphatha imali, ukuphatha izimpahla nokuphatha iketshi yokuhlinzeka (SCM). Amakhono aphezulu okuphatha nokuxhumana (okuqoshiwe nokukhulunwayo). Ukuqonda okujulile kwemiyalo ye-Financial Management ne-Supply Chain Management Prescripts e-Public Service.
zu.duties: Omakethe ohamba phambili uzobe nesibopho sokunikeza ukuphatha imali okuhle, nokuphatha iketshi yokuhlinzeka ukuze abaphathi bomnyango bakwazi ukwenza izinqumo ezinolwazi. Yena uzokuqinisekisa ukuthi kukhona uhlelo lokulinganisa imali olusebenzayo (i-MTEF elungisiwe neqoqwe), kanye nokulungiselela izitatimende zemini nezinye zonyaka ezinganabungozi. Ukuqhuba uhlelo lokuphatha kokuhlinzeka olusebenzayo. Ukuqinisekisa ukugcinwa okulungile kwezinhlelo zolawulo lwangaphakathi, ukuphatha imali eshandeni, ukuphatha izikweletu, kanye nokuphatha izinkokhelo namali engenayo. Ukubona, ukuphatha nokuphetha amaphuzu engcuphe nemikhakha yokunciphisa ingcuphe ukuze kufezeke izinjongo ze-GCIS. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umphathi uzobe esebenza ukuphatha nokulawula iChief-Directorate, i-Financial Management ngokuphelele. Ukunikeza izeluleko ezinolwazi emnyangweni mayelana ne-Financial Management. Ukuqaphela izinqubo zokulinganisa imali nokuqapha izinkokhelo. Ukunikela izibiko zemali zanyanga zonke ku-Budget Committee naku-Executive Committee. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kwethulwa ngasikhathi samba imibhalo yemali ye-Government Communication and Information System ku-National Treasury. Ukunikeza izeluleko zemali ezisebenzayo kubaphathi bomugqa. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kulandelwa ngokugcwele i-PFMA, i-SCM Regulations, i-Treasury Regulations nayo yonke imithetho ehlobene ne-Auxiliary Services. Umfaki kumele abe namakhono aqinile we-Financial Management nokuphatha i-Human Resource. Ikhono lokubuka futhi ukuhlola amaphuzu engcuphe, ukuqapha nokuphatha ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zokunciphisa ingozi. Ukubamba iqhaza enqabweni yokuhlela i-audit nokuphatha impendulo kumibuzo ye-audit. Ukuqinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwezincomo ze-audit njengoba kuchaziwe kuzinhlelo zokungenelela/isinyathelo. Ulwazi olujulile ngokwakheka, ukusetshenziswa nokubheka izinhlelo. Amakhono okusebenza: Ukuphatha ulwazi, Intuthuko yokuletha izinsizakalo, Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya, Ukugxila kumthengi nokuqapha umthengi, Ukuxhumana. Amakhono: Ubuholo nobuhlakani obusemthethweni; Ukuphatha imali; Ukuphatha ingcuphe; Ukuphatha inkampani ngokomthetho; Ulwazi olujulile lwe-Government Communication Policy; umthethosisekelo weRiphabhlikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika ka-1996; uMthetho we-Public Service ka-1994 ne-Regulations; uMthetho we-Public Administration Management ka-2014; uMthetho we-Public Finance Management ka-1999; kanye nalezo mvumela ezengeziwe ezisebenza emkhakheni wokuxhumana, e-Public Service nakuzo zikhungo ezibika ku-GCIS. Kumele abe nelayisensi yokushayela evumelekile.

xh.title: Nozulu we-Mali
xh.summary: UNozulu weMali e-Government Communications and Information System e-Pretoria, efunayo isidanga sobachelors neminye elihlanu yoqeqesho ekulawuleni abaphathi abaphakamileyo ekulawuleni imali.
xh.requirements: Isidanga sobachelors esifanelekileyo NQF level 7 njengokuqatshwa yi-SAQA kwinkalo yoLawulo lweMali ineminye eliqela (5) yokuba ngumlawuli ophakamileyo kwinkalo yoLawulo lweMali. Amakhono obuhlakani obuhle bokuhlahleba imali nobungenisa izinto ezintsha. Isibhozo esinamandla sokulawula imali, ukulawula izinto ezithengwayo nokuqonda ukulawula iqhagamshelwano (SCM). Amakhono abalulekileyo okulawula nokunyanzelisa (okubhalwe nokuthethwayo). Ulwazi oluqinileyo ngeendaba zoLawulo lweMali nokuLawula iQhagamshelwano esiSebenzwa kwiNkonzo kaRhulumente.
xh.duties: Omele kuya kubandakanya ekuboneleleni ngolawulo oluluncedo lwemali nolwesiqhengqwane saluqhagamshelwano, ukuze abaphathi beSebe bakwazi ukwenza izigqibo ezinolwazi. Uya kuqinisekisa ispilu elisebenzayo (MTEF elungisiweyo nelungiselwe), kunye nolungiso lwemibiko yemali yexesha elithile nemibiko yemali yonyaka engenamdla. Ukugcina Inkqubo yokuLawula uQhagamshelwano nokuSebenzisa esebenzayo. Ukuqinisekisa ukugcinwa okulungileyo kweenkqubo zolawulo langaphakathi, ulawulo lwemali yolwazi olutyalwe, ulawulo lwezithwarwa kunye nolawulo lochitho noluqhagamshelo. Ukuqonda, ulawule uze usebenzise iinkqubo zesigqibo sokuba sisebenze kunye neenkqubo zokunciphisa iingxaki ukuze kufikelelwe kwizinqobo ezijoliswe kuzo ze-GCIS. Ngaphezu koko, umntu othatha isithuba uya kuqinisekisa ulawulo nolawulo olubanzi loNobumba weNqanaba eliPhakamileyo, uLawulo lweMali. Ukuze bonezele iindaba ezimalunga noLawulo lweMali, uya kubonezela iimfuno-nqubo ezibalulekileyo kuSebe. Ukuqonda iinkqubo zokulungisa ispilu nokuqonda indlela yokuchithwa kwemali. Ukuvezwa kwemibiko yemali yenyanga kuKomiti ye-Spilu nakwiKomiti yeNkulumbuso. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba imibhalo yemali ye-Government Communication and Information System ithunyelwa kwesikhathi esiyingozi kwiNational Treasury. Ukuze kube kukubonezela iimfuno-nqobo ngeemfuno zomsebenzi, uya kubonezela iindaba ezimalunga noLawulo lweMali. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthelekiswa okupheleleyo na ku-PFMA, iinkqubo ze-SCM, iinkqubo zeTreasury kunye nawo onke amaqonga alawulayo abandakanya iinkonzo eziyimbi. Isicelo kufuneka sinamakhono amaninzi ekulawula iMali nabaBasebenzi. Ukuba nokwazi ukuqonda nokuphonononga izigqibo ezibalulekileyo, ukuze uqonde ulawule uze usebenzise iinkqubo zokunciphisa iingxaki. Ukubamba iqhaza kwinkqubo yokucwangcisa i-audit nokulawula iimpendulo kwimibuzo ye-audit. Ukuqinisekisa ukusebenziswa kweziindlela ezisiwa yimibuzo ye-audit njengoko kuchazwe kwiinkqubo zesigqibo nenzira. Ukuqonda ngokucwangciswa, ukusebenziswa nokulawula iinkqubo. Amaphawu eNkqubo: Ulawulo loLwazi, Intsingiselo yokuzisa iNkonzo ngeendlela ezintsha, ukuSombulula iingxaki ukuZonda, ukuQondisisa uMthengi nokuJolisa kuMthengi, ukuQhuba uNyanzeliso. Amaphawu obuNkulumbuso nokuBa ngumQambi: Ulawulo lweNqanaba ePhezulu nobuNkulumbuso; Ulawulo lweMali; Ulawulo loGqitho; Ulawulo lweNkampani; Ulwazi olubanzi lweNkqubo yeNkqubo yoNyanzeliso kaRhulumente; uGqitho loRiphabhuliki yoMzantsi Afrika ka-1996; uMthetho woNkonzo kaRhulumente ka-1994 nemiQathango; uMthetho woLawulo loLawulo kaRhulumente ka-2014; uMthetho woLawulo lweMali yoRhulumente ka-1999; nemiQathango elawulayo namanye amaqonga esetyenziswa kwicandelo lokunyanzeliswa, kwiNkonzo kaRhulumente nakweziqulatho ezibika kwi-GCIS. Kufuneka abe nelayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo.

jobs.title: Provincial Director: Western Cape Provincial Office
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 per annum (Level 13), (an all-inclusive package), of which 70% will be basic salary and 30% may be structured according to an individual’s needs.
jobs.summary: Lead the GCIS Western Cape Provincial Office as Provincial Director, managing provincial communication campaigns and strategic communication systems.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate Bachelor’s Degree (NQF level 7 as recognised by SAQA) in Communication / Media Studies / Journalism / Public Relations / Development Communication or related (NQF Level 7) qualification, majoring in Communication / Media Studies/ Journalism/ Public Relations / Development Communication. Successful completion of the Public Service Senior Management Leadership Programme (Nyukela certificate) as endorsed by the National School of Government is a pre-requisite for appointment. Must have a valid driver’s license and be computer literate. At least five (5) years’ experience at middle/senior management level with extensive experience in and knowledge of development communication, proven leadership capabilities, and sound interpersonal and project management skills. Extensive experience in coordinating multi-stakeholders and inter-governmental multi-media communication campaigns. Knowledge: Comprehensive knowledge of the Western Cape Province, including socio-economic and development dynamics as well of the communication footprint and dynamics of the province, including also at municipal level. Sound knowledge of the Public Finance Management Act. Must have a valid driver’s license and be computer literate. Required Core Competencies: Strategic Capacity and Leadership, People Management and Empowerment, Financial Management, Change Management, Programme and Project Management.
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will be responsible for providing strategic leadership and management to the GCIS Provincial Directorate in the Western Cape Province particularly in support of the provincial communication system headed by the Office of the Premier. Deliver communication campaigns in line with the National Communication Strategic Framework and the Medium-Term Development Plan (MTDP), and the Provincial MTDP and communication programme. Advocate for the application of the Norms and Standards of Government Communications amongst the communication system in the province and lend support to the Local Government Communication System. Develop and maintain communication partnerships and networks with provincial stakeholders from Government and Civil Society. Participate actively in all communications forums in the province and provide strategic direction on government communication in such forums and when urgent or rapid communication is concerned, to protect and enhance the reputation of government. Operate an effective, and compliant government communication organisation. Identify and review strategic risks, oversee and manage the implementation mitigation plans. Participate in the audit planning process and manage responses to audit queries.

af.title: Provinciale Direkteur: Wes-Kaapse Provinciale Kantoor
af.summary: Tree as Provinciale Direkteur van die GCIS Wes-Kaapse Provinciale Kantoor op en bestuur provinsiale kommunikasieveldtogte en strategiese kommunikasiestelsels.
af.requirements: ’n Toepaslike Baccalaureusgraad (NQF vlak 7 soos deur SAQA erken) in Kommunikasie / Mediastudie / Joernalistiek / Openbare Betrekkinge / Ontwikkelingskommunikasie of ’n verwante (NQF Vlak 7) kwalifikasie, met Kommunikasie / Mediastudie / Joernalistiek / Openbare Betrekkinge / Ontwikkelingskommunikasie as hoofvakke. Suksesvolle voltooiing van die Openbare Dienst Senior Bestuursleierskap-program (Nyukela-sertifikaat) soos deur die National School of Government goedgekeur, is ’n voorvereiste vir aanstelling. Moet ’n geldige bestuurslisensie hê en rekenaarvaardig wees. Ten minste vyf (5) jaar ervaring op middel-/seniorbestuursvlak met uitgebreide ervaring in en kennis van ontwikkelingskommunikasie, bewese leierskapsvermoëns, en goeie interpersoonlike en projekbestuursvaardighede. Uitgebreide ervaring in die koördinering van multibydraer- en intergovernmentele multimediakommunikasieveldtogte. Kennis: Omvattende kennis van die Wes-Kaapse Provinsie, insluitend sosio-ekonomiese en ontwikkelingsdinamika asook die kommunikasievoetspoor en dinamika van die provinsie, insluitend ook op munisipale vlak. Degelike kennis van die Public Finance Management Act. Moet ’n geldige bestuurslisensie hê en rekenaarvaardig wees. Vereiste kernbevoegdhede: Strategiese Kapasiteit en Leierskap, Personebestuur en Bemagtiging, Finansiële Bestuur, Veranderingsbestuur, Program- en Projektbestuur.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal verantwoordelik wees daarvoor om strategiese leierskap en bestuur aan die GCIS Provinciale Direktoraat in die Wes-Kaapse Provinsie te verskaf, veral ter ondersteuning van die provinsiale kommunikasiestelsel wat deur die Kantoor van die Premier gelei word. Lewer kommunikasieveldtogte ooreenkomstig die National Communication Strategic Framework en die Medium-Term Development Plan (MTDP), asook die Provinciale MTDP en kommunikasieprogram. Pleitbesorg vir die toepassing van die Norme en Standaarde van Regeringskommunikasie onder die kommunikasiestelsel in die provinsie en verleen ondersteuning aan die Plaaslike Regeringskommunikasiestelsel. Ontwikkel en onderhou kommunikasievennootskappe en -netwerke met provinsiale belanghebbendes vanuit Regering en die Burgerlike Samelewing. Neem aktief deel aan alle kommunikasieforums in die provinsie en verskaf strategiese rigting oor regeringskommunikasie in sodanige forums en wanneer dringende of vinnige kommunikasie ter sprake is, om die reputasie van die regering te beskerm en te verbeter. Bedryf ’n doeltreffende en nakomende regeringskommunikasie-organisasie. Identifiseer en hersien strategiese risiko's, en hou toesig oor en bestuur die implementering van mitigasieplanne. Neem deel aan die ouditbeplanningsproses en bestuur reaksies op ouditnavrae.

zu.title: Umphathi wesifundazwe: Western Cape Provincial Office
zu.summary: Hola i-GCIS Western Cape Provincial Office njengomphathi wesifundazwe, uphathe imikhankaso yokuxhumana yesifundazwe kanye namasistimu okuxhumana anamasu.
zu.requirements: I-Degree ye-Bachelor efanele (NQF level 7 njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA) ku-Communication / Media Studies / Journalism / Public Relations / Development Communication noma iziqu ezihlobene (NQF Level 7), ezinabugciso obuphambili ku-Communication / Media Studies/ Journalism/ Public Relations / Development Communication. Ukuphumelela ukugqiba i-Public Service Senior Management Leadership Programme (Nyukela certificate) njengokuqashwe yi-National School of Government kuyisidingo sokuqashwa. Kumele abe nelayisensi yokushayela evumelekile futhi azi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha. Okungenani iminyaka emihlanu (5) yamava ezingeni labaphathi abaphakathi / abaphezulu ngencazelo evamile yamava nakolwazi lwe-development communication, amandla okuhlola abaswele, kanye namakhono abantu nokuqondisa amaphrojekthi. Iminyaka eminingi yamava ekuhlanganiseni abahlanganyeli abaningi kanye nemikhankaso yokuxhumana yohlelo lokulingana nemithombo eminingi yezindaba phakathi kahulumeni. Ulwazi: Ulwazi oluphelele mayelana ne-Western Cape Province, okuhlanganisa izinguquko ezingokomnotho nentuthuko kanye nezinyawo ezenziwayo zokuxhumana namaguguwesifundazwe, okuhlanganisa neninga likamasipala. Ulwazi oluhle mayelana ne-Public Finance Management Act. Kumele abe nelayisensi yokushayela evumelekile futhi azi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha. Amandi abadingekayo abalulekile: Amandla okwenza amasu nokuhlola, Ukuphathwa kwabantu nokuqinisa, Ukuphathwa kwezimali, Ukuphathwa inguquko, Ukuphathwa amaphrojekthi nanohlelo.
zu.duties: Ophumelelayo uzoba nesibopho sokunika i-GCIS Provincial Directorate e-Western Cape Province ukuholwa okunesisu nokuphathwa ikakhulukazi ngokusekela isistimu yokuxhumana yesifundazwe eholwa yi-Office of the Premier. Yenza imikhankaso yokuxhumana ngokuhambisana ne-National Communication Strategic Framework kanye ne-Medium-Term Development Plan (MTDP), kanye ne-Provincial MTDP nenkqubo yokuxhumana. Zwakalisa ukusekelwa kwe-Norms and Standards of Government Communications phakathi kwesistimu yokuxhumana esifundazweni futhi nikeza usizo ku-Local Government Communication System. Yakha futhi ugcine ubudlelwano nokuxhumana nabahlanganyeli besifundazwe abavela kuHulumeni naseMphakathini Zangempela. Hlanganyela ngokusebenzayo kuzo zonke izinkundla zokuxhumana esifundazweni futhi nikeza isu sokuhola mayelana nokuxhumana kahulumeni kulezo zincwadi futhi lapho kunesidingo sokuxhumana ngokushesha, ukuze uvikele futhi wenze ngcono isithombe kahulumeni. Qamba futhi uphathe inhlelakahulumene yokuxhumana evumelekile, ehambisana nomthetho. Hlaza futhi ubuke izingozi ezenzakalayo ezinamasu, uqaphele futhi uphathe ukuqashwa kwezinhlelo zokunciphisa izinkinga. Hlanganyela kwinqubo yokuhlela isibhekezo futhi uphathe impendulo ezibhekweni.

xh.title: Umgcina weeNkovela kwiNqanaba lePhondo: Isebe lePhondo elaseWestern Cape
xh.summary: Qonda iSebe lePhondo elaseWestern Cape le-GCIS njengomgcina weeNkovela kwiphondo, ulawule iikhempani zokunyanya ukunxibelelwana kwiphondo nezakhiwo zokunxibelelwana ezibalulekileyo.
xh.requirements: I-Degree ye-Bachelor efanelekileyo (inqanaba le-NQF 7 njengokuqatshiwe yi-SAQA) kwi-Communication / Media Studies / Journalism / Public Relations / Development Communication okanye izifundo ezinxulumene nazo (i-NQF Level 7), ezithatha i-Communication / Media Studies / Journalism / Public Relations / Development Communication njengesigaba esiphambili. Ukuqedwa ngemvumbo kwe-Public Service Senior Management Leadership Programme (isatifikethi se-Nyukela) njengokuqinisekiswa yi-National School of Government sisiphithiphithi sokumiselwa. Kufuneka abe nelayisenisi yokuqhuba esemthethweni azi namakhompyutha. Ubuncinane eminyaka emihlanu (5) yamava kwinqanaba lolawulo lwelinga eliphakathi/elphezulu, enamava alula nolwazi lokunxibelelwana koluntu olutshintshayo, amandla obuqhawe aqinisiweyo, namakhono abantu athembekileyo okulawula iiprojekthi. Amava alula ekusebenzeni nabaphathi abaningi nokuhambelana namakhompyutha weendaba ezininzi kunye namakomishani woluntu wolwazi wemihla ngemihla. Ulwazi: Ulwazi olubanzi lwe-Western Cape Province, kuquka nokutshintsha kwezalo-mali noluntu, kunye nokuqondwa kolwazi lwendalo yokunxibelelwana kwakunye nokutshintsha kwephondo, kuquka nangamazinga oomasipala. Ulwazi olululo lwe-Public Finance Management Act. Kufuneka abe nelayisenisi yokuqhuba esemthethweni azi namakhompyutha. Amanobhalo aBalulekileyo afunekayo: Amandla Okuqamba iNdlela nokubaNgumLawuli, uLawulo lwabaNtu ngoBunini namandla, uLawulo lweMali, uLawulo lokuTshintsha, uLawulo lweNkqubo neeProjekthi.
xh.duties: Umntu ofezelayo uza kuba nawo umsebenzi wokunika iindlela eziphambili zokuqhatha nolawulo kwiSebe loLawulo lwe-GCIS kwiphondo le-Western Cape Province ngakumbi ngokuxhasa inkqubo yolwazi lokunxibelelwana kwiphondo eholwa yi-Office of the Premier. Yaza iikhempani zokunxibelelwana ngokwecandelo le-National Communication Strategic Framework ne-Medium-Term Development Plan (MTDP), kunye ne-Provincial MTDP nenkqubo yolwazi lokunxibelelwana. Mela ukusebenzisa okokuqinisekisa kwaye uqonde iindlela ezimiselweyo zikaRhulumente kunye namagunya okunxibelelwana phakathi kwendalo yolwazi kwiphondo uncedise inkqubo yolwazi lokunxibelelwana kolawulo lwasekhaya. Yakhe ulondoloze ulwazi lokunxibelelwana lwamakhonco namashishini nolwazi olubanzi nabaphathi kwiphondo abavela kuRhulwe nasekuBuntwini bentlalo. Thabatha inxaxheba ngokubalulekileyo kuzo zonke iindawo zokunxibelelwana kwiphondo uze unike iindlela ezibalulekileyo zolwazi lukaRhulumente kwezo ndawo, kwakunye naxa kusenzeka ukunxibelelwana okukhawulezayo ngokukhawuleza, ukuze uvikele ulondoloze igama lukaRhulumente. Qhuba ulawulo lokunxibelelwana lukaRhulumente olusebenzayo, olulandela umthetho neendlela ezimiselweyo. Qonda uhlole iingozi ezibalulekileyo, ulawule ukuqhutywa kweenkqubo zokuzalisa ngxaki. Thabatha inxaxheba kwinkqubo yokulungelelanisa i-odit oze ulawule iimpendulo zemibuzo ye-odit.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Curriculum Implementation
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.salary_text: R605 742 per annum (Level 10), plus actual benefits
jobs.summary: Assistant Director for curriculum implementation at the Central Office in Vryheid, overseeing curriculum policy development and occupational programme rollout.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate Bachelors’ Degree / National Diploma in Engineering and/or Business Studies augmented by qualification in Education (NQF Level 6) recognized by SAQA. A minimum of three (3) to five (5) years’ supervisory experience as Senior Lecturer/ Head of Division in the relevant field is required. The candidate should have strong understanding of occupational curriculum development, implementation, and assessment strategies. A valid drivers’ licence and willingness to drive long distances. Knowledge of PSET and CET Act. Knowledge of Teaching and Learning. Knowledge of Skills Development Act, Public Service Regulations and Public Service Act as well as Labour Relations Act. Knowledge of the Public TVET sector and its regulatory and legislative framework. Knowledge and understanding of the Higher Education sector. Skills: Administrative, planning and organizing, financial management, report writing, communication and interpersonal, problem solving, analytical, client oriented, project management, team leadership and computer Literacy and people management.
jobs.duties: Oversee the implementation and monitoring of curriculum services by developing policy/ guidelines for management of curriculum (classroom management policy), monitoring the implementation of curriculum policies, leading the implementation of new programmes such as Occupational Programmes, coordinating review of the ICASS guidelines for all programmes in accordance with DHET guidelines, monitoring the conduct of assessments on all programmes, provide required report to senior management and other stakeholders, overseeing coordinated curriculum delivery at all college delivery sites, ensuring implementation of best practices teaching in collaboration with campus managers. Oversee Curriculum Services by facilitating new programme decisions and manage planning process, identifying learner material, equipment and other resources, distributing LTSMS (Learning, Teaching Support Materials) to all campuses. Ensure the provision of guidance for the improvement of curriculum content and delivery based on engagements with public and private industry stakeholders by analysing results and provide necessary intervention to critical subjects, planning class visits to improve quality teaching and learning. Provisioning of Assessment and Moderation by conducting workshops for academic staff

af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Kurrikulumimplementering
af.summary: Assistentdirekteur vir kurrikulumimplementering by die Sentrale Kantoor in Vryheid, wat toezig hou oor kurrikulumbeleidontwikkeling en die uitrol van beroepsprogramme.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike Baccalaureusgraad / Nasionale Diploma in Ingenieurswese en/of Besigheidstudies aangevul deur 'n kwalifikasie in Onderwys (NQF Vlak 6) wat deur SAQA erken word. 'n Minimum van drie (3) tot vyf (5) jaar se toesigervaring as Senior Lektor / Hoof van Afdeling in die relevante veld word vereis. Die kandidaat moet 'n sterk begrip hê van beroepskurrikulumontwikkeling, implementering en assesseringsstrategieë. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie en bereidwilligheid om lang afstande te bestuur. Kennis van PSET en CET-wet. Kennis van Onderrig en Leer. Kennis van die Wet op Vaardigheidsontwikkeling, Regulasies vir die Staatsdiens en Staatsdienswet asook die Arbeidsverhoudingswet. Kennis van die openbare TVET-sektor en sy regulatoriese en wetgewende raamwerk. Kennis en begrip van die Hoër Onderwys-sektor. Vaardighede: Administratiewe, beplanning en organisering, finansiële bestuur, verslagskryf, kommunikasie en interpersoonlik, probleemoplossing, analities, kliëntgerig, projekbestuur, spanleierskap en rekenaargeletterdheid en mensebestuur.
af.duties: Hou toezig oor die implementering en monitering van kurrikulumdienste deur beleid/ riglyne vir die bestuur van kurrikulum (klaskamerbestuursbeleid) te ontwikkel, die implementering van kurrikulumbeleide te moniteer, die implementering van nuwe programme soos Beroepsprogramme te lei, die hersiening van die ICASS-riglyne vir alle programme in ooreenstemming met DHET-riglyne te koördineer, die uitvoering van assesserings op alle programme te moniteer, die vereiste verslag aan senior bestuur en ander belanghebbendes te verskaf, gekoördineerde kurrikulumaflewering by alle kollege-afleweringsplekke toe te sien, die implementering van Beste praktyke-onderrig in samewerking met kampusbestuurders te verseker. Hou toezig oor Kurrikulumdienste deur besluite oor nuwe programme te fasiliteer en die beplanningsproses te bestuur, leerdermateriaal, toerusting en ander hulpbronne te identifiseer, LTSMS (Leer- en Onderrigondersteuningsmateriaal) na alle kampusse te versprei. Verseker die voorsiening van leiding vir die verbetering van kurrikuluminhoud en -aflewering gebaseer op betrokkenheid by openbare en private nywerheidsbelanghebbendes deur resultate te ontleed en nodige ingryping by kritieke vakke te verskaf, klasbesoeke te beplan om die kwaliteit van onderrig en leer te verbeter. Voorsiening van Assessering en Moderering deur werkswinkels vir akademiese personeel te hou.

zu.title: Umsizi Womphathi: Ukuqashwa Kohlelo Lwemfundo
zu.summary: Umsizi Womphathi wokuSebenzisa Uhlelo Lwemfundo ehhovisi elikhulu Vryheid, oqapha ukuthuthukiswa kwezinqubomgomo zohlelo Iwemfundo nokuqalwa kwezinhlelo zobuchwepheshye.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanele ze-Bachelor / National Diploma eNjenini nakuhlelo Lwebhizinisi ezikhulunyiswe ngokuthi zibe nokuqeqeshwa eMfundeni (NQF Level 6) esesabalele i-SAQA. Kudingeka ubuhlotshisi be minyaka yonke emithathu (3) kuya kuhlanu (5) ngokuhola njengo-Mkhulu-Mfundisi / Nkomasa Webandla esimqoka othile. Kufanele umuntu azibe nosizo olunamandla ngokwakha, ukubeka, nokubuyekeza uhlelo Iwemfundo yomuntu ngamunye, nendlela yokulinganisa. Ilayisense yokuqasha elikhungqwe kakhulu neanthwaba yokwazi ukuhamba ibanga elide. Ulwazi lwe-PSET kanye noMtsetfo we-CET. Ulwazi lokufundisa nokufunda. Ulwazi ngoMtsetfo we-Thuthukiswa Kobuchule, Izimap ngombuso weziko losobpulu nomtsetfo obhejiwe phansi kwelungelo, kanye nomtsetfo wezwi lebandla. Ulwazi lomhlobi weziko Le-Public TVET nomuhloba womtsetfo oyifunisela. Ulwazi nokuqonda ngaphakathi kwe-Higher Education. Izinyandza ezenzivele: Izisebenzi zokulawula, ukuhlela nokuhlelanganisa, imali yokulawula, ukubhala imibiko, ukuxhumana nabantu, ukuxazula izinkinga, ukuhlaziya, ukulungiselela ibhasi, imiphumela ngokuba ngomphathi weqembu kanye nesikhathi esidingekile emphakathini, ukuphatha eqhingini, ukuphatha abantu, kanye nokusebenzisa ikhompyudha.
zu.duties: Qapha ukuphathwa kanye nokulandelela izinsizakalo zohlelo lwemfundo ngokuthuthukisa izinqubomgomo/ izindlela zokuphatha uhlelo lwemfundo (isinqubomgomo sokuphatha igumbi lokufundisa), ukulandelela ukuphathwa kwezinqubomgomo zohlelo lwemfundo, ukuhola ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo ezintsha njengabezobunini, ukuhlanganisa ukubuyekezwa kwezindlela ze-ICASS kuzo zonke izinhlela ngokuvumelana nezindlela ze-DHET, ukulandelela ukwenziwa kokuqashwa kwezinhlelo kuwo onke amaphathi, ukunikeza umbiko odingekela abaphathi abaphezulu kanye nalabo abanye abahlanganyeli, ukuqapha ukulethwa kohlelo lwemfundo okuhlanganiswe emawebhusayithi wonke aphathwayo enkoleji, ukuqinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwezindlela ezinhulu kakhulu zokufundisa ngokubambisana nabaphathi basekhasimende. Qapha izinsizakalo zohlelo lwemfundo ngokwesekela izinqumo zezinhlelo ezintsha bese uphatha inqubo yokuhlela, ukukhomba izinto zokufunda zesifundi, izinto namanye amathuluzi, ukwabiwa kwe-LTSMS (izinto zokufunda nokufundisa) emakhasini wonke. Qinisekisa ukunikezwa kolwazi olusiza ukuthuthukisa okuqukethwe uhlelo lwemfundo nokulethwa kwalo ngokusekelwe ekuhlanganyeni nabahlanganyeli bomphakathi nabangasese abakuleso sikhundla ngokuhlaziya iziphetho bese unikeza ukungenelela okudingekayo kumaphathi abalulekile, ukuhlela ukuvakatshela amakilasi ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukufundisa nokufunda okunemithombo. Ukuletha ukubuyekeza nokulinganisa ngokubumba izingqungquthela zeqhaza labaqeqeshi bokufundisa

xh.title: Umphathi oMncedi: Ukusebenza kweNkqubo yoFundo
xh.summary: Umphathi oMncedi wokusebenza kwenkqubo yofundo eCentral Office eVryheid, elawula uphuhliso lwengqikithi yomgaqo-nkqubo yofundo nokuqwalaselwa kwenkqubo yemisebenzi.
xh.requirements: Isidanga sokuQala esifanelekileyo / iDiploma yaseLizwe eNjineli kwaye/nakwiZifundo zeShishino esomelezwe ngemfundo eNqanaba le-6 (NQF) ekuqatywa nguSAQA. Kufuneka kube khona ulwazi lokusebenza olungaphezulu kweminyaka emithathu (3) ukuya kumihlanu (5) njengomphathi kwiziko eliphakamileyo / Nolawula ulwahlulo kwinkqubo ehambelana nalommandla. Umpha esibusweni kufuneka abe nokuqonda okuqinileyo ngophuhliso, ukusebenza, namacebo okuqikelela inkqubo yemisebenzi. Ilayisenisi yokushayela esebenzayo nokulungele ukuqhuba iindlela ezinde. Ulwazi ngomthetho wePSET neCET. Ulwazi ngokuFundisa nokufunda. Ulwazi ngomthetho woPhuhliso loBuchule, iMigaqo yoBuphondo loLuntu nakuMthetho woLuntu, nakuMthetho weZenzo zoBabini baseMsebenzini. Ulwazi ngenqanaba leTVET likaRhulumente nemigaqo-nkqubo yalo. Ulwazi nokuqonda inqanaba lemfundo ePhakamileyo. Ikhono: LoLawulo, iplani nokuhlelwa, ulawulo lwezimali, ukubhala iingxelo, unxibelelwano nokuqondana nabantu, ukusombulula iingxaki, ukuhlalutya, ukujolisa kumxhasi, ulawulo lwaprojekthi, ukulawula iqela nolwazi lwekhompyutha nokulawula abantu.
xh.duties: Ulawula ukusebenza nokuphononongwa kweenkonzo zenkqubo yofundo ngokuphuhlisa umgaqo-nkqubo / iindlela zokulawula inkqubo yofundo (umgaqo-nkqubo wolawulo lweklasi), ukuphonononga ukusebenza kweemigaqo-nkqubo yofundo, ukukhokela ukusebenza kweenkqubo ezintsha ezinjengenkqubo yemisebenzi, ukulungisa uluhlu lwemigaqo ye-ICASS yeenkqubo zonke ngokwemigaqo ye-DHET, ukuphonononga ukuqhutywa kokuqikelelwa kweenkqubo zonke, ukunika iingxelo ezifunekayo kubaphathi abaphezulu nakuwo onke amanye amalungu, ukulawula ukunikezelwa kwenkqubo yofundo ekunye kwiindawo zonke ezinikezela ngayo inkqubo yofundo, kuqinisekiswa ukusebenza kweendlela ezilungileyo zokufundisa ngokusebenzisana nabaphathi bekhamphi. Ulawula iinkonzo zenkqubo yofundo ngokukhuthaza iigqibo zenkqubo entsha nokulawula inqubo yokuqulunqa, ukuqonda izixhobo zamagqabi, izixhobo nento ezinye ezifunekayo, ukusasaza ii-LTSMS (izixhobo zokuFunda nokuFundisa) kumakhamphi onke. Kuqinisekiswa ukunikelwa kolwazi ngokuphucula okuqulethwe kwinkqubo yofundo nendlela eyinikwe ngayo ngokuxoxa ngabuchule phakathi koluntu kunye namarhwebo, ngokuhlalutya iziphumo kunye nokubonelela ngenkqubo yokungena ngezinye iindlela kwizifundo eziyimfuneko, iplani yokutshaya iindawo zokufunda nangokuphucula ukufundisa nokufunda ngokukhawuleza. Ukubonelela nokuqikelelwa nokuhlahlemba ngokwenziwa kweendibano zemisebenzi kubasebenzi bamabanga aphezulu.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Internal Audit and Quality Assurance
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.salary_text: R487 197 per annum (Level 09), plus actual benefits
jobs.summary: Assistant Director for Internal Audit and Quality Assurance at the Department of Higher Education and Training in Vryheid, requiring a degree and three to five years of audit experience.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate Bachelors’ Degree / National Diploma in Internal Audit / Accounting. A minimum three (3) to five (5) years’ functional experience in Internal Audit environment two (2) years of which should be at managerial or supervisory level. Experience in the development of policies / implementation strategies. Proven computer literacy – MS Office: Word, Excel and PowerPoint. Unendorsed valid driver’s licence. Recommendation: Registered member with professional body e,g. Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA). Understanding of TVET landscape. Knowledge: Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Public Service Regulations (PSR), Public Service Act (PSA), Auditor General Processes and Procedures and Promotion of Access to Information Act (PAIA). Skills: Risk Assessment, Negotiation, Presentation, Problem Solving, Planning and Organizing, Policy analysis and Development, Communication and interpersonal, Financial Management and Report writing.
jobs.duties: Preparation and execution of the internal audit Plan. Conduct pre-engagement meetings with college management prior to commencement of the audits. Obtain College Management approval of the audit scope -prior to commencements of the internal audits. Planning and drafting of detailed audit procedures for audits per the approved annual audit plan. Executing and performing of audit testing per annual audit plan. Establish a quality audit risk management function and monitor assessments to ensure compliance with formal systems. Conduct schedules and reactivates audits and inspections and produce reports on all audits, inspections and incidents. Provision of the secretarial support services to the Audit Committee. Conduct research on best practices and application of standards. Distribution and collection of audit clients’ surveys for service rendered. Ensure that legislation and acts are implemented correctly in the college. Ensure that all audit findings are supported by required audit evidence. Ensure that processes needed for quality management systems are established, implemented and maintained. Develop quality management system policies and procedures for the college. Report to college management on the performance of the QMS and the need for improvement. Ensure the promotion of awareness of customer requirements throughout the college. Provide information and reports to the executive and committees to make final decisions. Liaise with external assessment body on all matters related to the external accreditation process. Ensure that all suppliers used by the college are selected, re-evaluated and that records of this assessment are maintained. Oversee the development, implementation and monitoring of policies. Conduct institutional performance assessment and evaluation of the implementation of policies, programs and systems Management of staff development.
