af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Interne Oudit en Kwaliteitsversekering
af.summary: Assistentdirekteur vir Interne Oudit en Kwaliteitsversekering by die Department of Higher Education and Training in Vryheid, wat 'n graad en drie tot vyf jaar se ouditeringservaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike Bachelorsgraad / Nasionale Diploma in Interne Oudit / Rekeningkunde. 'n Minimum van drie (3) tot vyf (5) jaar se funksionele ervaring in 'n Interne Oudit-omgewing waarvan twee (2) jaar op bestuurlike of toesighoudende vlak moet wees. Ervaring in die ontwikkeling van beleide / implementeringsstrategieë. Bewese rekenaarvaardigheid – MS Office: Word, Excel en PowerPoint. Ongetekende geldige bestuurderslisensie. Aanbeveling: Geregistreerde lid van 'n professionele liggaam, bv. Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA). Begrip van die TVET-landskap. Kennis: Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Public Service Regulations (PSR), Public Service Act (PSA), Auditor General Processes and Procedures en Promotion of Access to Information Act (PAIA). Vaardighede: Risikobevalging, Onderhandeling, Voorlegging, Probleemoplossing, Beplanning en Organisering, Beleidsontleding en -ontwikkeling, Kommunikasie en interpersoonlike vaardighede, Finansiële Bestuur en Verslagdoening.
af.duties: Voorbereiding en uitvoering van die interne ouditeerplan. Voer vooraf-vergaderings met die kollegebestuur voor die aanvang van die oudite. Verkry kollegebestuur se goedkeuring van die oudit-omvang voor die aanvang van die interne oudite. Beplanning en opstel van gedetailleerde ouditprosedures vir oudite volgens die goedgekeurde jaarlikse ouditplan. Uitvoering en verrigting van oudittoetsing volgens die jaarlikse ouditplan. Stel 'n kwaliteitsoudit-risikobestuurfunksie in en monitor assesserings om nakoming van formele stelsels te verseker. Voer skeduleerde en gereaktiveerde oudite en inspeksies uit en produseer verslae oor alle oudite, inspeksies en voorvalle. Verskaffing van sekretariële ondersteuningsdienste aan die Ouditekomitee. Doen navorsing oor beste praktyke en toepassing van standaarde. Verspreiding en insameling van ouditkliënte se opnames vir gelewerde dienste. Verseker dat wetgewing en wette korrek in die kollege geïmplementeer word. Verseker dat alle ouditbevindings deur die vereiste ouditbewyse ondersteun word. Verseker dat prosesse wat vir kwaliteitsbestuurstelsels nodig is, gevestig, geïmplementeer en in stand gehou word. Ontwikkel kwaliteitsbestuurstelsel-beleide en -prosedures vir die kollege. Rapporteer aan kollegebestuur oor die prestasie van die KBS en die behoefte aan verbetering. Verseker die bevordering van bewustheid van kliëntevereistes dwarsdeur die kollege. Verskaf inligting en verslae aan die uitvoerende beamptes en komitees om finale besluite te neem. Skakel met die eksterne assesseringsliggaam oor alle aangeleenthede wat verband hou met die eksterne akkreditasieproses. Verseker dat alle verskaffers wat deur die kollege gebruik word, geselekteer, herevalueer word en dat rekords van hierdie assessering gehou word. Hou toesig oor die ontwikkeling, implementering en monitering van beleide. Voer instellingprestasie-assessering en evaluering van die implementering van beleide, programme en stelsels uit. Bestuur van personeelontwikkeling.

zu.title: Umnikazi Wezikhundla: Ukuhlola Ngaphakathi Neqiniso Lokwenza
zu.summary: Umnikazi Wezikhundla wokuHlola Ngaphakathi Neqiniso Lokwenza eDepartment of Higher Education and Training eVryheid, ofuna idiploma yesiqu n eminyaka yisithupha kuya kwesihlanu yohlelo lokuhlola.
zu.requirements: Idiploma yesiqu efanelekile / National Diploma kokuHlola Ngaphakathi / i-Accounting. Ukuze kuthathwe isikhundla kuyadingeka abe nobuchule obungu-(3) kuya kwangu-(5) emsebenzini wokuHlola Ngaphakathi, kanti eminyaka yayo (2) kumele ibe ngabalawuli noma abaphathi. Ukuze kuthathwe isikhundla kuyadingeka abe nobuchule bokwakhiwa kwezinqumo / amasu okusebenzisa. Abantu abafuna ukuthatha isikhundla kumele bakwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha – MS Office: Word, Excel kanye ne-PowerPoint. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile ehhoxwa abantu. Okunconywayo: ibe lilungu elibhalisiwe komhlangano wemisebenzi, njll. Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA). Ukuqonda ukuthi yiTVET landscape kanjani. Ulwazi: Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Public Service Regulations (PSR), Public Service Act (PSA), i-Auditor General Processes and Procedures kanye ne-Promotion of Access to Information Act (PAIA). Amandla: Ukulinganisa ingozi, ukuxoxisana, okokubonisa, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuhlela nokuqamba, ukuhlaziya nokwakhiwa kwezinqumo, ukuxhumana nobuntu, ukuLawula imali nokubhala imibiko.
zu.duties: Ukuhlela nokuphefumulelwa kohlolo lwangaphakathi. Ukuqoba izinkulumo phambi kokuqala ukuhlola nokubeka izinqumo kubaphathi bekolishi. Ukuthola ukuvunyelwa kwabaphathi bekholishi bokuqamba ukuhlola - ngaphambi kokuqala ukuhlola ngaphakathi. Ukuhlela nokubhala izindlela zokuHlola ngeminingciphe eQinisekisiwe ngohlelo lwangaphakathi. Ukwenza kwaye kwenziwe ukuHlola ngohlelo lwangaphakathi. Ukumisa isikhungo sokuLawula ingozi yokuHlola iqiniso futhi kugawule ukulinganisa ukuze kuQinisekiswe ngemithetho. UkuHlola kokushediswa kabusha kwezimoto kanye nokubika ngazo zonke izinto eziHlolwayo. Ukunika abeluleki bomhlangano wokuHlola. Ukwenza ucwaningo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Ukuba nokwazi ngokwezidingo zabathengi. UkuQinisekisa ukuthi imithetho yasekolishi iyasetshenziswa. UkuQinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinto eziHlolwayo zinokwesekwa. UkuQinisekisa imithetho yekolishi. Ukwenza imibiko ngokuSebenza kwaye kudingeka ukuthuthwa. UkuQinisekisa ukuthi konke ukudluliselwa kwamatholwa. Ukusebenzisa imithetho ngokufanele. Ukuphathwa kokuthutha abasebenzi.

xh.title: Isekela-Jongenosiba: Ukuqinisekiswa kwangaphakathi kweVeki nokuQinisekisa iNgcwalisa
xh.summary: Isekela-Jongenosiba lokuQinisekiswa kwangaphakathi kweVeki nokuQinisekisa iNgcwalisa kwisebe leMfundo ePhakamileyo nokuQeqesha eVryheid, lifuna isidanga kunye neminyaka esi-3 ukuya kwesi-5 yamava alolu hlobo lokuqinisekisa.
xh.requirements: Isidanga esifanelekileyo seBachelors / iNational Diploma kukuQinisekiswa kwangaphakathi / ukuBala. Uphelelo lweminyaka esi-3 (3) ukuya kwesi-5 (5) yamava asebenzayo ukwimojula yokuQinisekiswa kwangaphakathi apho kweminyaka mibini (2) kufuneka ibe kwinqanaba lobaphathi okanye babaphathi. Amava ekwakheni iindulamthetho / iindlela zokuzezelwa. Ukuqinisekiswa kokusebenza ngekompyutha – iMS Office: iWord, iExcel nePowerPoint. ilayisenisi yokuqhuba esemthethweni engazange igaxwe. Inkomiso: Lilungu elibhalisiweyo kumthambo wezangcali mhlawumbi iInstitute of Internal Auditors (IIA). Ukuqonda i-TVET landscape. Ulwazi: iPublic Finance Management Act (PFMA), iPublic Service Regulations (PSR), iPublic Service Act (PSA), iinkqubo neendlela zeAuditor General kunye nePromotion of Access to Information Act (PAIA). Amandla: ukuLinganisa iingozi, ukuNxaxhiselana, iPresentation, ukuSombulula iingxaki, ukuCwangcisa nokuHlela, ukuHlalutya nokuYila iindulamthetho, ukuThethathuthi nokuHamba ngqo nabantu, ukuLawula imali nokubhala iingxelo.
xh.duties: Ukuqokelela nokuzezelwa kwecwecwe lokuqinisekiswa kwangaphakathi. Ukuqhuba iindibano zakuqala nomphathi webhetya phambi kokuqalisa ukuqinisekisa. Ukufumana isigunyaziso somphathi webhetya sokuba ngakanani na ukugqithisa ukuqinisekisa -phambi kokuqalisa ukuqinisekisa kwangaphakathi. Ukuqokelela nokubhala iindulamthetho ezicatshulwayo zokuqinisekisa ngokwecwecwe elivunyiweyo lonyaka. Ukuzezelwa nokuzeza ukuqinisekisa ngokwecwecwe lonyaka. Ukuqumba inkqubo yokulawula iingozi zekhwalithi yokuqinisekisa ukwathatha iingqinisekiso qho ukunyanzelekiswa kweenkqubo ezisemthethweni. Ukuhlela iinkqubo zokuqinisekisa, ukuzibuyela emva kwezokunyukwisa iingqinisekiso, ukubhala iingxelo nazo zonke iingqinisekiso, ukuqhutywa iingqinisekiso kunye neziganeko. Ukubonelela ngenkonzo yocalulo kwiKomiti yokuQinisekisa. Ukuqonda iindlela ezilungileyo nezazisi zeziseko kwingcali. Ukusasaza nokuqokelela iisurveji zabathengi bakuqinisekiswa malunga nenkonzo ebonelelweyo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba iMigqabo neemiThetho yamanyundwala isetyenziswa kakuhle kwibhetya. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba zonke iintshebe zokuqinisekisa zixhaswa zifumane izibonelelo ezifunekayo zokuqinisekisa. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba inkqubo efunekayo ukuze kugcinwe isixokelelwano sekhwalithi siqunjwe, sibekwe usetyenziso kwaye sigcinwe. Ukuyila iindulamthetho neendulamthetho zesixokelelwano sekhwalithi kwibhetya. Ukubhala iingxelo kubaphathi webhetya malunga namandla okusebenza koQoqosho iNgcwalisa nemfuno yokuyinyukusa. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba zidanyazwe izibonelelo zabathengi kuyo yonke ibhetya. Ukubonelela ngolwazi nongxelo kubaphathi nakwiikomiti ukuze bathathe iigqibo. Ukunxibelelana nolunye uLwazi wokulinganiselwa lusemthethweni malunga nobunye buLoncedo ngaphandle. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba bonke abazincwadi abasetyenziswa yibhetya bakhethwa, baphinda bahlalutya nokuqinisekisa ukuba izazisi ezibhaliweyo zalo nkoliso zigcinwe. Ukuphatha ukwandiswa kweendulamthetho, ukuzezelwa nokulawulwa kweendulamthetho. Ukuqhutywa iisaziso seNgcwalisa kunye noncedo lweyure ukwaziswa kweekhalendi nalwazi lwabashicileli. Ukubhala iingxelo zangaphakathi ngokuvunyelwa kweenkalo ezahlukeneyo ezikwibhetya.

Finansiële rekenkundige prosedures, metodes en beginsels wat vir die verwerking van spesifieke salaris-/finansiële transaksies vasgestel is. Kennis van Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Treasury Regulations, National Treasury Asset Management Framework, General Recognised Accounting Practice (GRAP). Kennis van finansiële bedryfstelsels (PERSAL, BAS, LOGIS, COLTECH, SAGE, ens.). Vaardighede: Rekenaarvaardighede, beplanning en organisering, goeie mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasie, basiese syfervaardighede, vermoë om roetine-take uit te voer, vermoë om kantoortoerusting te bedryf, buigsaamheid, interpersoonlike verhoudings, akkuraatheid. Waardes/eienskappe: Kliëntediensfokus, integriteit, toegewyd, proaktief, lojaal.
af.duties: Voer bateverifikasie uit vir eie en gehuurde bates. Gereelde bywerking van die bateregister en huurregister. Voorsien nuutverkrygde bates van strepieskodes. Vereffening van die geverifieerde bates teen die bateregister. Vereffen die bate-uitgawes teen die bateregister. Onderhou die register vir nuwe bate-toevoegings. Werk die huurregister by met nuut afgesluite of verlengde kontrakte. Fasiliteer die beskikking van onbruikbare, oortollige, verouderde en verlore bates. Onderhou 'n register vir alle verlore bates ondersteun deur tersaaklike ondersteunende dokumente. Bystand met die oplossing van ouditnavrae en verseker volledigheid en akkuraatheid van die bateregister. Bystand met navrae rakende gehuurde bates en beskikking. Verseker die voorsiening van uitgawes en algemene betalingsdienste. Verseker kontant- en inkomstebestuursdienste. Verseker die voorsiening van bate-aanspreeklikheid en skuldbestuur. Verseker die voorsiening van boekhou- en finansiële rekenkundige dienste. Bestuur van die vaste bateregisters.

zu.title: I-State Accountant Ephakeme: UkuBala Kwezimali
zu.summary: Kudingeka i-state accountant Ephakeme eNdiweni Elikhulu eVryheid ukuphatha ukuqinisekiswa kwempahla, ukubhaliswa kwempahla nama-lease, kanye nokuhambisanisa impahla ngaphakathi kweNyuvesi yamabanga aphezulu kanye nokuQeqesha.
zu.requirements: I-Bachelors' degree / National Diploma efanele kokuBala Kwezimali / ezokuLawula Izimali / ukuHlola Ngaphakathi / ukuBala Kwezindleko NokuLawula (NQF Level 6). Umbhalo ongaphansi kweminyaka engu-3 - 5 yokuqashwa okuyiminyaka yamabili (2) okumele ibe ngazinga lokubeka phansi endaweni yokuLawula izimali. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yezimali, izindlela kanye namandla okufaka idatha, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuhlela izibalo zezimali. Inqubo yekhadi lezimali, izindlela nezinhlelo ezisunguliwe ekucubunguleni utholakalo oluthize lweholo/ezomsebenzi wezimali. Ulwazi ngomthetho we-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), izimiso ze-Treasury, Isikhathi Esibekiwe Somngcwango Wempahla Kuzwelonke, i-General Recognised Accounting Practice (GRAP). Ulwazi ngezinhlela ezisebenza ngamaphayiphini ezimali (PERSAL, BAS, LOGIS, COLTECH, SAGE, etc.). Amakhono: Amakhono ekhompyutha, ukulungelela ukuhlela nokuqamba, ukuxhumana kalula ngokukhulunywa kanye nokubhaliwayo, izibalo ezisisiseko, amandla okwenza imisebenzi evamile, amandla okusebenzisa izinto zethuluzi lokusebenza ekhaya, ukuguquka, izinhlelo zokubambana nabantu, ukwenza ngokuchanekileyo. Amaxabiso/izinto ezibonwayo: ukugxila emsebenzini womthengi, inkinga, ukuzibophezela, ukwenza ngaphambi kwesikhathi, ukuzigcina.
zu.duties: Yenza ukuqinisekiswa kwempahla yempahla ebhalisiweyo nethile e-rantiselwa. Ukuvuselela ngokuvamile isibuko sempahla nami hegelo yohlelo lokuqashisa. Hloma ikhodi yempahla ethathwe entsha. Ukubuyisela ndawonye impahla eqinisekisiweyo mayelana nemiqulu yohlelo lokuqashisa. Vuselela isibuko semali e-hukuliswe ngempahla ehambisana nemiqulu yempahla. Gcina umqulu wokuqhagamshelwa kwempahla entsha. Vuselela i-Lease Ledger ngeminwezo entsha noma ebe saziqalelwe inkinga. Khuthaza ukuqashiswa kwempahla engayi nzuzo, e-hlala noma ibikwa noma ilahlekileyo. Gcina umqulu wazo yonke impahla elahlekileyo ohiqwe ngamaphepha okuqinisekisa. Siza ekugcwaliseni imibuzo yokuhlolwa ukuze uqinisekis ukuba lona ngamaphepha nokubekiweyo imiqulu yempahla. Siza nangemibuzo mayelana nokuphela kwempahla eqashiswe nokuhamba kwamaphuzu. Qinisekisa ngamaphuzu amaningi mayelana nemali yokuhlawula nemikhakha yokwenza imisebenzi. Siza ekubhukuthweni kokuqinisekiswa kwemali ngesikhathi esifanele nakuqhagamshelweni nendlela yokwenza imiholo. Siza ekuphathweni kwamaphepha anezinto eziyimfuneko noma eziyimfuneko ngokupheleleyo kwemali yokuphathwa kwesikhwama sendawo. Bukela imali etfolwe kwaye igcinwe ngokupheleleyo ngokusemthethweni. Bukela imali esebenzisekayo nokuhlawulwa ngokubanzi. Qinisekisa ukubonelela ngenkonzo yezimali. Bukela imali ehlawulekwayo ngokugqithiseleyo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukubhalwa kwemali eqokiweyo kwisakhethi ngokubanzi.

xh.title: Mongameli Wesebe Lelizwe: I-Akhawunti Yezimali
xh.summary: Kufuneka igcinwe mongameli wesebe lelizwe kwi-Ofisi Ephakathi e-Vryheid ukuze alawule ukuqinisekiswa kweempahla, irejista yamafa kunye namasha, nokulinganiswa kweempahla ngaphakathi kwisebe i-Department of Higher Education and Training.
xh.requirements: I-degree ye-Bachelors esifanelekileyo / i-National Diploma kwi-Akhawunti Yezimali/ Ukulawula Izimali/ Ukuhlola Ngaphakathi/ Ikhawunti Yexabiso Nokulawula (NQF Level 6). Amava amabalala angu-3 - 5 eminyaka apho emnyaka mibini (2) kufuneka ibe kwinqanaba lokulawula kwindawo yolawulo lwezimali. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yezimali, iinkqubo kunye nokuqonda ukwazi ukubhala idatha, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuqokelela izibalo zezimali. Iinkqubo, iindlela neemigaqo ye-akhawunti yezimali ezisikiweyo ngokucacileyo ekuqwalaselweni kweziguqo ezithile zemvuzo/ezezimali. Ulwazi nge-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), iimigaqo zeTreasury, i-National Treasury Asset Management Framework, i-General Recognised Accounting Practice (GRAP). Ulwazi ngeenkqubo zokusebenza ngezimali (PERSAL, BAS, LOGIS, COLTECH, SAGE, njl.). Ikhono: Ikhono lekhompyutha, ukucwangcisa nokuhlela, ukunxibelelana ngemlomo nangokubhalwa, izibalo ezisisiseko, ikhono lokwenza imisebenzi yemihla ngemihla, ikhono lokusebenzisa izixhobo zefesile, ukuguquguquka, uqhagamshelwano nabantu, ukuchaneka. Imaxabiso/okubalulekileyo: Ukugxila kwindlela yokukhonza abathengi, ukuzithembisa, ukuqinisekisa, ukuba nobuchule, ukuthembeka.
xh.duties: Ukuqhuba ukuqinisekiswa kweempahla zamafa abanawo nakwezoqeshwayo. Ukuhlaziya rhoqo irejista ye-mpahla kunye nerejista yamaqesho. Ukubhala i-barcode kwiimpahla ezizutsha. Ukuqwalasela ulingano lwe-mpahla eqinisekisiweyo nerejista ye-mpahla. Ukuqwalasela ukuchithwa kwemali yempahla nerejista yeempahla. Ukugcina irejista yezongezo ezintsha zeempahla. Ukuhlaziya irejista yamaqesho ngesivumelwano esisha esiphethweyo okanye esandisiweyo. Ukwenza lula ukulahla iimpahla ezingasebenzayo, ezingafunekiyo, ezindala kwaye ezilahlekileyo. Ukugcina irejista yazo zonke iimpahla ezilahlekileyo ezixhaswa ngamaxwebhu axhaso afanelekileyo. Ukuncedisa ekusombululeni imibuzo yokuhlola nokufezekisa ukubakho nokuchaneka korejista yimpahla. Ukuncedisa ngeempahla eziqeshiweyo & imibuzo enxulumene nokulahla. Ukuqinisekisa ukubonelelwa kweenkonzo zokuqwalasela ukuchithwa kwemali nentlawulo jikelele. Ukuqinisekisa iinkonzo zolawulo lwemali ngenxwalo emzimleni. Ukuqinisekisa ukubonelelwa kweenkonzo zolawulo lwe-mpahla kule ntlobo yetyala elikwingozi. Ukuqinisekisa ukubonelelwa kweenkonzo zokubhala iibhuku ngenkqubo kwaye nge-akhawunti yezimali. Ukulawula iirejista zeempahla ezisisigxina.

jobs.title: Chief Personnel Officer: Human Resource Management and
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.salary_text: R413 001 per annum (Level 08), plus actual benefits
jobs.summary: Supervise conditions of service and remuneration administration, including pensions, housing allowances and leave, at the Department of Higher Education and Training in Vryheid.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate Bachelors’ degree/National Diploma in Human Resource Management. A minimum of three (3) to five (5) years’ functional experience within human resources environment two (2) years of which should be at salary level 7. Sound knowledge of PERSAL System. Understanding of legislative framework governing the Public Service. Storage and retrieval procedures in terms of the working environment. Unendorsed valid driver’s licence. Recommendation: Introduction to PERSAL Certificate. Skills: Planning and organising. Sound Verbal and written communication skills. Intermediate computer literacy – MS Office: Word, Excel and PowerPoint. Skills: Planning and organising. Flexibility, Customer care services, teamwork and report writing.
jobs.duties: Supervise and administer the implementation of conditions of service and remuneration of employees by administering Pension, Housing Allowance and Long Service benefits etc. Ensuring that new employees complete assumptions duty forms. Administering employee leave. Ensure that staff files are maintained electronically. Administering all termination requests. Administering the payroll for all employees and deal with all administrative queries related to pension and medical aid. Submitting reports to management as required so that they are informed of HR related matters and can make informed decisions. Supervising and administering recruitment and selection by receiving requests for advertisement of vacant posts in the college. Developing a recruitment plan. Preparing advertisements and obtain approval to advertise posts in line with the delegations. Advertising all vacancies in line with delegations. Coordinating shortlisting and interviews. Ensuring all logistical arrangement for shortlisting and interviews are prepared on time (arrangements of interview dates, venues and invitations to panel members and candidates). Facilitating the verification of qualifications for all recommended candidates. Compiling submission for approval to appoint the suitable candidates in line with the delegations. Facilitating the appointments and placement. Administering recruitment database. Manage records for the college by developing, reviewing and ensuring implementation of records management processes and systems. Administering the opening, archiving, closing and filing of files for new and existing employees. Ensuring the updating of personnel files. Ensuring safekeeping of Human Resource records. Administering all records required for auditing purposes. Ensuring disposal of files in terms of the applicable legislations and approved college policy. Administering all incoming and outgoing mail. Administering register of file index on filing system.
jobs.enquiries: Mr SC Hadebe/ Mr S Zulu / Mr LK Mthethwa/ Ms GL Sikhosana Tel No: (034) 980 1010
jobs.applications: Email Address: Corporate.Applications@mthashana.edu.za
jobs.notes: All attachments must include an application form Z83 and CV only combined, in PDF and as one attachment. Zipped, IMG and JPEG documents will not be accepted. Indicate the correct job tittle and the reference number of the post on the subject line of your email. Use the correct email address associated with the post. Failure to do so will result in your application being disqualified. Applications quoting the relevant reference number must be submitted on the new Z83 form, obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.gov.za/documents. Received applications using incorrect application for employment (old Z83) will not be considered. Each post(s) advert must be accompanied by its own application form for employment and must be fully completed, initialled and signed by the applicant as instructed below. Failure to fully complete, initial and sign the Z83 form will lead to disqualification of the application during the selection process. All fields of Section A, B, C and D of the Z83 must be completed in full. Section E, F, G (Due to the limited space on the Z83 it is acceptable for applicants to indicate refer to CV or see attached. However, the question related to conditions that prevent re-appointment under Part “F” must be answered and declaration signed. Only an updated comprehensive CV (with detailed previous experience if any) and a completed and signed new Z83 application form is required. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit copies of qualifications and other related documents on or before the day of the interview following the communication from Human Resources and such qualification(s) and other related documents will be in line with the requirements of the advertisement. Non-RSA Citizens/ Permanent Resident Permit holders in possession of foreign qualifications must be accompanied by an evaluation report issued by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) (only when shortlisted). The College does not accept hand delivered applications. Applications who do not comply with the abovementioned instructions/ requirements, as well as applications received late will not be considered. Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the candidate not being considered. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. If you have not been contacted within eight (8) weeks after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Suitable candidates will be subjected to a personnel suitability check (criminal record, citizenship, credit records checks, qualification(s) verification and employment verification). Please note that by responding to this advertisement, you consent to the collection, processing, and storing of your Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA). Your information will be used solely for the purpose of this promotion and will not be shared with third parties without prior written consent unless required by law. The college reserves the right not to make any appointment(s) to the below advertised post(s). The successful candidate will be expected to sign a performance agreement. The College is an equal opportunity affirmative action employer. The Employment Equity Plan of the Department shall inform the employment decision. It is the College's intention to promote equity in terms of race, gender and disability, through the filling of this post(s)

af.title: Hoofpersoneelbeampte: Menslike Hulpbronbestuur en
af.summary: Ouloer toezig op diensvoorwaardes en vergoedingsadministrasie, insluitend pensioene, behuisingstoelaes en verlof, by die Departement van Higher Education and Training in Vryheid.
af.requirements: 'n Geskikte Bachelors-graad/Nasionale Diploma in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur. 'n Minimum van drie (3) tot vyf (5) jaar se funksionele ervaring binne 'n menslike hulpbronne-omgewing waarvan twee (2) jaar op salary level 7 moet wees. Deeglike kennis van die PERSAL-stelsel. Begrip van die wetgewende raamwerk wat die Public Service regeer. Berging en onttrekking van prosedures in terme van die werksomgewing. Ongeëndorsede geldige bestuurderslisensie. Aanbeveling: Inleiding tot PERSAL-sertifikaat. Vaardighede: Beplanning en organise. Deeglike mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Tussengemiddelde rekenaarvaardigheid – MS Office: Word, Excel en PowerPoint. Vaardighede: Beplanning en organise. Buigsaamheid, kliëntesorgdienste, spanwerk en verslagdoening.
af.duties: Ouloer toezig op en administreer die implementering van diensvoorwaardes en vergoeding van werknemers deur Pensioen, Behuisingstoelaag en Langdiensvoordele ens. te administreer. Verseker dat nuwe werknemers aanvaarding van diensvorms invul. Administreer werknemerverlof. Verseker dat personeellêers elektronies gehou word. Administreer alle beëindigingsversoeke. Administreer die salarystrook vir alle werknemers en hanteer alle administratiewe navrae wat verband hou met pensioen en mediese hulp. Dien verslae aan bestuur in soos vereis sodat hulle ingelig is oor HR-verwante aangeleenthede en ingeligte besluite kan neem. Ouloer toezig op en administreer werwing en seleksie deur versoeke te ontvang vir advertensie van vakante poste by die kollege. Ontwikkel 'n werwingsplan. Berei advertensies voor en verkry goedkeuring om poste te adverteer in ooreenstemming met die delegasies. Adverteer alle vakatures in ooreenstemming met delegasies. Koördineer kortlyste en onderhoude. Verseker dat alle logistieke reëlings vir kortlys en onderhoude betyds voorberei word (reëlings van onderhouddatums, plekke en uitnodigings aan paneellede en kandidate). Fasiliteer die verifikasie van kwalifikasies vir alle aanbevole kandidate. Stel voorlegging op vir goedkeuring om die geskikte kandidate aan te stel in ooreenstemming met die delegasies. Fasiliteer die aanstellings en plasing. Administreer werwingsdatabasis. Bestuur rekords vir die kollege deur die ontwikkeling, hersiening en versekering van implementering van rekordbestuursprosesse en stelsels. Administreer die opening, argivering, sluiting en indien van lêers vir nuwe en bestaande werknemers. Verseker die opdatering van personeellêers. Verseker die veilige bewaring van Menslike Hulpbronrekords. Administreer alle rekords wat vir ouditsdoeleindes vereis word. Verseker die wegdoen van lêers in terme van die toepaslike wetgewing en goedgekeurde kollegebeleid. Administreer alle inkomende en uitgaande pos. Administereer register van lêerindeks op indienstelsel.

zu.title: Inkantshala Eyinhloko Yabasebenzi: Ukuphathwa Kwabantu Abasebenzayo
zu.summary: Qapha izimo zesevisi nokuphathwa kweholo, okuhlanganisa ngemivuzo, izimali zokuhlala ezinikelwa abasebenzi nokuphumula, esikhundleni esithi Department of Higher Education and Training e-Vryheid.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-Bachelors’/National Diploma ezifanele kokuqashwa kwabantu. Okungenani iminyaka eyisithuphu (6) kuya kwayisishiyagalombili (8) yeminyaka yokuqashwa kwabantu, okuyisithupha (6) kuyo kufanele kube ngizinga lesikhombisa (7) eholo. Ukuqonda okuhle mayelana nesistimu ye-PERSAL. Ukuqonda umthethosisekelo ohlongoza isevisi yomphakathi. Izindlela zokugcina nokukhipha okushaya inkalo ngokwesimo sokusebenza. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekwe kangangale minyaka yonke ngaphandle kokuphika. Isincoma: Isitifikedi sokwaziswa nge-PERSAL. Amakhono: Ukucubungula nokuhlela. Amakhono okuxoxa nokubhala kahle. Ulwazi oluphakathi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha – i-MS Office: Word, Excel kanye ne-PowerPoint. Amakhono: Ukucubungula nokuhlela. Ukuguquguquka, ukunakekelwa kwayikhasimodi, ukusebenza njengeqembu kanye nokubhala imibiko.
zu.duties: Qapha uphinde ulawule ukusetshenziswa kwezimo zesevisi neholo labasebenzi ngokuphatha Umvuzo wokuphumula, isibonezelo sokuthenga indlu kanye nezinikezelo ezinjengokuqashwa isikhathi eside njll. Qinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi abasha bagcwalisa amafomu okuqala ukusebenza. Ukuphatha ukuphumula kwabasebenzi. Qinisekisa ukuthi amafayela abasebenzi agcinwa ngesistimu yamakhompyutha. Ukuphatha wonke amasimu okuqeda ukusebenza. Ukuphatha ukukhokhelwa kweholo kubo bonke abasebenzi bese ubhekana nemibuzo yonke yezokuphathwa enamaqhinga okuphuma emvuzweni wokuphumula usizo lwamafakhalthi. Ukuhambisa imibiko ekuphathweni njengoba kudingwa ukuze bakwazi ukwazi ngemibuzo ehlobene nokuqashwa kwabantu bese bena izinqumo ezibonakalayo. Ukuqapha uphinde ulawule ukuqashwa nokukhethwa ngokuqasha izicelo zokumemeza izikhundla ezingenaluthokolweni. Ukuthuthukisa isu sokuqashwa. Ukulungisa imemezo bese uthola ukugunyazwa ukumemeza izikhundla ngokuhambisana namandla okugunyaza. Ukumemeza wonke amasimo anganalutho ngokuhambisana namandla okugunyaza. Ukulungisa uhlu lwabathunywe bahloliwe kanye nezinkinguxa zokubuzwa. Ukwenza uhlu lweqembu abathunywe ukulungiselela abahola abantu abadinga ukubuzwa bese bekhethwa ngokuhambisana nemigomo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinhlelo zokubeka izikhathi zokubuzwa abantu abadinga ukubuzwa zilungiselelwe ngokuhambisana kanye namalungu okubuzwa abantu abafuna ukusebenza. Ukwenza uhlu lwabafuna ukusebenza abahloliwe ukubuzwa ngokuhambisana nezinhlelo ezithile. Ukwenza isibopho sokuthumela izinhlelo zokubuzwa abantu kumalungu onke amaqembu. Ukuphatha izinhlelo zokubuzwa abantu njengoba imigomo ithi kufanele kubuzwe wonke umuntu ofuna ukusebenza. Ukulawula imibhalo yale kolishi ngokuthuthukisa, ukubuyeka futhi ukwenza kusebenze izinhlelo bese kugcinwa imibhalo yonke yalabo ababuzwa. Ukulungisa uhlu lwabafuna ukusebenza abaqediwe ngokuhambisana nemigomo yesikhundla. Ukubeka kuleso sikhundla wonke umuntu okhethiwe njengoba kudingwa imigomo ethile. Ukugcina isikhathi esithile ngokumisa isikhathi esithile sokubuzwa. Ukuphatha amaqembu abantu njengoba kudingwa imigomo ethile. Ukuphatha imithumelo yonke emzamweni wokuqasha noma wokukhupha ngemvume yomphakathi. Ukulawula amafayela wonke abafuna ukusebenza ngokugcina imigomo yesikhundla nokuthumela imibiko yonke kumalungu onke amaqembu.

xh.title: Isikhulu Esihamba Phambili Sezabasebenzi: Ulawulo Loluntu Olusebenzayo ne
xh.summary: Kulawula iimeko zomsebenzi nokulawula intlawulo, kuquuka imihlali, iimalana zendlu nokusiya, kwiSebe leMfundo ePhakamileyo nokuQeqesha eVryheid.
xh.requirements: I-degree ye-Bachelors efanelekileyo okanye i-National Diploma kwi-Human Resource Management. Amava afanelekileyo amathathu (3) ukuya kwisele (5) eminyaka yokusebenza kumo yamandla abantu, apho kweminyaka mibini (2) kufuneka ibe kwinqanaba lesixa 7. Ulwazi olucacileyo nge-PERSAL System. Ukuqonda kwezithintelo ezilawula iNkonzo yaMatumba. Iinkqubo zokugcina nokuphinda kufunyanwe ulwazi ngokwemo yomsebenzi. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba eyasebenzayo engenazigxobo. Iceliselo: Isatifikethi esithi Introduction to PERSAL. Amaphezulu okwenza umsebenzi: Uqwalaselo nokuhlelwa. Amakhono amabini athethwayo nendlela ephathwayo yokuthetha. Ulwazi olulinganiselweyo kumatshini e-Intermediate – MS Office: Word, Excel ne-PowerPoint. Amaphezulu okwenza umsebenzi: Uqwalaselo nokuhlelwa. Ukuguquguquka, iinkonzo zokukhathalela abakhobi, ukusebenza ngokubambisana nokubhala iingxelo.
xh.duties: Kulawula nokuphatha ukusebenza kweimeko zomsebenzi nentlawulo yabasebenzi ngokuphatha imihlali, iimalana zendlu neenzuzo ze-Long Service njl. Kuqinisekiswa ukuba basebenzi abatsha bagcwalise iifomu zokuqalisa umsebenzi. Ukulawula ukusiya kwabasebenzi. Kuqinisekiswa ukuba iifayile zomsebenzi zigcinwa ngokuqhubekayo kumatshini. Ukulawula zonke iicelo zokuvala isithuba. Ukulawula umvuzo wonke abasebenzi nokusingatha yonke imibuzo elawulwayo ehlotshaniswa nemihlali nenkonzo yezempilo. Kuthunyelwa iingxelo kubaphathi njengoko kufuneka ukuze bazi ngezindaba ezihlotshanwe namandla abantu bakwaye banokwenza izigqibo ezikumgangatho. Kulawula nokuphatha ukuzikhethela abantu nokubakhethe ngokwamkela iicelo zokutshintsha izikhululo zabasebenzi abangenabantu kuloo kholeji. Kuyilwa icebo lokuzikhethela abantu. Kulungiselelwa iindaba zokutshintsha kwaye kufunyaniswe isigqibo sokutshintsha ngokwemigaqo yokunika abanye amandla. Kutshintshwa zonke izikhululo ngokwemigaqo yokunika abanye amandla. Kuhlelwa ukulista abantu abafutshane nokuvula iindlela yokudlulisela. Kuqinisekiswa ukuba zonke izicwangciso zokuloga ngokulista abafutshane nokuqamba iindlela zilungele ngexesha (izicwangciso zemihla yokudlulisela iindlela, indawo neemvito kubakhuseli nakanjani). Kubangwa ukuqinisekiswa kwezati zabafundi zonke oonozakelayo abagqitywa ukuba bakhethwe. Kubhalwa izicelo zokuqinisekiswa ukuba bagqitywe ngokwemigaqo yokunika abanye amandla. Kwenziwa ukumiswa nokubekwa. Kugcinwa ulwazi kwikompyutha lwabo bonke abantu abakhethiweyo. Kulawulwa izithuba kule koleji ngokuyila, ukuhlola nokubaqinisekisa abasebenzi ngokwenza, ukuhlola nokusebenzisa iinkqubo zokulawula izithuba. Kulawulwa ukuvula, ukugcina,okuvala nokugcina iifayile zabasebenzi abatsha nalawo aselekhona. Kuqinisekiswa ukuba iifayile zabasebenzi zihlaziya. Kuqinisekiswa ukuba iifayile zabantu zigcinwe ngokukhuselekileyo. Kulawulwa zonke iifayile ezifunwa ngenjongo yokuqinisekisa. Kuqinisekiswa ukusetyenziswa kolwazi ngeemithetho ezikwalo nengqiqo yakololeji evunyiweyo. Kulawulwa yonke imifanekiso ephume kunye nethi ingena. Kugcinwa inani lefayile kwinkqubo yokugcina iifayile.

jobs.title: Senior Administration Officer (OHS)
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.summary: Senior Administration Officer for Occupational Health and Safety at the Department of Higher Education and Training central office, requiring a diploma in safety management and relevant experience.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 or equivalent; a National Diploma or Degree in Environmental Health/Occupational Hygiene/Safety Management or relevant qualification. Two (2) to Three (3) years relevant functional experience in Occupational Health and Safety, Policy implementation, Compensation for Occupational Injuries and Diseases Act; Occupational Health and Safety Act; Public Finances Management Act; Public Service Act and Regulations; Basic Conditions of Employment Act; Knowledge of research procedures and techniques; Knowledge of design principles; techniques and tools and an understanding of Government legislation. A valid driver’s license. Skills and Competencies: Computer literacy (Microsoft Office). Candidates should display good communication, liaison, Planning and decision-making skills.
jobs.duties: Conduct safety audits; Compile statistics of all Occupational Health and Safety related matters; Implement all SHERQ related activities and ensure proper integration of the EHWP framework and supporting SHERQ policies; Facilitate hazard and risk identification; Implementing risk mitigation and monitor Implementation of corrective measures to prevent occupational injuries/illness; Implementing and promoting ergonomics standard, fire prevention, safety evacuations procedures, standards of operation for medical surveillance and worker compensation; Champion investigation of incidents and monitor non- compliance pertaining to SHERQ policies, OHS legislation and report to relevant stakeholders. Assist with operational planning and identify objectives to further enhance and improve the SHERQ function within the department; Co-ordinate safety training and awareness programmes; Implement Occupational Health and Safety within the entire department; interpret and co- ordinate recommendations from external audits; reports. Develop quarterly reports on fatalities, serious injuries and all related issues described on the incidents reporting matrix; report all defects of OHS and Facilities to relevant managers and perform other administrative related duties.
jobs.applications: must be forwarded to: recruit@goldfieldstvet.edu.za
jobs.notes: goldfields college is an equal opportunity employer Please Note: A completed New Z83 form should be accompanied by a recently updated comprehensive CV (inclusive of three contactable referees and contact details). Shortlisted candidates will be requested to bring certified copies of their qualifications and identity document on the day of the interviews Please quote the relevant reference number of the post you are applying for. Candidates who apply for more than one post should complete a separate application form for each post. Applications received after the closing date as well as faxed or e-mailed applications will not be considered. shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a vetting process (criminal record, citizenship, credit record checks, qualification, and employment verification). All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment The College reserves the right not to make appointments, and correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. If you do not receive any response within three months after closing date of this advertisement, kindly accept that your application was unsuccessful. Note: All costs incurred due to your application and interviews will be at your own expense. Preference will be given to persons from designated groups, especially with regard to race, gender and disability.

af.title: Senior Administratiewe Beampte (OHS)
af.summary: Senior Administratiewe Beampte vir Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid by die Departement of Higher Education and Training se hoofkantoor, wat 'n diploma in veiligheidsbestuur en relevante ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Graad 12 of ekwivalent; 'n Nasionale Diploma of Graad in Omgewingsgesondheid/Beroepshigiëne/Veiligheidsbestuur of relevante kwalifikasie. Twee (2) tot Drie (3) jaar relevante funksionele ervaring in Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid, beleidstoepassing, Compensation for Occupational Injuries and Diseases Act; Occupational Health and Safety Act; Public Finances Management Act; Public Service Act and Regulations; Basic Conditions of Employment Act; Kennis van navorsingsprosedures en -tegnieke; Kennis van ontwerpsbeginsels; tegnieke en gereedskap en 'n begrip van Regeringswetgewing. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Vaardighede en Bevoegdhede: Rekenaarvaardigheid (Microsoft Office). Kandidate behoort goeie kommunikasie-, skakel-, beplannings- en besluitnemingsvaardighede te toon.
af.duties: Voer veiligheidsoudits uit; Stel statistieke op van alle Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid-verwante aangeleenthede; Implementeer alle SHERQ-verwante aktiwiteite en verseker behoorlike integrasie van die EHWP-raamwerk en ondersteunende SHERQ-beleide; Fasiliteer gevaar- en risiko-identifikasie; Implementering van risikobeperking en monitering van implementering van korrektiewe maatreëls om beroepsbeserings/siektes te voorkom; Implementering en bevordering van ergonomiese standaarde, brandvoorkoming, veiligheidsontruimingsprosedures, bedryfsstandaarde vir mediese waarneming en werkerskompensasie; Lei ondersoeke na voorvalle en moniter nie-nakoming ten opsigte van SHERQ-beleide, OHS-wetgewing en doen verslag aan relevante belanghebbendes. Bystand verleen met operasionele beplanning en identifisering van doelwitte om die SHERQ-funksie binne die departement verder te verbeter en te versterk; Koördineer veiligheidsopleiding en bewustheidsprogramme; Implementeer Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid binne die hele departement; interpreteer en koördineer aanbevelings van eksterne oudits; verslae. Stel kwartaalverslae op oor sterftes, ernstige beserings en alle verwante kwessies wat op die voorvalverslagmatriks beskryf word; rapporteer alle defekte van OHS en Fasiliteite aan bestuurders en verrig ander administratiewe verwante pligte.

zu.title: Umpezulu Womphathi Wokuphathwa Kwezinto (OHS)
zu.summary: Umpezulu Womphathi Wokuphathwa Kwezinto wezempilo nokuphepha ezikhungweni eziphakamileyo ze Department of Higher Education and Training, ofuna idiploma ekuphathweni kokuphepha namava ahambisanayo.
zu.requirements: Grade 12 noma okulinganayo; i-National Diploma noma i-Degree kwi-Environmental Health/Occupational Hygiene/Safety Management noma izifundo ezihambisanayo. Amava amabili (2) kuya kwayathathu (3) emisebenzini ephathelene nezempilo nokuphepha kwabasebenzi, ukusebenzisa izinqubomgomo, i-Compensation for Occupational Injuries and Diseases Act; i-Occupational Health and Safety Act; i-Public Finances Management Act; i-Public Service Act and Regulations; i-Basic Conditions of Employment Act; ulwazi ngezenzo nezindlela zocwaningo; ulwazi ngemigangatho yokwakha; izindlela nezixhobo nokuqonda ukwethula komthetho kahulumeni. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Amakhono namandla: Ukuba nakho ukusebenza ngamakhompyutha (Microsoft Office). Abafanelekileyo kufanele babonise ukuba nakho ukuxhumana, ukuxhumana ngokusemthethweni, ukucwangcisa nokuthatha izinqumo.
zu.duties: Qhuba ukuhlolwa kokuphepha; Qoqa izibalo zazo zonke izindaba eziphathelene nezempilo nokuphepha kwabasebenzi; Sebenzisa yonke imisebenzi ephathelene ne-SHERQ futhi qinisekisa ukudityaniswa okufanele kwesakhiwo se-EHWP kanye namapholisi asekelayo e-SHERQ; Siza ekuboniseni izingozi nengozi; Sebenzisa ukunciphisa ingozi futhi hlola ukusebenziswa kwezinyathelo zokulungisa ukuze kuthintelwe izengozi/izifo ezisebenzweni; Sebenzisa futhi khuthaza imigangatho yama-ergonomics, ukuthintela umlilo, izinqubo zokuqhumanisa ezokuphepha, imigangatho yokusebenza okubhekene nokuqashelwa kwesikhashana kwezokwelapha kanye nenhlawulezelo yomsebenzi; Qhuba ucwaningo lwezehlakalo futhi hlola ukungalaleli kumapholisi e-SHERQ, umthetho we-OHS bese ukubika kubandakanyekile abahlobene. Siza ngeplani yokusebenza futhi chaza izinhloso ukuze kuphushwe futhi kuthuthukiswe umsebenzi we-SHERQ ngaphakathi kumnyango; Hlanganisa izifundo zokuphepha namaphrogramu okwazisa; Sebenzisa izempilo nokuphepha kwabasebenzi kumnyango wonke; chaza futhi hlanganisa izincomo ezivela kokuqashelwa kwangaphandle; imibiko. Kwakha imibiko yenyanga zihlanu ngezinhlawulelo, izingozi ezinkulu kanye nazo zonke ezinye izindaba ezichazwe kumatriksi yokubika izehlakalo; bila zonke iziphazamiso ze-OHS kanye nezezimo zokwakha kubaphathi abahlobene futhi wenze eminye imisebenzi ephathelene nokuphathwa.

xh.title: Isebe lamaPhathi eMisebenzi yaBaphathi (OHS)
xh.summary: Isebe lamaPhathi eMisebenzi yaBaphathi loYakho lokuZinza kunye noKhuseleko kwiofisi engusentshenya yoMnyango weMfundo ePhakamileyo nokuQeqesha, lifuna idiploma ekulawulweni kokhuseleko kunye noluhlu lokugqitha.
xh.requirements: I-Garde 12 okanye efanayo; i-National Diploma okanye i-Degree eKwimpilo yeNdalo/i-Hygiene yoMsebenzi/iNkululeko yoKhuseleko okanye ngesi sthathu esifanelekileyo. Iiminyaka eziMbini (2) ukuya kweziThathu (3) yamava afanelekileyo kwimisebenzi ephathelene noYakho lokuZinza kunye noKhuseleko, ekusebenziseni iNkqubo yoLulwazi, iMthetho woRhoxiso oluvela kwiNkalakaxa kunye nesiCango soMsebenzi; uMthetho woYakho lokuZinza kunye noKhuseleko; uMthetho woLawulo lweMali kaRhulumente; uMthetho woMsebenzi kaRhulumente nemiQathango; uMthetho oBekela ngokusebenza okuqhelekileyo; ulwazi lweenkqubo nendlela zokuphand; ulwazi lwezimiso zokuyila; iindlela nezixhobo nokulonda ngokwemiThetho yoRhulumente. I-Layisensi yokushayela esebenzayo. Ikhono namakhono: ukusabela ngelikhompyutha (iMicrosoft Office). oMgangatho kufuneka abonise ukuba uyakwazi ukuzalathelana ngokulungileyo, noQeqesho, kwakhona iplani nokuThatha izigqibo.
xh.duties: Qeqesha isiqiniseko sokhuseleko; qokelela izibalo zonke iindaba ezinxulumene noYakho lokuZinza kunye noKhuseleko; zenza zonke iindaba ezinxulumene ne-SHERQ kuze kuqinisekiswe ukudityaniswa okulungileyo kweNkqubo ye-EHWP ngenkxaso ye-SHERQ; lungiselela ukuqaphelwa kweengozi nezithuba ezikhoyo; zenza iNkqubo yokunciphisa iingozi uze ulawule ukuSetyenziswa kweendlela zokulungisa ukuze kunqandwe iingozi ezivela kumsebenzi/ukurhawuzelelwa; yenza kwaye ukhuthaze iNkqubo yokuzinza ngokomzimba, ukuthintela iMlilo, iNkqubo yokuphuma ngokhuseleko, iNkqubo yokuQhuba imo yokwenziwa kokuqwalasela kokwamakholwa nokhutshelwa kwabasebenzi; phatha ukuphandwa kweengozi uze ulawule ukungahambelani nemiThetho ye-SHERQ, uMthetho we-OHIS uze uxele abantu abalulekileyo. Nceda ngokuCwangcisa imisebenzi yamanye amaqela kwaye uchaze izigqibo ukuze kwandiswe kwaye kulungiswe iNkqubo ye-SHERQ ngaphakathi kwesebe; lungiselela uQeqesho lokhuseleko kwaye wenze ulwazi ngenkqubo yokhuseleko; yenza uYakho lokuZinza kunye noKhuseleko kwesebe liphela; uchaze kwaye ulawule izindulo evela kumagunya angaphandle; iirepothi. Yaziya iirepothi zethatu kwiminyaka, ezizoni ezingozi kunye nazo zonke iindaba ezichazwe kwinkqubo yokurepotha iingozi; chaza zonke iziphoso ezikw-OHIS naseziko nakwiinkundla abaphathi abalawulayo kwaye wenze omnye umsebenzi ongundoqo wokulawula iNkqubo ye-SHERQ.

af.title: Senior Arbeidsbetrekkinge-beampte
af.summary: Hou toesig oor en implementeer arbeidsbetrekkingeprosesse, insluitend dissiplinêre sake, klagtes en geskilbeslegting by die sentrale kantoor van die Department of Higher Education and Training.
af.requirements: Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat/vlak 4 of gelykwaardig, Graad of Diploma (NQF Level 6), in Arbeidsbetrekkinge, Indienstnemingsbetrekkinge/Menslike Hulpbronbestuur of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie. Ten minste 3 jaar in 'n Arbeidsbetrekkinge- of Menslike Hulpbronbestuursomgewing of verwante veld. Moet rekenaarvaardig wees en 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie hê. Goeie mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede, insluitend voorleggings- en verslagdoeningsvaardighede. Vermoë om onder druk te werk, sperdatums te haal en vertroulikheid te handhaaf. Vermoë om onafhanklik en in 'n span te werk met goeie verslagdoeningsvaardighede. Bykomende voordele: PERSAL-sertifikaat, Kennis van Labour Relations Act, Openbare Dienswetgewing, Kennis van die implementering van PSCBC- en GPSSBC-resolusies Kennis en begrip van die bedingingsproses, klagte- en geskilbeslegtingsprosesse Deeglike kennis van Arbeidsbetrekkingewetgewing Deeglike kennis van die International Labour Organization (ILO) Kennis en begrip van die TVET/CET-administrasie Kennis en begrip van die hoër onderwyssektor.
af.duties: Die ampshouer sal verantwoordelik wees vir: Die versekering van algehele toesig en behoorlike implementering van arbeidsbetrekkingeriglyne en -prosesse. Verseker algehele toesig en behoorlike implementering van die oplossing van dissiplinêre sake, klagtes en geskilprosesse. Verseker algehele toesig en behoorlike implementering van wangedrag-sakeprosesse. Verseker algehele toesig en behoorlike implementering van kollektiewe bedinging en geskilbeslegting. Verseker algehele toesig en verteenwoordig die werkgewer en monitor die implementering van litigasie-uitsprake. Verseker algehele toesig en gesonde indienstnemingsbetrekkinge. Verseker algehele toesig en monitor PERSAL en databasis oor klagtes, geskille, wangedrag en kollektiewe bedinging.

zu.title: Umphathi Ohleziwe Wezabasebenzi
zu.summary: Qondisa futhi usebenzise izinqubo zezomthetho zabasebenzi okuhlanganisa icala lokuhlukumezwa, izikhalazo kanye nokuxazulula izingxabano ehhovisi elikhulu loMnyango weMfundo ePhakeme nokuQeqesha.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi samabanga aphakeme senazzwe/level 4 noma okulinganayo, I-Digri noma i-Diploma (NQF Level 6), kwezomthetho zabasebenzi, Ezingxabano zabasebenzi/IsiNdaba Sobuqu noma iziqu ezilinganayo. Okungenani eminyakeni engu-3 kwezomthetho zabasebenzi noma kwindawo yoNakekelwe Lobuqu noma enkundleni ephathelene nokho. Kumele ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha futhi ube nelayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Amakhono amahle okukhuluma nokubhala, okuhlanganisa amakhono okwenza izinkombiso nokubhala imibiko. Ikono lokusebenza ngaphansi koxinzelelo, ukuhambisa izinhlelo ngosuku kanye nokugcina imfihlo. Ikono lokusebenza kodwa nakwethimba ngamakhono amahle okubhala imibiko. Izinzuzo ezingeziwe: Isitifiketi se-PERSAL, ulwazi ngomthetho wezomthetho zabasebenzi, umthetho wesevisi yomphakathi, ulwazi lokusebenzisa izinqumo ze-PSCBC kanye neze-GPSSBC Ulwazi nokuqonda inqubo yoxhumo ngezinkulumo, izikhalazo kanye nokuqonda inqubo yokuxazulula izingxabano Ulwazi oluhle ngemithetho ezohlobene nezomthetho zabasebenzi Ulwazi oluhle nge-International Labour Organization (ILO) Ulwazi nokuqonda i-TVET/ Administration ye-CET Ulwazi nokuqonda inkundla yoMfundo ePhakeme.
zu.duties: Owayeqokwayo uzobe unobuhlakule ekulandeleni: ukuqinisekisa ukulawula okuphelele kanye nokusetshenziswa okulungile kwemiyalo kanye nezinqubo zezomthetho zabasebenzi. Qinisekisa ukulawula okuphelele nokusetshenziswa okulungile ekuxazululeni icala lokuhlukumezwa, izikhalazo kanye nokuqonda izinqubo zokuqala icala. Qinisekisa ukulawula okuphelele nokusetshenziswa okulungile kwezinqubo zocala lokwenza okungalungile. Qinisekisa ukulawula okuphelele nokusetshenziswa okulungile koxhumo ngezinkulumo kanye nokuxazulula izingxabano. Qinisekisa ukulawula okuphelele futhi umele umqashi ulawule nokusetshenziswa kwezinhlaya zemithetho. Qinisekisa ukulawula okuphelele nokuxhumana okuhle kwabasebenzi. Qinisekisa ukulawula okuphelele bese ulawula i-PERSAL nedethabhesi ngezikhalazo, izingxabano, ukwenza okungalungile nokuqhinga bokuxhumana ngezinkulumo.

xh.title: Umncedi Wezabasebenzi AbaPhakamileyo Kwezomsebenzi
xh.summary: Ukulawula nokuphumeza iinkqubo zonxibelelwano lokusebenza eziquka iicala zolwahluko, iingxaki nezixazululo zengxabano kwindlu enkulu yesebe le Higher Education and Training.
xh.requirements: I-National Senior Certificate/level 4 okwaqwalaselwa ngayo, i-Degree okanye i-Diploma (NQF Level 6), kwe-Labour Relations, i-Employment Relations/Human Resource Management okwaqwalaselwa ngayo. Ubuncinane eminyaka 3 kwindawo ye-Labour Relations okanye i-Human Resource Management okwaloo ndawo ephathe kakhulu. Kufuneka ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kwaye ube nelayisenisi esemthethweni. Ikhono elilo lokunxibelela ngomlomo nangokubhalayo, kuquka nokubonelela ngezibizo nokubhala iiripoti. Ikhono lokusebenza ngoxinizelo, ukuzalisa iintsuku zokuvala nokugcina ibali lyaqhwanya. Ikhono lokusebenza lodwa nakwiqela ngekhono elilo lokubhala iiripoti. Izinto ezenza ukuba ube nammehlo amanqanaba: Isatifikethi se-PERSAL, ulwazi ngoMthetho weLabour Relations Act, ngokusemthethweni kolwakhiwo lwamanyathelo, ulwazi ngokuphumeza iinkqulumbana ze-PSCBC ne-GPSSBC Ulwazi nenqanaba lokuqonda inkqubo yoxabano, iinkqubo zoxinzelelo kwingxaki nexazululo lengxabano Ulwazi oluqinileyo malunga neelwabiwo zomthetho we-Labour Relation Ulwazi oluqinileyo malunga le-International Labour Organization (ILO) Ulwazi nenqanaba lokuqonda i-TVET/CET Administration Ulwazi nenqanaba lokuqonda urhwebo lwe-Higher Education.
xh.duties: Umntu oze kulo nxaxheba uya kubizwa ngokuba ngqundwa kwaye: Aqinise ukulawula ngokupheleleyo nokuphumeza ngokufanelekileyo iinkqubo nezinkqubela zonxibelelwano lokusebenza. Aqinise ukulawula ngokupheleleyo nokuphumeza ngokufanelekileyo ukuxazulula iicala zolwahluko, iingxaki neenkcubeko zexazululo lengxabano Aqinise ukulawula ngokupheleleyo nokuphumeza ngokufanelekileyo iinkqubo zocala lokwenza okungalunganga. Aqinise ukulawula ngokupheleleyo nokuphumeza ngokufanelekileyo inkqubo yoxabano nangokulawula iinkqubo zoxazululo. Aqinise ukulawula ngokupheleleyo amele iqabane elisebenzayo alawule nokulawula ukuphumeza iziphumo zokuvakalelwa ngokusemthethweni. Aqinise ukulawula ngokupheleleyo amandla okulawula unxibelelwano lokusebenza oluqinileyo. Aqinise ukulawula ngokupheleleyo alawule i-PERSAL ngedata ngokuthungwa koxinzelelo kwingxaki nexazululo, kaloku nangakwicala kolwahluko nokuxabano ngenhlangano.

jobs.title: Practitioner: Human Resource Development
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.salary_text: R338 106 per annum (Level 07), plus actual benefits
jobs.summary: Implement training programmes, process bursaries and coordinate performance management systems at the Higher Education and Training central office in Vryheid.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate Bachelors’ Degree /National Diploma in Human Resource Management / Development (NQF Level 6). Unendorsed valid driver’s licence. Relevant PERSAL Certificates will be an added advantage. A minimum of two (2) to three (3) years relevant experience in Human Resource Development environment. Knowledge and understanding of the application of Public Service legislative framework (PSA, PFMA, PSR, etc.). Knowledge and understanding of coordination and facilitation of training. Knowledge and understanding of application of Employment Equity Act. Knowledge and understanding of PMDS and IQMS. Skills: Coordination and facilitation of training programmes, planning and organising, good verbal and written communication, computer literacy, flexibility, customer care services, report writing, flexibility, teamwork.

af.title: Praktisyn: Menslike Hulpbronontwikkeling
af.summary: Implementeer opleidingsprogramme, verwerk beurse en koördineer prestasiBESTUURstelsels by die Hoër Onderwys en Opleiding se sentrale kantoor in Vryheid.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike Baccalaureusgraad / Nasionale Diploma in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur / Ontwikkeling (NQF Vlak 6). Ongeëndorsede geldige bestuurderslisensie. Relevante PERSAL-sertifikate sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. 'n Minimum van twee (2) tot drie (3) jaar relevante ervaring in 'n Menslike Hulpbronontwikkelingsomgewing. Kennis en begrip van die toepassing van die Wetgewende Raamwerk van die Openbare Diens (PSA, PFMA, PSR, ens.). Kennis en begrip van die koördinering en facilitering van opleiding. Kennis en begrip van die toepassing van die Wet op Indiensnemingsgelykheid. Kennis en begrip van PMDS en IQMS. zu.title: Umsebenzi: Intuthuko Yamathambo Abantu
zu.summary: Qalisa izinhlelo zokuqeqesha, qhashel imali yezifundo futhi uhlele izinhlelo zokuphatha ukusebenza kohlelo lwe-Higher Education and Training esikhungweni esikhulu e-Vryheid.
zu.requirements: I-Degree yezinga elithile ye-Bachelors / i-National Diploma e-Human Resource Management / Development (NQF Level 6). Ilayisensi yokuqasha evumelekile engagqokiwe. Izifundo ezithinte i-PERSAL zibe ngusizo olwengeziwe. Isiphephelo esingaphansi konyaka wamabili (2) kuya kothathu (3) iminyaka esiphephelo esihlobene nendawo ye-Intuthuko Yamathambo Abantu. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukusetshenziswa kohlaka lomthetho lwe-Public Service (PSA, PFMA, PSR, njll.). Ulwazi nokuqonda ukuhlela nokuqeqesha ukuzijwayeza kolwazi. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukusetshenziswa kwomthetho we-Employment Equity Act. Ulwazi nokuqonda i-PMDS ne-IQMS. Amakhono: Ukuhlela nokuqeqesha izinhlelo zokuqeqesha, ukucubungula futhi uhlele, ukuxhumana ngomlomo futhi ngokubhala okuhle, ukwaziswa ngekhompuyutha, ukuguquguquka, izinsiza zokunakekelwa kumthengi, ukubhala izikolo ezithintwe ngalo, ukuguquguquka, ukusebenza njengoba iqembu.
zu.duties: Qalisa yonke imiqondo yokuqeqesha nentuthuko ngesihle esigunyaziwe. Qhashel imali yezifundo ngesiyalelo esemthethweni somnyango. Hlela ukusetshenziswa kohlelo lokuphatha intuthuko yokusebenza, uhlelo oluhlanganisiwe lokuphatha izinga futhi uhlele ukuqeqesha izisebenzi zesikole. Qeqesha ukwakheka kwezinkomba zomsebenzi. Nikeza usizo ekwakheni, ukubuyekeza nokuqalisa iSiyalelo se-Employment Equity ngesikole. Qaphise izisebenzi.

xh.title: Umpraktisi: Ukuzinza kweziCandelo zoBuntu
xh.summary: Yenza inkqubo yolugcino, ukuqhuba iibhursari kunye nokulungelelanisa iindlela zolawulo lomgangatho kwiofisi egqithiswe kuyo e-Higher Education and Training e-Vryheid.
xh.requirements: I-Degree ye-Bachelors efanelekileyo okanye i-National Diploma kuHuman Resource Management / Development (NQF Level 6). Ilayisenisi yokushayela evakalayo engagqitywanga. Iifatshisi ze-PERSAL ezifanelekileyo ziya kuba lusizo olongezo. Amava ahambelanayo amabini (2) kuthathu (3) kwiminyaka kwindawo yokuzinza kweziCandelo zoBuntu. Ulwazi nokuqondaokusetyenziswa kwesiseko semithetho yoLuntu bomPhatho (PSA, PFMA, PSR, njl.). Ulwazi nokuqonda ukulungelelanisa nokuqhutywa kolugcino. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukusetyenziswa koMthetho we-Employment Equity. Ulwazi nokuqonda i-PMDS ne-IQMS. Amakhono: Ukulungelelanisa nokuqhuba iinkqubo zolugcino, ukucwangcisa nokuqamba izinto, ukuxelela nokuwela ngemilomo nangesibhalo, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ukuguquguquka, iinkonzo zokukhathalela abathengi, ukubala iingxelo, ukuguquguquka, ukusebenza njengomthi.
xh.duties: Yenza zonke iinkqubo zolugcino nentlafaho ngokwemigaqo esemvumanweni. Qhuba iibhursari ngokwemigaqo yesebe. Lungiselelanisa ukusetyenziswa kwenkqubo yoLawulo lomGangatho lokuTshintshiswa, iNkqubo elungelelanisiweyo yoLawulo loBomi kwaye ulungelelanise ulugcino labasebenzi bakholiji. Qhuthumba ukuqamba okubaliweyo kwemisebenzi. Nikeza uncedo ekuyileni, ukuphononza nokuqaqambisa iNkqubo yoLawulo lwesiQingqa sikaSebe seKholeji. Lawula abasebenzi.

jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.salary_text: R338 106 per annum (Level 07), plus actual benefits
jobs.summary: Chief Administration Clerk in Human Resource Management at the Central Office in Vryheid, requiring a degree or diploma in HR with two to three years' relevant experience.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate Bachelors’ degree/National Diploma in Human Resource Management. A minimum of two (2) to three (3) years’ functional experience within human resources environment. Sound knowledge of PERSAL System. Understanding of legislative framework governing the Public Service. Storage and retrieval procedures in terms of the working environment. Unendorsed valid driver’s licence. Recommendation Introduction to PERSAL Certificate. Skills: Planning and organizing. Sound Verbal and written communication skills. Intermediate computer literacy – MS Office: Word, Excel and PowerPoint. Skills: Planning and organizing. Flexibility, Customer care services, teamwork and report writing.

Administering the payroll for all employees and deal with all administrative queries related to pension and medical aid. Provide information as and when required so that authorities are informed of HR related matters and can make informed decisions. Administering recruitment and selection by receiving requests for advertisement of vacant posts in the college. Developing a recruitment plan. Keep a database of all vacant posts. Ensuring all logistical arrangement for shortlisting and interviews are prepared on time (arrangements of interview dates, venues and invitations to panel members and candidates). Facilitating the verification of qualifications for all recommended candidates. Compiling submission for support by the supervisor to appoint the suitable candidates in line with the delegations. Administering recruitment database. Administering the opening, archiving, closing and filing of files for new and existing employees. Ensuring the updating of personnel files. Ensuring safekeeping of Human Resource records. Administering all records required for auditing purposes. Ensuring disposal of files in terms of the applicable legislations and approved college policy. Administering all incoming and outgoing mail. Administering register of file index on filing system. Administer Employee Health and Wellness programmes.

af.title: Hoof Administratiewe Klerk: Menslike Hulpbronbestuur
af.summary: Hoof Administratiewe Klerk in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur by die Hoofkantoor in Vryheid, wat 'n graad of diploma in MH met twee tot drie jaar se relevante ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Geskikte Bachelorsgraad/Nasionale Diploma in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur. 'n Minimum van twee (2) tot drie (3) jaar se funksionele ervaring binne 'n menslike hulpbron-omgewing. Deeglike kennis van die PERSAL-stelsel. Begrip van die wetgewende raamwerk wat die Openbare Diens reguleer. Berging en onttrekkingsprosedures met betrekking tot die werksomgewing. Onbeperkte geldige bestuurderslisensie. Aanbeveling Inleiding tot PERSAL-sertifikaat. Vaardighede: Beplanning en organisering. Deeglike mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Intermediate rekenaargeletterdheid – MS Office: Word, Excel en PowerPoint. Vaardighede: Beplanning en organisering. Buigsaamheid, klikedienste, spanwerk en verslagdoening.
af.duties: Verskaf diensvoorwaardes en vergoeding van werknemers. Verwerk Pensioen, Behuistoeslae en Langdiensvoordele. Hou alle getekende dienskontrakvorms. Werknemers deur die administrasie van Pensioen, Behuistoeslae en Langdiensvoordele ens. verseker dat nuwe werknemers aanvaarding van diensvorms voltooi. Administreer werknemerverlof. Verseker dat personeeldossiere elektronies gehou word. Administreer alle beëindigingsversoeke en ontwikkel 'n databasis van beëindigings. Administreer die salaristrolys vir alle werknemers en hanteer alle administratiewe navrae wat verband hou met pensioen en mediese hulp. Verskaf inligting soos en wanneer vereis sodat owerhede ingelig word oor MH-verwante aangeleenthede en ingeligte besluite kan neem. Administreer werwerwing en seleksie deur versoeke vir advertensies van vakante poste by die kollege te ontvang. Ontwikkel 'n werweringsplan. Hou 'n databasis van alle vakante poste. Koördineer kortlyste en onderhoude. Verseker dat alle logistieke reëlings vir kortlyste en onderhoude betyds voorberei word (reëlings van onderhouddatums, plekke en uitnodigings aan paneellede en kandidate). Fasiliteer die verifikasie van kwalifikasies vir alle aanbevole kandidate. Stel 'n voorlegging op vir ondersteuning deur die toesigvoerder om die geskikte kandidate in ooreenstemming met die delegasies te benoem. Administreer die werweringsdatabasis. Administreer die oopmaak, argivering, sluiting en indiening van lêers vir nuwe en bestaande werknemers. Verseker die opdatering van personeellêers. Verseker die veilige bewaring van Menslike Hulpbronrekords. Administreer alle rekords wat vir ouditdoeleindes vereis word. Verseker die beskikking van lêers in ooreenstemming met die toepaslike wetgewing en goedgekeurde kollegebeleid. Administreer alle inkomende en uitgaande pos. Administreer die register van lêerindeks op die indieningstelsel. Administreer Werknemergezondheid en Welstandsprogramme.

zu.title: Inkulu Yomsekela Wezokuphathwa: Izempilo Yabasebenzi
zu.summary: Inkulu Yomsekela Wezokuphathwa kwiSimo Sempilo Yabasebenzi Ehhovisi Elikhulu eVryheid, idinga idiploma noma ibhakholashi kwi-HR eneminyaka emibili kuya kwayithathu yohlelo lokusebenza oluhambisanayo.
zu.requirements: I-Bachelors’ degree/National Diploma efanele kwi-Human Resource Management. Okungenani iminyaka emibili (2) kuya kuyithathu (3) yohlelo lokusebenza lwezinzuzo ngaphakathi kwesimo sempilo yabasebenzi. Ulwazi oluhle mayelana ne-PERSAL System. Ukuqonda ikhaphethi yomthetho elawula Public Service. Inqubo yokugcina nokuthola ukwaziswa ngokwezesimo sokusebenza. Ilayisense yokushayela ephathekayo engagqokiwe. Okunconyiwe Isitifikedi se-Introduction to PERSAL. Amakhono: Ukuletha futhi kuhlelwe. Amakhono okuxoxa nokubhala ahambisanayo. Ulwazi lwegumbi lakhalenda ezingeni eliphakathi – MS Office: Word, Excel kanye ne-PowerPoint. Amakhono: Ukuletha futhi kuhlelwe. Ukuguquguquka, izinsizakalo ezinhle kubahlabadali, ukusebenza njengeqembu kanye nokubhala umbiko.
zu.duties: Hlinzeka ngemibandela yezinsiza kanye nokuqhathaniswa kweholo labasebenzi. Phatha izinzuzo ze-Pension, i-Housing Allowance kanye nezinzuzo ze-Long Service. Gcina wonke amafomu wezinkontileka zokusebenza asiwe. Labasebenzi ngokuphatha izinzuzo ze-Pension, i-Housing Allowance kanye nezinzuzo ze-Long Service njll. Qinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi abasha bagcwalisa amafomu okuthatha umsebenzi. Phatha ukuphumula kwabasebenzi. Qinisekisa ukuthi amafayela abasebenzi agcinwa ngokugcina kwekhompyutha. Phatha yonke izicelo zokuphela kokusebenza futhi udale isikhathi sakho sokutholakala kokuphela kokusebenza. Phatha i-payroll yabo bonke abasebenzi futhi uphathane nayo yonke imibuzo yezokuphathwa ehlobene ne-pension kanye ne-medical aid. Nikeza ukwaziswa njengoba kudingeka ukuze izigaba zikwazi ukwaziswa ngemibuzo ehlobene ne-HR futhi zikwazi ukwenza izinqumo eziqondile. Phatha ukutholwa futhi ukhethwe ngokuthola izicelo zokumemeza izikhundla ezingenalutho e-college. Ukulungisa isu lokuthola abasebenzi. Gcina isikhathi sakho sokutholakala sonke izikhundla ezingenalutho. Hlanganisa ukweliswa kohlu nemicimbi yokuxoxisana. Qinisekisa ukuthi bonke bohlelo bokulungiselela ukwelwa kohlu kanye nemicimbi yokuxoxisana kulungele ngosuku (ukulungiselela izinsuku zemicimbi yokuxoxisana, izindawo kanye namemukelwe kubahluli kanye nabagqwayizwa). Ukwenza usizo ekulinganisweni kwamakhwalifheyishini kubo bonke abagqwayizwa abanconyiwe. Ukulungisa isibonelo sokusekela ngumlawuli wokuqasha abagqwayizwa abafanele ngokuhambisana nezinketho. Phatha isikhathi sokutholakala kwabasebenzi abaqashiwe. Phatha ukuvulwa, ukugcina,okuvala nokugcina amafayela abasebenzi abasha kanye nabakhona. Qinisekisa ukuvuselelwa kwamafayela abantu. Qinisekisa ukugcwaqwa okuhle kweekhodi ze-Human Resource. Phatha yonke amarekhodi adingekayo ngenjongo yokuqeqesha. Qinisekisa ukulahla kwamafayela ngokwemithetho okuhambisana kanye nenqubo ekuqashiwe ye-college. Phatha wonke imeyile engena nesephuma. Phatha ukubhaliswa kohlu lwamafayela kule nkqubo yokugcina. Phatha amaphulo Ezempilo kanye Nezokuphila Kwabasebenzi.

xh.title: Obeleki Ohlangothini Olungoyena Njiniyela: Ulawulo Lwabasebenzi
xh.summary: Obeleki Ohlangothini Olungoyena Njiniyela kwilawulo LoBantu kwisebe eNgqondoni eVryheid, efunisa idigri okanye idiploma kwi-HR nom_gcina onyaka ababini (2) ukuya kathathu (3) abambe kakhulu ngobuchule obuqhagamshelana nolu luntu.
xh.requirements: Isidanga esifanelekileyo seBachelors/National Diploma kwiNtshukumo yamandabantu eLawulwa ngenkqubo. Amava amabalwa amabini (2) ukuya kwamathathu (3) emisebenzi ehambelana nendalo yentlalo-nkcubeko ngaphakathi kweziko lamanani abasebenzi. Ulwazi olululo lwenkqubo ye-PERSAL. Ukuqonda iinkqubo-mthetho ezilawula ulwelo lweNkundla yoBuntu. Iinkqubo zokugcina nokuvela ngokwale ndawo yokusebenza. Ilayisensi yokuqesha into elungileyo engenamalinge amabi. Isiphembiso: Isatifikedi esingenisa kwi-PERSAL. Amakhono: Ukuhlela nokulungelelanisa. Amakhono olu lwimi-mbe-naba wokuqamba nokuqamba kwamagama abakufundo-nkqubo. Ukwazi kwinkqubo yekhompyutha kwinqanaba eliphakathi – i-MS Office: Word, Excel ne-PowerPoint. Amakhono: Ukuhlela nokulungelelanisa. Ukuqhuba komzimba, iinkqubo zokukhathalela iintengi, ukusebenza ngokuthimba nokubhala iingxelo.
xh.duties: Nika iimeko zokukhonza nentlawulo yabasebenzi. Cwangcisa i-Pension, iHousing Allowance neLong Service benefits. Gcina yonke iifom zeekontraka zobuqukiselelo ezingenisayo, nazo zonke iimpawu ezisayiniweyo. Sebenzisa ngokulawula i-Pension, iHousing Allowance neLong Service benefits njl.njl. Kuqinisekiswe ukuba abasebenzi abasha bagcwalise iifom zokuqalisa umsebenzi. Lawula iholo labasebenzi. Kuqinisekiswe ukuba iifayile zabasebenzi zigcinwa ngenkqubo yekhompyutha. Lawula zonke iicelo zokuvala inkqubo yomsebenzi uze wakhe isiseko seenkcukacha zemisebenzi epheliweyo. Lawula inkqubo yokuhlawulela onke amasebenzi kwaye uphathwe ngayo yonke imibuzo yolawulo enxulumene ne-pension nomncedisi wezonyango. Nikezela nolwazi xa kufuneka khona ukuze iziphathwa-mandla zixelelwe ngemiba enxulumene noLawulo lwabasebenzi zenze izigqibo ezinolwazi. Lawula inkqubo yokubiza abantu bese ukhetha ngokwamkelwa kwemiqulu yokuphawula iimbaleko ezingenalwazi kwikholeji. Yila inkqubo yokubiza abantu. Gcina isiseko seenkcukacha zawo onke amathuba angenalwazi. Lungiselela ukwenza uluhlu lokubekwa koluhlu nokubuzwa ngabantu. Kuqinisekiswa ukuba yonke imicimbi yokulungiselela uluhlu lokubekwa koluhlu nokuqatywa kwabantu ihlelwe ngexesha elifanelekileyo (izinto ezifana namaxesha, iindawo nezimemo kwabahlali bezixeko kunye nabafuna ukuba ngabaphathi bemiba). Yenza inkqubo yokucinga ngokutsha nokuqinisekisa izidanga zabantu abakhethwa. Lungiselela inkqubo yokuxhaswa ngumlawuli ukuba abantu abafanelekileyo bathunyelwe ngokulandela iinkqubo ezamkelekileyo. Lawula inkqubo yokugcina iinkcukacha zabantu abafuna ukuba abasebenzi. Lawula ukuvula, ukugcina iifayile kwimbaleko, ukuvala nokuzenza iifayile zabasebenzi abasha nalabo bakhoyo. Kuqinisekiswa ukuvuselelwa kweefayile zabasebenzi. Kuqinisekiswa ukugcinwa ngokhuselekileyo kweenkcukacha zoLawulo lwabantu. Lawula yonke imiqulu efuneka ngenjongo yokuvavanya. Kuqinisekiswa ukulahwa kweefayile ngokwemithetho egunyazisiweyo nenkqubo yekholeji evunyiweyo. Lawula yonke imiyalezo engena nephuma. Lawula ukubhaliswa koluhlu lweefayile ngokwenkqubo yokuzenza iifayile. Lawula iinkqubo zoBuntu eZempilo nokuZola nokuKhanya kwabaLuntu.
