EH&W-kandidate wat by die onderskeie professionele liggame geregistreer is, sal 'n bykomende voordeel hê. Begrip van alle Pilaarprosesse en die COID-wet. Interpersoonlike verhoudingsvaardighede. Kommunikasievaardighede (skriftelik en mondelings), aanbieding en luister). Analitiese denke, probleemoplossing en besluitnemingsvaardighede, innoverend en kreatief, projeksbestuursvaardighede, aanbiedingsvaardighede, strategiese vermoë, kliëntgerigtheid, veranderingsbestuursvaardighede, verslagskryfvaardighede, vertroulikheid en etiese kode. Begrip van Openbare Diens-wetgewing, regulasies en beleide. Rekenaarvaardigheid in MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint en Outlook. Goeie koördinering- en verslagskryfvaardighede. Bereidwilligheid om te reis en 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Bereidwilligheid om te reis en 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie. Administreer die Werknemer-Gesondheids- en Welstandsprogram. Bied bystand met die beplanning, koördinering en implementering van alle Gesondheids- en Welstandsintervensies. Bied bystand met die evaluering van die impak van werknemer-gesondheids- en welstandsprogramme. Verskaf opvoeding en bewustheid oor gesondheids- en welstandsverwante kwessies. Verskaf advies en leiding aan bestuur en personeel oor EH&W-verwante aangeleenthede. Verseker die monitering en evaluering van die EH&W. Toets EH&W-praktyke om beste praktyk in alle EH&W-programme vir Streekskantoor, CET en TVET Kolleges-personeel te verseker. Bevorder gesondheidsbewustheid en die facilitering van gesondheidsverwante gebeurtenisse, aktiwiteite en intervensies (Welstandsdag, MIV/VIGS, ens.). Voer berading, psigo-opvoeding en trauma-debriefing uit. Fasiliteer en monitor die implementering van enige vereiste aanbevelings wat deur die diensverskaffers gemaak is. Vermoë om die implementering van ongeskiktheidsverlof en die bestuur van siekteverloftendense te ontleed en uit te pak, en om voorleggings oor ongeskiktheids-uittrede vir die werknemers op te stel. Bestuur die welvaartsentrum, verskaf Eerste Hulp aan werknemers en bestuur die administrasie van beserings op diens. Aktiewe saakbestuur. Effektiewe rekordbestuur. Stel en skryf EH&W-verslae, stelselmoniteringsinstrumente en voorleggings/interne en eksterne memorandumme op. Voer enige ander verwante take uit.

zu.title: Umceli wezeMpihlakulo nokuZinza Kwabasebenzi
zu.summary: Umceli wezeMpihlakulo nokuZinza Kwabasebenzi ehhovisi elikhulu le-Department of Higher Education and Training, ofuna iziqu ze-Psychology noma i-Social Work okuhambisana nolwazi olufanele.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-Bachelor's Degree / National Diploma (NQF Level 6) ezifanelekile e-Psychology kanye/noma i-Social Work egxila kwi-Psychology noma iziqu ezingeqile. Ubulwelwane beminyaka yodwa (1) kuya k eminyakeni emibili (2) bolwazi lokusebenza kumkhakha wezeMpihlakulo nokuZinza Kwabasebenzi. Ulwazi mayelana ne-Employee Health and Wellness Integrated Strategic Framework emKhashweni kaZwelonke. Ulwazi oluhle mayelana namaphilari amane wonke e-EHW, ulwazi olujulile ekwenzeni umsebenzi wokweluleka, ukufundisa ngokwengqondo, kanye nokususa isibhaxu esimnyama. Abagqizi be-EH&W ababhaliswe emagunjini abaprofeshinali ahambisana nabo bazoba nolunga olwengeziwe. Ukuqonda iphononongo lwawo wonke amaphrosesi ePillar naye-Acti ye-COID. Amakhono obudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Amakhono okuxhumana (abhalwe nokuKhulunywa), okubonisa nokuLalela). Ukucinga ngokuhlaziya, ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuthatha izinqumo, kuba nodumo futhi ukuba nobuciko, amakhono abaphathi bephrojekthi, amakhono okubonisa, ikhono lezinqumo, ukuqondisisa izikhathi, ulwazi lokuphatha abathengi, amakhono abaphathi oshintsho, amakhono okubhala umbiko, ukugcina imfihlo, kanye nesikhwama somthetho. Ukuqonda umthetho, izimiso namapholisi aKhashwe kuZwelonke. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha ekusetshenzisweni kwe-MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint ne-Outlook, amakhono ahle okuhlela futhi okubhala imibiko. Ukuqonda ukuthanda ukuhamba nelayisensi yokuqasha ehlotshaniswa nomqashi osemthethweni.
zu.duties: Ukuthanda ukuhamba nelayisensi yokuqasha ehlotshaniswa nomqashi osemthethweni. Ukuqasha uhlelo lwe-Employee Health and Wellness Programme, ukusiza ekwelapheni, ukuhlela nokusebenzisa wonke amaphatho wezeMpihlakulo nokuZinza Kwabasebenzi. Ukusiza ekuhlola isibuko sezinhlelo zezempihlakulo nokuzinza kwabasebenzi. Ukunikeza imfundo nokwazisa ngemikhathi yezempilo nokuZinza okuhambisana nalokhu. Ukunikeza izeluleki nokuhola abaphathi kanye nabasebenzi ngalokuhambisana ne-EH&W, ukuqinisekisa ukuphenya nokuHlolwa kwe-EH&W. Ukwenza ukuqhathanisa izenzo ze-EH&W ukuze kuqinisekiswe okuhamba kahle kuzo zonke izinhlelo ze-EH&W zabasebenzi be-Regional Office, CET namakolishi we-TVET, ukukhuthaza ukwaziswa kwezempilo nokuhlinzeka ngezinkathi ezihlobene nezempilo, izenzo, namaphatho (Usuku lokuZinza, HIV/AIDS, nokunye). Ukwenza umsebenzi wokweluleka, ukufundisa ngokwengqondo, nokususa isibhaxu esimnyama. Ukukhuthaza bese kuqinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwanoma yikuphi okukhombiswe ngabakliniki abahlinzayo. Ikhono lokuhlaziya nokuxazulula ukusetshenziswa kwezinkululeko zokungasebenzi kahle komzimba nokuphatha ukuba khona kwesikhathi esigulayo, ukubhala izincomo ezingemva kokogulayo ezikhungweni ngokwesibhedlela sabasebenzi. Ukuphatha isikhungo sokuzinza, ukunikeza i-First-Aid abasebenzi kanye nokuphatha ukulimala esikhundleni somsebenzi. Ukuphatha icala ngokusebenzayo. Ukuphatha amarekhodi ngokusebenzayo. Ukubhala nokwenza imibiko ye-EH&W, izinto zokuqinisekisa ukubuka kwemikhankaso kanye nokuHlolwa/okungaphakathi nangaphandle kwaleyo nginguqo. Ukwenza noma yikuphi okunye okuhlobene nalokhu.

xh.title: Umpractitioner wezeMpilo neZempilo zabasebenzi
xh.summary: Umpractitioner wezeMpilo neZempilo zabasebenzi kwisebe leMfundo ePhakamileyo kunye noqeqesho kwiofisi ephakathi, efunayo inqanaba lezifundo kwiPsychology okanye iSocial Work kunye namava ahambelanayo.
xh.requirements: Izifundo ezifanelekileyo zeBachelor's Degree / National Diploma (NQF Level 6) kwiPsychology kwaye okanye iSocial Work eqhuba izifundo kwiPsychology okanye isifundo esilinganayo. Iqondo elingagqithanga elithathwa kwinyanga enye (1) kuye kwezimbini (2) zeminyaka yamava emsebenzini kwindawo yokuMpilo neZempilo zabasebenzi. Ulwazi ngoMqondo weNkqubo eManyanisiweyo eNtsenziwtsho ngoMpilo neZempilo zabasebenzi kuQeqesho loLuntu. Ulwazi olulungileyo ngeempiliso ezine ze-EHW, ulwazi olujulileyo ekwenzeni iseluleko, ekufundiseni ngengqondo, nasekuhlalweni iinguqu zengqondo. Abagqithiswa be-EH&W ababhaliswe kumaziko abo ngobuchwepheshe baya kuba nenzuzo eyongeziweyo. Ukuqonda konkeokuqhuba kweempiliso kunye nesoMtsetfa we-COID. Amakhono obudlelwane bomntu nomntu. Amakhono oxulumxho (okubhaliweyo nokuTHetha), okubonisa nokuva). Ukucinga ngokwahlulelwa, ukuxazulula iingxaki kunye nokuTHATHA izigqibo, ukuba yintsha nokuqamba, amakhono olawulo lweenkqubo, amakhono okubonisa, amandla okuqonda iNkqubo eNtsenziwtsho, ujongano nomxhasi, amakhono olawulo lenguqu, amakhono okubhala iingxelo, iyimfihlo, kunye neKhowude yomahluko. Ukuqonda uMtsetfa, iimigaqo kunye neenkqubo zoQeqesho loLuntu. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kwi-MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint kunye ne-Outlook, amakhono olungelelano oluhle nokuBhala iingxelo. UkuTTyala ukuhamba nokuba nelayisensi yokuqhuba esebenzayo.
xh.duties: UkuTTyala ukuhamba nokuba nelayisensi yokuqhuba esebenzayo. Ukupatha iNkqubo yokuMpilo neZempilo zabasebenzi, Uncedo ekucwangceni, ukulungelelanisa nokusebenzisa konke ukungenelela koMpilo neZempilo. Uncedo ekuqwalaselweni kwempembelelo yeenkqubo zompilo nezempilo zabasebenzi. Ukunika imfundo nolwazi ngemiba ehambelana nompilo nezempilo. Ukunika icebiso nolwalathiso abalawulo nakubasebenzi ngemiba ehambelana ne-EH&W, Qinisekisa ukulawula nokuqwalasela i-EH&W. Ukuthethisa iinkqubo ze-EH&W ukuze kuqinisekiswe amalungiselelo amaninzi ezoQeqesho iZiko leNdawo, i-CET kunye ne-TVET Colleges abasebenzi, Ukukhuthaza ulwazi ngempilo nokuTTyala iiganeko, imisebenzi, nokuNgenelela ngempilo (iNtsasa yeZempilo, i-HIV/AIDS, njl.). Ukwenza iseluleko, ukufundisa ngengqondo, nokuHlala iinguqu zengqondo. Ukukhuthaza nokuLawula ukusebenzisa nasiphi na isalathiso esinjaniyo esenziwe ngababoneleli benkxaso. Amandla okuvula nokuQwalasela ukusebenzisa iNqanaba lokuya kuvakalelweni lokungaphumeleli kwemisebenzi nokuLawula amathuba okuhlala esick, ukuqokelela iingxelo zokuRhoxa ngenxa yokugula kubasebenzi. Ukulawula iziko lezempilo, ukunikela iNkxaso yeokuqala kubasebenzi nokuLawula iNtengiso yokulimala emsebenzini. Ukulawula igqabo elisezinyeNi. Ukulawula iirekhodi ngokusebenzayo. Ukuqokelela nokuBhala iingxelo ze-EH&W, izixhobo zokuqwalasela iinkqubo nokuQokelela iingxelo/ngamagqabhaxo angaphakathi nangaphandle. Ukwenza naniphi na eminye imisebenzi eholelanayo.

jobs.title: Transport Officer
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.summary: Manage fleet vehicles, monitor trip logbooks, authorise itineraries and process invoices at the Department of Higher Education and Training central office.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate Bachelor’s Degree/ National Diploma in Transport Management / Logistics / Public Management or related qualification. A minimum of one (1) year experience in fleet management, transport management or logistics services environment. Sound knowledge and understanding of pertinent policies related to PFMA, national Treasury Regulations, Government Motor transport Handbook Version 1 of 2019, the Subsidized Motor Transport Handbook, Version 1 of 2017 and Batho Pele Principles and Code of Conduct. Through knowledge and understanding of BAS. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, problem solving and analytical skills. Computer literacy, an ability to work in a team and independent. Ability to work effectively and efficiently under pressure. Clientele/ customer relation skills. Good interpersonal skills, decision making skills and presentation skills. A valid driver’s license.
jobs.duties: Ensuring day to day management and maintenance of fleet vehicles. Monitor daily kilometres before and after trips and ensure monthly closing of kilometres on the logbooks. Authorize trip itineraries/ trip authorization. Receive and certify invoices for processing of monthly payments. Maintain records of driver’s licenses, trip authorization fines. Etc. Ensure service maintenance of vehicles. Redirect traffic fines. Pre and post inspections of vehicles. Quarterly inspections of subsidized vehicles and processing of new applications. Ensure compliance with the transport policies, processes and processes. Perform other related tasks as per supervisor’s instructions and willingness to adapt to work schedule in accordance with office requirements.
jobs.applications: must be forwarded to: recruit@goldfieldstvet.edu.za
jobs.notes: Please Note: A completed New Z83 form should be accompanied by a recently updated comprehensive CV (inclusive of three contactable referees and contact details). Shortlisted candidates will be requested to bring certified copies of their qualifications and identity document on the day of the interviews. Please quote the relevant reference number of the post you are applying for. Candidates who apply for more than one post should complete a separate application form for each post. Applications received after the closing date as well as faxed or e-mailed applications will not be considered. shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a vetting process (criminal record, citizenship, credit record checks, qualification, and employment verification). All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment The College reserves the right not to make appointments, and correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. If you do not receive any response within three months after closing date of this advertisement, kindly accept that your application was unsuccessful. Note: All costs incurred due to your application and interviews will be at your own expense. Preference will be given to persons from designated groups, especially with regard to race, gender and disability.

af.title: Vervoerbeampte
af.summary: Bestuur vlootvoertuie, monitor reislogboeke, magtig reisroetes en verwerk fakture by die Department of Higher Education and Training sentrale kantoor.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike Baccalaureusgraad/ Nasionale Diploma in Vervoerbestuur / Logistiek / Openbare Bestuur of 'n verwante kwalifikasie. 'n Minimum van een (1) jaar ervaring in vlootbestuur, vervoerbestuur of 'n logistiekediensomgewing. Deeglike kennis en begrip van toepaslike beleide rakende PFMA, nasionale Tesourie-regulasies, Government Motor transport Handbook Version 1 of 2019, die Subsidized Motor Transport Handbook, Version 1 of 2017 en Batho Pele-beginsels en Gedragskode. Deeglike kennis en begrip van BAS. Uitstekende mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede, probleemoplossing en analitiese vaardighede. Rekenaarvaardigheid, vermoë om in 'n span en onafhanklik te werk. Vermoë om effektief en doeltreffend onder druk te werk. Kliënt/ klantverhoudingsvaardighede. Goede interpersoonlike vaardighede, besluitnemingsvaardighede en aanbiedingsvaardighede. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Verseker dag-tot-dag bestuur en onderhoud van vlootvoertuie. Monitor daaglikse kilometer voor en na rittogte en verseker maandelikse afsluiting van kilometer in die logboeke. Magtig reisroetes/ reismagtiging. Ontvang en sertifiseer fakture vir verwerking van maandelikse betalings. Onderhou rekords van bestuurderslisensies, reismagtigingsboetes. Ens. Verseker diensonderhoud van voertuie. Herlei verkeersboetes. Voor- en na-inspeksies van voertuie. Kwartaallikse inspeksies van gesubsidieerde voertuie en verwerking van nuwe aansoeke. Verseker nakoming van die vervoerbeleide, prosesse en prosedures. Voer ander verwante take uit volgens toesighouer se instruksies en gewilligheid om aan werkskedule aan te pas in ooreenstemming met kantoorvereistes.

zu.title: Inkantshana Eziphatha Ezigqoka
zu.summary: Iphathe imoto zomnyango, ilandele amabhukhu ohamba, ivume izinhlela zohambo futhi ilenze amabhilidi ehhovisi elikhulu le-Department of Higher Education and Training.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-Bachelor's Degree/ National Diploma ezifanelekile kwi-Transport Management / Logistics / Public Management noma iziqu ezihlobene nakho. Okungenani unyaka munye (1) weminyaka yamava ekulawulweni kwenqwaba yemoto, ekulawulweni kokuhamba noma kumazwe wezinsizakalo. Ukwazi nokuzuva kahle izinqubomgomo ezihlobene ne-PFMA, izimiso ze-National Treasury Regulations, i-Government Motor transport Handbook Version 1 of 2019, i-Subsidized Motor Transport Handbook, Version 1 of 2017 kanye ne-Batho Pele Principles and Code of Conduct. Ulwazi olujulile nokuqonda i-BAS. Amakhono amahle okukhuluma nokubhala, okuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya. Ukusebenzisana nekhompyutha, ikhono lokusebenza eqenjini nangabodwa. Ikhono lokusebenza ngempumelelo nangokusebenza kahle ngaphansi kwenkulu. Amakhono obuhlobo nabathengi. Amakhono amahle abantu, okuthatha izinqumo nokwethula. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile.
zu.duties: Ukuqinisekisa ukuphathwa kwansuku zonke nokugcinwa kwenqwaba yemoto. Landa amakhilomitha nsuku zonke ngaphambi nangemva kwezinhamba ukuqinisekisa ukuvalwa kwamakhilomitha nyangazonke kumabhukhu. Vuma izinhlela zohamba/ imvume yokuhamba. Thola futhi uqinisekise amabhilidi ukuze akhushulwe izinkokhelo nyangazonke. Gcina amarekhodi e-layisensi zabashayeli, izinkokhelo zezinqubo zemvume yokuhamba njll. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa kwenqwaba yemoto. Qondisa izikhulumi. Ukuhlola imoto ngaphambi nangemva. Ukuhlola imoto ezigqokiswe nyanga zonke ukutholakala kwezinsizakalo ezintsha zokungenisa. Qinisekisa ukuthobela izinqubomgomo zokuhamba, izinqubo. Yenza omunye umsebenzi ohlobene njengokusho komphathi kanye nokuthanda ukulungisa ishejuli yokusebenza ngokwezidingo zehhovisi.

xh.title: Iofisa woHamba lwamaxwele
xh.summary: Lawula izithuthi zebe, alandele iibhuku zohamba lweenxweme, avume amaluncwamo ohamba aze axhese iinqobo kwindlu enkulu yesebe le Department of Higher Education and Training.
xh.requirements: Izidanga ezifanelekileyo ze-Bachelor’s Degree/ National Diploma ku-Transport Management / Logistics / Public Management okanye ngesiqinisekiso esinxulumene neso. Amava amabalwa ngonyaka omnye (1) kulawulo lwebe, ulawulo lohamba lwamaxwele okuba kwindawo yeenkonzo zokuhambisa izithuthi.
xh.duties: Ukuqinisekisa ulawulo nosuku nosuku nolondolozo lwezithuthi zebe.

jobs.title: Supply Chain and Asset Administration Clerk
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.summary: Supply Chain and Asset Administration Clerk needed at the Department of Higher Education and Training central office to handle travel bookings, procurement administration and LOGIS functions.
jobs.requirements: A minimum if National Senior Certificate / Grade 12 or equivalent qualification. No experience required. Knowledge in the following areas: Provisioning Administration / Supply Chain Management environment / Logistics or Facilitation of travel and accommodation arrangements; Knowledge of electronic administration of procurement system; Knowledge of LOGIS, BAS, SAGE, Reapatala invoice tracking and Archibus systems would be an added advantage; wide range of office management and administration tasks. Advanced communication, basic numeracy, interpersonal relations and general office administrative and organizational skills. Computer Literacy.
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will provide the following services: facilitate and coordinate bookings for travel, accommodation or conference. Administrate office correspondence, documents and reports. Execute various LOGIS functions in relation to procurement of goods and services. Ensures timely capturing of invoice payments on LOGIS, BAS or SAGE and approving of calls on Archibus. Assist with ordering of material and equipment from suppliers; administer documentation for requisitions and reports; submit invoices for payment. Ability to work on applicable invoice tracking system. Updating of commitment registers and monthly reconciliation of accounts. Assist with provision of financial statements inputs. Perform transit duties and other related tasks as per supervisor’s instruction.
jobs.applications: must be forwarded to: recruit@goldfieldstvet.edu.za
jobs.notes: Please Note: A completed NEW Z83 form should be accompanied by a recently updated comprehensive CV (inclusive of three contactable referees and contact details). Shortlisted candidates will be requested to bring certified copies of their qualifications and identity document on the day of the interviews Please quote the relevant reference number of the post you are applying for. Candidates who apply for more than one post should complete a separate application form for each post. Applications received after the closing date as well as faxed or e-mailed applications will not be considered. shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a vetting process (criminal record, citizenship, credit record checks, qualification, and employment verification). All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment The College reserves the right not to make appointments, and correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. If you do not receive any response within three months after closing date of this advertisement, kindly accept that your application was unsuccessful. Note: All costs incurred due to your application and interviews will be at your own expense. Preference will be given to persons from designated groups, especially with regard to race, gender and disability.

af.title: Voorsieningsketting- en Bateadministratiewe Klerk
af.summary: Voorsieningsketting- en Bateadministratiewe Klerk benodig by die Department of Higher Education and Training se sentrale kantoor om reisbesprekings, verkrygingsadministrasie en LOGIS-funksies te behartig.
af.requirements: 'n Minimum van 'n National Senior Certificate / Grade 12 of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie. Geen ervaring vereis. Kennis in die volgende areas: Voorseeningsadministrasie / Voorsieningskettingbestuur-omgewing / Logistiek of fasilitering van reis- en akkommodasierreëlings; Kennis van elektroniese administrasie van verkrygingstelsel; Kennis van LOGIS, BAS, SAGE, Reapatala-faktuurontvangs en Archibus-stelsels sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees; wye reeks van kantoorbestuurs- en administratiewe take. Gevorderde kommunikasie, basiese numeriese vaardighede, interpersoonlike verhoudings en algemene kantooradministratiewe en organisatoriese vaardighede. Rekenaarvaardigheid.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal die volgende dienste lewer: fasiliteer en koördineer besprekings vir reis, akkommodasie of konferensies. Administreer kantoorkorrespondensie, dokumente en verslae. Voer verskeie LOGIS-funksies uit met betrekking tot verkryging van goedere en dienste. Verseker tydige vaslegging van fakturenbetalings op LOGIS, BAS of SAGE en goedkeuring van oproepe op Archibus. Help met bestelling van materiaal en toerusting by verskaffers; administreer dokumentasie vir versoeke en verslae; dien fakture in vir betaling. Vermoë om op toepaslike faktuurontvangstelsel te werk. Opdatering van verbintenisregisters en maandelikse rekonsiliasie van rekeninge. Help met verskaffing van insette vir finansiële state. Voer transpligte en ander verwante take uit soos deur toesighouer aangedui.

zu.title: Umlobi Wezokuphathwa Kwenkokhiso Ephethwe Isiphakamiso Nokuphathwa Kweimpahla
zu.summary: Kudingeka Umlobi Wezokuphathwa Kwenkokhiso Ephethwe Isiphakamiso Nokuphathwa Kweimpahla ehhovisi elikhulu le-Department of Higher Education and Training ukuphatha ukubhuka okokuhamba, ukuphathwa kokuthenga kwezimpahla nemisebenzi ye-LOGIS.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi samatoho samazwe ngqondohle / Ibanga le-12 noma iziqu ezingangayo. Akukho mhloli wokusebenza odingekile. Ulwazi emikhakheni elandelayo: Ukuphathwa kokuhlinzeka / Izinkambu zokuphathwa kwenkokhiso esemthethweni yokuthenga izimpahla / Logistics noma ukuhlela ukuhamba nokuhlala; Ulwazi ngokuphathwa kwezithompumlilo kokuthenga izimpahla; Ulwazi lwe-LOGIS, BAS, SAGE, ukulandela isitifikedi se-Reapatala kanye namasistimu we-Archibus kungeyenza kube nenzuzo enkulu; ibanga elibanzi lemisebenzi yokuphathwa kwehhovisi nezokubhaliswa. Amandla okukhuluma aphakeme, ukubala okuyisisekelo, ubudlelwano obuhle nabantu kanye namakhono ajwayelekile okuphatha hhovisi nokuqamba izinhlelo. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha.
zu.duties: Umqashi opumelelo uzohlinzeka ngalezi zinsizakalo ezilandelayo: ukwenza futhi ukuhlanganisa ukubhuka ukwenza ukuhamba, ukuhlala noma imihlangano. Ukuphatha okubhaliwe kwehhovisi, amadokhonda kanye nemibiko. Ukwenza imisebenzi ehlukene ye-LOGIS ehlobene nokuthenga izimpahla kanye nesevisi. Ukunikeza isiqiniseko sokuthi ukukhokhelwa kwesitifikedi sekhalazuwe ngokushesha kwi-LOGIS, BAS noma SAGE kanye nokuvuma izinkingo kwi-Archibus. Ukusiza ukuthi kuthengwe izinto kanye neqhekeza kubanikezi; ukuphatha amadokhonda ezinkingo zemali kanye nemibiko; ukunikela izitifikedi ukuze zikhokhelwe. Ukukwazi ukusebenza kwisistimu esifanelekile yokulandela isitifikedi. Ukuhlaziya irejista zokuzibophezela kanye nokulinganisa ama-akhawunti nyanga zonke. Ukusiza ngokunikeza okungenayo kwemibiko yezimali. Ukwenza imisebenzi yokuhanjiswa kanye namanye emisebenzi ehlobene njengoba kushiwo umphathi.

xh.summary: Kufuneka kubaMlawuli Wabasebenzi WeSupply Chain Kunye Nee-Asset Administration kwindlu enkulu yesebe le-Department of Higher Education and Training ukusingatha amabhukhingu ehambo, ulawulo lweakhwitha kwaye nesebenze ngokwemisebenzi yeLOGIS.
xh.requirements: Ubuncinci beNational Senior Certificate / Grade 12 okanye isiqinisekiso esilinganayo. Akukho mdlandu ofunekayo. Ulwazi kwimizila elandelayo: Provisioning Administration / Supply Chain Management environment / Logistics okanye ulungiselelo lwezinto zokuhambla nendawo yokuhlala; Ulwazi ngolawulo lwangokuqhathanakhawuleza lwenkqubo yweakhwitha; Ulwazi ngenkqubo zeLOGIS, BAS, SAGE, Reapatala invoice tracking kunye neArchibus kunganceda ngakumbi; uluhlu olubanzi lomsebenzi wolawulo kwindlu yomsebenzi nemisebenzi yolawulo. Amandla okunxibelelana, ukubala okuyintloko, ubudlelwane nabantu kunye namakhono ajikelezi wolawulo kwindlu yomsebenzi nokuqhawula. Ukwaziswa ngekhompyutha.
xh.duties: Umamkeli ophumeleleyo uya kubonelela ngemisebenzi elandelayo: ukulungelelanisa nokuqhobosha amabhukhingu ehambo, indawo yokuhlala okanye inkqubo. Ukulawula iindaba zendlu yomsebenzi, amaxwebhu nadiresiti. Ukusebenzisa imisebenzi eyahlukeneyo yeLOGIS engenzelwa ukukhwela izinto kunye nezinkonzo. Kuqinisekiswa ukugcinwa ngelo thuku kwezinxibelelanisi zamahlawula kwiLOGIS, BAS okanye SAGE kunye nokuvuma izindlu kwiArchibus. Ukuncedisa ngokufuna izinto zomsebenzi nempahla kubahanjiswa; ukulawula amaxwebhu okufuna nokudwelisa nadiresiti; ukungenisa iindleko ngenxa yamahlawula. Amandla okusebenza ngenkqubo yokulandela iindleko esetyenziswayo. Ukuhlaziya izibuko zokuzithembisa nokuqwaqwa ngenyanga nge-accounts. Ukuncedisa ngokubonelela ngesalathiso semali yemali yeseshini. Ukwenza imisebenzi yokuthumela nokubuyisela emva komthetho wentlanganisi njengoko kumiselwe.

Minimum of 5 years of experience at middle / senior managerial level in the relevant environment. Experience in the implementation and management of projects. A valid driver’s licence. Facilitate the establishment and support of participatory community development. Facilitate and coordinate NARYSEC project implementation. Facilitate youth programmes and skills development at provincial and district level. Reduce household poverty in accordance with comprehensive Rural Development Programme (CRDP). Provide strategic land acquisition services. Implement strategic land acquisition projects proposals. Procure service providers for development of project proposals. Coordinate the implementation process of land acquisition. Provide strategic land acquisition support services in the district. Facilitate poverty reduction, and the development of cooperatives, rural enterprises and industries. Promote rural businesses development and facilitate rural development financing. Facilitate establishment and support of primary cooperatives. Facilitate organisation of primary cooperatives into secondary and tertiary cooperative sand provide support. Facilitate the development of rural enterprises and industries. Provide land development support services. Manage the development of business plans for the development or agrarian development projects. Promote the participation of farmers through ownership and control across commodities value chains. af.title: Distriksdirekteur

Minimum van 5 jaar se ervaring op middel- / seniorbestuursvlak in die tersaaklike omgewing. Ervaring in die implementering en bestuur van projekte. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Werksverwante kennis: 'n Deeglike begrip van projektbestuur. Begrip van korporatiewe bestuursbeginsels. Vermoë om prestasiebestuur- en moniteringstelsels te implementeer. Kennis van regeringsstelsels. Vermoë om konseptueel te dink wanneer data ontleed en konsepte ontwerp word om korporatiewe beleide, prosedures en prosesse te wysig. Werksverwante vaardighede: Projektbestuur. Afrigting en mentorskap (deur leierskap). Analitiese denke. Aanpasbaarheid en buigsaamheid. Klantediens. Inisiatief. Innovasie en kreatiwiteit. af.duties: Verskaf kapasiteitsbou- en National Rural Youth Service Corps (NARYSEC)-dienste. Verskaf NARYSEC-ondersteuningsdienste. Fasiliteer die vestiging en ondersteuning van deelnemende gemeenskapsontwikkeling. Fasiliteer en koördineer NARYSEC-projekimplementering. Fasiliteer jeugprogramme en vaardigheidsontwikkeling op provinsiale en distriksvlak. Verminder huishoudelike armoede in ooreenstemming met die omvattende Rural Development Programme (CRDP). Verskaf strategiese grondverkrygingsdienste. Implementeer strategiese grondverkrygingsprojekvoorstelle. Procureer diensverskaffers vir die ontwikkeling van projekvoorstelle. Koördineer die implementeringsproses van grondverkryging. Verskaf strategiese grondverkrygingsondersteuningsdienste in die distrik. Fasiliteer armoedevermindering, en die ontwikkeling van koöperasies, landelike ondernemings en nywerhede. Bevorder landelike besigheidsontwikkeling en fasiliteer landelike ontwikkelingsfinansiering. Fasiliteer die vestiging en ondersteuning van primêre koöperasies. Fasiliteer die organisering van primêre koöperasies in sekondêre en tersiêre koöperasies en verskaf ondersteuning. Fasiliteer die ontwikkeling van landelike ondernemings en nywerhede. Verskaf grondontwikkelingsondersteuningsdienste. Bestuur die ontwikkeling van besigheidsplanne vir die ontwikkeling of agrariese ontwikkelingsprojekte. Bevordel die deelname van boere deur eienaarskap en beheer oor die waardekettings van kommoditeite. Monitor die implementering van grondontwikkelingsondersteuningsprojekte en die ontwikkeling van besigheidsplanne. Verskaf eiendomsbestuursdienste. Administreer en verskaf eiendomsverhuuradministrasie. Administreer en verskaf eiendomsbesit en beskikbare eiendomme. Implementeer grondbeginsel- en erfreghervormingsprogramme. Verskaf gemeenskaplike erfregprogramme. Verskaf grondbeginselprogramme. Vestig, handhaaf en ondersteun gemeenskaplike eiendomsinstellings. Fasiliteer grondbeslissingoplossings. Verskaf korporatiewe en finansiële ondersteuningsdienste. Verskaf regsadvies. Verskaf telekommunikasiedienste. Verskaf administratiewe en finansiële ondersteuningsdienste. Verskaf kliëntverhoudingsdienste. Verskaf kantoordienste.

zu.title: Umphathi wesifunda
zu.summary: Umphathi wesifunda ofakazi kwakhiwa ikhono nokuhlelwa kwenkonzo yabasha ye-NARYSEC ngaphakathi kwa-Mpumalanga.
zu.requirements: Izidingo okungehlwa: Abafaka izifundo kumele babe nesitifiketi se-Grade 12 kanye ne-Bachelor's Degree noma i-Advanced Diploma ku-Business Administration / Public Management / Public Administration / Project Management / Bachelor of Arts ku-Sociology / Anthropology / Community Development Studies (NQF level 7) noma isiqu esihambisana nalokhu kanye nesitifiketi se-Nyukela (Pre-entry Certificate to the SMS) esithunyelwe ngaphambi kokubekwa esikhundleni. Uqobo lokuqashwa kweminye emincane engu-5 njengomanjala wesikhathi esiphakathi noma esiphezulu endaweni ehambisana nalokhu. Uqobo lokuqashwa kokusebenzisa nokuphatha amaphrojekthi. Ilayisense yokushayela elisebenzayo. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ukuqonda okujulile kwephrojekthi yokuphatha. Ukuqonda imigomo yokubusa inkampani. Isikhathi sokuqashwa kokuphatha ukusebenza kahle kanye nezinhlelo zokulawula. Ulwazi ngemithetho yuhulumeni. Isikhathi sokuqonda ngemibono uma kuqoqwa idatha nokwakhiwa izinto zokushintsha imigomo, izinqubo kanye nezindlela zenkampani. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukuphatha iphrojekthi. Ukubeka kanye nokuhola (kuhola abaqashi). Ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya. Ukuzivumelanisa nokuba noguquko. Inkonzosomthengi. Isiqondiso. Ubuciko bokwenza izinto. Unxibelelwano (lwaqondwayo nolwelimi). Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuzithobile ukwendawo ezahlukene. Isikhathi sokuqashwa ngaphansi kwezinkinga. Ukuzithobile ukusebenza ngemva kwevamahora.
zu.duties: Nika amandla ukuqashwa kokwakha ikhono kanye nabezinkonzo ze-National Rural Youth Service Corps (NARYSEC). Nikeza izinkonzo zokwesekwa kwe-NARYSEC. Hlela ukusungulwa kanye nokwesekwa kokuthuthukiswa kwemiphakathi ngabathathi nxaxheba. Hlela futhi uhlele ukusetshenziswa kwamaphrojekthi e-NARYSEC. Hlela izinhlelo zabasha kanye nokuqashwa kwamakhono ezingeni lesifundazwe nasesifundeni. Nciphisa ubumpofu bawomuzi ngokusho kwe-Comprehensive Rural Development Programme (CRDP). Nikeza izinkonzo zokuthola izinkalo zomhlaba ngemigomo. Sebenzisa izinkuleko zamaphrojekthi zokuthola izinkalo zomhlaba. Thola abanikezeli besebekho emigqweni yokwakhiwa kwezinkuleko zamaphrojekthi. Hlela inqubo yokusetshenziswa kokuthola umhlaba. Nikeza izinkonzo zokwesekwa okuhlelekile kokuthola izinkalo zomhlaba esifundeni. Hlela ukunciphiswa kobumpofu, nakho kokuthuthukiswa kwezinhlangano zokubambisana, amabhizinisi ezemidlalo nasembonini. Khuthaza ukuthuthukiswa kwebhizinisi lasemadolobheni futhi uhlele ukuxhaswa kokuthuthukiswa komnotho wemiphakathi. Hlela ukusungulwa kanye nokusekelwa kwezinhlangano eziyisisekelo zokubambisana. Hlela ukuhlanganiswa kwezinhlangano eziyisisekelo zaba yizesibili nezeshumi nakuba sesithathu zinikwesekwa. Hlela ukuthuthukiswa kwebhizinisi nezimboni zasemiphakathini. Nikeza izinkonzo zokusekelwa kokuthuthukiswa komhlaba. Phatha ukwakhiwa kwezinhlelo zebhizinisi ukuthuthukisa amaphrojekthi okulima. Khuthaza ukubandakanyeka kwabalimi ngokuphathwa nokulawula iyunithi emigqweni yamahlelo ahlukene. Qapha ukusetshenziswa kwamaphrojekthi okusekela ukuthuthukiswa komhlaba kanye nezinhlelo zebhizinisi. Nikeza izinkonzo zokuphatha izimpahla. Lawula futhi nikeza ukuphathwa kwezinsiza zokuphatha izimpahla. Lawula futhi nikeza izimpahla ezibambisene nezokuphatha. Sebenziza amaphrojekthi emigomo yamalungelo omhlaba nokushintsha kwezinsiza. Nikeza amaphrojekthi emigomo yamalungelo amukelekile emiphakathini. Nikeza amaphrojekthi amalungelo omhlaba. Sungula, gcina futhi weseke izikhungo zempahla yakomkhulu. Hlela ukuxazulula izinkinga ngomhlaba. Nikeza inkampani kanye nokuxhaswa kwezimali. Nikeza izeluleko zomthetho. Nikeza izinkonzo zocingo. Nikeza izinkonzo zokuphatha nokuxhaswa kwemali. Nikeza izinkonzo zobudlelwano nomthengi. Nikeza izinkonzo zohhovisi.

xh.title: Umgcini weSithili
xh.summary: Umgcini weSithili oqhubekayo ngokwakha amandla nokuqhubeleka kwenkonzo yabaselula i-NARYSEC kulo Mpumalanga.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezibalulekileyo: Abafaki isicelo kufuneka babe neSetifikathi seGrade 12 kunye neDegree yeBachelor okanye iDiploma ePhakamileyo kwi-Business Administration / Public Management / Public Administration / Project Management / Bachelor of Arts in Sociology / Anthropology / Community Development Studies (NQF level 7) okanye iziqinisekiso ezingaphambana ezinjalo kunye neSetifikathi yeNyukela (iSetifikathi sokuqala sokungena kwi-SMS) esinikezwa ngaphambi kokubekwa esikhundleni. Ubuncinane iiminyaka engama-5 yamava kwinqanaba eliphakathi / eliphezulu lolawulo kwimeko ephathwayo. Amava ekuphathweni nokuqhuba amaprojekthi. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Ulwazi oluhambelana nomsebenzi: Ukuqonda okubanzi ekuphathweni amaprojekthi. Ukuqonda iimigaqo yolawulo lwenkampani. Ikhono lokusebenzisa iinkqubo zolawulo kwaye nokuqhuba iinkqubo zokuqonda. Ulwazi ngenkqubo zorhulumente. Ikhono lokucinga ngokubakho kwezinto xa kuqhutywa uhlalutyo lwedatha nokuyila iingcinga zokulungisa iinkqubo, iinkqubo nendlela zolawulo lwenkampani. Amakhono ahambelana nomsebenzi: Uphatho lwamaprojekthi. Ukuyala kunye nokukhuthaza (ngokuba ngumgcekiswa bokulawula). Ukuqonda ngokucoba. Ukuzinza nokuqhwalela kwindawo ezahlukeneyo. Iinkonzo zabathengi. Ukuzimisela. Ubuchule bokuqamba nokuqamba iindlela. Unxibelelwano (ngokuthetha nangokubhala). Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuzimisela ukuhamba. Ikhono lokusebenza phantsi kwengcinezelo. Ukuzimisela ukusebenza emva kweeyure ezisezantsi.
xh.duties: Kunikezelwa iinkonzo zokwakha amandla kunye ne-National Rural Youth Service Corps (NARYSEC). Kubonezelwa iinkonzo zoxhaso lwe-NARYSEC. Kukhutywa uqoqosho lolwakhiwo ngenkxaso yentshukumbiso ekuphuhliseni koluntu. Kuqhutywa kunye noqhubeleko ekuphathweni lwamaprojekthi e-NARYSEC. Kuqhutywa iinkqubo zaselula nophuhliso lwamakhono kwinqanaba lephondo naselona sithili. Kuncitshiswa ubuyanga kolwazi kwintsapho ngokuvumelana ne-Comprehensive Rural Development Programme (CRDP). Kunikezelwa iinkonzo ezibalulekileyo zokufumana umhlaba. Kusebenziswa iindaba zokufumana umhlaba ezingabalulekileyo. Kuthengwa abaniki zinkonzo ukuphuhlisa iindaba zamaprojekthi. Kuqhubeleka inkqubo yokuqhuba umhlaba. Kunikezelwa iinkonzo zoxhaso olubalulekileyo zokufumana umhlaba kwisithili. Kuqhutywa ukuncitshiswa kwehlazo, nophuhliso lwekhophoreyishini, iivenkela zasemaphandleni namashishini. Kukhuthazwa ukuphuhliswa kwezoshishino zasemaphandleni kuqhutywa nolwabiwo-mali lokuphuhlisa iindawo zasemaphandleni. Kuqhutywa ulwakhiwo ngenkxaso yeendawo eziseko naxa kubakho. Kuqhutywa uqoqosho lweekhophoreyishini zokuqala. Kuqhutywa uqoqosho lweekhophoreyishini zokuqala zibe zekhophoreyishini zesibini nesesithathu. Kuqhutywa ukuphuhlisa iivenkela zasemaphandleni namashishini. Kunikezelwa iinkonzo zokuphuhlisa umhlaba. Kuphathwa ukuphuhliswa kweengcamango zamashishini ukuphuhlisa okanye ukuphuhlisa amaprojekthi ezolimo. Kukhuthazwa ungamathi ngokubandakanywa nokulawula ikonzo. Kugqitywa ukusebenza kumaprojekthi zokuphuhlisa umhlaba. Kunikezelwa iinkonzo zokulawula iziphumo. Kuphathwa kubonezelwa amawasho wolawulo. Kuphathwa amapulo wokulawula izipho. Kubonezelwa ulawulo lolwandiso. Kusetyenziswa iinkqubo zokulungisa ilayisensi yomhlaba noluqoqosho. Kunikezelwa iinkqubo zomhlaba wonke. Kunikezelwa iinkqubo zalayo yomhlaba. Kuqaliswa, kugcinwa kuqhutywa ngenkxazo iintshishino zomhlaba. Kuqhutywa ukulunga iingxaki zomhlaba. Kumbonezelwa iinkonzo zokuxhaso korhulumente kutsho nemali. Kufunyanwa ingcebiso yomthetho. Kuthunyelwa iinkonzo zokunxibelelwa ngeempawu. Kunikezelwa iinkonzo zokulawula nemali. Kunikezelwa iinkonzo ezinxulumene nabathengi. Kunikezelwa iinkonzo zeqhondo.

zu.title: Umphathi: Eziphathwa kweze-Mali kanye ne-Chain Management Yezimpahla
zu.summary: Umphathi Wezephathwa kweze-Mali kanye ne-Chain Management Yezimpahla oseMbombela, ofuna idigri ekuqashweni kwezemali noma indlela ehlobene nayo, ethola R1,317,384 ngonyaka ezingeni le-SMS Level 13.
zu.requirements: Izidingo ezingaphansi: Abafaka izicelo kumele babe ne-Certificate ye-Grade 12 kanye ne-Bachelor's Degree noma i-Advanced Diploma ku-Cost Management Accounting / Financial Management / Accounting / Public Finance / Auditing / Supply Chain Management / Logistics Management / Purchasing Management / Management (Logistics / Supply Chain Management) (NQF Level 7) noma izifundo ezifana nalezi ezithunyelwe kanye ne-Nyukela certificate (Isitifiketi sangaphambi kokuqashwa kwi-SMS) esithunyelwe ngaphambi kokubekwa esikhundleni. Okungenani unyaka be-5 wojahuleka ezingeni eliphakathi noma eliphezulu lokuphatha endaweni ehlobene nalesi. I-driver's licence evunyiwe. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi olwendlulela olwazi ngo-General Accepted Accounting Principles, i-Treasury Regulations Generally Reviewed Accounting Principles. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukuletha futhi ukululeka (ngekhono elihambisana nobuholi). Ukulungiselela futhi ukunikeza izinkulumo-zimiselo. Ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya. Ukuzivumelanisa nezimo futhi ukuguquguquka. Isevisi yabathengi. Ukuthatha inyathelo. Ukuba nobuntu obubonisa ukuzakhela futhi ukudala. Ukuthuthukiswa kwenqubo. Ukuxhumana (ngomlomo nakubhalwe). Ukuphatha amaphrojekhi. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuthanda ukuhamba.
zu.duties: Qinisekisa ukuzithoba kumazinga ephathwa kwezimali ngokulandela izinqulumo nemihlahlandlela. Qinisekisa ukuzithoba kwi-Public Finance Management Act, i-Treasury Regulations kanye nomthetho ohlobene nalesi kanye nemiyalo. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwezinqulu, amasistimu, izinqubo, kanye nama-processes ukuze kutholakale ukuphathwa kwezimali okuhle. Buka ngaphezulu izinsizakalo zokwesekwa kwezemali phakathi kwamasikhungo ahlanganyelwe esifundazweni. Phatha izinqobo zokuqamba izimali. Phatha i-budget yomnyango. Phatha amaholo ne-payroll. Ukugcina amasistimu ezezimali. Buka ngaphezulu i-supply chain, izindawo kanye nokulawulwa kwe-ofisi. Phatha i-demand management plan nokuqasha izimpahla, izinsizakalo kanye namafa. Nikeza izinsiza ze-logistics, ukuhamba kanye nezokusuka. Nikeza ukuphathwa kwamafa kanye nezindawo. Buka ngaphezulu izinsizakalo zokwesekwa eziphathwa kwezemali. Nikeza ukulawulwa kwangaphakathi kanye nezinsizakalo zokubika. Buka futhi zigcine i-budget nokubika. Nikeza izinsizakalo zokukhokha. Nikeza ukuphathwa kwezimali ezitholwe kumafa. Nikeza ukuphathwa kwezimali ezitholwe kwamasheya.

xh.title: Umphathi: Ukulawula kwemali kweziqhithi nemisebenzi eqokelela nethunyelwa kwezinto
xh.summary: Umphathi wokuLawula kwemali kweziqhithi nemisebenzi eqokelela nethunyelwa kwezinto ozinze eMbombela, ofuna isidanga kumalinge wobuxhakaxhakambemali okanye indawo enxulumene nayo, onikeza nika R1,317,384 ngonyaka kwinqanaba le SMS Level 13.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezisisiseko: Abafaka izicelo kufuneka babe nesatifikethi se Grade 12 kwaye be ne Degree ye Bachelor okanye i Diploma ePhakamileyo kwi Cost Management Accounting / Financial Management / Accounting / Public Finance / Auditing / Supply Chain Management / Logistics Management / Purchasing Management / Management (Logistics / Supply Chain Management) (NQF Level 7) okanye isifaniso esinxulumene neso kwaye benesatifikethi se Nyukela (isatifikethi sokuqala sokuungena kwi SMS) esinikelwe ngaphambi kokwamkelwa. Iyure ezincinci ze 5 zemiyalezo ngaphezulu kwinqanaba elingunozincwadi ophakathi / ophakamileyo kwindawo ethile. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ulwazi olunxulumene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi olubanzi kwimigaqo ethi Generally Accepted Accounting Principles, Treasury Regulations Generally Reviewed Accounting Principles. Ikhono elinxulumene nomsebenzi: Ukulolonga kwaye kuqeqeshe (ngokulawula). Ulungiselele kwaye unike ipezenteshini. Ukucinga ngokuhlalahlwa. Ukuzinza nokuguquguquka. Iinkonzo zabathengi. Ukuzimisela. Inovethi nokudala. Ukuphucula iinkqubo. Unxibelelwano (ngomlomo nangokubhalwayo). Ukulawula iiprojekthi. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuzimisela ukuhamba.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa ukuzingatha kwemigaqo yolawulo kwemali ngokulandela iimigaqo nemikhomba. Qinisekisa ukuzingatha nge Public Finance Management Act, Treasury Regulations namanye omthetho onxulumene naye nemiyalelo. Qinisekisa ukusebenza kweemigaqo, iinkqubo, iinkqubo zemisebenzi, namaqondo okuqinisekisa ukulawula kwemali okulungiley. Qaphela iinkonzo zoxhaso lwemali kwiziko zolwazi ezithile ezabelana ngazo iiphondo. Lawula iinkqubo zemali yesixhobo. Lawula umgangatho wesebe. Lawula imivuzo kwaye uhlole iindleko zokuqwalasela. Ukugcina iinkqubo zemali. Qaphela ukwenziwa kwezinto, izixhobo nolawulo lweofisi. Lawula icebo lokulawula iimfuno nokuqokelela izinto, iinkonzo nempahla. Yenza iinkonzo zokuhanjiswa kwezinto, okuhamba nokuthutha. Yenza ukulawula impahla nendawo. Qaphela iinkonzo zoxhaso lolawulo lwemali. Yenza iinkonzo zolawulo langaphakathi nokubika. Yakha kwaye ulondoloze umgangatho wemali nokubika. Yenza iinkonzo zokuhlawulela. Yenza ukulawula imali ehamba kwindalo yempahla. Yenza ukulawula imali ehamba kwindawo yolawulo.

jobs.title: Director: Provincial Operations Support
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 per annum (Level 13), (all-inclusive package). The package includes a basic salary (70% of package), and a flexible portion that may be structured in accordance with the rules for Senior Management Services (SMS)
jobs.summary: Director of Provincial Operations Support sought in Mbombela to facilitate planning, resource allocation and performance management under the Corporate Governance Framework.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in a possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and a Bachelor’s Degree or Advanced Diploma in Public Administration / Business Administration / Public Management (NQF Level 7) or related equivalent qualification and a Nyukela certificate (Pre-entry Certificate to the SMS) submitted prior to appointment. Minimum of 5 years of experience at middle / senior managerial level in the operations support environment. A valid driver’s licence. Job related knowledge: Understanding of corporate governance principle. Ability to implement performance management and monitoring systems. Knowledge of government systems. Job related skills: Ability to communicate effectively across a broad spectrum. A thorough understanding and practical experience of Project Management. Analytical and problem-solving. Facilitation and coordination. Experience in implementation of goals / plans, including monitoring, tracking and reporting status toward goal completion. Ability to think conceptually when analysing data and designing concepts to modify corporate policies, procedures and processes. Presentation and comfortable creating and communicating compelling arguments for modifying a course of action. Computer literacy. Willingness to travel. Ability to work under pressure and long hours.
jobs.duties: Facilitate the integration of planning, resource allocation and performance management of outcomes of the Provincial Office through the Corporate Governance Framework. Facilitate the issuing of planning framework by the Directorate: Strategic Planning for all Provincial Offices and monitor Provincial Offices planning process. Analyse the District Integrated Operational Plans and ensure alignment with the DLRRD Annual Performance Plan. Analyse Provincial Integrated Operational Plans and ensure alignment to the District Operational Plans. Ensure approval (signing off) of all Districts and Provincial Integrated Operational Plans. Lead the development and implementation of consistent corporate performance monitoring and evaluation to focus on the delivery of Provincial Office Annual Performance Plan outcomes. Manage and implement evaluation and research frameworks. Monitor the initiating and conducting research and evaluation. Coordinate the integration of all monitoring and evaluation systems within the province. Manage reporting instruments and tools on monitoring and evaluation. Ensure robust governance, effective decision making, value for money and appropriate benefits are achieved through corporate activity, policy and strategy frameworks. Monitor monthly and provide written reports on functionality of provincial governance structures. Randomly attend the provincial governance structures as part of monitoring functionality. Provide professional advice and support to the Chief Director: Provincial Office in community participation, community planning, corporate and operational planning, program performance reporting, corporate project, policy, strategy and infrastructure development and implementation, and corporate governance development and implementation. Provide quarterly reports identifying performance risks and recommending intervention plans and improvements for operational efficiency and performance improvements. Prepare bi-annual integrated operational plan performance reports clearly identifying trends, areas requiring policy and systems improvements. Provide professional advice as when the need arise and especially when risks are identified. Provide assistance with the initiation, management, coordination and the implementation of strategic corporate projects. Integrate strategic, operational and performance management functions, frameworks and systems, including recommendations for strategic resource allocation at provincial level. Provide assistance to the Chief Director: Provincial Office Coordination to initiate and coordinate the implementation of strategic corporate (cross-provincial service centres) projects to improve the Provincial Office ability to meet strategic outcomes and service delivery objectives exercising appropriate discretion to achieve required outcomes. Monitor the performance of the identified DLRRD key programmes and facilitate sharing of the best practices and lessons learnt by provinces through the existing departmental governance structures. Monitor implementation of Standard Operating Procedures in implementation of the departmental key programmes (obtain reports from Directors, analyse and produce bi-monthly reports). Establish and maintain internal and external networks to monitor trends and best practice in corporate governance. Identify institutions that will be part of the networks for the DLRRD and have a report approved by the Chief Director and facilitate development of relationships and networks with those institutions. Ensure the maintenance of these networks and ongoing relationships. Benchmark with the identified institutions to get best practices and learn lessons from these institutions once a year. Develop a report on proposed continuous improvement. Develop Integrated Operational Plans performance reporting system. Monitor all provincial performance against the approved Integrated Operational Plans monthly. Request and get monthly reports from Directors. Analyse the reports (performance reported against plans, reasons for variance and proposed intervention plans). Consolidate monthly the Provincial Performance to one (1) Integrated Operational Performance plan.
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to: 17 Van Rensburg Street, 7th Floor Bateleur Building, Mbombela, 1200 or by email to Post214@dlrrd.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE Targets: Coloured and White Males and African, Coloured and Indian Females and Persons with disabilities. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Direkteur: Provinsiale Operasieondersteuning
af.summary: Direkteur van Provinsiale Operasieondersteuning gesoek in Mbombela om beplanning, hulpbrontoewysing en prestasiebestuur onder die Korporatiewe Bestuursraamwerk te fasiliteer.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Bachelorsgraad of Gevorderde Diploma in Openbare Administrasie / Besigheidsadministrasie / Openbare Bestuur (NQF Vlak 7) of 'n verwante ekwivalente kwalifikasie besit, asook 'n Nyukela-sertifikaat (Voor-toelatingsertifikaat tot die SMS) wat voor aanstelling oorhandig is. Minimum van 5 jaar se ervaring op middel / senior bestuursvlak in die operasieondersteuningsomgewing. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Werksverwante kennis: Begrip van korporatiewe bestuursbeginsels. Vermoë om prestasiebestuur en moniteringstelsels te implementeer. Kennis van regeringstelsels. Werksverwante vaardighede: Vermoë om oor 'n breë spektrum doeltreffend te kommunikeer. 'n Deeglike begrip en praktiese ervaring vanProjekbestuur. Analitiese en probleemoplossing. Fasilitering en koördinering. Ervaring in die implementering van doelwitte / planne, insluitend monitering, naspeuring en verslagdoening oor die status tot voltooiing van doelwitte. Vermoë om konseptueel te dink wanneer data ontleed en konsepte ontwerp word om korporatiewe beleide, prosedures en prosesse te wysig. Voorlegging en gemak om oortuigende argumente te skep en te kommunikeer vir die wysiging van 'n verloop van aksie. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Bereidwilligheid om te reis. Vermoë om onder druk en lang ure te werk.
af.duties: Fasiliteer die integrasie van beplanning, hulpbrontoewysing en prestasiebestuur van uitkomste van die Provinsiale Kantoor deur die Korporatiewe Bestuursraamwerk. Fasiliteer die uitreiking van 'n beplanningsraamwerk deur die Direktoraat: Strategiese Beplanning vir alle Provinsiale Kantore en moniteer die beplanningsproses van Provinsiale Kantore. Ontleed die Distrik Geïntegreerde Operasionele Planne en verseker belyning met die DLRRD Jaarlikse Prestasieplan. Ontleed Provinsiale Geïntegreerde Operasionele Planne en verseker belyning met die Distrik Operasionele Planne. Verseker goedkeuring (onderskrifting) van alle Distrikte en Provinsiale Geïntegreerde Operasionele Planne. Lei die ontwikkeling en implementering van konsekwente korporatiewe prestasiemonitering en -evaluering om te fokus op die lewer van uitkomste van die Provinsiale Kantoor se Jaarlikse Prestasieplan. Bestuur en implementeer evaluering- en navorsingsraamwerke. Moniteer die inisieer en uitvoer van navorsing en evaluering. Koördineer die integrasie van alle monitering- en evalueringstelsels binne die provinsie. Bestuur verslagdoeningsinstrumente en -nutsprogramme oor monitering en evaluering. Verseker robuuste bestuur, effektiewe besluitneming, waarde vir geld en toepaslike voordele word bereik deur korporatiewe aktiwiteite, beleid en strategie-raamwerke. Moniteer maandeliks en verskaf skriftelike verslae oor die funksionering van provinsiale bestuursstrukture. Woon lukraak die provinsiale bestuursstrukture by as deel van monitering van funksionering. Verskaf professionele advies en ondersteuning aan die Hoofdirekteur: Provinsiale Kantoor in gemeenskapsdeelname, gemeenskapsbeplanning, korporatiewe en operasionele beplanning, programprestasieverslagdoening, korporatiewe projek, beleid, strategie en infrastruktuuronwikkeling en -implementering, en korporatiewe bestuursontwikkeling en -implementering. Verskaf kwartaalverslae wat prestasierisiko's identifiseer en ingrypingsplanne en verbeterings vir operasionele doeltreffendheid en prestasieverbeterings aanbeveel. Berei halfjaarlikse geïntegreerde operasionele planprestasieverslae voor wat tendense en areas wat beleids- en stelselverbeterings benodig, duidelik identifiseer. Verskaf professionele advies soos wanneer die behoefte ontstaan en veral wanneer risiko's geïdentifiseer word. Verskaf bystand met die inisiëring, bestuur, koördinering en implementering van strategiese korporatiewe projekte. Integreer strategiese, operasionele en prestasiebestuursfunksies, -raamwerke en -stelsels, insluitend aanbevelings vir strategiese hulpbrontoewysing op provinsiale vlak. Verskaf bystand aan die Hoofdirekteur: Provinsiale Kantoor Koördinasie om die implementering van strategiese korporatiewe (kruis-provinsiale dienssentrums) projekte te inisieer en te koördineer om die Provinsiale Kantoor se vermoë om strategiese uitkomste en diensleweringdoelwitte te bereik te verbeter, met toepaslike diskresie wat uitgeoefen word om vereiste uitkomste te bereik. Moniteer die prestasie van die geïdentifiseerde DLRRD sleutelprogramme en fasiliteer die deling van die beste praktyke en lesse geleer deur provinsies deur die bestaande departementele bestuursstrukture. Moniteer implementering van Standaard Operasionele Prosedures by implementering van die departementele sleutelprogramme (verkry verslae van Direkteure, ontleed en produseer tweemaandelikse verslae). Vestig en handhaaf interne en eksterne netwerke om tendense en beste praktyke in korporatiewe bestuur te moniteer. Identifiseer instellings wat deel van die netwerke vir die DLRRD sal wees en laat 'n verslag deur die Hoofdirekteur goedkeur en fasiliteer die ontwikkeling van verhoudings en netwerke met daardie instellings. Verseker die handhawing van hierdie netwerke en voortgesette verhoudings. Benchmark met die geïdentifiseerde instellings om beste praktyke te verkry en lesse van hierdie instellings te leer een keer per jaar. Ontwikkel 'n verslag oor voorgestelde deurlopende verbetering. Ontwikkel Geïntegreerde Operasionele Planne prestasieverslagdoeningstelsel. Moniteer alle provinsiale prestasie teen die goedgekeurde Geïntegreerde Operasionele Planne maandeliks. Versoeke en kry maandelikse verslae van Direkteure. Ontleed die verslae (prestasie gerapporteer teen planne, redes vir afwyking en voorgestelde ingrypingsplanne). Konsolideer maandeliks die Provinsiale Prestasie tot een (1) Geïntegreerde Operasionele Prestasieplan.

zu.title: Umphathi: Ukwesekwa Kwezimisebenzi EYifundazwe
zu.summary: Kufunwa Umphathi Wokwesekwa Kwezimisebenzi EYifundazwe eMbombela ukwenza izindlelela zokuqamba izinhlelo, ukwabelwa izinsiza kanye nokuqashwa kokusebenza ngaphansi kohlaka Lokuqonda Okuzimele Kwezinkampani.
zu.requirements: Izidingo okungenakuphikiswa: Abafakeli kumele babe nesitifikedi se-Grade 12 kanye ne-Degree yesiqu noma i-Advanced Diploma ku-Public Administration / Business Administration / Public Management (NQF Level 7) noma iziqu ezifanayo ezihlobene nalokhu kanye nesitifikedi se-Nyukela (isitifikedi sokungena ku-SMS esinikezwa ngaphambi kokubekwa esikhundleni. Kumele ube neminyaka engu-5 yohlu lobuchule bokusebenza emazinga aphakathi / aphezulu okuphathi emkhakheni wokwesekwa kwezimisebenzi. Ilayisensi yokushayela emthethweni. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ukuqonda izimiso zokuqonda okuzimele kwezinkampani. Ikhono lokuphatha ukwesekwa kokusebenza kanye nezinhlelo zokuqaphela. Ulwazi ngamaphulo ohulumeni. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ikhono lokuxhumana ngempumelelo kubandakanya abantu abaningi. Ukuqonda okujulile kanye nolwazi lokusebenza loHlelo Lokuphatha Amaphrojekthi. Ukuhlaziya kanye nokuxazulula izinkinga. Ukwenza izindlelela kanye nokuhlanganisa. Okuhlangenakho ekusebenizeni izinhposo / izinhlelo, okuhlanganisa ukuqaphela, ukulandelana kanye nokubika inqubo eduze kokuqedwa kwenhposo. Ikhono lokucabanga ngokwemibono umakuhlaziya idatha nokwakha imibono yokulunga izinqubomgomo, izinqubo kanye namaphulo ezinkampani. Ukuthula okuhle ekwakheni nokuxhumana ngamaphuzu anamandla okulunga isu senqubo. Ukusebenzisa ikhakhombhuytha. Ukuzijwayeza ukuhamba. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwenkungaba nangamahora amade.
zu.duties: Yenza izindlelela zokuhlanganisa ukuqamba izinhlelo, ukwabelwa izinsiza nokuphatha ukusebenza kweziphumelelo zeNkundla Yefundazwe ngaphansi kohlaka Lokuqonda Okuzimele Kwezinkampani. Yenza izindlelela zokunikwa kohlaka hlelo lokuphathwa yi-Directorate: Strategic Planning yazo zonke iziNkundla Zefundazwe bese uqaphela inqubo yokuphathwa kweziNkundla Zefundazwe. Hlaziya amaphu ambalwa okusebenza ahlanganisiwe ahlezi isifunda uze uqiniseke ukuvumelana ne-DLRRD Annual Performance Plan. Hlaziya amaphu okusebenza ahlanganisiwe eYifundazwe uze uqiniseke ukuvumelana namaphu okusebenza ayisifunda. Qinisekisa ukugunyazwa (okusayiniwe) kwazo zonke amaphu okusebenza ahlanganisiwe ayisifunda neyifundazwe. Hola ekuthuthukiseni nakusebenizeni ukuqondwa okuhambisanayo kokusebenza kwezinkampani ukuze kuqashe ukulethwa kweziphumelelo zeNkundla Yefundazwe Yohlelo Lokusebenza LwamNyaka Yonke. Phatha futhi usebenzise amaqoqo okuhlola imibiko nokuphenya. Qaphela ukuqalwa nokwenziwa kwemibuko yokuphenya kanye nokuqondisisa. Hlanganisa ukuhlanganiswa kwazo zonke izinhlelo zokuqaphela nokuqondisisa ngaphakathi kwesifunda. Phatha izibhali nobuchophobuhle bokubuka emibikweni yokuqaphela nokuqondisisa. Qinisekisa ukuqondiswa okuqinile, ukwenza izinqumo ezinhle, ukuthola inzuzo yemali kanye nezinzuzo ezifanele ezitholwa ngemicimbi yezinkampani, izinqubomgomo kanye namaphu ayo. Qaphela nyanga zonke bese unikeza imibiko ebhalwayo ngokusebenza kwezinhlobo zokuqondiswa eYifundazwe. Zwa ukuya ngokungalandelile ezinhlobo zokuqondiswa eYifundazwe njengengxenye yokuqaphela ukusebenza. Nikeza izeluleko zobuchwepheshe kanye nokesekwa kuChief Director: Provincial Office ekuhlanganyeleni kwomphakathi, ekuqabeni izinhlelo zomphakathi, ekuqabeni izinhlelo zokusebenza kwezinkampani noma ukusebenza, ekubikweni ngokusebenza kwezinhlelo, ekuqabeni, kwesinqubomgomo, noma emqondo wokuqhutsa imikhakha, futhi ekuthuthukiseni nakusebenziseni kokuqondiswa okuzimele kwezinkampani. Nikeza imibiko yenyanga yonke yehlukanisa ukubekezela kwezinhlelo bese ukhetha izinhlelo zokungena ezingafaka isidingo nangaphezulu kokuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza zokusebenza nokuphathwa. Lungezela imibiko yokuqondiswa okuhlanganisiwe okusebenza ngesikhathi esingaphezulu konyaka esiveza kabanzi ukuthi kuyiphi indlela, izindawo ezidinga izinqubomgomo kanye nokuphuculwa kwezinhlelo. Nikeza izeluleko zobuchwepheshe sithi uma sikhona isidingo futhi ikakhulukazi uma kutholwa ubungozi. Siza ngokuqala, ukuphatha, ukuhlanganisa nokusebenzisa amaphrojekthi ezinkampani ezingaguquki kalula. Hlanganisa imisebenzi, amaphu nezinhlelo zokuphatha ukusetshenziswa kwamatholide angaphandle, ukuphatha ukusebenza nokuhlanganisa izingxenye ezinkomba ukwabelwa kwezinsiza eziguqukayo ezingeni leYifundazwe. Siza uChief Director: Provincial Office Coordination ukuqala futhi ahambe ekusebenziseni amaphrojekthi ezinkampani (izikhungo zokukhonzwa kufundazwe ngokuhamba kwezinsiza) ngokuqonda ukuthi kwakha isu lokuphucula amandla eNkundla Yefundazwe Yohlelo Lokusebenza LwamNyaka Yonke okungenzeka ngaphandle kokugunyazwa okuyisidingo. Qaphela ukusebenza kwezinhlelo eziyisidingo eziyisihluthulelo ze-DLRRD bese wenza izindlelela zokwabelana ngamakhono amahle kanye nezifundo eziyisifundo esifundwa yizifundazwe ngamaphu obulungu bomnyango. Qaphela ukusetshenziswa kwezinqubo ezijwayelekile zokusebenza kumphumela wokusebenza kohlelo oluyisihluthulelo bomnyango (thola imibiko kubaphathi, uyihlaziye futhi udale imibiko yenyanga ngayinye). Sika futhi ulondoloze uxhumo lwangaphakathi nangaphandle ukuze uqaphele amatholide kanye namakhono amahle okusebenza kokuqondiswa okuzimele kwamaphoyisa. xh.title: Umongameli: Inkxaso yeMisebenzi yePhondo
xh.summary: Kufunwa uMongameli weNkxaso yoMisebenzi wePhondo eMbombela ukunceda kolulwa ucwangciso, ukwaba iimveliso nolawulo lolusebenzo ngaphansi koBuntu bebuLungisa beNkampani.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezizingunaphakathi: Abafaki isicelo kufuneka babe nesiQinisekiso seQela le-12 kwaye naba neQhalaba loBizo okanye iDiploma ePhakamileyo kuLawulo lwakuLuntu / uLawulo loQhagamshelwano lweShishini / uLawulo lokuLuntu (iNqanaba le-7 le-NQF) okanye isifikelelo esinxulumeneko kwaye nabenesiQinisekiso seNyukela (isiQinisekiso sokuNgena ngaphambi koko kuMnyezo we-SMS) esinikwa ngaphambi kokwamkelwa. Kufuneka abe neminye eli-5 yamava kwinqanaba eliphakathi / eliphezulu lolawulo kwimeko yenkxaso yomisebenzi. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo. Ulwazi oluxhomekeke kumsebenzi: Ukuqonda iingcamango zobulungisa beNkampani. Amandla okusebenzisa iinkqubo zolawulo lolusebenzo nokuqwalasela. Ulwazi ngeenkqubo kahulumathe. Amandla axhomekeke kumsebenzi: Amandla okunxibelelana ngokusebenzayo kuwo wonke amanqanaba. Ukuqonda ngokupheleleyo nokuqonda ngokwenene iLawulo loMsebenzi woMnyezo. Ukuhlalutya nokuxazula iingxaki. Ukunceda kolulwa nokuqhubana. Amava ekusebenziseni iinjongo / iicwangciso, kuquka ukuqwalasela, ukulandela nokubika isimo ngokufezekiswa kwenjongo. Amandla okucinga ngokuyilwa naxa uhlalutya iingcombolo naxa uyila iingcamango ukutshintsha iinqobo, iinkqubo nendlela zebuLungisa beNkampani. Ukubonisa nokuqinisekisa ukudalwa nokunxibelelana kweengxoxo ezinamandla zokutshintsha indlela yomsebenzi. Ukusebenza ngekhompyutha. Ukuzimisela ukuhamba. Amandla okusebenza ngaphantsi kwexinxaka nangamaxa amade.
xh.duties: Unceda kolulwa ukudibanisa ucwangciso, ukwaba iimveliso nolawulo lolusebenzo lweziphumo zoMnyezo wePhondo ngaphansi koBuntu bebuLungisa beNkampani. Unceda kolulwa ukupapasha koludwe lwendlela yocwangciso nguMmandla: uCwangciso lokuQonda lazo zonke iMnyezo zePhondo aze aqwalasele inkqubo yocwangciso yoMnyezo wePhondo. Uhlalutya iCwangciso zoBusebenzi eDityanisiweyo zeSithili aze aqinisekise ukulungelelanisa neCwangciso loMnyezo loNyaka ka-DLRRD. Uhlalutya iCwangciso zoBusebenzi eDityanisiweyo zePhondo aze aqinisekise ukulungelelanisa neCwangciso zoBusebenzi zeSithili. Uqinisekisa ukwamkelwa (ukuSayina) kuzo zonke iCwangciso zoBusebenzi eDityanisiweyo zeSithili nasePhondo. Ukulosa okuqhubekayo phantsi kolusebenzo ngokusisezindlela ezizezinye kwinkqubo yokuSebenza kwaye azisebenzise iNkqubo yoQwalaselo loMsebenzi kaNnyezo oMnye weSizwe. Unceda kolulwa upapasho loludwe ngumanyezelwa weCwangciso oQondisiweyo. Uyilisa inkqubo yokuQwalasela nokubeka ngaphambili kwaye ayisebenzise kuyo yonke iminyezo yoMnyezo. Unika inkxaso yamakhono kuloMongameli oMkhulu woMnyezo kumisebenzi yoluntu, ekunikezelwa koludwe lweziPhondo, uqoqosho nolwa polisi, isixhobo seNkqubo seendlela ezibhalwayo zokuQwalasela nokuBika ngemisebenzi yamakhulu amabini namaninani amabini kwakhona nawaphesheya kweendawo, iziko lokuQwalasela loBulungisa beNkampani nokuNika amakhulu amathathu noBulungisa beNkampani namakhulu amaninzi ezigqibo ngokusetyenziswa koluntu ngokwawonke uluntu noluntu ngokubumbeko ekunye kwiziPhondo. Unceda kolulwa ukulungelelanisa nokuSetyenziswa koluntu, inkqubo yokubeka kwangaphambili nokuQwalasela ngakumbi iNkqubo yokwamkelwa kweNkqubo yokuNgeniswa ngaphandle ngokubaluleka ngokusetyenziswa kwendlu yoluntu ngokusebenzisa iNkqubo yoLawulo lweziPhakade nokuSetyenziswa koluntu ngokubaluleka iNkqubo yoluntu kwaye uxhobe iNkqubo yoLawulo lwezinto ezibalulekileyo eziNqanaba nasemizini yokuLawulo kwakunye nokuQwalasela iNkqubo iNkqubo yoluntu nakwelinye ilizwe ukuze kubekho iiNkqubo ezizezinye ezibonelela ngokusebenzisa iNkqubo eNdalo yeDlrrd aze angene kuloMongameli oMkhulu weeNkcukacha nakuqwalasela ukusebenza ngokusetyenziswa kweziNkqubo ezibonelela ngokusebenzisa iNkqubo yokusebenzisa iNkqubo yoluntu njengoko kubalulekile. Unika iNkqubo yoQwalasela iNkqubo yoluntu iNkqubo ezeNgqindilili kunye noQwalaselo lwamakhulu amathathu kwiinkqubo zokuHamba ukuza kwiNkqubo yeNkqubo eyodwa (1) yeNkqubo yoBusebenzi eDityanisiweyo.

af.title: Senior Administratiewe Beampte
af.summary: Senior Administrative Officer-pos in Cape Town wat R413001 per jaar bied, met 'n vereiste van 'n National Diploma in Public Administration en twee jaar se administrasie-ervaring.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n National Diploma in Public Administration / Public Management / Business Administration / Business Management of 'n relevante eweknie-kwalifikasie. Minimum van 2 jaar se ervaring in 'n administratiewe omgewing. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Werksverwante kennis: Public Service Regulations, finansiële prosedures, Treasury Regulations en Basic Accounting System (BAS). Werksverwante vaardighede: Rekenaarvaardigheid, interpersoonlike verhoudinge, organisering en beplanning, kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik), analitiese denke, probleemoplossingsvermoë, finansiële bestuur en verslagskryf. Werk onder druk, spanwerk en bereidwilligheid om ekstra ure te werk.
af.duties: Verskaf finansiële bestuursdienste. Fasiliteer, beplan, hou toesig oor en dryf die tydige en akkurate voorbereiding van die jaarlikse begroting in ooreenstemming met die Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Treasury Regulations strategiese prioriteite weekliks / maandeliks / kwartaalliks. Stel Demand Management Plan (DMP), Medium Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF), aanpassingsramings en Estimated National Expenditure (ENE) op. Hou toesig oor doeltreffende, effektiewe en ekonomiese benutting van fondse. Dokumenteer en kommunikeer prosedures vir toegang tot en verskuiwing van fondse. Koördineer begroting, oudit en finansiële funksies. Verifieer Transport and Subsistence (T&S) en diverse en oortyd-betalings. Administreer die verkryging van goedere en dienste. Stel, bestuur en onderhou die Demand Management Plan. Fasiliteer Supply Chain Management (SCM) dienste. Fasiliteer maandelikse, kwartaallikse en jaarlikse verslagdoening oor SCM-verwante aangeleenthede. Beheer die veilige bewaring, benutting en instandhouding van alle bates. Verseker behoorlike administrasie van die sourcing en evaluering van kwotasies. Vang en magtig goedere / dienste op die LOGIS-stelsel. Hanteer navrae van interne en eksterne kliënte rakende verskaffingsketting-aangeleenthede. Verskaf algemene kantoorondersteuningsdienste. Onderrig, motiveer en ontwikkel personeel deur middel van individuele prestasie-ooreenkomste. Verskaf bystand by die opstelling/hersiening van die operasionele plan. Stel verskeie voorleggings/memorandums en antwoorde op. Skenk aandag aan navrae van Internal Audit. Administreer verlofvorms / hanteer navrae. Doen reis/konferensie-besprekings en bevestigings. Verskaf sekretariatsdienste. Kontroleer konsepnotules vir akkuraatheid teen opnames van notas. Administreer bates. Onderhou bate-register. Skakel met bate-eenheid gedurende bate-verifikasie. Bestee uitgaande en lopende bates. Ken toerusting aan amptenare toe.

zu.title: Umphathi Omkhulu Wokuphathwa Kwamafa
zu.summary: Isikhundla somgcinamafa ophakeme eCape Town esihlinzeka ngo-R413001 ngonyaka, esidinga i-National Diploma ku-Public Administration kanye neminyaka emibili yohlotshaniswa lolawulo.
zu.requirements: Kufuneka kuse be okuncane okudingwayo: Abafakwayo kumele babe nesitifiketi se-Grade 12 kanye ne-National Diploma ku-Public Administration / Public Management / Business Administration / Business Management noma iziqu ezingokulinganisa okuhlobene. Okuncane iminyaka engu-2 yokuhlotshaniswa emhlabeni wophatho. Ilayisenisi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Izimiso ze-Public Service Regulations, izindlela zezimali, izimiso ze-Treasury kanye ne-Basic Accounting System (BAS). Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukubhala ngokwesistimu, ubudlelwano ngokomuntu, ukuhlela nokuhlela isikhathi, ukuxhumana (ngomlomo nakubhalwe), ukucabanga ukohlukanisa, ikhono lokuxazulula izinkinga, ukuphathwa kwezimali kanye nokubhala imibiko. Ukusebenza ngwenhliziyo, ukusebenza ngokubumba kanye nokuvuma ukusebenza amasikhathi okwedlule.
zu.duties: Hlinzeka ngesevisi yezimali. Qondisa, hlela, qaphela, qhuba ukulungiselelwa okusheshise okunembile kwesabelo somnyaka sonyaka ngokuvumelana ne-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), izinqunqo zeTreasury namaphambili aphathelene nomthethosisekelo ngesonto / ngenyanga / nhlangathela. Hlanganisa i-Demand Management Plan (DMP), i-Medium Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF), ukulinganisa okulungisiwe kanye ne-Estimated National Expenditure (ENE). Qaphela ukusetshenziswa okusebenzayo, okunempumelelo nokugcina imali. Qamba futhi uxhumane izindlela zokuviswa nentshontshwa kwemali. Lawula ukulinganiselwa kwesabelo, ukuhlolwa kanye nemisebenzi yezimali. Qinisekisa ukuhlinzeka ngesikhathi kwe-Transport and Subsistence (T&S) kanye nentela yezinsuku kwezinye izinto kanye nentela yamasikhathi womsebenzi owedlule. Phatha ukuthenga kwezimpahla kanye nesevisi. Hlanganisa, phatha futhi gcina i-Demand Management Plan. Qondisa izinsizakalo ze-Supply Chain Management (SCM). Qondisa ukubika ngenyanga, ngenhlangathela kanye nonyaka ngezindaba ezihlobene ne-SCM. Lawula ukugcina okuphephile, ukusetshenziswa kanye nokulondolozwa kwawo wonke amafa. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa ngokufanele kokuqasha kanye nokuqonda kwezitesi. Faka futhi uvume impahla / isevisi kwisistim ye-LOGIS. Phathisela imibuzo evela kubathakeli bendlango yangaphakathi nangaphandle ehlobene nezindaba zenhlangano yomthengisi. Hlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zesikhungo. Qaphisa, hlambe futhi uthuthukise izisebenzi ngemvumelwano ngemisebenzi yomuntu ngamunye. Hlinzeka ngosizo ekwakheni / ukuhlola kabusha khwehle lohlelo lokusebenza. Hlanganisa izincomoloshlo ezihlukene / izaziso kanye nempendulo. Phathisela imibuzo evela kwi-Internal Audit. Phatha amafomu wokuphumula / phathisela imibuzo. Yenza ukubhuka / ukubhukuda izindaba zohambo / izinkambiso futhi uqinisekise. Hlinzeka ngemisebenzi yamabhodi abalulekile. Hlola iminethi yekhophi ngokuqinisekisa ngokuqhathaniswa nokubhalwa kwezinkomba. Phatha amafa. Gcina ukubhaliswa kwamafa. Xhumana nenhlangano yamafa ngesikhathi sokuqinisekisa amafa. Phatha okungenayo nakokuphela kwamafa. Amathuluzi abalwa kubasebenzi.

xh.title: Senior Administrative Officer
xh.summary: Isithuba seSenior Administrative Officer eCape Town esinika R413001 ngonyaka, sifuna iNational Diploma kwiPublic Administration kunye neminyaka emibini yamava kulawulo.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezisisiseko: Abafaki isicelo kufuneka babe neSatifikethi seQeli 12 kwaye beNdiploma yesiZwe kuLawulo loLuntu / uLawulo loLuntu / uLawulo lweShishini / uLawulo lweShishini okanye izidanga ezifanayo ezifanelekileyo. Ungaphantsi kweminyaka emi-2 yamava kwimeko yolawulo. Ifayile yelayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ulwazi oluhambelana nomsebenzi: Iimigaqo yeNkonzo yoLuntu, iinkqubo zeMali, Iimigaqo yeNgxowa-mali kunye neNkqubo yoBhalo nokuTshaya iCwecwe (BAS). Amandla ahambelana nomsebenzi: Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, Ubudlelwane phakathi kwabantu, uKuqamba nokuCwangcisa, uNxibelelwano (ngolwimi lwesidlane nolubhalwayo), uKucinga ngokucocoza, Amandla okuSombulula iingxaki, uLawulo lweMali nokuBhala iingxelo. Ukusebenza ngxamiseko, uKusebenza njengeqela nokuzimisela ukusebenza iiyure ezongezelelweyo.
xh.duties: Bonezela iinkonzo zolawulo lwemali. Qhubeza, cwenga, lawule, qhuba ulungiselelo oluchanekileyo nangexesha elilungileyo lwesinqumo sonyaka ngokweMthetho woLawulo lweMali yoLuntu (PFMA), Izinto eziBaluleleyo zeNgcenye yeNgeniso, iiveki / nyanga / nkwamakhulu. Hlela iPlani yoLawulo loMfuno (DMP), uPhando loMgaqo-wekho wokuSebenzisa iMali ixesha eliphakathi (MTEF), uLungelelwaniso lwamaxabiso, kwaye ulungelelanise uQikelelo lokuSebenzisa iNgcenye yoLuntu (ENE). Lawula ukusebenzisa imali ngokusebenza kakuhle, ngokuchanekileyo nangokuchitha kancinci. Bhala ichaza iinkqubo zokufumana nokuguqula imali. Lawula inkqubo yesinqumo, ukuhlolwa kwemali nemisebenzi eyimali. Qinisekisa uHambio loKuthutha nokuSweleka (T&S) nakwezinye iinkhetho nentlawulo yexesha elongezelelweyo. Lawula ukuthenga izinto kunye neenkonzo. Hlela, lawula kwaye ulugcine uLungelelwaniso loLawulo loMfuno. Qhubeza iinkonzo zoLawulo loQhagamshelo lweziQendu zokuThenga (SCM). Qhubeza ukuxela ngenyanga, ngenkwarhu, ngonyaka ngemiba ehambelana ne-SCM. Lawula ukugcinwa, ukusetyenziswa nolondolozo lweempahla zonke. Qinisekisa ulawulo olululo lokufumana nokuhlola iivoti. Faka kwaye uvume izinto / iinkonzo kwinkqubo ye-LOGIS. Phatha imibuzo ivela kumaxhaso angaphakathi nangaphandle ehambelana nemiba yokuqhuba imigca. Zenza iinkonzo ze-ofisi eziqhelekileyo. Lawula, gqrutha kwaye uphucule abasebenzi ngemvumelwano ngemisebenzi yabo. Nika inkxaso ekwakheni / ukuhlola iplani yokusebenza. Hlela iingxelo ezahlukeneyo / iimemo kunye neempendulo. Phendula imibuzo evela kuQeqesho angaphakathi. Lawula amafomu okushiya / uphendule imibuzo. Yenza iibhuki zokuhamba / iikonfarensi kwaye uqinisekise. Bonezela iinkonzo zesikrondo. Phepha kwangaphambili imizuzu ukujonga ukuba yichanekile ngokumelene nokubhalwa kweenqaku. Lawula impahla. Gcina irejista yempahla. Thintathuse kunye nenqanaba lempahla ngelixa kuqatshelwa impahla. Lawula impahla ephumayo neseleyo.abelisa izixhobo kubasebenzi.

Hlinzeka, hlela, qaphela, qhuba ukulungiselelwa okusheshiseyo nokuchanekileyo kobuchule bonyaka ngokuhambisana ne-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), izinto eziyisihloko eziyinhloko ze-Treasury Regulations ngesonto / nyanga / kota.
