Qaphela ukusetshenziswa okusebenzayo, okusebenza kahle futhi okugwema ukuchithwa kwemali. Qamba futhi wazise ngalezo zinqubo zokuthola nokushintsha imali. Hlela ngokubambisene ukumisa amabhajethi, ukuhlola nokusebenza kwemali. Qinisekisa i-Transport and Subsistence (T&S) kanye nemali yokuhamba kwezinye izinto nokuqasha ngaphezu kwesikhathi. Phatha ukuthenga izimpahla kanye namasevisi. Qamba, phatha futhi ulondoloze i-Demand Management Plan. Hlinzeka ngamasevisi e-Supply Chain Management (SCM). Hlinzeka ngemibiko yamnye, yekota kanye nenyanga yamayikhombe ahambisana ne-SCM. Lawula ukugcina, ukusetshenziswa kanye nokuqashwa kwaleyo ndawo yazo zonke izimpahla. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa okulungile kokuthola kanye nokuhlola izikhalazeli. Faka futhi vumela izimpahla / amasevisi kuleso sikgabhasi i-LOGIS. Shwephesha imibuzo evela kubathengi baphakathi kanye nalabo baphandle ephathelene nezinto zokuqasha. Yisa izinhlelo zokusekela endaweni yokusebenza. Qaphisa, khuthaza futhi thuthukise abasebenzi ngokuqashwa ngamunye ngemvume yawo. Siza ekuthuthukiseni / ukubuyekezeni uhlelo lwangaphandle. Qamba izincazelo ezehlukene / izinkumbulo kanye nezimpendulo. Yala imibuzo evela ku-Internal Audit. Phatha amafomu esikhathi esingangeni endaweni yokusebenza / yala imibuzo. Yenza izibukelo / izibukelo zoxhumano namanje kanye nezikhalazeli. Yethula amasevisi othuba. Hlola ukulungile kwemizuzu ekhishiwe ukuze kuboniswe ukuchaneka kwayo ngokubaqoqwayo. Phatha izimpahla. Gcina ibhalo lesampulu. Xhumana nehlelo lezimpahla ngesikhathi sokuhlolwa kwezimpahla. Lawula izimpahla eziphuma kanye nalawo ezingaphandle. Yabelanisa amathuluzi abasebenzi.

xh.title: Umsebenzi Wolawulo Ophakamileyo
xh.summary: Isithuba somsebenzi wolawulo ophakamileyo e Cape Town esinikezela ngo R413001 ngonyaka kwi Level 8, sifuna i-National Diploma neminyaka emibini yamava olawulo.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingungatshwanga abantu: Abafaki isicelo kufuneka babe nesatifikethda se Grade 12 ne-National Diploma kwi Public Administration / Public Management / Business Administration / Business Management okanye nesiMfuno esilinganayo. Ubuncinane beminyaka engama-2 yamava kwimeko yolawulo. Ilayisenisi yomqhubi egqityiweyo. Ulwazi oluhambelana nomsebenzi: I-South African Public Service Regulations, iinkqubo zemali, i-Treasury Regulations ne-Basic Accounting System (BAS). Amakhono ahambelana nomsebenzi: Ukusebenza ngemikhumbi nokuzincedisa, Ukuhlelana koluntu, Ulungiselelo nokuqamba, Unxibelelwano (ngomlomo nangokubhalwayo), Ukuqonda ngokucinga, Isakhono somxholo wengxaki, Ulawulo lwemali nokuwaloba iirapothi. Ukusebenza ngaphantsi kwengxaki, Ukusebenza njengeqela nokuzimisela ukusebenza iiyure ezongezelelweyo.
xh.duties: Kwanikezwa iinkonzo zolawulo lwemali. Ukwenza uxhwebo, ukucwangcisa, ukulawula nokuqhutywa ngokuchanekileyo nangexesha elichanekileyo lolungelelwaniso lonyaka ngokwe-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), iinkqubo ezibalulekileyo ze-Treasury Regulations ngeveki / ngenyanga / ngekwiktha. Ukuqamba i-Demand Management Plan (DMP), i-Medium Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF), ulawulo olulungiselelwe kwaye ulungiswa ngokunesilinganiselo kwi-Estimated National Expenditure (ENE). Ukugcina ukuba urhola iimali ezisebenzayo, ezichanekileyo neziliguguweyo. Ukubhala nokwazisa iinkqubo zokufumana nokusuka kwimali ukuya kwenye. Ukulungelelanisa ulungelelwaniso lweNgxowomali, ukuqhutywa kwemali kwaseburhulumente nokuqhutywa kweempahla. Ukutshata iimali zokuHamba nokuNdiza (T&S) ngezinye iimali ezingenamsebenzi thile nezimali zokusebenza ngeyure ezingaphezu kwemithetho. Ukulawula ukuthengwa kweempahla naziinkonzo. Ukulungiselela, ukulawula nokuqhuba i-Demand Management Plan. Ukuqhutywa kwe-Supply Chain Management (SCM). Ukwenza ukuqhutywa kwemali, amamemoranda kunye nokubika kwexesha ngexesha ngokuqhutywa kolawulo lwe-Supply Chain. Ukulawula ukugcinwa, ukusetyenziswa nokulondolozwa kweempahla. Ukugcina ukuba ukulawulwa kokuqhutywa kwemali kuyenzeka ngokufanelekileyo kwi-system ye-LOGIS. Ukuphendula iimbuzo evela kubakhenkethi abangaphakathi nangaphandle ngokuqhutywa kwe-Supply Chain. Kukho inkonzo yoxhaso lohambo jikelele. Ukulawula, ukuxhasa nokukhuthaza abasebenzi ngokuqinisekiswa ngokwemisebenzi yabo. Ukunika inkxaso ekuthengwa nokuqhutywa kweempahla. Ukulungelelanisa iindululo ezahlukeneyo / amamemoranda kwaye kwanikeza iimpendulo. Ukuphendula iimbuzo evela kwabaholi baseKhomishini. Ukugcina iifomu zokushiya inkonzo / ukuphendula iimbuzo. Ukwenza ulungiselelo lokuhamba nokuqhutywa kwezindaba zeNgqungquthela. Kukho inkonzo zentshenyelwa yeNkundla. Ukutshata iiyure ezahlukeneyo ngokuchanekileyo kumalinge namaphuphu amakhulu. Ukulawula iimpahla ezifunekayo ngokutsha kwaye zicace ngokwengxoxo yayo. Ukubhala iirekhodi ngemali efunwayo kumthetho olandelayo kwindlu yethu.

jobs.title: Secretary
jobs.summary: Seeking a Grade 12 certificate holder with computer literacy to provide secretariat and receptionist support to the Director at Level 05 in Mmabatho.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12 Certificate. Job related knowledge: Computer literacy (Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, etc.) Job related skills: Good telephone etiquette. Sound organisational ability. Good people skills. Computer literacy. Ability to communicate well with people at different levels and from different backgrounds (both written and verbal). Ability to act with tact and discretion.
jobs.duties: Provide a secretariat / receptionist support service to the Director. Receive telephone calls and refer the calls to the correct role players if not meant for the relevant senior manager. Record appointments and events in the diary. Type documents for the senior manager and other staff within the unit. Operate office equipment e.g. computers and photocopiers. Provide a clerical support service to the Senior Manager. Liaise with travel agencies to make travel arrangements. Check arrangements when relevant documents are received. Arrange meetings and events for the senior manager and the staff in the unit. Identifies venues, invite role players, organise refreshments and sets up schedules for meeting and events. Process the travel and subsistence claims for the unit. Process all invoices that emanate from the activities of the work of the senior manager. Records basic minutes of meetings of the senior manager where required. Draft routine correspondence and reports. Do filing of documents for the senior manager and the unit where necessary. Administer matters like leave registers and telephonic accounts. Receive, records and distributes all incoming and outgoing documents. Handle the procurement of standard items like stationary, refreshments etc. Collects all relevant documents to enable the Director to prepare for meetings. Remains up to date with regard to prescripts / policies and procedures applicable to her / his work environment to ensure efficient and effective support to the senior manager. Study the relevant public service and the departmental prescripts / policies and other documents to ensure that the application thereof is understood properly. Keep abreast with the procedures and process that apply in the office of the senior manager.
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to: Cnr James Moroka and Sekame Drive, West Gallery, Megacity, Mmabatho, 2735 or by email to Post211@dlrrd.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE Targets: African, Indian and White Males and African, Indian and White Females and Persons with Disabilities.

af.title: Sekretaresse
af.summary: Soek 'n Graad 12-sertifikaathouer met rekenaargeletterdheid om sekretariële en ontvangsondersteuning aan die Direkteur te verskaf op Vlak 05 in Mmabatho.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet oor 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat beskik. Werksverwante kennis: Rekenaargeletterdheid (Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, ens.). Werksverwante vaardighede: Goeie telefoonetiket. Gesonde organisatoriese vermoë. Goeie mensevaardighede. Rekenaargeletterdheid. Vermoë om goed met mense op verskillende vlakke en uit verskillende agtergronde te kommunikeer (sowel skriftelik as mondelings). Vermoë om met takt en diskresie op te tree.
af.duties: Verskaf 'n sekretariaats- / ontvangsondersteuningsdiens aan die Direkteur. Neem telefoonoproepe in aanwang en verwys oproepe na die korrete rolspelers indien dit nie vir die betrokke seniorbestuurder bedoel is nie. Noteer afsprake en geleenthede in die dagboek. Tik dokumente vir die seniorbestuurder en ander personeel binne die eenheid. Bedryf kantoor.toerusting byvoorbeeld rekenaars en fotokopieerders. Verskaf 'n klerklike ondersteuningsdiens aan die seniorbestuurder. Skakel met reisagentskappe om reiereëlings te tref. Kontroleer reëlings wanneer tersaaklike dokumente ontvang word. Reël vergaderings en geleenthede vir die seniorbestuurder en die personeel in die eenheid. Identifiseer plekke, nooi rolspelers uit, organiseer verversings en stel skedules op vir vergaderings en geleenthede. Verwerk die reis- en subsistensie-eise vir die eenheid. Verwerk alle fakture wat voortvloei uit die aktiwiteite van die werk van die seniorbestuurder. Neem basiese notule van vergaderings van die seniorbestuurder waar nodig. Opstel roetinekorrespondensie en verslae. Doen indien nodig lêerwerk van dokumente vir die seniorbestuurder en die eenheid. Administreer sake soos verlofregisters en telefoonrekenings. Ontvang, noteer en versprei alle inkomende en uitgaande dokumente. Hanter die verkryging van standaarditems soos skryfbehoeftes, verversings ens. Versamel alle tersaaklike dokumente om die Direkteur in staat te stel om vir vergaderings voor te berei. Bly op hoogte van voorskrifte / beleide en prosedures wat van toepassing is op haar / sy werkomgewing om doeltreffende en effektiewe ondersteuning aan die seniorbestuurder te verseker. Bestudeer die tersaaklike staatsdiens- en departementele voorskrifte / beleide en ander dokumente om te verseker dat die toepassing daarvan behoorlik verstaan word. Hou treden met die prosedures en prosesse wat in die kantoor van die seniorbestuurder van toepassing is.

zu.title: Unobhala
zu.summary: Sifuna umuntu onemfundo ye-Grade 12 futhi osebenzise kahle ikhompyutha ukunikeza inkonzo yobuhlalu-nkezo nokwamukela abavakashi kwi-Director ezingeni 05 eMmabatho.
zu.requirements: Izidingo okungenakungalahlwa: Abafaka izeluleko kumele babe nesitifiketi se-Grade 12. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, njll.) Izindlela ezihlobene nomsebenzi: Indlela ehle yokukhuluma efoni. Ikhono elihle lokuhlela. Izindlela ezinhle zokusebenza nabantu. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ikhono lokuxhumana kahle nabantu bezinga elihlukene futhi abavela kwezindlela ezihlukene (kokubhalwayo nokukhulunwayo). Ikhono lokuziphatha ngobuhlakani kanye nokugcina imfihlo.
zu.duties: Nika inkonzo yobuhlalu-nkezo / yokwamukela abavakashi kwi-Director. Amukele amakholi efoni futhi adlulise kubantu abafanele uma engabhoqa kuphathi ophakeme ohlobene nalowo. Bhalise izinhlelo zemibhaliso nezinkomisho kukhalenda. Bhala amadokhumenti kuphathi ophakeme kanye nabanye abasebenzi ohlelweni. Setha izinsiza zehhovu njengekhompyutha namashaya-mapeyiphangxadi. Nikeza inkonzo yabahleli kuphathi ophakeme. Xhumanise nezinkezo zokuhamba ukwenza izinhlelo zokuhamba. Hlola izinhlelo lapho amadokhumenti ahlobene ahlolwa. Hlela izinkomisho nezinkathi kuphathi ophakeme kanye nabasebenzi ohlelweni. Thola izikhungo, mema abantu abaphathekayo, hlela iziphuzo futhi usethe izinkathi zezinkomisho nezinkathi. Qhuba izimali zokuhamba kanye nezimali zokuphila ehhhovini. Qhuba zonke izikweletu eziphuma emisebenzini yophathi ophakeme. Bhala iminethi yezinkomisho zophathi ophakemo lapho kudingeka. Bhala imininingwane ejwayelekile nemibiko. Yenza ukugcina kwamadokhumenti kuphathi ophakeme nohhovini lapho kudingeka. Phatha izindaba ezinjengokubhaliswa kwamadini ihhovu kanye nama-akhawunti efoni. Thola, bhaleze ululeke zonke iziqalekiso ezifakwa naseziphumayo. Phatha ukuthenga izinto ezenzakalelayo ezinjengamaphepha, iziphuzo njll. Qoqa wonke amadokhumenti ahlobene ukuze akwazi ukuhunyushwa kukaholi-ihhovu ngaphambi kwezinkomisho. Hlala uyazi ngemithetho / izinqubomgomo kanye nenqubo ezenza kuleminyuzi yakhe / hhovini lakhe ukuze anikeze inkonzo ephumelelayo futhi esebenzayo kuphathi ophakeme. Fundisa imithetho yomphakathi kanye nengxenye yomnyango / izinqubomgomo neminye imibhalo ukuze ukuqonda isebenza kabuhlungu. Hlala uyazi ngenqubo kanye neqhuba ebuthweni bophathi ophakeme.

xh.title: Unobozana
xh.summary: Kufunusiwe umntu onegqabo lesidanga se-12 onesiphatho kumanabakompyutha ukunika inkxaso yokuba nobozana nasekubeni namkelwani kwiMlawuli kwinqanaba le-05 eMmabatho.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingaphantsi: Abafaki isicelo kufuneka babe nesatikhethte lesidanga se-12. Ulwazi oluhambelana nomsebenzi: Ulwazi lokusebenza ngokwesiphatho kumanabakompyutha (Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, njl). Amakhono ahambelana nomsebenzi: Indlela elungileyo yethetha ngomnxeba. Ikono elilodwa lokuhlela izinto. Amakhono alungileyo aphathwa ngabantu. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngokwesiphatho kumanabakompyutha. Ikono lokunxiba ngendlela efanelekileyo nabantu abakumazantsi amanqanaba ahlukeneyo evela kumaphiko ahlukeneyo (kubhaliwe nasekuthethweni). Ikono lokuzipatha ngendlela echasene nolwalamano olubhekwa iyoyo into ekumgangatho othile.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso yesebe lokuba nobozana / ekubeni namkelwani kwiMlawuli. Amkela amacandi ommxeba uze awaphathise kubantu abafaneleyo ukuba engabikho kumongameli ophakamileyo. Qulatha izicelo zokubonisana nemiganu kwincwadi yemiganu. Thetha amaxwebhu kuze kubengameli ophakamileyo nakubasebenzi abakulesebe. Sebenzisa izixhobo zofise njengamakompyutha nezikitshi-zixhobo zamaphepha. Nika inkxaso yeklirhiki kumongameli ophakamileyo. Thathana nemiqulu yokuhamba ukwenza isikhokelo sokuhamba. Hlola izikhokelo xa kufika amaxwebhu afaneleyo. Hlela iintlanganiso nemiganu kumongameli ophakamileyo nasebasebenzi bakulesebe. Chonga izindlu zokuhlangana, mema abo baya kuzithatha inxaxheba, hlela ukutya kunye nokusela, uze umishe iinkqubo zemizuzu nakuqaliswa kweziganeko zemiganu yemiboniso yexesha elithile, kwaye ukhuphe imifanekiso yokubakho kwento esemthethweni ityhilwa kumlinganiso wokwakhiwa. Yinga iingxelo ngemfanelo nokutyeleleka koluntu. Tsala ukubhaliswa kwamaxwebhu, hlela amaxwebhu afanelekileyo wokusetyenziswa kwindawo yakho yomsebenzi. Xela nokugcina ulwazi olumamisayo lwamaxwebhu ahambelana nomsebenzi wakho kunye noyilo lwemigaqo ehleli kwikomkhulu lokuhamba phantsi.

jobs.title: Medical Inspector
jobs.department: Department of Mineral and Petroleum Resources
jobs.summary: Medical Inspector role at the Department of Mineral and Petroleum Resources in Pretoria, requiring an MBCHB degree and Occupational Medicine qualification to oversee mine health compliance.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate MBCHB Degree and a postgraduate qualification in Occupational Medicine (NQF 10). Registered with the HPCSA. Certificate for entry into SMS. Valid driver's license Plus minimum of 5 years senior/middle management level in Occupational Health/ Medicine and work as an OMP in the mines, Knowledge of: Knowledge of Mine Health and Safety Act and other occupational health related prescripts, knowledge of the mining sector in South Africa and internationally, Knowledge of policy development techniques, Knowledge of policy analysis processes, Knowledge of international legislation and local legislation and interface with mines’ health regulations, Knowledge of research processes, knowledge of the Occupational Health trends and challenges, Knowledge of the public service legislation Skills: Management of people and finances, Strategic development and implementation, Policy development, Networking skills, presentation and report writing skills, Stakeholder management, Communication skills, Project management skills, General management skills Thinking Demand: Rigorous non-corruption thinking relating in the development and implementation of plans and strategy, Managerial mindset relating to economics, Ability to source or identify sources of credible information from local and international sources.
jobs.duties: Resolve disputes on findings of medical unfitness of mine employees through the appeals process as provided for in the MHS Act. Collect and analyse statistics gathered from Medical Reports. Coordinate and ensure quality assurance of the process to receive and archive mine closure employee medical records. Participate /make inputs in mine health and safety accidents/ accident investigations (occupational medicine). Liaise/collaborate with relevant compensation houses with aspects related to compensation. Provide specialist advice/ information regarding HIV/AIDS/TB in the mining industry and liaise with the Department of Health and other relevant organisations dealing with TB/HIV. Manage the Directorate.
jobs.applications: Applicants must be submitted via DMPR E-Recruitment System accessible using the following link: https://erecruitment.dmpr.gov.za Applications must create a user profile by completing all required personal information and setting up your login credential on DMPR E-Recruitment System. Once registration is complete and logged in to the system, you may browse all vacant positions. Another option is to submit application by post or courier, quoting relevant reference, addressed to: The Director-General, Department of Mineral and Petroleum Resources, Private Bag X59, Pretoria, 0001. Alternatively, applications may also be hand delivered to Trevenna Campus, corner Meintjies and Francis Baard Street, former Schoeman. General enquiries may be brought to the attention of Ms T Gumede Tel No: (012) 444- 3319.
jobs.notes: No appointment shall be affected without the recommended candidate producing a Certificate of completion for the SMS Pre-Entry Programme (Nyukela) offered by the National School of Government, which can be accessed via this link: https://www.thensg.gov.za. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. The Candidate will have to disclose her/ his financial Interests. Applications are strongly advised to complete and attach recent Z83 application form which came into effect from 01 January 2021 as issued by the Minister of Public Service Administration in line with regulation 10 of the Public Service Regulations, 2016 as amended, which is obtainable online from www.dpsa.gov.za and detailed Curriculum Vitae when submitting applications on DMPR E-Recruitment System. Applications must be submitted on the recent Z83 application form which came into effect from 01 January 2021 as issued by the Minister of Public Service Administration in line with regulation 10 of the Public Service Regulations, 2016 as amended, which is obtainable online from www.gov.za and www.dpsa.gov.za. All sections of the Z83 must be completed (In full, accurately, legibly, honestly, initialled, signed and dated), and accompanied by a comprehensive/ detailed Curriculum Vitae only. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application but must submit the Z83 and a detailed Curriculum Vitae. Certified copies of qualifications and other relevant documents will be required from shortlisted candidates only on or before the day of the interview. The Curriculum Vitae must have at least three (3) reference persons and their contacts. Failure to provide accurate information on a job application as well as incomplete information will result in a disqualification. Job applicants in possession of a foreign qualification(s), must also provide an evaluation certificate obtainable from the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. If an invitation for an interview is not received within three (3) months after the closing date, please regard your application as unsuccessful. Requirements stated on the advertised posts are minimum inherent requirements; therefore, criteria for shortlisting will depend on the proficiency of the applications received. Shortlisted candidates will be assessed through practical exercise and an oral interview. Applicants must note that personnel suitability checks (PSC) will be conducted on the short-listed applicants, therefore will be required to give consent in terms of the POPI Act in order for the Department to conduct this exercise. PSC includes security screening and vetting, qualification verification, criminal records, financial records checks. Applicants who do not comply with the above-mentioned requirements, as well as application received after the closing date will not be considered. If an applicant wishes to withdraw an application, He/ She must do so in writing. It is also important to note that the Department reserves the right not to fill any advertised post at any stage of the recruitment process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Mediese Inspekteur
af.summary: Mediese Inspekteur-pos by die Department of Mineral and Petroleum Resources in Pretoria, wat 'n MBCHB-graad en 'n kwalifikasie in Bedryfsgeneeskunde vereis om myngesondheidsnakoming te oorsien.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike MBCHB-graad en 'n nagraadse kwalifikasie in Bedryfsgeneeskunde (NQF 10). Geregistreer by die HPCSA. Sertifikaat vir toetrede tot SMS. Geldige bestuurslisensie Plus minimum van 5 jaar se ondervinding op senior/middelbestuursvlak in Bedryfsgesondheid/Geneeskunde en werk as 'n OMP in die myne, Kennis van: Kennis van die Mine Health and Safety Act en ander bedryfsgesondheidsverwante voorskrifte, kennis van die mynsektor in Suid-Afrika en internasionaal, Kennis van beleidsontwikkelingstegnieke, Kennis van beleidsanaliseprosesse, Kennis van internasionale wetgewing en plaaslike wetgewing en skakeling met myne se gesondheidsregulasies, Kennis van navorsingsprosesse, kennis van Bedryfsgesondheidstendense en -uitdagings, Kennis van die staatsdienswetgewing Vaardighede: Bestuur van mense en finansies, Strategiese ontwikkeling en implementering, Beleidsontwikkeling, Netwerkvaardighede, voorleggings- en verslagskryfvaardighede, Belanghebbendebestuur, Kommunikasievaardighede, Projekbestuursvaardighede, Algemene bestuursvaardighede Denkvereistes: Streng nie-korrupsie-denke met betrekking tot die ontwikkeling en implementering van planne en strategie, Bestuursmatige denke met betrekking tot ekonomie, Vermoë om geloofwaardige inligting uit plaaslike en internasionale bronne te verkry of bronne daarvan te identifiseer.
af.duties: Los geskille oor bevindings van mediese ongeskiktheid van mynwerkers deur die appèlproses soos voorsien in die MHS Act op. Versamel en analiseer statistiek wat uit Mediese Verslae versamel is. Koördineer en verseker gehaltversekering van die proses om mynsluiting-werker mediese rekords te ontvang en te argiveer. Neem deel / lewer insette in myngesondheids- en veiligheidsongelukke/ ongelukondersoeke (bedryfsgeneeskunde). Skakel/samenwerk met relevante vergoedingshuise oor aspekte wat met vergoeding verband hou. Verskaf spesialisadvies/inligting rakende MIV/VIGS/TB in die mynbedryf en skakel met die Department of Health en ander relevante organisasies wat met TB/MIV werk. Bestuur die Direktoraat.

xh.title: Isiphenduli kwizophulo kumazwe amaninzi nakwindalo yamasheya amaninzi kwaye ethile.
xh.summary: Indima ka-Somagungqi woMzobi kwiSebe leeNgcweti zeMigodi kwiMineral and Petroleum Resources ePretoria, kubange i-MBCHB degree nezidanga kwiOccupational Medicine ukulawula ukuqinisekiswa kwezoKhuseleko kwimigodi.
xh.requirements: I-Degree efanelekileyo ye-MBCHB nangemfundo yasekunqamlweni kwi-NzuluLwazi yoMsebenzi (NQF 10). Ubhaliswe kwi-HPCSA. Isatifikethi sokungena kwi-SMS. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekileyo Enamandla amninzi weminyaka engama-5 kwinqanaba lolawulo oluphezulu/phakathi kuMzilo wezeMpilo wokuSebenza/ oMzobi nokusebenza njengo-OMP kumigodi, ulwazi ngo: Ulwazi ngoMthetho woKhuseleko noMzila kuMigodi nalamanye amagunya ahlobene nempilo yomsebenzi, ulwazi ngohlahlo lwabiwo lwemigodi eMzantsi Afrika nakwelinye ilizwe, ulwazi ngamashishini aphuhlisa iinkqubo zolwazi, ulwazi ngemiba yohlalutyo lweenkqubo, ulwazi ngomthetho wamazwe ngamazwe nomthetho wengingqi nontsingisano ngamathetha ezempilo kwimigodi, ulwazi ngokuphanda iinkqubo, ulwazi ngemigangatho kwaye kuphakamise iingozi ezikwimpilo yomsebenzi, ulwazi ngomthetho wesebe likawonke-wonke Ulwazi: Uphatho labantu nemali, Uphuhliso nokusebenza ngakwimigaqo, Uphuhliso lweenkqubo, Amandla okudibanisa abantu, amandla okubonisa noku bhala iiripoti, Uphatho lwezixhobo, Amandla okunceda, Amandla okuphatha amaprojekthi, Amandla obulumko bokulawula iDima: Okuqinisekileyo ukuzithiba ukungabakho kolwaphulo-mthetho ngakumbi kwimiba ethile ekwinkqubo nokusetyenziswa kweenkqubo ngakumbi iindlela zokuphuhlisa kwaye zisebenze amandla egqondo, indlela yokucinga ngokumqondiso wemali, Ulwazi lokufumana okanye iindlela zokuba neendonga zemfihlo malunga nolwazi ngokwawo nakumazwe amaninzi ezithixo zomthombo wokuqinisekileyo wamazwe ngamazwe.
xh.duties: Sombulula iingxabano malunga neziphumo zengaprofetho yempilo yabasebenzi bemigodi ngombana kungenjalo ngakwimixholo yoxhaso njengoko kucetywa kwiMthetho woKhuseleko noMzila kuMigodi. Qokelela ucocise uhlalutyo lweenani ezithathwa kwiiRipoti zezoNzululwazi. Yiba nolwaphulo-mthetho uze uqiniseke umgangatho wokuqinisekiswa kwenkqubo yokwamkela nokuvgcina amarekhodi ezempilo abasebenzi bayo kutshatyalaliswa imigodi. Thatha inxaxheba/zenze iingcali kwiingozi zokhuseleko nezomzila kwimigodi/naluphando lweengozi (inzululwazi yemisebenzi). Qhagamshelana/sebenzisana neentolongo ezifanelekileyo zexhaso kumacandwo ahlobene nexhaso. Nike isalathiso/esazinolwazi ngenxa yeHIV/AIDS/TB kwishishini lomigodi uze uqhagamshelane neSebe lezeMpilo namananye amagatya ahlobene nokusingatha iTB/HIV. Lawula iNdawo yoLawulo.

zu.title: Isihelo Sezokwelapha
zu.summary: Isikhundla sesihelo sezokwelapha eDepartment of Mineral and Petroleum Resources ePretoria, esidinga idigri ye-MBCHB nesifundo sezokwelapha abasebenzi ukuze qaphela ukuziphathisa kwezempilo ezimayini.
zu.requirements: Idigri efanele ye-MBCHB nesifundo se-Postgraduate kwezokwelapha abasebenzi (NQF 10). Kubhaliswe ne-HPCSA. Isitifikati sokungena ku-SMS. Ilayisense yokuqasha elisebenzayo kanye nemicimbe eminceni eminingi yeminyaka engu-5 ezingeni labaphathi abaphezulu/abaphathi phakathi kwezokwempilo/ezokwelapha abasebenzi kanye nokusebenza njengo-OMP kumayini, Ulwazi ngo: Ulwazi ngoMthetho Wezempilo Nokuphepha Kwezimayini namanye omthetho ohlobene nezokwempilo abasebenzi, ulwazi ngendawo yezimayini eNingizimu Afrika nangaphandle kwezwe, Ulwazi ngezindlela zokuthuthukiswa kwemigomo, Ulwazi ngezinqubo zokuhlaziya imigomo, Ulwazi ngomthetho wesizwe jikelele nomthetho wasekhaya nokuhlobana nomthetho wezempilo ezimayini, Ulwazi ngezinqubo zocwaningo, ulwazi ngemigcotha kanye nosezinkingeni ezokwempilo abasebenzi, Ulwazi ngomthetho wesevisi yomphakathi. Amakhono: Ukuphatha abantu nezimali, Ukuthuthukiswa nokusetshenziswa kwenqubo ezinkulu, Ukuthuthukiswa kwemigomo, Amakhono okuxhumanisa, amakhono okubhalingisa nokubhala imibiko, Ukuphatha abahlanganyeli, Amakhono okuxhumana, Amakhano okuphatha imiklamo, Amakhono abaphathi abajwayelekile. Isidingo Sokucabanga: Ukucabanga ngokungenisa inkohliso ngokuzinikezela ekuthuthukiseni nasekusebenziseni izinhlelo nokuqamba izinhlelo, Isabalelo somphathi ngemisebenzi yezomnotho, Ikhono lokuthola noma ukuzikhethela izinsimu zolwazi olwethembekayo endaweni yangaphakathi nangaphandle kwezwe.
zu.duties: Ukuxazulula izinkinga ezitholakele ngezokwelapha okungalungile kubasebenzi bezimayini ngesinqumo sokuphikisa njengoba kuhlinzekwe nguMthetho we-MHS. Ukuthola ukuhlaziya izibalo ezitholakala kumibiko yezokwelapha. Ukuhlanganisa futhi kuqinisekise izinga lenqubo yokwamukela nokulondoloza imibiko yezokwelapha yabasebenzi uma imayini ivalwa. Ukubamba iqhaza/ukunika izimpendulo ezinkingeni zeempahla nezokuphepha kumayini/ukuphenya izehloko (ezokwelapha abasebenzi). Ukuhamba uxhumane/nomanyane namazwe okuhlinzeka ngokukhokha ngemayelana nezinkondo zokukhokha. Ukunika izeluleko/ulwazi olukhulu nge-HIV/AIDS/TB emkhakheni wezimayini ukuze uhambisane ne-Department of Health namanye amaqembu ahlobene abelapha i-TB/HIV. Ukuphatha i-Directorate.

jobs.title: Inspector: Occupational Medicine
jobs.department: Department of Mineral and Petroleum Resources
jobs.summary: Inspector for Occupational Medicine in Welkom requiring a Nursing Science qualification and SANC registration to conduct mine medical surveillance audits and enforcement.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate Bachelor of Nursing Science (B Cur)/ National Diploma, B Tech Occupational Health Nursing (NQF Level 6) registered with South African Nursing Council (SANC), coupled with minimum of 3 years’ experience in Occupational Medicine/ Health and valid Driver’s License Plus the following competencies Knowledge of: Sound knowledge of both occupational Medical and Nursing discipline, understanding of MHSA & Regulations and directives. Understanding general mining practices and occupational health risks associated with, knowledge of petrochemical industry, diving and equipment. Skills: Ability to apply knowledge, Researching skills, Good Communicator, Have good investigating skills, Must be computer literate. Thinking Demands: Health and Safety hazards/risks recognise and respond, be able to apply MHSA, dedicated, hard working, loyal and conscientious, well experienced in Occupational Health on mines and industry, knowledge of offshore oil exploration and diving industry and sound temperament.
jobs.duties: Conduct and report on underground, and surface audits and inspections on matters relating to medical surveillance, and other matters relating to occupational medicine and take the necessary enforcement action where necessary. Ensure the investigation of and reporting of mine related diseases, contraventions and complaints as well as analyse regional disease trends to determine high risk mining operations and take appropriate action. Investigate, consult and provide input on Mine Closures, Prospecting Rights, Mining Rights and permits, EMPS’s and township development. Provide inputs to regional reports, revision of medical regulations, guidelines and standards and applications of exemptions, permissions and approvals related to occupational medicine.

af.title: Inspekteur: Beroepsgeneeskunde
af.summary: Inspekteur vir Beroepsgeneeskunde in Welkom wat 'n verpleegkundige wetenskapkwalifikasie en SANC-registrasie vereis om myn mediese toesigoudits en handhawing uit te voer.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike Bachelor of Nursing Science (B Cur)/ National Diploma, B Tech Occupational Health Nursing (NQF Level 6) geregistreer by die South African Nursing Council (SANC), gekoppel aan 'n minimum van 3 jaar se ervaring in Beroepsgeneeskunde/ Gesondheid en 'n geldige bestuurslisensie Plus die volgende bevoegdhede Kennis van: Deeglike kennis van beide die beroepsgeneeskundige en verpleegkundige dissipline, begrip van die MHSA & Regulasies en direktiewe. Begrip van algemene mynboupraktyke en die gepaardgaande beroepsgesondheidsrisiko's, kennis van die petrochemiese bedryf, duik en toerusting. Vaardighede: Vermoë om kennis toe te pas, Navorsingsvaardighede, Goeie kommunikeerder, Oor goeie ondersoekvaardighede beskik, Moet rekenaargeletterd wees. Denkvereistes: Gesondheids- en veiligheidsgevare/risiko's herken en reageer, in staat wees om die MHSA toe te pas, toewyding, hardwerkend, lojaal en pligsgetrou, goed ervare in Beroepsgesondheid in myne en die bedryf, kennis van die see-olie-verkennings- en duikbedryf en 'n goeie geaardheid.
af.duties: Voer verslag uit oor ondergrondse en bogrondse oudits en inspeksies rakende mediese toesig en ander aangeleenthede rakende beroepsgeneeskunde en neem waar nodig die nodige handhawingsaksie. Verseker die ondersoek van en verslagdoening oor mynverwante siektes, oortredings en klagtes asook die ontleding van streeksiekte-tendense om hoërisiko-mynboubedrywighede te bepaal en toepaslike aksie te neem. Ondersoek, konsulteer en voer insette oor Mynsluitings, Prospekteerregte, Mynbouregte en permitte, EMPS's en dorpsontwikkeling. Verskaf insette tot streeksverslae, hersiening van mediese regulasies, riglyne en standaarde en toepassings van vrystellings, toestemmings en goedkeurings verwant aan beroepsgeneeskunde.

zu.title: Inkulumiphefumlo: Izokwelaphwa Komsebenzi
zu.summary: Inkulumiphefumlo yezokwelaphwa komsebenzi eWelkom ofuna iziqu ze-Nursing Science nokubhaliswa kwi-SANC ukuze kwenzike ukuhlola okubhekene nokulawulwa kwezokwelaphwa kumayini nokuqinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwemithetho.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanele ze-Bachelor of Nursing Science (B Cur)/ National Diploma, B Tech Occupational Health Nursing (NQF Level 6) ezibhaliswe ku-South African Nursing Council (SANC), kanye nokuhlangenwe ndaba okungenani iminyaka engu-3 kwezokwelaphwa komsebenzi/ impilo nelayisensi evumelekile yokuqasha kanye nezinkompha ezilandelayo Ulwazi mayelana ne: Ulwazi olunzima ngokuhlukanisa kokubili izokwelaphwa komsebenzi nezokuhluleka, ukuqonda i-MHSA & Izimiso nemiyalo. Ukuqonda izindlela ezijwayelekile zokuqasha umayini nengozi ezihlobene nempilo yomsebenzi, ulwazi ngemboni yamakhemikhali okuthutha, ukubhukuda nezimpahla. Amakhono: Ikono lokusebenzisa ulwazi, amakhono okucwaninga, Umnxhumanzi ohle, ukuba namakhono okuphenya ahle, kumele ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Izidingo zokuqonda: Ukuba nolwazi futhi uphendule ngengozi/ingozi yezempilo nephephayo, ukwazi ukusebenzisa i-MHSA, ukuzinikela, ukusebenza kanzima, ukwethembeka nokuba nozwela, ube nobuhlotshisi obunzima kwezempilo yomsebenzi kumayini nasemabhizinisini, ulwazi ngemboni yokuqhenya ngeqha negazi kogwandhle nokuqhenya, kanye nesithunzi somoya esihle.
zu.duties: Yenza uluvo futhi umbike ngokuqashwa emaphandleni, nokuqashwa phansi komhlaba kanye nokuhlolwa ezindabeni ezihlobene nokulawulwa kokwelaphwa, kwezinye izindaba ezihlobene nezokwelaphwa komsebenzi bese uthatha isinyathelo esidingekayo sokuqinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwemithetho lapho kudingeka khona. Qinisekisa ukuphenya nokubika izifo ezihlobene nomayini, ukwephuka imithetho kanye nemicimbi yokudangayo, futhi uhlaziye ukuphindaphinda kwabezifo esifundeni ukuze ukwazi ukuthola imisebenzi yokuqasha emayini engengozi ephezulu bese uthatha isinyathelo esifanele. Phenya, weluleka futhi unikeze imibono ekuvalekeni Kwamayini, Amalungelo Okuhlola, Amalungelo Okuqasha nemvume, ama-EMPS kanye nentuthuko yamadolobha. Nikeza imibono emibikweni yesifunda, ukulungiswa kwemithetho yokwelaphwa, imihlahlandlela namazinga, kanye nezicelo zokukhishwa kumthetho, imvume nokugunyazwa okuhlobene nezokwelaphwa komsebenzi.

xh.title: InkQwatha: Iyeza loMsebenzi
xh.summary: Inkqwatha yeZiyeza zoMsebenzi eWelkom efuna isiqinisekiso seNzululwaziweZamaphunga neregistre kwiSigungu samaNesi aseMzantsi Afrika (SANC) ukuze yenze ukuphonononga kwamayeza kunye nokuxhasa umthetho kumzi-mveliso weemigodi.
xh.requirements: Isiqinisekiso esifanelekileyo se-Bachelor of Nursing Science (B Cur)/ National Diploma, B Tech Occupational Health Nursing (NQF Level 6) neregistre kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC), kunye namava anomlinganiselo oonyaka bam-3 kwiOccupational Medicine/ Health nelayisense yokushayela egqityiweyo ngokuchanekileyo kwaye nangamakhono alandelayo Ulwazi ngolu: Ulwazi olusembathini ngamabanga omnye wamayeza omsebenzi nendlu yamayeza, ukuqonda i-MHSA & Regulations namalungiselelo. Ukuqonda iindlela zemigodi ngokubanzi nemiingeni yempilo ezamele kuyo, ulwazi ngumzi-mveliso weepetrochemical, ukutyhela nolunye uhlakulisio. Amakhono: Ikhono lokusebenzisa ulwazi, amakhono okucinga ngokuphonononga, umthethi othetha kakuhle, ukuba namakhono am ngokuphandisisa, kufuneka athi nakwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Iimfuno zoQqho-mthetho: Iingozi/imiingeni yezeMPilo noKhuseleko wayazi nokuphendula, akwazi ukusebenzisa i-MHSA, zigqithiselwe, zisebenza nzima, zinobugcisa obuhle nolwazi olubanzi, zinamava am kwiOccupational Health kwimigodi nakuqoqosho, zikwazi ngemigodi yamafutha olwandle nokutyhela kunye nobugcisa bokuziphatha okusembathini.
xh.duties: Qhuba undikele ngokubyaleleyo, ukuphonononga nokuqinisekisa indawo ngaphantsi komhlaba, nasemhlabeni ngaphezulu kwemiba echasa ngokubyaleleyo ngokugcinwa kwamayeza, nangemiba elowo ngamnye echasa ngamayeza omsebenzi uze uthathe isigqibo sokugqithisa umthetho apho kufuneka. Qinisekisa ukuphandisiswa nendwelo ekubikweni ngamagatya asahloko, amafutshane omgama nengxaki ezikumzi-mveliso weemigodi, ngokutsha nayidilinga amagatya asahloko ekummandla ukuze ugqithe iindlela eziyingozi zemigodi uze uthathe isigqibo esifanelekileyo. Phandisisa, yingcwatiso yaye unike ulwazi ngokwavalwa kwamagatya, amalungelo okuzingela, amalungelo okwakha imigodi namavya, i-EMPS's nasezithuthweni zentlalo. Nikeza ulwazi kumbiko wemimandla, uhlengahlengiso kwimithetho yamayeza, imigaqo nemilinganiselo nangokusetyenziswa kwesaziso, iimvume nokugqithiswa kwamagatya achasa ngamayeza omsebenzi.

af.summary: Assistent-direkteur benodig in Witbank om minerale regte en permit-aansoeke te administreer, om wettige nakoming te verseker en advies te gee oor besluitnemingsprosesse.

zu.summary: Kudingeka Umfolosikhulu e Witbank ukuphatha izicelo zamalungelo nezimvume zamaminerali, kuqinisekiswe ukuziphatha ngokomthetho nokuphakamisa ngeminqumo yokwenza izinqumo.

Ngaphezu kwalokho, ulwazi ngokuqonda: Ulwazi olusisekelo ngomthetho wangaphambile wezimveli, ulwazi olusisekelo ngo-MPRDA, ulwazi olusisekelo ngemigogo yokuphatha, ulwazi olusisekelo ngomthetho wemithetho-sisayensi womnyango maqondana nokulawula amaminerali. Amakhono: ikhono lokubhala imibiko, ikhono lokubhala iziphakamiso, ikhono lokubumba imihlangano nokuhlola, ikhono lokuxhumana ngokubhala nangokukhuluma, ikhono lokuba ngumxhumanisi phakathi kweziqu (ezibukhali). Isidingo sokucabanga: ukukwazi ukucabanga lapho kubhekene nezimo ezinzima, umcabango oshukumisayo.
zu.duties: Phatha inqubo yokuphatha yalezicelo zamalungelo noma izimvume ngokulandela umthetho. Phesheya konke okungase kubange impi phakathi kwamalungelo angaphambilini nokusetshenziswa kwomhlaba. Nikeza izeluleko eqondene nenqubo yokwenza izinqumo. Qinisekisa ukuhlela ukukhokha izimali zomhlalaphansi namafemu okusesha ezavela esimeni ngokulandela umthetho. Hlola imisebenzi engasemthethweni yokusesha nokumba bese uthatha izinyathelo ezifanele zokulungisa lapho kudingeka khona. Qinisekisa/phenya izicelo zokusetshenziswa kwomhlaba bese uhlolisisa ukusetshenziswa kwomhlaba ngokuya ekusetshenzisweni (kuphela lapho kungakakhiwa igatsha eliphathiswe ngokuthuthukiswa kwezozomnotho. Nikeza inkxaso e-Komiti Yokuqondisa nokuqondiswa Komhlaba Wezifunda kanye Nebhidjhana (i-RMDEC).

xh.summary: Kufuneka iAssistant Director eWitbank ukulawula izicelo zamalungelo namavulelo wamaminerali, kuqinisekiswe ukuthobela umthetho kunye nokunikela ingcebiso malunga nenkqubo yokwenza izigqibo.
xh.requirements: I Degree yeBachelor/iDegree yeBTech/iDiploma ePhakamileyo kwiZomthetho okanye i-LLB (NQF7) ubuncinane i3 years yamava kwishishini Ngaphezu koko, ulwazi nge: Ulwazi olusesiqwini ngomthetho wangaphambili wamaminerali, Ulwazi olusesiqwini nge-MPRDA, Ulwazi olusesiqwini ngeenkqubo zophalo, Ulwazi olusesiqwini ngengqungquthela yeSebe nge-Regulation yeeMinerali Amakhono: Ukuba nokwalulo lokubhala iingxelo, Ukuba nokwalulo lokubhala izicelo, Ukuba nokwalulo lokubamba iintlanganiso kunye nokuphonononga, Ukuba nokwalulo lokunxibelelana ngokubhaliweyo nangomlomo, Ukuba nokwalulo lokuba ngumxhumanisi phakathi kweqela (elinamandla) abantu Ukufuna ukucinga: Ukuba nokwalulo lokucinga xa ubuso nobunzima, Umcingi onobuchule.

Phanda ngeemfazamano ezinokubakha phakathi kwamalungelo angaphambili nendlela yokusebenzisa umhlaba. Nikela ingcebiso kwinkqubo yokwenza izigqibo. Qinisekisa ukuhlelwa kokuhlawula iindleko zokuhlola kunye nemali ohlawulwa kulo rhulumente ngokwomthetho. Bathatha izigqibo ezifanelekileyo zokulungisa apho kubakho ukuphanda nokumba ngemigodi ngokungemthethweni. jobs.title: Assistant Director: Beneficiation Strategy Development

Provide support in the development of policy and strategy interventions to overcome constraints to promote further local processing of mineral commodities. Encourage local processing of mineral commodities through local and international promotional activities. Provide logistical support in planning and executing local and international events.

af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Ontwikkeling van Batekrag-strategie
af.summary: Assistentdirekteur-pos by die Department of Mineral and Petroleum Resources in Pretoria met fokus op die ontwikkeling van batekrag-strategie op salarisvlak 10.
af.requirements: A B Comm (Econometrics)-graad (NQF 7), geldige bestuurslisensie, 3 jaar se ondervinding in ekonomie/mynbou/statistiek of strategie-ontwikkeling. Kennis van: Begrip van die Mineral and Petroleum Resources Development Act (MPRDA), National Environmental, kennis van minerale kommoditeite en die batekrag-sektor, gevorderde kennis van regeringsbeleid van toepassing op mynbou- en minerale nywerhede. Vaardighede: Ontwikkelde vaardighede in strategie-ontwikkeling en implementeringsvaardighede, ondervinding in strategie- en beleidsontwikkelingsprosesse, insluitend die uitvoer van sosio-ekonomiese navorsing en omgewingsskanderings, sterk probleemoplossing, tydbestuur, interpersoonlike en organisatoriese vaardighede, goed ontwikkelde navorsings- en aanbiedingsvaardighede, bekwame kommunikasie insluitend openbare spreke en doeltreffende en bondige verslagskrywing, sterk analitiese vermoëns en belanghebbende-bestuur, data-analise. Denkvereiste: In staat om onafhanklik probleme/uitdagings te identifiseer en gepaste korrektiewe maatreëls te tref, die vermoë om komplekse sosio-ekonomiese navorsing, globale markneigings en minerale kommoditeitsdata te analiseer om strategiese geleenthede vir waardetoevoeging te identifiseer, die ontwikkeling van "buite-die-boks"-intervensies om "beperkende faktore" te omseil.
af.duties: Voer navorsing uit om beperkinge wat minerale batekrag raak, te identifiseer en oplossings voor te stel. Verskaf ondersteuning in die ontwikkeling van beleids- en strategie-intervensies om beperkinge te oorkom en verdere plaaslike verwerking van minerale kommoditeite te bevorder. Bevorder plaaslike verwerking van minerale kommoditeite deur plaaslike en internasionale bevorderingsaktiwiteite. Verskaf logistieke ondersteuning by die beplanning en uitvoering van plaaslike en internasionale byeenkomste.

zu.title: Umncedisi weSikhulu: Ukuthuthukiswa Kwendlela Yokwenza Inzuzo

zu.requirements: Idegree ye-B Comm (Econometrics) (NQF 7), ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile, unyaka woku-3 woluvo kwezomnotho/okwemayini/ngezibalo noma ekuthuthukisweni kwendlela. Ulwazi: Ukuqonda i-Mineral and Petroleum Resources Development Act (MPRDA), i-National Environmental, Ulwazi ngamamineral commodities naseqenjini lokwenza inzuzo, Ulwazi oluthuthukile lwemigomo kahulumeni osebenza kumayini nasezimbonini zamamineral. Amakhono: Amakhono athuthukiswe kahle ekuthuthukiseni nokuphatha ukusetshenziswa kwezinqubo zendlela, Uluvo kumaprosesi okuthuthukiswa kwendlela nemigomo, okuhlanganisa ukwenza ucwaningo olumayelana nezomnotho zomphakathi nokubuka imvelo, Amakhono amakhulu okuxazulula izinkinga, okuphatha isikhathi, abantu nokuhlela izinhlelo, Amakhono ocwaningo nokubonisa athuthukiswe kahle, Ukuxhumana okuphumelelayo okuhlanganisa ukukhuluma phakathi kwomphakathi kanye, nokubhala umbiko ngokusebenza ngokuchofoza nangokufingqa, Ikhono elikhulu lokuhlaziya kanye nokuphatha abahlanganyeli, Ukuhlaziya idatha. Isidingo sokucabanga: Ukuba nakho ukuzibonakalisa izinkinga/izinselelo nokuthatha izinyathelo ezifanele zokulungisa, Ikhono lokuhlaziya ucwaningo oludidingekile lolwazi mayelana nezomnotho zomphakathi, izinkomba zomphakathi zomhlaba nedatha yamamineral commodities zokuqonda ithuba elihle lokwengeza inani, ukuthuthukisa izexwayiso ezingaphezu kothiyo ukuze udlule konke okubopha.
zu.duties: Yenza ucwaningo ukuze ubone izinselelo ezibhekene nokwenza inzuzo kumamineral bese uphakamisa izixazululo. Nikeza inkxaso ekuthuthukisweni kwezinqubo zemigomo nezindlela ukunqanda izinselelo ukuze usize ukuthuthukiswa okwengeziwe kokucubungula kwamamineral commodities. Khuthaza ukucubungula kwamamineral commodities ngokwamanonza kanye nakamazinga omhlaba. Nikeza inkxaso yokuhlela nokwenza imikhakha yamanonza kanye namazinga omhlaba.

xh.title: Umncedisi weQhala: Uphuhliso loNqumama lweZiqu eziNtsalayo
xh.summary: Indima kaMncedisi waseQhaleni kwiSebe lezeMineral ngeeNkonzana ePretoria elubhekiselelo kuxanduva lokuphuhisa uNqumama lweZiqu eziNtsalayo kwinqanaba lesiqingqselele sesi-10.
xh.requirements: I-Degree ye-B Comm (Econometrics) (NQF 7), ilayisenise yomqhubi egqithisiweyo, unyaka wam-3 wobuchule obumalunga noqoqosho/obumalunga namayini/nobumalunga neesitathistikha okanye uphuhliso loNqumama. Ulwazi malunga: Ukuqonda umThetho woPhuhliso lwezeMineral ngeeNkonzana (MPRDA), iSizwe seNdalo. Ulwazi malunga neempahla zamamineral nesebe elifuna ukubaphucula. Ulwazi olujulile lwamapolisi kaRhulumente afanelekile kumashishini amayini naye mineral. Amakhono: Amakhono obukhali antsonyotshiweyo kwiphuhliso loNqumama nasekusebenziseni iinkqubo ngeziqu. Uphuhliso lomRhumo wokubakho nokuqonda iinkqubo zomRhumo nempahla ezikwisizwe, kuquka ukuphanda ngayo iNkokheli ekuqhuba uphando ngemimiselo yesiXeko somB renderisi weNdalo. Ikhono eliNamandla lokusombulula iingxaki, ekuLawuleni isixa lesiXeko esithile, ebuLisaneni namanyathelo, nasekuBulaleni iNqanaba lesiXeko. Ikhono elipheleleyo lokuphanda ngolwazi nokuM nkela ngelivi elithetha kakhulu. IsiXeko esinamandla sokuthetha ngokunyanzelisa, kuquka nokuThetha esiBhalwe ngokunyanzelisa, iNkcazelo ebalulekileyo nengangatyiwa-Ngengozi ekuBhaleni amanqaku. IKhono elinamandla lokuNikonisa ngokwemigaqo nokuBeka kuLungelelanisa iingcali. Ukuqwalasela iNgxaki.
xh.duties: Yenza uphando ukuze uqonde iingxaki ezithintela ukuphuculwa kweziqu zamamineral uze udxulele iindlela zokuZixa. Nikela inkxaso ekuphuhisweni iNgxaki-mGama nokuQwalasela iindlela ezokuZisa iNgxaki ukuze kuQatshulwe ukutshatshaliswa kwangaphakathi kweziqu zamamineral. Khuthaza ukutshatshaliswa kwangaphakathi kweziqu zamamineral ngokusebenzisa iNkxaso-mali naseZweni naseZwe nakuM zantsi. Nikela iNkxaso-mali ekuCwangciseni nasekuZaliseleleni iMigaqo ekuZweni nakuM zantsi.

jobs.summary: Director of Administration sought by the National Prosecuting Authority in Kimberley to manage finance, supply chain, human resources and security at SMS Level 13.
jobs.requirements: A qualification at NQF level 7 as recognized by SAQA in Finance/Public Administration/Management or relevant equivalent qualification. Nyukela Certificate (Certificate for entry into the senior management service from the National School of Government). At least five (5) years relevant experience at middle/senior managerial level. Demonstrable competency in acting Independently, Professionally, Accountable and with Credibility. Knowledge of legislation and regulations pertaining to Public Service Administration. Knowledge and understanding of PFMA Act. Basic Conditions of Employment Act. Skills Development Act. Labour Relations Act. Ability to use PERSAL and BAS. General computer literacy skills and knowledge in programs such as MS Word, MS Excel, Ms outlook and MS PowerPoint. Good presentation skills. Written and verbal communication skills. Research skills and interpersonal skills. Good administration skills. People management and empowerment. Strategic capability and leadership. Planning and prioritizing skills. Customer focus and responsiveness. Problem solving and Decision Making. Valid driver’s license.
jobs.duties: Manage Finance and Supply Chain. Manage Human Resources. Manage Information. Manage Security. Ensure the provision of general administration. Provide administrative leadership on the finances of the unit through developing the budget of the unit. Manage and monitor expenditure of the unit and report as required. Ensure compliance of the unit with financial management framework and applicable legislation and prescripts. Monitor suppliers/vendor to ensure the development of an HR plan for the unit in conjunction with the national HR plan. Manage and facilitation of skills development plan. Ensure the compliance with the performance management development system. Manage the provision of an effective HR administration (leave and recruitment). Ensure the co-ordination of Employment Equity Forum. Ensure effectiveness of document management system. Facilitate the development of annual operational plans and strategy for the unit. Ensure the overall compliance of the unit with all applicable legislation and policies. Ensure the implementation of information and knowledge management.

af.title: Direkteur: Administrasie
af.summary: Die National Prosecuting Authority in Kimberley soek 'n Direkteur van Administrasie om finansies, voorsieningsketting, menslike hulpbronne en sekuriteit op SMS Vlak 13 te bestuur.
af.requirements: 'n Kwalifikasie op NQF vlak 7 soos deur SAQA erken in Finansies/Openbare Administrasie/Bestuur of 'n tersaaklike gelykwaardige kwalifikasie. Nyukela-sertifikaat (Sertifikaat vir toetrede tot die senior bestuursdiens van die National School of Government). Ten minste vyf (5) jaar tersaaklike ervaring op middel-/seniorbestuursvlak. Aantoonbare bevoegdheid om Onafhanklik, Professioneel, Verantwoordelik en met Geloofwaardigheid op te tree. Kennis van wetgewing en regulasies met betrekking tot Openbare Diensadministrasie. Kennis en begrip van die PFMA Act. Basic Conditions of Employment Act. Skills Development Act. Labour Relations Act. Vermoë om PERSAL en BAS te gebruik. Algemene rekenaarvaardighede en kennis in programme soos MS Word, MS Excel, Ms outlook en MS PowerPoint. Goeie voorleggingsvaardighede. Skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasievaardighede. Navorsingsvaardighede en interpersoonlike vaardighede. Goeie administratiewe vaardighede. Mensebestuur en bemagtiging. Strategiese vermoë en leierskap. Beplannings- en prioriteitsvaardighede. Kliëntfokus en responderendheid. Probleemoplossing en besluitneming. Geldige bestuurslisensie.
af.duties: Bestuur Finansies en Voorsieningsketting. Bestuur Menslike Hulpbronne. Bestuur Inligting. Bestuur Sekuriteit. Verseker die voorsiening van algemene administrasie. Verskaf administratiewe leierskap oor die finansies van die eenheid deur die begroting van die eenheid te ontwikkel. Bestuur en monitor besteding van die eenheid en doen verslag soos vereis. Verseker nakoming van die eenheid met die finansiële bestuursraamwerk en toepaslike wetgewing en voorskrifte. Monitor verskaffers/verkoper om die ontwikkeling van 'n HR-plan vir die eenheid in samewerking met die nasionale HR-plan te verseker. Bestuur en fasiliteer die vaardigheidsontwikkelingsplan. Verseker nakoming van die prestasiebestuursontwikkelingstelsel. Bestuur die voorsiening van effektiewe HR-administrasie (verlof en werwing). Verseker die koördinering van die Indiensnemingsgeregtigheidsforum. Verseker doeltreffendheid van die dokumentbestuurstelsel. Fasiliteer die ontwikkeling van jaarlikse operasionele planne en strategie vir die eenheid. Verseker die algehele nakoming van die eenheid met alle toepaslike wetgewing en beleide. Verseker die implementering van inligting- en kennisbestuur.

zu.title: Onqangi: Ukulawula
zu.summary: Ngesikhundla sokuqondisa ukulawula kuhlatshiwe umuntu ngu-National Prosecuting Authority e-Kimberley ukuphathwa kwezimali, nomzila wokuhlinzeka, nabasebenzi nokuvikela e-13 le-izinga le-SMS.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezinga le-7 le-NQF njengoba zivunywe u-SAQA kwezimali/okuphathwa kwezomphakathi/okuphathwayo noma iziqu ezifanayo ezihambisana nalokho. Isitifiketi seNyukela (isitifiketi sokungena ohlelweni lokuqondisa abalulekile esikoleni sezwe). Okungenani iminyaka eyisihlanu (5) yohlelo lokusebenza oluhambisana nalokho ngezinga eliphakathi/phezulu lokuqondisa. Ukukwazi ukubonakalisa ikhono lokusebenza ngokuzimele, ngobungcweti, ngobubele nobungangamela. Ukwazi umthetho nemithetho ehlobene nokuphathwa kwezinsizakalomphakathi. Ukuqonda nokwazi umthetho we-PFMA. Umthetho wokuqashwa kwezisebenzi. Umthetho wokuqashwa kwezisebenzi. Umthetho wokuqashwa kwezisebenzi. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa i-PERSAL ne-BAS. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kanye nolwazi kumaprogremu afana ne-MS Word, MS Excel, MS Outlook ne-MS PowerPoint. Ukukwazi ukubukhoma ngokuhle. Amakhono okuxoxa nokubhala. Amakhono okucwaninga nokuxhumana nabantu. Ukuphathwa kolu hlelo kahle. Ukuqondisa nokunikeza amandla. Ukukwazi ukulungelele ukuba ngumholi. Ukucubungula futhi uqale ngokubaluleka. Ukukhathalela abathengi nokubakhonza. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokwenza izinqumo. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni.
zu.duties: Mengemela izimali nomzila wokuhlinzeka. Mengemela abasebenzi. Mengemela ulwazi. Mengemela ukuvikela. Qinisekisa inikezwe lolu hlelo lokulawula ngokuvamile. Nikeza ibhalwe elibusayo ngemali yesikhungo ngokuthuthukisa ihlelo lemali yesikhungo. Mengemela futhi ulawule ukuchithwa kwemali yesikhungo futhi wenze imibiko njengoba kudingeka. Qinisekisa ukuthi isikhungo sihambisana nendlela yokuphathwa kwezimali nemithetho nezincwadi ezifanele. Lawule abanikezeli/abathengi ukuze qinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa kwehlelo labasebenzi lesikhungo ngokubambisana nenhlelo labasebenzi yezwe. Mengemela futhi ulawule ukuthuthukiswa kwehlelo lokuthuthukiswa kwezikhono. Qinisekisa ukuhambisana nendlela yokuphathwa kokusebenza kahle. Mengemela ukunikezwa kolu hlelo lokuphathwa kwezisebenzi olusebenzayo (ukushiya nokubhungqa). Qinisekisa ukuhlanganiswa kwenkundla yeQinisekiso Lokusebenza. Qinisekisa ukusebenza kahle kwehlela lokuphatha amadokhumenti. Facilite ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo zomsebenzi zonyaka nendlela yesikhungo. Qinisekisa ukuhambisana kwesikhungo konke ukuthi kuhambisana nomthetho kanye namapholisi asho ukuthi kufanele. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kolu hlelo lokuphathwa kolwazi nolwazi olubalulekile.

xh.title: Umphathi: Isebe lolawulo
xh.summary: Kufunwa umPhathi woLawulo ngamajelo eZiko leGunya elizaNgeniselwa iNkcukacha eKimberley ukuze alawule izimali, unxibelelwano lwezinto, iziseko zoluntu nezinto ezithengiswayo kunye nokhuseleko kwiNqanaba le-SMS 13.
xh.requirements: Isidanga seNQF 7 njengokuqatshwa yi-SAQA kwiZimali/uLawulo lwaRulumndo/inkqubo yolawulo okanye isidanga esilinganayo esihambelana nayo. Isatifikethi seNyukela (Isatifikethi sokuNgena kwinkqubo yonikezelo lolawulo osemgangathweni ophezulu esuka kwiSikolo seZiko). Ubuncinane beminyaka emihlanu (5) yamava ahambelana nayo kwinqanaba eliphakathi/elphezulu lolawulo. Ulwazi olubonwayo lokuziphatha nokuzimela, ngokutsha ngokwemisebenzi, ngokubekiweyo, ngokuzithembisa nokuba nokuqatshwa kolwazi. Ulwazi ngomthetho kunye namagunya achwepheshileko ngokuLawulwa kukaRulumndo ka Wonke-Wonke. Ulwazi kunye nokuqonda uMthetho ka-PFMA. uMthetho weMigaqo yoBungakanisi yokuSebenza. uMthetho woPhuhliso lweNkawu. uMthetho woBudlelwano bokuSebenza. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa i-PERSAL kunye ne-BAS. xh.duties: Lawula izimali kunye nentshiso yezendlalvela. Lawula izisebenzo zoluntu. Lawula inkcazelo. Lawula ukhuseleko. Qinisekisa ukunikwa kolawulo olubanzi. Nikezela ngolawulo olusemmandleni kumali zeyunithi ngokuphuhliswa kwexabiso leyunithi. Lawula kwaye ulandele ukuchithwa kwemali yeyunithi uze uxele njengoko kufunekile. Qinisekisa ukuthobela kolawulo lweyunithi ngenkqubo yolawulo lwezimali kunye nomthetho osebenzayo namagunya. Landela abathengisi/abathengisi ukunikezela ngeKhadi lesiQinisekiso soMthetho ka-(2003) (iKhadi lesiQinisekiso) ukugcina uluhlu lwabo, nokunika iingxelo ezenzeka kwimaxhoba amabakha afunekayo ukuyigcina. Landela imigaqo yokuphuhliswa kwenkqubo yoluntu yeyunithi ngokuhambelana nenkqubo yoluntu yaseziko. Lawula kwaye uphuhlise inkqubo yamakhono ophuhliso. Qinisekisa ukuthobela kwenkqubo yophuhliso yolawulo lokuphumeza kumsebenzi. Lawula ukunikwa kolawulo olusebenzayo lwabantu (ngeyunithi nezinto ezithengwa). Qinisekisa ukuqwalaselwa kwezinja eziqhelanayo zeNqanaba. Qinisekisa ukusebenza kwenkqubo yolawulo lweefayile ezingabhalwanga ngokuqinisekileyo. Qhutywa uphuhliso lweenkqubo zokuSebenza ngamnye kunye namacebo okuzimisela iyunithi. Qinisekisa ukuthobela okubanzi yeyunithi kumthetho wonke osebenzayo nengcamango. Qinisekisa ukusebenza kolwazi kunye nokuLawula iNkcazelo esemhlabeni.

jobs.summary: Deputy Director of Public Prosecutions at the National Prosecuting Authority in Pietermaritzburg, requiring an LLB and ten years' litigation experience.
jobs.requirements: An LLB. For serving prosecutors seeking promotion any appropriate legal qualification. At least ten (10) years’ post-qualification experience in civil and/or criminal litigation. Right of appearance as contemplated in section 25(2) of the NPA Act, 32 of 1998. Demonstrable competency in acting Independently, Professionally, Accountable and with Credibility. Admission as an Attorney/Advocate will be an added advantage. Good advocacy and legal drafting skills. Strong organisational leadership skills. Strong interpersonal and communication skills. Ability to think strategically and innovatively and management. A Valid driver’s license.
jobs.duties: Manage the portfolio assigned by the Director. Manage, train and guide Advocates, Prosecutors and stakeholders in respect of all matters, including complex / high profile matters, in the high court, the highest court of appeal and the constitutional court. Investigate and prosecute cases. Provide legal oversight and guidance in investigation projects and legal casework. Study case dockets and other documents relating to corruption matters, criminal matters, make and review decisions with regard to the institution of criminal proceedings. Prepare cases for court including the acquisition of additional evidence and drafting charge sheets, indictments and other court documents. Present the state’s case in court, including examination and cross-examination of witnesses and addressing the court on conviction and sentence. Study appeals and reviews, prepare opinions and heads of argument and argue cases in the appropriate court. Appear in motion applications pertaining to criminal matters. Map out strategic planning for the division and lead staff members towards achieving the strategic objectives. Oversee resources and align them to strategic objectives. Development, performance management and assessment of staff members. Deal with representations and complaints. Ensure that a high standard of professional work is being carried out. Promote partner integration, community involvement and customer satisfaction in conjunction with partners in the criminal justice system.

af.title: Onderdirekteur van Openbare Aanklagte
af.summary: Onderdirekteur van Openbare Aanklagte by die National Prosecuting Authority in Pietermaritzburg, wat 'n LLB en tien jaar se litigasie-ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: An LLB. Vir dienende aanklaers wat bevordering soek enige toepaslike regskwalifikasie. Ten minste tien (10) jaar se post-kwalifikasie-ervaring in siviele en/of strafregtelike litigasie. Verskyningsreg soos oorweeg in artikel 25(2) van die NPA Act, 32 van 1998. Aantoonbare bevoegdheid om Onafhanklik, Professioneel, Verantwoordelik en met Geloofwaardigheid op te tree. Toelating as 'n Prokureur/Advokaat sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Goie pleit- en regsdienstigheidsvaardighede. Sterk organisatoriese leierskapsvaardighede. Sterk interpersoonlike en kommunikasievaardighede. Vermoë om strategies en innoverend te dink en bestuur. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Bestuur die portefeulje wat deur die Direkteur toegewys is. Bestuur, leer en gee leiding aan Advokate, Aanklaers en belanghebbendes ten opsigte van alle sake, insluitend komplekse / hoëprofielsake, in die hooggeregshof, die hoogste appèlhof en die grondwetlike hof. Ondersoek en vervolg sake. Verskaf regstoesig en leiding in ondersoekprojekte en regsgevalle. Bestudeer saakdossiers en ander dokumente wat verband hou met korrupsiesake, strafregtelike sake, en neem en hersien besluite ten opsigte van die instelling van strafregtelike verrigtinge. Berei sake vir die hof voor, insluitend die verkryging van bykomende bewyse en die opstel van klagstate, aanklagteskrifte en ander hofdokumente. Lewer die staat se saak in die hof, insluitend die ondersoek en kruisondervraging van getuies en die toespreek van die hof oor skuldigbevinding en vonnis. Bestudeer appèlle en hersienings, bereie menings en hoofsake van betoog en voer sake in die toepaslike hof. Verskyn in motieverrigtinge rakende strafregtelike sake. Bepaal strategiese beplanning vir die afdeling en lei staflid in die rigting van die bereiking van die strategiese doelwitte. Hou toesig oor hulpbronne en belyn dit met strategiese doelwitte. Ontwikkeling, prestasiebestuur en assessering van staflid. Hanteer vertoë en klagtes. Verseker dat 'n hoë standaard van professionele werk uitgevoer word. Bevorder vennootskapsintegrasie, gemeenskapsbetrokkenheid en klintediendheid in samewerking met vennote in die strafregstelsel.

zu.title: Isekela Mongameli Wezigwebo Zomphakathi
zu.summary: Isekela Mongameli Wezigwebo Zomphakathi e-National Prosecuting Authority e-Pietermaritzburg, kudingeka i-LLB namava iminyaka elishimu kokuhola izigwebo.
zu.requirements: I-LLB. Kubavuli abakhulelayo abafuna ukukhushulwa noma yiphi ithifikhehsi yomthetho efanele. Okungenani iminyaka elishumi (10) yamava emumva kwethifikheshi esigwebweni sesil civil noma yobugebengu. Ilungelo lokubonakala njengokuqinisekiswe esigabeni 25(2) se-NPA Act, 32 ka-1998. Ukufaneleka okubonakalayo ekusebenzeni ngokuzimela, ngobungcweti, ngobhekena nangokwethembeka. Ukwamukelwa njengoMmeli / Sikhulumi kuzoba yinzuzo eyengeziwe. Amakhono amahle okusukela komthetho nokuqamba ohlwini lomthetho. Amakhono amakhulu ohlwini lokuqamba ohlelo. Amakhono amakhulu abantu nokuquketha. Isidlulelo sokucabanga ngokwezindaba zangaphambili ngokushintsha nokuphatha. Amalayisensi okushayela asemthethweni.
zu.duties: Phatha iphothifoliyo elinikiwe nguMqondisi. Phatha, qeqesha futhi uholele oMmela / oSikhulumi / oBavuli nalabo abasemkhakheni mayelana nazo zonke izindaba, okuhlanganisa izindaba ezinzima / ezinkulu, enkantolo ephakeme, enkantolo ephezulu yokwamukela izigwebo naseNkantolweni yoMthethosisekelo. Phenya futhi ushole izigwebo. Nikeza ukubuka nokuhola okusemthethweni kumaprojekthi okuphenya nasemsebenzini wesigwebo. Funda amafayela esigwebo namanye amadokhumenti ahlobene nezindaba zenkohlakalo, izindaba zobugebengu, zenze futhi ubuyeke izinqumo mayelana nokuqaliswa kwezinqubo zobugebengu. Lungiselela izigwebo enkantoleni okuhlanganisa ukuthola iziqinisekiso ezingeziwe nokubhala amakhasi ezinkinga, iziphakamiso namanye amadokhumenti enkantolo. Yethula isigwebo sesiFule enkantoleni, okuhlanganisa ukubuza futhi kabuhlungu ufakazi nokukhuluma enkantoleni mayelana nokutholwa enecala nesigwebo. Funda iziphakamiso nokuqinisekisa ibuyekezo, lungelelela izinkulumo-zimvo namakhanda empikiswano uphikise izigwebo enkantoleni efanele. Bonakala ezifakeni zokunyakaza mayelana nezindaba zobugebengu. Yila indlela yokuhlela isikhungo uholele abasebenzi ukufeza imigomo yenhloko. Buka izinsiza futhi uzihambisane nemigomo yenhloko. Ukuthuthukiswa, ukuphatha inkambiso nokuhlolwa kwabasebenzi. Phatha izinkomba nezikhulumi. Qinisekisa ukuthi kwenziwa umsebenzi obungcweti ongangeni muva. Khuthaza ukuhlanganiswa kwabahlanganyeli, ukubandakanywa komphakathi nesidingo sabathengi kanye nabalunganyelo kwisimiso somthetho sobugebengu.

xh.title: Umgadi Wamagosa KaQhamakusho
xh.summary: Umgadi Wamagosa KaQhamakusho kwi-National Prosecuting Authority e-Pietermaritzburg, efuna i-LLB nesiqithi seminyaka elishumi sokusebenza kumagosa.
xh.requirements: I-LLB. Kwalabo bagosi abasebenzayo abafuna ukuphakamiswa nalipho na igqeba lomthetho elifanelekileyo. Ubuncinane iminyaka elishumi (10) yesiqithi sokusebenza ekumamenza amagosa ebungcali nakwamagosa ezenzo ezingalunganga. Ilungelo lokubonakala njengoko kucetyisiwe kwicandelo 25(2) loMthetho we-NPA, 32 ka-1998. Ukuzipatha ngokuzimeleyo, ngobungcali, ngokubekiweyo nangokwethembeka okubonakalayo. Ukungeniswa njengogqatsha lomthetho kuya kuba lusidlavu. Amakhono amahle okugosa nokupepeta amaxwebhu omthetho. Amakhone amandla okuhola kwicala lolungiselelo. Amakhone amandla amanengi okuthetha nabantu nokuqhathanisa. Amandla okucinga ngolwangqam nangokutsha kwaye nokulawula. Ilayisensi evumelekileyo yokushayela.
xh.duties: Lawula isigqebelo esinikiwe nguMlawuli. Lawula, qeqesha kwaye uholele oGqatsha bethetho, oGosi nabathathi-nxaxheba malunga nayo yonke imicimbi, kuquka imicimbi enzima ebucala, kwigosa eliphezulu, igosa eliphezulu lezibhalo kwaye legosa lolulo-mthetho. Phanda kwaye ugxole imicimbi. Nikezela ngokulawula nokuqonda kwimicimbi yophando kwaye kumagosa. Funda iifayile zemicimbi namaxwebhu amanye athe ngqo kwimicimbi yokukhukhumala, imicimbi ezingalunganga, wenze kwaye uhloliswe ngokumalunga nesigqibo sokusungula imicimbi yezozenzo ezingalunganga. Lungiselela imicimbi yamagosa kuquka nokufumana iziqinisekiso ezongeziweyo nokupepeta amaphepha okutyhila, izibhalo zokutyhila namaxwebhu amanye egosa. Bonisa icala lelilizwe kwigosa, kuquka nokubuzwa nokubuzwa kwengangelelo kwaye unxibelelane negosa ngokuwela kwisigwebo nesigqibo. Funda izibhalo zokurhoxiswa nezohlolwayo, lungiselela iimbono nentloko nengxoxo kwaye uxoxe imicimbi kwigosa elifanelekileyo. Bonakala kwisicelo sokushukuma ngokumalunga nemicimbi ezingalunganga. Lwakho isicwangciso sezicwangciso zolwangqam kwicala kwaye uholele abasebenzi ukuba bafikelele kwizinjongo zolwangqam. Qwalasela izixhobo kwaye uzidibanise nezinjongo zolwangqam. Uphuhliso, ulawulo lokusebenza kunye nokuqwalasela kwabasebenzi. Jongana nemiganeko neengxaki. Qinisekisa ukuba umgangatho ophezulu womsebenzi obungcali uyenziwa. Khuthaza udibaniso lwabahlobo, unxibelelwano loluntu kwaye wenze abathengi bayonwabela ngokudibana nabahlobo kwinkqubo yolulwazi lwemigalelo.

jobs.title: Deputy Director of Public Prosecutions (REGIONAL Head)
jobs.summary: Lead the Johannesburg regional office of the NPA as Deputy Director of Public Prosecutions, overseeing prosecution decisions and managing operations.
jobs.requirements: An LLB. For serving prosecutors seeking promotion any appropriate legal qualification. At least ten (10) years’ post qualification experience in civil and/or criminal litigation. Knowledge and experience in Strategic and Operations Management. Right of appearance as contemplated in section 25(2) of the NPA Act, 32 of 1998. Demonstrable competency in acting Independently, Professionally, Accountable and with Credibility. Admission as an Attorney/Advocate will be an added advantage. Good advocacy, well developed skills in legal drafting skills. Good knowledge of civil and/or criminal procedure. Willing to travel and able to work extended hours. Strong organisational leadership skills. Strong interpersonal and communication skills. Ability to think strategically and innovatively and management. Strong computer skills will be required. Valid driver’s license.
jobs.duties: Manage and direct the activities of the regional office. Exercise oversight on any decisions to prosecute and to give any necessary advice and report to the DPP. Ensure that all decisions to prosecute comply with all relevant legal prescripts, the Constitution and all applicable policies, procedures and directives. Ensure that plans are in place to promote good stakeholder and partner engagement. Ensure that the regional office meets targets, to continuously analyse, review and monitor operational performance of the office in order, inter alia, to identify any operational deficiencies and to monitor the achievement of strategic objectives and annual targets. Develop any performance or delivery improvement plans or make such interventions as circumstances may require. Conduct specialised litigation of complex/high profile criminal and civil matters in the High Court, the Highest Court of Appeal and the Constitutional Court. Study case dockets and other documents relating to criminal cases, make and review decisions with regard to the institution of the criminal proceedings. Represent the States’ case in court including examination and cross-examination of witnesses. Study appeals and reviews. Prepare opinions and heads of argument and argue cases in the appropriate court. Appear in the motion applications pertaining to criminal and civil matters. Conduct research and provide advice/legal opinion/case law relevant to specialised field of law. Deal with representations and complaints and ensure that a high standard of professional work is being carried out. Train and guide Advocates, Prosecutors and stakeholders in respect of all specialised matters. Oversee resources and align them to strategic objectives.

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur van Openbare Vervolgings (STREEKSHoof)
af.summary: Bestuur die Johannesburg streekkantoor van die NPA as Adjunkdirekteur van Openbare Vervolgings, hou toesig oor vervolgingsbesluite en bestuur operasies.
af.requirements: 'n LLB. Vir dienende aanklaers wat bevordering soek, enige toepaslike regskwalifikasie. Ten minste tien (10) jaar se kwalifikasie-na-ervaring in siviele en/of strafregtelike litigasie. Kennis en ervaring in strategiese en operasionele bestuur. Verskyningsreg soos uiteengesit in artikel 25(2) van die NPA-wet, 32 van 1998. Aantoonbare bevoegdheid om onafhanklik, professioneel, verantwoordelik en met geloofwaardigheid op te tree. Toelating as 'n prokureur/advokaat sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Goie pleitvaardigheid, goed ontwikkelde vaardighede in regsdienste. Goeie kennis van siviele en/of strafregtelike prosedure. Bereid om te reis en in staat om verlengde ure te werk. Sterk organisatoriese leierskapvaardighede. Sterk interpersoonlike en kommunikasievaardighede. Vermoë om strategies en innoverend te dink en te bestuur. Sterk rekenaarvaardighede sal vereis word. Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Bestuur en dirigeer die aktiwiteite van die streekkantoor. Oefen toesig uit oor enige beslissings om te vervolg en om enige nodige advies te gee en aan die DPP te rapporteer. Verseker dat alle beslissings om te vervolg aan alle tersaaklike regswoorde, die Grondwet en alle toepaslike beleide, prosedures en direktiewe voldoen. Verseker dat planne in plek is om goeie belanghebbende- en vennootbetrokkenheid te bevorder. Verseker dat die streekkantoor teikens bereik, om die operasionele prestasie van die kantoor deurlopend te ontleed, te hersien en te monitor om, onder andere, enige operasionele tekortkominge te identifiseer en die bereiking van strategiese doelwitte en jaarlikse teikens te monitor. Ontwikkel enige prestasie- of leweringsverbeteringsplanne of maak sulke ingrypinge soos omstandighede mag vereis. Voer gespesialiseerde litigasie van ingewikkelde/hoëprofiel strafregtelike en siviele sake in die Hooggeregshof, die Hoogste Hof van Appèl en die Konstitusionele Hof uit. Bestudeer saakdossiers en ander dokumente wat met strafsake verband hou, maak en hersien beslissings met betrekking tot die instelling van strafregtelike verrigtinge. Verteenwoordig die Staat se saak in die hof insluitende ondervraging en kruisondervraging van getuies. Bestudeer appèlle en hersienings. Berei menings en hoofde van argument voor en pleit sake in die toepaslike hof. Verskyn in motie-aansoeke rakende strafregtelike en siviele sake. Doen navorsing en verskaf advies/regsmening/regspraak wat relevant is tot die gespesialiseerde regsgebied. Hanteer voorleggings en klagtes en verseker dat 'n hoë standaard van professionele werk uitgevoer word. Train en lei Advokate, Aanklaers en belanghebbendes ten opsigte van alle gespesialiseerde sake. Hou toesig oor hulpbronne en belyn dit met strategiese doelwitte.

zu.title: Isikhathi Somabili Somqondisi Wezombusazwe Mphakathi (Nhloko Yendawo)
zu.summary: Mqondisa ofisi yendawo ye-NPA e-Johannesburg njengoba Somqondisi Ohambisana Nezinto Ezimbili Zomqondisi Wezombusazwe Mphakathi, ubuke iminqumo yokushenxisa izigwebo uphinde ulawule imisebenzi.
zu.requirements: I-LLB. Kubavuli abafuna ukukhushulwa esikhundleni noma yisiphi isifundo esifanele samalungelo abo. Okungenani iminyaka eyishumi (10) yeminyaka yokusebenza ngemuva kokuthola isifundo ekulweni izinkantolo zamaphoyisa noma ezomphakathi. Ulwazi noluhla oluhlelekile kokuphathwa kwezomnotho. Ilungelo lokubonakala njengoba kuchaziwe esigabeni 25(2) soMthetho we-NPA, 32 ka-1998. Isikhathi sokuziphatha okuzimele ngokuzenzakalela, ngokuziphatha, nangokuziphatha okuhle. Ukumukelwa njengommeli kuzoba yinongo ezongwayo. Ukumelwa okuhle, amakhono amakhulu okubhala izixuku ezomthetho. Ulwazi oluhle ngamasu amaphoyisa namaphakathi. Ukuthanda ukuhamba nokusebenza amasikhathi amade. Amakhono amakhulu okulawula inhlangano. Amakhono amakhulu okukhuluma nabantu nokuxhumana. Isikhathi sokuqamba amasu amakhulu nokuhlanganisa okulawulwayo. Amakhono amakhulu kakhulu kumakhompyutha. Ilayisense yokushayela evumelekile.
zu.duties: Phatha futhi uqondise imisebenzi yofisi yendawo. Buka phezulu noma yimiphi iminqumo yokufaka izigwebo ukuze unikeze izeluleko eziyimfuneko uphide ubike ku-DPP. Qinisekisa ukuthi yonke iminqumo yokushenxisa izigwebo ihambisana nemithetho yonke emayelana, uMthethosisekelo kanye nanoma yimiphi imithetho elandelwayo, amasu kanye nemiyalo. Qinisekisa ukuthi kunamaphulani ukuthuthukisa ubudlelwane obuhle nabathintekayo nabalingani. Qinisekisa ukuthi ofisi yendawona ifinyelela imigomo, ihlale ihlola uphinde ibuke imisebenzi yofisi ukuze kutholakale, phakathi kwezinye izinto, noma yimaphi amaphutha emisebenzi bese ubuka ukufeza kwemigomo enkulu nemigomo yonyaka. Hlela amaphulani okuthuthukisa ukusebenza nokulethwa noma wenze izinhlelo ezithile njengoba kudingeka izimo. Yenza izinkantolo ezibalulekile zezindaba ezinzima/ezaziwayo zamaphoyisa namaphakathi enkantolo enkulu, enkantolo ephakeme yokuphikisana nenkantolo yomthethosisekelo. Funde amafayili ezinkantolo namadokhumenti amanye ahlobene nezinkolezi zamaphoyisa, wenze uphinde ubuke iminqumo ngokuqalisa izinkantolo zamaphoyisa. Mela icala lesiFunda enkantolo kufaka phakathi ukubuka nokubuza imephu. Funde izinhlawulo nezibuyekezo. Lungiselela izinhliziyo namakhanda emibhalo bese uphikisa icala enkantolo efanele. Bonakala ezicini zezinhlelo zokukhishwa kwezindaba zamaphoyisa namaphakathi. Yenza ucwaningo unikeze izeluleko/izinhliziyo ezomthetho/isimo somthetho esibhalwe izinkantolo. Phatha izinkalo ngezinkathaziso bese uqinisekisa ukuthi kwenziwa umsebenzi ophakeme wezomthetho. Fundisa futhi uhola abamelisiizinkantolo ababambe izinkantolo nabathintekayo ngezindaba ezithile. Buka ngaphezulu amathuba bese uwahambisanisana nemigomo enkulu.

xh.title: Sekela Mongameli weeNkonzo zoBukhosi (REGIONAL Head)
xh.summary: Hola kwideofisi yemimandla yeJohannesburg yeNPA njengoSekela Mongameli weeNkonzo zoBukhosi, ulawule iigqibo zokwalathela abatywiniwa kwaye ulawule imisebenzi.
xh.requirements: I-LLB. Ukubagqwethi abakhoyo abafuna ukukhushulelwa nawuphi na umthetho ofanelekileyo. Akukho nanzantsi kweminyaka elishumi (10) yokusingathiwa kwamava emva kokufumana isidanga kubudabi obungazweni kunye/nobe obugcugu. Ulwazi kunye namava ekulawulweni kweekhomitywe kunye neendawo zokusebenza. Ilungelo lokubonakala njengoko kuchazwe kwicandelo 25(2) lomthetho weNPA, 32 ka 1998. Ikhono eliyakwaziyo ukubonakala ngokuzimele, ngobugcisa, ngokubuzwa kwaye nangokwethenjwa. Ukuvunywa njengoAttorney/Advocate kuya kuba luncedo. Ubugcisa obuhle bokugqwetha, amakhono abhala amaxwebhu omthetho. Ulwazi oluhle lweenkqubo zabugcugu nobungazweni. Ulungele ukuhamba kwaye ukwazi ukusebenza iiyure ezongezelelweyo. Amandla amakhulu abakhokheli bokuhlelwa. Amandla amakhulu abantu kunye nokuqhathanisa. Ikhono lokucinga ngokulingana nokubakho iindlela ezintsha kunye nolawulo. Amandla amakhulu ekhompyutha kuya kufuneka. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba esemthethweni.
xh.duties: Phatha ihola umsebenzi weofisi yemimandla. Zenza ukujonga ngaphezulu nge nayiphi na igqibo lokwalathela abatywiniwa, kunye nokunikela nayiphi na icebiso elidingekayo kwaye ube ngxelo kuDPP. Qinisekisa ukuzonke iigqibo zokwalathela abatywiniwa zihambelana nazo zonke izalathiso ezifanelekileyo zomthetho, iKhalenda nayo yonke inkqubo, iinkqubo ezichaziweyo kunye neendikimba ezinikwayo. Qinisekisa ukuba kukho iindawo zokusetyenziswa ukukhuthaza ubudlelwane obuhle nabathintekayo kunye nabahlobo. Qinisekisa ukuba ofisi yemimandla ifikelela kumgangatho oqokiweyo, uhlalo uyahlola, uphephindo ubuke kwaye ulawule ukusebenza kweofisi ukuze, phakathi kwabanye, iqonde naziphi na iingcaphepho ekusebenzeni kwaye ilawule ukuphumeza iinjongo ezibaluleke kakhulu kunye nemigangatho yonyaka. Yila nayiphi na iindawo zokuphucula ukusebenza okanye ukulethwa okanye wenzangezi njengoko imeko idinga. Zenza imisebenzi yamatyala ezimo ezinzima nakumatyala abaluleke kakhulu obugcisa obuyeyona bubudabi phakathi kwamatyala obugebengu nobungazweni kwiHigh Court, iHighest Court of Appeal nakuwo wonke amatyala eConstitutional Court. Funda amatyala amabhokhwe kunye namanye amaxwebhu ahambelana namatyala obugcugu, wenze kwaye uhlolojle iigqibo ngokumayela nokuqalisa iinkqubo zobugcugu. Mela icala loBukhosi enkundleni kuquka nokubuza nokubuzwa ngabafakankqubo. Funda iingxelo zokuphikisana kunye nezokupephiswa. Lungiselela iingcinga kunye neengxelo zeengcinga kwaye uze ubhaxa amatyala enkundleni efanelekileyo. Phakama kwiinkqubo eziguquguqukayo ezihambelana namatyala obugcugu nobungazweni. Yenza uphando kunye nokunika icebiso/ingcinga yomthetho/umthetho ohambelana nendawo ekhethekileyo yomthetho. Jongana neengxelo zamabali kunye neendikwebe kwaye uqinisekise ukuba kwenziwa umsebenzi wabugcisa obumgangatho ophezulu. Qeqesha kwaye uhola abaGqwetha, abagqwethi kunye nabathintekayo ngokumayela nayo yonke imiba ekhethekileyo. Jonga iindulu kwaye uzibandakanye nazo kunye neenjongo ezibaluleke kakhulu.
