af.title: Adjunkdirekteur van Openbare Vervolgingsgesag
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur van Openbare Vervolgingsgesag by die NPA Bloemfontein Georganiseerde Misdaadkomponent, wat toesig hou oor vervolgingsbesluite en advies gee oor FATF- en POCA-aangeleenthede.
af.requirements: 'n LLB. Vir dienende aanklaers wat bevordering soek, enige toepaslike regskwalifikasie. Ten minste tien (10) jaar se kwalifikasie-ervaring in siviele en/of strafregtelike litigasie. Ten minste vyf (5) jaar se ervaring in strafproses en die POCA-wetgewing is noodsaaklik. Reg van verskyning soos uiteengesit in artikel 25(2) van die NPA-wet, 32 van 1998. Aantoonbare bevoegdheid om onafhanklik, professioneel, verantwoordelik en met geloofwaardigheid op te tree. Toelating as 'n prokureur/advokaat sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Goed ontwikkelde vaardighede in regsnavorsing en regsdienste. Kennis van siviele en/of strafproses. Goeie interpersoonlike, ontledende, voorleggings- en kommunikasievaardighede. Die vermoë om onafhanklik op te tree. Sterrekenaarisegtervaardighede sal benodig word. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie.
af.duties: Om toesig te hou oor enige besluit om te vervolg, en om enige nodige advies te gee en verslag te doen aan die Hoof van die Georganiseerde Misdaadkomponent. Om alle dokumente wat deur die FATF opgestel is te lees en te interpreter, en leiding/menings aan die NPS oor die betrokke dokumente te gee. Om hoëvlak- en deeglik nagevorsde menings en verslae aan die Hoof van die Georganiseerde Misdaadkomponent te verskaf. Om bestuur en bedrywighede in die Geldwassingskomponent te bestuur en te rig. Om bedryfsondersoek van die streekkantore deurlopend te ontleed, te hersien en te monitor om, onder andere, bedryfstekorte te identifiseer en die bereiking van strategiese doelwitte en jaarlikse teikens te monitor. Om enige prestasie- of leweringsverbeteringsplanne te ontwikkel of sulke ingrypings te doen soos omstandighede mag vereis. Om strategie en bedrywighede te monitor en te hersien. Om toesig te hou oor die ontwikkeling en implementering van toepaslike werknemersprestasiebestuurstelsels. Om te verseker dat aksieplanne in plek is om goeie belange- en vennootskapbetrokkenheid te bevorder. Om interne en eksterne vergaderings te reël en te koördineer. Om aan alle belange- en vennootskapvergaderings deel te neem. Om gereeld met tersaaklike belanghebbendes te vergader om die mandaat van die Geldwassingskomponent doeltreffend uit te voer. Om voorleggings vir die Uitvoerende Komitee en die Bestuurskomitee voor te berei. Om opleidingsgappe te identifiseer en dit aan die hoof van die Opleidingskomponent te kommunikeer.

zu.title: Isikhundla sikaSekela Mkhuzo wezinkantolo zomphakathi
zu.summary: Isikhundla sikaSekela Mkhuzo wezinkantolo zomphakathi e-NPA Bloemfontein Organised Crime Component, sibheke izinqumo zokumangalela futhi sinike izeluleko ezindabeni ze-FATF kanye ne-POCA.
zu.requirements: I-LLB. Kubaphathi bezinkantolo abafuna ukuthuthuka noma yisiphi isimiso sezomthetho esifanele. Okungenani amaphesenti ayishumi (10) okutholwa emsebenzini wesikhathi eside emacala abomphakathi kanye/noma abobugebengu. Okungenani amaphesenti amahlanu (5) okutholwa emsebenzini wendlela yamacala obugebengu kanye nomthetho we-POCA kubalulekile. Ilungelo lokubonakala njengoba kucatshangelwa esigabeni 25(2) somthetho we-NPA, 32 ka-1998. Ubungazi bokusebenza ngokuzimele, ngobungcweti, ngobuzayo nokwaziseka okubonakalayo. Ukubhaliswa njengommeli kuzoba yinzuzo yokwenyeza. Ukumela okuhle, amakhono obubalo obuhlakaniphile ngocwaningo olusemthethweni namakhono okubhala amadokhumenti ezomthetho. Ulwazi ngendlela yamacala abomphakathi kanye/noma obugebengu. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana nabantu, ukuhlaziya, ukubonisa nokucommunicateda. Ikhono lokusebenza ngokuzimela. Amakhono amakhulu ekhompyutha azodingeka. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni.
zu.duties: Ukubheka ngaphezulu noma yisiphi isinqumo sokumangalela, futhi ukunikeza noma yisiphi iseluleko esidingekile nokubika kuHloko be-Organised Crime Component. Ukufunda nokutolika yonke imibhalu ethuthwe yi-FATF nokunikeza iziqondiso/iziboniso ku-NPS ngaleyo mibhalu. Ukunikeza iziboniso nemibiko enezinga eliphezulu efundwe ngokujulile kuHloko be-Organised Crime Component. Ukuphatha nokuhola ukulawula kanye nemisebenzi kwi-Money Lauftoring Component. Ukuhlaziya ngokuqhubekayo, ukubuyekeza nokubheka ukusebenza kweminye yamakomidi ezifundazweni ukuze, phakathi kwokunye, kuqashelwe izinto ezingenzi okungenani emsebenzini futhi kubhekwe ukufeza izinhloso ezibalulekile izinguquko ezinyakeni. Ukuthuthukisa noma yimiphi imiklamo yokuthuthukisa ukusebenza noma ukuletha izinhlelo ezithile njengoba zingase zidingwe zizimo. Ukubheka nokuyekeza ukwesabelo kanye nemisebenzi. Ukubheka ukuthuthukiswa nokusetshenziswa kwemiklamo yokuqashwa komsebenzi abasebenzi abafanelekile. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kukhona izinhlelo zomsebenzi zokuqasha kuzo zonke izindandathulo ukuze kube nokubambe iqhaza abantu kubambisene kakhulu nabaholi abaningi kanye nabaholi abangenamakhosi. Ukuhlela nokuhlanganisa izinkomfa ezingaphakathi nasezangaphandle. Ukubamba iqhaza kuzo zonke izinkomfa zabantu. Ukuhlangana nabantu abahola njalo ngesikhathi esithile ukulalela imiyalelo efanele ngokuphatha kanye neqembu lezomthetho ze-Money Laundering Component. Ukulungela izinkomfa zokhulu wephini futhi wephini ophethe iphathi leqembu. Ukuqashela izikhala ezingezwa ukubaluleka bese ethumela ekuhohweni beqembu leqembu lokuthola ulwazi oluncane.

xh.title: iSekela Mongameli weZigqibo zeNdlela zokuJonga eMizekelweni
xh.summary: iSekela Mongameli weZigqibo zeNdlela zokuJonga eMizekelweni kwisiCandu seNtengo eNcadweni iBloemfontein, iphethe iigqibo zokuqhotyiswa kweenkundla kwaye inika izigqibo ezimalunga neFATF nakwiPOCA.
xh.requirements: iDigri yeLLB. Kumatshati abungameli abafuna ukuphakamiswa nalipho na igunya eliqhathaniswa ngokomthetho. Uqobo lweyure eziliqumi (10) zeminyaka yamava emva kokufumana idigri ekugqibenzi nasekuqhotyisweni kweenkundla. Kubalulekile ukuba nobungozi bobungakanisi bokuzimisela okungaphantsi kwemigca yemithetho yePOCA. Ilungelelwaniso lokubonakala njengoko kucatshulwe kwisiqendu 25(2) seMthetho weNPA, 32 ka-1998. Ukubonakala ngamandla okuSebenza ngokuzimela, ngobungcalisebe, ngokubekiweyo nangokuzinikela. Ukubhaliswa njengommeli kuya kuba nenzuzo enkulu. Ukukhokela imizekelo ngokubalaseleyo, amandla abucala kwiNdlela zokuKhangela nakuwoWonke-wonke ulwazi ngokubhalwa kolwazi oluBekiweyo. Ulwazi ngolawulo lweekhaya nasekuqhotyisweni ngokomthetho obabuzayo. Amabala amaninzi okulingana nabantu, ukwahlula-hlula ulwazi, okubonakalisa nokuqhathanisa ulwazi. Ukuzimela ngokusebenza. Amandla amaninzi ekhompyutha kuya kufuneka. Ilayisenisi yokushayela esebenzayo.
xh.duties: Ukuphatha naliphi na igqibo lotyholo, nokuqwalasela iingcebiso ezifunekayo kwakunye nokubika kumntu ophezulu kwiNtengo yoLuntu. Ukufunda nokutolika zonke iifayile ezichaziweyo yiFATF nokunika iingcebiso eziphambili / izigqibo kwiNPA ngeefayile ezichaziweyo. Inika iingcebiso namaxephula aphezulu nophando olulungelelwaniswe ngokuphantsi kukaMongameli weLigatya leZigqibo eziLungelelwanisiweyo. Ukulawula nokuhamba phambathi kolawulo nakupembeleko kwiLigatya leMali eSwela ukuSetyenziswa ngokomthetho. Ukuphanda qho, ukubukisa kwaye ulandele inkqubo yemisebenzi kwi-ofisi ezinkulu ukujonga, phakathi kwamanye, iindida kwinkqubo yokusebenza ukuze ujonge ukuphumelela iindawo ezibalulekileyo neziphumo zeminyaka yonke. Ukuqamba naliphi na icebo lokuziphumeza okanye ukubamba inkalo ekunzimeni kokuhamba njengoko kuyimfuneko. Ukulandela nokubukisa amacebo nokuqhuba imisebenzi. Ukuqwalasela ukuqanjwa kwaye kusetenziswe inkqubo ekulungelelwaneni nokusebenza komntu ngamnye. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba kukho iindlela ezilungelelwanisweyo ukwandisa ubudlelwane obuhle nabantu abathile nabahlangeneyo. Ukuhlela nokulungelelwanisa iindibano ezangaphakathi nangaphandle. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kuzo zonke iindibano ezibekelwe abantu abahlangeneyo. Ukudibana nabantu abathile abahlangeneyo rhoqo ukuze kuze kuqwalaselwe ngokuchanekileyo iNyanisela yeLigatya leMali eSwela ukuSetyenziswa. Ukulungiselela iingcebiso ezibonakaliswa ngokubonakaliswa kwiKomiti yoLawulo. Ukubona iindlela ezikulungelelwaniswa kwaye zidityaniswe nomtshato weLigatya leMfundo.

jobs.title: Deputy Director of Public Prosecutions (REGIONAL Head)
jobs.summary: Deputy Director of Public Prosecutions sought to guide investigations, conduct prosecutions and oversee prosecutorial decisions at the NPA's regional head office in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: An LLB. For serving prosecutors seeking promotion any appropriate legal qualification. At least ten (10) years’ post qualification experience in civil and/or criminal litigation. Demonstrable competency in acting Independently, Professionally, Accountable and with Credibility. Admission as an Attorney/Advocate will be an added advantage. Good advocacy and legal drafting skills. Knowledge of civil and/or criminal procedure. Right of appearance as contemplated in section 25(2) of the NPA Act, 32 of 1998. Good interpersonal, analytical, presentation and communication skills. Computer skills. Able to work extended hours. Valid driver’s license.
jobs.duties: To guide investigations and conduct prosecutions of identified cases. To exercise oversight on any decision to prosecute, and to give any necessary advice and report to the Head of the SCCU. To ensure that decisions to prosecute or not prosecute comply with all relevant legal prescripts, the Constitution, and all applicable policies, procedures and directive. To provide high level and well researched opinions and reports to the Head of the SCCU. To manage and direct governance and operations in the SCCU. To monitor and review strategy and operations. To provide enterprise performance reports. To liaise with regional offices and arrange meetings in this regard. To render professional advice to the Head of the SCCU, as required. To ensure that plans are in place to promote good stakeholder and partner engagement. To ensure that the national strategy and annual plan of the SCCU are developed and implemented. To monitor delivery of the regional offices in line with the strategy and plan. In order to ensure that the regional offices meet targets, to continuously analyse, review and monitor operational performance of the offices in order, inter alia, to identify and operational deficiencies and to monitor the achievement of strategic objectives and annual targets. To develop any performance or delivery improvement plans or make such interventions as circumstances may require. To oversee the development and implementation of appropriate employee performance management systems. To initiate and implement training initiative by establishing training needs both at national and regional levels. To meet with relevant stakeholders on a regular basis in order to effectively execute the mandate of SCCU
jobs.applications: e mail: Recruit2026264@npa.gov.za
jobs.notes: Applicants must apply by submitting applications on the most recent Z83 form obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the DPSA web site link: https://www.dpsa.gov.za/newsroom/psvc/ and a comprehensive CV ONLY (with detailed experience information). Failure to do so will result in your application being disqualified. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on or before the day of the interview following communication from Human Resources. Foreign qualifications must be accompanied by an evaluation report issued by SAQA (only when shortlisted). It is the applicant’s responsibility to have all foreign qualifications evaluated by SAQA and to provide proof of such evaluation (only when shortlisted). All applications must reach the NPA on/or before the closing date. No late applications will be accepted/processed. Documents should not be password protected, and ZIP files will be blocked. The NPA cannot be held responsible for server delays. All applications must reach the NPA on/or before the closing date. No late applications will be accepted/processed. The applicant’s attention is drawn to the fact that the NPA uses an Electronic Response Handling System in terms of e-mailed applications. Please do not contact the NPA directly after you have e-mailed your applications to enquire if your application(s) have been received. If you have not received an acknowledgement of receipt within one week after the closing date, then you can contact the NPA. The NPA reserves the right not to fill any particular position. If you do not hear from us within (6) six months from the closing date of the advert, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Successful candidates will be subjected to a security clearance of at least confidential. Appointment to this position will be provisional, pending the issue of security clearance. Fingerprints will be taken on the day of the interview. The social media accounts of shortlisted applicants may be accessed as part of the verification process. A valid driver’s license will be a requirement where applicable. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments which are, a practical exercise and an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All SMS posts will be subjected to a lifestyle audit. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. A pre-entry certificate obtained from the National School of Government (NSG) is required for all SMS applicants for Public Service Act positions in the NPA (SMS pre-entry certificate to be submitted prior to appointment). NPA Act appointments are exempted from the pre-entry certificate requirement. This is a Public Service specific training programme. af.title: Adjunkdirekteur van Openbare Vervolgings (Streekshoof)
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur van Openbare Vervolgings gesoek om ondersoeke te lei, vervolgings te voer en vervolgingsbesluite by die NPA se streekshoofkantoor in Pretoria te hou.
af.requirements: 'n LLB. Vir dienende aanklaers wat bevordering soek, enige toepaslike regsgehalte. Ten minste tien (10) jaar se ervaring na kwalifikasie in siviele en/of kriminele litigasie. Aantoonbare bevoegdheid om Onafhanklik, Professioneel, Verantwoordelik en met Geloofwaardigheid op te tree. Toelating as 'n Prokureur/Advokaat sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Goeie pleit- en regsdienstvaardighede. Kennis van siviele en/of kriminele prosedure. Verskyningsreg soos uiteengesit in artikel 25(2) van die NPA-wet, 32 van 1998. Goeie interpersoonlike, analitiese, voorlegging- en kommunikasievaardighede. Rekenaarvaardighede. In staat om buitegewone ure te werk. Geldige bestuurslisensie.
af.duties: Om ondersoeke te lei en vervolgings van geïdentifiseerde sake te voer. Om toesig te hou oor enige besluit om te vervolg, en om enige nodige advies te gee en aan die Hoof van die SCCU te rapporteer. Om te verseker dat besluite om te vervolg of nie te vervolg nie voldoen aan alle tersaaklike regswaarskuwings, die Grondwet, en alle toepaslike beleide, prosedures en riglyne. Om hoëvlak- en goed nagevorsde menings en verslae aan die Hoof van die SCCU te verskaf. Om bestuur en bedrywe in die SCCU te bestuur en te rig. Om strategie en bedrywe te monitor en te hersien. Om ondernemingsprestasieverslae te verskaf. Om met streekkantore te skakel en vergaderings in hierdie verband te reël. Om professionele advies aan die Hoof van die SCCU te lewer, soos vereis. Om te verseker dat planne in plek is om goeie belanghebbende- en vennootbetrokkenheid te bevorder. Om te verseker dat die nasionale strategie en jaarlikse plan van die SCCU ontwikkel en geïmplementeer word. Om leweransie van die streekkantore in ooreenstemming met die strategie en plan te monitor. Ten einde te verseker dat die streekkantore teikens bereik, om bedryflike prestasie van die kantore deurlopend te ontleed, te hersien en te monitor om, onder andere, enige bedryfstekorte te identifiseer en om die bereiking van strategiese doelwitte en jaarlikse teikens te monitor. Om enige prestasie- of leweransieverbeteringsplanne te ontwikkel of sodanige ingrypings te maak soos omstandighede mag vereis. Om toesig te hou oor die ontwikkeling en implementering van toepaslike werknemerprestasiebestuurstelsels. Om opleidingsinisiatiewe te begin en te implementeer deur opleidingsbehoeftes sowat op nasionale as streekvlak vas te stel. Om op 'n gereelde basis met tersaaklike belanghebbendes te vergader ten einde die mandaat van die SCCU doeltreffend uit te voer.

zu.title: IBamba Ohamba Lezokulwelwa Izimali Mphathwa (Inhloko Yesifunda)
zu.summary: Kufunwa iBamba Ohamba Lezokulwelwa Izimali Mphathwa ukuba ohole iziphothongo, zenze izinkantolo futhi ziqaphe izinqumo zezinkantolo ehhovisi likahamba lesifunda le-NPA ePretoria.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-LLB. Kubashimanga abayasebenza abafuna ukuthuthuka noma yisiphi isabelo sezomthetho esifanele. Okungenani iminyaka eyishumi (10) yokuhamba kwamava emisebenzi ekulwelweni noma ngasese noma lezobhekene nobugebengu. Ukubonakala kwamakhono okusebenza ngokuzimele, ngobungcwathi, ngekubamba ibhayo, kanye nokuqinisekiswa. Ukungena njengesigqili noma njengomgcinimafa kuzoba yindlela engeza inzuzo. Amakhono amahle okulwela izikhulumi kanye nokuqamba amaphoyili emthethweni. Ulwazi lwenkqubo noma ngasese noma lezobhekene nobugebengu. Ilungelo lokubonakala njengoba kucatshangwa kwisigaba 25(2) soMthetho we-NPA, 32 ka-1998. Amakhono amahle abantu, okuhlaziya, okubonisa kanye nokuxhumana. Amakhono ekhompyutha. Ukwazi ukusebenza amahora amanengi. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni.
zu.duties: Ukuhola iziphothongo kanye nokwenza izinkantolo zemikhankaso ebonwe ngendlela ethile. Ukwenza ulwazi oluphelele ngesiphi isinqumo sokulwela icala, kanye nokunika nasiphi isixhaso esidingekayo futhi kubike kuNhloko ye-SCCU. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinqumo zokulwela noma ukungalwela icala zihambelana nazo zoke izimiso ezibalulekile zomthetho, uMthethosisekelo, kanye nazo zoke izinqubo, izimiso, nemiyalo. Ukunikeza imibono namabhikidi ephenzwe kabanzi kwizinga eliphezulu kuNhloko ye-SCCU. Ukuphatha futhi kuhole imiso nokusebenza kwi-SCCU. Ukulandela futhi kuhlaziye iwuqobo nokusebenza. Ukunikeza amabhikidi emigwaqo yemisebenzi yentShiqamo. Ukuxhumanisa namahhovisi wesifunda futhi ahlele imihlanganiso ngokufanele. Ukunikela ngengosi esemthethweni kuNhloko ye-SCCU, njengoba kudingekile. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kukhona izinkqubo zokukhuthaza ubudlelwano obuhle nabashowo bamasheya kanye nabahlanganyeli. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi iwuqobo kazwelonke kanye nenkqubo yonyaka ye-SCCU zikhiqizwa futhi zisetshenziswe. Ukuqaphela ukulethwa kwemisebenzi yamahhovisi wesifunda ngokuhambelana newuqobo kanye nenkqubo. Ukugcina ukuthi amahhovisi wesifunda ahlangabezana nokuqedwa, ukuhlaza, kwahlule futhi aqaphe ukusebenza kwamahhovisi njalo ukuze, phakathi kwokunye, athole noma yisiphi isileso kokusebenza futhi aqaphe ukufeza kwezinhloso ziwuqobo kanye neziqu zonyaka. Ukukhiqiza noma yiziphi izinkqubo zokuthuthukisa ukufeza noma ukulethwa noma ukwenza noma yimiphi imikhankaso njengoba izimo zingase zidinge. Ukubuka ngokugcwele ukukhiqizwa kanye nokusetshenziswa kwezinkqubo ezifanele zokuphatha imisebenzi yabasebenzi. Ukuqala futhi kuyise inkqubo yokuhlola ngokusungela izidingo zokuhlolwa kokubili kazwelonke nakwesifunda. Ukuhlangana nabashowo bamasheya abahlobene ngokujwayelekile ukuze kwenziwe ngempumelelo umsebenzi ka-SCCU

xh.title: U Somlawuli ongumLawuli ongasebenzele uMbuso (INtloko Yommandla)
xh.summary: Kufunwa uSomlawuli ongumLawuli ongasebenzele uMbuso ukuba alungele imaphu, aqhube izigqibo zokugweba aze alawule iingqibo zokugweba kwindawo enkulu yentloko yommandla ye-NPA ePretoria.
xh.requirements: Isidanga se-LLB. Kubagwebi abakhoyo abafuna ukuzuzisa nbulungelo nanaziyo yiphi na idanga yomthetho elifanelekileyo. Ubuncinane ihlobo elingamashumi alikhulu (10) leminyaka yamava emva kokufumana idanga ekuthethwa ngokulwa izigqibo zabahlali nakanye ngezobugweba. Ukuqonda okubonakalayo ekusebenzeni kodwa, ngobungcalu, ngokuziphendula nangokwamkelwa njengomntu othembakayo. Ukubhaliswa njengommeli/ntyatyambo kuya kuba lusizo olongezelelweyo. Amakhono amabalawa ekubeka ngokuchanekileyo umthetho kwaye ulungise amanqaku omthetho. Ulwazi ngendlela yohla lothetho ngabahlali nakanye ngezobugweba. Ilungelo lokubonakala njengoko kucetyiswa kumaziko angama-25(2) e-NPA Act, 32 ka-1998. Amakhono amabalawa kokwenzelana nabantu, ukuhlalutya, okubonisa nokucommunicate. Amakhono ekusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuba nakho ukusebenza iiyure ezengezelekileyo. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni.
xh.duties: Ukulungelela imaphu nokurhola izigqibo ngokugweba eziyaziwayo. Ukwenza ulawulo ngaphezu kwalo naliphi na igqibo lokugweba, nokunika naliphi na icebiso elidingekayo kwaye uchaze kwiNtloko ye-SCCU. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba iigqibo zokugweba nokungagwebi zihambelana nayo yonke imimiselo yomthetho, uMgaqo-siseko, nayo yonke iinkqubo, iimiso nokuwohloka. Ukunika amacebiso amanqaku apheleleyo apha phiwe ngokucokisiswa kuNtloko ye-SCCU. Ukulawula nokukhokela ulawulo nokuqhuba kwi-SCCU. Ukuqapha nokuhengahlengisa inqanaba nokuqhutywa kweenkqubo. Ukuhluza iingxelo zokusebenza kommoya. Ukuqhagamshelana neendawo zommandla ukuze uqhelane iindibano malunga noku. Ukunika icebiso elingomcalu kuNtloko ye-SCCU, njengoko kufuneka. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba kukho iindawo zokusombulula ukuqhagamshelana kakuhle nabanegalelo nabadibanyi. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba inqanaba lelizwe nenkqubo yonyaka ye-SCCU zilungiswa zize zisetyenziswe. Ukuqapha ukuphunywa kweendawo zommandla ngokuhambelana nainqanaba nenkqubo. Ukuze aqinisekise ukuba iindawo zommandla zifikelela kwiziphongo, ukuhlalutya ngokuqhubekekayo, ukuhenga-hengisa ukuze aqaphe ukusebenza kweendawo ezinjalo, phakathi kwamanye, aze afumane amaphula ekusebenzeni aze aqaphe ukufezekiswa kwezinjongo zommandla neziphongo zonyaka. Ukulungisa nayiphi na iinkqubo zokuphucula ukusebenza nokuphunywa okanye wenze amanyathelo njengoko imeko ingayidinga. Ukulawula ukulungelelwa nokusebenzisa iinkqubo ezifanelekileyo zokulawula ukusebenza koqeqeshwa. Ukuqalisa nokusebenzisa iindlela zokuqeqesha ngokusika iimfuno zokuqeqesha kumaziko alizwe nakuzo nazommandla. Ukuhlangana nabanegalelo abahlobene ngokuhamba rhoqo ukuze apha phathe ngokuchanekileyo umthetho we-SCCU.

af.title: Senior Staatsadvokaat (WVK)
af.summary: Senior Staatsadvokaat-pos by die NPP in Makhanda wat WVK-verwante strafregtelike sake hanteer, wat 'n LLB en ten minste agt jaar se post-kwalifikasie-regsonderwerp in strafregtelike litigasie vereis.
af.requirements: An LLB. Vir dienende aanklaers wat bevordering soek enige toepaslike regskwalifikasie. Ten minste agt jaar se post-kwalifikasie-regsonderwerp, in strafregtelike litigasie. Aantoonbare bevoegdheid om Onafhanklik, Professioneel, Verantwoordelik en met Geloofwaardigheid op te tree. Verskyningsreg soos uiteengesit in artikel 25(2) van die NPA-wet, 32 van 1998. Vaardigheid in MS Word, Excel en PowerPoint word vereis. ondervinding met MS Teams en Power BI sal 'n voordeel wees. Vermoë om onafhanklik sonder konstante toesig op te tree. Moet goeie administratiewe vaardighede hê. Kan onder druk werk, wat lang ure kan behels. Uitstekende analitiese en probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Aanpasbaarheid, kommunikasie en spanwerk word ook vereis met betrekking tot samewerking met ander rolspelers. Kennis en ondervinding van WVK-sake sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. 'n Geldige bestuurderlisensie.
af.duties: Bestudeer die aanbevelings van die WVK (insluitend tersaaklike volumes van die WVK en sy finale verslag, verwante artikels, videoclips en rekords en alle uitstallings en dokumente by die verhore, verhore, ondersoeke, verrigtinge ingedien) met betrekking tot toegekende WVK-sake. Oorweeg die aanbevelings van die WVK en verwante sake. Verskaf leiding aan toegewyde WVK-ondersoekbeamptes. Opstel van dokumente met betrekking tot toegang tot misdaadtonele, hofdokumente, dokumente en uitstallings in besit van ander staatsdepartemente, universiteite, nie-regeringsorganisasies en ander bystand soos deur ondersoekers benodig. Doen navorsing, opstel van regsdokumente en attendeer vertoepe voortspruitend uit WVK-sake. Neem regbesluite in ooreenstemming met die reg, beleide en geregtigheid. Bystand met die voorbereiding van klagstate/aanklagbriewe waar van toepassing. Samewerk en raadpleeg met alle tersaaklike belanghebbendes en kollegas met betrekking tot WVK-sake. Neem regbesluite in ooreenstemming met die reg, NPA-vervolgingsbeleid en -riglyne. Doen ook navorsing, berei verslae voor en opstel regsraad, beleide, belanghebbende-betrokkenheid, vergaderings en projekte. Monitor, analiseer en verslag oor prestasie-inligting en statistieke. Bystand met die ontwikkeling van strategiese, operasionele en implementeringsplanne. Identifiseer en los uitdagings wat die prestasie van die NPA beïnvloed op.

zu.title: Senior State Advocate (TRC)
zu.summary: Isikhundla sobunkantoli obaphezulu esikhungweni i-NPP eMakhanda esephatha izindaba zezono eziphathe kwi-TRC, sifuna isiqu se-LLB kanye nesipiliyono semithetho okungenamaphakathi eminyaka engu-eighti ngemuva kokuthola isiqu ekulawuleni ubugebengu.
zu.requirements: I-LLB. Kubasolwa abasebenzayo abafuna ukukhushulwa noma yisiphi isiqu somthetho esifanele. Ungaphansi kweminyaka eyisishiyagalombili yesipiliyoni semithetho ngemuva kokuthola isiqu, ekulawuleni ubugebengu ngasese. Ukukwazi ukuziphatha ngokuzimela, ngobungcweti, ngokubhekwa kanye nokuzethemba. Ilungelo lokubonakala njengoba kucatshangelwa esigabeni 25(2) se-NPA Act, 32 ka-1998. Ukukhanya ekusebenziseni i-MS Word, Excel, kanye ne-PowerPoint kudingeka. Isipiliyono kusebenzisa i-MS Teams kanye ne-Power BI kuzoba yinhlahla. Ukukwazi ukusebenza ngokuzimela ngaphandle kokulawulwa njalo. Kumele kube nokuba nobucwebebezane bokuphatha izindaba. Ukukwazi ukusebenza ngaphansi kwesinde, okungase faka amahora amade. Amakhono aphezulu okuhlaziya bese kubona ukuxazulula izinkinga. Ukuzivumelanisa, ukuxhumana nokusebenza njengomqopi kudingeka futhi mayelana nokusebenza nabanye abadlali indima. Ulwazi nesipiliyono kumayelana nezindaba ze-TRC kuzoba yinhlahla. Ilayisense yomshayeli evumelekile.
zu.duties: Funda izincomo ze-TRC (okuhlanganisa namavolumu ahlobene ne-TRC nendlalo yayo yokugcina, izihloko ezihlobene, amavidiyo ayisikhindi kanye namarekhodi, kuyo yonke imiboniso namadokhumenti anikezwe ezezinkumiso, eziyizinkantolo, iziphenyo, izinkulumo ezithinteka kulezi zindaba), ezihlobene nezindaba ze-TRC ezinikeziwe. Cabangela izincomo ze-TRC kanye nezindaba ezihlobene. Nikeza isiqondiso kubaphenyi ababekelwe ezelaphi ze-TRC. Kubhalwa kwamadokhumenti ahlobene nokufinyelela ezindawweni zobugebengu, amadokhumenti enkolo, amadokhumenti namaboniso akuleminye iminyango kahulumeni, izikhungo zezemfundo, izinhlangano ezingekho ngaphansi kohulumeni, kanye nanoma yisiphi isizo esingadingwa abaphenyi. Yenza ucwaningo, ukubhalwa kwamadokhumenti omthetho bese ukwenzela izimeko ezisuka kuzindaba ze-TRC. Thatha izinqumbo zomthetho ngokuvumelana nomthetho, izinqubomgomo nobulungiswa. Siza ekulungiseleleni amashidi okwesolwa izono izitatimende zenkolo lapho kufanele khona. Sebenzisana ube negxiba kubo bonke abasemgciningweni kanye nabafundisi bahlobene nezindaba ze-TRC. Thatha izinqumbo zomthetho ngokuvumelana nomthetho, izinqubomgomo zokumangalela ze-NPA kanye neziyalezo. Futhi wenze ucwaningo, ulungiselele imibiko, ube ushilo imibono yomthetho, izinqubomgomo, ukuxhumana nabasemgciningweni, izinkompha kanye namaphrojekthi. Qapha, hlaziya futhi ungaze ngolwazi olukhombisa izimpumelelo kanye nezibalo. Siza ekwakheni amasu abalulekile, asebenzayo kanye nezinkundla zokuqashwa. Chaza bese uxazulula izinselele ezithinta izimpumelelo ze-NPA.

xh.summary: Isithuba somHlahli weLizwe oPhakamileyo kwi-NPP eMakhanda uphatho ngemiba yobukrimeni ehlobene ne-TRC, kufuneka i-LLB nobunini obungazive kotyikwelwangasekho kweminyaka eyi-8 ngokomgaqo-nkqubo wezomthetho ekuxhweni kweekhalasi zobukrimeni.
xh.requirements: I-LLB. Kubahlahli abakhonza bafuna ukuphakuliswa nayiphi na ifanelekileyo nkqubo yomthetho. Ubunini bobugcisa obungazive kotyikwelwangasekho kweminyaka eyi-8, ekuxhweni kweekhalasi zobukrimeni. Ulwazi lokuzibophelela nokwenza ngendlela ezingathethekiyo, ngobungcali, ngokubekiweyo nangokwethembeka. Ilungelo lokubonakala njengoko kuchaziwe kwicala lesi-25(2) loMthetho we-NPA, u-32 ka-1998. Ukugqweswa ekusebenziseni i-MS Word, Excel, ne-PowerPoint kufuneka. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa i-MS Teams ne-Power BI kuya kuba lusizo. Ikhono lokwenza ngokuzimeleyo ngaphandle kolawulo olusoloko lukhoyo. Kufuneka kubekho nobuchule obuhle bokulawulo. Ikhono lokusebenza ngxamxeleko, oko kunokubandakanya iiyure ezinde. Ubuchule obuhle bokuhlalutywa nokusombulula iingxaki. Ikhono lokuzivumela, nolwazi lokusebenziswana nangokuthetha luyafuneka ngokuphathelele ukusebenza nabanye abathathi nxaxheba. Ulwazi namava kumabakhe-TRC kuya kuba lusizo. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni.

af.requirements: An LLB. Vir dienende aanklaers wat bevordering soek, enige toepaslike regskwalifikasie. Ten minste agt jaar se post-kwalifikasie regsonderervaring in strafregtelike litigasie. Aftoonbare bevoegdheid om onafhanklik, professioneel, verantwoordelik en met geloofwaardigheid op te tree. Verskyningsreg soos uiteengesit in artikel 25(2) van die NPA Act, 32 of 1998. Toelating as advokaat of prokureur sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Goed ontwikkelde vaardighede in regsnavorsing en regsdienstaalvaardighede. Goed ontwikkelde vaardighede in regsnavorsing en regsdienstaalvaardighede. Goede kennis van siviele en/of strafregtelike prosedure. Bekwaamheid in aanklag, bevoegdheid om ondersoeke te lei, klagstate, aktes van beskuldiging en hofdokumente op te stel en om vertoë te hanteer. Goede interpersoonlike, analitiese, voorlegging- en kommunikasievaardighede. Kennis van bateverbeurdreg. Die vermoë om onafhanklik op te tree. Sterk rekenaarvaardighede sal benodig word. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie.
af.duties: Vervolging van ernstige, komplekse en georganiseerde kommersiële misdaad- en korrupsiesake behartig. Adviseer die DPCI oor die ondersoek van ernstige, komplekse en georganiseerde kommersiële misdaad- en korrupsiesake. Regsnavorsing doen en op hoogte bly van regsontwikkelings. Klagstate en ander hofdokumente opstel en die Staat in alle howe verteenwoordig. Sake in die hof voorlê, getuies lei, kruisverhoor afneem en die hof oor skuldigbevinding en vonnis toespreek. In mosieprosedures verskyn en appèlle en hersienings behartig. In die algemeen vervolging namens die Staat behartig, en alle daarmee verbandhoudende pligte verrig, insluitend administratiewe pligte. Vertoë en klagtes behartig. Aanklaers en belanghebbendes mentoreer, lei en/of opleidingsessies aanbied. Met belanghebbendes oor kommersiële misdaadverwante aangeleenthede skakel.

zu.title: Umneliulelo Omkhulu Wezwe
zu.summary: Kudingeka Umneliulelo Omkhulu Wezwe eBloemfontein ukugxuma iziqephu zezono ezinkulu zentengiselwano neziququli, kudingeka i-LLB neminyaka yisishiyagalombili yamava omtsetfo emumva kokuthola iziqu.
zu.requirements: I-LLB. Kubavuli abafuna ukuthuthukiswa noma yikuphi ukulingana okufanele komtsetfo. Okungenani iminyaka yisishiyagalombili yamava omtsetfo emumva kokuthola iziqu, ekulweni izono. Ukukwazi ukusebenza ngokuzimela, ngobungcali, ngobubele kanye nokuthembeka. Ilungelo lokubonakala njengokuvezwe esigabeni 25(2) seNqumayo i-NPA, 32 ka-1998. Ukungamiswa njengomneliulelo noma ummeli kuzoba yinto engeza inhlangothi. Ukuloba kahle, amakhono ahlobile ocophayo lomtsetfo kanye namakhono okubhala imibhalo yomtsetfo. Ulwazi oluhle ngemithetho yomchithazwe kanye/noma yezono. Ukukghona ekuhola izingadi, ukubhala amaphepha ezikhulumi, izikhulumi ezifakiweyo kanye nemibhalo yezinkantolo nokubhekana nezimesabhalo. Amakhono ahle abantu, ahlukanisayo, abonwayo nakakhuluma. Ulwazi ngomtsetfo wokuthatha izimpahla. Ikhono lokuzimela. Amakhono amakhulu ekhompyutha uzodinga Ilayisensi yaseshova esemthethweni.
zu.duties: Qhuba ukugxuma iziqephu zezono ezinkulu, ezibucayi nezengeziwe zentengiselwano neziququli. Weda i-DPCI ekuphenyweni kwezono ezinkulu, ezibucayi nezengeziwe zentengiselwano neziququli. Yenza ucwaningo lomtsetfo uze ugcine ukuya phambili nentuthuko yomtsetfo. Bhala amaphepha ezikhulumi nezinye imibhalo yezinkantolo bese umela umbuso kuzo zonke izinkantolo. Bizwa izinkantolo, hola ofakazi, kabafakazi bese ukhuluma ngesinkantolo ngokuqinisekiswa nesigwebo. Bonakala ezinkathini zokunyakaza futhi wenze iziphakamiso kanye nokubuyekeza. Ngokuvamile, qhuba ukugxuma ngokomthetho umbuso, bese wenza yonke imisebenzi ehlobene nalokho, okufaka imisebenzi yabaphathi; Bhekana nezimesabhalo kanye nezikhulumi; Holisa, weda kanye/noma wenza ukwelashwa kubavuli kanye namaphuzu abantu. Khuluma namaphuzu abantu ngemibuzo ehlobene nezigameko zentengiselwano ezingezonke ezemthethweni.

xh.title: Umviwankulu Wohulu weSizwe
xh.summary: Kufunekwa umviwankulu wohulu weSizwe eBloemfontein ukuba athathe izigaba ezibandakanya tsheshi ezinkulu ezimaxabiso namanani kunye nokukhwelwa kwemali. Kufuneka abe ne-LLB kunye neminyaka yamava yawo emthethweni emva kokuqwalasela iminyaka esibhozo.
xh.requirements: I-LLB. Kwalabo bavimba bakhoyo abafuna ukuphakanyiswa, noma yiliphi na igaba elilungileyo lomthetho. Ubuncinane iminyaka esibhozo yamava emthethweni emva kokuqwalasela, kwicala lokwaluswa kwezobugewala. Ukuzibonakalisa ngokusebenzela ngokuzodwa, ngobungcali, ngokubanjwa ixanduva nangokuthembeka. Ilungelo lokubonakala njengoko kucetyiswa kwicandelo 25(2) loMthetho we-NPA, 32 ka-1998. Ukubhalwa njengomprofeti okanye njengommeli kuya kuba luncedo elongezelelekileyo. Ubungcali obuhle bokuchaza, amakhono obuwonke avelisiweyo ekuphenjeni komthetho nakubhalweni kwamaxwebhu omthetho. Ulwazi oluhle malunga nenkqubo yezombuluvo noma yezobugewala. Ukubekekile ekwalusweni kwezobugewala, ulwazi lokukhokela iingxoxo zamava, ukubala amaxwebhu okutyhila, izatyalo kunye namaxwebhu enkundla kunye nokusebenza nokuqwalasela iingxoxo. Amakhono amahle okuhamba nabantu, ekuhlalutya, okubonisa nokuqhathanisa. Ulwazi ngomthetho wokusetyenzwa kwempahla. Ikakhulu nokusebenza ngokuzodwa. Amaxabiso amakhulu kakhulu kwikhompyutha kuya kufuneka kwaye ilayisensi yomqhubi esebenzayo.
xh.duties: Ukwenza ukwaluswa kwezigaba ezinzima, ezibaxabiso namanani kunye nezigwebulu ezimaxabiso namanani kunye nezigaba zokukhwelwa kwemali. Ukuyalela i-DPCI ngokuphenya iigaba ezinzima, ezibaxabiso namanani kunye nezigwebulu ezimaxabiso namanani kunye nezigaba zokukhwelwa kwemali. Ukwenza uphando lomthetho kwaye ugcine ulwazi olutsha ngapandle kwezinto ezikhoyo kumthetho. Ukubhala amaxwebhu okutyhila namaxwebhu amanye enkundla kwaye umele iSizwe kuzo zonke iinkundla. Ukubonisa izigaba enkundleni, ukukhokela iingxaki, ukujonga ngokuchaneleyo kwaye uthethe nenkundla ngokuvuma nangohlwayo. Ukubonakala kwiinkqubo zentshukumo kwaye ukhokule iingxoxo zokuqwalasela izigwebo nezezinyikima. Ngokubanzi, ukwenza ukwaluswa ixelwe iSizwe, kwaye uzenze yonke imisebenzi edityanisiweyo nayo, kuquka imisebenzi yolawulo; Ukusebenza neengxoxo zokuqwalasela neengxelo zamabinzana; Ukukhokela, ukuyalela okanye ukwenza isikhokelo sabavimba kunye namachaphaza. Ukuxoxa namachaphaza ngemiba enxulumene netsheshi yamaxabiso namanani.

jobs.title: Senior Public Prosecutor
jobs.salary_text: R1 242 915 – R1 934 208 per annum (CM-1), (Total cost package)
jobs.summary: Senior Public Prosecutor needed at the NPA in Mthatha to supervise and train lower-level prosecutors, requiring an LLB and eight years of legal experience.
jobs.requirements: An LLB. For serving prosecutors seeking promotion any appropriate legal qualification. At least eight (8) years post qualification legal experience. Five (5) years’ experience in legal practice will be an added advantage. Demonstrable competency in acting Independently, Professionally, Accountable and with Credibility. Good management skills. Manage, give guidance to and train prosecutors. Proficiency in prosecuting, guiding investigations and giving instructions in reasonably complex or more difficult common law and statutory offences. Able to draft charge sheets and complex court documents. Ability to act independently without constant supervision. Must have good administrative skills. A valid driver's license.
jobs.duties: Manage and supervise allocation of work and management of performance for lower-level prosecutors including trainee Prosecutor. Train and guide Prosecutors including trainee Prosecutors and stakeholders in preparation of case dockets and deciding on the institution and conduct criminal proceedings. Represent the State in all courts. Present and assist prosecutors including trainee Prosecutors in presentation of state’s case court, lead and cross examination of witnesses and address court on inter alia conviction and the like. Attend to representations and complaints. Attend to instructions of the Chief Prosecutor and the Director of Public Prosecutions. Lead Prosecutors towards achieving strategic goals and operational targets set by NPA, DPP office and CPP. Perform all duties including administrative duties related thereto, in accordance with code of conduct, policy directives of NPA. Promote partner integration, community involvement and customer satisfaction in conjunction with partners in the criminal justice.
jobs.applications: e mail: Recruit2026267@npa.gov.za
jobs.notes: Applicants must apply by submitting applications on the most recent Z83 form obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the DPSA web site link: https://www.dpsa.gov.za/newsroom/psvc/ and a comprehensive CV ONLY (with detailed experience information). Failure to do so will result in your application being disqualified. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on or before the day of the interview following communication from Human Resources. Foreign qualifications must be accompanied by an evaluation report issued by SAQA (only when shortlisted). It is the applicant’s responsibility to have all foreign qualifications evaluated by SAQA and to provide proof of such evaluation (only when shortlisted). All applications must reach the NPA on/or before the closing date. No late applications will be accepted/processed. Documents should not be password protected, and ZIP files will be blocked. The NPA cannot be held responsible for server delays. All applications must reach the NPA on/or before the closing date. No late applications will be accepted/processed. The applicant’s attention is drawn to the fact that the NPA uses an Electronic Response Handling System in terms of e-mailed applications. Please do not contact the NPA directly after you have e-mailed your applications to enquire if your application(s) have been received. If you have not received an acknowledgement of receipt within one week after the closing date, then you can contact the NPA. The NPA reserves the right not to fill any particular position. If you do not hear from us within (6) six months from the closing date of the advert, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Successful candidates will be subjected to a security clearance of at least confidential. Appointment to this position will be provisional, pending the issue of security clearance. Fingerprints will be taken on the day of the interview. The social media accounts of shortlisted applicants may be accessed as part of the verification process. A valid driver’s license will be a requirement where applicable. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments which are, a practical exercise and an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All SMS posts will be subjected to a lifestyle audit. SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise that intends to test relevant technical elements of the job, the logistics of which will be communicated by the NPA. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. A pre-entry certificate obtained from the National School of Government (NSG) is required for all SMS applicants for Public Service Act positions in the NPA (SMS pre-entry certificate to be submitted prior to appointment). NPA Act appointments are exempted from the pre-entry certificate requirement. This is a Public Service specific training programme. The name of the course is Certificate for entry into the SMS.        The     full  details     can    be     sourced     from      the   link https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/.. Applicants are advised that from 1 January 2021 a new application form for employment (Z83) is in use. The new application for employment form can be downloaded at www.dpsa.gov.za-vacancies. From 1 January 2021 should an application be received using the incorrect (old) application for employment (Z83), it will not be considered. NB! Applicants who are successful must please note that the NPA is not in a position to pay resettlement costs. af.title: Senior Openbare Aanklaer
af.summary: Senior Openbare Aanklaer benodig by die NPA in Mthatha om laer-vlak aanklaers te superviseer en op te lei, met 'n LLB en agt jaar se regsale ondervinding as vereiste.
af.requirements: 'n LLB. Vir dienende aanklaers wat bevordering soek enige toepaslike regskwalifikasie. Ten minste agt (8) jaar se post-kwalifikasie regsale ondervinding. Vyf (5) jaar se ondervinding in regspraktyk sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Aantoonbare bevoegdheid om onafhanklik, professioneel, verantwoordelik en met geloofwaardigheid op te tree. Goeie bestuursvaardighede. Bestuur, gee leiding aan en lei aanklaers. Bedrywigheid in die aankla, lei ondersoeke en gee instruksies in redelik komplekse of moeiliker gemene reg en statutêre oortredings. In staat om klagbriewe en komplekse hofdokumente op te stel. Vermoë om onafhanklik sonder konstante toesig op te tree. Moet goeie administratiewe vaardighede hê. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie.
af.duties: Bestuur en superviseer toewysing van werk en bestuur van prestasie vir laer-vlak aanklaers insluitend opleidingsaanklaer. Lei en gee leiding aan aanklaers insluitend opleidingsaanklaers en belanghebbendes in die voorbereiding van saakdossiers en besluite oor die instelling en voer van strafregtelike verrigtinge. Verteenwoordig die Staat in alle howe. Bied hulp aan aanklaers insluitend opleidingsaanklaers in die voorlegging van die Staat se saak in die hof, hoof- en kruisverhoor van getuies en rigting aan die hof oor onder andere skuldigbevinding en dergelike. Spreek aandag aan vertoë en klagtes. Spreek aandag aan instruksies van die Hoofaanklaer en die Direkteur van Openbare Vervolging. Lei aanklaers om strategiese doelwitte en operasionele teikens wat deur NPA, DPP-kantoor en CPP gestel is, te bereik. Verrig alle pligte insluitend administratiewe pligte wat daarmee verband hou, in ooreenstemming met die gedragskode en beleidsrigtings van NPA. Bevorder vennoot-integrasie, gemeenskapsbetrokkenheid en kliëntetevredenheid in samewerking met vennote in die strafregpleging.

zu.title: Umnelomthetho Ophakeme Womphakathi
zu.summary: Kudingeka Umnelomthetho Ophakeme Womphakathi e-NPA eMthatha okuba abeke izindlela kanye nokuhlela abamnelomthetho abasezingeni eliphansi, kudingwa i-LLB kanye neminyaka yisishiyagalombili yesiphotho sokusebenza ngomthetho.
zu.requirements: I-LLB. Kubamelomthetho abasebenzayo abafuna ukuthuthela phambili noma yisiphi isifundo esifanele somthetho. Okungenani eminyakeni yisishiyagalombili (8) yesiphotho sokusebenza ngomthetho. Emnyakeni omuhlanu (5) wokuthola isiphotho sokusebenza ngomthetho kuzoba yinjabulo enimbulala. Ukukhombisa ikhono lokuziphatha Ngokuzimele, Ngesiqu, Ngokubhekele kanye Nokuqinisekisa. Izindlela ezinhle zokuphatha. Ukuphatha, ukunika isiqondiso kanye nokuhlela abamnelomthetho. Ukukhombiswa ukukhanya ekushayweni izicala, ekuqondiseni ukuphenya kanye nokunika imiyalo ezicaleni ezinzima kakhulu noma ezibandakanya umthetho wesiko kanye nomthetho ogunyaziwe. Ukukwazi ukubhala amaphepha okushaya izicala kanye namadokhumenti ezinkantolo ezinzima. Ikhono lokuziphatha ngokuzimele ngaphandle kokubukeka njalo. Kumele kube nezindlela ezinhle zokuphatha. Ilayisense evumelekile yokushayisa ibhayisikili.
zu.duties: Ukuphatha kanye nokubeka izindlela okwabiwa umsebenzi kanye nokuphatha ukusebenza kwabamnelomthetho abasezingeni eliphansi kubandakanya Umhlekengi oqeqeshwayo. Ukuqeqesha kanye nokuqondisa Abamnelomthetho kubandakanya Abamnelomthetho oqeqeshwayo kanye nalabo ababendzima bezenzo ekuqejweni izibhamu sezicala nasekwenzeni isinqumo ngokuqala kanye nokuhola izinkantolo ezingezonjini. Ukumela umbuso zonke izinkantolo. Ukubonisa kanye ukusiza abamnelomthetho kubandakanya Abamnelomthetho oqeqeshwayo ekuboniseni icala lesiwe somphakathi enkantolo, ukubuza kanye nokubuzwa ngaqovo kwofakazi kanye nokuthi inkantole phakathi kweminye ibe nokuqinisekiswa ngokuhlangana njalo. Ukuze afungelwe izinkomba nezikhalazo. Ukuhlangabezwa imiyalo yoMhlekengi Omkhulu kanye noMqondisi Wokushaya Izicala. Ukukhokha Abamnelomthetho ukuthi bafinyelele emigqweni ebaluleke kakhulu nasezinhlosweni zokusebenza ezibekwe yi-NPA, ihhovisi le-DPP kanye ne-CPP. Ukwenza yonke imisebenzi kubandakanya imisebenzi yemibhalo ehlobene nayo, ngokulandelwa komthetho wokuphatha, iziqondiso zokuqondisa ze-NPA. Ukukhuthaza ukuhlanganiswa kwabalingani, ukubandakanya umphakathi kanye namakhasimede kuhlangene ngabalingani ekubusweni ikhotsho eziphathelene nobugebengu.

xh.title: Umchukiwephondo oPhakamileyo
xh.summary: Kufunekwa uMchukiwephondo oPhakamileyo kwi-NPA eMthatha ukuba alawule ekugxininiseni aze afundise abachukiwephondo abakwingqanaba eliphantsi, kwaye kufuneka abe ne-LLB kunye neminye yamashumi asibhozo yemvelaphi yomsebenzi wezomthetho.
xh.requirements: I-LLB. Kubachukiwephondo abasebenzayo abafuna ukuzaliswa kwangaphezulu nawuphi na umthetho ofanelekileyo. Ubuncinane iminyaka eyisishiyagalombali (8) yemvelaphi yamava ezomthetho emva kokufumana isidanga. Iminyaka emihlanu (5) yamava kumasebenzi ezomthetho iya kuba lulunga olongeziweyo. Ukuziphatha okubonakalayo ngokusebenzaNgokuzimeleyo, ngoBubele bemisebenzi, ngoBuzemfuneko nangeSinikelo esemthethweni. Amakhono amabalwe ekulawuleni. Ukulawula, ukubeka iindlela nokufundisa abachukiwephondo. Ulwazi lokushukuma, ekulawuleeni iingxoxo eziphathiswe ngokuphandwa nokunikela iimiyalelo kumatyala azeke ngesiqhithi okanye esingqongqo kwelinye ilizwe. Ikhono lokubhala ipepa ezalathisa ityala namatyala ezinkundla ezingqongqo. Ikhono lokusebenza ngokuzimelelo ngaphandle kolawulo olusoloko ukhoyo. Kufuneka ube namakhono amabalwe ekulawuleni imisebenzi. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni.
xh.duties: Ukulawula ekugxininisweni ukwabiwa komsebenzi nolawulo lwemveliso yabachukiwephondo abakwingqanaba eliphantsi kuquka uMchukiwephondo ofundwayo. Ukufundisa ekugxininisweni nokubeka iindlela kuBachukiwephondo kuquka abaFundayo nabathintekayo ekulungiselelweni kwamaxwebhu amatyala nasesiggibeni ngokuqaliswa nokuhamba kwamacandelo obugebengu. Ukumela uRhulumende kuzo zonke iinkundla. Ukuzibhaxa ukuncede abachukiwephondo kuquka abaFundayo ekuvezweni kwetyala lenkundla, ukuqhankqalaza nokubuza ukutshintshiselana kweengxoxo ngamangqina nokuthetha nenkozo ngokuqinisekiswa kobutyala njalonjalo. Ukuqhwalomela kwakho iimpahla zoluntu kunye neengoziwo. Ukusuka kwimiyalelo kaMchukiwephondo oMkhulu noMqondisi kaMchukiwephondo. Ukukhokela abachukiwephondo ngokuqhuba izigqibo eziphakamileyo ezingagqibekanga njengoko zimiselwe yi-NPA, iNkundla ka-DPP ikomkhulu le-CPP. Ukuphumeza yonke imisebenzi ebandakanya imisebenzi yolawulo ehlobene nayo, ngokulandelela umthetho wokuziphatha, iinkqubo ezimiselwa yi-NPA. Ukukhuthaza ungcwatyelwano lweenkqubo loluntu ngokuphathelele ukudibana nazo kwindima ezenzwayo zocala uluntu.

af.title: Regionale Hofbeheer-aanklaer
af.summary: Posisie as Regionale Hofbeheer-aanklaer by die NPA wat 'n LLB, ses jaar se regservaring en bestuursvaardighede vereis om aanklaers by die Ntuzuma-hof te onderrig.
af.requirements: 'n LLB. Vir dienende aanklaers wat bevordering soek, enige toepaslike regskwalifikasie. Ten minste ses (6) jaar se post-kwalifikasie regservaring. Aantoonbare bevoegdheid om onafhanklik, professioneel, verantwoordelik en met geloofwaardigheid op te tree. Goeie bestuursvaardighede. Moet die vermoë hê om onafhanklik of met minimum toesig op te tree. Bedrewe in die vervolging, die lei van ondersoeke en die gee van instruksies in komplekse of meer moeilike gemeenregtelike en statutêre oortredings in die Regionale en Distrikshof. Opstel van komplekse aanklagbriewe en komplekse hofdokumente. Goeie bestuursvaardighede. Moet aanklaers bestuur, lei en oplei.
af.duties: Bestuur, oplei en gee leiding aan en oplei van aanklaers. Bestudeer saakdossiers, besluit oor die instelling van en die voer van strafregtelike verrigtinge. Onderhoudsake en geregtelike ondersoeke van 'n algemene en meer gevorderde aard in die Regionale en Distrikshof. Berei sake vir die hof voor en stel aanklagbriewe en ander verrigtinge vir die hof op. Lewer en help aanklaers om die Staat se saak in die hof voor te lê, om getuienis te lei, kruisondervraging te doen en die hof te spreek oor onder andere skuldigbevinding en vonnis, en in die algemeen om vervolgings namens die Staat te voer. Verrig alle take wat daarmee verband hou in ooreenstemming met die gedragskode, beleid en riglyne van die NPA. Help die Senior Openbare Aanklaer met die prestasie-evaluering van personeel. Verrig algemene administratiewe take van die kantoor. Bevorder vennote-integrasie, gemeenskapsbetrokkenheid en kliëntetevredenheid in samewerking met vennote in die strafregstelsel.

zu.title: Umphathi Wabavuli BeNkantolo Yesifunda
zu.summary: Isikhundla sokuba nguMphathi Wabavuli BeNkantolo Yesifunda e-NPA esidinga i-LLB, iminyaka eyisithupha yokuhlolwa komthetho, nezakhono zokuqondisa ukubaqondisa abavuli eNkantolo iNtuzuma.
zu.requirements: I-LLB. Kubavuli abasebenzayo abafuna ukuthuthuka noma yisiphi isimemo somthetho esifanele. Okungenani iminyaka eyisithupha (6) yokuhlolwa komthetho ngemva kokuthola isimemo. Ukukwazi ukusebenza ngokuzimela, ngobungcweti, ngobunele futhi ngokwethembeka okubonakalayo. Izakhono ezinhle zokuqondisa. Kumele ukwazi ukusebenza ngokuzimela noma ngaphansi kolawulo oluncane. Ukukhombisa ukugqamile ekuvuleni izinkantolo, ekuqondisweni ekuphenyweni kanye nokunika iziyalo ezinkanlweni eziyinkimbinkimbi noma ezinzima komthetho ovamile nezomthethosisekelo eNkantolo Yesifunda naseNkantolo Yesigodi. Ukubhala amakhadi okugxekwa okuyinkimbinkimbi kanye nemibhalo yenkantolo eyinkimbinkimbi. Izakhono ezinhle zokuqondisa. Kumele uphathe, aqondise futhi afundeze abavuli.
zu.duties: Ukuphatha, ukuhlakanisa futhi ukuqondisa futhi ufundeze abavuli. Ukufunda amafayela ezimoto, ukuthatha isinqumo sokuqala nokwenza izinkambiso zezcala. Izindaba zokondza kanye nokuphenya okunjalo jikelele futhi okuthuthukile eNkantolo Yesifunda naseNkantolo Yesigodi. Ukulungiselela izinkantolo izinhlobonhlobo zamacala futhi ubhale amakhadi okugxekwa kanye nezinye izinkambiso zezinkantolo. Ukubuyekeza futhi usize abavuli ukuba babeke inqobo kaZwe enkantolo, ukubuza uhlezi bafakelwe ubufakazi, ukubuza imibuzo futhi ukuthi inkantolo ngokubukhaliya kukho ukugxekwa futhi ukuthi njalo yonke into ekuthunyelwe inkantolo kwenzeke. Ukwenza yonke imisebenzi ehlobene naleyo ngokuvumelana nomthetho wokuziphatha, inqubomgomo kanye nezinqumo ze-NPA. Ukusiza oMvuli Basesiphezulu ekubalweni komsebenzi wabasebenzi. Ukwenza imisebenzi ejwayelekile yolawulo ehhovisi. Ukukhuthaza ukuxhumana nabalingani, ukubandakanya umphakathi nokwaneliseza abathengi kanye nabalingani kusimiso sokulwa nobugebengu.

xh.title: UmGwebi oLawulayo weNdlu yomGwebo weRegional
xh.summary: Isithuba somgwebi oLawulayo weNdlu yomgwebo weRegional kwi-NPA esifuna i-LLB, iminyaka eli-6 yamava womthetho, namakhono okulawula ukuze alawule abagwebi endlwini yomgwebo yaseNtuzuma.
xh.requirements: I-LLB. Kwigunya labagwebi abayi kukhuthazwa nayiphi na ifundo yomthetho efanelekileyo. Ubuncinane i-six (6) iminyaka yamava womthetho emva kokufumana ifundo. Ukuzinza okubonakalayo ekuziphatheni Ngokuzimela, NgoBungcali, Ngokubekiweyo kwaye noQinisekiso. Amakhono amabalulu okulawula. Makube nakho ikhono lokuzimela okanye ngaphantsi kolawulo oluncinci. Ukuchana ekugwebeni, ekukhokeleni uphononongo nasekunikezela iilayisenise kwiintlolo ezingubalo-mve okunzima okanye ezinobunzima ngaphezulu komthetho oqhelekileyo nomyalelo webanga kwindlu yomgwebo weRegional nende yomgwebo weDistrict. Qulunqa amaphepha ezityholo anzima namanye amaphepha anzima endlwini yomgwebo. Amakhono amabalulu okulawula. Makaphathe, akhokele kwaye aqeqishe abagwebi.
xh.duties: Phatha, qeqisha kwaye nikezela isikhokelo kwabagwebi. Phonononga amadosiwe ecala, gqiba ekusekweni kwexesha kwaye uqhube iinkqubo zobugewete. Iindaba ezingondlelwana nezifundo zokufa ezingubalo-mve ezinqamlezileyo kwaye zingaphezulu kwelona nqanaba kwindlu yomgwebo weRegional nende yomgwebo weDistrict. Lungiselela iicala zendlu yomgwebo kwaye uqulunqe amaphepha ezityholo namanye amaphepha ezinqubo zendlu yomgwebo. Mbonelele kwaye uncede abagwebi ukuba bamze ngcalulo icala loMbuso kwindlu yomgwebo, ukuba bakhokhe ooqaqamba-fakhi, bagqithise ngembuzo kwaye bathethe kwindlu yomgwebo ngaphezu kwezinye izinto, ngokuhanjiswa kolahleko nesisigqibo, kwaye ngokubanzi aqhube iicala ngenkxelwano yoMbuso. Zenze yonke imisebenzi ehambelana naleyo ngokwemigaqo yokuziphatha, iinkqubo neelayisenise ze-NPA. Ncede uMgwebi kaMbuso oMkhulu ekuboneni ulwandiso lomsebenzi basebenzi. Zenze imisebenzi yolonwabo olubanzi lewohlobo. Khuthaza udibaniso lwabalinganiseli, ingatho komphakathi kwayeanelise amaxhwebha kwindibaniselwano nabalinganiseli kwinkqubo yobulungisa bobugewete.

af.title: Hoofbeheerprokurateur 3
af.summary: Hoofbeheerprokurateurpos wat 'n LLB en ses jaar se regsonderwinding vereis om prokurateurs te bestuur, op te lei en te begelei in die voer van strafregtelike verrigtinge.
af.requirements: 'n LLB. Vir dienende prokurateurs wat bevordering soek enige toepaslike regskwalifikasie. Ten minste ses (6) jaar se na-kwalifikasie regsonderwinding. Aantoonbare bevoegdheid om onafhanklik, professioneel, verantwoordelik en met geloofwaardigheid op te tree. Bedryf in die vervolging, begeleiding van ondersoeke en die gee van instruksies in redelik komplekse of meer moeilike gemeenregtelike en statutêre oortredings in die laer howe. Bedryf in die opstel van komplekse klagstate en ander komplekse hofdokumente. Moet in staat wees om onafhanklik sonder konstante toesig op te tree en hof- en saakvloeie onafhanklik te bestuur. Goeie bestuurs- en administratiewe vaardighede. Algemene rekenaarvaardigheid met uitstekende kennis van Ms Word, PowerPoint, Excel en Outlook ECMS-stelsel. Hoë vlak van betroubaarheid. Vermoë om met takt en diskresie op te tree. Vermoë om vertroulike aangeleenthede te identifiseer en te hanteer. Kennis van toepaslike wetgewing, beleid, voorskrifte en prosedures wat in die openbare sektor van toepassing is. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie.
af.duties: Bestuur, lei en gee begeleiding aan prokurateurs. Bestudeer saakdossiers, besluit oor die instelling van en voer van strafregtelike verrigtinge. Onderhoudsake en lykskouings van 'n algemene en meer gevorderde aard in die Streekhof en Distrikshof. Berei sake vir die hof voor en stel klagstate en ander verrigtinge vir die hof op, bied en help prokurateurs om die Staat se saak in die hof voor te lê, om getuies te lei, kruisverhoor af te neem en die hof toe te spreek oor onder andere skuldigbevinding en vonnis, en in die algemeen om vervolgings namens die Staat te behartig. Voer alle daarmee verbandhoudende pligte uit in ooreenstemming met die Gedragskode, Beleid en Riglyne van die Nasionale Vervolgingsgesag. Help die Senior Openbare Prokurateur met die prestasie-evaluering van personeel. Bestuur, beheer en handhaaf die administrasie van die kantoor van die Distrikshof en Streekhof. Bevorder vennootintegrasie, gemeenskapsbetrokkenheid en kliëntetevredenheid in samewerking met vennote in die strafregspleging.

zu.title: Ihhova Lezocala Elibamba Izinga 3
zu.summary: Isikhundla sehhova lezocala elibamba esidinga i-LLB namashumi eminyaka eyisithupu wemfundo yezomthetho ukuze siphathe, siqeqeshe futhi siholele abashicileli bezocala ekwenzeni izehlakalo ezenza ubugebengu.
zu.requirements: I-LLB. Kubashicileli bezocala abafuna ukwesethwa esikhundleni noma ikuphi ukufaneleka okuhambisana komthetho. Okungenani eminyaka eyisithupha (6) wemfundo yezomthetho emva kokuthola iziqu. Ukukhombisa ikhono lokusebenza ngokuzimele, ngobungcweti, ngobubele nokwethembeka. Ukukhanya ekushicilelweni izcala, ekuholeni iphoyisa lokuphenya nasekunikezeni izinkomba ezibucayi noma ezinzima kakhulu ezenzwe ngomthetho wesiko nalomthetho wezwe emanzini. Ukukhanya ekubhalweni amaphepha ezcala anzima namanye amaphepha enkantolo anzima. Kufanele ukwazi ukusebenza ngokuzimele ngaphandle kolawulo oluqhubekayo futhi uphathe inkantolo nokuhamba kwezicala ngokuzimele. Amakhono amahle okuphatha nokuqamba amaphepha. Ulwazi oluvamile lwekhompyutha elinolwazi oluhle nge-Ms Word, PowerPoint, Excel kanye nesistimu ye-ECMS ye-Outlook. Izinga elikhulu lokwethembeka. Ikhono lokusebenza ngobuhlakani bengqondo nangokubeka izinto ezimfihlo. Ikhono lokubona nokuphatha izinto ezingamfihlo. Ulwazi ngemithetho, izinqubo nemikhakha ekhona emnyangweni womphakathi. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile.
zu.duties: Ukuphatha, ukuqeqesha, nokunikeza inkomba kubashicileli bezocala. Ukuhfunda izikhwama zezicala, ukuthatha isinqumo sokuqala nokwenza izehlakalo ezenza ubugebengu. Izinto zokuncedwa abantwana nokuphenya izehlakalo ezenjalo ezenzakalayo nobunzima emanzini enkantolo yesifunda nase enkantolo yesithili. Ukuhlela izinkantolo nokubhala amaphepha ezcala namanye amaphepha enkantolo, okubonwayo nokusiza abashicileli bezocala ukuba baveze icala lezwe enkantolo, ukuhola ofakazi, ukubafakazisa nokukhuluma enkantolo, ngokukhetwa ukubajwayele, ukuqinisekiswa, nesigwebo, futhi jikejile ukwenza izinkantolo ngokwalezwe. Ukwenzwa komsebenzi ohlobene noku ema qiniseni nemikhakha yamathuluzi emithetho yokuqondisa, nemisika yezeluleki ezokuphathwa komphakathi sikaZwelonke wezocala ezenza izakhiwo. Ukusiza ongqongqoshe abaphakathi bezicala ngokuhlola ukuphathwa kwemisebenzi yabasebenzi. Ukuphatha, ukulawula nokunakekelwa kwezokuphatha ibhilidi enkantolo yesithili nase enkantolo yesifunda. Ukuqasha umakhalekhaya, ukunganeni kwabantu ngakho komsebenzi futhi wanelise izidingo ezijwayelekile emkhakheni wecala.

Unkululeko ekusebenzeni ekwenzeni kwaye nasekubeki nokuqondisa iindaba eziphantse zibucala okanye ezingqingqingweni ngakumbi kumthetho wenkqubo yolawulo namagosa alinganiselweyo ezi zingxengexezinkundla ezisezantsi. Unkululeko ekubhaliweyo kumaxwebu amaninzi ebala ezi gqithiswayo namaxwebu amaninzi angenxaxhe ezenkundla. Makabe nokwazi ukusebenza kodwa nangaphandle kolawulo oluhlala lukho lokulawula ukushona kwenkundla nokuhamba kwemizekeliso. Ubuchule obukhulu bokulawula nangokwendlela yorhulumente. Iqondo eliphezulu elithembekileyo. Ukuba nakho ukuziphatha ngobundoda nangokulinganisele. Ukuba nakho ukuqonda nokuphatha iindaba ezifihlakeleyo. Ulwazi ngemithetho, iinkqubo, iindawo zobulumko namacebo okuseshejini karhulumente kummandla wezopolitiko.
xh.duties: Ukulinganisa ukufundisa kunye nokuqondisa abaququqi. Ukufunda iifayile zemizekeliso, ukugqiba ukuba kusuke kwenziwe ntoni nakwindlela yokwenza izigubo kwaye naziphi na iziphango kwaye uzakusebenzisa imithetho yorhulumente koku. Amaxwebu angenxa yokulondolozwa kunye neemfuno eziphakamileyo ezingatshintshwanga ezingajeliswa kwinduli yophando loluntu kunye ne-Regional Court kwinduli yoluntu yasezantsi. Ukulungiselela imizekeliso yendalulo yebala alikhankanywayo kunye namaxwebu amaninzi emizekeliso yamanye amaxwebu ayakwenza imisebenzi yorhulumente nakwindalulo phantsi kolawulo lwezenkqubo yokugqibela ngokuchasene nemithetho yoluSebenzo ngokubanzi kunye nokugqiba imithetho karhulumente. Ukwenza yonke imisebenzi edibene nento ethile ngokwerhulumente ngemigaqo yesiCinga soBulumko iNkqubo kunye neMiyalezo yeSizwe yokuqondisa. Ukunceda uMnu kaMnu woluntu oseNqanaba eliphezulu ekulawulweni kwabasebenzi. Ukulawula, ukulawula nokujongana nendlela yorhulumente yolawulo lwe-Regional Court kunye neNkundla yaseZantsi ekwinduli yophando loluntu. Ukukhuthaza ukudibana kweenqanaba kunye nokuzanyiswa komntu wonke kwaye nalapho kubakho iindlela zokulinganisa uluntu malunga nothutho loluntu nakwimeko-nkcubeko yorhulumente.

af.summary: Staatsaanklaerpos by die DPP Kimberley wat 'n LLB, vyf jaar se regskundige ervaring en 'n reg van verskyning ingevolge die NPA Act vereis.
af.requirements: 'n LLB. Vir dienende aanklaers wat bevordering soek, enige toepaslike regskwalifikasie. Reg van verskyning soos beoog in artikel 25(2) van die NPA Act, 32 of 1998. Ten minste vyf (5) jaar se regskundige ervaring na kwalifikasie. Aantoonbare bevoegdheid om Onafhanklik, Professioneel, Verantwoordelik en met Geloofwaardigheid op te tree. Goed ontwikkelde vaardighede in regsnavorsing en regsopstelling. Goede kennis van siviele en/of strafregtelike prosedure. Bedrevenheid in vervolging, bevoegdheid in die begeleiding van ondersoeke, die opstel van aanklaglyste, aanklagbriewe en hofdokumente en die hantering van vertoë. Kennis van en vaardighede in algemene vervolging. Hoë vlak van bedrevenheid in die vervolging en voorlegging/voer van sake in die hof. Ervaring in die begeleiding van strafregtelike ondersoeke en die gee van instruksies in regs- en statutêre oortredings. Interpersoonlike vaardighede. Skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasievaardighede. Vermoë om onafhanklik met minimale toesig te werk.
af.duties: Bestudeer en lei ondersoeke in saakdossiers. Besluit oor die instelling van en voer strafregtelike verrigtinge. Stel aanklaglyste, aanklagbriewe en ander hofdokumente op. Verteenwoordig die Staat in alle howe. Berei 'n saak voor vir die hof, insluitend die verkryging van bykomende getuienis en die opstel van aanklaglyste en aanklagbriewe. Lewer die Staat se saak in die hof, ondervra en kruisondervra getuies, rig die hof oor, onder andere, skuldigbevinding en vonnis, bestudeer appèlle en hersienings. Skenk aandag aan vertoë, berei menings en pleitgronde voor en voer sake in die toepaslike hof. Verskyn in die hof in motie-aansoeke wat op strafregtelike aangeleenthede betrekking het en voer in die algemeen vervolging namens die staat uit. Voer alle daarmee verbonde pligte uit in ooreenstemming met die gedragskodebeleid en riglyne van die NPA. Bevorder vennootintegrasie, gemeenskapsbetrokkenheid en kliëntetevredenheid in samewerking met vennote in die strafregstelsel.

zu.title: Ummeli kahulumeni
zu.summary: Isikhundla sommeli kahulumeni e-DPP Kimberley esidinga i-LLB, iminyaka emihlanu yeziphatheko ezomthetho nelungelo lokubonakala emathekwini ngaphansi kwe-NPA Act.
zu.requirements: I-LLB. Kubavakashi ababhala izinkulumo ezingaba khulunywa ukuba bathole ukuthuthela kwesinye isikhundla, noma yikuphi ukufaneleka ngokomthetho okufanelekile. Ilungelo lokubonakala njengokucatshangelwe kusigaba 25(2) se-NPA Act, 32 ka-1998. Okungenani iminyaka emihlanu (5) yokuhlangabezana nezidingo ngemva kokuthola iziqu. Ukuze kwazi ukubonakala ngokusebenza kodwa, ngobungcweti, ngobuzemfanelo futhi ngokwethembeka. Amakhono avelwe kahle ocwaningweni lomthetho nokubhala izixhumanisi zomthetho. Ulwazi oluhle nendlela yomthetho wesivila kanye/noma yobugebengu. Ukukhono ekushumayeleni, ukukwazi ukulawula iziwoyelo, ukubhala amaphepha ezinkomba, izinkomba nezahlulelo zethekwini kanye nokuphathwa kwemibhalo. Ulwazi namakhono ekushumayeleni ngokuvamile. Izinga eliphezulu lokukwazi ukushumayela futhi ukubeka/ukuphikisana namacala emathekwini. Isiphatheko ekulawuleni izephondo ezibhekiswe kubugebengu nokunikela izinkomba ngomthetho nezehlazo ezomthetho. Amakhono okuxhumana nabantu. Amakhono okuxhumana kokubhalwayo nakokukhulunywayo. Ukukwazi ukusebenza nosuke ungahlotshiwe ngokuncane.
zu.duties: Funda futhi ulawule iziphando ezikwimaphoyisha amacala. Thatha isinqumo ngokuqaliswa kanye nokwenza izinkulumo zemacala abagebengu. Bhala amaphepha ezinkomba, izinkomba nezinye izahlulelo zethekwini. Mela umbuso emithekwini yonke. Lungiselela icala lezinkantolo, okuhlanganisa ukuthola izinkomba ezingezansi futhi ubhale amaphepha ezinkomba nezinkomba. Beka icala lombuso ezinkantolo, condozela futhi ubuze abafakibanga imibuzo, ukhulume ngenkantolo ngokubanjwa kwecala kanye nesiswayo ngokuvamile, funda ukuphikisana nokubuyekezwa. Khathalele imibhalo ebuso, lukela izinkomba kanye nezinhloko zezinkulumo-zombuso futhi uphikise amacala kwizinkantolo ezifanelekile. Bonakala enkantolo ezicongweni ezithinta izindaba zokwesula kanye nokuthi ngokuvamile wenza isimo sokuthi umbuso wenze isiguqulo. Yenza yonke imisebenzi ehambisana nayo ngokuvumelana nenqubo yokuziphatha kanye nezinkomba ezingeyamndeni NPA. Siza ukwenza kubumbene ngokubandakanya nabalingani, ukungeniswa komphakathi kanye nokwanelisa izidingo ngokuhlanganiswa ngaphakathi nabalingani eNkantolo yobugebengu yesiFunda.

xh.title: Mphathiswa kurhulumente
xh.summary: Isithuba soMphathiswa kurhulumente kwi-DPP Kimberley esifuna i-LLB, iminyaka emihlanu yamava omthetho nelungelo lokubonakala ngaphantsi koMthetho we-NPA.
xh.requirements: I-LLB. Kwalabo bagxekiweyo njengabaqwalaseli abafuna ukuphakanyiswa nayiphi na ifanelekileyo ifomali yomthetho. Ilungelo lokubonakala njengoko kucetyiswa kwicandelo 25(2) loMthetho we-NPA, 32 ka 1998. Ubuncinane eminyaka mihlanu (5) yokuhluza umthetho emva kokufumana ifomali. Isakhono esibonakalayo sokuziphatha ngokuzimeleyo, ngobungcali, ngobunyulu ngenxaxheba. Amaphepha amakhulu Obuchule ekuphenjeni komthetho nasekubhalweni kwamaxwebhu omthetho. Ulwazi olululo lwenkqubo yesithethe nesono nakanye. Isiphumelelo ekugxekeni, isakhono sokukhokela iindwendwe zophando, ukubhala amaqebulana amacala, iindikitha namaxwebhu enkundla nokujongana neenkcazelo. Ulwazi nobuchule ekugxekeni kwijikelele. Iqanaba eliphezulu lesiphumelelo ekugxekeni nasekuboniseni/ukuxoxeni amacala enkundleni. Isipho esithile sokuqonda kwiindwendwe zophando lwamacala nezono nokunika imiyalelo ngomthetho kwaye kwezona ezinyanzelekileyo ngomthetho. Isakhono somnxeba. Amaphepha abhalwayo nasethethwayo. Isakhono sokuzigalela ngokuzimela ngokulawulwa okuncinci.
xh.duties: Funda kwaye ukhokelele iindwendwe ekuphenyeni iicala. Thatha isigqibo sokuseka kwaye uqhube iinkqubo zezono. Bhala amaqebulana emacala, iindikitha namaxwebhu ezinkundla amanye. Mela uRhulumente kuzo naziphi na iinkundla. Lungiselela icala lenkundla, kuquka ukuqokelela ubungqina obongezelelweyo nokubhala amaqebulana emacala nendikitha. Tshonisa icala loRhulumente enkundleni, khokela kwaye udibuze iingqina, kuchaze inkundla ngecala elithile, ngokuqinisekiswa ngesigwebo, funda izikhalazo nokuqwalaselwa. Jongana nemiselo yenkcazelo, lungiselela iimbono neentloko zengxoxo kwaye uxoxe amacala kwinkundla efanelekileyo. Velisa inkundla kwizicelo ezihamba phambili ezithinta amacala ezono nakunyana uqhube ukugxeka ngokomcelo kurhulumente. Zenza yonke imisebenzi edibene nayo ngokwekhowudi yomthetho wezenzo nemiyalelo ye-NPA. Khuthaza ukudityaniswa kwabahlobo, ukubandakanywa komphakathi nokwaneliseka abathengi ngokubambisana nabahlobo kwinkqubo yocalulo lwezono.

jobs.title: State Advocate
jobs.salary_text: R970 221 - R1 600 893 per annum (Level LP- 7 to LP-8), (Total cost package)
jobs.summary: State Advocate position at the National Prosecuting Authority in Pietermaritzburg requiring an LLB and five years of prosecution experience.
jobs.requirements: An LLB. For serving prosecutors seeking promotion any appropriate legal qualification. Right of appearance as contemplated in section 25(2) of the NPA Act, 32 of 1998. At least five (5) years’ post qualification legal experience in prosecution/litigation of Sexual Offences, Criminal Procedure, Civil litigation and management of gender-based violence matters. Demonstrable competency in acting Independently, Professionally, Accountable and with Credibility. Experience in guiding criminal investigations and giving instructions in law and statutory offences. Drafting charge sheets and complex court documents. Ability to act independently without constant supervision. Strong interpersonal and communication skills. Decision making ability. Computer literacy and knowledge of programs in MS Office. A valid driver’s licence.
jobs.duties: To institute and conduct criminal proceedings on behalf of the State, to perform any act incidental thereto and to carry out the duties and functions assigned to the prosecution under any Act and/or the Policy Manual and/or any other directives inter alia, study case dockets, decide on the institution of and conduct criminal proceedings, including proceedings of an advanced or complex nature in the dedicated Sexual Offences Courts. Prepare cases for court, guide investigations and consult with witnesses, draft charge sheets and other court documents including documents that are more complex in nature. Present the States’ case in court. Present evidence, cross-examine and address the court on, inter alia, conviction and sentence. To ensure criminal and civil litigation in compliance with requirements legally imposed upon the State regarding aspects of criminal and civil activities relevant to the mandate of the National Prosecuting Authority on the management of Gender based violence and all matters incidental thereto. To track, monitor and facilitate cases through the Criminal Justice System, manage the court rolls at dedicated Sexual Offences Courts. Securing the attendance of witnesses, investigating officers’ and accused in custody at court. Ensuring a reduction of turnaround time in the finalization of cases in line with the mandate of NPA. Assist to improve functional relationships with stakeholders. Constant follow up with the relevant stakeholders. Assist to improve the conviction rate. Supervise, train and develop relevant role-players where required. Submit monthly reports (including statistics) regarding performance management.
jobs.applications: e mail: Recruit2026272@npa.gov.za
jobs.notes: Applicants must apply by submitting applications on the most recent Z83 form obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the DPSA web site link: https://www.dpsa.gov.za/newsroom/psvc/ and a comprehensive CV ONLY (with detailed experience information). Failure to do so will result in your application being disqualified. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on or before the day of the interview following communication from Human Resources. Foreign qualifications must be accompanied by an evaluation report issued by SAQA (only when shortlisted). It is the applicant’s responsibility to have all foreign qualifications evaluated by SAQA and to provide proof of such evaluation (only when shortlisted). All applications must reach the NPA on/or before the closing date. No late applications will be accepted/processed. Documents should not be password protected, and ZIP files will be blocked. The NPA cannot be held responsible for server delays. All applications must reach the NPA on/or before the closing date. No late applications will be accepted/processed. The applicant’s attention is drawn to the fact that the NPA uses an Electronic Response Handling System in terms of e-mailed applications. Please do not contact the NPA directly after you have e-mailed your applications to enquire if your application(s) have been received. If you have not received an acknowledgement of receipt within one week after the closing date, then you can contact the NPA. The NPA reserves the right not to fill any particular position. If you do not hear from us within (6) six months from the closing date of the advert, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Successful candidates will be subjected to a security clearance of at least confidential. Appointment to this position will be provisional, pending the issue of security clearance. Fingerprints will be taken on the day of the interview. The social media accounts of shortlisted applicants may be accessed as part of the verification process. A valid driver’s license will be a requirement where applicable. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments which are, a practical exercise and an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All SMS posts will be subjected to a lifestyle audit. SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise that intends to test relevant technical elements of the job, the logistics of which will be communicated by the NPA. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. A pre-entry certificate obtained from the National School of Government (NSG) is required for all SMS applicants for Public Service Act positions in the NPA (SMS pre-entry certificate to be submitted prior to appointment). NPA Act appointments are exempted from the pre-entry certificate requirement. This is a Public Service specific training programme. The name of the course is Certificate for entry into the SMS.        The     full  details     can    be     sourced     from      the   link https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/.. Applicants are advised that from 1 January 2021 a new application form for employment (Z83) is in use. The new application for employment form can be downloaded at www.dpsa.gov.za-vacancies. From 1 January 2021 should an application be received using the incorrect (old) application for employment (Z83), it will not be considered. NB! Applicants who are successful must please note that the NPA is not in a position to pay resettlement costs.
