af.title: Staatsadvokaat
af.summary: Staatsadvokaatpos by die National Prosecuting Authority in Pietermaritzburg wat 'n LLB en vyf jaar se vervolgingservaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n LLB. Vir dienende aanklaers wat bevordering soek, enige toepaslike regskwalifikasie. Verskyningsreg soos uiteengesit in artikel 25(2) van die NPA Act, 32 van 1998. Ten minste vyf (5) jaar se post-kwalifikasie regsonderervaring in die vervolging/litisasie van Sexual Offences, Criminal Procedure, siviele litigasie en die bestuur van geslagsgebaseerde geweldsake. Aantoonbare bevoegdheid om onafhanklik, professioneel, verantwoordelik en met geloofwaardigheid op te tree. Ervaring in die begeleiding van kriminele ondersoeke en die gee van instruksies in regs- en statutêre oortredings. Opstel van klagstate en komplekse hofdokumente. Vermoë om onafhanklik sonder konstante toesig op te tree. Sterke interpersoonlike en kommunikasievaardighede. Besluitnemingsvermoë. Rekenaarvaardigheid en kennis van programme in MS Office. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Om kriminele verrigtinge namens die Staat te instelleer en te voer, om enige daarmee gepaardgaande handeling te verrig en om die pligte en funksies uit te voer wat aan die vervolging opgedra word kragtens enige Act en/of die Policy Manual en/of enige ander riglyne, onder andere om saakdossiers te bestudeer, te besluit oor die instelling van en die voer van kriminele verrigtinge, insluitend verrigtinge van 'n gevorderde of komplekse aard in die toegewyde Sexual Offences Courts. Skep sake gereed vir die hof, begelei ondersoeke en raadpleeg getuies, stel klagstate en ander hofdokumente op, insluitend dokumente wat meer kompleks van aard is. Voer die Staat se saak in die hof. Lewer getuienis, kruisverhoor en spreek die hof toe oor, onder andere, skuldigbevinding en vonnis. Om kriminele en siviele litigasie in ooreenstemming met vereistes wat wettiglik op die Staat geplaas word met betrekking tot aspekte van kriminele en siviele aktiwiteite relevant tot die mandaat van die National Prosecuting Authority oor die bestuur van geslagsgebaseerde geweld en alle aangeleenthede daaraan verbonde, te verseker. Om sake deur die Criminal Justice System te volg, te monitor en te fasiliteer, bestuur die hofrolle by toegewyde Sexual Offences Courts. Verseker die bywoning van getuies, ondersoekbeamptes en aangehoudenes by die hof. Verseker 'n vermindering van die tyd neergelê op die finalisering van sake in ooreenstemming met die mandaat van NPA. Help om funksionele verhoudings met belanghebbendes te verbeter. Konstante opvolg met die tersaaklike belanghebbendes. Help om die skuldigbevindingskoers te verbeter. Superviseer, leer en ontwikkel tersaaklike rolspelers waar nodig. Dien maandelikse verslae (insluitend statistieke) rakende prestasiebestuur in.

zu.title: Ummeli kahulumende
zu.summary: Isikhundla sommeli kahulumende e-National Prosecuting Authority e-Pietermaritzburg esidinga i-LLB kanye neminyaka emihlanu yemvelaphi yokushesha izimoto.
zu.requirements: I-LLB. Kubambeleli abasebenzayo abafuna ukuthuthela phambili noma yikuphi ukulingana okuhambisana nomthetho. Ilungelo lokubonakala njengoba kucatshangelwe esigabeni 25(2) se-NPA Act, 32 of 1998. Okungenani iminyaka emihlanu (5) yemvelaphi yokusebenza ngomthetho emva kokuthola iziqu ekushesheni izimoto/izinkantolo ezingezinhle, e-Criminal Procedure, ezinkantolweni zomthetho wesintu nakuphathweni kwezindaba zokuziphathela ngokobulili. Ukukwazi ukubonakala ngokusebenza Ngazimele, Ngalokobungcwathi, Ngokubekezelelene futhi Ngesithunzi. Imvelaphi yokuhola uphenyo lwezobugebengu kanye nokunikeza imiyalo ngomthetho nezobugebengu ezibalulekileyo. Ukulanda amaphepha ezikhalazo nemibhalo yezinkantolo esiyinkimbinkimbi. Ukukwazi ukusebenza ngazimele ngaphandle kokuqashelwa okungapheli. Amandla okukhuluma nabantu kanye nokuxhumana. Amandla okwenza izinqumo. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokwazi amaphulo e-MS Office. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni.
zu.duties: Ukuqala futhi uhodle izinkantolo ezingezinhle emabhalini kahulumende, ukwenza noma yimuphi umsebenzi ohambisana nalokho kanye nokwenza imisebenzi nemisebenzi enikiwe ekusheshweni izimoto ngaphansi komthetho noma i-Policy Manual noma nanoma yimuphi umyalo ohlangenwe phakathi kokunye, ukufunda amafayela ezicala, ukwenza isinqumo sokuqala nokwenza izinkantolo ezingezinhle, okuhlanganisa izinkantolo eziyinkimbinkimbi ezinkantolweni ezingezinhle zobugebengu. Ulungiselela izinkantolo, uhole uphenyo futhi uxhumane oqaphelisi, ulande amaphepha ezikhalazi namanye amaphepha ezinkantolo okuhlanganisa amaphepha ayinkimbinkimbi. Nika inkomba yohulumende enkantolo. Nikeza ubufakazi,ibuze imibuzo futhi ukhulume nenkantolo ngokuqinisekiswa ngesigqibo phakathi kokunye. Ukuqinisekisa ukushesha izimoto nokwenza izinkantolo ngomthetho wesintu ngokulandelwa kwezidingo ezibekwe ngomthetho kahulumende ngemigqwetho yezobugebengu nesomthetho wesintu ebalulekileyo emandleni e-National Prosecuting Authority ekuphathweni kokuziphatha ngokobulili nakuyo yonke eminye imigqwetho ebalulekileyo. Ukulandela, ukubheka futhi ukweseka izinkantolo ngqo kulesi Criminal Justice System, ukuphatha uhlu lwezinkantolo ezinkantolweni ezingezinhle zobugebengu. Ukuqinisekisa ukubakho koqaphelisi, bamaphoyisa abaphenya izimoto kanye nabophikisayo ababoshiwe enkantolo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuncitshwa kwesikhathi sokuphela izinkantolo ngokulandelwa kwemandla e-NPA. Ukusiza ukuthuthukisa ubuhlobo bokusebenza nabashabaleli. Ukulandela ngokuqhubekayo nabashabaleli abahlobene. Ukusiza ukuthuthukisa inani lokuqinisekiswa. Ukulawula, ukuqeqesha futhi ukuthuthukisa abadlali abahlobene lapho kudingeka khona. Ukwethula imibiko yenyanga (okuhlanganisa izibalo) mayelana nokuphathwa kokusebenza.

xh.title: Mmeli waseLizwe
xh.summary: Isikhundla sommeli waseLizwe kuNational Prosecuting Authority ePietermaritzburg esifuna izidanga ze-LLB namashumi amahlanu eminyaka yamava obummeli.
xh.requirements: Isidanga se-LLB. Kummeli abasebenzayo abafuna ukuphakanyiswa kunoma yiphi na igunya elifanelekileyo lemigaqo. Ilungelo lokubonakala njengoko kucetywe kwicandelo lesigqeba 25(2) seNdinguqo ye-NPA, yama-32 ka-1998. Ubuncinane eminyakeni emihlanu (5) yamava osemthethweni emva kokufumana isidanga kwiprosekushoni/umgwebo wezono zobulala, ukuqhubwa kwezono, umgwebo wengcali nokulawula izigaba zohlobo lobudlolo obusekwe kweentlalahlaza. Ikhono elibonakalayo lokuziphatha ngokuzimeleyo, ngobungcali, ngokuziphendulela nangokwenyaniso. Amava okukhokela uphononongo lwezono ezithile nokunika iimiyalelo ngomthetho nezono ezithile. Ukuqulunqa amaphepha ezityholo namaxwebhu asingxaki enkundleni. Ikhono lokusebenza ngazibingazimbi ngaphandle kolawulo olungapheliyo. Amakhono amaninzi okuziqhelanisa nabantu nokuqhathanisa. Ikhono lokwenza izigqibo. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngokwesikhompyutha nokwazi iinkqubo kwi-MS Office. Ilayisenisi esemthethweni yokushayela.
xh.duties: Ukuqalisa nokusingatha iinkqubo zemithetho ezisolwayo emele uRhulumande, ukwenza naliphi na isenzo esidibanayo neso kunjalo nokwenza imisebenzi nokusebenza okunikiwe kubaphengululi phantsi kwaliphi na umthetho kwaye/okanye iNkqubo yokuLawula kwaye/okanye naliphi na elinye iye nje kubalawuli okuquka, ukuphonononga izixwebhu zeqoso, ukwenza isigqibo nokuqalisa nokusingatha iinkqubo ezisolwayo, kuquka iinkqubo ezinzima okanye ezibucucu enkundleni ezibekelwe iqnqozo lezono zobudlolo. Ukuqulunqa iimeko zenkundla, ukukhokela iophononongo nokuqaphela iigqabi zenkcazelo, ukuqulunqa amaphepha ezityholo namanye amaxwebhu enkundla kuquka namaxwebhu anzima ngokwawo. Ukubonisa imeko yoRhulumande enkundleni. Ukuboniswa kwezibangelo, ukubuzwa ngasemva nokunxibelela nenkundla nokuqhubeleka phambili, phakathi kwezinye, ukugqitywa kwenkohlakalo nesigqibo-sokujeziswa.okuqinisekisa imithetho eqhutywa enkundleni nakwingxoxo yengcali ngokwemfuneko emiselweyo ngumthetho kuRhulumande malunga neenkqubo zemithetho ezisolwayo nengxoxo yengcali ezithintela kumthetho wokuzelelwa kweNational Prosecuting Authority ekulawulweni kobudlolo obusuka kweenkozo nayo yonke imiba edibanayo nayo. Ukulandelela, ukuqaphela nokunceda iimeko ziqhubeke kwindlela yokuLawula ezoZono, ukulawula iinkqubo zenkundla ezibekelwe iqnqozo lezono zobudlolo. ukuqinisekisa ubukho beengxamvile enkundleni zolulwazi, abaphengululi bakho kunye nabaqulunqiweyo kwindlu yamagunyazi ecala. Ukuqinisekisa ukutshatyalaliswa kwexesha ekugqibeleni kwezityholo ngokuvumelana nomyalelo wokulawula we-NPA. Ukunceda ukuphucula uqhagamshelwano ngokusebenza nabanomdla. ukulandelela ngokukhawuleza ngokuchasene nabanomdla. ukunceda ukuphucula ukugqitywa kwezityholo ezingangcoliswa nangako. Ukulawula, ukuqeqesha nokuphuhlisa iindaba ezithintela ekusebenzini apho kuyimfuneko. ukuhambisa iingxelo nyanga zonke eziquka nemigca ngenkqubo yokuqhutywayo.

af.title: Staatsadvokaat
af.summary: Staatsadvokaatpos by die National Prosecuting Authority in Bloemfontein wat 'n LLB en vyf jaar se regsonderervaring in die vervolging van seksuele misdrywe en geslagsgeweldsake vereis.
af.requirements: 'n LLB. Vir dienende aanklaers wat bevordering soek, enige toepaslike regskwalifikasie. Verskyningsreg soos uiteengesit in artikel 25(2) van die NPA-wet, 32 van 1998. Ten minste vyf (5) jaar se post-kwalifikasie regsonderervaring in die vervolging/litigasie van seksuele misdrywe, strafregtelike prosedure, siviele litigasie en die bestuur van geslagsgewildsake. Aantoonbare bevoegdheid om onafhanklik, professioneel, verantwoordelik en met geloofwaardigheid op te tree. Onderervaring in die begeleiding van strafregtelike ondersoeke en die gee van instruksies oor regs- en statutêre misdrywe. Opstel van aanklaglyste en komplekse hofdokumente. Vermoë om onafhanklik sonder konstante toesig op te tree. Sterk interpersoonlike en kommunikasievaardighede. Besluitnemingsvermoë. Rekenaargeletterdheid en kennis van programme in MS Office. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie.
af.duties: Om strafregtelike verrigtings namens die Staat in te stel en te voer, om enige daarmee gepaardgaande handeling te verrig en om die pligte en funksies te vervul wat ingevolge enige wet en/of die beleidshandleiding en/of enige ander richtlyne aan die vervolging opgedra word, onder andere, saakdossiers te bestudeer, te besluit oor die instelling en voering van strafregtelike verrigtings, insluitend verrigtings van 'n gevorderde of komplekse aard in die toegewyde Sexual Offences Courts. Sake vir die hof voorberei, ondersoeke begelei en met getuies konsulteer, aanklaglyste en ander hofdokumente opstel insluitend dokumente wat meer kompleks van aard is. Die Staat se saak in die hof voorlê. Getuienis voorlê, kruisverhoor uitvoer en die hof onder andere oor skuldigbevinding en vonnis toespreek. Om strafregtelike en siviele litigasie in ooreenstemming met vereistes wat wettiglik op die Staat geplaas word te verseker rakende aspekte van strafregtelike en siviele bedrywighede relevant tot die mandaat van die National Prosecuting Authority oor die bestuur van geslagsgeweld en alle daarmee gepaardgaande aangeleenthede. Om sake deur die strafregstelsel te volg, te monitor en te fasiliteer, die hofrole by toegewyde Sexual Offences Courts te bestuur. Om die bywoning van getuies, ondersoekbeamptes en beskuldigdes in aanhouding by die hof te verseker. Om 'n vermindering in die tydperk vir die finalisering van sake in ooreenstemming met die mandaat van NPA te verseker. Help om funksionele verhoudings met belanghebbendes te verbeter. Konstante opvolging met die tersaaklike belanghebbendes. Help om die skuldigbevindingskoers te verbeter. Toesig hou, oplei en ontwikkel tersaaklike rolspelers waar nodig. Maandelikse verslae (insluitend statistieke) rakende prestasiebestuur voorlê.

zu.title: Umindi Weluwo
zu.summary: Isikhundla somindi weluwo e-National Prosecuting Authority e-Bloemfontein esifuna i-LLB kanye namahora eminyaka emihlanu wokuqashwa emthethweni ekushayweni izigwebo zezono zocansi kwezinkinga zezinhlupo ngokobulili.
zu.requirements: I-LLB. Kubahumushi abasebenzayo abafuna ukwesekwa noma ngasiphi isibili somthetho esifanele. Ilungelo lokubonakala njengoba kucatshangelwa kusection 25(2) ye-NPA Act, 32 of 1998. Okungenani eminyaka emihlanu (5) wokuqashwa emthethweni ngemuva kweziqu ekushayweni izigwebo/ukulwa izigwegwe kwezono zocansi, Criminal Procedure, Civil litigation kanye nokuphathwa kwezinkinga zezinhlupo ngokobulili. Ukulingana okubonakalayo ekwenzeni izenzo ezizimele, ngobungqabi, ngobuqotho kanye nokuqinisekiswa. Isipiliwo ekuholeni uphenyo lwezobugebengu kanye nokunika imiyalo emthethweni naso ezono ezesikhashana. Ukubhala amaphepha ezinsimba kanye namadokhumenti esikhungasoma abenza kanzima. Ukukwazi ukuzenzela ngaphandle kokubukiwa njalo. Izindlela ezinhle zokuxhumana nabantu nokukhuluma. Ikhono lokwenza izinqumo. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha nokwazi izinhlelo kwi-MS Office. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile.
zu.duties: Ukuqala futhi kuhole izinqubo zobugebengu ngokwesimo, ukwenza noma yisiphi isenzo esihlotshaniswa nalokho kanye nokuqhuba imisebenzi nemisebenzi enikiwe ekushayweni izigwebo ngaphansi kwanoma yimuphi umthetho kanye/noma i-Policy Manual kanye/noma noma yimiphi imiyalo elandelayo, ukufunda amafayela ecaleni, ukwenza isinqumookuqala futhi kuqhutshwe izinqubo zokushaya izigwebo, okuhlanganisa izinqubo ezithuthukile noma ezibucayi ezenkelweni ze-Sexual Offences Courts. Ulungelela izimo zesikhungasoma, hole uphenyo futhi uxoxe nofakazi, bhala amaphepha ezinsimba namanye amadokhumenti esikhungasoma okuhlanganisa namadokhumenti abiza kakhulu. Bonisa icala lesimo esikhungasomeni. Bonisa ubufakazi, buze imibuzo futhi ukhulume nesikhungasoma ngokuqiniswa kanye nesigwebo. Ukuqinisekisa ukulwa izigwebo zobugebengu nasenkantolo ngokwesimo esivumelana nezidingo ezibekiwe ngomthetho esimeni ngendlela yezenzo zobugebengu nasenkantolo ezihlotshaniswa nemandla e-National Prosecuting Authority ekuphathweni kwezinkinga zezinhlupo ngokobulili kanye nazo zonke izinto eziyihlotshaniswa nalokho. Ukulandela, ukubuka futhi ukweseka izimo ngqo kwi-Criminal Justice System, phatha amashedu esikhungasoma ezinkantolo ze-Sexual Offences Courts. Ukuqinisekisa ukubakhona kofakazi, zabalazi bophenyo kanye nezigwebo eziboshiwe esikhungasomeni. Ukuqinisekisa ukunciphisa isikhathi sokuqedwa kwezimo ngokuhambisana namandla e-NPA. Ukusiza ukuthuthukisa izinhlobonhlobo zokusebenza nabalingani. Ukulandela njalo nabalingani abafanele. Ukusiza ukuthuthukisa izinga lokugxeka. Hola, qeqesha futhi uthuthukise abalingisi abafanele lapho kudingwa khona. Hola imibiko yenyanga (okuhlanganisa izibalo) ngokuphathwa kokusebenza.

xh.title: Mmeli waloMphathiswa
xh.summary: Isithuba sommeli waloMphathiswa kwiNational Prosecuting Authority eBloemfontein esifuna izidanga ze-LLB kunye neminye emihlanu yamava okusebenza kwimisebenzi yommthetho ekugxekweni kweekwephula-mthetho zobulili kunye nendaba ezahlukeneyo ezaliswe ngokwesini.
xh.requirements: Isidanga se-LLB. Kumgxeki okusesikhundleni ofuna ukukhuliswa esikhundleni nangaluphi na ulwazi olufanelekileyo lomthetho. Ilungelo lokubonakaliswa njengoko kucatwe kumacandelo 25(2) eNPA Act, 32 ka-1998. Ubuncinane eminye emihlanu (5) yamava okusebenza emva kokuqulunqa izidanga kwimisebenzi yomthetho ekugxekweni/engqungquthelweni yamahlela e-ekugxekweni kwamabetha-mthetho, eNqanaba lomthetho wokuwelwa amacala, ekuwelweni amacala abantu, nakulawulweni kweenkqubo zokuhlukunywa kwabantu ngokobulili. Ukuba nalwazi olubonakalayo lokuziphatha ngokuzimela, ngobungcali, ngokuba nabaphathwa nkqo, nangokwazi ukunyaniseka. Amava ekukhululeni iingxoxo zokuphandwa kwamabetha-mthetho nokunikela imiyalelo ngomthetho nangeenkqubo zomthetho ezahlukeneyo. Ukubhala ipepa necwadi leenkokhelo kunye namaxwebhu angqamanyeneyo enkundla. Ikhono lokuzimela ngaphandle kolawulo olusoloko lukhona. Amakhono amanam kwindalo yokuzonxibelelana nabantu nokuqhathanisa. Ikhono lokwenza izigqibo. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha nolwazi lweenkqubo kwi-MS Office. Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba esemthethweni.
xh.duties: Ukuqalisa nokwenza iinkqubo zokugxeka ababethi-mthetho ngenkululeko yelizwe, ukwenza nalo naluphi na umsebenzi ongaphakathi kwawo, nokuphanga imisebenzi nako nasekwenziweni amaxwebhu anikwa abagxeki nangaluphi na umthetho kwaye nakwilungelo loGqibo kwaye nakwezinye iindlela ezikukhokelela, phakathi kwazo, ukuphonononga iifayile zamacala, ukwenza isigqibo sokugxeka nokwenza iinkqubo zokugxeka, kuquula iinkqubo ezibucumi okanye ezinzima ngokumzimba kundlu zokugxeka kwabathengi bobulili. Ukulungiselela amacala enkundla, ukukhokela iingxoxo zophando konke nokudibana ngokusetyenziswa nabangqongqoshele, ukubhala iincwadi zeengxoxo zomthetho namaxwebhu, kuqala nokuba ngamaxesha aphinda kwaye onzima ekubhalweni. Ukugcinwa kwendlela yegunya lenkundla ngemisebenzi. Ukubonisa ubungqina, nokubuqamba ekuthetheni nasekubukeni ikomiti ngakumbi ngokuqinisekiswa kwakhona nangemvuzo wecala ngokomthetho. Ukwenza ngenkululeko ukuba nalo naluphi na umsebenzi wamabandla nomyalezo ekuthunyelweni ngenkululeko kwelizwe. Ukulawula ulawulo lweekhathalogu ukugcina abantu, abaniki-mvuzo, nabo bethula iingxabano kwindlu yokugxeka. Ukwenza isigqibo ngokulinganisela isikhathi ngokulinganiselwa kwemisebenzi yamanye amaqela. Ukubamba ngqo nokulandelela iingxoxo ngenkululeko. Ukuncedisa ukuphucula amakhulu ukwenza umsebenzi. Ukunika iingcebiso, ukuqeqesha nokuphucula abo baphathwa nguMnyango. Ukuba liqhina nelungelo lokulwiza ulwazi oluqinisekileyo ngenkululeko phantsi komthetho mayelana nokulawulwa kwamabetha-mthetho. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba kusetyenziswa lula amaxesha amanqanaba amabini kwelizwe nakuwo nawaphi na amanye amanqanaba abo baphethe ababethi-mthetho ekuqwalaselweni iinkqubo ngokumthetho. Ukwenza iingcebiso ezahlukeneyo ngokweminyaka eqwalaselwa ngokomthetho namaxwebhu okufumanisa, ngokukhokelwa luluhlu kwindlu yokugxeka. Ukubhala imisebenzi yophando nokunika abantu iindawo zokusebenzela ekwenziweni ixesha elide. Ukuphatha ukubhalwa kwemisebenzi ngokukhawuleza ngemithetho yokulawula inxulumene neenkqubo zobulili ekusebenziseni. Ukubonisa abo baphathwa nguMnyango abangamagosa amanqanaba aqinisekisa ukuba basetyenziswa kwindlu yokugxeka. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba kukho imisebenzi ekhawulezayo yokuphumeza izigqibo ezingangqinelani nabaphathwa ngokomthetho ngakumbi ukunika iingcebiso, izimvo ngomntu kunye nokuqwalasela iingxoxo kwinkqubo yolawulo lwamabetha-mthetho. Ukubonelela ngeziphumo ezincinane ngokusetyenziswa kolwazi lokubeka kuphela umntu ekubeni ngowokuqinisekisa ukuba ugqibela ukubhalisa iindlela abathunyelwa kuzo iingxoxo zokubakho kwamajelo eendaba ngakumbi ngokuvumela nokulungelelanisa ulwazi lwezabasebenzi nolwazi lwezimali ngokubhaliswa kwamagosa ahambisana nomyalezo wokuqhutywa kolwazi. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba ngamanye amaxesha ukuba kukho ulwazi lweekhomishani ezahlukeneyo zolwazi oluvela kumakhaya ngokusetyenziswa kolwazi lokuqwalasela isiphelo somsebenzi. Ukulandelela nokugcina iinkqubo ukuze zinakho ukuphumeza izigqibo ngokukhawuleza ngokomthetho olulawulayo nokukhokela umsebenzi wokubonelela ulwazi. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba ngalo naliphi na ixesha abantu bakwazi ukugcina ulwazi oluzakuthi lube ngokusetyenziselwa okusesikhundleni ngokukhawuleza kwinkqubo yolawulo ngamanye amaxesha ngokusetyenziswa kolwazi olukhoyo ukulungelelanisa ulwazi. Ukulandelela nokugcina iinkqubo ezifuna ukubakho kolwazi olufanelekileyo. Ukuthumela iingxelo nyanga zonke (kuquka izibalo) malunga nokulawulwa kwamabetha-mthetho.

af.title: Streekhofaanklaer
af.summary: Die National Prosecuting Authority soek gekwalifiseerde aanklaers met 'n LLB en vier jaar se regsonderwinding om strafregtelike verrigtinge oor meerdere streefhofte landwyd te voer.
af.requirements: 'n LLB. Vir dienende aanklaers wat bevordering soek, enige toepaslike regskwalifikasie. Ten minste vier (4) jaar se regsonderwinding na kwalifisering. Aantoonbare bevoegdheid om onafhanklik, professioneel, verantwoordelik en met geloofwaardigheid op te tree. Die ampsdraer moet die vermoë hê om onafhanklik of met minimale toesig op te tree. Onderwindig in die begeleiding van ondersoeke en die gee van instruksies in reg en statutêre oortredings in streekhof. Goeie interpersoonlike vaardighede. Goeie analitiese vaardighede. Goeie aanbiedingsvaardighede. Goeie projekbestuursvaardighede. Geldige bestuurslisensie.
af.duties: Bestudeer saakdossiers. Besluit oor die instelling van en die voer van strafregtelike verrigtinge. Opstel van aanklagbriewe en ander dokumente en verteenwoordig die Staat in alle howe. Okungenani iminyaka emine (4) yohlelo lokusebenza ngomthetho emva kokuthola isiqu. Ukukwaziswa ngokugqwala ekubeni zenzele, ngokuhloniphekile, ngokubhekele kanye nobungamandla. Lowo ohole isikhundla kufanele abe nokukwazi ukuzenzela noma ngaphansi kokulawula okuncane. Uhambo olusukela ekubusiseni imibuzo nangokunika imiyalo emthethweni nasezigonweni ezisetshenziswa esinkantolo. Izindlela ezinhle zokusebenza nabantu. Izindlela ezinhle zokuhlaziya. Izindlela ezinhle zokubukisa. Izindlela ezinhle zokuphatha imigomo. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile.
zu.duties: Ukuhlola amafayili ezicala. Ukunquma nokuqala nokuqhuba izinkantolo ezisozonamanga. Ukwabhala amakhasi ezinyawo nezinye izibhalwa futhi umele iSime kuyo yonke izinkantolo. Ukuyisa oofakazi, ukubuzisisa futhi ukukhuluma enkantolo phakathi kwabantu abagqamile ngokugqamisa icala nokubeka izigwebo ngokuvamile ukugqamisa izicala ngokuhlomula iSime. Ukuze kwenziwe imisebenzi ejwayelekile yosasulo. Ukugqugquzela ukuhlanganiswa ngokubambisana, ukungena kwomphakathi nokwaneliseka abathengi kanye nabahlanganyeli kuso isimiso sezomthetho ebuswa ubugebengu. Ukwenza yonke imisebenzi ehambisana nekhodi yokuziphatha, iNkambiso, nezinkomba ze-National Prosecuting Authority.

xh.title: Umthethisi weNkundla yeSithili
xh.summary: I-National Prosecuting Authority ifuna abathethisi abanemfuno with i-LLB nenyanga ezine zemfundo yomthetho ukuba bagcise iinkqubo zezephulamthetho kumazwana amaninzi enkundla yesithili kwilizwe lonke.
xh.requirements: I-LLB. Kubathethisi abakhoyo abafuna ukukhushulwa naziphi na izifundo ezifanelekileyo zomthetho. Ukwaziswa okungenani kwemyaka yena (4) yemfundo yomthetho emva kokufumana isidanga. Ukubonisa ukuzipatha ngokuzimeleyo, ngobungcali, ngokubhekisele kumthwalo wemisebenzi nangqinaselo. Umbeki kufuneka abe nokuba nakho ukuziphatha ngokuzimeleyo okanye ngolawulo oluncinci. Amava ekuqwalaselweni kweekweliso noku nikela iinkqubo ngomthetho nezenzo eziphulamthetho ezisemthethweni enkundla yesithili. Amabakho obudlelwane obuhle nabantu. Amakhono obuhlalantlu obuhle. Amakhono obugqithisa obuhle. Amakhono olawulo lweelwabiwo obuhle. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni.
xh.duties: Funda iifolda zamacala. Gqiba isigqibo sokuseka kwaye ugcise iinkqubo zezephulamthetho. Bhala amaphepha otyholo namaxwebhu amanye kwaye umele iSizwe kuzo zonke iinkundla. Qamba iiqonga, nantsa umbuzo ngokutshisana kwaye uthethe enkundleni phakathi kwezinye izinto, ngegunya ngesohlwayo nakakhulu ukugcisa iinkxaso ngokomceli weSizwe. Yenza imisebenzi yeentlobo-ngqondo ejikeleze lesi sichinga. Khuthaza udibaniso lwabalinganiswayo, inkululeko kwiqumrhu nelwaneliseko kumthengi ngokusebenzisana nabalinganiswayo kwinkqubo yokulwa naye nobuhlule bezephulamthetho. Yiza yonke imisebenzi ehambelana nayo ngokwemigaqo yokuziphatha, iNkqubo, neendawo ezilawulayo ze-National Prosecuting Authority.

af.title: Streekhofaanklaer
af.summary: Streekhofaanklaer-pos by die National Prosecuting Authority in Cape Town, waar 'n LLB en vier jaar se regservaring vereis word om strafregtelike vervolgings te voer.
af.requirements: An LLB. Vir dienende aanklaers wat bevordering soek, enige toepaslike regskwalifikasie. Ten minste vier (4) jaar se regservaring na kwalifikasie. Aantoonbare bevoegdheid om Onafhanklik, Professioneel, Verantwoordelik en met Geloofwaardigheid op te tree. Ervaring in die begeleiding van ondersoeke en die gee van instruksies in regs- en statutêre oortredings in die streekhof. Goeie interpersoonlike vaardighede. Litigasie in die streekhof en bestuurservaring sal 'n voordeel wees. Die persoon sal vereis word om uitkukaanklaerpligte by howwe binne die tros te verrig. Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Bestudeer saakdossiers. Besluit oor die instelling van en voer strafregtelike verrigtinge. Opstel van klagstate en ander dokumente en verteenwoordig die Staat in alle howwe. Lei getuies, kruisverhoor en spreek die hof toe oor onder andere, skuldigbevinding en vonnis en in die algemeen om vervolgings namens die staat te voer. Verrig algemene administratiewe pligte van die kantoor. Bevorder vennoot-integrasie, gemeenskapsbetrokkenheid en kliëntetevredenheid in samewerking met vennote in die strafregstelsel. Verrig alle pligte daarmee saamhangende ooreenkomstig die Gedragskode, Beleid en Riglyne van die National Prosecuting Authority.

zu.title: Umvelaphi weNkantolo YeSifunda
zu.summary: Isikhundla sokuba ngumvelaphi wenkantolo yesifunda e-National Prosecuting Authority e-Cape Town, sifuna i-LLB neminyaka emine yokuqeqeshwa kwemithetho ukuze kwenziwe izimpushana zezwelonke.
zu.requirements: I-LLB. Kubaveli abasebenza njengabaveli abafuna ukukhushulwa kunanoma yisiphi isifundo esifanele semithetho. Okungenani iminyaka emine (4) yokuhlinzekwa ngenani emva kokuthola isifundo ngemithetho. Ukukwazi ukubonisa ukuzihlakanipha ngokuzenzakalelayo, ngobungcweti, ngobumno futhi ngokwethembeka. Ukuhlakanipha ekubukeni izinhlela zokuphenya kanye nokunika imiyalelo emthethweni nasezehlakalweni ezomthetho enkantolo yesifunda. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana nabantu. Ukusebenza izinkantolo zesifunda nobugqila bokuphatha kuzobe kungeza inzuzo. Lowo okhethwe uzodingeka ukuba enze imisebenzi yokubavela kwezokweluleka kumazinkantolo angaphakathi kwesigaba. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni.
zu.duties: Ukufunda amafayela ezimpushana. Ukwesula ukugcinwa nokubanjwa kwezindlela zezwelonke nokuzihola. Ukuhluza amakadi ezityalo kanye namanye amadokhumende futhi umele umbuso kuzo zonke izinkantolo. Ukubusa ofakazi, ukupose imibuzo futhi ukukhuluma enkantolo ngokuqinisekisa kokubili ukugwetshwa kanye nesigwebo futhi ngokuvamile ukuze uqonde izimpushana emabala ambuso. Ukwenza imisebenzi ejwayelekile yokuphatha ihhovisi. Ukukhuthaza ukuhlanganiswa kwabalingisi, ukubandakanywa komphakathi kanye nokwaneliseka kwabathengi ngokubambisana nabalingisi ohlelweni lobungcweti bezomthetho. Ukwenzisa wonke umsebenzi ohlobene nalowo ngokuhambisana nekhodi yokuziphatha, inkambiso, kanye nemiyalelo ye-National Prosecuting Authority.

xh.title: Umgwebi weNkundla yePhondo
xh.summary: Isithuba somgwebi weNkundla yePhondo kwiNational Prosecuting Authority eCape Town, sifuna izigqibo ze-LLB neminye iminyaka emine yamava obugcisa ukuqhuba izigwebo zobugcisa.
xh.requirements: Izigqibo ze-LLB. Kumagwebi abakhoyo abafuna ukukhuliswa naziphi na izifundo ezifanelekileyo zomthetho. Ubuncinane beminyaka emi (4) yamava obugcisa emva kwezigqibo. Ukuziphatha ngokuzimeleyo, ngobungcali, ngokuziphendula nangenembeko. Amava okukhokela uphando nokunika imiyalelo ngomthetho neelwimi ezisemthethweni enkundla yephondo. Amandla amabalukuokusebenza nabantu. Ukulinga inkundla yephondo namava okulawula kuya kuba lusizo. Umyaleli oqeshweyo kuya kufuneka enze imisebenzi yokugweba kwiinkundla ngaphakathi kwesiqu. Ilayisensi yokuqeshisa evunyiweyo.

zu.requirements: Isidanga se-LLB. Kuba ngabantu abavela kubasebenzi abafuna ukuba bakhuliswe kwindima ephakamileyo nayiphi na ifundo yamagunya efanelekileyo. Ubuncinane iminyaka emine (4) yamava emisebenzi emagunya. Inkonzo ebonakalayo ngokuziphatha ngokuzimela, ngobungcalu, ngokubeya inani ekubeni nenkxaso yenyani. Umntu okhethiweyo kufuneka akwazi ukuziphatha yedwa ngenxa yakhe okanye ngokuqwalaselwa okuncincileyo. Ukusebenza kakuhle ekuwalathiseni/rhangqweni lwezocalulo. Amaxa ekuqondisa uphando nokunika iimvumelwano ngamagunya kunye nezono ezisisigaba kwiinkantolo zesithili. Amakhono amaninzi okuchazana nabantu. Amakhono amaninzi okuhlola. Amakhono amaninzi okubeka ipejethi phambi. Amakhono amaninzi okulawula iprojekthi. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni.
zu.duties: Kufunda iidosiwe zamacala. Sigqiba ukumisa nokuqhuba izigqibo ezimala nenkantolo. Ukubhala ipepa zamacala namanye amaxwebhu nokumela uMbuso kuzo zonke iinkantolo. Ukuba ngengcali ngokubeka ubungqina, nokupenda ngokuchasene nobungqina, nokuthetha ngenkantolo phakathi kwabanye ngezinto, ukugxitywa kwecalana nesigwebo ngokubanzi nokuba ngabantu abayimeko yohlelo ekuqwalaselweni kwamagunya. Ukwenza imisebenzi yolonke lwezolawulo ekomkhulu. Khuthaza udibaniso olusetyenziswayo, ithatha kuluntu nokuvuya amaxhweba kumaxwebhu axhasa inkqubo yokulwa nobugxhola bokulwa. Ukwenza yonke imisebenzi ehambelana nayo ngokulandela iKhowudi yokuziphatha, iNgqungqutha, nemiGaqo yoMbutho wokuBamba uBukhosi.

Amandla aqondisa ukuphonononga nokunika imiyalelo ngomthetho nezenzo ezingamthetho ezinkundleni zeNgingqi. Amandla alungileyo omdibaniso nabantu. Amandla alungileyo oqobo lokuhlahlela. Amandla alungileyo okubamba amabalu umbhalo. Amandla alungileyo olawulo lwezigqibo. Ilayisenisi yomqhubi esemthethweni.

Qamba ngabafakeli, phonononga ngokucamdeka uze uthethe ngenkundla ngakunye ukuxelwa kolahleko nomthetho ngokubanzi ukuze uqambe amacala ngenkxaso kurhuluwa. Zenza imisebenzi yeENTS ka-qumrhu. Phakamisa udibaniso lwabathengi, ninyaniso loluntu nokwaneliseka kwabakhoyo kwakunye nabahlobo kwinkqubo yocalulo yomthetho. jobs.title: Close Protector
jobs.summary: Provide close protection to threatened NPA employees at the Pretoria Head Office, requiring a security qualification and three years of VIP protection experience.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate B Degree (NQF 7) or Three (3) year Diploma (NQF 6) in Security Management / Policing or equivalent. At least three (3) years’ experience in VIP close protection either in public and/or private sector. VIP close protection training from any accredited institution (Firearm Training Certificate) Demonstrable competency in acting Independently, Professionally, Accountable and with Credibility. Advanced close protection. Valid competency certificate in the handling of the firearm (Valid for a year). Grade C PSIRA registration. Minimum three (3) years relevant experience in personnel security and operational planning. Should be able to conduct threat & profiling investigations. good planning and organizational skills. Problem-solving and communication skills. The candidate must be able to work independently. The candidate must be willing to travel and work extended hours. Good interpersonal skills. The candidate must have the ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines. Valid driver’s license and have an advanced driving certificate.
jobs.duties: Provide protection to the assigned threatened NPA employees. Conduct threat and risk assessment on the identified NPA employees. Conduct safety route plan before each operation. Engage with the threatened NPA employees at the venue before the commencement of any assignment. Driving threatened NPA employees to and from various venues. Conduct security appraisals for threatened NPA officials. Protect threatened NPA employees from threats of physical violence. Ensure that the routes used by the threatened NPA employee and the places where the vehicle is packed are safe and secured all the times. Build and maintain working relations with stakeholders. Coordinate security with all security stakeholders for the safety of the protected NPA employees (South African Police Service (SAPS), State Security Agency (SSA). Participate in security coordination for the organisation during NPA events and court proceedings. Liaison with both public and private institutions including law enforcement agencies. Monitor the provision and utilization of government and operational fleet. Ensure that the vehicle used by the threatened NPA employee is clean, roadworthy and in good condition all the times. Ensure that the vehicle used by the threatened NPA employee is not exposed to the placing or attaching of harmful devices rendering the vehicle unsafe. Prepare operation plan for approval by the head.

zu.title: Umvikeli Osedu
zu.summary: Nikela ngokuvikela osedu abasebenzi be-NPA abasengozini ePretoria Head Office, okudinga iziqu zokuvikela kanye neminyaka emithathu yamava wokuvikela abantu ababalulekile.
zu.requirements: I-Degree (NQF 7) efanelekile noma i-Diploma (NQF 6) yeminyaka emithathu (3) eNqwenweni / EPolisini noma okulingana naleyo. Okungenani eminyakeni emithathu (3) yamava wokuvikela osedu abantu ababalulekile kunoma yikuphi kuleso sezwe nokuhlotshaniswa / noma kumhakahakathi. Uqeqesho lokuvikela osedu abantu ababalulekile nasiphi isikhungo esiqinisekisiwe (Isitifikedi Sokuziqeqesela Ngemikhosi). Ukuze kwakhiwe ukuzigqoka ngokuzenzela, ngobungcweti, ngokubhekele nangokwethembeka. Ukuze kwakhiwe ukuvikela osedu okuphakeme. Isitifikedi esivumelekile sokusebenzisa isibhamu (Kuvumelekile unyaka odlule). Ukubhalisa ku-Grade C PSIRA. Okungenani iminyaka emithathu (3) yamava ahlobene nokuvikeleka kwabasebenzi kanye nokuhlela ukusebenza. Kufanele ukwazi ukuqumba ukuphenya ngengozi kanye nokudweba iprofayili. Amandla okuhlela nokuqamba izinhlelo. Amandla okuxazula izinkinga nokuxhumana. Umuntu ophakanywayo kufanele akwazi ukusebenza ngokuzenzela. Umuntu ophakanywayo kufanele avumele ukuvakasha nasekusebenzen ixesha elide. Amandla kahle okuxhumana kwabantu. Umuntu ophakanywayo kufanele akwazi ukusebenza ngaphansi kwegcwele futhi ahambe ngesikhathi. Ilayiseni yomshayeli evumelekile nokuba nesitifikedi sokushayela esiphezulu.
zu.duties: Nikela ngokuvikela abasebenzi be-NPA abasengozini ababelwe. Qamba ukuphenya nokuqinisekisa ingozi kubasebenzi be-NPA abatholakele. Yenza isu lokuphepha endleleni ngaphambi kokuqamba ukusebenza. Xhumana nabasebenzi be-NPA abasengozini esikhungweni ngaphambi kokuqalisa noma yimuphi umsebenzi. Shayela abasebenzi be-NPA abasengozini kuyo nayisuka kumakhaya nemikhakha ehlukene. Yenza izinhlola zokuvikeleka kubasebenzi be-NPA abasengozini. Vikela abasebenzi be-NPA abasengozini kuyo nayisuka kumakhaya nemikhakha ehlukene. Qinisekisa ukuthi izindlela ezisetshenziswa umuntu othengisiwe kanye nezindawo lapho kugcinwa khona izimoto ziphephile futhi zivikelekile sonke isikhathi. Yakha futhi ulondoloze ubudlelwane bokusebenza nabalawuli. Hlela ngokuvikeleka kubo bonke abalawuli bokuqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi be-NPA abavikelekile baphephile (South African Police Service (SAPS), State Security Agency (SSA). Thatha inxaxheba ekuhleleni ukuvikeleka kwenhlangano ngesikhathi kwemikhosi ye-NPA kanye nezigaba zenkantolo. Xhumana namazwe kahulumeni namunhlaka njengoba kuye kubekho amaphoyisa nezikhungo. Qapha ukubiyela kanye nokusetshenziswa imishini kahulumeni nengaphansi komthetho. Qinisekisa ukuthi imoto esetshenziswa umuntu othengisiwe ihlanzwe, ilungele ukushaywa futhi ikulungele ngaso sonke isikhathi. Qinisekisa ukuthi imoto esetshenziswa abasebenzi be-NPA abasengozini ayishiywanga ukubekwa noma ukunamathiselwa izinto ezingcolisayo ezenza imoto ingaphephile. Lungiselela isu lokusebenza ukuze siphezu kuso ihhoveli.

xh.title: Umposi Wokuvala Umthelela
xh.summary: Nika umthelela wokuvala abasebenzi be-NPA abasengozini ePretoria Head Office, okufuna izifundo ezithile kumkhwa wokhuseleko neminyaka emithathu yamava lokhuvala kumthelela i-VIP.
xh.requirements: I-Degree yesidanga (NQF 7) okanye i-Diploma yeminyaka emithathu (3) (NQF 6) kwimeko yoLawulo loKhuseleko / uPoliso okanye okulinganayo. Ubuncinane iminyaka emithathu (3) yamava ekubeni ukhuvala kumthelela i-VIP kunako kwindawo kaRhulumente nakwabucala. Uqeqesho lokuhamba kumthelela kwi-VIP kulo naliphi na isikhongo esifundiswe kuso (Isatifikethi sokuQeqesha iMfanelo) Ulwazi olubonakalayo ekusebenzeni Ngabodwa, ngobuGqatswa, ekuBambeni inxaxheba nokuBeka inqanaba elithembekileyo. Ukuhamba kumthelela kwesidanga esiphezulu. Isatifikethi esisebenzayo sokuziphatha okugqithiswe kuso kwisikhokelo sempahla yokubetha (Sebenza unyaka). Ubumagama be-GRADE C PSIRA. Ubuncinane iminyaka emithathu (3) yamava kwimeko yokhuseleko labantu nokuqulunqa iinkqubo zokuSebenza. Kufuneka akwazi ukuqhuba iingxoxo nophando lokubeka iingozi. Ukulungiselela kakuhle kwaye ube namakhono abuhlalo. Amakhono okusombulula iingxaki nokuxoxwa. Umphathi-mfuni makakwazi ukusebenza ngabodwa. Umphathi-mfuni kufuneka avumele ukuhamba aze akwazi ukusebenza iiyure ezongezelelweyo. Amakhono abomi abantu. Umphathi-mfuni kufuneka akwazi ukusebenza ngaphantsi kwent mbanjana aze afikelele kwimizila yokuphela. Ilayisenisi yokushayela esebenzayo nokuqinisekiswa ngesatifikethi sokuqeqesha ukushayela isidanga esiphezulu.
xh.duties: Nika ukhuseleko abasebenzi be-NPA abasengozini ababelwe. Qhubeza ulwazi noluhlolo lweengozi abasebenzi be-NPA abatshiwo. Qhubeza iplani yokhuseleko yendlela phambi kwinqobo yomsebenzi wokwenza. Thetha nabasebenzi be-NPA abasengozini eIndaweni phambi kokuba kuqalwe naliphi na igqibo lokusebenza. Bahole abasebenzi be-NPA abasengozini baye beze kwezinye iindawo. Qhubeza ukubeka ixabiso lokhuseleko kumaphandle abasebenzi be-NPA abasengozini. Vela abasebenzi be-NPA abasengozini ngemiba yokoyikisa ngamandla okungcali. Qinisekisa ukuba iindawo ezisetyenziswa ngumsebenzi we-NPA osengozini nendawo apho iginqwa khona imoto zikhuselekile ngalo lonke ixesha. Yakha zigqibelana ngokusebenza nakubahlali bokukhusela. Qhubeza ukubeka iindawo ezikhuselekileyo nabaphathi bokukhusela abo bonke ukuze kubekho ukhuseleko lwabasebenzi be-NPA abalindelweyo (South African Police Service (SAPS), State Security Agency (SSA). Thatha inxaxheba ekubeni nabaphathi bokubeka iindawo ezikhuselekileyo kuluntu ngexesha lomanyano lwemiba yamacala nabasengozini kwi-NPA. Thethathu nabantu babucala nabarhulumente nabalawuli bomthetho. Qwalasela ukunikwa nokuSetyenziswa koluntu ngexesha lomanyano lwezixhobo ezahlukeneyo. Qinisekisa ukuba imoto esetyenziswa ngumsebenzi we-NPA osengozini ihlala icocekile, iyasebenza kwaye ilunge ngalo lonke ixesha. Qinisekisa ukuba imoto esetyenziswa ngumsebenzi we-NPA osengozini ayingeni esimangaliso sokubeka izinto ezinobungozi ezenza ukuba imoto ingasebenzi. Lungisa iplani yokusebenza ukuba ivunyelwe ngumlawuli.

af.title: Nabybeskermer
af.summary: Verskaf nabybeskerming aan bedreigde NPA-werknemers by die Pretoria-hoofkantoor, wat 'n sekuriteitskwalifikasie en drie jaar se VIP-beskermingservaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike B-graad (NQF 7) of 'n Drie (3) jaar Diploma (NQF 6) in Sekuriteitsbestuur / Polisiëring of gelykwaardig. Ten minste drie (3) jaar se ervaring in VIP-nabybeskerming in die openbare en/of privaatsektor. VIP-nabybeskermingsopleiding van enige geakkrediteerde instelling (Vuurwapenopleidingsertifikaat). Aantoonbare bevoegdheid om Onafhanklik, Professioneel, Verantwoordelik en met Geloofwaardigheid op te tree. Gevorderde nabybeskerming. Geldige bevoegdheidsertifikaat in die hantering van die vuurwapen (Geldig vir 'n jaar). Graad C PSIRA-registrasie. Minimum drie (3) jaar relevante ervaring in personeelsekuriteit en operasionele beplanning. Moet in staat wees om dreigings- en profielondersoeke uit te voer. Goeie beplannings- en organisatoriese vaardighede. Probleemoplossings- en Kommunikasievaardighede. Die kandidaat moet onafhanklik kan werk. Die kandidaat moet bereid wees om te reis en verlengde ure te werk. Goeie interpersoonlike vaardighede. Die kandidaat moet die vermoë hê om onder druk te werk en sperdatums te haal. Geldige bestuurderslisensie en 'n gevorderde bestuursertifikaat hê.
af.duties: Verskaf beskerming aan die toegewysde bedreigde NPA-werknemers. Voer dreigings- en risikobevaluing op die geïdentifiseerde NPA-werknemers uit. Voer 'n veilige roeteplan voor elke operasie uit. Raakpleeg die bedreigde NPA-werknemers by die plek voor die aanvang van enige opdrag. Ry bedreigde NPA-werknemers na en vanaf verskeie plekke. Voer sekuriteitswaarderasies vir bedreigde NPA-amptenare uit. Beskerm bedreigde NPA-werknemers teen dreigemente van fisiese geweld. Verseker dat die roetes wat deur die bedreigde NPA-werknemer gebruik word en die plekke waar die voertuig geparkeer word, te alle tye veilig en beveilig is. Bou en handhaaf werksverhoudinge met belanghebbendes. Koördineer sekuriteit met alle sekuriteitsbelanghebbendes vir die veiligheid van die beskermde NPA-werknemers (South African Police Service (SAPS), State Security Agency (SSA). Neem deel aan sekuriteitskoördinering vir die organisasie gedurende NPA-gebeure en hofverrigtinge. Skakeling met beide openbare en privaat instellings insluitend wetstoepassingsagentskappe. Monitor die verskaffing en benutting van regerings- en operasionele vloot. Verseker dat die voertuig wat deur die bedreigde NPA-werknemer gebruik word, skoon, padwaardig en te alle tye in goeie toestand is. Verseker dat die voertuig wat deur die bedreigde NPA-werknemer gebruik word, nie blootgestel word aan die plasing of aanhegting van skadelike toestelle wat die voertuig onveilig maak nie. Berei 'n operasionele plan voor vir goedkeuring deur die hoof.

Conduct OHS Inspections and maintain OHS file. Request information on high profile cases from Prosecutors. Attend to any queries with regard to physical and information security services. Attend to OHS meetings quarterly.

af.title: Administratiewe Beampte
af.summary: Administratiewe Beampte wat sekuriteitskontroldienste by die DPP-kantoor in Mthatha verskaf, wat 'n graad of diploma in Sekuriteit of Openbare Administrasie plus twee jaar se sekuriteitservaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike B-graad (NQF 7) of Drie (3) jaar Diploma (NQF 6) in Sekuriteit, Openbare Administrasie / Openbare bestuur of gelykwaardig. Ten minste twee (2) jaar relevante ervaring in die veld van Sekuriteit. Aantoonbare bevoegdheid om Onafhanklik, Professioneel, Verantwoordelik en met Geloofwaardigheid op te tree. Vermoë om vertroulike sake te identifiseer en te hanteer. Deeglike beplannings- en organisasievaardighede, skriftelike en verbale kommunikasie. Algemene rekenaargeletterdheidsvaardighede en kennis van programme MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint en Outlook. Goeie mensevaardighede. Sterk interpersoonlike en kommunikasievaardighede. Vermoë om onafhanklik op te tree. Geldige bestuurslisensie.
af.duties: Verskaf sekuriteitskontroldienste in die streek. Onderhou en dateer databasis op met betrekking tot kontrole en hofsaakklassifikasie. Voer persoonlike geskikheidskontroles uit. Versamel nie-openbaringsvorms en hou 'n register daarvan. Tree as 'n Sleutelbeheerbeampte volgens die Diensvlakooreenkoms. Voer inspeksie uit op wagaktiwiteite, sleutelbeheer en verskaf verslag. Dien inligting by Nasionale Kantoor in. Stel verslae op en dien by Streeksbestuurder in. Voer OHS-inspeksies uit en onderhou OHS-lêer. Versoek inligting oor hoëprofielsake van Aanklaers. Behandel enige navrae met betrekking tot fisiese en inligtingssekuriteitsdienste. Woon kwartaalliks OHS-vergaderings by.

zu.title: Iofisa Ohlusize Izinto Ezingenisa Izinsizakalo
zu.summary: Iofisa Ohlusize Izinto Ezingenisa Izinsizakolo edlula imisebenzi yokuhlola ukuphepha ehhovisi le-DPP Mthatha, edinga idigri noma idiploma ekuphepheni noma ekuqondiseni koncisile kanye neminyaka emibili yohlelo lokuphepha.
zu.requirements: Idigri elifanele le-B (NQF 7) noma iDiploma leminyaka emithathu (3) (NQF 6) ekuphepheni, ekuqondiseni komphakathi / ekuphatheni komphakathi noma okulinganayo. Okungenani iminyaka emibili (2) isipiliyoni esihambisana nomkhakha wezokuphepha. Ikakhono elibonakalayo lokusebenza ngokuzimela, ngobungcweti, ngobusabela nokwethembeka. Ikakhono lokubona nokuphatha izindaba ezimfihlo. Ikakhono lokuhlela nokuhlela izinto ngokuhlakanipha, ikhono lokukhuluma nokubhala. Ikhono lokusebenzisa ikhompuyutha ngokujwayelekile nolwazi ohlelweni lwamagama MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint kanye ne-Outlook. Amakhono amahle okusebenzelana nabantu. Amakhono amakhulu okuxhumana nokukhuluma. Ikhono lokusebenza ngokuzimela. Ilayisense yokushayela okusemthethweni.
zu.duties: Nikela ngemisebenzi yokuhlola ukuphepha esifundeni. Gcina futhi uvuselela idathheyisi ngezigaba zokuhlola nokuhlukaniswa kamacala enkantolo. Yenza ukuhlolwa komuntu ngokufaneleka kwakhe. Qoqa amafomu okungavezi bungazi futhi ugcine irekhodi yawo. Yiba nobhala eNqbenzameni izibamboze ngokweSevi Level Agreement. Yenza ukuhlola imisebenzi yokubalwa, ukulawula izibamboze futhi unikeze ingxoxo. Thumela ulwazi eNkantolo YesiZwe. Hlela ingxoxo futhi uzithumele kumanejamane wesifunda. Yenza ukuhlolwa kwezokuphepha kwe-OHS futhi ugcishe ifayela le-OHS. Cele ulwazi ngamacala abalulekile kubahuleli. Phendula noma yimiphi imibuzo ngemisebenzi yokuphepha kobungoko kukhona nolwazi. Hlanganyela kumihlangano ye-OHS njalo ngemuva kwezinyanga ezintathu.

xh.title: Iofisa oluphatha izinto zolawulo
xh.summary: Iofisa oluphatha izinto zolawuloelinika iinkonzo zokuqinisekiswa kokhuseleko kwisebe le-DPP eMthatha, lifuna idigrimu okanye idiploma kuKhuseleko okanye ekuLawulweni kuze kongezwe iminyaka emi-2 yamava okhuseleko.
xh.requirements: IDigrimu elifanelekileyo le-B (NQF 7) okanye iDiploma yeminyaka emiThree (3) (NQF 6) kuKhuseleko, ekuLawulweni koluntu / ekuLawulweni koluntu okanye okulinganayo. Ubuncinane iminyaka emiTwo (2) yamava afanelekileyo kwimbondo yeKhuseleko. Ubuchule obubonakalayo bokuziphatha ngokuzimeleyo, ngobungcali, ngokubekiweyo nangobunyanisekisiyo. Ikhono lokuchonga nokusingatha iindaba ezifihlakeleyo. Amakhono amnandi cebo nokuhlela, ukubhaliweyo noku Thethwa. Amakhono jikelele okusebenzisa ikhompyutha nolwazi kwiinkqubo i-MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint ne-Outlook. Amakhono amnandi ebantini. Amakhono amanikhiwo phakathi kwabantu noku Thetha. Ikhono lokuziphatha ngokuzimeleyo. Ilayisensi yokuqhayisa esemthethweni.
xh.duties: Kwanikela iinkonzo zokuqinisekiswa kokhuseleko kummandla. Sigcina uze uhlaziye isiseko sedatha malunga nokucwangciswa nokuhlelwa kweekhathanga zezigqibo zevenkile. Yenza ukuvavanya okufanelekileyo komntu. Qokelela iifomu ezingabhalwa ngaphandle aze azigcine kwirejista. Yiba njengetshaba yolawulo lwama-key ngokwesivumelwano seNqanaba leSebe. Yenza ukutlolwa kweenkqubo zokulondolozo, ulawulo lwee-key unike ingxelo. Rhwebisa ulwazi kwiNqanaba lweZiko leSizwe. Hlenga iingxelo uze uzirhwebise kuMlawuli wommandla. Yenza ukuvavanya kwe-OHS uze ulondoloze ifayile ye-OHS. Celisa ulwazi ngeekhathanga eziphakamileyo kubachwephesha bobumcali. Yaphula nayiphi na imibuzo malunga neenkonzo zokhuseleko okubonakalayo nolwazi. Zibandakanya kwiintlanganiso ze-OHS kwikatatu ngenxa yonyaka.

jobs.title: Administrative Clerk: Supervisor
jobs.summary: Supervise legal administration, document management and registry sections at the Director of Public Prosecutions in Bloemfontein.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate B Degree (NQF 7) or Three (3) year Diploma (NQF 6). Minimum two (2) years’ relevant experience in Administration Management. Demonstrable competency in acting Independently, Professionally, Accountable and with Credibility. Understanding of criminal court administration processes. Excellent communication and administrative skills. Report writing, good verbal and written communication skills. Ability to work independently without constant supervision. Excellent administrative skill and problem-solving skills. Strong organizational and management skills. Good analytical skills. af.title: Administratiewe Klerk: toesighouer
af.summary: Hou toesig oor regsadministrasie, dokumentbestuur en registratuurafdelings by die Direkteur van Openbare Vervolging in Bloemfontein.

Aantoonbare bevoegdheid om onafhanklik, professioneel, verantwoordelik en met geloofwaardigheid op te tree. Begrip van strafhofadministrasieprosesse. Uitstekende kommunikasie- en administratiewe vaardighede. Verslagskrywing, goeie verbale en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Vermoë om onafhanklik sonder konstante toesig te werk. zu.title: Clerk Wezokuphathe: Umphathi
zu.summary: Qapha ukuphathwa kwemithetho, ukuphathwa kwamadokhumenti kanye nezigaba zobungqangi kuDirector of Public Prosecutions eBloemfontein.
zu.requirements: I-Degree efanelekile ye-B (NQF 7) noma i-Diploma yeminyaka eyi-Three (3) (NQF 6). Okungenani amava eminyaka emi-two (2) ehlobene nokuphathwa kwezokuphathhe. Amakhono abonakalayo okusebenza Ngokuzimele, Ngobungcweti, Ngoxanduva kanye Nokwethembeka. Ukuqonda izinqubo zokuphathwa kwezinkantolo zezephathi. Amakhono aphumelelo okuxhumana nezokuphathe. Ukubhala imibiko, amakhono aphumelelo okukhuluma nokubhala. Ikhono lokusebenza ngokuzimele ngaphandle kokuqaphwa njalo. Amakhono aphumelelo okuphathhe nezokuxazulula izinkinga. Amakhono aqinile ahleliwe nokuphathwa. Amakhono aphumelelo ahlukanisayo. Amakhono wekhompyutha kuma-MS Word, Excel (elinganeni noma ePhezulu) kanye ne-Outlook. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni.
zu.duties: Phatha kanye/noma qapha izigaba ze-Legal Admin kanye nezokuphathwa kwamadokhumenti. Phatha kanye/noma qapha isigaba sebhalansi. Phatha yonke imifakelo engemthetho esikhungini samadokhumenti se-DPP. Hlola futhi usayine izinkomba ezikagesi (amafayela ezinkonzo ze-Corporate, HR, Fleet kanye ne-Finance njll). Hlola futhi usayine amafayela avaliwe. Yenza izinsuku zenyanga zokuhlolwa. Phatha amafayela amacala. Hlela futhi uhambise izibalo zesinkantolo. Sebenzisa futhi qinisekisa ukuzwela kwezinqubomgomo nezinqubo. Xhumana nabathengi kanye nabathintekile. Phendula imibuzo yokuhlola. Phatha kanye/noma qapha imisebenzi yamabhansi abantu kubasebenzi esigabeni se-Registry/Legal Admin kanye nesigaba sokuphathwa kwamadokhumenti. Yenza noma yimuphi umsebenzi ongamelwe ukwenziwa ngumqaphi.

xh.title: Clerk yeengqungquthela: Omlandeli
xh.summary: Qwalasela ulawulo lwezomthetho, ulawulo lwamaxwebhu neenqanaba zeregistry kwiDirektha yokuShicilelwa kweZityholo eBloemfontein.
xh.requirements: I-Degree elifanelekileyo (NQF 7) okanye i-Diploma yeminyaka emithathu (3) (NQF 6). Ukuba ngaphezulu kweminyaka emibini (2) yamava afanelekileyo kulawulo lolawulo. Ulwazi olubonakalayo lokuziphatha ngokuzimele, ngobungcali, ngobunini bubomi nangokuziphatheka kakuhle. Ukuqonda iinkqubo zolawulo lweenkantolo zobugwesenga. Amandla anomdla wokuthetha nokulawula ngesakhono. Ukubhala iingxelo, amandla amhle okuthetha nokubhala. Amandla okusebenza ngazimele ngaphandle kolawulo olusoloko lukhoyo. Amandla amhle olawulo nolawulwa ngamathuba. Amandla amahle olawulo nolawula. Amandla amhle okuhlola. Amandla ekhompyutha kwi-MS Word, Excel (intermediate okanye Advanced) kwaye no-Outlook. Ilayisenisi yokuqeshisa efanelekileyo.
xh.duties: Lawula nokuthi omlandele ulawulo lwezomthetho neenqanaba zoLawulo lwamaxwebhu. Lawula nokuthi omlandele isicatulwa seregistry. Lawula onke amagama angekhoyo kwangomthetho kwisikhululo samaxwebhu se-DPP. Khangela uphawule onke oonxibelelwano ababhalwe ngokukhowuda (oosayizi abakwiinkonzo zoBuchule, HR, Fleet neMali njl) Khangela uphawule iifayile eziyiyo. Yenza olovo olunyaka ngenyanga. Lawula iifayile ze-tyala. Lungelelanisa uze ungenise izibalo zekhosi. Lawula uqinisekise ulawulo ngemigaqo iinkqubo. Thinta abathengi kunye nabathathi-nxaxheba. Phendula kumbuzo wokuhlola. Lawula nokuthi omlandele iinkqubo zobomi abasebenzi abakwesiKakhulutya/ulawulo lwezomthetho kwaye ulawule isicatulwa soLawulo lwamaxwebhu. Yenza nankelwanyana omnye umsebenzi njengoko kubonwa kufuneka ngumlandeli.

af.title: Hofvoorbereidingsbeampte
af.summary: Hofvoorbereidingsbeampte benodig in Upington om slagoffers en getuies te ondersteun deur hofvoorbereiding en berading, wat 'n graad of diploma in Sosiale Wetenskappe of Gedragsstudies vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Geskikte B-graad (NQF-vlak 7) of Drie (3) jaar Diploma (NQF-vlak 6) in Sosiale Wetenskappe / Gedragsstudies of gelykwaardig. Ten minste een (1) jaar werkservaring wat ondervinding opgedoen gedurende opleiding insluit. Aantoonbare bevoegdheid om Onafhanklik, Professioneel, Verantwoordelik en met Geloofwaardigheid op te tree. Goëie koördinasie- en beradingserfaring. Vermoë om goed met kinders te werk. Kennis van die Strafregstelsel. Uitstekende administratiewe vaardighede, goeie kommunikasievaardighede en probleemoplossingsvaardighede.
af.duties: Verskaf holistiese en geïntegreerde sorg vir slagoffers van misdaad, kliënte en getuies binne die hofomgewing. Voorkom sekondêre trauma deur 'n veilige en beveiligde omgewing te bied waarin om getuienis te lewer. Implementeer hofvoorbereiding vir kinders en volwasse slagoffers van misdaad, kliënte en getuies en voer alle ander pligte in verband daarmee uit. Skakel met en doen verslag aan die Aanklaer/Bestuurder. Voer alle pligte uit ooreenkomstig algemeen aanvaarde hofvoorbereidingstegniek.

zu.title: Ink kokeli yolungelelwaniso lwenkantolo
zu.summary: Kudingeka iNkokeli Yolungelelwaniso Lwenkantolo e-Upington ukuze inikeze ababhekwe nolaka kanye nofakazi inkxaso ngolungelelwaniso lwenkantolo kanye nokuweluleka, idinga idigri noma idiploma kweSocial Science noma izifundo zokuziphatha.
zu.requirements: I-Degree (NQF level 7) ehambisana noma i-Diploma (NQF level 6) yeminyaka emithathu (3) kweSocial Science / Behavioural Studies noma okulinganayo. Okungenani unyaka owodwa (1) weminyaka yomsebenzi ofaka phakathi ulwazi olutholwe ngesikhathi sokuleqwa. Ukukwazi ukusebenza ngokuzimele, ngobungcweti, ngobuwezinye nangokwethembeka okubonakalayo. Ulwazi oluhle lokuhlanganisa nokweluleka. Ukukwazi ukusebenza kahle izingane. Ulwazi ngesiHele seCriminal Justice System. Amakhono aphelele okuphatha, amakhono aphumelele okuxhumana kanye namakhono okuxazulula izinkinga.
zu.duties: Nika ukunakekelwa okuphelele nokuhlanganisiwe ababhekwe nobubi, abathengi kanye nofakazi endaweni yenkantolo. Thinta isikhashana ngokusondzula ngokunikeza indawo ephephile nekhululekile lapho kungabenwa khona ubufakazi. Sebenzisa ulungelelwaniso lwenkantolo izingane nabantu abadala ababhekwe nobubi, abathengi kanye nofakazi, futhi wenze onke eminye imisebenzi ehambisana nalokho. Xhumana futhi umbike kuMmangaleli/Abaphathi. Yenza yonke imisebenzi ngokuvumelanisa nobuchwepheshe obujwayelekile bolungelelwaniso lwenkantolo.

xh.title: Ofisi Wolulungeleliso Koludwe
xh.summary: Kufuneka iOfisi Wolulungeleliso Koludwe eUpington ukuxhasa iibathuli namangqina ngolulungeleliso koludwe nenkxaso-moyza, kwaye kufuneka kubekho izidanga okanye idiploma kwiSayensi yeZenkcubeko okanye iZifundo zoKuziphatha.
xh.requirements: Idegree elungileyo ye-B (NQF level 7) okanye iDiploma yeminyaka emithathu (3) (NQF level 6) kwiSayensi yeZenkcubeko / iZifundo zoKuziphatha okanye echanekileyo. Okungenani unyaka omnye (1) wamava asebenza aquka namava afunyanwe ngelixa kusezikalweni lokuzilolonga. Ubuchwepheshe obubonakalayo ekusebenzeni Luzimele, ngokwabantu bomprofu, eKuzibopheleleki nasekuBambeni ngenyaniso. Amandla amaninzi okusebenzisana kwakunye namava enkxaso-moyza. Ikhono lokusebenza kakuhle nabantwana. Ulwazi ngeNkqubo yeMate wokuLwa eThetha wona ubugwenya. Amakhono aphambili okulawula izinto, amakhono aluloqhaxo amahle namakhono oksombulula iingxaki.
xh.duties: Yonike inkxaso eze yaye eyonanileyo kwiibathuli zezeni, kumaxhoba nakumanqina kwindlu yamagunya. Thintela ukungcoliswa ngokutsha ngokunika indawo ekhuselekileyo nethamsanqa apho ungengxamvakazi. Ukuqalisa ululungeleliso koludwe kwabantwana nakuwamaxhoba amadala ezixelwa, kwamaxhoba nakumanqina kwenze yonke eminye imisebenzi ehambelana nayo. Xhumana kwaye unike iingxelo kuMmangalelisi/Maneja. Yenza yonke imisebenzi ngokwemigaqo eqphelekileyo yendlela yolulungeleliso koludwe.

af.summary: Persoonlike Assistent wat administratiewe en sekretariële ondersteuning aan die Kantoor vir Etiek en Verantwoordbaarheid by die NPA-hoofkantoor in Pretoria verleen.
af.requirements: Graad 12 en 'n Sekretariële Diploma of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie. Minimum drie (3) jaar se ervaring in die lewer van ondersteuningsdienste aan senior bestuur. Aantoonbare bevoegdheid om Onafhanklik, Professioneel, Verantwoordelik en met Geloofwaardigheid op te tree. zu.title: Umsekeli Wezokuphathwa Kwemibhalo
zu.summary: Umsekeli wezokuphathwa kwemibhalo ohlinzeka ngokwesekwa okulinganiselwe kwesimo eliphezulu abaswebi bezecala esikhungweni saseMmabatho eLichtenburg, ofuna ibhodi leKholishi laseSouth Africa nomkhuleko wokusebenza njengomsekeli.

Ulwazi nokuzuva umthethosisekelo ophatha isevisi yomphakathi. Amandla abonakalayo okuziphatha ngokuzimele, ngobungcweti, ngobhekephayo nangokwethembeka. Amakhono aphezulu okuxhumana nezokuphathwa kwemibhalo. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana ngomlomo nakubhalwe. Amakhono aphezulu ezokuphathwa kwemibhalo nakumathuba okuxazulula izinkinga. Amakhono ekhompuyutheni njengengxenye ye-MS Word, Excel, MS Office suite kanye ne-Outlook. Ukuguquguquka. Amakhono okuphatha imibhalo, ukuhlela nokuhlela izinto.
zu.duties: Unikeze wesekwa olulinganiselwe kwesimo eliphezulu ezokuphathwa kwemibhalo esikhungweni sommeli womphakathi ophakeme kanye nabaswebi bezecala kunxubelelwane futhi unikeze izinsizakalo zokuhambisa. Ukuphatha imibhalo yonxibelelwano. Uxhume uxhumane nabantu abaningi bezikhashana emkhakheni wezobulungiswa. Uhlele uhle futhi uhlanganise imicimbi, izinkumbulo noma ezinye izinhlelo. Uphathe ulwazi futhi uqiniseke isimiso esifanele sokugcina imibhalo. Ulenze izinhlelo zokuhamba nokuhlala uma kunesidingo. Ukuphatha uhlu lwemisebenzi yansuku zonke. Wamukele imibhalo yonxibelelwano yohlelo. Uqoqele ulwazi. Uwenze uhlotshaniswa lwezinhlobo ezahlukene zemisebenzi yezokuphathwa kwemibhalo. Weseke abasebenzi bomthetho ezindabeni zezimali, zokuhambisa nokwenza izinsiza zomuntu. Uhanthiswe imibhalo nefeksi esikhungweni futhi unikeze wesekwa olujwayelekile olunjengokulungisa, ukushumayiza, ukuthumela imibhalo, ukwamukela nokuthumela imibhalo. Uqoqe futhi ungathe izibalo.

xh.title: Iclerk yoMlilo
xh.summary: Iclerk yolawulo enika inkxaso ezingqinelweni kumatshuni kwiofisi kaMmabatho eLichtenburg, efunisa ibhayile yesi-12 kunye namava okubhala imibhalo.
xh.requirements: Ibhayile yesi-12 okanye izifundo ezilinganayo. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yokubhala imibhalo njengoko nako ukukwazi ukuqokelela iingcombolo, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuqokelela izibalo. Ulwazi nokuqonda ngoluntu lolulo olulawula inkonzo yorhulumente. Ubungunyanisezisi obubonakalayo bokuziphatha ngokuzimeleyo, ngobungcalo, ngobuzembeza nangokuzinikela. Amakhono abalulekileyo entetho nakulawulo. Amakhono amabalulekileyo entetho yokuthetha nokupecisa. Amakhono abalulekileyo wolawulo nokupekula iingxaki. Amakhono ekhompyutha njengakwiMS word, Excel, Ms Office suite neOutlook. Intsinakalo. Ulawulo lwezixhobo, iplani nokuhlelwa kwamakhono.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso yolawulo ezingqinelweni kwiofisi kaSenior Public Prosecutor nakumatshuni ecluster unike iinkonzo zokuhambisa izinto. Ulawulo lwemibhalo. Qhathanisa unxibelelane nabantu abanengi kwisebe loBulungisa. Hlela, uqhelanise usilungise iinkhethezo, iindibano okanye ezinye izicwangciso. Lawula iinkcukacha uqiniseise inkqubo yokugcina iifayile. Yenza izicwangciso zokuhamba nendawo yokuhlala xa kunesidingo. Ulawulo lwesiqendu. Yamkele imibhalo yesebe. Qokelela iinkcukacha. Zenza imisebenzi emininzi yolawulo. Nike inkxabo yolawulo kwabasebenzi bomthetho, ngokumayelana nezimali, izinto nabasebenzi. Thumela ipeyile, iifeksi ngaphakathi kwiofisi unike inkxabo yolawulo evamileyo njengokubeka iifayile, ukuphatha izikrweqe, ukuthumela iifeksi, ukwamkela nokuthumela imibhalo. Qokelela uqokele iizibalo.

zu.title: Unonozindo Wokulawula
zu.summary: Kudingwa unonozindo wokulawula ehhovisi le-DPP eBloemfontein ukubhalisa amadokhethi, ukufaka ulwazi lwamacala nokuxhumana nabomeli bomango.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 noma okulinganayo. Ubungcweti obubonakalayo bokuziphatha ngokuzimele, ngobungcweti, ngobuzibophezelo kanye nobulethu. Amakhono ahle ohlelo nokuhlela, unxibelelwano olubhalwe phansi nolwenyanya. Amakhono jikelele okusebenzisa ikhompuyutha nolwazi ezinhlelweni ze-MS Word; Excel; PowerPoint kanye ne-Outlook. Amakhono ahle abantu. Amakhono amandla okuxhumana noxhumo lunye. Ikhono lokuziphatha ngokuzimele.
zu.duties: Bhalisa amadokhethi ahamba phambili kanye nokuskeneza. Ukufaka ulwazi kusibhalo samacala sesikhombiso-mkhondo (ECR). Ukubuyekeza ulwazi nsuku zonke esinkundleni. Nikeza amadokhethi ngendlela yesikhombiso-mkhondo kanye namakhophi, lapho kudingeka khona, kuwo Mziyosi ngesicelo sabo Mmeli bomango. Xhumana nabo Mmeli bomango mayelana nemicabango ehlangene nayo. Qinisekisa okwenzekayo enkundleni. Bhala ulwazi ezofakwa kusistimu yokungena. Xhumana nabo Mmeli bomango ngezonxibelelwano ukuze zihambisane nesistimu yokungena. Khipha imibiko esuka ku-ECR ngenjongo yezibalo. Khipha amashidi ahlukene ezibalo. Khipha imibiko esuka kokungena, amathuluzi i-Power BI kanye ne-PowerPoint. Khipha amaspredshithi we-Excel njengomfushanamacala. Khipha imibiko esuka ku-ECR ongayinikwa abaphathi, i-DPP kanye ne-National Office njengembiko yenyanga zonke. Buyekeza isibhalo samacala ngendlela yesikhombiso-mkhondo uma sekutholakala ulwazi olwengeziwe. Phendula imibuzo mayelana nokuhamba kwamacala evela kubo Mmeli bomango nase-SAPS esuka ku-ECR. Nikeza ngokusimamiswa kwamacala kanye nokulawulwa kwamadokhumenti. Lungiselela kanye nogcina amafayela. Khulula amadokhumenti afanele kunanoma iyiphi enye iqembu elithakazelwe. Gcina indawo ye-E disclosure. Phatha amacala abo Mmeli bomango. Siza ngemisebenzi yolawulana eminye njengoba kudingwa ngumphathi wesiquka.

xh.title: Clerk Wezolawulo
xh.summary: Kufuneka i-Clerk Wezolawulo ebhentshini le-DPP e-Bloemfontein ukubhalisa iidokhethi, ukuthatha iinkcukacha zemigwaqo kunye nokunxibelelana nogqethezemigvaqo.
xh.requirements: I-Grade 12 okanye into efanayo. Ubukrelekesi obubonakalayo ekusebenzeleni kodwa, ngokungathembekanga, ngokwenza iintshukumo ezizimeleyo, ngobuchwephesha, ngokubekwa ngabucala ngokwenza iintshukumo ezibophelelekayo nokwenza izinto ngenkathalo yokuzinika isithembwa. Amakhono amabalwa wokucinga nokuhlela, nolwazi lokubhala nolwazi lomlomo. Ulwazi olubanzi lekhompyutha nolwazi kumanqaku e-MS Word; Excel; PowerPoint naku-Outlook. Amakhono amahle abantu. Amakhono amakhulu okunxibelelana nabantu nolwazi lokunxibelelana. Ulwazi lokwazi ukuzenza izinto ngokuzimela.
xh.duties: Bhalisa iidokhethi ezizingenayo kwaye uzihlole iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokuzenza. Thatha iinkcukacha kwirejista yamagama esitampu (i-ECR). Hlaziya iinkcukacha zeenkohlakalo ngemihla. Thatha iidokhethi ngeendlela zekhompyutha nokwenza iikopi ezingabhalwa ngaphandle kwento ethile, xa kufuneka, kumamkeliweyo kuze kubekwe iinkcukacha kubamkeliweyo. Thumela iinkcukacha kwiinkonzo ezahlukeneyo ngenxa yemigiqo efunyenweyo. Qinisekisa ukuba kwenziwa ntoni enkantolo. Bhala iinkcukacha eziza kuthathwa kwizicelo ezifunyanweyo. Qhagamshela nabagqethezemigvaqo ukuthatha iinkcukacha ukubambelela kwizicelo ezifunyenweyo. Khupha iingxelo kwi-ECR ngenxa yeentlanga-ndlela ezahlukeneyo. Khupha amanqaku eentlanga-ndlela ahlukeneyo. Lula iingxelo ezivela ku-Access, Power BI nakumanqaku e-PowerPoint. Lula iikhrwada ze-Excel ukubonelela iinkcukacha zemigwaqo. Lula iingxelo kwi-ECR ngenxa yokuthumela kubaphathi, ku-DPP nakwindlu enkulu yonnyana lweenkonzo ukubonelela iingxelo zenyanga. Hlaziya irejista yamagama esitampu njalo naxa kuvela iinkcukacha ezintsha. Phendula imibuzo engamva kwemigwaqo evela kubagqethezemigvaqo nase-SAPS kwi-ECR. Algemene rekenaarvaardigheid en kennis van programme in MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint.
af.duties: Verwerk betalings van diensverskaffers vir die eenheid. Verskaf ondersteuning aan Finansiële Rekenkunde. Bestuur betaalregister. Ontvang alle eise en fakture, kontroleer vir korrektheid en dien voor by Direkteur: Administrasie vir goedkeuring. Vang S & T-eise en selfoon-eise op PERSAL- en BAS-stelsel vas. Administreer klein kontant vir die kantoor. Dien gesertifiseerde loonstaat maandeliks by Hoofkantoor in. Volg skuldeisersbetalings op die opvolgstelsel. Versprei alle finansiële verwante beleide en sirkulaires aan amptenare. Hou by beleide en prosedures. Skakel met kliënte en verskaffers. Verifieer beskikbaarheid van fondse en beveel goedkeuring van besteding aan. Help met samestelling van streeksbegroting. Druk en versprei bestedingsverslae aan verskillende bestuurders.

zu.title: iFinance Clerk
zu.summary: Kudingwa iFinance Clerk e-Bloemfontein DPP ukucubungula izinkokhelo zabanikazi izikweletu, ukuphatha amabhilidi kanye nokungenisa amafomu okuhamba nethulefono kwi-PERSAL ne-BAS.
zu.requirements: IGrade 12 noma izifundo ezilinganayo. Ikhono elibonakalayo lokusebenza kodwa, ngobungcweti, ngobubezela futhi ngokuqinisekile. Amandla okubala okuyisisekelo. Ulwazi ngemali kahulumeni yokubhala ebhekene nokucubungula izinkokhelo zabanikazi izikweletu nezabelo zomsebenzi njengethulefono nokuhamba. Ikhono lokusebenza kodwa ngaphandle kokulawuleka njalo. Ulwazi lwemali kahulument, i-PERSAL; i-BAS kanye ne-LOGIS. Amandla okukhulumisana okuhle, okukhulunywayo nokubhaliwe. Amandla okwelula nokuqamba izinhlelo. Amandla okuhlola kahle. Ulwazi oluvamile lokusebenza ngamakhompyutha kanye nolwazi lwezinhlelo kwi-MS Word, i-Excel, PowerPoint.
zu.duties: Kucubungula izinkokhelo zabahlinzeki bezinsiza kuleyo unit. Nikela inkxaso ekubhalwen kwemali kahulumeni. Phatha uhlu lwezinkokhelo. Yamukela wonke amafomu okufuna imali namabhilidi, hlola ukuqonda bese uzithumela kwiDirector: Administration ukuthi azamukele. Faka amafomu okufuna imali yokuhamba nethulefono kusistimu ye-PERSAL ne-BAS. Phatha imali encane yohhovelo. Thumela iholo evunyiwe eNtabathamba njalo ngenyanga. Landa izinkokhelo zabanikazi izikweletu esistimini yokulandelana. Sabelisa wonke amapholisi namasexwayo ahlobene nemali kwabasebenzi. Landela amapholisi namagejana. Xhumana nabathengi nabanikezeli. Qinisekisa ukuthi khona imali uphinde ubeke ukuthi kungaba yisimo sokusetshenziswa kwemali. Siza ekwenziweni kabalwe imali wesifunda. Shicilela uphinde usabalise imibiko yesimo sokusetshenziswa kwemali kubaphathi abahlukene.

Ulwazi lwezezimali ngokubalwa kwezimali ezinxulumene nokuHLawula abanikezeli nokuHLawula izibonelelo zabasebenzi ezinjengefowuni ye-S&T.

jobs.title: Control Room Operator
jobs.summary: Monitor CCTV and emergency systems, control access, record incidents and safeguard premises at the National Prosecuting Authority in Johannesburg.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 or equivalent qualification. Demonstrable competency in acting Independently, Professionally, Accountable and with Credibility. Registration with the Private Security Regulation Authority (PSIRA) Grade C. Reliable, tolerant and determined. Able to act independently. High level of integrity. Willing to work shifts, after hours and over weekends. Good report writing skills and able to work under pressure. General computer literacy and knowledge of programs in MS Word, Excel, Outlook and Power Point. knowledge of security management in public sector administration (MISS &n MPSS documents). A valid driver’s license.
jobs.duties: Operate control room security and emergency system to ensure safety of the premises. Control cameras through CCTV system to monitor and safeguard the premises. Identify and record all suspicious incidents. Safekeeping of recorded information and back-up footage and access control records. Compile incident reports. Ensure proper use of control room systems. Identify and report faults and malfunctioning of the system. Monitor all scheduled and repair maintenance to ensure the effective working of all systems and equipment. Implement access control and key control for NPA building facilities and conduct key audits as and when required. Ensure access control of the control room. Control entry and exit of the control room. Ensure all relevant control room registers are complete. Respond to security emergencies. Activate the emergency systems and immediately report incidents. Liaise with internal and external stakeholders.

af.title: Beheerkameroperateur
af.summary: Monitor CCTV- en noodstelsels, beheer toegang, registreer voorvalle en beskerm persele by die National Prosecuting Authority in Johannesburg.
af.requirements: Graad 12 of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie. Aantoonbare bevoegdheid om onafhanklik, professioneel, verantwoordelik en met geloofwaardigheid op te tree. Registrasie by die Private Security Regulation Authority (PSIRA) Grade C. Betroubaar, verdraagsaam en vasberade. In staat om onafhanklik op te tree. Hoë vlak van integriteit. Bereid om skofte te werk, na ure en oor naweke. Goeie verslagskryfvaardighede en in staat om onder druk te werk. Algemene rekenaarvaardigheid en kennis van programme in MS Word, Excel, Outlook en Power Point. kennis van sekuriteitsbestuur in openbare sektor administrasie (MISS &n MPSS dokumente). 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Bedien die beheerkamer se sekuriteits- en noodstelsel om die veiligheid van die perseel te verseker. Beheer kameras deur die CCTV-stelsel om die perseel te monitor en te beskerm. Identifiseer en registreer alle verdagte voorvalle. Veilige bewaring van opgeneemde inligting en rugsteunbeeldmateriaal en toegangbeheerrekords. Stel voorvalverslae op. Verseker behoorlike gebruik van beheerkamerstelsels. Identifiseer en rapporteer foute en wanfunksionering van die stelsel. Monitor alle geskeduleerde en herstelonderhoud om die doeltreffende werking van alle stelsels en toerusting te verseker. Implementeer toegangbeheer en sleutelbeheer vir NPA-geboufasiliteite en voer sleuteloudits soos en wanneer vereis uit. Verseker toegangbeheer van die beheerkamer. Beheer toegang tot en uitgang uit die beheerkamer. Verseker dat alle tersaaklike beheerkamerregisters voltooi is. Reageer op sekuriteitsnoodgevalle. Aktiveer die noodstelsels en rapporteer voorvalle onmiddellik. Skakel met interne en eksterne belanghebbendes.

zu.title: Umlawuli Wekamelo Lokulawula
zu.summary: Qapha amasistimu e-CCTV nezimo eziphuthumayo, lawula ukungena, qamba amarekhodi ezehlakalo ezithile futhi uvikele izindawo eNational Prosecuting Authority eJohannesburg.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 noma isifundo esilinganayo. Ukuze ubonakale ukuhlakanipha ekusebenzeni Ngokuzimela, Nobungcweti, Nebandulela futhi Ngesithunzi. Ukuqashwa ku-Private Security Regulation Authority (PSIRA) izinga C. Ethembekile, oyezwa futhi onezinkambiso. Akwazi ukuzenzakalela. Izinga eliphezulu lokuziphatha kahle. Vilapha ukusebenza ngokushintshashintsha, ngemva wezinsuku nangaphezulu kwamasonto. Amakhono amahle okubhala imibiko nokukwazi ukusebenza ngaphansi kwezingcindezi. Ukwaziswa okujwayelekile mayelana nokusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokwazi amaphrograqimu e-MS Word, Excel, Outlook kanye ne-Power Point. Ulwazi lokuphatha ukuvikeleka kwempilo emigqeni yomphakathi (amadokhumenti e-MISS & MPSS). Ilayisense yokuqasha elisebenzayo.
zu.duties: Phatha ukuvikeleka kwekamelo lokulawula nesistimu yezimo eziphuthumayo ukuze kuqiniseke ukuphepha kwezindawo. Lawula amakhamera ngesistimu ye-CCTV ukuze uqapse futhi uvikele izindawo. Qaphela futhi urekhode zonke izehlakalo ezingezinhle. Ukugcina ukwaziswa okurekhodiwe nokuthunyelwe kabusha futhi ulawule amarekhodi okungena. Hlola futhi uqambe imibiko yezehlakalo. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okufanele kwamasistimu ekamelo lokulawula. Qaphela futhi uxaxe iziphazimo kanye nokungasebenzi kahle kwesistimu. Qaphela lonke ulwelwesiwe oluhleliwe futhi ulungise izinto ukuze kuqiniseke ukusebenza kahle kwazo zonke izistimu nezinto zokusebenza. Sebenzisa ukulawula ukungena nokulawula amakhiye kumasiza wezakhiwo ze-NPA futhi wenze ukuhlolwa kwamakhiye noma nini lapho kudingeka khona. Qinisekisa ukulawula ukungena ekamelo lokulawula. Lawula ukungena nokuphuma ekamelo lokulawula. Qinisekisa ukuthi wonke amarejista ahambisanwe ekamelo lokulawula aqediwe. Phendula ezimweni eziphuthumayo zokuvikeleka. Yenza masistimu ezimo eziphuthumayo futhi uxaxe izehlakalo ngokushesha. Xhumana nabalingani bangaphakathi nangaphandle.

xh.title: Umlawuli Wegumbi Lolawulo
xh.summary: Qapha ii-CCTV nezisilawulo zezezigulo, lawula ingeno, lungisa iirekhodi ezibaxa iziganeko zigqitywe kwaye uvikele iindawo kwi-National Prosecuting Authority eJohannesburg.
xh.requirements: I-Grade 12 okanye isidanga elinganayo. Ubuchule obubonakalayo bokuziphatha Ngokuzimeleyo, Ngobungcali, Ngobunini bokwaziphendula kwaye Ngentembeko. Ukuqatshelwa kwi-Private Security Regulation Authority (PSIRA) Grade C. Uthembekile, unomonde kwaye unesigqibo. Akwazi ukuziphatha ngokuzimeleyo. Inqanaba eliphezulu lwentembeko. Volontile ukusebenza ngokutshintshwa kweenyanga, emva kweeyure nakwiwekendini. Amakhono amahleni okubhaliweyo akulembiweyo kwaye akwazi ukusebenza ngaphantsi kwexinzelelo. Ulwazi jikelele lweekhompyutha nolwazi lweenkqubo kwi-MS Word, Excel, Outlook ne-Power Point. Ulwazi lolawulo lokhuseleko kulawulo lwentlalo yoluntu (amaxwebhu e-MISS &n MPSS). Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni.
xh.duties: Sebenzisa inkqubo yokhuseleko negundo-moya yegumbi lolawulo ukuqinisekisa ukhuseleko kwindawo. Lawula iikhamera ngenkqubo ye-CCTV ukuqaphela kwaye uvikele indawo. Qaphela kwaye ulungise iirekhodi zonke iziganeko ezikrakra. Ukugcina iinkcukacha ezirekhodiweyo nengxolo yefoto ngee-rekhodi zolawulo loyingeniso. Hlanganisela iingxelo ngezigauzeko. Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa okuchanekileyo kweenkqubo zegumbi lolawulo. Qaphela kwaye uxele malunga namashwa nokungasebenzi kahle kwenkqubo. Qaphela zonke iinkqubo zolungiso ezijolwe kulo nakwezona ngeenyanga ukuqinisekisa ukusebenza ngokuchanekileyo kweenkqubo zonke nempahla. Zisebenzisa ulawulo loyingeniso nolawulo lokuqala lelakhule le-NPA xa kusetyenziswa naxa kufuneka. Qinisekisa ulawulo loyingeniso kwigumbi lolawulo. Lawula ukungena nokuphuma kwelafu yegumbi lolawulo. Qinisekisa ukuba zonke iirekhodi ezimali nezigaba zegumbi lolawulo zigqityiwe. Phendula kwiigxelo zokhuseleko. Yenza inkqubo yezezigulu ihanjiswe kwaye uxele ngokukhawuleza iziganeko. Thintathanisela nabantu abe ngaphakathi nangaphandle.

Knowledge of Financial Accounting dealing with processing creditors payments and employee’s allowances such as cellphone and S&T. Ability to work independently without constant supervision. Knowledge of Public Finance, PERSAL; BAS and LOGIS. Good communication skills, verbal and written. Planning and organizing skills. Good analytical skills. xh.summary: Kufuneka abe nguMphathi wezeMali kwi-DPP eMakhanda ukucubungula imali ezahlulelo, ukulawula i-invoisi nokubhala iklheyim kwi-PERSAL naku-BAS.
xh.requirements: I_Grade 12 okanye isiqu esingulingana nalo. Ubungangamfu obubonakalayo bokuziphatha ngabodwa, ngokuchanekileyo, ngokuziphatha ngokubambekwayo nangokwethemba. Amandla abalwa abhalwayo. Ulwazi ngeZeMali eZimalini ezithintayo nokuqhathwa kweentlawulo zabanikazi bashukumisiyo nezimali ezizonwabisa abasebenzi njengeselula ne-S&T. Ikhono lokusebenzela bodwa ngaphandle kolawulo olungapheleleyo. Ulwazi ngezeMali zikaRhulumente, i-PERSAL; i-BAS ne-LOGIS. Ikhono lokuthetha nokubhala elilodwa. Ikhono lokuqamba iplani nokuqamba intlangano. Ikhono elilodwa lokuhlola. Ulwazi olubhalwayo ngekhompyutha nakuzo zonke iinkqubo ze-MS Word, i-Excel, ne-PowerPoint.
xh.duties: Cubungula iintlawulo zababanikezeli besebenzela kwisebe lenqanaba elinye. Nika inkxaso kwezeMali eZimalini. Lawula irejista yentlawulo. Yamkele zonke iiklheyim nazo i-invoisi, khangelo ukuba zichanekile kwaye unikeze kuMongameli woBulungisa ukuba azamkele. Bhala iiklheyim ze-S & T neziye eziselula kwinkqubo ye-PERSAL ne-BAS. Lawula imali encinci ebhokisini yofiso. Thumela isilumkiso somvuzo ogunyaziweyo kwiNtloko eNkwenkwezela nyanga ngamnye. Landela iintlawulo zabachithi kwinkqubo yokulandela. Yahlula zonke iinkqubo nangokuhamba kwexesha malunga nezeMali nakwiinkqubo ezahlukene kubaphathi. Landela iinkqubo neenkqubo zolawulo. Thintana nabaqingquli nababanikazi. Qinisekisa ukuba kukho imali yokuqinisekisa ukuze ugcobe ukuba kufuneka kubekho isixa esingamkelekanga somvuzo ongagqithiswa kwi-ndawonye. Nceda ngokusika ijejwe legcisa leMali ngamanye amacandalo alawulwa ngemithetho yebhajeti echongiweyo. Phinda umbhalo ufaka izigqibo ngokumila omfutshane. Thumela ngokubhaliweyo iindaba eziguqukileyo kubaphathi ngokubhalwa kwexesha ukubhala izindaba zemali ukuze kubhale izindaba eziguqukileyo ezibhaliweyo kumanqaku ekhompyutha.

jobs.title: Chief Registrar
jobs.centre: North West Division of The High Court: Mmabatho
jobs.salary_text: R610 434 – R1 442 451 per annum (MR6). The successful candidate will be required to sign a performance agreement. Salary will be in accordance with Occupation Specific Dispensation (Resolution 1 of 2008). Shortlisted candidates will be required to submit a service certificate/s for determination of their experience.
jobs.summary: Chief Registrar sought for the North West High Court in Mmabatho to manage court documentation and case administration systems, requiring an LLB degree and eight years' experience.
jobs.requirements: Applicants should be in possession of an LLB Degree or a four (4) year legal qualification as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of eight (8) years’ post qualification experience obtained as a Registrar. A valid driver’s license. Knowledge and skills: Knowledge of registry duties, knowledge of legislative framework governing the public service, knowledge of storage and retrieval procedures in terms of the working environment, knowledge of Quasi-Judicial, knowledge of Case flow management, knowledge of court documentation management and Human Management and Batho Pele Principles. Skilled in planning, organising numeracy, problem solving, decision making, computer literacy (MS Office), communication (written and verbal), people skills/interpersonal relations, report writing and interviewing skills.
jobs.duties: Manage the Information and case/court documentation Management System: Implement information desk in the court, develop and maintain a complaints management system, interface with external court stakeholders on a regular basis, ensure that the checking of relevant registers is done in terms of the codes. Provide support to court and case flow management / Quasi-Judicial functions: Develop & implement case management strategies, review and implement projects to improve court efficiency regularly, implement a case/ court documentation and information management system. Implement Service Level Agreements and Strategic Court projects: Ensure that all J33 requests to Service Providers are timeously returned, liaise with the service provider on a regular basis to ensure smooth service delivery, peruse proposed amendments received from the rules board and provide comments, if any to them. Provide leadership of the High Court: Develop annual institutional performance reports & other statutory reports, give direction and guidance to the court based on best court management practices and lead transformation in the High court. Supervise and develop staff: Ensure general supervision of employees, allocate duties and perform quality control on the work delivered by officials, manage leave of staff, advise and lead supervisees with regard to all aspects of the work, perform quality control on the work delivered by officials, manage leave of staff, advise and lead supervisees with regard to all aspects of the work.
jobs.enquiries: Technical Related Enquiries: Mr OPS Sebapatso Tel No: (018) 397 7004 HR Related Enquiries: Ms L Makula Tel No: (018) 397 7064
