af.title: Hoofregistrateur
af.summary: Hoofregistrateur gesoek vir die North West High Court in Mmabatho om hofdokumentasie en saakadministrasiestelsels te bestuur, met 'n LLB-graad en agt jaar se ervaring as vereiste.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet oor 'n LLB-graad of 'n vier (4) jaar regskwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken beskik. 'n Minimum van agt (8) jaar se ervaring na kwalifikasie verkry as 'n Registrateur. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van registrateurpligte, kennis van die wetgewende raamwerk wat die openbare diens regeer, kennis van bergings- en onttrekkingsprosedures in terme van die werksomgewing, kennis van Kwasi-Regterlike werksaamhede, kennis van saakvloei-bestuur, kennis van hofdokumentasie-bestuur en Menslike Bestuur en Batho Pele-beginsels. Vaardig in beplanning, organisasie, syfergebruik, probleemoplossing, besluitneming, rekenaargeletterdheid (MS Office), kommunikasie (skriftelik en mondeling), mensevaardighede/interpersoonlike verhoudings, verslagskrywing en onderhoudvoeringsvaardighede.
af.duties: Bestuur die Inligting- en saak-/hofdokumentasie-bestuurstelsel: Implementeer 'n inligtingskantoor in die hof, ontwikkel en handhaaf 'n klagtebestuurstelsel, skakel gereeld met eksterne hofbelanghebbendes, verseker dat die nagaan van relevante registers gedoen word volgens die kodes. Verskaf ondersteuning aan hof- en saakvloeibestuur / Kwasi-Regterlike funksies: Ontwikkel en implementeer saakbestuurstrategieë, hersien en implementeer projekte om hofdoeltreffendheid gereeld te verbeter, implementeer 'n saak-/hofdokumentasie- en inligtingsbestuurstelsel. Implementeer Diensvlakooreenkomste en Strategiese Hofprojekte: Verseker dat alle J33-versoeke aan Diensverskaffers betyds terugbesorg word, skakel gereeld met die diensverskaffer om gladde dienslewering te verseker, lees voorgestelde wysigings ontvang van die reëlsraad en verskaf kommentaar, indien enige, aan hulle. Verskaf leierskap aan die Hoë Hof: Ontwikkel jaarlikse institusionele prestasieverslae en ander statutêre verslae, gee rigting en leiding aan die hof gebaseer op beste hofbestuurspraktyke en lei transformasie in die Hoë Hof. Outeur en ontwikkel personeel: Verseker algemene toesig oor werknemers, wys pligte toe en voer gehaltebeheer uit op die werk gelewer deur amptenare, bestuur verlof van personeel, adviseer en lei toesighouers met betrekking tot alle aspekte van die werk, voer gehaltebeheer uit op die werk gelewer deur amptenare, bestuur verlof van personeel, adviseer en lei toesighouers met betrekking tot alle aspekte van die werk.

zu.title: Umnuathi Omkhulu
zu.summary: Kufunwa uMnuathi Omkhulu we North West High Court eMmabatho ukuphatha imibhalo yenkantolo namaphrojekthi okuphatha izindaba, kudingeka iziqu ze-LLB neminyaka eyisishiyagalombulu yamava.
zu.requirements: Abafaki izicelo kufanele babe neziqu ze-LLB noma iziqu zomthetho zeminyaka emine (4) njengoba zaziwa yi-SAQA. Ubufakazi beminyaka eyisishiyagalombulu (8) bokusebenza esikhundleni somnuathi ngemuva kokuthola iziqu. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yomnuathi, ulwazi ngohlelo lomthetho oluphatha asebentela kahulumeni, ulwazi ngamaphrosedha okugcina nokuthola kabusha emzileni wokusebenza, ulwazi ngokuqamba kwomthetho, ulwazi ngokuphatha ukuhamba kwamacala, ulwazi ngokuphatha imibhalo yenkantolo nokuphatha Abantu nemigomo kaBatho Pele. Ukubekezela ekwelulekeni, ekuhleleni, ezibalweni, ekuxazululeni izinkinga, ekwenzeni izinqumo, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (MS Office), ukuxhumana (okubhalwayo nokukhulunwayo), amakhono abantu/ubudlelwano nabantu, ukubala imibiko namakhono okuxoxa.
zu.duties: Phatha inkalo yolwazi nokuqashwa kwezindaba/imibhalo yenkantolo: Fakela ideski lolwazi enkantolo,akha uphondle isistimu yokuphatha izikhalazo, xhumana namabalasi bangaphandle benkantolo njalo, qinisekisa ukuthi ukuhlola okuyimibhalo edingekayo kwenziwa ngokomthetho. Nikeza usizo enkantolo nakuphathweni kokuqhubeleka kwamacala / imisebenzi yokuqamba komthetho: Akha uphinde usebenzise izindlela zokuphatha amacala, cabangalisize uphinde usebenzise amaphrojekthi ukuthuthukisa amandla enkantolo njalo, sebenzisa isistimu yokuphatha amacala / imibhalo yenkantolo nolwazi. Sebenzisa izivumelwano zenkonzo yizinga namaphrojekthi abalulekile enkantolo: Qinisekisa ukuthi yonke izicelo ze-J33 ezithunyelwa kubanikazi benkonzo zibuyiswa ngasikhathi sokuqondile, xhumana nabanikazi benkonzo njalo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukulethwa kwenkonzo okushibhile, funda izinguquko eziphakanyisiwe ezitholakale kubhodi yomthetho uphinde unikeze imibono yawo, uma kunakho kubona. Nikeza ubuholo beNkantolo Ephakeme: Akha imibiko yamava okwenziwa minyaka yonke namanye imibiko esemthethweni, nikeza isiqondiso nokuholela enkantolo ngokususelwa kumakhono amahle okuphathwa kwenkantolo uphinde uholele inguquko eNkantolo Ephakeme. Qaphela uphinde uthuthukise abasebenzi: Qinisekisa ukuqaphelelwa okujwayelekile kwabasebenzi, abeza imisebenzi uphide wenze ukuqondisa ikhwalithi emsebenzini othunyelwe abasebenzi, phatha ukunqamula kwabasebenzi, weluleke uphinde uholele abaqaphiwe ngakho konke okuhlobene nomsebenzi, wenze ukuqondisa ikhwalithi emsebenzini othunyelwe abasebenzi, phatha ukunqamula kwabasebenzi, weluleke uphinde uholele abaqaphiwe ngakho konke okuhlobene nomsebenzi.

xh.title: Ntlola Omkhulu
xh.summary: Kufunwa iNtlola Omkhulu kwiNkundla eNkulu yaseNorth West eMmabatho ukuyilawula inkqubo yolawulo lwamafa weenkundla nolawulo lwezimo, kufuneka idigri yeLLB nenkampani yeminyaka yethoba (8).
xh.requirements: Abafake izicelo kufuneka babe neDigri yeLLB okanye isigqibo semithetho yeminyaka eyi-four (4) eseqiniswe yiSAQA. Ngokuncitshisiweyo yiminyaka yethoba (8) yamava emva kokuqeqeshwa ajolwe njengoNtlola. Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yolawulo bwezikhewu, ulwazi lwezakhono zomthetho ezilawula inkonzo zikarhulumente, ulwazi lweenkqubo zokugcina nokuzelelana ulwazi ngokwendalo yomsebenzi, ulwazi lwe-Quasi-Judicial, ulwazi lolawulo lwe-flow lwezimo, ulwazi lolawulo lwamafa weenkundla nolawuloabantu kwaye nezenzo. Ukugqwesa kwakhona ekuqhelaniseni, ukulungelelanisa, ukubala, ukusombulula iingxaki, ukwenza izigqibo, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (MS Office), unxibelelwano (olubhaliweyo noluthethwayo), amakhono okuhamba nabantu/oqhagamshelwano namahu, ukubhala iingxelo namakhono okudiba.
xh.duties: Lawula inkqubo yoLwazi nolawulo lwamafa wezimo/weenkundla: Zisebenzise idesika yolwazi enkundleni, yahlaze ugcinze inkqubo yolawulo lwezinto ezingamakhonza, qxhama nabanxibelelanayo kunxe yeenkundla rhoqo, qinisekisa ukuba ukuphangela kwezikhewu eziphathelene nokwenziwa ngokwekhowudi. Nikezela inkxaso enkundleni nasekubeni ngokwamanqanaba lwezimo / ngokwe-Quasi-Judicial: Yahlaze & uqale amacebo olawulo lwezimo, hlola uze usebenzise iiprojekthi ukuphucula iziphumelelo zenkundla, qale inkqubo yolawulo lwamafa/inkundla nolwazi. Zisebenzise iNqanaba leZenzo eziyivumelano neeprojekthi eziQhagamshelayo zeNkundla: Qinisekisa ukuba zonke izicelo zeJ33 kubanikezeli beNkonzo zibuyiswa ngexesha, unxibelelane nobanikezeli benkonzo rhoqo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ulawulo olusulungekileyo, hlohla izigqibo ezifakwa kwindlu yemithetho ukubaxhasa ze unikeze izimvo kukuba zikho. Nikezela intsalela enkundleni eNkulu: Yahlaza iingxelo zemveliso yonyaka weziko & ezinye iingxelo zomthetho,ika enika indlela nolayisense enkundleni ngenkqubo yokulawula iinkundla ezinobhedala, uze ukhokelele uguqulo enkundleni eNkulu. Lawula uthathe ingxaki abasebenzi: Qinisekisa ukulawula jikelele abasebenzi, wabaqondise imisebenzi uze ungene enkqubo yolawulo kolona, lawula ipeyile zangaphandle zenkonzo, uncede uze ukhokelele abalawuli kuzo zonke iindawo zemisebenzi, uhlole umgangatho wemisebenzi ekhutshwe ngabasebenzi, ulawule ipeyile zabantu, uncede uze ukhokelele abalawuli kuzo zonke iindawo zemisebenzi.

jobs.summary: Senior Law Researcher needed at the Pretoria High Court to provide legal research and analytical support to the judiciary, requiring an LLB degree and three years' research experience.
jobs.requirements: Applicants should be in possession of an LLB Degree at (NQF level 8). A minimum of three (3) years’ legal research experience of which two (2) years should be at supervisory level. A valid driver’s license will serve as an added advantage. Knowledge and Skills: Knowledge of electronic information resources and the ability to access and utilise computer research programmes (Westlaw, LexisNexis, Jutastats), knowledge of operating DCRS/ CRT machine, Employment Equity Act, Practice Manual of the Court, sound understanding of South African law and Judicial system, interpretation and application of the law and Batho Pele Principles. Skilled in Microsoft Office Programs, research, problem solving, planning and organising, good judgment and decision-making, interpersonal relations, time management, effective communication (verbally and in writing) and supervisory skills. Along with the following attributes: Ability to multitask, able to work under pressure, telephone etiquette, professionalism, ability to meet strict deadlines and ability to maintain confidentiality with ability to take charge.

performance, conduct and discipline of employees, ensure that all employees are trained and developed to be able to deliver work of the required standard efficiently and effectively, develop, af.title: Senior Regsonderzoeker
af.summary: Senior Regsonderzoeker benodig by die Pretoria Hooggeregshof om regsondersteuning en analitiese steun aan die regbank te bied, met 'n LLB-graad en drie jaar se ondervinding in navorsing as vereiste.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet 'n LLB-graad op (NQF vlak 8) hê. 'n Minimum van drie (3) jaar se regsonderzoekservaring waarvan twee (2) jaar op toesigvlak moet wees. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Kennis en Vaardighede: Kennis van elektroniese inligtingsbronne en die vermoë om rekenaarnavorsingsprogramme (Westlaw, LexisNexis, Jutastats) te bekom en te gebruik, kennis van die bedryf van 'n DCRS/CRT-masjien, die Wet op Geslagsgelykheid in Arbeid, die Praktykhandboek van die Hof, 'n deeglike begrip van Suid-Afrikaanse reg en die Regstelsel, interpretasie en toepassing van die reg en Batho Pele-beginsels. Vaardig in Microsoft Office-programme, navorsing, probleemoplossing, beplanning en organisering, goeie oordeel en besluitneming, interpersoonlike verhoudings, tydbestuur, doeltreffende kommunikasie (mondeling en skriftelik) en toesigvaardighede. Asook die volgende eienskappe: Vermoë om veelvuldige take gelyktydig uit te voer, kan onder druk werk, telefoonetiket, professionaliteit, vermoë om streng sperdatums na te kom en vermoë om vertroulikheid te handhaaf met vermoë om beheer te neem.
af.duties: Verskaf regsonderzoek, raadpleeg die regbank in kamers en neem opdragte in aanmerk, deursoek alle ingediente materiaal, identifiseer die kwessie en begin toepaslike navorsing, verskaf 'n analitiese opsomming van advokate se argumente of skriftelike getuienis in die hof, delegeer opdragte aan die navorser, voer navorsing op elektroniese databasisse uit soos deur die Regter versoek, verseker dat alle navorsing aan Regters omvattend en akkuraat is, verseker dat konsepvonisse, artikels en toesprae duidelik, konsekwent en omvattend is, verseker dat daar geen vonnis is wat nie aan die aanvaarde skryfstylgids van elke hof voldoen nie, verseer die voorbereiding van 'n omvattende memo oor die uitkoms van die navorsing, dubbeltoets alle verwysings en voetnote in alle vonnisse en regartikels teen die oorspronklike teks om korrektheid te verseker, help die regters met ander buite-regtelike take, skryf toesprae, konferensiepapiere en regartikels, verseker dat alle toesprae, konferensiepapiere en artikels deeglik nagevors is, akkuraat is en van die hoogste gehalte is, verseker dat sekretariële funksies insluitend Provinsiale Doeltreffendheidsverbeteringskomitee (PEEC) vergaderings doeltreffend uitgevoer word, verseker dat die regbank van die Afdeling op hoogte is van onlangse ontwikkelings in casusreg, praktykriglyne en wetgewing, hou treding met al die mylpuilvonnisse / onlangse ontwikkelings in die reg, veranderings in wetgewing en regulasies, verseker dat navorsers aandag gee aan uitgewerverwante navrae (bv. Juta, Lexis en Saflii), hou toesig oor en ontwikkel personeel, verseker algemene toesig oor werknemers, wys take toe en voer gehaltebeheer uit op die werk wat deur amptenare gelewer word, bestuur verlof van personeel, adviseer en lei ondergeskiktes met betrekking tot alle aspekte van werk, bestuur prestasie, gedrag en dissipline van werknemers, verseker dat alle werknemers opgelei en ontwikkel word om in staat te wees om werk van die vereiste standaard doeltreffend en effektief te lewer, ontwikkel, implementeer en monitor werkstelsels en prosesse om doeltreffende en effektiewe funksionering te verseker, hanteer navrae en verskaf advies en leiding oor bates toedelings en beheer.

zu.title: Umcingi Omkholejiwo weMithetho
zu.summary: Kudingeka umcingi omkholejiwo wemithetho ePretoria High Court ukunikeza ukwesekwa kokucwaninga nokuhlaziya kwemithetho kubaphathi bomthethosisekelo, kudinga iziqu zeLLB neminyaka emithathu yamava wokucwaninga.
zu.requirements: Abafaka izicelo kufanele babe neziqu zeLLB Degree e-(NQF level 8). A kufanele kube nokuncike ukuthi munyaka omithathu (3) umva wokucwaninga komthetho lapho kweminyaka emibili (2) kufanele ibe ezingeni lokubusa. Ilayisensi yokuqasha evumelekile izobe yinconywa ngaphezulu. Ulwazi Nobuchwepheshe: Ulwazi ngamathuluzi wokwaziswa kagesi kanye nesandla sokungena futhi sisebenzise izinhlelo zokucwaninga ngokusebenzisa ikhompyutha (Westlaw, LexisNexis, Jutastats), ulwazi lokuqhuba imishini yeDCRS/ CRT, Employment Equity Act, Practice Manual of the Court, ukuqonda okuqinile komthetho waseNingizimu Afrika kanye nesistemu yobuzima bomthethosisekelo, ukuhumusha nokusebenzisa umthetho kanye nemigomo yeBatho Pele. Ubuchwepheshe ohlelweni lweMicrosoft Office Programs, ekucwaningeni, ekuxazululeni izinkinga, ekuhlelweni nokuqamba, esikweni esihle sokuthathela izinqumo, emiphakathweni yabantu, ekulawuleni isikhathi, ekunxibelelwini okusebenzayo (ngomlomo nangokubhaliwe) kanye nobuchwepheshe bokubusa. Kanye nezimpawu ezilandelayo: Isandla sokwenza izinto eziningi ngesikhathi esisodwa, ukwazi ukusebenza ngaphansi koxibuso, ukuziphatha kahle ohlayini, ukuziphatha ngobungcweti, isandla sokuhlangabezana namadethedi alawula kakhulu kanye nesandla sokugcina imfihlo kanti nokwazi ukuthatha isibambi.
zu.duties: Nikeza ukucwaninga komthetho, wayezana nabaphathi bomthethosisekelo emakamweni uthathe imiyalo, hlola zonke izinto ezithunywe, wazi inkinga uqale ukucwaninga okuhambisana nayo, nikeza incazelo ehlaziyiwe yengqikithi yamazwi abashaba noma ubufakela obubhaliwe enkantolo, whena imiyalo kumcingi, wenze ukucwaninga kwamasisekelo wokwaziswa kagesi njengobawejwayele umahluleli, qinisekisa ukuthi konke ukucwaninga okunikiwa abahluleli kuqukathe kakhulu futhi kuqinise, qinisekisa ukuthi izinqumo, izihloko nezinkulumo ezibhaliwe zicacile zihambisana futhi ziqukethe kakhulu, qinisekisa ukuthi ayikho izinqumo epanhambene nomhlahlandlela wokubhaliswa omvamile wesinkantolo ngasinye, qinisekisa ukulungiselela imemorandamu ephathe kakhulu ngemiphumela yokucwaninga, hlolo kabusha zonke izinkomba kanye nezansi ezibhalweni zamahlulelo kanye ngezihloko zomthetho nasekuhloleni umbhalo wangempela ukuqinisekisa ukuzenza kahle, siza abahluleli eminye imisebenzi evela enkantolo, bhala izinkulumo, amaphepha okuhlangana nezihloko zomthetho, qinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinkulumo, amaphepha okuhlangana nezihloko zocwaningwa ngokujulile, ziqinise futhi zibe nzinga eliphezulu kakhulu, qinisekisa ukuthi imisebenzi yobunhloli okuhlanganisa nezinkathi zeProvincial Efficiency Enhancement Committee (PEEC) meetings izenziwa ngempumelelo, qinisekisa ukuthi abaphathi bomthethosisekelo bale Division bakamuva ngemipumela entsha emthethweni wezinkundla, imiyalo yokuziphatha nanyathelo lomthetho, gcina ukuqonda ngawo wonke amahlulelo abalulekile / imipumela entsha emthethweni, izinguquko emthethweni nasemithethweni, qinisekisa ukuthi abacwaningi baphendula imibuzo ephathelene nabashicileli (isb Juta, Lexis kanye neSaflii), qapha futhi uthuthukise abasebenzi, qinisekisa ukulawula ngokujwayelekile abasebenzi, abela imisebenzi wenze ukulawula ikhwalithi emsebenzini ohlinzekwe abahluleli, lawula ukulaleka kwabasebenzi, lwela futhi uhola abalawuliyo ngakho konke okuphathelene nomsebenzi, lawula ukusebenza, ukuziphatha nokuwothula abantu, qinisekisa ukuthi bonke abasebenzi bahlatshwa futhi bathuthukiswa ukuba bakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngomsebenzi wokuqinisekiswa kahle ngenkinga nangempumelelo, uthuthukise, uphumeze futhi uqaphe amasistimu nomshwamshwa womsebenzi ukuze kuqhubeke ukusebenza ngempumelelo, phendula imibuzo, nikeza ijadi nokuqondisa ngokusabalalisa nokulawula izimpahli.

xh.title: Umngeni oPhezulu woPhando koMthetho
xh.summary: Kufuneka kugqitywe umPhandi oPhandle ukuqikelelo kwesiXhosa.
xh.requirements: Abafaka isicelo kufuneka babe neLLB Degree kwi (NQF level 8). Kufuneka babe nokuguqulwa okungenangaphezu kweminyaka elishumi (10) yokuguqulwa komthetho, apho kweminyaka mithathu (3) kufuneka ibe ngowokulawula. Idrivhi esemthethweni iya kuthathwa njengentoongezelelweyo. Ulwazi nakhono: Ulwazi ngeendlela zolwazi kwinethiwekhi nokukwazi ukufikelela nokusebenzisa iinkqubo zophando kakhompyutha (Westlaw, LexisNexis, Jutastats), ulwazi ngokusebenza i-DCRS/CRT machine, i-Employment Equity Act, i-Practice Manual yaseNkantolo, ukuqonda kakuhle umthetho waseMzantsi Afrika nendlela yokusebenza kwamagosa amthetho, ukutolika nokusebenzisa umthetho nakuMgaqo-nkqubo we-Batho Pele. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa iinkqubo zeMicrosoft Office, ukuphanda, ukuxazula iingxaki, ukuqamba iindaba nokuqamba, isigqibo esilungileyo nokwenza izigqibo, ubudlelwane nabantu, ulawulo lwexesha, ukunxibelelwana kakuhle (ngemilo nakubhalwe) nakhono okulawula. Kwaye nokuqulunqa oku kulandelayo: ukwenza izinto ezininzi ngesikhathi esinye, ukukwazi ukusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo, isithethe kumnxeba, ukuziphatha ngobungcali, ukukwazi ukugqiba umsebenzi kwixesha elicwelisiweyo nakhono ukuhlala ufihla imfihlo njengoko ukwazi ukuzimela.
xh.duties: Nika olu phando lwomthetho, kuxoxe nezonyuli kwigumbi lawo eliyimfihlo uze wamkele imiyalelo, uqwalasele onke amaxwebhu axelwe, uqaphele ingxaki uze uqale olu phando olufanelekileyo, unike ingxelo enzulu yemibhalo yeedatha nangamagama abhaliweyo enkantolo, wabelane imiyalezo kumphandi, wenze olu phando kudatabase yekhompyutha njengoko ifunwa liJaji, qinisekisa ukuba olu phando lunikiwe kumaJaji luya yonke yinyani, qinisekisa ukuba iimemo ezixutyiweyo, iingxelo nemiibhalo yomthetho icace, ihambelane nayonke idatha ngokweenkqubo zobuGcisa bokubhala zamanye amaNkantolo, qinisekisa ulungiselelo lwezinto ezahlukeneyo kwiyure elibe yinyani emanyuzeni, phinda uqinisekise konke ukugqitywa kwemibhalo yomthetho nakumagama ohlu ngokumxholo wokuqinisekisa amagama ngokwawo, nkuncede amaJaji kuminye imisebenzi engengowenkantolo, yiphe iimemo, amaphepha emibhalo yomthetho, qinisekisa ukuba yonke imemo, amaphepha exesha kwaye ngokupheleleyo, zinyanisekile yaye zibengangona kwakhona, qinisekisa imisebenzi yababhali okubandakanya iinkqubo zokulungiselela izinto ngoMmandla ngokwemigaqo eqinisekisa izinto ezikwindla ezinzulu, qinisekisa ukuba abaNyuli balo Mmandla balungile ngokwentsinselo yosuku malunga namagosa abucala, iinkqubo zokwenza imithetho yenkantolo, neyamanyathelo okusebenza, hlala uphehlele ngokwentsinselo ngamagosa amnikezelo womthetho, iinkqubo zokwenza umthetho namanyathelo aqinisekisa amagosa, qinisekisa ukuba abaphandi bathatha iingxaki ezivela kubantu abanikela nabashicilela (umzekelo Juta, Lexis and Saflii), lawula naphuhlisise abasebenzi, qinisekisa ukuphathwa kwangaphezu komzila ngokuzimela kwabashadi, abele imisebenzi uze wenze ulawulo ngokobunyani bemisebenzi ehambelana nolonke lwezinto ezikwindla yonke imisebenzi ekuwohloko, nkqamlela nokulawula ngenkqubo ngokuziphatha kwabashadi, qinisekisa ukuba yonke imisebenzi ibalulekileyo iya kufundiswa nathi iya kuphuhliswa ukuze bakhwazi ukuza nemihla yemini nemihla yonke imisebenzi ngokwemilinganiselo efanelekileyo ngokukhawuleza ngokuchanekileyo, mkezele, wenze ulawulo lwemisebenzi yonke imihla nokwenza nkqubo ukuze qinisekisa imisebenzi esebenza kakuhle ngokukhawuleza, phendula imibuzo unikezelwa ngokuthandathu yolwazi nokuqonda ngokwemali nolawulo lweempahle.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Human Resource Management
jobs.centre: Western Cape Division Provincial service centre
jobs.salary_text: R487 197 – R573 897 per annum (Level 09). The successful candidate will be required to sign a performance agreement.
jobs.summary: Assistant Director for Human Resource Management at the Office of the Chief Justice, Western Cape Division, managing HRM administration and conditions of service.
jobs.requirements: Applicants should be in possession of a three-year National Diploma in Human Resources Management/Public Administration/Public Management/Personnel Management or equivalent qualification at NQF Level 6 with 360 credits as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of three (3) years relevant experience in Human Resources Management environment of which one (1) should be at supervisory level. Formal PERSAL training. A valid driver’s license will serve as an added advantage. Knowledge and skills: Knowledge and understanding of relevant Human Resources Management Legislation/Directives and Policies, must be able to understand/interpret policies and implement strategies, extensive, knowledge of the PERSAL system, knowledge in Training and Development processes. Skilled in computer literacy (MS Office), communication (written and verbal), people management/interpersonal relations, report writing and problem solving. Along with the following attributes: Ability to work long hours when required, commitment and integrity, ability to work under pressure and adhere to deadlines, be self motivated, pay attention to detail, maintaining discipline, confidentiality and professionalism.
jobs.duties: Manage and coordinate HRM administration matters within the Department, contribute to the rendering of a professional Human Resource Management services with respect to conditions of service and benefits, leave, housing, medical aid, injury on duty, termination, long service recognition, overtime, relocation, pension, allowances. HR provisioning (Recruitment and selection, appointment, transfers, verification of qualifications, secretariat functions at interviews etc). Implement and manage the Performance Management and Development system in the province. Responsible for the facilitation and coordination of Labour Relations, Employee Wellness and Learning and Development in the Province. Address Human Resources Administration enquiries and manage all PERSAL transactions. Ensure the correct implementation of Departmental/Public Service policies on matters related to Human Resources Management and adherence to the relevant prescripts/ legislations. Inform, guide and advice relevant stakeholders on Human Resources administration matters to enhance the correct implementation of Personnel administration practices/policies. Manage and administer policy and procedures on incapacity leave and ill-health retirement (PILIR) in the Department. Manage the HRM Registry services and records management. Prepare and consolidate reports. Human resources management administration issues.
jobs.enquiries: Technical Related Enquiries: Mr SD Hlongwane Tel No: (021) 469 4032 HR Related Enquiries: Mr SD Hlongwane Tel No: (021) 469 4032
jobs.applications: Applications can be sent via email to 2026/98/OCJ@judiciary.org.za
jobs.notes: The Organisation will give preference to candidates in line with the Employment Equity goals. All applications must be submitted on a New Z83 form, which can be downloaded           on        internet       at       www.judiciary.org.za       / www.dpsa.gov.za/dpsa2g/vacancies.asp or obtainable from any Public Service Department and should be accompanied by a recent comprehensive CV only; contactable referees (telephone numbers and email addresses must be indicated). Please send your documents in a PDF and put them in one folder. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other related documents on or before the day of the interview following communication from Human Resources. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Applicants could be required to provide consent for access to their social media accounts. Prior to appointment for SMS, a candidate would be required to complete the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to Senior Management Services as endorsed by DPSA which is an online course, endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into the SMS and the full details can be sourced by the following link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. Each application form must be fully completed, duly signed and initialed on both pages by the applicant. The application must indicate the correct job title, the office where the position is advertised and the reference number as stated in the advert. Failure by the applicant to complete, sign and initial the application form will lead to disqualification of the application during the selection process. Applications on the old Z83 will unfortunately not be considered. Should you be in possession of a foreign qualification, it must be accompanied by an evaluation considered. Suitable candidates will be subjected to a personnel suitability check (criminal record, financial checks, qualification verification, citizenship checks, social media, reference checks and employment verification). Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. The Department reserves the right not to make any appointment(s) to the advertised post(s). Applicants who do not comply with the above-mentioned requirements, as well as applications received late, will not be considered. Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the application not being considered during the selection process. All successful candidates will be expected to enter into an employment contract and a performance agreement within 3 months of appointment, as well as be required to undergo a security clearance three (3) months after appointment. The Office the Chief Justice complies with the provisions of the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA); Act No. 4 of 2013. We will use your personal information provided to us for the purpose of recruitment only and more specifically for the purpose of the position/vacancy you have applied for. In the event that your application was unsuccessful, the Office of the Chief Justice will retain your personal information for internal audit purposes as required by policies. All the information requested now or during the process is required for recruitment purposes. Failure to provide requested information will render your application null and void. The Office of the Chief Justice will safeguard the security and confidentiality of all information you shared during the recruitment process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Menslike Hulpbronbestuur
af.summary: Assistentdirekteur vir Menslike Hulpbronbestuur by die Kantoor van die Hoofregter, Western Cape Divisie, wat HRM-administrasie en diensvoorwaardes bestuur.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet oor 'n driejarige Nasionale Diploma in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur/Openbare Administrasie/Openbare Bestuur/Personeelbestuur of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie op NQF Vlak 6 met 360 krediete soos deur SAQA erken, beskik. 'n Minimum van drie (3) jaar se relevante ervaring in 'n Menslike Hulpbronbestuursomgewing waarvan een (1) jaar op toesigvlak moet wees. Formele PERSAL-opleiding. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis en begrip van relevante Menslike Hulpbronbestuurswetgewing/Riglyne en Beleide, moet in staat wees om beleide te verstaan/interpreteer en strategieë te implementeer, uitgebreide kennis van die PERSAL-stelsel, kennis van Opleiding en Ontwikkelingsprosesse. Vaardig in rekenaargeletterdheid (MS Office), kommunikasie (skriftelik en mondelings), mensebestuur/interpersoonlike verhoudings, verslagskrywing en probleemoplossing. Saam met die volgende eienskappe: Vermoë om lang ure te werk wanneer nodig, toewyding en integriteit, vermoë om onder druk te werk en sperdatums na te kom, selfgemotiveerd wees, aandag aan besonderhede gee, dissipline, vertroulikheid en professionaliteit handhaaf.
af.duties: Bestuur en koördineer HRM-administrasie-aangeleenthede binne die departement; dra by tot die levering van professionele Menslike Hulpbronbestuursdienste met betrekking tot diensvoorwaardes en voordele, verlof, behuising, mediese hulp, besering op diens, beëindiging, erkenning vir langdiens, oortyd, hervestiging, pensioen, toelaes. HR-voorsiening (Werwing en seleksie, aanstellings, oorplasings, verifikasie van kwalifikasies, sekretariaatfunksies by onderhoude ens). Implementeer en bestuur die Prestasiebestuurs- en Ontwikkelingstelsel in die provinsie. Verantwoordelik vir die fasilitering en koördinering van Arbeidsverhoudinge, Werknemerswelstand en Leer en Ontwikkeling in die Provinsie. Hanteer Menslike Hulpbronadministrasie-navrae en bestuur alle PERSAL-transaksies. Verseker die korrekte implementering van Departementele/Openbare Diensbeleide oor aangeleenthede verwant aan Menslike Hulpbronbestuur en nakoming van die relevante voorskifte/wetgewing. Lig, lei en adviseer relevante belanghebbendes oor Menslike Hulpbronadministrasie-aangeleenthede om die korrekte implementering van personeeladministrasiepraktyke/beleide te verbeter. Bestuur en administreer beleid en prosedures oor ongeskiktheidsverlof en siekte-afkeer-pensioen (PILIR) in die departement. Bestuur die HRM-registerdienste en rekordbestuur. Berei en konsolideer verslae voor. Menslike hulpbronbestuursadministrasie-aangeleenthede.

zu.title: Umndluleli weNqola: Ukuphathwa Kwabasebenzi
zu.summary: Umndluleli weNqola wokuphathwa kwabasebenzi kwiOfisi yoMengamela weNkantolo, iWestern Cape Division, uphatha uhlelo lokusebenza lwe-HRM nemigomo yesevisi.
zu.requirements: Abafakeli kufanele babe ne-National Diploma yeminyaka eyithathu kuHuman Resources Management/Public Administration/Public Management/Personnel Management noma izifundo ezilinganayo ezingeni le-NQF Level 6 ngama-360 credits njengoba kuqashwa yi-SAQA. Okungezeleli isiphiwo seminyaka eyithathu (3) yemisebenzi ephathene nokuqondiswa kokuphathwa kwabasebenzi, okunyanye yonye (1) okufanele abe ngazinga lokuqondisa. Ukuqeqeshwa okusemthethweni kwe-PERSAL. Ilayisensi yomshayeli evumelekile izoba yinzuzo. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi nokuqonda imithetho/umyalelo nemigubo ephathene nokuphathwa kwabasebenzi, kufanele ukwazi ukuqonda/uchaze imigubo futhi usebenzise izuvelo, ulwazi olubanzi ngohlelo lwe-PERSAL, ulwazi naziqiniso nemithelela yokuthuthukiswa kakhono. Ukhono lokusebenzela ikhompuyutha (MS Office), ukuxhumana (okubhaliwe nokukhulunywa), ukuphatha abantu/buqu ubudlelwano, ukubhala imibiko nokuxazulula izinkinga. Kanye nezimfongo ezilandelayo: Isikhathi eside uma kudingekile, isibopho nokuqotho, ikhono lokusebenza ngokucindezelekile kwaye uhambisane nemikhawulo yesikhathi, ukuziqembela, ukunakisisa imininingwane, ukugcina inqubo, ukubhala ngenhlonipho futhi ngobungcweti.
zu.duties: Phatha uhlelo lokuqondisa imicimbi yokuphathwa kwabasebenzi ngaphakathi kumnyango, yedlule ekunikeni isevisi yobungcweti bokuphathwa kwabasebenzi ngokuphathene nemigomo yesevisi nezinzuzo, ukuyeka umsebenzi, izindlu, usizo lwezokwelapha, ukulimala ngemuva kokubuyekezwa kwesikhathi eside, ukubuyiswa kwabakwamabhizinisi, nokufuduka kubasebenzi. Imisebenzi yokuqinisekisa isikhundla sabantu: (ukubumba abafaki nhlobonhlobo, ukubhalisa kwesikhundla, ukuthunyelwa kwesikhundla, ukuqinisekiswa kweziqu, ukusebenza njengomlondolozi kumakhemikheli wokuqinisekiswa, ukuyekiswa kwesikhundla phakathi kokunye). Hlela futhi usebenzise izinhlelo ezinhle zokuphathwa nokuthuthukiswa kwezempilo esifundeni. Phathe futhi qondisa imicimbi yemisebenzi yokubambisana kwezokusebenza kanye nezeMpilo nabasebenzi kanye nezinhlelo zokuqeqesha nokuthuthukisa izikhulu kulelive. Phendula imibuzo yezempilo yabasebenzi futhi phathe zonke izinkomba ezisetshenziswayo. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okuphelele kwezinhlelo lapha kumnyango/iNkalo yoluntu mayelana nezokulawula izinhlelo zokuphatha izinsizakusebenza futhi ulandelwe ngemithetho/yemithetho ebalulekile. Yazisa, hona futhi nike i-advise abantu abaphathene nemicimbi yezokuphathwa kwabasebenzi ukwenzela ukuba basebenzise ngokuphelele imigebengi yezinhlelo zobulungiswa babantu. Hlela futhi lawula imigebengi nemithelela yokuphathwa kwesikhathi esingekho emsebenzini nokusiza ukuphatha izikhundla (PILIR) kumnyango. Lawula imisebenzi yokuqondisa imibhalo yamandla abantu kanye nokuphathwa kolwazi. Hlela futhi uhlanganise imibiko. Imicimbi yokulawula izinsizakusebenzi zomnyango.

xh.title: Um lawuli oncedisayo: Ulawulo Lwamabalu abasebenzi
xh.summary: Um lawuli oncedisayo woLawulo Lwamabalu abasebenzi eKwindla leNkokheli yoBulungisa, iNgingi yangentshona yeKoloni, elawula imicimbi yolawulo nomisi wolawulo lwamabalu abasebenzi.
xh.requirements: Abafakeli kufuneka babe neDiploma yamavaka amathathu eSizwe kwiZixhobo zoLawulo Lwabantu/uLawulo LukaRhamenthe/uLawulo lukaRhamenthe abantu/ uLawulo lwamabele okanye izifundo ezilinganayo kwinqanaba le-6 le-6 le-6 ze-6 ne-6 nge-6 nge-6 njengoko kuthathwa ngokumkwa yi-SAQA. Amava amaninzi amathathu (3) emisebenzi enxulumene nolawulo lwamabalu abasebenzi apho kunyaka omnye (1) kufuneka abe kukunqanaba bokulawula. Isikolo se-PERSAL eselona. Ilayisenesi yokushayela elisebenzayo iyakuba luncedo. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi nokuqonda ngemithetho/ iindlela ezalulweyo neengqungquthela ezimalana noLawulo Lwamabalu abasebenzi, kufuneka ukwazi ukuqonda/ ukucazulula iindlela nokuzisebenzisa njengendlela, ulwazi olubanzi ngendlela ye-PERSAL, ulwazi ngemisebenzi yoqeqesho nokuqqisa. Ukukwazi ukusetyenziswa kwekhompyutha (i-MS Office), ukunxibelela (nokubhala nokuThetha), ulawulo lwabantu/nobudlelwane babantu, ukubhala iingxelo nokusombulula iingxaki. Kunye neempawu ezilandelayo: Ukuba nakho ukusebenza iiyure ezinde xa kuyimfuneko, ukuzinikela nokuqina, ukuba nakho ukusebenza ngomthwalo kunye nokuhlonela iindlela ezihlwemiweyo, ukuziqhayisela, ukunakwa iinkcukacha, ukugcina isithozela, imfihlo nokuba ngumthethodidi.
xh.duties: Ukulawula nokuqamisa imicimbi yolawulo lwamabalu abasebenzi kwisebe, uncedo ekubeni kuvezelwe iinkonzo zobungcalu bokulawula amabalu abasebenzi ngakumbi ngemibandela yomsebenzi nezibonelelo, iibhetya bokubaleka, indlu, incedo lokhunselo, ukulimala ngelixa kusebenza, ukuqwalasela iinkonzo, isiquko sokwakha umsebenzi isithembu, ukugqitha iiyure, ukutshihlaliswa kwakhona, umhlalaphantsi, izibonelelo ezongeziweyo. Ibonele labantu (Ukunxulumana nokhetho, ukuqashwa, ukuqhutywa kolutshintsho, ukuqinisekiswa kwezifundo, imisebenzi yababhalisi kwi zindwendwe njl). Ukusebenzisa nokulawula inkqubo yoLawulo lokuQatshwa noPhuhliso kwelinye ilizwe. Uphethe ukuqhuba nokuqamisa ubudlelwane basebenzi, ukhuseleko lwabasebenzi noQeqesho nokuQqwesa kwelinye ilizwe. Ukuphendula imibuzo yolawulo lwamabalu abasebenzi nokulawula naziphi na iindlela ze-PERSAL. Ukuqinisekisa ukusebenzisa ngendlela efanelekileyo iingqungquthela zesebe/loluntu kwimicimbi echaseneyo noLawulo Lwamabalu abasebenzi nokuhlonela imithetho/ izixhobo ezilawulayo. Ukwazisa, ukuyalela nokuqondisa abantu abanomdla kwimicimbi yolawulo lwamabalu abasebenzi ukwazi ukusebenza ngokuchanekileyo imimiselo yolawulo lwabantu. Ulawulo lolunye lwezindulo kwiindlela ngokungasebenzi ngenxa yokugula nokuhlala kwamahlonge ngenxa yokugula (PILIR) kwisebe. Ulawulo lwezindulo zomngeniso wolawulo lwamabalu abasebenzi nolawulo lwegama. Ukulungiselela nokuqamba iingxelo kwakunye. Imicimbi yolawulo lwamabalu abasebenzi.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Judicial Support
jobs.centre: Gauteng Division of The High Court: Pretoria
jobs.salary_text: R487 197 - R573 897.per annum (Level 09). The successful candidate will be required to sign a performance agreement.
jobs.summary: Manage administrative operations in the Office of the Judge President at the Pretoria High Court, including coordinating meetings, engagements and queries.
jobs.requirements: Applicants should be in possession of a National Diploma in Office Management/ Business Administration/ relevant qualification at NQF level 6 as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of three (03) years’ relevant experience in an administrative office management environment of which one (1) year should be at supervisory level. A driver’s license/LLB degree will serve as an added advantage. Knowledge and Skills: Knowledge of relevant legislatives and regulations, knowledge of case lines, knowledge of office management responsibilities, systems and procedures, knowledge of Supervisory Facets, knowledge of Electronic Information Resource and online retrieval. Skilled in communication (written and verbal), facilitation, report writing, people management and empowerment, strategic and leadership, problem solving, presentation, decision-making, interpersonal relations. Along with the following attributes: Ability to multitask, professional telephone manners, able to work under pressure and meticulous.
jobs.duties: Manage the administration in the Office of the Judge President, arrange and diarise meetings and appointments involving the Judge President, coordinate all engagements between Judges and Divisional Senior Officials with the Judge President, ensure attendance on all queries addressed to the office of the Judge President, attend to general correspondence in the Office of the Judge President, including but not limited to drafting and compiling all memos, letters, reports and presentations, by the Judge President, coordinate and administer leave management of the Office of the Judge President, attend to correspondence in relation to reserved Judgements as well as complaints arising from reserved Judgements, attend to arrangements for the Judge President to preside in the administering of oaths of office to members of the Provincial Executive and other office bearers, coordinate arrangements for the reconstruction of delayed appeals records involving retired and deceased Judges, facilitate the monthly reserved judgements statistics for the division, coordinate correspondence and statistics regarding reserved Judgements and updating the reserved Judgements register, collect and co-ordinate inputs from Judges including all necessary documentation to inform the budgetary processes, provide support to the Judge President in determining funding requirements for budgeting process, check and verify financial reports in support of the Judge President’s office, source and certify the correctness of invoices and statements, regarding expenditure in the Judge President’s office, coordinate all logistics for meetings and other engagements of the Judge President, locally and internationally, including the submission of reports and presentations as well as the implementation of resolutions emanating from such meetings, attend to the Judge President’s actionable items from the Heads of Court committees he chairs, ensure necessary secretariat support in meetings chaired by the Judge President, including but not limited to Divisional Leadership meetings, Divisional operational meetings as well as Divisional Judges meetings and Divisional stakeholder meetings, manage travel arrangements and complete documentation for approval. facilitate maintenance of Judge President’s vehicle and submit logbook. Submit S&T claims, cell phone and 3G data claims, provide a record management function, including collection, distribution, retrieval and filling of records.
jobs.enquiries: Technical Related Enquiries: Mr. PA Nkone Tel No: (012) 492 7606 HR Related Enquiries: Ms T Mbalekwa Tel No: (010) 494 8515
jobs.applications: Applications can be sent via email to 2026/99/OCJ@judiciary.org.za
jobs.notes: The Organisation will give preference to candidates in line with the Employment Equity goals. All applications must be submitted on a New Z83 form, which can be downloaded           on        internet       at       www.judiciary.org.za       / www.dpsa.gov.za/dpsa2g/vacancies.asp or obtainable from any Public Service Department and should be accompanied by a recent comprehensive CV only; contactable referees (telephone numbers and email addresses must be indicated). Please send your documents in a PDF and put them in one folder. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other related documents on or before the day of the interview following communication from Human Resources. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Applicants could be required to provide consent for access to their social media accounts. Prior to appointment for SMS, a candidate would be required to complete the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to Senior Management Services as endorsed by DPSA which is an online course, endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into the SMS and the full details can be sourced by the following link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. Each application form must be fully completed, duly signed and initialed on both pages by the applicant. The application must indicate the correct job title, the office where the position is advertised and the reference number as stated in the advert. Failure by the applicant to complete, sign and initial the application form will lead to disqualification of the application during the selection process. Applications on the old Z83 will unfortunately not be considered. Should you be in possession of a foreign qualification, it must be accompanied by an evaluation considered. Suitable candidates will be subjected to a personnel suitability check (criminal record, financial checks, qualification verification, citizenship checks, social media, reference checks and employment verification). Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. The Department reserves the right not to make any appointment(s) to the advertised post(s). Applicants who do not comply with the above-mentioned requirements, as well as applications received late, will not be considered. Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the application not being considered during the selection process. All successful candidates will be expected to enter into an employment contract and a performance agreement within 3 months of appointment, as well as be required to undergo a security clearance three (3) months after appointment. The Office the Chief Justice complies with the provisions of the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA); Act No. 4 of 2013. We will use your personal information provided to us for the purpose of recruitment only and more specifically for the purpose of the position/vacancy you have applied for. In the event that your application was unsuccessful, the Office of the Chief Justice will retain your personal information for internal audit purposes as required by policies. All the information requested now or during the process is required for recruitment purposes. Failure to provide requested information will render your application null and void. The Office of the Chief Justice will safeguard the security and confidentiality of all information you shared during the recruitment process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Geregtelike Ondersteuning
af.summary: Bestuur administratiewe bedrywighede in die Kantoor van die Regterpresident by die Pretoria Hooggeregshof, insluitend die koördinering van vergaderings, betrekkinge en navrae.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet 'n Nasionale Diploma in Kantoorbestuur/ Besigheidsadministrasie/ 'n relevante kwalifikasie op NQF-vlak 6 soos deur SAQA erken besit. 'n Minimum van drie (03) jaar se relevante ervaring in 'n administratiewe kantoorbestuursomgewing waarvan een (1) jaar op toesigvlak moet wees. 'n Bestuurslisensie/LLB-graad sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Kennis en Vaardighede: Kennis van relevante wetgewing en regulasies, kennis van saaklyne, kennis van kantoorbestuursverantwoordelikhede, stelsels en prosedures, kennis van toesigfasiliteite, kennis van Elektroniese Inligtingsbronne en aanlynterugwinning. Bedrewe in kommunikasie (geskrewe en mondeling), fasilitering, verslagskryfwerk, menslikebestuur en bemagtiging, strategiese en leierskapvaardighede, probleemoplossing, aanbieding, besluitneming, interpersoonlike verhoudinge. Saam met die volgende eienskappe: Vermoë om veelvuldige take gelyktydig te hanteer, professionele telefoonmaniere, in staat om onder druk te werk en nougeset.
af.duties: Bestuur die administrasie in die Kantoor van die Regterpresident, reël en dagboek vergaderings en afsprake wat die Regterpresident behels, koördineer alle betrekkinge tussen Regters en Afdelingsleërbeamptes met die Regterpresident, verseker opvolg op alle navrae wat aan die kantoor van die Regterpresident gerig word, hanteer algemene korrespondensie in die Kantoor van die Regterpresident, insluitend maar nie beperk tot die opstel en saamstel van alle memo's, briewe, verslae en aanbiedings deur die Regterpresident nie, koördineer en administreer verlofbestuur van die Kantoor van die Regterpresident, hanteer korrespondensie rakende voorbehoude vonnisse asook klagtes wat voortspruit uit voorbehoude vonnisse, hanteer reëlings dat die Regterpresident voorsit by die aflê van ampseedlede van die Provinsiale Uitvoerende Gesag en ander amptsbekleërs, koördineer reëlings vir die rekonstruksie van vertraagde appèlakrome wat afgetrede en oorlede Regters behels, fasiliteer die maandelikse statistieke van voorbehoue vonnisse vir die afdeling, koördineer korrespondensie en statistieke rakende voorbehoude vonnisse en opdatering van die register van voorbehoude vonnisse, versamel en koördineer insette van Regters insluitend alle nodige dokumentasie om begrotingsprosesse in te lig, verskaf ondersteuning aan die Regterpresident by die vasstelling van befondsingsvereistes vir die begrotingsproses, kontroleer en verifieer finansiële verslae ter ondersteuning van die Kantoor van die Regterpresident, bekom en sertificeer die korrektheid van fakture en state rakende uitgawes in die Kantoor van die Regterpresident, koördineer alle logistiek vir vergaderings en ander betrekkinge van die Regterpresident, plaaslik en internasionaal, insluitend die indiening van verslae en aanbiedings asook die implementering van besluite wat uit sulke vergaderings voortspruit, hanteer die Regterpresident se aksie-items wat voortspruit uit die komitees van Hofhoofde wat hy voor sit, verseker nodige sekretariële ondersteuning in vergaderings wat deur die Regterpresident ge sit word, insluitend maar nie beperk tot Afdelingsleierskap-vergaderings, Afdelingsoperasionele vergaderings asook Afdelingsregtersvergaderings en Afdelingsbelanghebbende-vergaderings nie, bestuur reëlings vir reis en voltooi dokumentasie vir goedkeuring. Fasiliteer instandhouding van die Regterpresident se voertuig en dien die logboek in. Dien S&T-eise, selfoon- en 3G-data-eise in, verskaf 'n rekordbestuursfunksie, insluitend versameling, verspreiding, ontsluiting en invul van rekords.

zu.title: Osiza-Abaqondisi: Ukweseka Kwezomthetho
zu.summary: Phatha imisebenzi yenhlangano yolawulo eMhlathini loMongameli wesahlulelo eNkantolo ePhakathi yasePretoria, okuhlanganisa ukumatanisa izinkqubo, inhlangano nemibuzo.
zu.requirements: Abafaka izicelo kufanele babe ne-Diploma yaseZwe ekuphathweni kwehhovisi/nkululuso yebhizinisi/izifundo ezihambisana nalezo ezingeni le-NQF level 6 njengoba kuthathwa nguhlelo lwe-SAQA. Kufanele babe okungenani eminyakeni emithathu (03) enkathini yokusebenza emkhakheni wokuphathwa kwehhovisi lapho kuthathwa isikhathi esiyunye (1) senyaka sibe ezingeni lokuba ngumphathi. Ilayisensi yokushayela/iziqu ze-LLB kuzoba yinconyenti. Ulwazi nezakhono: Ulwazi ngemithetho nehlelo lokuhambisana nayo, ulwazi ngemigqa yamacala, ulwazi ngemisebenzi yokuphathwa kwehhovisi, izinhlelakhombo nezinqubo, ulwazi ngezindlela zokuhlola abaphathi, ulwazi ngemithombo yolutheleleko abukhwayo nokulanda imininingwane kwi-inthanethi. Ukuba nezakhono ekuxhumaneni (okulotshiwe nokuvela ngomlomo), ekuletheni izinqubo phambili, ekubhaleni imibiko, ekuphathweni kwabantu nasekunika amandla, ekuqondiseni nasekuholeni, ekuxazululeni izinkinga, ekuboniseni, ekwenzeni izinqumo, nasemibhinjweni yabantu. Kanye nale mininingwane: Isikhondo sokwenza izinto eziningi ngesikhathi esisodwa, izindlela ezihloniphekile zokuxoxa ngomakhalefoni, ukwazi ukusebenza ngaphansi koxinzelelo nokuba nocophelelo.
zu.duties: Phatha ukuphathwa kwehhovisi eMhlathini loMongameli wesahlulelo, hlela futhi ubhale emakhasetheni izinkqubo nezivumelwano ezihilela uMongameli wesahlulelo, matanisa yonke inhlangano phakathi kwabahluleli nabaphathi abaphezulu bezigaba noMongameli wesahlulelo, qinisekisa ukuthi kuphendulwe yonke imibuzo eqondiswe ehhovisini loMongameli wesahlulelo, zajula imibhalo ejwayelekile eMhlathini loMongameli wesahlulelo, okuhlanganisa kodwa kangagqamuki ekubhaleni nasekuhlanganiseni yonke imemo, izincwadi, imibigo nezinkombazindalo, nguMongameli wesahlulelo, matanisa futhi uphathe ukulawulwa kwezinkhathi zokuphumula eMhlathini loMongameli wesahlulelo, zajula imibhalo ehlobene nezinqumo ezibekiwe ezingesinyathelo kanye nezikhalazo eziphuma ezinqumweni ezibekiwe ezingesinyathelo, zajula izimanga zokuqasha uMongameli wesahlulelo ekuzinzeni kwesifungo sobukhosi kubaluli beNdlu yesiPhethamandla esiFunda kanye nabanye abantu bawo lima, matanisa izimanga zokumalinda kabusha imaphuphu amadelwe isikhathi eside ehilela abahluleli abasethulwa kanye nalabo abashonile, khuthaza izibalo zanyanga zonke zezenqumamaphuphu ezisesigabeni, matanisa imibhalo nezibalo ngemayelana nezinqumo ezibekiwe ezingesinyathelo futhi uvuselele uhumushi wezenqumo ezibekiwe ezingesinyathelo, lwethe izidingo futhi umatanise imibhalo evela kubahluleli ehlanganisa yonke imibhalo edingekayo ukuze kuholele ezinqumweni zalebholo, nikeza inkxaso kuMongameli wesahlulelo ekunqumeni izidingo zemali zalebholo, hlunga futhi qinisekisa imibigo yemali ngokweseka kwehhovisi loMongameli wesahlulelo, thola futhi qinisekisa ukulunga kwamabhilidi namavesi, ngokuhlobene neqinisekiso kwehhovisi loMongameli wesahlulelo, matanisa yonke inhlangano nezinye izinhlelo zenkqubo zikaMongameli wesahlulelo, endaweni nangaphandle kwezwe, okuhlanganisa ukulondoloza imibigo nezinkombazindalo kanye nokuphumeza izinqumbo eziphuma ezinkqubweni, zajula izinto ezenziweyo zikaMongameli wesahlulelo ezivela emakomiti amehhosi enkantolo ayaphatha, qinisekisa ukweseka ngokwemibhalo evamile yasesikhundleni kwizinkqubo eziqhathwa nguMongameli wesahlulelo, okuhlanganisa kodwa kangabi yikuphela kwezinkqubo zesiqonda sabaphathi besigaba, izinkqubo zokusebenza zesigaba kanye nezinkqubo zabahluleli besigaba kanye nezinkqubo zabalingani besigaba, phatha izimanga zokuhamba futhi ugcwalise imibhalo ukuze ivumeke. khuthaza ukulondwa kweveza likaMongameli wesahlulelo futhi ungenezela incwadi yokuphetha uhambo. Ngena izinkalashe ze-S&T, izinkalashe zocingo ne-3G data, nikeza imisebenzi yokuqopha imibhalo, okuhlanganisa ukuqoqa, ukwabelana, ukulanda kabusha nokugcwalisa imibhalonqumbo.

xh.title: Isikhundla seNkokeli: Inkxaso yoMthetho
xh.summary: Lawula imisebenzi yolawulo kwiOfisi yomongameli wamajaji ePretoria High Court, kuquka ukuququzelela iindibano, intlangano nemibuzo.
xh.requirements: Kufuneka abafaki zibe neNational Diploma kwiOffice Management/Business Administration/izifundo ezifaneleyo kwinqanaba leNQF 6 njengoko evunywa yiSAQA. A maximum years abangenamava ahambelanayo kwindawo yolawulo lweofisi yolawulo lwayo ngaphakathi amava eli (1) lonyaka ungamandla njengenkokeli kwindawo olawula iqela labantu. Ilayisensi yokuqhwesha/iceba leLLB liza kuba yinto eyongeza isibini. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi ngomthetho oluzayo namacebo axhobileyo, olwazi malunga nomthetho wamajaji (case lines), ulwazi malunga nemisebenzi yolawulo lweofisi, iinkqubo neendlela, ulwazi ngokubeka abantu kwindawo yolawulo, ulwazi malunga nokubeka abantu kwendawo yolawulo. Ukulawula iofisi kwakhona, ulwazi ngolwazi lweComputer nendlela yokulibuyisa kwinethiwekhi kakhulu. Ulwazi oluphakamileyo: Ukuziphatha kolunye nofuzisile ukuba noLwazi olukhawulezileyo kwi-Computer, iindlela ezahlukeneyo zolwazi. Kwakhona kubakho olu hlobo ngokulawula ulwazi oluziwa nawe olu hlukeneyo ngokuyilwa kwemigaqo, iindidi ezahlukeneyo zolwazi ngokubuyisa iindlela eziphelileyo zolwazi, namakhono omculo. Ulwazi oluqinisekileyo nolukhawulezayo kwindlela zokubeka iintlobo ezahlukeneyo zeComputer. Ulwazi oluqinileyo oluqinisekiswa yiNkqubo yolwazi oluziwa nawe olutsha kwindlela ezahlukeneyo zokuzinza kunye neenkqubo ezahlukeneyo zolwazi oluqinileyo. Namakhono omtsetfo wesini oluqinileyo nowoqinisekileyo ngokuziphatha okuhle. Namakhono amaninzi ngokuziphatha okuhle kwindlela ezahlukeneyo zolwazi oluqinileyo nolufanelekileyo. Ulwazi oluqinileyo nokugqibeleleyo ngokubeka abantu kulawulo oluqinileyo nolusemgangathweni. Amakhono okuba nolwazi oluqinileyo nolukhawulezayo ngokuqonda ngokwakho. Amakhono okubeka ulwazi oluninzi etafileni. Ulwazi olufumaneka kumalathiso ngokunika ulwazi ngokubeka abantu kwindawo yolawulo. Namakhono okuba nolwazi olukhawulezayo ngokuqonda ngokwakho, iinkqubo nendlela ezahlukileyo zolwazi. Ulwazi oluqinileyo ngokubeka abantu kwindawo yolawulo oluqinileyo. Amakhono okusebenza kolunye uhlangothi ngokunika isaziso ngokubeka abantu kwindawo yolawulo oluqinileyo.
xh.duties: Lawula izicwangciso kwiOfisi kaMongameli weZiko loMthetho ePretoria ePretoria High Court, ukuze iqulunqe iindaba ezahlukeneyo ezikhethiweyo eziquka iindaba ezahlukeneyo ngaphakathi kwesikhundla sokulawula. Kuqinisekiswe ukuba zizonke izinto eziziweyo ngokwemigaqo yomthetho. Qinisekisa ukuba konke okukhankanyiweyo kusetyenziswa ngokwemigaqo esemthethweni ngokwefomathi yamagama abangenangxaki. Kwaye ngokwemigaqo yokugcina ubunyani bomthetho, kuqinisekiswe ukuba zizonke iinkcukacha ezikwindawo yolawulo zihamba phambili ngokuchanekileyo. Qinisekisa ukuba imigca yomthetho iyaxhaswa ngokuchanekileyo ngeendlela ezahlukeneyo ezifumaneka kumthetho weSizwe. Kuqinisekiswe ukuba zizonke iindaba ezahlukeneyo ze-Computer zixhaswa ngokuchanekileyo ngokwemigaqo yolawulo. Kuyakuthi kubekho izaziso ezahlukeneyo ezikulawulo lwesikhundla sikaMongameli weZiko. Kwaye ngokwemigaqo yolawulo, kuqinisekiswe ukuba konke okufunekayo kusetyenziswa ngokuchanekileyo. Qinisekisa ukuba zonke iinkcukacha zomthetho zifumaneka kwindlela echanekileyo. Kwaye ngokwemigaqo yomthetho, kuqinisekiswe ukuba konke okufunekayo kusetyenziswa ngokuchanekileyo. Qinisekisa ukuba zonke iinkcukacha zomthetho zifumaneka kwindlela echanekileyo. Kwaye ngokwemigaqo yomthetho, kuqinisekiswe ukuba konke okufunekayo kusetyenziswa ngokuchanekileyo.

jobs.title: Senior Court Interpreter
jobs.centre: Eastern Cape Division of The High Court: Gqeberha
jobs.salary_text: R338 106 - R398 277 per annum (Level 07). The successful candidate will be required to sign a performance agreement.
jobs.summary: Senior Court Interpreter needed at the Eastern Cape High Court in Gqeberha to render interpreting services across various court proceedings.
jobs.requirements: Applicants should be in possession of a National Diploma in Legal Interpreting or equivalent qualification at NQF level 6 with 360 credits as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of two (2) years’ practical experience in court Interpreting or Grade twelve (12) certificate with at least ten (10) years’ practical experience in court Interpreting. Proficiency in English, Afrikaans and isiXhosa. Proficiency in any other indigenous languages and a valid driver’s license will serve as an added advantage. Knowledge and skills: Knowledge of relevant acts and regulations, knowledge of culture, knowledge of subject area, knowledge on how to translate and be able to keep to time frame. Skilled in computer literacy (MS Office), communication (written and verbal), time management, interpersonal relations, listening, customer service, problem solving, planning, organising, decision-making, analytical thinking, excellent English language along with the following attributes: flexible, motivational, able to work under pressure, meticulous, self-driven and people centric.
jobs.duties: Render interpreting services: Interpret in Children’s Act matters, criminal proceedings, Civil proceedings, Domestic Violence Act matters, Older Persons Act matters, Family, Protection from Harassment Act matters, Labour, Maintenance Act matters, Child Justice matters, Inquests, and quasi-judicial matters. af.title: Senior Hofvertaler
af.summary: Senior Hofvertaler word benodig by die Eastern Cape High Court in Gqeberha om tolkdienste tydens verskeie hofverrigtinge te lewer.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet 'n Nasionale Diploma in Regstolkunde of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie op NQF-vlak 6 met 360 krediete soos deur SAQA erken, hê. 'n Minimum van twee (2) jaar se praktiese ondervinding in hoftolk of 'n Graad twaalf (12) sertifikaat met ten minste tien (10) jaar se praktiese ondervinding in hoftolk. Vaardigheid in Engels, Afrikaans en isiXhosa. Vaardigheid in enige ander inheemse tale en 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van relevante wette en regulasies, kennis van kultuur, kennis van die vakgebied, kennis van hoe om te vertaal en die vermoë om tydsbestekke na te kom. Vaardig in rekenaarvaardigheid (MS Office), kommunikasie (skriftelik en mondelings), tydbestuur, interpersoonlike verhoudinge, luister, kliëntediens, probleemoplossing, beplanning, organiserings, besluitneming, analitiese denke, uitstekende Engelse taal asook die volgende eienskappe: buigsaam, motiverend, in staat om onder druk te werk, deeglik, selfgedrewe en mensegerig.
af.duties: Lewer tolkdienste: Tolke in Kinderwet-sake, strafregtelike verrigtinge, siviele verrigtinge, Wet op Huishoudelike Geweld-sake, Wet op Bejaarde Persones-sake, Familie, Wet op Beskerming teen Teistering-sake, Arbeid, Onderhoudswet-sake, Kinderjustisie-sake, lykskouings, en kwasi-geregtelike sake. Tolke in klein eise howe, tolke in disiplinêre verhore, tolke in bemiddeling en arbitrasie, tolke in belydenis, tolke in voorverhore en konsultasies, skakel met die toesighouer vir buitelandse taaltolke, tolke van brontaal na doeltaal tydens hofverrigtinge, voorverhoor, konsultasie, kwasi, geregtelik. tolke nie-verbale gebare, dramatisering en belydenisse, skakel met die regbank om te oorleg oor die gereedheid en/of prestasie van 'n spesifieke tolker in die hof. Lewer regskwasi-geregtelike en taaldienste: Lewer hoorbare en duidelike tolkwerk van brontaal na doeltaal sonder versiering of weglatings terwyl die taal bewaar word, draf die korrekte taal ooreenkomstig die taalgebruik van die spreker, beheer die spreker en verseker dat die aanhalings korrek getolk word, Vertaal regsdokumente en bewysstukke: Bestudeer en ontleed die brondokument, doen die nodige navorsing en raadpleeg die relevante partye, verseker akkurate vertaling van aanhalings in dokumente, kontroleer, redigeer en hersien die vertaalde dokument, vertaal meganies opgeneemde oudiomateriaal. Ontwikkel terminologie en verskaf ondersteuning in die rekonstruksie van rekords: Versamel terminologie en ontwikkel 'n databasis, vul die terme en onderskeie betekenisse in die glossariumregister in, versamel alle verhoordokumente, spreek meganiese opnames aan, vergelyk notas van die voorsittende beampte, Staat en Verdediging.

Ulwazi kanye nezakhono: Ulwazi ngemithetho kanye nemithetho ehlobene, ulwazi ngamasiko, ulwazi ngesihlabathi sendaba, ulwazi lokuthi ungakuhumusha kanjani futhi ukwazi ukugcina isikhathi. Ukhono lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha (MS Office), ukuxhumana (okubhaliwe nokuqhutshwa), ukuphatha isikhathi, ubudlelwano nabantu, ukuzwa, inkonzo yabathengi, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukwelula, ukuhlela, ukwenza izinqumo, ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya, ulimi oluhle lwesiNgisi kanye nalezi zinto ezilandelayo: ukuguquguquka, ukukhuthaza, ukukwazi ukusebenza ngaphansi kwezingcindezi, ukunakelela iminikelo, ukuziqhayisa nentuzuko yabantu.

af.title: Regter se Sekretaris
af.summary: Die Kantoor van die Hoofregspreker soek 'n sekretaris om administratiewe ondersteuning aan 'n regter by die Gauteng Hooggeregshof in Johannesburg te bied, insluitend die tik en lê van vonnisse.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet oor 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat beskik. 'n Minimum van 20 modules voltooi vir 'n LLB, BA/BCOM Regte-graad. 'n Minimum van een (01) jaar sekretariële ervaring; 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Om 'n tiktoets af te lê. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van departementele beleide, voorskrifte en prosedures of riglyne, navorsingsvermoëns insluitend die ondertekening van betaalstatings. Vaardig in kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik), administrasie, kliëntediens, uitstekende tikvaardighede insluitend Dictaphone-tik, rekenaarvaardigheid (MS Word), interpersoonlike vaardighede en tydbestuur. Saam met die volgende eienskappe: vermoë om streng sperdatums te haal, onder druk te werk, vertroulikheid en aandag aan detail.
af.duties: Verleen sekretariële ondersteuning aan die Regterbank: Dagtik die afsprake en vergaderings van die Regter. Tik en lê die vonnisse; verseker dat vonnisse wat gelewer is, ondertekende konsepbevele wat in die hof of virtueel toegestaan is, na die Tikster gestuur word vir skandering, oplaai na Case-lines/Court-Online en die Biblioteek; verseker dat alle besoekers ontvang, gesif en hul navrae hanteer word; teken alle inkomende en uitgaande dokumente; bestel en haal skryfbehoeftes vir die Regter. Verskaf ondersteuningsfunksies vir siviele, kriminele en hersieningsake/howe en saaktoewysings in kamers: Haal die lêers voor die aanvang van 'n kriminele saak by die Registrateur se kantoor in die Kriminele afdeling; hou die register van hersienings op datum en teken by ontvangs om die hersienings aan die Klerk terug te besorg; verseker dat die register/sjabloon van die voorbehoue vonnis opgedateer word en die Statistiekbeampte en die Kantoor van die Regterpresident in kennis stel wanneer die vonnis gelewer is; verseker dat die getranskribeerde vonnisse van transkribeerders die Regters bereik vir goedkeuring en handtekening; berei hofrolle voor teenoorgestelde mosies en dringende howe en versprei dit aan belanghebbendes. Verskaf ondersteuningsfunksies aan siviele/kriminele howe: Dien die korrekte eed of verklaring in die hof toe wanneer vereis; verseker dat die Regter se bankboek voorberei is en lêers deur Bisserds na die hof geneem word voor die aanvang van die verrigtinge; verseker dat alle betrokke belanghebbendes voor die aanvang van verrigtinge in die hof teenwoordig is; verseker dat alle sake op rekord volgens die hofrol geroep word deur die saaknommer en die partye se name te noem voordat 'n Regter partye kan toelaat om met hul sake te begin. Verskaf algemene administratiewe ondersteuning aan die Regterbank: Verseker dat alle reis- en akkommodasie-reëlings in orde is en teken die dokumente vir goedkeuring; verseker dat die Regter se logboek op of voor die 5de van elke maand by die Vervoerbeampte ingediend word; verseker dat die voertuig vir onderhoud of diens bespreek word; ontvang die voorafmagtiging vir die Regter se voertuig; herinner die Regter aan die fakture sodat die indiening van die S&K-eise verwerk kan word; verseker die indiening van selfoon- en 3G-data-eise vir verwerkingsdoeleindes en verseker dat alle opdaterings van die losblaaie in die Regters se biblioteek hanteer word.

Provide support functions to Civil, Criminal and review matters/courts and case allocations in chambers: Collect the files before the commencement of a Criminal matter from the Registrar's office at the Criminal section, keep update on the register of reviews and sign on receipt to return the reviews to the Clerk, ensure that the register/template of the reserved judgement is updated and notify the Statistics Officer and the office of the Judge President when judgment has been handed down, ensure that the transcribed judgements from transcribers reach the Judges for approval and signature, prepare court rolls for Opposed Motion and Urgent court and distribute to stakeholders. Provide support functions to civil / criminal courts: Administer the correct Oath ID or declaration in court when required, ensure that the bench book of the Judge is prepared and files are taken by Ushers to court before the commencement of the proceedings, ensure that all stakeholders involved are present in court before commencement of proceedings, ensure that all cases are called on record as per the court roll by means of calling the case number and the parties' names, before a Judge can allow parties to start with their matters. Provide general administrative support to the Judiciary: Ensure that all the travel, accommodation arrangements are in order and attend to sign the documents for approval, ensure that the Judge's logbook is submitted on or before the 5th of every month to the Transport Officer, ensure that the car is booked for either maintenance and service, receive the pre-authorisation for the Judge's vehicle, remind Judge of the invoices so that the submission of the S&T claims can be processed, ensure the submissions of Cell phone and 3G data claims for process purposes and ensure that all updates on the loose leafs in the Judges library are attended to.

xh.title: Unobhala weJaji
xh.summary: IOfisi yoMlawuli weZiqithi zobufama ibhala iphantisisa unobhala onikeze inkxaso yolawulo kwejaji eGauteng High Court eJohannesburg, kuqukiyo ukuchwetheza nokugcina iifayile izigwebo.
xh.requirements: Abafakeli kufuneka babe neSatifikethi seQeli lesi-12. Kufuneka ugqibe okungenani amaqula angama-20 kwaze kufikela kwindima ye-LLB, i-BA/BCOM Law degree. Okungenayo iminyaka enye (01) yamava ngendlela yokusebenza njengonobhala, ilayisenisi yokuqhuba esemthethweni iya kuba luncedo ekongezeleleni. Kugqithwe uvavayo lokuchwetheza. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi ngeenkqubo zolawulo, izalathiso nemigaqo okanye iinkqubo zokwenzisa iinkcukacha, ikhono lokucinga kuquka nokusayina ngesandla inkxaso-mvuzo. Ukho kokusebenza ukunxibelelana (ngomlomo nangokubhaliweyo), kulawulo, kwinkonzo yabathengi, ukuchwetheza ngokuphuhliswa kakhonye nokuchwetheza ngokuthi Dictaphone, ukwazi ukusebenza ngakumbi (MS Word), ukunxibelelana nabantu nokulawula ixesha. Kuquka nokuqwalaselwa okulandelayo: ukwazi ukuhlala ethutyana ezinqamlezileyo, ukusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo, ukugcina imfihlo kakhulu nokunaka iinkcukacha ezininzi.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso ngendlela yokusebenza njengonobhala kuBumba: Qamba kumaxhesha kwaye ubhale iindibano zoJaji eziyakuqhankqalazwa. Chwetheza kwaye ugcine iifayile izigwebo, qiniseka ukuba izigwebo ezikhululwayo (ezinikezelwayo), ioda ezikunqwamba-mbama ezamkelekileyo ekhotyen okanye ngokwamajelo asuka zithunyelwe kuTyphi wokuqamba, zifakwe kwi-Case-lines/Court-Online naseLaibrari, qiniseka ukuba wonke abakhenkethi bamkelwe, baqwalaselwe kwaye imibuzo yabo iphendulwe, qamba zonke amaxwebhu angenayo naphumayo, ucele kwaye uqokelele izixhobo zokubhala zoJaji. Phathiswa inkxaso kwimicimbi ngeMbango, eMtyholweni nakuphononongo lwemicimbi/zi nkundla kwaye kumanyathelo okwaba imicimbi ekwindlu kaJaji, athi angenwa ngaphakathi: Qokelela iifayile phambi kokuqaliswa komcimbi weMtyholo eNkundleni, kwindlu kaMvunyi wesigqi seMtyholo, gcina ukuvuselelwa kule ndlu uphononongo lwemicimbi kwaye usayine ngokusayina kwenzalo ukubuyisa uphononongo loMmeli, qiniseka ukuba indlu le-Templates eyavulwa ibhaliweyo ukuze isigwebo sigcinwe ngcono kwaye yenzele umfundi weeNkcukacha zobulinganiso nokuba uluntu olusesikhundleni seSigqeba asazi ukuba isigwebo sesiphathunyelwa esisakuba sikhululwe senziwa isaziso, qiniseka ukuba izigwebo eziguqulwe ezisuka kubagqibi-magama zifika kwiJaji ukuba zamkele kwaye zisayine, lungelelanisa irola yekundla yokuxhobilela iMibuzo esindileyo yamaviki ayimBalasela kubantu abahlobo bayo nabanjani. Phathiswa inkxabo inkxaso ekwindlu zombango / zomtyholo zekundla: Setyenziswa isifungo esichanekileyo sokuqinisekisa uluntu nakwindla xa kufunwa, qiniseka ukuba incwadadi yohempe yejaji ilungelelanisiwe kwaye amaxwebhu abathwe ngesandla ngabathunywa ekundla phambi kokuqala kweziganeko zemfazwe, qiniseka ukuba onke amakhosikazi anikwe igazi amagama ekundla phambi kokusebenza koluntu, qiniseka ukuba onke amacala abizwa ngokulandelana ngokweNgqungqutheli yekundla ngokubiza inani lesigqeba lamagama amacala, ngokudlula kwiJaji onceda amacala ukuba ahambe amacala abo. Phathiswa inkxabo yonke yolawulo kuBumba: Qiniseka ukuba yonke iindlela zokuqinisa, iindlela zokuhlengwa ziyakwenzelelana kwaye zithunyelwe ukuba zisayine amaxwebhu okugqiba ukuba asikwenziwa, qiniseka ukuba incwadadi yokuhamba yegama leSizwe ipapashwe ngomhla woku-5 yenyanga yonke kumniki wokuHamba ziiNkovA, qiniseka ukuba igama lihlengwa ngenxa yokulungiswa nokwenziwa inkonzo, qiniseka ukuba ufumana isaziso sokugqiba kwangaphambili kwemoto yejaji, khumbuza iJaji ngefaksimila ukwazi ukuba iinkqubo ezazisesazweni zeS&T zenziwe ukuba zibhiyozwa ngokupapashwa ngokutsha kwamagatya eposi, qiniseka ukuba zathunyelwa iinkqubo ezifakwe kakhwi i-S&T ezininzi ukuba zithunyelwe kwakhona kunye nokupapashwa kwenkxaso-mvuzo, qiniseka ukuba zathunyelwa imali yesaziso esesazweni seTrafiki yekhaya lejaji nokuba yonke inkxaso-mvuzo yemali yokuhambahamba ibhiyozwe ngokulawulwa kwindlu yoJaji ipapashwe ngokukhawuleza ngokutsha kwamaxwebhu angenamanzi esazweni sabo.

jobs.title: Provisioning Administrative Officer: Demand and Tender
jobs.salary_text: R338 106 - R 398 277 per annum (Level 07). The successful candidate will be required to sign a performance agreement.
jobs.summary: The Office of the Chief Justice seeks a Provisioning Administrative Officer for Demand and Tender at its National Office in Midrand.
jobs.requirements: Applicants should be in possession of a National Diploma in Supply Chain Management / Economics / Finance / Financial Management / Procurement/ Logistic/Public Administration or relevant qualification at (NQF level 6) as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of two (2) years’ experience Demand Management and Tender Administration environment. A valid driver’s license. Knowledge and skills: Knowledge and understanding of administrative and procurement procedure, knowledge of the Public Financial Management Act, knowledge of supply chain management frameworks, policies and procedures, knowledge of budgeting and financial management, knowledge of procurement policies and relevant legislation prior to awarding contracts, knowledge of PPPFA regulations, Public Service Act 1994, Public Service Regulations 2016, National Treasury Regulations, good understanding of departmental prescripts and frameworks (e.g. departmental codes: COIDA and BBBEE and Batho Pele Principles. Skilled in computer literacy MS Office, MS Power Point, MS Word, MS Excel, presentation, conceptual orientation, planning, organising, problem- solving, financial management, interpersonal relations, decision making, time management, communication and report writing skills.
jobs.duties: Coordinate the compilation of tender/quotation specifications as required: Conduct briefing sessions. Coordinate the Development of sourcing strategy. Development of specifications/Terms of Reference. Compilation of Demand Management Plans and Procurement Plans. Coordinate the amendment of the procurement plan. Serve as a secretariat of Bid Specification and Bid Evaluation and Adjudication Committee. Maintaining of filling system for awarded bids. Compile bid documents, Publish bid documents and bid invitations. Coordinate the development of sourcing strategy document. Verify alignment of the acquisition of goods and services with the Demand Management Plans and provide support with information for Audit queries. Conduct proper filling system for all the records, schedule and organise meetings, render secretarial services to the meetings within the unit, update and maintain the project dashboard for the unit, facilitate the subsistence and facilitate procurement of stationary and all other petty cash purchases and handle incoming and outgoing office correspondence. Collate and compile monthly progress reports on the procurement plan and quarterly report to the National Treasury. ENQUIRIES Technical Related Enquiries: HR Related Enquiries: Ms N Ntimane Tel No: (010) 493 2601
jobs.applications: Applications can be sent via email to 2026/102/OCJ@judiciary.org.za
jobs.notes: The Organisation will give preference to candidates in line with the Employment Equity goals. All applications must be submitted on a New Z83 form, which can be downloaded           on        internet       at       www.judiciary.org.za       / www.dpsa.gov.za/dpsa2g/vacancies.asp or obtainable from any Public Service Department and should be accompanied by a recent comprehensive CV only; contactable referees (telephone numbers and email addresses must be indicated). Please send your documents in a PDF and put them in one folder. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other related documents on or before the day of the interview following communication from Human Resources. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Applicants could be required to provide consent for access to their social media accounts. Prior to appointment for SMS, a candidate would be required to complete the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to Senior Management Services as endorsed by DPSA which is an online course, endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into the SMS and the full details can be sourced by the following link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. Each application form must be fully completed, duly signed and initialed on both pages by the applicant. The application must indicate the correct job title, the office where the position is advertised and the reference number as stated in the advert. Failure by the applicant to complete, sign and initial the application form will lead to disqualification of the application during the selection process. Applications on the old Z83 will unfortunately not be considered. Should you be in possession of a foreign qualification, it must be accompanied by an evaluation considered. Suitable candidates will be subjected to a personnel suitability check (criminal record, financial checks, qualification verification, citizenship checks, social media, reference checks and employment verification). Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. The Department reserves the right not to make any appointment(s) to the advertised post(s). Applicants who do not comply with the above-mentioned requirements, as well as applications received late, will not be considered. Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the application not being considered during the selection process. All successful candidates will be expected to enter into an employment contract and a performance agreement within 3 months of appointment, as well as be required to undergo a security clearance three (3) months after appointment. The Office the Chief Justice complies with the provisions of the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA); Act No. 4 of 2013. We will use your personal information provided to us for the purpose of recruitment only and more specifically for the purpose of the position/vacancy you have applied for. In the event that your application was unsuccessful, the Office of the Chief Justice will retain your personal information for internal audit purposes as required by policies. All the information requested now or during the process is required for recruitment purposes. Failure to provide requested information will render your application null and void. The Office of the Chief Justice will safeguard the security and confidentiality of all information you shared during the recruitment process. OTHER POSTS
