'n Minimum van twee (2) jaar se ervaring in 'n Demand Management en Tender Administration-omgewing. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis en begrip van administratiewe en procurment prosedures, kennis van die Public Financial Management Act, kennis van voorsieningskettingbestuursraamwerke, beleide en prosedures, kennis van begroting en finansiële bestuur, kennis van procurmentbeleide en toepaslike wetgewing voor die toekenning van kontrakte, kennis van PPPFA-regulasies, Public Service Act 1994, Public Service Regulations 2016, National Treasury Regulations, goeie begrip van departementele voorskrifte en rame (bv. departementele kodes: COIDA en BBBEE en Batho Pele-beginsels. Vaardig in rekenaargeletterdheid MS Office, MS Power Point, MS Word, MS Excel, aanbieding, konseptuele oriëntasie, beplanning, organisering, probleemoplossing, finansiële bestuur, interpersoonlike betrekkinge, besluitneming, tydbestuur, kommunikasie en verslagskryfvaardighede.
af.duties: Koördineer die samestelling van tender/kwotasiespesifikasies soos vereis: Hou inligtingsessies. Koördineer die ontwikkeling van die voorsieningsstrategie. Ontwikkeling van spesifikasies/Terme van Verwysing. Samestelling van Vraagbestuursplanne en Procurement Plans. Koördineer die wysiging van die procurment plan. Tree op as sekretariaat van die Bidspecificasie- en Bidevaluering- en Toekenningkomitee. Onderhou 'n liasseerstelsel vir toegekende bie. Stel biedokumente op, pubiseer biedokumente en biduitnodigings. Koördineer die ontwikkeling van die voorsieningsstrategiedokument. Verifieer die belyning van die verkryging van goedere en dienste met die Demand Management Planne en verskaf ondersteuning met inligting vir ouditnavrae. Voer 'n behoorlike liasseerstelsel uit vir al die rekords, skeduleer en organiseer vergaderings, lewer sekretariële dienste aan vergaderings binne die eenheid, dateer die projekdashboard vir die eenheid op en onderhou dit, fasiliteer die bestaansmiddele en fasiliteer die procurment van skryfbehoeftes en alle ander klein kontant aankope, en hanteer inkomende en uitgaande kantoor korrespondensie. Versamel en stel maandelikse vorderingsverslae oor die procurement plan en kwartaalverslae aan die National Treasury op. zu.title: Inkulu Yesiphathimandla Esiyinhloko Sezolimo: Isidingo Nokuqashwa Kwemisebenzi

zu.requirements: Abafaka izicelo kufanele babe ne-Diploma Yezwe ku-Supply Chain Management / Economics / Finance / Financial Management / Procurement/ Logistic/Public Administration noma iziqu ezifanele ezingeni le-(NQF level 6) njengoba kuhlonzwa yi-SAQA. Isipesheli esingaphansi kweminyaka emibili (2) semisebenzi enkathi yokuphathwa kwezidingo nendawo yokuphathwa kokuqashwa kwemisebenzi. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ukubekezeli kakhulu ekusebenzeni ngekhompyutha i-MS Office, MS Power Point, MS Word, MS Excel, ukubumba inkombandlela, ukuhlela, ukubamba iqhaza, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuphathwa kwezimali, ubudlelwano obuhle nabantu, ukwenza izinqumo, ukuphathwa kwesikhathi, ukuxhumana nokubhala imibiko.
zu.duties: Bumba izingxenye ezichaza ngokuthengiswa kwemisebenzi noma amagama okuthengiswa njengoba kudingeka. Yenza izikhathi zokuxoxa. Yenza izingxenye ezichaza ngesu sokuthola izinsiza. Yenza izingxenye ezichaza ngemigomo noma amagama abhekiswe kuyo. Bumba amaphuzu okuphathwa kwezidingo namaphuzu okuthenga. Yenza izinguquko ezithintelayo ezibhalwe phansi ezimali zokuthenga. Yiba ngumlobi wakho konke okubhalwayo kwe-Bid Specification, Bid Evaluation and Adjudication Committee. Gcina isimiso sokushaja konke okuthengiwe okunikezwe abantu. Bumba amadokhumenti okuthengisa, shicilela amadokhumenti okuthengisa nemikhankaso yokuthengisa. Yenza izingxenye ezichaza ngesu sokuthola izinsiza. Qinisekisa ukuthi ukuthenga izimpahla namasevisi kuhambisana namaphuzu okuphathwa kwezidingo uphinde unikeze ukwesekwa ngolwazi kumibuzo ye-Audit. Gcina isimiso esifanele sokushaja yonke imibiko, hlela futhi ubambe iqhaza emihlanganweni, nikeza izinsiza zokubhala ohlelweni lwakho, buyekeza futhi ulondoloze isibonakaliso sohlelelo lomsebenzi kwesikhungo sakho, phatha izimali zokuphila, futhi ungakwenza nokuthenga izinto zokubhala kanye nalezinye izinto ezithengiswa ngezimali ezincane, uphinde uphathe okufakwayo nokuphumayo kohlelweni. xh.title: uMphathi weNkonzo yeNkonzo: uKuZisa nokuthumela
xh.summary: IOfisi kaMantshi wokuZisa ifuna uMphathi woLawulo lweZinto kuZisa ezidingwayo namaminikelo kwiOfisi yayo yaseLizwe eMidrand.

Unobuchule bokubhala ikhompyutha, ii-MS Office, i-MS Power Point, i-MS Word, i-MS Excel, ukubamba ikomityi, ukuqonda iingcamango, ukucwangciswa, ukulungiselelwa, ukusombulula iingxaki, ulawulo lwe-mali, iziganeko kumntu nomntu, ukwenza izigqibo, ulawulo lwebanga, unxibelelwano nakhono okubhala iingxelo.
xh.duties: Qamba ngokuhlangeneyo iimveliso zeminikelo/iingxelo zamaxabiso njengoko kufuneka: Yenza iinkqubo zokwazisa. Lungelanisa ukuphuhliswa kwenkqubo yokufumana iindawo zokuthenga. Ukuphuhlisa iimveliso/Igama leNdlela yokusebenza. Ukuqamba iindlela zoLawulo loMfuno namaCandu okuThengwayo. Lungelanisa ulungiselelo lwendlela yokuthenga. Phatha ikomiti yokuqamba iimveliso zeminikelo nokuhlola nokugunyazisa iminikelo. Ugcinelo lwenkqubo yokugcina iifayile zemikelo ethunyelweyo. Qamba amaxwebhu eminikelo, Shicilela amaxwebhu eminikelo nemema yeminikelo. Lungelanisa ukuphuhliswa kwegama lenkqubo yokusebenza. Qinisekisa ukuvumelana kokufumanisa izinto neenkonzo namaCandu oLawulo loMfuno unike inkxaso ngeenkcukacha zemibuzo yoKhangelo. Yenza inkqubo elungileyo yokugcina iifayile zonke irekhodi, lwazelele ukuhlanganisa iimfundiso, unike iinkonzo zobungqangi kwiimfundiso ngaphakathi kweyuniti, uhlaziye ugqibe ukugcina idashibhodi yeprojekthi yeyuniti, wenze okusingathwayo nelungelelanise ukuthengwa kwemathulasi nakho konke ukuthenga okuncinci kwekheshi uphatha ungenise buphume ngesigqibo ofisi. Qokelela uqamba iingxelo zentsuku zonke zentshowulo yexabiso kwaye ngokwexesha lemihla yegqhina kule candu loThengiso ukuya kwiQela leQonga leSizwe.

jobs.title: Registrar
jobs.salary_text: R337 563 - R1 155 777 per annum (MR3 - MR5). Salary will be in accordance with Occupation Specific Dispensation (Resolution 1 of 2008). Shortlisted candidates will be required to submit a service certificate/s for determination of their experience. The successful candidate will be required to sign a performance agreement.
jobs.summary: Registrar at the Northern Cape High Court in Kimberley requiring an LLB degree and postgraduate legal experience to process default judgements and quasi-judicial court functions.
jobs.requirements: Applicant should be in possession of an LLB Degree or a four (4) year Legal qualification at NQF level eight (8) as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of two (2) years post graduate legal experience. MR3: LLB Degree or equivalent plus a minimum of 2 years post graduate legal experience. MR4: LLB Degree or equivalent plus minimum of 8 years post graduate legal experience. MR5: LLB Degree or equivalent plus a minimum of 14 years post graduate legal experience. Superior Court of litigation experience and a driver’s license will serve as an added advantage. Skills and Competencies: Knowledge of registrar’s duties, Case Flow Management, legislative framework governing the public service and Batho Pele Principles. Skilled in communication (verbal and written), computer literacy, numeracy, planning, organising, controlling, problem solving, decision making, customer service orientation, interpersonal skills and conflict management. Along with the following attributes: Attention to detail, strong work ethics, professionalism, ability to work under pressure and meeting of deadlines, results driven, honesty/trustworthy and observance of confidentiality.
jobs.duties: Process default judgements to enhance efficiency of the court in handling of quasi- judicial functions: Determine whether pleadings/processes comply with the court rules, consider applications for default judgement (Rule 31(5) – by applying court rules and regulations, case law, discretion and knowledge, capture accurate outcome to the relevant litigating party, capture and update accurate Default applications register and data tool on percentage of default judgements granted by Registrars to the Statistician, execute taxations to enhance efficiency of the court in handling of quasi-judicial functions, Tax bills of cost-by hearing arguments from the parties and apply discretion and knowledge to the reasonable litigation costs, process and finalise Opposed and Unopposed Taxations in accordance with SOP, deal with and finalise taxation reviews (Rule 48) through the drafting of stated cases, replies, and submission to the Judiciary, capture and update accurate Bills of costs registered and data tools in the office, submit reporting tool on Taxations to the Statistician, manage criminal /civil process to enhance efficiency of the court: Analyse statistical data to assess trends and devise strategies to address identified risk factors, resolve Presidential Hotline queries and chapter 9 institution enquiries, coordinate and report on the provision of support staff in Court Rooms and Registrars supporting offices, manage the collation of performance information /data/ Statistics for purpose of reporting as per Reporting Tools, maintain and update manual registers for Audit of reported Performance information, supervise, develop staff and ensure general supervision employees.

af.title: Registrateur
af.summary: Registrateur by die Northern Cape High Court in Kimberley wat 'n LLB-graad en nagraadse regsonderwindings vereis om verstekvonnisse en kwasi-geregtelike hoffunksies te prosesseer.
af.requirements: Aansoeker moet 'n LLB-graad of 'n vier (4) jaar regskwalifikasie op NQF-vlak agt (8) soos deur SAQA erken besit. 'n Minimum van twee (2) jaar nagraadse regsonderwindings. MR3: LLB-graad of ekwivalent plus 'n minimum van 2 jaar nagraadse regsonderwindings. MR4: LLB-graad of ekwivalent plus 'n minimum van 8 jaar nagraadse regsonderwindings. MR5: LLB-graad of ekwivalent plus 'n minimum van 14 jaar nagraadse regsonderwindings. Hooggeregshof-litigasie-ervaring en 'n bestuurslisensie sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Vaardighede en Bevoegdhede: Kennis van registrateur se pligte, Saakvloei-bestuur, wetgewende raamwerk wat die openbare diens regeer en Batho Pele-beginsels. Bedrewe in kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik), rekenaarvaardigheid, syfergeletterdheid, beplanning, organisering, beheer, probleemoplossing, besluitneming, klikediens-oriëntasie, interpersoonlike vaardighede en konflikbestuur. Tesame met die volgende eienskappe: Aandag aan besonderhede, sterk werketiek, professionaliteit, vermoë om onder druk te werk en sperdatums na te kom, resultaatgedrewe, eerlikheid/betroubaarheid en inagneming van vertroulikheid.
af.duties: Prosesseer verstekvonnisse om die doeltreffendheid van die hof in die hantering van kwasi-geregtelike funksies te verbeter: Bepaal of pleitstukke/prosesse met die hofreëls voldoen, oorweeg aansoeke om verstekvonnis (Rule 31(5) – deur hofreëls en regulasies, case law, diskresie en kennis toe te pas, vaslegging van akkurate uitkoms aan die betrokke litigerende party, vaslegging en opdatering van akkurate verstekaansoeke-register en data-instrument oor persentasie verstekvonnisse deur Registrateurs toegestaan aan die Statistikus, uitvoer van belastings om doeltreffendheid van die hof in die hantering van kwasi-geregtelike funksies te verbeter, Belasting van kosterekvens deur argumente van die partye aan te hoor en diskresie en kennis toe te pas op die redelike litigasiekostes, prosesseer en finaliseer Besette en Onbesette Belastings ooreenkomstig SOP, hanteer en finaliseer belastings hersienings (Rule 48) deur die opstel van stated cases, antwoorde, en voorlegging aan die Regbank, vaslegging en opdatering van akkurate kosterekvens geregistreer en data-instrumente in die kantoor, voorlegging van verslagdoeningsinstrument oor Belastings aan die Statistikus, bestuur van strafregtelike/siviele proses om doeltreffendheid van die hof te verbeter: Analiseer statistiese data om tendense te assesseer en strategieë te beraam om geidentifiseerde risikofaktore aan te spreek, los Presidential Hotline navrae en hoofstuk 9 instelling-navrae op, koordineer en rapporteer oor die verskaffing van ondersteuningspersoneel in Regsale en Registrateurs se ondersteuningskantore, bestuur die samestelling van prestasie-inligting/data/statistiek vir die doel van verslagdoening soos per Verslagdoeningsinstrumente, handhaaf en dateer handmatige registers op vir Oudit van gerapporteerde prestasie-inligting, bestuur, ontwikkel personeel en verseker algemene toesig oor werknemers.

zu.title: Umrejista
zu.summary: Isikhundla somrejista e-Northern Cape High Court e-Kimberley esidinga idiploma ye-LLB nenkokhelo yomsebenzi wezomthetho emva kokuqeda izifundo ukuthi kwenziwe izahlulelo ezingezona ezomthetho nemisebenzi yenkantolo.
zu.requirements: Umfuni kufanele abe nediploma ye-LLB noma iziqu zezomthetho zangeminyaka emine (4) ezingeni le-NQF lesi-8 njengoba kuvunyiwe yi-SAQA. Ukwenzela okungenani iminyaka emibili (2) ngaphansi kwezomthetho ngemva kokuqeka. MR3: Idiploma ye-LLB noma esilinganayo kanye naphakathi kweminwe emib (2) yokuhlolakeli ngemva kokuqeda iziqu. MR4: Idiploma ye-LLB noma esilinganayo kanye naphakathi kwemiyaka esi-8 yokuhlolakeli ngemva kokuqeda iziqu. MR5: Idiploma ye-LLB noma esilinganayo kanye naphakathi kwemiyaka eyi-14 yokuhlolakeli ngemva kokuqeda iziqu. Okuhlolakelayo e-Nkantolo Ephakamayo nokuba namalayisense wokushayela kuzokuba ngelakho sovunyelwayo. Amakhono namandla: Esiqondile ngaphansi kwemisebenzi yomrejista, ukugcinwa kwebhizinisi ukuze kuhamba kahle imohlape, uhlaka lomthetho olawula isabelomphakathi kanye nemigomo ye-Batho Pele. Nekakhono ekuthinteni ngomlomo nakubhalwayo, ukuqwasha ngeminiyashe, ukusebenzisa iminwe-nto, ukwakheka nokuphatha nolawulo, isixazululi sohlulelo, ukwenza izinkomba, ukubikezela ngomthengi, khono elihlobene nemiqondo kanye nokuphatha imizwa. Kanye nezimfihlo ezilandelayo: Ukunaka imininingwane ngokwanele, izimilo ezinhle zomsebenzi, ukuziphatha ngobungcalu, ukusebenza ngaphansi kwexinxu futhi ugweme ukungabi khona yizikhathi ezibekiwe, ukuphathwa yimvelaphi, ukuqiniseka/Ukwethembeka kanye nokugcina izimfihlo.
zu.duties: Buyekeza isiqunto esimhlophe ukwandise isivusekileseni le-Nkantolo ekwenzeni imisebenzi engenaso isinqumo somthetho: Hlola ukuthi okuqediwe kwezinkomba/izinkomba ziyasemthethweni na ngokwendlela yaseNkantolo, cwaninga izicelo zezinqunto ezimhlophe (umthetho 31(5) - ngokusebenzisa izigubhu zemithetho enkantolo, indlela yesigaba, isiso nokwaziswa ngesi sizathu, ibele iminwe-nto ebunqamule, beka isiqunqo esifanelekilele kubandakanywa ekcaleni, qamba ibhalansi yokubuyekisa izicelo zabafakelwa bentshontshwa, shova ngcono imininingwane ngamakhompyutha ngokomthetho we-31 (5) weziganeko zezenweza zimhlophe, bizeza izolo ukwandisa isivusekileseni esilekukutholakala noma evela kwezinye izigxi, kubumbuza izindleko eziyisiko, cuttetu imali eshanduna iyeza insika nenyuko esingcolile ekufeza iyunithi yezinkinga zokubeka imithetho. Lulunge ukuthi abantu bahlinzeke amapuleti aye kwezinye izindawo futhi bathole ngcono ibhalansi yalapha kubhalwe khona izinto, titisa amandla omphakathi uma kudinga isivivinyo sezigqibo sokuthi kusebenza kubandakanya imisebenzi ebelwe ngemva kweminwe yokuvela ukuba yinkomba, hlakanipha isidumbu sakho, lungisele ukubhaliswa okugula kwabashaywe ngokomthetho futhi uhlole izimpawu ezingafanele zabantu e-Nkantolo.

jobs.centre: Gauteng Division of The High Court: Pretoria
jobs.salary_text: R337 563 - R1 155 777 per annum (MR3 - MR5), Salary will be in accordance with Occupation Specific Dispensation (Resolution 1 of 2008). Shortlisted candidates will be required to submit a service certificate/s for determination of their experience. The successful candidate will be required to sign a performance agreement.
jobs.summary: Registrar sought at the Gauteng High Court in Pretoria to assess court pleadings, consider default judgment applications and apply court rules, requiring an LLB degree and legal experience.
jobs.requirements: Applicants should be in possession of an LLB Degree or a four (4) year Legal qualification at NQF level eight (8) as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of two (2) years’ experience in legal environment. MR3: LLB Degree or equivalent plus a minimum of 2 years post graduate legal experience. MR4: LLB Degree or equivalent plus minimum of 8 years post graduate legal experience. MR5: LLB Degree or equivalent plus a minimum of 14 years post graduate legal experience. Superior Court of litigation experience and a driver’s license will serve as an added advantage. Knowledge and Skills: Knowledge of registry duties, Case Flow Management, legislative framework governing the public service, knowledge of storage and retrieval procedures in terms of the working environment, Batho Pele Principles. Skilled in communication (verbal and written), computer literacy, numeracy, planning, organising, problem solving, decision-making, interpersonal skills, conflict management, time management, analytical skills. Along with the following attributes: strong work ethics and professionalism, time bound, meticulous, honesty/trustworthy and observance of confidentiality.
jobs.duties: Determine whether pleadings/ processes comply with the Court rules, consider applications for default judgment (Rule 31[5]) – by applying Court rules and regulations, case law, discretion and knowledge, capture accurate outcome of discretion applied on the file cover, ensure circulation of the outcome to the relevant litigating party, capture and update accurate Default applications register and data tool registered in the office daily, verify data and submit reporting tool on percentage of default judgments granted by Registrars to the Statistician, analyse statistical data to assess trends and devise strategies to address identified risk factors, resolve Presidential Hotline queries and chapter 9 institution enquiries, coordinate and report on the provision of support staff in Court Rooms and Registrars supporting offices, manage the collation of performance information/ data/ Statistics for purpose of reporting as per Reporting Tools, maintain and update manual registers for Audit reported Performance information, supervise, develop staff and ensure general supervision of employees. Allocate duties and perform quality control on the work delivered by officials, manage leave of staff, advise and lead supervisees with regard to all aspects of the work, manage performance, conduct and discipline of employees, ensure that all employees are trained and developed to be able to deliver work of the required standard efficiently and effectively, develop, implement and monitor work systems and processes to ensure efficient and effective functioning, address enquiries and provide advice and guidance on asset allocations and control.

Ukubekezela ekuxhumeni (ngomlomo nangokubhaliwe), ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ukubala, ukwelula, ukuhlela, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukwenza izinqumo, amakhono obudlelwano, ukuphathwa kwezinkinga, ukuphathwa kwesikhathi, amakhono okuhlaziya. Kanye nalezimo ezilandelayo: izimilo ezinhle zomsebenzi nobungcweti, ukuhlonipha isikhathi, ukukhathalela imininingwane, ukuqotho/ukuthembeka kanye nokugcina imfihlo.
zu.duties: Qiniseka ukuthi amadokhumenti/ inqubo zihambisana nemithetho yenkantolo, cabange izicelo zokwahlulelwa ezingezongo (Rule 31[5]) – ngokusebenzisa imithetho kanye nomthetho wenkantolo, umthetho wamacala, ukusetshenziswa kwesinklothi nelwazi, shiya imiphumela eqinisekisiwe yesinklothi esethenzwe kumvalo wefayela, qinisekisa ukusakazwa komphumela kumuntu ohlanganyela enkantolo, shiya futhi uvuselele umlando wezicelo ezingezongo kanye nethuluzi ledata elibhaliswe kantu nsuku zonke, qinisekisa idata futhi uhambise ithuluzi lokubika ngamaphesenti ezinkantolo ezingezongo ezinikezwa abalobi kwi-Statistician, hlaziya idata yezibalo ukuze uhlole ukuthi kuyaqhubeka kanjani uhlele izindlela zokuxazulula izinto eziyingozi ezibonwe, xazulula imibuzo ye-Presidential Hotline nezinkinga zezikhungo ezingu-9 zesahluko, hlela futhi ubike ngokunikezwa kokusekela abasebenzi emakamelweni enkantolo nakumahhovu asekelayo abalobi, phatha ukuqoqwa kwemininingwane/ idata/ izibalo zokusebenza ngenjongo yokubika njengoba kuhlelwe kumatuluzi okubika, gcina futhi uvuselele izinkomba zesandla eziyibhukh lemininingwane yokuqinisekiswa ukusebenza, qaphela, thuthukisa abasebenzi futhi uqinisekise ukuqaphelwa ngokuvamile kwabasebenzi. Nika imisebenzi futhi wenze ukulawula ngosimo komsebenzi ohlinzekwe abasebenzi, phatha ukukhishwa kwabasebenzi, luleka futhi uhola abalawuli ngakho konke okumayelana nomsebenzi, lawula ukusebenza, ukuhlala kwesimo nokuziphatha kwezinkinga, qiniseka ukuthi bonke abasebenzi balolongwa futhi bathuthukiswa ukukwazi ukuhlinzeka umsebenzi wolwazi oludingekayo kalula nangokusebenza, thuthukisa, ukusebenzisa futhi uqapethe izinhlelo zomsebenzi kanye nenqubo ukuze kusebenze ngokusebenza ngokuphindaphindiwe nangokuphumelela, xazulula imibuzo futhi unikeze izeluleko nokuqondisa kokuhlelwa nokulawulwa kwempahla.

xh.title: Registrar
xh.summary: Kufunwa i-Registrar eGauteng High Court ePretoria ukuba ahlobole iikhalathi zangaphakathi zenkundla, acinge izicelo zesigwebo esingenangxaxheba kwaye asebenzise iindlela zolawulo lenkundla, kubekho needigri ze-LLB kunye namava omthetho.
xh.requirements: Abafaka izicelo kufuneka babe ne-Degree ye-LLB okanye isiqinisekiso somthetho seminyaka emine (4) kwinqanaba le-NQF elinesibhozo (8) njengoko evunyiwe yi-SAQA. Amava ambalwa eminyaka emi-2 (2) kwindawo yomthetho. MR3: Degree ye-LLB okanye ekanambuduli nencwadana efanayo kunye namava ambalwa eminyaka emi-2 yomthetho emva kwedigri. MR4: Degree ye-LLB okanye ekanambuduli nencwadana efanayo kunye namava ambalwa eminyaka esi-8 yomthetho emva kwedigri. MR5: Degree ye-LLB okanye ekanambuduli nencwadana efanayo kunye namava ambalwa eminyaka elishumi nane (14) yomthetho emva kwedigri. Amava enkundla ephezulu yotywalomthetho kunye nelayisensi yokushayela kuya kuba lusizo olongezelelweyo. Ulwazi nokhono: Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yeregistri, uLawulo Lokuhamba kweziTyholo, inkqubo yomthetho elawula inkonzo yorhwebo, ulwazi lwenkqubo yokugcina nokuvelisa iinkcukacha ngokwendawo yokusebenza, iimpawu ze-Batho Pele. Ukhonwa ekunxibelelaneni (ngemilomo nangokubhalwayo), ukwaziswa ngakomputa, ukubala, ukuqamba iiplan, ukuqamba izinto, ukuxazulula iingxaki, ukwenza izigqibo, ukhono lokuchazana nabantu, ulawulo lwezingxabano, ulawulo lwexesha, ukhono lokuhlola. Kunye nendlela elandelayo: inkqubo yomsebenzi eqinileyo nobugcisa bokusebenza, ukubophelelwa ngxesha, ukucinga ngokucokisekileyo, inyaniso/ukwathembeka kwaye ulandele imfihlelo.
xh.duties: Ukuqumatha ukuba iikhalathi/inkqubo ziyahambisana na nemigaqo yenkundla, ukucinga izicelo zesigwebo esingenangxaxheba (Indlela 31[5]) – ngokusebenzisa imigaqo nolawulo lenkundla, umthetho weziyhaluyo, isigqibo nokho ekugqibele ukwazi, ukuqamba isiphumo esichanekileyo sesigqibo esenziwe kwisiqobo sefayile, ukuqinisekisa ukusasazwa kwesiphumo kumqhubki othintekayo enkundla, ukuqamba kwaye uvuselele isiphindo esichanekileyo sesicelo esingenangxaxheba nesixhobo sedatha esibhalwe kwindawo yokusebenza yonke imihla, ukuqinisekisa idatha kwaye unikeze isixhobo sobungakanani ngamaphesenti ezigwebo ezingenangxaxheba ezinikiwe ngabaBhalisi kwi-Statistician, ukuhlola idatha yobungakanani ukulinganisa amathrend kwaye wakhe iindlela zokuvelisa iingozi ezibonisiweyo, ukuxazulula imibuzo ye-Presidential Hotline nedayile yamaphando yesahluko 9, ukuququzelela nokubika ngokunikezwa kwebasebenzi abancedisayo kwiNkundla kwiiofisi ezixhasa abaBhalisi, ukulawula ukuqokelelwa kolwazi lwemisebenzi/idatha/ubungakanani ngenjongo yokubika njengoko kumathemu okubika, ukugcina kwaye uvuselele iirejista zendlela yesandla yobungakanani bokuqhuba olubikiweyo, ukulawula, ukuphucula abasebenzi nokuqinisekisa ukulawula jikelele kwabasebenzi. Ukwabelwa imisebenzi kwaye kwenziwe ulawulo lwekhwalithi kwimisebenzi ephiwe ngamaphandla, ukulawula ukukhutshwa kwabasebenzi, ukubakhokela nokuqhuba abo bakhokelwayo ngayo yonke iindlela zomsebenzi, ukulawula ukwenza umsebenzi, indlela nobulungisa kwabasebenzi, ukuqinisekisa ukuba onke abasebenzi bafundise baphuculwe ukuba bakwazi ukunikela umsebenzi owuchanekileyo ngokuphumezekileyo nangokusebenzayo, ukuphucula ukwakha kwaye kulandelwe iinkqubo zomsebenzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza okusebenzayo, ukuphendula iimbuzo kwaye nikezelwe ngolwazi lokuqabelana nolawulo lweempahla.

jobs.title: Registrar
jobs.centre: Western Cape Division of The High Court: Cape Town
jobs.salary_text: R337 563 - R1 155 777 per annum (MR3 - MR5), Salary will be in accordance with Occupation Specific Dispensation (Resolution 1 of 2008). Shortlisted candidates will be required to submit a service certificate/s for determination of their experience. The successful candidate will be required to sign a performance agreement.
jobs.summary: Registrar sought to process default judgments and perform quasi-judicial court functions at the Western Cape High Court in Cape Town.
jobs.requirements: Applicants should be in possession of an LLB Degree or a four (4) year Legal qualification at NQF level eight (8) as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of two (2) years’ experience in legal environment. MR3: LLB Degree or equivalent plus a minimum of 2 years post graduate legal experience. MR4: LLB Degree or equivalent plus minimum of 8 years post graduate legal experience. MR5: LLB Degree or equivalent plus a minimum of 14 years post graduate legal experience. Superior Court of litigation experience and a driver’s license will serve as an added advantage. Knowledge and Skills: Knowledge of Case Flow Management, knowledge of the legislative frameworks governing the public service. Skilled in communication (verbal and written), planning, organising, problem solving, numeracy, conflict management and time management. Along with the following attributes: ability to work under pressure, professionalism, strong work ethics and attention to details.
jobs.duties: Process default judgments to enhance efficiency of the court in handling of quasi- judicial functions, consider applications for default judgment (Rule 31[5]) by applying court rules and regulations, case law, discretion and knowledge, ensure circulation of the outcome to the relevant litigating party, capture and update accurate Default applications register and data tool registered in the Office daily, verify data and submit reporting tool on percentage of default judgments granted by Registrars to the Statistician, execute taxations to enhance efficiency of the court in handling of quasi-judicial functions, determine whether pleadings/ processes comply with the court rules, Tax bills of cost by hearing arguments from the parties and apply discretion and knowledge to the reasonable litigation costs, process and finalise opposed and Unopposed Taxations in accordance with SOP, deal with and finalise taxation reviews (Rule 48) through the drafting of stated cases, replies, and submission to the Judiciary, capture and update accurate Bills of costs registered and data tools in the Office, submit reporting Tool on Taxations to the Statistician, verify data and submit reporting taxations dealt with by Registrars to the Statistician, manage criminal/civil process to enhance efficiency of the court, analyse statistical data to assess trends and devise strategies to address identified risk factors, resolve Presidential Hotline queries and chapter 9 institution enquiries, coordinate and report on the provision of support staff in Court Rooms and Registrars supporting offices, manage the allocation of performance information/ data/ Statistics for purpose of reporting as per Reporting Tools, maintain and update manual registers for Audit of reported Performance information, supervise and develop staff, ensure general supervision of employees, allocate duties and perform quality control on the work delivered by officials, manage leave of staff, advise and lead supervisees with regard to all aspects of the work, manage performance, conduct and discipline of employees, ensure that all employees are trained and developed to be able to deliver work of the required standard efficiently and effectively, develop, implement and monitor work systems and processes to ensure efficient and effective functioning, address enquiries, provide advice and guidance on asset allocation and control.
jobs.enquiries: Technical Related Enquiries: Ms. N Hanekom Tel No: (021) 480 2635 HR Related Enquiries: Mr SD Hlongwane Tel No: (021) 469 4032
jobs.applications: Applications can be sent via email to 2026/105/OCJ@judiciary.org.za
jobs.notes: The Organisation will give preference to candidates in line with the Employment Equity goals. All applications must be submitted on a New Z83 form, which can be downloaded           on        internet       at       www.judiciary.org.za       / www.dpsa.gov.za/dpsa2g/vacancies.asp or obtainable from any Public Service Department and should be accompanied by a recent comprehensive CV only; contactable referees (telephone numbers and email addresses must be indicated). Please send your documents in a PDF and put them in one folder. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other related documents on or before the day of the interview following communication from Human Resources. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Applicants could be required to provide consent for access to their social media accounts. Prior to appointment for SMS, a candidate would be required to complete the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to Senior Management Services as endorsed by DPSA which is an online course, endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into the SMS and the full details can be sourced by the following link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. Each application form must be fully completed, duly signed and initialed on both pages by the applicant. The application must indicate the correct job title, the office where the position is advertised and the reference number as stated in the advert. Failure by the applicant to complete, sign and initial the application form will lead to disqualification of the application during the selection process. Applications on the old Z83 will unfortunately not be considered. Should you be in possession of a foreign qualification, it must be accompanied by an evaluation considered. Suitable candidates will be subjected to a personnel suitability check (criminal record, financial checks, qualification verification, citizenship checks, social media, reference checks and employment verification). Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. The Department reserves the right not to make any appointment(s) to the advertised post(s). Applicants who do not comply with the above-mentioned requirements, as well as applications received late, will not be considered. Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the application not being considered during the selection process. All successful candidates will be expected to enter into an employment contract and a performance agreement within 3 months of appointment, as well as be required to undergo a security clearance three (3) months after appointment. The Office the Chief Justice complies with the provisions of the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA); Act No. 4 of 2013. We will use your personal information provided to us for the purpose of recruitment only and more specifically for the purpose of the position/vacancy you have applied for. In the event that your application was unsuccessful, the Office of the Chief Justice will retain your personal information for internal audit purposes as required by policies. All the information requested now or during the process is required for recruitment purposes. Failure to provide requested information will render your application null and void. The Office of the Chief Justice will safeguard the security and confidentiality of all information you shared during the recruitment process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Registrateur
af.summary: Registrateur gesoek om verstekvonnisse te prosesseer en kwasi-geregtelike hofpligte by die Western Cape High Court in Cape Town uit te voer.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet 'n LLB-graad of 'n vier (4) jaar Regskwalifikasie op NQF-vlak agt (8) soos deur SAQA erken word, hê. 'n Minimum van twee (2) jaar se ondervinding in 'n regsonderwerp. MR3: LLB-graad of ekwivalent plus 'n minimum van 2 jaar se nagraadse regsondervinding. MR4: LLB-graad of ekwivalent plus 'n minimum van 8 jaar se nagraadse regsondervinding. MR5: LLB-graad of ekwivalent plus 'n minimum van 14 jaar se nagraadse regsondervinding. Ondervinding in Hooggeregshof-litigasie en 'n bestuurslisensie sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Kennis en Vaardighede: Kennis van Saakvloei-bestuur, kennis van die wetgewende raamwerke wat die openbare diens regeer. Vaardig in kommunikasie (mondeling en skriftelik), beplanning, organisering, probleemoplossing, syfergeletterdheid, konflikbestuur en tydbestuur. Saam met die volgende eienskappe: vermoë om onder druk te werk, professionaliteit, sterk werksetiek en aandag aan detail.
af.duties: Prosesseer verstekvonnisse om doeltreffendheid van die hof in die hantering van kwasi-geregtelike funksies te verbeter. Oorweeg aansoeke om verstekvonnis (Reël 31[5]) deur hofreëls en -regulasies, case law, diskresie en kennis toe te pas. Verseker sirkulasie van die uitslag aan die relevante litigerende party. Vang en dateer akkurate verstekaansoeke-register en data-instrument wat daagliks in die Kantoor geregistreer is, op. Verifieer data en dien rapporteringsinstrument oor persentasie verstekvonnisse deur Registrateurs toegestaan, by die Statistikus in. Voer belastings uit om doeltreffendheid van die hof in die hantering van kwasi-geregtelike funksies te verbeter. Bepaal of pleidooie/prosesse met die hofreëls voldoen. Belas kosterekennings deur argumente van die partye aan te hoor en diskresie en kennis op redelike litigasiekoste toe te pas. Prosesseer en finaliseer teengesette en onteengesette belastings ooreenkomstig SOP. Hanteer en finaliseer belasting hersienings (Reël 48) deur die opstel van gestelde sake, antwoorde, en voorlegging aan die Regbank. Vang en dateer akkurate kosterekennings geregistreer en data-instrumente in die Kantoor op. Dien rapporteringsinstrument oor belastings by die Statistikus in. Verifieer data en dien rapportering van belastings deur Registrateurs hanteer, by die Statistikus in. Bestuur strafregtelike/siviele prosesse om doeltreffendheid van die hof te verbeter. Analiseer statistiese data om neigings te assesseer en strategieë te bedink om geïdentifiseerde risikofaktore aan te spreek. Los Presidentsleillyne-navrae en navrae van hoofstuk 9-instellings op. Koördineer en rapporteer oor die voorsiening van ondersteuningspersoneel in Hofkamers en Registrateurs se ondersteuningskantore. Bestuur die toekenning van prestasie-inligting/data/statistiek vir doeleindes van verslagdoening soos per Rapporteringsinstrumente. Handhaaf en dateer handmatige registers vir Oudit van gerapporteerde prestasie-inligting. Superviseer en ontwikkel personeel. Verseker algemene toesig oor werknemers. Ken pligte toe en voer kwaliteitsbeheer uit op die werk wat deur amptenare gelewer word. Bestuur verlof van personeel. Adviseer en lei toesighouers rakende alle aspekte van die werk. Bestuur prestasie, gedrag en dissipline van werknemers. Verseker dat alle werknemers opgelei en ontwikkel word om in staat te wees om werk van die vereiste standaard doeltreffend en effektief te lewer. Ontwikkel, implementeer en monitor werkstelsels en -prosesse om doeltreffende en effektiewe funksionering te verseker. Hanteer navrae, verskaf advies en leiding oor bate-toekenning en -beheer.

zu.title: UmBhalisi
zu.summary: Kufunwa umBhalisi ukuze abhape izinkantolo ezingenwa muntu ongavikeli futhi enze imisebenzi yenkantolo ehlukaniswa nabanye kwi-Western Cape High Court eCape Town.
zu.requirements: Abafaka izicelo kumele babe ne-LLB Degree noma nge-minyaka yamane (4) yomthetho ogunyaziwe ezingeni le-NQF level eight (8) njengoba kugunyazwe i-SAQA. Ukuze kube muncu iminyaka emibili (2) yokusebenza emthethweni. MR3: LLB Degree noma okulinganayo kanye nokuba muncu kweminyaka emibili (2) yokusebenza emthethweni ngemva kokuphothula. MR4: LLB Degree noma okulinganayo kanye nokuba muncu kweminyaka eyisishiyagalombili (8) yokusebenza emthethweni ngemva kokuphothula. MR5: LLB Degree noma okulinganayo kanye nokuba muncu kweminyaka eyishiyangombili (14) yokusebenza emthethweni ngemva kokuphothula. Okuhlanganisa inkantolo ephezulu nolwazi lomsebenzi kanye nemvume yokushayela kuzoba ngemiphumela emihle. Ulwazi nemakhono: Ulwazi lokuLawula Ukuphana kwezinkantolo, kanye nolwazi ngemithefho elawula inkonzo kaZwelonke. Kubakhono ekuhumusheni (ngomlomo futhi ngokubhala), ekwelweni, ekulungiseni, ekuqondiseni izinkinga, ekuqondiseni izinamba, ekuqondiseni izingxoxo zomlando kanye nokuqondisa isikhathi. Ukuhlangene nakho okulandelayo: ikhono lokusebenza ngokucindezelwa, ukuthatha izinto ngokungathathi hlangothi, ukuzithoba ngomsebenzi, kanye nokuqapha izinto ezinembile.
zu.duties: Cubungula izinkantolo ezingenwa muntu ongavikeli ukuze kube lula ukusebenza kwenkantolo ekwenzeni imisebenzi eyehlukaniswe nabanikazi bomsebenzi, hlola izicelo zenkantolo ezingenwa muntu ongavikeli (Rule 31[5]) ngokusebenzisa imithetho yenkantolo nemibandela, izinqumo zabenkantolo, abantu abakwaziyo ukwahlulela, kwanela nokwazi, qinisekisa ukuthi iziphetho zifinyelela kubantu abathintekayo, faka futhi uvuselele ngokunembile uhlu lwabangenwayo abangenwa muntu ongavikeli kanye nesithulusi sedatha esibhalwe kwi-Ofisi nsuku zonke, qinisekisa idatha futhi uhlele isithulusi sokubika ngamaphesenti wenkantolo ezingenwa muntu ongavikeli ezinikwa ababhalisiwe kwisezibaluli, phatha izinkokhelo ukuze kube lula ukusebenza kwenkantolo, qinisekisa ukuthi amaphepha nemithefho ihambisana nemithetho yenkantolo, beka izinkokhelo ngokuzwa izinkulumo zabantu bese usebenzisa ukwakwanela ukwazi ukuze uthole izinkokhelo ezifanele zomsebenzi, phatha futhi uqedele izinkokhelo eziphikiswayo noma ezingaphikiswayo ngokuhambisana ne-SOP, phatha futhi uqedele ukubuyiswa kwezinkokhelo (Rule 48) ngokubhala izinkantolo ezichaziwe, izimpendulo, nokuzithumela kwi-Judiciary, faka futhi uvuselele ngokunembile izinkokhelo ezibhalwe kanye nezithulusi zedatha kwi-Ofisi, hlela isithulusi sokubika ngezinkokhelo kwisezibaluli, qinisekisa idatha futhi uhlele ukubika ngabezinkantolo abaphethe izinkokhelo kwisezibaluli, phatha imithefho yobugebengu nyesinyensele ukuze kube lula ukusebenza kwenkantolo, hlaziya idatha yesibalo ukuze kuqondwe ukuthi kuyiphi indlela ephila bese kubakho izindlela zokuphana nengozi eqaphiwe, xazula imibuzo ye-Presidential Hotline nemibuzo yamasiko esahluko 9, lungelelana futhi ube ngumlayezo ngokunikezwa kwabasebenzi abasiza enkantolo nakumahhovisi ababhalisiwe, phatha ukwabiwa kwemininingwane yokusebenza, idatha, noma izibalo ukuze kubikwe ngokwezithulusi zokubika, gcina futhi uvuselele ohlu lwesandla olubhalwa ngemininingwane yokusebenza ebikiwe, qondisa futhi uthuthukise abasebenzi, qinisekisa ukulawulwa kwawo wonke amalungu abasebenzi, abela imisebenzi futhi wenze ukulawula ngobungcono umsebenzi ophenyiwe, phatha ukukhishwa kwabasebenzi, nikela ngeluleko futhi uhola abalawuli ngakho konke okuphathelene nomsebenzi, lawula ukusebenza, ukuziphatha, kanye nenhlalo yolwazi yabasebenzi, qinisekisa ukuthi bonke abasebenzi baholwa futhi bathuthukiswa ukuze bakwazi ukuphuza umsebenzi osemzinganweni ofunekayo kahle futhi ngokusebenza kahle, yakha futhi ulawule futhi uqaphe izinhlelo futhi imithefho ukuze kusebenze kahle futhi ngokusebenza kahle, phendula imibuzo, nikela ngeluleko futhi nomoya ohambisana nokwabiwa nokulawulwa kwempahla.

xh.title: Umali wokubhalisa
xh.summary: Kufunwa umali wokubhalisa ukuba aqhubele phambili izigwebo ezizelekileyo nokuba yenze imisebenzi yenkundla yamacala enjengowekhotane kwiNkundla ePhakamileyo yeNtshona Kapa eCape Town.
xh.requirements: Abafakeli kufuneba benayo i-Degree ye-LLB okanye isidanga sezomthetho esingeminyaka yamane (4) kwinqanaba le-NQF elibhozo (8) njengokuqatshelwa yi-SAQA. Kufuneka abe nobugcisa obungaphantsi kweminyaka emibini (2) bokwenza umsebenzi kwindawo yomthetho. MR3: i-Degree ye-LLB okanye ekingathiyo kunye nobugcisa obungaphantsi kweminyaka emi-2 bokwenza umsebenzi womthetho emva kokuqesha. MR4: i-Degree ye-LLB okanye ekingathiyo kunye nobugcisa obungaphantsi kweminyaka emi-8 bokwenza umsebenzi womthetho emva kokuqesha. MR5: i-Degree ye-LLB okanye ekingathiyo kunye nobugcisa obungaphantsi kweminyaka eli-14 bokwenza umsebenzi womthetho emva kokuqesha. INkundla ePhakamileyo yamava wokuqhuba imicimbi yekhotane kunye nelayisense yokuqhuba iya kuba yinxibelelwano elongezelelweyo. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi lokuLawula ukuHamba kweMiCimbi, ulwazi ngeendlela zomthetho ezilawula inkonzo kaholide. Ukuba nobuchule ekunxibelelwani (ngomlomo nakubhalwe), ekuqukeni, ekuqwalaselweni, ekuxazululeni iingxaki, kwimathematika, ekulawuleni ingxabano nakulawulo lwexesha. Kunye neempawu ezilandelayo: ikholeko lokusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo, ubungcali, iziganeko ezomeleyo zomsebenzi nokuchonga iinkcukacha.
xh.duties: Qhubela phambili izigwebo ezizelekileyo ukuze kuphuculwe isiseko sekontile ekuphathweni kwemisebenzi engajengomthetho, qwalasela iimvume zezigwebo ezizelekileyo (Rule 31[5]) ngokusebenzisa iirhula nokumiso zekhotane, umthetho wamacala, isigqibo nolwazi, qinisekisa ukusasazwa kwesiphumo kumacandu ach relevant anayo ekhotane, bamba uzeuhlaziye ngokuchanekileyo irejista yeemvume jobs.title: Registrars Clerk
jobs.centre: Gauteng Division of The High Court: Johannesburg
jobs.salary_text: R237 453 - R279 708 per annum (Level 05). The successful candidate will be required to sign a performance agreement.
jobs.summary: A Grade 12 clerk is sought for the Gauteng High Court in Johannesburg to handle case file registration, allocation and administrative duties at salary level 5.
jobs.requirements: Applicants should be in possession of a Grade 12 Certificate or equivalent qualification at NQF level four (4) as recognised by SAQA. No experience required. A valid driver’s License will serve as an added advantage. Knowledge and Skills: Knowledge of working procedures in terms of the working environment, knowledge of registry processes and practice, knowledge of storage and retrieval procedures in terms of the working environment, knowledge and understanding of legislative frameworks governing the Public Service, knowledge of Filling system, Mail procedure manual, Promotion of access to information Act and National archives and Batho Pele Principles. Skilled in computer literacy (Microsoft Office), communication, numeracy, interpersonal relations, problem solving, analysis, time management and administration. Along with the following attributes: ability to work under pressure, self-motivated, accuracy, ability to work independently, attention to detail, teamwork and flexible.
jobs.duties: Perform clerical and administrative work within the court: Register/ allocate case numbers to all pleadings and court documents received, ensure that the files have been served on all parties concerned, draw up files for the litigants/Attorney, update the file of return service/s proof services, safe-keep and dispose of case records, handle court’s request files, retrieve the requested files and make the file available to the requester, attend to queries from parties and members of the public, record documents received, ensure systematically recording of court files, keep record of requests received from litigants, render case management duties, attend to case management and set down notice, implement case management practices (placing request forms in the space of a file that has been requested, complete and file the movement sheet), monitor files and records as per the case Management, provide support with administrative registrar, submit leave forms to HR for compliance, maintain and keep all registers for filing and archiving, comply with the telephone prescripts and leave policies, prepare and sign performance agreement timeously.
jobs.enquiries: Technical Related Enquiries: Mr T Musana Tel No: (010) 494 8403/8402 HR Related Enquiries: Ms T Mbalekwa Tel No: (010) 494 8515

Please send your documents in a PDF and put them in one folder. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other related documents on or before the day of the interview following communication from Human Resources. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Applicants could be required to provide consent for access to their social media accounts. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. The Department reserves the right not to make any appointment(s) to the advertised post(s). Applicants who do not comply with the above-mentioned requirements, as well as applications received late, will not be considered. Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the application not being considered during the selection process. All successful candidates will be expected to enter into an employment contract and a performance agreement within 3 months of appointment, as well as be required to undergo a security clearance three (3) months after appointment. The Office the Chief Justice complies with the provisions of the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA); Act No. 4 of 2013. af.title: Registrasieklerk
af.summary: 'n Graad 12-klerk word gesoek vir die Gauteng Hooggeregshof in Johannesburg om saaklêerregistrasie, toewysing en administratiewe pligte te behartig op salarisvlak 5.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie op NQF-vlak vier (4) soos deur SAQA erken, hê. Geen ervaring vereis nie. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van werksprosedures binne die werksomgewing, kennis van registerprosesse en -praktyke, kennis van berging en onttrekkingsprosedures binne die werksomgewing, kennis en begrip van wetgewende raamwerke wat die Openbare Diens regeer, kennis van die lêerstelsel, Posprosedurehandboek, Bevordering van toegang tot inligting-wet en Nasionale argiewe en Batho Pele-beginsels. Vaardig in rekenaargeletterdheid (Microsoft Office), kommunikasie, syfergeletterdheid, interpersoonlike verhoudings, probleemoplossing, analise, tydbestuur en administrasie. Saam met die volgende eienskappe: vermoë om onder druk te werk, selfgemotiveerd, akkuraatheid, vermoë om onafhanklik te werk, aandag aan besonderhede, spanwerk en buigsaamheid.
af.duties: Voer klerklike en administratiewe werk binne die hof uit: Registreer/ wys saaknommers toe aan alle pleitstukke en hofdokumente wat ontvang is, verseker dat die lêers op alle betrokke partye betrek is, stel lêers op vir litigante/Prokureurs, werk die lêer van betekening van proses/ bewys van diens by, bewaar en beskik oor saakrekords, hanteer die hof se aanvraaglêers, haal die aangevraagde lêers op en maak die lêer beskikbaar aan die aanvrager, skakel navrae van partye en lede van die publiek na, teken ontvang dokumente aan, verseker sistematiese optekening van hoflêers, hou rekord van versoeke wat van litigante ontvang is, lewer saakbestuurspligte, skenk aandag aan saakbestuur en vasstelling van kennisgewings, implementeer saakbestuurspraktyke (plaas aanvraagvorms in die plek van 'n lêer wat aangevra is, vul die bewegingsblad in en lê dit weg), monitor lêers en rekords ooreenkomstig die saakbestuur, verskaf administratiewe registrateurondersteuning, dien verlofvorms by HR in vir nakoming, onderhou en hou alle registers vir lêer en argivering, voldoen aan die telefoondirektiewes en verlofbeleide, berei tydig die prestasie-ooreenkoms voor en teken dit.

zu.title: Umlobi we-Registrars
zu.summary: Kufunwa umlobi we-Grade 12 osebenza eGauteng High Court eJohannesburg ukuphatha ubhaliso lwamafayela wamacala, ukuqabelanisa nemisebenzi yokuqashelisa engekhona emshwameni ohola izinga 5.
zu.requirements: Abafaka izicelo kufanele babe nesitifikedi se-Grade 12 noma iziqu ezingabalinganayo ezingeni le-NQF level four (4) njengoba kunconywa u-SAQA. Akukho mkhuba odingiwe. Ilayisensi evumelekile yokushayela izoba yinzuzo ekungeyona efanayo. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi lwenqubo yokusebenza ngokwesimo sezulu sokusebenza, ulwazi lwenqubo zokugcina amaphepha kanye nokuzijwayeza, ulwazi lwenqubo zokulondoloza nokubuyisa kabusha ngokwesimo sezulu sokusebenza, ulwazi nokuqonda izimiso ezibusula ukusebenza komnyango kahulumeni, ulwazi lwenqubo yokugcwalisa amaphepha, imanuali yohlelo lweposi, umthetho wokuthuthukisa ukufinyelela kwolwazi kanye nomthetho wolwazi wesibili kanye Nemisela ye-Batho Pele. Ubuchwepheshe ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha (Microsoft Office), ukuxhumana, ukubala, ubudlelwano bantu, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuhlaziya, ukuphatha isikhathi nokuphatha. Kanye nezimpawu ezilandelayo: ikono lokusebenza ngaphansi komfutho, ukuzimisela, ukunembeza, ikono lokusebenza ngokuzimela, ukuqaphela izinto ezincane, ukusebenza njengoba iqembu kanye nokuguquguquka.
zu.duties: Qeqesha umsebenzi wekhompyutha futhi uphathe imisebenzi engaphakathi komnyango kahulumeni. Hlola / qabelanisa izinhlelo zokubhaliswa kwamacala emaphepha nawomagama wamacala atholwe noma okungenani amaphuzu amakhulu, qinisekisa ukuthi wonke amaphepha athunyelwe emaphaketheni; sela amapheshana ibanga kubaphathi / abameli, buyisela kabusha amaphepha wokuhanjiswa kwezinsiza, gcina kwakho futhi ulahle ngemibusela; phatha izinsiza zamaphepha ekhonzo lesikhungo, buyisela amaphepha noma imibusela ibheke olwandle ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Qeqesha imibuzo emaphepha kubantu bakaHulumeni nohlelo lokuphathwa kwamacala, qinisekisa ukuthi kuye kwenzeke ukulalelwa kolwazi olutholakalayo, gcina ukulalelwa kwamaphepha asephathini, phatha imisebenzi yokuphathwa kwamacala, qinisekisa ukuphathwa kwamacala kanye nezaziso zokubekwa emhlabeni, setha izinkinga ezihole ekwakheni inqubo yokulawula amaphroxy ezinkomba zolwazi oluhlelwe ukuvumela ukukhetha amalungu okuhlela; qinisekisa ukuvuleka kolwazi ngaphakathi kwesikhathi, gcina kanti noma isikhathi esithile ukwenza ukusetshenziswa kwamacala namaphasela emagama alahlekelwe ngaphandle noma agqokwa ngaphandle kwelizwe, vumela ukusetshenziswa kolwazi emaphepha, qinisekisa ukwenziwa kwenqubo yokuphathwa kwamacala esikhundleni esibekiwe, hlela futhi usayine isivumelwano sokwenzeka ngokushesha.

ULwazi neKhono: Ulwazi ngemigaqo yokusebenza ngokwemizi esisebenza kuyo, ulwazi lweenkqubo zokubhalisa nokuzilolonga, ulwazi lweenkqubo zokugcina nokuphinda kuthathe iinkcukacha ngokwemizi esisebenza kuyo, ulwazi nokuqonda iinkqubo zomthetho ezilawula inkonzo kaRhulumende, ulwazi lwenkqubo yokuzaliswa kolwazi, incwadana yendlela yeposi, uMthetho wokukhuthaza unikezelo kolwazi noMthetho weziko lokuGcina amafa kulawulo kwiArchive yaseNingizimu Afrika nemiGaqo yeBatho Pele. Ukukrelekrele ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha (Microsoft Office), ekuNdululeni ulwazi, kwamanani, ekuHlobaneni nabantu, ekuXazululeni iingxaki, ekuLuhlazulula ulwazi, ekuLawuleni ixesha nokuLawulwa. Kunye neempawu ezilandelayo: ikhono lokusebenza ngexesha elinzima, ukuzimotela, ukuchaneka, ikhono lokusebenza yedwa, ukuchaza iinkcukacha, ukusebenza njengeqela kwaye uyakwazi ukwabela.
xh.duties: Kwenza umsebenzi wolawulo nolwesikolo eNkundleni yamacala: UkuBhalisa/ukwaba iinombolo zemicambi kuyo yonke imibhalo nemiqulu yenkundla efunyenweyo, kuQinisekiswe ukuba iifayile zininikwe kuwo onke amaqela achaphazelekayo, ukuKhulula iifayile kubaphi/magqirha, ukunQwela iifayile ze nkqubo yokubuyisa inkonazo/inkqubo yokuqinisekisa inkonazo, kuGcinwe kwaye kutsitywe iirekhodi zemacala, ukuSebenza ngefayile eceliweyo yenkundla, ukuZithabatha iifayile eziceliweyo kwaye uzenze zibonelele umceli, ukuPhendula imibuzo eqhumayo kumacala kwaye kwabathengi bokarhulumende, kuBhalwe imibhalo efunyenweyo, uQinisekisa ubhalo olulandelelanayo lweefayile zenkundla, ukuGcina irekhodi yemicebo efunyenweyo kubaphi, ukunikezela ngemisebenzi yokulawula imicambi, kuPhendula ekulawuleni imicambi kwaye icacise izaziso, ukuzalisa iinkqubo zokulawula imicambi (ukubeka iifomu zokucela kwithuba sefayile eceliweyo, ukuze igqitshwe kwaye ifakwe iphepha lokushukuma), ukuQaphela iifayile neerekhodi njengoko kulawulwa imaCala, ukunika inkxaso ngumlawuli wezicwangciso, ukunikela ngeefomu zeholide kwi-HR ngokuqhinelana nokulawula, ukugcina nokuPhatha iirejista zonke zokubhalisa nokugcina, ukuqhinelana nemiyalelo yefowuni namagqabantshintshi eholide, ukulungisa kwaye usayine isivumelwano senkonzo ngexesha elifanelekileyo.

jobs.title: Administration Clerk: Asset Controller
jobs.centre: Western Cape Division of The High Court: Cape Town
jobs.salary_text: R237 453 - R279 708 per annum (Level 05). The successful candidate will be required to sign a performance agreement.
jobs.summary: Asset controller clerk needed at the High Court in Cape Town to maintain the asset register, allocate assets and conduct physical verifications.
jobs.requirements: Applicants should be in possession of a Grade 12 certificate or equivalent qualification at NQF level four (4) as recognised by SAQA. No experience is required. A valid driver’s license will serve as an added advantage. Knowledge and skills: Knowledge of Public Service Finance Management Act (PFMA), PPPFA, BBB_EE Act and Treasury Regulations, In-depth knowledge of financial systems, e.g. LOGIS. Skilled in planning, organising, interpersonal relations, communication (written and verbal) and computer literacy. Along with the following attributes: ability to work independently and meet deadlines, ability to work under pressure, work in a team and preparedness to work overtime when required.
jobs.duties: Render efficient and effective support to the court, facilitate the maintenance of a complete, reliable, and accurate asset register for the Departmental owned assets, allocate assets as per purchasing request, conduct physical verification of assets in line with asset management policy and procedures to ensure the existence of assets as well as completeness of the asset register, identify and report stolen or lost assets and unserviceable, redundant, damaged, underperforming, and obsolete assets, monitor leased assets register and expiring contracts.
jobs.enquiries: Technical Related Enquiries: Mr SD Hlongwane Tel No: (012) 482 3809 HR Related Enquiries: Mr SD Hlongwane Tel No: (012) 482 3809
jobs.applications: Applications can be sent via email to 2026/108/OCJ@judiciary.org.za
jobs.notes: The Organisation will give preference to candidates in line with the Employment Equity goals. All applications must be submitted on a New Z83 form, which can be downloaded           on        internet       at       www.judiciary.org.za       / www.dpsa.gov.za/dpsa2g/vacancies.asp or obtainable from any Public Service Department and should be accompanied by a recent comprehensive CV only; contactable referees (telephone numbers and email addresses must be indicated). Please send your documents in a PDF and put them in one folder. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other related documents on or before the day of the interview following communication from Human Resources. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Applicants could be required to provide consent for access to their social media accounts. Prior to appointment for SMS, a candidate would be required to complete the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to Senior Management Services as endorsed by DPSA which is an online course, endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into the SMS and the full details can be sourced by the following link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. Each application form must be fully completed, duly signed and initialed on both pages by the applicant. The application must indicate the correct job title, the office where the position is advertised and the reference number as stated in the advert. Applications on the old Z83 will unfortunately not be considered. Should you be in possession of a foreign qualification, it must be accompanied by an evaluation considered. Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the application not being considered during the selection process. All successful candidates will be expected to enter into an employment contract and a performance agreement within 3 months of appointment, as well as be required to undergo a security clearance three (3) months after appointment. The Office the Chief Justice complies with the provisions of the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA); Act No. 4 of 2013. We will use your personal information provided to us for the purpose of recruitment only and more specifically for the purpose of the position/vacancy you have applied for. af.title: Administrasieklerk: Batebeheerder
af.summary: Batebeheerklerk benodig by die Hooggeregshof in Cape Town om die bate-register te onderhou, bates toe te ken en fisiese verifikasies uit te voer.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie op NQF-vlak vier (4) soos deur SAQA erken, hê. Geen ervaring word vereis nie. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van die Public Service Finance Management Act (PFMA), PPPFA, BBB_EE Act en Treasury Regulations, diepgaande kennis van finansiële stelsels, bv. LOGIS. Bedrewe in beplanning, organisasie, interpersoonlike verhoudings, kommunikasie (skriftelik en mondeling) en rekenaarvaardigheid. Sowel as die volgende eienskappe: vermoë om onafhanklik te werk en sperdatums te haal, vermoë om onder druk te werk, in 'n span te werk en bereidwilligheid om oortyd te werk wanneer vereis.
af.duties: Lewer doeltreffende en effektiewe ondersteuning aan die hof, fasiliteer die instandhouding van 'n volledige, betroubare en akkurate bate-register vir die Departement se eie bates, ken bates toe volgens aankoopversoeke, voer fisiese verifikasie van bates uit in ooreenstemming met batebestuursbeleid en prosedures om die bestaan van bates sowel as die volledigheid van die bate-register te verseker, identifiseer en rapporteer gesteelde of verlore bates en onbruikbare, oortollige, beskadigde, onderpresterende en verouderde bates, monitor die gehuurde bates-register en vervallende kontrakte.

zu.title: Ikilaki loKuphathwa kwabasebenzi: Umlawuli Wezimpahla
zu.summary: Kudingeka ikilaki elawula izimpahla eNkantolo Ephakamayo e-Cape Town ukugcina ibuko lezimpahla, ukubeza izimpahla kanye nokwenza ukwahlulela okokoqobo.
zu.requirements: Abafakisi kumele babe nesitifiketi se-Grade 12 noma izifundo ezingabalinganiswa ezinganeni i-NQF level four (4) njengoba eqashelwe i-SAQA. Akukho okuhlolwayo noma okungenwa isipiliyoni. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile izoba yinza engeza inzuzo. Ulwazi namateka: Ulwazi ngomthetho we-Public Service Finance Management Act (PFMA), i-PPPFA, umthetho we-BBB_EE Act kanye nezimiso ze-Treasury Regulations, ulwazi olujulile mayelana nezinhlelo zezezimali, isb. i-LOGIS. Ubuchwepheshe ekwelaphula, ekuhleleleni, ema sixhulumeni phakathi kwabantu, ekuxhumaneni (okubhaliwe nokuvela emlonyeni) kanye nolwazi ngokusebenzisa isicompyutha. Ngokuhambisana nalezo zinto ezilandelayo: ikono lokusebenza kodwa futhi nokuhlangabezana namasonti okuvalwa, ikono lokusebenza ngengcindezi, ukusebenza esiqhingini kanye nokuzibophezela ekusebenzeni ngaphezamuva yesikhathi lapho kucelwa.
zu.duties: Nikela ngelelo elisebenzayo nokusiza inkantolo, nqumela ukugcinwa kwesibuko sezimpahla esiphelele, esithembekile, nesiqinisekile sezimpahla ezingeyakho umnyango, abeza izimpahla njengoba kunconywa isicelo sokuthenga, yenza ukwahlulela okokoqobo izimpahla ngokuhambisana nomthetho wezimpahla nendlela yokusebenza ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba khona kwalezo zimpahla kanye nokuphela kwebuko lezimpahla, qapha futhi umbule izimpahla ezibyiwe noma ezilahlekile nezimpahla ezingasebenzi, ezigqamile, ezonakele, ezingaphumeleli, kanye nalezo esesikhathi. Qapha isibuko sezimpahla eziqashiwe namasonti aphelelwe isikhathi.

xh.title: Iklerk yolawulo: UmLawuli weziAsetu
xh.summary: Kufuneka iklerk yolawuli weziasetu eNkundla eNkulu eCape Town ukugcina irekhodi leziasetu, ukwabela iziasetu nokwenza uqinisekiso lwasemzimbeni.
xh.requirements: Iingxaki kufuneka zibe nesatifikethi seGrade 12 okanye isiqinisekiso esilinganayo kwinqanaba leNQF elingunani (4) njengoko evunywe yiSAQA. Akukho nqubo yomsebenzi efunekayo. Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba egunyaziwe iya kuba ngomdla ongaphezulu. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi ngomthetho wePublic Service Finance Management Act (PFMA), iPPPFA, umthetho weBBB_EE Act namalawu eTreasury, ulwazi olujulile ngezintlobo zemali, umz. iLOGIS. Ukwazi ukuceba, ukuqamba, ubudlelwane phakathi kwabantu, unxibelelwano (olubhaliweyo noluthethwayo) nokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Kunye nempawu ezilandelayo: ikholo lokusebenza kodwa nokuhlangabezana nemihla yokupela, ikholo lokusebenza ngoxinzelelo, ukusebenza nqamlelana nokulungele ukusebenza ixesha elongezelelweyo xa kufuneka.
xh.duties: Nika inkundla inkxaso eqinisekisayo nesebenzayo, qhuba ukugcinwa korekhodi leziasetu elizeleyo, elithembekileyo, elichanekileyo leziasetu ezinikelwa yisebe, wabe iziasetu njengoko kucelwa ngokusetyenziswa, yenza uqinisekiso olusemzimbeni lweziasetu ngokwemigaqo nokuqhuba kolawulo lweziasetu ukuqinisekisa ukuba zikho iziasetu nakwindalo elizeleyo yerekhodi leziasetu, qamba wanike izwi ngeziasetu eziphushiweyo okanye ezilahlekileyo nangeziasetu ezingasebenzisekiyo, ezingadingekiyo, ezonakaliswe kwaye ezingazange zenze kwaye ezilahlekileyo, qhatha irekhodi leziasetu ezeziweyo namagqabi aqhelezayo aphela.

zu.requirements: Abafakeli kumele babe nesitifiketi se-Grade 12 noma izifundo ezilinganayo ezingeni le-NQF level four (4) njengobaqashwa yi-SAQA. Akukho mkhondo odingekayo. Ulwazi Nobuhlakani: Ulwazi oluyisisekelo ngemikhuba yokuphathwa, ukulawula amarekhodi kanye ne-Batho Pele Principles, ulwazi ngamasistimu kahulumeni nesakhiwo somthetho ohambisanana nowasezikhungweni zikahulumeni. Ubugcwele ekusebenziseni ikhompuyutha ngekhono ekusebenziseni i-Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook ne-PowerPoint, ukubala ngemibhalo, ukuxhumana ngokukhulunywa nokubhalwa, ubudlelwano nabathintekayo nesevisi yamakhasimende, ukuhlela, ukulungiselela ukusebenza ngexesha kanye nobuhlakani bokuxazulula iingxaki. Kwaye kufuneka abe nokuqonda okulandelayo: ikhono lokugcina imfihlo, ukunaka iinkcukacha, ikhono lokusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo nokugqiba umsebenzi ngexesha, ikhono lokusebenza kakuhle njengesabelo sethimba, ikhono lokwenza imisebenzi yokuphathwa nezomzimba wesikhundla.
zu.duties: Nikeza inkxaso esezokuphathwa kwi-Directorate ye-Judicial Remuneration and Conditions of Service, nikeza inkxaso ekuphathweni kweholo neenzuzo zokusebenza kwabajudi abathathwa njengabashaqileyo kwanabathi balawulwe ngokungenisa isigqibo,abajudi ababoshiweyo nabanomzanyi oshonileyo, nceda ekuphathweni kwezibonelelo kwabajudi abasasebenzayo,abajudi abaphumayo kwanabanomzanyi oshonileyo, qamba uhlaziye ulwazi ngeenkonzo zokuhola nenzuzo kulasistimu kahulumeni, nceda ngemisebenzi ehambisana nokuqeswa kwezithuthi ezisemthethweni, wamkele, babhale, ugcine kwaye wabelane amaxwebhu nolwazi oluhamba nabo, gcina inkqubo yokubhala kwezangaphakathi nezisezikhompuyutheni yamarekhodi, phendula imibuzo evamile evela kubathintekayo bangaphakathi nangaphandle, nceda ekulungiseleleni amaxwebhu aqhelekileyo, iingxelo naxwebhu okunye okusezokuphathweni kwaye wenze imisebenzi yezokuphathwa ngokubekelwe nguMphathi.

Ukuba nobuchule ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha ngokubanzi kwaye ukwazi kakuhle ukusebenzisa iMicrosoft Word, Excel, Outlook nePowerPoint, ukuba nobuchule ekubalweni, nasekubonakaliseni nasekubhalweni intetho, ukuqhathanisa nabantu nokukonza abaxhasi, ukuqamba, ukuqulunqa nokulawula ixesha kunye nobuchule bokuxazulula iingxaki.
