xh.duties: Nikeza inkxaso yolawulo kwiDirectorate yoMvuzo wabaGwebi neMiqathango yesebenzo, nikeza inkxaso kulawulo lomvuzo neenzuzo zesebenzo zabagwebi abasebenza njengabathathu kwindalo kwaye abagwebi abathi babekiweyo ngokusisigxina, abagwebi ababekhutshiweyo kwaye nabalingani abasaleleyo, nceda kulawulo lomvuzo wentsomsu abagwebi abasemsebenzini, abagwebi abasatshatayo kwaye nabalingani abasaleleyo, tsala kwaye uhlaziye ulwazi ngomvuzo neenzuzo zesebenzo kwisixhobo karhulumente, nceda namagqabantshintshi olawulo athintela ukuthenga izithuthi ezisemthethweni, amukele, ubhalise, urekhode, ugcine kwaye wahlule ixatso namagqabantshintshi, gcina amafayile angokuziintsomi kwaye eskhanyelo kunye namandulo olawulo lwerekhodi, phendula imibuzo eqhelekileyo evela kubantu abangaphakathi naphandle, nceda kulungiselelo lweekhomityisi eziqhelekileyo, iingxelo namaxatso olawulo kwaye wenze imisebenzi yolawulo ngokubanzi njengoko iyalelwe ngumlawuli.

jobs.title: Data Capturer
jobs.centre: Gauteng Division of The High Court: Johannesburg
jobs.salary_text: R201 093 – R236 877 per annum (Level 04). The successful candidate will be required to sign a performance agreement.
jobs.summary: Data Capturer needed at the Gauteng High Court in Johannesburg to capture, verify and maintain data in databases and spreadsheets.
jobs.requirements: Applicants should be in possession of a Grade 12 certificate or equivalent qualification at NQF level four (4) as recognised by SAQA. No experience required. A valid drivers’ license will serve as an added advantage. Knowledge and skills: Knowledge of clerical duties, practices as well as the ability to capture data, Batho Pele principles, knowledge of working procedures in terms of the working environment. Skilled in communication (written and verbal), interpersonal relations, computer literacy, customer services, planning, organising, problem solving, analytical skills, numerary. Along with the following attributes: ability to work under pressure, flexible, be motivated, meticulous and be self-driven.
jobs.duties: Capture data from available records into the required formats e.g. databases, table, spreadsheet, verify missing data and errors observed during data entry, review and validate all data from the records, submit data and make regular backups of data, update registers and statistics, keep and maintain records and files, ensure records and files are properly sorted and secured, provide information to components, provide support to the verification personnel with availing data sources required and files, collect correspondence from general office, distribute files and correspondence to Registrars, provide any other support as required by the judiciary, Court Manager and/or supervisor, provide information to responsible components, keep and maintain records and files in an organised method, ensure that all case records/court documents for data capturing are kept safely while in your possession, attend to Attorneys queries with respect to quasi-judicial matters, review and validate all data from the files, open files, sort and distribute incoming data to be captured equally, update registers and statistics.
jobs.enquiries: Technical Related Enquiries: Mr T Musana Tel No: (010) 494 8403 HR Related Enquiries: Ms T Mbalekwa Tel No: (010) 494 8515
jobs.applications: Applications can be sent via email to 2026/111/OCJ@judiciary.org.za
jobs.notes: The Organisation will give preference to candidates in line with the Employment Equity goals. All applications must be submitted on a New Z83 form, which can be downloaded           on        internet       at       www.judiciary.org.za       / www.dpsa.gov.za/dpsa2g/vacancies.asp or obtainable from any Public Service Department and should be accompanied by a recent comprehensive CV only; contactable referees (telephone numbers and email addresses must be indicated). Please send your documents in a PDF and put them in one folder. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other related documents on or before the day of the interview following communication from Human Resources. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Applicants could be required to provide consent for access to their social media accounts. Prior to appointment for SMS, a candidate would be required to complete the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to Senior Management Services as endorsed by DPSA which is an online course, endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into the SMS and the full details can be sourced by the following link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. Each application form must be fully completed, duly signed and initialed on both pages by the applicant. The application must indicate the correct job title, the office where the position is advertised and the reference number as stated in the advert. Failure by the applicant to complete, sign and initial the application form will lead to disqualification of the application during the selection process. Applications on the old Z83 will unfortunately not be considered. Should you be in possession of a foreign qualification, it must be accompanied by an evaluation considered. Suitable candidates will be subjected to a personnel suitability check (criminal record, financial checks, qualification verification, citizenship checks, social media, reference checks and employment verification). Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. The Department reserves the right not to make any appointment(s) to the advertised post(s). Applicants who do not comply with the above-mentioned requirements, as well as applications received late, will not be considered. Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the application not being considered during the selection process. All successful candidates will be expected to enter into an employment contract and a performance agreement within 3 months of appointment, as well as be required to undergo a security clearance three (3) months after appointment. The Office the Chief Justice complies with the provisions of the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA); Act No. 4 of 2013. We will use your personal information provided to us for the purpose of recruitment only and more specifically for the purpose of the position/vacancy you have applied for. In the event that your application was unsuccessful, the Office of the Chief Justice will retain your personal information for internal audit purposes as required by policies. All the information requested now or during the process is required for recruitment purposes. Failure to provide requested information will render your application null and void. The Office of the Chief Justice will safeguard the security and confidentiality of all information you shared during the recruitment process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Data Vanger
af.summary: Data Vanger benodig by die Gauteng Hooggeregshof in Johannesburg om data in databasisse en sigblaaie vas te lê, te verifieer en te onderhou.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie op NQF-vlak vier (4) soos deur SAQA erken, hê. Geen ondervinding nodig. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van klerklike pligte, praktyke asook die vermoë om data vas te lê, Batho Pele-beginsels, kennis van werksprosedures ten opsigte van die werksomgewing. Bedrewe in kommunikasie (skriftelik en mondelings), interpersoonlike verhoudings, rekenaarvaardigheid, kliëntediens, beplanning, organiseer, probleemoplossing, analitiese vaardighede, syferkundigheid. Saam met die volgende eienskappe: vermoë om onder druk te werk, buigsaam, gemotiveerd, noukeurig en selfgedrewe wees.
af.duties: Vang data van beskikbare rekords in die vereiste formate vas bv. databasisse, tabel, sigblad, verifieer ontbrekende data en foute wat tyens datavastlegging waargeneem word, hersien en bevestig alle data van die rekords, dien data in en maak gereelde rugsteunkopieë van data, werk registers en statistieke by, hou en onderhou rekords en lêers, verseker rekords en lêers is behoorlik gesorteer en beveilig, verskaf inligting aan komponente, verskaf ondersteuning aan die verifikasiepersoneel met die beskikbaarmaking van benodigde databronne en lêers, versamel korrespondensie van die algemene kantoor, versprei lêers en korrespondensie aan Registrateurs, verskaf enige ander ondersteuning soos deur die regbank, Hofbestuurder en/of toesighouer vereis, verskaf inligting aan verantwoordelike komponente, hou en onderhou rekords en lêers op 'n georganiseerde wyse, verseker dat alle saakrekords/hofdokumente vir datavastlegging veilig gehou word terwyl dit in jou besit is, hanteer Prokureurs se navrae ten opsigte van kwasi-geregtelike aangeleenthede, hersien en bevestig alle data van die lêers, open lêers, sorteer en versprei inkomende data om eweredig vasgelê te word, werk registers en statistieke by.

zu.title: Umbambi Wezinsiza
zu.summary: Kudingeka Umbambi Wezinsiza e-Gauteng High Court e-Johannesburg ukuze abambe, aqiniseke futhi agcine izinsiza kumadatabheyisi nakumaspredishithi.
zu.requirements: Abafakwayo kufanele ukuthi babe ne-Gramu 12 certificate noma izifundo ezalinganayo ezingeni le-NQF four (4) njengokuthiwa yi-SAQA. Akukho mbangomuzwa odingekayo. I-drivers' license esebenzayo izoba yithuba elengeziwe. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yabakhiqizi, izinqubo kanye namandla okubamba izinsiza, izimiso ze-Batho Pele, ulwazi ngemisebenzi yokusebenza ngokomthetho wendawo yokusebenza. Unesipho sokuxhumana (okulotshiwe nokuKhulunywa), ubudlelwano nabantu, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ukukhonza abathengi, ukucubungula, ukuhlela, ukuxazulula izinkinga, amakhono okuhlaziya, ukubala. Kanye nezimfanelo ezilandelayo: ikono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwegcinusizi, ukuguquguquka, ukuzethemba, ukunakekelana kakhulu nokuziqhuba ngokwakho.
zu.duties: Bamba izinsiza ezivela emarekhodimukhona osuke ukhona kumafomethi adingekayo njengamadatabheyisi, ithebula, spredishithi, qinisekisa izinsiza ezishodiwe namaphutha abonakaliswa ngesikhathi sokufaka izinsiza, hlola futhi uqinisekise yonke imininingwane evela emarekhodini, hambisa izinsiza futhi wenze i-backups ezivamile zezinsiza, buyekeza amarekhisidi namarithistikhi, gcine futhi ulondoloze amarekhodi namafayela, qinisekisa ukuthi amarekhodi namafayela ahlelwe kahle futhi avikelekile, nikeza imininingwane kwizinhlanga, nika inkusekelo abasebenza ngokuqinisekisa ngokuzinikela amathuba ezinsiza adingekayo namafayela, butsana ukuqoshisa kwezikhungo ejimeneli, sabisa amafayela nokuqoshisela kwa-Registrars, nikeza okunye okusekelo njengoba kudingeka yisibonelo, Court Manager noma omphathi, nikeza imininingwane kwizinhlanga ezibhekele, gcine futhi ulondoloze amarekhodi namafayela ngendlela ehleliwe, qinisise ukuthi yonke imirekhodi yamacala/amadokhumenti enkolo okuzoba izinsiza zigcinwe ngokuphepha uma usesandleni sakho, hlangabezana namaphuzu ka-Attorneys ngomuzwa wemicabango enezinkantolo eziphathwa, hlolela futhi uqinisekise yonke imininingwane evela kwamafayela, vula amafayela, hlela futhi sabisa imininingwane engenayo okuzobe njengoba kulingana, buyekeza amarekhisidi namarithistikhi.

xh.title: Umtheleli weData
xh.summary: Kufunekwa umtheleli weData eGauteng High Court eJohannesburg ukuyalela, kuqinisekise kugcinwe idata kumabala wasekhaya kunye namaphepha e-odolo.
xh.requirements: Abafaka izicelo kufuneka babe nesatifikethi seGrade 12 okanye ngesiphelo esilinganayo kwinqanaba le-NQF eline four (4) njengoko kubonwa yi-SAQA. Akukho mfundo yemisebenzi efunekayo. Ilayisensi yokuqhayisa elisebenzayo iya kuba lusizo olongeziweyo. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yobhala, iindlela zayo kunye namandla okuyalela idata, iimfuno ze-Batho Pele, ulwazi ngamacebo okusebenza ngokwendalo yendawo yokusebenza. Ubuchule kuncam (olubhalwayo noluthethwayo), ubudlelwane nabantu, ulwazi lokusebenza ngekhompyutha, iinkonzo zabathengi, ukulungiselela, ukuqamba, ukusombulula iingxaki, amakhono okuhlalutya, ukubala. Kwididi leempawu ezilandelayo: amandla okusebenza phantsi koxinzelelo, ukuguquguquka, ukuzimotivatha, ukucinga ngocoselelo nokuzinqubela ngokwakho.
xh.duties: Yalela idata ezimagqibini ezikhoyo kwimilo efunekayo nje. abala wasekhaya, itafile, amaphepha e-odolo, qinisekisa idata engekho namaphoso abonakalayo ngelixa kuyalelwa idata, phawula ukuqinisekisa yonke idata ezimagqibini, thumela idata kwenze iinkqubo zokuzithengela ngokutsha idata ngamaxesha athile, hlaziya amagqibi nestatistiki, gcina uqokelele imabala namagqiba, qinisekisa ukuba imagqibi namagqiba ahleliwe kakuhle ayikho sengozini, nikeze ulwazi kumacandelo, nikeze inkxaso abantu bokuqinisekisa ngokuthi bakhulule iimveliso zamagqiba efunekayo namagqiba, khangela imibhalo eofisini jikelele, sasaza amagqiba nemibhalo ku-Registrars, nikeze naluphi na usizo olunye njengoko kufunwa y ayure, u-Registrar weNkundla kunye/nom lawuli wokusebenza, nikeze ulwazi kumacandelo achathelele ekuthini abizwe, gcina uqokelele imabala namagqiba ngenkqubo econdileyo, qinisekisa ukuba yonke imabala yamacala/amaxwebhu enkundla ayalelelwa idata zigcinwe ngokhuselekileyo nangasentlango lwakho, phendula imibuzo yama-Attorneys ngemiba evela enkundleni, phawula ukuqinisekisa yonke idata emagqibeni, vula amagqiba, hlela usasaze idata engenayo ukuyalelwa ngokulinganayo, hlaziya amagqibi nestatistiki.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Procurement
jobs.department: Department of Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 – R1 098 195 per annum (Level 11), all-inclusive salary package. The remuneration package consists of a basic salary, the State’s contribution to the Government Employees Pension Fund and a flexible portion that may be structured according to personal needs within the relevant framework.
jobs.summary: Deputy Director: Procurement managing demand, acquisition, logistics and contract administration for the Department of Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: A relevant Bachelor’s Degree / Advanced Diploma (NQF level 7) in Supply Chain Management, or Finance with at least 6 years’ experience in Supply Chain Management of which 3 years must be at Middle Management (ASD) level. Competencies & Skills: Excellent financial skills, supervisory and operational management skills. Problem solving skills. Good communication & report writing skills. Computer literacy skills. Knowledge requirements: Working knowledge of LOGIS and sound knowledge of Microsoft Office applications (especially Microsoft Excel) are essential. In-depth knowledge of the legislative environment applicable to government supply chain management process and the development, implementation and monitoring of related policies and procedures. Personal Attributes: Must be client orientated and customer focused, solution orientated and able to work under stressful situations. The ability to maintain a high level of confidentiality and to prioritize work in a high- pressure environment.
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will be responsible to manage the Sub-directorate, Demand and Acquisition Management, Logistics Management and Contract Administration in support of providing procurement services to the Department. This entails managing the functional operation of the Sub-directorate: Demand and Acquisition Management. Oversee RFQ and the bidding processes: Compilation of bid documents and advertisements. Publishing of bid documents. Contribute to compilation of Interim and Annual Financial Statements. Attend and respond to SCM related audit findings, and develop an Audit Action Plans and ensure its implementation. Ensure effective Contract Administration, Logistics and Warehouse Management, and Payment of suppliers within 30 days of receipt of invoice. Manage and supervise employees to ensure an effective acquisition management service and undertake all administrative functions required with regard to financial and HR administration: Develop, implement and maintain processes to ensure proper control of work. Maintenance of discipline and Management of performance and development of Sub-directorate staff.
jobs.applications: can also be emailed to: Recruitment35@dpme.gov.za
jobs.notes: The relevant reference number must be quoted on all applications. The successful candidate will have to sign an annual performance agreement and will be required to undergo a security clearance. Applications must be submitted on a signed Z83 accompanied by a comprehensive CV only specifying all experience indicating the respective dates (MM/YY) as well as indicating three reference persons with the following information: name and contact number(s), email address and an indication of the capacity in which the reference is known to the candidate. Certified copies of qualifications and other relevant documents will be requested from shortlisted candidates only. Applicants will be required to meet vetting requirements as prescribed by Minimum Information Security Standards. The DPME is an equal opportunity affirmative action employer. The employment decision shall be informed by the Employment Equity Plan of the Department. It is the Department’s intention to promote equity (race, gender and disability) through the filling of this post(s) Failure to submit the above information will result in the application not being considered. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Reference checks will be done during the selection process. Note that correspondence will only be conducted with the short-listed candidates. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months of the closing date of the advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Shortlisted candidates must be available for interviews at a date and time determined by DPME. Applicants must note that pre-employment checks will be conducted once they are short-listed and the appointment is also subject to positive outcomes on these checks, which include security clearance, security vetting, qualification verification and criminal records. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. For salary levels 11 to 15, the inclusive remuneration package consists of a basic salary, the state’s contribution to the Government Employees Pension Fund and a flexible portion in terms of applicable rules. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. The DPME reserves the right to utilise practical exercises/tests for non-SMS positions during the recruitment process (candidates who are shortlisted will be informed accordingly) to determine the suitability of candidates for the post(s). The DPME also reserves the right to cancel the filling / not to fill a vacancy that was advertised during any stage of the recruitment process. Prior to appointment, a candidate would be required to complete the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to Senior Management Services as endorsed by DPSA which is an online course, endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into the SMS and the full     details      can   be     sourced        by     the     following    link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. Candidates are required to use the new Z83 (Application for employment) that is implemented with effect from 1 January 2021. A copy can be downloaded on the website of the Department of Public Service & Administration (DPSA) at www.dpsa.gov.za OTHER POSTS

af.title: Onderdirekteur: Verwerwing
af.summary: Onderdirekteur: Verwerwing wat vraag, verwerwing, logistiek en kontrakadministrasie vir die Department of Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation in Pretoria bestuur.
af.requirements: 'n Relevante Bachelorsgraad / Gevorderde Diploma (NQF level 7) in Supply Chain Management, of Finansies met ten minste 6 jaar se ervaring in Supply Chain Management waarvan 3 jaar op Middle Management (ASD) vlak moet wees. Bevoegdhede & Vaardighede: Uitstekende finansiële vaardighede, toesighoudende en operasionele bestuursvaardighede. Probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Goeie kommunikasie- en verslagskryfvaardighede. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Kennisvereistes: Werkende kennis van LOGIS en deeglike kennis van Microsoft Office-toepassings (veral Microsoft Excel) is noodsaaklik. Diepgaande kennis van die wetgewende omgewing wat van toepassing is op die regeringsproses vir supply chain management en die ontwikkeling, implementering en monitering van verwante beleide en prosedures. Persoonlike eienskappe: Moet kliensteinrig en k Defokus wees, oplossingsgeoriënteerd wees en in staat wees om onder stresvolle omstandighede te werk. Die vermoë om 'n hoë vlak van vertroulikheid te handhaaf en werk in 'n hoëdruk-omgewing te prioriteer.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal verantwoordelik wees om die Subdirektoraat, Vraag- en Verwerwingsbestuur, Logistieke Bestuur en Kontrakadministrasie te bestuur ter ondersteuning van die verskaffing vanurveverskaffingsdienste aan die Departement. Dit behels die bestuur van die funksionele werking van die Subdirektoraat: Vraag- en Verwerwingsbestuur. Toesig hou oor RFQ- en die bodprosesse: samestelling van boddokumente en advertensies. Publiseering van boddokumente. Bydrae tot die samestelling van Tussentydse en Jaarlikse Finansiële State. Bywoon van en reaksie op SCM-verwante ouditbevindings, en ontwikkeling van 'n Oudit-aksieplan en versekering van die implementering daarvan. Verseker effektiewe Kontrakadministrasie, Logistiek en Pakhuisbestuur, en Betaling van verskaffers binne 30 dae na ontvangst van fakture. Bestuur en toesig hou oor werknemers om 'n effektiewe verwerwingsbestuursdiens te verseker en alle administratiewe funksies te onderneem wat vereis word met betrekking tot finansiële en HR-administrasie: Ontwikkel, implementeer en handhaaf prosesse om behoorlike beheer van werk te verseker. Handhawing van dissipline en Bestuur van prestasie en ontwikkeling van Subdirektoraat-personeel.

zu.title: i-Deputy Director: Procurement
zu.summary: i-Deputy Director: Procurement ephatha isidingo, ukutholwa kwemikhiqizo, ukulawula imisebenzi ngokulandelana kanye nokuphathwa kwemiqashi eDepartment of Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation ePretoria.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-Bachelor ezihlobene / i-Diploma Ephezulu (NQF level 7) ekulawulweni kwenkqubo yokuhlinzeka ngeziwomiso, noma izimali ezinoluhlu lweminyaka eyi-6 yotholwano ekulawulweni kwenkqubo yokuhlinzeka ngeziwomiso lapho iminyaka eyi-3 kumele ibe ngqungqulu wabaphathi (ASD) level. Amandla namakhono: Amakhono mahle wezezimali, amakhono okubuka abasebenzi nokuphatha imisebenzi yansuku zonke. Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga. Amakhono mahle okuxhumana nokubhala umbiko. Amakhono okusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Izidingo zolwazi: Ulwazi lokusebenza nge-LOGIS nolwazi oluhle lwezinhlelo zika-Microsoft Office (ikakhulukazi i-Microsoft Excel) kuyadingeka. Ulwazi olujulile ngemvelo yomthetho osebenza enkqutshweni yohulumeni yokuhlinzeka ngeziwomiso kanye nentuthuko, ukuphumelelisa nokubuka imithetho nemigomo ehlobene nayo. Izici zobuntu: Kumele abheke abathengi futhi aqonde kwabathengi, aqonde izixazululo futhi akwazi ukusebenza ezimeni ezinomingo. Ikhono lokugcina izinga eliphezulu lokubaluleka kokuVELA futhi abeke phambili umsebenzi endaweni egxile umongo.
zu.duties: Umphumeleli kuzophatha iNkqunta elingaphansi, ulawulo lwesidingo nokutholwa kwemikhiqizo, ulawulo lokuqhuba imisebenzi ngokulandelana nokwetulwa kwemiqashi ngenhloso yokunika inkonzo yemikhiqizo eDepartment. Lokhu kuhilela ukuphatha ukusebenza kweNkqunta elingaphansi: ulawulo lwesidingo nokuqothwa kwemikhiqizo. Ukwengamela imibuzo yokuqasha kanye namaxubhu okuthengisa: uhlu lwamaphepha okuthengisa nokukhishwa kwabalandeli emibhalweni. Ukushicilela amaphepha okuthengisa. Ukuphakamisa ukwenziwa kwamavesi ezezimali amaxeshana nakonyaka. Ukubakha bese uphendula iziphetho zokuhlola ezihlobene nokuphathwa kwenkqubo yemikhiqizo, bese uphatha uhlelo lokusebenza isiphetho bese uqinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwalo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuphathwa okusebenzayo kwemiqasho, ukulawulwa kokugcinwa kwemikhiqizo nendawo yokulonda, kanye nokuhlawulela abahlinzeki ngaphakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-30 zokuthola inkomishi. Ukuphatha futhi ukubuka abasebenzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukutholwa okusebenzayo kohlelo lokuphathwa kwemikhiqizo nokwenza yonke imisebenzi eyimphumela yohlelo oludingekayo ngokuphathwa kwezezimali nokuphathwa kwezabantu: ukuphatha, ukuphumelelisa futhi ukugcina imikhuba ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukulawulwa okuhle komsebenzi. Ukugcina isigqi nokuphatha imisebenzi nokuthuthukiswa kwabantu benkqunta elingaphansi.

xh.title: iPhini leJenerali: Ulweso
xh.summary: iPhini leJenerali: Ulweso elilawula ufuno, lokufumana, lothelekiso nolawulo lwezivumelwano zeSebe loCwangco, lokuQonda nokuLinganisa kwindawo yokusebenza ePretoria.
xh.requirements: Izdegree yaseKholishi eliqhelekileyo / iDiploma ePhakamileyo (NQF level 7) kukuLawula ukuQhagamshelana kweeNhlanga, okanye eeMali ngelixa unamava eminyaka engama-6 ekulawulweni kweNhlanga-ndibaniswano apho eminyaka engama-3 kufuneka ibe ngumdlalo wolawulo ophakathi (ASD). Ikhono namava: Ikhono elihle leemali, ukulawula abantu nolawulo lomsebenzi. Ikhono lokuxazulula iingxaki. Ikhono elihle lokunxibelelwana nokubhala iingxelo. Ikhono lokusebenza ngekhompyutha. Iimfuno yolwazi: Ulwazi olusebenzayo lwe-LOGIS nolwazi oluchanekileyo kusetyenziso lweMicrosoft Office (ikakhulu iMicrosoft Excel) ngemfuno. Ulwazi oluwevu olumayelana nemigaqo-nkqubo esebenza kwindlela yokulawula ukunxibelelwana kweenhlanga karhulumente nophuhliso, ukusebenzisa nokuqonda iindlela namacebo ahlobene. Iimpawu zobuntu: Kufuneka ugqibe ekubeni uqwalasele abakhumi useke kubo abathengi, ugqibe kwisixazululi samagcala usakwazi ukusebenza kwiimeko ezinxungunyezayo. Ikhono lokugcina inqanaba eliphezulu lokubumba iimfihlo nokuqwalasela umsebenzi kwindawo ebanzi ixineke.
xh.duties: Umphathi ophumeleleyo uya kumiselwa ukuba alawule iSisebe esincinci, uLawulo loFakelo nokuFunyanwa, uLawulo lothelekiso nokuLawulwa kweziVumelwano ngenkxaso yokuqinisekisa iinkonzo ezifakwa yiSebe. Oku kuquka ukulawula ukusebenza okusemandleni kwiSisebe esincinci: uLawulo loFakelo nokuFunyanwa. Ukugcina iliso iinkqubo ze-RFQ nezakhiwo ezibuzwayo: Ulungiseleloamaxwebhe okubuza nokuzivakalisha kwiindaba. Ukushicilela amaxwebhe okubuza. Ukuba ngumanyano kwelungiselelo leeNgxelo zezeMali ezeThutyana nazo zoNyaka. Ukuqwalasela nokuPhendula iziphumo zokuHlolwa ezihlobene ne-SCM, aze achaze amacebo okuHlolwa aze aqinisekise ukusetenziswa kwawo. Ukuqinisekisa uLawulo olusebenzayo lweziVumelwano, lothelekiso nokuLawulwa kweziQlanga, nokuRhuqwa kweengxangxasi kwingamantsaku angama-30 ukususela kumini yokufumana isixa. Ukulawula nokuqwalasela abasebenzi ukwenza ukuba lisebenze ngokusebenza okuqinisekisiweyo kulawulo lokufakela abantu nokwenzakho konke okumiselwa ukuba kwenziwe ngokumayela nolawulo lweemali nolawulo lweemfihlo zabantu: Ukuphuhlisa, ukusebenzisa nokuLawula iindlela ukuqinisekisa ukuLawula okuchanekileyo komsebenzi. Ukugcina isithunzi nokuLawula ukubonakala nokuQonda abantu baseSisebe.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Demand and Acquisition Management
jobs.department: Department of Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation
jobs.salary_text: R487 197 – R573 897 per annum (Level 09), plus benefits
jobs.summary: Assistant Director for Demand and Acquisition Management at the Department of Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation in Pretoria, requiring a Supply Chain Management diploma and five years' experience.
jobs.requirements: A National Diploma (NQF 6) in Supply Chain Management with at least 5 years’ experience in Demand and Acquisition of which 3 years should be at Senior Officer level in Demand and Acquisition Management. An NQF level 7 in Supply Chain Management will be an added advantage. Knowledge requirements: Should have extensive knowledge Public Finance Management Act, Public Service Act and regulations. Knowledge of National Treasury SCM instruction notes and Circulars. Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act (PPPFA) and its regulations. Competencies and skills: Must have good Presentation and problem-solving Skills. Must have good verbal and written communication skills. High level of analytical skills. Be able to engage with stakeholders. Personal Attributes: Ability to accept responsibility, and produce good quality of work. Must be a team player, flexible and reliable.
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will be responsible to provide effective and efficient demand and acquisition management system within the Department. This entails ensuring approval and authorization of quotations, Request for Proposal (RFP) and tenders: Compile and submit monthly SCM reports to Deputy Director and ensure all quotations, RFP and tenders comply with SCM Policy, delegations and SCM legislations. Monitor and facilitate requests for quotation (RFQ), RFP and tenders: Monitor and update the SCM tracking tool, Ensuring RFQ, RFP and bid processes timeframes are aligned with the approved SCM charter and ensuring all Bid committees are convened for RFP and Tender process. Update policies and respond to audit queries and risk management: Provide inputs into the review of the SCM policy and Provide inputs into Internal audit report and queries. Compilation of SCM Reports: Compile monthly reports on the status of RFQ, RFPs and Tenders and HR Management: Develop and manage the implementation of SCM operational plans, provide continuous training, mentoring and supporting to sub-ordinates and Ensure staff discipline is manged.
jobs.applications: can also be emailed to: Recruitment36@dpme.gov.za
jobs.notes: The relevant reference number must be quoted on all applications. The successful candidate will have to sign an annual performance agreement and will be required to undergo a security clearance. Applications must be submitted on a signed Z83 accompanied by a comprehensive CV only specifying all experience indicating the respective dates (MM/YY) as well as indicating three reference persons with the following information: name and contact number(s), email address and an indication of the capacity in which the reference is known to the candidate. Certified copies of qualifications and other relevant documents will be requested from shortlisted candidates only. Applicants will be required to meet vetting requirements as prescribed by Minimum Information Security Standards. The DPME is an equal opportunity affirmative action employer. The employment decision shall be informed by the Employment Equity Plan of the Department. It is the Department’s intention to promote equity (race, gender and disability) through the filling of this post(s) Failure to submit the above information will result in the application not being considered. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Reference checks will be done during the selection process. Note that correspondence will only be conducted with the short-listed candidates. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months of the closing date of the advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Shortlisted candidates must be available for interviews at a date and time determined by DPME. Applicants must note that pre-employment checks will be conducted once they are short-listed and the appointment is also subject to positive outcomes on these checks, which include security clearance, security vetting, qualification verification and criminal records. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. For salary levels 11 to 15, the inclusive remuneration package consists of a basic salary, the state’s contribution to the Government Employees Pension Fund and a flexible portion in terms of applicable rules. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. The DPME reserves the right to utilise practical exercises/tests for non-SMS positions during the recruitment process (candidates who are shortlisted will be informed accordingly) to determine the suitability of candidates for the post(s). The DPME also reserves the right to cancel the filling / not to fill a vacancy that was advertised during any stage of the recruitment process. Prior to appointment, a candidate would be required to complete the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to Senior Management Services as endorsed by DPSA which is an online course, endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into the SMS and the full     details      can   be     sourced        by     the     following    link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. Candidates are required to use the new Z83 (Application for employment) that is implemented with effect from 1 January 2021. A copy can be downloaded on the website of the Department of Public Service & Administration (DPSA) at www.dpsa.gov.za OTHER POSTS

af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Vraag- en Verwerwingsbestuur
af.summary: Assistentdirekteur vir Vraag- en Verwerwingsbestuur by die Department of Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation in Pretoria, wat 'n diploma in Voorsieningskettingbestuur en vyf jaar se ondervinding vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Nasionale Diploma (NQF 6) in Voorsieningskettingbestuur met ten minste 5 jaar se ondervinding in Vraag en Verwerwing waarvan 3 jaar op Senior Beampte-vlak in Vraag- en Verwerwingsbestuur moet wees. 'n NQF-vlak 7 in Voorsieningskettingbestuur sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Kennisvereistes: Uitgebreide kennis van die Public Finance Management Act, Public Service Act en regulasies. Kennis van National Treasury SCM-instruksienotas en Sirkulaires. Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act (PPPFA) en sy regulasies. Bevoegdhede en vaardighede: Moet oor goeie voorleggings- en probleemoplossingsvaardighede beskik. Moet oor goeie mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede beskik. Hoë vlak van analitiese vaardighede. In staat wees om met belanghebbendes in te skakel. Persoonlike eienskappe: Vermoë om verantwoordelikheid te aanvaar en goeie gehalte werk te lewer. Moet 'n spanspeler wees, buigsaam en betroubaar.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal verantwoordelik wees om 'n effektiewe en doeltreffende vraag- en verwerwingsbestuurstelsel binne die departement te voorsien. Dit behels die verseker van goedkeuring en magtiging van kwotasies, Request for Proposal (RFP) en tenders: Stel maandelikse SCM-verslae aan die Adjunkdirekteur op en dien dit in en verseker dat alle kwotasies, RFP en tenders aan SCM-beleid, delegasies en SCM-wetgewing voldoen. Monitor en fasiliteer versoeke vir kwotasie (RFQ), RFP en tenders: Monitor en werk die SCM-opsporingsinstrument by, verseker dat RFQ-, RFP en biedproses-tydslyne met die goedgekeurde SCM-handves ooreenstem en verseker dat alle Biedkomitees vir RFP- en Tenderprosesse byeengeroep word. Werk beleide by en reageer op ouditnavrae en risikobestuur: Verskaf insette tot die hersiening van die SCM-beleid en verskaf insette tot interne ouditverslae en navrae. Samestelling van SCM-verslae: Stel maandelikse verslae op oor die status van RFQ, RFP's en Tenders en HR-bestuur: Ontwikkel en bestuur die implementering van SCM-operasionele planne, verskaf deurlopende opleiding, mentorskap en ondersteuning aan ondergeskiktes en verseker dat personeelsdissipline bestuur word.

zu.title: Umuntu Ohambisana Nomqondisi: Ukuphathwa Kokuqashwa Nokutholwa Kwemikhiqizo
zu.summary: Umuntu Ohambisana Nomqondisi wokuqashwa nokutholwa kwemikhiqizo eMnyangweni WezokuCubungula, UkuQapha nokuQokomisha ePretoria, ofuna idiploma yokuphathwa koxhaxha lokuhlinzeka ngemikhiqizo futhi abe neminyaka emihlanu yeziphalangiswa.
zu.requirements: I-National Diploma (NQF 6) ekuPhathweni Koxhaxha Lokuhlinzeka Ngemikhiqizo nobuhlobo bezimyanga emuva emincane kakhulu eminyakeni eyi-5 kokuqashwa nokutholwa kwemikhiqizo, okuyilapho eminyakeni eyi-3 kufanele ibe ngengozi yesigaba seSihlalo Sewomphathi kokuqashwa nokutholwa kwemikhiqizo. I-NQF ezingeni lesi-7 ekuPhathweni Koxhaxha Lokuhlinzeka Ngemikhiqizo izoba ngumphumela omuhle. Izidingo zolwazi: Kufanele abe nolwazi olujulile ngoMthetho WokuPhathwa Kwezimali Zomphakathi, uMthetho Womsebenzi Womphakathi namayelidi. Ulwazi ngemiyalezo yolwazi nemiqondo ye-National Treasury SCM kanye namaphephancwedi. uMthetho Womthethosisekelo Wokuthengiswa Okuhlolwa Kakhulu (PPPFA) namayelidi awo. Ikhono nezindlela: Kufanele abe nolwazi oluhle lokubonisa nokuxazulula izinkinga. Kufondele abe nokukhuluma nokubhala kahle. Izinga eliphezulu lekhono lokuhlaziya. Akghone ukuxhumana nabahlanganyeli. Izici zobuntu: Ukuthola nokuqaphela ithuba, kanye nokukhiqiza umsebenzi womlinganiselo othile. Kufanele abe ngumuntu osebenza ngokubambisana nabanye, oguqukayo futhi othembekile.
zu.duties: Umuntu ophumelelayo uzoba nobumbo lokunikeza isixokezwi esisebenzayo nesiphumelelayo sokuphathwa kokuqashwa nokutholwa kwemikhiqizo kuloMnyango. Lokhu kusho ukuqinisekisa ukuvunywa nokuvunyelwa kwezazi zentengo, i-Request for Proposal (RFP) kanye netender: Hlanganisa futhi unikeze imibiko yenyanga zonke ye-SCM kuMqondisi osesikhundleni esiphezulu ukuze kuqiniseke ukuthi zonke izazi zentengo, i-RFP kanye netender zihambisana nenqubomgomo ye-SCM, amandla anikeziwe kanye nomthetho we-SCM. Qapha futhi usize izicelo sezazi zentengo (RFQ), i-RFP kanye netender: Qapha futhi buyekeza ithuluzi elilandelayo le-SCM, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi isikhathi sezinkomba ze-RFQ, i-RFP kanye nenqubo yokuhweba sihambisana nesivumelwano esivunyiwe se-SCM, futhi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi yonke emaKomidi e-Bid abizwa kwinqubo ye-RFP ne-Tender. Buyekeza izinqubomgomo uphendule imibuzo ye-odit kanye nokuphathwa kwezingozi: Nikeza okokufaka esibukweni ukubuyekeza inqubomgomo ye-SCM, futhi unikeze okokufaka umbikweni ngaphakathi kwe-odit nakumibuzo. Ukuhlanganiswa kwemibiko ye-SCM: Hlanganisa imibiko yenyanga zonke ngobunjwa be-RFQ, ama-RFP nama-Tender, kanye noPhatho lwe-HR: Buka futhi uphathe ukusetshenziswa kwezinqubo ezisebenzayo ze-SCM, unikeze ukuqeqeshwa okungapheli, ukuqondisa kanye nokusekela ababeseleyo, kanye futhi uqinisekiswe ukuthi ukuhlonipheka kwabasebenzi kuphathwa.

xh.title: UmLawuli ongenamanye: Ulawulo lwesicelo kunye nokuFumana
xh.summary: UmLawuli ongenamanye woLawulo lwesicelo kunye nokuFumana kwiSebe leCwangciso, loQwalaselo nokuLinganisa ePretoria, elifuna idiploma yoLawulo lweHlathi lokuNgcangathela kunye neminyaka emi-5 yamava.
xh.requirements: Idiploma yelizwe (NQF 6) kuLawulo lweHlathi lokuNgcangathela nangaphezulu kweminyaka eli-5 yamava kwisicelo nokuFumana apho iminyaka emi-3 kufuneka ibe kwinqanaba loMsebenzi oPhezulu kuLawulo lwesicelo nokuFumana. Nqanaba le-7 le-NQF kuLawulo lweHlathi lokuNgcangathela luya kuba ngumonde ongathathiyo. Iimfuno zolwazi: Kufuneka abe nolwazi oluqhubekayo kuMthetho woLawulo lweMali yoLuntu, uMthetho woQeqesho loLuntu kunye neemithetho. Ulwazi lweziPHEKISO zoBhongo lweHlathi lokuNgcangathela zeSizwe kunye namaZigu. UMthetho woBuzela bobuNika-mazwe (PPPFA) kunye neemithetho yawo. Iikhompetensi nezakhono: Kufuneka abe nezakhono ezilungileyo zokuTyhila nokuSombulula iingxaki. Kufuneka abe nezakhono ezilungileyo zokuThetha nokuBhala. Inqanaba eliphezulu lezakhono zokuhlalutya. Kufuneka akwazi ukudibana nabathathi-nxaxheba. Iimpawu zobuntu: Ulwazi lokwamkela urevideo, nokukhiqiza umsebenzi womgangatho ophezulu. Kufuneka abe ngumdlali wetimu, esuguquguqukayo ethembekileyo.
xh.duties: Umogqo ophumelelayo uya kuba nexanduba lokunika inkqubo ekhoyo ngokufanelekileyo yokulawula isicelo nokufumana phakathi kwiSebe. Oku kuthetha ukuqinisekisa isigunyaziso namagunya esipro njengesicelo, ngesicelo soLucuvo lwesiCingo (RFP) nokuqashwa iinkonzo: Ukuqamba kwaye ufake iingxelo zenyanga ze-SCM kuLawuli ongaMfundi kwaye uqiniseke ukuba onke amapro esicelo, i-RFP nokuqashwa iinkonzo ahambelana neNqumamngeni ye-SCM, izinikelo zamagunya kunye nemithetho ye-SCM. Ukuphatha kwaye ulawule izicelo zokubonelela (RFQ), i-RFP nokuqashwa iinkonzo: Ukuqwalasela kwaye uhlaziye isixhobo sokulandelela i-SCM, kuqinisekisa ukuba ixesha lemigqango yokuqhubela iqoqo i-RFP nokuqashwa iinkonzo luya ngokomDla we-SCM ovunyiweyo kwaye uqinisekisa ukuba onke amaKomiti wonxibelelwano kuqoqwa iinkonzo aquthelwe i-RFP nokuqashwa iinkonzo. Ukuhlaziya iinkqubomphango kwaye uphendule kumibuzo yokulawulwa kwaye ulawule iingozi: Nika izigqibo kundwendwelo lwenqumamngeni ye-SCM kwaye nike izigqibo kwikomitywe engxelo nangemibuzo yoQwalaselo langaphakathi. Ukulungiselela iingxelo ze-SCM: Hlola iingxelo zenyanga zomgangatho we-RFQ, i-RFP nokuqashwa iinkonzo kunye noLawulo lwabaPhathi: Phezulu kwaye ulawule isicatshulwa se-SCM nokuqhubela iqoqo linamsebenzi, ukuqeqesha ngokuqhubelekayo, ukukhusela nokuxhasa abasebenzi abangaphantsi kwaye uQinisekisa ukuba isigqibo sabasebenzi sithathwa ngokufanelekileyo.

jobs.department: Department of Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation

Basic Numeracy. Knowledge requirements: Basic knowledge of how to hygienically prepare food, Managing stock and store in the kitchen and storeroom. Ability to use a variety of cleaning equipment and products. Knowledge of Batho Pele Principles. Personal attributes: Must be a team player. Flexible and reliable. Ability to accept responsibility for own areas of work.

Maintain cleaning materials/ products and equipment: Monitor stock and request cleaning materials, report broken cleaning machines and equipment and safekeeping of catering equipment and stock.
