af.title: Kosdiens Hulp
af.summary: Verskaf kosbereidings-, skoonmaak van kombuis en raadskaamer-opstellingsdienste by die Department of Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation in Pretoria.
af.requirements: 'n NQF-vlak 1 (onder graad 10) of vlak 2 (graad 10). (Abet-vlak 2-sertifikaat of eweknie). Geen ervaring word vereist nie. Basiese kosdienservaring sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. 'n Kwalifikasie/sertifikaat in die area van kosbereiding/dienste sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Bevoegdhede en vaardighede: Behoort goeie interpersoonlike verhoudingsvaardighede en goeie kommunikasievaardighede te hê. Basiese syferkennis. Kennisvereistes: Basiese kennis van hoe om kos higiënies voor te berei, bestuur van voorraad en stoor in die kombuis en stoorkamer. Vermoë om 'n verskeidenheid skoonmaaktoerusting en -produkte te gebruik. Kennis van Batho Pele-beginsels. Persoonlike eienskappe: Moet 'n spanspeler wees. Buigsaam en betroubaar. Vermoë om verantwoordelikheid te aanvaar vir eie werkareas.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal verantwoordelik wees vir die verskaffing van dienste met betrekking tot kosbereiding, die skoonmaak van die kombuis en die opstelling van raadskamers: Voorbereiding van plekke vir vergaderings en funksies. Onderhoud van skoonmaakmateriale/produkte en toerusting: Monitor voorraad en versoek skoonmaakmateriale, rapporteer gebreekte skoonmaakmasjiene en toerusting en veilige bewaring van spysenieringstoerusting en voorraad. Vul waterkoelers en pas higiëne- en veiligheidsmaatreëls toe in die werkarea wat met pligte verband hou.

zu.title: Umsizi Wezenkonzo Yokudla
zu.summary: Nikeza izinkonzo zokulungiselela ukudla, ukusha isikhishi kanye nokulungiselela amagumbi lokuhlangana e-Department of Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation e-Pretoria.
zu.requirements: I-NQF level 1 (ngaphansi kwe-grade 10) noma i-level 2 (grade 10). (Isitifiketi se-Abet level 2 noma okulingana naso). Akukho ngokuhlolwa okudingekayo. Okuhlolwa okuncane kwezenkonzo zokudla kuzoba yinzuzo. Isiqu/isitifiketi endaweni yokulungiselela/inkonzo yezokudla kuzoba yinzuzo. Amandla nokubekezela: Kufanele kube nokuba nobuhlakani bokuxhumanana nabantu nobuhlakani bokukhuluma kahle. Ukubala okuyisisekelo. Izidingo zolwazi: Ulwazi oluyisisekelo ngendlela yokulungiselela ukudla ngokuhlanzekileyo, ukuphathwa kwesitokwe nendlu yokugcina isikhishi nendlu yokugcina. Ikono lokusebenzisa izinto ezihlukene zokucwasha izinkimbi namaphrokhathi. Ulwazi ngemigome yamagugu namakhono abantu. Izimpawu zobuntu: Kufanele ube ngumuntu othanda ukusebenza nqwa. Ukuguqukela futhi uthembekile. Ukukwazi ukuziphatha ngokuziphathela izindawo zakho zomsebenzi.
zu.duties: Oqeqeshiweyo kuzoba yisibopho esithi akaze angaze abe ngumuntu ophathwe ngemisebenzi yokulungiselela nokudla, ukuhlanza isikhishi nokulungiselela amagumbi lokuhlangana. Ukulungiselela izikhundla zemihlangano nemikhosi. Ukulondolozwa kwamaphrokhathi okuhlanza/izinkimbi zokuhlanza futhi imisebenzi ezosetshenziswa ekulungiseleleni kwesitokwe esingangenwa ukudla: ukugcina isitokwe futhi wacela izinkimbi zokuhlanza, ukubika ngamaphrokhathi abolekileyo futhi izinkimbi zokuhlanza kanye namaphrokhathi abolekileyo futhi ukugcina amaphrokhathi okusinga noma ukuphuca kanye nendawo yokugcina isitokwe. Ukugcwalisa amakhaphuphu amakhulu omanzi kanye nokusetshenziswa kwamathuluzi amakhulu okuhlanzwa futhi wamathuluzi amakhulu ukuvikela indlela yokuhlanzwa emsebenzini okufanele kusetshenziswe emisebenzini yokudla nokupheka.

xh.title: Umniki Weziko Lokutya
xh.summary: Nika iinkonzo zokulungiselela ukutya, ukucofa kweekhithi nokumisa iibhodrum kwisebe Leplani, Lokumonitula nokuHlola ePretoria.
xh.requirements: Inqanaba le-NQF 1 (ngaphansi kwaklaasi 10) okanye inqanaba 2 (klaasi 10). (Isatifikethi se-Abet inqanaba 2 okanye esilinganayo). Akukho mfundo yamava idingekayo. Amanqanaba aphambili amava ezinkonzo zakutya kuya kuba lusizo. Isiqu/ isatifikethi kwendawo yokulungiselela ukutya/ezinkonzweni kuya kuba lusizo. Amakhono namava: Kufuneka abe nokuba namakhono obudlelwane nabantu abanye nangokuchanekileyo ekunxibelelaneni. Amanani amabini. Iimfuno zolwazi: Ulwazi olusisiseko ngendlela yokulungiselela ukutya ngokwengcam, ulawulo lwesitokhwe nendlu yokugcina kweekhithi nendlu yokugcina. Ikhono lokusebenzisa iindidi ezahlukeneyo zempahla nokucoca nemveliso. Ulwazi ngeMigaqo yeBatho Pele. Iimpawu zabantu: Kufuneka abe ngumdlali wetim. Ajikelezileyo waye athembekileyo. Ikhono lokwamkela uxanduva kwindawo yakhe yokusebenza.
xh.duties: Umphathiswa opumeleleyo uya kuba nexanduva lonikezelo lweenkonzo ezinxulumene nokulungiselela ukutya, ukucofa kweekhithi nokulungiselela iibhodrum: Ulungiselelo lweendawo zemiboniso nemisebenzi. Ukugcina iimpahla/ imveliso zokucoca nempahla: Ukumonitula isitokhwe nokucela iimpahla zokucoca, ukuchaza iimpahla zokucoca ezingasebenziyo nempahla, nokugcina ngokhuselekileyo impahla yokunikela nesisitokhwe. Ukugcwalisa iikhuula zamanzi nokusebenzisa iindlela zokhuseleko nangococeko kwendawo yokusebenza enxulumene nemisebenzi.

jobs.title: Chief Director: Construction Management
jobs.department: Department of Public Works and Infrastructure
jobs.salary_text: R1 554 696 per annum, (Total package to be structured in accordance with the rules of the Senior Management Services)
jobs.summary: Chief Director overseeing construction and refurbishment projects at the Department of Public Works and Infrastructure Head Office in Pretoria, requiring SACPCMP registration.
jobs.requirements: A minimum of NQF 7 in Engineering/ Built Environment or related field of study as recognised by the SAQA. A minimum of 5 years’ experience at a senior managerial level in built environment and or construction management. Registration as a Professional Construction Project Management with the SACPCMP. Knowledge: Construction best practice, Project Management, Extensive knowledge of all engineering aspects of the building and construction environment, Public Finance Management Act, Occupational Health and Safety Act, Supply Chain Management, Contract Management. Skills: Decision making, Team leadership, Analytical skills, Creativity, Self- management, financial management, Customer focus and responsiveness, Communication, Computer literacy, Planning and organising, Conflict management, People management, Negotiation skills, Problem solving and analysis, Change management, Innovation, Strategic capability and leadership. Personal Attributes: Project management skills, principles and methodologies, Project and professional judgement, Computer-aided engineering and project applications, Project design and analysis knowledge, Project operational communication, Process knowledge and skills, Maintenance skills and knowledge, Mobile equipment operating skills, Legal and operational compliance, Research and development, Creating high- performance culture, technical consulting. Willing to adapt work schedule in accordance with professional requirement.
jobs.duties: Oversee the management of construction or refurbishment projects Construction Management Methodology: Oversee final review and approvals or audits on project designs according to design principles or theory. Ensure effective design efforts and integration across disciplines to ensure seamless integration with current technology. Manage the execution of project management strategy through the provision of appropriate structures, systems and resources. Ensure that project standards, specifications and service levels according are set to departmental objectives to ensure optimum operational availability. Monitor project management efficiencies according to organisational goals to direct or redirect project services for the attainment of organisational objectives. Manage and control project budget and expenditure. Oversee the management of construction management guidelines, processes, standards and strategies: Identify construction management trends and opportunities for businesses processes improvement. Approves recommendations for changes and improvements to existing construction management guidelines, standards, policies and procedures. Oversee the implementation of guidelines, standards, policies, procedures and strategies and related prescripts. Ensure the development and implementation of support tools. Monitor the implementation and ensure compliance with applicable policies and legislation. Ensure the implementation of sound effective and efficient internal control system. Ensure structuring of the project’s delivery model along IDIP & IDMS methodologies: Business model definition and documentation. Develop new business process, standard operating procedures, new service level standards, and system automation. Re- arranging the resources to service the new processes adequately. Structuring of current professional teams into portfolio arrangements. Re-engineering of business processes and delegations and implementation of insourcing strategies. Develop sustainable design guidelines to form the basis for future design solutions and construction technology as informed by DPW Green Building Policy. Manage the Chief Directorate: Establish and maintain appropriate internal controls and reporting systems in order to meet performance expectations. Develop and manage the operational plan of the Chief Directorate and report on progress as required. Manage performance and development of employees. Establish, implement and maintain efficient and effective communication arrangements. Compile and submit all required administrative reports. Quality control of work delivered by employees. Monitor the budget and expenditures for the Chief Directorate.
jobs.applications: Head Office Applications: The Director-General, Department of Public Works, Private Bag X65, Pretoria, 0001 or Hand deliver at 256 Madiba Street, CGO Building, Pretoria or email to: Recruitment26-65@dpw.gov.za FOR ATTENTION : Ms NP Mudau
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on the prescribed Z83 application form (obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the DPSA website link: https:/www.dpsa.gov.za/newsroom/psvc/, which must be signed, initialled and dated by the applicant, and must be accompanied by a detailed curriculum vitae (CV) only. Candidates are not required to submit certified copies of qualifications and related documents on application. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualification and other related documents on or before the date of interview, which should not be older than six months. Should an application be submitted using incorrect/old Z83 application form, such an application will be disqualified. Further take note of the following on completion of Z83 application form: PART A and PART B must be fully completed. PART C - PART G: Noting that there is a limited space provided applicants may refer to CV or indicate. This will be acceptable as long as the CV has been attached and provides the required information. Page 1 of the Z83 application form must be initialled and page 2 signed and dated by the applicant. Failure to comply with the above instructions may result in an application being disqualified. Applicants applying for more than one advertised post must submit separate Z83 application forms and CVs in respect to each post being applied for. Should an application be received where an applicant has applied for more than one posts on the same Z83 application form, the applicant will be considered for the first post indicated on the Z83 application form only. Applications will be received via post/courier services, hand deliveries or email. Late applications will not be considered. Regulation 57 (c) and 67 (9) of the Public Service Regulations 2016, as amended, requires the executive authority to ensure that he or she is fully satisfied of the claims being made and the finalisation of Personnel Suitability Checks in order to verify claims and check the candidate for purpose of being fit and proper for employment, respectively. Shortlisted candidates must be willing to undergo normal vetting and verification processes. Note: It is the responsibility of all applicants to ensure that foreign qualifications are evaluated by SAQA. Due to large volume of responses anticipated, receipt of applications will not be acknowledged, and correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. Should you not have heard from us within three months from the closing date, please regard your application as unsuccessful. Entry level requirements for SMS posts: in terms of the Directive on Human Resource Management and Development on Public Service Professionalisation Volume 1 a requirement for appointment into SMS posts is the successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-Entry programme as endorsed by the National School of Governance (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into SMS and the full details can be obtained by following the below link: https: www.thensg.gov.za/training –course /sms-pre-entry programme/. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Note: For emailed applications, please submit a single PDF document or one attachment per application to the email address designated on the specific position. Kindly note that the emailed applications and attachments should not exceed 15MB. It remains the candidate’s responsibility to ensure that their application is successfully submitted using the required single pdf document. Encrypted document will not be accepted. All though an email application option is available, applicants are encouraged to hand deliver their application. IMPORTANT: Applicants must submit a separate application for each post applied for, clearly indicating the correct reference number and post title on each application. Applicants who apply for more than one post must submit a separate application for each post. Failure to comply with this requirement may result in the application not being considered. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Hoofdirekteur: Konstruksiebestuur
af.summary: Hoofdirekteur wat toezicht hou oor konstruksie- en opknappingsprojekte by die Departement of Public Works and Infrastructure se hoofkantoor in Pretoria, wat SACPCMP-registrasie vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum van NQF 7 in Ingenieurswese/ Geboude Omgewing of verwante studierigting soos deur SAQA erken. Minimum van 5 jaar se ervaring op senior bestuursvlak in geboude omgewing en of konstruksiebestuur. Registrasie as 'n Professionele Construction Project Management by die SACPCMP. Kennis: Konstruksie-bestuurpraktyke, projekbestuur, uitgebreide kennis van alle ingenieursaspekte van die gebou- en konstruksieomgewing, Public Finance Management Act, Occupational Health and Safety Act, Supply Chain Management, kontrakbestuur. Vaardighede: Besluitneming, spanleierskap, analitiese vaardighede, kreatiwiteit, selfbestuur, finansiële bestuur, klintefokus en reaksievermoë, kommunikasie, rekenaarvaardigheid, beplanning en organisering, konflikbestuur, mensebestuur, onderhandelingsvaardighede, probleemoplossing en analise, veranderingbestuur, innovasie, strategiese vermoë en leierskap. Persoonlike eienskappe: Projekbestuurvaardighede, beginsels en metodes, projek- en professionele oordeel, rekenaargesteunde ingenieurs- en projektoepassings, projekontwerp en analise-kennis, projekoperasionele kommunikasie, proseskennis en vaardighede, onderhoudsvaardighede en -kennis, mobiele toerustingbedryfsvaardighede, wetlike en operasionele nakoming, navorsing en ontwikkeling, skepping van 'n hoëprestasiekultuur, tegniese konsultasie. Bereid om werkskedule in ooreenstemming met professionele vereistes aan te pas.
af.duties: Hou toezig oor die bestuur van konstruksie- of opknappingsprojekte. Konstruksiebestuursmetodologie: Hou toezig oor finale hersiening en goedkeurings of oudits op projekontwerpe volgens ontwerpbeginsels of -teorie. Verseker effektiewe ontwerppogings en integrasie oor dissiplines heen om naatlose integrasie met huidige tegnologie te verseker. Bestuur die uitvoering van die projekbestuurstrategie deur die verskaffing van toepaslike strukture, stelsels en hulpbronne. Verseker dat projekstandaarde, spesifikasies en diensvlakke volgens departementele doelwitte gestel word om optimale operasionele beskikbaarheid te verseker. Monitor projekbestuursdoeltreffendheid volgens organisatoriese doelwitte om projekdienste te rig of te herlei vir die bereiking van organisatoriese doelwitte. Bestuur en beheer projekbegroting en uitgawes. Hou toezig oor die bestuur van konstruksiebestuursriglyne, prosesse, standaarde en strategieë: Identifiseer konstruksiebestuurstendense en geleenthede vir besigheidsprosesverbetering. Keur aanbevelings vir veranderinge en verbeterings aan bestaande konstruksiebestuursriglyne, standaarde, beleide en prosedures goed. Hou toezig oor die implementering van riglyne, standaarde, beleide, prosedures en strategieë en verwante voorskrifte. Verseker die ontwikkeling en implementering van ondersteuningsinstrumente. Monitor die implementering en verseker nakoming van toepaslike beleide en wetgewing. Verseker die implementering van 'n gesonde, effektiewe en doeltreffende interne beheerstelsel. Verseker strukturering van die projek se afleweringsmodel langs IDIP & IDMS-metodologieë: Besigheidsmodeldefinisie en -dokumentasie. Ontwikkel nuwe besigheidsprosesse, standaard bedryfsprosedures, nuwe diensvlakstandaarde en stelseloutomatisering. Herrangskik die hulpbronne om die nuwe prosesse voldoende te bedien. Struktureering van huidige professionele spanne in portefeuljereëlings. Herontwerp van besigheidsprosesse en delegasies en implementering van insourcing-strategieë. Ontwikkel volhoubare ontwerpriglyne om die basis vir toekomstige ontwerpoplossings en konstruksietegnologie te vorm soos geïnformeer deur DPW Green Building Policy. Bestuur die Hoofdirektoraat: Vestig en handhaaf toepaslike interne beheer- en verslagdoeningstelsels om prestasieverwagtinge te bereik. Ontwikkel en bestuur die operasionele plan van die Hoofdirektoraat en verslag oor vordering soos vereis. Bestuur prestasie en ontwikkeling van werknemers. Vestig, implementeer en handhaaf doeltreffende en effektiewe kommunikasiereëlings. Stel alle vereiste administratiewe verslae op en dien in. Kwaliteitsbeheer van werk deur werknemers gelewer. Monitor die begroting en uitgawes vir die Hoofdirektoraat.

zu.title: Umqondisi Ohamba Phambili: Ukuphathwa KwakhoMakhiwo
zu.summary: Umqondisi Ohamba Phambili ohlola amaphrojekthi okwakha nokulungisa eKantolo Elikhulu le-Department of Public Works and Infrastructure ePretoria, ofuna ukubhalwa kwi-SACPCMP.
zu.requirements: Isilinganiso esingaphansi kwesibili se-NQF 7 ku-Engineering/ Built Environment noma enkabeni efana naleyo njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA. Isiphepho seminyaka eyi-5 yohlu lobudala bobaphathi ohlubeni eliphezulu kokwakha noma ekuphathweni kwakhoMakhiwo. Ukubhalwa njengoMphathi wePhrojekthi weProfeshinali wakhoMakhiwo ku-SACPCMP. Ulwazi: Izinto ezinhle zokwakha, Ukuphathwa kwePhrojekthi, Ulwazi olunzima lwazo zonke izici zomfundi wezokwakha nokuqasha imvelo, umthetho wokuPhathwa kweMali yoMphakathi, umthetho wezezeNkalo kanye noKuphathwa Kwezempilo, ukuphathwa kwezinsiza ezihambisanayo, ukuphathwa kwezivumelwano. Amandla: Ukwenza izinqumo, ukuhola iqembu, Amandla okuhlaziya, ukudala, ukuziphatha, ukuphathwa kwezezimali, ukugxila kumthengi nokuxhumana, ukuxhumana, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ukuhlela nokuhlela izinto, ukuphathwa kwezinkinga, ukuphathwa kwabantu, amandla okuxoxa ngamaphuzu, ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya, ukuphathwa koshintsho, ukudala okusha, amandla aqinisekile okuhola. Izici zobuntu: Amandla okuphatha iphrojekthi, imigqa nendlela, isahlukaniso sophando, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kwezokwakha nabezinhlelo, ulwazi lolwakhiwo nokuhlaziya, ukuxhumana ekusebenzeni, amandla nolwazi lokuqasha izinsiza, ukugcina futhi ulwazi, amandla okusebenzisa izinsiza eziyadludluzwa, ukuhambisana nomthetho, ukuphenya nokuthuthukisa, ukudala isiko elisebenza kahle, ukweluleka ngezobuchwepheshe. Ukuzethemba ekulandeleni isikhathi somsebenzi lapho kufuneka ngokwezidingo zobungcweti.
zu.duties: Ukuhlola ukuphathwa kwamaphrojekthi wokwakha noma ukulungisa. Indlela yokuphatha kokwakhiwo: ukuhlola ukuphela kokuhlola nokuvuma noma ukubuyekeza emiklanyweni yephrojekthi ngokemigqa noma ukuzidanga. Qinisekisa ukuzikhandla okuyinhloso emiklanyweni nokuhlanganiswa phakathi kweminye yemikhiqizo ukuze kuhle bekuphathwa ngekhompyutha. Phatha ukusetshenziswa kwendlela yokuphathwa kokwakhiwa emaqenjini anezakhiwo eziyinhloko ngezinsiza eziyinhloko. Qinisekisa ukuba imigqa yephrojekthi, izinkomba namanani amakhulu ukwakhiwa ahlelwe ngokwezinhloso zomnyango ukuze kusetshenziswe okuyinhloso. Bheka ukusebenza kahle kokwakha ngokamgomo wenkampani ukuze ukhombise noma ukukhombise ngokufanele izinkonzo zokwakhiwo ngokusettshenziswa kwezinhloso zenkampani. Phatha futhi lolube imali yokwakhiwa nokuqedwa kwayo. Hola ukuphathwa kwemigqa, izindlela, amanani nezinhloso zokwakhiwa. Chaza amathuba amakhulu kokwakhiwa kanye namathuba okuthuthukisa ukusetshenziswa. Vuma ukushintshwa nokuthuthukiswa kwemigqa, amanani, amapholisi nendlela zokwakhiwa ezikhona. Hola ukusetshenziswa kwemigqa, amanani, amapholisi, izindlela kanye nezincazelo ezihambisana. Qinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa nokusetshenziswa kwezinsiza. Hola ukusetshenziswa bese uqinisekisa ukuhambisana namapholisi kanye nomthetho. Qinisekisa ukusungulwa kokuhlolwa okuyiphunga nokusebenza kahle ngaphakathi kweso. Qinisekisa ukwakhiwa kokuhlelelwa kokwakhiwa ngezindlela ze-IDIP & IDMS. Incazelo nokubhala i-modeli yeshabhulo. Thuthukisa inkambiso entsha, izindlela ezinhle zokusebenza, amanani amasha okwakhiwo, ukusebenza ngesistimu. Kabhisa izinsiza ukuze kusetshenziswe izindlela ezingafakwa ezintsha zokusebenza. Kabhiza amaqembu abangcali angaphandle angafakiwa ngaphakathi ngendlela zokubhalisa. Dlulisa okuyinhloko ngokusebenza ngokwendlela ezintsha kanye nokuhlela abangcali. Thuthukisa imigqa engaphelele yokwakha ukuba ingumgqa wokwakhiwa nokusungula amathuluzi uma kunesidingo ngokwe-Green Building Policy. Phatha iKhikhulu leMfuzo: Sungula futhi ulondoloze izindlela ezingaphakathi ezinhle nezinsiza ezibika ukulingana noma ukwedlula ukwenza okulindelekile. Thuthukisa futhi ulawule indlela eseyisikhathi eside yokusebenza kweKhikhulu futhi ubeke incazelo ngokufunwa. Lawula ukusebenza nokuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi. Sungula, qinisekisa futhi gcina izindlela ezinhle zokuqhathanisa izindaba ezibalulekile. Hlela futhi uhlinze ngemininingwane yonke imibhalo efunekayo. Ukubuyekeza kabusha ukuthula kokusebenza okuwenziwe abantu. Hlola imali yokwakhiwa nokuyisebenzisa iKhikhulu.

xh.title: Umphathi oMkhulu: uLawulo lokuSetjhiiswa
xh.summary: Umphathi oMkhulu oqonda amaprojekthi okwakha nokuLungisa iNdawo eNtloko yeSebe loVuselelo lwaZentengiso nokuHlola kwiSebe lezeMisebenzi zoLuntu neZeNzululwazi ePretoria, efunwa ukuQwalaselwa kwi-SACPCMP.
xh.requirements: Isiqalo se-NQF 7 kwiNjulalwazi/Endalo eYakhiweyo okanye inkalo efanayo yefundo njengoko iphakanyiswe yi-SAQA. Isiqangqo seminyaka engama-5 yamava elinqanaba eliphezulu lophatha endalweni eyakhiweyo nisecaleni kolawulo lokwakha. Ukuqwalaselwa njengomphathi weProjekthi eNdiwe yolawulo yokuSetjhiiswa nge-SACPCMP. ULwazi: Iindlela ezilungileyo zokwakha, uLawulo lweProjekthi, ulwazi olusasileyo ngamacala onjiniwe onke endalo yokwakha nolwakhiwo, uMthetho woLawulo lweMali kaRhamenthe, uMthetho woKhuseleko lweMisebenzi nayeMojula, uLawulo lweNkqubo yoThengiso, uLawulo lweNkqubo yoQeqesho. Amakhono: Ukwenza izigqibo, ukuhola iqela, amakhono obunzuli bokuhlalutya, ukuqamba, ukuqonda ngokwakho, ulawulo lweziqhinga, ugqibo ngamaxa alinganayo kubathengi nokusabela, iNkqubo yokuxoxa, ukuzazi ngezikroba, uQeqesho nokuHlela, uLawulo lokungqubuzana, uLawulo labantu, amakhono okuxoxa ngexesha elinzima, ukuSombulula iingxaki nokuHlalutya, uLawulo lokuTshintsha, iNqamba, iNkqubo eNobuNzululwazi nokuHola. IimPawu zobuMntu: Amakhono, imigaqo neendlela zolawulo lweprojekthi, isigqibo seprojekthi nesonesiNdiwo, izicelo zolawulo lweProjekthi zokwakha ezisebenzisa iikhompyutha, ulwazi loyilo lolwakhiwo nokuHlalutya, isinxibelelwano ngokusebenza kolwakhiwo, ulwazi namakhono enkqubo, amakhono nolwazi lokuGunyazisa, amakhono okuQhuba izixhobo eziyahamba, ukuZaliseka kweMithetho nokuQaliswa, uPhuhliso nokuTyholwa, ukuMdiba kweNkqubo enokuPhezulu kwiNkqubo yokuSebenza, ugqibo lwesikolo nokuQeqesha abanye. Ukuvuma ukuhlela ishedyuli yokusebenza ngokomthetho onesiNdiwo.
xh.duties: Ukuqonda ukulawulwa kweziprojekthi zokwakha okanye zokulungisa iindlela zoLawulo loKwakha: Ukuphatha oluvo lokugqibela nokuvamisa okanye iindaba ezicondzulwayo kumadelwa amaprojekthi ngokwemigaqo yoyilo okanye inzululwazi. Qinisekisa imizamo yoyilo ebanzi kwaye idityaniswe phakathi kwezithuba ukuqinisekisa ukudityaniswa okusesikweni netekhnoloji yangoku. Lawula ukuqaliswa kwenkqubo yolawulo lweprojekthi ngokunikezela iindawo ezifanelekileyo, iinkqubo namagece. Qinisekisa ukuba amanqanaba amaprojekthi, iinkcazelo namanqanaba abasebenzi abeka ngokwemigomo yesebe ukugcina ukusebenza ngokulinganayo. Qapha ukusebenza ngamandla kolawulo lweprojekthi ngokwemigomo yenhlangano ukuyalela okanye ukuqamba kwakhona iinkonzo zeprojekthi ukufezela iinjongo zenhlangano. Lawula kulawule imali yokusebenza neproyekthi nemali echithwayo. Qonda ukulawulwa kwemigaqo yolawulo lokwakha, iinkqubo, amanqanaba namacebo: Phawula iindlela zamanqanaba ekuqwalaselweni kolawulo lokwakha namathuba okuphucula iinkqubo zoshishino. Vumela imigomiso ezipela ushintsho nophoniso kwimigaqo ekhoyo yolawulo lokwakha, amanqanaba, iinkqubo nemigangatho. Qonda ukusebenza kwemigaqo, amanqanaba, iinkqubo, iinkqubo namacebo nezinye iinkcazelo ezinxulumene nazo. Qinisekisa ukuphuhliswa nokusebenza kwezixhobo zokuncedisa. Qapha ukusebenza ukuqinisekisa ulandelo lwemigaqo nemiqathango. Qinisekisa ukusebenza kwenkqubo elungileyo, esebenzayo neseziko lokulawula ngaphakathi. Qinisekisa ukuhlelwa kohenelo lokunikela iinkonzo kwiprojekthi ngokweendlela ze-IDIP & IDMS: Incazelo yohenelo lokushishino nolwazi oluqwalaselwayo. Phuhlisa iinkqubo ezintsha zoshishino, iinkqubo eziseziko ezidibanayo, amanqanaba amasha obulungisebenzi, nolawulo lwenkqubo. Phinda uhlele amacece ukuba aphumeze iinkqubo ezintsha ngokwaneleyo. Hlela iqela langoku labachambi ngohlelo lweekhofa. Phinda uhlele iinkqubo zoshishino nokuhlinzeka nokuqaliswa kweekqubo zokungenisa ngaphakathi. Phuhlisa imigaqo enobomi yokuyila ukuyila isiseko somnxeba woyilo ixesha elizayo nantekhnoloji yokwakha njengoko kutshoyo iNkqubo ye-DPW Green Building. Lawula isiDikhephe seNkululeko: Misela ulondolaze iindawo zolawulo zangaphakathi nezinxibelelwano zokuvela ekuhlaleni ukuze uhlangabezane nethemba lokusebenza. Phuhlisa ulawule icebo lokusebenza leSebe eliya kuhlala lisebenza ngokwayo kwaye uchaze inkqubela njengoko kufuneka. Lawula ukusebenza nophuhliso labasebenzi. Misela, phumeza ulondolaze izinxibelelwano ezisebenzayo nangexesha elifanelekileyo. Hlanganisela ungenise zonke iingxelo zolawulo ezifunekayo. Lawulo lobakhali bomsebenzi oqediweyo ngabasebenzi. Qapha imali yokusebenza kunye namaxa othengo aseSebe esikhulu.

jobs.title: Director: Mechanical Engineering
jobs.department: Department of Public Works and Infrastructure
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 per annum, (Total package to be structured in accordance with the rules of the Senior Management Services)
jobs.summary: Director of Mechanical Engineering at the Department of Public Works and Infrastructure Head Office in Pretoria, requiring NQF 7, professional registration and five years' managerial experience.
jobs.requirements: A minimum of NQF 7 in Mechanical Engineering as recognised by the SAQA. A minimum of 5 years’ experience at a middle or Senior managerial level in mechanical engineering field. Registration as a Professional Engineer (Mechanical) with the Engineering Council of South Africa. Knowledge: Mechanical Engineering best practice. Extensive knowledge of all mechanical engineering aspects of the building and construction environment, Public Finance Management Act, Occupational Health and Safety Act, Supply Chain Management, Contract Management. Skills: Ability to undertake critical review/analysis and provide technical advice, Ability to maintain integrity of confidential information, financial administration, Effective verbal communication, Advanced technical report writing, Numeracy, Computer literacy, Organisation and planning, Relationship management, Programme and project management, Problem solving skills, Decision making skills, Motivational skills, Negotiation skills. Personal Attributes: Analytical thinking, Innovative, Creative, Solution orientated – ability to design ideas without direction, Ability to work under stressful situations, Ability to communicate at all levels, People orientated, Reliable, highly motivated. Willing to adapt work schedule in accordance with professional requirement.
jobs.duties: Manage the development, implementation and maintenance of mechanical engineering related policies, guideline and professional standards: Develop evaluation criteria that will serve to measure progress and effectiveness of departmental mechanical engineering operations. Develop and maintain professional best practice parameters and quality standards and manuals and guideline on professional standards. Monitor and ensure the implementation and continuous adherence to policies and procedures, as well as professional and industry-specific standards and regulations. Provide technical consulting services for the operation on engineering related matters to minimize possible engineering risks. Manage the design, planning and implementation of engineering projects: Perform audits on engineering designs and approve according to design principles or theory. Manage design efforts and integration across disciplines to ensure seamless integration with current technology. Analyse technology, resources and market demand, to plan and assess the feasibility of projects. Oversee production, quality assurance, quality control, testing and maintenance as required. Verify compliance with plans, industry and project standards, building codes, legal requirements and more. Monitor progress against project schedules and budgets and recommend allocation of resources as required to accomplish goals. Manage the maintenance of engineering operational effectiveness: Manage the execution of maintenance strategy through the provision of appropriate structures, systems and resources. Set engineering maintenance standards, specifications and service levels to ensure optimum operational availability. Monitor maintenance efficiencies according to departmental goals to direct or redirect engineering services. Manage mechanical engineering operations budget: Ensure the availability and management of funds to meet the MTEF objectives within the engineering environment. Manage the operational capital project portfolio for the operation to ensure effective resourcing according to organisational needs and objectives. Manage the commercial value add of the discipline-related programmes and projects. Facilitate the compilation of innovation proposals to ensure validity and adherence to organizational principles. Allocate, control and monitor expenditure according to budget to ensure efficient cash flow management. Manage the Directorate: Establish and maintain appropriate internal controls and reporting systems in order to meet performance expectations. Develop and manage the operational plan of the Directorate and report on progress as required. Manage performance and development of employees. Establish, implement and maintain efficient and effective communication arrangements. Compile and submit all required administrative reports. Quality control of work delivered by employees. Monitor the budget and expenditures for the Directorate.
jobs.applications: Head Office Applications: The Director-General, Department of Public Works, Private Bag X65, Pretoria, 0001 or Hand deliver at 256 Madiba Street, CGO Building, Pretoria or email to: Recruitment26-66@dpw.gov.za FOR ATTENTION : Ms NP Mudau
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on the prescribed Z83 application form (obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the DPSA website link: https:/www.dpsa.gov.za/newsroom/psvc/, which must be signed, initialled and dated by the applicant, and must be accompanied by a detailed curriculum vitae (CV) only. Candidates are not required to submit certified copies of qualifications and related documents on application. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualification and other related documents on or before the date of interview, which should not be older than six months. Should an application be submitted using incorrect/old Z83 application form, such an application will be disqualified. Further take note of the following on completion of Z83 application form: PART A and PART B must be fully completed. PART C - PART G: Noting that there is a limited space provided applicants may refer to CV or indicate. This will be acceptable as long as the CV has been attached and provides the required information. Page 1 of the Z83 application form must be initialled and page 2 signed and dated by the applicant. Failure to comply with the above instructions may result in an application being disqualified. Applicants applying for more than one advertised post must submit separate Z83 application forms and CVs in respect to each post being applied for. Should an application be received where an applicant has applied for more than one posts on the same Z83 application form, the applicant will be considered for the first post indicated on the Z83 application form only. Applications will be received via post/courier services, hand deliveries or email. Late applications will not be considered. Regulation 57 (c) and 67 (9) of the Public Service Regulations 2016, as amended, requires the executive authority to ensure that he or she is fully satisfied of the claims being made and the finalisation of Personnel Suitability Checks in order to verify claims and check the candidate for purpose of being fit and proper for employment, respectively. Shortlisted candidates must be willing to undergo normal vetting and verification processes. Note: It is the responsibility of all applicants to ensure that foreign qualifications are evaluated by SAQA. Due to large volume of responses anticipated, receipt of applications will not be acknowledged, and correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. Should you not have heard from us within three months from the closing date, please regard your application as unsuccessful. Entry level requirements for SMS posts: in terms of the Directive on Human Resource Management and Development on Public Service Professionalisation Volume 1 a requirement for appointment into SMS posts is the successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-Entry programme as endorsed by the National School of Governance (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into SMS and the full details can be obtained by following the below link: https: www.thensg.gov.za/training –course /sms-pre-entry programme/. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Note: For emailed applications, please submit a single PDF document or one attachment per application to the email address designated on the specific position. Kindly note that the emailed applications and attachments should not exceed 15MB. It remains the candidate’s responsibility to ensure that their application is successfully submitted using the required single pdf document. Encrypted document will not be accepted. All though an email application option is available, applicants are encouraged to hand deliver their application. IMPORTANT: Applicants must submit a separate application for each post applied for, clearly indicating the correct reference number and post title on each application. Applicants who apply for more than one post must submit a separate application for each post. Failure to comply with this requirement may result in the application not being considered. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Direkteur: Meganiese Ingenieurswese
af.summary: Direkteur van Meganiese Ingenieurswese by die Departement van Public Works and Infrastructure Hoofkantoor in Pretoria, wat NQF 7, professionele registrasie en vyf jaar se bestuurservaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Minimum van NQF 7 in Meganiese Ingenieurswese soos erken deur die SAQA. 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se ervaring op 'n middel- of senior bestuursvlak in die veld van meganiese ingenieurswese. Registrasie as 'n Professionele Ingenieur (Meganies) by die Engineering Council of South Africa. Kennis: Bestens gebruik van meganiese ingenieurswese. Uitgebreide kennis van alle aspekte van meganiese ingenieurswese binne die bou- en konstruksie-omgewing, Public Finance Management Act, Occupational Health and Safety Act, Supply Chain Management, Contract Management. Vaardighede: Vermoë om kritiese hersiening/analise te onderneem en tegniese advies te gee, Vermoë om die integriteit van vertroulike inligting te handhaaf, finansiële administrasie, Effektiewe mondelinge kommunikasie, Gevorderde tegniese verslagskrywing, Syfergeletterdheid, Rekenaargeletterdheid, Organisasie en beplanning, Verhoudingsbestuur, Program- en projekbestuur, Probleemoplossingsvaardighede, Besluitnemingsvaardighede, Motiveringsvaardighede, Onderhandelingsvaardighede. Persoonlike eienskappe: Analitiese denke, Innovatief, Kreatief, Oplossingsgerig – vermoë om idees sonder rigting te ontwerp, Vermoë om onder stresvolle omstandighede te werk, Vermoë om op alle vlakke te kommunikeer, Mensegerig, Betroubaar, hoogs gemotiveerd. Bereid om werkskedule ooreenkomstig professionele vereistes aan te pas.
af.duties: Bestuur die ontwikkeling, implementering en onderhoud van meganiese ingenieurswese-verwante beleide, riglyne en professionele standaarde: Ontwikkel evalueringskriteria wat sal dien om vordering en doeltreffendheid van departementele meganiese ingenieurswese-bedrywighede te meet. Ontwikkel en handhaaf professionele best-praktijk parameters en kwaliteitsstandaarde en handleidings en riglyne oor professionele standaarde. Monitor en verseker die implementering en deurlopende nakoming van beleide en prosedures, asook professionele en bedryfsspesifieke standaarde en regulasies. Verskaf tegniese konsultasiedienste vir die bedryf aangaande ingenieurswese-verwante aangeleenthede om moontlike ingenieursrisiko's te minimeer. Bestuur die ontwerp, beplanning en implementering van ingenieursprojekte: Ouditteer ingenieursontwerpe en keur goed volgens ontwerpbeginsels of -teorie. Bestuur ontwerppogings en integrasie oor dissiplines heen om naatlose integrasie met huidige tegnologie te verseker. Analiseer tegnologie, hulpbronne en markvraag om die haalbaarheid van projekte te beplan en te assesseer. Hou toesig oor produksie, kwaliteitversekering, kwaliteitsbeheer, toetsing en onderhoud soos vereis. Verifieer nakoming van planne, bedryfs- en projekstandaarde, boukodes, wetlike vereistes en meer. Monitor vordering teenoor projekskedules en begrotings en beveel toekenning van hulpbronne soos vereis aan om doelwitte te bereik. Bestuur die onderhoud van ingenieursbedryfsdoeltreffendheid: Bestuur die uitvoering van die onderhoudsstrategie deur die voorsiening van toepaslike strukture, stelsels en hulpbronne. Stel ingenieursonderhoudsstandaarde, spesifikasies en diensvlakke om optimale bedryfsbeskikbaarheid te verseker. Monitor onderhoudsdoeltreffendheid volgens departementele doelwitte om ingenieursdienste te rig of herlei. Bestuur die begroting vir meganiese ingenieursbedrywighede: Verseker die beskikbaarheid en bestuur van fondse om MTEF-doelwitte binne die ingenieursomgewing te bereik. Bestuur die operatiewe kapitaalprojekportefeulje vir die bedryf om effektiewe hulpbronvoorsiening volgens organisatoriese behoeftes en doelwitte te verseker. Bestuur die kommersiële waardebyvoeging van die dissipline-verwante programme en projekte. Fasiliteer die samestelling van innovasie-voorstelle om geldigheid en nakoming van organisatoriese beginsels te verseker. Ken, beheer en monitor besteding volgens begroting om doeltreffende kontantvloei-bestuur te verseker. Bestuur die Direktoraat: Stel en handhaaf toepaslike interne beheermaatreëls en verslagdoeningstelsels om prestasieverwagtinge te bereik. Ontwikkel en bestuur die operatiewe plan van die Direktoraat en rapporteer oor vordering soos vereis. Bestuur prestasie en ontwikkeling van werknemers. Stel, implementeer en handhaaf doeltreffende kommunikasie-reëlings. Stel alle vereiste administratiewe verslae op en dien dit in. Kwaliteitsbeheer van werk wat deur werknemers gelewer word. Monitor die begroting en besteding vir die Direktoraat.

zu.title: Umkhulu: Injiniyela Yezobuchwepheshye
zu.summary: Umkhulu Wobuchwepheshye Bezentengiswa eNqekwanda LeBhodi LoMnyango WezeRruntu Nemisebenzi Ephezulu ePretoria, ofuna iNQF 7, ukubhaliswa njengochwephileshe kanye neminyaka emihlanu yohlu lwaloluhlelo lokuba ngumphathi.
zu.requirements: Okungaphezulu kweNQF 7 kwezobuchwepheshye bokwenza izinto zokushaywa ngesikhathi esithathwa njengesabhalwa yi-SAQA. Okungaphezulu kweminyaka eyi-5 yokuthwetshulwa kweso sezikhathi sendlela yaba ngumphathi phakathi noma phezulu olunendima enkulu yokuqasha kwezobuchwepheshye bokwenza izinto zokushaywa. Ukuqashwa njengenjiniyela ngobuchwepheshile (yemishini) eNdkundleni YabaChwephileshe BakwaNingizimu Afrika. Ulwazi: Isimo esihle kakhulu sobuchwepheshye bokwenza izinto zokushaywa. Ulwazi olubanzi ngezidingo zonke zezobuchwepheshye bokwenza izinto zokushaywa kwendawo yokwakha nokwakhiwa, uMthetho Wokuqasha Wezimali Zomphakathi, uMthetho Wokuqaphela Iimpilo Nokuphila Kwezisebenzi, Ukuphathwa Kwezinkambu Zokuhlinzeka, Ukuphathwa KwamaQembu. Amakhono: Ikono lokwenza inhlolankatholo nokuqapha futhi kunikezelwe izeluleko ezobuchwepheshye, Ikono lokuqonda ukuba inamathelayo afile kakhulu endaweni ethize, okugcina imininingwane, ukugcinwa kwesimo sobumfihlo, ukuphathwa kwezimali, ukukhuluma kahle ngomlomo, ukubhala imibhalo ebalulekile ngobuchwepheshye ukuya phansi, ukubala, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ukuphathwa kohlelo nokuhlela, ukuphathwa kwezinkinga, ukuphatha amaphrojekthi, amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga, amakhono okwenza izinqumo, amakhono okukhuthaza, amakhono okuxoxa ngokuzwa. Izimilo: Ukucabanga ngezenzo ezihlolwayo, okusha, okudaliwe, okuholela ekuxazululweni - ikono lokucabanga izinkhangelo ngaphandle kokukhokhelwa, ikono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwezimo ezinomthwalo, ikono lokuxhumana ngezigaba zonke, ukuthanda abantu, okwethemba, okukhuthazwa kakhulu. Ukuzithoba ukushintsha isikhathi sokuqasha ngokubhalanise nezidingo zobuchwepheshile, izinkomba ezisebenza njengengxenye yesikhathi sokusebenza, kwezocansi nobuchwepheshile.
zu.duties: Ciphula ukuthuthukiswa, ukusetshenziswa nokugcinwa kwezinqulumo, izinkomba nemiKhubalo yokusebenza yezobuchwepheshye bokushaywa izinto: Tumba izinkomba eziyisisekelo ezoqondisa ukuba kulinganiswe kangakanani ukuthuthuka nempumelelo kokushaywa izinto zikahulumeni ngobuchwepheshye bokushaywa. Tumba futhi ulondoloze imingcele yokugcina isimo esihle ngobuchwepheshye, izikalo zekhwalithi namabhuku okungasibali kanye nezinkomba ngemikhawulo yezocansi. Qapha futhi uqinisekise ukusetshenziswa kanye nokubambezela okukhulu ezinqumulweni nasezinhleleni zokusebenza, kanye nemikhawulo yezobuchwepheshile nezimbona emithe ngokuthile. Nikeza izinkonzo zokusiza ezobuchwepheshye ekusebenzeni kwezokushaywa izinto ukunciphisa okungaba yingozi ezobuchwepheshye. Ciphula ukwakhiwa, ukuhlela nokusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo ze-elemu zokushaywa izinto: Yenza ukuphonononga kwezokusakhiwa ukwenzela ukuqinisekiswa ngaphandle kobuchwepheshye obukhulu. Hlela ukushaywa kwezinto okusetshenzisiwe ngokuhlanganisa izindlela ezihlukene ukugcina ukungena kobuchwepheshye bokushaywa izinto kulawulo olulukhuni emthethweni wemisebenzi. Hlaziya ubuchwepheshye, amandla okusebenza kanye neskwe zohwebo mayelana nemigwaqo, ukunakekelwa nokuphethwa kwezinkomba ezifanele khona nasezinhlelweni ezithize. Qapha inqubo yokukhiqizwa, ukugunyazwa, ukucwazulwa kokukhiqiza nokuvunyelwa njengoba kudingeka. Hlola ukuhambisana neNkqubo, imikhawulo yesimbona kanye neprojekthi, izikalo zokwakha, izinkululeko ezomthetho nakakhulu. Qapha ukuthi kuhamba kahle yini ngohlelo lwezinsuku nezimali futhi aze asinikeze izinkomba ngokuthi kuhlelwa imali nendlela ezothile ngokwemigomo nezinsizakalo ezifanele ekuzuzeni izinhloso. Ciphula ukugqama kwezinsizakalo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ezobuchwepheshye bokushaywa izinto: Qamba futhi ulondoloze imithetho yokuphatha ukugcinwa kwaleminikelo ngokuhlinzeka ngokusungwa, izimiso kanye nezinsizakalo. Hlela imithetho yokugcina ukusebenza kwezinto zokushaywa, izinkomba kanye nemigomo yezinsizakazo ukuze kugcinwe isimo esifanele sokusebenza kahle. Qapha inqubo yokugcinwa kwezinto zokushaywa ngemigomo yohlelo ukuze kwakhiwe futhi kulawulwe ukulawulwa kwezokushaywa izinto ezingahle zithinte isimo ngqo seNqubo. Lawula imali yokusebenza yohlelo lokuqasha ezinkampanini ezinkulu: Qina nokusebenza kweMali ukugcina izinhloso zokuqashwa ezikahulumeni kanye nokuhlelwa komsebenzi wocansi. Qamba futhi uqinisekise ukuba ngumgibe futhi uthuthukise imiKhubalo ekubhaleni imibhalo ebalulekile ekuzuzeni izinhloso kanye nomthelela ekubalulekeni kolwazi. Cisha imali esebenziswa ngokuhleleka kwesikhathi, ulawule futhi ulandele imali esebenziswa ngemali yokusebenza ukugcina ukugcinwa kokuhamba kahle kwemali. Lawula imisebenzi yokubhala nemibhalo yohlelo lokuphatha: Susa nokulawula ukungena ngemithetho nokuqashwa emsebenzini ohleliwe kokuhlela ukuhlangabezana nenyongo yomsebenzi. Hlela futhi ciphula uhlelo lokusebenza lokuqasha futhi unikeze imibhalo yokuhamba emsebenzini njengethemba. Ciphula ukusetshenziswa okuzwakalayo nokuphathwa kwemisebenzi yabasebenzi. Susa, sikhombise futhi ulondoloze izindlela ezibalulekile zokuxhumana. Tola futhi unikeze imibhalo eminingi eqohiweyo efuna imikhubalo yokuhlela. Ukulawula ukusebenza kahle kolwazi olunikelwe abasebenzi. Qapha imali nezezimali ezimalini eqohiweyo ngemali esebenziswa.

xh.title: Umphathi: Injineli Yezobuchwephetha
xh.summary: Umphathi weNjineli Yezobuchwephetha kwiSebe leZaMisebenzi kaRhulumathi nezeMiGangatho eNtliko kwiNtloko ePretoria, efunwa kukuba ngumntu onemvelaphi yemfundo esebenzayo eyi-NQF 7, abhalisiwe njengongcali kakhulu kwaye anamava eminyaka emihlanu ebaleni ukuba ngumphathi.
xh.requirements: Isiphelo se-NQF 7 kwiNjineli Yezobuchwephetha njengokuqatshiweyo yi-SAQA. Isiphelo samava emnyakeni ongama-5 kwinqanaba labaphathi abaphakathi okanye abakhulu kakhulu kummandla wezobuchwephetha. Ukubhaliswa njengeNjineli eNobuchwephetha kunye neBhunga lezoBuchwephetha loMzantsi Afrika. Ulwazi: Iindlela ezilungileyo zokuqwalasela iNjineli Yezobuchwephetha. Ulwazi olubanzi ngazo zonke iindawo zezobuchwephetha zendalo yokwakha nokwakhiwa, uMthetho woLawulo lweMali kaRhulumathi, uMthetho weMpilo yoKhuseleko loMsebenzi, uLawulo lweNxibelelwano yoQoqosho, noLawulo beeNkqubo zoNxibelelwano. Amandla: Ukuba nokwazi lokwenza isiphelo/ukuphonononga kwaye unikezelwe ngelixa lezobugcisa, Ulwazi lokugcina iinkcukacha ezimfihlo zisayimfihlo, ulawulo lweemali ezisetyenziswa kwicala lokulawula imali, Ukuba nolwazi lokuthetha ngokusebenzisa iindlela ezahlukeneyo, Ulwazi lokubhala iiripoti ezibuxhaka kakhulu ngezobugcisa, Ulwazi lokwahlula amanani, Ulwazi lokusebenza ngekhompyutha, Ukuqamba kwaye ulungelelanise, Ukulawula iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokubamba ilondolozo nemigaqo, Ukulawula iinkqubo, Ukulawula imisebenzi ebalulekileyo kubomi, Isiphithiphithi sokuzama ukuzonakalisa nokuphucula ulwazi, Ukuba nolwazi ngendlela yokuthetha nokuxoxa, Ulwazi lokuzama ukuphucula ulwazi. Iimpawu zobuNtu: Isiphelo sokucinga ngendlela efanayo, Isiphelo sokuzama ukufumana iindlela ezintsha, Ulwazi lokudala izinto ezintsha, Ulwazi lokunika iindlela ezahlukeneyo ezinokuthi zisombulule iingxaki – isiphithiphithi sokudala iindlela ngeendlela ezahlukeneyo, Ulwazi lokwenza umsebenzi ngexesha elinzima, Ulwazi lokuba nakho ukuthetha nabantu abanemfundo ezahlukeneyo, Ukuba nobulungisa kubomi bakho, Ulwazi olunyuka ngobuchwephetha nangokwengqondo.
xh.duties: Lawula iinkqubo ezintsha zokwakha iindawo ezahlukeneyo zokuthengiswa kwezobuchwephetha: Dala iindlela zokuqwalasela ukuba ngaphi na inkqubo efuna ukuqwalaselwa kwaye kubekwe iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokuqwalaselwa kwezobuchwephetha ngokwemigaqo yeliso. Dala kwaye ugcine iindlela ezilungileyo nezigqibo zokwakha iindawo ezilungileyo kwaye uzame ukugcina iindlela ezilungileyo nemiqathango yokusebenza. Qwalasela kwaye uqinisekise ukuba kusebenza ngokwemigaqo nemithetho yeliso, kwaye ngokwezobuchwephetha nabantu abakweli cala. Nikela ngelixa lobugcisa kwinkqubo ngemida ezahlukeneyo zokunciphisa iingozi ezinokubakho kwindalo yokusebenza. Lawula ukwakhiwa, ukulungelelanisa nokusebenza kweenkqubo zezobuchwephetha: Yenza iindlela zokuqwalasela iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokwakha kwaye uvume ngokwemiqathako yolwazi. Lawula iindlela zokwakhiwa nokudibanisa iindawo ezahlukeneyo kuqinisekise ukuba kusebenza ngokwemigaqo yolwazi lwamnye. Qwalasela iindlela ezahlukeneyo zolwazi, iindlela ezinokuthi zisetyenziswe kakhulu, ukuya kwindawo yokuba kukho amathandathu, ukuya kwamathandathu. Lawula ukugcinwa kolwazi nokulungelelanisa kweenkqubo ezahlukeneyo zeendawo ezahlukeneyo.

jobs.title: Director: Marketing and Public Relations
jobs.department: Department of Public Works and Infrastructure
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 per annum, (all-inclusive package), (total package to be structured in accordance with the rules of the Senior Management Services).
jobs.summary: Director of Marketing and Public Relations at the Department of Public Works and Infrastructure in Pretoria, offering R1,317,384 per annum.
jobs.requirements: A minimum of NQF 7 in Journalism, Public Relations, Marketing or related field of study as recognised by the SAQA. A minimum of 5 years’ experience at a middle or Senior managerial level in the relevant field. Knowledge: Marketing and communications, Extensive knowledge of department strategic objective, In-depth knowledge of Government Communication processes, Extensive knowledge of Departments Communication processes and policies, Extensive knowledge about the dynamics of South African media, In-depth knowledge of government protocol processes, Development and implementation of strategies, Public Finance Management Act, Supply Chain Management, Office Management, Structure and functioning of the Department. Skills: Advanced marketing skills, Language proficiency, Advanced report writing, Organising and planning, Computer utilisation, Policy formulation, Planning and organising, Negotiation skills, Advanced communication (verbal and written), Advanced interpersonal and diplomacy skills, Time management, Decision making skills, Conflict management, Motivational skills, Influencing skills, Programme and management skills. Personal Attributes: Team player, Innovative, Creative, Resourceful, Energetic, Ability to meet tight deadlines whilst delivering excellent results, Ability to communicate at all levels, particularly at an executive level, Ale to establish and maintain personal networks, Trustworthy, Assertive, Hardworking, highly motivated, Ability to work independently. Willing to adapt work schedule in accordance with professional requirement; Willing to travel.
jobs.duties: Manage the development and implementation of marketing and public relations policies and strategies: Undertake research on the latest developments in professional guidelines, legislations and standards. Manage benchmarks with various institutions for marketing and public relations best practices. Lead the development and execution of comprehensive marketing and public relations strategies. Ensure that all marketing and public relations policies, guidelines and standards are developed in line with applicable prescripts and are aligned to the Department’s strategic objective. Monitor the implementation and ensure compliance with applicable policies and Directives. Evaluate marketing and public relations strategies and processes in order to continually improve them. Oversee the coordination of the departments marketing to enhance awareness and public relations: Oversee the planning of marketing and public relations campaigns. Manage the coordination of marketing and public relations surveys and analysis of the department’s public image and reputation. Manage the use of corporate advertising to establish maintain departments` corporate identity in the public domain. Oversee the production of marketing and public relations written and visual communication material. Ensure documents and marketing materials are current, accurate and properly reflect the department’s brand and desired message. Manage the coordination of all departmental and Ministers Public Participation Programmes (MPPP). Manage the building of the department’s corporate identity and work on maintaining a positive image: Establish and maintain sound stakeholder relations. Respond to requests for information release with regard to marketing and public relations. Oversee the promotion the department’s image through public participation at special publicity events and exhibitions. Manage the development of programs to maintain positive public and stockholder views of the department's agenda and accomplishments. Ensure brand compliance as per the corporate identity guidelines. Manage the corporate identity promotional materials. Provide advice to stakeholders on corporate identity guidelines. Manage the Directorate: Establish and maintain appropriate internal controls and reporting systems in order to meet performance expectations. Management of performance and development. Establish, implement and maintain efficient and effective communication arrangements. Develop and manage the operational plan of the directorate and report on progress as required. Compile and submit all required administrative reports. Serve on transverse task teams as required. Quality control of work delivered by employees. Manage and monitor the budget and expenditure for the directorate. Quality control of work delivered by employees.
jobs.applications: Head Office Applications: The Director-General, Department of Public Works, Private Bag X65, Pretoria, 0001 or Hand deliver at 256 Madiba Street, CGO Building, Pretoria or email to: Recruitment26-67@dpw.gov.za FOR ATTENTION : Ms NP Mudau
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on the prescribed Z83 application form (obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the DPSA website link: https:/www.dpsa.gov.za/newsroom/psvc/, which must be signed, initialled and dated by the applicant, and must be accompanied by a detailed curriculum vitae (CV) only. Candidates are not required to submit certified copies of qualifications and related documents on application. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualification and other related documents on or before the date of interview, which should not be older than six months. Should an application be submitted using incorrect/old Z83 application form, such an application will be disqualified. Further take note of the following on completion of Z83 application form: PART A and PART B must be fully completed. PART C - PART G: Noting that there is a limited space provided applicants may refer to CV or indicate. This will be acceptable as long as the CV has been attached and provides the required information. Page 1 of the Z83 application form must be initialled and page 2 signed and dated by the applicant. Failure to comply with the above instructions may result in an application being disqualified. Applicants applying for more than one advertised post must submit separate Z83 application forms and CVs in respect to each post being applied for. Should an application be received where an applicant has applied for more than one posts on the same Z83 application form, the applicant will be considered for the first post indicated on the Z83 application form only. Applications will be received via post/courier services, hand deliveries or email. Late applications will not be considered. Regulation 57 (c) and 67 (9) of the Public Service Regulations 2016, as amended, requires the executive authority to ensure that he or she is fully satisfied of the claims being made and the finalisation of Personnel Suitability Checks in order to verify claims and check the candidate for purpose of being fit and proper for employment, respectively. Shortlisted candidates must be willing to undergo normal vetting and verification processes. Note: It is the responsibility of all applicants to ensure that foreign qualifications are evaluated by SAQA. Due to large volume of responses anticipated, receipt of applications will not be acknowledged, and correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. Should you not have heard from us within three months from the closing date, please regard your application as unsuccessful. Entry level requirements for SMS posts: in terms of the Directive on Human Resource Management and Development on Public Service Professionalisation Volume 1 a requirement for appointment into SMS posts is the successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-Entry programme as endorsed by the National School of Governance (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into SMS and the full details can be obtained by following the below link: https: www.thensg.gov.za/training –course /sms-pre-entry programme/. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Note: For emailed applications, please submit a single PDF document or one attachment per application to the email address designated on the specific position. Kindly note that the emailed applications and attachments should not exceed 15MB. It remains the candidate’s responsibility to ensure that their application is successfully submitted using the required single pdf document. Encrypted document will not be accepted. All though an email application option is available, applicants are encouraged to hand deliver their application. IMPORTANT: Applicants must submit a separate application for each post applied for, clearly indicating the correct reference number and post title on each application. Applicants who apply for more than one post must submit a separate application for each post. Failure to comply with this requirement may result in the application not being considered. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Direkteur: Bemarking en Publieke Verhoudinge
af.summary: Direkteur van Bemarking en Publieke Verhoudinge by die Department of Public Works and Infrastructure in Pretoria, teen R1,317,384 per jaar.
af.requirements: 'n Minimum van NQF 7 in Joernalistiek, Publieke Verhoudinge, Bemarking of 'n verwante studieveld soos deur die SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se ervaring op 'n middel- of senior bestuursvlak in die relevante veld. Kennis: Bemarking en kommunikasie, Uitgebreide kennis van die departement se strategiese doelwitte, Diepgaande kennis van regeringskommunikasieprosesse, Uitgebreide kennis van die departement se kommunikasieprosesse en -beleide, Uitgebreide kennis oor die dinamika van die Suid-Afrikaanse media, Diepgaande kennis van regeringsprotokolprosesse, Ontwikkeling en implementering van strategieë, Public Finance Management Act, Supply Chain Management, Kantoorbestuur, Struktuur en funksionering van die departement. Vaardighede: Gevorderde bemarkingsvaardighede, Taalvaardigheid, Gevorderde verslagskrywing, Organisering en beplanning, Rekenaargebruik, Beleidsformulering, Beplanning en organisering, Onderhandelingsvaardighede, Gevorderde kommunikasie (mondeling en skriftelik), Gevorderde interpersoonlike en diplomatieke vaardighede, Tydbestuur, Besluitnemingsvaardighede, Konflikbestuur, Motiveringsvaardighede, Beïnvloedingsvaardighede, Program- en bestuursvaardighede. Persoonlike eienskappe: Spanspeler, Innoverend, Kreatief, Vindingryk, Energiek, Vermoe om styngedagtenames na te kom terwyl uitstekende resultate gelewer word, Vermoe om op alle vlakke te kommunikeer, veral op uitvoerende vlak, Vermoe om persoonlike netwerke op te bou en in stand te hou, Betroubaar, Selfversekerd, Ywerig, hoogs gemotiveerd, Vermoe om onafhanklik te werk. Bereid om werkskedule in ooreenstemming met professionele vereistes aan te pas; Bereid om te reis.
af.duties: Bestuur die ontwikkeling en implementering van bemarkings- en publieke verhoudingsbeleide en -strategieë: Ondersoek die jongste ontwikkelinge in professionele riglyne, wetgewing en standaarde. Bestuur vergelykings met verskeie instellings vir bestuurspraktyke in bemarking en publieke verhoudinge. Lei die ontwikkeling en uitvoering van omvattende bemarkings- en publieke verhoudingsstrategieë. Verseker dat alle bemarkings- en publieke verhoudingsbeleide, riglyne en standaarde in ooreenstemming met toepaslike voorskrifte ontwikkel word en op die departement se strategiese doelwitte uitgelyn is. Monitor die implementering en verseker nakoming van toepaslike beleide en richtlyne. Evalueer bemarkings- en publieke verhoudingsstrategieë en -prosesse om dit voortdurend te verbeter. Hou toesig oor die koordinasie van die departement se bemarking om bewustheid en publieke verhoudinge te bevorder: Hou toesig oor die beplanning van bemarkings- en publieke verhoudingsveldtogte. Bestuur die koordinasie van bemarkings- en publieke verhoudingsopnames en ontleding van die departement se openbare beeld en reputasie. Bestuur die gebruik van korporatiewe advertensies om die departement se korporatiewe identiteit in die openbare domein te vestig en te handhaaf. Hou toesig oor die produksie van geskrewe en visuele kommunikasiemateriaal vir bemarking en publieke verhoudinge. Verseker dat dokumente en bemarkingsmateriaal huidig, akkuraat is en die departement se merk en gewenste boodskap behoorlik weerspieël. Bestuur die koordinasie van alle departementele en Ministers Public Participation Programmes (MPPP). Bestuur die opbou van die departement se korporatiewe identiteit en werk aan die handhaaf van 'n positiewe beeld: Vestig en handhaaf goeie belanghebbendeverhoudinge. Reageer op versoeke om inligtingsvrystelling met betrekking tot bemarking en publieke verhoudinge. Hou toesig oor die bevordering van die departement se beeld deur publieke deelname aan spesiale publisiteitsgeleenthede en uitstallings. Bestuur die ontwikkeling van programme om positiewe publieke en aandeelhouersienings van die departement se agenda en prestasies te handhaaf. Verseker merknakoming volgens die riglyne vir korporatiewe identiteit. Bestuur die korporatiewe identiteitspromosiemateriaal. Verskaf advies aan belanghebbendes oor riglyne vir korporatiewe identiteit. Bestuur die Direktoraat: Vestig en handhaaf toepaslike interne beheermaatreëls en verslagdoeningstelsels om prestasieverwagtinge te bereik. Bestuur van prestasie en ontwikkeling. Vestig, implementeer en handhaaf doeltreffende en effektiewe kommunikasiereëlings. Ontwikkel en bestuur die operasionele plan van die direktoraat en doen verslag oor vordering soos vereis. Stel alle vereiste administratiewe verslae op en dien dit in. Dien soos vereis op dwarstaakspanne. Kwaliteitsbeheer van werk wat deur werknemers gelewer word. Bestuur en monitor die begroting en besteding vir die direktoraat. Kwaliteitsbeheer van werk wat deur werknemers gelewer word.

zu.title: Umphathi: UkuMarket nokuHlobana nomPhakathi

Ukwazi: UkuMarket nokuThumela imiyalezo, Ukwazi okujulile ngemigomo yokuhlose komnyango, Ukwazi okujulile ngemiqondo yokuxhumana kahulumeni, Ukwazi okujulile ngemiqondo nezenzo zokuxhumana zomnyango, Ukwazi okujulile ngamandlaabezindaba aseNingizimu Afrika, Ukwazi okujulile ngemikhuba yephothokholi kahulumeni, Ukuthuthukisa nokuphatha imigomo, uMthetho WokuPhathwa KweMali Yomphakathi, uPhathwa Lwezinkomba Zokuhlinzeka, uPhathwa KoMsebenzi, Isakhiwo nokuSebenza komnyango. Amakhono: Amakhono aphakeme wokuMarket, Ukuqonda ulimi, Ukubhala umbiko ngendlela ephakeme, ukuHlela nokuCubungula, Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, Ukwakheka kwemigomo, ukuHlela nokuCubungula, Amakhono okuxoxisana, UkuThumela imiyalezo ngesimo somlomo nokushibhile ngesimo esiphezulu, Amakhono okuhlobana nabantu nokuhambisana nabo ngesimo esiphezulu, ukuPhathwa kwesikhathi, Amakhono wokuThatha izinqumo, ukuPhathwa phakathi kokungavumelani, Amakhono okukhuthaza, Amakhono okuNtanta, Amakhono wokuPhatha imibekezelo. zu.duties: uPhathwa kokuthuthukiswa nokuSetshenziswa kwemigomo nendlela yokuMarket nokuHlobana nomPhakathi: UkuQhuba ucwaningo ngentuthuko yakamuva emiholishini yobuchwepheshe, emithethweni nasemazingeni. uPhathwa kokulinganisa nezinye izikhungo ezahlukene ngokwemigomo yokuMarket nokuHlobana nomPhakathi. ukuHola ukuthuthukiswa nokuQashwa kwemigomo yokuMarket nokuHlobana nomPhakathi eqoqwe ndawonye. ukuQinisekisa ukuthi yonke imigomo, imiholishini namazinga yokuMarket nokuHlobana nomPhakathi ithuthukiswe ngokohlelo olusebenzayo futhi ihambisana nemigomo yokuhlose yomnyango. ukuQapha ukuSetshenziswa kwayo nokuQinisekisa ukuthi ihambisana nemigomo neziyalezo ezisebenzayo. ukuHlolwa kwemigomo nendlela yokuMarket nokuHlobana nomPhakathi ukuze iyithuthukise ngokuqhubekayo. ukuQapha ukuHlanganisa imisebenzi yokuMarket yomnyango ukuze kuQeduliswe ukwazi nokuhlobana nomPhakathi: ukuQapha ukuHlela imigomo yokuMarket nokuHlobana nomPhakathi. uPhathwa kokuHlanganisa imibuzo yokucwaninga yokuMarket nokuHlobana nomPhakathi nokuHlolisisa isithombe somnyango esiphakathi nendawo yokubukeka kwawo. uPhathwa kokusetshenziswa kokuthumela izikhangiso zenhlangano ukuze kusungulwe futhi kugcinwe isibonakaliso senhlangano kumphakathi. ukuQapha ukwenziwa kolwazi lokuMarket nokuHlobana nomPhakathi olushibhile nolubonwayo. ukuQinisekisa ukuthi amafayela nolwazi lokuMarket lumanje, luyiqiniso futhi lumela isibonakaliso somnyango nomyalezo ofunekayo. uPhathwa kokuHlanganisa bonke abahola imibekezelo yomphakathi bomnyango kanye noNgqongqoshe. uPhathwa kokwakheka kwesibonakaliso somnyango nokuGcina isithombe esihle: ukuSungula nokuGcina uHlobano oluhle nalabo abanomdlandla. ukuPhendula izidingo zokukhishwa kolwazi ngokuMarket nokuHlobana nomPhakathi. ukuQaphaukuKhuthaza isithombe somnyango ngokuhlanganyela emphakathi emicimbini ekhethekile kanye emayezezweni. uPhathwa kokuthuthukiswa imibekezelo ukuze kugcinwe ukubuka okuhle kwentando yomnyango nemisebenzi yawo. ukuQinisekisa ukuthi kuhambisana nesibonakaliso ngokohlelo lwesibonakaliso senhlangano. uPhathwa izinto zokuKhuthaza isibonakaliso senhlangano. ukuNika izinkulelo kulabo abanomdlandla ngezenzo zesibonakaliso senhlangano. uPhathwa iHholo: ukuSungula nokuGcina izilawuli zangaphakathi ezifanele nokuPhathwa kokuQoqwa kokutholakala ukuze kuGcotshwe ukwenza emandleni. uPhathwa kokwenza nentuthuko. ukuSungula, ukuSetshenzisa nokuGcina ukuHlelana kokuthumela imiyalezo okuphumelelayo. ukuThuthukisa nokuPhatha uHlelo lokuHamba lwebholo bese uBika ngentuthuko njengoba kudingekile. ukuQamba nokuHambisa onke amaphawu okubika ahlelekile. ukuHlalela emigoqweni yabakho ekuHlangenwe ndawonye njengoba kudingekile. ukuQinisekisa ithemba lomsebenzi okhishwe ngabasebenzi. uPhathwa nokuQapha umthamo wemali kanye nezimali ezichithwa yibholo. ukuQinisekisa ithemba lomsebenzi okhishwe ngabasebenzi.

xh.title: Umphathi: EzokuTyyla nezomPhatho kuLuntu
xh.summary: Umphathi wezokuTyala nezomPhatho kuLuntu kwisebe leZiZenzo zoLuntu nakuZinzo kwelaPretoria, elinika umvuzo ka R1,317,384 ngonyaka.
xh.requirements: Ngowunciphilelo obungakanani kwi NQF 7 kwiJournalism, izomPhatho kuLuntu, ezokuTyala okanye indlela efana nayo yokufunda njengoko kubonwa yi SAQA. Amakhono: Amakhono aphambili ezokuTyala, Unyuso lulwimi, uKubhala iingxelo ngenqanaba eliphezulu, ukuQamba nokuCwangcisa, ukuSebenzisa iKhompyutha, ukuMiswa kweenqobo, ukuCwangcisa nokuQamba, amakhono ekuNxibelelanweni, uNxibelelwano oluphambili (oluthethwayo nolubhaliwayo), Amakhono aphambili oNxibelelwano noManyano, uLawulo lwexesha, amakhono okuThatha iziGqibo, uLawulo lweNxaxheba, amakhono okuKhuthaza, amakhono ekuNika amandla, amakhono oBomi nokuLawulwa. Iimpawu zeNtobo yomXhasi: Umdlali welqela, Onamabala amatsha, Onomdla wokudala, Onobugcisa obubalulekileyo, Onesipho, Onamandla, Ukuba nakho ukuze upheze iindali eZintsundu ngelixa unikezela iziphumo ezilungileyo, Ukuba nakho ukunxibelelana kwawo onke amanqanaba, ngokukodwa kwinqanaba leempleyikhensi, Ukuba nakho ukuza sisiseko sigcinwe kwaye sibe namanye oomanyano, Othembekileyo, Oqinisekileyo, Osebenzela ngamandla, onamandla okuziqhelanisa, Ukuba nakho ukusebenza kodwa. Uxolo lokulinganisa ishedyule yakho yomsebenzi ngokwemfuneko yenkqubo; Uxolo lokuhamba.
xh.duties: Lawula uphuhliso nokuSebenzisa iinqobo neendqptha zomthetho wezokuTyala nezomPhatho kuLuntu: Zenza uphando ngokuvakalayho ekuphuhlisweni kwemigaqo yemisebenzi, eMthethweni nasemiQondiso. Lawula imilinganiselo ebandakanya iindawo ezahlukeneyo ukuziphumelela kwindlela emihle yokutyala nezomPhatho kuLuntu. Qamba kuphuhliso lwe ndqptha ezibambeneyo nezazobe kwindawo yesebe ezoyikeleyo nakwindlela ezoyikeleyo. Qinisekisa ukuba zonke iinqobo, imigaqo namagqabantshushi ezokuTyala nezomPhatho kuLuntu ziyilwe ngokwemithetho ephathwayo kwaye zongamiselwe kwimigaqo yendawo yesebe. Qwalasela ukusetenziswa kwaye uqinisekise ukuzithobela iNqobo namagqabantshushi aphilayo. Qwalasela iindqptha neenkqubo zomthetho wezokuTyala nezomPhatho kuLuntu ukuze ukuze uzise upheze usebenze ngcono. Lawula uxhumaniso olubumbene neendawo zonke ezahlukeneyo zesityala ukuphucula ukuqonda nokubakho kweshishini nakwindawo kaLuntu: Lawula ucwangciso lwamajenda omthetho neshishini nokuziphatha kwawo. Lawula uxhumaniso olubumbene nokuPhanda nokwahlulela iindaba ngomFanekiso weshishini nokuhlonelwa kwawo. Lawula ukusetyenziswa kokutshaja kwamashishini ukuzakha ukugcina imvelaphi yeshishini kwilizwe. Qwalasela ukuveliswa kolwimi ngemiVuzo nolunye ulwimi olubhaliweyo lokuTyala nezomPhatho kuLuntu. Qinisekisa ukuba amaxwebhu nolunye ulwimi lokutyala olukwindawo okulindeleyo alungileyo ngokwemigaqo nolusebenzayo. Lawula uxhumaniso ngokubanzi lweNkqubo zoNcopho kaLuntu nezeNgqonyela zezoNcopho (MPPP). Lawula ukuqhakamshelwa kwentengiso yeshebe neSabelo puculula nokuba nakho ukuzinza imimiselo yokwenza into: Misela kwaye ugcine uxhumano oluhle. Phendula izicelo ezifuna ukukhululwa kolwazi ngezokutyala ezomphatho kuluntu. Qwalasela ukukhuthaza umfanekiso weShebe kumanyano aveliswa kumzila wokutyalela amajenda nokulungisa iindaba. Lawula uphuhliso lweenkqubo ukuze kugcinwe okuqwalaselwayo okuhle koluntu kwizinhloso nokufezekiswa kwesebe. Qinisekisa iziphumezeli ngokweemigaqo yokulandelanisa imithetho yeshebe. Lawula izinto ezikhuthazwa ngokuhlonelwa koluntu ipilo: Lilongeze kunye nentengiso imigaqo iinkqubo ezihlwempuzekileyo ngalo lonke ixesha. Qwalasela imisebenzi yemigaqo yamalungu lawo onke amagunya oLuntu: Misela uLawulo loLuntu, unginise kwaye ugcine izindikimba eZenzelelayo. Misela, usebenzise kwaye ugcine ulungelelwano kwazwana ukudibana kwendlela ezisebenza kakuhle kwaye iphumela iziphumo. Yila kwaye ulawule isicwangciso sokusebenza kwendawo kwaye uxelo ngokuqhubeka njengoko kufuneka. Hlaba kwaye ungenise yonke iingxelo ezifunwa ngokomthetho. Nceda kumanqanqalaba aveliswa njengoko kufuneka. Lawula iziphumo ezithunyelwa ngabasebenzi. Lawula kwaye ulawule imali yokusetyenziswa kwindawo yolawulo. Lawula iziphumo ezithunyelwa ngabasebenzi.

jobs.title: Director: Real Estate Management Services
jobs.department: Department of Public Works and Infrastructure
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 per annum, (all-inclusive package), (total package to be structured in accordance with the rules of the Senior Management Services).
jobs.summary: Director of Real Estate Management Services to implement guidelines, processes and strategies for the Department of Public Works and Infrastructure in Kimberley.
jobs.requirements: A Minimum of NQF 7 degree in Real Estate/Property Studies, Immovable Asset Management or Built Environment (e.g., Urban/Town Planning, Quantity Surveying, Construction Management) as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of 5 years’ experience at a middle or Senior managerial level in Real Estate Management. (An NQF 8 qualification or higher in the above fields will serve as an added advantage). Knowledge: Knowledge of Public Finance Management Act, Government Budget systems and procedures, Government Financial Systems, Financial administration; Procurement directives and procedures; Programme and project planning; Real Estate Management; State Land Disposal Act; Market research; Property economics; Reporting procedures. Skills: Planning and organizing; Problem solving; Interpersonal and diplomacy; Ability to conduct research and gathering of information; Ability to work on specific timeframes; Report writing; Management skills; Numeric skills; Decision making; Project management skills; Effective communication. Personal Attributes: Creative; Dedicated; Approachable; Hard-working; Trustworthy; Ability to communicate at all levels. Analytical thinking. Willing to adapt work schedule in accordance with professional requirements and compelling circumstances.
jobs.duties: Manage the implementation and monitoring of real estate management guidelines, processes, standards and strategies-: Undertake research on the latest developments in professional guidelines, legislations and standards. Identify real estate management trends and opportunities for businesses processes improvement. Make recommendations for changes and improvements to existing immovable asset management guidelines, standards, policies and procedures. Manage the implementation of guidelines, standards, policies, procedures and strategies and related prescripts. Ensure the development and implementation of support tools. Monitor the implementation and ensure compliance with applicable policies and legislation. Ensure the implementation of sound effective and efficient internal control system. Manage and ensure administration of leased property-: Manage the maintenance process and function ability of leased properties. Ensure effective administration and performance of buildings for client satisfaction. Manage property portfolios. Ensure that buildings are user-friendly and accessible. Establish and maintain sound client relationships. Manage acquisition and the disposal of states` fixed assets-: Establish availability of funds for client departments. Ensure optimal procurement practices for all properties Make findings regarding offices and procured accommodation. Manage and facilitate the process of identifying superfluous properties to be disposed. Manage the prioritisation of assets to be disposed. Develop and implement strategies to guide the disposal of state immovable properties. Establish the ownership of properties to be disposed. Ensure that all property disposals do not infringe with the National Land Reform Programme. Manage the transfer of ownership of immovable assets disposed. Ensure compliance to departmental policies on disposal. Manage state properties (Including vacant land)-: Ensure effective and efficient utilisation of State property. Ensure proper maintenance of State property. Direct preparation of financial reports on status of property (e.g. occupancy rates). Monitor maintenance of vacant and unimproved state property. Ensure security for vacant properties. Supervise property maintenance operations. Ensure the implementation of reconditioning of unimproved properties. Manage the periodic inventory of building contents and property condition. Ensure completeness of contractual documentation for contractors. Monitor and ensure property compliance with local regulations and laws. Management of private tenants-: Manage private tenants occupying State-owned property. Supervise preparation processes of rental agreements. Ensure timeous collection of rates. Manage grievances related to rentals. Management of the Directorate-: Establish and maintain appropriate internal controls and reporting systems in order to meet performance expectations. Maintenance of discipline. Management of performance and development. Establish implement and maintain efficient and effective communication arrangements. Develop and manage the operational plan of the directorate and report on progress as required. Compile and submit all required administrative reports. Serve on transverse task teams as required. Quality control of work delivered by employees. Monitor the budget and expenditures on financial accounting directorate.
