jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on the prescribed Z83 application form (obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the DPSA website link: https:/www.dpsa.gov.za/newsroom/psvc/, which must be signed, initialled and dated by the applicant, and must be accompanied by a detailed curriculum vitae (CV) only. Candidates are not required to submit certified copies of qualifications and related documents on application. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualification and other related documents on or before the date of interview, which should not be older than six months. Should an application be submitted using incorrect/old Z83 application form, such an application will be disqualified. Further take note of the following on completion of Z83 application form: PART A and PART B must be fully completed. PART C - PART G: Noting that there is a limited space provided applicants may refer to CV or indicate. This will be acceptable as long as the CV has been attached and provides the required information. Page 1 of the Z83 application form must be initialled and page 2 signed and dated by the applicant. Failure to comply with the above instructions may result in an application being disqualified. Applicants applying for more than one advertised post must submit separate Z83 application forms and CVs in respect to each post being applied for. Should an application be received where an applicant has applied for more than one posts on the same Z83 application form, the applicant will be considered for the first post indicated on the Z83 application form only. Applications will be received via post/courier services, hand deliveries or email. Late applications will not be considered. Regulation 57 (c) and 67 (9) of the Public Service Regulations 2016, as amended, requires the executive authority to ensure that he or she is fully satisfied of the claims being made and the finalisation of Personnel Suitability Checks in order to verify claims and check the candidate for purpose of being fit and proper for employment, respectively. Shortlisted candidates must be willing to undergo normal vetting and verification processes. Note: It is the responsibility of all applicants to ensure that foreign qualifications are evaluated by SAQA. Due to large volume of responses anticipated, receipt of applications will not be acknowledged, and correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. Should you not have heard from us within three months from the closing date, please regard your application as unsuccessful. Entry level requirements for SMS posts: in terms of the Directive on Human Resource Management and Development on Public Service Professionalisation Volume 1 a requirement for appointment into SMS posts is the successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-Entry programme as endorsed by the National School of Governance (NSG). All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Note: For emailed applications, please submit a single PDF document or one attachment per application to the email address designated on the specific position. Kindly note that the emailed applications and attachments should not exceed 15MB. It remains the candidate’s responsibility to ensure that their application is successfully submitted using the required single pdf document. Encrypted document will not be accepted. All though an email application option is available, applicants are encouraged to hand deliver their application. IMPORTANT: Applicants must submit a separate application for each post applied for, clearly indicating the correct reference number and post title on each application. af.title: Direkteur: Dienste vir die Bestuur van Vastgoed
af.summary: Direkteur van Dienste vir die Bestuur van Vastgoed om riglyne, prosesse en strategieë vir die Departement van Openbare Werke en Infrastruktuur in Kimberley te implementeer.
af.requirements: 'n Minimum van 'n NQF 7-graad in Vastgoed/Eiendomsstudies, Bestuur van Onroerende Bates of die Geboude Omgewing (bv. Stads-/Dorpsbeplanning, Hoeveelheidsopname, Konstruksiebestuur) soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se ervaring op 'n middel- of seniorbestuursvlak in Vastgoedbestuur. ('n NQF 8-kwalifikasie of hoër in bogenoemde velde sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien). Kennis: Kennis van die Openbare Finansiesbestuurswet, Regeringsbegrotingstelsels en -prosedures, Regeringsfinansiestelsels, Finansiële administrasie; Aanbestedingsriglyne en -prosedures; Program- en projekbeplanning; Vastgoedbestuur; Staatsgrondbeskikkingswet; Marknavorsing; Eiendomsekonomie; Verslagdoeningsprosedures. Vaardighede: Beplanning en organisering; Probleemoplossing; Interpersoonlik en diplomatiek; Vermoë om navorsing te doen en inligting in te win; Vermoë om binne spesifieke tydsrame te werk; Verslagskrywing; Bestuursvaardighede; Numerieke vaardighede; Besluitneming; Projekbestuursvaardighede; Effektiewe kommunikasie. Persoonlike eienskappe: Skeppend; Toegewyd; Toeganklik; Ywerig; Betroubaar; Vermoë om op alle vlakke te kommunikeer. Analitiese denke. Bereid om werkskedule ooreenkomstig professionele vereistes en dwingende omstandighede aan te pas.
af.duties: Bestuur die implementering en monitering van riglyne, prosesse, standaarde en strategieë vir vastgoedbestuur-: Ondersoek die jongste ontwikkelinge in professionele riglyne, wetgewing en standaarde. Identifiseer vastgoedbestuurstendense en geleenthede vir die verbetering van besigheidsprosesse. Doen aanbevelings vir veranderinge en verbeterings aan bestaande riglyne, standaarde, beleide en prosedures vir die bestuur van onroerende bates. Bestuur die implementering van riglyne, standaarde, beleide, prosedures en strategieë en verwante skrifte. Verseker die ontwikkeling en implementering van ondersteuningsinstrumente. Monitor die implementering en verseker nakoming met toepaslike beleide en wetgewing. Verseker die implementering van 'n deeglike, doeltreffende en effektiewe interne beheerstelsel. Bestuur en verseker die administrasie van huureiendom-: Bestuur die instandhoudingsproses en funksioneelheid van gehuurde eiendomme. Verseker effektiewe administrasie en prestasie van geboue vir kliëntediens. Bestuur eiendomsportefeuljes. Verseker dat geboue gebruikersvriendelik en toeganklik is. Vestig en handhaaf goeie kliëntverhoudings. Bestuur die verkryging en beskikking van die staat se vaste bates-: Vestig die beskikbaarheid van fondse vir kliëntdepartemente. Verseker optimale aanbestedingspraktyke vir alle eiendomme. Doen bevindings oor kantore en verkrygte akkommodasie. Bestuur en fasiliteer die proses om oortollige eiendomme te identifiseer vir beskikking. Bestuur die prioritisering van bates vir beskikking. Ontwikkel en implementeer strategieë om die beskikking van staatsonroerende eiendomme te begelei. Vestig die eienaarskap van eiendomme wat beskik moet word. Verseker dat alle eiendombskikings nie inbreuk maak op die Nasionale Landhervormingsprogram nie. Bestuur die oordrag van eienaarskap van onroerende bates wat beskik is. Verseker nakoming van departementele beleide oor beskikking. Bestuur staats eiendomme (insluitend oop grond)-: Verseker effektiewe en doeltreffende benutting van staatseiendom. Verseker behoorlike instandhouding van staatseiendom. Rig die voorbereiding van finansiële verslae oor die status van eiendom (bv. besettingsyfers). Monitor instandhouding van oop en onverbeterde staatseiendom. Verseker sekuriteit vir oop eiendomme. Superviseer eiendomsinstandhoudingsoperasies. Verseker die implementering van die herstel van onverbeterde eiendomme. Bestuur die periodieke inventaris van gebou-inhoud en eiendomstoestand. Verseker volledigheid van kontraktuele dokumentasie vir kontrakteurs. Monitor en verseker eiendomsnakoming met plaaslike regulasies en wette. Bestuur van private huurders-: Bestuur private huurders wat staatbesitte eiendom bewoon. Superviseer voorbereidingsprosesse van huurooreenkomste. Verseker tydige invordering van tariewe. Bestuur griewe wat met huur verband hou. Bestuur van die Direktoraat-: Vestig en handhaaf toepaslike interne beheer- en verslagdoeningstelsels om prestasieverwagtinge te bereik. Handhawing van dissipline. Bestuur van prestasie en ontwikkeling. Vestig, implementeer en handhaaf doeltreffende en effektiewe kommunikasie-reëlings. Ontwikkel en bestuur die operasionele plan van die direktoraat en doen verslag oor vordering soos vereis. Stel alle vereiste administratiewe verslae op en dien dit in. Dien soos vereis op dwarstaakspanne. Kwaliteitsbeheer van werk wat deur werknemers gelewer word. Monitor die begroting en besteding aan die finansiële rekenkundige direktoraat.

zu.title: Umengamele: Amasevisi Okuphathwa Kwezimpahla Ezingakahdulwa
zu.summary: Umengamele wamasevisi okuphathwa kwezimpahla ezingakahdulwa ukusebenzisa izinqubomgomo, izinqubo kanye namasu ohlelo lwe-Department of Public Works and Infrastructure e-Kimberley.
zu.requirements: I-Degree yesikhathi esingaphansi kweminyaka eyi-7 ye-NQF kwezimpahla ezingakahdulwa / izifundo zempahla, ukuphathwa kwezimpahla ezingakahlukwa noma indawo akiwe (isb., i-Urban / Town Planning, i-Quantity Surveying, ukuphathwa kokwakha) njengoba kuqashelwe yi-SAQA. Okungenani iminyaka engu-5 yamava emazingeni aphakathi noma aphakeme okubusa ekuphathweni kwezimpahla ezingakahdulwa. (I-NQF 8 noma ephezulu kulezi zinkomba kuzoba yinzuzo eyengeziwe). Ulwazi: Ulwazi lwe-Public Finance Management Act, izinhlelo nezinqubo zabelo kahulumeni, izinhlelo zezimali kahulumeni, ukuphathwa kwezimali; iziqondiso nezinqubo zokuthenga; ukuhlelwa kwezinhlelo namaphrojekthi; ukuphathwa kwezimpahla ezingakahdulwa; i-State Land Disposal Act; ucwaningo lwemakethe; ezomnotho zempahla; izinqubo zokubika. Amakhono: Ukucwangcisa nokuhlela; ukuxazulula izinkinga; ubudlelwano bomuntu nabantu nobunoziprofundo; ikono lokwenza ucwaningo nokuqoqa ulwazi; ikono lokusebenza ngemitshana yesikhathi ethize; ukubhala imibiko; amakhono okubusa; amakhono ezigaba; ukwenza izinqumo; amakhono okuphatha amaphrojekthi; ukuxhumana okusebenzayo. Izimpawu zobuntu: Okudalayo; okuzithelayo; okusondelwayo; okusebenza kanzima; okethembekayo; ikono lokuxhumana kwazo zonke izinga. Okucabangayo. Ukuzithoba ekulungeniseni isheduli yomsebenzi ngokwezidingo zobungcali kanye nemibandela ebonakalisayo.
zu.duties: Phatha ukusebenzisa nokulondolozwa kwezinqubomgomo, izinqubo, izinga namasu okuphathwa kwezimpahla ezingakahdulwa-: Yenza ucwaningo ngentuthuko yakamuva kuzinqubomgomo zobungcali, emthethweni nasemazingeni. Hlaba izinqubo ezintsha ezinkundla yokuphathwa kwezimpahla ezingakahdulwa kanye namathuba okuthuthukisa izinqubo zebhizinisi. Nikezana ngemibono yoshintsho nokuthuthuka kuzinqubomgomo, izinga, imigomo nezinqubo ezivezile zokuphathwa kwezimpahla ezingakahlukwa. Phatha ukusebenziswa kwezinqubomgomo, izinga, imigomo, izinqubo namasu kanye nemibhalo ephathelene nayo. Qinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa nokusetshenziswa kwamathuluzi axhasayo. Londa ukusetshenziswa futhi uqinisekise ukuhambisana nemigomo nandlela zomthetho ezifanele. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kohlelo lokulawula langaphakathi olusebenzayo futhi olusebenza kahle. Phatha futhi uqinisekise ukuphathwa kwezimpahla eziqashiwe-: Phatha inqubo yonakekelo kanye nokuzeletha ukusebenza kwezimpahla eziqashiwe. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa okusebenzayo kanye nokusebenza kwakho konke izakhiwo ukuze kutholwe ukwaneliseka komthengi. Phatha izinhlobo zempahla. Qinisekisa ukuthi izakhiwo ziyasebenza futhi zifinyeleleka kalula. Sula futhi ulondoloze ubudlelwano obuhle nomthengi. Phatha ukuthola nokulahleka kwezimpahla ezingakahlukwa kahulumeni-: Hlola ukutholakala kwemali kuminyango yomthengi. Qinisekisa izinqubo ezinhle zokuthenga kuyo yonke impahla. Yiza ngemibiko mayelana namahofo kanye nendawo ethengiwe. Phatha futhi wenze kube lula inqubo yokuhlonza izimpahla ezingaphezudwa okufanele zilahleke. Phatha ukubeka phambili izimpahla okufanele zilahleke. Thuthukisa futhi usebenzise amasu okuhola ukulahleka kwezimpahla ezingakahlukwa kahulumeni. Hlola ukuba bani ngemipahla okufanele zilahleke. Qinisekisa ukuthi ukulahleka kwazo zonke izimpahla akuphikisani ne-National Land Reform Programme. Phatha ukudluliswa kobani bempahla ezingakahlukwa ezilahliwe. Qinisekisa ukuhambisana nemigomo yomnyango ekulahlekeni. Phatha izimpahla kahulumeni (okuhlanganisa namabala angasekho)-: Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okusebenzayo futhi okusebenza kahle kwempahla kahulumeni. Qinisekisa onakekelo olulunge impahla kahulumeni. Qondisa ukuhlelwa kwemibiko yezimali ngokuba seikhundla sempahla (isb., izinga lokuhlala). Londa onakekelo amabala angasekho angakagqitwa kahulumeni. Qinisekisa ukhuseleko lwezimpahla ezingasekho. Qapha imisebenzi yonakekelo wempahla. Qinisekisa ukuthi kusetshenziswa ukulungiswa kwezimpahla ezingakagqitwa. Phatha ukubhaliswa kwemimoto yokuqoqwa kwemiphumela yezakhiwo kanye nesimo sempahla. Qinisekisa ukugqamisa kabusha kwemibhalo yasekhaya yokwenza isivumelwano. Londa futhi uqinisekise impahla ukuthi ihambisana nemithetho nangezomthetho yaseduze. Ukuphathwa kwabahlinzekiwe bangaqashwa-: Phatha abahlinzeki bangaqashwa abaphethe impahla kahulumeni. Qapha izinqubo zokuqasha ukubhaliswa kwemibalo. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuthathwe izilinganiso ngesikhathi. Phatha izikhalazo eziphathelene nezimali zokuqashwa. Ukuphathwa kwesiHleli-: Sula futhi ulondoloze izindlela zokulawula kanye nezinhlelo zokubika ezifanele ukuze kuhlangatshezwe nethemba lokusebenza. Ukugcinwa kwesitayi. Ukuphathwa kokusebenza nokuthuthukiswa. Sula usebenzise futhi ulondoloze izinhlelo zokuxhumana ezisebenza kahle futhi zisebenza ngempumelelo. Thuthukisa futhi uphathe iplani yokuqhuba yesihleli futhi ubeke imibiko ngokwenyuka njengoba kudingekile. Hlela futhi unikeze yonke imibiko engadingekayo yokuqhuba. Khonza kwamathimba amiselwe njengoba kudingekile. Ukulawula izinga lemigwaqo yomsebenzi abayipha izisebenzi. Londa ibhajethi nezinkokhelo kumyango wezimali.

xh.title: Um lawuli: Iinkonzo zoLawulo loMlungiseleli wokuThengisa izakhiwo
xh.summary: Umlawuli weenkonzo zoLawulo loMlungiseleli wokuThengisa izakhiwo ukuphumeza iindlela, iinkqubo namacebo asekelwa kwi Ndlu yeeNkonzo zoLuntu nokuThungatha eKimberley.
xh.requirements: I degree ezingaphantsi kwe NQF 7 kwi Real Estate/Property Studies, Immovable Asset Management okanye Built Environment (umz., Urban/Town Planning, Quantity Surveying, Construction Management) njengakuqatshwa yi SAQA. Amava angazange ngaphantsi kweminyaka emi 5 kwinqanaba eliphakathi okanye eliphezulu kolawulo kw Real Estate Management. (I NQF 8 okanye ephezulu kumagatya angentla ichaza ngenzuzo yongezelelweko). Ulwazi: Ulwazi nge Public Finance Management Act, iinkqubo namacebo abechwe abalulekileyo, abechwe alothelekiso nemali, ulawulo lwemali; iindlela nemigaqo yokuthengisa; ulungiselelo lwenkqubo namaphulo; ulawulo lomhlaba othengiswayo; i State Land Disposal Act; ulwazi olutsha kwimarike; ulawulo lwemali ezinguzahlule; iindlela zokubika. Amakhono: Ulungiselelo nokuququzelela; ukuzisombulula iinkinga; ubudlelwane nabantu nobugosa; ikhono lokwenza ulwazi lokutsha kokuqokelela iinkcukacha; ikhono lokusebenza kwithuba elitsha lexesha; ukubhala iingxelo; amakhono olawulo; amakhono omanani; ukwenza izigqibo; amakhono okulawula amaphulo; unxibelelwano olusebenzayo. Iimpawu zobuqu: Ukuba nomdla wokudala; Inkonzo yenkxaso; Esondeleyo kubantu; Osebenzayo ngamandla; Othembekileyo; Ikhono lokunxibelelana nakwawo onke amanqanaba. Ukucinga ngesimo sokuhlola. Ukhululekile ukulungelelana ishedi yakho yomsebenzi ngokwemfuno yabasebenzi nangemeko ephoqayo.
xh.duties: Lawula ukuphumeza nokulandela iindlela, iinkqubo, amagatya namacebo olawulo lomhlaba othengiswayo-: Yenza ulwazi lwakutsha kumashishini axubeneyo abasebenzi ngamagatya amasha. Phawula iindlela namathuba olawulo lomhlaba othengiswa ngokuphucula iinkqubo. Yenga izindululo zamaguqulo nokupha amaphuphu kwimigaqo, amagatya, iinkqubo esele zikho ekulawuleni izinto ezingahambeki. Lawula ukuphumeza iindlela, amagatya, iinkqubo, imigaqo namacebo. Qinisekisa ukuba kusebenza izixhobo ezinganiki nkxaso. Landela ukusebenza kwemigaqo yonke neyomthetho. Qinisekisa ukusebenza kolawulo ngokutsha kwangaphakathi olusebenzayo. Lawula nokuqinisekisa ukulawulwa kwendawo ethengiswayo-: Lawula ulwazi lokulungiselela ukuze isebenze nendawo ethengiswayo. Qinisekisa ukulawulwa kwezinto ezisebenzayo nendawo yokuhlala ngokonikezelo oluvela kubathengi. Lawula abathengi abanomhlaba. Qinisekisa ukuba izindlu zibambelelo kwabanini bazo. Ziseka igqibo lokubeka ngokusemthethweni abathengi abazinzileyo. Lawula ukufumana nokuthengiswa kokulungelelaniswa kwemfihlelo-: Balula isenzeko sezigqibo ezifumaneka kwabathengi. Qinisekisa inkqubo ekufanelekileyo yendawo ekuthengwa kuyo naziphi na iindawo ezithengiswayo. Yenza iziphumo ezingagqibekanga kwindawo ekuthengwe kuyo. Lawula nokuqinisekisa ukulungelelana kolawulo ngokuchonga ukuthengiswa kwendawo engadingekanga ekufuneka ithengiswe. Lawula ukubeka ngokulungele ukuthengiswa kwendawo. Phuhlisa nokuqinisekisa iindlela ezilungelelanisa ngokuthengiswa kwendawo yorhulumente. Balula abanindalo yendawo ethengiswa. Qinisekisa ukuzinza kolawulo lwendawo ethengiswa ngokuchasa isigqibo sikarhulumente. Lawula ukudluliswa kolawulo lwendawo ethengiswa. Qinisekisa ukuzinza ngokomthetho olulawula ukuthengiswa. Lawula iindawo zorhulumente (kuquka nomhlaba ongenanto)-: Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa kwe ndawo korhulumente. Qinisekisa ukulungiselelwa kolawulo lwemali olunika abathengi (umz. ukubakka kwabanini). Lawula ukulungiselelwa kwendawo ethengiswa nengangenanto. Qinisekisa ukhuseleko lwendawo ethengiswa. Lawula ukusebenza kolawulo lomhlaba othengiswa. Qinisekisa ukulungiselelwa kwe ndawo ethengiswa engangenanto nengaqhwabazekanga. Lawula ukubeka kwangaphakathi ngokwendlela yemali yangaphakathi nokuqinisekisa ukulungelelana kwendawo ethengiswa ngokomthetho. Lawula abathengi abangowabo nabo-: Lawula abathengi abangowabo umhlaba. Qinisekisa ukulungelelana kolawulo lomhlaba. Lawula izibakaliso ezinxulumene nentengiso. Lawula abathengi abangowabo nabo-: Lawula abathengi abahlala kwindawo yorhulumente. Qeqesha abathengi ekwenzeni iindlela zentengiso. Qinisekisa ukwamkelwa kwamaxabiso ngexesha elifanelekileyo. Lawula iingxaki ezinxulumene nentengiso. Lawulo loQeqesho-: Ziseka nokuqinisekisa ukulungelelana nendawo ekhoyo ngakumbi nangaphezulu kwindawo. Lawula izikhalazo. Lawula ulawulo ngokomsebenzi wakho. Qinisekisa ukuba abantu bakho baphumelele ngokwemfuneko ngexesha elitsha. Zisa nokuqinisekisa iindaba ezifunekayo emva kokuhlola imisebenzi yakho. Lawula nokuqinisekisa iinkcukacha ezidibana nalawulo alungelelanisa izindlu ezidibanayo ngokomthetho wengingqi.

jobs.title: Director: User Demand Management
jobs.department: Department of Public Works and Infrastructure
jobs.centre: Head Office (Pretoria): Defence And Military Veterans Ref No: 2026/308A (X1 Post) Defence Ref No: 2026/308B (X1 Post)
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 per annum, (all-inclusive package), (total package to be structured in accordance with the rules of the Senior Management Services).
jobs.summary: Director: User Demand Management at the Department of Public Works and Infrastructure in Pretoria, requiring an NQF 7 qualification and five years of managerial experience.
jobs.requirements: A minimum of NQF 7 in Public Administration/Management, Business Administration, Law, Real Estate Management and Town and Regional Planning) as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of 5 years’ experience at a middle or Senior managerial level in the relevant field. Committed to designated tasks. Knowledge: DPWI Asset Management Policies, Government Immovable Asset Management Act (GIAMA), Program and Project Management, Property Charter, Expropriation Bill, Land Development Act, Supply Chain Management Framework, Circulars, and Directives, Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Treasury Regulations, referential Procurement Policy Framework Act, Broad-Based Black Economic Empowerment Act (B-BBEE), Occupational Health and Safety Act (OHSA), Public Service Act and Public Service Regulations and other relevant legislation, Real Estate Management. Skills: Strategic capability and leadership, People management and empowerment, Program and project management, Financial management, Change management, Client Orientation and Customer focus, Advanced interpersonal and diplomacy skills, Advanced report writing, Advanced communication, Language proficiency, Advanced Computer skills, Analytical thinking, Strategic planning, Conflict management, Problem identification and solving ability, Organising and planning, Decision making abilities, Motivational skills, Policy formulation. Personal Attributes: Ability to interact with clients and stakeholders in professional and knowledgeable manner, High ethical standards, Able to conduct operations with integrity and in a fair and reasonable manner, Ability to promote mutual trust and respect, Innovative and creative, Solution orientated – ability to design ideas without direction, People orientated, Hard- working and highly motivated, Ability to work effectively and efficiently under sustained pressure, Ability to meet tight deadlines whilst delivering excellent results. Willing to adapt work schedule in accordance with office requirements.
jobs.duties: Manage the development, review and maintenance of User Demand Management policies, strategies and procedures: Manage the development, review, and maintenance of User Demand Management policies, strategies, and procedures, ensuring alignment with legislative prescripts and departmental strategic objectives. Contribute to the review and development of policies, procedures, and governance frameworks, where necessary. Lead strategic interventions to address challenges in uniform policy implementation. Ensure that the Users Asset Management Plans (UAMPs) are developed in line with GIAMA and other relevant prescripts: Supervise the development, review, and submission of User Asset Management Plans (UAMPs) by User Departments to ensure compliance, while delivering ongoing support and technical guidance. Facilitate UAMP training, compilation of portfolio report to inform feasibility studies, property trend research, and risk mitigation measures. Escalate non-compliance in UAMP submission through formal executive channels. Manage the oversight of infrastructure planning and budgeting: Oversee user engagement in infrastructure budget meetings, re- allocations and allocation processes for current and upcoming financial years. Align infrastructure initiatives with client needs and departmental priorities through coordinated feasibility studies, trend research and risk mitigation plans. Ensure the timely processing and recommendation of Procurement Instructions (PIs) and Pre-Design Information Requests (PDIRs) based on Demand Management Plans, to support project feasibility and implementation. Analyse and resolve user demand issues promptly while monitoring and implementing measures to ensure efficient and effective service delivery. Manage client relationships and integrated planning and co-ordination: Lead the development and finalisation of service delivery standards and Service Level Agreements (SLAs) with client departments to formalize service commitments. Manage client engagement through portfolio reporting, bilateral forums, task teams, and oversight meetings, fostering strong collaborative relationships. Facilitate and direct accommodation needs assessments and feasibility studies, promoting alignment with government precinct development and Smart City principles to enhance client satisfaction and operational efficiencies. Manage the Directorate: Manage the Directorate’s business plan deliverables, administrative budget monitoring, performance management of officials and quality assurance to ensure compliance with departmental and legislative requirements. Address audit and parliamentary queries, maintain risk registers, certify payments, and ensure timely submission of administrative documentation. Establish and maintain robust internal controls, reporting, and communication systems to meet performance expectations. Lead staff development and serve on transversal task teams.

jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on the prescribed Z83 application form (obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the DPSA website link: https:/www.dpsa.gov.za/newsroom/psvc/, which must be signed, initialled and dated by the applicant, and must be accompanied by a detailed curriculum vitae (CV) only. Candidates are not required to submit certified copies of qualifications and related documents on application. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualification and other related documents on or before the date of interview, which should not be older than six months. Applicants applying for more than one advertised post must submit separate Z83 application forms and CVs in respect to each post being applied for. Should an application be received where an applicant has applied for more than one posts on the same Z83 application form, the applicant will be considered for the first post indicated on the Z83 application form only. Applications will be received via post/courier services, hand deliveries or email. Late applications will not be considered. Regulation 57 (c) and 67 (9) of the Public Service Regulations 2016, as amended, requires the executive authority to ensure that he or she is fully satisfied of the claims being made and the finalisation of Personnel Suitability Checks in order to verify claims and check the candidate for purpose of being fit and proper for employment, respectively. Shortlisted candidates must be willing to undergo normal vetting and verification processes. Note: It is the responsibility of all applicants to ensure that foreign qualifications are evaluated by SAQA. Due to large volume of responses anticipated, receipt of applications will not be acknowledged, and correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. Should you not have heard from us within three months from the closing date, please regard your application as unsuccessful. Entry level requirements for SMS posts: in terms of the Directive on Human Resource Management and Development on Public Service Professionalisation Volume 1 a requirement for appointment into SMS posts is the successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-Entry programme as endorsed by the National School of Governance (NSG). All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Note: For emailed applications, please submit a single PDF document or one attachment per application to the email address designated on the specific position. af.title: Direkteur: Bestuur van Gebruikersvraag
af.summary: Direkteur: Bestuur van Gebruikersvraag by die Department of Public Works and Infrastructure in Pretoria, wat 'n NQF 7-kwalifikasie en vyf jaar se bestuurservaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Minimum van NQF 7 in Publieke Administrasie/Bestuur, Besigheidsadministrasie, Regte, Eiendomsbestuur en Stads- en Streekbeplanning) soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se ervaring op 'n middel- of senior bestuursvlak in die betrokke veld. Toegewyd aan aangewese take. Kennis: DPWI Asset Management Policies, Government Immovable Asset Management Act (GIAMA), Program and Project Management, Property Charter, Expropriation Bill, Land Development Act, Supply Chain Management Framework, Circulars, and Directives, Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Treasury Regulations, referential Procurement Policy Framework Act, Broad-Based Black Economic Empowerment Act (B-BBEE), Occupational Health and Safety Act (OHSA), Public Service Act and Public Service Regulations en ander relevante wetgewing, Real Estate Management. Vaardighede: Strategiese vermoë en leierskap, Mensebestuur en bemagtiging, Program- en projekbestuur, Finansiële bestuur, Veranderingsbestuur, Kliëntgerigtheid en kliëntfokus, Gevorderde interpersoonlike en diplomatieke vaardighede, Gevorderde verslagskrywing, Gevorderde kommunikasie, Taalvaardigheid, Gevorderde rekenaarvaardighede, Analitiese denke, Strategiese beplanning, Konflikbestuur, Probleemidentifisering en oplossingsvermoë, Organisasie en beplanning, Besluitnemingsvermoë, Motiveringsvaardighede, Beleidsformulering. Persoonlike eienskappe: Vermoë om op 'n professionele en kundige wyse met kliënte en belanghebbendes te skakel, Hoë etiese standaarde, In staat om bedrywighede met integriteit en op 'n billike en redelike wyse uit te voer, Vermoë om wedersydse vertroue en respek te bevorder, Innovatief en kreatief, Oplossingsgerig – vermoë om idees sonder rigting te ontwerp, Mensegerig, Hardwerkend en hoë gemotiveerd, Vermoë om effektief en doeltreffend onder volgehoue druk te werk, Vermoë om styf deadlines te haal terwyl uitstekende resultate gelewer word. Gewillig om werkskedule in ooreenstemming met kantoorvereistes aan te pas.
af.duties: Bestuur die ontwikkeling, hersiening en instandhouding van beleid, strategieë en prosedures vir die bestuur van gebruikersvraag: Bestuur die ontwikkeling, hersiening en instandhouding van beleid, strategieë en prosedures vir die bestuur van gebruikersvraag, en verseker belyning met wetgewende voorskrifte en departementele strategiese doelwitte. Dra by tot die hersiening en ontwikkeling van beleid, prosedures en bestuursraamwerke, waar nodig. Lei strategiese ingrypings om uitdagings in uniforme beleidstoepassing aan te spreek. Verseker dat die Users Asset Management Plans (UAMPs) in ooreenstemming met GIAMA en ander relevante voorskrifte ontwikkel word: Hou toezig op die ontwikkeling, hersiening en indiening van User Asset Management Plans (UAMPs) deur User Departments om nakoming te verseker, terwyl deurlopende ondersteuning en tegniese leiding gelewer word. Fasiliteer UAMP-opleiding, samestelling van portefeuljeverslag om haalbaarheidstudies in te lig, eiendomstendensnavorsing en risikobeperkingsmaatreëls. Eskaleer nie-nakoming in UAMP-indiening deur formele uitvoerende kanale. Bestuur die toesig oor infrastruktuurbeplanning en begroting: Hou toezig oor kliëntbetrokkenheid by infrastruktuurbegrotingsvergaderings, herverdelings en toekenning prosesse vir die huidige en komende finansiële jare. Belyn infrastruktuurinisiatiewe met kliëntbehoeftes en departementele prioriteite deur gekoördineerde haalbaarheidstudies, tendensnavorsing en risikobeperkingsplanne. Verseër die tydige verwerking en aanbeveling van Procurement Instructions (PIs) en Pre-Design Information Requests (PDIRs) gebaseer op Demand Management Plans, om projekhaalbaarheid en implementering te ondersteun. Analiseer en los gebruikersvraagkwessies vinnig op terwyl maatreëls gemonitor en geïmplementeer word om doeltreffende en effektiewe dienslewering te verseker. Bestuur kliëntverhoudings en geïntegreerde beplanning en koördinering: Lei die ontwikkeling en finalisering van diensleweringstandaarde en Service Level Agreements (SLAs) met kliëntdepartemente om diensverbintenis te formaliseer. Bestuur kliëntbetrokkenheid deur portefeuljeverslag, bilaterale forums, taakspanne en toesigvergaderings, wat sterk samewerkingsverhoudinge bevorder. Fasiliteer en bestuur akkommodasiebehoeftesassessering en haalbaarheidstudies, wat belyning met regeringsprecinct-ontwikkeling en Smart City-beginsels bevorder om kliënttevredenheid en operasionele doeltreffendheid te verbeter. Bestuur die Direktoraat: Bestuur die Direktoraat se besigheidsplanlewerbaredes, administratiewe begrotingsmonitering, prestasiebestuur van amptenare en gehalteversekering om nakoming van departementele en wetgewende vereistes te verseker. Spreek oudit- en parlementêre navrae aan, handhaaf risikoregistre, sertifiseer betalings en verseër tydige indiening van administratiewe dokumentasie. Stel en handhaaf robuuste interne kontroles, verslagdoening en kommunikasiestelsels om prestasieverwagtinge te bereik. Lei personeelontwikkeling en dien op transversale taakspanne.

zu.title: Umdlweli: Ukuphathwa Kwezidingo Zabasebenzisi
zu.summary: Umdlweli: Ukuphathwa Kwezidingo Zabasebenzisi e-Department of Public Works and Infrastructure ePretoria, kudinga izifundo ze-NQF 7 kanye neminyaka emihlanu yeziphalo ezenza umsebenzi wabaphathi.
zu.requirements: Umkhawulo oshibhile we-NQF 7 kwi-Public Administration/Management, Business Administration, Law, Real Estate Management kanye ne-Town and Regional Planning) njengoba kuhlonishwa yi-SAQA. Umkhawulo oshibhile weminyaka eyi-5 yamava ezingeni lomphathi ophakathi noma ophakeme ensimini ehambisana naleyo. Uzinikeze kumisebenzi okuhleziwe. Ulwazi: DPWI Asset Management Policies, Government Immovable Asset Management Act (GIAMA), Program and Project Management, Property Charter, Expropriation Bill, Land Development Act, Supply Chain Management Framework, Circulars, kanye ne-Directives, Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Treasury Regulations, referential Procurement Policy Framework Act, Broad-Based Black Economic Empowerment Act (B-BBEE), Occupational Health and Safety Act (OHSA), Public Service Act kanye ne-Public Service Regulations kanye nomthetho omunye ohambisana nale minyakazo, Real Estate Management. Amandla: Amandla ahlelwanga kanye nokuba ngumholi, Ukuphathwa kwabantu kanye nokubusisa, Ukuphathwa kwe-program namagepha, Ukuphathwa kwezimali, Ukuphathwa koshintsho, Ukuqondiswa kumthengi kanye nokugxila kumthengi, Amandla aphakeme okuxhumana namabantu kanye nesikhathi, Ukubhala umbiko ongumthelela, Ukuxhumana okuphakeme, Ukuqonda izilimi, Amandla aphakeme ekusebenzeni ngekhompyutha, Ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya, Ukuhlela ngokulinganisela, Ukuphathwa kwezinkinga, Ukuqonda izinkinga nokuzezisa isixazululo, Ukuhlela nokuhlela isikhathi, Amandla okuthatha izinqumo, Amandla okukhuthaza, Ukubumba inqubo. Izici Zomuntu: Amandla okuxhumana namathenga kanye nabahlanganyeli ngendlela ephathekayo kanye nolwazi, Amagugu aphezimu okuziphatha, Amandla okwenza izinto ngokuzithobilela nangendlela eqotho kanye eqotho, Amandla okuthuthukisa ukwethemba komzimba kanye nohlonipho, Okusha nokubunjwa, Okuqondiswa esixazululweni - amandla okuqamba izindinganiso ngokungeho inomdla, Okuqondiswe kubantu, Ukusebenza kanzima kanye nokukhuthazwa kakhulu, Amandla okusebenza ngempumelelo nangesikhathi phantsi koxinzelelo, Amandla okuhlangabezana nesikhathi esibekiwe kuyilapho kunikeza izixazululo ezinhle. Ulungele ukushintsha isikhathi sikawonke-wonke ngokuvumelana nezidingo zofuzisi.
zu.duties: Phatha ukuthuthukiswa, ukuhlolwa nokugcinwa kwezinqubo ze-User Demand Management, izu nokuqondiswa: Phatha ukuthuthukiswa, ukuhlolwa, nokugcinwa kwezinqubo ze-User Demand Management, izu, kanye nokuqondiswa, kuqinisekise ukulandelana kwezinhlelo zomthetho kanye nezinhloso ezinomsoco zomnyango. Faka isandla ekuhlolweni nasekuthuthukisweni kwezinqubo, izu, kanye nezakhiwo zokuphatha, lapho kudingeka khona. Hola ukungena okuhlelwenga ukubhekana nezingqikithi ekwenzeni kwenqubo ehambisana. Qinisekisa ukuthi Amaphulani Abasebenzisi Okuphathwa Kwempahla (UAMPs) athuthukiswa ngokulandelana kwe-GIAMA kanye nezinye izinqubo ezihambisanayo: Qapha ukuthuthukiswa, ukuhlolwa, nokuthunyelwa kwamaphulani abasebenzisi okuphathwa kwempahla (UAMPs) yizinyanga zomsebenzisi ukuze kuqinisekise ukulandelana, kuyilapho kunikeza isixhaso kanye nokuqondisa ngobuchwepheshe. Lexa ukuqeqeshwa kwe-UAMP, ukuhlanganiswa kombiko wokuqonda ukuthuthukiswa kocwaningo, ukuphenya ngokuthuthuka kwempahla, kanye nezinyathelo zokunciphisa ubungozi. Nyusa ukungalandelani kokuthunyelwa kwe-UAMP ngezindlela eziphathwa ngabaphathi. Phatha ukuqapha ukucaciswa kwezinsiza kanye nezenza-mali: Qapha ukuxhumana komsebenzisi emihlanganweni yezenza-mali, ukwabelwa kabusha kanye nezenqubo zokwabelwa izikhathi zangalesi kanye nezakusoza. Hlanganisa izinhloso zokuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza nezidingo zamathenga kanye nezinhloso zomnyango ngokuhlelwa kwocwaningo, ukuphenya ngokuthuthuka kanye nezinhlelo zokunciphisa ubungozi. Qinisekisa ukucutshungulwa kanye nokunconywa kwe-Procurement Instructions (PIs) kanye ne-Pre-Design Information Requests (PDIRs) ngokwe-Demand Management Plans, ukuze sixhase ukuze kwenzeke nokuqondiswa kophulo. Hlaziya futhi uxazulule izinkinga zezidingo zabasebenzisi ngokushesha kuyilapho ubuka futhi usebenzisa izinyathelo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukulethwa kwenkonzo efanele. Phatha ukuxhumana namathenga kanye nokuhlelwa okuhlangene nokuhlanganisa: Hola ukuthuthukiswa kanye nokuqediswa kwezinga lokulethwa kwenkonzo kanye ne-Service Level Agreements (SLAs) naminyango yamathenga ukuze kuqinisekiswe izinketho zenkonzo. Phatha ukuxhumana namathenga ngombiko wocwaningo, amaphanela abhangayo, amaqembu abasebenzi, kanye namahlangano, ukuthuthukisa ubudlelwane obuhle. Faka isandla kanyeokuqondisa ukuhlolwa kwezidingo zesikhundla nokucwaninga ukuze kwenzeke, ukuthuthukisa ukulandelana nokuthuthukiswa kwesikhungo sikahulumeni kanye nemigomo ye-Smart City ukuze kuphuculwe ukwaneliseka kwamathenga kanye nokusebenza kahle. Phatha Isikhundla: Phatha izinto ezihlinzekwayo zephulani lebisinhloko, ukubuka kwezimali zokuphatha, ukuphathwa kokusebenza kwabasebenzi kanye noqiniseko lwekhwalithi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukulandelwa kwezidingo zomnyango kanye nomthetho. Phendula imibuzo ye-audit kanye yephalamente, gcina izinkomba zengozi, qinisekisa izinkokhelo, futhi uqinisekise ukuthunyelwa kwemibhhalo yokuqondiswa ngesikhathi. Siseka kanye nokugcina okuqinile ukulawula ngaphakathi, umbiko, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhumana ukuze kuhlangabezane nezinkomba zokusebenza. Hola ukuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi kanye nokusebenza kumaqembu abasebenzi abathatha isikhathi.

xh.title: Umphathi: Ulawulo Lwemfuno Yabasebenzisi
xh.summary: Umphathi: Ulawulo Lwemfuno Yabasebenzisi kwisebe lezoZimoLwakhiwo zikaZweni nolwaQhinga ePretoria, lifuna izatifikethi ze-NQF 7 neminyaka emi-5 yamava abaphathi.
xh.requirements: Isiqinisekiso esingaphantsi kwe-NQF 7 kwiNtengiso kahulumendi/ulawulo, uLawulo lweShishini, umTetho, uLawulo lwesigcawu sabantu begodi nokuCwangcisa iNdawo nengingqi) njengokuqatshwa yi-SAQA. Isiqinisekiso seminyaka emi-5 yamava kwinqanaba lolawulo laphakathi okanye labaphathi abaphezulu kwilizoba elintsengeni. Uzinikezela kumsebenzi ochaziweyo. Ulwazi: Iindaba zolawulo lwefa kwisebe lezoZimoLwakhiwo zikaZweni nolwaQhinga, umTetho wokusetyenziswa kwefa esingatshintshiyo kahulumendi (GIAMA), ulawulo lwenkqubo nentatho-nxaxheba, isatifikethi sempahla, iNgcinyeka yokuTshabalalisa, umTetho wokuPhuhlisa umHlaba, uLwakhiwo loQoqosho lwezibonelelo, iindlela zokuqondisa, namalungiselelo, umTetho woLawulo lweMali kaHulumende (PFMA), iMigaqo yeNgingqi yeQongo, umTetho woQoqosho lokuThenga ngezinketho, umTetho woQhankqaliso lweQoqosho elibanzi iimisonto emnyama (B-BBEE), umTetho woKhuseleko nokuLondolozo kwamagcisa (OHSA), umTetho weNkonzo kaHulumende nemiQathango yeNkonzo kaHulumende namanye emisebenzi yomtetho, ulawulo lwesigcawu sabantu. Amandla: Isakhono esinqamlezileyo sobuqhawe nokuhalalisa, ulawulo lomntu nokuNika amandla, ulawulo lwenkqubo nentatho-nxaxheba, ulawulo lweemali, ulawulo lenguquko, ukujongana nabathengi nokujolisa kubathengi, amandla aphakamileyo okuziqhelanisa nabanye nolwimi oluqotho, ukubhala iingxelo ezithuthukileyo, unxibelelwano oluthuthukileyo, isidanga kolwimi, amandla aphakamileyo ekhompyutha, okucinga ngokuhlalutya, ukuCwangcisa ngokuqonda, ulawulo lweengxabano, ukubona iingxaki nokuZisombulula, ukuHlelwa nokuCwangcisa, amandla okuThatha iziGqibo, amandla okudala isithembiso. Iimpawu zobuntu: Amandla okunxibelelana nabathengi nakuhlukaniswa nawo nawo nawo ngeendlela ezithobekileyo nolwazi, amanqanaba aphezulu obugqila bokuziphatha, ukuba nakho ukuqhuba iinkqubo ngokuzinikela nangendlela eqhotsiyo nelungileyo, amandla okukhuthaza ukwabela nokuhlonela, okutsha nokuqamba, ukujolisa kwiisombulu – amandla okuyila iingcamango ngaphandle kokukhokelwa, ukujolisa kubantu, ukusebenza ngamandla nokuQhutywa ngamandla, amandla okusebenza ngempumelelo nangokuchanekileyo ngaphantsi kogcino olungaphezulu, amandla okuhlangabezana nexesha elincinci ngelixa unika iziphumo ezingagqithiswayo. Kulungele ukuhlela uhlelo lomsebenzi ngokwemfuno ye-ofisi.
xh.duties: Lawula uphuhliso, ukuhlolwa nokugcina iindaba, iindlela namaqhinga oLawulo Lwemfuno Yabasebenzisi: Lawula uphuhliso, ukuhlolwa, nokugcina iindaba, iindlela, namaqhinga oLawulo Lwemfuno Yabasebenzisi, kuqinisekiswa ukuvumelana neemiyalelo zomtetho nemiqathango esebe. Yaphulaonke ekubukeni nasekuphuhliseni iindaba, iindlela, nakulawulo lomthetho, apho kufuneka khona. Khokela ukungenelela ngokuplan mga qhinga ukusombulula iingxaki ekuqweneni iindlela ezingaguqukiyo. Qinisekisa ukuba iindlela zoLawulo lwefa lomsebenzisi (UAMPs) ziyilwa ngokwemiYalelo yeGIAMA namanye emiyalelo ephathwayo: Qondisa uphuhliso, ukuhlolwa, nokungenisa iindlela zoLawulo lwefa lomsebenzisi (UAMPs) ngaphandle kweendawo zokuSebenza ukuya kubasebenzisi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuzithobela, ngelixa unikezela inkxaso ehubekayo nokuqondisa ngobugcisa. Khokelela ekuyileni uLwazi lwe-UAMP, ukubhali kweziganeko zemisebenzi ukwenza izifundo ezikwaziyo ukubakho, intoleki yophando lwempahla, nezithithi zokuthintela iingozi. Nyusa ukungazithobeli kungeniso kwe-UAMP ngeendlela eziphakathi zokhokho. Lawula ukuqwalasela kokuCwangcisa uLwakhiwo nokuHlola imali: Qwalasela ukuNxibelelana komsebenzisi kwiiNkomfa zokuHlola imali yomCwangciso, ukuQhwa nokwabelwa imali kweminyaka ezo-za kuso-utitshala. Qondanisa iNdawo zokuQala nomPhathiswa wamaphupha namaphupha abathengi kwindawo zesebe ngokuvumelana nazo. Qinisekisa ukuba kuqhubeka kwaye kunconywa imiYalelo yokuthenga (PIs) nemifuzisela yolwazi yangaphambili (PDIRs) ngokweLindlela zoLawulo lwemfuno, ukuxhasa ukwazi ukubakho nokusebenza kwethu. Hlalutywa izifundo ezikwaziyo ukubakho ngokuchanekileyo.

jobs.title: Director: Construction Project Management (REGIONS)
jobs.department: Department of Public Works and Infrastructure
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 per annum, (all-inclusive package), (total package to be structured in accordance with the rules of the Senior Management Services).
jobs.summary: Director of Construction Project Management for the Department of Public Works and Infrastructure in Pretoria, requiring an NQF Level 7 qualification and SACPCMP registration.
jobs.requirements: A minimum of NQF Level 7 qualification in Built Environment or related field of study as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of 5 years’ experience at a middle or Senior managerial level in built environment. Registration as a Professional Construction Project Management with the SACPCMP. Knowledge: Financial management, Contract management, Programme and project management, Information management, Public Finance Management Act, Technical knowledge of the built environment, Construction regulations, Political Environment, Procurement processes and systems, Occupational health and safety, financial administration processes and systems (WCS), PMBOK Guidelines. Skills: Management skills, Advanced report writing, Advanced communication, Analytical thinking, Strategic planning, influencing skills, Time management, Negotiation skills, Programme and project management skills, Organising and planning, Policy formulation, Decision making skills, Motivational skills, Advanced interpersonal and diplomacy skills. Personal Attributes: Ability to work effectively and efficiently under pressure, Ability to meet tight deadline whilst delivering excellent results, Ability to communicate at all levels, participate at an executive level, Able to establish and maintain personal networks, Ability to work independently. Willing to adapt work schedule in accordance with professional requirement.
jobs.duties: Manage the implementation and monitoring of construction management guidelines, processes, standards and strategies: Identify construction management trends and opportunities for businesses processes improvement. Make recommendations for changes and improvements to existing construction management guidelines, standards, policies and procedures. Ensure compliance with project progresses approved programs and relevant framework. Ensure the development and implementation of support tools. Ensure the implementation of sound effective and efficient internal control system. Design and ensure implementation of project management methodologies for the projects` life cycle. Manage the implementation and compliance of projects-Provide inputs to client departments on conceptualisation of special major projects. Manage the project change management process. Manage service level agreements. Ensure the final design conforms to the departmental quality standards and client requirements. Provide technical advice on special projects and other related matters and maintain relations with stakeholders. Manage the process of appointment of service providers/contractors. Oversee the contract management services for construction projects. Manage the implementation and coordination of RAMP projects-Manage the design, planning, documentation processes and milestones of the projects. Provide strategic and technical support to RAMP activities. Ensure the implementation of RAMP in Regional Offices. Manage the co-ordination of special projects in Regional Offices. Develop a holistic maintenance on RAMP programmes. Manage construction projects operations budget: Ensure the availability and management of funds to meet the MTEF objectives within the engineering environment. Manage the operational capital project portfolio for the operation to ensure effective resourcing according to organisational needs and objectives. Manage the commercial value add of the discipline-related programmes and projects. Facilitate the compilation of innovation proposals to ensure validity and adherence to organizational principles. Allocate, control and monitor expenditure according to budget to ensure efficient cash flow management. Manage the Directorate: Establish and maintain appropriate internal controls and reporting systems in order to meet performance expectations; Develop and manage the operational plan of the Directorate and report on progress as required; Manage performance and development of employees; Establish, implement and maintain efficient and effective communication arrangements; Compile and submit all required administrative reports; Quality control of work delivered by employees; Monitor the budget and expenditures for the Directorate.

af.title: Direkteur: Construction Project Management (REGIONS)
af.summary: Direkteur van Construction Project Management vir die Department of Public Works and Infrastructure in Pretoria, wat 'n NQF Level 7-kwalifikasie en SACPCMP-registrasie vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Minimum van 'n NQF Level 7-kwalifikasie in Built Environment of 'n verwante studieveld soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se ervaring op 'n middel- of seniorbestuursvlak in die geboude omgewing. Registrasie as 'n Professional Construction Project Management by die SACPCMP. Kennis: Finansiële bestuur, Kontrakbestuur, Program- en projekbestuur, Inligtingsbestuur, Public Finance Management Act, Tegniese kennis van die geboude omgewing, Konstruksieregulasies, Politieke omgewing, Inskaffingsprosesse en -stelsels, Beroepsveiligheid en -gesondheid, finansiële administratiewe prosesse en stelsels (WCS), PMBOK Guidelines. Vaardighede: Bestuursvaardighede, Gevorderde verslagskrywing, Gevorderde kommunikasie, Analitiese denke, Strategiese beplanning, beïnvloedingsvaardighede, Tydbestuur, Onderhandelingsvaardighede, Program- en projekbestuursvaardighede, Organisering en beplanning, Beleidsformulering, Besluitnemingsvaardighede, Motiveringsvaardighede, Gevorderde interpersoonlike en diplomatiese vaardighede. Persoonlike eienskappe: Vermoe om doeltreffend en effektief onder druk te werk, Vermoe om stywe sperdatums te haal terwyl uitstaande resultate gelewer word, Vermoe om op alle vlakke te kommunikeer, op uitvoerende vlak deel te neem, in staat is om persoonlike netwerke te vestig en te handhaaf, Vermoe om onafhanklik te werk. Bereid om werkskedule in ooreenstemming met professionele vereistes aan te pas.
af.duties: Bestuur die implementering en monitering van konstruksiebestuursriglyne, prosesse, standaarde en strategieë: Identifiseer konstruksiebestuurstendense en geleenthede vir verbetering van besigheidsprosesse. Maak aanbevelings vir veranderinge en verbeterings aan bestaande konstruksiebestuursriglyne, standaarde, beleide en prosedures. Verseker nakoming van goedgekeurde programme vir projekvoortgang en die toepaslike raamwerk. Verseker die ontwikkeling en implementering van ondersteuningsnutsmiddels. Verseker die implementering van 'n gesonde, doeltreffende en effektiewe interne beheerstelsel. Ontwerp en verseker implementering van projekbestuurmetodologieë vir die projekte se lewensiklus. Bestuur die implementering en nakoming van projekte-Verskaf insette aan kliëntdepartemente oor konseptualisering van spesiale hoofprojekte. Bestuur die projekveranderingsbestuursproses. Bestuur diensvlakooreenkomste. Verseker dat die finale ontwerp aan die departementele gehaltestandaarde en kliëntvereistes voldoen. Verskaf tegniese advies oor spesiale projekte en ander verwante aangeleenthede en handhaaf verhoudings met belanghebbendes. Bestuur die proses van die aanstelling van diensverskaffers/kontrakteurs. Hou toesig oor die kontrakbestuursdienste vir konstruksieprojekte. Bestuur die implementering en koördinering van RAMP-projekte-Bestuur die ontwerp, beplanning, dokumentasieprosesse en mylpale van die projekte. Verskaf strategiese en tegniese ondersteuning aan RAMP-aktiwiteite. Verseker die implementering van RAMP in Streekskantore. Bestuur die koördinering van spesiale projekte in Streekskantore. Ontwikkel 'n holistiese onderhoudsplan vir RAMP-programme. Bestuur die bedryfsbegroting van konstruksieprojekte: Verseker die beskikbaarheid en bestuur van fondse om die MTEF-doelwitte binne die ingenieursomgewing te bereik. Bestuur die operasionele kapitaalprojekportefeulje vir die operasie om doeltreffende bemanning volgens organisatoriese behoeftes en doelwitte te verseker. Bestuur die kommersiële waardetoevoeging van dissiplineverwante programme en projekte. Fasiliteer die samestelling van innoveringsvoorstelle om geldigheid en voldoening aan organisatoriese beginsels te verseker. Allokeer, beheer en monitor besteding volgens begroting om doeltreffende kontantvloei-bestuur te verseker. Bestuur die Direktoraat: Vestig en handhaaf toepaslike interne beheer en verslagdoeningstelsels om prestasieverwagtinge te bereik; Ontwikkel en bestuur die operasionele plan van die Direktoraat en doen soos vereis verslag oor vordering; Bestuur prestasie en ontwikkeling van werknemers; Vestig, implementeer en handhaaf doeltreffende en effektiewe kommunikasierreëlings; Stel al die vereiste administratiewe verslae op en dien dit in; Gehaltebeheer van werk wat deur werknemers gelewer word; Monitor die begroting en besteding vir die Direktoraat.

zu.title: Umngqibela: Ukuqondiswa Kwezinhlelo Zokwakha (IZIFUNDAVAKHISHINI)
zu.summary: Umngqibela Wokuqondiswa Kwezinhlelo Zokwakha woMnyango Wezomsebenzi Kabezindlu Netholwathi ePretoria, ofuna iziqu eziseNqanaba le-NQF Level 7 nokubhaliswa kwi-SACPCMP.
zu.requirements: Iziqu eziseNqanabeli elinganisiwe le-NQF Level 7 kwi-Built Environment noma enye indawo efanayo yemfundo njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA. Okungenani iminyaka engu-5 yohlelo lwesikhathi esisezingeni sokuphatha eliphakathi noma eliphezulu kwi-built environment. Ukubhaliswa njengo-Professional Construction Project Management kwi-SACPCMP. Ulwazi: Ukuphatha kwezimali, Ukuphatha izinkulumo-mvumelwano, Ukuphatha amaphrogramu namaphrojekthi, Ukuphatha ulwazi, I-Public Finance Management Act, Ulwazi lobuchwepheshe le-built environment, Izilawulo zokwakha, Isimo sezepolitiki, Inqubo kanye nezinhlelo zokuthenga, I-Occupational health and safety, inqubo kanye nezinhlelo zokuphatha izimali (WCS), Izinhla zokuqondisa ze-PMBOK. Amakhono: Amakhono okuphatha, Ukubhala okuthuthukisiwe kwemibiko, Ukuxhumana okuthuthukisiwe, Ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya, Ukuhlela ngokubukeka, amakhono okumuncaya, Ukuphatha isikhathi, Amakhono okuxoxisana, Amakhono okuphatha amaphrogramu namaphrojekthi, Ukuqamba nokuhlela, Ukwenziwa kwenqambomgomo, Amakhono okuthatha izinqumo, Amakhono okukhuthaza, Amakhono aphakeme okuhlobana nobuqotho. Izici zabantu: Isikhono sokusebenza ngokusebenza kahle nangesikhathi ngaphansi koxinzelelo, Isikhono sokuqedana namadeadlini aphuthunyiwe kuyilawula imiphumela emihle, Isikhono sokusakaza izwi kuwo wonke amazinga, ukuthatha inxaxheba ezingeni eliphezulu, Isikhono sokwakhiba kugcine izinkungubo zomuntu siqu, Isikhono sokusebenza kodwa. Ukuze alungise ishejuli yokusebenza ngokuvumelana nezidingo zobuchwepheshe.
zu.duties: Phatha ukusetshenziswa kwayo ukulandelwa kwezinhla zokuqondisa, izinqubo, izinga kanye nezindlela zokuqondisa izinhlelo zokwakha: Qaphula izinto ezintsha zokuqondisa izinhlelo zokwakha kanye namathuba okuthuthukisa inqubo yezamabhizinisi. Nikela izincomo mayelana noshintsho kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwezinhla zokuqondisa ezingokwakha, amazinga, inqambomgomo, nanezinqubo ezikhona. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuhambisana nokuqhubekayo kwamaphrojekthi ohlelo oluvunyiwe kanye nendida efanayo. Qinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa kanye nokusetshenziswa kwezinsizakusekela. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kohlangothini oluhle nolusebenza kahle lwengxenye yongqongo. Cakula bese uqinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwezindlela zokuqondisa amaphrojekthi ngokuhamba kwezinsuku zaphrojekthi. Phatha ukusetshenziswa kwayo ukuhambelana kwamaphrojekthi-Nikeza okokufakwayo eminyangweni yabathengi ngokuqonda amaphrojekthi amakhulu akhethekile. Phatha inqubo yokushintshwa yamaphrojekthi. Phatha izinkulumo-mvumelwano ezinga lomsebenzi. Qinisekisa ukuthi isakhiwo sokugcina sihambisana n amazinga omnyango kanye nezidingo zabathengi. Nikeza lelo zeluleko lobuchwepheshe kumaphrojekthi akhethekile nanalezinye izinto eziyibhangqa kanti ulondoloze ubuhlobo namahlathi. Phatha inqubo yokumisebenzisa abanikeli bamasevisizi/kontrakhthi. Qapha izinkonzo zokuphatha izinkulumo-mvumelwano zamaphrojekthi zokwakha. Phatha ukusetshenziswa nokuqondanisa kwe-RAMP project-Sebenzisana ngohlelo, ukuhlela, izinqubo zoxhumano lwamafayela namagagu amaphrojekthi. Nikeza lelo ncedo elisezingeni eliphezulu nelobuchwepheshe emisebenzini ye-RAMP. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwe-RAMP kumakilasi abhalwe ndawonye. Phatha ukuqondana kwamaphrojekthi akhethekile kumakilasi abhalwe ndawonye. Thuthukisa ukugcinwa okuphelele kwamaphrogramhu we-RAMP. Phatha ukusebenza kwehejethi yamaphrojekthi wokwakha: Qinisekisa ukutholakala nokuphathwa kwemali ukuze kuhambisane namagomo e-MTEF emkhankathini wezobugqila. Phatha hejethi ebhaliwe yamaphrojekthi yizesulu ukusebenza kahle ngokomtholampilo ngokwezidingo kanye namagomo enhlangano. Phatha inani leminyuzo yokuhweba kwamaphrogramhu namaphrojekthi ahlobene nesifundo. Yenza kube lula ukuqoqwa kwezinkamela zezinto ezintsha ukuze kutholwe ukuthi ziyiqiniso futhi zilandelwe imigomo yenhlalo. Ngamisa, lawula futhi ulandele imali ekhishiwe ngokwehejethi ukuze kusebenze kahle ukuphatha kwokusakaza kwemali. Phatha iqenjelo: Sakaza ulondolozo olufanele kolawulo lwangaphakathi kanye nezinhlela zokubika ukugcwaliseka nendodakalo; Thuthukisa futhi uphathe ihelelo lokusebenza iqenjelo ubike ngokuhamba kwesikhathi njengoba kudingeka; Phatha ukusebenza kahle kanye nentuthuko yabasebenzi; Sakaza, setshenzise futhi ulondoloze izinhlelo zokuxhumana ezisebenza kahle nangempumelelo; Qamba ubike zonke imibiko ebalulekile yokuphatha bese uyiyalela; Lawula khwalithi yomsebenzi ohlinzekwa abasebenzi; Qapha ihejethi kanye nemali ekhishiwe iqenjelo.

xh.title: Umphathi: Ulawulo Lwamaprojekthi WoLwakhiwo (IINDAWO)
xh.summary: Umphathi WoloLawulo Lwamaprojekthi WoLwakhiwo kwiSebe leZoLuntu eZisebenzayo nakoZeLwakhiwo ePretoria, lifuna izifundo ezikumgangatho we-NQF Level 7 nokuqatshelwa kwi-SACPCMP.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esingaphantsi komgangatho we-NQF Level 7 kwindawo yoLwakhiwo okanye indawo ephathelene nayo njengokuqatshelwa yi-SAQA. Okungeka phantsi kweminyaka engama-5 yamava kwinqanaba eliphakathi okanye eliphezulu lolawulo kwindawo yolwakhiwo. Ukuqatshelwa njengoGunyazwe WokuLawula Amaprojekthi ZoLwakhiwo e-SACPCMP. Ulwazi: Ulawulo lweemali, Ulawulo lwamakontraki, Ulawulo lwenkqubo namaprojekthi, Ulawulo lolwazi, i-Public Finance Management Act, Ulwazi lobuchwepheshe bendawo yolwakhiwo, Iimigaqo yolwakhiwo, Iindawo zezepolitiki, Iinkqubo nendlela zokuthenga, Ulutshingo-nempi loqoqosho nolukhuselekileyo, iinkqubo nendlela zolawulo lwemali (WCS), Izelengiso ze-PMBOK. Amakhono: Amakhono olawulo, Ukubhala iiriphothi eziphezulu, Unxibelelwano oluphezulu, Ukuqonda ngokuhlalutya, Uqwalaselo lokuqamba, amakhono okuchukumisa, Ulawulo lwexesha, Amakhono okuxoxisana, Amakhono olawulo lwenkqubo namaprojekthi, Ukuqamba nokuqwalasela, Uqwalaselo lweenqobo, Amakhono okwenza izigqibo, Amakhono okukhuthaza, Amakhono aphakamileyo obuntu bomntu nodiplomasi. Iimpawu zobuntu: Amandla okusebenza ngokusebenzayo nangokuchanekileyo ngaphantsi komgcini, Amandla okuhlanganela iimvela ezinqamlezileyo ngelixa unikezela iziphumo eziphezulu, Amandla okunxibelelana kwonke amanqanaba, ukuthatha inxaxheba kwinqanaba lesigqeba, Amandla okuseka nokuagcina iinethiwekhi zobuqu, Amandla okusebenza nodwa. Ukulungele ukuhlengahlengisa ijeshi yomsebenzi ngokwemfuno yomsebenzi.
xh.duties: Lawula ukusebenza nokuhlola iixelengiso, iinkqubo, iistandathi neendlela zolawulo lolwakhiwo: Chonga iintshukumo zolawulo lolwakhiwo namathuba okuphucula iinkqubo zoshishino. Nikeza izindululo zotshintsho nokuphucula iixelengiso, iistandathi, iingqungquthela neenkqubo zolawulo lolwakhiwo ezikhoyo. Qinisekisa ukuthobela amaphulo amaprojekthi kumanqamlebzo avunyiweyo nasemigaqweni ephathelene. Qinisekisa ukuphuhliswa nokusebenza kwezixhobo zoxhaso. Qinisekisa ukusebenza kwenkqubo egcinayo, esebenzayo nengachanekileyo yolawulo lwangaphakathi. Yila uze uqinisekise ukusebenza kweendlela zolawulo lwamaprojekthi kwinkqubo yobomi bamaprojekthi. Lawula ukusebenza nokuthobela kwamaprojekthi-Nikeza izixhobo kumasebe abathengi ngokuqamba amaprojekthi amakhulu akhethekileyo. Lawula inkqubo yotshintsho lolawulo lweprojekthi. Lawula iinkqubo zomvuzo wabe nomyalezo. Qinisekisa ukuba ulo lwekokugqibela luhambelana neendawo zomgangatho zesebe nadiimfuno zabathengi. Nikeza icebiso lobuchwepheshe kwamaprojekthi akhethekileyo nakwezinye izinto ephathelene nazo zigcine ubudlelwane nabathathi-nxaxheba. Lawula inkqubo yokumisela abahanjisi bezebenzi/abakhi. Lawula iinkonzo zolawulo lwamakontraki kwamaprojekthi yolwakhiwo. Lawula ukusebenza nokuhambelanisa kweeprojekthi ze-RAMP-Lawula ukuyila, uqwalaselo, iinkqubo zoxwebhu namaphulo amaprojekthi. Nikeza inkxaso yamangqamba nolwazi olubuchwepheshe kumashishini e-RAMP. Qinisekisa ukusebenza kwe-RAMP kwiOfisi zamaPhondo. Lawula ukuhambelanisa kwamaprojekthi akhethekileyo kwiOfisi zamaPhondo. Phuhlisa ulondolozo olubandakanya zonke izithjengi kwiinkqubo ze-RAMP. Lawula imigangatho yophondo yemali yamaprojekthi yolwakhiwo: Qinisekisa ukubakhona kolawulo lwemali ukuze kuhlanganelwe iinjongo ze-MTEF ngaphakathi kwendawo ye-engineering. Lawula ibhashe lephulo le-capital yophondo lokusebenza ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukunikwa ngokuchanekileyo koyilo ngokweenkqobo neenjongo zoluntu. Lawula ixabiso lenkonzo nabahlinzeki kwii-program namaprojekthi ephathelene nodidi. Yenza kuqokelelwe izindululo zokufumanisa izinto entsha ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza nokuhambelana nemigaqo yoluntu. Sabelwa, lawula uze uhlale ukuthelekisa imali echithiweyo ngokomgangatho weemali ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukulawula ngokuchanekileyo kokuhamba kwekhwakha. Lawula iSebe: Sika uze ulondoloze izixhobo zolawulo ezifanelekileyo neendalo zokuriphotha ukuze kuhlanganelwe iilindwezo zokusebenza; Phuhlisa uze ulawule icebo lophando lokusebenza loSebe uze uriphothe ngophuhliso njengoko kufuneka; Lawula ukusebenza nophuhlulo abasebenzi; Sika, usebenzise uze ulondoloze indlela zokunxibelelana ezisebenzayo nangokuchanekileyo; Qamba uze ungenise yonke iiriphothi zolawulo eziqungiweyo; Lawulo lomgangatho lomsebenzi onikiweyo ngabasebenzi; Hlola umgangatho weemali ezichithiweyo kulo Sebe.

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Real Estate Management Services
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur vir Real Estate Management Services by die Department of Public Works and Infrastructure in Polokwane, wat ʼn tersiêre kwalifikasie en juniorbestuurservaring in die eiendomsbedryf vereis.
af.requirements: ʼn Minimum driejaar tersiêre kwalifikasie (NQF Level 06) / Nasionale Diploma in Eiendomswaardasies, Eiendomsbestuur, Real Estate, LLB, Town & Regional Planning. Toepaslike ervaring in die eiendomsbedryf op ʼn Junior Bestuurs- / Assistent Direkteur-gelykwaardige vlak in Real Estate Management. Kennis en begrip van PFMA, eiendomverwante Wette en ander eiendomswette en plaaslike regulasies. Dorpsbeplanningservaring of -kennis. Goeie finansiële vaardighede, bewese begrotingsvermoë. Kennis van gebou-inspeksies en waarderingsmetodes en die vastegoedmark en sy tendense. Analitiese vermoë. Sterk skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasievaardighede en goeie interpersoonlike vaardighede. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Implementeer en handhaaf verkrygings en huurbeleid; benuttings-, kontrak- en eiendomsoorddragsbeleid, prosedures, raamwerke, delegasies en verseker nakoming daarvan. Koördineer die eiendomsverkrygingsproses in ooreenstemming met die goedgekeurde verkrygingsraamwerk. Fasiliteer en bestuur die huuradministrasieproses vir private en huurkontrak-portefeuljes. Verseker die optimale benutting van staatseiendomme. Bestuur die vrystellingsproses van oortollige grondpersele om Regeringsgrondhervormingsdoelwitte te bereik. Verseker effektiewe en doeltreffende staatseiendomsinligtingsbestuur. Bestuur van die komponent-: Vestig en handhaaf toepaslike interne kontroles en verslagdoeningstelsels om prestasieverwagtinge te bereik; Handhawing van dissipline; Bestuur van prestasie en ontwikkeling; Vestig en handhaaf belanghebbendesverhoudinge. Ontwikkel en bestuur die operasionele plan van die direktoraat en rapporteer oor vordering soos vereis; Stel alle vereiste administratiewe verslae op en dien dit in; Dien op dwarsafdelingstaakspanne soos vereis; Kwaliteitskontrole op verslae wat deur ander sub-direktorate ingedien is; Verskaf finansiële bestuursondersteuning. Neem deel aan en koördineer finansiële insetsels tot die departementele Jaarlikse Finansiële State.

zu.title: Umphathinhwebe: Izenzo Zokuphathwa Kwamasimu Nobumbiso
zu.summary: Umphathinhwebe wezenzo zokuphathwa kwamasimu nobumbiso e Department of Public Works and Infrastructure e Polokwane, ofuna iziqu eziphakeme nemfundo yokuphatha kwabasebenzi abancane emkhakheni wesimi.
zu.requirements: Iziqu eziphakeme ezincane zonyaka omuthathu (NQF Level 06) / National Diploma ekuqokweni kwamasimu, ekuphathweni kwamasimu, kumasimu nobumbiso, LLB, ekubekweni koluntu neplani sezifunda. Ulwazi olufanele emkhakheni wesimi ezingeni lokuphatha kwabasebenzi abancane / okulingana noAssistant Director ekuphathweni kwamasimu nobumbiso. Ulwazi nokuqonda kwe-PFMA, kumthetho ohlobene namasimu nomunye umthetho wesimiu nemithetho yendawo. Ulwazi noma kemvelo yekubeka koluntu nezifunda. Amakhono amahle emali, amandla okwenza isabelo somali esiqinisekisiwe. Ulwazi ngokuqisiswa kwakho kwakhiwo nezindlela zokuqoka kanye nenzalo yamasimu nobumbiso namatrendi awo. Amandla okuhlaziya. Amakhono amakhulu okubhala nokuKHULUMA kahle namakhono amahle abantu. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile.
zu.duties: Phatha futhi zigcine izinkambiso zokuthenga nokuhlinzeka; ukusetshenziswa, izinkambiso zokucashwa nokukhiqizwa kwamasimu, izinqubo, izakhiwo, izimemo kanye nokuqinisekisa ukuthi zihambisana. Hlela inqubo yokuthenga kwamasimu ngokuhambisana nesakhiwo esivunyiwe sokuthenga. Phathise futhi uphathe inqubo yokuphathwa kwamasimu okhishiwe yizinto eziyakathumba nasemakethe. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okuhle kakhulu kwamasimu ohulumeni. Phatha inqubo yokukhulula izinkaba zezwe ezingayedlule ukuze kufezeke izinhloso zikaHulumene ezenza ulutsha. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa kolwazi lwesimohulumeni ngokuphelele kahle nokusebenza kalula. Ukuphathwa kwesigaba: Yakha futhi ugcine ukulawula okuhle ngaphakathi kanye nezinhlelo zokubika ukuze kuhambisana nezilindelo zokusebenza; Ukugcina inyikemba; Ukuphathwa kokusebenza kokwaziswa; Yakha futhi ugcine ubuhlobo nabanomzabalazo. Yakha futhi uphathe ihlelo lokuqhuba ledirectorite ubike ngokuhamba njengoba kudingeka; Hlanganisa futhi uthumele yonke imibiko efunwa ngokuphathwa; Phathisane namathimamu abesebenzayo njengoba kudingeka; Ukulawula ikhwalithi kwemibiko ethunyelwe amanye amaphuzu amancane; Nikeza inkaxa yokuphatha imali. Thinta futhi uhleze imibhalo yemali ekuqokweni kwezimali zonyaka kazwelonke kanye neholo lesonto.

xh.title: Isebe Elincedisayo: Iinkonzo zoLawulo lweNdalo yoMhlaba
xh.summary: Isebe elincedisayo kwiinkonzo zolawulo lwendalo yomhlaba kwiDepartment of Public Works and Infrastructure ePolokwane,elifuna isiganga sethathu semfundo ephakamileyo nolwazi lokusebenza kwinqanaba lobaphathi abancinci kwishishini lamasheya epropati.
xh.requirements: Isidanga esingaphantsi kwethatu semfundo ephakamileyo (NQF Level 06) / iDiploma yesiZwe kwizigqibo zePropati, uLawulo lwePropati, iNdalo yoMhlaba, iLLB, uCococisa loMzi neMimandla. Ulwazi olufanelekileyo kwishishini lepropati kwinqanaba loLawulo lwabancinci / iSahluko esincedisayo esilingana nalo kwikuLawulo kweNdalo yoMhlaba. Ulwazi nokuqonda kukaPFMA, iMithetho ehlobene nePropati neminye imithetho yepropati nemitsetho yendawo. Ulwazi ngenzame lokucocisa umzi nemimandla. Amakhono amabalwe amakhulu, ikhono elibonakaliswe kumalinganiso wemali. Ulwazi ngokujonga izakhiwo nendlela zokuqamba ixabiso nendalo yomhlaba kunye namathrendi ayo. Ikhono lokuhlola kunye nokuyilanga. Amanqanaba amakhulu ekhono lokubhala nokuthetha kunye nakhono amakhulu okuhlobana nabantu. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngeminyuzi. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo.
xh.duties: Ziza kusebenzisa konke okufunekayo ekuthathweni izinto nokuphatha iinkonzo zokuhlala; ukusetyenziswa, kontrakthi, namagunya anika ngaphezulu ezinye izinto; iindlela, iinkqubo, iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo, namagunya aphilayo ngokwenza ngokwemithetho ngokubonelela. Hlela inkqubo yedatha ngokwenza okunamagunya okuthabatha ipropati. Tshintshela yonke imisebenzi yokulawula ukugcinwa kolwazi, kwaye ulawule imisebenzi yokuphatha izindlu ezininzi zaseburhulumente. Qinisekisa ukulungelelaniswa kwendlu ekulingeneyo ngokuthengisa emzini. Lawula inkqubo yokukhulula ihlabathi elizeleleyo ukwanelisa iinjongo zeNyuso yoRhulumente. Lawula ngokulungele inkqubo yolwazi kwiiPropati ezisebenzayo. Lawula iNqanaba elingaphantsi-: Misela uLawulo olungaphakathi olufanelekileyo nemitsetho yokuvela ngokulinganisa iinkqubo zokwenza imisebenzi; Ukuqinisekisa imfundo ekulungelelweni; ULawulo oluzenzeleyo nolusetyenziswa kakhulu; Misela kwaye ulondoloze iindaba ezahlukeneyo zokuzimisela. Yila ulwazi lwamanye amasebe ngokubonelela amanqanaba abalulekileyo okubhaliswa kwemali yonyaka.

jobs.title: Junior Developer ICT

af.title: Junior ontwikkelaar ICT
af.summary: Junior ICT-ontwikkelaarpos by die Department of Public Works and Infrastructure in Pretoria, wat 'n IT-diploma en ervaring in sagtewareontwikkeling, stelselontleding en databasisbestuur vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Minimum van 'n drie-jaar tersiêre kwalifikasie (NQF Level 06) / Nasionale Diploma in Inligtingstegnologie of gelykwaardige kwalifikasies. Relevante jare van ervaring in stelselontleding, sagtewareontwikkeling en sagtewaretoetsing. Databasiskennis van Oracle, MS SQL, MySQL en Spring boot Java-raamwerk. Gewenste kennis en begrip van twee of meer van die volgende programmeertale word vereis: C/C++, Visual Basic, C#, Java, XML, Angular en enige BI-rapporteringsnutsmiddel. Rekenaarvaardig. Vermoë om innoverend te dink en by verskillende benaderings tot stelsels/toepassings aan te pas. Vermoë om onder druk te werk. Analitiese en probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Goeie mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasie. Interpersoonlike, beplannings- en organisasievaardighede. Integriteit en eerlikheid.
af.duties: Ontleed en implementeer nuwe vereistes. Ontwikkel toekomstige toepassingstelsels. Verseker gehalte van gelewerde oplossing. Probleemoplossing, ontfouting, onderhou en pas bestaande toepassingstelsels aan. Verskaf tegniese ondersteuning. Stel gebruikerterugvoer saam en evalueer dit om sagtewareprestasie te verbeter. Ontwikkel tegniese dokumentasie om toekomstige sagtewareontwikkelingsprojekte te begelei. Neem deel aan ICT-projekte, stelselopgraderings en digitale transformasie-inisiatiewe. Pas die wetlike vereiste van die direktoraat toe op die bywerking van toepassings volgens vereiste riglyne.

zu.title: UmDeveloper we-ICT oMusha
zu.summary: Isikhundla sokuba ngumDeveloper we-ICT oMusha ku-Department of Public Works and Infrastructure e-Pretoria, esidinga idiploma le-IT nokuhlangenwe ndaba ekuthuthukisweni kwe-software, ukuhlaziya amasistimu nokuphathwa kwemininingwane.
zu.requirements: Ithuba elincane lezemfundo ephakeme leminyaka emithathu (NQF Level 06) / National Diploma in Information Technology noma iziqu ezingalinganayo. Eminyaka edingekile yokuhlangenwe ndaba ekuhlaziyeni kwamasistimu, ekuthuthukisweni kwe-software, nasekuhlolweni kwe-software. Ulwazi lwemininingwange malunga ne-Oracle, MS SQL, MySQL kanye ne-Spring boot Java framework. Kudingeka ulwazi oluqondile nokuqonda izilimi zokulungisa uhlelo ezimbili noma ngaphezulu okulandelayo: C/C++, Visual Basic, C#, Java, XML, Angular kanye nanoma yisiphi isisetshenziswa sokubika se-BI. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ikhono lokucabanga ngendlela entsha nokuzivumela eendlelweni ezingafani zokusebenza kwamasistimu/izinhlelo zokusebenza. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi koxinzelelo. Ikhono lokuhlaziya izinkinga nokuqonda. Ukukhuluma kahle nokubhala kahle. Amakhono okuxhumana nabantu, ukweluleka nokuhlela izinto. Ukuqotho nokuba nesithunzi.
zu.duties: Hlaziya futhi usebenzise izidingo ezintsha. Thuthukisa izinhlelo zokusebenza ezizayo. Qinisekisa ikhwalithi yesixazululo esinikezwe. Lungisa amaphutha, hlola, gcina futhi ulungise izinhlelo zokusebenza ezikhona. Nikeza inkxaso yobuchwepheshe. Qamba futhi uhlolojwe imibono yabasebenzisi ukuthuthukisa ukusebenza kwe-software. Bhala imibhalo yobuchwepheshe ukuyahola izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa kwe-software ezizayo. Hlanganyela kumaprojekthi we-ICT, ekuqotheni kwamasistimu, nakumagumbi okushintsha kwe-digital. Sebenzisa izidingo zomthetho zeqoqo lezindaba ekuqotheni izinhlelo zokusebenza ngokwemiyalo edingekayo.

xh.title: Junior Developer ICT
xh.summary: Indima ye-Junior ICT Developer kwisebe lePublic Works and Infrastructure ePretoria, efunisa idiploma ye-IT namava ekuphuhlisweni kwesoftware, kuqwalaselo lweenkqubo naku lawulo lolwazi olugcinwe kumagazini.
xh.requirements: Isifundo seze-mfundi esingapheli kweminyaka emithathu (NQF Level 06) / National Diploma kwiInformation Technology okanye izifundo ezalinganayo. Iminyaka engqongqo yamava ekuqwalaselweni kweenkqubo, ekuphuhlisweni kwesoftware, nakuvavwokeni kwesoftware. Ulwazi ngeDatabase malunga ne-Oracle, MS SQL, MySQL ne-Spring boot Java framework. Kufuneka kube khona ulwazi nokuqonda okulindelekweyo kwesilandi sakudweba iinkqubo esibini okanye ngaphezulu esilandelayo: i-C/C++, i-Visual Basic, i-C#, i-Java, i-XML, i-Angular nakho nakunye na isixhobo sokubika se-BI. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amandla okucinga ngenindlela entsha nokuzinza kwiindlela ezahlukeneyo zeenkqubo/iinkqubo zokusebenzisa. Amandla okusebenza ngaphantsi kwexinzelelo. Amandla okuqwalasela nokusombulula iingxaki. Ilizwi elihle nokubhala ngokuchanekileyo. Amandla abantu, okucwangcisa nokuqamba izinto ngokweenkqubo. Uyinjongo nokuba nyani.
xh.duties: Qwalasela ukuze usebenzise iimfuno ezintsha. Phuhlisa iinkqubo zokusebenza zexesha elizayo. Qinisekisa umgangatho wembiselo ehanjisiweyo. Lungisa iimpazamo, khangela iimpazamo, zigcine uze uzenze ngendlela oyifunayo iinkqubo zokusebenza ezikhoyo. Zize iinkxaso ezobuchwepheshe. Qokelela uze uqwalasele izimvo zabasebenzisi ukuphucula ukusebenza kwesoftware. Bhala imibhalo yobuchwepheshe ekuyakukhokeza iiprojekthi zexesha elizayo zokuphuhlisa isoftware. Thatha inxaxheba kwiiprojekthi ze-ICT, ekuvenzelweni kweenkqubo, nakwinqanaba lokuguqula izinto zibe ngamazwe. Sebenzisa iimfuno ezichaziweyo ngumthetho kumkhakha kubhalo lweenkqubo ngokwemigaqo efunekayo.

af.duties: Verskaf 'n administratiewe ondersteuningstelsel vir interne en eksterne belanghebbendebestuur in die Eenheid. Neem deel aan streeksbiedspesifikasie- en evalueringskomitees om leiding te gee en te verseker dat aan EPWP-nakomingsvereistes voldoen word. Berei logistiek voor vir die werwing en uitrede van NYS-leerders. Stel opleidingsbehoeftes wat vir NYS-leerders geïdentifiseer is, saam en kommunikeer dit. Ontwikkel en handhaaf 'n akkurate databasis van begunstigdes se rekords. Berei statusverslae oor ontvange projeginligting voor. Berei notule van vergaderings met interne en eksterne belanghebbendes voor. Voer projekwerfbesoeke uit vir monitering en dataversameling. Berei logistiek voor vir EPWP-worksessies en gradeplegtighede. Neem deel aan kapasiteitsbou-worksessies om te verseker dat aan EPWP-vereistes voldoen word. Bestuur en verbeter voortdurend EPWP-verslagdoening en data-integriteit. Stel projegdata volgens verslagdoeningsstandaarde saam vir vaslegging op die EPWP-verslagdoeningstelsel. Dien maandelikse vorderingverslae in. Handhaaf lêerrekords vir ouditdoeleindes. Verskaf finansiële administratiewe ondersteuningsdienste. Algemene toesig oor werknemers.

Zukela emakomithi asikhungweni sokucacisa nokuqinisekisa izitende ukuze unikeze imibono waze uqinisekise ukuthi kuhozwe ngezidingo zokuzezelwa kwe-EPWP. Lungiselela izinsiza zokuqasha nokuphuma kwabafundi be-NYS. Qamba uthotho futhi uxoxe ngemfuneko yokulekelela ezihlonzekiwe zabafundi be-NYS. Yakha futhi ulondoloze ngokunembile idathabheysi yokugcina amarekhodi wabazuzi. Lungiselela imibiko yezimo mayelana nemininingwane yephrojekthi etholwe. Lungiselela imizuzu yokuhlanganiswa namhlanje nabahlinzeki bongaphakathi nangaphandle. Yenza ukuvakashela iziteshi zephrojekthi ukuze kubhekelewe futhi kuqoqwe imininingwane. Lungiselela izinsiza zamakoloko e-EPWP nemikhosi yokuthweswa iziqu. Zukela emakolokweni okwakha amandla ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuzelana nezidingo zokuzezelwa kwe-EPWP. Phatha futhi ucacise ngokuphila ukubika nokuba nokuzinembile kwemininingwane yaku-EPWP. Qamba imininingwane yephrojekthi ngokulingana namazinga okubika ukuze kungenwe kwiSistimu yokubika ye-EPWP. Thumela imibiko yentuthuko nyanga zonke. Londoloza amafayela amarekhodu ukuze kuhlolwe. Hlinzeka ngezinsiza zokuphatha izimali. Ukugada ngokuvamile abasebenzi.

Lungiselela i-logistics zokuqokelela nokuphuma kwabafundi be-NYS. Qokelela uhlobo lokuzilolonga abafundi be-NYS bathanda ukulifunda baze ulusasaze. Yila uze ulondoloze ngokuchanekileyo idatabase yemiba yabemi ababonelelwayo. Lungiselela iingxelo zemo yeprojekthi nge-nkcukacha ezifunyenweyo. Lawula uze uluhlaze ngokuqhubekayo ingxelo ye-EPWP nokuzinza kweenkcukacha. Qokelela i-nkcukacha yeprojekthi ngokwezinga lengxelo ekufuneka ifakwe kwi-EPWP Reporting System. Ngenisa iingxelo zentshukumo nyanga zonke. Gcina iifayile zemiba ze-audit. Nika inkxaso yemiraro yolawulo yemali. Lawula ngokubanzi abasebenzi.
