jobs.title: ASD: Informal & Micro Business Development
jobs.closing_date_text: 29 August 2026 at 16h00. Applications received after the closing date will not be considered.
jobs.summary: Informal and micro business development specialist role involving research, programme design, and support for interventions to grow informal and micro businesses.
jobs.requirements: A Bachelor’s degree (NQF 7) in Public Administration / Business Management /Development Studies / Project Management / Economics / Development Finance or an equivalent / related as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of three (3) years’ experience at a functional specialist level in the Informal Sector, Local Economic Development, Project Management, and Micro Business Support environment, including proven experience in the development, drafting, and implementation of policies, frameworks, strategies, guidelines, and related governance instruments. Knowledge of the National Development Plan, Understanding of the National Integrated Small Enterprise Development framework, Knowledge of the National Informal Business Upliftment Strategy, Understanding of the Informal and Micro Enterprise Development Programme and Knowledge of Public Finance Management Act. The candidate must possess the following skills and competencies: Incentive processing, Policy development, Data management, Problem Solving, Planning and Organising, Analytical Thinking, Interpersonal Skills, Client Orientation and Customer Focus, Stakeholder Relations, Service Delivery and Innovation and Networking. Additional requirements include computer literacy (MS Office 365 Packages), a valid Code B/EB driver’s licence and security clearance.
jobs.duties: Conduct research and comparative analyses to identify best practices and emerging trends, and contribute to the design, review, enhancement, and piloting of programmes, models, instruments, and interventions that support the development and growth of informal and micro businesses. Support the implementation of the National Informal Business Upliftment Strategy (NIBUS) and Informal and Micro Enterprise Development Programme (IMEDP) through application assessment and processing, due diligence, funding recommendations, beneficiary support, stakeholder linkages, and the administration of approved claims and disbursements in accordance with programme requirements and financial controls. Coordinate stakeholder engagements and capacity-building initiatives with municipalities, government entities, associations, and sector partners, while providing advisory support on policies, procedures, and strategies to promote compliance, collaboration, and effective programme delivery. Monitor and evaluate programme performance through post-disbursement assessments, compliance monitoring, performance tracking and reporting, while supporting internal and external audit processes to ensure accountability, policy alignment, and effective programme outcomes. Develop and maintain beneficiary and programme information systems, and ensure accurate data management to support reporting, informed decision- making, and effective stakeholder coordination. Draft and manage a range of correspondence, reports, presentations, memoranda, and submissions, and maintain effective communication with internal and external stakeholders on programme, policy, and operational matters. EENQUIRIES : Enquiries for all advertised posts should be directed to the recruitment office on Tel No: (012) 394-5286/43097
jobs.applications: The Department of Small Business Development is committed to the pursuit of diversity and redress.
jobs.notes: Applications must quote the relevant reference number and consist of: A fully completed and signed Z83 form and a recent comprehensive CV. Submission of copies of qualifications, Identity document, and any other relevant documents will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. All non-SA citizens will be required to submit proof of permanent residence in South Africa when shortlisted. Personnel suitability checks will be done during the selection process. Applicants could be required to provide consent for access to their social media accounts. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. If you have not been contacted within 1 month of the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. In the pursuit of diversity and redress, appointments will be made in line with the DSBD EE Plan. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The successful candidate will be required to sign a performance agreement within three months of appointment, as well as complete a financial interest declaration form within one month of appointment and annually thereafter. The Department reserves the right not to fill or withdraw any advertised post. Note: a new application for employment (Z83) form is applicable from 01 January 2021. af.title: ASD: Informele & Mikrobesigheidsontwikkeling
af.summary: Spesialisrol in informele en mikrobesigheidsontwikkeling wat navorsing, programontwerp en ondersteuning van ingrypings behels om informele en mikrobesighede te laat groei.
af.requirements: ‘n Bachelorsgraad (NQF 7) in Openbare Administrasie / Besigheidsbestuur / Ontwikkelingstudies / Projekbestuur / Ekonomie / Ontwikkelingsfinansies of ‘n gelykwaardige / verwante kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken. ‘n Minimum van drie (3) jaar se ervaring op ‘n funksionele spesialisvlak in die Informele Sektor, Lokale Ekonomiese Ontwikkeling, Projekbestuur, en Mikrobesigheidsondersteuningsomgewing, insluitend bewese ervaring in die ontwikkeling, opstel en implementering van beleide, raamwerke, strategieë, riglyne en verwante beheerinstrumente. Kennis van die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan, begrip van die Nasionale Geïntegreerde Klein Ondernemingsontwikkelingsraamwerk, kennis van die Nasionale Informele Besigheidsopheffingsstrategie, begrip van die Informele en Mikro-ondernemingsontwikkelingsprogram en kennis van die Wet op Openbare Finansiesbestuur. Die kandidaat moet oor die volgende vaardighede en bevoegdhede beskik: Insetieverwerking, beleidsontwikkeling, databestuur, probleemoplossing, beplanning en organisering, analitiese denke, interpersoonlike vaardighede, kliëntgerigtheid en kundefokus, belanghebbende verhoudings, dienslewering en innovasie en netwerking. Addisionele vereistes sluit in rekenaarvaardigheid (MS Office 365-pakketten), ‘n geldige Code B/EB-bestuurderslisensie en veiligheidsklarering.
af.duties: Voer navorsing en vergelykende ontledings uit om beste praktyke en ontluikende tendense te identifiseer, en dra by tot die ontwerp, hersiening, verbetering en loods van programme, modelle, instrumente en ingrypings wat die ontwikkeling en groei van informele en mikrobesighede ondersteun. Ondersteun die implementering van die National Informal Business Upliftment Strategy (NIBUS) en Informal and Micro Enterprise Development Programme (IMEDP) deur toepassingsassessering en -verwerking, behoorlike ondersoek, befondsingsaanbevelings, begunstigde-ondersteuning, belanghebbendeskakeling, en die administrasie van goedgekeurde eise en uitbetalings in ooreenstemming met programvereistes en finansiële beheermaatreëls. Koördineer belanghebbende-betrokkenheid en kapasiteitsbou-aktiwiteite met munisipaliteite, regeringsentiteite, verenigings en sektpartners, terwyl voorligtingsondersteuning oor beleide, prosedures en strategieë verskaf word om nakoming, samewerking en effektiewe programlewering te bevorder. Monitor en evalueer programprestasie deur na-uitbetaling-assesserings, nakomingsmonitering, prestasiesopvolging en verslagdoening, terwyl interne en eksterne ouditprosesse ondersteun word om verantwoordelikheid, beleidsbelyning en effektiewe programuitkomste te verseker. Ontwikkel en handhaaf begunstigde- en programinligtingstelsels, en verseker akkurate databestuur om verslagdoening, ingeligte besluitneming en effektiewe belanghebbende-koördinering te ondersteun. Stel ‘n reeks korrespondensie, verslae, aanbiedings, memoranda en voorleggings op en bestuur dit, en handhaaf effektiewe kommunikasie met interne en eksterne belanghebbendes oor program-, beleids- en operasionele aangeleenthede. Navrae: Navrae oor alle geadverteerde poste moet na die werweringskantoor gerig word by Tel No: (012) 394-5286/43097.

zu.title: I-ASD: Inqubo Yokuthuthukisa Izinkampani Ezingakalungulemi Neze-Micro
zu.summary: Indima yokuba nguchwepeshe ekuthuthukiseni izinkampani ezingakalungulemi neze-micro, ehilela ucwaningo, ukwakheka kwezinhlelo, kanye nokwesekwa kwezinhlela ezibhekene nokukhuliswa kwezinkampani ezingakalungulemi neze-micro.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-Bachelor's (NQF 7) kwi-Public Administration / Business Management / Development Studies / Project Management / Economics / Development Finance noma okulingana / okuhlobene njengoba kuhlonzwa yi-SAQA. Ukwazi okuncane kweminyaka emithathu (3)emisebenzini ezingeni lochwepeshe ohlinzeka ngemisebenzi ecishe ibe ngalowo oyedwa kwimikhakha ye-Informal Sector, Local Economic Development, Project Management, kanye ne-Micro Business Support, okuhlanganisa nokubonakala ngokuhlanganyela ekuthuthukiseni, ekubhalweni, kanye nokusebenziseni izinqubomgomo, izakhiwo, izu, iziqondiso, kanye nezinye izinsiza ezibhekene nokuphathwa. Ukwazi nge-National Development Plan, ukuqonda i-National Integrated Small Enterprise Development framework, ukwazi i-National Informal Business Upliftment Strategy, ukuqonda i-Informal and Micro Enterprise Development Programme, kanye nokwazi i-Public Finance Management Act. Umethuli kufanele abe namakhono namandla okulandelana: ukuphathwa kwezinsiza eziyikhuthazo, ukuthuthukiswa kwezinqubomgomo, ukuphathwa kwemininingwane, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuhlela futhi ahlele, ukucabanga ngokuhlola, amakhono okuxhumana, ukugxila kumthengi nokugxila ekusebenzeleni umthengi, ubudlelwano nezithakameli, ukulethwa kwenkonzo kanye nokwakha okusha nokuxhumanisa. Ezinye izidingo zihlanganisa ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (Izinhlelo ze-MS Office 365 Packages), ilayisensi evumelekile yokushayela ye-Code B/EB kanye nokuhlolwa kokuphepha.
zu.duties: Yenza ucwaningo kanye nohlolo olufaniswayo ukuze ukhombise izindlela ezinhle nokuthi ziyathuthuka kanjani izinto ezintsha, futhi uneze ekwakheni, ukubuyekezeni, ukuthuthukiseni, kanye nokuqamba izinhlelo, izibonelo, izinsiza, kanye nezinye izindlela ezisekela ukuthuthukiswa nokukhuliswa kwezinkampani ezingakalungulemi neze-micro. Sekela ukusetshenziswa kwe-National Informal Business Upliftment Strategy (NIBUS) kanye ne-Informal and Micro Enterprise Development Programme (IMEDP) ngokuhlola futhi ucubungule izicelo, wenza iziqinisekiso ezizile, unike izincomo zokuxhaswa, usekela abazuza, uxhumanise izithakameli, futhi uphathwe izikhungo ezimukiwe kanye nezimali ezikhishwayo ngokuvumelana nezidingo zohlelo kanye nolawulo lwezimali. Hlela ubudlelwano nezithakameli kanye nokuqalwa kwezinhlelo zokwakha amandla namakhono namasipala, izikhungo zahulumeni, izinhlangano, kanye nabalinganiswa bomkhakha, ngokunikeza usizo lwelwazi ngezinqubomgomo, izinqubo, kanye nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa ukuze kugqugquzelwe ukulandela izimiso, ukusebenza ndawonye, kanye nokuze kufinyeleleke izinhloso zohlelo. Bhekisisa futhi uhlole ukusebenza kohlelo ngokuhlola ngemva kokukhishwa kwemali, ukugcina ilale ukuqinisekiswa kokulandela izimiso, ukulandela imiphumela kanye nokubika, ngokunikeza usizo kwindlela yokuhlola ngaphakathi nangaphandle ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukubhekana kwezinto, ukuhambisana nezinqubomgomo, kanye nemiphumela yohlelo. Bukaze futhi ulondoloze izinhlelo ezinolwazi ngabazuza ngokuhlelo ngokuhlelo, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi kugcinwa imininingwane ngendlela eqinisekile ukusekela ukubika, ukwenza izinqumo ezinolwazi, kanye nokuqondisa izithakameli ngendlela ephumelelayo. Bhala uphathwe uhlukahlukene olwemiyalezo, imibiko, okwethulwayo, okubhaliwe ngokufihliwe, nezinto ezithunyelwa, futhi gcina ukuxhumana ngendlela ephumelelayo nezithakameli ezingaphakathi nangaphandle ngemikhuba yohlelo, inqubomgomo, nezinto ezisetshenziswa emsebenzini. EENQUIRIES: Imibuzo ngawo wonke amashemo abekwe kalulu kumele ithunyelwe kwi-ofisi yokubhalisa kule-Telephone No: (012) 394-5286/43097

xh.title: ASD: Ukusetyenziswa koluntu kwezimboni ezincinci kunye nentlDeveloping Development
xh.summary: Indima ekhusela ukusetyenziswa koluntu kwezimboni ezincinci equka uphando, uyilo lweenkqubo, kunye noncedo kumathuba okukhulisa iimboni ezincinci ezisetyenziswa koluntu kunye namashishini amancinci.
xh.requirements: Isidanga se-Bachelor (NQF 7) kwi-Public Administration / Business Management / Development Studies / Project Management / Economics / Development Finance okanye esinxilileyo / nxulumene njengoko kubonwa yi-SAQA. Amava amancinci eminyaka emithathu (3) kwinqanaba lomceli-mngeni ongundoqo kwindawo yoluntu olungasebenzeliyo ngokusesikweni, eNtshukumso-mPhakathi yokuQinisekisa uQoqosho oluLingana noluBonakalayo, oluLawulwa iProject Management, nasekuncedeni amashishini amancinci, kuquka amava abonwayo ekuqokeleleni, ekubhali, nasekuphothulweni kweenkqubo, iinkqubo zokusebenza, iindlela ezisemthethweni, izikhokelo, kunye nezixhobo ezinxulumene noku lawula ukusebenza. Ulwazi ngeSicwangciso seQoqosho lweSizwe, uQonde ngeNational Integrated Small Enterprise Development framework, ulwazi ngeNational Informal Business Upliftment Strategy, uQonde ngeInformal and Micro Enterprise Development Programme, nolwazi ngePublic Finance Management Act. Umzobi kufuneka anobuchule obu kulandelayo: ukugqiba iinkqubo zamakhadi okhuseleko, uphuhliso lweenkqubo zoluntu, ulawulo lwemveliso, ezingxaki, ulungiselelweni nokuqamba nokudidiyela, ukuziphatha ngokwahlulelana, ukunxibelelwana, ukubhekisa kumthengi nokuqwalasela iindaba zabathengi, uqhagamshelwano namabalengwe, ulwazi lokwala inkonzo yokuQinisekisa, uluntu oluphuhlisa namabalengwe abanomdla. Iimfuno ezongezelelweyo zibandakanya ukwazi ukusebenza ngesixhobo esikwi-computer (MS Office 365 Packages), ilayisense yokushayela i-Code B/EB egunyazisiweyo kunye nesatifikethi esihambisana nesigaba sikawonke-wonke sokhuseleko lwezangaphakathi.
xh.duties: Yenza uphando nokuqwalasela ngokuthe ngqo ukuze uchaze ulwazi olusemthethweni kakhulu neendaba ezisanda kuqhubeka, kwaye uncedo ekuyilweni, ekuphuhlisweni, ekuqwalaseleni, ekuqweni, kwakunye nokubonisa iinkqubo, iindlela, izixhobo, nolungelelwaniso olunceda ekusetyenzisweni koluntu nakukhuliseni amashishini amancinci. Nceda ekuqwalaseleni isicwangciso esilawulwa ikomiti ethile yokuqwalasela iNIBUS nakwisakhono sokulawula izixhobo ze-IMEDP ngokuhlola nokugqiba izicelo, ngokwenza isigqibo sokuvavanya okukhulu, ngokunikela ngenkca mayiselti, ngokuxhasa abasoloko belifuna ngokubakho kwiinkqubo zoluntu, ngokudibanisa abo balawulwa nabantu abadibana nayo iNkqubo, nakulawulweni kwemigqa ethile yamacebo okuLawula iNgxowa mali ngokuthile nakuhambelana nemeko yokwenza urhwebo lwakho ekuqwalaseleni nokuLawulwa kwengeniso ngokuchithwa ubomi bakho kwiNgxowa mali. Lungelelanisa imibuzo yomanyano lwabahlali kumanyano lwalamanyuzini nakuhlelwa ngokobuchule oqwalaselwa kuwo ngamahub, ngokunjalo lowo mceli-mngeni osebenzayo kubakho isaziso ngenkca-mayiselti ukunceda izikwama uncedo-mthethweni, iinkqubo zokuphumeza iNkqubo yakho, nakwiindaba ezilawulwa yilawula inqanaba elincedayo. Linganisa nokuqwalasela ngokukhawuleza iziphumo zokuLawulwa kwamacebo abo bomanyano lwezilumkiso-mthetho nangaphandle kokubakho ukusetyenziswa koluntu kwazo zonke iinkqubo ngokulingana, ukuba nolwazi ngemigaqo yaso, ngokusebenzisa ulungelelwaniso lwemigaqo-somthetho emva kokusetyenziswa koluntu kunye nomthetho, kungenjalo, iindlela zokwenza, iziphuma kwindawo ethile, iprograms yonke iinkqubo, kunye nokubakhona kwezinye iindawo ezilungelelanisa, kuqwalaselwa kwezo mpawu ezibakho yilawula ngokusemthethweni iNkqubo. Yakha nokuLawula ulwazi ngoluntu kwindawo ecaleni kweenkqubo zalo, ngokuqinisekisa ukuba ulwazi ngokulawula urhwebo kwindawo abayibambekileyo ukuze luncede ekuxhaseni izixhobo zokuqala urhwebo, nakwemiqobo yokwenza isigqibo esigqibiyo, nakwindawo ethile ekulawulweni kwabantu abadibana nayo ngokwenza urhwebo. Bhala ulawulo lweenkcazelo ezingathethwa ngamntu ongamaziyo lula, iingxelo zemigaqo yamacebo okubala kuphela izixhobo zokusebenza ezikuyo inkqubo yonke, kuphuhle lisicwangciso ibaluleke ngokukhawuleza kuphuhle lisicwangciso ibaluleke ngokukhawuleza ngokubakho kwentswela-nkululeko ekuphumezeni imithetho yophuhliso iNkqubo yakho. EENQUIRIES : Imibuzo ngezithuba ezibhalisiweyo zonke kufuneka ithunyelwe kwiofisi yokubhalisa kwinani lefowuni: (012) 394-5286/43097

jobs.title: Deputy Director-general: Budget Office
jobs.summary: Lead the National Treasury Budget Office in Pretoria, managing the national budget process and advising on fiscal policy.
jobs.requirements: A Grade 12 is required coupled with a minimum post graduate qualification at NQF level 8 in Finance or Economics. A Master’s degree is an added advantage, A minimum of 8 years’ experience is required at a senior managerial level obtained in public finance, economics, budgeting or fiscal management, Knowledge and experience of donor funding principles and related. A practical demonstration of skills and knowledge will be required, Knowledge of strategic management, policy analysis and development, Knowledge and experience of publications of budget documents and the editing process, Knowledge of the PFMA, Treasury Regulations and the SOC’s policy framework, Ability to gather and analyse information for policy development and application of policies, Successful completion of the Nyukela Public Service Senior Management Leadership Programme as endorsed by the National School of Government available as an online course on https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/, prior to finalisation of an appointment.
jobs.duties: Budget Process and Budget Reform Programme: Manage the national budget process. Coordinate the Ministers’ Committee on the Budget process. Provide strategic advice on a range of issues relating to the budget, fiscal policy, infrastructure delivery and budget reform. Public Finance Statistics: Produce the Medium-Term Budget Policy Statement and Budget review. Produce the Estimates of National Expenditure and appropriate legislation. Coordinate the process of advising the Minister on the Budget Speech, Present public finance statistics according to function and economic classification. Fiscal and Budget Framework: Align the division of revenue between national, provincial and local government with the budget framework and medium-term expenditure priorities. Ensure a budget framework consistent with government’s fiscal policy guidelines and public expenditure priorities. Infrastructure Regulation and Assessment: Oversee Public Private Partnership (PPP) Infrastructure procurement in compliance with PFMA and MFMA regulations and guidelines. Oversee compliance with the capital projects approval and evaluation framework. Official Development Assistance (ODA): Align ODA funding decisions with the budget process. Support departments and donors to facilitate international development cooperation agreements. Public Sector Remuneration Analysis and Forecasting: Improve stakeholder understanding of the implications of changes in remuneration policy and wage settlements on public sector wage bill. Communicate policy analysis and forecasting results. Generate accurate and timeous insight into changes in government compensation and its trends.
jobs.enquiries: enquiries only (No applications): Recruitment.Enquries@treasury.gov.za OTHER POSTS
jobs.applications: To apply visit: https://erecruitment.treasury.gov.za/eRecruitment
jobs.notes: Effective from 7 April 2021, the National Treasury now utilises an e-Recruitment System which means all applicants must login/register to apply for positions, we only accept hand delivered/posted applications should an applicant prove that he/she tried to apply via e-Recruitment with no success and the National Treasury ICT unit was unable to assist. The applicant’s profile on the e- Recruitment is equivalent to the newly approved Z83, and it is the responsibility of applicants to ensure their profiles are fully completed or their applications will not be considered, as per the DPSA Practice Note. Certain documentation will still be required to be uploaded on the system such as copies of all qualifications including National Senior Certificate/Matric certificate, ID, etc., however these documents need not be certified at point of application, however certification will be required prior to attending the interview. Please note: All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. It should be noted that the National Treasury does not support the use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in any of its recruitment and selection processes and will disqualify an application if it picks up the use of AI when completing assessments without acknowledging the source of information. Successful completion of the Nyukela Public Service SMS Pre-entry Programme as endorsed by the National School of Government,            available       as      an       online       course      on https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/, prior to finalisation of appointment, is a requirement for all SMS positions. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. All qualifications, criminal and SA citizenship checks will be conducted on all short-listed candidates and, where applicable, additional checks will be conducted in line with the new DPSA Directive effective 01 April 2024. Please note that by responding to our advertisement/s, you consent to the collection, processing, and storing of your Personal Information for internal HR processes in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA), Act No. 4 of 2013. In the event that your application is unsuccessful, the Department will retain your personal information only for audit purposes as required by policies, only for a specific period, of which the submitted documents will then be destroyed as legislated in the National Archives Act. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have all their foreign qualifications (this includes O and A level certificates) evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA), at your own expense. Upon appointment, successful candidates will be required to disclose particulars of all registrable financial interests and to sign a Performance Agreement within 3 months from date of appointment and for candidates whose appointment exceeds 12 calendar months will be appointed on probation for the period of twelve (12) calendar months excluding leave taken as prescribed by Public Service Regulation 68. The status of your application will be visible on the e-Recruitment system. However, if you have not received feedback from the National Treasury within 3 months of the closing date, please regard your application as unsuccessful. Note: The National Treasury reserves the right not to fill the below-mentioned posts, withdraw or to put on hold a position and/or to re-advertise a post. All queries must be submitted via email addressed to the Human Resources Recruitment Support Team on Recruitment.Enquiries@treasury.gov.za. Kindly note that all National Treasury adverts published/LIVE on the eRecruitment System have a closing date listed and closing time of 12h00 (Midday) on that closing date. The system is designed to automatically remove the advert from public view at exactly 12h00 (MIDDAY) of the said closing date for that post. There are no other means to submit applications post the closing date and time, if you have missed or delayed in submitting on time. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Adjunk Direkteur-generaal: Begrotingskantoor
af.summary: Lei die Nasionale Tesourie Begrotingskantoor in Pretoria, bestuur die nasionale begrotingsproses en gee advies oor fiskale beleid.
af.requirements: A Graad 12 word vereis tesame met 'n minimum nagraadse kwalifikasie op NQF vlak 8 in Finansies of Ekonomie. 'n Meestersgraad is 'n bykomende voordeel, A minimum van 8 jaar se ervaring word vereis op 'n senior bestuursvlak verkry in openbare finansies, ekonomie, begroting of fiskale bestuur, Kennis en ervaring van skenkerbefondsingsbeginsels en verwante aspekte. 'n Praktiese demonstrasie van vaardighede en kennis sal vereis word, Kennis van strategiese bestuur, beleidsontleding en -ontwikkeling, Kennis en ervaring van publikasies van begrotingsdokumente en die redigeringsproses, Kennis van die PFMA, Tesourie-regulasies en die SOC se beleidsraamwerk, Vermoë om inligting in te samel en te ontleed vir beleidsontwikkeling en toepassing van beleid, Suksesvolle voltooiing van die Nyukela Public Service Senior Management Leadership Programme soos onderskryf deur die National School of Government beskikbaar as 'n aanlyn kursus op https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/, voor afhandeling van 'n aanstelling.
af.duties: Begrotingsproses en Begrotingshervormingsprogram: Bestuur die nasionale begrotingsproses. Koördineer die Ministers se Komitee oor die begrotingsproses. Verskaf strategiese advies oor 'n reeks sake rakende die begroting, fiskale beleid, infrastruktuurlewering en begrotingshervorming. Openbare Finansiestatistiek: Lewer die Medium-Term Budget Policy Statement en begrotingsondersoek. Lewer die Estimates of National Expenditure en toepaslike wetgewing. Koördineer die proses om die Minister oor die Begrotingsrede te adviseer, Verdeel openbare finansiestatistiek volgens funksie en ekonomiese klassifikasie. Fiskale en Begrotingsraamwerk: Belyn die verdeling van inkomste tussen nasionale, provinsiale en plaaslike regering met die begrotingsraamwerk en mediumtermyn bestedingsprioriteite. Verseker 'n begrotingsraamwerk wat in ooreenstemming is met die regering se fiskale beleidsriglyne en openbare bestedingsprioriteite. Infrastruktuurregulering en -assessering: Hou toesig oor Public Private Partnership (PPP) infrastruktuurverkryging in ooreenstemming met PFMA- en MFMA-regulasies en -riglyne. Hou toesig oor nakoming van die goedkeurings- en evalueringsraamwerk vir kapitaalprojekte. Official Development Assistance (ODA): Belyn ODA-befondsingsbesluite met die begrotingsproses. Ondersteun departemente en skenkers om internasionale ontwikkelingsamewerkoorooreenkomste te fasiliteer. Openbare Sektor Remunerering Ontleding en Vooruitskatting: Verbeter belanghebbendes se begrip van die implikasies van veranderinge in remunereringsbeleid en lonie-oeenkomste op die openbare sektor se loonrekening. Kommunikeer beleidsontleding en vooruitskattingsresultate. Genereer akkurate en tydige insig in veranderinge in regeringsvergoeding en die neigings daarvan.

zu.title: USomabhala oyinhloko: Ihhovisi leBhajethi
zu.summary: Hola izinhlobo ze-CSS ne-GCS kumasiko awo onke amakhulu anezithakazelo eziphakathi kwe-CSS ne-GCS kwezinhlelo ze-CSS ne-GCS ezinhle kakhulu kwe-CSS ne-GCS ezinhle ngokusemthethweni.
zu.requirements: Kudingeka inqwaba yeminyaka yobudala be-10 kokufunda okungenamdenderede (i-Grade 10) okuhambisana nodunankulu wethu kwi-MSc noma i-PhD kwezempilo nomphakathi. Ukuqeqeshwa okwengeziwe kuzuba lusizo. Kudingeka ukuthi umuntu afunde iziqu ze-Honours noma ze-PhD noma ngabe e-Certificates eziyisikhombisa kweziyisikhala esingafundwa emikhakheni ehlukene. Kudingeka ufunde inqubo yokutholakala kwenhlangano ethile.
zu.duties: Inqubo yebhajethi nenqubo yokulungisa ibhajethi: Phatha inqubo yebhajethi kazwelonke. Lunganisa inqubo yagoKomiti labaNguMphathiswa ngeBhajethi. Nikeza inceku ngamacebo ohlelo lwentela kwezindaba ezihlobene nebhajethi, umthethosisekelo wezimali, ukuhlinzwa kolwakhiwo lolwandle kanye nokulungiswa kwebhajethi. Izigaba zezibalo ezimali zomphakathi: Khiqiza isitatimende senqubo yeNkomba yeBhajethi Esesikhathini Esiphakathi kanye nocwaningo lwebhajethi. Khiqiza izilinganiso zokuchithwa kwemali kazwelonke kanye nomthetho ohambisanayo. Lunganisa inqubo yokunikeza inceku nguMphathiswa ngokukhulunywa kwebhajethi. Shicilela izibalo zezimali zomphakathi ngokwemisebenzi kanye nokuhlelwa kwezomnotho. Umthethosisekelo wezimali kanye nebhajethi: Lunganisa ukwehlukaniswa kwemali phakathi kuhulumeni kazwelonke, kumaphovinsi kanye nohulumeni wendawo nokuqondiswa kwesakhiwo sebhajethi kanye nezinto eziyinhloko zokuchithwa kwemali esesikhathini esiphakathi. Qinisekisa isakhiwo sebhajethi esihambisana nemihlahlandlela yomthethosisekelo wezimali kahulumeni kanye nezinto eziyinhloko zokuchithwa kwemali komphakathi. Ukubuyekeza nokuhlolwa kolawulo lolwakhiwo: Qaphula ithenga lolwakhiwo lwabalinganiseli Abalingana Bangekhaya nangasese (PPP) ngokuhambisana nemithetho nemiqathango yePFMA kanye neMFMA. Qaphula ukuziphatha ngokuhambisana nesakhiwo sokuvunyelwa nokuhlola amaphrojekthi amakhulu. Usizo olusemthethweni oluvela kothisela (ODA): Lunganisa izinqumo zemali ye-ODA ngenqubo yebhajethi. Sekelela eminyango kubatholi bezimali ukuze kube lula izivumelwano zokusebenzisana komphakathi nakwamanye amazwe. Ukuhlukaniswa kwezimali zomphakathi nokubikezela: Khuphula ukuqonda kwabahlinzeki ngemiphumela yoshintsho kumthethosisekelo wokukhokhelwa kanye nokuqotshwa kwamaholo ohlelweni lokukhokhelwa komphakathi. Yezisa imiphumela yokuhlaziya umthethosisekelo kanye nokubikezela. Toza ulwazi olunembile nangesikhathi ngoshintsho ekukhokhelweni kahulumeni kanye nemigqa yayo.

xh.title: Under-Secretary General: Isebe leBhajethi
xh.summary: Qhatha kwiSibe leBhajethi leNazhonal Trezhari ePretoria, lulawule inkqubo yebhajethi yezwe lonke uze unike izindaba mayela nenqgbagqagqela yemali-mali.
xh.requirements: Kufuneka ubekho nesiNqanaba se-12 kunye nequalifications ephezulu de-equification level 8 kw Economics okanye iNqanaba leFinance. Master's degree ngumphumo othuthuzelayo, kufuneka ulukhise lweminyaka engama-8 okuqonda ekondweni ongumlawuli ophakamileyo elotholwe kuqonda phakathi kwemali-mali yezizwe, amakhulu amakhulu eeNomics, okanye iMali-mali. Ilwazi nemfundo yemithetho yokulawula namaphulo aphathelene nayo, kwiSixeko sezimali-mali yezizwe nokwemveliso yamaphulo. Ilwazi leNqanaba lenkqubo yeNyukela iSizwe kolunye lolawulo oluqinisekiswayo nguNdlu yoQeqesho leLuntu oluqinisekiswayo efumaneka njengesikolo sikawonke-wonke kwi-URL: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/, ngaphambi kokugqibela kwesiSithuba.
xh.duties: Inkqubo yeBhajethi neNkqubo yeNtengiso yamaphulo: Yiba negunya lokulawula iinkqubo zebhajethi yezizwe. Qhagamshela iinkqubo zeKomiti yaMaPhonde-phonde mayela neBhajethi. Nika ngamacebo amaninzi ixabiso elingundoqo kwinkqubo ebhekisa kumaphulo, inkqubo yamali-mali amakhulu amakhulu, iinkqubo zeemveliso namaphulo. Imali-mali yezizwe ezikwinkqubo: Yenza iNqanaba leNkqubo yeBhajethi eNqanaba eliphakathi nezixeko ezinkuni nezixeko. Yiza ngezilinganiselo ezifanelekileyo ziwe ezaziswa kwizixeko ezinkulu. Lawula iinkqubo zokunika amaphulo iNgqungquthela nokuqamba iNkqubo yeBhajethi. Yiza ngezibalo kwimali-mali yezizwe ukuya ngokwemisebenzi nangokwahlukana kweenkqubo. Inkqubo yeMali-mali neNqanaba leBhajethi: Qhagamshela ngokwahlukana kwemali-mali ngokwesizwe, ngokwephondo nakomasipala phakathi kwemisebenzi yokuthengisa iinkqubo ezibalulekileyo kubakho ungcangciselo lwezigqibo. Qinisekisa isiseko seBhajethi esithi sime ngokwemigaqo yamali-mali karhulumthe namaphulo obulawulo beenkqubo ezinkhulu. Ukuqwalasela nokwakha iNkqubo: Beka ixhoba ukuqhuba imisebenzi yaBantu abayimpahla noma amakhosi alawulwa ngumthetho wePFMA nakuMFMA. Qinisekisa ulawulo lweenkqubo ezinqwenela ukuyilwa kweendlela ezintsha zokwakha iindlu namaphulo alawula iinkqubo. Ukuncedisa ngokuphathiswe ngokuXhaphaka kweMali-mali: Qhagamshela iinkqubo zokunikwa imali-mali ngeenkqubo zebhajethi. Nceda iindawo zolawulo kwakunye namaBantu ahambisa imali-mali ukwenza iingqinqana zamazwe ngamanye ukubumba iinkqubo ezintsha. Ukuqamba nokuqhathanisa iMali-mali yokuLawula iNgqiqo: Nceda abantu abanegunya lokulawula ukuba bayiqonde impembelelo yamaphulo abayitshintshayo. Yiza ngezixeko ngokwahlula amaphulo. Yiza nezisombululo ngokwexesha nangokuchanekileyo ezibakho ekutshintshweni kwemali-mali yeluntu.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Editing and Research
jobs.summary: Deputy Director: Editing and Research at National Treasury in Pretoria, managing the editing of key budget publications for R1,101,468 per annum.
jobs.requirements: A Grade 12 is required, coupled with a minimum Honours Degree (equivalent to NQF level 8) in Economics, Finance or Journalism. A minimum 5 years’ experience in a business journalism, economic research, professional editing or financial communications environment. In-depth knowledge of macroeconomic and fiscal issues and financial markets. Detailed knowledge of the South African public finance landscape, the budget process and government policy processes. Knowledge of digital media platforms.
jobs.duties: Manage editing of the Budget Review and Medium-Term Budget Policy Statement: Assist the Editor in Chief and external service providers to review chapters and annexures for clarity, quality, flow, style, consistency and tone. Work with chapter and annexure authors to fact-check and verify the accuracy of content and ensure alignment with National Treasury editorial guidelines. Work with the Budget Office and editors to manage the editing, copy editing and sign-off processes for the Budget Review and Medium Term Budget Policy Statement and ensure deadlines are met, Co-ordinate writer training for chapter authors and budget analysts in order to improve the quality of the budget documents and expand the National Treasury’s pool of authors. Monitor the use of artificial intelligence in the drafting of National Treasury documents and other content to prevent the inappropriate use of AI. Assist with strategic messaging and reputation management for the Director General: Research, draft, review presentations, speaking notes and other content. Coordinate the implementation of regular monitoring and analysis of social media and other media coverage, to identify opportunities for public engagement. zu.title: Isikhulu Esikhulu Sokuhambisa: Ukuhlela nokucwaninga
zu.summary: Isikhulu Esikhulu Sokuhambisa: Ukuhlela nokucwaninga e-National Treasury e-Pretoria, ephatha ukuhlela kwemibhalo eyinhloko yesabelo somali nge-R1,101,468 ngonyaka.
zu.requirements: Kudingeka ibe ne-Grade 12, kanye nokuqeqeshwa okuncane kwe-Honours Degree (elingana ne-NQF level 8) kwe-Economics, Finance noma i-Journalism. Kubalulekile ukuba neminyaka engu-5 yamava emhlabathini wokubhala ngemabhizinisi, ukuhcwaninga ngamnotho, ukuhlela ngobungcweti noma okuxhumana kwezezimali. Kudingeka ukuqonda kabanzi ngemibuzo yamnotho omkhulu nezomali kanye namakethe ezezimali. Kudingeka ulwazi oluyinkimbinkimbi ngokubukeka kwezomfundo yomphakathi e-South Africa, inqubo yesabelo kanye nezinqubo zomgomo kahulumeni. Kudingeka ulwazi ngamapulatifomu wemidiya yasendininii.
zu.duties: Phatha ukuhlela kwe-Budget Review kanye ne-Medium-Term Budget Policy Statement. Siza u-Editor in Chief kanye nabahlinzeki bangaphandle ukubuyekezwa kwezahluko nezokwengezelwe ukugqamisa ukuqonda, izinga, ukuhamba, isitayela, ukuhambisana netoni. Sebenzisanisa nababhali bezahluko nezokwengezelwe ukuqinisekisa ukubhekisisa amaqiniso bese uqinisekisa ukunemba kokuqukethwe kanye nokuqinisekisa ukuhambisana nemiqulu yohlelo lokuhlela e-National Treasury. Sebenzisanisana ne-Budget Office nabahleli ukuphatha ukuhlela, ukuhlela okufanayo kanye nezinqubo zokuqinisekisa ukuthi kwe-Budget Review kanye ne-Medium Term Budget Policy Statement bese uqinisekisa ukuthi izikhathi zokuphela ziyahlangatshezwa. Hlanganisa ukuqeqesha ababhali kubabhali bezahluko kanye nabahlaziya isabelo ngenhloso yokuthuthukisa izinga lemibhalo yesabelo kanye nokwandisa inqwaba yababhali e-National Treasury. Qaphelwa ukusetshenziswa kobuhlakani bokwenziwa ekubhaleni kwemibhalo ye-National Treasury kanye nezinye okuqukethwe ukuvimba ukusetshenziswa okungalungile kwe-AI. Siza nokwethulwa komyalezo oyisimanga kanye nokuphathwa kwebungaziwemuntu kumkhulu we-Director General: Ukucwaninga, bhalu, buke izinkombiso, izikhombe zokukhuluma kanye nalokunye okuqukethwe. Hlanganisa ukusetshenziswa kokubukeka njalo kanye nokuqaphela indikimba yasendininii kanye nezinye indaba zasendininii, ukuze kutholakale amathuba okuxhumana nomphakathi. Qaphela indaba yasendininii kanye nobukeka lwendikimba yasendininii ukusiza ukuphathwa kwebungaziwemuntu kwe-Office of the Director General kanye nokweseka i-National Treasury ukuze ihlale ngaphambi kwezingozi eziphakamayo ngokubungaziweemvelo kanye noshintsho lwemibono. Hlanganisa, cwaninga udale okuqukethwe ekhasini le-Director General le ndikimba yasendininii kanye nakubanye abasebenzi abaphakeme.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Fiscal Outreach
jobs.summary: Coordinate fiscal outreach campaigns and public media engagements for National Treasury in Pretoria, requiring an Honours degree and five years' relevant experience.
jobs.requirements: A Grade 12 is required, coupled with a minimum Honours Degree (equivalent to NQF level 8) in Economics, Sciences or Finance or Journalism or Development Studies. A minimum 5 years’ experience in financial communications, business journalism, economic research or financial education. In-depth knowledge of policy development and implementation. Experience of project management or public outreach programmes. Detailed knowledge of the South African public finance landscape, the budget process and government policy processes.
jobs.duties: Co-ordinate fiscal outreach campaign: Work with the Budget Office, project partners and the communications division to co-ordinate the rollout of the Fiscal Outreach campaign to the targeted stakeholder groups. Co-ordinate public and targeted media engagements and events to support the campaign strategy, working with the Budget Office, Communications and external service providers. Coordinate media training for senior National Treasury officials to support the campaign strategy. Coordinate the development and strategic distribution of content for the campaign. Maintain sound relationships with key external and internal stakeholders and build appropriate project partnerships to support the campaign. Track the progress of the campaign and compile quarterly reports. Oversee external service providers to ensure project targets are met. Assist the Editor in Chief to manage the editing of the Budget Review and Medium-Term Budget Policy Statement to with the Fiscal Outreach campaign. Edit and socialise the Budget Review and Medium-Term Budget Policy Statement: Assist the Editor in Chief to manage the editing of the Budget Review and Medium-Term Budget Policy Statement for clarity, consistency, tone and flow. Work with Budget Office to coordinate the Budget calendar and content and incorporate the Fiscal Outreach campaign into the process. Monitor the impact and effectiveness of National Treasury’s efforts to socialise the Budget and Medium Term Budget Policy Statement and to engage with stakeholders to improve fiscal literacy. Monitor the effectiveness of fiscal outreach consultation and engagement initiatives and identify potential risks and opportunities for the fiscal outreach campaign. Manage surveys to assess budget and fiscal literacy among the targeted stakeholder groups. Social Media monitoring and engagement: Implement regular monitoring and analysis of social media to identify gaps in fiscal literacy and opportunities to address these. Evaluate existing National Treasury social media platforms to identify opportunities to improve or expand to support the Fiscal Outreach campaign. Work with Communications and Budget Office and service providers to refine Budget related content for social media.

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Fiskale Inbeping
af.summary: Koördineer fiskale inbepingveldtogte en openbare mediabelangstelling vir National Treasury in Pretoria, wat 'n Honneursgraad en vyf jaar se relevante ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: A Grade 12 word vereis, tesame met 'n minimum Honneursgraad (ekwivalent aan NQF level 8) in Ekonomie, Wetenskappe of Finansies of Joernalistiek of Ontwikkelingstudies. 'n Minimum 5 jaar se ervaring in finansiële kommunikasie, besigheidsjoernalistiek, ekonomiese navorsing of finansiële opvoeding. Diepgaande kennis van beleidsontwikkeling en -implementering. Ervaring van projekbestuur of openbare inbepingprogramme. Gedetailleerde kennis van die Suid-Afrikaanse openbare finansielandskap, die begrotingsproses en regeringsbeleidprosesse.
af.duties: Koördineer fiskale inbepingveldtog: Werk saam met die Budget Office, projekvennote en die kommunikasieafdeling om die uitrol van die Fiscal Outreach-veldtog na die teikenbelanghebbende groepe te koördineer. Koördineer openbare en geteikende mediabelangstellings en -geleenthede om die veldtogstrategie te ondersteun, in samewerking met die Budget Office, Communications en eksterne diensverskaffers. Koördineer mediabedryf vir senior National Treasury-amptenare om die veldtogstrategie te ondersteun. Koördineer die ontwikkeling en strategiese verspreiding van inhoud vir die veldtog. Onderhou goeie verhoudings met sleutel eksterne en interne belanghebbendes en bou toepaslike projekvennootskappe om die veldtog te ondersteun. Hou die vordering van die veldtog dop en stel kwartaallikse verslae op. Hou toesig oor eksterne diensverskaffers om te verseker dat projekteikens bereik word. help die Editor in Chief om die redigering van die Budget Review en Medium-Term Budget Policy Statement met die Fiscal Outreach-veldtog te bestuur. Redigeer en sosialiseer die Budget Review en Medium-Term Budget Policy Statement: help die Editor in Chief om die redigering van die Budget Review en Medium-Term Budget Policy Statement vir duidelikheid, konsekwentheid, toon en vloei te bestuur. Werk saam met Budget Office om die Budget-kalender en -inhoud te koördineer en die Fiscal Outreach-veldtog in die proses te inkorporeer. Monitor die impak en doeltreffendheid van National Treasury se pogings om die Budget en Medium Term Budget Policy Statement te sosialiseer en om met belanghebbendes te skakel om fiskale geletterdheid te verbeter. Monitor die doeltreffendheid van fiskale inbepingkonsultasie- en betrokkenheidsinisiatiewe en identifiseer potensiële risiko's en geleenthede vir die fiskale inbepingveldtog. Bestuur opnames om begrotings- en fiskale geletterdheid onder die teikenbelanghebbende groepe te assesseer. Sosiale media-monitering en -betrokkenheid: Implementeer gereelde monitering en analise van sosiale media om gapings in fiskale geletterdheid en geleenthede om dit aan te spreek, te identifiseer. Evalueer bestaande National Treasury-sosiale media-platforms om geleenthede te identifiseer om te verbeter of uit te brei ter ondersteuning van die Fiscal Outreach-veldtog. Werk saam met Communications en Budget Office en diensverskaffers om Budget-verwante inhoud vir sosiale media te verfyn.

zu.title: Umsizi Wezinqindi: Ukufinyelela Kwezomnotho
zu.summary: Hlela imikhankaso yokufinyelela kwezomnotho nokuvinjelwa kwabezindaba kumphakathi i-National Treasury ePretoria, kudinga iziqu ze-Honours neminyaka emi-5 yokuhlanganyela.
zu.requirements: Itholakala isidingo se-Grade 12, edwetshwe ngesiqu se-Honours esingaphezulu (esalingana nalinga le-NQF 8) kwi-Economics, Sciences, Finance, Journalism noma i-Development Studies. Kudingwa ubhontide weminyaka emi-5 wokuhlanganyela ekuxhumaneni kwezomnotho, ebufundazini bezohwebo, ekuphenyeni izomnotho noma emfundweni yezomnotho. Ukwazi ngokujulile ngokuthuthukiswa nokusetshenziswa kwezinqubomgomo. Ukuhlanganyela ekuphathweni amaphrojekthi noma imikhankaso yokufinyelela kumphakathi. Ukwazi ngokuningi indawo yezomnotho zikahulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika, inqubo yesabelo kanye nezinqubomgomo zahulumeni.
zu.duties: Hlela imikhankaso yokufinyelela kwezomnotho: Sebenzisana ne-Budget Office, abahlanganyeli bephrojekthi nesigaba sezoxhumo ukuhlela ukusetshenziswa kwenkhankaso Yokufinyelela Kwezomnotho kumaqembu abathintekayo. Hlela ukuvunyelwa kumphakathi nakubezindaba abakhethwayo nemikhosi yokuqinisekisa isu lenkhankaso, usebenzisana ne-Budget Office, i-Communications kanye nabahlinzeki besezinkundla zangaphandle. Hlela ukuqeqeshwa kwezomsoceme abaphezulu be-National Treasury ukuze kuqinisekiswe isu lenkhankaso. Hlela ukuthuthukiswa kokugqanyiswa kokuqinisekiswa isu lenkhankaso kanye nokusatshaliswa ngokobuchule kokuqinisekiswa isu lenkhankaso. Gcina ubuhlobo obuhle nabathintekayo abakhulu bangaphandle nangaphakathi ukwakha ubuhlobo obuhle bephrojekthi ukuze kuqedwe isu lenkhankaso. Landela inqubo yenkhankaso ukwakha imibiko yamakhula. Qaphelisa abahlinzeki bangaphandle ukuze kuqedwe amaphrojekthi. Siza i-Editor in Chief ukuphatha ukulungiswa kwe-Budget Review ne-Medium-Term Budget Policy Statement ukuze kuqedwe isu lenkhankaso yokufinyelela kwezomnotho. Lungisa futhi wenze umphakathi ukwazi nge-Budget Review ne-Medium-Term Budget Policy Statement: Siza i-Editor in Chief ukuphatha ukulungiswa kwe-Budget Review ne-Medium-Term Budget Policy Statement ukuze kube nokucacile, ngokuvumelana, nengxenye yokuhamba. Sebenzisana ne-Budget Office ukuhlela ikhalenda namaphrojekthi yokugqamisa ukuba ngesabelo kanye nakunokuthi ukufakwa esikhundleni kwezinsizakalo ngokwenza imisebenzi. Qapha ukusebenza kokuqinisekiswa ngemizamo ka-Local Government Finance Committee kwenza umphakathi ukwazi nge-Budget and Medium Term Budget Policy Statement futhi ukhulume nabathintekayo ukuthuthukisa ukwazi ngemithetho yezimali. Hlela imikhankaso yokuhlangenwe nakho nokuhlangana nabantu ukuyiqinisekisa futhi uhumuswe ukuyifaka ubungozi kanye namathuba emikhankasweni yokufinyelela kwezomnotho. Phatha imibuzo yokuhlola ukwazi okumayelana nesabelo kanye nalo mthetho emaqenjini abathintekayo. Ukulawula nokuxhumana kwezokuxhumo ezinkundla zomsakazo ezezimali: Qeqesha abantu ngokuqhuba imisebenzi ezingeni elikhulu ngokuhlola nokuhlaziya imiyalo yesohwebo ukuthola izinto ezingezona ngokugqamisa kwemfundo yokugqamisa isimo se-Izinga Lokucabanga Ngemali nezenzo ezisetshenziswayo ukukhombisa izinga eliphezulu kokuqinisekiswa kwesabelo. Sebenzisana ne-Communications ne-Budget Office kanye nabahlinzeki ukulungisa izinto ezihambisana ne-Budget ngokwezokuxhumo ezingeni eliphezulu lesikhashana.

xh.title: Iseyi-Mongameli: Unyuso lwezenzo zezezimali
xh.summary: Lungelelanisa iinkqubo zokunyusa izabelo zekampana zezimali kunye nokuthatha inxaxheba kwimedia yomnye kwi-National Treasury ePretoria, kufuneka kubekho isidanga se-Honours kunye neminye emihlanu yamava ahambelanayo.
xh.requirements: Kufuneka ibekho i-Grade 12, ekwenziweyo kunye nesidanga se-Honours esingentla (esilingana ne-NQF level 8) kwi-Economics, Sciences okanye Finance okanye Journalism okanye Development Studies. Kubekho iminye elishumi (5) yamava ekunxibelelanweni ngezimali, ebhlogeni ngebhizinisi, kuphandolwemfundo lwezomnozo okanye ekrwakweni kweemfuno zezimali. Ulwazi oluthe ngceba ngokuphuhliswa nokusebenza kweenkqubo zemigango. Amava ekulawuleni iiprojekthi okanye iinkqubo zokunyusa isabelo sabantu. Ulwazi oluchazwe ngokweenkcukacha ngendlela yokusebenza kweemali zorhulumente eNingizimu Afrika, inkqubo yesabelo nemigaqo yurhulumente.
xh.duties: Lungelelanisa iinkqubo zokunyusa isabelo sabantu ngemali: Sebenzisana ne-Budget Office, ababini beprojekthi kunye nesigaba senxibelelwano ukulungelelanisa ukuqhubwa kwenkqubo yokunyusa isabelo sabantu ngemali kumagqabi ekujoliswe kubo. Lungelelanisa ukuthatha inxaxheba ngasentlakunye nakwimedia ekujoliswe kuyo, neziganeko ukuze sixele inkqubo yekampana, selebesenzaisana ne-Budget Office, e-Nxibelelwano nakubahanjiswa besebenzangaphandle. Lawula isikolo-media kuwoonxibelelwano ophakamileyo be-National Treasury ukuxelela inkqubo yekampana. Lungelelanisa ukuphuhliswa nokuhliswa ngokwezicwangciso kolwazi ovela kwikampana. Zigcine iindibaniselwano ezilungileyo nababini abangaphandle nangaphakathi ababalulekileyo yaye usakhe ubudlelwane obufanelekileyo beprojekthi ukuxelela ikampana. Landela inkqubo yekampana yaye uqoke iindawo zexesha zeminye emininzi. Qondisa abahanjiswa besebenza ngaphandle ukuqinisekisa ukuba izigqibo zeprojekthi zifezekiswa. Siza uMlawuli weNkqubo yokulungisa-gqibo yokulawula ukulungiswa kwe-Budget Review naye-Medium-Term Budget Policy Statement ngenkqubo yokunyusa isabelo sabantu ngemali. Leriliseze iqela lakho-gqibo yokulungisa i-Budget Review naye-Medium-Term Budget Policy Statement: Siza uMlawuli-gqiba ukulawula ulungiso Iwe-Budget Review naye-Medium-Term Budget Policy Statement ngolwazi, ngokumngqina wolwazi, nengxoxo ezimbalwa. Sebenzisana ne-Budget Office ukulungelelanisa ikhalenda yentlawulo-mali nolwazi ukuze ufakenkqubo yokunyisa isabelo sabantu kinkqubo. Qwalasela impembelelo nenzaleko yezigubudulo zika-National Treasury ngokuyidibanisa i-Budget naye-Medium Term Budget Policy Statement kwaye uthathe inxaxheba kwizigqibo ukuplota nzalo yokugqithisa ulwazi ngezabelo. Qwalasela impembelelo yengxoxo yokwaziswa kwababumalana kwakunye nokulinganiselwa izabelo zimali, kwaye uchaze eengozi ezinokubakho namathuba anokubakho ngenkqubo yekampana yezabelo-mali. Yiqhube iingxoxo-bonisano ngokusetyenziswa kolwazi ngemali kwizigaba ezijoliswe kuzo. Ulawulo-lwesazali-somathwendwe kwaye unxibelelwano nkqubo: Qhubele phambili ngolawulo-iqondo Iwesazali somathwendwe-ngsengezoIwezenzo zokwenza isazali somathwendwe ukufumana iindawo ezingalunganga ngokwaziswa ngemali yaye amathuba okuzilungisa. Linganisa iindlela ezikhoyo ze-National Treasury zesazali-ngokutsho-uqobo ukuba kuko amathuba okulungisa-ngokubakho okanye ukomelela inkqubo yekampana yezabelo. Sebenzisana-kwabahlengi-bhalo neseNxibelelwano ne-Budget Office kubanikazi-benziso ukulungelelanisa ulwazi-ngebhajeti ezalungelelwa iindlela zokubonakalisa isazali somathwendwe.

jobs.title: Programme Coordinator
jobs.summary: Programme Coordinator sought by National Treasury in Pretoria to coordinate business support processes, requiring a diploma or degree and at least two years' administrative experience.
jobs.requirements: A Grade 12 is required coupled with a minimum National Diploma or Bachelor’s. degree (equivalent to NQF Level 6 or 7) in Office Administration or Public Administration or Business Management or Project Management. A minimum of 2 years’ experience obtained in an administrative environment. Knowledge of the legislative framework on administration management within government. Knowledge and exposure to the coordination of budget coordination processes. Knowledge of the analysis and interpretation of internal policies for the correct application thereof.
jobs.duties: Integrated Business Support: Co-ordinate and perform quality assurance on processes pertaining to all in-coming and out-going memoranda for service enhancement and standardisation. Develop and maintain a filing system for record and audit purposes within the Office of the Chief Director. Monitor the effectiveness of service delivery within the Office of the Chief Director and propose improvements where necessary. Administer leave centrally within the business environment and updates the leave register for verification. Assist with the monitoring of all procurement and administrative initiatives and verify alignment of claims and invoices. Provide input to memoranda and record receipt thereof on the electronic filing system for record purposes, editing, etc, if and when required. Business Support: Acknowledge and confirm meetings, invitations to workshops on behalf of the Office of the Chief Director. Provide inputs to the compilation of agendas, initiating the taking minutes for the Office of the Chief Director, and follow-up on outstanding commitments from stakeholders. Administer all duties with utmost discretion in the execution of confidential matters and converse with clients in utmost diplomacy. Stakeholder Relations and Engagement: Engage internal clients on the coordination and enhancement of the integration of dual processes for execution within the unit. Attend to clients’ needs, address concerns and complaints timeously, improve relations with stakeholders, and obtain their trust. Analyse quotations for the attainment of the most effective and efficient procurement of goods and services and advise accordingly. Budget Co- ordination: Assist and prepare relevant documentation pertaining to the consolidated budgetary inputs in compliance with the MTEF requirements and cycle. Monitor expenditure against commitments and sensitise on possible overspending. Initiate the movement of funds between items after consultation with relevant stakeholders and compile relevant papers for execution.
jobs.applications: To apply visit: https://erecruitment.treasury.gov.za/eRecruitment
jobs.notes: Effective from 7 April 2021, the National Treasury now utilises an e-Recruitment System which means all applicants must login/register to apply for positions, we only accept hand delivered/posted applications should an applicant prove that he/she tried to apply via e-Recruitment with no success and the National Treasury ICT unit was unable to assist. The applicant’s profile on the e- Recruitment is equivalent to the newly approved Z83, and it is the responsibility of applicants to ensure their profiles are fully completed or their applications will not be considered, as per the DPSA Practice Note. Certain documentation will still be required to be uploaded on the system such as copies of all qualifications including National Senior Certificate/Matric certificate, ID, etc., however these documents need not be certified at point of application, however certification will be required prior to attending the interview. Please note: All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. It should be noted that the National Treasury does not support the use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in any of its recruitment and selection processes and will disqualify an application if it picks up the use of AI when completing assessments without acknowledging the source of information. Successful completion of the Nyukela Public Service SMS Pre-entry Programme as endorsed by the National School of Government,            available       as      an       online       course      on https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/, prior to finalisation of appointment, is a requirement for all SMS positions. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. All qualifications, criminal and SA citizenship checks will be conducted on all short-listed candidates and, where applicable, additional checks will be conducted in line with the new DPSA Directive effective 01 April 2024. Please note that by responding to our advertisement/s, you consent to the collection, processing, and storing of your Personal Information for internal HR processes in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA), Act No. 4 of 2013. af.title: Programkoördineerder
af.summary: Programkoördineerder gesoek deur National Treasury in Pretoria om besigheidsondersteuningsprosesse te koördineer, waarvoor 'n diploma of graad en ten minste twee jaar se administratiewe ervaring vereis word.
af.requirements: Graad 12 word vereis tesame met 'n minimum Nasionale Diploma of Bachelors-graad (gelykstaande aan NQF Level 6 of 7) in Office Administration of Public Administration of Business Management of Project Management. 'n Minimum van 2 jaar se ervare in 'n administratiewe omgewing. Kennis van die wetgewende raamwerk oor administrasiebestuur binne die regering. Kennis en blootstelling aan die koördinering van begrotingskoördinasieprosesse. Kennis van die analise en interpretasie van interne beleide vir die korrekte toepassing daarvan.
af.duties: Geïntegreerde Besigheidsondersteuning: Koördineer en voer gehaltsekerheid uit op prosesse rakende alle inkomende en uitgaande memorandums vir diensverbetering en standaardisering. Ontwikkel en handhaaf 'n lêerstelsel vir rekord- en ouditdoeleindes binne die Kantoor van die Hoofdirekteur. Monitor die doeltreffendheid van dienslewering binne die Kantoor van die Hoofdirekteur en stel verbeterings voor waar nodig. Administreer verlof sentraal binne die besigheidsomgewing en werk die verlofregister by vir verifikasie. Bystand verleen met die monitering van alle verkrygings- en administratiewe inisiatiewe en verifieer die belyning van eise en fakture. Verskaf insette tot memorandums en registreer die ontvangs daarvan op die elektroniese lêerstelsel vir rekorddoeleindes, redigering, ens, indien en wanneer nodig. Besigheidsondersteuning: Bevestig en erken vergaderings en uitnodigings tot werkswinkels namens die Kantoor van die Hoofdirekteur. Verskaf insette tot die opstel van agenda's, stel die neem van notule vir die Kantoor van die Hoofdirekteur in werking en volg uitstaande verbintenisse van belanghebbendes na. Administreer alle pligte met uiterste diskresie in die uitvoering van vertrouelike sake en kommunikeer met kliënte met uiterste diplomaat. Belanghebbende verhoudinge en betrokkenheid: Betrek interne kliënte by die koördinasie en verbetering van die integrasie van dubbele prosesse vir uitvoering binne die eenheid. Skenk aandag aan kliënte se behoeftes, spyt bekommernisse en klagtes betyds aan, verbeter verhoudinge met belanghebbendes en verkry hul vertroue. Analiseer kwotasies vir die verkryging van die mees doeltreffende en effektiewe verkryging van goedere en dienste en gee dienooreenkomstig advies. Begrotingskoördinasie: Bystand verleen en berei tersaaklike dokumentasie voor rakende die gekonsolideerde begrotingsinsette in ooreenstemming met die MTEF-vereistes en -siklus. Monitor besteding teenoor verbintenisse en maak sensitiiseer vir moontlike oorbesteding. Stel die skuif van fondse tussen items in na oorleg met tersaaklike belanghebbendes en stel tersaaklike dokumente op vir uitvoering.

zu.title: Nhlanganisi Wohlelo
zu.summary: National Treasury is Pretoria ifuna uNhlanganisi Wohlelo ongahlanganisa izinqubo zokusekela umkhakha, ofuna idiploma noma iziqu kanye nokuhlomula okungenani unyaka weminyaka emibili ngokusebenza ngabokuphathwa.
zu.requirements: Kudingeka i-Grade 12 kanye National Diploma noma ibhalori ye. degree (ehambisana ne- NQF Level 6 noma 7) ku-Office Administration noma Public Administration noma Business Management noma Project Management. Kudingeka ukuhlomula okungangaphelezu kweminyaka engu-2 okutholwe emkhakheni wokuphatwa. Ukwazi umthethosisekelo ngokuphathwa kahle emphakathini kahulumeni. Ulwazi nokuvezwa ekweni ukuhlanganiswa kwemithetho yesabelo yokwenza. Ulwazi ngokuhlaziya noku humusha izinqubomgomo zangaphakathi ukuze kusetshenziswe ngendlela efanele.
zu.duties: Ukusekela Umkhakha Ngokuhlangenwayo: Hlanganisa futhi wenze isiqiniseko sokuthi kuhle kwezinqubo ezihlobene nakho konke ukufika nokuphuma kwemibhalo ukuze kuthuthukiswe futhi kuqashelwe isibalo esisodwa.akhiwe futhi sigcinwe isistimu yokulondolozwa kwemibhalo yokuqopha futhi kusetshenziswe ngokophenyo kule-Office of the Chief Director. Hlola ukuthi ukusebenza kahle kukho yini ekule-Office of the Chief Director bese ungaphephethe ukuthuthukisa lapho kunesidingo. Phatha ukuphumula komkhakha ngokuzinthayo bese ubuyisa indlela yokuphawula ukuphumula njalo uyifake ohlelweni ukuze kuhlolwe. Siza ekuphenyeni yonke imigudu yokuqasha nokuphathwa kwaleyo minikelo bese uqinisekisa ukuthi izikhalazo nezibambole zihambelana. Nikeza umbhalo othile kumemoranda ubhalwe noma ukwazi ukuthi wamukele kusuka ohlelweni ukuze kuhlakaniswe, ukuthi kwensiwe eminye imisebenzi ebalulekile. Ukusekela Umkhakha: Yamukela futhi uqinisekise ukuthi imihlangano, nemiyalo yokuya eminye imihlangano ibhalwe ibuyeqinisekiswe i-Office of the Chief Director. Zinike emisebenzini yokufaka nokubhala amamu akonze njalo ulandele imisebenzi engaphelele kubantu abathintekayo ngesikhundla se-Office of the Chief Director. Yenza konke umsebenzi ophathwa ngokuzipatha kakhulu ekunyatheleni izinto ezingathunyelwa futhi ukhulume ngabathengi ngokwesibindi esikhulu. Ukuhlobana Nokubambisana Nabantu Abahlobene: Hlangabezana ngaphakathi nabathengi ngokuhlanganisa nokulungiselela ukuphumelelisa izinqubo eziyisibili ukuba zisebenze endaweni. Yalahlekelela kwezidingo zabathengi, uxazulule izinkinga nezinkinga ngokushesha, ulungise ubudlelwano nalabo abakunamathiselwe bese uthola inthemba labo. Hlola izinkokhela ukuze uthole ukuthenga okuhle kakhulu kwezimpahla izinkonzo futhi uphethe njengokulawulekayo. Ukuhlanganisa izabelo: Siza ukulungiselela imibhalo ehlukanisayo ngokweminye iminikelo ehlobene nokuhlanganisa izinkomba zesabelo kuhambisana nezidingo nesikhathi se-MTEF. Hlola ukuchithwa okubhekene nezibopho bese ulumkisa ngokuchithwa okungenzeka kakhulu. Qala ukushintsha imali phakathi kwezinkomba ngemva kokubonisana nalabo abahlobene bese uhlela imibhalo ekufanele yenziwe.

xh.title: Umqondisi wenkqubo
xh.summary: Umqondisi wenkqubo afunwa yi-National Treasury e-Pretoria ukuya kulinganisa iinkqubo zokusekela ishishini, efuna idiploma okanye isidanga kwaye nobuninzi bobenyaka wobomi bobungangeleminyaka emi-2 wamava oluloulo lwentlalo.
xh.requirements: Kufuneka ibe ne-Grade 12 ngokubhekiselele kwi-National Diploma okanye isidanga se-Bachelor (elingqangana ne-NQF Level 6 okanye 7) kwi-Office Administration okanye Public Administration okanye Business Management okanye Project Management. Kufuneka ube nobuninzi bobenyaka wobomi bobungangeleminyaka emi-2 wamava obufunyenwe kwindawo yolulo lwentlalo. Ukuqonda inkqubo yomthetho ekulawulweni kolulo lwentlalo ngaphakathi kurhulumente. Ulwazi nokubonwa ekulinganiseni iinkqubo zolungelelwaniso lweemali. Ulwazi lokuhlalutya nokutolikwa iinkqubo zamaphakathi kahle ngaphakathi endlu yonke yokuziphendulela.
xh.duties: Integrated Business Support: Linganisa kwaye wenze isiqinisekiso sokuhamba kwezinto kumacandavo onke ongamkhethiyo nayaphumayo eememorandam zeenkonzo ukwenzela ukuphuculwa nokulinganiseka kwazo. Yakhe kwaye ugcine inkqubo yokugcina amafayela kwindawo yagqoki-luvo yokuqinisekiswa nokuhlolwa rhoqo kwindawo kaMongameli oyiNjingalwazi. Qaphela ukusebenza kolwazi lweenkonzo kwindawo kaMongameli oyiNjingalwazi kwaye uphende ngokuqhutywa kolona apho kunesidingo. Lawula ipekule ngokubambisana kwindawo yeshishini kwaye uvuselela irejista yepekule yokuqinisekiswa. Nceda ekulawulweni kokuqwalaselwa kolonke ukuthenga nolulo lwentlalo kwaye qinisekisa ukulungelelwanisa kolonke iingxelo kwaye iinkethekede. Nikezela ngesandi kuimemorandam kwaye qwashula ukwamkelwa kwazo kule nkqubo yamafayela abhalwe ngokubhalwa-ngekhompyutha ngomgca wokugcina, ukuhlela, nokunye, ukuba nasini na ixesha esifunekayo. Business Support: Qaphela kwaye qinisekisa iintlanganiso, imemelelo kumasebe eendlela zokusebenza emele indawo kaMongameli oyiNjingalwazi. Nikezela ngesandwana ekwakheni i-ajenda, lityale amaNqaku phiwo yonke kwindawo kaMongameli oyiNjingalwazi, kwaye ulandele izibheno ezingangqinelwanga namacandawo abathathi nxaxheba. Lawula lonke umsebenzi ngokubakho bucheni kakhulu ekuphumezeni izinto ezifihliweyo kwaye thetha nabathengi bucheni bezidibi zengqondo. Stakeholder Relations and Engagement: Xhaphaza abathengi bungaphakathi ekulinganiseni nokuphuculweni kokubakho kolonke iziganeko zoluntu nezigulo ezimbini ngokubakho komgangatho opheleleyo ngokulinganiselwa. Zinike zidingo zabathengi, ziphendule iingxaki nezikhathazo ngokukhawuleza, phucula ulwazi lwamava ngabathathi nxaxheba kwaye ufumane ukuthembwa kwabo. Hlalutya izilinganiselo zokuthenga iimpahla neenkonzo ezisebenzayo nangexesha elifanelekileyo kwaye uphendule ngokungalathwayo. Budget Co- ordination: Nceda kwaye ulungiselele izixhobo zolwazi ezichasene nokulinganiselwa kwezandi zemali ngokubambelela kwi-MTEF kwaye ulandele inkqubo. Qaphela ukutshatyalaliswa kwemali ngokubakho kolonke izibheno kwaye ulumkise ngokuchitha emidl. Qalisa intshutshiso yemali phakathi kwezinto emva kokuba uthetha ngeento ezibalulekileyo kwaye ulungise izixhobo zolwazi ngokulinganiselwa ngokuchasene nokusetyenziswa.

jobs.title: Financial Analyst: Banking Services
jobs.summary: Financial analyst needed at National Treasury in Pretoria to authorise local and foreign payments on the Safety Web banking system and assist with grant payments.
jobs.requirements: A Grade 12 is required coupled with a minimum National Diploma (equivalent to NQF level 6) in Accounting. A Bachelor’s Degree (equivalent to NQF level 7) in any of the above disciplines will be an added advantage. A minimum 2 years’ experience obtained in a financial management environment; and basic knowledge of Accounting.
jobs.duties: Initiate Payments: Initiate the authorisation of local and foreign payments on Safety Web banking System as per SWIFT Requirements, Process cancellation of payments on the system. Assist with grant payments to municipal primary account as prescribed in the Division of Revenue Act (DORA). Verify payments to municipalities excluded from the DORA schedule as set out per the agreed rules and regulations. Process any cancellation of foreign payments. Confirm local and foreign payments settled with SARB and Commercial Banks and verify against SWIFT messages and SARB report. Process cancellation of payments on the system. Assist with grant payments to municipal primary account as prescribed in the Division of Revenue Act (DORA). Verify payments to municipalities excluded from the DORA schedule as set out per the agreed rules and regulations. Process any cancellation of foreign payments. Confirm local and foreign payments settled with SARB and Commercial Banks and verify against SWIFT messages and SARB report. Verification of Banking Details: Upload and submit verification of Bank Details (AVS) to respective banks received from Central Supplier Database (CSD) system, SASSA grants, Assets and Liability Management, Pension and other Departments. Extract data files from banks and transfer to Central Supplier Database (CSD) system, SASSA grants, Assets and Liability Management, Pension and other Departments. Reconcile daily number of AVS requests received from PMG account holders against data stakeholder banks. End-of- Business Process Clearence: Verify unmatched EBT Bank detail reports. Process deposits statements emanating from banking systems. Reconcile end-of-business processes suspense accounts and submit bank statements and monthly revenue reports to National Revenue Fund and financial systems. Order deposit books on request of a department. Admin support: Prepare documents for processing bank charges. Follow up on outstanding departmental bank reconciliations. Obtain banking details of public entities and departments in terms of Section 7(2) of PFMA and Treasury regulations. Distribute documents and departmental queries per cluster. System maintenance, upgrade & enhancement testing: Assist with the testing of new releases of the Safety Web Banking system and updating manuals. Assist with departmental training and preparation of procedure manuals.

af.title: Finansiële Ontleder: Bankdienste
af.summary: Finansiële ontleder benodig by National Treasury in Pretoria om plaaslike en buitelandse betalings op die Safety Web-bankstelsel te magtig en met toelaagbetalings te help.
af.requirements: Graad 12 word vereistes tesame met 'n minimum Nasionale Diploma (gelykstaande aan NQF-vlak 6) in Rekeningkunde. zu.title: Umhloli Wezimali: Izinkonzo Zebhange
zu.summary: Kudingeka umhloli wezimali e-National Treasury e-Pretoria ukuze avume izinkokhela zendawo nakwamanye amazwe ohlelweni lwebhange i-Safety Web futhi asize ezinkokhelini zezibonelelo.
zu.requirements: Kudingeka i-Grade 12 kanye ne-National Diploma okuyimfuneko (elingana ne-NQF level 6) kwezokuBhaliswa kwezimali. I-Bachelor's Degree (elingana ne-NQF level 7) kunoma yisiphi isikhundla esingenwe ngaphezulu kuzoba yinzuzo. Kubalulekile ukuba namava okungenani eminyakeni engu-2 atholakale endaweni yokuphathwa kwezimali; futhi ulwazi oluyisisekelo mayelana nokuBhaliswa kwezimali.
zu.duties: Qala Izinkokhela: Qala ukugunyaza izinkokhela zendawo nakwamanye amazwe ohlelweni lwebhange i-Safety Web njengoba kudingwa i-SWIFT Requirements, Abuye asebenzise ukukhanselwa kwezinkokhela ohlelweni. Siza ezinkokhelini zezibonelelo esikhundleni sokuqala somasipala njengoba kucacisiwe ku-Division of Revenue Act (DORA). Qinisekisa izinkokhela kumamasipala abekwe ehluze kwisikqedile i-DORA schedule njengoba kumiswe ngemithetho nemiyalelo evunyelwe. Sebenzisa noma yikuphi ukukhanselwa kwezinkokhela zamazwe. Qinisekisa izinkokhela zendawo nakwamanye amazwe ezizohlwaywe ne-SARB namabhange Aphasize futhi uqinisekise ngokumelana nemiyalezo ye-SWIFT nengabe ye-SARB. Sebenzisa ukukhanselwa kwezinkokhela ohlelweni. Siza ezinkokhelini zezibonelelo esikhundleni sokuqala somasipala njengoba kucacisiwe ku-Division of Revenue Act (DORA). Ukuqinisekisa Imininingwane Yebhange: Layisha futhi uhende ukuqinisekiswa kweMininingwane YeBhange (AVS) kumabhange ahambisanayo atholakale ohlelweni lwe-Central Supplier Database (CSD), izibonelelo ze-SASSA, Ukuphathwa Kwempahla Nezikweletu, Impeshini kanye namanye Amaphahla. Khhipha amafayela wedatha kumabhange futhi adlulise ohlelweni lwe-Central Supplier Database (CSD), izibonelelo ze-SASSA, Ukuphathwa Kwempahla Nezikweletu, Impeshini kanye namanye Amaphahla. Linganisa inani lamaphuzu we-AVS atholakale kubanikazi bama-akhawunti i-PMG nsuku zonke ngokumelana namabhange abaphathi bamaphuzu. I-Prosesi Yokuqeda Ibizini: Ukuqinisekisa Amabezwe; Qinisekisa umbiko we-EBT Bank ongahambisani. Hlela izinkokhela ezivela ohlelweni lwebhange. Linganisa izikhundla sokunganisa kwemali ezinhlelhweni ekupheleni kwebhizinisi futhi uhende izinkokhela zebhange namabezwe omqondo wenyanga ku-National Revenue Fund kanye nezindlela zezimali. Faka odolo amabhuku we-akhawunti eminyangweni ngokucelwa. I-Admin support: Hlela amadokhenda ngesikhathi kubekelwa phansi izinkokhela zebhange. Landela ukuthi kwensiwe ngeminqulo yamabhange eminyangweni. Thola imininingwane yebhange yenhlangano kahulumeni kwamanye amaphahla ngaphansi kwesigaba 7(2) se-PFMA kanye nemithetho ye-National Treasury. Sabelisa amadokhenda nemibuzo yeminyangweni nangokweqoqo. Ukulondolozwa kohlelo, ukulungiswa & ukuhlolwa kwezinto ezithuthukisiwe: Siza ekuphenyweni kwezinguqulo ezisha zohlelo lwebhange i-Safety Web Banking kanye nokubuyekezwa kwezincwadi zokuhola. Siza emaqhoshini eminyangweni kanye noku-iquketha imibhalo yokwenza imisebenzi ngokulandelana.
