jobs.title: Scientist Production Grade a – C
jobs.centre: Bloemfontein Ref No: VOCMA 24 Kimberly Ref No: VOCMA 25 Upington Ref No: VOCMA 26
jobs.salary_text: R791 604 – R1 144 008 per annum, (all-inclusive OSD salary package), (Offer will be based on proven years of experience)
jobs.summary: Scientist Production Grade A–C positions in water quality planning across Bloemfontein, Kimberley and Upington, requiring a BSc Honours and SACNASP registration.
jobs.requirements: A Science degree (BSc) (Hon) in Chemistry, Biochemistry or Microbiology. or relevant qualification. Three (3) years post qualification experience. Compulsory registration with SACNASP as a Professional Natural Scientist. The disclosure of a valid unexpired driver’s license. Sound knowledge of integrated water resource management and water resource protection. Understanding of the water resource classification system and its application thereof. Knowledge and experience in Project management is essential. Understanding and knowledge of water quality management. Implement principles of national water act in terms of protection, development, use, control and management of water resources of the National Water Act, 1998 and related legislation. Knowledge and understanding of the water sector: relevant legislations (NWA, CARA and NEMA, MPRDA) together with the related policies, regulations, principles, guidelines, tools and procedures; policy development, implementation and monitoring. Excellent communication skills including verbal, report writing, presentation skills. Sound interpersonal skills as well as the ability to work in a multi-disciplinary team. Willingness to work abnormal hours and under pressure as well as travel country wide. Proven liaison and networking skills especially as they relate to Corporative Governance and stakeholder engagement.
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will join a team of professionals responsible for strategic water resource planning, focusing on water quality through the development and maintenance of integrated water quality planning solutions. This requires conducting assessment studies to address data and information gaps and needs for water quality planning. Responsible for forward planning utilising predictive modelling tools, among other methods. Implement National Water Act with focus on classifying water resources and determining associated resource quality objectives for current and future needs of significant water resources in the Vaal-Orange Water Management Area; Review and recommend scientific projects; Give input on water use license applications for mining, industries, municipalities, urban development and agriculture activities as they relate to resources water quality. Process water use license applications. Conduct site inspections and attend meetings for various water uses. Promote surface and groundwater protection and management through the water use authorisation process and implement DWA’s role and function with respect to water resource protection and management. Management of waste discharge charge system and surface water data management. Provide assistance in drafting of specific water quality license conditions. Collection and interpretation an analysis of surface water data and monitoring of the surface water resources.
jobs.applications: Interested applicants must submit their applications via the online link https://erecruitment.dws.gov.za
jobs.notes: Other related documentation such as copies of qualifications, identity documents, driver’s license etc need not to accompany the application when applying for a post as such documentation must only be produced by shortlisted candidates during the interview date in line with DPSA circular 19 of 2022. With reference to applicants bearing professional or occupational registration, fields provided in Part B on the online Z83 must be completed as these fields are regarded as compulsory. Failure to complete or disclose all required information will automatically disqualify the applicant. No late applications will be accepted. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to suitability checks (SAQA verification, reference checks criminal and credit checks). SAQA evaluation certificate must accompany foreign qualifications (only when shortlisted). Applications that do not comply with the above- mentioned requirements will not be considered. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Candidates will be required to complete a financial disclosure form and undergo security clearance. Foreigners or dual citizenship holders must provide a police clearance certificate from country of origin (only when shortlisted). The Vaal-Orange Catchment Management Agency is a Public Water Resource Management Agency, established in line with the provisions of the National Water Act, 1998 (Act no 36 of 1998) (NWA) and National Water Policy for South Africa. It is an entity of the National Department of Water and Sanitation. Employees appointed in the CMA have similar employment terms and conditions as those of employees appointed in terms of the Public Service Act, though not employed in terms of the Public Service Act. If you do not hear from us within three (3) months of this advertisement, please accept that your application has been unsuccessful. Faxed applications will not be considered. The agency reserves the right not to fill these positions. Women and persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply and preference will be given to the EE Targets. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Wetenskaplike Produksie Vlak A – C
af.summary: Wetenskaplike Produksie Vlak A–C posisies in watergehaltebeplanning regdeur Bloemfontein, Kimberley en Upington, wat 'n BSc Honneurs en SACNASP-registrasie vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Wetenskapsgraad (BSc) (Honneurs) in Chemie, Biochemie of Mikrobiologie. of 'n tersaaklike kwalifikasie. Drie (3) jaar ervaring na kwalifikasie. Verpligte registrasie by SACNASP as 'n Professionele Natuurwetenskaplike. Die bekendmaking van 'n geldige, onverstrekte bestuurslisensie. Deeglike kennis van geïntegreerde waterhulpbronbestuur en waterhulpbronbeskerming. Begrip van die waterhulpbronneklassifikasiestelsel en die toepassing daarvan. Kennis en ervaring in Projekbestuur is noodsaaklik. Begrip en kennis van watergehaltebestuur. Implementeer beginsels van die Nasionale Waterwet ten opsigte van beskerming, ontwikkeling, gebruik, beheer en bestuur van waterhulpbronne van die Nasionale Waterwet, 1998 en verwante wetgewing. Kennis en begrip van die watersektor: tersaaklike wetgewing (NWA, CARA en NEMA, MPRDA) tesame met die verwante beleide, regulasies, beginsels, riglyne, instrumente en prosedures; beleidsontwikkeling, implementering en monitering. Uitstekende kommunikasievaardighede insluitend verbale, verslagskrywing, aanbiedingsvaardighede. Gesonde interpersoonlike vaardighede asook die vermoë om in 'n multidissiplinêre span te werk. Bereidwilligheid om buitegewone ure en onder druk te werk asook landwyd te reis. Bewese skakelings- en netwerkvaardighede veral soos dit verband hou met Korporatiewe Bestuur en belanghebbende-betrokkenheid.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal aansluit by 'n span professionele persone verantwoordelik vir strategiese waterhulpbronbeplanning, met die fokus op watergehalte deur die ontwikkeling en instandhouding van geïntegreerde watergehaltebeplanningsoplossings. Dit vereis die uitvoer van assesseringsstudies om data- en inligtinggapings en -behoeftes vir watergehaltebeplanning aan te spreek. Verantwoordelik vir vooruitbeplanning deur gebruik van voorspellende modelleringsinstrumente, onder andere metodes. Implementeer die Nasionale Waterwet met die fokus op die klassifisering van waterhulpbronne en die bepaling van geassosieerde hulpbrongeischteikkomste vir huidige en toekomstige behoeftes van noemenswaardige waterhulpbronne in die Vaal-Orange Waterbestuursgebied; Hersien en beveel wetenskaplike projekte aan; Verskaf insette oor watergebruiklisensie-aansoeke vir mynbou, nywerhede, munisipaliteite, stedelike ontwikkeling en landbouaktiwiteite soos dit verband hou met hulpbron-watergehalte. Prosesseer watergebruiklisensie-aansoeke. Voer terreininspeksies uit en woon vergaderings by vir verskeie watergebruike. Bevordere oppervlak- en grondwaterbeskerming en -bestuur deur die watergebruikmagtigingsproses en implementeer DWA se rol en funksie ten opsigte van waterhulpbronbeskerming en -bestuur. Bestuur van die afvalafvoerheffingstelsel en oppervlakwaterdatabestuur. Verskaf hulp met die opstel van spesifieke watergebruiklisensie-voorwaardes. Versameling en interpretasie en ontleding van oppervlakwaterdata en monitering van die oppervlakwaterhulpbronne.

Amakhono aphumelelayo okuxhumana kwabanye abantu kanye nokuqinisekisa ukusebenza ohlehlweni oluhlobene. Ilungelo lokusebenza emahoreni angalungi kanye nokusebenza ngcindezulu kanye nohambo lonke ezweni. Lokhu kudinga ukwenziwa kwezifundo zokuhlolisisa ukuxazulula izikhala nezingxenye zolwazi kanye nezidingo zamasu omthamo wamanzi. Onesibopho sokuhlela isikhathi esizayo ngokusebenzisa amasu amaqhinga noma okunye. Ukusebenzisa inqubo yesiZwe egqamisa ukulinganisa izinsiza zamanzi kanye nokuhlela izinhloso ezihlobene zomthamo wezinsiza zezikhathi ezikhombayo nangomuso kwezinsiza ezibalulekile zamanzi e-Vaal-Orange Water Management Area. Ukubuyeza nokuncoma izinhlela zemisebenzi yezangempela. Ukunikeza isibonelo ezicelweni zamalayisense wokusebenzisa amanzi kobuciko bokukhiqiza, izimboni, imiphakathi yezomdabu, ukuthuthukiswa kwezokuhlala kanye nemisebenzi yokulima ukwenzelana nomthamo wamanzi. Ukucubungula izicelo zamalayisense wokusebenzisa amanzi. Ukuhlola iziteshi nokubakhonza amakhefi ohlelweni lokuqasha amanzi. Ukugqugquzela ukuvikelwa nokuphathwa kwamanzi phezulu nangaphansi komhlaba nangomkhakha wezokuvunyelwa komsebenzisi wamanzi nokusebenzisa i-DWA iphethe kanye nesibopho mayelana nokuvikelwa nokuphathwa kwezinsiza zamanzi. Uphathwa lwezindleko zokuqashelwa kwendlula kanye nokuphathwa kolwazi lwamanzi phezulu. Unikeza usizo ekubhaleni izidingo ezithize zamalayisense womthamo wamanzi. Ukuqoqa, ukutolika nokuhlolisisa ulwazi lwamanzi phezulu kanye nokuqapha ukuba amanzi phezulu emthonjeni.

Ulwazi olululo lokulawula izixhobo zamanzi ngokuhlangeneyo nokukhusela izixhobo zamanzi. Ukuqonda inkqubo yokwahlula izixhobo zamanzi nokuviso kwayo. Ulwazi namava kokulawula iiprojekthi kuyimfuneko. Ukuqonda nolwazi ngokulawula umgangatho wamanzi. Ukusebenzisa iinkqubo ze-National Water Act mayela nokukhusela, ukuphuhliswa, ukusetyenziswa, ukulawula nolawulo lwamanzi ngokwe-National Water Act, 1998 nolwaphulo-mthetho oluxhubekayo. Ulwazi nokuqonda ingingqi yamanzi: ulwaphulo-mthetho olufanelekileyo (NWA, CARA, NEMA, MPRDA) kunye neenkqubomgobo ezinxulumeneyo, iimigaqo, iinkqubo, iinkethelo, izixhobo nendlela zokusebenza; ukuphuhliswa, ukusebenzisa nokujonga iinkqubomgabo. Amandla amaninzi okunxibelelana okuquka okubalayo, okubhala iingxelo, namandla okubonakalisa. Amandla okuhlobana nabantu njengoko kukwakho nokuqatshelwa kwakho ukusebenza kwiqela elinabapolofeshonali ahlukeneyo. Ilungelo lokusebenza iiyure ezingezoqeqesho kwaye ngaphantsi kwexesha elinzima kwaye uhambe wonke ilizwe. Amandla abonakalileyo okuxhumana nokuqhagamshelana ngokukodwa njengoko anxulumene noLawulo lweshishini nentloswano namalungu ombutho.
xh.duties: Omqeshi opumeleyo uza kuzibandakanya nomthintela wabapolofeshonali abajulene nokucwangciswa kwezohlulo lwamanzi ngokwamasu, egqamisa umgangatho wamanzi ngokuphuhliswa nokugcinwa kwezisombululo zokucwangciswa okuhlangeneyo komgangatho wamanzi. Oku kufuna ukuqhuba izifundo zokuqinisekisa ukuze kusetyenziswe idatha nolwazi olungalikhoyo nemifuno yokucwangciswa komgangatho wamanzi. Uxanduva lokucwangciswa okuya phambili ngokusebenzisa izixhobo zokubikezela inkqubo, phakathi kwezinye iindlela. Ukusebenzisa iNational Water Act ngophandle wokwahlula izixhobo zamanzi nokumiswa kweenjongo ezinxulumene nomgangatho wezixhobo zamanzi kuze kubekho iimfuno zangoku nangomso kwezixhobo eziphambalala zamanzi kwi-Vaal-Orange Water Management Area; Ukuphonononga kunye nokuncoma iziprojekthi zesayensi; Ukunikela ngolwazi kwiimveliso zesicelo somvuzo wokusebenzisa amanzi ezingodo, amashishini, oomasipala, uphuhliso lweendawo zasezidolophini nemisebenzi yezolimo njengoko ezithi zinxulumene nomgangatho wamanzi. Ukuqhuba iimveliso zeesicelo zokusebenzisa amanzi. Ukuqhuba iindawo zokuqinisekisa nokuza kuthunyelwa kwiindibano zamahla ahlukeneyo okusebenzisa amanzi. Ukukhuthaza ukukhuselwa nokulawulwa kwamanzi angaphezulu nangaphantsi komhlaba ngoluqeqesho lokugunyaziswa okusebenzisa amanzi nokusebenzisa indima kunye nolwazi lwe-DWA ngokuthintela nokulawula izixhobo zamanzi. Ulawulo lonxibelelwano lwentlawulo yemveliso yamashishini kunye nolawulo lolwazi lwamanzi angaphezulu. Ukunika inkxaso ekubhalweni kweemigangatho ethile yesicelo somgangatho wamanzi. Ukuqokelela, ukuhunyula nokuhlalutya idatha yamanzi angaphezulu kwaye kugqitywe ngokuqwalasela iindawo zokujonga amanzi angaphezulu.

Six (6) years post qualification experience in compliance monitoring and enforcement environment. The disclosure of a valid unexpired driver’s licence. Extensive experience in the environmental and water management field, waste management, industries, urban development and mining. A clear understanding of the VOCMAs role and policies about water resource management. Knowledge of the National Water Act 36 of 1998, other applicable laws and related policies, strategies and guidelines. Understanding the principles of Integrated Water Resource Management. zu.title: Isikhundla Sokulawula Umphathi Wezohumushi Ezinga a
zu.summary: Izikhundla Sokulawula Umphathi Wezohumushi ezibeka emsebenzini umthetho wamanzi kanye nokuqaphela ukuziphendulela, ezifuna idigri yezesayensi ezenza kanye neminyaka eyisithupha yohlelo.
zu.requirements: Idigri yeminyaka emine kwe Natural Science / Environmental science noma iziqu ezihambisanayo. Iminyaka eyisithupha (6) yohlelo ngemva kweziqu kokuphawula nokubeka emsebenzini ukuziphendulela endaweni yokuqaphela nokubeka emsebenzini. Ukufanekisa ikhilabhisi yomshayeli enyuzileyo ehlelekileyo. Uhlelo olubanzi endaweni yezohumushi nokuphathwa kwamanzi, ukuphathwa kwezinkunkuma, izimboni, ukuthuthukiswa kwedolobha kanye nokumbatha. Ukuqonda okucacile ngendima ye VOCMAs kanye namapholisi ngokuphathwa kwemithombo yamanzi. Ulwazi ngomthetho we National Water Act 36 of 1998, eminye imithetho ehambisanayo kanye namapholisi, amasu kanye namahlela ahambisanayo. Ukuqonda imigomo ye Integrated Water Resource Management. Ulwazi lwezinqobo ze Human Resources kanye namapholisi we Financial Management. Ukucabanga okusha, ukuxoxisana, ukuxhumana, ukuphatha kanye n amakhono okuxhumana okuhle (okuqhathanisiwe kanye nokubhaliwe). Ukuzethemba ekwenzeleni uhlelo lokuhamba kakhulu kanye nokusebenza emahoreni angajwayelekile. Amakhono okubhala imibiko yobuchwepheshe, isinqumo sobungcweti kanye namakhono okuhlaziya idatha. Amakhono okulekela nokuqumba izinqumo. Amakhono okuphatha izimali kanye nokuhola iqembu. Ukudala kanye nokuqaxumisa izinkinga. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amakhono okuphatha abantu kanye nokuphatha iziphixamphixana.
zu.duties: Faka emsebenzini kanye nokubeka emsebenzini umthetho we National Water Act kanye namnye umthetho, amapholisi kanye namasiko ahambisanayo. Siza ekuthuthukisweni kwamapholisi namasiko. Siza ngokufaka emsebenzini i Compliance Monitoring and Enforcement Strategy. Faka emsebenzini amasistimu okuqaphela ukuziphendulela, imihlahlandlela yokuhlolwa noma amaphrothokholi. Hlola ukuziphendulela ngamakhilabhisi okusebenzisa amanzi, umthetho, amapholisi, kanye namasiko. Yenza izihlolo ezijwayelekile ukuze qinisekisa ukuziphendulela ngemithetho ephathelene namanzi kanye nezemvelo. Yenza uphenyo, izihlolo kanye ulungise imibiko yophenyo kanye nezihlolo, faka emsebenzini isenzo sokubeka emsebenzini ngendlela yesexwayo esesimweni noma esingenasimilo, ukubeka emsebenzini ngokwalawulo njengesaziso somthetho, izaziso zokuziphendulela kanye neziyalezo, kanye nemiyalezo yenkantolo ukuze kubeke izaziso, kanye nokubeka emsebenzini ngomthetho webuyezo. Lungisela ulwazi oludingekayo, imibiko kanye nobufakela imiyalezo yenkantolo. Lulela izikhulu zomkhakaba ngamapholisi kanye namasu ahambisanayo ne Directorate futhi qinisekise ukukhuthaza ukuziphendulela. Qinisekisa ukuxhumana, ukusebenzisana kanye noqoqosho namanye amajensi okubeka emsebenzini kanye nezikhungo zahulumeni ezibandakanyeka ekuziphenduleleni kanye nokubeka emsebenzini. Qinisekisa ukuhambisana nanyalo zokusethulwa njengoba kuhlelelwe yi Standard Operating Procedures. Qondanisa abasebenzi ngokwamapholisi kanye namasiko we VOCMA.

xh.title: Isikhokelo Somphathi Wemeko Yamandulo inqanaba a
xh.summary: Izithuba sokubakhokhela iindwendwe ezimala nomthetho wamanzi nokuqwalasela ukuzithoba, kufuneka kubekho izidanga kwenzulwa kwesayensi endalo kwaye kubekho iminyaka elishoba ekwenzeni umsebenzi.
xh.requirements: Isidanga sezinyanga ezine kwenzulwa kwesayensi endalo / Ulwazi lwemeko yamandulo okanye izidanga ezifanayo. Ekutheni kube kukho iminyaka eyandishuba elishoba (6) emva kokuqwalaselwa ukugqitha kwemeko yokwenza umsebenzi ekugqwethweni nokumiswa komthetho kwemeko endalo. Ukubuyisa ilayiseni yokushaya enye eqinisekisiweyo engagqibekanga. Ulwazi olubanzi kwinkundla yemeko yamandulo nolawulo lwamanzi, ulawulo lwezinto ezingcoliswayo, iindawo zenkqubo, ulwazi lwezichwephesha endlu nophuhliso lwedolophu. Ukuqonda okucacileyo ngendima iVOCMA nemigaqo yayo mayela nolawulo lwemithombo yamanzi. Ulwazi ngomthetho weSizwe wamanzi 36 ka 1998, eminye umthetho ofanayo kwaye namathethe nokuqwalasela, iindlela zokwenza izicwangciso kunye nezikhokelo. Ukuqonda iinkqubo zokuNika ubunyulu kuLawulo lomThombo wamanzi. Ulwazi ngemigaqo yolawulo lweZigidi zamaHlengi kunye nezimali. Okunika amandla indlela yokucinga, ukuxoxisana, ukukhulisanana, okusemplilweni noluntu lwezidalwa. Ilungiselelo lokuhamba kakhulu ukuze kube nokwenzakala emini nasebusuku. Ulwazi ngokubhala iingxelo zobugcisa, ukwahlula isigqibo seMtyholo kwaye kubekho nolwazi ngokuhlaziya imiba. Ulwazi ngokukhokela kwaye nikwazi ukuthatha isigqibo. Ulwazi ngokulawula imali kunye nokuqhuba iqela labantu. Ukukhawuleza nokuqonda iingxaki ezibakhoyo. Ukuba nolwazi ngokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulwazi ngokulawula abantu nokulawula iingxabano.
xh.duties: Ukuqalisa kwaye uphakamise umthetho weSizwe wamanzi kwaye kubekho nomthetho ofanayo, imigaqo nolawulo. Ukuncedisa ekuyileni imigaqo nolawulo. Ukuncedisa ekuqalisweni kwenkqubo yokujonga nokuzithoba kwaye kubekho nokumiswa komthetho. Ukuqalisa inkqubo yokujonga ukuzithoba, izikhokelo zokuqwalasela okanye iinkqubo. Ukuqwalasela ukuzithoba ngamalayisenisi okusebenzisa amanzi, umthetho, imigaqo nolawulo. Ukuqhubeza iingxelo zokuqwalasela rhoqo ukuze kukhangelwe ukuzithoba ngokwentetho yamaza kunye nemigaqo yemeko yamandulo. Ukuqhubeza uqhakamshelwano, uqwalasele kwaye ulungise iingxelo zophando, uqalise inkqubo yokusebenzisa umthetho ngohlobo lwezilumkiso ezingalunganga okanye ezingalungelanga, ukusebenzisa umthetho ngokurhoqo njengoko kubhalwe kumgaqo-sishwankathelo, iindaba ezilumkisa ngokuzithoba kunye nemiyalelo, kwaye kubekho nezicelo zesigqitha esilawulayo ukuze kusebenziswe iindaba, nakwinkqubo yomthetho wolwembu. Ulungiselela iinkcukacha, iingxelo kunye nobungqina ezidingekayo kwisicelo sesigqitha. Ukuba luncedo kwizibhunga ezahlukeneyo kwimigaqo noluntu kwinkqubo ebalulekileyo kuSebe kwaye uqinisele ukuthuthwa kwemigaqo. Qinisekisa uluntu, intsebenzisano nokuqwalaselwa koluntu olunye olusebenzisa amaza kunye namaziko karhulumente abandakanyekayo ekuzithobenzi nasekuwiseni umthetho. Qinisekisa ukuba kuhlanjululwe iindaba ngexesha elibekiweyo njengoko kubonakaliswe kumgaqo-sishwankathelo woMsebenzi oqhelekileyo. Qhuba abasebenzi ngokomthetho nemigaqo yeVOCMA.

zu.summary: Izikhundla zesiphathi sesebe sezolimo eBloemfontein nasePretoria ezidinga iziqu zeminyaka emi-4 kwiNatural noma i-Environmental Sciences kanye namava eminyaka eyisithupha ukuze kusetshenziswe i-National Water Act.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zeminyaka emi-4 noma iziqu ezingakulinganiswa kwi-Natural noma i-Environmental Sciences. Amava eminyaka eyisithupa (6) emva kokuthola iziqu. Ukubonisa ilayisense lokushayela elivumelekile elingakapheli. Ulwazi ngi-National Water Act kanye nayo yonke imithetho kanye namapholisi ohlelo lolawulo lwemvelo ahlobene namanzi futhi afa kuleso sifundo. Ulwazi oluhle ngazo zonke izingxenye nemicimbe ehlobene ne-Resource Directed Measures kanye noLawulo Oluhlanganiswe Lwamathuluzi Amanzi. Ulwazi namava ku-River Health Monitoring kanye nezinkomba. Ulwazi nokuqonda kwamathuluzi abekiwe ukuze kwenziwe ukugunyazwa kweReserve. Ikhono elivezwe nalamava lokubhala nokuhumusha imibiko namadokhumenti asemgangathweni kanye nesayensi, futhi usize ngokuphathi kwamaphrojekthi. Amakhono abonakalayo okuphatha kanye nokuxoxisana. Ikhono lokusebenza ngemvelo kuleso sikhundla esihlanganisa abasebenzi abangenyo nangaphandle be-VOCMA abavela kumagatsha ahlukene kanye nabahlanganyeli. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amakhono amahle okubhala nokukhuluma, okwethula kanye nokubhala imibiko. Ukukwazi ukunika ukusekelwa okusemgangathweni kwesayensi kwezinye izimisebenzi ze-VOCMA kanye nakhono lokuthuthukisa, ukuba ngumfundisi kanye nokuba ngumphathi kwabasebenzi abasebaseni. Amakhono amahle okuhlobana nabantu. Ikhono lokuxhumana namaphandle kanye namaqembu abahlanganyeli.
zu.duties: Ukusetshenziswa kwe-National Water Act 36 ka-1998 kugxile kwi-Resource Directed Measures (RDM). Ukusetshenziswa kweReserve kwiWMA. Ukulandelwa kwezimpilo zemifula esiKuhlaba LokuLawula Amanzi kwa-Vaal-Orange, ukwenza amaReserve ahlakulekile kalula, okuhlanganisa nokusebenzisa amamodeli wehydrology kanye nawo wonke amanye amamodeli ahlobene lapho kudingeka khona. Ukulungisa izinkathi zokuhamba ezinkundleni kanye nokusiza ukulungisa ulwazi olusemgangathweni oludingekayo kanye nokubhala imibiko emgangathweni phezu kokunye. Ukuxhumana noMnyango WeAmanzi NokuKhipha Amanzi ngaphansi kwenqubo ye-Adopt-a-River, ukugunyazwa nokusebenzisa iReserve, uhlelo lwe-River Health kanye nezinye izinhlelo. Ukuxhumana nabahlanganyeli bangenyo nangaphange ngokuhlobene nokuqaliswa kwe-RDM, ikakhulukazi i-ARI. Ukuhlanganisa ukugunyazwa kweReserve nezinye izimisebenzi ze-VOCMA ezifana nezicelo zelayisense yokusebenzisa amanzi, futhi kunike ukusekelwa olujwayelekile nemibono yesayensi. Ukuthuthukisa i-ToR's futhi kuphathe ama-PSP. Ukubamba iqhaza kuhlelo lokwakha amandla kanye nehlelo lokuba ngumfundisi kwabasebenzi abasebaseni. Ukulungisa imibiko yenyanga zonke kanye nemibiko yenyanga eyisishiyagalombili. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kuhlotshaniswa namadesikhedi ngezinto ezithunyelwe njengoba kukushiwo ezinqumoka ZokuSebenza Ezijwayelekile. Ukuphatha futhi ukuqinisekisa ukulungiswa okusebenzayo kwezimali ngolawulo lwamathuluzi amanzi. Ukuphatha abasebenzi ngokuvumelana namapholisi kanye nemicimbe ye-VOCMA.

xh.title: Isikhululi SikaMphathi WeemProto Zenzelelo ezingoBuntu inqanaba a
xh.summary: Izithuba zoMphathi WemiloYoBuntu eBloemfontein nasePretoria efunayo inqanaba lesidanga leminyaka eli-4 kwiZoloji ezeNdalo okanye ezeMiloYoBuntu nolwazi lweminyaka esi-6 ekusebenzeni ukuqala umthetho weNational Water Act.
xh.requirements: Isidanga seminyaka eli-4 okanye nesiqinisekiso esilinganayo kwiZoloji ezeNdalo okanye ezeMiloYoBuntu; Kulandela ulwazi lweminyaka esi-6 emva kokufumana isidanga. Ukwaziswa ngeelayiseni yokushaya etshatiyweyo engazange iphelelwe lixesha; Ulwazi ngomthetho weNational Water Act nawo onke emithethweni ngeemithethonqubo ezidityaniswe namanzi nezeMiloYoBuntu ezinomdla; Ulwazi oluzinzileyo ngeendidi zonke neenkqubo ezidityaniswe neZindlela ezalulwa kumMthwalo weziSento zeNdalo ezahlukeneyo kunye noLawulo oluqhagamshelweyo loMthwalo wamaza. Ulwazi nolwazi lokusebenza kuQaphelo iMPhilo yeMilambo namanani. Ulwazi nokuqonda iisixhobo ezizezelwe ukuqesha ukuQinisekiswa koMthwalo oLondoloziweyo. Amandi anokuqinisekiswa kwaye nolwazi ukubhala nokutolika iireport ezobugcigca nobugcisa kunye namaxwebhu nokuncedisa ngolawulo lweziprojekthi. Amabala alawulo noBuchule bokucinga; Amandla okusebenza ngokwenza iziphumelelo kwindawo equka abasebenzi be-VOCMA abangaphakathi nangaphandle kumagatya amaninnye naba niba nentshisekelo; Ulwazi lweekhompyutha; Amabala amabini obuqu nabangatya athethiweyo, okubonakalisa ngebhalweweyo nokuBhala iireport; Ukuba nakho ukunika inkxaso yobugcisa nobugcigca kumisebenzi yamanye amagatya e-VOCMA, nokuqonda nokuqhutywa njengomoboniso yolwazi noGqwesileziseko. Ulwazi oluzolileyo lwabantu. Amandi okudibana neemveli nemitme yokuthetha nabantu bamanywe ngentshisekelo.
xh.duties: Ukuqalelwa komthetho weNational Water Act 36 ka 1998 kugxilwe kwimizila yaLwa kumMthwalo weziSonto ezahlukeneyo (RDM); Ukuqaliseka kukaMthwalo oLondoloziweyo kwiWMA; Ukuqalisa nokuvulandlelana kwesiSihloko sokubamba iNcwadi yakuMlambo (ARI); UQaphelo lweMPhilo yemiLambo esiKweni soLawulo lwamaza aseVaal-Orange, Ulungelelwaniso lweMigibekela ezingathiU zimbaxa, equka ukusebenza kwezimothelo ze-hydrological nezinye iindlela ezinomdla na kwafuneka; ukuHlola iNdalo noBuntu kumoya wendawo nokuncedisa ngokulungiselelwa kolwazi oluNxholo ngokuQinisekisa iNtshahenezo ezizeze zokuchithwa kona na kokuBhala iinkhokhobhe na zeminye iiNcwadi. ukuvakalisa na kweliBhlikiseki lisebe leZamanzi na koLuhlambelo ngoSihloko sokubamba iNcwadi yomLambo, ukubeka ngemeko yokuQinisekiswa kweMithwalo eLondolozweyo, uhlelwa lokuQala ukusebenzisa, iNkqubo yeMphilo yemilambo nakwenye imimiselo. Unakuluvakalisa kunabanemi nkxaso abanexesha elingaphakathi na bangangaphandle ngeenkqubo zeRDM, ngakumbi iNcwadi yokubamba uMlambo. Unakuludibanisa iNcwadi yokuQinisekisa iMithwalo na komsebenzi oqongo nobuNkqangi bakaVOCMA njengesicelo soLungelelwaniso lwamaza alulwayo, unike inkxaso ngokubugcisa nobugcigca na iziphawuli zoluntu. unako ukuseka ukuqinisekiswa kweMithwalo na kuphathwe iNkqubo yoLawulo eQhingqiyo; ukuvakalelisa kwamahle ngokomgaqo-nkqubo wokwakhiwa ngokwemisebenzi yokubakho na kwezobuGcisa kuMntu oQhayiya. ulungisele iNcwadi zeNnyanga na zeNxwaka enkulu; uQinisekisa ukuHlinzwa ngesiXeko somSebenzi na ngokomGaqo-nkqubo oqhelekileyo wokuSebenza. ulawula kuqinisekisa uLungelelwaniso ngokweMali oluSebenzayo ngokomthwalo wamaza; ulawula abasebenzi ngokuLandela iNkqubo nemigaqo yeVOCMA.

jobs.reference_number: VOCMA 31 Branch: Vaal-Orange Catchment Management Agency Division: Institutions, Stakeholder Engagement and Governance
jobs.title: Assistant Director: Institutions, Stakeholder Engagement
jobs.summary: Assistant Director needed in Bloemfontein to develop and implement water management policies and engage stakeholders, requiring a degree and four to six years of experience.
jobs.requirements: A bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Social Sciences or related environment. Four (4) to six (6) years relevant experience. Proven ability to interpret and implement policy and strategy. Experience in terms of intergovernmental relations, co-operative governance, institutional structures management, regulation and marketing. Experience in project and programme management. Proven ability to solve problems and demonstrated decision-making ability. Ability to communicate with a range of stakeholders inclusive of communities. Experience in establishment of Water Management Institutions (Water Users Association, Catchment Management Agencies and Catchment Management Forums). Ability to forge partnerships between governments, non-government stakeholders and good interpersonal skills. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Knowledge of the National Water Act (1998). A valid unexpired driver’s license and willingness to travel extensively.
jobs.duties: Ensure effective development and implementation of VOCMA policies and strategies. Ensure integration of marginalised and previously disadvantaged water users / stakeholders in water tariff determination, water allocation and reform processes. Establishment of water resource management structures led by VOCMA and / or in partnership with National, provincial and local government to ensure integration and participation of all affected and interested parties. Ensure effective establishment and operation of Water Management Institutions. Develop the requirements and guidelines for water management institutions functioning and perform the institutional regulation and oversight. Reviewing and approving water management institutions’ business plans as well as oversight of water management institutions’ operations against annual reports and business plans. Support the transformation agenda of VOCMA and facilitate access to VOCMA programmes designed for water users and historically disadvantaged groups. Support strategic and business planning. Supervise staff in accordance with VOCMA policies and procedures.
jobs.applications: Interested applicants must submit their applications via the online link https://erecruitment.dws.gov.za
jobs.notes: Other related documentation such as copies of qualifications, identity documents, driver’s license etc need not to accompany the application when applying for a post as such documentation must only be produced by shortlisted candidates during the interview date in line with DPSA circular 19 of 2022. With reference to applicants bearing professional or occupational registration, fields provided in Part B on the online Z83 must be completed as these fields are regarded as compulsory. Failure to complete or disclose all required information will automatically disqualify the applicant. No late applications will be accepted. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to suitability checks (SAQA verification, reference checks criminal and credit checks). SAQA evaluation certificate must accompany foreign qualifications (only when shortlisted). Applications that do not comply with the above- mentioned requirements will not be considered. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Candidates will be required to complete a financial disclosure form and undergo security clearance. Foreigners or dual citizenship holders must provide a police clearance certificate from country of origin (only when shortlisted). The Vaal-Orange Catchment Management Agency is a Public Water Resource Management Agency, established in line with the provisions of the National Water Act, 1998 (Act no 36 of 1998) (NWA) and National Water Policy for South Africa. It is an entity of the National Department of Water and Sanitation. Employees appointed in the CMA have similar employment terms and conditions as those of employees appointed in terms of the Public Service Act, though not employed in terms of the Public Service Act. If you do not hear from us within three (3) months of this advertisement, please accept that your application has been unsuccessful. Faxed applications will not be considered. The agency reserves the right not to fill these positions. Women and persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply and preference will be given to the EE Targets. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Instellings, Belanghebbende-betrokkenheid
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur benodig in Bloemfontein om waterbestuursbeleid te ontwikkel en te implementeer en belanghebbendes te betrek, met 'n graad en vier tot ses jaar se ervaring as vereiste.
af.requirements: 'n Bachelor se graad of gelykwaardig in Sosiale Wetenskappe of verwante omgewing. Vier (4) tot ses (6) jaar se relevante ervaring. Bewese vermoë om beleid en strategie te interpreteer en te implementeer. Ervaring ten opsigte van intergouvernementele betrekkinge, samewerkende regering, instellingsstruktuurbestuur, regulasie en bemarking. Ervaring in projeks- en programbestuur. Bewese vermoë om probleme op te los en gedemonstreerde besluitnemingsvermoë. Vermoë om met 'n verskeidenheid belanghebbendes insluitend gemeenskappe te kommunikeer. Ervaring in die vestiging van Waterbestuursinstellings (Watergebruikersverenigings, Opvangsgebiedbestuursagentskappe en Opvangsgebiedbestuursforums). Vermoë om vennootskappe tussen regerings, nie-regeringsbelanghebbendes te smee en goeie interpersoonlike vaardighede. Uitstekende mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Kennis van die Nasionale Waterwet (1998). 'n Geldige onverstreke bestuurderslisensie en bereidwilligheid om uitgebreid te reis.
af.duties: Verseker effektiewe ontwikkeling en implementering van VOCMA-beleid en -strategieë. Verseker integrasie van gemarginaliseerde en voorheen benadeelde watergebruikers / belanghebbendes in waterheffingbepaling, watertoekenning en hervormingsprosesse. Vestiging van waterhulpbronbestuursstrukture gelei deur VOCMA en / of in vennootskap met Nasionale, provinsiale en plaaslike regering om integrasie en deelname van alle geaffekteerde en geïnteresseerde partye te verseker. Verseker effektiewe vestiging en werking van Waterbestuursinstellings. Ontwikkel die vereistes en riglyne vir die funksionering van waterbestuursinstellings en voer die instellingsregulering en toesig uit. Hersiening en goedkeuring van waterbestuursinstellings se besigheidsplanne asook toesig oor waterbestuursinstellings se bedrywighede teenoor jaarverslae en besigheidsplanne. Ondersteun die transformasie-agenda van VOCMA en fasiliteer toegang tot VOCMA-programme wat vir watergebruikers en histories benadeelde groepe ontwerp is. Ondersteun strategiese en besigheidsbeplanning. Onderrig personeel in ooreenstemming met VOCMA-beleid en -prosedures.

zu.title: Onkosikazi Oncane: Izikhungo, Ukuxhumana Nabahlanganyeli
zu.summary: Kudingeka Onkosikazi Oncane eBloemfontein ukuthuthukisa futhi asebenzise izinqubomgomo zokuphathwa kwamanzi nokuxhumana nabahlanganyeli, kudingeka iziqu neminyaka yokuqhuba ukusuka kune kuya kuyisithupha.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-bachelor noma okulinganayo kwi-Social Sciences noma emikhakheni ehlobene nayo. Ukuthola iminyaka emine (4) kuya kweyisithupha (6) yokuqhuba okuhlobene nalesi sikhundla. Ukukwazi ukutolikwa nokusebenziswa kwenqubomgomo noma isu. Ukuqhuba mayelana nezindinganiso zohulumeni abahlanganyele, ukuphathwa ngokubambisana, ukuphathwa kwezakhiwo zezikhungo, ukulawula kanye nokumaketha. Ukuqhuba ekuphathweni kwezinhlelo kanye namaphrojekhi. Ukukwazi ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokukwazi ukwenza izinqumo. Ukukwazi ukuxhumana nabahlanganyeli abahlukene kubantu bendawo. Ukuqhuba ekusekweni kwezikhungo zokuphathwa kwamanzi (Water Users Association, Catchment Management Agencies kanye ne-Catchment Management Forums). Ukukwazi ukwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kohulumene, abahlanganyeli abangeyona bohulumene kanye nobuso obuhle bokuxhumana nabantu. Ukukwazi ukukhuluma nokubhala kahle. Ukwazi ngo-National Water Act (1998). Ilayisense lokushayela elisebenzayo kanye nokuzimisela ukuhamba kakhulu.
zu.duties: Qinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa nokusetshenziswa okusebenzayo kwezinqubomgomo nama-su e-VOCMA. Qinisekisa ukubandakanywa kwabasebenzisi bamanzi abayizigcugcu kanye nalabo ababenengcakuzu ngaphambilini ekwenqumeni inani lemfuyo yamanzi, ekwesweni amanzi kanye kwiNqubo zenguquko. Ukusekwa kwezakhiwo zokuphathwa kwemithombo yamanzi eziholelwa i-VOCMA futhi noma ngokubambisana nohulumende kazwelonke, ozifunda nasedolobheni ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukubandakanyeka nokuthatha inhlangothi yabo bonke abathintekayo nabakuthandayo. Qinisekisa ukusekwa nokusebenza okuhle kwezikhungo zokuphathwa kwamanzi. Thuthukisa izidingo kanye nomhlahlandlela wokusebenza kwezikhungo zokuphathwa kwamanzi futhi wenze ukulawula nokugqamisa izikhungo. Ukuhlola futhi uvume amapulani wezikhungo zokuphathwa kwamanzi kanye nokugqamisa imisebenzi yezikhungo zokuphathwa kwamanzi mayelana namapulani nemibiko yonyaka. Sekela iNqubo yenguquko ye-VOCMA futhi uhlinzeke ngokufinyelela kumaphrogramu e-VOCMA ahlelwe abasebenzisi bamanzi kanye namagumbi ababengenako ngaphambilini. Sekela iplani yesu nekwezoshishino. Lawula abasebenzi ngokuvumelana nezinqubomgomo kanye namaphroseduri e-VOCMA.

xh.title: Umncedisi weNgqondo: Iindlela ezahlukeneyo, Umanyano lwamalungu
xh.summary: Kufuneka umncedisi weNgqondo kwiZiko lezeNkululeko eBloemfontein ukuze aphuhlise aze asebenzise iinkqubo zolawulo lwamanzi ajonge ulwalamano namalungu ahlukeneyo, kwaye kufuneka abe nedyuma kwiiNqanaba ezahlukeneyo zenqanaba lesiXhenxe kwaye abe neminyaka elishumi elinesibini ukuya kwaye ngaphezulu kwamashumi amathathu yamava ahambelanayo.
xh.requirements: Isidanga se-Bachelor okwa silinganayo kwiiSayensi zeZeMveli okunye endaweni ehlobene nayo. Amanye amashumi amabini anesine (4) ukuya kwamashumi amathandathu (6) yeminyaka yamava ahambelanayo. Ulwazi olubonwayo lokuphonononga nokusebenzisa iinkqubo nemigaqo ezahlukeneyo. Amava ngokwamanya urhulumente nakunye namanye amalungu ahlukeneyo. Isakhono esibonwayo sokwazi ukusebenzisa iindlela ezahlukeneyo zeenkqubo, ukuqamba iindlela ezintsha nokusebenzisa iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo. Ulwazi lokulawula iinkqubo neenkqubo ezahlukeneyo. Isakhono esibonwayo sokuxazulula iingxaki nokuzimisela ukwenza izigqibo. Isakhono sokunxibelelwana namalungu ahlukeneyo kuquka iindawo ezahlukene. Amava ekwaziseni iindlela ezahlukeneyo zolawulo lwamanzi. Isakhono sokwakha urhulumente nakunye namanye amalungu ahlukeneyo. Ulwazi oluhle lokunxibelelwana ngelivi nangesibhelo. Ulwazi lweNkqubo yezeLwandle yoMhla (1998). Ilayisenisi yokushuka elisebenzayo nokuzimisela ukuhamba njalo.
xh.duties: Ukuqinisekisa ukuphuhliswa nokusebenziswa kwakho konke okusemthethweni okulungelelanisiweyo. Ukuphuhliswa nokusebenziswa kweNkqubo ezahlukeneyo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukubandakanyeka koluntu olucwaswe ngaphambili ekusebenziseni amanzi. Ukusekwa kweenkqubo ezahlukeneyo ngokutsho kweNkqubo yokuqinisekisa amanzi ukuba azahlule ngokomthetho. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba ngokubanzi konke okusemthethweni kusebenza ngokuchanekileyo. Ukusebenzisa amanyathelo athile ukuze kusebenze ngokuchanekileyo. Ukusebenzisa amanye amandla okuqinisekisa amanzi ukuba akwazi ukusebenza. Ukwakha nokusebenzisa amagosa athile. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba ngokubanzi kusebenza ngokuchanekileyo. Ukuphuhliswa kweenkqubo ezahlukeneyo. Ukuqinisekisa ukusebenza ngokuchanekileyo ngokwemigaqo yaseNgingqi.

af.title: Regstellende Regsadministratiewe Beampte (MR5)
af.summary: Regsadministratiewe beampte wat regsondersteuning verskaf, adviese opstel en oortredings van die National Water Act vervolg vir die Department of Water and Sanitation in Bloemfontein.
af.requirements: LLB of 'n relevante kwalifikasie. Ten minste agt (8) jaar se toepaslike post-kwalifikasie regsonderwerping. Vereiste bevoegdhede: Kennis en ervaring van beleidsontwikkeling en -implementering, openbare sektor regsprosesse, wetgewing en kontrakte, PAIA, PAJA, die Grondwet en alle relevante wetgewing. Kennis van Tesourie-regulasies. Vermoë om te onderhandel en kontrakte en internasionale instrumente op te stel. Vermoë om spesifieke omgewingswetgewing, kwessies wat die omgewing raak en algemene omgewingsreg te interpreteer word vereis. Kennis van die Public Finance Management Act. Regsnavorsing en -interpretasie. Analitiese vaardighede. Verslagskrywing. Program- en projekbestuur. Rekenaargeletterdheid. Goeie beplannings- en besluitnemingsvaardighede. Taalvaardigheid. Vertroulikheid. Uitstekende kommunikasievaardighede (skriftelik en mondelings). Strategiese vermoë en leierskapsvaardighede. Verantwoordelikheid en Etiese Gedrag.
af.duties: Verskaf regsondersteuning om nakoming van relevante wetgewing te verseker. Ontwikkel standaard bedryfsprosedures. Adviseer en stel regsadviese en dokumente op om strafregvervolgings vir oortredings van die National Water Act te ondersteun. Stel regsdokumente, memoranda, verslae en voorleggings op. Stel kontrakte namens die entiteit op, ondersoek en hersien dit. Adviseer, onderhandel en stel multilaterale en bilaterale ooreenkomste op. Hanteer litigasiesake en appèlle namens die CMA. Lewer regsondersteuning by alle litigasiesake. Ontwikkel ingrypings waar uitdagings ondervind word. Monitor die implementering van die Promotion of Access to Information Act, 2000 en die Promotion of Administrative Justice Act, 2000 in die CMA. Hanteer PAIA- en PAJA-sake namens die CMA.

zu.title: IOfisa Wezomthetho Wokuphatha (MR5)
zu.summary: IOfisa Wezomthetho Wokuphatha oboneza inkxaso yomthetho, abhalwe imibono yomthetho futhi esusa imitatshana ye-National Water Act ku-Department of Water and Sanitation e-Bloemfontein.
zu.requirements: I-LLB noma izifundo ezihambisanayo. Okungenani amashumi lasishiyagalombye (8) eminyaka yamava womthetho okufanele emva kokuthola izifundo. Izici ezidingekayo: Ulwazi namava ngokuqhakambiswa nokusetshenziswa kwenqubomgomo, inqubo yomthetho yomkhakha wabezimali ngawowonke umnyango, umthetho namasheya, i-PAIA, i-PAJA, umthethosisekelo nayo yonke imithetho ephathelene nalokho. Ulwazi ngomthetho weTreasury. Ikono lokuxoxisana nokubhala amasheya namathuluzi anamaphesheya. Isidingo sokuba nangqondo yokuphikoza imithetho emayelana namathonya, izinto ezithinta imvelo kanye nomthetho jikelele wemvelo. Ulwazi ngomthetho we-Public Finance Management Act. Ukuphicoza nokuhumusha komthetho. Amakhono okuhlaziya. Ukubhala kwezibalo. Ukuphatha izinhlelo namaphrojekthi. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amakhono amahle okucubungula nokwenza izinqumo. Ukukhuluma ulimi kahle. Ukugcina imfihlo. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana (okubhaliwe nokukhulunywa). Ikono lokubuka phambili kanye namakhono okuba ngumholi. Ukubhekana nomthwalo wemisebenzi kanye nokuziphatha ngokuzithoba.
zu.duties: Nika inkxaso yomthetho ukuze kuqiniseke ukulandela imithetho ephathelene nalokho. Qakambisa inqubo ejwayelekile yokusebenza. Nikeza izeluleko ubhale imibono yomthetho namadokhumenti ukuze useke ukushaya iziqalekiso ezingezomthetho ngokwephula i-National Water Act. Bhala amadokhumenti womthetho, imemoranda, izibalo nezicelo. Bhala, hlola ubuyekeze amasheya ngenkomba yale ndawo. Nikeza izeluleko, xoxa ubhale izivumelwano ezenza ngasobunye kanye nangaphandle. Phatha izindaba zokushaywa iziqalekiso nokulalelwa kwamacala ngenkomba ye-CMA. Nikeza inkxaso yomthetho kuyo yonke imicimbe yokulalelwa kanye nokushaywa kwezicala. Qakambisa izinyathelo lapho kuvela khona izinselele. Qapha ukusetshenziswa komthetho we-Promotion of Access to Information Act, 2000 kanye no-Promotion of Administrative Justice Act, 2000 kwi-CMA. Phatha izindaba ze-PAIA ne-PAJA ngenkomba ye-CMA.

xh.title: Iofisi yoMlawulo wezomthetho (MR5)
xh.summary: Iofisi yoMlawulo wezomthetho enika inkxaso yomthetho, ezibalula iimboniso kwaye ebandakanya ekuqwalaselweni kolwaphulo-mthetho lwoMthetho wezeZicziba zeSizwe kwisebe lezeManzi nokuQhwesha eBloemfontein.
xh.requirements: Isiqinisekiso se-LLB okanye isiqinisekiso esifanelekileyo. Ubuncinane elishumi elininzi (8) leminyaka yamava amthetho afanelekileyo emva kokuqinisekiswa. Ikhomphethensi efunekayo: Ulwazi namava ngophuhliso nokuzezelwa kweenqongo, iinkqubo zamthetho kwicala likarhulumente, umthethowezivumelwano, i-PAIA, i-PAJA, uMthethosiseko nayo yonke imithetho ehambelana nayo. Ulwazi ngomthetho wezeNkxaso mali. Amandla okuxoxa nokuzeza iinkonzo ezahlukeneyo nezixhobo zamazwe ngamazwe. Amandla okuchaza imithetho ethile yendalo, iingxaki ezichaphazela indalo nomthetho jikelele wendalo ayafuneka. Ulwazi ngoMthetho woLawulo lweMali kaRhulumente. Uphononongo lolwandiso lomthetho. Amandla okuhlola. Ukubhala iingxelo. Ulawulo lweenkqubo namaprojekthi. Ukuzigqatsa kwekhompyutha. Amandla amabenathiwokuncuma nokwenza izigqibo. Ukuhlakanipa kolwimi. Eqhotsiweyo. Amandla aphezulu okunxibelelan (okubhaliweyo nangomlomo). Amandla okuzama ngakumbi noqhankqalazo lokulawula. Ukwenza iingxelo nokuziphatha ngokusesikweni.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso yomthetho ukuqinisekisa ukuthobela imithetho ehambelana nayo. Puhlisa iinkqubo zokuqhuba ngokwasemthethweni. Celisa kwaye uzibhale iimboniso zamthetho namaxwebhu ukuze uxhase amacala obundlobongela ngokuchasene noMthetho wezeZicziba zeSizwe. Bhala amaxwebhu omthetho, iimemo, iingxelo nokuqukumbela. Bhala, kuphondoze kwaye uqwalasele iinkonzo ewangcwele ihlabathi ngokwerhwebo. Celisa, yinxoxe kwaye uzibhale iivumelwano ezininzi nosisini-bini. Umathelathelo neengxoxo zamacala ihlala ngokwerhwebo lama-CMA. Zinika inkxaso yomthetho kuzo zonke iingxoxo zemithetho. Yakhiwe iindlela ezingangenwa xa kubakho iingxoxo eziyoyikeka. Yithobe ukusetyenziswa koMthetho wokuNxululwa kweInkcazelo ngokwenene, 2000 noMthetho wokwenziswa kolawulo lwesimo somthetho, 2000 kwi-CMA. Phatha iindaba ezize i-PAIA ne-PAJA ngokwerhwebo lama-CMA.

jobs.title: Senior Human Resource Practitioner
jobs.summary: Senior Human Resource Practitioner sought in Bloemfontein to facilitate recruitment and selection, prepare shortlisting schedules, and draft appointment submissions for the Department of Water and Sanitation.
jobs.requirements: A National Diploma at (NQF) level 6 in Human Resources Management or relevant qualification with majors in Human Resource Management. Three (3) to four (4) years’ experience in specialisation in Recruitment and Selection and OSD appointment procedures. Experience in developing and managing data tracking systems and reporting on progress of filling of posts. Knowledge and experience in drafting reports and submissions. Knowledge and experience of administrative, clerical procedures and systems. Knowledge and understanding of Human Resource Management legislation, policies, practices, procedures and Human Resource Planning. Knowledge of equal opportunities and affirmative action guidelines and laws. Understanding of socio-economic and development issues. Extensive exposure to OSD recruitment processes, verifications and knowledge and understanding of the OSD Framework. Problem solving and decision-making skills. Good communication and presentation skills (written and verbal). Strong negotiation and conflict management skills.
jobs.duties: Facilitate Recruitment and Selection processes. Prepare detailed schedules (long list), score sheets and applications from the Z83 application system. Supply statistics regarding employment equity. Facilitate the shortlisting and interview processes. Draft appointment submissions and route for approval. Render a human resource advisory service to line managers on recruitment and selection. Ensure that OSD appointments are done in compliance with the OSD Framework. Ensure personal suitability checks. Ensure the promotion of effective human resource management. Ensure that policies / legislations / prescripts are followed and complied with during the recruitment and selection process. Monitoring and evaluation of all HR processes, supervision, training and motivation of staff. Co-ordinate and conduct investigations of human resource related problems and advise management accordingly. Management of Human Resources which include, staff and work allocation to subordinates. Management of the recruitment and selection database.
jobs.applications: Interested applicants must submit their applications via the online link https://erecruitment.dws.gov.za
jobs.notes: Other related documentation such as copies of qualifications, identity documents, driver’s license etc need not to accompany the application when applying for a post as such documentation must only be produced by shortlisted candidates during the interview date in line with DPSA circular 19 of 2022. With reference to applicants bearing professional or occupational registration, fields provided in Part B on the online Z83 must be completed as these fields are regarded as compulsory. Failure to complete or disclose all required information will automatically disqualify the applicant. No late applications will be accepted. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to suitability checks (SAQA verification, reference checks criminal and credit checks). SAQA evaluation certificate must accompany foreign qualifications (only when shortlisted). Applications that do not comply with the above- mentioned requirements will not be considered. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Candidates will be required to complete a financial disclosure form and undergo security clearance. Foreigners or dual citizenship holders must provide a police clearance certificate from country of origin (only when shortlisted). The Vaal-Orange Catchment Management Agency is a Public Water Resource Management Agency, established in line with the provisions of the National Water Act, 1998 (Act no 36 of 1998) (NWA) and National Water Policy for South Africa. It is an entity of the National Department of Water and Sanitation. Employees appointed in the CMA have similar employment terms and conditions as those of employees appointed in terms of the Public Service Act, though not employed in terms of the Public Service Act. If you do not hear from us within three (3) months of this advertisement, please accept that your application has been unsuccessful. Faxed applications will not be considered. The agency reserves the right not to fill these positions. Women and persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply and preference will be given to the EE Targets. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Senior Menslike Hulpbronpraktisyn
af.summary: Senior Menslike Hulpbronpraktisyn gesoek in Bloemfontein om werwing en keuring te fasiliteer, kortlysskedules voor te berei en aanstellingsvoorleggings op te stel vir die Department of Water and Sanitation.
af.requirements: 'n Nasionale Diploma op (NQF) vlak 6 in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur of 'n relevante kwalifikasie met hoofvakke in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur. Drie (3) tot vier (4) jaar se ervaring in spesialisering in Werwing en Keuring en OSD-aansteltingsprosedures. Ervaring in die ontwikkeling en bestuur van datavolgstelsels en verslagdoening oor vordering met die vul van poste. Kennis en ervaring in die opstel van verslae en voorleggings. Kennis en ervaring van administratiewe, klerklike prosedures en stelsels. Kennis en begrip van Menslike Hulpbronbestuurwetgewing, beleide, praktyke, prosedures en Menslike Hulpbronbeplanning. Kennis van gelyke geleenthede en regstellende aksie-riglyne en wette. Begrip van sosio-ekonomiese en ontwikkelingskwessies. Uitgebreide blootstelling aan OSD-werwingsprosesse, verifikasies en kennis en begrip van die OSD-raamwerk. Probleemoplossing en besluitnemingsvaardighede. Goeie kommunikasie en voorleggingsvaardighede (skriftelik en mondelings). Sterk onderhandelings- en konflikbestuursvaardighede.
af.duties: Fasiliteer Werwing en Keuringsprosesse. Berei gedetailleerde skedules (lang lys), tellyste en aansoeke vanuit die Z83-aansoekstelsel voor. Verskaf statistiek rakende indiensnemingsgelykheid. Fasiliteer die kortlysskuiwer en onderhoudprosesse. Stel aanstellingsvoorleggings op en stuur dit vir goedkeuring. Lewer 'n menslike hulpbronadviesdiens aan lynbestuurders oor werwing en keuring. Verseker dat OSD-benoemings gedoen word in ooreenstemming met die OSD-raamwerk. Verseker persoonlike geskiktheidskontroles. Verseker die bevordering van effektiewe menslike hulpbronbestuur. Verseker dat beleide / wetgewing / voorskrifte gevolg en nagekom word tydens die werwing en keuringsproses. Monitering en evaluering van alle HR-prosesse, toesig, opleiding en motivering van personeel. Koördineer en voer ondersoeke uit na menslike hulpbronverwante probleme en gee dienooreenkomstig advies aan bestuur. Bestuur van Menslike Hulpbronne wat insluit, personeel- en werktoewysing aan ondergeskiktes. Bestuur van die werwing en keuringsdatabasis.

zu.title: Umuntu Ohlakaniphile Ophethe Izindaba Zabasebenzi Esibangeli
zu.summary: Kufunwa umuntu ohlakaniphile ophethe izindaba zabasebenzi esibangeli eBloemfontein ukuba ahole ekubumbeni nasekhethweni zabantu, alungise izincwadi zokubeka abantu ohlwini abafanelekile, abhale izincomo zokumiswa kubantu abasha koMnyango Wezamanzi Nokuhlanzwa Kwendawo.
zu.requirements: I-Diploma Yezwe ezingeni le-(NQF) 6 ekuphatweni kwezinsiza zabantu noma iziqu ezifanele ezinamagatsha ekuphatweni kwezinsiza zabantu. Ukuhlolwa kweminyaka eyithathu (3) kuya kune (4) yamava ekusebenzeni ngenkambu yokubumba nokukhetha kanye namalebula okumisa abantu ngendlela ye-OSD. Ulwazi ngokwakha nokuphatha izinhlelo zokulandela idatha nokubika ngentuthuko yokuvala izikhundla. Ulwazi nolwazi kwimibhalo nokuzincoma. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yebhurokrasi nendlela ezisebenza ngayo. Ulwazi nokuqonda ngemithetho ekuphatweni kwezinsiza zabantu, izinqubomgomo, izindlela zokwenza izinto, kanye nokuqamba izinhlelo zabantu. Ulwazi ngezezimo ezilinganayo kanye noMgugulo Wamathuba Mabili kanye nezinyathelo zemithetho. Ukuqonda ngemibuzo eziphatelene nokuqashwa komnotho kanye nentuthuko. Ukwaziswa kakhulu ngeminyuzulo yokubumba abantu abasha kwinkambu ye-OSD, ukuhlola ukubhekana kwezinto, kanye nokuqonda inkandla ye-OSD. Ikhono lokuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokwenza izinqumo. Ikhono elihle lokuthetha nabantu nokuzethula (okubhalayo nakukhulunywayo). Ikhono elikhulu lokuxoxisana nokuphatha izinxantela.
zu.duties: Ukuhola iminyuzulo yokubumba nokukhetha abantu. Ukulungisa izincwadi eziyisibopho ezinemininingwane (uhlu oludele), amakhasi okubhala amaphuzu, kanye nezicelo ezivela kuhlelo lokusebenza lwe-Z83. Ukuhlathaza ngobuningi bezibalo ukulingana ekusebenzeni. Ukuhola iminyuzulo yokuqasha nabantu abafanelekile kanye nesikhathi sokuxoxa nabo. Ukubhala izincomo zokumisa abantu abasha kuyakuthi kuthunyelwe bathole isigunyaziso. Ukunikela ngomsebenzi wokuncokola abaphathi ngemiyalo ngokubumba nokukhetha. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba abantu abashwa ngesikathi se-OSD kwenziwa ngendlela efanele lapha ebekiweyo yiNkandla ye-OSD. Ukuqinisekisa ukuqinisekiswa kwemfaneleko yomuntu. Ukuqinisekisa ukukhuthazwa kogqoqo elihle lokuphathwa kwezinsiza zabantu. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba izinqubomgomo / imithetho / imiyalo ilandelwe futhi ihlonishwe esimweni sokubumba nokukhetha. Ukugcina amehlo kanye nokuqamba imibuzo yonke iminyuzulo yezindaba zabantu, ukugcina izingqapheli, ukufundisa kanye nokukhuthaza abasebenzi. Ukuhola iminyuzulo yokuxazulula imibuzo ephathelene nezinsiza zabantu nokuxoxa ngayo ngenkambu ekutheni umphathi. Ukuphatha izinsiza zabantu okubandakanya ukuhlakaniphisa abasebenzi ukubasebenzise. Ukuphatha idatha yokubumba nokukhetha.

xh.title: Omgangatho Ophezulu Womsebenzi Wamathala Abasebenzi
xh.summary: Kufuneki kungamiselwe Omgangatho Ophezulu Womsebenzi Wamathala Abasebenzi eBloemfontein ukwenza lula inqubo yokubanga abantu nokukhetha, ukulungula iinkqubo zoluhlu lwabangenileyo, nokubhala izibhalo zokuqesha abantu kwiSebe leZamanzi nokuQhotyiswa.
xh.requirements: I-National Diploma kumqondo we-(NQF) inqanaba le-6 kwabaphathi bamathala abasebenzi okanye isiqu esifanelekileyo ngeentlobo ezinkulu kwabaphathi bamathala abasebenzi. Iiminyaka emithathu (3) kuneyane (4) yamava kwinto ekhethekileyo ekubeni nabantu nakukhethwa iinkqubo zokuqesha abantu kwi-OSD. Amava ekujolweni nokulawula iinkqubo zokulandela ulwazi nokuvelisa iingxelo ngentlalo yokuvala izithuba. Ulwazi namava ekubhalweni kwengxelo neesibhalo. Ulwazi namava ngolawulo lwebhala ngezikhokelo ezibhalwayo nemiqathango. Ulwizi nokuqonda ngomthetho wepholisi, iinkqubo, iindlela namacebo okulawula amathala abasebenzi noBulelo abalulekileyo bamathala abasebenzi. Ulwazi ngamagunya alinganayo namacebo okuziphendulela ngokwemithetho yolawulo lwabantu abantsundu. Ukuqonda ngengxaki zentlalo-zoqoqoskela nentlalo-phononongo. Ukuvezwa okukhulu kumalunga neenkqubo zokuqesha abantu kwi-OSD, ukuqinisekiswa kolwazi nokuqonda ngokuqengqeleka kwe-OSD. Amakhono okusombulula iingxaki nokwenza izigqibo. Amakhono amahle okuthetha nokubonisa (okubhaliweyo nokuTHethwa). Amakhono amakhulu okuziqhelanisa nokulawula iingxabano.
xh.duties: Yenza lula iinkqubo zokuqesha abantu nokukhethwa. Lungela iinkqubo ezibalulekileyo (uludwe olude), amaphephana amanani namagama avakaliswa kwinkqubo yokumamkela i-Z83. Nikela ngeentatho ngokulingana kwamathala abasebenzi. Yenza lula iinkqubo zoluhlu lwabangenileyo nayemibuzo yokudibana. Bhala izibhalo zokuqesha abantu ukuze zithunyelwe kuvunywa. Nikezelwa ngoncedo ngolwazi kwabaphathi begosa malunga nokubakho nokukhethwa kwabantu. Qinisekisa ukuba amagama abantu abayiwa kwi-OSD ayenziwa ngokuhambelana nomthetho we-OSD Framework. Qinisekisa ukuhlolwa kokuziphatha komntu. Qinisekisa ukukhuthazwa kolawulo olusebenzayo lwamathala abasebenzi. Qinisekisa ukuba iipholisi/omthetho/iimpawu zelandelwa kwaye zihambelana ngexesha lokuqesha nokukhethwa kwabantu. Okokulandela nokuqwalasela zonke iinkqubo ze-HR, ukulawula, ukulolonga nokuqinisekisa abasebenzi. Lawula uze uphehlele ezindabeni ezingxaki zamathala abasebenzi ukuze uxelele abaphathi ngokufanelekileyo. Ulawulo lwamathala abasebenzi oluquka ulwabiwo lwabasebenzi nomsebenzi kubantu abangaphantsi kwakho. Ulawulo lwedata yokuqesha nokukhetha abantu.

jobs.title: Senior Administrative Officer (WARMS)
jobs.summary: Senior Administrative Officer needed in Kimberley to oversee data capturing and office administration for water use registration under the National Water Act.
jobs.requirements: A National Diploma or Degree in Administration or relevant qualification. Two (2) to Three (3) years’ data management and quality control experience. The candidate must be computer literate and have appropriate experience especially in word processing and spreadsheets. The disclosure of a valid unexpired driver’s license. Sound experience in WARMS. Proven organisational, interpersonal, conflict resolution, problem solving and analytical skills. Good verbal and written communication skills. Practical experience in a client service environment, letter and report writing. Knowledge of the National Water Act, (Act 36 of 1998) and other relevant legislations. Knowledge of the following will serve as recommendations: Ability to work under pressure. Working experience in working with spatial data.

Implement and interpret procedures in terms of the National Water Act, (Act 36 of 1998) for the registration of water use. Ensure that the standard operating procedures of VOCMA for WARMS are adhered to by date capturers. Provide training on water use registration. Produce statistical reports and ensure that file maintenance systems are maintained. Maintain discipline within the section. Supervise staff in accordance with VOCMA policies and procedures.

The agency reserves the right not to fill these positions. Women and persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply and preference will be given to the EE Targets. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Senior Administratiewe Beampte (WARMS)
af.summary: Senior Administratiewe Beampte word in Kimberley benodig om datavaslegging en kantooradministrasie vir watergebruikregistrasie ingevolge die National Water Act te oorsien.
af.requirements: 'n Nasionale Diploma of Graad in Administrasie of 'n relevante kwalifikasie. Twee (2) tot Drie (3) jaar se ervaring in databestuur en kwaliteitsbeheer. Die kandidaat moet rekenaargeletterd wees en toepaslike ervaring hê, veral in woordverwerking en sigblaaie. Die openbaarmaking van 'n geldige, ongeïgnoreerde bestuurslisensie. Klankervaring in WARMS. Bewese organisatoriese, interpersoonlike, konflikoplossings-, probleemoplossings- en analitiese vaardighede. Goeie mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Praktiese ervaring in 'n kliëntediensomgewing, asook die skryf van briewe en verslae. Kennis van die National Water Act, (Act 36 of 1998) en ander relevante wetgewing. Kennis van die volgende sal as aanbevelings dien: Vermoë om onder druk te werk. Werkervaring in die werk met ruimtelike data.
af.duties: Oorsien alle datavaslegging en algemene kantooradministrasie van die registrasie van watergebruik. Onderneem die algehele beplanning van werkvloei. Magtig transaksies in WARMS. Implementeer en interpreteer prosedures ingevolge die National Water Act, (Act 36 of 1998) vir die registrasie van watergebruik. Verseker dat die standaard bedryfsprosedures van VOCMA vir WARMS deur datavasleggers nagekom word. Verskaf opleiding oor watergebruikregistrasie. Produseer statistiese verslae en verseker dat lêeronderhoudstelsels in stand gehou word. Handhaaf dissipline binne die afdeling. Oorsien personeel in ooreenstemming met VOCMA-beleide en prosedures.

zu.title: Isikhulu Esiphezulu Sezolawulo (WARMS)
zu.summary: Isikhulu Esiphezulu Sezolawulo sifuna eKimberley ukuphatha ukungeniswa kwemininingwane nokulawulwa kwezofisi ekubhalisweni kokusetshenziswa kwamanzi ngaphansi kweNational Water Act.
zu.requirements: I-National Diploma noma i-Degree kuzolawulo noma izifundo ezihambisanayo. Ubungozi beminyaka emibili (2) kuyekuthathu (3) ekuphatheni imininingwane nasekolweni lokulawula ikhwalithi. Umphakeli kufanele ukuthi akwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha abe nokuhlangabezana okufanele ikakhulukazi ekushayeni amadokhumenti nakumatafuleni. Ukwenza okuyisihluthulelo kolayisensi yokushayela evumelekile engaphelelwe yisikhathi. Ulwazi oluhle kuWARMS. Amandla okuhlelwa, okuhlobana nabantu, okuxazulula izinkinga, okuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuhlaziya izinto abakufundise ngokwenza. Amandla kahle okuxoxa ngomlomo nangokubhala. Ulwazi lokwenza okusebenzayo emazweni okukhonza abathengi, ukubhala izincwadi namabhiko. Ulwazi ngeNational Water Act, (Act 36 of 1998) kanye nezinye izimiso ezihambisanayo. Ulwazi ngokulandelayo luzothathwa njengengxenye yezincomo: Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwegcindo. Ulwazi lokusebenza emininingwaneni esikhundleni.
zu.duties: Qaphela ukungeniswa kwakho konke imininingwane nokuqondiswa kwesofisi ejwayelekile ekubhalisweni kokusetshenziswa kwamanzi. Thatha ihlelo eliphelele lomsebenzi. Vuma izinkomba ezenzayo kuWARMS. Faka futhi uchaze izindlela ngokweNational Water Act, (Act 36 of 1998) ekubhalisweni kokusetshenziswa kwamanzi. Qiniseka ukuthi izindlela ezijwayelekile zokusebenza zeVOCMA zeWARMS zihlonishwa abangenisayo imininingwane. Nikeza ukholisiswa ekubhalisweni kokusetshenziswa kwamanzi. Hlola izibali ezibalo bese uqinisekisa ukuthi amasistimu okugcina amafayihlaliswa. Faka isikhathi emagatsheni ayingxenye. Qapha abasebenzi ngokomthetho wezinqubomgomo nezindlela zeVOCMA.

xh.title: I-Senior Administrative Officer (WARMS)
xh.summary: I-Senior Administrative Officer (WARMS) e-Kimberley ukuze aze aphathe ukuqulunqwa kwedata nolawulo lweofisi ngokubhaliso kokusetyenziswa kwamanzi phantsi komthetho weNational Water Act.
xh.requirements: I-National Diploma okanye i-Degree kulawulo okanye nelifanelekileyo. I-Mbari (3) ukuya kweshumi (3) yokuphatha idata namava okulawula ikhwalithi. Umama kufuneka akwazi i-computer aze abe namfanele nangokwakha amagama ngokukodwa nakunxibelelwano phakathi kwamagama namagama. Isaziso esifanelekileyo lesikhashana nengazange ipheleko lesitya sasemva. Umdla obukhulu kwi-WARMS. Iindlela ezibonakalisa zokuhlela ukuqhelana nabantu ekuxabaneni, ekunyanisekeni iingxaki nasekuyini iingxaki. Iindlela ezimhlophe ezikhangeleka ezisedula zokubhala. Amaposti
xh.duties: Qwalasela lonke ukuqulunqwa kwedata nolawulo jikelele lweofisi yobhaliso lokusetyenziswa kwamanzi. Thatha inkunzi yenkqubo yokuqulunqa umsebenzi. Vuma iinkcenkcesho kwi-WARMS. Zisebenzise interpreti iinkqubo ngokomthetho weNational Water Act, (Act 36 of 1998) wokubhalisa ukusetyenziswa kwamanzi. Qinisekisa ukuba iinkqubo ezisezantsi zokusebenza zika-VOCMA kwi-WARMS zilandwa ngabadibadi be-data. Nikeze uqeqesho ngokubhaliswa kokusetyenziswa kwamanzi. Velisa iingxelo ezibhekiswe kwizibalo qinisekisa ukuba iinkqubo zokulondoloza iifayile zigcinwayo ziyagcinwa. Phatha isithiyo ngokwemithelela kwindawo. Lawula abasebenzi ngokomthetho nangeenkqubo zika-VOCMA.

jobs.title: Information Technology Technician
jobs.summary: IT technician needed in Bloemfontein to provide end-user hardware, software and network support, manage logged calls and enforce IT policies within the Department of Water and Sanitation.
jobs.requirements: A National Diploma or Degree in Information Technology. Three (3) years appropriate experience in IT. The disclosure of a valid unexpired driver’s license. Certification in the following will be an added advantage: Certified Microsoft Engineer, Microsoft Certified Solutions Associate (MCSA) or Microsoft Certified Solutions Expert (MCSE). A+ and Network+ certification is required. Knowledge of Windows 7; Windows 8; Window 10; MS Office 2010, 2013 and Office 365; Symantec Ant-virus; Microsoft MS; Transversal systems (PERSAL, SAP and LOGIS) and ITIL will serve as an advantage. Willingness to travel to various remote sites and offices Competences: An in-depth knowledge of client server IT environment. Leadership qualities as well as strong customer service and interpersonal skills. Good computer knowledge and skills (Ms Word, Excel and PowerPoint). Ability to work under pressure. Good communication skills both verbal and written. Exposure to different business application platforms.
jobs.duties: Manage calls logged on the call management systems. Provision of end-user support with regards to hardware, software and network connectivity. Ensure that all IT policies, norms and standards are enforced. Perform quality control for the Local Area Network (LAN). Perform installation, maintenance and upgrading of computer hardware as second fault-finding identification. Install and upgrade software applications not performed by resources from the outsourced partner. Provide and maintain internet and e-mail client services. Ensure that antivirus software signature and operating systems patches are up to date. Initiate and co-ordinate the change control procedures. Provide technical input for training and development of computer end-user skills. Perform routine back-ups for all the available servers. Compile monthly performance reports. The appointees will be expected to perform overtime and standby duties when necessary as well as assist the Deputy Director: Regional Information Systems Support with all IT related tasks.

af.title: Inligtingstegnologetegnikus
af.summary: IT-tegnikus benodig in Bloemfontein om eindgebruiker-hardeware, sagteware en netwerksteun te verskaf, aangetekende oproepe te bestuur en IT-beleide binne die Department of Water and Sanitation af te dwing.
af.requirements: 'n Nasionale Diploma of Graad in Inligtingstegnologie. Drie (3) jaar toepaslike ervaring in IT. Die openbaring van 'n geldige, nie-verstreke bestuurderslisensie. Sertifisering in die volgende sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees: Certified Microsoft Engineer, Microsoft Certified Solutions Associate (MCSA) of Microsoft Certified Solutions Expert (MCSE). A+ en Network+ sertifisering word vereis. Kennis van Windows 7; Windows 8; Window 10; MS Office 2010, 2013 en Office 365; Symantec Ant-virus; Microsoft MS; Transversale stelsels (PERSAL, SAP en LOGIS) en ITIL sal 'n voordeel wees. Bereidwilligheid om na verskeie afgeleë terreine en kantore te reis. Bevoegdhede: Diepgaande kennis van 'n kliënt-bediener IT-omgewing. Leierskapskwaliteite asook sterk kliëntediens- en interpersoonlike vaardighede. Goeie rekenaarkennis en vaardighede (Ms Word, Excel en PowerPoint). Vermoë om onder druk te werk. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede beide mondeling en skriftelik. Blootstelling aan verskillende besigheidstoepassingsplatforms.
af.duties: Bestuur oproepe wat op die oproepbestuurstelsels aangeteken is. Verskaffing van eindgebruikersteun met betrekking tot hardeware, sagteware en netwerkverbinding. Verseker dat alle IT-beleide, norme en standaarde afgedwing word. Voer kwaliteitsbeheer uit vir die Local Area Network (LAN). Voer installasie, instandhouding en opgradering van rekenaarhardeware uit as tweede foutopsporing-identifikasie. Installeer en gradeer sagteweretoepassings op wat nie deur hulpbronne van die uitbesteeerde vennoot uitgevoer is nie. Verskaf en handhaaf internet- en e-poskliëntdienste. Verseker dat antivirus-sagteware-handtekeninge en bedryfstelsel-korrigeringslêers op datum is. Inisieer en koördineer die veranderingbeheerprosedures. Verskaf tegniese insette vir opleiding en ontwikkeling van rekenaar-eindgebruikervaardighede. Voer roetine-rugsteune uit vir alle beskikbare bedieners. Stel maandelikse prestasieverslae op. Die aangesteldes sal verwag word om oortyd en wagdienspligte te verrig wanneer nodig, asook om die Adjunkdirekteur: Streeksinligtingstelselsteun met alle IT-verwante take by te staan.

zu.title: Ithokinolojie Yolwazi Injiniya
zu.summary: Kudingeka injiniya ye-IT eBloemfontein ukuze inikeze inkuseleko yohwebo olungakahluki, isofthiwe nethuluzi lokuxhumanisa. Kudingeka uphathwe amakholi abhalisiwe futhi kuqinisiswe izinqubomgomo ze-IT ngaphakathi kweDepartment of Water and Sanitation.
zu.requirements: I-Diploma yezwe noma i-Degree ku-Information Technology. Iminyaka emithathu (3) yomlando obuzayo ku-IT. Ukwembula ilayisensi yokuqasha esevumelekileyo engagayipheli. Ukugqunywa kwemvume kulezo kuzongezwa okuthile okuhle: Certified Microsoft Engineer, Microsoft Certified Solutions Associate (MCSA) noma Microsoft Certified Solutions Expert (MCSE). Kudingeka ukugqunywa kwemvume kulezo A+ kanye ne-Network+. Ulwazi nge-Windows 7; Windows 8; Window 10; MS Office 2010, 2013 kanye ne-Office 365; Symantec Ant-virus; Microsoft MS; Transversal systems (PERSAL, SAP kanye ne-LOGIS) kanye ne-ITIL kuzobe kungumthombo wokuzuzisa. Ukuthanda ukuhamba ezindaweni ezahlukene futhi kumahhovisi. Ukuzwela: Ulwazi oluqhubekayo ngezindawo ezisebenza ngokomthengi noma njiniya. Izinto eziyisihluthulelo sokuba ngumholi, kanye nokusebenza kahle nabathengi kanye nolwazi lokuqhathanisa nabantu. Ulwazi oluhle kanye nesisuso sekhompyutha (MS Word, Excel kanye ne-PowerPoint). Isisuso sokusebenza ngaphansi kwezinga eliphezulu. Isisuso sokuxhumana kahle ngomlomo kanye nokuqhathanisa. Ulwazi ngamaphulatifomu ohwebo ahlukene.
zu.duties: Ukuphatha amakholi abhalisiwe kumaphulatifomu okuphatha amakholi. Ukunikeza inkuseleko kubasebenzisi ngaphakathi kwezinsizakalo zohwebo noma isofthiwe nethuluzi lokuxhumanisa. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinqubomgomo, izimiso nezindinganiso ze-IT ziyagcinwa. Ukuwenza isibalo sokuhlolwa kwemvela ngaphakathi kwethuluzi lokuxhumanisa ngaphakathi (Local Area Network - LAN). Ukwenza ukufakwa, ukugcinwa kanye nokuqasha isofthiwe noma uhwebo olungakahluki ngendlela yesibili yokuthola inkinga. Ukufaka kanye nokuqasha isofthiwe okungalwenziwa ngaphandle kwabafakiwe abavela kumapulathi. Ukunikeza kanye nokugcina isifundo se-intanethi nese-imeyili. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi uhwebo lokubeka igunya lolwazi kanye nezilungiselelo zohlelo lokusebenza zisesikhundleni. Ukuqala nokuhlanganisa izinqubo zokushintsha izimpilo. Ukunikeza ulwazi olusetshenziswa ekufundiseni nasekuthuthukiseni izisuso zabasebenzisi bekhompyutha. Ukwenza isibalo sokugcina imininingo yazo zonke izinto ezingakahluliwe. Ukuqamba umbiko wenyanga ngeminye yemisebenzi. Abasebenziswa bazobe bethembeleke ukwenza umsebenzi ngaphezulu noma ukusebenza ngaphandle kwesikhathi esijwayelekile uma kunesidingo, futhi basekela uMjoni: Regional Information Systems Support ngeminye yemisebenzi ehlobene ne-IT.

xh.title: Umntu Oqhelanayo Nolwazi LweTeknoloji Yolwazi
xh.summary: Kufuneka abe ngumntu oqhelanayo nolwazi lweteknoloji yolwazi kwiBloemfontein ukuba anike inkxaso yabasebenzisi ngekhompyutha, isoftware nanethiwekhi, aphule amagama abhalwe ngayo yaye awenze amagama obulungisa krwada ngaphakathi kwiDepartment of Water and Sanitation.
xh.requirements: I-National Diploma okanye i-Degree kwiziNzululwazi ZeTeknoloji Yolwazi. Iinyanga ezintathu (3) zeminyaka yamava afanelekileyo kwinkqubo yonikezelo lolwazi ngekhompyutha. Ukutyhila ilayisensi yokushayela elsebenzayo nengazange iphelelwe lixesha. Uqinisekiso koku landelayo kuya kuba yinxaxheba eñ谈: uNjineli oQinisekisiweyo weMicrosoft, iMicrosoft Certified Solutions Associate (MCSA) okanye iMicrosoft Certified Solutions Expert (MCSE). Kufuneki kubekho uqinisekiso lwe-A+ neli ye-Network+. Ulwazi ngeWindows 7; Windows 8; Window 10; MS Office 2010, 2013 neOffice 365; iSymantec Ant-virus; Microsoft MS; iinkqubo zeTransversal (PERSAL, SAP neLOGIS) neITIL kuya kubakho nzuzo. Ukulungelelana ukuhamba kwiindawo ezahlukeneyo ezikude namacala. Iakhoni ezibandakanya: Ulwazi olujulileyo ngenkqubo yolwazi ngekhompyutha yabathengi kunye nabasebenzisi. Iimpawu zobuqhawe kunye nenceba yamava amakhulu ezibeko zolwazi nobudlelwane nabantu. Ulwazi nakhono oluhle ngekhompyutha (iMs Word, Excel nePowerPoint). Ukuba nakho ukusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo. Amanyathelo amahle okunxibelela ngokubhaliswa nangokuthethwa. Ukuba sityhile kwiinkqubo ezahlukeneyo zoshishino.
xh.duties: Lawula amagama abhalwe kwiinkqubo zolawulo lwamagama. Nikela inkxaso kumsebenzisi wokugqibela ngekhompyutha ngekhompyutha, isoftware nendlela yokudibanisa kwainethiwekhi. Qinisekisa ukuba zonke iinkqubo ezibalulekileyo ze-IT, iinkqubo nemigangatho zisetyenziswa. Yenza ulawulo oluhle lweLocal Area Network (LAN). Yenza ukufakela, ukulondolaza nokuphucula iintsingiselo zekhompyutha njengendlela yesibini yokukhangela iingxaki. Faka kuphinde uphucule iinkqubo zesoftware ezingenziwa ziimveliso zomanyano wabangaphandle. Nikela uphinde ulondoloze iinkonzo zase-intanethi ze-imeyile zabathengi. Qinisekisa ukuba i-antivirus software signature kunye namaphasi ezinkqubo ezisebenzayo zilhanga ziyatsha. Qala uphinde ulungelelanise iinkqubo zolawulo lotshintsho. Nikela ingcali yonikezelo lwamava kwizikhuliso nentluko yamava okusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Yaza wenze iibhakapu zemihla ngemihla kuzo zonke iiseva ezikhoyo. Hlenga iingxelo zemivuzo yenyanga. Abo bakhetiweyo kuya kufuneka benze iiyure ezongezelelweyo ezikwi-standby xa kuyimfuneko kwaye bancedise uMongameli Wamacala: uNxiba-mali WeNkqubo Yolwazi ngekhompyutha nakuzo zonke iinkqubo ezinxulumene ne-IT.

af.title: Omgewingsbeampte Produksie Vlak a – C
af.summary: Assesseer aansoeke vir watergebruiklisensies en voer terreinbesoeke uit vir die Department of Water and Sanitation in Bloemfontein en Kimberley.
af.requirements: Nasionale Diploma in Omgewingsbestuur of Natuurwetenskap in enige een (1) van die volgende velde: Landbou, Landbou-geïntegreerde Waterhulpbronbestuur, Hidrologie (Oppervlak of Grond); Chemie, Biochemie, Mikrobiologie, Waterbenutting, Waterhulpbroningenieurswese en of Geohidrologie. Die openbaarmaking van 'n geldige, nie-verstreke bestuurderslisensie. Twee (2) jaar toepaslike / herkenbare ervaring in 'n veld na die verwerwing van die tersaaklike kwalifikasie sal 'n voordeel wees. Deeglike kennis van geïntegreerde waterhulpbronbestuur en waterhulpbronbeskerming. Kennis en begrip van die watersektor insluitend tersaaklike wetgewing (NWA, CARA en NEMA, MPRDA) tesame met die verwante beleide, regulasies, beginsels, riglyne, nutsinstrumente en prosedures; beleidontwikkeling, implementering en monitering. Uitstekende kommunikasievaardighede insluitend verbale, verslagskryf- en voorleggingsvaardighede. Ster interpersoonlike vaardighede asook die vermoë om in 'n multidissiplinêre span te werk. Bereidwilligheid om buitengewone ure en onder druk te werk asook landwyd te reis. Bewese skakelings- en netwerkvaardighede veral soos dit verband hou met Korporatiewe Bestuur en belanghebbende-betrokkenheid.
af.duties: Assesseer volledigheid van WULAs en voer terreinbesoeke uit. Skakel met kliënte en ander belanghebbendes om uitstaande inligting tydens WULA-assesserings te verkry. Versoek wetenskaplike insette binne die VOCMA asook die Department Water and Sanitation met behulp van die gespesifiseerde sjablone. Toegang tot en evaluering van Hidrologiese, Omgewings- en Tegniese inligting met betrekking tot lisensie-aansoeke. Bied bystand by die ontwikkeling van beleide en riglyne vir die implementering van die National Water Act (NWA), 36 of 1998 met betrekking tot die watergebruiksektor. Finale assessering van inligting wat deur Watergebruiklisensie-aansoekers ingedien is en insette van interne spesialiste. Opstel van rekords van aanbevelings (RoRs) en gevolglike besluitdokumente. Opstel van lisensievoorwaardes om die negatiewe impakte van watergebruik te beheer / versag. Bied bystand by die reaksie op navrae van kliënte binne en buite die departement.

zu.title: Umphathi Wezokusingatha Kwemvelo Izinga a – C
zu.summary: Hlola izicelo zelayisensi yokusebenzisa amanzi futhi wenze ukukilola kwendawo kuMnyango Wezamanzi Nokucocekisa eBloemfontein naseKimberley.
zu.requirements: I-Diploma Yezwe Lemfundo Ephakeme kokuLawulwa Kwemvelo noma Ezenzululwazi Yemvelo kunoma yikuphi (1) kwale mingcele elandelayo: Ezolimo, Ezolimo, ukuLawulwa Okuhlangene koBovu lwamanzi, I-Hydrology (Phezulu noma Phansi); I-Khemistry, I-Biochemistry, I-Microbiology, Ukusetshenziswa Kwamanzi, Injini Yokubona Amanzi kanye noma nge-Geohydrology. Ukuzivula kwelayisensi yokushayela evumelekile engakaveli. Amawula (2) weminyaka yokuhlangenwe okuhambisana noma okubonakalayo endaweni ngemva kokuthola iziqu ezihambisanayo kuzoba yinzuza. Ukuqonda okuhle ngokuLawulwa Okuhlangene koBovu lwamanzi nokuvikelwa kobovu lwamanzi. Ulwazi nokuqonda ngohwebo lwamanzi okuhlanganisa umthetho ohambisana nawo (NWA, CARA kanye no-NEMA, MPRDA) kanye nezinqubomgomo ezihambisana nawo, imithetho, imigomo, iziqondiso, izinto ezisetshenziswa kanye nokuqashwa; ukuthuthukiswa kwezinqubomgomo, ukusetshenziswa kanye nokuqapha. Amakhono okuxhumana ahle kakhulu okuhlanganisa okwenkomishi, ukubhala imibiko, amakhono okubukhoma. Amakhono ohle abantu kanye nokuthi ukwazi ukusebenza eqenjini elihlukene imikhakha. Ukuzithoba ekusebenziseni amahora angajwayelekile nasephansi kokucindezela kanye nokuhamba ezweni lonke. Amakhono abonakalayo okuxhumana nokuxhumana nabanye ikakhulukazi ngoba ahlobene noBuguqulo BoBukhulu kanye nokuxhumana nabalawuli.
zu.duties: Hlola ukuqedwa kwe-WULAs futhi wenze ukukilola kwendawo. Xhumana naklienti kanye nabanye abalawuli ukuthola ulwazi olusalele ngesikhathi kuhlolelwa i-WULA. Celana izinikelo zenzululwazi ngaphakathi kwe-VOCMA kanye noMnyango Wezamanzi Nokucocekisa usebenzisa amafomu achaziwe. Finyelela futhi uhlole ulwazi lwe-Hydrological, lwezemvelo nolobuchwepheshe ngamalayisensi ezicelo. Siza ekuthuthukisweni kwezinqubomgomo kanye neziqondiso ukuze kusetshenziswe uMthetho Wezamanzi Kazwelonke (NWA), 36 ka-1998 ngohwebo lwezokusebenzisa amanzi. Ukuhlolwa kokugcina kolwazi olunikelwe ngabafakeli beLayisensi Yokusebenzisa Amanzi kanye nenzikelo kubuchwepheshebangaphakathi. Ukubhala irekhodi leziqambiso (RoRs) kanye namadokhumenti ezinqumo eziphuma kulo. Bhala izimo zelayisensi ukulawula / ukukhombisa izipho ezingezinhle zokusebenziswa amanzi. Siza ekuphenduleni imibuzo evela naklienti ngaphakathi nangaphandle komnyango.

xh.title: I-ofisa yokuZinza kwiNdalo ekuvelisweni inqanaba elingu-A – C
