jobs.title: Environmental Officer Production Grade a – C
jobs.summary: Monitor water user compliance across sectors, conduct audits and compile reports for the Department of Water and Sanitation in Bloemfontein.
jobs.requirements: A National Diploma in Environmental Management or Natural Science in any one of the following fields: Agriculture, Agricultural, Integrated Water Resource Management, Hydrology (Surface or Ground); Chemistry, Biochemistry, Microbiology, Water Utilization, Water Resource Engineering and or Geohydrology. Practical experience in the field of compliance monitoring and enforcement will be an added advantage. The disclosure of a valid unexpired driver’s license. Good computer literacy and writing skills. Good communication skills both written and verbal. Knowledge and understanding of water sector relevant legislation (National Water Act 1998, Water Services Act 1997 and related Environmental legislation e.g. NEMA, Waste Act). Knowledge of Industrial, agricultural, afforestation, municipal and mining processes. Knowledge of compliance monitoring and enforcement with an understanding of prevailing principles of Integrated Water Resource Management, water resource protection and Catchment Management. Knowledge of GIS. Willingness to travel extensively and work irregular hours.
jobs.duties: Compliance monitoring of water users across all sectors (Mines, Afforestation, Municipal, Industry, Agro processing) against issued authorizations and other regulatory requirements. Notification of audit to water user. Compilation of audit report through NCIMS. Communicate audit findings to water users. Investigation of non-compliant cases (Queries, complaints, pollution incidents, etc). Ensure administrative enforcement by issuing Notices/ Directives/ Follow- ups on notices/ directives issued. Monitor compliance on sites issued with notices/ directives by conducting follow-up site inspections. – Institute legal actions where legal notices do not achieve the desired outcome. Compilation of investigation reports through the ECMS. Facilitate representation / action plan review on non-compliant cases / sites and attend Representation committee meetings. Adherence to deadlines on submissions as per the Standard Operating Procedures.

af.title: Omgewingsbeampte Produksie Graad A – C
af.summary: Monitor nakoming deur watergebruikers oor sektore heen, voer oudits uit en stel verslae op vir die Department of Water and Sanitation in Bloemfontein.
af.requirements: Nasionale Diploma in Omgewingsbestuur of Natuurwetenskap in een van die volgende velde: Landbou, Landbou-ewewig, Geïntegreerde Waterhulpbronbestuur, Hidrologie (Oppervlak of Grond); Chemie, Biochemie, Mikrobiologie, Waterbenutting, Waterhulpbroningenieurswese en of Geohidrologie. Praktiese ervaring op die gebied van nakomingsmonitering en -handhawing sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Die openbaarmaking van 'n geldige, onverstreke bestuurderslisensie. Goeie rekenaarvaardigheid en skryfvaardighede. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede, beide skriftelik en mondeling. Kennis en begrip van wetgewing wat vir die watersektor relevant is (National Water Act 1998, Water Services Act 1997 en verwante omgewingswetgewing bv. NEMA, Waste Act). Kennis van industriële, landbou-, bosbou-, munisipale en mynprosesse. Kennis van nakomingsmonitering en -handhawing met 'n begrip van die heersende beginsels van Geïntegreerde Waterhulpbronbestuur, waterhulpbronbeskerming en Opvanggebiedbestuur. Kennis van GIS. Bereidwilligheid om uitgebreid te reis en onreëlmatige ure te werk.
af.duties: Nakomingsmonitering van watergebruikers oor alle sektore (Myne, Bosbou, Munisipaal, Nywerheid, Agroverwerking) teen uitgereike magtigings en ander regulatoriese vereistes. Kennisgewing van oudit aan watergebruiker. Opstelling van ouditverslag deur NCMS. Kommunikasie van ouditbevindings aan watergebruikers. Ondersoek van nie-nakomende sake (Navrae, klagtes, besoedelingsvoorvalle, ens). Verseker administratiewe handhawing deur uitreik van Kennisgewings/ Riglyne/ Opvolgings op uitgereikte kennisgewings/ riglyne. Monitor nakoming op terreine wat met kennisgewings/ riglyne uitgereik is deur opvolgterreininspeksies uit te voer. – Instellering van regstappe waar regskennisgewings nie die verlangde uitkoms bereik nie. Opstelling van ondersoekverslae deur ECMS. Fasiliteer vertoe/ aksieplan-hersiening oor nie-nakomende sake/ terreine en bywoon van Vertoeekomiteevergaderings. Voldoening aan sperdatums op voorleggings soos per die Standaardbedryfsprosedures.

zu.title: Iphini Lemvelo - Ukukhiqiza Izinga a – C
zu.summary: Qaphela ukuthobela imithetho yabasebenzisi amanzi kuzona zonke izikhungo, wenze ukuhlola futhi uhloze imibiko kumnyango wezamanzi nokuhlolwa kwezimpahla eBloemfontein.
zu.requirements: I-Diploma Yezwe ezingeni eliphezulu kuPhathi Kwemvelo noma iSayensi Yamvelo kunoma yisiphi esinye sezinkundla ezilandelayo: Izolimo, Izolimo, ukuPhathi Kwebalengiswa Lwamanzi okuhlanganisiwe, i-Hydrology (Phezulu noma Phansi); i-Chemistry, i-Biochemistry, i-Microbiology, ukusebenzisa amanzi, ukuYila ibalengiswa lamanzi kanye noma i-Geohydrology. Ukuhlanganyela okusebenzayo enkundleni yokuqaphela ukuthobela imithetho nokuphoqa kuzoba yinuzu ekhethwa kakhulu. Ukwaziswa ngesikhwama sokushayela esivumelekileyo esingapheliyo. Amakhono amahle okusebenza ngamakhompyutha nokubhala. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana okubhalwayo nokukhulwayo. Ulwazi nokuqonda okubhalwa kwemithetho ehlobene nendawo yamanzi (uMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke 1998, uMthetho Wamasevisi Wamanzi 1997 kanye nemithetho ehlobene Nemvelo ngokwesibonelo i-NEMA, uMthetho Wemfucuza). Ulwazi lwezinqubo zoshishino, zolimo, zokuhlahlamba izihlahla, zasemadolobheni kanye nezokuwohloqa. Ulwazi lokuqaphela ukuthobela imithetho nokuphoqa lokuqonda izimiso ezikhona zokuPhathi Kwebalengiswa Lwamanzi okuhlanganisiwe, ukuvikela ibalengiswa lamanzi kanye noPhathi Kwesifunda. Ulwazi lwe-GIS. Ukuzithoba ukuhamba kakhulu futhi usebenze emahoreni angajwayelekile.
zu.duties: Ukuqaphela ukuthobela imithetho kwabasebenzisa amanzi kuzo zonke izikhungo (Izimayini, ukuHlahlamba izihlahla, AmaDolobha, Ushishino, ukuHlelwa kwezolimo) ngokumelene nezimvume ezinikiwe kanye nezinye izidingo ezibusayo. Isaziso sokuhlola kumsebenzisi wamanzi. Ukuhlanganisa umbiko wokuhlola nge-NCIMS. Xhumisa iziphetho zokuhlola kubasebenzisi bamanzi. Ukuphenya izehlakalo ezingathobeli imithetho (Izibuzo, izikhalazo, izehlakalo zokungcola, njll). Qinisekisa ukuphoqa ngokwesiphakamiso ngokunikeza Izaziso/ Izimfuneko/ ukulandelana kwezaziso/ izimfuneko ezinikiwe. Qaphela ukuthobela imithetho kumasayithi anikiwe izaziso/ izimfuneko ngokwenza ukubhekisisa kwangemuva kumasayithi. – Faka izinyathelo zomthetho lapho izaziso zomthetho ezingafinyeleli kumgomo othandwayo. Ukuhlanganisa imibiko yokuphenya nge-ECMS. Lehla ukumelana / ukucutshungulwa kohlaka lwenzuwo izehlakalweni ezingathobeli imithetho / amasayithi futhi uzikhonze iNkomfa yokumelelana. Ukuthobela izikhathi zokuvalwa kokuthunyelwe njengoba kusho Izinqubo Eziyisiseko Zokusebenza.

xh.title: NoLungelo lweNdalo uKukhiqiza uBukhulu beCandelo a – C
xh.summary: Qwalasela ukuthobela imithetho yabasebenzisa amanzi kwawo onke amawonga, yenza isango ulungiselela iisango sitywalwei zebe seZixhobo Zamanzi nokungalungiyo kwiSebe leZixhobo Zamanzi nokuTsala iNdalo eBloemfontein.

Imfundo ngokusebenza kwemisebenzi eqwalaselwa ngokulawula nokuphocebisa iya kuba luncedo. Isityholo senleke yemoto eyiyo engekadluli ithuba layo. Ukuba mgama ekusebenzeni ngekhompyutha nakhona ekubhaleni. Amakhono echungechunge echazwa ngokubhalwa nangokuthethwa. Ulwazi nokuqonda ngemithetho echungechunge yamanzi (uMthetho weAmanzi ka-1998, uMthetho weZikhonzo zeAmanzi ka-1997 kunye nemithetho ebandakanya iNdalo njengoko kwiNEMA, uMthetho weMpahla eyiyo). Ulwazi ngemigangatho yezoShishino, zolimo, kokutyalo kwezihlahla, zikamasipala nangokugoduka iinkqubo. Ulwazi ngokuqwalasela nokuphocebisa nokusebenza nokuqonda ngamagunya abakhoyo ekuQuquzelelweni kuQhinga lwamaQhinga aManzi, ukhuselo lwaQhinga aManzi nokuLawulwa kweNdawo. Ulwazi ngeGIS. Ukulungela ukuhamba kakhulu nokusebenza iiyure ezingaqhelekanga.
xh.duties: Ukuqwalasela ukuthobela kwemithetho abasebenzisa amanzi kulo lonke iwonga (Migodi, Kutyalo kwezihlahla, Ngomasipala, Eshishini, ekuqhubeni iintsimbi zolimo) ngokuchasene namagunya anikiweyo nakwezinye iimfuno ezilawulayo. Isaziso songezo kumsebenzisi wamanzi. Ulungiselelo lwesango solicelo nge-NCIMS. Ukunikezela iimpendulo zesango kubasebenzisi amanzi. Uphando lwemimeko ezingathobelanga imithetho (Iimbuzo, iipingcolo, iiganeko zothonotho, njl njl). Qinisekisa ukwenziwa kolawulo ngokupapasha Izaziso/ Iyaliso/ Ukulandela izaziso/ amaxwebhu alyalisiweyo aphilisiweyo. Qwalasela ukuthobela imithetho kwindawo ezinikezelwe izaziso/ amaxwebhu ayalisiweyo ngokwenza ukuqwalasela kwendawo ngokulandela. – Faka izigqibo zomthetho apho izaziso zomthetho ezingafikeleli kumphumela oqwenwayo. Ulungiselelo lweesango sophando nge-ECMS. Skenza imeko ebekiweyo / ukuhlola inkqubo yomgangatho wemimeko ezingathobelanga imithetho / iindawo athunde kwiKomiti yeMeko ebekiweyo. Ukuthobela iintsuku zokuvala kwesityhalo njengoko kumiselwa ziNqobo eziSebenzayo zoKusebenza.

zu.duties: Ukuthuthukisa ukuqonda ngamathuba amanzi ukuze kugcinwe izinqubomgomo zekhwalithi yamanzi, umthetho, izinqubo, imithetho nezinhlelo zokuqondisa. Ukwenza ulwazi lwemifula nokubhala imibiko yekhwalithi yamanzi. Ukuphathela izehloko ezingcolisa imvelo. Ukuphathwa kwekhwalithi yamanzi endaweni ethize yemifula. Ukubambisana ekuthuthukisweni kwezindlela zobuchule bokukhiqiza ngendlela ehlanzekile. Ukuqinisekisa ukuphathwa kwezibopho zomthetho mayelana nekhwalithi yamanzi. Ukuthatha inxaxheba ekuphathweni kwamathuba amanzi.

Uitstekende mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede is essensieel. Die kandidaat moet in staat wees om onafhanklik of in 'n span te werk. Moes bewese ervaring hê in gemeenskaps- of landelike ontwikkeling asook omgang met ander sfere van Regering. Moet die vermoë hê om konflik deur 'n deursigtige en deelnemende benadering te bestuur, komplekse projekverwante probleme op te los, wetgewing, beleid en strategie te interpreteer en toe te pas. 'n Deeglike begrip van geïntegreerde waterhulpbronbestuur. 'n Geldige, nie-verstreke bestuurderslisensie en bereidwilligheid om uitgebreid te reis. Van die kandidaat word verwag om oor uitstekende aanbiedings-, navorsings-, tydbestuur- en projekbestuursvaardighede te beskik.
af.duties: Skakel nou en verskaf ondersteuning aan waterbelanghebbendes insluitend boere (sowel kommersiële as ontluikende), alle sfere van regering, industrieë, plaaslike gemeenskappe en ander externe instellings. Verskaf advies en ondersteuning aan die instellingsontwikkelingsfunksie van waterhulpbronbestuur. Bystand verleen met die totstandkoming, koördinering en bestuur van Opvanggebiedvorms en Watergebruikersverenigings. Fasiliteer en reël belanghebbede- raadpleegingsessies vir die tariefbepalingsproses, die ontwikkeling van die Opvanggebiedbestuurstrategie en ander VOCMA-belanghebbende-inisiatiewe.

zu.title: Inkantsheli Yentuthuko Yomphakathi
zu.summary: Xhumana nabaphathi bezingxenye zamanzi futhi unike inkxaso yentuthuko yezikhungo ekuphathweni kwemithombo yamanzi, okudinga ibhodi lesi fundi lesi 12 kanye nolwazi ngentuthuko yomphakathi.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi samatikilikhi/ ibhodi lesi 12. Uhambo lweminyaka emibili (2) kuya kuyine (4) lolwazi kwizinkambu zentuthuko yomphakathi, izifundo zentuthuko, ezomnotho, kwezomuntu noma kwezenhlalo kuzoba yinzuzo. Isikhulumi esifanele kumele sibe nolwazi ngemithetho, izinqubomgomo namasu ahlobene namanzi. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuqonda izinhlelo zemithombo yamanzi. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana ngomlomo nakubhalwe ayabaluleke kakhulu. Isikhulumi kumele sikwazi ukusebenza sodwa noma kwiseqembu. Kumele sibe nolwazi oluqinisekisiwe kwintuthuko yomphakathi noma yezemidolobha kanye nokuxhumana nezinye izinhlelo zahulumeni. Kumele sibe nakhono lokuphatha ngxabano ngendlela evulekile nebandakanyayo, ukuxazulula izinkinga eziyinkimbinkimbi ezihlobene nezinhlelo, ukuhumusha futhi sisebenzise umthetho, izinqubomgomo namasu. Kumele sibe nekuqonda okuzinakile ngokuphathwa kwezihlanganisi zemithombo yamanzi. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile ngayizayo kanye nesithakazezelo sokuhamba kakhulu. Kuzomele kulindeleke ukuthi isikhulumi sibe namakhono amahle okethula, ukuphenya, ukuphatha isikhathi kanye nokuphatha izinhlelo.
zu.duties: Xhumana ngokusondele futhi unike inkxaso kubaphathi bezingxenye zamanzi kubandakanya, abalimi (bobabilomagumbi abakhulu nabasakazayo), zonke izinhlelo zahulumeni, izimboni, imiphakathi yendawo kanye nezinye izikhungo zangaphandle. Ukunikeza izeluleko nenkxaso emsebenzini wentuthuko yezikhungo ekuphathweni kwemithombo yamanzi. Siza ekusekweni, ukuhlanganiseni nasokuphathweni kwezinhlobo zemikhawulo yomthombo wamanzi kanye namaQembu Abasebenzisi Amanzi. Yenza lula futhi ulungise izinkulumo zokubonisana nabaphathi bezingxenye zesinqumo semali ezofakwayo, intuthuko kwamasu okuphatha imikhawulo yomthombo wamanzi kanye nezinye izinhlelo zabaphathi be-VOCMA.

xh.title: Isikhululi SoPhuhliso Lomphakathi
xh.summary: Dibana namalungu aphathwayo amanzi ukuze unike inkxaso yophuhliso lweziko ekulawulweni kwamathafa eamanzi, okufuna ibhasi lokugqibela kwisigaba sesi-12 nolwazi lokuphuhlisa umphakathi.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi se-Senior/Grade 12. Amashumi amabini (2) ukuya kwamane (4) unyaka loluhlu olusezindaweni zophuhliso lomphakathi, iZifundo zoPhuhliso, iEconomics, iHuman okanye iSocial Science kuya kuba lundesho elongezelelweyo. Umphuli ofanelekayo kufuneka abenolwazi ngemithetho, iinkqubo namagqabantshintshi ahambelana namanzi. Ukubakholwa kumakhompyutha. Ukuqonda iinkqacha zomthombo wamanzi. Ukuzabalazela ngokwemile nokuqamba amagama ibalulekile. Umphuli kufuneka akwazi ukusebenza ngokweyakhe okanye esiqhaweni. Kufuneka abe noluvo lokusebenza ngokwemida yomphakathi okanye eluhlaza ukwaye adibane nolunye uluntu luRhulumente. Kufuneka akwazi ukuphatha ukungabathathabaxa ngendlela ethembakaliyo necutshungulwayo, asolwe iingxaki ezinzima ezidityaniswe neeprojekthi, azicenge asebenzise umthetho, iinkqubo namagqabantshintshi. Abenokonda okululo malunga nokulawula ngokudibana amathafa eamanzi. Ilayisensi yokushayela ezingatshongo yangakhuli nemvume yokuzingela iiindawo ezikude. Kulindeleke ukuba umphuli abe nakhona ukubonisa ngokwemveliso, ukuphandla, ukulawula ixesha neeprojekthi.
xh.duties: Dibana ngokuchanekileyo unike inkxaso kwamalungu amanzi aquka, abalimi (kooka Intengiso nabaqalayo), onke amaqumzhu kaRhulumente, iindawo zoshishino, umphakathi wasekuhlaleni namanye amaziko angaphandle. Unika ingcebiso nenkxaso kwinkqubo yophuhliso lweziko ekulawulweni kwamathafa eamanzi. Nceda ekusekweni, ekulawuleni nasekuphathweni kwe-Catchment Forms ne-Water User Associations. Yenza amaxesha okudibana namalungu malunga neenkqacha zokuqamba amaxabiso, ukuphuhlisa i-Catchment Management Strategy nolunye i-VOCMA ukuzonke kumalungu amanzi.

jobs.title: Administration Clerk (SUPERVISOR)
jobs.summary: Supervisory administration clerk needed in Bloemfontein to provide clerical support, data capture and records management for the Department of Water and Sanitation.
jobs.requirements: A Senior/Grade 12 certificate or equivalent. Four (4) to (5) Five years’ experience in clerical and administrative duties. Good knowledge of clerical duties, practices as well as the ability to capture data, operate computer and collecting statistics. Knowledge and understanding of the legislative framework governing the VOCMA. Knowledge of working procedures in terms of the working environment. Good planning, organising and reporting skills. Good financial management skills. Ability to have good interpersonal relations, flexibility and teamwork. Good verbal and written communication skills. Computer literacy (Word, Excel and Power Point). Ability to work independently and to work under pressure.
jobs.duties: The purpose of this post is to render administrative support services in the Institutions, Stakeholder Engagement and Governance component. The incumbent is expected to render general clerical support services by recording, organising, storing, capturing and retrieving correspondence and data. Update registers and statistics. Handle routine enquiries. Distribute documents / packages to various stakeholders as required. Keep and maintain the filing system for the component. Type letters and / or other correspondence when required. Keep and maintain the incoming and outgoing document register of the component. Provide supply chain clerical support within the component. Provide financial administration support services in the component. Capture and update expenditure in component. Supervise staff in accordance with VOCMA policies and procedures.
jobs.applications: Interested applicants must submit their applications via the online link https://erecruitment.dws.gov.za
jobs.notes: Other related documentation such as copies of qualifications, identity documents, driver’s license etc need not to accompany the application when applying for a post as such documentation must only be produced by shortlisted candidates during the interview date in line with DPSA circular 19 of 2022. With reference to applicants bearing professional or occupational registration, fields provided in Part B on the online Z83 must be completed as these fields are regarded as compulsory. Failure to complete or disclose all required information will automatically disqualify the applicant. No late applications will be accepted. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to suitability checks (SAQA verification, reference checks criminal and credit checks). SAQA evaluation certificate must accompany foreign qualifications (only when shortlisted). Applications that do not comply with the above- mentioned requirements will not be considered. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Candidates will be required to complete a financial disclosure form and undergo security clearance. Foreigners or dual citizenship holders must provide a police clearance certificate from country of origin (only when shortlisted). The Vaal-Orange Catchment Management Agency is a Public Water Resource Management Agency, established in line with the provisions of the National Water Act, 1998 (Act no 36 of 1998) (NWA) and National Water Policy for South Africa. It is an entity of the National Department of Water and Sanitation. Employees appointed in the CMA have similar employment terms and conditions as those of employees appointed in terms of the Public Service Act, though not employed in terms of the Public Service Act. If you do not hear from us within three (3) months of this advertisement, please accept that your application has been unsuccessful. Faxed applications will not be considered. The agency reserves the right not to fill these positions. Women and persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply and preference will be given to the EE Targets. OTHER POSTS

zu.title: Clerk wezokuphatha (UMQONDISI)
zu.summary: Kudingeka umqondisi wezocwengezwe kulezi zikhundla eBloemfontein ukunikeza ukusekela kwezocwengezwe, ukuthwebula idatha kanye nokuphathwa kwezinkomba kwiNkundla yeManzi nokuhlanza.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi samaSenior/Grade 12 noma esilinganayo. Ukuqashelwa kweminyaka eyi Four (4) kuya kwi (5) Five kwemisebenzi yezocwengezwe kanye nokuphatha. Ulwazi oluhle ngemisebenzi yezocwengezwe, izindlela kanye namandla okuthwebula idatha, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuthola izibalo. Ulwazi nokuzuva kwesakhiwo sezomthetho esibusayo iVOCMA. Ulwazi lwezindlela zokusebenza ngokwesimo sendawo yokusebenza. Amakhono amahle okuhlela, ukuhlela kanye nokubika. Amakhono amahle okuphatha izimali. Amandla okuba nobuhlobo obuhle nabantu, ukuguquguquka kanye nokusebenza njengqembu. Amakhono amahle okuxoxa nokubhala. Ukuba nalwazi ngekhompyutha iWord, Excel kanye nePower Point. Amandla okusebenza ngodwa kanye nokusebenza ngaphansi koxanduva.
zu.duties: Inhloso yalesikhundla ukunikela ngokusekela ngokuphatha izinsizakalo kumnyango, ukuhlanganyela ngokwabathintekile kanye neNkantolo yokuqondisa isimo. Umsebenzi okhethekileyo wule nje ukusekela ezocwengezwe ngokubhala, ukuhlela, ukulondoloza, ukuthwebula nokubuyisa idatha nemibhalo. Ukuvuselela izinkomba kanye nezibalo. Uphathe imibuzo ejwayelekileyo. Ukusatshalisela imibhalo/amasenthosi ezindaweni ezahlukene njengoba kudingekile. Ukuphathwa kwezinkomba ezikulesimilo. Ukuchofoza imibhalo noma eminye imibhalo lapho kudingekile khona. Ukuqinisekiswa kwebhalansi yezemali ezingangeni kanye nezingaphumile. Ukunikeza ukusekela ngokuphatha izinsiza zomzimba wezinsizakalo. Ukunikeza izinsizakalo zokuphatha izimali ezikulesimo. Ukubhala nokuvuselela ukushiswa kwemali. Ukuphatha abasebenzi ngaphansi kwemigomo kanye nezindlela zeVOCMA.

xh.title: Iklerk yeolononxulumo (UMPHATHI)
xh.summary: Kufuneka kubekho iklerk yeolononxulumo ephethe abantu kwiBloemfontein ukubonelela inkxaso yabasebenzi, ukubamba idatha nolawulo lwamarekhodi kwiDepartment of Water and Sanitation.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seGrade 12 okokuqeqeswa kwabapheleleyo. Ukuba nokhuluphale weminyaka emine (4) ukuya kumihlanu (5) kumsebenzi wokwenza imisebenzi yeklerki nolononxulumo. Ukwazi kakuhle imisebenzi yeklerki, iindlela zokwenza umsebenzi kunye namandla okubamba idatha, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuqokelela izibalo. Ulwazi nokuqonda isakhiwo somthetho esilawula iVOCMA. Ulwazi lweenkqubo zokusebenza ngokommandla wokusebenza. Amakhono amahle eplani, yolungelelwaniso nokubika. Amakhono amahle olawulo lweemali. Ulwazi lokuba nabantu abahle, ukuguquguquka nokusebenza njengesiqhenga. Amakhono amahle okunxibelelwana ngomlomo nangesibhalo. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (Word, Excel nePower Point). Ukwazi ukusebenza eyedwa nangxaki.
xh.duties: Injongo yalesi sithuba kukubonelela iinkonzo zononxulumo kwicandelo leziko, unxibelelwano nabathathi-nxaxheba nolawulo. Umntu okhethiweo uyakuthatha ukubonelela iinkonzo zonke zeklerki ngokubhala, kulungelelanisa, ukugcina, ukubamba nokuvelisa ukunxibelelwana idatha. Ukuhlaziya amarejista nezibalo. Ukuphatha imibuzo eqhelekileyo. Ukusasaza amaxwebhu ngeenjongo kumathathi-nxaxhebaahlukahleyo njengoko kuyimfuno. Ukugcina nokuhlaziya inkqubo yamafayili yecandelo. Ukubhala iileta okunxibelelwano naxa kuyimfuno. Ukugcina nokuhlaziya irejista lamaxwebhu angena aphuma ecandelo. Ukubonelela iinkonzo zeklerki kumaziko aneenkonzo ezincinci kwicandelo. Ukubonelela iinkonzo zolononxulumo lweemali kwicandelo. Ukubamba nokuuphela imali echithwa kwicandelo. Ukulawula abasebenzi ngokwemigaqo nolandelelwano lweVOCMA.

zu.title: Umlobi Wengoqoqo (WARMS)
zu.summary: Kudingeka abalobi bengoqoqo kumamakhelana amaningi ukubamba ukubhaliswa kokusebenzisa amanzi, ukungena kolwazi kanye nosebenzise abathengi ezingeni 5.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Senior/Grade 12 kahle nokuqinisekisiwe kokuhlanganyela komsebenzi kahle emahhovisi jikelele nokungena kolwazi. Umethuli kumele akwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha elinolwazi oluhle lokubhala ngamagama kanye namaspredishithi. Amakhono ahle okukhuluma nokubhala. Okuhlangenwe nakho emsebenzini wokukhonza abathengi, ukubhala lwemigca nemibiko. Okuhlangenwe nakho kwindlela yokubhaliswa kokusebenzisa amanzi esizwe. Ulwazi ngoMthetho Wamanzi Wezwe, (Act 36 of 1998) kanye nomthetho abhekiweyo abahlobene. Ikhono lokusebenza emandleni.
zu.duties: Nika abasebenzisi amafomu okubhalisa ahambisana naye. Siza abasebenzisi ukuthi bagcwalise amafomu okufaka isicelo. Hlola ukuthi amafomu okufaka isicelo agcwalisiwe kahle yini. Faka amafomu okufaka isicelo kubasebenzisi abasha. Lungisa ulwazi lwabasebenzisi ababhalisile ngokomphumela ovunyiwe. Yidwe imibhalo yokwaba isiqiniseko. Hlela isitifikethi sokubhalisa ukuze sivunywe. Ledisa ukuqedela imifanekiso bese uyithumela kubasebenzisi ababhalisile. Beka amaphesenti okuhambisana wayo okutholakele emakhasimende kanye nemicimba abekwe kuyo amafayela ahleliwe esikhungweni. Zinikele emsebenzini wokukhonsa othule.

xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seSenior/Grade 12 kunye namava afanelekileyo kolawulo lwe-ofisi jikelele nokuungenisa iingcombolo. Umgunyathi kufuneka azazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha enolwazi oluhle lokusebenza ngokuhlengwa kwamagama namakwadi. Amakhono amabal asebenzayo ebhalwe nokuThetha. Amava oqobo kwinkonzo yabathengi, nokubhala iileta nemiqulu. Amava kwinkqubo yelizwe yokuBhaliswa kokusetbenziswa kwamanzi. Ulwazi ngomthetho weNational Water Act, (Act 36 of 1998) namanyathelo amanye ahlobene. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo.
xh.duties: Ukunika abasebenzisi iifomu ezifanelekileyo zokuBhaliswa. Uncede abasebenzisi ekuGcwaliseni iifomu zesicelo. UkuKhangela igqibo leefomu zesicelo. UkuNgenisa iifomu zesicelo kwabasebenzisi abatsha. Ukulungisa iinkcukacha zabasebenzisi ababhalisiweyo njengoko kugqityiwe. UkuVelisa amaxwebhu okuQinisekisa. UkuLungisa isatifikethi sokuBhaliswa ukuze sivunywe. UkuKopa kwaye uthume iisatifikethi zokuBhaliswa kubasebenzisi ababhalisiweyo. UkuGcina iirekhodi zeendaba ezivela kubathengi namaxwebhu egqibo kwiifayile zempahla esemthethweni. UkuZenza imisebenzi yedeski yoncedo.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Municipal Accounting and Asset
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 per annum (Level 11), an all-inclusive salary package. (This all- inclusive flexible remuneration package consists of a basic salary, the Government’s contribution to the Government Employees Pension Fund and a flexible portion, which may be structured in terms of the rules for the structuring of the flexible portion and which may include a 13th cheque, motor car allowance, housing allowance and medical aid assistance)
jobs.summary: Deputy Director overseeing municipal accounting, GRAP compliance and financial statement reporting at Free State Treasury in Bloemfontein.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate degree or advanced diploma (NQF level 7) majoring in Financial Accounting with a minimum of five (5) years’ experience in an accounting environment of which three (3) years should have been on an Assistant Director / supervisory level. Knowledge of the Municipal Finance Management Act (MFMA), Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Municipal Structures Act (MSA), Division of Revenue Act (DORA), Treasury Regulations, Municipal Standard Chart of Accounts (mSCOA) and other relevant local government legislation. Must possess the following skills: Leadership, report writing, analytical, communication, presentation, project management, and conflict management. Computer literacy. Valid driver’s license.
jobs.duties: Promote adherence to Generally Recognized Accounting Practice (GRAP) standards and timeous submission of credible financial statements. Report on compliance with National/Provincial Treasury reforms. Report on the readiness of municipalities to compile annual financial statements (AFS). Review and report on the quality of annual financial statements submitted. Promote the improvement of audit outcomes in municipalities. Provide support and monitor internal controls in municipalities, which involves reporting on the assessed Financial Management Capability Maturity Model (FMCMM), e-Monitor Portal and submitted 5 Key Controls. Support and monitor compliance with accounting and asset management. Manage the resources of the Sub- directorate to ensure effective and efficient operations.
jobs.applications: Effective from 1 April 2026, the Free State Provincial Treasury now utilises an e-Recruitment System (applicants must submit their applications via the online link https://www.erecruitment.fs.gov.za
jobs.notes: all applicants must login/register to apply for positions, we only accept hand delivered/posted applications should an applicant prove that he/she tried to apply via e-Recruitment with no success and the Free State Provincial Treasury Information Technology Sub-directorate was unable to assist. af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Munisipale Inkomste en Skuld
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur vir Munisipale Inkomste en Skuld in Bloemfontein, wat 'n finansies-graad en drie jaar se rekenmeesterkundige ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Ter sy staande graad/gevorderde diploma (NQF level 7) in Finansiële Bestuur/Finansiële Rekeningkunde/Bestuursrekeningkunde of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie met 'n minimum van drie (3) jaar se ervaring in 'n rekeningkundige omgewing. Kennis van die Municipal Finance Management Act (MFMA), Municipal Property Rates Act (MPRA), Munisipale begrotings en verslagdoeningsregulasies, Tesourie-regulasies en Munisipale Finansiële Bestuursomwisselings. Moet oor die volgende vaardighede beskik: analitiese, basiese numeriese, onderhandelings-, verslagdoenings-, voorleggings-, kommunikasie- en aksiegerigte vaardighede. Rekenaarbevoegd. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Ondersteun die implementering van inkomstebestuur deur geteikende munisipaliteite. Ondersteun die implementering van skuldbestuur deur munisipaliteite. Verskaf advies en tegniese leiding rakende inkomste-verwante tariewe, beleide, en tariefbepaling verbonde aan die inkomstebestuurssiklus. Verskaf advies en tegniese leiding rakende inkomste- en skuldbestuur. Ondersteun en help met die koördinering van opleiding om kapasiteit in munisipaliteite op te bou.

zu.title: Umcedisi weNduna: Inzuzo kamasipala kanye Nenhlanhla Yemali
zu.summary: Umcedisi weNduna weNzuzo kamasipala kanye Nenhlanhla Yemali eBloemfontein, ofuna isiqu sezezimali kanye namapheshana amathathu wemfundo yohlelo lokubala imali.
zu.requirements: Isiqu/iploma eliphezulu elifanele (NQF level 7) kuFinancial Management/Financial Accounting/Management Accounting noma iziqu ezinganakuvo eziphansi kokuqukethwe okufanayo okungenisa okungenani iminyaka emithathu (3) yemfundo ngenhlelo lokubala imali. Ulwazi nge-Municipal Finance Management Act (MFMA), i-Municipal Property Rates Act (MPRA), izikweletu zamabhandi kanye nemithetho yokubika imibhalo engantsunda ezimali zemikhakha kahulumeni, imithetho evezwa ngumnyango Wezimali kanye namapheshana e-Finance Management Act ayathunyelwa abantu abambe iqhaza. Kufanele aphathele amakhono alandelayo: Ukwaziswa kwamaphoyinti, izinombolo eziyisisekelo, ukuhlangana negunya lokubeka izinsizakusebenza emsebenzini, ukubika, ukwethula amaphoyinti, ukubonakalisa kanye nokuqondisa ngokuthatha isinyathelo. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisense yokushayela elisebenzayo.
zu.duties: Lalela futhi useke ngokuqinisekiswa kolawulo lwenhlanhla ngamasipala abekiwe. Lalela futhi usekela ngokuqinisekiswa kolawulo lwenhlanhla yemali ngamasipala. Nikeza izeluleko kanye nezinhlobo zolwazi oluthile ezimali ezidingekayo eziyisisekelo, emisebenzini kahulumeni, kanye nokuqinisekisa izinsizakusebenza emsebenzini ezihlobene nenhlanhla kamasipala. Nikeza izeluleko kanye nezinhlobo zolwazi oluthile emaleni anhlanhla kamasipala kanye nalawulo lwenhlanhla yemali. Usekele kanye nokubonisana ngezinhlelo zokuqeqesha ukwakha amandla emasipaleni.

xh.title: Umncedisi weCandwe: Imbuyekezo yeeMasipala kunye nokuMiswa kwetyala
xh.summary: Umncedisi weCandwe weMbuyekezo yeeMasipala kunye nokuMiswa kwetyala eBloemfontein, efuna isidanga kwezimali kunye neminyaka emithathu yamava ohlelwe-i-akhawuntingi.
xh.requirements: Isidanga/diploma esiphezulu esifanelekileyo (NQF level 7) kwi-Financial Management/Financial Accounting/Management Accounting okanye ngokulinganayo nesi ngesiqendu, esinamava amabalwa angu-(3) kwimeko yohlalo-lwazi kwimozamo ye-akhawuntingi. Ulwazi nge-Municipal Finance Management Act (MFMA), i-Municipal Property Rates Act (MPRA), iMithetho yolu lawulo lwamahlawule ablelwa nemithetho yokuba ngababali bengxelo, iTreasury Regulations naku Mazimba we-Municipal Management ezinomaphu. Makaba nalamakhono alandelayo: okusikwa-hlengahlengisiweyo, okubala ngokomlinganiselo, okuncokola, kokubika, okusazisa, okuthetha-cangci, nokuba ngumntu othe rhoqo esebenzisa izandla. Kude kuthi wazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokushayela eseza.
xh.duties: Xhasa ukusetyenziswa kolawulo lwembuyekezo zimasipala abajoliswe kuzo. Xhasa ukusetyenziswa kolawulo lwembuyekezo-emasisi kwimasipala. Nikeza ngcebiso nolondolozo ngokwasemva ngemithetho-nkqubo mayelana nembuyekezo-kutyala evela kwimbuyekezo-tshintshiso, naziphi izixhobo ze-polisa etyala, nakumthetho wokuyilinganisa osetyenziwe kwisakhizi senkqubo yophicotho-imbuyekezo. Nikeza ngcebiso nolondolozo olusesigengeni ngembuyekezo nemisebenzi yokuqengqelela iimali kwakunye nokulawula imbuyekezo netyala. Xhasa kunye nokuncedisa ngokusasaza inkqubo yokuzincedisa ngokwemfundo ekuqeqeshwa kumasipala ukwazi ukusasaza isiphithiphithi sabo.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Economic Analysis
jobs.summary: Assistant Director: Economic Analysis position at the Department of Treasury in Bloemfontein, contributing to provincial economic reviews and budget statements.
jobs.requirements: An Honors Degree/Postgraduate Diploma (NQF Level 8 qualification) in Economics/Econometrics/Statistics/Mathematical Statistics or equivalent qualification with a minimum of three years’ working experience in a research or economic policy analysis environment. Knowledge of the Division of Revenue Act, Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Public Service Regulations, Treasury Regulations, research methods, Macro-Economics, Socio-Economics and policy interpretation/formulation. Must possess the following skills: Analytical, mathematical, publication writing, research, problem solving, interpersonal, ability to work independently, decision making, presentation and report writing. Computer literacy. Valid driver’s license.
jobs.duties: Contribute to the annual Provincial Economic Review and Outlook (PERO) publication and the Municipal Economic Review and Outlook (MERO) publication. Contribute to Section 3 of the Provincial Budget Statement 1 on economy, social and labour issues. Contribute to the annual financial statements or Quarterly Labour Market Review. Conduct and provide support in socio economic research analysis and development. Analyse key economic variables their interrelations and relevance for the budget. Perform periodic collection, maintenance and update Provincial Socio Economic indicators in database. Conduct research and contribute to Departmental publications.

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Ekonomiese Analise
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur: Ekonomiese Analise pos by die Department of Treasury in Bloemfontein, wat bydra tot provinsiale ekonomiese hersienings en begrotingsverklarings.
af.requirements: 'n Honneursgraad/Postgraadse Diploma (NQF Level 8-kwalifikasie) in Ekonomie/Ekonometrie/Statistiek/Wiskundige Statistiek of 'n ekwivalente kwalifikasie met minstens drie jaar se werkservaring in 'n navorsings- of ekonomiese beleidsanalise-omgewing. Kennis van die Division of Revenue Act, Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Public Service Regulations, Treasury Regulations, navorsingsmetodes, Makro-ekonomie, Sosio-ekonomie en beleidsinterpretasie/-formulering. Moet oor die volgende vaardighede beskik: Analities, wiskundige, publikasieskryfwerk, navorsing, probleemoplossing, interpersoonlik, vermoë om onafhanklik te werk, besluitneming, aanbieding en verslagskryfwerk. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Geldige bestuurslisensie.
af.duties: Dra by tot die jaarlikse Provincial Economic Review and Outlook (PERO)-publikasie en die Municipal Economic Review and Outlook (MERO)-publikasie. Dra by tot Seksie 3 van die Provincial Budget Statement 1 oor ekonomie, sosiale en arbeidsake. Dra by tot die jaarlikse finansiële state of Quarterly Labour Market Review. Voer en bied ondersteuning in sosio-ekonomiese navorsingsanalise en -ontwikkeling. Analiseer sleutel ekonomiese veranderlikes, hul onderlinge verbande en relevansie vir die begroting. Voer periodieke versameling, onderhoud en opdatering van Provinsiale Sosio-Ekonomiese aanwysers in databasis uit. Doen navorsing en dra by tot departementele publikasies.

zu.title: Umsekeli weNkhulu: Ukuhlaziya iNqoqo yezoMnotho
zu.summary: Isikhundla sokuba nguMsekeli weNkhulu: Ukuhlaziya iNqoqo yezoMnotho kuMnyango we-Treasury eBloemfontein, okusize ekubukeni kabusha kwezomnotho ezifundazweni nakumasimemi wesabelomali.
zu.requirements: I-Degree ye-Honors noma i-Postgraduate Diploma (iziqu ze-NQF Level 8) kwi-Economics/Econometrics/Statistics/Mathematical Statistics noma iziqu ezingokulingana nokuba nokuhlangenwe nakho okuncane eminyakeni emithathu kokusebenza endaweni yokucwaninga noma yokuhlaziya inqubomgomo yezomnotho. Ukwazi i-Division of Revenue Act, i-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), i-Public Service Regulations, i-Treasury Regulations, izindlela zokucwaninga, i-Macro-Economics, i-Socio-Economics kanye nokutolikwa/ukwakhiwa kwenqubomgomo. Kumele abe namakhono okulandelayo: Ukuhlaziya, izibalo, ukubhala okushicilelwayo, ucwaningo, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ubudlelwano nabantu, ikono lokusebenza kodwa, ukuthatha izinqumo, okwethulwayo nokubhala imibiko. Ukwazi ukusebenisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile.
zu.duties: Ukusebenzela ekushicilelweni konyaka i-Provincial Economic Review and Outlook (PERO) nasekushicilelweni i-Municipal Economic Review and Outlook (MERO). Ukusebenzela kuSection 3 yesimemo se-Provincial Budget Statement 1 mayelana nomnotho, izindaba zomphakathi kanye nezomsebenzi. Ukusebenzela emafinyezwe emali wonyaka noma ku-Quarterly Labour Market Review. Ukuqhuba nokunika inkundla ekuhlaziyweni kwocwaningo nezomnotho emphakathini nakuntuthukweni. Ukuhlaziya okubalulekile kwaguquguquki okuvela komunotho, ukuhlobana kwako kanye nokubaluleka kwako kumasabelomali. Ukuqoqa, ukugcina nokubuyekeza njalo izinkomba ze-Provincial Socio Economic esidathini. Ukuqhuba ucwaningo ukubhala izinto abazithumayo kuMnyango.

xh.title: Umncedisi weNkokeli: Uhlolojocorvo Lwezoqoqoshe
xh.summary: Isithuba somncedisi wenkokeli koluhlolojocorvo lwezoqoqoshe kwisebe leTreasury eBloemfontein, kunyeko kwiNqubo yoJongolwango Lwezoqoqoshe LwePhondo nokuNxibelelana ngeNkcazengo-imali.
xh.requirements: IGedyu yeQabunyulu/iDiploma ezayo kumgangatho (isigqibo seNQF Level 8) kwiZohlolojocorvo ngezoqoqoshe/Izibalo zeendalo/Izibalo zeemathematikhi okanye isigqibo esilinganayo, esinolwazi olungenangaphakathi lonyaka wemisebenzi emithathu kwindawo yophando okanye uhlolojocorvo lwemigaqo yorhwebo. Ulwazi ngoMthetho woLawulo LweNgeniso-Mali, uMthetho woLawulo Lwe Mali kaRhulumente (PFMA), iNgqibekekela zeNkonzo zaRhulumente, iNgqibekekela zeTreasury, iindlela zophando, iZoqoqoshe ezikhulu, iZentlalo kunye nokuqondisa/ukwenza imigaqo. Kufuneka anobuchule obulandelayo: Uhlolojocorvo, izibalo, ukubhaliweyo kwezazindaba, uphando, ukusombulula iingxaki, ukuhamba ngokwahlukana kwabantu, ukuba nakho ukusebenza ngedwa, ukwenza izigqibo, ukubonisa nokuqamba iingxelo. Ulwazi ngemikhonisi. ilayisensi yokuqhuba esemthethweni.
xh.duties: Ukunikela ngonyaka kwipapasha yeNqubo yoJongolwango nokuNdulamkela iZoqoqoshe zePhondo (PERO) nasepapasheni yeNqubo yoJongolwango nokuNdulamkela iZoqoqosze zeSixeko (MERO). Ukunikela kwiQela lesi-3 seNkcazengo-imali yoPhondo 1 ngezoqoqoshe, iindaba zentlalo nezomsebenzi. Ukunikela kumaxwebhu e-nyaka okanye kuJongolwango lweSihloko seNyanga ngoNyaka woMsebenzi wokuQashwa. Ukuqhuba futhi unike inkxaso kuhlolojocorvo nophando lwentlalo-urhwebo nentlalo-urhwebo. Ukwenza uhlolojocorvo ngeemlinganiselo ezibalulekileyo urhwebo neendibaniselwano nokuqatshelwa kwayo kumxholo weNkcazengo-imali. Ukwenza ukuqokelela, ukusingatha kugqibo ukuya kuQqokolelwana loQoqo-ulwazi ngomlinganiselo weZentlalo-urhwebo wePhondo. Ukuqhuba uphando kunye nokunikela kumapapasha esebe.

jobs.title: Legal Administration Officer
jobs.salary_text: R337 563 – R685 812 per annum, (A basic salary), Salary will be determined according to the number of years post qualification legal experience in accordance with the OSD Determination).
jobs.summary: Provide legal support and guidance on the Legal Management Framework for the Department of Treasury in Bloemfontein, requiring an LLB degree and two years post-qualification experience.
jobs.requirements: A LLB degree or an equivalent/recognized four-year law degree. At least two (2) years post qualification legal experience. Knowledge of the Public Finance Management Act, Municipal Finance Management Act, Treasury Regulations, Public Service Regulations, and other relevant legislation related to the Public Sector environment. Computer literate. Good business communication, interpersonal and analytical skills. A valid driver’s license.
jobs.duties: Identify legal capacity gaps within the Department. Market the Legal Management Framework. Provide continuous support and guidance on the implementation of the Legal Management Framework and guidelines within the Department. Liaise with different stakeholders of the Department regarding legal matters. Analyze documents and provide legal advice. Monitor the application of legal matters. Act as a presiding officer during disciplinary hearings. Draft legal service level agreements. Monitor compliance to service level agreements. Create awareness on legal matters. Manage the human resource of the Division to ensure the smooth functioning of the Division.

af.title: Regsonderhoudbeampte
af.summary: Verskaf regsondersteuning en -leiding oor die Regsbestuursraamwerk vir die Department of Treasury in Bloemfontein, wat 'n LLB-graad en twee jaar se ervaring na kwalifisering vereis.
af.requirements: 'n LLB-graad of 'n gelykwaardige/erkende vierjarige regtegraad. Ten minste twee (2) jaar se regsonderhoudervaring na kwalifisering. Kennis van die Public Finance Management Act, Municipal Finance Management Act, Treasury Regulations, Public Service Regulations en ander tersaaklike wetgewing wat verband hou met die openbare sektor-omgewing. Rekenaarvaardig. Goeie sakekommunikasie-, interpersoonlike en analitiese vaardighede. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Identifiseer regskapasiteithiate binne die departement. Bemark die Regsbestuursraamwerk. Verskaf deurlopende ondersteuning en leiding oor die implementering van die Regsbestuursraamwerk en riglyne binne die departement. Skakel met verskillende belanghebbendes van die departement rakende regsaangeleenthede. Ontleed dokumente en verskaf regsadvies. Monitor die toepassing van regsaangeleenthede. Tree op as 'n voorsittende beampte tydens dissiplinêre verhore. Ontwerp regsdiensvlakooreenkomste. Monitor nakoming van diensvlakooreenkomste. Skep bewustheid oor regsaangeleenthede. Bestuur die menslike hulpbronne van die afdeling om die gladde funksionering van die afdeling te verseker.

zu.title: Iofisa Ophethe Izomthetho
zu.summary: Nika inkuseleko nokuqondisa ngohlelo Lolawulo Izomthetho lwaboMnyango weTreasury eBloemfontein, okudinga iziqu zeLLB neminyaka emibili yokuqeqeshwa kweminyaka yamava.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zeLLB noma esifanayo/saziwayo ezinye iziqu zomthetho zineminyaka emibili. Okungenani iminyaka emibili (2) yamava omthetho emuva kokuqedwa kwesiqu. Ulwazi ngoPublic Finance Management Act, Municipal Finance Management Act, Treasury Regulations, Public Service Regulations, kanye nomthetho othintana nendawo yoMnyango kahulumeni. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana kobuchwepheshe, abantu nokuhlaziya izinto. Ilayisense esemthethweni sokushayela.
zu.duties: Hlola izikhala ezikhona ngamandla ezomthetho ngaphakathi koMnyango. Dlulisa ulwazi ngohlelo Lolawulo Izomthetho. Nikeza inkuseleko eqhubekayo nokuqondisa ngokusetshenziswa kohlelo Lolawulo Izomthetho kanye nezindlela ngaphakathi koMnyango. Xhumana nabahlanganyeli abahlukahlukene boMnyango mayelana nezomthetho. Hlaziya amadokhumenti unikeze iqiniso lomthetho. Qapha ukusetshenziswa kwezomthetho. Yiba ngumgcinamthetho kumasexwayo aphathelene nezohlolo. Bhala izivumelwano mayelana namakhono ezomthetho. Qapha ukulandelwa kwezivumelwano. Yenza abantu bazi mayelana nezomthetho. Phatha abantu besebenza kule Divijini ukuqinisekisa ukuthi Divijini isebenza kahle.

xh.title: Ofisi Wolawulo Isemtyebiso
xh.summary: Nikeza inkxaso nemigaqo ngoLulawulo Lolawulo Isemtyebiso kwiSebe le Treasury e Bloemfontein, elifuna isidanga se-LLB neminyaka emibini yamava emva kokufumana izidanga.
xh.requirements: Isidanga se-LLB okanye isidanga semithetho esithatha iminyaka emine esilinganayo/esiqaphelekileyo. Uneamava amabalwa (2) amava wokusebenza kwemithetho emva kokufumana izidanga. Ulwazi ngoMthetho woLawulo lweMali yoLuntu, uMthetho woLawulo lweMali kaMasipala, Iilawulwa zeTreasury, Iilawulwa zoKukhonza koLuntu, nalomnye umthetho olongezelelekileyo onxulumene nokusingathwa koluntu olusebenza kurhulumente. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amakhono amabalawu ekunxibelelaneni kobuhle bomisebenzi, abantu, nokuhlalutya. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo.
xh.duties: Tsala umxhoba wamakhono emithetho ngaphakathi kwisebe. Thandaza ulLulawulo Lolawulo Isemtyebiso. Nikeza inkxaso ekhoyo nemigaqo ngokusebenza kolulawulo lolawulo losemtyebiso nemiqathango ngaphakathi kwisebe. Qhagamshelana nabahlobo bahlukeneyo besebe ngezindaba zemithetho. Hlalutya amaxwebhu unikeze ingcebiso yomthetho. Qhoboshea ukusetyenziswa kwezindaba zemithetho. Yiba ngumrhwebi phakathi kwemibuzo yosuku yamathuba. Bhala iinkqubo zemithetho yamakhonzwi. Qhoboshea ukusetyenziswa kwezi nkrqubo zemithetho yamakhonzwi. Yakha ingqiqo ngezindaba zemithetho. Phatha amabele abantu abelali ngenjongo yokuvakalelwa kokuqhubela phambili kweNkqubo.

jobs.title: Control Environmental Officer Grade a
jobs.salary_text: R636 978 per annum, (plus benefits), offer will be based on appropriate and recognizable experience in line with the OSD requirements).
jobs.summary: Control Environmental Officer Grade A position in Johannesburg requiring an Honours degree and six years of environmental experience, offering R636978 per annum.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 plus Honours Degree (NQF Level 8) in Environmental Management/Sciences, Natural Sciences, Engineering and Chemistry as recognised by SAQA. Minimum of 6 years’ relevant experience within environmental Field. Valid drivers’ license. Competencies: Computer Literacy. Good writing skills. Good communication skills (listening, explanation, influencing, motivating, negotiation). Good admin skills, organising skills. Good chairing skills/ability to manage meetings. Management of people. Management of finances (budgeting, controls, reporting) Strategic Planning and project management; including contingency planning Understanding Public Service and Departmental acts and policies (e.g. HR/ Finance/ tender regulations).
jobs.duties: Manage a unit or region within the Directorate (Provide strategic direction and leadership). Ensure Unit work is in line with the strategic direction of the Directorate and for the Department. Provide technical input on environmental issues in the province (i.e. EIA decision, and making recommendations on policies, guidelines, GPEMF standard and legislative options) Sign off work (content and quality) as delegated by the Department. Hold regular team meetings and facilitate cooperation and coordination and ensure ongoing information sharing between Units or Regions. Coordinate and collaborate with other Units and with rest of departments on joint work. Assist staff to plan their work, provide support by giving advice and by taking on work when there are capacity constraints. Conduct all aspects of the PMDS. Fulfil financial reporting requirements as set out and ensure that the Unit can answer audit queries. Ensure that there is proper control and administration of procurement and purchasing when required.
jobs.applications: To apply for the below positions, please submit your application online at http://professionaljobcentre.gpg.gov.za or send an email @ GDENVrecruitment@gauteng.gov.za
jobs.notes: Quoting the relevant reference number applications must be submitted on the New Z83 form obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.gov.za/documents. Suitable candidates will be subjected to personnel suitability checks (criminal record, citizenship, credit record checks, qualification verification and employment verification). af.title: Beheer-omgewingsbeampte Graad A
af.summary: Beheer-omgewingsbeampte Graad A-pos in Johannesburg wat 'n Honneursgraad en ses jaar omgewingservaring vereis, teen R636978 per jaar.
af.requirements: Graad 12 plus Honneursgraad (NQF-vlak 8) in Omgewingsbestuur/Wetenskappe, Natuurwetenskappe, Ingenieurswese en Chemie soos deur SAQA erken. Minimum van 6 jaar se relevante ervaring binne die omgewingsveld. Geldige bestuurslisensie. Bevoegdhede: Rekenaarvaardigheid. Goeie skryfvaardighede. Goeie Kommunikasievaardighede (luister, verduideliking, beïnvloeding, motivering, onderhandeling). Goeie administratiewe vaardighede, organisasievaardighede. Goeie voorsittervaardighede/vermoë om vergaderings te bestuur. Bestuur van persone. Bestuur van finansies (begroting, kontroles, verslagdoening) Strategiese beplanning en projekbestuur; insluitend noodbeplanning Begrip van Openbare Diens- en Departementele wette en beleide (bv. HR/ Finansies/ tenderregulasies).
af.duties: Bestuur 'n eenheid of streek binne die Direktoraat (Verskaf strategiese rigting en leierskap). Verseker dat die eenheid se werk in lyn is met die strategiese rigting van die Direktoraat en van die departement. Verskaf tegniese insette oor omgewingsake in die provinsie (d.w.s. EIA-beslissing, en voorstelle rakende beleide, riglyne, GPEMF-standaard en wetgewingsopsies) Onderteken werk (inhoud en gehalte) soos deur die departement gedelegeer. Hou gereelde spanvergaderings en fasiliteer samewerking en koördinasie en verseker deurlopende inligtingdeling tussen eenhede of streke. Koördineer en werk saam met ander eenhede en met die res van die departemente oor gesamentlike werk. Ondersteun personeel om hul werk te beplan, verskaf ondersteuning deur advies te gee en deur werk oor te neem wanneer daar kapasiteitsbeperkings is. Voer alle aspekte van die PMDS uit. Voldoen aan finansiële verslagdoeningsvereistes soos uiteengesit en verseker dat die eenheid ouditvrae kan beantwoord. Verseker dat daar behoorlike beheer en administrasie van verkryging en aankope is wanneer vereis.

zu.title: Umphathi Wezemvelo Onazinga A
zu.summary: Isikhundla somPhathi Wezemvelo Onazinga A esise Johannesburg esidinga iziqu ze-Honours neminyaka eyisithupu yohlaka lwemvelo, sinikeza iholo le-R636978 ngonyaka.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-Grade 12 kanye nzedegree ye-Honours (NQF Level 8) kwimphathi Yemvelo/Ezayesayensi, Ezemvelo, Injiniyela NeKhemikhathi njengoba kubonwa yi-SAQA. Ukube ngaphezulu kweminyaka eyisithupha (6) yohlaka oluhambisana nendawo yemvelo. Ilayisense yokuqisha elisebenzayo. Ikhono: Ukusebenzana nekhompyutha. Ikakhono okuhle lokubhala. Ikakhono okuhle lokuxhumana (ukulalela, ukucazulula, ukushukumisa, ukukhuthaza, ukuqashana). Ikakhono okuhle lolawulo, lokuhlela. Ikakhono okuhle lokubusa/ikakhono lokupatha izinkomfa. Ukuphatha abantu. Ukuphatha imali (ukwenza amabhajethi, ukulawula, ukubika). Ukuhlela okubheke phambili nokuphatha amaphrojekthi; okuhlanganisa ukuhlela izinhlela zokuqalisa. Ukuqonda umthetho namapholisi osebenza kahle emmangweni nakumnyango (isb. HR/ Finance/ imithetho yethenda).
zu.duties: Ukuphatha inqola noma isifunda ngaphakathi kwesiKhungo (Nikeza isiqondiso esibheke phambili nokuqonda ukuba nguqhube). Qinisekisa ukuthi umsebenzi weNqola uya ngohambo olubheke phambili lwesiKhungo futhi oMnyangweni. Nikeza umbhalo ngemikhakha yemvelo esifundazweni (isb. isinqumo se-EIA, nokwenza izincomo ngamapholisi, iziqondiso, amazinga e-GPEMF kanye nezinketho zomthetho). Phela umsebenzi (okuqukethwe nkhathi nethuthukisiwe) njengoba kunikwa igunya nguMnyango. Biza izinkomfa zeqembu njalo baza uxhume ukusebenza ndawonye nesinxaxhi nokwazana ngaphakathi kweziNqola noma ezifundeni. Xhuma ndawonye nesiZingqi kanye nayo yonke eminye iminyango ekwenzeni umsebenzi ndawonye. Siza abasebenzi ekubhekaniseni imisebenzi yabo, nikeza inkokhelo ngokunika izeluleki nangokuthatha umsebenzi uma kunemingcorosha yamandla okwenza. Yenza yonke imicabango ye-PMDS. Gcwalisa izidingo zokubika ngemali ezibe sekubekwe futhi qinisekisa ukuthi iNqola ikwazi ukuphendula imibuzo ye-odidi. Qinisekisa ukuthi kukhona ukulawula nokuphatha kokuthenga nokuthengisa lapho kudingeka khona.

xh.title: Control Environmental Officer Grade a
xh.summary: Isithuba sikaControl Environmental Officer Grade A e-Johannesburg esifuna isidanga se-Honours kunye nonyaka wama-6 wamava wendalo, sinika umvuzo we-R636978 ngonyaka.
xh.requirements: Unyaka wama-12 wesikolo plus Isidanga se-Honours (NQF Level 8) kwi-Environmental Management/Sciences, Natural Sciences, Engineering ne-Chemistry njengoko eqatyiwe yi-SAQA. Oonyakeni abange-6 ubudala bamava ahambelana nalo ndawo yendalo. Ilayisenisi yokushayela esemthethweni. Iikhompetensi: Ulwazi lokusebenza ngamakhompyutha. Amabomvu amaninzi ebali elilungelelanenyo. Amabomvu amaninzi kuluntu nokudibana nabantu (ukulalela, ukunika ingcamango, ukuchukumisa iingqondo, ukukhusela umbono, ukulawula iingxoxo). Amabomvu amaninzi kuluntu kweliso lokusingathwa kunye nokuqamba izinto. Amabomvu amaninzi kweliso lokusingathwa kweendibano/akhono okulawula iindibano. Ulawulo lwabantu. Ulawulo lweemali (ukwakha umthetho wokuhola imali, ukulawula, nokusetyenziswa kwayo) Ulungelelwaniso lweNqanaba ePhakamileyo nolawulo lweeprojekthi; kuquka nokulungelelwaniso olungalindelelwayo Ukuqonda oMthetho baseKadali neSazinda seNkonzo yoLuntu kunye neeNkqazo zoLuntu nakweSebe (okt. i-HR/ iNtzOmzobo/ iimdR/thetho yokusingathwa kwemigalelo).
xh.duties: Phatha icandelo okanye indawo ngaphakathi kwiNqanaba leNdlela (Nika isalathiso esingqamisana noyalelo nokuba ngumlawuli). Qinisekisa ukuba umsebenzi weCandelo ulandela isalathiso esingqamisana noyalelo lweNqanaba leNdlela neliSebe. Nikeza isigqibo sendlela ngemiba yendalo kwingingqi (okt. isigqibo seEIA, nokwenza izindululo malunga neenkqazo, iindlela eziluncedo, namanqanaba aGPEMF kunye nezikhethwa zomthetho) Sayina umsebenzi (okuqulethweyo nobungakanani) njengoko kuNdululwe yiSebe. Bamba iindibano ezisoloko zenzeka kwaye wenze ukusebenzisana kunye nolungelelwaniso ukuze kuqhubeke ukwabelwana ngolwazi phakathi kweeCandelo okanye iiNdawo. Lungiselela usebenzisana namanye amacandelo nesebe liphela kwimisebenzi edibana kunye. Nceda abasebenzi ukuba balungiselele umsebenzo wabo, banikeze inkxaso ngokunika izalathiso nangokuthatha umsebenzi xa kunzima ngenxa yokungabi nabo babanikiweyo abasebenzi. Zenza onke amanqanaba e-PMDS. Phumeza iimfuno zokuvela ngemali ezikwisalathiso ukuze kuqiniseke ukuba iCandelo linakuphendula imibuzo yokuhlolwa. Qinisekisa ukuba kukho lawulo ngokuchanekileyo nolawulo lokuthenga nokulethwa kwemali xa kufuneka.

jobs.summary: Clinical Manager position in Sedibeng District Health Services Family Medicine requiring an MBChB degree, HPCSA registration, four years' experience and a valid driver's licence.

af.title: Klinieke Bestuurder
af.summary: Klinieke Bestuurder-pos in Sedibeng Distrik Gesondheidsdienste Huisartskunde wat 'n MBChB-graad, HPCSA-registrasie, vier jaar se ervaring en 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie vereis.
af.requirements: Graad 12/Senior Sertifikaat. MBChB-graad wat registrasie met HPCSA as 'n Mediese Offisier toelaat. Registrasie met HPCSA as 'n Mediese Praktisyn. 'n Minimum van 4 jaar toepaslike ervaring as Mediese Offisier na registrasie met die HPCSA as Mediese Praktisyn. 'n Geldige kode 8/10-bestuurderslisensie. Ervaring in PHC, met die vermoë om te lei, te bestuur asook vaardighede oor te dra, is essensieel. Must bereid wees om verminderde oortyd te werk.
af.duties: Bestuur van die distrik Huisartskunde-eenheid. Verskaf bestuurs- en klinieke ondersteuning in die verskaffing van normale en buite-kantoorure diensdekking deur mediese offisiere en internes. Lewer klinieke dienste aan pasiënte in die distrik Primêre Gesondheidsorg-klinieke en roteer deur dienspunte soos deur diensbehoeftes aangewys. Ondersteun en koördineer met bestuurs- en klinieke spanne by distrikgesondheidsfasiliteite vir die verskaffing van gehalte gesondheidsdienste en bestuur. Verskaf klinieke kundigheid aan die distrik PILIR, gehalteversekering en pasiëntveiligheidsprogramme. Interpreteer, versprei en implementeer Departement beleide verwant aan kern klinieke standaarde en ondersteun die Huisartskunde-eenheid in die ontwikkeling van klinieke oudite, protokolle, riglyne en verwysingsondersteuning. Skakel en koördineer met Distrikhospitaal, Streekshospitaal en Noodmediese Dienste om toepaslike interfasiliteit-pasiëntverwysings en klinieke sorg te verseker. Verteenwoordig en ondersteun die Huisartskunde-eenheid in verskeie distrik klinieke en bestuursforums, PHC-heringenieuring en ontwikkeling van subdistrikte. NAVRAE : Dr. A. Kalain by 073 235 1762

zu.title: Umdluli wezokwelapha
zu.summary: Isikhundla sikaphathi wezokwelapha esigabeni se-Sedibeng District Health Services Family Medicine esidinga i-degree ye-MBChB, ukubhaliswa ne-HPCSA, iminyaka emine yohlu oluphelele lwezinto ezingangeni emzimba, kanye nelaysensi evumelekile yokushayela ibhasikidi namagumbi.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12/Senior Certificate. I-degree ye-MBChB evumela ukubhaliswa ne-HPCSA njengomphathi wezokwelapha. Ukubhaliswa ne-HPCSA njengomelaphi. Okungenani unyaka o-4 wokuhlala ohambelanayo njengomphathi wezokwelapha ngemva kokubhaliswa ne-HPCSA njengomelaphi. ilayisensi evumelekile yokushayela ibhasikidi namagumbi ikhodi 8/10. Okubalulekile ukuba nohlu oluphelele lwezinto ezingangeni emzimba, ulwazi, kanye nobuchwepheshe ekusebenzeni kwezamahlela emphakathi nakwezokwelapha, nokwazi ukuphatha futhi uzidlulisele kolunye abantu. Kumele ukhululeke ekwenzeni imisebenzi engaphezulu yamahora abhalwe ngokwesivumelwano.
zu.duties: Ukuphathwa kwesigaba sezolwelaphi Sendlu iSedibeng District. Nikela ngokuphathwa nasekuxhasweni ezindaweni zokwelapha ekunikezweni kwesevisi evamile nangemva kwamahora abalwelaphi nabafundi-abagadli. Nikeza izinsizakusebenza zokwelapha iziguli emaklinikeni ezingaphela kwesikhungo se-Sedibeng District Primary Health Care futhi ujikeleze emaphoyintini esevisi njengokuqondiswa izidingo zesevisi. Xhasa futhi uhlanganyele nomphathi namaqembu okwelapha eziteshini ezinkulu zempilo zesikhungo ukuze kunikezwe izinsizakusebenza zempilo ezinhle nokuphathwa. Nikeza ubuchwepheshe bokwelapha esikhungweni i-PILIR, isiqiniseko sokuthola inani elihle kanye nezinhlelo zokuphepha kanye nokuphathwa kwesiguli. Humusha, sasaza futhi usebenzise izinqazo zomnyango eziphathelene nezilinganiso ezibalulekile zokwelapha futhi uxhase i-Family Medicine Unit ekwakheni ukuhlolwa ngokwelapha, imithetho yokusebenza, imihlahla yokuhola kanye nexhaso lokuthumela kwezinye izikhungo. Xhumana futhi uhlanganyele ne-Sedibeng District Hospital, i-Regional Hospital kanye ne-Emergency Medical Services ukuze kutholakale ukuthunyelwa okuhambisana nemithetho kweziguli phakathi kwamafasitela kanye nesenzo sokwelapha. Mele futhi uxhase i-Family Medicine Unit emahlelokucosimuntu ahlukene okwelapha nokuphathwa, ekwakhiweni kabusha kwe-PHC kanye nokuqanjwa kabusha kwesikhungo esincane. IMIBUZO : Dr. A. Kalain ku-073 235 1762

xh.title: Umphathi wezonyango
xh.summary: Isithuba somphathi wezonyango kwiSebe lezeMeko zeMpilo eSedibeng District Family Medicine esifuna iziqu ze-MBChB, ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA, unyaka wamine (4) wamava nokuba nelayisenisi yokuqhuba esemthethweni.
xh.requirements: Iqela lesi-12/Isetifikathi ePhakamileyo. Isiqu se-MBChB esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengomahluleli wezokwelapha. Ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengoSolwazi bezokwelapha. Ukuze ube nobuncinane beminyaka eyi-4 yamava afanelekileyo njengomahluleli wezokwelapha emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengoSolwazi bezokwelapha. Ilayisenisi yekhowudi ye-8/10 esemthethweni yokuqhuba. Amaxabisa kwi-PHC, anamandla okukhokela, yolisa nokudlulisa amakhono ayeyimfuno. Kufuneka ukulungiselelwe ukwenza ovetha othi bhaxa.
xh.duties: Ukulawula iyunithi ye-Family Medicine yommandla. Ukunika inkxaso yolimo nezonyango ekuboneleleni ngesevisi eqhelekileyo nangemva emva-veki ngabahluleli bezokwelapha nabafundi. Ukubonelela ngezenzo ezonyango kubaphathwa kwiiklinikhi ze-Primary Health Care zommandla kwaye ujikeleze kumaphondo esevisi njengoko kuyalelwa yiimfuno zesevisi. Ukuxhasa nokusebenzisana nabaphathi kunye namaqela ezonyango kwi-facilities zezempilo zommandla ukubonelela ngeenzonzi ezintle zempilo nolawulo. Ukunika ulwazi oluchanekileyo nezonyango kwi-PILIR yommandla, ukuqinisekisa umgangatho nokhuseleko lwesigulane. Ukutolika, ukusasaza nokusebenzisa iimigaqo zeSebe ezidibene nemilinganiselo ebalulekileyo yezonyango kwaye uxhase iYunithi ye-Family Medicine ekuphuhliseni ukuphononongwa kwezonyango, iimigaqo, izikhokelo nenkxaso yokuqhubela. Ukuxhumana nokusebenzisana ne-District Hospital, i-Regional Hospital ne-Emergency Medical Servicesukuqinisekisa ukuthunyelwa kwabaphathwa ngokufanelekileyo phakathi kwezifo kunye nonyango. Ukumela nokuxhasa iYunithi ye-Family Medicine kwiindawo ezahlueneyo zolimo nezonyango yolimo zommandla, i-PHC Reengineering nokuphuhlisa iindawo ezingaphantsi kommandala. IMIBUZO : Dr. A. Kalain kwi-073 235 1762

jobs.title: Medical Specialist: Psychiatry
jobs.centre: Sedibeng District Health Services – Mental Health
jobs.city: Sedibeng District Health Services – Mental Health
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R1 395 528 per annum, (all-inclusive package) Grade 2: R1 592 274 per annum, (all-inclusive package) Grade 3: R1 844 151 per annum, (all-inclusive package)
jobs.summary: Medical Specialist in Psychiatry for Sedibeng District Mental Health Services, jointly appointed with Wits, involving clinical, academic, research and community psychiatry duties.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12/Matric Certificate. MBCHB. FC Psych / MMed (Psychiatry) or equivalent qualification that allows for registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) in Psychiatry. Current registration with HPCSA. Grade 1: no experience after registration with the HPCSA as Medical Specialist in a recognised Specialty, Grade 2: a minimum of 5 years appropriate experience as a Medical Specialist after registration with the HPCSA in Psychiatry and Grade 3 a minimum of 10 years appropriate experience as Medical Specialist after registration with the HPCSA as Medical Specialist in a Psychiatry. Sound knowledge and skills associated with the practice of Psychiatry. Ability to diagnose and manage common medical problems including emergencies. Good communication, leadership, interpersonal and decision-making qualities. Knowledge of current Health Legislation and policies as it relates to Public Institutions.
jobs.duties: This is a position which is jointly appointed with the University of the Witwatersrand and therefore incorporates academic and research duties as well as service provision and administrative obligations. Support and implement community psychiatry and integrated primary mental health care in the Sedibeng Health District. Provide community-based specialist psychiatric care, treatment, and rehabilitation as part of the community psychiatry team. Provide academic teaching and supervision to the Psychiatric Registrars and Medical Officers in the district psychiatric clinics. Provide in-service training and clinical support to the district Family Physicians and primary health care practitioners towards the provision of integrated mental health care. Collaborate with non-health sectors within the district regarding the recognition and care of people with mental illness. Participate in community level mental health outreach education and awareness activities. Promote and conduct research in the fields of community psychiatry and integrated primary mental health care. This includes supervision of Master’s Research Reports by Psychiatric Registrars, participation in collaborative projects and own research studies. Work with the district mental health team with respect to administrative duties, clinical audits, and quality improvement of the Sedibeng mental health services.
jobs.applications: Should be submitted strictly online at the following E-Recruitment portal: http://jobs.gauteng.gov.za. No hand-delivered, faxed, or emailed applications will be accepted. For assistance with online applications, please email your query to healthjobqueries@gauteng.gov.za
jobs.notes: Only online applications will be considered. Applicants must utilise the most recent Z83 application form for employment, issued by the Minister for the Public Service and Administration in line with Regulation 10 of the Public Service Regulations, 2016. All fields in the New Z83 form must be completed, initialled and signed. Furthermore, a comprehensive Curriculum Vitae (CV) 108 must also be attached. Failure to attach the completed Z83 and Comprehensive Curriculum Vitae (CV) will result in disqualification. The New Z83 form is obtainable from any Public Service Department or the DPSA website www.dpsa.gov.za/documents. Only shortlisted candidates who meet all the requirements of the post will be requested to submit certified copies of qualifications, identity document and valid driver’s license (where driving/travelling is an inherent requirement of the job) not older than six (06) months. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. It is our intention to promote representation (race, gender and disability) in the Public Service through the filling of posts and candidates whose transfer/promotion/appointment will promote representation will receive preference. It is the Department’s intention to promote equity through the filling of all numeric targets as contained in the Employment Equity Plan. To facilitate this process successfully, an indication of race, gender and disability status is required. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). The Department reserves the right not to appoint. If you do not receive any response from us within 3 months, please accept your application was unsuccessful.

af.title: Mediese Spesialis: Psigiatrie
af.summary: Mediese Spesialis in Psigiatrie vir Sedibeng Distrik Geestgesondheidsdienste, gesamentlik aangestel met Wits, wat kliniese, akademiese, navorsings- en gemeenskapspsigiatriepligte behels.
af.requirements: Graad 12/Matrieksertifikaat. MBCHB. FC Psych / MMed (Psigiatrie) of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie wat registrasie met die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) in Psigiatrie moontlik maak. Huidige registrasie met HPCSA. Graad 1: geen ervaring na registrasie met die HPCSA as Mediese Spesialis in 'n erkende Spesialiteit nie, Graad 2: 'n minimum van 5 jaar gepaste ervaring as Mediese Spesialis na registrasie met die HPCSA in Psigiatrie en Graad 3 'n minimum van 10 jaar gepaste ervaring as Mediese Spesialis na registrasie met die HPCSA as Mediese Spesialis in 'n Psigiatrie. Deeglike kennis en vaardighede wat verband hou met die beoefening van Psigiatrie. Vermoë om algemene mediese probleme insluitend noodgevalle te diagnoseer en te bestuur. Goeie kommunikasie-, leierskaps-, interpersoonlike en besluitnemingskwaliteite. Kennis van huidige Gesondheidswetgewing en beleide soos dit op Openbare Instansies betrekking het.
af.duties: Dit is 'n pos wat gesamentlik met die University of the Witwatersrand aangestel word en gevolglik akademiese en navorsingspligte sowel as dienslewering en administratiewe verpligtinge insluit. Ondersteun en implementeer gemeenskapspsigiatrie en geïntegreerde primêre geestelike gesondheidsorg in die Sedibeng Health District. Verskaf gemeenskapsgebaseerde spesialistiese psigiatiese sorg, behandeling en rehabilitasie as deel van die gemeenskapspsigiatrieteam. Verskaf akademiese onderrig en toesig aan die Psigiatiese Registrateurs en Mediese Beamptes in die distrik se psigiatriese klinieke. Verskaf in-diensopleiding en klinieke ondersteuning aan die distrik se Huisarts en primêre gesondheidsorgbeoefenaars ten einde geïntegreerde geestelike gesondheidsorg te lewer. Werk saam met nie-gesondheidssectore binne die distrik rakende die herkenning en sorg van persone met geestessiekte. Neem deel aan gemeenskapsvlak geestelike gesondheidsuitreikonderrig en bewustheidsaktiwiteite. Bevorder en voer navorsing uit op die gebiede van gemeenskapspsigiatrie en geïntegreerde primêre geestelike gesondheidsorg. Dit sluit toesig oor Meestersnavorsingsverslae deur Psigiatiese Registrateurs, deelname aan gesamentlike projekte en eie navorsingstudies in. Werk saam met die distrik se geestelike gesondheidspan ten opsigte van administratiewe pligte, kliniese oudits en gehalteverbetering van die Sedibeng geestelike gesondheidsdienste.

zu.title: Izenguxhumanisi Esezokwelapha: I-Psychiatry
zu.summary: Izenguxhumanisi Esezokwelapha ku-Psychiatry sezinkonzo ZikaSedibeng District Mental Health Services, ebekwe kahle no-Wits, okuhilela imisebenzi yokwelapha, yezemfundo, yocwaningo kanye neyomphakathi mayelana ne-Psychiatry.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi seGrade 12/Matric. MBCHB. FC Psych / MMed (Psychiatry) noma izifundo ezingalinganayo ezivumela ukubhaliswa ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) ku-Psychiatry. Ukubhaliswa okwamanje ne-HPCSA. I-Grade 1: akukho njinomva kokubhaliswa ne-HPCSA njengeMedical Specialist esigabeni esiqapheliwe, I-Grade 2: okungenani eminyaka eyi-5 yonjiniyela efanele njengeMedical Specialist emva kokubhaliswa ne-HPCSA ku-Psychiatry kanye ne-Grade 3 okungenani eminyaka eyi-10 yonjiniyela efanele njengeMedical Specialist emva kokubhaliswa ne-HPCSA njengeMedical Specialist ku-Psychiatry. Ulwazi olujulile namakhono ahambisana nokusebenza kwefundo ye-Psychiatry. Ikhono lokuxilonga nophatha izinkinga ezejwayelekile zokwelapha kuhlanganise izimo eziphuthumayo. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana, kokuhola, kokuxhumana nabantu nokwenza izinqumo. Ulwazi ngemithetho namapholisi okwelapha okwamanje ngokuvumelana nezikhungo zikahulumeni.
zu.duties: Leli isikhundla esibekwe kahle ne-University of the Witwatersrand futhi ngaleyo ndlela sihlanganisa imisebenzi yezemfundo nocywangingo kanye nezenzo zokulekelela nezinkingo zokuphatha. Sekela futhi usebenzise i-Psychiatry yomphakathi kanye nenakekelo lokuqala elihlanganisiwe lezemivo yengqondo eSedibeng Health District. Nikeza inakekelo, ukwelashwa, kanye nokulungisa izinkinga zobuchwepheshe bomphakathi njengengxenye yeqembu le-Psychiatry lomphakathi. Nikeza ukufundisa okwemfundo nokuqondisa abaphathi be-Psychiatric Registrars nabaphathi be-Medical Officers emakliniki le-Psychiatry esifundeni. Nikeza ukuqeqesha ngaphakathi kwenkonzo kanye nokuqondisa ngokwelapha kubaphathi be-Family Physicians balesifundo kanye nalabo abanakekela inempilo yokuqala ngokuqondisa ekunikeleni inakekelo lezemivo yengqondo ehlanganisiwe. Hlanganyisana nezinye izigaba ezingezona zokwelapha ngaphakathi kwesifundo ukubona futhi unakekele abantu abanesimo sengqondo. Thatha inxaxheba emigqweni yokufundisa nokwazisa ngokuya emphakathini ngokunakekelwa kwezemivo yengqondo. Khuthaze futhi wenze ucwaningo emkhakheni we-Psychiatry yomphakathi nokuqala inakekelo lezemivo yengqondo elihlanganisiwe. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuqondisa imibhalo yocwaningo we-Master's abayibhalayo abaphathi be-Psychiatric Registrars, ukuthatha inxaxheba emapuleketini ahlanganyelayo nezifundo zakho zocwaningo. Sebenza neqembu lezemivo yengqondo lesifundo okuvumelana nemisebenzi yokuphatha, ukuhlola izinhlobo zokwelapha, kanye nokuthuthukisa izinga lezinkonzo eziphansi zokwelapha i-Sedibeng Mental Health Services.

xh.title: Isebe lokwelapha: iPsychiatry
xh.summary: Isebe lokwelapha kwiPsychiatry leeNkonzo zeMental Health zeSedibeng District, elidityanisiwe neseWits, elibandakanya imisebenzi yeklinikhi, yezemfundo, yophando nakwimpilo yomtshato wepsychiatry.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seGrade 12/Matric. MBCHB. FC Psych / MMed (Psychiatry) okanye ngesiNgumelwane esivumela ubhaliso kuHealth Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) kwiPsychiatry. Ubhaliso lwangoku kwiHPCSA. Grade 1: akukho nqanaba lolwazi emva kokubhalisa kwiHPCSA njengesebe lokwelapha kummandla owaziwayo, Grade 2: ubuncinane eminyaka emi-5 yolwazi olufanelekileyo njengesebe lokwelapha emva kobhaliso kwiHPCSA kwiPsychiatry kwaye uGrade 3 ubuncinane eminyaka engama-10 yolwazi olufanelekileyo njengesebe lokwelapha emva kobhaliso kwiHPCSA njengesebe lokwelapha kwiPsychiatry. Ulwazi olulula namakhono ahambelana nokuzilolonga iPsychiatry. Ikhono lokuxilonga nokulawula iingxaki ezixhaphakileyo zokwelapha ezibandakanya ezingxwangu. Iimpawu ezilungileyo zokunxibelelana, kokukhokela, zobuntu nosigqibo. Ulwazi ngokuMthetho wezeMihla namagqabantsheti okuNemphi yamajele maholo njengoko ukhathalela iNkundla zikaLuntu.
xh.duties: Olu luthango oludityanisiweyo neNyuvesi yaseWitwatersrand ngoko ke luhlanganisa imisebenzi yezemfundo nophando kwaye nolwazi oluhlinzekiweyo nemisebenzi yokulawula. Xhasa nokusebenzisa iPsychiatry yomnqamulophakathi nokuNkqonkqotho yokuqala yemithi yengqondo eSedibeng Health District. Hlinzekela ngamasebe okwelapha abhalwe ngomntu singakunqamela kwiphakathi iPsychiatry yokunyanga nokuphinda uphephe kwindima eqela lePsychiatry yomphakathi. Hlinzekela ukufundisa ngemfundo nokugcina iqondo kumaPsychiatric Registrars namaMedical Officers kwiikliniki zikaPsychiatry zesithili. Hlinzela uqeqesho kwisebe kwaye usixhase iFamily Physicians abaqhuba isikhundla kwisebe kwaye abaqeqeshi bokunyanga iingxaki zokuqala kwindawo enokuzithuthisa komntu oyo kuye kuhambelane nokuhlinzela iNkqonkqotho yokuNkqonkqotho eqhagamshelene. Sebenzisana namaphandle angengawamaphakathi ngaphakathi kwendawo malunga nokuziqonda ukulungiselela nokuthathwa kwengqondo abantu abanengqondo egabhileyo. Thatha inxaxheba kumazinga omphakathi ezinga lemihla yokufundisa ngokuthumela nokuziqondisa. Khuthaza futhi uqeqeshe ucwaningo kolwazi kolwazi oluhle ziindawo zePsychiatry yomphakathi nokuNkqonkqotho yokuqala yemithi yengqondo. Oku kuquka ukulawula amabali oPhando weMaster's ngamaPsychiatric Registrars, ukuthathwa kwexesha kumaphulo abanengqondo nakwiaphulo ezingatshatanga. Sebenzisana neqela lemental health lesithili ngokubhekisele kumasebe okulawula, ukuqinisekisa izigqibo eziphathwayo, nokuphucula ngcono izinto ezingamva oluKholo lweeNkonzo zokuzilolonga iingqondo iSedibeng.

jobs.title: Medical Specialist Grade 1-3
jobs.centre: Tara the H. Moross Centre, Sandton
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R1 395 528 – R1 459 275.per annum, (all-inclusive salary package) Grade 2: R1 592 274 – R1 688 553.per annum, (all-inclusive salary package) Grade 3: R1 844 151 – R2 301 186.per annum, (all-inclusive salary package)
jobs.summary: Medical Specialist position in psychiatry at Tara the H. Moross Centre in Sandton, providing clinical services to psychiatric inpatient and outpatient units.
jobs.requirements: A medical MBBCh or equivalent degree with an appropriate qualification in psychiatry (FC Psych (SA), MMed (Psych) or equivalent qualification recognised by the HPCSA), which allows registration as a specialist psychiatrist with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA). Sound clinical knowledge and skills in psychiatry and child psychiatry. Ability to work in a multi-disciplinary team. Ability to fulfil the required teaching and training requirements. Knowledge of legislation, policies and procedures about mental health care users. Adequate interpersonal skills as well as professional and ethical conduct always. A valid driver’s license.
jobs.duties: Provide a direct clinical service and manage a psychiatric biological male inpatient unit. And a weekly outpatient clinic. The provision of care, treatment, and rehabilitation to mental health care users within the framework of the Mental Health Care Act (No 17 of 2002); involvement in other general psychiatry work as needed. Provide outreach services to District Health Services and District/ Regional hospitals. Teaching and training of medical students, medical officers and psychiatry registrars, as well as other personnel (e.g. nurses, etc.). To stimulate, assist with and conduct research relevant to the Gauteng Department of Health and Department of Psychiatry. To supervise and manage junior staff, which would include disciplinary responsibilities, when necessary. Administrative duties. Active participation in hospital management committees. To assist with the development of policies and protocols of the hospital. Active participation in quality improvement programs, including clinical audits, morbidity and mortality meetings and continuous professional development activities. To liaise with external stakeholders when appropriate. To always maintain professional and ethical conduct. This post is a joint appointment with the Department of Psychiatry, University of the Witwatersrand. The incumbent will be expected to participate in the teaching program of the department and to provide training to a range of students and healthcare workers.
jobs.enquiries: Ms. M.A Ngobeni – Ngobeni.mixo@gauteng.gov.za Ms S. Naidoo - Sheryl.naidoo@gauteng.gov.za

jobs.notes: Kindly note that no payment of any kind is required when applying for posts advertised by the Gauteng Department of Health. The Department reserves the right not to fill any advertised posts. Applications should be accompanied by a fully completed and signed new Z83 form obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.dpsa.gov.za/documents. The new Z83 form must be fully completed and signed by the applicant. The following must be considered in relation to the completion of the Z83 by applicants: All the fields in Part A, Part C and Part D must be completed. Leave the following question blank if they do not have such: “If your profession or occupation requires official registration, provide date and particulars of registration. Applications without proof of a new Z83 application form and a detailed CV will be disqualified. Applicants must indicate the post reference number on their applications. Shortlisted candidates will receive communication from the HR unit to submit certified copies of educational qualifications and other relevant documents not older than 6 months on or before the day of the interview. Personnel Suitability Checks (criminal checks, citizenship checks, qualification verification, company directorship, social media, financial record checks, reference checks) must be conducted before appointment. The recommended candidate will be subjected to Medical Surveillance as required by the Occupational Health and Safety Act, Act 5/1993.
