One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment.

af.title: Mediese Spesialis Vlak 1-3
af.summary: Mediese Spesialis-posisie in psigiatrie by Tara the H. Moross Centre in Sandton, wat kliniese dienste aan psigiatriese inpasient- en uitpasient-eenhede bied.
af.requirements: 'n Mediese MBBCh- of ekwivalente graad met 'n toepaslike kwalifikasie in psigiatrie (FC Psych (SA), MMed (Psych) of ekwivalente kwalifikasie erken deur die HPCSA), wat registrasie as 'n spesialis-psigiater by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) moontlik maak. Deglike kliniese kennis en vaardighede in psigiatrie en kinderpsigiatrie. Vermoë om in 'n multidissiplinêre span te werk. Vermoë om die vereiste onderrig- en opleidingsvereistes na te kom. Kennis van wetgewing, beleide en prosedures rakens geestesgesondheidsorggebruikers. Voldoende interpersoonlike vaardighede asook professionele en etiese gedrag te alle tye. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Verskaf 'n direkte kliniese diens en bestuur 'n psigiatriese biologiese manlike inpasient-eenheid. En 'n weeklikse uitpasient-kliniek. Die verskaffing van sorg, behandeling en rehabilitasie aan geestesgesondheidsorggebruikers binne die raamwerk van die Mental Health Care Act (No 17 of 2002); betrokkenheid by ander algemene psigiatriewerk soos benodig. Verskaf uitreikdienste aan Distriksgesondheidsdienste en Distriks-/Streeks-hospitale. Onderrig en opleiding van mediese studente, mediese beamptes en psigiatrie-registrateurs, asook ander personeel (bv. verpleegkundiges, ens.). Om navorsing wat relevant is tot die Gauteng Department of Health en die Department of Psychiatry te stimuleer, mee te help en uit te voer. Om junior personeel te superviseer en te bestuur, wat disiplinêre verantwoordelikhede sal insluit, wanneer nodig. Administratiewe pligte. Aktiewe deelname aan hospitaalbestuurskomitees. Om te help met die ontwikkeling van beleide en protokolle van die hospitaal. Aktiewe deelname aan gehalteverbeteringsprogramme, insluitend kliniese oudits, morbiditeits- en mortaliteitsvergaderings en voortdurende professionele ontwikkelingsaktiwiteite. Om met eksterne belanghebbendes te skakel wanneer toepaslik. Om te alle tye professionele en etiese gedrag te handhaaf. Hierdie pos is 'n gesamentlike aanstelling met die Department of Psychiatry, University of the Witwatersrand. Die persoon sal verwag word om aan die onderrigprogram van die departement deel te neem en opleiding aan 'n reeks studente en gesondheidsorgwerkers te verskaf.

zu.title: Isikhulu Sezokwelapha Esinga 1-3
zu.summary: Isikhundla sokuba ngumeluleki wezokwelapha kwizifo zengqondo eTara the H. Moross Centre eSandton, ukunikeza izinsizakalo zokwelapha kumagumbi okuhlala abaguli nabo abangahlali esibhedlela abanezifo zengqondo.
zu.requirements: Isiqu se-medical MBBCh noma esilinganayo nokuqeqeshwa okufanele kwizifo zengqondo (FC Psych (SA), MMed (Psych) noma isiqu esiqashelwa yi-HPCSA), esivumela ukubhalisa njengomeluleki wezifo zengqondo ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA). Ulwazi olujulile nezakhono zokwelapha kuzifo zengqondo nasezifo zengqondo zezingane. Ikono lokusebenza eqenjini elihlangeneabezikhulumi abahlukene. Ikono lokufeza izidingo zokufundisa nokuqeqesha. Ulwazi ngemithetho, izinqubomgomo nenqubo ngabasebenzisi bezokunakekelwa kwezempilo yengqondo. Izakhono ezanele zokuhlobana nabantu kanye nokuziphatha ngobungcweti nangokusesikweni ngaso sonke isikhathi. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile.
zu.duties: Nikeza insizakalo yokwelapha ngokuqondile uphathe igumbi labesilisa abagula bengqondo abahlala esibhedlela. Nakliniki yansuku zonke yabo abangahlali esibhedlela. Ukunikeza ukunakekelwa, ukwelashwa, kanye nokubuyisela empilweni abasebenzisi bezokunakekelwa kwezempilo yengqondo ngaphakathi kohlaka lwe-Mental Health Care Act (No 17 of 2002); ukubandakanyeka emsebenzini wezifo zengqondo jikelele njengoba kudingeka. Nikeza izinsizakalo zokwesekela kumnyango wezempilo wesifunda nakumasibhedlela wesifunda nesesifundazwe. Ukufundisa nokuqeqesha abafundi bezokwelapha, abaphathiwe bezokwelapha nabalawuli bezifo zengqondo, kanye nabasebenzi abanye (isb. osohlanga, njll). Ukukhuthaza, ukusiza nokwenza ucwaningo oluhambisana noMnyango Wezempilo waseGauteng noMnyango Wezifo Zengqondo. Ukulawula baphathiwe abasha, okufaka phakathi izibopho zesisulu, uma kunesidingo. Imisebenzi yolawulo. Ukubamba iqhaza kumakomidi olawulo esibhedlela. Ukusiza ekwakheni izinqubomgomo nenqubo yesibhedlela. Ukubamba iqhaza kuhlelo lokuthuthukisa izinga, okufaka phakathi ukuhlola ukwelapha, izinkomfa zokugula nokufa kanye nemisebenzi yokuthuthukisa obungcweti ngokuqhubekayo. Ukuxhumana namajitha angaphandle uma kufanelekile. Ukugcina ukuziphatha ngobungcweti nangokusesikweni ngaso sonke isikhathi. Lesisikhundla singabekwa ngokuhlanganyiswa noMnyango Wezifo Zengqondo, eNyuvesi yaseWitwatersrand. Uzothiwa athathe inxaxheba kuhlelo lokufundisa lomnyango futhi anikeze ukuqeqeshwa ohlotsheni lubafushi nabasebenzi bezempilo.

xh.title: Isebe Lsezempilo lenqanaba 1-3
xh.summary: Isikhundla sokuba ngIgqirha eziquphele kwindawo yobuchopho kwiZiko leTara the H. Moross eSandton, sinika iinkonzo zezempilo kwiiyuniti zabagula abalala esibhedlele nabo bengangena kwiiyuniti zabagula abangalali esibhedlele kwizifo zomqondo.
xh.requirements: Degree ye-MBBCh yezempilo okanye isidanga esilinganayo kunye nefomali efanelekileyo kwindawo yobuchopho (FC Psych (SA), MMed (Psych) okanye isidanga esilinganayo esivunyiwe yi-HPCSA), esivumela ukubhalisa njengogqirha ohlolwe nzima kwindawo yobuchopho ku-HPCSA. Ulwazi olungathandabuzekiyo nezakhono ezenzweni yezempilo kwizifo zomqondo nakuwo onke amacala okuziphatha kwizifo zomqondo. Ukuba namandla okusebenza kwiqela labasebenzi abavela kumacandelo ahlukeneyo. Ukuba namandla okuphumeza iimfuno zokufundisa nokulungiselela ukuqeqesha. Ulwazi ngemithetho, iinkqubo nezendlela zokwenza izinto ezithintela abasebenzisi bemfundo yezempilo yomqondo. Amandla ahambelana nabantu abanye kwaye ukhokelele ngokungazityezisi nangokunesithunzi xesha lonke. Ilayisense yokuqhuba esebenzayo.
xh.duties: Ukunika inkonzo yezempilo ngqo kwaye ulawule iyuniti yamadoda abagula abalala esibhedlele kwizifo zomqondo. Kunye nenkliniki yabagula abangangeni esibhedlele ngeveki. Ukunika ukunakekelwa, unyango, nokubuyisela kwimpilo kubasebenzisi bemfundo yezempilo yomqondo ngaphakathi kwendlela ephantsi koMthetho wokuNakekelwa kweZempilo yomQondo (No 17 of 2002); ungenelo kwenye imisebenzi eqhelekileyo yezifo zomqondo njengoko kudingeka. Ukunika iinkonzo ezithunyelwa kumacandelo ezeZempilo ezingangingeli namaziko ezempilo ezingangingi noma asezingqongqo. Ukufundisa nokuqeqesha abafundi bezempilo, abantu basebenza ngamagqirha kwizifo zomqondo nababhalisiweyo, nabo bonke abanye basebenzi (umz. abafundisi, njl.). Ukuxhobisa, unceda kwaye uqhube uphando oluhambelana neSebe leZempilo laGauteng nesebe lezoZifo zoMqondo. Ukulawula abasebenzi abasezantsi, oko kuza kuquka iintsundubuso, xa kudingeka. Imisebenzi yolawulo. Ukuzibandakanya ngokusebenzayo kwiikomiti ezilawula izibhedlele. Ukunceda ekwenzeni iinkqubo nezendlela zolawulo zesibhedlele. Ukubandakanywa ngokusebenzayo kwiinkqubo zokuphucula izinga lemfundo, kuquka ukuhlolwa kwezempilo, iindibano ezithetha ngokugula nokufa, namanyathelo okuqhubeka phambili ngemfundo yomuntu. Ukuxhumana nabo bavulelekileyo ngaphandle, kwelinye ilanga, apho kufanelekileyo. Ukuphila ubomi obunesithunzi kwaye uthathele ingqalelo ngokungazityezisi xesha lonke. Isikhundla sile sisesinye isikhundla esidibana nesebe leZifo zoMqondo, kwiYunivesithi yaseWitwatersrand. Umlandeli weza kulindeleke ukuba abambe iqhaza kwenkqubo yokufundisa kwesebe aze anikeze ukuqeqeswa kumalungu abafundi ablukeneyo nesebenzi basezempilo.

jobs.title: Principal Psychologist
jobs.centre: Tara the H. Moross Centre, Sandton
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R1 295 388 - R1 436 913 per annum, (all-inclusive salary package) Grade 2: R1 477 776 - R1 689 672 per annum, (all-inclusive salary package)
jobs.summary: Principal Psychologist position at Tara the H. Moross Centre in Sandton, requiring a Master's degree in Clinical Psychology and at least 5 years' post-community service experience.
jobs.requirements: A Master’s Degree in Clinical Psychology that allows registration with the Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a psychologist in a relevant registration category, i.e., Clinical. A minimum of 5 years’ appropriate clinical experience as a Clinical Psychologist after community service and registration with the HPCSA as an independent clinical psychologist. The candidate must be able to provide and oversee the provision of psychological services and be adept at working with multi-disciplinary teams and using different therapeutic modalities. Must be experienced in the use and supervision of various psychometric assessments. Must be knowledgeable, skilled, and experienced in supervising intern psychologists, other psychologists, clinical and didactic teaching, the Mental Health Care Act, and other relevant laws and regulations. Must possess good communication skills and administration and leadership skills. Must be computer literate and in possession of a valid driver's license. Experience working in a Specialized Psychiatry Hospital or Specialized Psychiatry Unit will be an added advantage. Experience with any of the following will be an added advantage: Psychodynamic Therapy, Dialectical Behavioural Therapy, Cognitive Behavioural Therapy and Family Therapy.
jobs.duties: The candidate will be responsible for planning, managing and overseeing psychological services in the institution. Provide clinical services within one of the hospital's treatment units. The candidate will be a joint appointee with WITS within the Division of Psychology, Department of Psychiatry, WITS. Coordinate and participate in the training and supervision of psychology interns, junior psychologists, psychiatric registrars, medical students, nurses and other clinical support and therapeutic service personnel, in addition to teaching undergraduate and postgraduate students at the University. Involved in promoting, conducting and supervising research projects. The candidate will serve on the Extended Management Team of the organisation and participate in some of the hospital’s committees. Collaborate with various relevant external organisations and stakeholders.
jobs.enquiries: Ms. M.A Ngobeni – Ngobeni.mixo@gauteng.gov.za Ms. S. Naidoo - Sheryl.naidoo@gauteng.gov.za
jobs.applications: should be submitted strictly online at the following E-Recruitment portal: http://jobs.gauteng.gov.za. No hand-delivered, faxed, or emailed applications will be accepted. For assistance with online applications, please email your query to healthjobqueries@gauteng.gov.za
jobs.notes: Kindly note that no payment of any kind is required when applying for posts advertised by the Gauteng Department of Health. The Department reserves the right not to fill any advertised posts. Applications should be accompanied by a fully completed and signed new Z83 form obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.dpsa.gov.za/documents. The new Z83 form must be fully completed and signed by the applicant. The following must be considered in relation to the completion of the Z83 by applicants: All the fields in Part A, Part C and Part D must be completed. Leave the following question blank if they do not have such: “If your profession or occupation requires official registration, provide date and particulars of registration. Applications without proof of a new Z83 application form and a detailed CV will be disqualified. Applicants must indicate the post reference number on their applications. Shortlisted candidates will receive communication from the HR unit to submit certified copies of educational qualifications and other relevant documents not older than 6 months on or before the day of the interview. Personnel Suitability Checks (criminal checks, citizenship checks, qualification verification, company directorship, social media, financial record checks, reference checks) must be conducted before appointment. The recommended candidate will be subjected to Medical Surveillance as required by the Occupational Health and Safety Act, Act 5/1993. Applicants with foreign qualifications remain responsible for ensuring that their qualifications are evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Preference will be given to South African citizens. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment.

af.title: Hoofsielkundige
af.summary: Hoofsielkundige pos by Tara the H. Moross Centre in Sandton, wat 'n Meestersgraad in Kliniese Sielkunde en ten minste 5 jaar se ervaring na gemeenskapsdiens vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Meestersgraad in Kliniese Sielkunde wat registrasie by die Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as sielkundige in 'n toepaslike registrasiekategorie, d.w.s. Klinies, moontlik maak. 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se toepaslike kliniese ervaring as 'n Kliniese Sielkundige na gemeenskapsdiens en registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n onafhanklike kliniese sielkundige. Die kandidaat moet in staat wees om sielkundige dienste te verskaf en te oorsien, en bedrewe wees in samenwerking met multidissiplinêre spanne en die gebruik van verskillende terapeutiese modighede. Moet ervaring hê in die gebruik en toesig van verskeie psigometriese assesserings. Moet kennis hê, vaardig en ervare wees in die toesig hou van internsielkundiges, ander sielkundiges, kliniese en didaktiese onderrig, die Mental Health Care Act, en ander relevante wette en regulasies. Moet oor goeie kommunikasievaardighede asook administratiewe en leierskapsvaardighede beskik. Moet rekenaargeletterd wees en oor 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie beskik. Ervaring in 'n Gespesialiseerde Psigiatriese Hospitaal of Gespesialiseerde Psigiatriese Eenheid sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Ervaring met enige van die volgende sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees: Psigodinamiese Terapie, Dialektiese Gedragsterapie, Kognitiewe Gedragsterapie en Gesinsterapie.
af.duties: Die kandidaat sal verantwoordelik wees vir die beplanning, bestuur en toesig van sielkundige dienste in die instelling. Verskaf kliniese dienste binne een van die hospitaal se behandelingseenhede. Die kandidaat sal 'n gesamentlike aanstelling by WITS binne die Division of Psychology, Department of Psychiatry, WITS wees. Koördineer en neem deel aan die opleiding en toesig van sielkunde-internes, junior sielkundiges, psigiatriese registrateurs, mediese studente, verpleegsters en ander kliniese ondersteunings- en terapeutiese dienstepersoneel, benewens die onderrig van voorgraadse en nagraadse studente aan die Universiteit. Betrokke by die bevordering, uitvoering en toesig van navorsingsprojekte. Die kandidaat sal op die Extended Management Team van die organisasie dien en aan sommige van die hospitaal se komitees deelneem. Werk saam met verskeie relevante eksterne organisasies en belanghebbendes.

zu.title: I-Psychologist Eyinhloko
zu.summary: Isikhundla sika-Psychologist Eyinhloko e-Tara the H. Moross Centre e-Sandton, sifuna iziqu ze-Master's degree ku-Clinical Psychology kanye nokuba nezinyanga ezingaphezu kuka-5 zokusebenza ngemva kwenkonzo yomphakathi.
zu.requirements: I-Master's Degree ku-Clinical Psychology evumela ukubhalisa ku-Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengo-psychologist ohlangothini oluhambisano lokubhalisa, okungukuthi, i-Clinical. Umkhulu ongafani naye weminyaka engu-5 wobuhle bezokwelapha njengo-Clinical Psychologist ngemva kwenkonzo yomphakathi nokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengo-clinical psychologist ezimele. Umuntu ophumelelayo kumele akwazi ukunikeza futhi aqaphele ukunikezwa kwezinsizakalo ze-psychological abe nolwazi ekusebenzeni namakhasu amaningi ahlangene kanye nokusebenzisa izindlela ezahlukene zokwelapha. Kumele abe namava ekusebenziseni nasekuqapheleni izivivinyo ezahlukene ze-psychometric. Kumele abe nalwazi, amakhono, namava ekuqapheleni abafundi be-intern psychologist, abanye ama-psychologist, ukufundisa ezokwelapha nasezifundweni, i-Mental Health Care Act, kanye nezinye izindlela nomthetho ahlobene nawo. Kumele abe namakhono amahle okuxhumana kanye namakhono okuphatha nokuqamba. Kumele akwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha abe nelayisensi evumelekile yokushayela. Amva ekusebenzeni esibhedlela se-Specialized Psychiatry noma kunithi ye-Specialized Psychiatry kuzoba yinzuzo. Amva kunoma yisiphi esilandelayo kuzoba yinzuzo: i-Psychodynamic Therapy, i-Dialectical Behavioural Therapy, i-Cognitive Behavioural Therapy kanye ne-Family Therapy.
zu.duties: Umuntu ophumelelayo uzobe nogwalolokubhekana nokuhlela, ukuphatha, nokuqaphela izinsizakalo ze-psychological esikhungweni. Nikela izinsizakalo ze-clinical kunithi enkunjanini yokwelapha yesibhedlela. Umuntu ophumelelayo uzoba ngumuntu ohlelwe kahlanganyelo ne-WITS phakathi kwe-Division of Psychology, i-Department of Psychiatry, i-WITS. Hlelelabanye futhi uthathe inxaxheba ekufundiseni nasekuqapheleni abafundi be-psychology internship, abangama-psychologist abasha, abafundi be-psychiatric registrar, abafundi bezokufundiswa, abasesi, abanye abanikela ngokusekelwa ezokwelapha nezinsizakalo zokwelapha, ngaphezu kokufundisa abafundi be-undergraduate nabe-postgraduate eNyuvesi. Nabantu ekuthuthukiseni, ekwenzeni nasekuqapheleni imikhuba yocwaningo. Umuntu ophumelelayo uzoba lilungu le-Extended Management Team yenhlangano futhi uthathe inxaxheba kwamakomidi ethile esibhedlela. Sebenzisana nama-organisation ahlukene ahlobene angaphandle nabantu abaneziqu.

xh.title: Unxibelelanisi weNtlalo-mpilo oPhambili
xh.summary: Isithuba sikaUnxibelelanisi weNtlalo-mpilo oPhambili kwiZiko i-Tara the H. Moross Centre eSandton, kufuneka kubekho isiQinisekiso seMasters kwipsikholoji yoNqanba lweMiba zenkcubeko kwaye kubekho iminyaka engu-5 ngenxa yamava emisebenzi yokuqala yangaphambi kokuba umphathiswa wenkundla yamasebe.
xh.requirements: IsiQinisekiso seMasters kwipsikholoji yoNqanaba lweMiba zenkcubeko esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengongxibelelanisi bentlalo-mpilo kuluhlu lwebhaliso elifaneleyo, oko kukuthi, iNkunguNqanaba lweMiba zenkcubeko. Kufuneka kubekho iminyaka engu-5 yamava abalulekileyo ekunxibelelaniseni ngokomsebenzi njengongxibelelanisi bentlalo-mpilo emva kwenkonzo yomphakathi nokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengongxibelelanisi bentlalo-mpilo ozimeleyo. Kufuneka umphathiswa akwazi ukubonelela nokulawula ukubonelelwa kweenkonzo zentlalo-mpilo abe nesipho sokusebenza namaqela anomsebenzi wemimandla eyahlukeneyo nokusebenzisa iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokuxhuba. Kufuneka abe namava ekusebenziseni nokuqonda iziphimo ezahlukeneyo ezikulinganiselwa ngokomqondo. Kufuneka abe nolwazi, amandla, namava ekulawulekeni abafundi bentlalo-mpilo, oonxibelelanisi benhlobo yentlalo-mpilo abanye, nokufundisa ngokweNqanaba lezeMfundo eNqanaba eliphezulu naseNqanaba lemibongo, iMthetho woNxibelelaniso weMiba yoMqondo, nemithetho yamanye amagatya alingana nayo. Kufuneka abe nethamsanqa lokuthetha kakuhle namandla okulawula nokuba ngumphathi. Kufuneka akwazi ukusebenzisa iikhompyutha abe nelayisenisi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Amava okusebenza eSibhedlele esiNgqongileyo sePsychiatry okanye kwiSebe sePsychiatry esiNgqongileyo ziya kuba lulonke olungalumkanga.
xh.duties: Umntu oya kukhethwa uya kuba uyilo, alawule, abe sikhokheli kwezona nkonzo zintle-mpilo zefekilishini yokusebenza. Uya kubonelela ngemisebenzi yomthunywa kwelinye iyunithi yokwelapha yesibhedlele. Uya kubakho ekubhalisweni okuhlangeneyo ne-WITS kwisiQendu sePsychology, isebe lePsychiatry, e-WITS. Uya kulungelelanisa nokuthabatha inxaxheba ekufundiseni nokuqondisa abafundi bentlalo-mpilo, oonxibelelanisi bentsha bentlalo-mpilo, ababhalisi bePsychiatry, abafundi bokugqonywa, oogqirha, ooNongxibelelanisi bamaqapho miba yokugonya nokunye ukusebenza nokuxhasa ukubonelelwa kokuthabatha inxaxheba nokufundisa abafundi benqanaba elingaphantsi kwesidanga senqanaba eliphezulu eYunivesithi. Uya kubakho ekugxilweni, ekwenzeni nasekuqondiseni amaprojekthi wophando. Umntu oya kukhethwa uya kuba ngumntu osemthethweni kwiNqanaba EliDlulileyo loLawulo loluntu apho uya kuthabatha inxaxheba kwamagqabantshushi amaninzi esibhedlele. Uya kuqamba iindlela zokusebenza ngokubambisana namahlelo angaphandle nemigangatho ehlobene nayo.

jobs.title: Assistant Manager Nursing Area (NIGHT Duty)
jobs.salary_text: R720 819 – R846 282 per annum, plus benefits
jobs.summary: Assistant Manager Nursing required for night duty at Tambo Memorial Hospital in Gauteng, needing eight years of nursing experience and SANC registration.
jobs.requirements: Basic qualification accredited with the SANC in terms of Government Notice R425 (i.e. Diploma / Degree in Nursing) or equivalent qualification that allows registration with the SANC as a Professional Nurse. A minimum of eight (08) years appropriate/ recognizable experience in nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. A diploma / Degree in Nursing Administration or Health Service Management. At least three (3) years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/ recognizable experience at Management level. Strong leadership skills, good communication and writing skills. Problem solving, conflict resolution skills, able to work above under pressure. Sound interrelationship is necessary in understanding of National Core Standards and Ideal Hospital Framework, Nursing Strategy, PFMA, Labour relations and other related legislative framework. Basic computer skill or qualification.
jobs.duties: Delegate, supervise and coordinate the provision of effective and efficient Patient care through adequate nursing care. Initiate and participate in health promotion to ensure consistence communication of relevant, accurate and comprehensive information on health care. Develop / establish and maintain constructive working relationship with nursing and other stakeholders (i.e. inter- sectoral and multidisciplinary teamwork). Participate in the analysis, formulation and implementation of nursing guidelines, practices, policies and standard operating procedures. Manage effective utilization and supervision of human, financial and material resources. Coordination of provision of effective training and research. Maintain professional growth / ethical standards and development of self and subordinates.
jobs.applications: Applications must be submitted on a (PDF Format only) to the following E- Recruitment Email: TMH.RecruitmentHR@gauteng.gov.za. Applications can be forwarded to the Human Resource Department, Tambo Memorial Hospital, Private Bag X2, Boksburg, 1459. Physical Address: Railway Street, Boksburg, 1459.
jobs.notes: Applications must include only completed and signed new Form Z83, obtainable      from     any     Public     Service     Department        or     on (www.dpsa.gov.za/documents) accompanied by a comprehensive CV highlighting or stating the requirements mentioned above. Only the shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of Identity document, Senior Certificate and highest required qualification as well as a driver’s licence where necessary on or before interviews. Applicants must indicate the post reference number on their applications. Qualifications of candidates recommended for appointment will be verified. Foreign qualifications will only be submitted by shortlisted candidates. Applications received after closing date and time will not be considered. Whites, coloured and people with disability are encouraged to apply. The candidates will be expected to be available for selection interviews on the date, time and place determined by the Department. NB: All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment.

af.title: Assistent-bestuurder Verpleging Area (NAG Diens)
af.summary: Assistent-bestuurder Verpleging benodig vir nagdiens by Tambo Memorial Hospital in Gauteng, wat agt jaar se verpleegervaring en SANC-registrasie vereis.
af.requirements: Basiese kwalifikasie geakkrediteer by die SANC ingevolge Regeringskennisgewing R425 (d.w.s. Diploma / Graad in Verpleegkunde) of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. 'n Minimum van agt (08) jaar toepaslike / herkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleging. 'n Diploma / Graad in Verpleegadministrasie of Gesondheidsdiensbestuur. Ten minste drie (3) jaar van die bovermelde tydperk moet toepaslike / herkenbare ervaring op bestuursvlak wees. Sterke leierskapsvaardighede, goeie kommunikasie en skryfvaardighede. Probleemoplossing, konflikoplossingsvaardighede, in staat om onder druk te werk. Gesonde interpersoonlike verhoudinge is nodig in begrip van Nasionale Kerntandaarde en Ideaal Hospitaalraamwerk, Verpleegstrategie, PFMA, Arbeidsverhoudinge en ander verwante wetgewende raamwerke. Basiese rekenaarvaardigheid of kwalifikasie.
af.duties: Delegeer, hou toesig en koördineer die verskaffing van doeltreffende en produktiewe pasiëntesorg deur voldoende verpleegsorg. Inisieer en neem deel aan gesondheidsbevordering om konsekwente kommunikasie van tersaaklike, akkurate en omvattende inligting oor gesondheidsorg te verseker. Ontwikkel / vestig en handhaaf 'n konstruktiewe werksverhouding met verpleegpersoneel en ander belanghebbendes (d.w.s. intersektoriële en multidissiplinêre spanwerk). Neem deel aan die ontleding, formulering en implementering van verpleegriglyne, praktyke, beleide en standaardbedryfsprosedures. Bestuur doeltreffende benutting en toesig oor menslike, finansiële en materiële hulpbronne. Koördineer die verskaffing van doeltreffende opleiding en navorsing. Handhaaf professionele groei / etiese standaarde en ontwikkeling van self en ondergeskiktes.

zu.title: Umphathi Ohlanganyele Wezindawo Zokunakekela Abagulayo (UMSEBENZI WASEBUSUKU)
zu.summary: Kudingeka umphathi ohlanganyele wezokunakekela abagulayo osebenza ebusuku eTambo Memorial Hospital eGauteng, ofuna iminyaka eyisishiyagalombili yokuhlolwa kokusebenza ezokunakekela abagulayo nokuqeshwa kwiSANC.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezisemthethweni ezivunyelwe yiSANC ngokusho kweGovernment Notice R425 (okungukuthi iDiploma / iDegree eNursing) noma iziqu ezilinganayo ezivumela ukuqeshwa kwiSANC njengenesi ohlotshaneni. Ubuncane beminyaka eyisishiyagalombili (08) yokuhlolwa okufanele/okuthathwa njengokuqashayo ezokunakekela abagulayo emva kokuqeshwa njengenesi ohlotshaneni kwiSANC eNursing jikelele. iDiploma / iDegree kwiNursing Administration noma iHealth Service Management. Okungenani iminyaka eyithathu (3) yalesosikhathi esishiwo ngenhla kumele ibe ukuhlolwa okufanele/okuthathwa njengokuqashayo ezingeni lokuphatha. Amakhono obuholi amakhulu, amakhono okuxhumana kahle nokuwakhuluma. Ikhono lokuxazulula izinkinga, amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga phakathi kwabantu, ukwazi ukusebenza ngaphansi komfutho. Kubalulekile ukuba nobudlelwano obuhle ukuze kuqondwe iNational Core Standards neIdeal Hospital Framework, iNursing Strategy, iPFMA, ubuhlobo bezabasebenzi kanye nezinye izakhiwo zomthetho ezihlobene nalokhu. Amakhono noma iziqu ezesidlula esisebenza ngesiCikizi.
zu.duties: Yabelise, lawula futhi uhlele ukunikezwa kokunakekelwa kwabagulayo okusebenza kahle nangempumelelo ngesokunakekela abagulayo okwanele. Qala futhi uthathe inxaxheba ekuthuthukisweni kwempilo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuxhumana okungaguquki kokwaziswa okufanele, okuqinisekisiwe nokuphelele mayelana nokuqashwa kwezempilo. Yakha / misa futhi ulondoloze ubudlelwano bokusebenza obuhle nezokunakekela abagulayo kanye nezinye izinxusa (okungukuthi, ukusebenza kwabobonke ngokuhlanganyela nakwezinye izigaba). Thatha inxaxheba ekuhloleni, ukwakheni nokuqalisweni kwezindlela zokunakekela, izenzo, izinqubomgomo kanye nendlela esemthethweni yokusebenza. Lawula ukusetshenziswa okusebenza kahle nokuqondisa izinsiza zomuntu, ezezimali nezempahla. Hlela ukunikezwa kokuqeqesha okusebenza kahle nokuphenya. Gitsha ukukhula kwabahofesi / izinga lezimiso zokuziphatha nokuthuthukiswa kwakho kanye nabangaphansi.

I-Diploma / I-Degree kwi-Nursing) okanye isifanekiso esilinganayo esivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengogqirha weSikhwi. Kufuneka kubekho ubuncinane beminyaka yamasi tu (08) yamava afanelekileyo / aqatyiweyo esikhwini emva kokubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengogqirha weSikhwi kwijikelezi yonke. I-Diploma / I-Degree eNkuliso yeNursing okanye eNkuliso yokuLawula Iinkonzo zeMpilo. Ubuncinane kwiminyaka emithathu (3) yexesha elidweliswe ngasentla kufuneka ibe ngamava afanelekileyo / aqatyiweyo kwinqanaba loLawulo. Amakhono amaninzi okukhokela, amakhono oluntu olulungileyo nokubhala. Amakhono okusombulula iingxaki, amakhono okusombulula iingxabano, ukwazi ukusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo. Kufuneka kubekho isimo esichanekileyo sokuqonda iNational Core Standards naye-Ideal Hospital Framework, i-Nursing Strategy, i-PFMA, i-Labour relations nayo nayiphi na enye inkqubo yomthetho. Isakhono esisisiseko sekhompyutha okanye isifanekiso.
xh.duties: Nikezela, ulawule yaye uhlole ukubonelelwa kokhatho olusebenzayo noluchanekileyo kumguli ngokusebenzisa ukhatho olufaneleyo lwesikhwi. Qalisa yaye uthathe inxaxheba ekuthuthuzeni impilo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukudibana ngokungathandabuzekiyo kweenkcazelo ezibalulekileyo, eziyinyaniso naneenkcazelo ezipheleleyo ngenkatho yempilo. Phuhlisa / misela yaye ulonde ubudlelwane bokusebenza obusempilweni nesikhwi nabanyeabanomdla (okt. ukusebenzisana ngaphakathi kweesebe nangaphandle kunye nomsebenzi wesiqhenga esininzi). Thathe inxaxheba ekwahlulweni phantsi, ekuyileni nasekuphozeni ekugqibeleni iinkqubo zesikhwi, iindlela zokwenza umsebenzi, iinkqubo neenkqubo zokusebenza ezisesikweni. Lawula ukusetyenziswa okusebenzayo nokuqondiswa kweempahla zabantu, zemali nezofuziso. Lawula ukubonelelwa kwemfundo nophando olusebenzayo. Londa ukukhula komsebenzi / iingqwalasela ezisesikweni kuphuhliso lwakho nabalawuli bakho.

jobs.summary: Clinical Nurse Practitioner in Forensic Nursing at Sedibeng District Health Services, providing specialised care to gender-based violence survivors.
jobs.requirements: A basic R425 qualification (i.e. Diploma / Degree in nursing or equivalent qualification that allows registration with SANC as professional nurse. Current registration with SANC. A post basic nursing qualification, with duration of at least one year in Forensic Nursing, specializing in the application of forensic science and Clinical Nursing Practice as accredited with SANC. Grade 1: A minimum of 4 years’ appropriate /recognizable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. Grade 2: A minimum of 14 years’ appropriate/recognizable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. At least 10 years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/recognisable experience in the specific speciality after obtaining the 1-year post-basic qualification in the relevant speciality.
jobs.duties: Coordination of optimal, holistic specialised nursing care provided for survivors of gender-based violence within set standards and professional/legal framework. Manage effectively the utilisation and supervision of resources including human and financial resources. Promote stakeholders collaboration, Provision of administrative and educational services through completion of statistics, ensuring safe keeping of records, health promotion and awareness campaigns relating to gender-based violence. Maintain professional growth/ethical standards and self-development and development of staff members. Generate weekly and monthly reports.

af.title: Kliniese Verpleegpraktisyn (PNB1) Forensiese Verpleegkundige
af.summary: Kliniese verpleegpraktisyn in Forensiese Verpleging by Sedibeng Distrik Gesondheidsdienste, wat gespesialiseerde sorg aan oorlewendes van geslagsgebaseerde geweld verleen.
af.requirements: A basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.w.s. Diploma / Graad in verpleging of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie wat registrasie by SANC as professionele verpleegkundige toelaat. Huidige registrasie by SANC. 'n Post-basiese verpleegkwalifikasie, met 'n duur van ten minste een jaar in Forensiese Verpleging, wat spesialiseer in die toepassing van forensiese wetenskap en Kliniese Verplegingspraktyk soos geakkrediteer by SANC. Graad 1: 'n Minimum van 4 jaar se toepaslike /herkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleging. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 14 jaar se toepaslike/herkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleging. Ten minste 10 jaar van die bogenoemde periode moet toepaslike/herkenbare ervaring in die spesifieke spesialiteit wees na verkryging van die 1-jaar post-basiese kwalifikasie in die tersaaklike spesialiteit.
af.duties: Koördinering van optimale, holistiese gespesialiseerde verpleegsorg wat aan oorlewendes van geslagsgebaseerde geweld binne vasgestelde standaarde en professionele/regsraamwerk verleen word. Bestuur die benutting en toesig oor hulpbronne, waaronder menslike en finansiële hulpbronne, doeltreffend. Bevorder belanghebbende-samewerking, voorsiening van administratiewe en opvoedkundige dienste deur voltooiing van statistieke, versekering van veilige bewaring van rekords, gesondheidsbevordering en bewusmakingsveldtogte rakende geslagsgebaseerde geweld. Handhaaf professionele groei/etiese standaarde en selfontwikkeling en ontwikkeling van personeellede. Genereer weeklikse en maandelikse verslae.

zu.title: Umhlengikazi Wemisebenzi Yokwelapha (PNB1) Umhlengikazi Wobuhlola
zu.summary: Umhlengikazi Wemisebenzi Yokwelapha Kwezobuhlola Ezisenyameni Esemkhakheni Wezempilo Esifundeni saka-Sedibeng, enikeza ukunakekelwa okukhethekile kulabo abasindile ekucasulweni ngokwesini.
zu.requirements: Ithifikhedi elinguneqolo le-R425 (okungukuthi iDiploma / I-digri ekwelapheni noma iziqu ezingalelo ezivumela ukubhalisa ku-SANC njengomhlengikazi othile. Ukubhaliswa njengamanje ku-SANC. Isiqu sokwelapha sangemva kwenqunqo, ngobude bonyaka ungamunye ekwelapheni kobuhlola, eziqhelanisa ngokusetshenziswa kwezesayensi yobuhlola nokusebenza njengomhlengikazi oqeqeshiwe okuhambisana nenhlangano ye-SANC. Izinga 1: Okungenani eminyaka engu-4 yokuhlangabezana / yokuqashwa kokuhlolwa ekwelapheni ngemva kokubhaliswa njengomhlengikazi othile ku-SANC ekwelapheni jikelele. Izinga 2: Okungenani eminyaka engu-14 yokuhlangabezana / yokuqashwa yokuhlolwa ekwelapha ngemva kokubhaliswa njengomhlengikazi othile ku-SANC ekwelapheni jikelele. Okungenani eminyaka engu-10 kule minyaka ekushiwo ngenhla kufanele kube ukuhlangabezana / ukuqashwa okuhlolwa ohlangothini oluthize ngemva kokuthola isiqu sangemva kwenqunqo sonyaka ungamunye ohlangothini oluhambisana nalolu.

Uphathe ngempumelelo ukusetshenziswa nokuqondwa kwemithombo kumbandakanya imithobo yabantu neyemali. Ukukhuthaza ukusebenzisana nezinxulumenye, ukunikela ngezenkonzo zokuphatha nezemfundo ngokugcwalisa izibalo, ukuqinisekisa ukugcinwa kuhle kwezinkomba, ukukhuthaza isempilo nakumikhankaso yokwazisa abantu abaye babathinteka ekucasulweni ngokwesini. Ukugcina ukukhula ngomsebenzi / izinga zokuziphatha nokuziphilisa komuntu ngamunye nokuqeqesha abasebenzi. Ukukhiqiza izibalo ezivezwe masontwe nanyanga zonke.

xh.title: Umntu oQeqeselwe uBuntšhakazi bokuGula kwiNdawo yeBaluleko (PNB1) wa Mosebetsi wa tša Setšo
xh.summary: Mongwa wa dikgwebo tša bongaka ge e le go tšwa Sedibeng District Health Services, a fana ka tlhokomelo ya go šireletsa batho ba ba šupeditšwego go hlokelega ka lebaka la bosenyi bjo bo amanego le bong.
xh.requirements: Tsebo yeo e lego motheo ya R425 (ke go reya Tekanyo/Khoso ya bongaka goba tekanyo ye e swanago yeo e dumelago go ngwalwa go SANC bjalo ka mongwadi wa bosebetsi. Boitsebišo bja gone bja go ngwalwa go SANC. Tekanyo ya go tšwa morago ga ya moya, yeo e nago le nako ya bonye e le ngwaga o tee go Mosebetsi wa tša Setšo, ya go šireletsa tsebo ya setšo le go šireletsa dikgwebo tša bongaka bjalo ka ge go dumetšwe go SANC. Go fiwa maemo a 1: Go na le tsebo ya bonye e le 4 ya boitsebišo bjo bo amanego kapa bjo bo tsebjago go tšwa go tšwa nakong ya go ngwalwa bjalo ka mongwadi wa bosebetsi go SANC go tša kgale. Go fiwa maemo a 2: Go na le tsebo ya bonye e le 14 ya boitsebišo bjo bo amanego kapa bjo bo tsebjago go tšwa go tšwa nakong ya go ngwalwa bjalo ka mongwadi wa bosebetsi go SANC go tša kgale. Go na le bonye e le 10 ya nako yeo e boletšwego godimo, e swanago go ba boitsebišo bjo bo amanego kapa bjo bo tsebjago lefelong lefe kapa lefe go tšwa morago ga go hwetša tekanyo ya 1 ya go tšwa morago ga ngwaga go lefelong leo le amanego.
xh.duties: Go hlokomela ka go šiya ditekanyo tša bongaka tše di šomago ka mo go feletšego, tše di akaretšago go šireletsa batho ba ba šupeditšwego go hlokelega ka lebaka la bosenyi bjo bo amanego le bong, go šiya ditekanyo tšeo di beilwego gona le tša molao. Go laola ka go šoma ka botirišo le tlhokomelo ya didiriswa go akaretša batho le madi. Go šireletsa tirišano ya batho, go fana ka ditirelo tša taolo le thuto ka go phetha dipalopalo, go šireletsa boloki bja ditokomanisi, go šireletsa botsogo le dikgatišo tša go tsebisa ka bosenyi bjo bo amanego le bong. Go šiya maemo a go gola a bosebetsi le maemo a maitshwaro le go iketla le go tsoša bakgamedi ba bangwe. Go hlaola pegelo tša ba beilwego ka beke le kgwedi.

jobs.summary: Chief Director leading infrastructure research, planning and coordination at the Gauteng Department of Infrastructure Development's Head Office in Johannesburg.
jobs.requirements: An undergraduate qualification at NQF level 7 Economics/ Management Sciences (Informatics)/ Built Environment/ Industrial Engineering/ Quality/ Operations Management as recognized by SAQA. A minimum of 5 years’ experience at senior managerial level in the research environment. A valid driver’s license. A Pre-Entry SMS Certificate (Nyukela) submitted prior to appointment. Competencies: Knowledge of PFMA/DORA/Treasury Regulations. All different contract options for infrastructure projects. Provincial/Departmental Supply Chain Management Policies. Promotion of Access to Information Act of 2000. Promotion of Administrative Justice Act of 2000. Broad Based Black Empowerment Act of 2003. Infrastructure Delivery Management System (IDMS). Project Management. People Management. Financial Management. Conflict Management. Skills: Presentation. Communication. Computer literacy. Project management. Report writing. Analytical. Problem solving. Planning and organising. Leadership. Negotiation. Influencing. Attributes- Responsive. Credible. Quality-oriented Innovative. Strategic thinker. Decisive. Credible. Motivating.
jobs.duties: Oversee the development, coordination, facilitation, and execution of infrastructure-related research across a range of disciplines, including construction and infrastructure, environmental management, energy, sustainability, water, property management, business process management, project management, and continuous improvement. Oversee the development of the research agenda for the Department. Oversee the incorporation of the research agenda into the infrastructure planning of the Department. Oversee the incorporation and implementation of research findings into the Departmental delivery processes. Oversee and direct the establishment, roll- out, and continuous improvement of project and programme management systems in infrastructure delivery. Oversee and direct relevant research pertaining to various areas of speciality and perspectives relating to infrastructure delivery. Oversee and direct research into appropriate best- practice property management, facilities management, and portfolio management systems and processes. Oversee and direct the setting of standards in line with legislative requirements and international standards. Oversee and analyse property management rates, market-related rates, and trends. Oversee, review, and sign off on research. Oversee and analyse industry trends for infrastructure delivery. Oversee and direct research into appropriate best practice for construction methodologies, alternative built solutions, and site management. Oversee and direct relevant aspects related to the use of Professional Service Providers, including appropriate fee structures. Oversee and direct research on market-related trends regarding construction and Professional Service Providers' fee rates. Oversee and direct the sharing of knowledge regarding changes made to construction procurement contracts. Oversee and direct the establishment, updating, and continuous improvement of the built environment-specific documentation system. Oversee interaction at different intergovernmental and intragovernmental forums. Oversee the development of inputs for long-term infrastructure and property planning from the perspective of the Department of Infrastructure Development (DID). Oversee best-practice tools, norms, instruments, guidelines, prototypes, policies, and technologies to improve the implementation of infrastructure delivery. Oversee the facilitation of internal departmental capacity to ensure the effective utilisation of developed best- practice tools, norms, instruments, guidelines, prototypes, policies, and technologies. Oversee the development of core and support reporting tools. Oversee the incorporation of best-practice tools, norms, instruments, guidelines, prototypes, policies, and technologies into departmental operations. Oversee and direct the utilisation of infrastructure-related technology. Oversee the development and modelling of infrastructure delivery and property management processes, standard operating procedures, and related service catalogues. Oversee and direct the gathering, analysis, and documentation of business requirements using appropriate methodologies and tools for effective system implementation. Oversee the translation of business requirements into functional and non-functional specifications. Oversee verification that requirements are traceable, validated, prioritised, and aligned with strategic objectives. Oversee the provision of strategic advice at national and provincial levels. Oversee the implementation and support of systems and programmes relevant to project management. Oversee and direct the analysis of protocols and policies to determine specific green technology projects and programmes. Oversee research into worldwide developments in green technology. Oversee and direct the planning and design of green technology projects. Oversee and direct the implementation of green technology projects. Oversee and direct the reporting on and monitoring of green technology projects. Oversee and direct the implementation of post-project evaluations to inform the future design of green technology projects. Oversee and direct the cost-effectiveness of proposed green technology projects and programmes. Oversee project and programme implementation of client departments' green technology objectives. Oversee the development of infrastructure research, programme, and project systems policies, strategies, and plans for the unit. Oversee the alignment of the unit's strategic priorities and work plans with those of DID. Oversee the preparation of the annual operational plan. Oversee the implementation of risk and mitigation plans. Oversee the preparation and presentation of management reports for the unit. Oversee written contributions to departmental quarterly progress reports, the Annual Report, SCOPA, Budget Speeches, the Annual Performance Plan, and related reports. Sign performance agreements for subordinates based on approved job descriptions and the Department's Strategic and Annual Performance Plans. Manage subordinates and maintain discipline. Manage the training and development of subordinates in accordance with agreed training interventions. Develop and update service delivery and work plans for subordinates. Manage funds within the unit in compliance with the Public Finance Management Act and Treasury Regulations. Ensure the unit operates within departmental budget allocations by preventing underspending and overspending.

af.summary: Hoofdirekteur wat infrastruktuurondersoek, -beplanning en -koördinasie by die Hoofkantoor van die Gauteng Department of Infrastructure Development in Johannesburg lei.

Promotion of Access to Information Act of 2000. Promotion of Administrative Justice Act of 2000. Broad Based Black Empowerment Act of 2003. Infrastructure Delivery Management System (IDMS).
