af.duties: Hou toesig oor die ontwikkeling, koördinasie, fasilitering en uitvoering van infrastruktuurverwante navorsing oor ’n reeks dissiplines, insluitend konstruksie en infrastruktuur, omgewingsbestuur, energie, volhoubaarheid, water, eiendomsbestuur, besigheidsprosesbestuur, projektbestuur en deurlopende verbetering. Hou toesig oor die ontwikkeling van die navorsingsagenda vir die departement. Hou toesig oor die inlywing van die navorsingsagenda in die infrastruktuurbeplanning van die departement. Hou toesig oor die inlywing en implementering van navorsingsbevindinge in die departementele leveringsprosesse. Hou toesig oor en rig die vestiging, uitrol en deurlopende verbetering van projeks- en programbestuurstelsels in infrastruktuurlewering. Hou toesig oor en rig ter sake navorsing met betrekking tot verskeie spitsgebiede en perspektiewe rakende infrastruktuurlewering. Hou toesig oor en rig navorsing na toepaslike beste-praktyk-eiendomsbestuur, fasiliteitsbestuur en portefeuljebestuurstelsels en -prosesse. Hou toesig oor en rig die vasstelling van standaarde in ooreenstemming met wetgewende vereistes en internasionale standaarde. Hou toesig oor en ontleed eiendomsbestuurstariewe, markverwante tariewe en tendense. Hou toesig oor, hersien en keur navorsing goed. Hou toesig oor en ontleed bedryfstendense vir infrastruktuurlewering. Hou toesig oor en rig navorsing na toepaslike beste praktyk vir konstruksiemetodes, alternatiewe geboude oplossings en werfbestuur. Hou toesig oor en rig ter sake aspekte rakende die gebruik van Professional Service Providers, insluitend toepaslike fooistrukture. Hou toesig oor en rig navorsing oor markverwante tendense rakende konstruksie en Professional Service Providers se fooitariewe. Hou toesig oor en rig die deling van kennis rakende wysigings aan konstruksie-aankoopkontrakte. Hou toesig oor en rig die vestiging, bywerking en deurlopende verbetering van die bou-omgewing-spesifieke dokumentasiestelsel. Hou toesig oor interaksie by verskillende intergoewermentele en intragoewermentele forums. Hou toesig oor die ontwikkeling van insette vir langtermyn-infrastruktuur- en eiendomsbeplanning vanuit die perspektief van die Department of Infrastructure Development (DID). Hou toesig oor beste-praktyk-instrumente, -norme, -hulpmiddels, -riglyne, -prototipes, -beleide en -tegnologieë om die implementering van infrastruktuurlewering te verbeter. Hou toesig oor die fasilitering van interne departementele kapasiteit om die effektiewe benutting van ontwikkelde beste-praktyk-instrumente, -norme, -hulpmiddels, -riglyne, -prototipes, -beleide en -tegnologieë te verseker. Hou toesig oor die ontwikkeling van kern- en ondersteuningsverslagdoeningsinstrumente. Hou toesig oor die inlywing van beste-praktyk-instrumente, -norme, -hulpmiddels, -riglyne, -prototipes, -beleide en -tegnologieë in departementele bedrywighede. Hou toesig oor en rig die benutting van infrastruktuurverwante tegnologie. Hou toesig oor die ontwikkeling en modellering van infrastruktuurlewering- en eiendomsbestuurprosesse, standaardbedryfsprosedures en verwante dienskatalogusse. Hou toesig oor en rig die versameling, ontleding en dokumentasie van besigheidsvereistes met behulp van toepaslike metodes en instrumente vir effektiewe stelselimplementering. Hou toesig oor die vertaling van besigheidsvereistes in funksionele en nie-funksionele spesifikasies. Hou toesig oor verifiëring dat vereistes naspeurbaar, bekragtig, geprioritiseer en in lyn met strategiese doelwitte is. Hou toesig oor die verskaffing van strategiese advies op nasionale en provinsiale vlak. Hou toesig oor die implementering en ondersteuning van stelsels en programme relevant tot projektbestuur. Hou toesig oor en rig die ontleding van protokolle en beleide om spesifieke groentegnologie-projekte en -programme te bepaal. Hou toesig oor navorsing na wêreldwye ontwikkelinge in groentegnologie. Hou toesig oor en rig die beplanning en ontwerp van groentegnologie-projekte. Hou toesig oor en rig die implementering van groentegnologie-projekte. Hou toesig oor en rig die verslagdoening oor en monitering van groentegnologie-projekte. Hou toesig oor en rig die implementering van post-projek-evaluerings om toekomstige ontwerp van groentegnologie-projekte in te lig. Hou toesig oor en rig die koste-effektiwiteit van voorgestelde groentegnologie-projekte en -programme. Hou toesig oor projeks- en programimplementering van kliëntdepartemente se groentegnologie-doelwitte. Hou toesig oor die ontwikkeling van infrastruktuurondersoek-, program- en projeksstelselsbeleide, -strategieë en -planne vir die eenheid. Hou toesig oor die belyning van die eenheid se strategiese prioriteite en werkplanne met dié van DID. Hou toesig oor die voorbereiding van die jaarlikse operasionele plan. Hou toesig oor die implementering van risiko- en mitigasieplanne. Hou toesig oor die voorbereiding en voorlegging van bestuursverslae vir die eenheid. Hou toesig oor skriftelike bydraes tot departementele kwartaalvorderingsverslae, die Annual Report, SCOPA, Budget Speeches, die Annual Performance Plan en verwante verslae. Teken prestasieooreenkomste vir ondergeskiktes op grond van goedgekeurde werksbeskrywings en die departement se Strategiese en Jaarlikse Prestasieplanne. Bestuur ondergeskiktes en handhaaf dissipline. Bestuur die opleiding en ontwikkeling van ondergeskiktes in ooreenstemming met ooreengekome opleidingsintervensies. Ontwikkel en werk dienslewering- en werkplanne vir ondergeskiktes by. Bestuur fondse binne die eenheid in ooreenstemming met die Public Finance Management Act en Treasury Regulations. Verseker dat die eenheid binne departementele begrotingstoekenning werk deur onderbesteding en oorbesteding te voorkom.

zu.title: Umkhulu Womqondisi: Ucwaningo Lwemisebenzi Eyakhiwayo, Ukuhlela
zu.summary: Umkhulu Womqondisi ohola ucwaningo lwemisebenzi eyakhiwayo, ukuhlela nokuhlanganisa ehhovisi eliyinhloko le-Gauteng Department of Infrastructure Development e-Johannesburg.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezingaphansi kwesiquphi ezingeni le-NQF 7 ku-Economics/ Management Sciences (Informatics)/ Built Environment/ Industrial Engineering/ Quality/ Operations Management njengokuqashwa yi-SAQA. Umdeni weminyaka engu-5 wokuhlolwa emzingeni wabaphathi abaphezulu emhlabeni wocwaningo. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Isitifiketi se-Pre-Entry SMS (Nyukela) esinikwa ngaphambi kokubekwa esikhundleni. Ikhono: Ulwazi nge-PFMA/DORA/Treasury Regulations. Zonke izinketho zezinkulumo zezinhlelo zemisebenzi eyakhiwayo. Amapholisi we-Provincial/Departmental Supply Chain Management. I-Promotion of Access to Information Act of 2000. I-Promotion of Administrative Justice Act of 2000. I-Broad Based Black Empowerment Act of 2003. I-Infrastructure Delivery Management System (IDMS). Ukuphathwa Kwezinhlelo. Ukuphathwa Kwabantu. Ukuphathwa Kwezimali. Ukuphathwa Kwezinkinga. Amakhono: Inkokhelo. Unxibelelwano. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha. Ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo. Ukubhala imibiko. Ukuhlaziya. Ukuxazulula izinkinga. Ukuhlela nokuhlela. Ukukhokela. Ukuxoxisana. Ukuthonya. Izimpawu- Ukubekezela. Ukuthembeka. Ukugxila ekwaleni. Okusha. Umuntu ocabanga ngokuhlela. Okwesinqumo. Ukuthembeka. Ukukhuthaza.
zu.duties: Qaphela intuthuko, ukuhlanganisa, ukwesekela, nokuphoqa ucwaningo oluhlobene nemisebenzi eyakhiwayo kulo lonke uhlu lwemikhakha, okuhlanganisa ukwakha kanye nemisebenzi eyakhiwayo, ukuphathwa kokusingathiwa kwemvelo, amandla, ukuzinza, amanzi, ukuphathwa kwezimpahla, ukuphathwa kwenqubo yebhizinisi, ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo, nentuthuko ephindaphindwayo. Qaphela intuthuko yohlelo locwaningo loMnyango. Qaphela ukuhlanganisa kohlelo locwaningo ohlelweni lwemisebenzi eyakhiwayo loMnyango. Qaphela ukuhlanganisa nokuphoqa imiphumela yocwaningo kumaprocesses okuletha loMnyango. Qaphela futhi uqondise ukumiswa, ukusabalalisa, nentuthuko ephindaphindwayo kwamasistimu okuphathwa kwezinhlelo kuletho kwemisebenzi eyakhiwayo. Qaphela futhi uqondise ucwaningo oluhlobene nezindawo ezahlukene zobuchwepheshe nezinkombolo ezihlobene naletho kwemisebenzi eyakhiwayo. Qaphela futhi uqondise ucwaningo ngokuphathwa kwezimpahla okuhamba phambili, ukuphathwa kwezimpahla, kanye namasistimu namaprocesses okuphathwa kwezinhlelo. Qaphela futhi uqondise ukumiswa kwemigomo ngokuhambisana nezidingo zomthetho kanye namagugu amazwe ngamazwe. Qaphela futhi uhlaziye izilinganiso zokuphathwa kwezimpahla, izilinganiso zomthengisi, kanye nezintambo. Qaphela, uhlaze, futhi usayine ucwaningo. Qaphela futhi uhlaziye izintambo zomkhakha weletho kwemisebenzi eyakhiwayo. Qaphela futhi uqondise ucwaningo ngendlela ephakeme yokwakha, izixazululo ezisha zokwakha, nokuphathwa kwendawo. Qaphela futhi uqondise izinkinga ezihlobene nokusetshenziswa kwe-Professional Service Providers, okuhlanganisa izakhiwo ezifanele zamafa. Qaphela futhi uqondise ucwaningo ngemigibe yemakethe mayelana namafa okwakha namafa we-Professional Service Providers. Qaphela futhi uqondise ukwabelana kolwazi mayelana noshintsho olwenziwe ezinkulumweni zokuqasha zokwakha. Qaphela futhi uqondise ukumiswa, ukubuyekeza, nentuthuko ephindaphindwayo kwesistimu yokubhalisa okwakhiwe. Qaphela ukuxhumana kwamapholamu ahlukene kahulumeni nakulawulo lukahulumeni. Qaphela ukuthuthukiswa kwezinsizo zohlelo olude lwemisebenzi eyakhiwayo nezimpahla kulo nyanga lokuthuthukiswa kwemisebenzi eyakhiwayo (DID). Qaphela izinto eziphakeme, imigomo, izinsiza, imiqondela, imiklamo, amapholisi, nobuchwepheshe ukuthuthukisa ukuphoqa ukuhlinzwa kwemisebenzi eyakhiwayo. Qaphela ukwesekwa kwamandla angaphakathi omnyango ukuqinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okusebenzayo kwezinto eziphakeme, imigomo, izinsiza, imiqondela, imiklamo, amapholisi, nobuchwepheshe. Qaphela ukuthuthukiswa kwezinsizo eziyisisekelo nezokusekela. Qaphela ukuhlanganiswa kwezinto eziphakeme, imigomo, izinsiza, imiqondela, imiklamo, amapholisi, nobuchwepheshe emsebenzini omnyango. Qaphela futhi uqondise ukusetshenziswa kobuchwepheshe oluhlobene nemisebenzi eyakhiwayo. Qaphela ukuthuthukiswa nokulinganisa ukuletha kwemisebenzi eyakhiwayo namaprocesses okuphathwa kwezimpahla, izinqubo ezinhle zokusebenza, namakhathalogu ohlelo ohlobene nawo. Qaphela futhi uqondise ukuqoqa, ukuhlaziya, nokubhala izidingo zebhizinisi ngokusebenzisa izindlela nezinsiza ezifanele ukuphoqa ukusetshenziswa kwesistimu. Qaphela ukuhumusha izidingo zebhizinisi kuba imibhalo esetshenziswa kanye naleyo engasetshenziswa. Qaphela ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izidingo ziyalandeka, ziqinisekisiwe, zihlukaniswe ngokubaluleka, futhi zihambisana nenhloso yokuhlela. Qaphela ukunika izeluleko zokuhlela emazingeni esiZwe nesiFunda. Qaphela ukuphoqa nokusekela amasistimu nezinhlelo ezihlobene nokuphathwa kwezinhlelo. Qaphela futhi uqondise ukuhlaziya amaphrothokholi namapholisi ukumisiza izinhlelo namaphulo athile obuchwepheshe boluhlaza. Qaphela ucwaningo ngentuthuko emhlabeni jikelele obuchwepheshe boluhlaza. Qaphela futhi uqondise ukuhlela nokumikla izinhlelo zobuchwepheshe boluhlaza. Qaphela futhi uqondise ukuphoqa izinhlelo zobuchwepheshe boluhlaza. Qaphela futhi uqondise ukubika nokuhlola izinhlelo zobuchwepheshe boluhlaza. Qaphela futhi uqondise ukuphoqa ukuhlolwa okwenziwa emuva kwephulo ukuqinisekisa ukumikla okuzayo kwezinhlelo zobuchwepheshe boluhlaza. Qaphela futhi uqondise ukusebenza kahle ngemali yezinhlelo zamaphulo obuchwepheshe boluhlaza. Qaphela ukuphoqa izinhlelo nezinhlelo zamaphulo ezigubhu zezinhloso zobuchwepheshe boluhlaza zamaphuzu abakhumi. Qaphela ukuthuthukiswa kocwaningo lwemisebenzi eyakhiwayo, amaphulo, namasistimu wezinhlelo, amapholisi, amasu, nezinhlelo lweyunithi. Qaphela ukuqondanisa okubalulekile kokuhlela kweyunithi nezinhlelo zokusebenza nalawo le-DID. Qaphela ukulungiselela ihlelo lokusebenza lonyaka. Qaphela ukuphoqa izinhlelo zengozi nezokunciphisa. Qaphela ukulungiselela nokwethula imibiko yokuphatha iyunithi. Qaphela izinsizo ezbhaliwe emibikweni yekota yomnyango, i-Annual Report, i-SCOPA, Izinkulumo zebhujethi, i-Annual Performance Plan, namanye emibiko ehlobene. Sayina izinkulumo zokusebenza zabantu abangaphansi kusuka kumagama amiswa emsebenzini naku-Strategic and Annual Performance Plans zomnyango. Phatha abantu abangaphansi futhi gcina isithunzi. Phatha uqeqeshwa nentuthuko yabantu abangaphansi ngokuvumelana nokungenelela uqeqesho oluvunyelwe. Thuthukisa futhi buyekeza izinhlelo zokuletha nokuzebenza zabantu abangaphansi. Phatha imali ngaphakathi kweyunithi ngokuvumelana ne-Public Finance Management Act kanye ne-Treasury Regulations. Qinisekisa ukuthi iyunithi isebenza ngaphakathi kwezabelo zebhujethi zomnyango ngokuvikela ukungachithi nokuchitha kakhulu.

xh.title: Umlawuli Ombhaxa: Uphononongo LwemiMasinyane, Uqwalaselo Noku
xh.summary: Umlawuli Ombhaxa ohola uphononongo lwemiasinyane, uqwalaselo nolungelelwaniso kwindawo ekuhlala kuyo eGauteng Department of Infrastructure Development eJohannesburg.
xh.requirements: Izidanga zasekupheleni kwesikolo kwinqanaba le-NQF 7 kwi-Economics/Management Sciences (Informatics)/Built Environment/Industrial Engineering/Quality/Operations Management njengoko kugunyaziswa yi-SAQA. Amava angaphantsi kweminyaka emi-5 kwinqanaba eliphezulu lolawulo kwindawo yophononongo. Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Isatifikethi se-Pre-Entry SMS (Nyukela) esinikelwa phambi kokubekwa esikhundleni. Iikhompetensi: Ulwazi nge-PFMA/DORA/Treasury Regulations. Zonke iinketho zendlela zethe ngqo zeeprojekthi zemiasinyane. Ipolisi ye-Provincial/Departmental Supply Chain Management. I-Promotion of Access to Information Act of 2000. I-Promotion of Administrative Justice Act of 2000. I-Broad Based Black Empowerment Act of 2003. I-Infrastructure Delivery Management System (IDMS). Ulawulo lweprojekthi. Ulawulo labantu. Ulawulo lweemali. Ulawulo lweengxaki. Amakhono abitela: Ukubonisa. Unxibelelwano. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulawulo lweprojekthi. Ukuhlalutywa kwemibhalo. Ukuhlalutywa. Ukusombulula iingxaki. Uqwalaselo nolungelelwaniso. Ukukhokela. Ukuxhomekeka. Ukuchasa. Izinto ezipawuliweyo: Ukuphendula. Ukuthembeka. Ukujolise kumgangatho. Ukuzisa izinto ezintsha. Umchazi werephe. Ukuthatha isigqibo. Ukuthembeka. Ukukhuthaza.
xh.duties: Ukulawula uphuhliso, ulungelelwaniso, ukuncedisa, nakuphothelelwa kolwazi mayela nemiasinyane kwizifundo ezahlukeneyo, kuquka ukuakhiwa nemiasinyane, ulawulo lendalo, amandla, ukuzinza, amanzi, ulawulo lwempahla, ulawulo lwenkqubo yoshishino, ulawulo lweprojekthi, nokuphucula ngokooko. Ukulawula uphuhliso loluqwalaselo lweSebe. Ukulawula ukuhlela oluqwalaselo kwiqwalaselo lemiasinyane leSebe. Ukulawula ukuhlela nokuphumeza iimpumlo zophononoko kumacebo okuhambisa iSebe. Ukulawula nokulawula ukusekwa, ukusaswa, nokuphucula ngokooko kweenkqubo zolawulo lweprojekthi nenkqubo ekuthunyelweni kwemiasinyane. Ukulawula nokulawula uphononongo olubalulekileyo mayela nendawo ezahlukeneyo ezibalulekileyo nemiqondo ethetha ukuthunyelwa kwemiasinyane. Ukulawula nokulawula uphononongo kumacebo amahle aphethelele kumaxwebhu okulawula impahla, ulawulo lweziseko, nolawulo lweekhathalogu. Ukulawula nokulawula ukumisela iisiko ngokwemfuno yomthetho ngee-siko yehlabathi. Ukulawula nokuqwalasela iindleko zolawulo lwempahla, iindleko zesimboni, nokuqhuba. Ukulawula, ukuhlalutya, nokuvumela uphononongo. Ukulawula nokuqwalasela ukuba nokuba ngathi kwesimboni kumathunyelwa emiasinyane. Ukulawula nokulawula uphononongo kumacebo amahle okuakhiwa kwendlela ezahlukeneyo, iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokuakhiwa, nalolawulo lwendawo. Ukulawula nokulawula iimpawu ezahlukeneyo ezibalulekileyo ngokuphathelene nokusetyenziswa kwe-Ngenzelwa zaBantu abanelwazi, kuqulathe iindleko ezifanelekileyo. Ukulawula nokulawula uphononongo kweendleko zesimboni malunga nokwakhiwa neendleko zaBantu abanelwazi. Ukulawula nokulawula ukusasaza ulwazi malunga noshintsho olwenziwe kumigqogiyo wethengo lokwakhiwa. Ukulawula nokulawula ukusekwa, okubuyekezwa, nokuphucula ngokooko inkqubo yamaxwebhu ebalulekileyo ukwakhiwa. Ukulawula ukuziphathisa kwamabala amahle ahlukeneyo karhulumente. Ukulawula uphuhliso lweenketho zeqwalaselo lemiasinyane nempahla ixesha elide ukusuka embonini ka-Gauteng Department of Infrastructure Development. Ukulawula izixhobo, iisiko, iisixhobo, iisikhokelo, iiprototype, iipolisi, nanakona ukuphucula ukuphumeza ukuthunyelwa kwemiasinyane. Ukulawula ukuncedisa ulawulo lothe ngqo kwesebe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusetyenziswa okululo kwezixhobo, iisiko, iisixhobo, iisikhokelo, iiprototype, iipolisi, nanakona. Ukulawula uphuhliso lwezixhobo zokubika eziphambili nukuncedisa. Ukulawula ukuhlela kwizixhobo, iisiko, iisixhobo, iisikhokelo, iiprototype, iipolisi, nanakona kulawulo lweSebe. Ukulawula nokulawula ukusetyenziswa kobuchwepheshe bemiasinyane. Ukulawula uphuhliso nokumodela ukuthunyelwa kwemiasinyane nokulawula lwempahla, iinkqubo ezisebenzayo, iinkqubo, namakhathalogu olwazi. Ukulawula nokulawula ukuthuthwa, ukuqwalasela, nokubhala iimfuno zenkqubo ngokusetyenziswa kweendlela eziphatha kakhulu nezixhobo ukuze kuqinisekiswe uphumeziwe. Ukulawula nokulawula ukuqwalasela iimfuno zenkqubo kwizicelo ezisebenzayo nangezo ezingasenzekiyo. Ukulawula ukuqinisekiswa kwezinto ezihamba ngokomthetho, ezifanelekileyo, eziphambili, nezilungelelaniswe neenjongo. Ukulawula ukunika ingcebiso ebalulekileyo kumaziko karhulumente amazwe naphantsi. Ukulawula uphumezwa nokuncedisa iinkqubo namacebo ebalulekileyo kwiprojekthi. Ukulawula nokulawula uqwalaselo lweprotoKholi neepolisi malunga namaxwebhu abalulekileyo namacebo. Ukulawula uphononongo malunga noshintsho lwehlabathi ekubeni yinto ebalekileyo yehlabathi mayela nobuchwepheshe. Ukulawula nokulawula uqwalaselo lolwakhiwo lwe nkqubo. Ukulawula nokulawula ukuphumeza iinkqubo ezibalekileyo. Ukulawula nokulawula ukubika nokulawula iiprojekthi ezibalekileyo. Ukulawula nokulawula ukuphumeza uphononongo emva kweprojekthi ukunikela ingcebiso mayela neyona ndlela yokwakhiwa. Ukulawula nokulawula ukusebenza kwemali kwamacebo abalulekileyo nenkqubo. Ukulawula uphumezwa lwaprojekthi namacebo abalulekileyo benjongo karhulumente. Ukulawula uphuhliso lweemfama zophononongo, iinkqubo, neendlela zemiasinyane, iipolisi, iisiko, namacebo eSebe. Ukulawula ukuqwalasela ukuqwalasela loluqwalaselo lweSebe kwelona. Ukulawula ukuqwalasela uphumeziwe lweSebe. Ukulawula ukulungiselela icebo lokusebenza lemihla ngemihla. Ukulawula ukuphumeza amacebo okubakho kweengozi nokuyinciphisa. Ukulawula ukuqwalasela nokuvezwa kwamaxwebhu eemfuno zeSebe. Ukulawula izinto ezibalulekileyo kwimibhalo yekota yophuhliso, imbali yonyaka, i-SCOPA, iNkcaso yebhajeti, iNkqubo yoNyaka yoMlinganiselo, namaxwebhu ahambelanayo. Ukusayina iimfanyano zemisebenzi kubantu abangaphantsini ngokwemisebenzi evunywe kwayo ngeeNkqubo zoNyaka zeSebe. Ukulawula abantu abangaphantsi kwaye egcine isithithi. Ukulawula ukhuseleko lokuziphilisa kwabantu ngokwezikhokelo ezivunyiweyo. Ukuphucula nokubuyela ngemva kwesixhobo sokuhambisa inkonzo nabantu. Ukulawula imali ngaphakathi kwenkqubo ngokwomthetho we-Public Finance Management Act nee-Treasury Regulations. Ukulawula ukuba inkqubo isebenzise ngemali ebekelwe iSebe ngokuthintela ukuchitha imali enganelanga neninzi.

jobs.title: Engineer Production: Electrical Grade A-C
jobs.salary_text: R914 517 – R1 376 199 per annum, (all-inclusive package). The package includes a basic salary (70% of package), and a flexible portion of 30% that may be structured in terms of applicable rules. Which includes state’s contribution to the Government Employees Pension Fund (13% of basic salary). The offer is based on recognition of experience after obtaining registration. (Proof of recognized experience will be requested from the shortlisted candidates).
jobs.summary: Electrical production engineer needed at the Department of Infrastructure Development in Johannesburg to plan, design and maintain engineering projects.
jobs.requirements: An Engineering Degree in Electrical (B Eng / BSC (Eng) or equivalent qualification. A minimum of 3 years’ post qualification experience in Engineering is required. Must be a registered as a Professional Engineer with ECSA. Must have a valid driver’s license. Competencies: Public Service Act of 1994. Public Service Regulations, 2016. PFMA and Treasury Regulations. Provincial/Departmental SCM policies. Government Immovable Asset Management Act of 2007. National Building Standards Act of 1977 and Regulations. Occupational Health and Safety Act of 1993 and Regulations. Health Act, Regulations and Guidelines. National Environmental Management Act of 1998. Engineering Profession Act of 2000. Engineering design and analysis Programme and project management. Computer-aided engineering applications. Knowledge of legal compliance. Skills- Decision making, Team leadership, Analytical, Creativity, Self-management, Financial management, Customer focus and responsiveness, Communication, Computer literacy Conflict management, Problem solving, Research, Technical report writing and Networking.
jobs.duties: Plan, design, operate and maintain engineering projects. Develop cost effective solutions according to standards. Evaluate existing technical manuals, standard drawings and procedures to corporate new technology. Develop tender specifications. Ensure through evaluation that planning and design by others is done according to sound engineering works according to norms and standards and code of practice and approve engineering works according to prescribed norms and standards. Ensure training and development of technicians, technologists and candidate engineers to promote skills/knowledge transfer and adherence to sound engineering principles and code of practice. Supervise the engineering work and process and administer performance management and development. Manage resources and prepare and consolidate inputs for the facilitation of resource utilization. Ensure adherence to regulations and procedures for procurement and personnel administration. Monitor, control expenditure and service report on expenditure and service delivery.
jobs.applications: To apply for the below position, please apply online at https://jobs.gauteng.gov.za
jobs.notes: In line with the Department’s Employment Equity Plan, People with Disabilities are encouraged to apply. Only online applications will be considered and for general enquiries please contact Human Resource on 076 521 4118. Applicants must complete the online Z83 and attach a comprehensive Curriculum Vitae (CV). All other documents are submitted by shortlisted candidates). All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Only shortlisted candidates will be requested to submit certified copies of qualifications not older than six (06) months, identity document and valid driver’s license (where driving/travelling is an inherent requirement of the job). It is our intention to promote representivity (race, gender and disability) in the Public Service through the filling of this post and candidates whose transfer/promotion/appointment will promote representivity will receive preference. It is the Department’s intention to promote equity through the filling of all numeric targets as contained in the Employment Equity Plan. To facilitate this process successfully, an indication of race, gender and disability status is required. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). The Department reserves the right not to appoint. If you do not receive any response from us within 3 months, please accept your application was unsuccessful. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Ingenieur Produksie: Elektriese Graad A-C
af.summary: Elektriese produksie-ingenieur word benodig by die Department of Infrastructure Development in Johannesburg om ingenieursprojekte te beplan, te ontwerp en te onderhou.
af.requirements: An Engineering Degree in Electrical (B Eng / BSC (Eng) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie. 'n Minimum van 3 years' na-kwalifikasie-ervaring in Ingenieurswese word vereis. Moet geregistreer wees as 'n Professionele Ingenieur met ECSA. Moet 'n geldige bestuurslisensie hê. Bevoegdhede: Public Service Act of 1994. Public Service Regulations, 2016. PFMA and Treasury Regulations. Provinciale/departementele SCM-beleide. Government Immovable Asset Management Act of 2007. National Building Standards Act of 1977 and Regulations. Occupational Health and Safety Act of 1993 and Regulations. Health Act, Regulations and Guidelines. National Environmental Management Act of 1998. Engineering Profession Act of 2000. Ingenieursontwerp en -analise. Program- en projekbestuur. Rekenaargesteunde ingenieurstoepassings. Kennis van regsonderhouding. Vaardighede- Besluitneming, spanleierskap, analities, skeppendheid, selfbestuur, finansiële bestuur, klagte- en kliëntefokus, kommunikasie, rekenaarvaardigheid, konflikbestuur, probleemoplossing, navorsing, tegniese verslagskrywing en netwerking.
af.duties: Beplan, ontwerp, bedryf en onderhou ingenieursprojekte. Ontwikkel kostudoeltreffende oplossings volgens standaarde. Evalueer bestaande tegniese handleidings, standaardtekeninge en prosedures om nuwe tegnologie te inkorporeer. Ontwikkel tender spesifikasies. Verseker deur evaluering dat beplanning en ontwerp deur ander gedoen word volgens deeglike ingenieurswerk volgens norms en standaarde en kode van praktyk en keur ingenieurswerk goed volgens voorgeskrewe norms en standaarde. Verseker opleiding en ontwikkeling van tegnici, tegnologe en kandidaat-ingenieurs om vaardighede/kennisoordrag en nakoming van deeglike ingenieursbeginsels en kode van praktyk te bevorder. Hou toesig oor die ingenieurswerk en proses en administreer prestasiebestuur en -ontwikkeling. Bestuur hulpbronne en berei en konsolideer insette voor vir die fasilitering van hulpbronbenutting. Verseker nakoming van regulasies en prosedures vir verkryging en personeeladministrasie. Monitor, beheer besteding en diensverslag oor besteding en dienslewering.

zu.title: Injiniya Yokukhiqiza: Kagesi Isigaba A-C
zu.summary: Kudingeka injiniya yokukhiqiza kagesi eDepartment of Infrastructure Development eGoli ukuplana, ukuklama futhi ukugcina imikhuba yojuluke.
zu.requirements: I-Digri Yojuluke eKagesini (B Eng / BSC (Eng) noma izifiso ezilinganayo. Kudingeka ubuhle obuncane beminyaka engu-3 wokuhlangabezana nezifiso ngemva kokuthola iziqu kwojuluke. Kumele ube ngofakaziwe njengoJiniya Ochunde nenhlangano i-ECSA. Kumele ube nelayisense yokushayela okusebenzayo. Ikhono: Public Service Act of 1994. Public Service Regulations, 2016. PFMA kanye ne-Treasury Regulations. Izenzo zikaHulumende zesifunda/nomnyango ze-SCM. Government Immovable Asset Management Act of 2007. National Building Standards Act of 1977 kanye noMthetho. Occupational Health and Safety Act of 1993 kanye noMthetho. I-Tha Act, Ithetho kanye Nezeluleko. National Environmental Management Act of 1998. Engineering Profession Act of 2000. Ukulama nokuhlaziula kwojuluke. Ukuqondisa uhlelo kanye nokuqondisa umqondo. Izinhlelo zokusebenzisa ezenziwa ikhompuyutha ezojuluke. Ulwazi ngokuhambisana nomthetho. Amakhono- Ukwenza izinqumo, Ukuyisa iqhaza ekubeni nhlobo yeqembu, Ukukahlileza, Ukudala, Ukuqondisa ikhotheni, Ukuphatha izimali, Ukuqaniswa nomthengi nokubajwayeleleleko, Ukuxhumana, Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompuyutha, Ukuphatha ukungahambelani, Ukuxazulula izinkinga, Ukucwaninga, Ukuhlunga imibiko yobuchwepheshe nokuxhumanisa
zu.duties: Iplana, ukulama, ukusebenza futhi ukugcina imikhuba yojuluke. Thutha izisombulu ezingabizi kakhulu ngokohlelo. Qapha imanuali zobuchwepheshe ezikhona, izithombe ezingokohlelo kanye nezenzimi ukuze wakhe ubuchwepheshe busha. Thutha izifiso zamathenda. Qinisekis ngokuqapha ukuthi ukuplana nokulama abakwenziyo kwenziwa ngokohlelo ohlelekile lokusebenza kwojuluke ngokomthetho nezinga futhi uvume ukusebenza kwojuluke ngokohlelo obukuthi kumiwe. Qinisekisa ukugcotshwa nokuqaliswa kwamajiniya, ubuchwepheshe nakamajiniya abangenammikelo ukuthuthukisa ukudluliswa kolwazi/akhono ukuthi kuhambisana nemigomo esekela ujuluke kanye nekhodi yokukwaziswa. Qondisa umsebenzi nokuqhuba kohlelo kwojuluke futhi uhlele ukuphathwa kokubunjwa komsebenzi nokuqaliswa. Phatha izinsiza bese ulungiselela futhi uhlanganisa okufakwe ukuze kwensize ukusetshenziswa kwemithombo. Qinisekisa ukuhambisana nohlelo lokuqasha nokuphatha abantu. Buka, lawula ukukhithimba futhi unike imibiko ngokukhithimba kanye nokuhanjiswa kwezinsiza.

xh.title: Inkqubo yokuQhuba iMisebenzi: oovakashi beBakala A-C
xh.summary: Kufunke onjiniyela bokuvelisa kolwandle eNgxoxweni yoPhuhliso Kolwakhiwo eRhawutini eRhawutini njengendlela yokucwangcisa, nokugcina iiprojekthi zonjiniyela.
xh.requirements: Kufunke iDiploma yonjiniyela kuMmandla weMontu (B Eng / BSC (Eng) okanye isifundo esilinganayo. Kufunke ufumene unyaka abangaphantsi kwa-3 isiphiwo-khaya esikwazi ukuba ngumpathimandi wenkqubo. Kufunke abhaliswe njengonjiniyela omtshotsho kwi-ECSA. Kufunke aneleyo yedilesi yokushukuma. Iindlela zokusebenza: Umthetho Womsebenzi Womphakathi ka-1994. IiMithetho Yomsebenzi Womphakathi, 2016. PFMA neMithetho yeTreasury. Iimaliso zeSizwe/Sebe zoKulawula iNtengiso nakwilwabiwo-mali. Umthetho Wokulawula Izixhobo ezingahambahambayo ka-2007. Umthetho WemiQathulo yeVakashi yeSizwe ka-1977. Umthetho Wokhuseleko kunye Nezempilo kumSebenzi ka-1993. Umthetho weZempilo, iMithetho malunga neNxibe-mithetho. Umthetho Wokulawula iNdalo iNdalo ka-1998. Umthetho WoBunjineli ka-2000. Ukudweba nokwahlula-hlula ubunjineli. Ulawulo lweenkqubo namaphulo. Iinkqubo ezisebenzisa ikhompyutha ekuncedeni ubunjineli. Ulwazi ngesigqibo somthetho. Amakhono - Ukwenza iigqibo, ukukhokela iqela, ukuhlola, ukudala, ukuzilawula, ulawulo lweemali, ukunaka abathengi nokuphendula, unxibelelwano, ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ulawulo lweempixano, ukuxazulula iingxaki, uphando, ukubhala iingxelo ezikolunjiniyela nokudibanisa.
xh.duties: Cwangcisa, kuyile, kuphuhlise kugcinwe imisebenzi yonjiniyela. Phuhlisa izisombulu ezingabizi kakhulu ngokwesigqibo. Hlola iimanuali ezisezantsi, iimizobo esemthethweni neendlela zokwenza ngokwamasiko oshishino abasha. Phuhlisa izicatshulwa zokuthengisa. Qinisekisa ngohlobo lukoluvo ukuba ucwangciso nokuklanywa ngabanye kwenziwa ngokwemisebenzi yonjiniyela emi ngokwezachazo nemithetho yokuziphatha kwaye vuma imisebenzi yonjiniyela ngokwezachazo nemithetho elawulayo. Qinisekisa ukuqeqeshwa nophuhliso lwabaphathi bekhonolojia, banjiniyela abangenamvuzo ukukhuthaza ukudluliswa kolwazi/lokuziphatha ngokwemigaqo yonjiniyela emi ngokwechiza nemithetho yomthetho wokuziphatha. Lawula imisebenzi yonjiniyela nendlela yokusebenza, lawula ngokomchaba ukulawula imisebenzi nophuhliso. Lawula izibonelelo, lungisa idatha zokugalela ngokwemigaqo yokusebenzisa izibonelelo. Qinisekisa ukuzithoba ngokwemiqathango nemigaqo yokuthenga nokuqhuba abantu. Lilonda, lawula ukuchithwa kolwabiwo-mali nokuvela kolwazi malunga nokuchithwa kolwabiwo-mali nolwazi lwenkonzo.

jobs.title: Chief Director
jobs.salary_text: R1 554 696 per annum (Level 14), (an all-inclusive SMS salary package)
jobs.summary: Chief Director sought by KwaZulu-Natal Department of Health to provide strategic HR leadership across multiple directorates at Level 14.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate Bachelor’s Degree in Human Resources Management / Public Management (NQF Level 7). A minimum of Five (5) years’ Senior Management experience in Human Resource environment. Unendorsed valid Code B driver’s license (Code 08) NB: For the Pre-Entry Certificate for SMS, any individual may register for the course and complete such in anticipation of wishing to apply for an SMS post in future. The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into the SMS and the full details can be sourced by following the link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-courses/sms- pre-entry-programme/.Individuals who have completed the course already, and who are therefore in possession of a certificate are welcome to submit such, however it is not required that an applicant submit such when applying for the post prior to the closing date. However, prior to an appointment being made to any SMS post, the appointee to such a post must have completed the pre-entry certificate and must be in possession of such prior to taking up the post. NB: All shortlisted candidates will be required to submit proof of work experience endorsed and stamped by the employer/s prior to the date of the interview. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Additional Requirements: Postgraduate qualification in Management will serve as recommendation for this post. Competencies: Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competencies Required: Competencies: Knowledge: The incumbent of this post will report to the Deputy Director General: Corporate Services and will be responsible for providing overall direction and management of the entire chief directorate to ensure that strategic goals are met. The ideal candidate must: Have through knowledge of the legislative framework regulating the Public Service, HRM Practices inclusive of Recruitment, Selection, Retention and Career Management Strategies within the sector. Possess knowledge of National Strategy on Integrated Employee Health and Wellness Framework and Employee Health and Wellness policies. Have the ability to work independently and under pressure. Have the ability to develop policies and understanding of HR Practices and Staff Relations. Have the ability to inspire actions in order to translate strategy into desired outcomes and outputs. Have the ability to develop a vision and inspire staff to achieve this. Have the ability to liaise at a senior level with a view to provide decision makers with clearly defined options. Have the ability to timeously identify transversal problem areas o the HR terrain and to develop innovative HRM strategies, action plans and policies. Have the ability to capitalise on human potential and to build a strong HR Team at Head Office, Regional, District and institutional levels. Have the ability to maintain levels of discretion. Have the ability to identify “best practices” and to facilitate through learning arrangements the mainstreaming thereof. Be able to lead and motivate staff. The candidate must have the following skills: Leadership and Decision Making, Problem Solving, Financial Management, Project Management, Planning and Organizing, Excellent Negotiation, High level of communication (both written and verbal) and People Management Skills. Be proficient in the application of computer software packages (MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint, amongst others.
jobs.duties: Job Purpose The successful candidate will be responsible for, amongst others Provide strategic leadership of the following directorates i.e. Human Resource Practices, Service Conditions, Labour Relations, Employee Health and Wellness, Human Resource Development, HR Planning, KZN College of Nursing and the College of Emergency Care (COEC), Organisational Efficiency Services and PERSAL and HRMIS. Oversee Human Resource Management, Development, Policy Development, HR System and Policy Monitoring and Evaluation Unit and System Maintenance Unit of the Department to ensure that it provides high quality and accessible services. Provide strategic HR leadership as part of a strategic planning process. Provide high level technical advice to the MEC, HOD and Senior Management regarding policy and strategic inputs for consideration at national level. Monitor and evaluate the implementation of the Department HR Policy Framework by Institutions with a view to identify implementation barriers and provide early warning and timeous technical assistance to Institutions to minimise the impact of such barriers. Manage special projects associated with HR as directed by the MEC and HOD. Provision of a supportive and enabling work environment for creating human competence through human resource development initiatives. Ensure existence and management of sound labour relations in the Department. Ensure effective and efficient human resource administration processes. Coordinate the implementation of the Performance Management and Development System in the Department. Provide strategic leadership and guidance on matters relating to Human Resources and translate strategic decisions taken by Top Management into actionable Human Resource projects and activities. Manage change management strategies to deal with Public Service Transformation and Restructuring processes; Ensure Departmental compliance with Government legislation. Give strategic direction in the development and implementation of policies regarding personnel administration. Adopt a strategic approach towards the development and training of Human Resources. Consult on Human Resource matters with the relevant line functionaries and stakeholders. Manage resources of the Chief Directorate inclusive of the development of staff.
jobs.applications: All applications should be forwarded to: The District Manager: Harry Gwala District Office: KZN Department of Health, Private Bag X502, Ixopo, 3969 OR Hand delivered to: 111 Margaret Street, Ixopo 3279 Interested applicants can visit the following website at www.kznonline.gov.za/kznjobs for full posts details. “Applicants are encouraged to apply for posts through the online e-Recruitment system at www.kznonline.gov.za/kznjobs or submit their Z83 and CV directly to the following email address Headoffice.Jobapplication@kznhealth.gov.za. Applicants may also visit any one of our Designated Online Application Centre’s (DOACS) where our friendly staff will assist you with applying online or receiving your hardcopy application. You can find the list of Designated Online Application Centre’s (DOACS) at www.kznonline.gov.za/kznjobs FOR ATTENTION : Miss N.S Buthelezi Tel No: (033) 395 2896
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on the new prescribed Application for Employment form (Z83) which must be originally signed, initialed and dated. Applications received on the incorrect Z83 will not be considered. All required information on the Z83 must be provided. Failure to complete or disclose all information will automatically disqualify the applicant. The Z83 should be accompanied by a comprehensive CV (with detailed experience). Persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply for the post. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified documents on or before the day of the interview following communication from Human Resources. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The appointments are subject to positive outcomes obtained from the State Security Agency (SSA) to the following checks (security clearance (vetting), criminal clearance, credit records, citizenship), verification of Educational Qualifications by SAQA, verification of previous experience from Employers and verification from the Company Intellectual Property Commission (CIPC). Applicants with foreign qualifications are requested to have their qualifications evaluated by SAQA and to provide proof of such evaluation (only when shortlisted). Applicants: Please ensure that you submit your application before the closing date as no late applications will be considered. If you apply for more than 1 post, submit separate applications for each post that you apply for quoting the relevant reference number. Should you not be contacted within 3 months of the closing date of the advertisement, please consider your application to be unsuccessful.

af.title: Hoofdirekteur
af.summary: Hoofdirekteur gesoek deur KwaZulu-Natal Department of Health om strategiese HR-leierskap oor verskeie direktorate op Vlak 14 te bied.
af.requirements: 'n Geskikte Bachelorsgraad in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur / Openbare Bestuur (NQF Vlak 7). 'n Minimum van Vyf (5) jaar Seniour Bestuurservaring in 'n Menslike Hulpbron-omgewing. Ongeënde geldige Kode B bestuurslisensie (Kode 08) NB: Vir die Voor-toelingsertifikaat vir SMS, kan enige individu vir die kursus registreer en dit voltooi in afwagting daarvan om in die toekoms vir 'n SMS-pos aansoek te doen. Die kursus is beskikbaar by die NSG onder die naam Certificate for entry into the SMS en die volledige besonderhede kan verkry word deur die skakel te volg: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-courses/sms- pre-entry-programme/.Individue wat die kursus reeds voltooi het, en wat dus in besit is van 'n sertifikaat, is welkom om dit in te dien, maar dit word nie vereis dat 'n aansoeker dit indien wanneer hy/sy voor die sluitingsdatum vir die pos aansoek doen nie. Voor aanstelling in enige SMS-pos egter gemaak word, moet die aangestelde in so 'n pos die voor-toelingsertifikaat voltooi het en in besit daarvan wees voordat hy/sy die pos aanvaar. NB: Alle kortelys-kandidate sal vereis word om bewys van werkervaring wat deur die werkgewer/s geëndorseer en gestempel is, voor die datum van die onderhoud in te dien. Alle kortelys-kandidate vir SMS-poste sal aan 'n tegniese oefening en onderhoud onderwerp word. Na die tegniese oefening en onderhoud sal 'n maksimum van drie (3) SMS-kandidate psigometriese assesserings ondergaan om kognitiewe vermoëns, gedragsvoorkeure, emosionele intelligensie en integriteit te assesseer. Bykomende Vereistes: 'n Nagraadse kwalifikasie in Bestuur sal as aanbeveling vir hierdie pos dien. Bevoegdhede: Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdhede Vereis: Bevoegdhede: Kennis: Die ampsdraer van hierdie pos sal aan die Adjunk-Direkteur-Generaal: Korporatiewe Dienste rapporteer en sal verantwoordelik wees vir die verskaffing van algehele rigting en bestuur van die hele hoofdirektoraat om te verseker dat strategiese doelwitte bereik word. Die ideale kandidaat moet: Deeglike kennis hê van die wetlike raamwerk wat die Openbare Diens reguleer, HRM-praktyke insluitend Werwing, Seleksie, Behoud en Loopbaanbestuurstrategieë binne die sektor. Kennis besit van die Nasionale Strategie oor Geïntegreerde Werknemer-Gesondheid en Welstand-Raamwerk en Werknemer-Gesondheid en Welstand-beleide. Die vermoë hê om onafhanklik en onder druk te werk. Die vermoë hê om beleide te ontwikkel en begrip van HR-praktyke en Personeelverhoudinge. Die vermoë hê om aksies te inspireer om strategie na gewenste uitkomste en uitsette te vertaal. Die vermoë hê om 'n visie te ontwikkel en personeel te inspireer om dit te bereik. Die vermoë hê om op 'n senior vlak te skakel met die oog daarop om besluitnemers met duidelik gedefinieerde opsies te voorsien. Die vermoë hê om betyds transversale probleemareas op die HR-terrein te identifiseer en om innoverende HRM-strategieë, aksieplanne en beleide te ontwikkel. Die vermoë hê om op menslike potensiaal te kapitaliseer en 'n sterk HR-span op Hoofkantoor-, Regionale, Distrik- en institutionele vlakke te bou. Die vermoë hê om vlakke van diskresie te handhaaf. Die vermoë hê om "beste praktyke" te identifiseer en om die hoofstroom daarvan deur leerreëlings te fasiliteer. In staat wees om personeel te lei en te motiveer. Die kandidaat moet oor die volgende vaardighede beskik: Leierskap en Besluitneming, Probleemoplossing, Finansiële Bestuur, Projekbestuur, Beplanning en Organisering, Uitstekende Onderhandeling, Hoë vlak van kommunikasie (sowel skriftelik as mondeling) en Personeelbestuursvaardighede. Bedrewe wees in die toepassing van rekenaarsagtewarepakkette (MS Word, Excel en PowerPoint, onder andere.
af.duties: Werksdoelwit Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal verantwoordelik wees vir, onder andere die verskaffing van strategiese leierskap van die volgende direktorate nl. Menslike Hulpbronpraktyke, Diensvoorwaardes, Arbeidsverhoudinge, Werknemer-Gesondheid en Welstand, Menslike Hulpbronontwikkeling, HR-beplanning, KZN College of Nursing en die College of Emergency Care (COEC), Organisasie-doeltreffendheidsdienste en PERSAL en HRMIS. Human Resource Management, Development, Policy Development, HR System and Policy Monitoring and Evaluation Unit en System Maintenance Unit van die departement oorsien om te verseker dat dit hoë gehalte en toeganklike dienste verskaf. Strategiese HR-leierskap verskaf as deel van 'n strategiese beplanningsproses. Hoë-vlak tegniese advies aan die MEC, HOD en Seniour Bestuur verskaf rakende beleid en strategiese insette vir oorweging op nasionale vlak. Die implementering van die departement se HR-Beleidsraamwerk deur Instellings monitor en evalueer met die oog daarop om implementeringshindernisse te identifiseer en vroegtydige en betydstegniese bystand aan Instellings te verskaf om die impak van sulke hindernisse te minimeer. Spesiale projekte wat met HR geassosieer word soos deur die MEC en HOD gerig word, bestuur. 'n Ondersteunende en bemagtigende werksomgewing verskaf vir die skep van menslike bevoegdheid deur menslike hulpbronontwikkelingsinisiatiewe. Die bestaan en bestuur van goeie arbeidsverhoudinge in die departement verseker. Effektiewe en doeltreffende menslike hulpbronadministrasieprosesse verseker. Die implementering van die Prestasiebestuur- en Ontwikkelingstelsel in die departement koördineer. Strategiese leierskap en leiding verskaf oor aangeleenthede rakende Menslike Hulpbronne en strategiese besluite deur Topbestuur geneem in aksioneerbare Menslike Hulpbronprojekte en -aktiwiteite vertaal. Veranderingsbestuurstrategieë bestuur om Public Service Transformation en Herstrukturering prosesse aan te spreek; Departementele nakoming van Regeringswetgewing verseker. Strategiese rigting gee in die ontwikkeling en implementering van beleide rakende personeeladministrasie. 'n Strategiese benadering teenoor die ontwikkeling en opleiding van Menslike Hulpbronne inneem. Oor Menslike Hulpbron-aangeleenthede met die relevante lynfunksionarisse en belanghebbendes konsulteer. Hulpbronne van die Hoofdirektoraat insluitend die ontwikkeling van personeel bestuur.

zu.title: Umqondisi Oyinhloko
zu.summary: KwaZulu-Natal Department of Health ifuna uMqondisi Oyinhloko ophile ukuthola abaqondisi ngamasu e-HR emiqondisini eminingana ezingeni 14.
zu.requirements: I-Degree ye-Bachelor ehambelana nezidingo ku Human Resources Management / Public Management (NQF Level 7). Okungenani iminyaka emihlanu (5) yamava e-Senior Management emkhakheni we-Human Resource. I-License yokushayela ye-Code B (Code 08) evumelekile nengangenwa lutho. NB: Mayelana ne-Certificate yokuNgena kwabalingiswa be-SMS, noma imuphi umuntu angabhalisa ukuthatha lesi sikole futhi asiqede egade afuna ukusebenzela isikhundla se-SMS esikhathini esizayo. Lesi sikole sitholakala e-NSG ngaphansi kwegama le-Certificate for entry into the SMS futhi imininingwane ephelele ingatholwa ngokulandela le link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-courses/sms- pre-entry-programme/.Abantu abesiqede lesi sikole, futhi abanohambo lwesiqinisekiso bayamukelwa ukuthi balifakishe, kodwa asikudingeki ukuthi umfaki langenisile lapho faka isikhundla ngaphambi kwe-closing date. Nokho, ngaphambi kokuba kwenziwe ukwabiwa kwesikhundla kunoma yisiphi isikhundla se-SMS, lowo ayethunyelwe esikhundleni kumele esiqede i-pre-entry certificate futhi abe nayo ngaphambi kokuba athathe isikhundla. NB: Bonke abafakwe ohlwini bayodingeka kulethe ubufakazi bamava emsebenzini ogqanyisiwe futhi ushaye isitembu umqashi ngaphambi kosuku lokuxoxwa ngomsebenzi. Bonke abafakwe ohlwini bamaphuzu e-SMS bazodlula kuso isenzo sezobuchwepheshe nasexoxweni ngomsebenzi. Emva kwesenzo sezobuchwepheshe nalexoxo ngomsebenzi, okungenabantu abathathu (3) abafaki be-SMS bazothatha izivivinyo ze-psychometric ukuze kuhlolelwe amandla okucabanga, okukhethayo ngokuziphatha, ukuqonda izinkalo, kanye nokuthembeka. Izidingo Ezingeziwe: I-qualification ye-Postgraduate eMqondisini izobe isebenza njengesincoma kulesi sikhundla. Ikhono: Ulwazi, Amakhono, Ukuqeqeshwa nokuKhona okudingekayo: Ikhono: Ulwazi: Lowo ophathe lesi sikhundla uzobe ebika ku-Deputy Director General: Corporate Services futhi uzobe nekweleta lokuphepha isiqondiso nokuqondiswa komqondisi oyinhloko wonke ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinhloso ezinkulu zifezwe. Umfaki oqotho kumele: Abenolwazi oluqondile ngesakhiwo somthetho esibeka umthetho e-Inszuzakalo Kahulumeni, izindlela ze-HRM okuhlanganisa ukuqasha, ukukhetha, ukugcina nokuphatha izinkomba zobudlelwano emkhakheni. Abenolwazi lwe-National Strategy on Integrated Employee Health and Wellness Framework kanye nezinqubomgomo ze-Employee Health and Wellness. Akwazi ukusebenza eyedwa naphansi kwesinde. Akwazi ukwakha izinqubomgomo futhi aqonde izindlela ze-HR kanye noBudlelwano Babantu. Akwazi ukukhuthaza izenzo ukuze ezinqubo zibe yimiphumela nezinkomba ezifunwayo. Akwazi ukwakha isibono futhi akhuthaze abantu ukuba basifeze. Akwazi ukuxhumana ezingeni eliphezulu ngenhloso yokunika abanqumi izinketho ezichaziwe ngokucacile. Akwazi ukuthola ngokushesha izinkinga ezingathinta khona zonke izinkalo ze-HR futhi akwazi ukwakha izindlela ezingahlukile ze-HRM, izinhlelo zokuqhuba izenzo kanye nezinqubomgomo. Akwazi ukusebenzisa ingqondo yomuntu ngokugcwele futhi akhe iqembu elinamandla le-HR eHead Office, ezingeni lezifundazwe, emimongo futhi emazingeni abasunguli. Akwazi ukugcina izinga lokuzethemba. Akwazi ukuthola izindlela ezinhle futhi asize ukuthi zitholakale ezinye izinhlelo zokufunda. Akwazi ukuhola futhi akhuthaze abantu. Umfaki kumele abe nalamakhono: Ukuholwa nokwenza izinqumo, Ukuxazulula izinkinga, Ukuphatha imali, Ukuphatha amaphrojekthi, Ukucubungula nokuHlela, ukuXoxa okuhle, Izinga elikhulu lokuxhumana (okubhaliwe nokuKhulunwayo) namakhono okuPhatha abantu. Akwazi ukusebenzisa izinhlelo zesoftware zekhompyutha (i-MS Word, i-Excel ne-PowerPoint, kanye nezinye.
zu.duties: Inhloso Yomsebenzi Umfaki opumelelo uzobe nekweleta lokwenza, kwezinye izinto, ukunikeza isiqondiso ngamabhizinisi amakhulu kumigqondo elandelayo i.e. Human Resource Practices, Service Conditions, Labour Relations, Employee Health and Wellness, Human Resource Development, HR Planning, KZN College of Nursing kanye ne-College of Emergency Care (COEC), Organisational Efficiency Services kanye ne-PERSAL ne-HRMIS. Qaphela i-Human Resource Management, i-Development, i-Policy Development, i-HR System kanye ne-Policy Monitoring and Evaluation Unit kanye ne-System Maintenance Unit yomnyango ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi inikeza isevisi enhle futhi etholakala kalula. Nikeza isiqondiso esibekiwe se-HR njengengxenye yenqubo yokucubungula ngamabhizinisi. Nikeza izeluleko ezingeni elikhulu zezobuchwepheshe ku-MEC, ku-HOD nakwi-Senior Management ngokuphathelene nezinqubomgomo kanye nezinto ezingeniswa kwamabhizinisi ukuze zihlolwe ezingeni lenational. Hlola futhi uhlole ukusetshenziswa kwe-Sakhiwo Se-Policy yomnyango yamasiko njengenhloso yokuthola okuvimbela ukusetshenziswa futhi unikeze isexwayiso nesixhaso sezobuchwepheshe esisheshayo kumaiqembu ukuze kuncishiswe umthelela waleyo minyaka. Phatha amaphrojekthi ajwayelekile ahlobene ne-HR njengoba kuqondiswa ngu-MEC no-HOD. Kuboniswe ngokwesekela futhi kwenzeke ukusebenza emkhakheni wokwakha amandla omuntu ngokusungula izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa umuntu. Qinisekisa ukuthi kubonakala futhi kuhlolwe ukuphatha kwabantu emnyangweni ngendlela ehle. Qinisekisa izinga elihle nangokushesha ezinqubweni zokuphatha abantu. Hlanganisa ukusetshenziswa kwe-Performance Management and Development System emnyangweni. Nikeza isiqondiso esibekiwe futhi uhole ngendlela okumayelana nabantu bese ukugucula izinqumo ezibekiwe ezenziwa yi-Top Management zaba ngamaphrojekthi kanye namabhizinisi abantu. Phatha izinqubomgomo zokushintsha ukuthi kubhekane nokuGuqulwa nokwakhiwa kabusha eNtsizeni Kahulumeni; Qinisekisa ukuthi umnyango ulandela imithetho kaHulumeni. Nikeza isiqondiso esibekiwe ekwakheni futhi ekusebenziseni izinqubomgomo ezithinta abantu. Thatha indlela yamabhizinisi ekuqondeni ukuthuthukiswa kwaHuman Resources. Xoxa ngemayelana ne-HR nalabo abahlobene kanye nalabo abashukunisayo. Phatha izinsiza ze-Chief Directorate okuhlanganisa nokuthuthukiswa kwabantu.

xh.title: Umlawuli Ochwethezileyo
xh.summary: KwaZulu-Natal Department of Health ifuna Umlawuli Ochwethezileyo onikezela ngabaphathi abalinganiselweyo ababalulekileyo bomsebenzi wabantu kumagunya amaninzi enqanaba lesi-14.
xh.requirements: Iziqu ze-Bachelor ezifanelekileyo kwiHuman Resources Management / Public Management (NQF Level 7). A minimum of Five (5) years’ Senior Management experience in Human Resource environment. Ilayisenisi evakalayo yekhowudi B (Code 08) engazange igqitywe. NB: Kwieso Sertifikathi Yokuqala YokuNgenela i-SMS, nabani na ungangena kule nkqubo ayiqede egade ethanda ukusebenza kwisithuba se-SMS ngelanga ezayo. Le nkqubo iyafumaneka kwi-NSG ngaphansi kwegama elithi Certificate for entry into the SMS kwaye iinkcukacha ezizeleyo zifumaneka ngokulandela lo mnxeba: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-courses/sms- pre-entry-programme/. Abantu abaqeile le nkqubo ngokuba, kwaye ngoko babanayo isatifikethi bamkelekile ukuyithumela, nangona kungafuneki ukuba umfaki ethumele into yakhe xa efaka isicelo kwisithuba ngaphambi komhla wokuvala. Nangona kunjalo, ngaphambi kokwenziwa isikhangelo kuyo nayiphi na isithuba se-SMS, umntu okhethiweyo kwelo sithuba kufuneka aqede isertifikathi yokuqala yokuNgenela i-SMS kwaye abe nayo ngaphambi kokuthabatha elo sithuba. NB: Bonke abakhethwe kuludwe lokuqala baya kufuneka benze isiqinisekiso semisebenzi esinamatshwe negungumbolo ngurhwebi/nomqeshi ngaphambi komhla wokudibana. Bonke abakhethwe kuludwe lokuqala kumawaka amakhulu bazakwenziwa isixhobo sethutyana nodliwano-ndlebe. Emva kokuqhuba ithutyana nodliwano-ndlebe, amanani amathathu (3) abafaki be-SMS bazakwenziwa uvavanyo lwe-psychometric lwesimilo sabo, ngeenjongo zokuqonda ukukwazi ukucinga, izinto abazithandayo ngokuziphatha, inqanaba lemininzi yokuqonda iimvakalelo, nobuzo. Iimfuno Eziphuthumayo: Iziqu zamabanga aphezulu kwiManagement ziya kuba sisifundo esihle kule sithuba. Ukuzinza: Ulwazi, Amandla, uQeqesho nokuZinza Okufunekayo: Ukuzinza: Ulwazi: Umntu oza kuba kwesi sithuba uya kubika kuMcpeshi uMlawuli Jikelele: Isebe lezikhedule kwaye uya kubizwa ngokuba ngumlawuli onika isalathiso kuphelo kwaye alawule lonke ulawulo lwesikhulu ukuqinisekisa ukuba iinjongo ezibalulekileyo ziyafezwa. Umntu ofanelekileyo makabe: Unolwazi olubanzi lwendlela esekelwe kumthetho olawula inkonzo kaRhulumunde, amalungiselelo e-HRM ahlanganisela okuBumba, ukhetho, ukugcina iinkonzo kwaye ulawule izicwangciso zomsebenzi kwicandelo. Abanolwazi lweSicwangciso sikaRhulumende seNational Strategy on Integrated Employee Health and Wellness Framework nemigaqo ye-Employee Health and Wellness. Akwazi ukusebenza yedwa nangaphantsi kokwesicwangciso. Akwazi ukwenza imigaqo kwaye aqonde iNkonzo yabaBasebenzi nabuBudlelwane babasebenzi. Akwazi ukubakhuthaza ukwenza izinto ngeenjongo zokuqamba isicwangciso kwaye afeze iziphumo nezinto eziphumileyo efunekayo. Akwazi ukwakha isibono kwaye akhuthaze abantu ukuba bafeze oku. Akwazi ukuqhathanisa ngomphakathi ongaphezulu ukuqinisekisa ukuba abathathi-ba-mabomu banokukhetha okucacileyo. Akwazi ukubona ngexesha izifo ezikhoyo kwinkalo ye-HR kwaye akwazi ukuqamba amacebo amasha e-HRM, iinkqubo zokukhetha kwaneemigaqo. Akwazi ukusebenzisa amandla abantu kwaye asakhe iqela eliqinileyo le-HR kumaziko aphakathi, kwilwandle, kwizithili nakwiiNkqubo ezingaphezulu. Akwazi ukuyigcina inqanaba lokubaluleka kwezinto. Akwazi ukuqonda ukuyilwa kwemigaqo emihle kwaye ayidlulise ngokukhuthaza, ngokukhetha, okanye ngokulungiselelwa ezinye iinkqubo ukuba zibe yinkqubo enkulu ngokungagqibekanga. Akwazi ukuba ngumlawuli nomkhuthazeli wabantu. Umntu okhethiweyo kufuneka abe nalamakhono alandelayo: Ulawulo lokuThatha isiGqibo, ukuSombulula iingxaki, uLawulo lweMali, uLawulo lwe Projekthi, uCwangciso nokuhlela, ukuqamba amacebo ngokudlulisela kolunye uLungelelwaniso oluBalulekileyo, iNqanaba eliphezulu lexesha lenkonzo yamagama (nangesipho sendlela yokubhala nokuthetha) namakhono okuLawula abaNtu. Akwazi ukusebenzisa iinkqubo zekhompyutha (i-MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, ezinye).
xh.duties: Injongo yomSebenzi Umntu oza kuba ngowona umjikelo wakhe oya kuba ngowona oza kuqhuba phakathi kwabanye ukunika ulawulo olubalulekileyo kolu qhinga lokulawula i-Human Resource Practices, i-Service Conditions, i-Labour Relations, i-Employee Health and Wellness, i-Human Resource Development, i-HR Planning, i-KZN College of Nursing ne-KZN College of Emergency Care (COEC), i-Organisational Efficiency Services nePERSAL ne-HRMIS. Qhobosha ulawulo, ukuqhutywa kwemisebenzi, ukuqhutywa kwemigaqo, ukuqondwa koluntu lwe-HR System kwaye alinganise iNkqubo yokulawula kwaye alungelelanise inkqubo yokulungisa i-HR System yesebe ukuze iqinisekise ukuba inikeza inkonzo ethile ethembekileyo kwaye ifikeleleka kalula. Nikeza ulawulo olubalulekileyo lomsebenzi wabantu njengenxalenye yenkqubo yokucwangcisa. Nikeza ulwazi olusemgangathweni ophezulu kwi-MEC, i-HOD noLawulo oluPhakamileyo mayela naye nawuphi na umba wemigaqo noqwalaselo lwezicwangciso ezinokwamkelwa kwinqanaba likarhulumente. Qhobosha ulungelelwaniso lwenkqubo yemigaqo ye-HR yesebe ngokubukwa kwamagosa ngeenjongo zokubona iinkqubo ezingakwazi ukuqhutywa kwaye anike isilumkiso esilula kwaye axhasa ngolwazi olukhawulezileyo amaziko ukuze atsibe isiphithiphithi esingavela kule ntsika. Lawula iinkqubo ezikhethe i-HR njengoko kalwe i-MEC ne-HOD. Nikeza ukuxhaswa ngokwenza indalo yamandla abantu ngokubakha imisebenzi eyahlukeneyo yabaqeqeshi. Qhobosha ukwakhiwa nokuqhutywa koluntu olusemthethweni ngokuchasene nalomnyhadala wemisebenzi kwesebe. Qhobosha ukwenziwa kolawulo olulungeleleneyo nolusebenzayo nolufikeleleka kakhulu kolawulo lwemisebenzi yabantu. Qhobosha inkqubo yokulawula ukwenza i-Performance Management and Development System yesebe. Lawula ulawulo oluPhakamileyo noqwalaselo ngokulawula abantu bese afake inkqubo ukuze lenziwe ngamanyathelo abalulekileyo afunekayo ngokusebenzisa izicwangciso ezamkelwe ngumthetho weqonga elingentla kwiinkalo ezikhethe uluntu. Qhobosha ulawulo olusemgangathweni wokulungiselela nokusika imigaqo yokudlulisela uluntu. Qhobosha ukulungelelwaniso olubalulekileyo ngokusika iinkqubo ezintsha ezihlawule isiseko senkonzo yomuntu. Yenza isicwangciso sokudlulisela kolunye ulwazi oluxelwa ukubakha nokubumba abantu abakwazi ukuba bakhuthazwe. Nikeza ulwazi olusemgangathweni ophezulu kwi-MEC, i-HOD noLawulo oluPhakamileyo ngokusekelwe kumagqabantshintshi nakulo lonke ulawulo lwemisebenzi yabantu. Qhobosha ukwakhiwa kweempawu eziyimfuno nokulawulwa kolawulo lwemisebenzi yabantu kwesebe. Yenza isicwangciso sokulawula uluntu oluhleliyo neyona ndlela yokwenza imisebenzi ngokutsha kwe-Strategic plan neMisebenzi yomThetho mayela noluLawulo lwaBantu. Yenza ngokusekelwe kumagqabantshintshi alinganiselweyo kubakha imisebenzi yamathambo, abasebenzi abakhethiweyo kunye noqeqesho lweSiseko seMveliso yokudlulisa izicwangciso kwelinye iqonga. Qhobosha ukwenza kwaye ulawule iinkqubo ezintsha ezihlawula isiseko senkonzo yomntu ngamnye. Linganisa amanqanaba okulungelelwaniso lwesicwangciso esisebenzayo kwinkqubo yokuqhutywa kwemisebenzi yabantu.

jobs.title: Head Clinical Unit (ORTHOPEADICS)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R2 168 145 – R2 301 186 per annum Grade 2: R2 370 741 – R2 592 273 per annum The all-inclusive package consists of 70% basic salary and 30% flexible portion that may be structured in terms of the applicable rules, 18% inhospitable of basic salary plus fixed commuted overtime.
jobs.summary: Head of Clinical Unit in Orthopaedics at Madadeni Provincial Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal, requiring an MBChB and HPCSA specialist registration with five years post-registration experience.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate qualification in the appropriate Health Science (MBCHB); Plus, Current registration with the Health Professionals Council of South Africa as a Specialist in the category of Orthopaedics. Plus At least Five (5) years appropriate experience as a Medical Specialist after registration with HPCSA as a medical specialist in the category of Orthopaedics. Knowledge, Skills and Competencies required: Sound Clinical knowledge and expertise in the relevant discipline. Knowledge of current health and Public Service Legislation, regulations and policy including medical ethics, epidemiology and statistics. Good communication, leadership, decision-making and clinical skills. Ability to teach junior doctors and participate in continuing professional development.
jobs.duties: Planning and implementation of Specialist Orthopaedic services (Outpatient, Inpatient and Operating Theatre lists). Participate/provision if after-hour service. Co-ordination and equitable rationalization of Specialist Orthopaedic service Amajuba District and outlying drainage areas. Liaison with institutional management of hospitals in the district and drainage areas to improve quality of care. Facilitation of staff training and development. Participate /support the outreach programme to the referring Hospitals and Clinics. Liaison with the relevant Chief Specialist regarding service development. Develop a training program for medical, nursing and allied services. Develop policies and guidelines facilitating service delivery. Participate in quality improvement projects and clinical auditing. Participate and facilitate clinical research. Cost effective utilization of scarce resources. Participate in Senior Management and strategic activities. Perform commuted overtime in line with hospital needs. Manage EPMDS of the General Surgery department. ENQURIES : Dr. X.F Nene Tel No: (034) 328 8007
jobs.applications: All applications can be submitted through hand delivery /courier to: The HR Recruitment Office no:3, Madadeni Hospital, f0001, section 6, Madadeni, 2951. Applications can also be emailed to: sibongiseni.kheswa@kznhealth.gov.za FOR ATTENTION : The Recruitment Officer
jobs.notes: This Department is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer, whose aim is to promote representivity in all levels of all occupational categories in the Department. Note: The contents of this Circular Minute must be brought to the notice of all eligible officers and employees on your establishment of all Institutions. Institutions must notify all candidates who qualify for post in this circular minute even if they are absent from their normal places of work to apply. Direction to Candidates: the following documents must be submitted: Application for Employment form (Z83) which is obtainable from any Government Department OR from the website - www.kznhealth.gov.za. The application form (Z83) must be accompanied by a detailed Curriculum Vitae, Certified copies of ID, Highest educational qualification and other relevant documents will be requested for submission only from shortlisted candidates. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The reference number must be indicated in the column provided on the form Z83 and on the back of the envelope, e.g. MAD 01/2016. NB: Failure to comply with the above instructions will be disqualify applicants. Person with disabilities should feel free to apply for the post. The appointment is subject to positive outcome obtained from the NIA the following checks (security clearance, credit records, qualification, citizenship and previous experience employment verification). Due to the large number of applications, receipt of applications will not be acknowledged. However, correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. Please note that due to financial constraint no S&T claims will be considered for payment to the candidates that are invited for an interview.

af.title: Hoof Kliniese Eenheid (ORTOPEDIE)
af.summary: Hoof van Kliniese Eenheid in Ortopedie by Madadeni Provinciale Hospitaal in KwaZulu-Natal, wat 'n MBChB en HPCSA spesialisregistrasie met vyf jaar se ervaring na registrasie vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Geskikte kwalifikasie in die toepaslike Gesondheidswetenskap (MBCHB); Plus, Huidige registrasie by die Health Professionals Council of South Africa as 'n Spesialis in die kategorie Ortopedie. Plus Ten minste Vyf (5) jaar toepaslike ervaring as 'n Mediese Spesialis na registrasie by HPCSA as 'n mediese spesialis in die kategorie Ortopedie. Kennis, vaardighede en bevoegdhede vereis: Deeglike kliniese kennis en kundigheid in die tersaaklike dissipline. Kennis van huidige gesondheids- en Openbare Dienswetgewing, regulasies en beleid insluitend mediese etiek, epidemiologie en statistiek. Goeie kommunikasie-, leierskaps-, besluitnemings- en kliniese vaardighede. Vermoë om junior dokters op te lei en aan voortgesette professionele ontwikkeling deel te neem.
af.duties: Beplanning en implementering van Spesialis Ortopediese dienste (Buitepasiënt-, Binnepasiënt- en Operasiesaallyste). Deelname/voorsiening van buite-ure diens. Koördinering en billike rasionalisering van Spesialis Ortopediese diens Amajuba Distrik en buite-agtergeblewe dreineringsgebiede. Skakeling met instellingsbestuur van hospitale in die distrik en dreineringsgebiede om gehalte van sorg te verbeter. Fasilitering van personeelopleiding en -ontwikkeling. Deelname/ondersteuning van die uitreikprogram na die verwysende Hospitale en Klinieke. Skakeling met die tersaaklike Hoofspesialis rakende diensontwikkeling. Ontwikkel 'n opleidingsprogram vir mediese, verpleeg- en verwante dienste. Ontwikkel beleide en riglyne wat dienslewering fasiliteer. Deelname aan gehalteenhouverbouprojekte en kliniese ouditering. Deelname en fasilitering van kliniese navorsing. Kostedoeltreffende benutting van skaars hulpbronne. Deelname aan Senior Bestuurs- en strategiese aktiwiteite. Verrig ploeg.oortyd in ooreenstemming met hospitaalbehoeftes. Bestuur EPMDS van die Algemene Chirurgie departement. NAVRAE: Dr. X.F Nene Tel No: (034) 328 8007

zu.title: Isikhulu Esihlezi Esikhundleni sezigaba zezezempilo (ORTHOPAEDICS)
zu.summary: Isikhulu Esihlezi Esikhundleni sezigaba zezezempilo (Orthopaedics) esibhedlela iMadadeni Provincial Hospital KwaZulu-Natal, sifuna iziqu ze-MBChB nokubhaliswa njengochwepheshe ku-HPCSA okuhambisana neminyaka emihlanu yokuhlangenwe nakho emumva kokubhaliswa.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanelekile kwezemfundo yezeSayense yezeMpilo (MBCHB); Futhi, ukubhaliswa kwamanje ne-HPCSA njengochwepheshe ohlinzayo ngaphansi kwe-Orthopaedics. Futhi okungenani iminyaka eyi-Five (5) yokuhlangenwe nakho okufanelekile njengoChwepheshe Wezokwelapha emva kokubhaliswa ne-HPCSA njengoChwepheshe Wezokwelapha ngaphansi kwe-Orthopaedics. Ulwazi, amakhono namaKhono adingekayo: Ulwazi olujulile nezimo zokuhlola ezithweni ezihlobene nokwelapha. Ulwazi ngemithetho yezempilo kanye nesevisi yomphakathi yamanje, imithethonqubo nemigomo ehlanganisa izimilo zokwelapha, amathuba ezifo kanye nezibalo. Amakhono okuxhumana kahle, ukubusa, ukuthatha izinqumo kanye nokuhlola iziguli. Ikhono lokufundisa othisha abasha bokuqashwa kwezokwelapha kanye nokuthatha inxaxhe ekuthuthukiseni umsebenzi ngobungcweti.
zu.duties: Ukuhlela nokusebenzisa izinsizakalo ze-Orthopaedic (Iziguli ezingaphandle, ezingaphakathi kanye nemibhalo yokuhlola enza imihlangano yokudlulisela ulwazi). Ukuthatha inxaxheke/nikela ngesikhathi esingemva kwesikhathi esivunyelwe. Ukuhlela ukubaluleka kokumisa ulwazi ngezinsizakalo ze-Orthopaedic kumasifundaze i-Amajuba District nezindawo ezisondela kuso. Ukwesekwa ukuxhumana nokuphathwa kwezikhungo ezibhedlela emasifundaze nasendaweni eziseduze kakhulu ukuthuthukisa inani lokunakekelwa. Ukuxhasa ukugcotshwa kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi. Ukuthatha inxaxheke /ukuxhasa uhlelo lokuhlolwa kwemibhalo kumabhedi neziguli ezigcina amaphasi ezigigaba ze-Orthopaedic. Ukuxhumana nomongameli wesikhundla esingenisa izinsizakalo ezibalulekile mayelana nenqubo yokuhlela. Ukuthuthukisa uhlelo lokuqeqesha izinsizakalo zokuqeqesha izinsizakalo ze-Orthopaedic. Ukuthuthukisa imigomo kanye nemiyalelo ezosiza ekunikelweni kwezinsizakalo. Ukuthatha inxaxheke emibhalweni yokulungiselelwa imisebenzi yokuqashwa nokuhlolwa okuphathwa ngaphansi kwezigigaba ze-Orthopaedic. Ukwenza futhi uxhase ucwaningo lwezokwaziswa ngezinsizakalo ze-Orthopaedic. Ukusetshenziswa okusiza ngemali kwezinsizakalo ezingavamilwa. Ukuthatha inxaxheke emzamweni wezinsizakulo ezingaphezulu mayelana nemigomo nezinqumo. Ukusebenzela imisebenzi ezengeziwe njengoba kudingwa isibhedlela. Ukulawula imigomo yesevisi yokuqedela izinsizakalo ze-General Surgery. IMIBUZO : Dr. X.F Nene Tel No: (034) 328 8007

xh.title: Umphathi weYunithi yeZempilo (i-ORTHOPEADICS)
xh.summary: Umphathi weYunithi yeZempilo kwizifundo zama-Orthopaedics eMadadeni Provincial Hospital eKwaZulu-Natal, efuna iziqu ze-MBChB nokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengongcali kunye neminyaka emihlanu yamava emva kokubhaliswa.
xh.requirements: Iziqu ezifanelekileyo kwiSayensi yeZempilo ezifanelekileyo (MBCHB); Kanjalo, ukubhaliswa okwangoku kwi-HPCSA njengongcali kwikhategori yama-Orthopaedics. Kanjalo, ubuncinane eminyaka emihlanu (5) yamava afanelekileyo njengongcali wezempilo emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengongcali wezempilo kwikhategori yama-Orthopaedics. Ulwazi, amakhono namandla afunekayo: Ulwazi olubanzi lweklinikhotshi nengqiqo kwizifundo ezimalunga nayo. Ulwazi ngomthetho oqhuba izempilo kunye noLawulo lwazeNkonzo zaLuntu, imithetho nemigaqo ehlangeneyo kuquka nemigaqo yamagosa ezempilo, i-epidemiology nezibalo. Ikhono elihle lokuzithethela, ukuba ngumqambi qhube, ukwenza izigqibo namakhono eklinikhotshi. Ikhono lokufundisa oogqirha abasha nokuthatha inxaxheba ekuphuhlisenwe ngobungcali ngokutsha ngokuqhubeka.
xh.duties: Ukuqamba nokuphumeza iinkonzo zama-Orthopaedics ezikumgangatho ophezulu (abaguli bengaphakathi, abaguli bangaphandle kunye nemihadi yase-Theatre). Ukuthatha inxaxheba/ukubonelela inkonzo yangemva kwiyure ezizezelwe. Ukuqamba nokulinganisa ngokufanelekileyo iinkonzo zama-Orthopaedics ezikumgangatho ophezulu kwi-Amajuba District nakumamashi okukhulula amanzi. Unxibelelwano loluntu noLawulo leziBhedlele kwisithili nakumamashi okukhulula amanzi ukuphucula umgangatho wokunyathelwa kwezempilo. Ukukhuthaza uqeqesho nokuphuhliswa kwabasebenzi. Ukuthatha inxaxheba/ukuxhasa inkqubo yokubakusa kwiZibhedlele nakumaClinics ezithumela abaguli. Unxibelelwano noNtloko ongcali ezihlobene ngokuphuhliswa kweenkonzo. Ukuyila inkqubo yokuqeqesha iinkonzo zezempilo, zobuhlalwa kunye nezoZenzo eziNye. Ukuyila imigaqo nemiqathango yokwenza kubelula ukuletkwa kweenkonzo. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kumaphrojekthi okuphucula umgangatho nokuhlola izinto zeklinikhotshi. Ukuthatha inxaxheba nokukhuthaza uphando lweklinikhotshi. Ukusebenzisa ngokugcinamali izibonelelo ezincinci. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kuLawulo oluphezulu nasemisebenzini ephuhliswa isicwangciso. Ukwenza iiyure ezongeziweyo ngenkqubo ngokweemfuno zesibhedlele. Ukulawula i-EPMDS yesebe leSurgery jikelele. IMIBUZO: Dr. X.F Nene Tel No: (034) 328 8007

Independent, Patience, Commitment, Trustworthiness, Honesty, Accountability, Commitment to excellence, Continuous learning, Amenable to change, Cultural awareness and Project Management.

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Fasiliteitebestuur
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur vir Fasiliteitebestuur by Madadeni Provinsiale Hospitaal, wat 'n graad en drie jaar se bestuurervaring in fasiliteitebestuur vereis.
af.requirements: Graad / Nasionale Diploma in Openbare Bestuur/Openbare Administrasie/ Gesondheidsdiensbestuur. 3 jaar bestuurservaring op Adjunkdirekteurvlak in Fasiliteitebestuur. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Kennis, vaardighede en bevoegdhede vereis: Kennis van Openbare Dienswet, Arbeidsverhoudingswet, Openbare Diensregulasies, Nasionale Gesondheidswet, Vaardigheidsontwikkelingswet, Indiensnemingsgelykheidswet. Mensebestuur, finansiële bestuur, beplanning en organisering. Tydbestuur. Leierskap, organisatoriese, besluitneming- en probleemoplossingsvermoëns. Finansiële en begrotingskennis. Menslikehulpbronbestuur en kommunikasievaardighede. Selfdissipline en vermoë om onder druk met minimale toesig te werk. Onafhanklik, geduld, toewyding, betroubaarheid, eerlikheid, aanspreeklikheid, toewyding aan uitnemendheid, deurlopende leer, ontvanklik vir verandering, kulturele bewustheid en projebestuur.
af.duties: Verseker effektiewe koördinering, bestuur en gehalte van werk van alle funksionele komponente van die stelselsdepartement binne die Hospitaal d.w.s. Skoonmaak, porterdienste, linnebestuur, lykhuis, vervoer, boodskappers, registratuur, voedseldiens, akkommodasie, Veiligheid en Sekuriteit, IT en Pasientadministrasie. Verseker die effektiewe, doeltreffende en ekonomiese benutting van hulpbronne aan die instelling toegeken insluitend die ontwikkeling van personeel. Bestuur kontrakte van alle uitbestee dienste wat deur private maatskappye verskaf word om nakoming van diensvlakooreenkoms te verseker. Verseker dat risikobestuur, veiligheidsprogramme en Ideale Hospitaalnorme en -standaardevereistes deur alle personeel nagekom word. Verseker die effektiewe, doeltreffende en ekonomiese bestuur van toegekende hulpbronne van die Divisie. Verseker dat personeel toepaslike PPB en uniform dra in ooreenstemming met KZN Gesondheid se uniformkode. Ontwikkel beleide en strategieë wat gemik is op die verbetering van dienslewering. Voer gereelde staptoere in die instelling uit. Lewer verslae by bestuursvergaderings oor die toestand van die instelling. Verseker die effektiewe, doeltreffende en ekonomiese bestuur van toegekende hulpbronne van die Divisie. Verseker betroubaarheid van nutsdienste en kritieke stelsels met nul aftyd vir lewensondersteunende stelsels bv. generators, mediese gasse, HVAS, water en rioolketels. Versewer levering van dienste binne begroting, PFMA, Tesourie-regulasies en verbeter doeltreffendheid. Stel verlofplan op en dateer verlofregisters op. Implementeer prestasiebestuur- en ontwikkelingstelsel vir personeel om kliniese dienste te ondersteun om pasientsorg te lewer. Verseker nakoming van gesondheids- en veiligheidsstandaarde en 'n veilige omgewing vir pasiënte, personeel en besoekers. Ondersteun aktief die implementering van inkomsteverbeteringstrategie. Verskaf fasiliteiteleierskap om beplanning, implementering en onderhoud van infrastruktuur in ooreenstemming met operasionele vereistes te ondersteun. Skakel met interne en eksterne belanghebbendes. Handhaaf dissiplinêre kode en prosedure. Verseker nakoming van gehaltestandaarde. NAVRAE: Mnr. jobs.title: Head of Department
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R741 783 per annum. Plus 13th cheque, medical-aid (optional) homeowners allowance (employee must meet the prescribed requirements)
jobs.summary: Head of Department at Grey's Hospital in Pietermaritzburg, requiring a nursing qualification with SANC registration and at least nine years of nursing experience.
jobs.requirements: Senior Certificate / Grade 12 Plus A Diploma /Degree in Nursing, and Midwifery that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse Plus A Post Basic Qualification in Nursing Education registered with SANC Plus Current Registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) 2026 Plus A minimum of 9 (nine) years appropriate / recognizable nursing experience after registration as a Professional nurse with SANC in General Nursing At least 5 (five) years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/recognisable experience in Nursing Education after obtaining 1year post-basic qualification in Nursing Education. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit proof of work experience/certificate of service endorsed and stamped by HR Department Additional Qualifications: A post registration qualification in Nursing Management / Nursing Administration / Health Services Management Masters Degree in Nursing. Knowledge, Skills and Experience: The incumbent of this post will report to the Principal of Grey’s Campus and will be responsible to coordinate, implement and monitor an effective and efficient clinical training system. The ideal candidate must: Possess knowledge of Public Service Administration Acts and Legislation such as Health Act, Higher Education Act, SAQA Act, NQF, Nursing Act, Rules and Regulations, Council on Higher Education Policies, College Policies, PSR, Disciplinary Code and Procedure, Labour Relations Act, etc. Have in-depth knowledge of procedures and processes related to nursing and nursing education and training. Possess sound knowledge and understanding of nursing code of ethics and professional practice of the South African Nursing Council. Thorough knowledge and understanding of Nursing Standard of Practice and Scope of Practice. Possess knowledge of curriculum development and review. Knowledge of procedures and processes related to coordination of undergraduate and postgraduate Nursing Possess proficiency in teaching and assessment in Nursing Education. Possess sound knowledge of planning, scheduling, implementation of Nurse training programmes. Possess sound conflict and decision-making/problem solving skills. Have good research and analytical skills. Have excellent communication and presentation skills (both verbal and written). Computer literacy with proficiency in MS Office package, Excel, Power Point and Outlook. Good interpersonal relations. Ability to work within set deadlines.
jobs.duties: Coordinates the provision of education and training of Student Nurses. Manages clinical learning exposure of students between college and clinical areas. Coordinates and ensure clinical accompaniment of students. Coordinates the implementation of Diploma in Nursing Develop and ensure implementation of quality assurance programmes. Collaborates with other internal and external stakeholders to build a sound relationship within the Department. Supervision and management of performance and development of staff under your discipline in accordance with EPMDS policy. Oversees the supervision of students. Policy analysis and development. Development and review of nursing curricula for all categories of training. Implements the new nursing programmes in line with SANC and CHE regulations. Participates in the provisioning of Continuous Professional Development (CPD) activities at the Campus. Participates in all governance structures of the College.

jobs.notes: This Department is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer, whose aim is to promote representivity in all occupational categories in the department.
