af.title: Hoof van Departement
af.summary: Hoof van Departement by Grey's Hospital in Pietermaritzburg, wat 'n verpleegkunde-kwalifikasie met SANC-registrasie en ten minste nege jaar se verpleegkundige ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Senior Sertifikaat / Graad 12 Plus 'n Diploma / Graad in Verpleegkunde en Vroedkuns wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige moontlik maak Plus 'n Post Basiese Kwalifikasie in Verpleegkunde-onderwys geregistreer by SANC Plus Huidige Registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) 2026 Plus 'n Minimum van 9 (nege) jaar toepaslike / erkenbare verpleegkundige ervaring na registrasie as 'n Professionele verpleegkundige by SANC in Algemene Verpleging. Ten minste 5 (vyf) jaar van bogenoemde periode moet toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in Verpleegkunde-onderwys wees na verkryging van 'n 1-jaar post-basiese kwalifikasie in Verpleegkunde-onderwys. Slegs gekandidateerde kandidate sal vereis word om bewys van werkservaring/dienssertifikaat voor te lê wat deur die HR-departement onderskryf en afgestempel is. Bykomende Kwalifikasies: 'n Post-registrasie-kwalifikasie in Verpleegkunde-bestuur / Verpleegkunde-administrasie / Gesondheidsdienste-bestuur. Meestersgraad in Verpleegkunde. Kennis, Vaardighede en Ervaring: Die beampte van hierdie pos sal aan die Skoolhoof van Grey's Kampus rapporteer en sal verantwoordelik wees vir die koördinering, implementering en monitering van 'n doeltreffende en doelmatige kliniese opleidingstelsel. Die ideale kandidaat moet: Oor kennis beskik van Openbare Dienst-administrasiewette en -wetgewing soos die Health Act, Higher Education Act, SAQA Act, NQF, Nursing Act, Reëls en Regulasies, Council on Higher Education-beleide, Kollegebeleide, PSR, Dissiplinêre Kode en Prosedure, Labour Relations Act, ens. Diepgaande kennis hê van prosedures en prosesse rakende verpleging en verpleegkunde-onderwys en -opleiding. Oor goeie kennis en begrip beskik van die verpleegkundige kode van etiek en professionele praktyk van die South African Nursing Council. Deeglike kennis en begrip van Nursing Standard of Practice en Scope of Practice. Oor kennis beskik van kurrikulumontwikkeling en -hersiening. Kennis van prosedures en prosesse rakende koördinering van voor- en nagraadse Verpleegkunde. Bedrewe wees in onderrig en assessering in Verpleegkunde-onderwys. Oor goeie kennis beskik van beplanning, skedulering en implementering van verpleegkundige opleidingsprogramme. Oor goeie konflik- en besluitnemings/probleemoplossingsvaardighede beskik. Oor goeie navorsings- en analitiese vaardighede beskik. Oor uitstekende kommunikasie- en voorleggingsvaardighede beskik (sowel mondeling as skriftelik. Rekenaargeletterdheid met beheersing van MS Office-pakket, Excel, Power Point en Outlook. Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudinge. Vermoe om binne vasgestelde sperdatums te werk.
af.duties: Koördineer die verskaffing van onderwys en opleiding van studenteverpleegkundiges. Bestuur kliniese leerblootstelling van studente tussen die kollege en kliniese areas. Koördineer en verseker kliniese begeleiding van studente. Koördineer die implementering van die Diploma in Verpleegkunde. Ontwikkel en verseker implementering van gehaltversekeringsprogramme. Werk saam met ander interne en eksterne belanghebbendes om 'n goeie verhouding binne die departement op te bou. Toesig en bestuur van prestasie en ontwikkeling van personeel onder jou dissipline in ooreenstemming met EPMDS-beleid. Hou toesig oor die toesig van studente. Beleidsanalise en -ontwikkeling. Ontwikkeling en hersiening van verpleegkundige kurrikula vir alle kategorieë van opleiding. Implementeer die nuwe verpleegkundige programme in ooreenstemming met SANC- en CHE-regulasies. Neem deel aan die verskaffing van Deurlopende Professionele Ontwikkeling (CPD)-aktiwiteite by die Kampus. Neem deel aan alle bestuursstrukture van die Kollege.

zu.title: Umphathi Womnyango
zu.summary: Umphathi Womnyango eGrey's Hospital ePietermaritzburg, ofuna iziqu zokube udokotela bezempilo ohlotshaniswa noguquko lokubhalisa ku-SANC kanti futhi kube nobuchule obungaphezulu konyaka wesishiyagalolunye bokusebenza njengongcwetiwe kokwelapha.
zu.requirements: I-Senior Certificate / Grade 12 kanye ne-Diploma / Degree ku-Nursing, kanye ne-Midwifery evumela ukubhalisa ku-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengenkosikazi yezokwelapha okungcwetiwe kanti futhi kufanele kube khona iziqu ze-Post Basic ze-Nursing Education ezibhaliswe ku-SANC kanye nokubhalisa kwamanje ku-South African Nursing Council (SANC) 2026. Kufanele kube nobuchule obungaphezulu kweminyaka eyi-9 (lesishiyagalolunye) obuhambisanayo / obuvelele emsebenzini wezokwelapha ngemva kokubhalisa njengongcwetiwe wezokwelapha ngokuvamile ku-SANC. Okungenani iminyaka eyi-5 (yihlanu) kuleso sikhathi okushihiwe ngenhla kufanele ibe yimisebenzi ehambisanayo / evelele e-Nursing Education ngemva kokuthola isiqu sonyaka owodwa se-post-basic e-Nursing Education. Abantu abafakwe ohlwini lwabaphumeleleyo kuphela abayobe bethunyelwa imvumbo yokusebenza / isitifiketi sezinsizakusebenza esiguqulwe ngemuva futhi sifakwe uphawu ngumnyango we-HR. Iziqu ezengeziwe: Isiqu sokubhalisa kwemva kwesikhathi se-Nursing Management / Nursing Administration / Health Services Management noma i-Masters Degree e-Nursing. Ulwazi, Amakhono nobuchule: Othatha lesi sikhundla uzobe exoxa noMphathi wesikolo sikaGrey’s Campus futhi abe nobandebeki lokuhlelela, ukuphumeza kanye nokuhlola isimiso sokwelolwa ngendlela ephumelelayo futhi esebenzayo. Isikhulu esifanele kufanele: Sibe nolwazi ngomthethosisekelo kanye nemithetho yobulungiswa bomphakathi njengalena: i-Health Act, i-Higher Education Act, i-SAQA Act, i-NQF, i-Nursing Act, Izimiso kanye nezinqubo, izinqubomgomo ze-Council on Higher Education, izinqubomgomo ze-College, i-PSR, ikhodi noma inqubo yesigwebo, i-Labour Relations Act, njll. Sibe nolwazi olujulile ngezinqubo kanye namazinga okwenza izinto ohlotshaniswa nezokwelapha kanye nokwelolwa nokuhlelela. Sibe nolwazi olusinekeli kanye nokuqonda ikhodi yokuziphatha kwezokwelapha kanye nokusebenza ngobuchwepheshe be-South African Nursing Council. Sibe nolwazi olubanzi futhi uqonde izimo ezinhle zokusebenza kanye nezibalo ezingangenwa ezokwelapha. Sibe nolwazi ngokwakwa kanye nokuphinda kuhlolwe uhlelo lokufunda. Sibe nolwazi ngamazinga wokwenza izinto ohlotshaniswa nokuhlelela abafundi be-undergraduate ne-postgraduate. Sibe nobuchule bokufundisa kanye nokuhlola e-Nursing Education. Sibe nolwazi olusinekeli lokuhlela, ukumisa izikhathi, nokusebenzisa amaphuzu okuhlelela abelaphi. Sibe namakhono okuxazamulana kanye nokuthathwa kwezinqumo / ukuxazamula izinkinga. Sibe namakhono amahle okuphanda kanye nokuqonda. Sibe namakhono okukhuluma kanye nokwenza izibonakaliso amahle (ngomlomo kanye nangokubhaliwe). Sibe nolwazi lwamakhompyutha okusebenza ngawo angenisa i-MS Office, i-Excel, i-Power Point kanye ne-Outlook. Sibe nobudlelwane obuhle nabantu. Sibe nobuchule bokusebenza ngokwesikhathi esimisiwe.
zu.duties: Uyabumba ukunikelwa kolwazi nokuqeqeswa kwabafundi bokuba oNkosikazi bomkhakha wezokwelapha. Uphatha ukutholwa kolwazi ngokuhlangana kwabafundi phakathi kwesikole namacandelo ezezokwelapha. Uyahlelela futhi aqinisekise ukusiza abafundi ekwelolweni ngezinto ezenziwayo. Uhlelela ukusebenzisa i-Diploma e-Nursing. Yakha futhi aqinisekise ukuphunywa kwezinhlelo zokuqinisekisa izinga lokuhlelela. Usebenzisana nabanye abahola ngaphakathi nangaphandle ukwakha ubuhlobo obuhle kule nyongotheleko. Ukulawula futhi kuphathe amaphuzu kanye nokuqasha abasebenzi abangaphansi kwesikhathi sakho ngokuhambisana nenqubomgomo ye-EPMDS. Ubuka ngaphezulu ukuqeqeshwa kwabafundi. Ukuqapha futhi kwakhe imithetho. Ukwakha futhi aphinde ahlolle imimiselo yeziqu zokuba oNkosikazi bahlangabezana nayo kuso sonke isikhathi sokuhamba. Yenza izinhlela ezisha zobukhosi bokukhululeka ngokuhambisana nemithetho ye-SANC ne-CHE. Uyathatha inxaxheba ekunikelweni kokuqeqeswa kokukhanya okuqhubekayo (CPD) esikoleni. Uyathatha inxaxheba kuso sonke isimiso sokubuso sesikole.

xh.title: Um lawuli weSebe
xh.summary: Isikhulu esiNtloko seSebe kwiGrey's Hospital ePietermaritzburg, sifuna isigqibo sezempilo esineregistesheni kwiSANC nobani phantse iminyaka elishoba esixhenxe yamava kwimisebenzi yezesondlo.
xh.requirements: ISenior Certificate / Grade 12 kwaye kunye neDiploma /Degree kwiNursing, naye uMidwifery evumela ukubhalisa kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengo Professional Nurse kwaye kunye nePost Basic Qualification kwiNursing Education ebhalisiwe kwiSANC kwaye kunye neCurrent Registration kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) 2026 kwaye ibe nthambele iminyaka elishoba esixhenze (9) yamava afanelekileyo / avakalisekayo kunyaka lokuqala lokusetyenziswa emva kokubhalisa njengo Professional nurse kwiSANC kwiGeneral Nursing. Ubuncinane beminyaka emihlanu (5) kwelo nkanxa elithethwe ngasentla kufuneka ibe ngamava afanelekileyo / avakalisekayo kwiNursing Education emva kokufumana unyaka owodwa (1) we-post-basic qualification kwiNursing Education. Kuphela abo bakhethwayo baza kufunwa bangenise isibiyela sabo bomsebenzi / isatifikethi esityikitywe nesemboziwe yiNdzamso yeHR. IziPhumezo ezongezelelweyo: Isigqibo se-post registration kwiNursing Management / Nursing Administration / Health Services Management okanye iMasters Degree kwiNursing. Ulwazi, Amakhono namava: Olu luze kule sithuba uya kuxela kuPrincipal weGrey's Campus uze ube noligibility lokulungelelanisa, ukuyila nokuhlola indlela esebenzayo nengagunyaziswa yokuqeqesha. Olu luze kuba: Noba nolwazi malunga nePublic Service Administration Acts ngezinye iSishiwo esinjengeHealth Act, Higher Education Act, SAQA Act, NQF, Nursing Act, Ithekhiwo nemimiselo, iNqununu yeHigher Education Policies, iCollege Policies, PSR, iDisciplinary Code and Procedure, iLabour Relations Act, njl. Nolwazi olujulileyo ngeendlela nemisebenzi ephathelene nokuqeqesha nokukhokelwa kwamakhosi ezesondlo. Noba nolwazi olusuka kwaye aqonde ikhowudi yamagunya obume namalungiselelo obugcisa besiNtloko kwiSouth African Nursing Council. Nolwazi olupheleleyo oluqonda iindlela neendlela ezichaza ukumisela kolulinganiselwe kolusebenziso lweNursing. Nolwazi lweqondo lokuyila nokuqwalasela kwimisebenzi. Nolwazi lwamacandla nokwenza imisebenzi enxulumene nokulungelelanisa i-undergraduate ne-postgraduate Nursing. Nolwazi ekukhokelwa iklasi nokulinganisa kwiNursing Education. Nolwazi olusuka ekuyilweni, ukumiseleni ishedyuli nokuqatywa kwemisebenzi yokuqeqesha abaFundi. Nakhono amahlulo aqhayisa kwaye alungise izisombululo kwiingxaki. Namakhono okuphanda nokuqwalasela. Namakhono amnandi okuthetha nokubonisa (ngokubhalayo nangokuthethayo). Ulwazi lokusebenzisa iikhompyutha kakuhle ngakumbi kwiMS Office package, Excel, PowerPoint nakuOutlook. Amakhono amnandi okuhamba nabantu. Ulungelelwaniso lokusebenza ngexesha elimisiweyo.
xh.duties: Ulungelelanisa inikezelo lokufundiswa nokuqeqeswa kwabaFundi bamaKhosi ezondlo. Uyawaphatha amava okufunda obomi kumalunga aze athungelwe phakathi kwesikolo nakuwo onke amabala eklasi. Ulungelelanisa uze uqiniseke ukulungiselelwa koluhlobo abafundi. Ulungelelanisa ukusebenza kweDiploma kwiNursing yaza yawafundisa, yaza waqinisekisa ukuyilwa kolwazi. Udibana nabanye abalinganiselweyo bangaphakathi nangaphandle ukuze akhe ulud olusuka phakathi kwesebe. Ulawulo lokulungelelana nokuphucula ukusebenza nentshukumo yamakhosi apha ngaphantsi kwalawulo lwakho ngokomthetho we-EPMDS. Uyakhalipha ngokulawula abafundi. Ukukhetha nokuqwalasela imigaqo. Ukuqamba nokuqwalasela amakhosi ezesondlo afanele ukusetyenziswa kuzo zonke iindidi zokuqeqesha. Uyayisebenzisa iinkqaba ezintsha zokusebenza kumakhosi esondlo ngokwemigaqo yeSANC neCHE. Uthatha inxaxheba ekunikeni iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo zokulungelelwa ngamava aqhubekayo zeNqanaba lemfundo eCampus. Uthatha inxaxheba kuzo zonke iinkqubo ezilawulwayo zeCollege.

'n Minimum van vyf (5) jaar van bogenoemde periode moet toepaslike/erkende ervaring in Verpleegonderwys as 'n Dosent by 'n erkende Verpleegonderwysinstelling wees. Aansoekers moet slegs 'n ten volle voltooide Z83-vorm en 'n gedetailleerde CV indien, alle ander dokumente insluitend enige bewys moet deur gekorte lys kandidate ingedien word. Dienssertifikaat wat deur die Menslike Hulpbronne Departement gepremieer is. In besit van 'n ongeëndorseerde geldige RSA-bestuurslisensie (Kode EB). Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdheid Vereis: Diepgaande kennis van Verpleegonderwysprogramme binne die Kollege. Beskik oor kennis van die tersaaklike wetgewing, Wette, Preskripte en Beleidsraamwerk binne die area van werksomstandighede. Oor uitstekende kommunikasievaardighede (geskrewe & mondeling) en aanbiedingsvaardighede beskik. Diepgaande kennis van verpleegonderwysprogramme en kurrikulum. Bekwaamheid in onderrig en assessering in verpleegonderwys insluitend evalueringsbenaderings. Kennis van beleidontwikkeling, -interpretasie, -implementering, monitering en evaluering. Gesonde konflik- en besluitnemings/probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Bereidwilligheid om te reis. Goeie navorsings- en analitiese vaardighede. Goeie bestuurlike en interpersoonlike vaardighede.
af.duties: Köördineer die voorsiening van onderwys en opleiding van studenteverpleegkundiges. Bestuur kliniese leerblootstelling van studente tussen kollege en kliniese area. Hou toesig oor studente. Samewerking met ander belanghebbendes en bou 'n gesonde verhouding binne die departement. Onderrig en koördineer die kliniese toesig van studente insluitend onderrig, leer en assessering van Verpleegonderwysprogramme by die Campus. Ontwikkel en verseker implementering van gehaltversekeringsprogramme. Werk saam met ander interne en eksterne belanghebbendes en bou 'n gesonde verhouding binne die Departement. Neem deel aan beleidontwikkeling en -analise. Ontwikkeling en hersiening van verpleegkurrikula vir alle kategorieë van opleiding. Implementeer die nuwe verpleegprogramme in ooreenstemming met SANC- en CHE-regulasies. Neem deel aan die voorsiening van Deurlopende Professionele Ontwikkeling (CPD)-aktiwiteite by die Campus. Neem deel aan alle bestuursstrukture van die Kollege. Ondersteun die missie en bevorder die beeld van die Kollege. Oefen beheer oor studente uit. Implementeer werknemerbestuur- en ontwikkelingstelsels. Onderhou alle kliniese rekords en verslae vir studente en personeel.

zu.title: Umhola Womnyango: Umcoordinatori Wezokwelapha
zu.summary: Kufunwa umhola womnyango umcoordinatori wezokwelapha o KwaZulu-Natal ukuxhumanisa imfundo yokunersa nokuqeqesha abafundi ngezokwelapha e-Addington Campus.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 (Senior Certificate) PLUS. I-Degree/ diploma kwi-General Nursing, Midwifery, Psychiatric nalase-Community Nursing Science evumela ukubhalisa ku-South African Nursing Council (SANC). I-Degree/Diploma kwi-Nursing Education ebhaliswe kwi-SANC. I-Degree/Diploma ye-Health Service Management/Nursing Administration ebhaliswe kwi-SANC. Okungenani iminyaka yisishiyagalolunye (9) yokuhlangenwe nakho okufanelekile/okuqashelwe emva kokubhalisa njengo-Professional Nurse ku-South African Nursing Council. Okungenani iminyaka eyisihlanu (5) kwesikhathi esingenhla kumele kube yokuhlangenwe nakho okufanelekile/okuqashelwe kwi-Nursing Education njengo-Lecturer esikhungweni se-Nursing Education esiqashelwayo. Abafake izicelo kumele balethe ifomu le-Z83 eligcwaliswe ngokuphelele ne-CV enemininingwane kuphela, wonke eminye imibalu kuhlanganise nanoma yisiphi isibonakaliso ithunyelwe abafakiwe ohlwini. Isitifiketi sezenza esigunyazwe u-Human Resource Department. Abanelayisense ehlukile evunyiwe lase-RSA (Code EB). Ulwazi, amakhono, ukuqeqeshwa namandla adingekayo: Ulwazi olujulile ohlelweni lwe-Nursing Education kolwazi. Ulwazi ngemithetho ehlobene, ama-Acts, izincwadi zemithetho nesakhiwo sezinqumo endaweni yokusebenza. Ukuba namakhono okuxhumana amahle (okubhala nokukhuluma) namakhono okunikeza izinkulumo. Ulwazi olujulile ngohlelo nokhulumi lwe-nursing education. Ukukhonya ekufundiseni nasekuhloleni kwe-nursing education kuhlanganise izindlela zokuqonda. Ulwazi ngokuthuthukiswa, ukuhumusha, ukuqalisa, ukulawula nokuqonda izinqumo. Amakhono amahle okuxazulula izinkinga nokwenza izinqumo. Ukuzithoba ukuhamba. Amakhono amahle okucwaninga nokuqonda. Amakhono amahle okulawula nokuxhumana nabantu.
zu.duties: Xhumanisa ukunikezwa kwemfundo nokuqeqeshwa kwabafundi bokunersa. Lawula ukutholakala kokufunda ngezokwelapha kwabafundi phakathi kwesikole nendawo yezokwelapha. Qaphela ukulawula abafundi. Ukusebenza nabanye abaphethwe ohlelweni futhi wakhe ubuhlobo obuhle phakathi komnyango. Lawula futhi uxhumanise ukulawulwa kwabafundi ngezokwelapha kuhlanganise ukufundisa, ukufunda nokuqoqa ohlelweni lwe-Nursing Education e-Campus. Thuthukisa futhi qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zokuqinisekisa ikhwalithi. Sebenzisana nabanye abaphethwe banganaphandle nangaphakathi futhi wakhe ubuhlobo obuhle phakathi Komnyango. Thatha inxaxheba ekuthuthukisweni nasekuhlaziyeni izinqumo. Ukuthuthukisa futhi uhlola ukhulumi lwe-nursing yazo zonke izigaba zokuqeqeshwa. Qalisa ohlelo olusha lwe-nursing ngokuvumelana nemithetho ye-SANC ne-CHE. Thatha inxaxheba ekunikeni izenzo ze-Continuous Professional Development (CPD) e-Campus. Thatha inxaxheba kuzo zonke izakhiwo zokuphatha ze-College. Sekela umhlaka futhi khuthaza isithombe se-College. Lawula abafundi. Qalisa izinhlelo zokuphatha nokuqeqesha abasebenzi. Zigcina zonke izinkulungwane nezibika zezokwelapha zabafundi nabasebenzi.

xh.title: Umlawuli weSebe: uMlahalwe weMisebenzi yeKliniki
xh.summary: Kufunwa iNtloko yeSebe yoMlahalwe weMisebenzi yeKliniki kwi-KwaZulu-Natal ukulungelelanisa imfundo yokhathalelo lwabaguli nokuqeqeswa kwabafundi kwindawo yamasebenzi eKliniki kwi-Addington Campus.
xh.requirements: I-Garde 12 (Isatifikethi esiphezimu) PLUS. Isidanga/iploma kwiNtsebenziso yoKhathalelo jikelele, iNkomba kabantu, iPsychiatric kunye neSayensi yoKhathalelo lweSimo esiNgqongileyo evumela ubhaliso ne-South African Nursing Council (SANC). Isidanga/Iploma kwiMfundo yoKhathalelo ebalulekileyo ebhalisiweyo kwi-SANC. Isidanga/Iplola kwimiQathango yoQoqosho yamasebenzi eMzimba/Imilawulo yoKhathalelo ebhalisiweyo kwi-SANC. I-9 yeminyaka elungileyo/eqondwayo yamava emva kokubhalisa njengoGqirha woKhathalelo kwi-South African Nursing Council. Okungenani eminyaka emi-5 (5) kule minyaka ingasentla kufuneka ibe yimava elungileyo/eqondwayo kwiMfundo yoKhathalelo njengoMfundisi kwiNkundla yoQeqesho yoKhathalelo elungileyo/eqondwayo. Abafaka isicelo kufuneka bagcwalise ngaphezu koko ifomu ye-Z83 egqityiweyo noda CV ekudityanisiweyo kuphela, zonke ezinye i-document eziquka nazo zonke izatifikethi zongeniswa ngabantu abakhethiweyo. Isatifikethi somsebenzi esagqinwa ngumnyango we-Human Resource. Kufuneka ube namali ye-RSA Drivers Licence (Code EB) esemthethweni ekuhlala iyasebenza. Ulwazi, Amakhono, uQeqesho namava aFunekayo: Ukuqonda okuphezulu kwemigaqo yeMfundo yoKhathalelo kwesiKholo. Ukuba nolwazi ngemiQathango yomthetho, imilaqo neMithetho yokuSebenza kwindawo uyisebenzela kona. Ukuba namakhono amabalisa ekuxhumaneni (okubhaliweyo noku-thethwayo) namakhono okubonisa. Ukuqonda okuphezulu kwemiba yeMfundo nemiQathango yayo kwiNkundla yoQeqesho yoKhathalelo. Ukuba bulumko ekufundiseni nokulinganisa kwiMfundo yoKhathalelo kuquka iindlela zokuqaphela. Ulwazi ngokwenza, ukuqonda, ukusebenzisa, ukuqaphelela nokuqokelela iimfundo zolwazi. Amakhono abalaseleyo ekuxazulula iingxaki nokwenza izigqibo/ekuxazulula iingxaki. Ukuzimisela ukuhamba. Amakhono abalaseleyo kuphononongo nokuqonda. Amakhono abalaseleyo okulawula nokuqonda abantu.
xh.duties: Ukulungelelanisa ukunikwa kwemfundo noQeqesho lwabo bafundi bakaKhathalelo. Ukulawula iNkcazelo yokuFunda kwezaseKliniki yabafudi phakathi kwesiKholo nendawo yamasebenzi eKliniki. Ukuqaphelela ngokusembakwini abafundi. Ukusebenzisana nabaqhubi bamanye amashishini nokwakha ubudlelwane obulungileyo kwisebe. Ukulawula nokulungelelanisa okusembakwini abafundi ngokuphatelene nokufundisa, ukufunda nokuqondakalisa imigaqo yeMfundo yoKhathalelo kwindawo. Ukuyila nokwazi ukuqinisekisa ukusetyenziswa kwenkqubo yekhwalithi. Ukusebenzisana nabanye abaphathi abangaphakathi nangaphandle nokwakha ubudlelwane obulungileyo kwisebe. Ukuthath inxaxheba ekuyileni nasekuphononongeni iinkqubo. Ukuyila nokuphonononga iNkqubo yemfundo kaKhathalelo kuzo zonke iindidi zokuqeqesha. Ukusebenzisa iinkqubo ezitsha zokuKhathalela ngokwemigaqo ye-SANC ne-CHE. Ukuthath inxaxheba ekunikeni iNkqubo ye-Continuous Professional Development (CPD) eCampus. Ukuthath inxaxheba kuzo zonke iindima ezilawulayo zeKholeji. Ukuxhasa iNjongo nokuzigqibelela isimilo seKholeji. Ukulawula abafundi. Ukusebenzisa iinkqubo zokulawula nokuqeqesha abasebenzi. Ukugcina zonke iirekhodi zaseKliniki neNgxelo zabafudi nasebenzi.

jobs.title: Operational Manager Nursing Specialty (HAST)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R720 819 - R821 454 per annum, plus 8% Inhospitable Allowance, 13th cheque, medical Aid (Optional) and housing allowance (employee must meet prescribed requirements)
jobs.summary: Operational Manager Nursing required at Madadeni Provincial Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal to oversee HIV, ARV, TB and STI services within the HAST unit.
jobs.requirements: Basic R425 qualification (i.e., Degree/Diploma) in general nursing, 1 year Post basic diploma in Clinical assessment, treatment and care. Minimum of 9 years appropriate recognizable nursing experience after registration as a professional nurse with SANC in General Nursing. At least five (5) years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/ recognizable experience in PHC after obtaining one (1) year post basic qualification in PHC. Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competencies Required: strong interpersonal, communication and presentation skills. Ability to make independent decisions, problem solving and conflict resolution. Understanding of the challenges facing the public health sector. Ability to prioritise issues and other work-related matters and to comply with time frames. Knowledge on nursing care processes and procedures, nursing statuses and other relevant legal framework.
jobs.duties: Oversee HIV management, ARV roll out, TB management STI services. Develop and implement quality assurance programmes, policies and operational plan for HAST unit to ensure compliance with National Core Standards. Promote quality of nursing care as directed by the professional scope of practise and standards as determined by the institution, District office and provincial office. Ensure provision of a safe therapeutic environment that allows for the practice of safe nursing care as laid by the nursing Act, Occupational Health and Safety Act and all other applicable prescripts. Exercise control over discipline, grievances and all labour relations issues. Develop/ establish and maintain constructive working relationship with staff and other stakeholders. Effective utilisation of all resources e.g human, financial, equipment and supplies. Monitor the management/ prevention and control infection within HAST unit. Develop, monitor and evaluate staff performance in terms of EPMDS policy. Display a concern for patients, promoting, advocating and facilitating proper treatment and care and ensuring that the unit adhere to the principles of Batho Pele. Perform other functions assigned by the supervisor. ENQURIES : Mr. R.M Sithole Tel No: (034) 328 8137
jobs.applications: All applications can be submitted through hand delivery /courier to: The HR Recruitment Office no:3, Madadeni Hospital, f0001. Section 6, Madadeni 2951. Applications can also be emailed to: sibongiseni.kheswa@kznhealth.gov.za FOR ATTENTION : The Recruitment Officer
jobs.notes: This Department is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer, whose aim is to promote representivity in all levels of all occupational categories in the Department. Note: The contents of this Circular Minute must be brought to the notice of all eligible officers and employees on your establishment of all Institutions. Institutions must notify all candidates who qualify for post in this circular minute even if they are absent from their normal places of work to apply. Direction to Candidates: the following documents must be submitted: Application for Employment form (Z83) which is obtainable from any Government Department OR from the website - www.kznhealth.gov.za. The application form (Z83) must be accompanied by a detailed Curriculum Vitae, Certified copies of ID, Highest educational qualification and other relevant documents will be requested for submission only from shortlisted candidates. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The reference number must be indicated in the column provided on the form Z83 and on the back of the envelope, e.g. MAD 01/2016. NB: Failure to comply with the above instructions will be disqualify applicants. Person with disabilities should feel free to apply for the post. The appointment is subject to positive outcome obtained from the NIA the following checks (security clearance, credit records, qualification, citizenship and previous experience employment verification). Due to the large number of applications, receipt of applications will not be acknowledged. However, correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. Please note that due to financial constraint no S&T claims will be considered for payment to the candidates that are invited for an interview. EE Targets: African Male.

af.title: Operasionele Bestuurder Verpleegkunde Spesialiteit (HAST)
af.summary: Operasionele bestuurder verpleegkunde word by Madadeni Provinsiale Hospitaal in KwaZulu-Natal benodig om HIV-, ARV-, TB- en STI-diens Binne die HAST-eenheid te oorsien.
af.requirements: Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.w.s. Graad/Diploma) in algemene verpleegkunde, 1 jaar postbasiese diploma in kliniese assessering, behandeling en sorg. Minimum van 9 jaar toepaslike herkenbare verpleegervaring na registrasie as 'n professionele verpleegkundige by SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Ten minste vyf (5) jaar van die bogenoemde tydperk moet toepaslike/herkenbare ervaring in PHC wees na die verkryging van 'n een (1) jaar postbasiese kwalifikasie in PHC. Kennis, vaardighede, opleiding en bevoegdhede vereis: sterk interpersoonlike, kommunikasie en aanbiedingsvaardighede. Vermoë om onafhanklike besluite te neem, probleemoplossing en konflikoplossing. Begrip van die uitdagings wat die openbare gesondheidssektor in die gesig staar. Vermoë om kwessies en ander werkverwante sake te prioritiseer en om tydraames na te kom. Kennis van verpleegsorgprosesse en prosedures, verpleegstatusse en ander relevante regskader.
af.duties: Oorsien HIV-bestuur, ARV-uitrol, TB-bestuur STI-diens. Ontwikkel en implementeer gehalteversekeringsprogramme, beleide en operasionele plan vir HAST-eenheid om nakoming van Nasionale Kerntandaarde te verseker. Bevorder gehalte van verpleegsorg soos bepaal deur die professionele omvang van praktyk en standaarde soos bepaal deur die instelling, Distrikkantoor en provinsiale kantoor. Verseker voorsiening van 'n veilige terapeutiese omgewing wat die beoefening van veilige verpleegsorg soos uiteengesit deur die Verpleegwet, Beroepsveiligheid en Gesondheidswet en alle ander toepaslike voorskryfte toelaat. Oefen beheer uit oor dissipline, griewe en alle arbeidsverhoudingsake. Ontwikkel/vestig en handhaaf konstruktiewe werksverhouding met personeel en ander belanghebbendes. Effektiewe benutting van alle hulpbronne bv. menslike, finansiële, toerusting en voorraad. Monitor die bestuur/voorkoming en beheer van infeksie binne HAST-eenheid. Ontwikkel, monitor en evalueer personeelprestasie in terme van EPMDS-beleid. Toon besorgdheid oor pasiënte, bevorder, beyker en fasiliteer behoorlike behandeling en sorg en verseker dat die eenheid by die beginsels van Batho Pele hou. Voer ander funksies uit wat deur die toesighouer toegeken word. NAVRAE: Mnr. R.M Sithole Tel No: (034) 328 8137

zu.title: Umphathi Wemisebenzi Wezokwelapha Okukhethekile (HAST)
zu.summary: Kudingeka Umphathi Wemisebenzi Wezokwelapha esibhedlela i-Madadeni Provincial Hospital e-KwaZulu-Natal ukuze aqaphele izinsiza ze-HIV, ARV, TB kanye ne-STI ngaphakathi kwenhlobo i-HAST.
zu.requirements: Ithelifikhejheshini yomqondo R425 (okt, I-digri/iploma) ekunakekelweni kwesifo jikelele, unyaka we-1 dipoloma yaseshashalazini ekulinganisweni okuyisofundo, ukwelapha nokunakekela. Okungenani eminyaka engu-9 yohlu lokunakekela abagula olwaziwayo olufanele emuva kokuqoshwa njengongugiwezokwelapha ngaphansi kwe-SANC ekunakekelweni kwesifo jikelele. Okungenani eminyaka eyisihlanu (5) kwesikhathi esishiwo ngenhla kumele kube oluhlaziwayo/olwaziwayo olufanele kwi-PHC emuva kokuthola unyaka owodwa (1) weqedile dipoloma yaseshashalazini kwi-PHC. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Ukuqeqeshwa Namandla Adingekayo: amakhono aqinile okuxhumana nokuzethula nokukhuluma. Isikhono sokuthatha izinqumo eziyizimono, ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuxazulula izinkinga phakathi kwabantu. Ukuqonda izinselele ezibhekene nomnyango wezempilo yomphakathi. Isikhono sokubeka ezindimeni izinto nezinye izindaba ezihlobene nomsebenzi futhikuhambisana namaganga okuhamba isikhathi. Ulwazi ngqo ngemizamo nangezinqubo zokunakekela kwezokwelapha, izimo zokunakekela kwabagula kanye nezinye izakhiwo zomthetho ezifanele.
zu.duties: Qaphekela ukuphathwa kwe-HIV, ukusetshenziswa kwe-ARV, ukuphathwa kwe-TB nezinsiza ze-STI. Bese uthuthukisa futhi usebenzise izinhlelo zokuqinisekisa izinga lekhwalithi, izinqubo nezinhlela zokusebenza zenhlobo i-HAST ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthobela amazinga abalulekile ezwe. Ukukhuthaza izinga lenakekelo kwabagula njengokuqondiswa ngobungcweti bokusebenza nangamazinga asetshenziswa isikhungo, ihhovisi lesifunda nehhovisi lesifundazwe. Qinisekisa ukunikezwa kwendawo ekhululekile ekwelaphayo evumela ukunakekelwa kwabagula okuphephile njengokuqondiswa umthetho wezokwelapha, umthetho wezempilo yabasebenzi nokuphepha kanye nomqondo ongasho konke okuphathelene nale minqumo yomthetho. Lawula ngokugcwele ukuziphendanisa, izikhalazo kanye nanoma yiziphi izindaba zomphatho wabasebenzi. Bese uthuthukisa/ukwakha ulwazi oluhle lokusebenza nabasebenzi kanye nalabo abanomthelela ekusebenzeni. Ukusetshenziswa okuphephile kolwazi wonke ohlelo lwabantu, izimali, izinto zokusebenza nokunikezwa. Landa imizamo yokuphathwa/ekuvikeleni futhi kulawule ukutheleleka okungahle kubekhona ngaphakathi kwenhlobo i-HAST. Thuthukisa, lapha ulale futhi uhlole ukusebenza kwabasebenzi ngokwe-policy ye-EPMDS. Khombisa ukukhathazeka ngabagula, ukukhuthaza, ukusekela futhi ululele ukwelapha nokunakekela okufanele futhi uqinisekise ukuthi inhlobo ihambisana nemigomo ye-Batho Pele. Yenza okunye okunconywa umphathi. IMIBUZO : Mr. R.M Sithole Tel No: (034) 328 8137

xh.title: Umphathi weMisebenzi we Nzalo lweNurse eNgowemsebenzi ongundoqo (HAST)
xh.summary: Kufuneka ibe nguMphathi weMisebenzi we Nzalo lweNurse eMadadeni Provincial Hospital eKwaZulu-Natal ukuba alawule iinkonzo ze HIV, ARV, TB ne STASTI ngaphakathi kwesebe le HAST.
xh.requirements: Iziqinisekiso ezisisiseko ze R425 (oko kukuthi, I-degree/Idiploma) kwinzalo lweNurse jikelele, inyanga yoku-1 idiploma yokuzitholela kwi Clinical assessment, treatment and care. Uqobo ngobuncinane kweminyaka engu-9 yamava obunokumkelwa obuhambelana nonyule ukuba lunyulwe njengenurse yobugcwethi kwi SANC kwinzalo lweNurse jikelele. Ubuncinane kweminyaka emihlanu (5) kwexesha elikhankanywe ngasentla kufuneka ibe ngamava ahambelana/ okumkelwa kwi PHC emva kokuqeqeshwa kwenyanga elinye (1) yokuzitholela isiqinisekiso kwi PHC. Ulwazi, amakhono, uqeqesho namandla afunekayo: amakhono amakhulu okuxhumana, okuthetha nokuvelisa. Isakhono sokwenza izigqibo uzibambele, ukuxazula iingxaki nokuzisa uxolo kwiingxoxo. Ukuqonda iingxaki ezibhekise naso candelo lempilo yomntu wonke. Isakhono sokubeka izinto phambili nangamanye amagqabantshintshi ahambelana nomsebenzi nokuhambelana nexesha elithiwithwe. Ulwazi ngamanyathelo neenkqubo ezinkathazo zenzalo lwenurse, izigqibo zenzalo lwenurse nolunye ulwmgangatho wezomthetho ohambelana nalo.
xh.duties: Ukulawula ulawulo lwe HIV, ukusasazwa kwe ARV, ulawulo lwe TB nolawulo lweenkonzo ze STI. Ukuphuhza nokusebenzisa iinkqubo ziqinisekisa umgangatho, iinqobo kunye nolwandebe loqikelelo kwesebe le HAST ukuqinisekisa ukutshatiselezwa ne National Core Standards. Ukukhuthaza umgangatho wonzalo lwenurse njengalawulwa lummandla weqondo lomsebenzi weNurse yobugcwethi namagqagamshela anqonyiweyo sisimo, iofisi eseBurgodi nethi provincial. Ukulawula imeko yamava yamava yamava nendalo nezinye iingxaki ezahlangene nomsebenzi. Ukuphuhza/ ukuseka nokulondoloza ibudlelwano obusetyenziswayo basebenzayo nabasebenzi nakunye nalabo abanomdla. Ukusetyenziswa okusebenzayo ko lonke ulondolozo ngenxa yokuba ngabantu, imali, amathuluzi nezinto ezifunekayo. Ukulawula ukulawula/ ukuthintela nokulawula ukuthelelelana ngaphakathi kwesebe le HAST. Ukuphuhza, ukulawula nokuhlolela ukusebenza ngokusetyenziswa koluntu. Ukuvelisa inkathazo ngabagulwa, ukukhuthaza, ukukhusela nokukhokeza kwizibonelelo ezikumgangatho ongakumbi ezindaweni zokuhlola kodlalo lweziganeko. Ukwenza naziphi na ezinye izinto ezinkunziwe sisikhokelo. ENQURIES : Mr. R.M Sithole Tel No: (034) 328 8137

jobs.title: Operational Manager Nursing (PHC)
jobs.salary_text: R720 819 - R809 313 per annum. Other Benefits: Medical Aid – Optional, Housing Allowance - Employee must meet prescribed requirements, 13th Cheque and 12% rural allowance.
jobs.summary: Operational Manager Nursing position at Vryheid District Hospital requiring a degree or diploma in nursing with nine years experience after SANC registration.
jobs.requirements: Degree / Diploma in General Nursing and Midwifery. One year post basic qualification in Primary Health Care. Registration with SANC as Professional Nurse and Midwifery. A minimum of (9) nine years recognizable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with SANC in General Nursing and Midwifery, of which five (5) years must be recognizable experience after obtaining one (1) year post basic qualification in Primary Health Care Current SANC receipt. A valid driver’s license. Recommendations: HIV and AIDS Training. Community Health Nursing. Knowledge, Skills, Training & Competencies Required: Knowledge and insight into nursing process and procedures. Knowledge of nursing statutes and other relevant Public Services Act/ legislations. Decision making and problem-solving skills. Interpersonal skills in dealing with conflict management. Knowledge and implement Batho Pele principles. Supervisory and analytical thinking skills. Stress tolerance, flexibility, empathy and ability to communicate constructively. Disaster management skills. Team building and supervisory skills.
jobs.duties: Provide effective management and professional leadership ensuring that facility is organized and covered with professional staff. Co-ordinate provision of quality patient care. Provide effective supervision of staff in the facility. Ensuring implementation of nursing standard, policies and procedures. Manage and direct efficient utilization of resources to enhance service delivery. Exercise control of discipline, grievance and any other Labour related issues in terms of laid down procedures. Maintain client satisfaction through monitoring and setting of service standards. Implement and monitor Norms and Standards, Ideal clinic priorities and procurement processes. Monitoring and Implementation of EPMDS. Advocate for patients in facilitating proper treatment care, and adherence to Patient Rights Charter and Batho Pele Principles. Ensure to keep accurate records. Compile unit statistics monthly.
jobs.enquiries: Ms. ATS Sibiya Tel No: (034) 9822111, Ext. 4692
jobs.applications: All applications should be forwarded to: Assistant Director: HRM, Private Bag X9371, Vryheid, 3100 or be hand delivered at Coswald Brown Street, Vryheid, 3100, HR office No: 09 or email to VryheidHospital.HRJobApplication@kznhealth.gov.za
jobs.notes: This Department is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer, whose aim is to promote representivity in all levels of all occupational categories in the Department. The contents of this circular minute must be brought to the notice of all eligible employees on the establishment of all institutions without delay. It must be ensured that all employees who meet the requirements of the post are made aware on this circular minute even if they are absent from their normal places of work. Directions To Candidates: The following documents must be submitted: Application for employment form (Form Z83), which is obtainable at any Government Department OR from the website (www.kznhealth.gov.za) issued by Minister of DPSA in line with regulation 10 of the Public Service Regulations 2016. Applicant must utilize the most recent Z83 form. The Z83 must be fully completed: Failure to do so will result in disqualification. A detailed Curriculum Vitae (CV) and please note that it is no longer a requirement to submit any qualification or supporting documents, only shortlisted candidate will be required to produce certified copies of documents on or before the day of the interview. The Reference Number and the position for which you are applying (as stated in the advert) must be clearly indicated in the columns provided on the Z83 form. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The appointments are subject to positive outcome obtained from the NIA to the following checks (Security clearance, credit records, qualifications, citizenship and previous experience verifications) It is the applicant’s responsibility to have a foreign qualification which is the inherent requirement of the job evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) and to provide proof when shortlisted. Failure to comply will result in the application not being considered. Applicants are respectfully informed that if no notification of appointment is received within 3 months after the closing date, they must accept that their applications were unsuccessful. People living with disabilities are encouraged to apply for the post. Please note that due to financial constraint no S&T claims will be considered for payment to the candidates that are invited for an interview. The department reserves the right not to fill the post. Failure to comply with the above instructions will disqualify your application. The post will be filled in terms of the Employment Equity Target. NB: Sending applications using courier service/email is encouraged as we have challenges with the post office.

af.title: Operasionele Bestuurder Verpleging (PHC)
af.summary: Operasionele Bestuurder Verpleging-pos by Vryheid Distrikshospitaal wat 'n graad of diploma in verpleging met nege jaar ervaring na SANC-registrasie vereis.
af.requirements: Graad / Diploma in Algemene Verpleging en Vroedvrouenskap. Een jaar postbasiese kwalifikasie in Primêre Gesondheidsorg. Registrasie met SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige en Vroedvrou. 'n Minimum van (9) nege jaar erkende ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige met SANC in Algemene Verpleging en Vroedvrouenskap, waarvan vyf (5) jaar erkende ervaring moet wees na verkryging van een (1) jaar postbasiese kwalifikasie in Primêre Gesondheidsorg. Huidige SANC-kwitansie. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Aanbevelings: MIV en VIGS-opleiding. Gemeenskapsgesondheidsverpleging. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding & Bevoegdhede Vereis: Kennis en insig in verpleegproses en prosedures. Kennis van verpleegstatute en ander tersaaklike Openbare Diensste-wette/wetgewing. Besluitneming- en probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Interpersoonlike vaardighede in die hantering van konflikbestuur. Kennis en implementering van Batho Pele-beginsels. Toesighoudende en analitiese denkvaardighede. Stresverdraagsaamheid, buigsaamheid, empatie en vermoë om konstruktief te kommunikeer. Rampbestuursvaardighede. Spanbou- en toesighoudende vaardighede.
af.duties: Verskaf doeltreffende bestuur en professionele leierskap wat verseker dat die fasiliteit georganiseer is en bedek is met professionele personeel. Koördineer die verskaffing van gehalte pasiëntversorging. Verskaf doeltreffende toesig oor personeel in die fasiliteit. Verseker implementering van verpleegstandaarde, beleide en prosedures. Bestuur en rig doeltreffende benutting van hulpbronne om dienslewering te verbeter. Oefen beheer uit oor dissipline, griewe en enige ander Arbeid-verwante kwessies volgens vasgestelde prosedures. Handhaaf kliëntetevredenheid deur monitering en instelling van diensstandaarde. Implementeer en monitor Norme en Standaarde, Ideale klinieke prioriteite en verkrygingsprosesse. Monitering en implementering van EPMDS. Pleitbesorg vir pasiënte in die fasilitering van behoorlike behandelingsorg, en nakoming van die Handves vir Pasiënteregte en Batho Pele-beginsels. Verseker om akkurate rekords te hou. Stel eenheidstatistieke maandeliks op.

zu.title: Umphathi Wemisebenzi Wezokunakekela (PHC)
zu.summary: Isikhundla somphathi wemisebenzi wezokunakekela esibhedlela saseduzane i-Vryheid esidinga idigri noma idiploma ezokunakekela okunesikhathi esiphelele sekhulu lapho kubhaliswa ku-SANC.
zu.requirements: I-Degree / Diploma General Nursing and Midwifery. Isidumbu sonyaka sobhalo olusekelwe Primary Health Care. Ukuze kubhalise ku-SANC njengenesi ehloniphekile Primary Health Care. (9) Isikhathi esinganani phantsi kwamathanga alandelayo General Nursing and Midwifery kwindawo Professional Nurse ku-SANC General Nursing and Midwifery, lapho (5) kuya kuba yisikhathi esinganani (1) SANC receipt. I-'driver's license'. Izindaba eziqondiswayo zocingo zolwazi olucutshungiweyo: HIV and AIDS Training. Community Nursing Community. Ulwazi Iminikelo yezidingo: Ulwazi nokuqonda ezokusikeka kuncedo kwezokuqonda zolwazi. Ulwazi ngokuqondisa nokusebenza ezinye izindlu. Iminikelo yamaphupha. Ulwazi lokuthuthukisa kwamaphupha. Ulwazi lokwenza izincwadi ezenziweyo. Iminikelo yezinto ezahlukeneyo zokusebenza. Iminikelo yocingo. Ulwazi lokusika izinsiza nokuqonda ukunakekelwa kwendalo. Iminikelo yokusebenza kwezinye izikhondlo.
zu.duties: Nika ukuphatha okusebenzayo nokuhamba komsebenzi wezokusiza kwezokunakekelwa kwesikhungo. Hlela ukusetshenziswa kwemithetho yamaphrofayili. Hlela ukusetshenziswa kokunakekelwa kwezokusiza kwesikhungo. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwezomthetho nokuhleleka kwemithetho yamaphrofayili. Phatha futhi uhlele ukusetshenziswa kwezindawo eziyizidingo zokwenza ukuthuthukiswa kokunakekelwa. Lawula izinkinga ezisetshenziswa ngokusebenzisa izindlela ezihleliweyo zokusebenza. Iminikelo yokunakekela amaphoyisa ngokuhlela ukusiza kokubhaliswa kwemithetho. Hlela nokubhala imithetho, izinhloso ze-clinic kanye namaphuzu. Hlela nokusebenzisa i-EPMDS. Siza abafundi ekwenzeni ukunakekelwa, nokukhonza uhlelo lokunakekelwa kwamaphuzu kanye nemithetho. Qinisekisa ukubhalwa okuhlelele kahle. Hlela izibalo zenyanga.

xh.title: Umlawuli Wezophando Wokusebenza (PHC)
xh.summary: Isithuba somlawuli wezophando wokusebenza eVryheid District Hospital sifuna isidanga okanye idiploma kulonzululwazi lokusika nezokuvelisa, elineminyaka elithoba yamava emva kokuqwalaselwa yiSANC.
xh.requirements: Isidanga / Idiploma kulonzululwazi lokusika nokubeletha. Isifundo esinye sasese after basic kulunyundo lwePrimary Health Care. Ukuqwalaselwa kwiSANC njengomongikazi wechiza nombelethisi. Okungenani iminyaka elithoba (9) yamava anawo oqatshelwayo kulonzululwazi lokusika emva kokuqwalaselwa njengomongikazi wechiza eSANC kulonzululwazi lokusika nokubeletha, apho iminyaka emihlanu (5) kumele ibe ngamava aqatshelwayo emva kokufumana isifundo esinye (1) sasese after basic kulunyundo lwePrimary Health Care. Isifungo sezimali zeSANC sangoku. Ilayisenisi yokushayela esebenzayo. Iingcebiso: Uqeqesho ngeHIV nosizi. Ulonzululwazi lokusika loluntu. Ulwazi, amakhono, uqeqesho & Amandla afunekayo: Ulwazi nokuqonda inqanaba lendlela nemigaqo yokusika. Ulwazi ngemithetho yokusika neminye iMithetho yoLuntu ephathelene nayo. Amandla okwenza izigqibo nokuxazula iingxaki. Amakhono onkele nabanye ekuphatheni iingxabano. Ulwazi nokusebenzisa iinkqubo zeBatho Pele. Amakhono okulawula nokuhlalutya. Ukumelana nengcinezelo, ukuguquguquka, unxibelelwano oluhle nokuqonda izembo zomntu. Amakhono okulawula iingozi. Amakhono okwakha iqela nokulawula.
xh.duties: Nika ulawulo olusebenzayo nobugcisa obuchatheleyo bokuba iziko lihlelwe kwaye linoogqirha abachatheleyo. Qhoboshisa ukunikela konke kunyango olungaganga kwelona hlabathi. Nika ulawulo olusebenzayo labasebenzi kwindawo yokusika. Qinisekisa ukusebenziswa kwemigaqo, iinkqubo neendlela zokwenza izinto kulonzululwazi. Lawula kwaye ukhokele ekusetyenzisweni okusebenzayo kwemithombo ukuphucula ukunikela inkonzo. Lawula isithintelo, iingxaki kunye nayo naluphi na usetyenziso olusemantla wombombo ngokweendlela ezishihiweyo. Gcina ukwaneliseka kumthengi ngokulawula nokumisa imilinganiselo yenkonzo. Sebenzisa kwaye ulawule iNorms and Standards, iindlela eziphambili zeIdeal clinic neendlela zokuthenga. Ukulawula nokusebenzisa iEPMDS. Mela ngokomthengi ukukhokelela kulonyango olufanelekileyo nokuqwalasela iLungelo loMthengi kwazulu ngeBatho Pele. Qinisekisa ukugcina iirekhodi ezichanekileyo. Hlazi idatha yesebe nyanga nganye.

jobs.title: Clinical Lecterer
jobs.summary: Clinical lecturer to provide clinical training and assessment of nurse learners at Addington Campus in KwaZulu-Natal.
jobs.requirements: Senior Certificate/Grade 12. A Diploma / Degree in Nursing: General, Midwifery / Psychiatric and Community Health and Nursing Education. Post Basic qualification in Nursing Education registered with SANC. Grade 1: A minimum of four (4) years appropriate / recognizable experience after registration as a Professional Nurse with the South African Nursing Council. Grade 2: A minimum of fourteen (14) years appropriate/ recognizable experience after registration as a Professional Nurse with the South African Nursing Council of which 10 years of the period must be in Clinical Nursing and/ or Nursing Education after obtaining the 1 year post qualification. Applicants must submit a fully completed Z83 form and a detailed CV only, all other documents including any proof is submitted by shortlisted candidates. In possession of an unendorsed valid RSA Drivers licence (EB). Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competence Required: Possess knowledge of relevant Legislation, Acts, Prescripts and Policy frameworks informing the area of operation. Have in- depth knowledge of procedures and processes related to nursing and nursing education. Possess sound knowledge and understanding of nursing code of ethics and professional practice. Possess in-depth knowledge of teaching and clinical approaches. Have good research and analytical skills. Competence in conflict management and problem-solving skills. Possess good communication and interpersonal skills. Willingness to travel.
jobs.duties: Provide effective and efficient clinical training of nurse learners. Develop/design, review and evaluate clinical evaluation tools. Coordinate clinical learning exposure of nurse learners between the Campus and the clinical area. Implement assessment strategies to determine nurse learner’s competencies. Exercise control over nurse leaners and maintain accurate records. Implement the quality management system for the Nursing Education Institution.
jobs.applications: All applications to be handed delivered or email to Mthobeni.Ndlovu@kznhealth.gov.za Addington Campus, 16 Erskine Terrace, South Beach, Durban, 4001. FOR ATTENTION : Mr. M Ndlovu (Academic Registrar)
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on the prescribed Application for Employment form (Z83) which must be originally signed and dated. The application form (Z83) must be accompanied by a detailed Curriculum Vitae. Applications are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application. Certified copies of qualifications, proof of registration and other relevant documents will be requested from shortlisted candidates only which may be submitted to HR on or before the day of the interview. The Reference Number must be indicated in the column (Part A) provided thereof on the Z83 form. NB: Failure to comply with the above instructions will disqualify applicants. Faxed applications will not be accepted. The appointments are subject to positive outcomes obtained from the State Security Agency (SSA) to the following checks (security clearance (vetting), criminal clearance, credit records, and citizenship), verification of Educational Qualifications by SAQA, verification of previous experience from Employers and verification from the Company Intellectual Property Commission (CIPC). Applicants are respectfully informed that, if no notification of appointment is received within 3 months after the closing date, they must accept that their applications were unsuccessful. Please note that due to the large financial constraints no S &T and settlement claims will be considered for payment to candidates that are invited for the interview. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment.

af.title: Kliniese dosent
af.summary: Kliniese dosent om kliniese opleiding en assessering van verpleegleerlinge by Addington-kampus in KwaZulu-Natal te bied.
af.requirements: Senior Certificate/Grade 12. 'n Diploma / Graad in Verpleegkunde: Algemeen, Vroedkuns / Psigiatriese en Gemeenskapsgesondheid en Verpleegkunde-onderrig. Post Basiese kwalifikasie in Verpleegkunde-onderrig geregistreer by SANC. Graad 1: 'n Minimum van vier (4) jaar gepaste / herkenbare ervaring na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by die South African Nursing Council. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van veertien (14) jaar gepaste / herkenbare ervaring na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by die South African Nursing Council waarvan 10 jaar van die tydperk in Kliniese Verpleegkunde en/of Verpleegkunde-onderrig moet wees na verkryging van die 1 jaar post-kwalifikasie. Aansoekers moet slegs 'n ten volle voltooide Z83-vorm en 'n gedetailleerde CV indien, alle ander dokumente insluitend enige bewys word deur gekortlysde kandidate ingedien. In besit van 'n ongekende geldige RSA-bestuurslisensie (EB). Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdheid Vereis: Besit kennis van tersaaklike Wetgewing, Wette, Voorskrifte en Beleidsraamwerke wat die operasionele gebied rig. Het diep kennis van prosedures en prosesse wat met verpleegkunde en verpleegkunde-onderrig verband hou. Besit deeglike kennis en begrip van die verpleegkunde-kode van etiek en professionele praktyk. Besit diepgaande kennis van onderrig- en kliniese benaderings. Het goeie navorsings- en analitiese vaardighede. Bevoegdheid in konflikbestuur en probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Besit goeie kommunikasie- en interpersoonlike vaardighede. Bereidwilligheid om te reis.
af.duties: Bied effektiewe en doeltreffende kliniese opleiding van verpleegleerlinge. Ontwerp/ontwikkel, hersien en evalueer kliniese evalueringsinstrumente. Koördineer kliniese leerblootstelling van verpleegleerlinge tussen die kampus en die kliniese area. Implementeer assesseringsstrategieë om verpleegleerlinge se bevoegdhede te bepaal. Oefen beheer uit oor verpleegleerlinge en hou akkurate rekords. Implementeer die gehaltebestuurstelsel vir die Verpleegkunde-onderwysinstelling.

zu.title: Umhlengikazi wezifundo zokwelapha
zu.summary: Umhlengikazi wezifundo zokwelapha ozoletha ukuqeqesha nokuhlola izifundo zobuhlengikazi eNyuvesi yase-Addington Campus e-KwaZulu-Natal.
zu.requirements: I-Senior Certificate/Grade 12. I-Diploma / i-Degree kwi-Nursing: General, Midwifery / Psychiatric kanye ne-Community Health kanye ne-Nursing Education. Isifundo se-Post Basic kwi-Nursing Education esibhalisiwe ku-SANC. I-Grade 1: Okungenani eminyaka emine (4) yohlelo olufanele / oluvelele emva kokubhalisa njengo-Professional Nurse ku-South African Nursing Council. I-Grade 2: Okungenazi eminyaka eyishisnamakhulu nane (14) yohlelo olufanele/ oluvelele emva kokubhalisa njengo-Professional Nurse ku-South African Nursing Council okuyingxenye yalo kumele iminyaka eyi-10 ibe kwi-Clinical Nursing futhi/noma i-Nursing Education emva kokuqeda unyaka o-1 we-post qualification. Abafaki izicelo kumele banikeze ifomu le-Z83 eligcwele ne-CV enemininingwane kuphela, wonke eminye imibhalo ehlanganisa noma iphi isiboniso inikwa abaphume ezinhlokweni ezimfushane. Kumele abe nelayisensi evumelekileyo e-RSA (EB) engagqokwa ngalutho. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Ukuqeqesha nama-Khono afunekayo: Kumele abe nolwazi ngezixuku eziphathelene, ama-Act, izibhalo kanye nezimiso ezibeka indlela yokusebenza. Kumele abe nolwazi olujulile ngokuquka emikhakheni namaphasiya ephathelene nobuhlengikazi kanye nokuqeqesha kobuhlengikazi. Kumele abe nolwazi oluhle nokuqonda ikhodi yamasiko okuziphatha kobuhlengikazi kanye nokusebenza ngobunjingalwazi. Kumele abe nolwazi olujulile ngendlela yokufundisa nokwelapha. Kumele abe namakhono okuhlola umbhalo kahle. Amakhono okuphatha ingxabano kanye nokuxazulula izinkinga. Kumele abe namakhono okuxhumana nabantu ngokuhle. Kube nesizinda sokuhamba.
zu.duties: Nikela ngesifundo esiphumelelayo nesisebenzayo sokwelapha izifundo zobuhlengikazi. Bumbe/hlela, hlola bese ucacisa amathuluzi okuhlola ukwelapha. Hlela ukufuduka ngokuzulwa izifundo zobuhlengikazi phakathi kwe-Campus nendawo yokwelapha. Sebenzisa izindlela zokuqhathanisa ukuze ucacise ukuthi izifundo zobuhlengikazi zikwazi ukwenza noma imiphi imisebenzi. Lawula izifundo zobuhlengikazi ugcine ukubhalwa okuchanekileyo. Sebenzisa isimiso sokuphathwa kwemigomo yobuningi emkhakheni we-Nursing Education Institution.

xh.title: Um fundisi we-Clinical
xh.summary: Um fundisi we-clinical onikeze uqeqesho kunye nokuqikelela kwabafundi bezolunyukela kwiziko le-Addington e-KwaZulu-Natal.
xh.requirements: I-Senior Certificate/Grade 12. Idiploma / I-degree kwi-Nursing: General, Midwifery / Psychiatric kunye ne-Community Health kunye ne-Nursing Education. I-Post Basic qualification kwi-Nursing Education ebhalisiwe kwi-SANC. I-Grade 1: Amalunga amane (4) obuncinane obugqibeleleyo / obuchazwekomvokuhle langa emva kokuqesha njengomsebenzisi we-Professional Nurse kunye ne-South African Nursing Council. I-Grade 2: Amalunga ali-14 (14) obuncinane obugqibeleloyo / obuchazwekomvokuhle langa emva kokuqesha njengomsebenzisi we-Professional Nurse kunye ne-South African Nursing Council kulapho iminyaka el-10 kule minyaka kufuneka ibengona kwi-Clinical Nursing kwaye / okanye kwi-Nursing Education emva kokuqeshwa kwi-1 year post qualification. Abaqeqeshi kufuneka banikeze ifomu ze-Z83 ezigqibeleleyo kunye ne-detailed CV kuphela, zonke ezinye iinxatso ziqhuthwa ngabaqeqeshi ababekwe kuluhlu. Analo ilayisenisi ye-RSA Drivers (EB) efanelekileyo ezingatshintshiwe. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Uqeqesho kunye nokuziphilisa a-Funekayo: Anel ulwazi ngemithetho, i-Acts, i-Prescripts kunye namapolicies anamagama abaliyo olusebenza kuso. Anel ulwazi olujulileyo ngeenkqubo ezidityaniswa nezolunyukela kunye nokuqeqesha kwazolunyukela. Anel ulwazi olucacileyo nokuqonda ikhowudi ye-ethics yezolunyukela kunye nenkqubo yabasebenzi. Anel ulwazi olujulileyo ngezindlela zokufundisa kunye ne-clinical. Anel amakhono amalungileyo ephando nokuqhubi imibuzo. Akho nzima ekulawuleni iingxabano kunye namakhono omba izisombululo. Anel amakhono amalungileyo ekuthetha kunye nokuhlangana nabantu. Kulungele ukuhamba.
xh.duties: Nika abafundi bezolunyukela uqeqesho olusebenzayo nolusemzantsi. Phekisa / blayiza, jonga kwakhona yaye uqikelele izixhobo zokuqikelela i-clinical. Linganisa ukubakho kokufunda ngokusebenzisa abafundi bezolunyukela phakathi kwe-Campus yaye ndawonye ne-clinical. Sebenzisa iindlela zokuqikelela ukumisela amandla abafundi bezolunyukela. Lawula abafundi bezolunyukela yaye gcina irekhodi ecacileyo. Sebenzisa inkqubo yolawulo lemfihlo kwiziko le-Nursing Education Institution.

jobs.title: Lecturer (GRADE 1, Grade 2) Clinical Facilitator
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R495 423 per annum Grade 2: R607 350 per annum plus 13th cheque, medical-aid (optional) homeowners allowance (employee must meet the prescribed requirements)
jobs.summary: Lecturer and Clinical Facilitator position at Grey's Hospital in Pietermaritzburg requiring nursing qualifications and SANC registration to train student nurses.
jobs.requirements: Senior Certificate/Grade 12 Plus A Diploma/Degree in Nursing and Midwifery Plus A post registration qualification in Nursing Education registered with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) Plus Current Registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) 2026 Plus A minimum of four (4) years appropriate/ recognizable experience after registration as a Professional Nurse with the South African Nursing Council in General Nursing (in the case of grade 1 PND 1) or A minimum of fourteen (14) years appropriate/recognizable experience after registration as a Professional Nurse with the South African Nursing Council in General Nursing of which ten (10) years of the period referred to above must be appropriate / recognizable experience in Nursing Education after obtaining the 1 year post-basic qualification (in the case of grade 2 PND 2) NB (Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit proof of all documents and certificate of Service endorsed by Human Resources) Additional Qualifications: Master’s degree in Nursing Postgraduate Nursing qualification Knowledge, Skills and Experience: Possess knowledge of relevant Legislation, Acts, Prescripts and Policy frameworks informing the area of operation. Have in-depth knowledge of procedures and process related to nursing practice and nursing education. Knowledge of nursing education programmes and curriculum Possess sound knowledge and understanding of nursing code of ethics and professional practice. Possess in depth knowledge of teaching and clinical approaches. Have good research and analytical skills. Competence in conflict management. Possess good communication and interpersonal skills. Willingness to travel. Computer Literacy.
jobs.duties: Provide an effective and efficient clinical training of student nurses in both undergraduate and postgraduate nursing programmes Develop/design, review and evaluate clinical evaluation tools. Co-ordinate clinical learning exposure of student nurses between the Campus and Clinical areas. Implement assessment strategies to determine student nurses’ competencies. Exercise control over student nurses Implement the quality management system for Nursing Education Institution. Participate in the provisioning of Continuous Professional Development (CPD) activities at the Campus. Participate in all governance structures of the College. Support the mission and promote the image of the college.
jobs.enquiries: Mrs. B.E Shezi- Grey’s Campus Principal Tel No: (033) 897 3508

Ukuba nolwazi oluqinileyo nokuqonda ngokuziphatha kwesoNursing nolwazi ngomthetho wokusetyenziswa kolwazi nokuqonda iNursing Standard of Practice ne-Scope of Practice. Ukuba nolwazi oluqinileyo nokuqonda iNursing Standard of Practice ne-Scope of Practice. Ukuba nolwazi ngokwakhiwa nokuhlaziywa kwemfundo. Ulwazi ngeendlela nokuqhubwa kweenkqubo ezinxulumene nokuququumbela kwi-Post Graduate Diploma kwi-Critical Care Nursing Science. Ukuba nolwazi lokufundisa nokuhlola ukungqina kwe-Nursing Education. Ukuba nolwazi oluqinileyo lokuqamba iindwendwe, ukuqamba iindwendwe, nokuhamba kwesikolo sikafundi be-Critical Care nursing. Ukuba nolwazi oluqinileyo ngokulwa nengxaki nokuqamba iindwendwe/ukuzalisa iingxaki. Ukuba namava okuzoba ukuphandi nokuyahlaziya. Ukuba nakhono okumangalisayo lokuqamba nokubonisa (ekubeni nokuqamba nokuqamba). Ukusebenzisa iKhompyutha ngokuzinika ikhono kwiprogram ye-MS Office, i-Excel, i-Power Point ne-Outlook. Ukuba nobudlelwane obuhle nabantu. Ukuba nakhono lokusebenza kwisikhathi esibekiweyo. Ukuba nolwazi lokufundisa nokuhlola i-Post Graduate Diploma kwi-Adult Critical Care ngeendlela zokuqwalasela. Ukuba nakhono lokuthetha (ekubeni nokubhala nokuqamba) nokuqamba.

Sekela iNjongo yokuNika nokuQinisa isithombe seKhosi. Qeqesha abafundi ngemisebenzi yokusebenza ukuze bakwazi ukuqwalasela iNqanaba labaFundi beNursing Lawula abafundi beNursing Thatha inxaxheba kwiinkqubo zokuQinisekisa iNqanaba Thatha inxaxheba kukuQwalasela, ukuQamba nokuQaliswa kweNkqubo. zu.title: Onjiniyela
zu.summary: Isikhundla sokuba ngionjiniyela e-Addington Campus e-KwaZulu-Natal esidinga izifundo zokuhlinzeka, ukubhaliswa ku-SANC nonyaka ungemuva wokuhlinzeka.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 (Senior Certificate) Plus. Degree/ diploma in General Nursing, Midwifery, Psychiatric Nursing, Community Health and Nursing Education Plus. Current Registration with South African Nursing Council for the year 2026 Plus. Okungenani iminyaka emine (4) (PN-D1) yokuhlinzeka okuhambelana/kungahamba nakho emva kokubhaliswa njengonongazi ohlinzayo ku-South African Nursing Council kwi-General Nursing. Okungenani iminyaka eyishumi nane (14) (PN-D2) yokuhlinzeka okuhambelana / kungahamba nakho emva kokubhaliswa njengonongazi ohlinzayo ku-South African Nursing Council lapho kwadinga ukuthi iminyaka eyi-10 kule minyaka kumele ibe yiso esihamba kalula sokuhlinzeka e-Nursing Education Institution emva kokuthola inyanga engu-1 ngemuva kokuthola izifundo e-Nursing Education. Kumele ube nephasipoti esevumelekile, engagqanyisiwe i-RSA Drivers Licence (Code EB). Ulwazi, Amakhono, Ukuqeqeshwa nekhono elidingekayo: Kumele ube nolwazi ngemithetho ephathelene nendawo, ama-Acts, amaphasiphothe kanye namapholisi. ahola kule ndawo. Kumele ube nolwazi olujulile ngemikhuba kanye nezinqubo ezihambelana nokuhlinzeka nokuqeqesha ngesiNursing. Kumele ube nolwazi oluhle kakuqonda ikhodi yokuziphatha kwezokuhlinzeka kanye nokwenza umsebenzi ngobungcweti. Kumele ube nolwazi olujulile ngezindlela zokufundisa nokuhlinzela kwi-General Nursing/ Midwifery. Kumele ube namakhono okuhlola futhi uhlaziye ulwazi. Kumele ukwazi ukuphatha izinkinga nokuxazulula izinkinga. Kumele ube namakhono okuxhumana kahle nabantu. Kumele ube ulungele ukuhamba.
zu.duties: Kumele ufake ulwazi kubafundi abafunda ukuba onongazi ohlinzayo. Kumele uhlolele iziqu zabo zokuhlinzela emhlabeni jikelele phakathi kwesikole nezindawo zokuhlinzela. Kumele usekele inhloso kanye nesithombe sesikole. Kumele uzenze izinkambu zokuqinisekisa ikhono labafundi bezokuhlinzeka. Kumele ube ngumphathi wabafundi bezokuhlinzeka. Kumele wenze isistimu yokuphatha izinga le-Nursing Education Institution.

xh.requirements: Isigaba se-12 (I-Certificate yesiniya) ngaphezulu. I-Degree/ diploma kwi-Nursing yeJikelele, i-Midwifery, i-Psychiatric Nursing, i-Community Health kunye ne-Nursing Education ngaphezulu. Amava afanelekayo/ aqondakalayo angaphantsi kweminyaka emi-4 (4) (PN-D1) emva kokubhaliswa njengogqirha we-Nursing ochlekileyo kunye ne-South African Nursing Council kwi-Nursing yeJikelele. Amava afanelekayo/ aqondakalayo angaphantsi kweminyaka eli-14 (14) (PN-D2) emva kokubhaliswa njengogqirha we-Nursing ochlekileyo kunye ne-South African Nursing Council apho iminyaka eli-10 kule mva kufuneka ibe ngamava afanelekayo aqondakalayo kwi-Nursing Education Institution emva kokufumana isigqibo seminyaka eli-1 ekuphela kokuqonda i-Nursing Education. Ulwazi, amakhono, uqeqesho kunye namandla afunekayo: Kufuneka ubenolwazi ngemithetho, i-Acts, i-Prescripts kunye namapholisi ohlobo oluthile. Olumela indawo yokuqhuba. Kufuneka ube nolwazi oluqinileyo. ngemigaqo kunye neenkqubo ezinxulumene nokunyunga nokufundisa ukunyunga. Kufuneka ube nolwazi oluqinileyo nokugonda ikhowudi yokuziphatha kokunyunga nokwenza umsebenzi ochumileyo. Kufuneka ube nolwazi oluqinileyo ngezicwangciso zokufundisa nokunyunga kwi-Nursing yeJikelele/ i-Midwifery. Kufuneka ube namakhono amabalisa ekuphanda kunye nokuqwalasela. Ukuzinza ekuphathweni kweengxaki kunye namakhono oxazululo lweengxaki. Kufuneka ube namakhono amabalisa ekunxibelelwana nabantu. Ukuzimisela ukuhamba.
xh.duties: Yikho ukufundisa nokuyiqeqesha umfundi we-Nursing. Qhoboshela ukuboniswa kokufunda ngokunyunga koququ abafundi phakathi kweKholeji kunye namakhaphondo anyukela kuko. Xhasa umnqobo wayo ukuba ifikelele kwindima yayo nokuphakamisa isithethe seKholeji. Misa amazizo azovakalisa isikhundla sabafundi bokunyunga. Lawula abafundi bezifo zokunyunga. Yenza ukusebenza kweNkqubo yokuqwalasela ithempile kwi-Nursing Education Institution.

jobs.title: Profesional Nurse Specialty (ADVANCED Midwifery)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R495 423 - R571 161 per annum Grade 2: R607 350 - R741 783 per annum Other Benefits: Medical Aid – Optional, Housing Allowance - Employee must meet prescribed requirements, 13th Cheque and 12% rural allowance.
jobs.summary: Professional nurse specialising in advanced midwifery sought for Vryheid District Hospital to provide comprehensive maternal and neonatal care.
jobs.requirements: Diploma / B Degree in nursing or equivalent qualification that allows registration with the SANC as a Professional Nurse with Midwifery. Relevant post basic qualification (Diploma in Advanced Midwifery and Neonatal Nursing Science). Registration with SANC as Professional Nurse (General) and Advanced Midwifery. Current SANC receipt. Grade 1: A minimum of 04 years appropriate /recognizable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with SANC in general nursing. Grade 2: A minimum of 14 years appropriate /recognizable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with SANC in general nursing. At least 10 years of the period referred above must be appropriate/recognizable experience in specific speciality after obtaining the 1 year post basic qualification in the relevant speciality. Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competences Required: Knowledge of nursing care processes and procedures, nursing statutes, and other relevant legal frameworks. Good communication skills. Report writing skills. Facilitation skills. Coordination skills. Liaison skills. Networking skills. Problem solving skills. Information Management. Knowledge Management. Planning and organizing. Computer Literacy.
jobs.duties: Provide comprehensive antenatal, intrapartum and postnatal care including normal deliveries and management of obstetric emergencies. Conduct risk assessments, early detection and management of complications in pregnancy, labour and puerperium. Perform newborn resuscitation, essential newborn care and Kangaroo Mother Care. Implement and monitor Maternal, Child and Women’s Health programmes in line with provincial and national guidelines. Ensure safe, quality maternity services to support reduction of maternal and neonatal mortality. Provide PHC services: HIV testing, initiation, retention to care, VL monitoring and suppression as per Siyeza and Operation Phuthuma requirements. Manage TB, STI, NCD, Family Planning and EPI programmes. Triage patients, diagnose, treat and refer in accordance with scope of practice and clinical protocols. Trace defaulters, missed appointments and loss to follow-up TROA. Monitor and reduce PSIs, complaints and waiting times. Ensure compliance with Ideal Clinic standards and infection prevention/control. Participate in audits, data validation and reporting for MCWH and HIV/TB indicators. Promote patient-centered care and professionalism. Maintain accurate clinical records, registers and statistics. Supervise and mentor PN, EN, ENA and CHWs on duty. Ensure cost-effective use of maternity equipment, drugs and stock. Report losses/damages. Participate in the 24/7 shift to ensure continuity of care in a busy township facility. Adhere to SANC regulations and Public Service Code of Conduct. Contribute to reducing risks. Provide health education to patients and community on maternal health, HIV/TB prevention.
