af.title: Professionele Verpleegkundige Spesialiteit (Gevorderde Vroedvrouenskap)
af.summary: Professionele verpleegkundige wat spesialiseer in gevorderde vroedvrouenskap word gesoek vir Vryheid Distrikshospitaal om omvattende moeder- en pasgebore sorg te verskaf.
af.requirements: Diploma / B-graad in verpleegkunde of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige met Vroedvrouenskap toelaat. Relevante postbasiese kwalifikasie (Diploma in Gevorderde Vroedvrouenskap en Pasgebore Verpleegkunde-wetenskap). Registrasie by SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige (Algemeen) en Gevorderde Vroedvrouenskap. Huidige SANC-kwitansie. Graad 1: 'n Minimum van 04 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by SANC in algemene verpleegkunde. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 14 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by SANC in algemene verpleegkunde. Ten minste 10 jaar van bogenoemde periode moet toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in die spesifieke spesialiteit wees na verkryging van die 1-jaar postbasiese kwalifikasie in die relevante spesialiteit. Vereiste kennis, vaardighede, opleiding en bevoegdhede: Kennis van verpleegsorgprosesse en -prosedures, verpleegstatute en ander relevante regskaders. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede. Verslagdoeningsvaardighede. Fasiliteringsvaardighede. Koördineringsvaardighede. Skakelvaardighede. Netwerkvaardighede. Probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Inligtingsbestuur. Kennisbestuur. Beplanning en organisering. Rekenaargeletterdheid.
af.duties: Verskaf omvattende voorgeboortelike, intrapartum en nageboortelike sorg, insluitend normale bevallings en die bestuur van verloskundige noodgevalle. Voer risiko-assesserings, vroeë opsporing en bestuur van komplikasies tydens swangerskap, kraam en puerperium uit. Voer pasgebore suiwering, noodsaaklike pasgebore sorg en Kangaroo Mother Care uit. Implementeer en monitor Moeder-, Kind- en Vroue-gesondheidsprogramme in ooreenstemming met provinsiale en nasionale riglyne. Verseker veilige, gehalte-verloskundige dienste om die vermindering van moeder- en pasgebore sterftesyfers te ondersteun. Verskaf PHC-dienste: MIV-toetsing, inisiasie, behoud in sorg, VL-monitering en -onderdrukking volgens Siyeza en Operation Phuthuma-vereistes. Bestuur TB-, STI-, NCD-, Gesinsbeplanning- en EPI-programme. Triageer pasiënte, diagnoseer, behandel en verwys in ooreenstemming met die omvang van praktyk en kliniese protokolle. Spoor standaardtrekkers, gemiste afsprake en verlies-vir-opvolg TROA op. Monitor en verminder PSI's, klagtes en wagtye. Verseker voldoening aan Ideal Clinic-standaarde en infeksievoorkoming/-beheer. Neem deel aan oudits, datavalidering en verslagdoening vir MCWH- en MIV/TB-aanwysers. Bevorder pasiëntgesentreerde sorg en professionele gedrag. Handhaaf akkurate kliniese rekords, registers en statistieke. Superveer en mentor PN, EN, ENA en CHW's op diens. Verseker koste-effektiewe gebruik van verloskundige toerusting, medisyne en voorraad. Rapporteer verliese/skade. Neem deel aan die 24/7-skof om kontinuïteit van sorg in 'n besige township-fasiliteit te verseker. Hou by SANC-regulasies en die Openbare Dienskode van Gedrag. Dra by tot die vermindering van risiko's. Verskaf gesondheidsvoorligting aan pasiënte en die gemeenskap oor moedersgesondheid, MIV/TB-voorkoming.

zu.title: Isibhedlela esigatsheni lesikhundla se-Professional Nurse Specialty (ADVANCED Midwifery)
zu.summary: Isibhedlela i-Professional Nurse esisezingeni eliphezulu lemidwifery sifunwa kwa-Vryheid District Hospital ukunikeza ukunakekelwa okuphelele kwezabazala kanye namasongo amasha.
zu.requirements: I-Diploma / I-Degree ye-B ezokwelapha noma iziqu ezingevumelanayo. Ukuze ukwazi ukubhalisa esikhungweni se-SANC njengesibhedlela somsebenzi we-Professional Nurse nge-Midwifery. Ukuthola iziqu ezifanele (I-Diploma Advanced Midwifery and Neonatal Nursing Science). Ukubhalisa kwi-SANC njengesiNgibiwe (Professional Nurse) (General) kanye ne-Advanced Midwifery. Isitifiketi sesikhathi esiseduze se-SANC. I-Grade 1: okungenani eminyakeni eyi-04 ukuthola okuhambelana/nokwaziwa ngokuzipha imisebenzi yezokwelapha emva kokubhalisa njengesibhedlela i-Professional Nurse ne-SANC ekunakekelweni komuntu ngamunye. I-Grade 2: okungenani eminyakeni eyi-14 ukuthola okuhambelana/nokwaziwa ngokuzipha imisebenzi yezokwelapha emva kokubhalisa njengesibhedlela i-Professional Nurse ne-SANC ekunakekelweni komuntu ngamunye. Kungenani iminyaka eyi-10 yaleso sikhathi esivezwe ngenhla kumele kube ngokuhambelana/nokwaziwa ngokuzipha imisebenzi kuleyo nkolo ethile emva kokuthola iziqu eziyisikhathi esingu-1 zokuzenzakela emva kwesisekelo kuleyo nkolo ethize. Ukwazwa, izikhombi, ukuqeqeswa namandla okulingene okudingekayo: Ukukwazi izinhlelo kanye namaphrotokholi okunakekelwa ezokwelapha, imithethonqondo yokugwemukela kanye namanye amakhadi omtsetho. Ukukhuluma kahle. Izikhombi zokubika. Izikhombi zokwezisa. Izikhombi zokuqondisa. Izikhombi zokuxhumanisa. Izikhombi zokusungula uxhumo. Izikhombi zokusungula ubudlelwano. Izikhombi zokusombulula izinkinga. Ukuphatha imininingwane. Ukuphatha ukwaziswa. Ukucubungula nokuquketha. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha.
zu.duties: Nikeza ukunakekelwa okuphelele kwangaphambi kokubeletha, ngesikhathi sokubeletha nangemva kokubeletha okuhlanganisa ukubeletha okujwayelekile kanye nokuphatha izimo eziphuthumayo zokubeletha. Yenza ukuhlola izingozi, ukutholwa kokuqala kanye nokuphatha izinkinga ezingase zibe khona ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa, ngesikhathi sokubeletha nangesikhathi sokuphola ngemva kokubeletha. Yenza ukuphilisa kabusha esigulini sesiguli esisha sokubeletha, ukunakekelwa okuyisisekelo kagesiguli esisha nesiqhingini sokubeka ingane esifubeni sikababe. Yize futhi ulawule imikhiqizo ye-Maternal, Child and Women’s Health ngokuhambisana nemithethonqondo yezifundazwe nezwe. Qinisekisa izinsiza zokubeletha eziphephile futhi ezinhle ukuze kuncishiswe ukufa kwabazala kanye namasongo amasha. Nikeza amasevisi we-PHC: ukuhlolwa kwe-HIV, ukuqalisa, ukuhlala kunakekelwa, ukulawula i-VL kanye nokuyinciphisa ngokuhambisana nezidingo ze-Siyeza kanye ne-Operation Phuthuma. Lawula imikhiqizo ye-TB, STI, NCD, Family Planning kanye ne-EPI. Hlukanisize abaguli ukuzohlinzeka ngokwesimo, yakha izifo, yaphula futhi uthumele kwezinye izibhedlela ngokuhambisana nemikhawulo yokwenza umsebenzi kanye namaphrotokholi ezokwelapha. Landa abayekileyo ukuthi bayeza, abaphuthelwe ithuba lokuzo esibhedlela kanye nalabo abalahlekile ngokwenza i-TROA. Londa futhi uncitshiswe amaphutha e-PSI, izikhalazo kanye nesikhathi sokuqalisa pha. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuhambisana namazinga e-Ideal Clinic kanye nokuvikela ukuqaliswa kwesifo. Thatha inxaxheba ukubuyekezwa, ukuqinisekiswa kwemininingwane nokubika ngemiqondiso ye-MCWH kanye ne-HIV/TB. Khuthaza ukunakekelwa okugqamisa isiguli kanye nobungcweti. Gcina amarekhodi ezokwelapha ohlwini lwemibhalo, okuyiqiniso, ukubhalisa nezibalo. Qapha futhi ulungise abahlolakazi be-PN, EN, ENA kanye nama-CHWs abakini. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okunenzuzo kwezibhalo zemali, amathuluzi nezinto ezingahle zisuswe esibhedlela zokusulela. Bika izinto ezengeziwe/ezonakele. Thatha inxaxhebe kwisikhathi sokuqalisa pha ukuyi kusenzo njalo ukuqinisekisa ukuqhubeka kokunakekelwa esikhungweni kwezokwakha kwezindawo zasemakhaya. Yifa ngemithethonqondo ye-SANC kanye namakhodi ezinsizakalo zomphakathi. Yila ekuncisheni izinsuku ezitholakala. Nikeza imfundo yezokunempilo kubaguli kanye nomphakathi ngempi esizayo, ngokuvikela i-HIV/TB.

xh.title: Umongikazi ophumeleleyo weNtofompi (Ukubeletha eNgangathwa)
xh.summary: Kufunekwa umongikazi ophumeleleyo obhaliswe ekubekeni abantu besifazana ezingangathwa ukunika inhlobo yonke yenkqubo yokunakekelwa kolunye noyosana kwiVryheid District Hospital.
xh.requirements: I-Diploma / i-B Degree ekunyusekelweni okanye isifanekiso esilinganayo esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-SANC njengomongikazi ophumeleleyo ongumbelethisi. Isifanekiso esifanelekileyo sokugqiba izifundo (i-Diploma ekubekeni abantu besifazana kangangamaxesha athile kwaye nezifundo zokunakekela iintsana). Ukubhalisela kwi-SANC njengomongikazi ophumeleleyo (Jikelele) nokubeletha kangangamaxesha athile. Iresiti yangoku ye-SANC. Inqanaba 1: Ubuncinane beminyaka elingama-04 yamava afanelekileyo / aqondakalayo ekunyusekelweni emva kokubhalisa njengomongikazi ophumeleleyo kwi-SANC ekunyusekelweni jikelele. Inqanaba 2: Ubuncinane beminyaka elingama-14 yamava afanelekileyo / aqondakalayo ekunyusekelweni emva kokubhalisa njengomongikazi ophumeleleyo kwi-SANC ekunyusekelweni jikelele. Okungenani iminyaka eli-10 yexesha elithintelwe ngasentla kufuneka kube ngamava afanelekileyo / aqondakalayo kwinto ecacisiweyo emva kokufumana isifanekiso sokugqiba izifudo seminyaka eli-1 kwinto efanayo. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Uqeqesho kunye Nokwaziswa Okufunekayo: Ulwazi ngenkqubo namacebo okunakekelwa kokunyuseka, izigaba ezimalunga nokunyuseka, nolunye ulwango olusesigxakeni ngokomthetho. Amakhono amahle ekunxibelelana. Amakhono okubhala iingxelo. Amakhono okukhuthaza. Amakhono olungelelwanisa. Amakhono okunxibelelana nabantu. Amakhono okwakha izihlobo. Amakhono oxazululo ziingxaki. Ulawulo lolwazi. Ulawulo nolwazi. Ucingo-lwazi nokuqamba. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha.
xh.duties: Unikezela ngenkqubo yonke yokunakekela ngaphambi kokubeletha, ngexesha lokubeletha kwaye emva kokubeletha kuquka nokubeletha ngokwemvelo kunye nokulawula iimeko eziphuthumayo zokubeletha. Yenza ukulinganiswa kokungapheli komda, ukugqaphela ngokuqengqeleka nogeniso ngexesha lokubeletha, kwaye elinye ixesha lokubeletha. Yenza ukuvusa ukuphila kolunye, iinkqubo ebalulekileyo zokunakekela iintsana kunye nokuqondisa unyoko nomntwana xa eleleEsifubeni. Zalisa kwaye ulandele iinkqubo ezingakliniki zemikhozo, abantwana kolunye nezesiFazana ngokwezikhokelo zesifundakunye nekarhulumente. Qinisekisa iinkonzo ezikhuselekileyo, ezilungele ukuyalela abantu ukuncitshiswa kwabafiweyo abasetyhini neentsana. Unikezela ngeenkconzo ze-PHC: ukuqonda i-HIV, ukuqalisa, ukugcina abantu abangenako ukuzikhangela ukuze banganyelwe, ukuqaphela i-VL kwaye ithintelwe njengoko kulindelekile kwinkqubo ye-Siyeza ne-Operation Phuthuma. Lawula iinkqubo ze-TB, i-STI, i-NCD, i-Family Planning ne-EPI. Hlukanisa abagulayo ngokohlobo lwesigulo, qamba ukuxilongo, funda ukwelapha kwaye uthumele kubasebenzi bangakliniki ngokommandla wokusebenza nemigaqo yokuqonda isigulo. Landela abantu abashiyekayo abangayekiyo, iiteshi ezingazange kuziwe kuzo kwaye abantu abalahlekayo ababuyi kwi-TROA. Landela, qaphela kwaye uncitshise i-PSI, iingxaki kunye nexesha elichithwa kulayini. Qinisekisa ukuzithoba ngokwezinga ze-Ideal Clinic nokuqhubeka kwezigulo kwindalo yobugqwetha / nokuqhuba. Thatha inxaxheba kwizihloko ezibalulwayo, ngokwenza idata ibe yinyaniso kwaye wenze iingxelo nge-MCWH kwaye nge-HIV/TB. Khuthaza ukunakekelwa okujolise kumguli kwaye ngokwemigaqo yesiphathwa. Gcina amagama abaguli, izibhalo ezingengeniswa kusapho nakwisibhalo sabaguli. Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa kwemiba ekulunge ukuba igqithiswe ngokwemali ekunokubakwa imiba efikelela kwinkqubo, amachiza kunye nalawo alungele ukubakwa eluntwini. ZiiNgxelo ngezinto ezilahlekileyo / ezonakalisiweyo. ZiiSebenza ngokutshintshiselana ngokweyure ngeyure ukuze kuqinisekiswa ukusuka kwindalo ebusywa ngumntu ongazange ahambe kwindalo ekhohlakeleyo yiNkqubo yokuqonda. Landela imigaqo ye-SANC nemiQango yoLuntu eLuntwini. Thatha inxaxheba ekunciphiseni iingozi. Unikezela ngolwazi ngeenkqubo zokukhulisa abantu abalimele nabakwichi mguli nabasebenzi ngeenkqubo zokuzivikela ekuwohlokeni kolunye nakuwohloke kwi-HIV/TB.

jobs.title: Professional Nurse (SPECIALTY) (THEATRE)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R495 423 – R581 931 per annum Grade 2: R607 350 – R752 913 per annum Plus 8% Inhospitable Allowance, 13th cheque, medical Aid (Optional) and housing allowance (employee must meet prescribed requirements)
jobs.summary: Professional nurse specialising in theatre required at Madadeni Provincial Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal to provide specialised nursing care and supervise junior staff.
jobs.requirements: Diploma / Degree in General Nursing. A post basic qualification in Operating Theatre Nursing Science. Registration with the SANC as a Professional Nurse. A minimum of 4 years appropriate or recognizable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competencies Required: Strong interpersonal, communication and presentation skills. Ability to make independent decisions. An understanding of the challenges facing the public health sector. Ability to prioritize issues and other work-related matters and to comply with time frames. High level of accuracy. Depth knowledge of Acts, Policies, Procedures, Prescripts and Legislations.
jobs.duties: Render an optimal holistic specialized nursing care to patients as member of the Multidisciplinary team. Train and supervise junior staff and student nurses Maintain accreditation standards by ensuring compliance with National Norma and Standards. Co-ordinate clinical activities of the unit. Participate in the formulation, analysis, implementation and monitoring of unit objectives, policies, and procedures. Participate in nursing audits and maintain accurate records. Display a concern for patients, promoting advocating, and facilitating proper treatment and care Ensure the unit complies with Infection Prevention and Control as well as Occupational Health and Safety policies. Strengthen ethics and professionalism. Provide safe and therapeutic environment for patients, staff and public. Maintain a constructive working relationship with nursing and other stakeholders. Participate in staff development using EPMDS System and other work-related programmes and training. Ensure that equipment and machinery is available and functional at all time. Attend to meetings, workshops and training programs as assigned by the supervisor. ENQURIES : Ms R. M Sithole Tel No: (034) 328 8137

af.title: Professionele Verpleegkundige (SPESIALITEIT) (TEATER)
af.summary: Professionele verpleegkundige wat in teater spesialiseer, word benodig by Madadeni Provincial Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal om gespesialiseerde verpleegsorg te verskaf en junior personeel te toesig te hou.
af.requirements: Diploma / Graad in Algemene Verpleegkunde. 'n Nagraadse kwalifikasie in Operating Theatre Nursing Science. Registrasie by die SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige. 'n Minimum van 4 jaar toepaslike of herkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdhede Vereis: Sterk interpersoonlike, kommunikasie en aanbiedingsvaardighede. Vermoeë om onafhanklike besluite te neem. 'n Begrip van die uitdagings wat die openbare gesondheidssektor in die gesig staar. Vermoeë om kwessies en ander werkverwante aangeleenthede te prioriteer en om tydraamwerke na te kom. Hoë vlak van akkuraatheid. Diepgaande kennis van Wette, Beleide, Prosedures, Skrifte en Wetgewing.
af.duties: Lewer optimale holistiese gespesialiseerde verpleegsorg aan pasiënte as lid van die Multidissiplinêre span. Lei en hou toesig oor junior personeel en studenteverpleegkundiges Handhaaf akkreditasiestandaarde deur te verseker dat daar aan Nasionale Norma en Standaarde voldoen word. Koördineer kliniese aktiwiteite van die eenheid. Neem deel aan die formulering, analise, implementering en monitering van eenheidsdoelwitte, beleide en prosedures. Neem deel aan verpleegoudits en hou akkurate rekords na. Toon besorgdheid oor pasiënte, bevorder pleitbesorg en fasiliteer behoorlike behandeling en sorg Verseker dat die eenheid voldoen aan Infeksievoorkoming en -beheer sowel as Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheidsbeleid. Versterk etiek en professionaliteit. Verskaf 'n veilige en terapeutiese omgewing vir pasiënte, personeel en die publiek. Handhaaf 'n konstruktiewe werksverhouding met verpleegkunde en ander belanghebbendes. Neem deel aan personeelsonwikkeling deur gebruik van die EPMDS-stelsel en ander werkverwante programme en opleiding. Verseker dat toerusting en masjinerie te alle tye beskikbaar en funksioneel is. Woon vergaderings, werkswinkels en opleidingsprogramme by soos deur die toesighouer toegewys. NAVRAE : Mev. R. M Sithole Tel No: (034) 328 8137

zu.title: Umongikazi Ohlolwayo (ISEKHUNDLA ESIKHETHIWE) (ISILILI)
zu.summary: Kudingeka umongikazi ohololwayo ozezela kulesilili eMadadeni Provincial Hospital eKwaZulu-Natal ukunikeza ukunakekelwa okukhethekile kokwelapha nokulawula abasebenzi abancane.
zu.requirements: I-Diploma / Isiqu ekuQeqesweni koGqozu jikelele. Isiqu esingemuva kokuqeqeshwa esiQeqeshweni sokunakekelwa kwesilili. Ukuqashelwa kwi-SANC njengengoMongikazi oHlolwayo. Okungenani eminyaka 4 yamava ahambisana noma aqashwayo ekuQeqeshweni koGqozu emuva kokuqashelwa njengengoMongikazi oHlolwayo e-SANC ekuQeqeshweni koGqozu jikelele. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Ukuqeqeshwa kanye namandla ayingqongqosana adingekayo: Amakhono amakhulu okuxhumana, ukuxhumana nokubonisa. Ikakhono lokwenza izinqumo ezime ngokwazo. Ukuqonda izinselelo ezibhekene nomkhakha wezempilo yomphakathi. Ikakhono lokubeka izindaba ezibalulekile kanye nezinye izinto ezihlobene nomsebenzi okwenziwe futhikuhambisane nawesikhathi. Izinga eliphezulu lokunembeka. Ulwazi olujulile ngemiThetho, Izinqubomgomo, Izaqiso, imiThetho yokuQondiswa kanye noMthetho.
zu.duties: Nikeza ukunakekelwa okugcwele, okukhethiwe, okuphumelelayo kokwelapha kubaphathi njengelungu leqembu elidala elinemikhakha eminingi. Qeqesha futhi ulawule abasebenzi abancane kanye nabafundi bomgogo. Gcina amazingaokuqashelwa ngokuqinisekisa ukuhambisana nama-National Norma and Standards. Hlela imisebenzi yokwelapha yeqenye. Thatha inxaxheba ekwakheni, ekuhloleni, ekusetshenzisweni nakubukweni kwemigomo yeqenye, izinqubomgomo, namaqiniso. Thatha inxaxheba ekubukweni kokwelapha kanye nokuqapha ukunakekelwa futhi zigcine ekuqinisekisiwe okunembile. Khombisa inkathazo ngabaphathi, ukusakaza ukumelaabaphathi, nokwenza kutholakale ukwelapha nokunakekelwa okufanele. Qinisekisa ukuthi iqenye lihambisana nokuvikela ukutheleleka nokulawula kanye nemicimbi yezaqiso yezenhlalo nokuphepha. Qinisekisa isimilo kanye nokusebenza ngobungcweti. Nikeza indawo eqinisekisiwe nelokwelapha abaphathi, abasebenzi, kanye nomphakathi. Gcina ubudlelwano obuakhono bokusebenza nokunakekelwa kanye nabanye abahlobene nalokho. Thatha inxaxheba ekuthuthukiseni abasebenzi ukusebenzisa I-EPMDS System kanye nezinye izinhlela ezihlobene nomsebenzi nokuzijwayeza. Qinisekisa ukuthi izinsimbi namashishini akhona futhi asebenza ngaso sonke isikhathi. Hlala emihlanganweni, kumakilasi lokuzijwayeza kumabhodi okufundela njengoba kuholele isoMkhulu wakho. I-ENQURIES : Nkosikazi R. M Sithole Inombolo Tel: (034) 328 8137

xh.title: Umqeshi weNesi ochunywe (EZESIBHEDLELA) (THEATRE)
xh.summary: Kufunekwa inesi ochunywe kwizibhila kum Sibhedlela sikaMadadeni Provincial Hospital eKwaZulu-Natal ukunika konakele kunye nokuqonda nokuqonda okukhoyo kwezibhila, nokulawula abasebenzi abasese ngowona wamagumbi.
xh.requirements: I-Diploma / I-Degree ekunakekelwa i-Nursing. Isifundo se-post basic kwi-Operating Theatre Nursing Science. Ubulungiselelo kwi-SANC njengo-Nesi ochunywe. Okungenani unyaka bane (4) ohlakaniphileyo noma obonakalayo kolwazi lokuzikhusela emva kokubhaliswa njengo-Nesi ochunywe e-SANC kwi-General Nursing. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Ukuqeqeshwa neNtlonipho efunekayo: Amandla amakhulu okuncedisa, okuthetha nokubonisa amakhono. Ukuzinceda ekwenzeni izigqibo. Ukuqonda iingxaki ezibhekisa kulawulo lwezempilo koluntu. Ukuzinceda ekubeka izinto ezibalulekileyo nezinye izinto ezidibene nomsebenzi nokuzinceda nokwanelisa iinkqubo zexesha. Inqanaba eliphezulu lemisindo yokuzinceda. Ukuqonda ngokujulileyo kwe-Acts, iinkqubo zolawulo, iindlela, i-Prescripts nokuqonda nokuzinceda kwamagumbi.
xh.duties: Kunikelwe ngokupela konakele okuyimfihlo ngokukhoyo kwizibhila kwizigulana njengelungu lenkomfa ye-Multidisciplinary team. Ukuqeqesha nokulawula abasebenzi abasese ngowona wamagumbi nabanabafundi abazikhuselayo. Ukulondoloza amagumbi okuzinceda ngokuqinisekisa ukuzinceda nokuzinceda ngokwamagumbi we-National Norma and Standards. Ukulawula imisebenzi yamagumbi. Ukuzinceda ekuyileni, ekwahlulweni, ekusebenziseni nasekuzincedeni amagumbi, iinkqubo, kunye namagumbi. Ukuzinceda kwizibhila ezihlolwayo nokulondoloza ukuzinceda okuzinceda. Ukubonisa ingatho kwizigulana, ngokukhuthaza, nokuzinceda nokuzinceda ekunikelweni konakele. Ukuzinceda ngokuzinceda kokuzinceda nokuzinceda kwamagumbi ngokuzinceda nokuzinceda. Ukuzinceda kwamagumbi nasekubuyeleni koluntu. Ukuzinceda nokuzinceda amagumbi ane-EPMDS System nasezinye iinkqubo ezidibene nomsebenzi nokuzinceda. Ukuzinceda ukuba amaqhinga nemichini iyafumaneka isebenza ixesha lonke. Ukubakho kwiinkomfa, nakwizibhila zokuqeqeshwa njengoko kuqhelwe ngumlawuli. IMIBUZO : Nkosazana R. M Sithole Tel No: (034) 328 8137

Verseker dat die eenheid voldoen aan Infeksievoorkoming en -beheer sowel as Beroepsgesondheid en -veiligheidsbeleid. Versterk etiek en profesionaliteit. Verskaf 'n veilige en terapeutiese omgewing vir pasiënte, personeel en die publiek. Neem deel aan personeelsonwikkeling deur gebruik van die EPMDS-stelsel en ander werkverwante programme en opleiding. NAVRAE : Me. R.M Sithole Tel No: (034) 328 8137

zu.title: Unesi Ochwepheshe Ohlotshanweni Oluthize (ICU)
zu.summary: Isikhundla senesi ochwepheshe se-ICU esibhedlela i-Madadeni Provincial e-KwaZulu-Natal, esidinga izifundo zokunakesa iziguli ezinobungozi kanye nokubhaliswa kwi-SANC.
zu.requirements: I-Degree/Diploma eyisiseko ye-R425 eZokunakesa noma iziqu ezingaphambili ezivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-South African Nursing Council njengonesi ochwepheshe. Isifundo esisodwa (1) senyanga ngemuva kweyisiseko sokunakesa iziguli ezinobungozi. Ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengonesi ochwepheshe. Ukuze ube nokuhlangenwe ndawon okungajwayelekile noma okubonakalayo okungaphezu kweminyaka eyi-4 ekuNakeseni emva kokubhaliswa njengonesi ochwepheshe kwi-SANC ngokwazi, amakhono, ukuqeqeshwa nethuba ekuNakeseni iJikelele. Ulwazi, amakhono, ukuqeqeshwa namandla ayingenayo: Amandla amakhulu okuxhumana, okukhuluma nokubukeka. Isikhathi sokwenza izinqumo ngokuzimela. Ukuqonda izinselele ezibhekene nomkhakha wezempilo yomphakathi. Amandla okubeka izinto ezibalulekile kanye nezinye izindaba ezihlotshaniswa nomsebenzi kanye nokuhambisana nemikhawulo yesikhathi. Izinga eliphezulu lokunemba. Ulwazi olujulile koMthetho, Izinkambiso, izinqubo, Izinkomba kanye noMthetho.
zu.duties: Nikeza ukunakekelwa okuhlukile okuphelele ngesimo seziguli njengelungu leqembu elibanzi lezokwelapha. Qeqesha futhi ulawule abasebenzi abasha kanye nabafundi banesiminya. Gigina amazinga okwemukelwa ngokuqinisekisa ukuhambisana nama-Azinga Abalulekile eZwelonke. Hlanganisa imisebenzi yezokwelapha yeqoqo. Zibandakanye ekwenzeni, ekuhlaziyeni, ekusebenziseni kanye nokuhlola izinjongo, izinkambiso nezinqubo zeqoqo. Zibandakanye ekubukeni izenzo zokunakesa futhi ugcine amarekhodi anemba. Khombisa ukukhathalela iziguli, ukukhuthaza ukumelwa, kanye nokwenza kube lula ukwelashwa okulungile nokunakekelwa. Qinisekisa ukuthi iqoqo lihambisana nokuvikela ukutheleleka nokulawula kanye nezenkambiso zeZezempilo nokuphepha kwabasebenzi. Qinisekisa izimiso zokuziphatha nokuba ngochwepheshe. Nikeza isimo esiphephile nelinokwelapha kubafundi, abasebenzi nomphakatha. Zibandakanye ekuqeqeshweni kwezisebenzi usebenzisa isistimu ye-EPMDS kanye nezinye izinhlela nokutholakala okuhlotshaniswa nomsebenzi. IMIBUZO : Nks. R.M Sithole Tel No: (034) 328 8137

xh.title: Umongikazi oGunyaziweyo ngobuchwephesha (ICU)
xh.summary: Isithuba sobuchwephesha somongikazi be-ICU eMadadeni Provincial Hospital eKwaZulu-Natal, sifuna isidanga sokongikwa kweZifo ezibiyo nokuqwalaselwa kwi-SANC.
xh.requirements: Isidanga/I-Diploma eR425 eNtsho sokongikwa okanye isidanga esingulingana esivumela ukuqwalaselwa kwi-South African Nursing Council njengomongikazi oGunyaziweyo. Unyaka owodwa (1) wokuqwalaselwa emva kwesidanga esintsho kwi-Critical Care Nursing Science. Ukuqwalaselwa kwi-SANC njengomongikazi oGunyaziweyo. Okona phantsi kweminyaka eli-4 yamava afanelekileyo okanye aqatyelweyo sokongikwa emva kokuqwalaselwa njengomongikazi oGunyaziweyo kwi-SANC kwi-General Nursing. Ulwazi, amakhono, uqeqesho namandla aFunekayo: Amandla amakhulu ekunxibelelana, ekuthetheni nasekubonisweni. Amandla okwenza izigqibo ezizimeleyo. Ukuqonda iingcinezinto ezibhekisa kummandla wezempilo yerhulu. Amandla okubeka kwindawo yokuqala iindaba nezinye izinto ezinxulumene nomsebenzi nokuzithoba kumaxesha amisiweyo. Inqanaba eliphezulu lokuchaneka. Ulwazi olujulileyo ngoMthetho weMithetho, Iinkqubo, iMithetho yoBulungisebe nezinye iMithetho.
xh.duties: Kwazisa ukongikwa okugqithisileyo okupheleleyo kwabanagula njengelungu leqela elizimeleyo lezongamilo. Uqeqesha Ulawula oogqabhelo abasezantsi nabafundi bomongikazi. Zisa iindawo ezibalo njengoko kuqinisekiswa ukuzithoba kwi-National Core Standards. Linganisa imisebenzi yezongamilo yeqela. Thatha inxaxheba ekwenzeni, ekuhlalweni, ekusebenziseni nasekuqwalaseleni iinjongo, iinkqubo neMithetho yeqela. Thatha inxaxheba kukuqwalaselwa kokongikwa wagcina irekhodi echanekileyo. Bonisa ukukhathalela abagula, ukukhuthaza ukuvakalisa, nokukhuthaza unyango nokongikwa okufanelekileyo. Qinisekisa ukuba iqela lizithoba kwiNqubo yokuthintela iinfections nokulawula kwaye nakuNxulumene neMithetho yeMpilo yoKhuseleko lomSebenzi. Qinisekisa maqaba nobugqila. Qinisekisa indawo ekhuselekileyo nekwanayo kubagula, abasebenzi noluntu. Thatha inxaxheba kolwakhisho labasebenzi kusetyenziswa inkqubo i-EPMDS System kwaye nasezinyeni iinkqubo ezinxulumene nomsebenzi noqeqesho. IMIBUZO : Ms. R.M Sithole Tel No: (034) 328 8137

jobs.title: Professional Nurse Specialty (OCCUPATIONAL Health)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R495 423 - R581 931 per annum Grade 2: R607 350 – R752 913 per annum Plus 8% Inhospitable Allowance, 13th cheque, medical Aid (Optional) and housing allowance (employee must meet prescribed requirements)
jobs.summary: Professional Nurse specialising in Occupational Health needed at Madadeni Provincial Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal to implement occupational health programmes and conduct medical surveillance for employees.
jobs.requirements: Basic R425 Degree/Diploma in Nursing or equivalent qualification that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council as Professional Nurse. One (1) year post basic qualification with a duration of at least 1 year in Occupational Health. Registration with the SANC as a Professional Nurse. A minimum of 4 years appropriate or recognizable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competencies Required: Knowledge of nursing care processes and procedures. Primary Health Care and Occupational Health Care, knowledge on nursing processes and procedure, nursing status and other relevant legal framework. Good and sound knowledge of compensation for Health and Safety Act No.85 of 1983. Good communication, team building and interpersonal skills. Coordination and liaison, problem solving and report writing. Batho Pele Principles. Computer literacy. Understanding of health programs VIZ, HIV, TB, Communicable and non-communicable diseases.

Conduct medical surveillance programme to employees. Execute all duties, functions and responsibilities in compliance with the OHS Act 85 of 1993, COID Act 130 of 1993 and relevant legislation. Administering and practical implementation of relevant Human Resource Management policies including those related to covid 19. Manage occupational health statistics and report. Develop occupational health and safety training programmes for employees (involving stakeholders with relevant experience). ENQURIES : Ms. R.M Sithole Tel No: (034) 328 8137

af.title: Professionele Verpleegkundige Spesialiteit (BEREPSGESONHEID)
af.summary: Professionele verpleegkundige wat spesialiseer in Beroepsgesondheid word benodig by Madadeni Provincial Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal om beroepsgesondheidsprogramme te implementeer en mediese surveillansie vir werknemers uit te voer.
af.requirements: Basiese R425-graad/diploma in Verpleegkunde of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council as professionele verpleegkundige toelaat. Een (1) jaar post-basiese kwalifikasie met 'n duur van ten minste 1 jaar in Beroepsgesondheid. Registrasie by die SANC as 'n professionele verpleegkundige. 'n Minimum van 4 jaar toepaslike of erkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as professionele verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleging. Kennis, vaardighede, opleiding en bevoegdhede vereis: Kennis van verpleegsorgprosesse en -prosedures. Primêre Gesondheidsorg en Beroepsgesondheidsorg, kennis van verpleegprosesse en -prosedures, verpleegstatus en ander relevante wetlike raamwerke. Deeglike kennis van die Compensation for Occupational Injuries and Diseases Act No. 85 van 1983. Goede kommunikasie, spansamenstelling en interpersoonlike vaardighede. Koördinering en skakeling, probleemoplossing en verslagskrywing. Batho Pele-beginsels. Rekenaargeletterdheid. Begrip van gesondheidsprogramme naamlik HIV, TB, oordraagbare en nie-oordraagbare siektes.
af.duties: Verskaf ondersteuning en bystand om optimale gesondheidsstatus vir alle werknemers in die instelling en klinieke te verseker. Rol beroepsgesondheidsprogramme vir die hospital en klinieke uit. Voer mediese surveillansieprogram aan werknemers uit. Voer alle pligte, funksies en verantwoordelikhede uit in ooreenstemming met die OHS Act 85 van 1993, COID Act 130 van 1993 en relevante wetgewing. Administreer en pas toepaslike Human Resource Management-beleide in praktyk toe, insluitend dié wat verband hou met covid 19. Bestuur beroepsgesondheidsstatistieke en verslag. Ontwikkel beroepsgesondheid- en veiligheidsopleidingsprogramme vir werknemers (met betrekking van belanghebbendes met relevante ervaring). NAVRAE : Me. R.M Sithole Tel No: (034) 328 8137

zu.title: Umhlengikazi Oholelayo Wezikhuthazi (EZEMSEBENZI Ezempilo)
zu.summary: Kudingeka umhlengikazi oholelayo ozigxile kwezempilo zemisebenzi eMadadeni Provincial Hospital eKwaZulu-Natal ukuze asungule izinhlelo zezempilo zemisebenzi futhi enze ulwangu lwezokwelapha abasebenzi.
zu.requirements: I-Degree/Diploma elinganiswe ngokwe-R425 ekuNakesi noma iziqu ezingalingana ezivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-South African Nursing Council njengomhlengikazi oholelayo. Isiqu esisodwa (1) sesikhathi esingemva kwesiqu esisisekelo esithatha isikhathi esingallude ngaphezulu kwonyaka osisodwa kwezempilo zemisebenzi. Ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengomhlengikazi oholelayo. Okungenani iminyaka engu-4 yohlaka olufanele noma olusabalele ekuNakesi ngemuva kokubhaliswa njengomhlengikazi oholelayo kwi-SANC ekuNakesi Jikelele. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Ukuqeqeshwa Namandla Adingekayo: Ulwazi ngokuqhuba nokwenza izinqubo zokunaka. Ukunazi i-Primary Health Care kanye ne-Occupational Health Care, ulwazi ngemisebenzi yezokunaka kanye nezinqubo, isimo sokunaka kanye nomthethosisekelo ohlobene. Ulwazi oluhle noluzwakalayo ngomthetho wokuHlinzekela ngezezeMpilo nokuPhepha iNombolo 85 ka-1983. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana, ukwakha iqembu nokuhlobana nabantu. ukuHlanganisa nokuxhumana, ukuxazulula izinkinga nokubhala imibiko. Izimiso ze-Batho Pele. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha. ukuQonda izinhlelo zezempilo okuyi-HIV, i-TB, izifo ezithathelana kalula nezingeke thathelane kalula.
zu.duties: Nikeza usekelo nosizo ukuze kuqiniseke isimo esihle sempilo kubo bonke abasebenzi esikhungweni nakumasayilini. Yisa izinhlelo zezempilo zemisebenzi esibhedlela nakumasayilini. Yenza ohlelo lokuqapha ezokwelapha kubasebenzi. Qhuba yonke imisebenzi, imisebenzi nemithwalo ngokulandelwa komthetho we-OHS Act 85 ka-1993, i-COID Act 130 ka-1993 nomthetho ohlobene. Ukuphatha nokusebenzisa ngobuhlakani izinqubomgomo ezihlobene nokuphathwa kwezinsizakalo zabantu okuhlanganisa nalezo ezihlobene ne-covid 19. Phatha izibalo zezempilo zemisebenzi futhi ubhale imibiko. Bula izinhlelo zokuqeqesha ngezempilo nemikhuba ephephile yabasebenzi (okuhlanganisa nabanomdabu ngenhlonipho abanolwazi ohlobene). IMIBUZO : Nkosazana R.M Sithole Tel No: (034) 328 8137

Ukwazi ukusebenza okungaphezulu kweminyaka engu-4 okanye olunokwamkeleka ekunyusekeni njengoNurse oGunyazisiweyo emva kokuza kubhalisa kwiSANC. Ulwazi, Amandla, uQeqesho namakhono aFunekayo: Ulwazi ngenkqubo namaxhoma okunyuseka kweempilo. IPrimary Health Care neOccupational Health Care, ulwazi ngenkqubo namaxhoma okunyuseka kweempilo, isimo sokunyuseka nolunye ulwimi olusemthethweni oluhambelana noku. Ulwazi olulungelekileyo noluzinzileyo ngomthetho weCompensation for Health and Safety Act No.85 of 1983. Amandla achanekileyo axoxo-dwa, ukwakhiwa kwethimba namakhano abantu. Ulinganiso nedxululwano, ukusombulula iingxaki nokubhala iingxelo. Iimvisiswano zeBatho Pele. Ukuzazi kwekhompyutha. Ukuqonda iinkqubo ezinzima ezithi VIZ, iHIV, iTB, iinkqhubo ezithatheka ngezinqamlezana ezingathathwa ngezingathathi.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso nceda ukuqinisekisa isimo esigqwesileyo sempilo kubo bonke abasebenzi kwisikhululo nasezikhulweni zezigulana. Yenza isiseko iinkqubo zemphezo yokhuseleko zesibhedlele nabezikhulini zezigulana. Yenza inkqubo yovakaliso lwezempilo kubasebenzi. Zenza yonke imisebenzi, imisebenzi namanyathelo ngokuthobela uMthetho iOHS Act 85 of 1993, iCOID Act 130 of 1993 nomthetho ohambelanayo. Lawula ukuze kusetenziswe iinkqacha ezihambelanayo zokuLawula abasebenzi abanjiniyela nalawo ahambelana ne-covid 19. Lawula izibalo zokhuseleko lomsebenzi wenkqubo uze uchaze ingxelo. Yenza iinkqubo zeqeqesho lokhuseleko nempilo yabasebenzi (kuquka nabanomdla abanolwazi oluhambelanayo). IMIBUZO : Nkosazana R.M Sithole Tel No: (034) 328 8137

af.summary: Kliniese Tegnoloog (Echo Cardio) pos by Madadeni Provinsiale Hospitaal in KwaZulu-Natal, wat HPCSA-registrasie en 'n diploma of graad in Kliniese Tegnologie vereis.
af.requirements: Diploma/Graad in Kliniese Tegnologie (Echo Cardio), huidige registrasie by HPCSA as Kliniese Tegnoloog as Echo Cardio. Kliniese Tegnoloog Graad 1: Geen na registrasie by HPCSA met betrekking tot RSA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers wat gemeenskapsdiens gedoen het, soos in Suid-Afrika vereis. af.duties: Voer pligte en funksies met vaardigheid uit, ter ondersteuning van die visie en missie. Stel pasiënte in kennis oor die aard van die prosedure en die rede vir die uitvoer van die toets. Handhaaf die beginsels van Batho-Pele, die pasiënt se regte en verantwoordelikhede. Verskaf opleiding en ondersteuning in die nier-eenheid, kritieke sorg en narkose. AbaThekhnoloji baseKlinikhi Izinga 2: Okungenani iminyaka eyishumi (10) yokuhlangenwe nakho okuhambisanayo ngemuva kokubhaliswa ne-HPCSA emsebenzini ophathwayo (lapho kusebenza khona) maqondana nabasebenzi abafanelekile be-RSA abenza inkonzo yomphakathi, njengokuqondiswa eNingizimu Afrika. Okungenani iminyaka eyikhulu nanye (11) yokuhlangenwe nakho okuhambisanayo ngemuva kokubhaliswa neHealth Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) emsebenzini ophathwayo (lapho kusebenza khona) maqondana nabasebenzi basemvelo ababhalisile ngaphandle, okuyidingo ukuba benze inkonzo yomphakathi njengokuqondiswa eNingizimu Afrika. Okungenani iminyaka engama-21 yokuhlangenwe nakho okuhambisanayo ngemuva kokubhaliswa neHealth Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) emsebenzini ophathwayo (lapho kusebenza khona) maqondana nabasebenzi basemvelo ababhalisile ngaphandle, okungekhona okudingekayo ukuba benze inkonzo yomphakathi njengokuqondiswa eNingizimu Afrika. Ulwazi, amakhono namandla adingekayo: -1- iminyaka eyi-2 yokuhlangenwe nakho okuhambisanayo emsebenzini. Okuhlangenwe nakho ehaemodialysis. Amakhono ahle okuhlela. Amakhono ahle okuxhumana. Amakhono ahle abantu. Okuhlangenwe nakho ekusebenzeni unit ye-echo Cardio. Okuhlangenwe nakho ekusebenzeni ngesisetshenzwa se-ICU ne-Theatre.
zu.duties: Feza imisebenzi nemisebenzi ngobuchwepheshe, ngokusekelwa kubono, umnthetho. Yezela iziguli ngohlobo lwenqubo nenzondo yokwenza ukuhlolwa. Gcina okugqamile kokuqoshwa kwezibalo zeziguli ezihlolwe. Xhumana nabadokotela nabasebenzi bokunakekela ngemiphumela yokuholwa kweziguli. Qiniseka ukuthi umnyango uhlanzekile, usebenza njalo ulungele ukugcinwa. Hlanganyela ohlelweni lokufundisa bonke abantu abasebenza kulelo mnyango. Yenza noma yimiphi eminye imisebenzi njengoba kuphoqwe nhloko yomnyango. Sebenzisa ukunakekelwa kweziguli nolwazi lwekhono lapho kwenziwa izinqubo. Yisa phezulu imigomo ka-Batho-Pele, amalungelo nezibopho zesiguli. Nikeza ukwelashwa nokusekela unit ye-renal, ukunakekelwa okubalulekile nase-anesthesiology. IMIBUZO : Dr. X.F Nene Tel No: (034) 328 8007

Abachwathi beTeknoloji yamanye amaphondo Umgangatho 3: Okuncinci amashumi amabini (20) eminyaka yobulumko obufanelekileyo emva kokubhaliswa ne-HPCSA kwishishini elifanelekileyo (apho kusebenzayo) malunga nabasebenzi abagqibiweyo e-RSA abenze inkonzo yomphakathi eMzantsi Afrika. Qinisekisa ukuba isebe lihle, lisenziwe ngonxibelelwano kwaye ligcinwe kakuhle. Thatha inxaxheba kwinkqubo yokufundisa yonke imisebenzi ngaphakathi kwesebe. Phatha nayiphi na eminye imisebenzi njengoko kuwelelwe ngumphephandaba wesebe. Sebenzisa ukhathalo lwabaguli nokuzelelwa xa uphatha iinkqubo. jobs.title: Health and Safety Officer
jobs.salary_text: R413 001 – R486 501 per annum. 13th cheque, Plus Medical Aid (Optional), Plus Housing Allowance (Employee must meet prescribed condition)
jobs.summary: Health and Safety Officer position at Madadeni Provincial Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal, requiring an Environmental Health or Safety Management diploma with 3-5 years of experience.
jobs.requirements: Degree / National Diploma in Environmental Health or Safety Management. Minimum of 3-5 years’ experience in Safety. Knowledge, Skills and Competencies required: Knowledge of relevant legislations pertaining to Occupational Health and Safety. Identification, control, elimination and monitoring of hazards. Health education and administration of the services. Knowledge of computer literacy. Accident investigation. Disaster management.
jobs.duties: Identification of potential situation that could lead to injury/disability/death of staff member/visitor. Proper damage or loss, internal disaster, medico-legal claim and reporting thereof to the Occupational health and safety manager. Ensuring the delegate management and administrative functions are carried out timely and correctly in order for health and safety to function in the institution. Assisting in development and compilation of manuals, policies and protocol that will be included in the rolling out of the health and safety training, orientation and induction programmes. Participate in safety audits for the institution in compliance with the occupational health and safety Act,85 of 1993. Assisting the occupational health and safety manager in ensuring that buildings, construction, plants, and machinery meet and maintain compliance certificates that are regulated by the occupational health and safety Act, 85 of 1993 and its regulation. Organise and record the Disaster drills. Ensure that all employees and service providers within the hospital complies with the required safety protocols. Ensure that people, patients, staff and the building are safe and Hospital is legally compliant, OHSD, norms and standards, DOH requirements, conduct workplace inspections, PPE management, ergonomics and staff safety. Liaise with occupational Health team on T.B, Hep B radiation monitoring etc. Ensure fire safety and emergency preparedness. Ensure Infection Control and patient safety support, i.e heater qudity, ventilation, waste management, contractor safety. Conduct training and awareness on Health and Safety. Implement monitoring and quality improvement.
jobs.applications: All applications can be submitted through hand delivery /courier to: The HR Recruitment Office no:3, Madadeni Hospital, f0001. Section 6, Madadeni, 2951. Applications can also be emailed to: sibongiseni.kheswa@kznhealth.gov.za FOR ATTENTION : The Recruitment Officer
jobs.notes: This Department is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer, whose aim is to promote representivity in all levels of all occupational categories in the Department. Note: The contents of this Circular Minute must be brought to the notice of all eligible officers and employees on your establishment of all Institutions. Institutions must notify all candidates who qualify for post in this circular minute even if they are absent from their normal places of work to apply. Direction to Candidates: the following documents must be submitted: Application for Employment form (Z83) which is obtainable from any Government Department OR from the website - www.kznhealth.gov.za. The application form (Z83) must be accompanied by a detailed Curriculum Vitae, Certified copies of ID, Highest educational qualification and other relevant documents will be requested for submission only from shortlisted candidates. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The reference number must be indicated in the column provided on the form Z83 and on the back of the envelope, e.g. MAD 01/2016. NB: Failure to comply with the above instructions will be disqualify applicants. Person with disabilities should feel free to apply for the post. The appointment is subject to positive outcome obtained from the NIA the following checks (security clearance, credit records, qualification, citizenship and previous experience employment verification). Due to the large number of applications, receipt of applications will not be acknowledged. However, correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. Please note that due to financial constraint no S&T claims will be considered for payment to the candidates that are invited for an interview.

af.title: Gesondheids- en Veiligheidsbeampte
af.summary: Pos vir Gesondheids- en Veiligheidsbeampte by Madadeni Provinsiale Hospitaal in KwaZulu-Natal, wat 'n diploma in Omgewingsgesondheid of Veiligheidsbestuur vereis met 3-5 jaar se ervaring.
af.requirements: Graad / Nasionale Diploma in Omgewingsgesondheid of Veiligheidsbestuur. Minimum van 3-5 jaar se ervaring in Veiligheid. Kennis, vaardighede en bevoegdhede vereis: Kennis van relevante wetgewing rakende Beroepsgesondheid en -veiligheid. Identifikasie, beheer, uitwissing en monitering van hazards. Gesondheidsopvoeding en administrasie van die dienste. Kennis van rekenaarvaardigheid. Ongelukondersoek. Rampbestuur.
af.duties: Identifikasie van moontlike situasies wat kan lei tot besering/onskiktheid/dood van 'n staflid/besoeker. Behoorlike skade of verlies, interne ramp, medies-juridiese eis en rapportering daarvan aan die bestuurder van beroepsgesondheid en -veiligheid. Verseker dat die gedelegeerde bestuurs- en administratiewe funksies betyds en korrek uitgevoer word sodat gesondheid en veiligheid in die instelling kan funksioneer. Bystand verleen by die ontwikkeling en samestelling van handleidings, beleide en protokolle wat ingesluit sal word by die uitrol van die gesondheids- en veiligheidsopleiding, oriëntering- en inlywingsprogramme. Deelneem aan veiligheidsoudits vir die instelling in ooreenstemming met die Wet op Beroepsgesondheid en -veiligheid, 85 van 1993. Bystand verleen aan die bestuurder van beroepsgesondheid en -veiligheid om te verseker dat geboue, konstruksies, aanlegte en masjinerie voldoen aan en behoud van voldoeningssertifikate handhaaf soos gereguleer deur die Wet op Beroepsgesondheid en -veiligheid, 85 van 1993 en die regulasies daarvan. Reëll en rekord hou van die rampoefeninge. Verseker dat alle werknemers en diensverskaffers binne die hospitaal voldoen aan die vereiste veiligheidsprotokolle. Verseker dat mense, pasiënte, personeel en die gebou veilig is en die Hospitaal wetlik voldoen, OHSD, norms en standards, DOH-vereistes, werkplekinspeksies uitvoer, PPE-bestuur, ergonomie en personeelveiligheid. Skakel met die beroepsgesondheidspan oor T.B, Hep B, stralingsmonitering, ens. Verseker brands veiligheid en noodgereedheid. Verseker Infeksiebeheer en pasiëntveiligheidsondersteuning, d.w.s. waterkwaliteit, ventilasie, afvalbestuur, kontrakteurveiligheid. Voer opleiding en bewustheid oor Gesondheid en Veiligheid uit. Implementeer monitering en kwaliteitverbetering.

zu.title: Umphathi wezoNempilo neNgekhe
zu.summary: Isikhundla somPhathi wezoNempilo neNgekhe esibhedlela iMadadeni Provincial Hospital eKwaZulu-Natal, sifuna idiploma yeNsimbi yeMvelo noma ukuqondiswa kweZokuphepha eminyakeni engu-3-5 yokuhlangenwe nakho.
zu.requirements: IDigri / iNasional Diploma kwiNsimbi yeMvelo noma ukuQondiswa kweZokuphepha. Okungenani eminyakeni engu-3-5 yohlu lwalusebenzo ekuQondisweni kweZokuphepha. Ukuwazi, amakhono kanye namandla okukwazi okudingekayo: ukuwazi ngemithetho ehlobene nokuSebenza kwezoNempilo nokuQondiswa kweZokuphepha. Ukuhlonza, ukulawula, ukususa kanye nokubuka ubungozi. uQondiso lwempilo nokuphatwa kwezinkonzo. ukuwazi ukusetshenziswa kwekhompyutha. uKuphenya izehlakalo. uPhathwa kwezinsile.
zu.duties: UKuhlonza izimo ezinokubanga ukulimala/ukukhubazeka/ukufa komsebenzi/visitha. Ukulahlekelwa okufanele noma ukulahleko, insile yangaphakathi, isikhalazo sezomthetho sokwelapha nokubika ngakho kumphathi wezokusebenza kwezonempilo nezokuphepha. UKuqinisekisa ukuthi ukuphathwa kwebandla nemisebenzi yokuphatha yenziwa ngesikhathi futhi ngendlela elungile ukuze izokuphepha zisebenze esikhungweni. Ukusiza ekuthuthukisweni nasekuqoqweni kwabamanuwala, izinqobo noma izimiso ezizobe zifakwe ekusakazeni uqeqesho lwezokuphepha, izinhlelo zokumamatheka nezokungenisa. Ukuthatha inhlathi kulingo zokuphepha zesikhungo ngokuhambisana nokuMthetho wezokuSebenza kwezoNempilo nokuQondiswa kweZokuphepha, 85 ka-1993. Ukusiza umphathi wezokusebenza kwezonempilo nezokuphepha ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi izakhiwo, ukwakhiwa, izitshalo, namashobolo ohamba ubuncwane bahlangabezane futhi bagcine amakhasimende okuhambisana nomthetho oqondiswe ngoMthetho wezokuSebenza kwezoNempilo nokuQondiswa kweZokuphepha, 85 ka-1993 kanye nezinqobo zabo. UkuHlela nokubhala ama-drill wezinsile. UKuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abasebenzi kanye nabahlinzeki bezinkonzo ngaphakathi kwesibhedlela bahlangabezana nezinqobo zokuphepha ezidingekayo. UKuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu, iziguli, abasebenzi kanye nesakhiwo bakhuselekile nesibhedlela sihambisana nomthetho, OHSD, izilinganiso nezimiso, izidingo ze-DOH, kwenze ukubheka izindawo zokusebenza, ukuphathwa kwe-PPE, i-ergonomics kanye nokuphepha kwabasebenzi. UKuxhumana nenkundla yezokuSebenza kwezoNempilo nge-T.B, i-Hep B ukubheka radiation njll. UKuqinisekisa ukuphepha komlilo nokulungiselelwa kwezimo eziphuthumayo. UKuqinisekisa ukuLawula ukutheleleka kanye nokuxhaswa kokuphepha kweguli, okungukuthi isimo sokushisa, ukukhanya/ukuhumusha, ukuphathwa kokungalahlanga, ukuphepha kwabalunga bezenkonzo. UKwenza uqeqesho kanye nokuqaphela ngazo eZokuSebenza nezokuQondiswa kweZokuphepha. UKuphatha ukubheka nokuthuthukiswa kwekhwalithi.

xh.title: Unozincwadi wezoMpilo loKhuseleko
xh.summary: Isithuba sokuba nguNozincwadi wezoMpilo loKhuseleko esibhedlele iMadadeni Provincial Hospital eKwaZulu-Natal, sifuna idiploma kwiZezoMpilo zeNdalo okanye uLawulo loKhuseleko kunye neminyaka eli-3-5 yamava.
xh.requirements: Idegree / iNational Diploma kwiZezoMpilo zeNdalo okanye uLawulo loKhuseleko. Ukuze kube kokubona phantsi iminyaka eli-3-5 yamava kuKhuseleko. Ulwazi, amakhono namakhono afunekayo: Ulwazi ngemithetho echwayitheyo edibana noMpilo weSebenza noKhuseleko. Ukuqaphela, ulawula, ukugqiba ukususwa kunye nokuhlola iingozi. Imfundo yempilo lolawulo lweenkonzo. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Uphononongo lwehlobo. Ulawulo leeze.
xh.duties: Ukuqaphela iimeko ezingenzeka ezinokubangela ilimala/ukuphulaphala ukusebenza/ukufa komsebenzi/omvakelayo. Ukubika ngokulimala okanye ukulahleka, isiganeko sangaphakathi, isicelo sezomthetho wezempilo, nokubika ngako kumlawuli wezempilo nokhuseleko lomsebenzi. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba kulawulwa kakuhle ukusebenza koluntu kwaye iinkqubo ezolawulweni zenziwe ngexesha elifanelekileyo nangendlela elungileyo ukuze izempilo nokhuseleko zisebenze kwishishini. Ukuncedisa ekuphuhlisweni nasekulungeniseni iimanual, iinkqubo kunye namacebiso aza kubandakanywa ekuskeni iinkqubo zolwazi olutsha nangokhuseleko, oqonde ikhaya kunye neenkqubo zokwamkela abantu basebenzayo. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwiindlela zokuqinisekisa ukhuseleko kwishishini ngokwemithelelo yomthetho wezempilo nokhuseleko lomsebenzi, 85 ka-1993. Ukuncedisa umlawuli wezempilo nokhuseleko lomsebenzi ekuqinisekiseni ukuba izakhiwo, ukwakhiwa, iindonga, kunye nezixhobo ziphumelele kwaye zigcine amagama okugqiba ukuvavanywa alawulwa ngumthetho wezempilo nokhuseleko lomsebenzi, 85 ka-1993 kunye nemithetho yawo. Ukuqamba kunye nokugcina izikrwebo ezibonisa iziqendu zeze. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba bonke abasebenzi kunye nabanikiwezya iinkonzo esibhedlele balandela iinkqubo ezifunekayo zokhuseleko. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba abantu, abaguli, abasebenzi kunye nesakhiwo sikhuselekile kwaye isibhedlele sihambisana nomthetho, i-OHSD, iinkqubo neemigangatho, iimfuno ze-DOH, ukuqhuba iindlela zokuvavanya indawo yokusebenza, ulawulo lwePPE, ukuzinza komzimba kunye nokhuseleko lwabasebenzi. Ukuqhubana nethimba loMpilo lomsebenzi ngeTB, iHep B, ukulawula ukusetyenziswa korhotho njl. Ukuqinisekisa ukhuseleko mlilo nolungiselelo lweziganeko ezingalindelekanga. Ukuqinisekisa uLawulo lotyalazo nokuxhaswa kukhuseleko lwesiguli, oko kukuthi ukufudumeza okuhle, ukuqulunqa umoya, ulawulo lweze, ukhuseleko lomsebenzi oqhutywa ngamanye amathambo. Ukuqhuba imfundo kunye nokuvakalisa ngazoMpilo noKhuseleko. Ukusebenzisa iindlela zokuqaphela n ukuphucula ikhwalithi.

jobs.title: Profesional Nurse (GENERAL Stream) with Midwifery
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R337 359 - R391 515 per annum Grade 2: R411 978 - R478 116 per annum Grade 3: R495 423 - R625 704 per annum Other Benefits: Medical Aid – Optional, Housing Allowance - Employee must meet prescribed requirements, 13th Cheque and 12% rural allowance.
jobs.summary: Professional nurse with midwifery sought for Vryheid District Hospital to supervise nursing care and implement quality standards across three experience grades.
jobs.requirements: Diploma / B Degree in nursing or equivalent qualification that allows registration with the SANC as a Professional Nurse with Midwifery. Registration with SANC as Professional Nurse with Midwifery. Current SANC receipt. Grade 1: No experience. Grade 2: A minimum of 10 years appropriate /recognisable experience in nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse with SANC in general nursing. Grade 3: A minimum of 20 years appropriate /recognizable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with SANC in general nursing. Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competences Required: Knowledge of nursing care processes and procedures, nursing statutes, and other relevant legal frameworks. Good communication skills. Report writing skills. Facilitation skills. Coordination skills. Liaison skills. Networking skills. Problem-solving skills. Information Management. Knowledge Management. Planning and organising. Computer Literacy.
jobs.duties: Provide directions and supervision for the implementation of the nursing plan (clinical practice/quality patient care. Implement standards, practices, criteria and indicators for quality nursing (quality of practice). Practice nursing and health care in accordance with the laws and regulations relevant to nursing and health care. Maintain a constructive working relationship with nursing and other stakeholders. Utilise human, material and physical resources efficiently and effectively. Provide comprehensive, antenatal, intrapartum and postnatal care including deliveries and management of obstetric emergencies. Perform physical assessments, diagnose and treat common health problems in line with scope of practice and PHC guidelines. Manage Maternal, Child and Women’s Health programmes, EPI, Family Planning. Provide HIV, TB, STI and NCD management and ensure adherence to 95/95/95 targets. Triage patients, refer appropriately, and follow up on defaulters and untraceable clients. Maintain patient hygiene, nutrition, mobility and elimination needs. Measure, interpret and record vital signs accurately. Ensure infection prevention and control measures are implemented. Promote patient-centered care to reduce complaints, PSIs and waiting times. Participate in outreach services and community health education. Support NHI and PHC re-engineering initiatives in the rural community. Work with CHWs and other stakeholders to improve access in rural areas. Maintain accurate patient records, registers and data capturing. Ensure cost-effective use of equipment, stock and resources. Report losses/damages. Supervise and mentor Enrolled Nurses, Staff Nurses and CHWs. Implement and monitor priority programmes as per Ideal Clinic standards. Reduce risk of litigation by applying correct clinical protocols. Contribute to achieving Ideal Clinic Realisation Status. Participate in on-call system to ensure 24/7 service delivery.
jobs.enquiries: Ms. ATS Sibiya Tel No: (034) 9822111, Ext. 4692
jobs.applications: All applications should be forwarded to: Assistant Director: HRM, Private Bag X9371, Vryheid, 3100 or be hand delivered at Coswald Brown Street, Vryheid 3100, HR office No: 09 or email to VryheidHospital.HRJobApplication@kznhealth.gov.za

af.title: Profesionele Verpleegkundige (ALGEMENE Stroom) met Kraamversorging
af.summary: Profesionele verpleegkundige met kraamversorging gesoek vir Vryheid Distrikshospitaal om verpleegsorg toesig te hou en gehuldstandaarde oor drie ervaringsgrade te implementeer.
af.requirements: Diploma / B-graad in verpleegkunde of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die SANC as 'n Profesionele Verpleegkundige met Kraamversorging toelaat. Registrasie by SANC as Profesionele Verpleegkundige met Kraamversorging. Huidige SANC-kwitansie. Graad 1: Geen ervaring nie. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar toepaslike /herkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as 'n Profesionele Verpleegkundige by SANC in algemene verpleging. Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 20 jaar toepaslike /herkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as Profesionele Verpleegkundige by SANC in algemene verpleging. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdhede Vereis: Kennis van verpleegsorgprosesse en -prosedures, verpleegstatutes, en ander relevante regsraamwerke. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede. Verslagdoeningsvaardighede. Fasiliteringsvaardighede. Koördineringsvaardighede. Skakelvaardighede. Netwerkvaardighede. Probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Inligtingsbestuur. Kennisbestuur. Beplanning en organisering. Rekenaarvaardigheid.
af.duties: Verskaf rigting en toesig vir die implementering van die verpleegsorgplan (kliniese praktyk/kwaliteit pasiëntsorg. Implementeer standaarde, praktyke, kriteria en aanwysers vir gehalteverpleging (kwaliteit van praktyk). Beoefen verpleging en gesondheidsorg in ooreenstemming met die wette en regulasies relevant tot verpleging en gesondheidsorg. Onderhou 'n konstruktiewe werksverhouding met verpleging en ander belanghebbendes. Benut menslike, materiaal- en fisiese hulpbronne doeltreffend en effektief. Verskaf omvattende antenatale, intrapartum en postnatale sorg insluitend bevallings en bestuur van verloskundige noodgevalle. Voer fisieke assesserings uit, diagnoseer en behandel algemene gesondheidsprobleme in ooreenstemming met die omvang van praktyk en PHC-riglyne. Bestuur Maternale, Kind- en Vrouegesondheidsprogramme, EPI, Gesinsbeplanning. Verskaf MIV-, TB-, VSO- en NCD-bestuur en verseker nakoming van 95/95/95-teikens. Sorteer pasiënte, verwys toepaslik, en volg teruglopers en onopspoorbare kliënte na. Onderhou pasiënthigiëne, voeding, mobiliteit en eliminasiebehoeftes. Meet, interpreteer en rekord vitale tekens akkuraat. Verseker dat infeksievoorkoming en -beheermaatreëls geïmplementeer word. Bevorder pasiëntgesentreerde sorg om klagtes, PSI's en wagtye te verminder. Neem deel aan uitreikdienste en gemeenskapsgesondheidsopvoeding. Ondersteun NHI- en PHC-herontwerpsinisiatiewe in die landelike gemeenskap. Werk saam met CHW's en ander belanghebbendes om toegang in landelike gebiede te verbeter. Onderhou akkurate pasiëntrekords, registers en data-invanging. Verseker koste-effektiewe gebruik van toerusting, voorraad en hulpbronne. Rapporteer verliese/skade. Superviseer en mentorer Ingeskrewe Verpleegkundiges, Stafverpleegkundiges en CHW's. Implementeer en monitor prioriteitsprogramme volgens Ideale Kliek standaarde. Verminder risiko van litigasie deur korrekte kliniese protokolle toe te pas. Dra by tot die bereiking van Ideale Kliek Realisasiestatus. Neem deel aan oproepstelsel om 24/7 dienslewering te verseker.

zu.title: Umhlengikazi oGwaziwe (Isimiso Esijwayelekile) onelebolo lokubeletha
zu.summary: Kufunwa umhlengikazi ogwaziwe onelebolo lokubeletha ukuze asebenze eVryheid District Hospital, ukuba aqophe izinhlela zokwelapha futhi asuse izindinganiso zobuchwepheshe kumazinga amathathu emisebenzi yawo.
zu.requirements: I-Diploma / I-B Degree ekunakekelwa kwabaguli noma iziqu ezingefana nalezo ezivumela ukubhalisa ku-SANC njengomhlengikazi ogwaziwe onelebolo lokubeletha. Ukubhaliswa ku-SANC njengomhlengikazi ogwaziwe onelebolo lokubeletha. Isipeshadi samanje se-SANC. I-Grade 1: Akukho mvelo. I-Grade 2: Umkhathi weminyaka engu-10 wemvelo ehambisana namazwe / ehloniphekile ekunakekelwa kwabaguli ngemuva kokubhalisa njengomhlengikazi ogwaziwe ku-SANC ekunakekelwa kwabaguli okujwayelekile. I-Grade 3: Umkhathi weminyaka engu-20 wemvelo ehambisana namazwe / ehloniphekile ekunakekelwa kwabaguli ngemuva kokubhalisa njengomhlengikazi ogwaziwe ku-SANC ekunakekelwa kwabaguli okujwayelekile. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Ukuqeqeshwa Namandla Adingekayo: Ulwazi ngamaphulo nemicimbi yokunakekela abaguli, izimoto zokunakekela, nezinye izikhulu eziyimithetho. Amakhono okuxhumana kahle. Amakhono okubhala imibiko. Amakhano okukhuthaza. Amakhono okuhlanganisa. Amakhono okuxhumana. Amakhono okwakha ukuxhumana. Amakhono okuxazula. Ukuphathwa kolwazi. Ukuphathwa kolwazi. Ukucubungula nokuhlela. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha.
zu.duties: Nika izinkomba nokuqapha ukuze kuqedwe inqubo yokunakekela abaguli (umthetho wezokwelapha / ukunakekela ngobuchwepheshe abaguli. Sebenzisa izindinganiso, amasiko, izinkomba nezinkomba zobuchwepheshe ekunakekelwa abaguli (obuchwepheshe bomthetho). Yenza ukunakekela abaguli nezempilo ngokuvumelana nemithetho nemithetho ehambisana nokunakekela abaguli nezempilo. Hlala uhlobene kahle ekunakekelwa nabanye abathintekayo. Sebenzisa abantu, izinto nezinsiza ngokusebenza kahle nangempumelelo. Nikez ukunakekela okuzenzakalelayo, ngaphambi kokubeletha, ngesikhathi sokubeletha nangemuva kokubeletha okuhlanganisa nokubeletha nokuphathwa kwezimo eziphuthumayo zokubeletha. Yenza isilinganiso somzimba, uhlonze futhi uphath izinkinga ezijwayelekile zezempilo ngokuvumelana nomkhawulo wokusebenza nezinkomba ze-PHC. Phatha amaphulo ezeswe, izingane nabesifazane, i-EPI, nezinkampani zokuhlela umndeni. Nikeza ukuphathwa kwe-HIV, i-TB, i-STI ne-NCD futhi qinisekisa ukulandela okuhlosiwe yi-95/95/95. Hlukanisa abaguli, wathumele kahle, futhi ulandele labo abangayeki nokutholakala. Hlola izidingo zokuhlanzeka, ukudla, ukunyakaza nokukhishwa kwabaguli. Linganisa, humusha futhi ubhale ngokunembile izimpawu eziyizikhathi. Qinisekisa ukuthi izinkondolo zokuvikela nokuqapha izifo ziyenziwa. Khuthaza ukunakekela abaguli kulelo ngalinye ukuze kuncishiswe izikhalazo, i-PSI kanye nesikhathi sokulinda. Thatha inxaxheba kulezo zinsiza zokuyosiza izichibi ukuthi nifunde ngempilo. Sekela i-NHI namaphulo okuqamba kabusha e-PHC emphakathini osemathempelweni. Sebenzisana ne-CHWs nabanye abathintekayo ukuthi kube lula ukungena kulezo ndawo. Hlola ngokunembile izibhalo zabaguli, izibhalo zokubhalisa nokubhalisa idatha. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa ngokugculisayo kwezinsiza, izinkwa nemithombo. Yikela imibiko yezinto ezehliwe/ezonakaliswe. Qapha futhi ubekelele abahlengikazi ababhalisile, abahlengikazi bomtholampilo kanye ne-CHWs. Sebenzisa futhi ulandele amaphulo abalulekile ngokuvumelana nezinkomba zeklinikhi efe. Nciphisa ingozi yokuxakwa ngokusebenzisa imithetho ebalulekile yomthetho. Faka iqhaza ekufezeni isimo se-Ideal Clinic Realisation. Thatha inxaxheba kwisimiso sokubiza ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukulethwa kwenkonzo yamahora angu-24/7.

xh.summary: Kufunwa ugqirza wemisebenzi yonursing onokusingathwa kwababelethi kwiSidlu saseVryheid District Hospital ukulawula ukunakekelwa kwinursing nokusebenzisa iinkqubo zezomgangatho kwezahu ezintathu zomgangatho wolwazi.
xh.requirements: I-Diploma / I-B Degree yonursing okanye isifanekiso esilinganayo esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-SANC njengoGqirza weMisebenzi yoNursing oNokusingathwa kwababelethi. Inqanaba 3: Ubuncinane beminyaka engama-20 yamava afanelekileyo / eziqaphelwayo kwimisebenzi yonursing emva kokubhalisa njengoGqirza weMisebenzi yoNursing kwi-SANC kwizonke iindawo zokunaka. Amakhono okubhala iingxelo. Amakhono okukhuthaza. Amakhono okulungisa. Amakhono onxibelelwano. Amakhono okuzama. Amakhono okuxazulula iingxaki. Ulawulo lolwazi. Ulawulo lolwazi. Uqekelo nokuqokelela. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha.
xh.duties: Nika iindlela nokuqonda ukuphumeza iphano lonursing (umzekelo wenqubo ekliniki / ukunakekelwa okusemgangathweni kwaguli. Phumeza iimigangatho, iindlela zokusebenza, iikhreyitha neziqulathi zomgangatho wonursing (umgangatho wokusebenza). Sebenza ngonursing nokunakekelwa kwezempilo ngokwemithetho nomigaqo ehambelana nonursing nokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Gcina ubudlelwane obululo bokusebenza nabasebenzi beNursing nakwezinye iindidi. Sebenzisa abantu, izinto nendalo ngokuchanekileyo nangokusebenza kakuhle. Nika ukunakekelwa okubandakanya bonke, ngaphambi kokubeletha, ngexesha lokubeletha, nangemva kokubeletha kuquka nokubeletha nolawulo iimeko ezibuthaka kwababelethi. Yenza ukunqumba umzimba, uxilile kwaye uphathela iingxaki ezidumileyo kwezempilo ngokwemida yomsebenzi neziqulatho ze-PHC. Lawula iinkqubo ezingababelethi, zabantwana nabafazi, i-EPI, uLawulo loLwamiliselwa. Nika ulawulo lwe-HIV, i-TB, i-STI ne-NCD kuqinisekisa ukuzithiba ngokumgama oyi-95/95/95. Hlengahlengisa abaguli, nqumla ngendlela efanelekileyo, landelela abo batshiyekayo nabangekabonwa. Gcina ucoce lwaguli, ukutya, intshukumo nemfuneko yokuqhwesha. Linganisa, thekola aze abhale ngokuchanekileyo iimpawu ezibalulekileyo zeempilo. Qinisekisa ukuba iindlela zokuthintela nolawulo ukuthelela kusebenza. Khuthaza ukunakekelwa okubhekise kuguli ukuze kuncitshiswe iingxaki, i-PSI nexesha lolinde. Thatha inxaxheba kwiinkonzo ezibakho aze achaze ngempilo koluntu.ixa. Sekela i-NHI nezimvo zokuphinda zenziwe i-PHC kuluntu lwemaphandla. Sebenzana nama-CHW nabanayo ukuphucola ukufikelela kumaphandla. Gcina ukubhalwa okuchanekileyo kwaguli, iirejista nokutsha iinukatha. Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa kwexabiso elisezantsi kwezixhobo, izinto nendalo. Xela ngokulahleka / ukonakala. Qondise aze ulumke abaNursing ababhalisiweyo, abaNursing abantu nama-CHW. Phumeza ulandele iinkqubo ezibalulekileyo njengoko kumiselwe ngemigaqo ye-Ideal Clinic. Nciphisa ingozi yokwalathwa ngokusebenzisa imigaqo ekliniki efanelekileyo. Yidia ngokuphumeza i-Ideal Clinic Realisation Status. Thatha inxaxheba kwinkqubo yokubakho ukuqinisekisa ukuphumeza iinkonzo ngo-24/7.

Implement standards, practices, criteria and indicators for quality nursing (quality of practice). Practice nursing and health care in accordance with the laws and regulations relevant to nursing and health care. Maintain a constructive working relationship with nursing and other stakeholders. Utilise human, material and physical resources efficiently and effectively. Provide comprehensive, antenatal, intrapartum and postnatal care including deliveries and management of obstetric emergencies. Promote patient-centered care to reduce complaints, PSIs and waiting times. Participate in outreach services and community health education. Support NHI and PHC re-engineering initiatives in the rural community. Work with CHWs and other stakeholders to improve access in rural areas. Maintain accurate patient records, registers and data capturing. Ensure cost-effective use of equipment, stock and resources. Report losses/damages. Supervise and mentor Enrolled Nurses, Staff Nurses and CHWs. Implement and monitor priority programmes as per Ideal Clinic standards. Reduce risk of litigation by applying correct clinical protocols. Isigaba 3: Okungenani eminyakeni engu-20 yokuhlakanipha / eyaziwayo ezenyangweni emva kokubhalisa njengomogulidingi ochwepheshe ne-SANC ezenyangweni ezenjwayelekile. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Ukuqeqesha kanye Nezakhono Eidingekayo: Ulwazi lwenqubo nezinqubo zokunakekelwa kwezonyango, izimiso zezonyango, kanye nezinye izikhungo ezomthetho ezihlobene. Amakhono okuxhumana ahle. Amakhono okubhala imibiko. Amakhono okukhuthaza. Amakhono okuhlanganisa. Amakhano okuxhumana. Amakhono okuxhumana nalabo abakude. Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga. Ukuqulwa Kolwazi. Ukuqulwa Kwezinkomba. Ukucubungula futhi uhlele. Ukusebenzisa Ikhompyutha.
zu.duties: Nikela izinkomba nezinhlelo zokusebenzisa uhlelo lokunakekelwa kwezonyango (izenzakalo ezenzwayo/ukunakekelwa kwemiguli okuhle. Sebenziza izinga, izinqubo, izindinganiso nezinkomba zokunakekelwa kwezonyango okuhle (izinga lenkqubo). Yenza ukunakekelwa kwezonyango kanye nezempilo ngokwemithetho nezimiso ezihlobene nezonyango nezempilo. Gcina isiqu sokusebenza esakhiwo ezomphakathi kubaguli nabanye abahlanganyeli. Sebenzisa izinsizakusebenza zabantu, izinto nezinto eziyisiqusemu ngokusebenza kahle nangempumelelo. Hlinzeka ngokunakekelwa okuphelele, ngaphambi kokubeletha, ngesikhathi sokubeletha, nangemva kokubeletha okuhlanganisa nokubeletha nokuphatha izimo eziphuthumayo zokubeletha. Yenza ukuhlola okomzimba, ukuxilonga nokwelapha izinkinga ezenzwayo ezempilo ngokohla lwemisebenzi kanye nezinkomba ze-PHC. Phatha amahlelo e-Maternal, i-Child ne-Women's Health, i-EPI, i-Family Planning. Hlinzeka ngokuqulwa kwe-HIV, i-TB, i-STI kanye ne-NCD futhi qinisekisa ukulandela izinhloso ze-95/95/95. Hlukanisa imiguli, ethumele endaweni efanele, futhi ulandele labo abangayeki ukuzayo kanye nalabo abangeke batholakale. Gcotshisa izidingo zokuhlanzwa, ukudla, ukunyakaza nokukhipha emzimbeni kwemiguli.ilinganisa, ahumushe abhale ngokunembile imigondo yomzimba. Qinisekisa ukuthi izinyathelo zokuvikela ukuthelelana nokulawulwa zisetshenziswa. Khuthaza ukunakekelwa kwemiguli okugxile emigulini ukunciphisa izikhalazo, i-PSIs kanye nesikhathi salokulindela. Hlanganyela ezinsizakwenza ezikhaya nokuhlinzeka ngolwazi ngezempilo emphakathini. Sekela i-NHI kanye nezinhlela zokwakhiwa kabusha kwe-PHC emphakathini yasemakhaya. Sebenza nama-CHWs nabanye abahlanganyeli ukukhulisa ukungena ezindaweni zasemakhaya. Gcina ngokunembile amaphathwa emiguli, izibhalo kanye nokushicilelwa kolwazi. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okugcina izindleko kwezinsizakusebenza, izinkomba kanye nezinsizakusebenza. Bika ukulahleka/ukulimala. Qaphaza futhi ubeke esikhundleni abaguli abathunywe, abahlinzisiyo nama-CHWs. Sebenzisa futhi ulawule amahlelo abalulekile ngokwezinkomba ze-Ideal Clinic. Nciphisa ingozi yokuxoshwa ngokusebenzisa izinqubo ezigcinwe kahle zokwelashwa. Ahloba ekufezeni i-Ideal Clinic Realization Status.

xh.title: Ugqirha wezempilo oncedisa kumazimolweni (I-GENERAL Stream)
xh.summary: Kufunwa ugqirha wezempilo oncedisa kumazimolweni e-Vryheid District Hospital, kunika umvuzo kuzo zonke iinqanaba ezintathu ezahlukeneyo ngenzubavu ethi ibandakanya uncedo wezempilo kunye nenzuzo yokuhlala.
xh.requirements: I-Diploma / I-Degree ye-B yokunyanga okanye isifundo esingana neso esivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengogqirha wezempilo oncedisa kumazimolweni. Ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengogqirha wezempilo oncedisa. Iresipi yamanje ye-SANC. I-Grade 1: Akukho nqanaba lolu hlobo. I-Grade 2: Ubuncinane beminyaka elingu-10 yohlobo lolu hlobo olulungileyo kwinkqubo yokunyanga emva kokubhaliswa njengoGqirha wezempilo ecelwa kwi-SANC kwingcinga ngokubanzi. I-Grade 3: Ubuncinane beminyaka elingu-20 yohlobo lolu hlobo olulungileyo kwinkqubo yokunyanga emva kokubhaliswa njengoGqirha wezempilo ecelwa kwi-SANC kwingcinga ngokubanzi. Ulwazi, Amandla, Uqeqesho namaphuzu abalulekileyo: Ulwazi ngemiba yokunyanga ngezicwangciso ezahlukeneyo, imithetho yezempilo nokuqonda eminye imithetho. Amandla okunxibelelana. Amandla okubhala iingxelo. Amandla okunceda. Amandla okulawula. Amandla okunxibelelana nabantu. Amandla okusebenza ngokwe-intanethi. Amandla okusombulula iingxaki. Ulawulo lolwazi. Ulawulo lolwazi. Ukuqamba nokuhlela. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha.
xh.duties: Nikezela izikhokelo nenkululeko kokuqhayiselwa kwenkqubo yokunyanga (inkqubo yokunyanga/ukhathalelo lomntu olungumlenze olusondeleyo. Qhayisa izigqibo, iinkqubo, iinkqubo zokuqamba nemiqondiso yekhwalithi yokunyanga (ikhwalithi yenkqubo yokunyanga). Yenza ukunyanga nokhathalelo lokhathalelo lweempilo ngokwemithetho nemigaqo ephathelene nokunyanga nokhathalelo lweempilo. Gcina ubudlelwane obunomsitho bokusebenza nabantu abanyanga nakunabanye abathabath' inxaxheba. Sebenzisa abantu, izixhobo namathuba okuzibonelela ngokuchanekileyo nangempumelelo. Nikezela ukhathalelo olubhekisa konke, phambi kokuzalwa, ngexesha lokuzalwa nangemva kokuzalwa kuquka nokubonelela nokulawula iimeko ezibungela inyanga. Yenza iindlela zokuvavanya umzimba, ukuqonda nokunyanga iingxaki ezixhaphakileyo ekuqhubeni impilo ngokwemigaqo yokusebenza kunye nemigaqo ye-PHC. Lawula iinkqubo zeMaternal, Child and Women's Health, EPI, Family Planning. Nikezela ulawulo lwe-HIV, TB, STI and NCD, ukuqinisekisa ukuzithoba ngokwemigaqo yamanani angu-95/95/95. Hlula abagulayo bathunyelwe ngokufanelekileyo, ulandele abalahlekileyo nalabo abangenangxaki. Gcinela ukhathalelo lwegumbi lokuhamba, ukutya, ukusetyenziswa kolungelelwano. Linganisela, ukuqonda ukubhala ngokuchanekileyo. Qinisekisa ukulwa nokungalwa ngendalo. Phakamisa ukhathalelo lwegumbi lokuhamba, ukutya, ukutshintsha ukubeka umntu ngokwakhe. Qinisekisa izigqibo zokuthintela ukutshintshelwa kolwazi. Thatha inxaxheba kwiinkonzo ezithunyelwa abantu basemaphandleni ngokwemigaqo. Yekela iindlela ezinceda ekuphuculeni ukhathalelo. Gcina amagama abagulayo, iindlela ezahlukeneyo nemiqondiso ngokuchanekileyo. Qinisekisa amaxesha okusebenza. Phatha nokulawula abantu abangabasebenzi abangangeni. Sebenzela inkqubo ngokwekhalenda yokuphucula imozulu. Thatha inxaxheba ekusebenzeni nasekuyaleleni ukusuka kumagumbi okuhamba ukuya kwabanye. Thatha inxaxheba kwinkqubo yokuziphatha kubakho ubuchule. Thatha inxaxheba ekusebenzeni nasekukhuthazeni iindlela ezintsha zokuqonda imiba engathathi ngxaxheba. Yekela iindlela zokulawula ezingathathi ngxaxheba. Zama ukufunda iindlela ezintsha zokusebenza ezifana ne-95/95/95. Phatha izigulana, ngokomthetho we-Ideal Clinic. Qikelela kwaye ulawule izicwangciso eziphambili ngokomthetho we-Ideal Clinic. Nciphisa ingozi yokuba kubekho izigqibo ezingezanga ngokusetyenziswa kwemigaqo yokunyanga. Yekela ekufezekiseni isikhundla se-Ideal Clinic Realization Status.

jobs.title: Profesional Nurse (GENERAL Stream) with Midwifery
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R337 359 - R391 515 per annum Grade 2: R411 978 - R478 116 per annum Grade 3: R495 423 - R625 704 per annum Other Benefits: Medical Aid – Optional, Housing Allowance - Employee must meet prescribed requirements, 13th Cheque and 12% rural allowance.
jobs.summary: Professional nurse with midwifery needed at Vryheid District Hospital to supervise nursing care and implement quality patient care standards.
jobs.requirements: Diploma / B Degree in nursing or equivalent qualification that allows registration with the SANC as a Professional Nurse with Midwifery. Registration with SANC as Professional Nurse with Midwifery. Current SANC receipt. Grade 1: No experience. Grade 2: A minimum of 10 years appropriate /recognizable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with SANC in general nursing. Grade 3: A minimum of 20 years appropriate /recognizable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with SANC in general nursing. Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competences Required: Knowledge of nursing care processes and procedures, nursing statutes, and other relevant legal frameworks. Good communication skills. Report writing skills. Facilitation skills. Coordination skills. Liaison skills. Networking skills. Problem solving skills. Information Management. Knowledge Management. Planning and organizing. Computer Literacy.
jobs.duties: Provide directions and supervision for the implementation of the nursing plan (clinical practice/quality patient care. Implement standards, practices, criteria and indicators for quality nursing (quality of practice). Practice nursing and health care in accordance with the laws and regulations relevant to nursing and health care. Maintain a constructive working relationship with nursing and other stakeholders. Utilise human, material and physical resources efficiently and effectively. Provide comprehensive, antenatal, intrapartum and postnatal care including deliveries and management of obstetric emergencies. Perform physical assessments, diagnose and treat common health problems in line with scope of practice and PHC guidelines. Manage Maternal, Child and Women’s Health programmes, EPI, Family Planning. Provide HIV, TB, STI and NCD management and ensure adherence to 95/95/95 targets. Triage patients, refer appropriately, and follow up on defaulters and untraceable clients. Maintain patient hygiene, nutrition, mobility and elimination needs. Measure, interpret and record vital signs accurately. Ensure infection prevention and control measures are implemented. Promote patient-centered care to reduce complaints, PSIs and waiting times. Participate in outreach services and community health education. Support NHI and PHC re-engineering initiatives in the rural community. Work with CHWs and other stakeholders to improve access in rural areas. Maintain accurate patient records, registers and data capturing. Ensure cost-effective use of equipment, stock and resources. Report losses/damages. Supervise and mentor Enrolled Nurses, Staff Nurses and CHWs. Implement and monitor priority programmes as per Ideal Clinic standards. Reduce risk of litigation by applying correct clinical protocols. Contribute to achieving Ideal Clinic Realization Status.
jobs.enquiries: Ms. ATS Sibiya Tel No: (034) 982 2111, Ext. 4692
