af.title: Profesionele Verpleegkundige (ALGEMENE Stroom) met Verloskunde
af.summary: Profesionele verpleegkundige met verloskunde benodig by Vryheid Distrikshospitaal om verpleegsorg te toesien en gehalte pasiëntesorgstandaarde te implementeer.
af.requirements: Diploma / B-graad in verpleegkunde of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die SANC as 'n Profesionele Verpleegkundige met Verloskunde toelaat. Registrasie by SANC as Profesionele Verpleegkundige met Verloskunde. Huidige SANC-kwitansie. Graad 1: Geen ervaring. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as Profesionele Verpleegkundige by SANC in algemene verpleging. Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 20 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as Profesionele Verpleegkundige by SANC in algemene verpleging. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdhede Vereis: Kennis van verpleegsorgprosesse en -prosedures, verpleegstatute, en ander tersaaklike regsrames. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede. Verslagdoeningsvaardighede. Fasiliteringsvaardighede. Koördineringsvaardighede. Skakelingsvaardighede. Netwerkvaardighede. Probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Inligtingbestuur. Kennisbestuur. Beplanning en organisering. Rekenaarvaardigheid.
af.duties: Verskaf rigting en toesig vir die implementering van die verpleegplan (kliniese praktyk/gehalte pasiëntesorg. Implementeer standaarde, praktyke, kriteria en aanwysers vir gehalteverpleging (gehalte van praktyk). Beoefen verpleging en gesondheidsorg in ooreenstemming met die wette en regulasies tersaaklik tot verpleging en gesondheidsorg. Onderhou 'n konstruktiewe werksverhouding met verpleging en ander belanghebbendes. Benut menslike, materiële en fisiese hulpbronne doeltreffend en effektief. Verskaf omvattende, antenatale, intrapartum en postnatale sorg insluitend bevallings en bestuur van verloskundige noodgevalle. Voer fisiese assessments uit, diagnoseer en behandel algemene gesondheidsprobleme in ooreenstemming met die omvang van praktyk en PHC-riglyne. Bestuur Maternale-, Kind- en Vrouegesondheidsprogramme, EPI, Gesinsbeplanning. Verskaf HIV-, TB-, STI- en NCD-bestuur en verseker nakoming van 95/95/95-teikens. Triage pasiënte, verwys toepaslik, en volg standaardbrekers en onnaspeurbare kliënte op. Onderhou pasiënthigiëne, voeding, mobiliteit en eliminasiebehoeftes. Meet, interpreteer en rekord vitale tekens akkurat. Verseker infeksievoorkoming en -beheermaatreëls geïmplementeer word. Bevorder pasiëntgesentreerde sorg om klagtes, PSIs en wagtye te verminder. Neem deel aan uitreikdienste en gemeenskapsgesondheidsopvoeding. Ondersteun NHI- en PHC-heringenieurstrewes in die landelike gemeenskap. Werk met CHWs en ander belanghebbendes om toegang in landelike gebiede te verbeter. Onderhou akkurate pasiëntrekords, registers en data vaslegging. Verseker koste-effektiewe gebruik van toerusting, voorraad en hulpbronne. Rapporteer verliese/skade. Toesien en mentor Ingeskrewe Verpleegkundiges, Personeelverpleegkundiges en CHWs. Implementeer en monitor prioriteitsprogramme volgens Ideal Clinic-standaarde. Verminder risiko van litigasie deur korrekte kliniese protokolle toe te pas. Dra by tot bereiking van Ideal Clinic Realization Status.

zu.title: Unesi Ochwepheshe (Isiqhingi Esijwayelekile) one-Obstetrics
zu.summary: Kudingeka unesi ochwepheshe one-obstetrics esibhedlela i-Vryheid District Hospital ukuze alawule ukunakekelwa kwanesi futhi asebenzise amazinga okunakekela amagula angcono.
zu.requirements: I-Diploma / I-Degree ye-B ekuhanisweni noma izifundo ezimbalivane ezivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengenesi ochwepheshe one-obstetrics. Ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengenesi ochwepheshe one-obstetrics. Isipeshadi samanje se-SANC. I-Grade 1: Akukho mkh phethwa. I-Grade 2: Okuncane kakhulu iminyaka engu-10 yokuh phethwa okufanele/okubonakalayo ekuhanisweni emva kokubhaliswa njengenesi ochwepheshe kwi-SANC ekuhanisweni kwesijwayelekile. I-Grade 3: Okuncane kakhulu iminyaka engu-20 yokuh phethwa okufanele/okubonakalayo ekuhanisweni emva kokubhaliswa njengenesi ochwepheshe kwi-SANC ekuhanisweni kwesijawayelekile. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Ukuqeqeshwa kanye namakhono afunekayo: Ulwazi ngezenzo nezingqubo zokunakekelwa kwanesi, izimiso zokuhambisa inesi, kanye nezinye izakhiwo zomthetho ezihlobene. Amakhono okuxhumana anhle. Amakhono okubhala imibiko. Amakhono okukhuthaza. Amakhano okuhlela. Amakhano okuxhumana nabantu. Amakhono okwakha izinhlangano. Amakhano okuxazwa izinkinga. Ukuqinisekiswa kolwazi. Ukuphathwa kolwazi. Ukuhlela kanye nokuhlela. Ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha.
zu.duties: Nika izinqondiso futhi ulawule ukusebenzisa iplani yokunakekelwa kwanesi (umkhankaso wesiko/ukunakekela amagula ngcono. Sebenzisa amazinga, izenzo, izinkomba kanye nezinkomba zokunakekelwa kwanesi okuhle (ikhwalithi yokusebenza). Hambisa inesi kanye nenhlalakahle ngokuvumelana nomthetho nezimiso ezihlobene nokuhanisa nenhlalakahle. Gcina ubudlelwano bokusebenza obuhle nabanesi kanye nabanye abahlanganyeli. Sebenzisa izinsizakusebenza zabantu, izinto kanye nezinto ezingamahhala ngokuphumelelayo nangokusebenza kahle. Nikeza ukunakekelwa okuphelele, ngaphambi kokubeletha, ngesikhathi sokubeletha nangemva kokubeletha okuhlanganisa ukubeletha kanye nokuphathwa kwezimpilo eziphuthumayo zokubeletha. Yenza ukuhlolwa komzimba, uhlole futhi uphathwe izinkinga ezijwayelekile zempilo ngokuvumelana nomkhawula wokusebenza kanye nokuqondiswa yi-PHC. Phatha amaphulo eNhlonhloko, lezo Zingane nakwoMama, i-EPI, kanye ne-Planning Yomndeni. Nikeza ukuphathwa kwe-HIV, i-TB, i-STI kanye ne-NCD futhi uqinisekise ukulandelwa kokuhlose ngu-95/95/95. Hlukanisa amagula ngokubaluleka, wanikezele kahle, futhi ulandele abangayeki ukuya esibhedlela kanye nabakhashuniwe. Ggiene, ukudla, ukunyakaza kanye nezingidingo zokukhipha igazi kwagula. Linganisa, humusha futhi ubhale izinkomba zempilo ngokunembile. Qinisekisa ukuthi izinyathelo zokuqinisekisa nokulwa izifo ziyasebenza. Khuthaza ukunakekela igula ngokugxila kugula ukuze kweh lwezikhungelo, ama-PSIs kanye nesikhathi sokulinda. Hlanganyela ekuqinisekiseni izinsizakusebenza komphakathi kanye nokuqeqeshwa kwempilo yomphakathi. Sekela i-NHI kanye nokuqakuliswa kabusha kwe-PHC emhlabeni omlhovu. Sebenzisana nama-CHWs kanye nabanye abahlanganyeli ukuze kube khona ukufinyelela kalula emawonke amakhaya. Gcina ukubhala kahle amaphathwa, amandla kanye nokungenisa idatha. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okuphelele izilekeleli, isitoko kanye nezinsizakusebenza. Mbika ukulahlekel/ukulimeka. Lawula kwaye uhlole ama-Enrolled Nurses, ama-Staff Nurses nama-CHWs. Sebenzisa futhi ulawule amaphulo abalulekile ngokwezinhlelo ze-Ideal Clinic. Nciphisa ingozi yokuxakwa emthethweni ngokusebenzisa ama-protocols okuhlola okufanele. Siza ekufezeni Isimo sokufeza i-Ideal Clinic Realization.

xh.title: Umongikazi oGqithisiweyo (iNqanaba eliQhelekileyo) onobuNokhwekazi bokuzala
xh.summary: Kufunekwa umongikazi oGqithisiweyo onobuNokhwekazi bokuzala eVryheid District Hospital ukuba alawule ukunyuka komngeni wokunikelwa kokhathalelo lokhathalelo lwamakhasiwe wokuvelisa amanqanaba akhoyo okhathalelo lwamakhasiwe.
xh.requirements: Diploma / B Degree in nursing okanye isifundo esithe ngqo esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-SANC njengoMongikazi oGqithisiweyo onobuNokhwekazi bokuzala. Ukubhalisa kwi-SANC njengoMongikazi oGqithisiweyo onobuNokhwekazi bokuzala. Iresiti yangoku ye-SANC. Inqanaba 1: Akukho nako nkqubo yokubakho kwaye abanakho ukuhlazi. Inqanaba 2: Ubuncinane beminyaka eli-10 yamava afanelekileyo / aqatshiweyo emngeni wokunikelwa kokhathalelo emva kokubhalisa njengoMongikazi oGqithisiweyo kwi-SANC kwinkqubo yemikhathi yamakhasiwe wokunikelwa. Inqanaba 3: Ubuncinane beminyaka eli-20 yamava afanelekileyo / aqatshiweyo emngeni wokunikelwa kokhathalelo emva kokubhalisa njengoMongikazi oGqithisiweyo kwi-SANC kwinkqubo yemikhathi yamakhasiwe wokunikelwa. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Uqeqesho namaNqanaba azelelwayo afunekayo: Ulwazi ngenkqubo yemikhathi yamakhasiwe wokunikelwa kwakunye nemithetho yemikhathi yamakhasiwe wokunikelwa, izibhalo zemithetho yamakhasiwe, nakwezinye iinkqubo zomthetho ezifanelekileyo. Amakhono amaninzi wokudibana nokubonakaliswa kwento. Amakhono wokubhala iinkcukacha. Amakhono okubonelela. Amakhono okuqamba. Amakhono wokudibana nabantu. Amakhono wokusebenza ngokudibana kwamanye amakhosi. Amakhono okusombulula iingxaki. Ulawulo lolwazi. Ulawulo ngenkqubo yolwazi. Ukulungiselela nokuqamba. Ulwazi lwenkqubo yekhompyutha.
xh.duties: Nika iinkqubo nokulawula ukusetyenziswa kwenkqubo yemikhathi yamakhasiwe (ukusebenza / ukhathalelo oluqinileyo lokhathalelo lwamakhasiwe. Zisebenzise iinkqubo, iinkqubo, iinkqubo nemigangatho yokunikelwa kwakhona kokhathalelo oluqinileyo (ikhwalithi yokusebenza). Sebenza imikhathi yamakhasiwe wokunikelwa nokhathalelo lokhathalelo ngokuvumelana nemithetho nemigangatho ephathelene nomngeni wokunikelwa nokhathalelo lokhathalelo. Gcina ubudlelwane obusebenzayo obulungileyo nomngeni wokunikelwa nakunye nabanye abathintekayo. Sebenzisa ngokuchanekileyo nangempumelelo abantu, izixhobo nethafa elingokomzimba. Bonelela ngokhathalelo oluqinileyo, lokhathalelo lwaphambi kokwethuka, ngesikhathi sokubeleka nangemva kokubeleka kuquka nokubonelela ngokuzala ukuphatha iingxaki ezibangelwa ukutshatyalaliswa kwethumba. Yenza ikuvo lokomzimba, uxilonge kwaye uphathise iingxaki ezixhaphakileyo zempilo ngokuvumelana nommandla wokusebenza nemiqathango ye-PHC. Lawula iinkqubo zeMaternal, Child and Women's Health, i-EPI, neFamily Planning. Bonelela ngokulawula i-HIV, i-TB, i-STI ne-NCD kwaye uqinisekise ukwamkelwa kumanqanaba angu-95/95/95. Hlulahlula abakhwelwa kukhathalelo, ukuqonda ngokufanelekileyo, kwaye ulandele abanakho ukusilela nokungabikho bakhwele. Gcina ukhathalelo lokhathalelo lokhathalelo lokhathalelo, ukutya, ukunyuka nokususwa kokuchithwa emzimbeni. Linganisa, chaza kwaye ubhale ngokuchanekileyo iimpawu ezibalulekileyo zempilo. Qinisekisa ukuba kusebenziwa iinkqubo zokuthintela nokulawula iintsholongwane. Khuthaza ukhathalelo olujolise kumakhwele ukunciphisa iingxaki, i-PSI nokulindwa. Thatha inxaxheba kwiinkqubo zokufikelela kwabahlali nakwizikolo zokukhathalela abahlali. Sekela i-NHI ne-PHC ekuqaleni iinkqubo zokwakhiwa kwamakhaya omzi kumakhaya amakhaya. Sebenza nama-CHW nabanye abathintekayo ukuze kulunge ukufikelela kwamakhaya amakhaya. Gcina ngokuchanekileyo iinkcukacha zabakhwelwa kukhathalelo, izikholodo nokuqokelela iinkcukacha. Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa ngokuchanekileyo kwezixhobo, izinto namanqwaba. Chaza ngokulahleka/ukonakala. Lawula kwaye uncede abaNgikazi abaBhaliweyo, abaNgikazi beKhompyutha nama-CHW. Sebenzisa kwaye ulandele iinkqubo eziphambili ngokuvumelana namagqabantshintshi e-Ideal Clinic. Nciphisa ingozi yemithetho yokubuyiswa ngokusebenzisa iinkqubo zokusebenza ezichanekileyo. Yedisa ekufezweni kwe-Ideal Clinic Realization Status.

Ulwazi, Amakhono, uQeqesho kunye namakhono afunekayo: Ulwazi ngamachokoza kunye neenkqubo zolunyango lomongikazi,imizolo yomongikazi, nolunye ulwalamano lomthetho ofanelekileyo njengalawa: Umthetho wokuNceda; Umthetho wezeMphefumlo; Umthetho wezaMpilo noKhuseleko koMsebenzi; IMali yamaLungelo eSigulagula; Imigaqo yeBatho Pele; Imigaqo yoMlambo woLuntu; Umthetho weMiba yeziBhalo; iKhowudi yoHlahlo-lwazi nendlela yokwenza. Iindlela zoNyango lwezinkinga, njl. Amakhono omgaqo wokunxibelelana Amakhono ombhalo osisiseko. Ukukwazi ukusebenza njengexenye yeqela. Amakhono obudlelwane nabantu abasiseko. Amakhono okulawula okusisiseko.
xh.duties: Nika inyango olukhuselekileyo, lunebulungisa nolunemgangatho lomongikazi, lwazi ulimo lwempilo yamagula uze uwatshinge ngokukhawuleza uncede ngemisebenzi yemihla ngemihla xa kufuneka Nikela namageza ngaphakathi kommandla wakho wensebenzo Qwalasela imiphumela ecaliweyo uze uqwalasele ngokuchanileyo amageza anikiweyo. Landela iinkqubo zentsholongwane nemanyano engemigaqo. Gcina indawo ehlanziweyo nakhuselekileyo kumagula. Gcina ugqibo oluchanekileyo, olupheleleyo, nolwenziwa ngexesha elifanelekileyo lwerhekodi zamagula. Qwalasela ngenyathelo lomongikazi nempendulo yamagula. Nxibelelana ngokusebenzayo namagula, minduli nesebe lonyango olunamabala amaninji. Thatha inxaxheba kokuhanahaniswa kweekhompyutha namanqanaba eqela. Uvimba iingozi nabezemidlalo, iingenelo nemiba emibi. Landela iinkqubo zokhuseleko uze uncede ngamanyathelo okuphucula umgangatho. Gcina imfihleko yamagula namazingaba amangatshatyo. Bonisa ukuziphatha ngokobungcali, ukungafiki ngesikhathi nokuziphendulela. Zithathe inxaxheba kwindlela zoqeqesho nokuqeqeshwa esikhundleni.

jobs.title: Nursing Assistant
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R181 230 – R207 225 per annum Grade 2: R211 401 – R239 922 per annum Grade 3: R249 141 – R310 890 per annum Other Benefits: 13th Cheque/ Service Bonus Medical Aid (Optional) Homeowners Allowance: Employee must meet prescribed requirements.
jobs.summary: The Department of Health seeks a nursing assistant at Niemeyer Memorial Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal to support patient care, hygiene, nutrition and clinical procedures.
jobs.requirements: Grade 1: Experience: None Grade 2: Experience: A minimum of 10 years appropriate/ recognisable experience in nursing after registration as Enrolled Assistant with SANC. Grade 3: Experience A minimum of 20 years appropriate/ recognisable experience in nursing after registration as Enrolled Nursing Assistant with SANC. Grade12 or equivalent qualification, plus 01 year Nursing Assistant certificate that allows registration with South African Nursing Council (SANC 2026). Current registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC 2026) as a Nursing Assistant. Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competencies Required: Nursing Act. Health Act Occupational Health and Safety Act. Patients’ Rights Charter. Batho Pele principles. Public Service Regulations Labour Relations Acts. Disciplinary Code and Procedure Grievance Procedure, etc. Basic communication skills Basic writing skills. Ability to function part of a team. Basic interpersonal skills. Elementary facilitation skills.
jobs.duties: Ensure maintenance of patient hygiene. Facilitate nutritional status of patients. Facilitate the mobility of patients. Facilitate the elimination process. Measure, interpret and record vital signs. Operate all relevant apparatus and equipment. Assist professional nurses with clinical procedures (i.e. administering intramuscular injections). Preparation of patients for diagnostic and surgical procedures. Order stock and equipment in a cost effective manner. Report loss or damage immediately. To maintain the code of conduct as required in the Public Service and by the Professional Body. Seek learning opportunities, i.e. in-service training, courses. Assist patients with bathing, dressing, feeding and toileting. Help patient with mobility, positioning, and transferring safely. Ensure patients are comfortable and maintain their dignity. Observe and record changes in patient’s physical/ emotional condition to the supervisor. Measure and record vital signs. Follow infection prevention and control procedures. Practice proper hand hygiene and personal protective equipment. Maintain cleanliness of patient care areas and equipment (PPE) Ensure a safe environment by preventing falls and reporting hazards. Respond promptly to patient requests and emergencies. Record care provided accurately and promptly. Participate in shift handover and follow up instructions from supervisors. Maintain patient confidentiality. Demonstrate punctuality, reliability and professional behaviour. Report faulty equipment and ensure supplies are adequately.
jobs.applications: Please forward applications quoting reference number to: Human Resource Management, Niemeyer Memorial Hospital, Private Bag X1004, Utrecht, 2980 or email: Niemeyer.Intern@kznhealth.gov.za
jobs.notes: Directions to Candidates: The following documents must be submitted: Applications are not required to submit copies of qualification and other relevant document on application but must submit the Employment Form (Z83) and the detailed Curriculum Vitae. Certified copies of certificates and other relevant documents will only be requested from shortlisted candidate on or before the interviews. Therefore only shortlisted candidates for a post will be required to submit certified documents on or before the day of the interview following communication from HR. It will be expected candidate(s) to be available for interview process on a day, all shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The reference number must be indicated in the column provided on form Z83, e.g. Reference Number (NMH/THRT2026). Persons with disabilities should feel free to apply for the post. Failure to comply with the above instructions will disqualify the applicants. The appointment is subject to positive outcome obtained from the State Security Agency (SAA) to the following checks (criminal clearance, credit records, and citizenship), verification of Educational Qualifications by SAQA, verification of previous experience from Employers. Please note that due to a large number of applications received, applications will not be acknowledged, however, only the short-listed applicants will be advised of the outcome. Applicants are respectfully informed that, if no notification of appointment is received within 3 months after the closing date, they must accept that their applications were unsuccessful. Please note that no S&T payments will be considered for payment to candidates that are Invited for interview. (This Department is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer, whose aim is to promote representivity at all levels of different Occupational Categories in the Department). Employment Equity Target for both posts African Male.

af.title: Verpleegassistent
af.summary: Die departement van Gesondheid soek 'n verpleegassistent by Niemeyer Memorial Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal om pasiëntsorg, higiëne, voeding en kliniese prosedures te ondersteun.
af.requirements: Graad 1: Ervaring: Geen Graad 2: Ervaring: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar toepaslike/ herkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as Ingeskrewe Assistent by SANC. Graad 3: Ervaring 'n Minimum van 20 jaar toepaslike/ herkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as Ingeskrewe Verpleegassistent by SANC. Grade12 of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie, plus 01 jaar Verpleegassistent-sertifikaat wat registrasie by die Suid-Afrikaanse Verpleegraad (SANC 2026) moontlik maak. Huidige registrasie by die Suid-Afrikaanse Verpleegraad (SANC 2026) as 'n Verpleegassistent. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdhede Vereis: Nursing Act. Health Act Occupational Health and Safety Act. Patients' Rights Charter. Batho Pele-beginsels. Public Service Regulations Labour Relations Acts. Disiplinêre Kode en Prosedure Grievance Procedure, ens. Basiese kommunikasievaardighede Basiese skryfvaardighede. Vermoë om as deel van 'n span te funksioneer. Basige interpersoonlike vaardighede. Elementêre faciliteringsvaardighede.
af.duties: Verseker die handhawing van pasiënthigiëne. Fasiliteer die voedingsstatus van pasiënte. Fasiliteer die mobiliteit van pasiënte. Fasiliteer die eliminasieproses. Meet, interpreteer en rekord vitale tekens. Bedryf alle toepaslike apparate en toerusting. Bied professionele verpleegkundiges bystand met kliniese prosedures (d.w.s. die toedien van intramuskulêre inspuitings). Voorbereiding van pasiënte vir diagnostiese en chirurgiese prosedures. Bestel voorraad en toerusting op 'n kostedoeltreffende wyse. Rapporteer verlies of skade onmiddellik. Om die gedragskode soos vereis in die Public Service en deur die Professionele Liggaam te handhaaf. Soek leergeleenthede, d.w.s. in-diensopleiding, kursusse. Bied pasiënte bystand met bad, aantrek, voed en toiletbehoefte. Help pasiënte met mobiliteit, posisionering en veilige oordrag. Verseker dat pasiënte gemaklik is en hul waardigheid handhaaf. Neem veranderinge in pasiënt se fisiese/ emosionele toestand waar en rapporteer dit aan die toesighouer. Meet en rekord vitale tekens. Volg infeksievoorkoming en -beheerprosedures. Beoefen behoorlike handhigiëne en persoonlike beskermingsuitrusting. Handhaaf netheid van pasiëntversorgingsareas en toerusting (PPE) Verseker 'n veilige omgewing deur val te voorkom en gevaar te rapporteer. Reageer vinnig op pasiëntversoeke en noodgevalle. Rekord versorging wat verskaf is akkuraat en vinnig. Neem deel aan skiftoorhandiging en volg instruksies van toesighouers op. Handhaaf pasiëntvertroulikheid. Toon stiptheid, betroubaarheid en professionele gedrag. Rapporteer foutiewe toerusting en verseker dat voorrade voldoende is.

zu.title: Umhlengikazi Osizayo
zu.summary: Umnyango Wezempilo ufuna umhlengikazi osizayo eNiemeyer Memorial Hospital eKwaZulu-Natal ukuxhasa ukunakekelwa kwabaguli, ukuhlanzwa, ukudla kanye nemithelela yezokwelapha.
zu.requirements: Izinga 1: Isiphephelo: Akukho Izinga 2: Isiphephelo: Okungenani iminyaka engu-10 isiphephelo esifanele/ esihlonishkayo ekunakekelweni ngemva kokubhaliswa njengoMsizi Oqashiwe no-SANC. Izinga 3: Isiphephelo Okungenani iminyaka engu-20 isiphephelo esifanele/ esihlonishkayo ekunakekelweni ngemva kokubhaliswa njengoMsizi Wezokunakekela Oqashiwe no-SANC. Izinga 12 noma izifundo ezilinganayo, kanye nesitifiketi somnyaka we-01 somhlengikazi osizayo esivumela ukubhaliswa kwiNdikwe Yezokunakekela yaseNingizimu Afrika (SANC 2026). Ukubhalisa kwamanje neNdikwe Yezokunakekela yaseNingizimu Afrika (SANC 2026) njengomhlengikazi osizayo. Ulwazi, Amakhono, uQeqesho kanye namaQiniso Afunekayo: umthetho Wezokunakekela. Umthetho Wezempilo noMthetho Wezokuphila kanye Nokuphephela Emsebenzini. Ikheli lezamalungelo abaguli. Izimiso ze-Batho Pele. Imithetho Yesevisi Yomphakathi noMthetho Wobudlelwano Basebenzini. Ikhodi Yokuhlwayo kanye nokuHlelelwa kwezinkathazo, njll. Amandla okuxhumana abalulekile namandla okubhala abalulekile. Ikhono lokusebenza njengengxenye yethimba. Amandla abalulekile okuxhumana nabantu. Amandla abalulekile okukhuthaza. Faka izinkomba ezibalulekile futhi uqaphele ukuthi zishintshwe kanjani.
zu.duties: Qinisekisa ukuthi kugcinwa ukuhlanzwa komuntu ofakwe esibhedlela. Khuthaza isimo sokudla kwabaguli. Khuthaza ukunyakaza kwabaguli. Khuthaza inqubo yokukhipha emzimbeni. Pima, chaza futhi ubhale izinkomba eziyisisekelo zempilo. Sebenzisa wonke amalebhu nezinsiza ezifanele. Siza oqeqeshi bomakekela ngemithelela yezokwelapha (okuyilowo. ukunikela imijovo emathambo). Ilungiselela abaguli bagenze izinkomba futhi bazakelwe ukwelashwa. Thumela izimpahla nezinsiza ngendlela engakwazi ukonga imali. Bika ukulahlekelwa noma ukonakala ngokushesha. Ukugcina ikhodi yokuziphatha njengokuze kudingeka kwiSevisi Yomphakathi futhi ngokomzimba ochaziwe. Funise ithuba lokufunda, okuyilowo. uqeqesho emsebenzini, izifundo. Siza abaguli ngokuwasha, ukugqoka, ukondla nokuya endaweni yokuphumula. Siza abaguli ukuthi bahambahambise, ukubekwa endaweni efanele, nokushintshwa babe sekuhlakanipha. Qinisekisa ukuthi abaguli bayakhululeka futhi kugcinwe isithunywa sabo. Buka futhi ubhale izinguquko ezisemzimbeni/ ezenzakalo zomuntu ofakwe esibhedlela kumqondisi. Pima ubhale izinkomba ezibalulekile zempilo. Landela imithetho yokuvikela nokulawula ukutheleleka. Yenza ukugeza izandla ngendlela efanele futhi usebenzise izinsiza zokuvikela. Gcina ukuhlanzwa kwezindawo zokunakekelwa kanye nezinsiza (PPE) Qinisekisa isimo esiphepha ngokuvikela ukuwa kanye nokubika izengozi. Phendula ngokushesha kumacala abaguli kanye nezimo eziphuthumayo. Bhale ngokucophelela futhi ngokushesha ukunakekelwa okunikezwe abaguli. Thatha inxaxheba ekushintshweni kwabaguli futhi ulandele imiyalelo evela kubaphathi. Gcina isimfihlo sabaguli. Khombisa ukufika ngasikhathi nokuqinisekile futhi uziphathe ngendlela ehloniphekile. Bika izinsiza ezingasebenzi kahle futhi uqinisekise ukuthi zitholakala ngokwanele.

xh.title: Umncedi Wezilo
xh.summary: Isebe lezeMpilo lufuna umncedi wezilo eNiemeyer Memorial Hospital eKwaZulu-Natal ukuxhasa ukunakekelwa kweguli, ukucocekileyo, ukutya nenkqubo yezorhwebo.
xh.requirements: Inqanaba 1: Isipilingo: Akukho Inqanaba 2: Isipilingo: Ubuncinane beminyaka yam-10 efanelekileyo/ evakalayo isipilingo ekuqhwesweni emva kokuqeshwa njengeKhaladi neNgcinezelo kunye neSANC. Inqanaba 3: Isipilingo Ubuncinane beminyaka yam-20 efanelekileyo/ evakalayo isipilingo ekuqhwesweni emva kokuqeshwa njengoMncedi Wezilo oneSANC. Inqanaba 12 okanye isidanga esifanayo, kwaye kunyuse isatifikhethe yoNyaka we-1 yoMncedi Wezilo evumela ukuqeshwa kunye neSouth African Nursing Council (SANC 2026). Ukuqeshwa kwangoku kunye neSouth African Nursing Council (SANC 2026) njengoMncedi Wezilo. Ulwazi, Amandla, uQeqesho nezakhono Efunekayo: Umthetho Wezilo. Umthetho WezeMpilo noMthetho woKhuseleko lweMisebenzi. Iqela lamalungelo eGuli. Iinkqubo zeBatho Pele. Imithetho yoBucukulu bwaMmandla. Umthetho weePelelabantu. Ikhodi yePaziso nendlela yenze ngxaxeleko, iNkqubo yePaziso, okunye. Amandla okuThetha oSiseko. Amandla okuBhala oSiseko. Amandla okusebenza njengesiqendu seqela. Amandla oluHlobo oSiseko phakathi kwabantu. Amandla okuQhuba iincomo ezingundoqo.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa ukuqhubeka kokucocekileyo kweguli. Phuhlisa isimo sokutya kwamaguli. Phuhlisa intshukumo yamaguli. Phuhlisa inkqubo yokukhupha. Linganisa, hlatha aze abhalwe izalathiso eziphathwayo. Qhatha zonke iisixhobo nezinto ezibalulekileyo. Ncedisa ooqhwejwana bezilo ngemisebenzi yezorhwebo (o.k.t. ukunikela iindawo ezingaphakathi zomzimba). Lungiselela amaguli kwinkqubo yokuqhwesa nokwenza isifuzo. Odela isitokhwe nezixhobo ngendlela eguquguqukayo. Phawula ukulahleka okanye ukonakala ngoko nangoko. Ukugcina ikhodi yokuziphatha njengoko kufuneka kuBucukulu bwaMmandla naseKhaladini. Fumanisa ithuba lokufunda, o.k.t. uqeqesho ngaphakathi, iindonga. Ncedisa amaguli ngokuhlamba, ukugqoka, ukutya nokuya endlini yabantu. Nceda iguli ngokuhamba, ukumisa, nokudlulisela ngokhuselekileyo. Qinisekisa ukuba amaguli akhululekile aze agcine isithunzi sabo. Qaphula uze ubhale utshintsho kwime yomzimba/ yokuzifihla kwiguli kumlawuli. Linganisa uze ubhale izalathiso eziphathwayo. Landela inkqubo yokuthintela ukutshatyalaliswa nokulawula isifo. Zisebenzise ngokuchanekileyo ukuhlamba izandla nokuzigqoka izixhobo ezikhuselekileyo. Gcina ukucocekileyo kwindawo yokunakekela iguli nezixhobo (PPE). Qinisekisa indawo ekhuselekileyo ngokuthintela ukubhaqo nokuphawula iingozi. Phendula ngokukhawuleza kwiimfuno zamaguli kwaye njalo nakunobandla. Bhala ngokuchanekileyo nangokukhawuleza ukunakekelwa okunikiweyo. Thatha inxaxheba kokudlulisa isikhundla ulandele imiyalelo yomlawuli. Gcina iyimfihlo yeguli. Bonisa ukufika ngexesha, ukuthembeka nokuziphatha ngokwemveliso. Phawula izixhobo ezisabaleleyo uze uqinisekise ukuba izinto zaneliswe ngokwaneleyo.

jobs.title: Control Provincial Inspector
jobs.centre: Road Traffic Inspectorate: Ladysmith Region Ref No: DOT 134/2026
jobs.closing_date_text: 28 August 2026 (at 16h00). Applications received after the closing date and time will not be considered.
jobs.summary: Lead the Road Traffic Inspectorate in the Ladysmith region, coordinating law enforcement operations and stakeholder relations for the Department of Transport.
jobs.requirements: A relevant tertiary qualification (3 year Diploma/Degree in a Traffic / Management / Law field – NQF 6 or higher); plus A Basic Traffic Officer’s Diploma; plus Registered as a Traffic Officer; plus 3-5 years’ management experience in a Traffic Law Enforcement field; plus 7-10 years’ working experience in a Traffic Law Enforcement field; plus A valid driving licence (minimum code B); plus No criminal record. Knowledge, Skills and Competencies Required: Knowledge on how to manage the implementation of Public Transport and Traffic Law Enforcement policies and regulations. Knowledge of driver fitness inspections. Knowledge of vehicle fitness inspections. Knowledge on the completion of Law Enforcement documents. Knowledge of operator fitness inspections. Knowledge of investigations. Working knowledge of applicable legislations – Public transport and traffic environment. Records, resource and customer relationship management skills. Performance, finance and conflict management skills. Projects, time and self- management skills. Risk, change and public information management skills. Planning, organising and people management skills. Service delivery, communication and decision-making skills. Results and quality management skills. Problem solving, report writing and workplace relations skills. Conflict management, monitoring and evaluation and management skills. Results/quality management skills. Innovation/continuous improvement skills. Analytical, negotiation and innovative skills. Computer literacy.
jobs.duties: Provide effective and efficient leadership: Co-ordinate stakeholder relations with other state departments and Law Enforcement Agencies (LEAs). Provide strategic guidance and leadership to law enforcement officials. Evaluate the activities of the Regional/District Operational plans to ensure strategic alignment with the Strategic plan, budget statements and national and provincial strategies: Co-ordinate the development of standardised operational plans. Monitor and evaluate operational performance of the region to ensure continuous alignment and development. Develop and maintain corrective action on identified problem areas. Research and capture national and international traffic law enforcement best practice. Promote a holistic integrated management approach in terms of support and other functions. Create and facilitate an enabling environment between provincial and local government in respect of traffic law enforcement and ensure alignment across these spheres. Co-ordinate the collection and analysis of regional law enforcement statistics, conduct research, formulate policy and develop new strategies and models to improve service delivery: Ensure that environmental analysis of each centre is updated on an annual basis and reviewed on a quarterly basis. Develop a monitoring mechanism to co-ordinate law enforcement operations and statistics. Develop provincial policies in terms of operations, public transport, legislation, equipment and prosecutions. Provide strategic leadership and mentoring to regional/district role-players regarding strategies, developments and trends. Manage and co-ordinate human resource processes in the region/district. Manage and co-ordinate the budget process and utilisation of facilities, vehicles and equipment of the region/district: Monitor the budget of the region to prevent over/under spending on a monthly basis. Monitor the procurement and utilisation of equipment of and services provided to the centre. Ensure appropriate use of all facilities.

af.title: Beheer Provinciale Inspekteur
af.summary: Lood die Padverkeersinspektoraat in die Ladysmith-streek, koördineer wetstoepassingsbedrywighede en belanghebbende betrekkinge vir die Department of Transport.
af.requirements: 'n Relevante tersiêre kwalifikasie (3 jaar Diploma/Grade in 'n Verkeer / Bestuur / Regte-veld – NQF 6 of hoër); plus 'n Basiese Verkeersbeampte-diploma; plus Geregistreer as 'n Verkeersbeampte; plus 3-5 jaar se bestuurservaring in 'n Verkeerswetstoepassingsveld; plus 7-10 jaar se werkservaring in 'n Verkeerswetstoepassingsveld; plus 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie (minimum kode B); plus Geen misdryfrekord. Kennis, Vaardighede en Bevoegdhede Vereis: Kennis van hoe om die implementering van Openbare Vervoer- en Verkeerswetstoepassingsbeleide en -regulasies te bestuur. Kennis van bestuurdergeskiktheid-inspeksies. Kennis van voertuiggeskiktheid-inspeksies. Kennis oor die voltooiing van Wetstoepassingsdokumente. Kennis van operateurgeskiktheid-inspeksies. Kennis van ondersoeke. Werkende kennis van toepaslike wetgewing – Openbare vervoer- en verkeersomgewing. Rekord-, hulpbron- en kliëntverhoudingsbestuursvaardighede. Prestasie-, finansies- en konflikbestuursvaardighede. Projekte, tyd- en selfbestuursvaardighede. Risiko, verandering en openbare inligtingsbestuursvaardighede. Beplanning, organisering en mensebestuursvaardighede. Dienslewering, kommunikasie en besluitnemingsvaardighede. Resultate- en gehaltebestuursvaardighede. Probleemoplossing, verslag-skryf en werkplekverhoudingsvaardighede. Konflikbestuur, monitering en evaluering en bestuursvaardighede. Resultate/gehaltebestuursvaardighede. Innovering/deurlopende verbeteringsvaardighede. Analitiese, onderhandeling en innoverende vaardighede. Rekenaargeletterdheid.
af.duties: Verskaf doeltreffende en effektiewe leierskap: Koördineer belanghebbende betrekkinge met ander staatsdepartemente en Wetstoepassingsagentskappe (LEAs). Verskaf strategiese leiding en leierskap aan wetstoepassingsbeamptes. Evalueer die aktiwiteite van die Streek/Distrik Operasionele planne om strategiese belyning met die Strategiese plan, begrotingsverklarings en nasionale en provinsiale strategieë te verseker: Koördineer die ontwikkeling van gestandaardiseerde operasionele planne. Monitor en evalueer operasionele prestasie van die streek om deurlopende belyning en ontwikkeling te verseker. Ontwikkel en handhaaf korrektiewe optrede op geïdentifiseerde probleemareas. Navors en vang nasionale en internasionale verkeerswetstoepassingsbeste praktyke. Bevorder 'n holistiese geïntegreerde bestuursbenadering in terme van ondersteuning en ander funksies. Skep en fasiliteer 'n bemagtigende omgewing tussen provinsiale en plaaslike regering ten opsigte van verkeerswetstoepassing en verseker belyning oor hierdie sfere. Koördineer die versameling en ontleding van streeks-wetstoepassingsstatistieke, doen navorsing, formuleer beleid en ontwikkel nuwe strategieë en modelle om dienslewering te verbeter: Verseker dat omgewingsontleding van elke sentrum jaarliks bygewerk en kwartaalliks hersien word. Ontwikkel 'n moniteringsmeganisme om wetstoepassingsbedrywighede en statistieke te koördineer. Ontwikkel provinsiale beleide in terme van bedrywighede, openbare vervoer, wetgewing, toerusting en vervolging. Verskaf strategiese leierskap en mentorskap aan streeks-/distriksrolspelers ten opsigte van strategieë, ontwikkelings en tendense. Bestuur en koördineer menslike hulpbronprosesse in die streek/distrik. Bestuur en koördineer die begrotingsproses en benutting van fasiliteite, voertuie en toerusting van die streek/distrik: Monitor die begroting van die streek om oor/onderbesteding op 'n maandelikse basis te voorkom. Monitor die verkryging en benutting van toerusting en dienste verskaf aan die sentrum. Verseker toepaslike gebruik van alle fasiliteite.

zu.title: Control Provincial Inspector
zu.summary: Beka ihlo le-Iphathi Yokuhlola Ithrafikhi endaweni yakwa-Ladysmith, uhlela imisebenzi yokuphoqa umthetho kanye nobudlelwano nabahlanganyeli bahulumeni be-Department of Transport.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezidingekayo zemfundo ephakeme (I-Diploma/Degree yeminyaka eyi-3 kumthetho wezithuthi / ukuphathwa / omunye umthetho – NQF 6 noma ngaphezulu); kanye ne-Diploma Yesisekelo Yomphathi Wezithuthi; kanye nokubhaliswa njengomphathi wezithuthi; kanye neminyaka eyi-3-5 yokuqeqesha ekuqoqweni komthetho wezithuthi; kanye neminyaka eyi-7-10 yomsebenzi ekuqoqweni komthetho wezithuthi; kanye nelayisensi evumelekayo yokushayela (ikhowudi encane B); kanye nokungabi norekhodi lobugebengu. Ulwazi, amakhono namandla adingekayo: Ulwazi lokuphatha ukuqediswa kwemithetho yokuhamba kahle komphakathi kanye nemithelela yokuphoqa umthetho. Ulwazi ngokuqoqa ukuzwana kwabashayeli. Ulwazi ngokuqoqa ukuzwana kwezimoto. Ulwazi ngokugcwalisa amadokhumenti okuphoqa umthetho. Ulwazi ngokuqoqa ukuzwana kwezinhlanga ezihamba ngemoto. Ulwazi ngokuphenya. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngemithetho ephathelene nezithuthi – isimo sezithuthi somphakathi. Amakhono okuphatha amarekhodi, izinsiza nobudlelwano namakhasimende. Amakhono okuphatha ukusebenza, imali kanye nokuxazulula izingxabano. Amakhono okuphatha imisebenzi, isikhathi nokuziphatha. Amakhono okuphatha ubungozi, ushintsho kanye nolwazi lomphakathi. Amakhono okuhlela, ukuhlela kanye nokuphatha abantu. Amakhono okuletha izinsiza, ukuxhumana kanye nokuthatha izinqumo. Amakhono okuphatha imiphumela kanye nenhla. Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga, ukubhala imibiko nobudlelwano emsebenzini. Amakhono okuphatha izingxabano, ukuqapha kanye nokuhlola nokuphatha. Amakhono okuphatha imiphumela/inhla. Amakhono okusiza ekwakheni okusha nasekusengusweni. Amakhono okuhlaziya, ukuxoxisana nokwakha okusha. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngakhalamitha.
zu.duties: Nika ubuholo obusebenzayo nasefanelekile: Hlela ubudlelwano nabahlanganyeli kwezinye izigaba zikahulumeni namaphoyisa aqinisa umthetho. Nikeza ubuholo obubonwayo phambili nokuqondisa abaphathi bomthetho. Hlola imisebenzi yamaphulo okusebenza afakwe endaweni/esifundeni ukuze kuqinisekise ukuhambisana neplano eshoqo phambili, izinkulumo zebhajethi kanye namasu kazwelonke nasifundazweni: Hlela ukwakhiwa kwamaphulo okusebenza ajwayelekile. Qaphisa futhi uhlole ukusebenza kwendawo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuqhubeka kokuhambisana nentuthuko. Sakhi futhi ulondoloze isinyathelo esilungile kumapulo abonakalisiwe abenamaphutha. Phonza futhi ubambe izenzo ezinhle zokuphoqa umthetho kazwelonke nakwamanye amazwe. Khuthaza indlela yokuphatha ehlanganisiwe ngokuphelele mayelana nokwesekela kanye Neminye imisebenzi. Dala futhi wenze kube lula isimo phakathi kohulumeni wesifundazwe nasedolobheni ngokuphoqa umthetho wezithuthi futhi uqinisekise ukuhambisana kulezi zigaba. Hlela ukuqoqwa kanye nokucrectalisa izibalo zendawo zokuphoqa umthetho, wenze ucwaningo, sakhi imithetho futhi uthuthuke amasha amasu namamodela ukwengeza ukuletha izinsiza: Qinisekisa ukuthi uhlalutyo lwemvelo laso isikhungo libuyekezwa ngonyaka futhi lihlolwe njalo ngenyanga ezintathu. Buka isimiso sokuhlola ukuze uhle imisebenzi yokuqinisa umthetho nezibalo. Hlela imithetho yesifundazwe mayelana nemisebenzi, izithuthi zomphakathi, umthetho, amasokhaya kanye nezinsimbi ezinayeswe ngumthetho. Nikeza ubuholo obubonwayo phambili kanye nokulondoloza omdlali endaweni/esifundeni mayelana namasu, intuthuko kanye namatrend. Phatha futhi uhlela izinkulumo zezinsiza zabantu endaweni/esifundeni. Phatha futhi uhlele inqubo yebhajethi kanye nokusetshenziswa kwemihloba, izimoto nezinsiza zendawo/esifundazwe: Qaphisa ibhajethi yendawo ukugwema ukusebenzisa ngokweqile/okungekhona njalo ngenyanga. Qaphisa ukuthenga kanye nokusebenzisa izinsiza nezinsiza abanikeza isikhungo. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okufanele kwazo zonke izinto.

xh.title: Control Provincial Inspector
xh.summary: Nika urhulabo kuNgendaba yoKuhlola ukuHamba koluntu kwendawo yaseLadysmith, ukucotha imisebenzi yokusebenza komthetho kunye neziqu zeabaphathi kwiSebe lezoKuthutha.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esifanelekileyo sesikolo samabanga aphakamileyo (iidiploma/izidanga zeminyaka emi-3 kwinkundla yoKuHamba koluntu / yoLawulo / yoMthetho – NQF 6 okanye ngaphezulu); kunye neDiploma esisiseko yoMphathi woKuHamba koluntu; kunye nokuba ubhalisiwe njengoMphathi woKuHamba koluntu; kunye nemimiselo yeminyaka eyi-3-5 yokulawula kwindundla yoMthetho woKusebenza kuKuHamba koluntu; kunye nemimiselo yeminyaka eyi-7-10 yokusebenza kwindundla yoMthetho woKusebenza kuKuHamba koluntu; kunye nelayisenisi yokushayela esemthethweni (ikhowude encinane B); kunye nokungabi nolando lwenxeba. Ulwazi, Amandla namakhono aFunekayo: Ulwazi lokulawula ukusebenza kwezintluwo zoKuthutha kuLuntu kunye namacebo oMthetho woKusebenza kuKuHamba koluntu. Ulwazi ngokuhlola ulungelelwaniso kabashayeli. Ulwazi ngokuhlola ulungelelwaniso lwezithuthi. Ulwazi ngokugqiba amaxwebhu oMthetho woKusebenza. Ulwazi ngokuhlola ulungelelwaniso labasebenzisi. Ulwazi ngokuphonononga. Ulwazi olusebenzayo lwemithetho ethile – imo yokuKuthutha koluntu nokuhamba koluntu. Amandla okulawula iirekhodi, izixhobo nokuba ngabathengi. Amandla okusebenza, ezemali nokulawula iingxabano. Amandla okulawula amaphulo, ixesha nokuzilawula. Amandla okulawula ingozi, utshintsho nolwazi koluntu. Amandla okucwangcisa, ukuqamba ngokutsha nokulawula abantu. Amandla okuhambisa iinkonzo, okunxibelelana nokuthatha iigqibo. Amandla okulawula iziphumo nomgangatho. Amandla okusombulula iingxaki, ukubhala iirekhodi nokubambisana nasemsebenzini. Amandla okulawula iingxabano, okuhlola nokuhluza namandla okulawula. Amandla okulawula iziphumo/umgangatho. Amandla okuyila nokusondezela ngokuqhubeka. Amandla okuhlola, okuxoxisana nokuqamba ngokutsha. Ulwazi lokusebenzela ikhompyutha.
xh.duties: Nika urhulabo olusebenzayo nolusebenzisana kalula: Qamba ubudlelwane nabaphathi kolunye uwo kazwelonke kunye nama-Arhente oMthetho (LEAs). Nikezela ingqiqo yokuyila kurhulabo abaphathi bomthetho. Hlola imisebenzi yeNkqubo zoBomi bomNatha ukuqinisekisa ukuqamaniswa okuyilayo kuye kuNkqubo yoBomi bomNatha, izitatimende zemali kunye namacebo kazwelonke namaphondo: Lungelelisa usukelo lweNkqubo zoBomi bomNatha eziziingqiqo. Hlola kwaye uhlôle inkqubo yemisebenzi yommandla ukuqinisekisa ukuqamanisa nokusuka kuqhubeka nokusuka. Zenze kwaye zigcinwe izinyathelo zolungiso kumacandelo aphawulweyo ngengxaki. Phonononga kwaye uthathe amandla oqobo olutsha koluntu nabamanye amazwe ngokuhamba koluntu eNkqubo. Khuthaza indlela yokulawula equlathe kwaye ihlanganiswe ngokwemisebenzi yonikezelo neminye imisebenzi. Yila kwaye uvule imo yokwenza lula ubudlelwane phakathi kolurhulabo nakomasipala ngokuhamba koluntu kwaye uqinisekise ukuqamanisa ngale ndlela. Lungelelisa ukuqokelelwa nokuHlola iisitathistikhi zokuKuhamba komMthetho wommandla, wenze uphononongo, udlal’indlela malungelelwaniso kwaye usukele amacebo amaxa amasha namayilo ukusondezela ukunikwa kweenkonzo: Qinisekisa ukuba uHlolo lolwazi malungiselelwa ngokwemeko yawo ngamnye qho ngamnyaka kwaye luhloliwe qho kwiNye imibe. Yila iNkqubo yokuhlola ukuze ulungelelise imisebenzi yomthetho nisitathistikhi. Yila amacebo eNkqubo kazwelonke ngokwemisebenzi, uKuthutha koluntu, umthetho, izixhobo nokugweba. Nikezela urhulabo wokuqamba kwaye ulungise abadlali bengquango ngamacebo, usukelo namashishini. Lawula kwaye ulungelelise iinkqubo zamandla abantu kummandla/isifunda. Lawula kwaye ulungelelise iNkqubo yemali nokuSetyenziswa kwezithuba, izithuthi nezeSixhobo zommandla/isifunda: Hlola imali yommandla ukuthintela ukuTlaba/ukungalawuli kakuhle ukusebenzisa imali qho nyaka kwiNyanga. Hlola ukuSetyenziswa kokuthengwa kwezixhobo nezeSixhobo ezinikwa iNkqubo malunga nasemmandla. Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa ngokufanelekileyo kwezithuba zonke.

jobs.title: Chief Provincial Inspector
jobs.centre: Inkosi Mhlabunzima Maphumulo House, Pietermaritzburg: Traffic Compliance & Monitoring (RTI) Ref No: DOT 135/2026 (X2 Posts) Traffic Training College: Refresher Course Ref No: DOT 136/2026 (X1 Post)
jobs.closing_date_text: 28 August 2026 (at 16h00). Applications received after the closing date and time will not be considered.
jobs.summary: Chief Provincial Inspector positions in Pietermaritzburg overseeing traffic law enforcement operational plans, requiring a traffic officer diploma and supervisory experience.
jobs.requirements: A Senior Certificate / National Certificate (Vocational) NQF Level 4; plus A relevant tertiary qualification (3 year Diploma/Degree in a Traffic / Management / Law field – NQF 6); plus a Basic Traffic Officer’s Diploma; plus Registered as a Traffic Officer; plus 3-5 years’ supervisory experience in a Traffic Law Enforcement field; plus 7-10 years’ working experience in Traffic Law Enforcement field; plus All valid relevant driving licences (A and EC); plus No criminal record. Knowledge, Skills and Competencies Required: Extensive knowledge of Traffic Management policies and regulations. Knowledge of relevant legislations and traffic management regulations. Knowledge of vehicle inspections/impoundment. Knowledge of driving skills. Records and resource management skills. Customer relationship management skills. Planning, organising, leadership, controlling and monitoring skills. People Management skills. Service delivery, communication and decision-making skills. Results and quality management skills. Problem solving skills. Innovation/continuous improvement skills. Analytical skills. Computer literacy. Negotiation and initiative skills. Project management, mentoring and coaching skills.
jobs.duties: Manage the implementation of operational law enforcement plan: Complete and update environmental analysis to ensure that it is used as a base line for planning. Develop operational plan for station/centre based on provincial annual performance plan and ensure successful implementation. Plan and monitor the execution of projects relating to the implementation of the strategy/plan. Monthly monitoring of the annual performance plan targets. Communicate regularly with station/centre management and facilitate the development of and participation in a centre strategic/operational plan. Participate in integrated partnerships with local authorities. Ensure effective and efficient leadership: Co-ordinate stakeholder relations with other state departments and Law Enforcement Agencies (LEAs). Management of service delivery improvement: Manage administration systems. Implement administrative processes to ensure registers are inspected weekly. Ensure that statistics kept are correct, current and forwarded by due dates and monitored and made available at centres. Manage and ensure effective external community communication and liaise with local Community Police Forums. Ensure that Testing Centre Stations (TCS) are operating optimally. Ensure that prescribed Acts, Policies and Procedures of the Department are implemented and adhered to. Ensure that all the relevant records and registers thereof are filed properly and kept up to date at all times. Management of Human Resources: Manage grievances according to prescribed procedures. Facilitate at least one team building activity per quarter for the centre. Ensure that leave is utilized and managed according to the relevant policies and instructions. Develop and implement in-service training program and monitor formal training needs of the unit. Manage performance of staff. Financial Management: Monitor monthly expenditure and inspection reports from the Province and implement corrective action in problem areas. Regular budget control and management discussions as part of management meetings. Document overtime planning based on priorities. Participate in budget planning as required by the Province. Respond to requests from head office regarding outstanding financial queries within provided time limit. Ensure effective and efficient Asset Management: Monitor vehicle costs for station/centre vehicles (as per worksheet) and identify and monitor members involved in accidents and ensure that motor vehicle fleet is managed properly and that vehicles are in good running order. Ensure effective loss control measures are in place to address loss of firearms and other related equipment i.e. the relevant equipment that gets lost and put measures in place to deal with it. Manage assets as per inventories of station/centre.
jobs.applications: Applications/Address: Applicants are encouraged to apply for posts through the KZN online e-Recruitment system at www.kznonline.gov.za/kznjobs Applicants may also visit any one of our Designated Online Application Centres (DOACs) where our friendly staff will assist you with applying for jobs on the KZN online e-Recruitment system or receiving your hardcopy application. You can find the list of Designated Online Application Centres (DOACS) at www.kznonline.gov.za/kznjobs. Please note that applicants should only use one of the following methods when applying for a post: either through the online e-Recruitment system or submit a hardcopy application as directed. Forward your application, quoting the relevant reference number to: Recruitment & Selection Section, Human Resource Administration Directorate, Private Bag X9043, Pietermaritzburg, 3200. Applications may alternatively be hand-delivered to the Office of the Department of Transport, Inkosi Mhlabunzima Maphumulo House, 172 Burger Street, Pietermaritzburg. FOR ATTENTION : Mr B Hornsby
jobs.notes: It is the intention of this Department to consider equity targets when filling these positions. Kindly note that the 24/7 Shift System will be applicable. Applications must be submitted on the NEW Application for Employment Form, Z83 (obtainable on the internet at www.dpsa.gov.za-vacancies). The Z83 form must be completed in terms of DPSA circular 03 of 2025. The completed and signed Z83 must be accompanied by a detailed CV. Dates of starting and leaving employment must be given as DD/MM/YYYY. Kindly take note that only shortlisted candidates will be required to provide certified copies of required documents (Where a Senior Certificate is a requirement for the post, kindly note that a statement of results will not be accepted. Where a tertiary qualification is required, kindly note that certificates are required, however, if a certificate is only to be issued at a graduation in the future, the statement of results, together with a letter from the educational institution, indicating the date of the graduation, will be accepted) on or before the date of the interviews following communication from Human Resources. Failure to comply with these instructions will lead to applications being disqualified. hould an applicant wish to apply for more than one post, separate applications must be submitted for each post applied for. Non-RSA Citizens/Permanent Resident Permit holders must provide a copy of their Permanent Residence Permits if shortlisted for an interview. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) and to provide proof of such if shortlisted for an interview. Under no circumstances will faxed applications be accepted. Receipt of applications will not be acknowledged due to the volume of applications, and should you not receive an invitation to attend an interview within three (3) months of the closing date applicants should assume that their application was unsuccessful. Please note that where experience is a requirement for the post, the successful candidate will be required to submit documentary proof of such work experience prior to assuming duty. A personnel suitability check (criminal record, citizenship, credit record checks, qualification verification and employment verification) will be conducted prior to employment. Prior to appointment being made to an SMS post, the appointee must have completed the pre-entry certificate and must be in possession of such prior to taking up the post. The Senior Management Pre- Entry Programme, which is a public service specific training programme applicable to all applicants who aspire to join the SMS, is to ensure that potential SMS members have a background on processes and procedures linked to the SMS. The duration of the online Pre-Entry Programme is 120 notional hours. Full details may be sourced by the following link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entryprogramme/.                 All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise that intends to test relevant technical elements of the job, the logistics of which will be communicated by the department. Following the interview and technical exercise, the selection panel will recommend candidates to attend a generic managerial competency assessment (in compliance with the DPSA Directive on the implementation of competency-based assessments). The competency assessment will be testing generic managerial competencies using the mandated DPSA SMS competency assessment tools. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. The Department of Transport reserves the right not to fill the advertised post(s) at any stage of the recruitment process. Persons with Disabilities (PWDs) and other designated groups are encouraged to apply. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. af.title: Hoofprovinsiale Inspekteur
af.summary: Hoofprovinsiale Inspekteur-posisies in Pietermaritzburg wat toesig hou oor operasionele planne vir verkeerswetstoepassing, wat 'n verkeersbeampte-diploma en toesigervaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Senior Sertifikaat / Nasionale Sertifikaat (Beroepsgerig) NQF Vlak 4; plus 'n Tertige tersiêre kwalifikasie (3 jaar Diploma/Degree in 'n Verkeers / Bestuurs / Regte veld – NQF 6); plus 'n Basiese Verkeersbeampte se Diploma; plus Geregistreer as 'n Verkeersbeampte; plus 3-5 jaar se toesigervaring in 'n Verkeerswetstoepassingsveld; plus 7-10 jaar se werkservaring in die Verkeerswetstoepassingsveld; plus Alle geldige relevante bestuurslisensies (A en EC); plus Geen strafrekord nie. Kennis, Vaardighede en Bevoegdhede Vereis: Uitgebreide kennis van Verkeersbestuursbeleid en -regulasies. Kennis van relevante wetgewing en verkeersbestuursregulasies. Kennis van voertuiginspeksies/-inbeslagname. Kennis van bestuursvaardighede. Rekord- en hulpbronbestuurvaardighede. Kliëntverhoudingsbestuurvaardighede. Beplannings-, organiseer-, leierskap-, beheer- en moniteringsvaardighede. Mensebestuurvaardighede. Dienslewering-, kommunikasie- en besluitnemingsvaardighede. Resultate- en gehaltebestuurvaardighede. Probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Innoverende/voortdurende verbeteringsvaardighede. Analitiese vaardighede. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Onderhandelings- en inisiatiefvaardighede. Projektebestuur-, mentorskaps- en afrigtingsvaardighede.
af.duties: Bestuur die implementering van die operasionele wetstoepassingsplan: Voltooi en werk omgewingsanalise by om te verseker dat dit as 'n basislyn vir beplanning gebruik word. Ontwikkel 'n operasionele plan vir die stasie/sentrum gebaseer op die provinsiale jaarlikse prestasieplan en verseker suksesvolle implementering. Beplan en monitor die uitvoering van projekte wat verband hou met die implementering van die strategie/plan. Maandelikse monitering van die jaarlikse prestasieplan-teikens. Kommunikeer gereeld met stasie/sentrum-bestuur en fasiliteer die ontwikkeling van en deelname aan 'n sentrum se strategiese/operasionele plan. Neem deel aan geïntegreerde vennootskappe met plaaslike owerhede. Verseker doeltreffende en effektiewe leierskap: Koördineer belanghebbendes se betrekkinge met ander staatsdepartemente en Wetstoepassingsagentskappe (LEAs). Bestuur van diensleweringverbetering: Bestuur administratiewe stelsels. Implementeer administratiewe prosesse om te verseker dat registers weekliks geïnspekteer word. Verseker dat statistieke wat gehou word korrek, huidig en teen die sperdatums versend word, gemonitor en by sentrums beskikbaar gestel word. Bestuur en verseker effektiewe eksterne gemeenskapskommunikasie en skakel met plaaslike Gemeenskapspolisieforums. Verseker dat Toetssentrumstasies (TCS) optimaal funksioneer. Verseker dat voorgeskrewe Wette, Beleide en Prosedures van die Departement geïmplementeer en nagekom word. Verseker dat alle relevante rekords en registers daarvan behoorlik ingedien en te alle tye op datum gehou word. Bestuur van Menslike Hulpbronne: Bestuur griewe volgens voorgeskrewe prosedures. Fasiliteer ten minste een spansamebindingsaktiwiteit per kwartaal vir die sentrum. Verseker dat verlof benut en bestuur word volgens die relevante beleid en instruksies. Ontwikkel en implementeer indiensopleidingsprogram en monitor formele opleidingsbehoeftes van die eenheid. Bestuur prestasie van personeel. Finansiële Bestuur: Monitor maandelikse uitgawes en inspeksieverslae vanaf die Provinsie en implementeer regstellende maatreëls in probleemareas. Reëlmätige begrotingsbeheer en bestuursbesprekings as deel van bestuursvergaderings. Dokumenteer oortydbeplanning gebaseer op prioriteite. Neem deel aan begrotingsbeplanning soos deur die Provinsie vereis. Reageer op versoeke van hoofkantoor rakende uitstaande finansiële navrae binne die verskafte tydperk. Verseker doeltreffende en effektiewe Batebestuur: Monitor voertuigkoste vir stasie/sentrum-voertuie (volgens werksblad) en identifiseer en monitor lede wat by ongelukke betrokke is en verseker dat die motorvoertuigvloot behoorlik bestuur word en dat voertuie in goeie rystand is. Verseker dat doeltreffende verliesbeheermaatreëls in plek is om die verlies van vuurwapens en ander verwante toerusting, d.w.s. die relevante toerusting wat verlore raak, aan te spreek en maatreëls in plek stel om dit te hanteer. Bestuur bates volgens inventarisse van stasie/sentrum.

zu.title: Isiphathi Esikhulu SesiFunda
zu.summary: Izikhundla ze-Isiphathi Esikhulu SesiFunda e-Pietermaritzburg ezibuka amaphulani okusebenza okuphathwa ngemithetho yezokuthutha, ezidinga idiploma yephathi lezokuthutha namava okuhlola.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi Samabanga Aphezulu / Isitifiketi Sabezwe (I-Vocational) NQF Level 4; kanye Nefayuni edingekayo emfundo ephakeme (idiploma/idigri eneminyaka engu-3 enkundeni yokuphathwa kwezokuthutha / Yabaphathi / Ngezomthetho – NQF 6); kanye Nedioploma Yephathi Elisiyisisekelo Sezokuthutha; kanye Nokubhalise njengesiphathi sezokuthutha; kanye Namava okuhlola iminyaka engu-3-5 enkundeni yophenyo lwezokuthutha; kanye Namava okusebenza iminyaka engu-7-10 enkundeni yophenyo lwezokuthutha; kanye Nazo zonke ilayisensi zokushayela eziyisisekelo futhi eziyiso (A kanye ne-EC); kanye Nokungabi nerekhodi lobugebengu. Ulwazi, Amakhono namakhono adingekayo: Ulwazi olubanzi ngezinqubomgomo nezimiso zokuphathwa kwezokuthutha. Ulwazi ngemithetho edingekayo nezimiso zokuphathwa kwezokuthutha. Ulwazi ngokuqatshwa kwemoto / ukuthathwa kwemoto ngokomthetho. Ulwazi ngamakhono okushayela. Amakhono okuphatha okuqoshiwe namathuluzi. Amakhono okuphatha ubudlelwano namakhasimende. Amakhono okuhlela, okuhlanganisa, okuholusa, okulawula nokuqapha. Amakhono okuphatha abantu. Amakhono okuletha izinsizakalo, ukuxhumana nokwenza izinqumo. Amakhono okuphatha imiphumela nokuqinisekisa ikhwalithi. Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga. Amakhono okuletha izinto entsha / ukuthuthuka ngokuqhubekayo. Amakhono okuhlaziya. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amakhono okuxoxisana nokuthatha inkinobho. Amakhono okuphatha iphrojekthi, ukuqonda ukubuqa futhi ukuqashelwe.
zu.duties: Phatha ukusetshenziswa kwephulani lophenyo lomthetho: Qedelela futhi uvuselele ukuhlaziya imvelo ukuze uqiniseke ukuthi kusetshenziswa njengomugqa wesisiseko wokuhlela. Hlela iphulani lokusebenza lesiteshi / isikhungo esebenzisa iphulani lenkulu yomphakama wesifunda ngonyaka futhi uqinisekise ukusetshenziswa okuphumelelayo. Hlela futhi uqaphe ukusetshenziswa kwamaphrojekthi ahlobene nokusetshenziswa kwenqubomgomo / iphulani. Ukuqaphela nyanga zonke i的目标 eziphulani lenkulu yomphakamo ngonyaka. Xhumana njalo nabaphathi besiteshi / isikhungo futhi usize ekuthuthukisweni nokubandakanyekeni kiphulani lenqubomgomo / lokusebenza lesikhungo. Thatha inxaxheba kubudlelwano obuhlanganisiwe namaphuzu omlandelo. Qinisekisa ukuhola okusebenzayo nokuqinisekisile: Hlanganisa ubudlelwano nabahlaningi namanye amasebe kombuso kanye namahlelo ePhenyo LoMthetho (LEAs). Uphathi ukuthuthukiswa kokulethwa kwensizakalo: Phatha amasistimu okuphathi. Sebenzisa izinqubo zokuphatha ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi okuqoshiwe kuhlolwa nsuku zonke zangaphakathi ngesonto. Qinisekise ukuthi izibalo ezigcinwe zilungile, zimanje futhi zithunyelwe ngosuku oluhleliwe futhi ziqaphele futhi zitholakale emaphakathi. Phatha futhi uqinisekise ukuxhumana okusebenzayo nomphakathi bangaphandle futhi uxhume namahlelo Aphakathi Komphakathi Nezaphoyi. Qinisekise ukuthi Amashesi Okuqeqeshe Akhaya (TCS) asebenza ngendlela eyingcono kakhulu. Qinisekise ukuthi Amagugu, Izinqubomgomo futhi Izinqubo ezezelwe uMnyango zisetshenziswa futhi zilandelwa. Qinisekise ukuthi yonke okuqoshiwe okuthinta okanye okuyikho kufakwe ngendlela efanele futhi kugcinwe kusekuyimanje kuwo wonke amashize. Uphathi Abasebenzi Bantu: Phatha izikhalazo ngokulandela izinqubo ezezelwe. Siza okungenani omsebenzi owodwa wokwakha ithimu ngesikhashana ngasenyangeni ngosuku lwesikhathi. Qinisekise ukuthi ukuphumula kusetshenziswa futhi kuphathwe ngokwezinqubomgomo nemiyalo edingekayo. Thuthukisa futhi usebenzise uhlelo lokuqeqeshwa ngaphakathi kwesikhathi sokusebenza futhi uqaphe izidingo zeqeqesho elisemthethweni leyunithi. Phatha ukusebenza kwabasebenzi. Uphathi Izimali: Qaphe imali yokuchithwa nyanga zonke namarekhodi okuhlola esifundeni futhi usebenzise izinyathelo zokulungisa kwendawo ezinachingo. Xoxa njalo ngolawulowebhajethi futhi uphathe izinkulumo njengengxenye yoxoxo lokuholusa. Qopha ukuhlela kolwazi ngokulandelana kwezinto ezibalulekile. Thatha inxaxheba ekuhleleni ibhajethi njengoba kudingwa isifunda. Phendula izicelo evela ehovu elikhulu mayelana nemibuzo yezimali engaxazululanga phakathi kwesikhathi esinikiwe. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa kweMathuluzi okusebenzayo futhi okuqinisekisile: Qaphe izindleko zemoto zesiteshi / isikhungo (njengoba kukhonjiswe ku-worksheet) futhi uchaze futhi uqaphe amalungu abandakanyekwe ezehlakalweni futhi uqinisekise ukuthi iqembu lezimoto liphathwe ngendlela efanele futhi izimoto zisezimweni esihle sokugijima. Qinisekise ukuthi kunezinyathelo zokuqinisekisa ukulawulwa kokulahleka ukuzobhekana nokulahleka kwezikhali ezishisayo namanye amathuluzi ahlobene okuyilowo mathuluzi alahlekayo futhi ufake izinyathelo ukubhekana nakho. Phatha amathuluzi njengengxenye yokubhalisa kwesiteshi / isikhungo.

xh.title: Isephephandaba Elikhulu Lenyanga
xh.summary: Izithuba zaseSephephandaba Elikhulu Lenyanga ePietermaritzburg ezibukelela iicwangciso zomsebenzi zokuphumeza imithetho yokuqhuba, ezifuna idiploma yomphathi wethrafikhi namava okulawula.

Ulwazi, amakhono namandla aFunekayo: Ulwazi olubanzi malunga namapholisi norhwebo woLawulo lweThrafikhi. Ulwazi ngomthetho ofanelekileyo norhwebo wolawulo lwethrafikhi. Ulwazi ngokuqwalaselwa kwezithuthi / ukuziba kwezithuthi. Ulwazi ngamakhono okuqhuba. Amakhono okulawula irekhodi nezixhobo. Amakhono okulawula ubudlelwane namaxhoba. Amakhono okucwangcisa, ukuhlela, ukulawula, nokulawula nokuphonononga. Amakhono okulawula abantu. Amakhono okunikeza inkonzo, unxibelelwano nokuthatha izigqibo. Amakhono okulawula iziphumo nokhwalithi. Amakhono okusombulula iingxaki. Amakhono okwenza izinto ngotshintsho / ukuphucula ngokuqhubekayo. Amakhono okuhlalutya. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amakhono okuxoxisana nokuthatha inyathelo. Amakhono okulawula iiprojekthi, ukululeka nokuyala.
xh.duties: Lawula ukuphunyezwa kocwangciso lomsebenzi wolwephulo-mthetho: Qedaza uhlaziyo lwendalo ukuqinisekisa ukuba lusetyenziswa njengesiseko soKucwangcisa. Phepha ucwangciso lomsebenzi lwesiteshi / iziko ngesiseko secwangciso lonyaka wemveliso yephondo ukuqinisekisa ukuphunyezwa okuphumeleleyo. Cwangcisa kwaye ulawule ukuphumeza iiprojekthi ezinxulumene nokuphunyezwa kwecwangciso / urhwebo. Ukuqwalaselwa nyanga zonke kweenjongo zecwangciso lonyaka wemveliso. Xhumana rhoqo nokulawulo lwesiteshi / iziko kwaye usasaze ukuphuhliswa nokuthathwa inxaxheba kwicwangciso lobuchule / lomsebenzi leziko. Thata inxaxheba kubudlelwane obuhle ngexesha namanyango aphuhlisa urhwebo. Qinisekisa ukulawula okusebenzayo nolusebenzayo: Lawula ubudlelwane nabathathi nxaxheba kumanye amasebe karhulumente nabaQhubi-mithetho. Lawula ukuphuculwa kokunikezwa inkonzo: Lawula iindidi zolawulo. Phumeza iinkqubo zolawulo ukuqinisekisa ukuba iirekothi zihlolwa ngeveki. Qinisekisa ukuba izibalo ezigcinwayo zifanelekile, zisangoku kwayu zithunyelwe ngeemihla ezimiselweyo kwaye ziyaphononongwa kwaye zifumaneka kwiiziko. Lawula ukuqinisekisa ukusebenza kwesiteshi/iziko sokuvavanya ngokusebenzayo kwaye unxibelelane namabhunga abahlali bendawo. Lawula ukuba iziko/esteshi lokuvavanya (TCS) lisebenza ngokugqibeleleyo. Qinisekisa ukuba iiSthetho, amapholisi kwaye iinkqubo zoSebe ziyaphunyezwa kwaye zihlonitshwa. Lawula nabantu: Lawula iingxaki ngokwezinqubo ezibekiweyo. Sasa ezinye iindidi zolwakhiwo lomthambo kwindawo ngandlelayo ngekwota ngesikhathi. Qinisekisa ukuba iholide isetyenziswa kwaye ilawulwa ngokwamapholisi neemiyalelo ebalulekileyo. Phuhlisa uphumeze inkqubo yokuzisebenzela kwakho nokuphucula iimfuno zokulawula imisebenzi yeqela. Lawula ukusebenza kwabasebenzi. Lawulo lweMali: Lawula ukuqhathaniswa kwezindleko zamaxesha onke, nezibalo zokuqwalaselwa esiPhondo neziphumo nezinye iingxaki ezizodwa. Qwalasela ulawulo loxhaso kwaye nexoxo ngokulawula kwamanani. Qamba iplani yexesha elongezelelekileyo kubuqhoqhotho bomsebenzi. Lawula inkqubo yokwenza ucwangciso lwamaxesha onke ngokucwangcisa inkqubo. Lawula iplani yakho ngokuchaziwe. Lawula izikolo nakuxhaxha eziqinisekisa ngokuchaziweyo ngokuchaziweyo ngokuchaziweyo ngokuchaziweyo ngokuchaziweyo ngokuchaziweyo.

Applications may alternatively be hand-delivered to the Office of the Department of Transport, Inkosi Mhlabunzima Maphumulo House, 172 Burger Street, Pietermaritzburg. FOR ATTENTION : Mr B Hornsby
jobs.notes: It is the intention of this Department to consider equity targets when filling this position. Applications must be submitted on the NEW Application for Employment Form, Z83 (obtainable on the internet at www.dpsa.gov.za-vacancies). The Z83 form must be completed in terms of DPSA circular 03 of 2025. The completed and signed Z83 must be accompanied by a detailed CV. Dates of starting and leaving employment must be given as DD/MM/YYYY. Kindly take note that only shortlisted candidates will be required to provide certified copies of required documents (Where a Senior Certificate is a requirement for the post, kindly note that a statement of results will not be accepted. Failure to comply with these instructions will lead to applications being disqualified. hould an applicant wish to apply for more than one post, separate applications must be submitted for each post applied for. Non-RSA Citizens/Permanent Resident Permit holders must provide a copy of their Permanent Residence Permits if shortlisted for an interview. Prior to appointment being made to an SMS post, the appointee must have completed the pre-entry certificate and must be in possession of such prior to taking up the post. Following the interview and technical exercise, the selection panel will recommend candidates to attend a generic managerial competency assessment (in compliance with the DPSA Directive on the implementation of competency-based assessments). The Department of Transport reserves the right not to fill the advertised post(s) at any stage of the recruitment process. Persons with Disabilities (PWDs) and other designated groups are encouraged to apply. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. Ensure the promotion of safety in line with statutory and regulatory requirements. Provide inputs into existing technical manuals, standard drawings and procedures to incorporate new technology. Ensure quality assurance in line with specifications. Manage administrative and related functions: Provide inputs into the budgeting process. Compile and submit reports as required. Provide and consolidate inputs to the technical operational plan. Update databases. Manage artisans and related personnel and assets. Financial Management: Control and monitor expenditure according to budget to ensure efficient cash flow management. Manage the commercial value add of the discipline-related activities and services. People management: Manage the development, motivation and utilisation of human resources for the discipline to ensure competent knowledge base for the continued success of technical services according to organizational needs and requirements. Manage subordinates’ key performance areas by setting and monitoring performance standards and taking actions to correct deviations to achieve departmental objectives. Maintain and advance expertise: Continuous individual development to keep up with new technologies and procedures. af.title: Hoof Ambagsman Graad A (Meganies)
af.summary: Hoof Ambagsman Graad A (Meganies) posisies in KwaZulu-Natal wat 'n ambagsman-sertifikaat en tien jaar ervare post-kwalifikasie-ervaring vereis, teen R499470 per jaar.
af.requirements: n Toepaslike Ambagsman-sertifikaat in Aardebewegingsuitrustings Meganikus / Konstruksie-aanlegmeganikus / Dieselmeganikus / Traktermeganikus; plus Tien (10) jaar post-kwalifikasie-ervaring as 'n Ambagsman / Ambagsman-voorman; plus 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie (minimum Kode C1). Kennis, vaardighede en bevoegdhede vereis: Projekbestuurskennis. Tegniese ontwerp- en ontledingskennis. Kennis van rekenaargesteunde tegniese toepassings. Kennis van regsvoorskrifnakoming. Kennis van tegniese verslagskrywing. Kennis van tegniese konsultasie. Produksie- en proseskennis en -vaardighede. Besluitneming- en spanwerkvaardighede. Kreatiwiteit- en veranderingbestuursvaardighede. Finansiële bestuursvaardighede. Kliëntfokus en responsiewe vaardighede. Kommunikasievaardighede. Beplannings- en organisatoriese vaardighede. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Probleemoplossings- en ontledingsvaardighede.
af.duties: Bestuur tegniese dienste: Bestuur tegniese dienste en ondersteuning in samewerking met Tegnici / Ambagsmanne en geassosieerdes in veld-, werkswinkel- en tegniese kantooraktiwiteite. Verseker die bevordering van veiligheid in ooreenstemming met statutêre en regulasionele vereistes. Verskaf insette tot bestaande tegniese handleidings, standaardtekeninge en prosedures om nuwe tegnologie in te lyf. Verseker gehaltesekerheid in ooreenstemming met spesifikasies. Bestuur administratiewe en verwante funksies: Verskaf insette tot die begrotingsproses. Stel verslae op en dien dit in soos vereis. Verskaf en konsolideer insette tot die tegniese operasionele plan. Werk databasisse by. Bestuur ambagsmanne en verwante personeel en bates. Finansiële bestuur: Beheer en monitor besteding volgens begroting om doeltreffende kontantvloei-bestuur te verseker. Bestuur die kommersiële meerwaarde van dissipline-verwante aktiwiteite en dienste. Mensebestuur: Bestuur die ontwikkeling, motivering en benutting van menslike hulpbronne vir die dissipline om bevoegde kennisbasis vir die voortgesette sukses van tegniese dienste volgens organisatoriese behoeftes en vereistes te verseker. Bestuur ondergeskiktes se sleutelprestasiegebiede deur prestasiestandaarde te stel en te monitor en maatreëls te tref om afwykings reg te stel om departementele doelwitte te bereik. Onderhou en bevorder kundigheid: Deurlopende individuele ontwikkeling om tred te hou met nuwe tegnologieë en prosedures. Navorsing / literatuurstudies oor tegniese / ingenieurswese-tegnologie om kundigheid te verbeter. Skakel met relevante liggame / rade oor tegniese / ingenieurswese-verwante aangeleenthede.

zu.title: Obaba bezentando yezinto abaphambili bezinga A (MECHANICAL)
zu.summary: Izikhundla zababa bezentando yezinto abaphambili bezinga A (Mechanical) eKwaZulu-Natal esidinga isitifiketi sokuhlola ubuciko kanye neminyaka yishumi yohlelo lokusebenza ngemva kokuthola iziqu, inikeza i-R499470 ngonyaka.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi sokuhlola ubuciko esifanele sokuba ngumonakali wemishino yensimbi ephusha umhlabathi / umonakali wemishino yokwakha / umonakali wensimbi oshayisa idizili / umonakali wethrektha; kanye Neminyaka eyishumi (10) yohlelo lokusebenza ngemva kokuthola iziqu njengobaba bensimbi / osikhulu babobaba bensimbi; kanye Nelayisensi yokuqasha ethize (okuncane kakhulu i-Code C1). Ulwazi, Amakhono namandla okwenza okudingekayo: Ulwazi lokuqeqesha amaphrojekthi. Ulwazi lokwakheka kobuchwepheshe kanye nokuhlaziya. Ulwazi ngemiyalo yobuchwepheshe esebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulwazi ngokuhambisana nomthetho. Ulwazi lokubhala imibhalo yobuchwepheshe. Ulwazi lokuqeqesha ngobuchwepheshe. Ulwazi namakhono okukhiqiza nokuqhuba inqubo. Amakhono okwenza izinqumo kanye nokusebenza ndawonye. Amakhono okudala kanye nokuphathwa koshintsho. Amakhono okuphatha imali. Amakhono okugxila kumthengi kanye nokuxhumana. Amakhono okuxhumana. Amakhono okucubungula kanye nokuhlela. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuhlaziya.
zu.duties: Qondisa izinsiza zobuchwepheshe: Phatha izinsiza zobuchwepheshe kanye nokusekelwa kanye nososayensi bensimbi / obaba bensimbi nabahlobene endaweni yomsebenzi, esixhobeni nasehhovisi lobuchwepheshe. Qinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa kokuphepha ngokuhambisana nezidingo zomthetho nezimiso zokubuyela emuva. Nikeza izimpendulo kwimiyaladizayini ekhona yobuchwepheshe, izithombe ezijwayelekile kanye nezinqubo ukuze kufakwe ubuchwepheshe obusha. Qinisekisa izinga lekhwalithi ngokuhambisana nezinkomba. Phatha imisebenzi yocwango kanye nemisebenzi ephathelene nayo: Nikeza izimpendulo kule nqubo yokwenza isabelo mali. Hlela futhi unikeze imibiko njengoba kudingeka. Nikeza futhi uhlanganise izimpendulo kwisabelo sokuqhuba kobuchwepheshe. Buyekeza izinngqomemibhalo. Phatha obaba bensimbi kanye nabantu abahlobene nabo kanye namafa. Ukuphathwa kwemali: Lawula futhi ulinde ukusebenzisa imali ngokwesabelo mali ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphathwa okusebenzayo kwe-flow yemali. Phatha inani lezokuhweba ezengeziwe kwemisebenzi ehlobene nodidi kanye nezinsiza. Ukuphathwa kwabantu: Phatha ukuthuthukiswa, ukukhuthazwa kanye nokusetshenziswa kwemithombo yabantu kulelo dhisiplini ukuze kuqinisekiswe ulwazi olunamandla lokuphumelela okuqhubekayo kwezinsiza zobuchwepheshe ngokwezidingo nezidingo zenkundla. Phatha izindawo ezibalulekile zokusebenza ezibekwe ngaphansi kwakho ngokuhlela futhi ulandele izinga lokusebenza bese uthatha izinyathelo zokulungisa ukwehluza ukufinyelela imigomo yomnyango. Gcina futhi uthuthukise amandla obuchwepheshe: Ukuthuthukiswa ngokuqhubekayo komuntu ngamunye ukuze aqhubelane nobuchwepheshe obusha kanye nezinqubo. Ucwaningo / imifundo yokufunda ngebhalo ngobuchwepheshe / ubunjiniyela ukuze kuthuthuke amandla obuchwepheshe. Xhumana nemizimba / amakhansili ahlobene nezindaba zobuchwepheshe / ubunjiniyela.

xh.summary: Izithuba zeNkathetho Uphhrofeshonali Oyintloko inqanaba A (Kumatshini) eKwaZulu-Natal ezifuna isatifikethi senkcubeko yovavvo neminyaka elishumi yamava emva kokugqiba izifundo, zinika umvuzo weR499470 ngonyaka.

Ulwazi, Amakhono namandla afunekayo: Ulwazi lolawulo lweenjongo. Ulwazi lokuyila ngokobuchwephethile nokuhlalutya. Ulwazi lwezicelo zobuchwephethile ezisebenziswa ikhompyutha. Ulwazi lolawulo ngokomthetho. Ulwazi lokubhala iingxelo zobuchwephethile. Ulwazi lokubonelela ngengcebiso zobuchwephethile. Amakhono obukhulu bobunyuki, amakhona enkqubo. Amakhona okuthatha iigqibo nokusebenza ngeqela. Amakhona okudala nokulawula utshintsho. Amakhona olawulo lweemali. Amakhona okugxila kumthengi nakuphendula. Amakhona okuthetha. Amakhono okucwangcisa nokuhlela. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngekhompyutha. Amakhona okusombulula iingxaki nokuhlalutya.
xh.duties: Lawula iinkonzo zobuchwephethile: Lawula iinkonzo zobuchwephethile inkxaso kunye noBachwephethile / abaKathetho uphhrofeshonali nabahlobene emmandla, kumanundwana nakumsebenzi weofisi yobuchwephethile. Qinisekisa ukukhuthaza kokhuseleko ngokwelikwalatho nemigaqo esemthethweni. Nikela ngezinto kumanuali ezikhoyo zobuchwephethile, izimilo ezisisiseko nemigaqo ukuze zibe nobuchwephethile obutsha. Qinisekisa umgangatho ngokwelikwalatho nemigaqo. Lawula imisebenzi yolawulo nezinxulumene nayo: Nikela ngezinto kumanejimethi yendlela yokusebenza. Hlanganisa unikezela iingxelo njengoko kufuneka. Nikela hlanganisa izinto kwinkqubo yokuqhuba yobuchwephethile. Mpela usayizi wemithombo yolwazi. Lawula abaKathetho uphhrofeshonali abantu abahlobene nabo nempahla. Ulawulo lweemali: Lawula hlole ukuchithwa kwemali ngokwemali yokulinganisa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ulawulo olusebenzayo lwenkcitho yemali. Lawula ixabiso lenkonzo ekhuthazayo yemisebenzi esekelwe kwicandelo neenkonzana. Ulawulo labantu: Lawula uphuhliso, ukukhuthaza nokusetyenziswa kwemithombo yabantu kwicandelo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ulwazi olunamandla kumphumela oqhubekayo wezonkonzo zobuchwephethile ngokweenkqubo nezidingo zoluntu. Lawula iindawo ezibalulekile zokusebenza ezisezantsi ngeziguqulo nangokumisela ukulinganisa amanqanaba okusebenza nokuthatha izinyathelo zokuqwalasela iziphene ukuze kufikelelwe kumgama wesebe. Gcina uphuhlise amandla obugcisa: Ukuphuhlisa okuqhubekayo komntuwonke ukuze ahambe ngebekhama yobuchwephethile nobuchwephethile obutsha. Uphononongo / izifundo zolwazi ngebekhama yobuchwephethile / yobugcisa bokunjiniyela ukuze uphucule amandla. Thetha nabahlobene / amabhunga ngeenjongo zobuchwephethile / zokunjiniyela.

af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Databasisbestuur
af.summary: Assistentdirekteur vir databasisbestuur in Pietermaritzburg wat 'n kwalifikasie in openbare bestuur of handel vereis, asook drie jaar se toesigervaring.
af.requirements: N 'n voorgraadse kwalifikasie in Openbare Bestuur of Handel (NQF-vlak 6 of hoër); plus 'n minimum van 3 jaar se toesigervaring in 'n BBBEE-/transformasie-omgewing; plus 'n geldige bestuurslisensie (minimum kode B). Kennis, Vaardighede en Bevoegdhede Vereis: Kennis van admin prosedures en beheer. Begrip van Openbare Diens- en Departementale wetgewing, prosedures en standaarde. Kennis van transformasiebeleid. Begrip van organisatoriese doelwitte en waardes. Kennis van departementele begroting en bestedingsprosesse. Leierskapsvaardighede. Motiveringsvaardighede. Besluitnemingsvaardighede. Vermoë om wetgewing/beleid/standaarde te vertolk en toe te pas. Vermoë om kwaliteit van gelewerde dienste te assesseer. Rekenaargeletterdheidsvaardighede. Interpersoonlike vaardighede. Skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasievaardighede. Fasiliteringsvaardighede. Opleidingsvaardighede. Verslagskryfvaardighede. Beleidontwikkelingsvaardighede. Moniterings- en evalueringvaardighede. af.duties: Ontwikkel en bestuur die Bemagtigingsprogramme, insluitend Departementale areas van deelname, vaardigheidsontwikkelingsprogramme, en ander geïntegreerde bemagtigingsinligting. Voer analise van statistiese inligting uit met die oog daarop om nuwe ontwikkelingsprogramme in ooreenstemming met waardekettingbeginsels te identifiseer. Verseker nakoming ten opsigte van BEE-transformasie-ingrypings regdeur die Departement. Rapporteer maandeliks oor die status van die BBBEE-prestasie. Verskaf advies, leiding en insette tot transformasiebeleidontwikkeling. Bestuur en hou toesig oor personeel binne die komponent.

Ulwazi, Amakhono kanye Namandla Adingekayo: Ulwazi lwezinqubo zolawulo kanye nokulawula. Ukuqonda umthetho wezinkonzo zomphakathi nowomnyango, izinqubo kanye namazinga. Ulwazi lwezinqubo ezithinta imigqa. Ukuqonda izinhloso kanye namagugu omanyango. Ulwazi lwenqubo yebhajethi kanye nezindleko zomnyango. Amakhono okubusa. Amakhono okukhuthaza. Amakhono okuthatha izinqumo. Ikhono lokuhumusha nokusebenzisa umthetho/inqubo/amazinga. Ikhono lokulinganisa ikhwalithi yezinkonzo eznakwe. Amakhono okusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amakhono bokuxhumana nabantu. Amakhono okuxhumana ngokubhala nangokukhuluma. Amakhono okwezela. Amakhono okuqeqesha. Amakhono okubhala imibiko. Amakhono okuthuthukisa izinqubo. Amakhono okuhlola kanye nokulinganisa. Obekhele okufanele umuntu kumele azibophezele, abe nokuzithoba, aze ahambe nenhloso, alandele iKhodi Yemikhuba okungukuthi zomunye, amasiko, aze azibophezele kuzinhloso kanye namaprogramu omnyango kanye nokulandela izinqubo, imikhuba kanye namazinga omnyango.
