jobs.title: Assistant Director: Expenditure, Revenue and Debt Control
jobs.closing_date_text: 28 August 2026 (at 16h00). Applications received after the closing date and time will not be considered.
jobs.summary: Assistant Director needed in Pietermaritzburg to manage expenditure, revenue and debt control services for the Department of Transport, requiring an NQF Level 6 accounting qualification and 3 years supervisory experience.
jobs.requirements: An undergraduate qualification in Accounting/ Financial Management (NQF Level 6) as recognised by SAQA; plus A minimum of 3 years’ supervisory experience in a revenue, expenditure and e-NaTIS environment; plus A valid driver’s licence (minimum Code B). Knowledge, Skills and Competencies Required. Knowledge of Public Finance Management Act (Act 1 of 1999). Knowledge of National Road Traffic Act (Act 93 of 1996). Knowledge of Provincial Road Traffic Act (Act 7 of 1997). Knowledge of Labour Relations Act, Employment Equity Act, Basic conditions of employment Act. Knowledge of Skills development Act. Knowledge of Delegations of Authority pertaining to the Department of Transport. Knowledge of Financial Audit procedure. Knowledge of Human Resource Management Principles. Knowledge of National Traffic Information System (e-NaTIS). Basic knowledge of accounting system (BAS). Knowledge of PERSAL. Computer literacy. Good Verbal and written Communication skills. Good interpersonal relations skills. Problem solving skills. Policy development and analysis skills. Management and supervisory skills. Planning and co-ordinating skills. Leadership and Team Development skills. Accounting and arithmetic skills. Decision Making skills. Negotiation Team Development skills. Report writing skills. Innovative thinking skills. The ideal candidate must be reliable, honest, innovative, decisive, culturally sensitive, have integrity, maintain confidentiality, ensure fairness, have respect, and be trustworthy. He/She must have the ability to Interpret and apply legislation and policies and have the ability to use training aids.
jobs.duties: Facilitate the provision of budgetary and expenditure control services. Ensure the effective provision of revenue control services. Co-ordinate effective debt control management services. Provide advice and guidance and input to policy. Manage resources of the Division.

Ulwazi lwezomthetho ngezenzo zokuthutha kanye nezohamba kwabantu, ukupheqa izimoto, ukuthweswa izimoto isikhundla kanye nokugcwalisa amafomu womthetho. Amakhono okuphatha imibhalo, izinsiza kanye nokuxhumana nomphakathi. Amakhono okuhlela kanye nokuhlanganisa. Amakhono okuqondisa, okulawula kanye nokulandelela. Amakhono okuphatha abantu. Amakhono okuhlaziya. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amakhono okuphatha imisebenzi/okwakhiwayo.

Phatha imisebenzi ehlanganyele yomthetho kanye nezinhloso (ukuhlangana komthetho kahulumeni). Phatha izinsiza kanye nokunika ababhalwe ngaphansi eqondiso kanye nokuqondisa. Ulwazi ngokuphothulwa komthetho ngeenqwelo-mota nakuthengiselwa koluntu, ukuhlolwa kwezithuthi, ukubekwa kwangaphantsi kwezithuthi nokugqiba kwamaxwebhu okuphothulwa komthetho. Amakhono okulawula irekhodi, izixhobo nokusebenzisana nabathengi. Amakhono okuqamba nokuhlela. Amakhono okukhokela, ukulawula nokujonga. Amakhono okulawula abantu. Amakhono okunikezela ngencebo, nokunxibelelana nokuthatha izigqibo. Amakhono okulawula imithombo neyekhwalithi. Amakhono okuzama ukuxazulula iingxaki, ukubhala nokubika namakhano ezenzo zabasebenzi. Amakhono okushayela, ukuphenya nokhuthazo. Amakhono okudala nantlaziso ethuba. Amakhono okucofa. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha. Amakhono okulawula izixhobo/oorhwebo.
xh.duties: Lawula ukuqinisekisa ukuzingela koluntu, abagqibi zithuthi zabagqibi, uMthetho wezeNtengiso nakwezinye iindlela ezizelelana nomthetho. Lawula imisebenzi yokuqinisekisa umthetho ehlanganiswayo neenjongo (ukulawulwa ngokubambisana). Lawula izixhobo kwaye unike ulawulo noqhagamshelo kubo bonke abangaphantsi kwakho. Ziva ulawule iingozi. Lawula inkqubo yomsebenzi wezabe ezizelelana nomyalelo kwaye nawo onke amanye amasebenzi ahambelanayo.

af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike erkende Bachelorsgraad / Nasionale Diploma in Siviele Ingenieurswese; plus 'n Minimum van 3 (drie) jaar na-kwalifikasie tegniese ervaring in 'n padomgewing (Ervaring: Vlak A is 0 tot 12 jaar na registrasie en Vlak B is 14 tot 24 jaar na registrasie en Vlak C is 26 jaar en ouer); plus Verpligte registrasie by die Engineering Council of South Africa as 'n "Professional Engineering Technician"; plus 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie (minimum kode B). Ulwazi, Amakhono namakhono adingekayo: Ulwazi loPhathwa lwezinhlaka. Ulwazi lokuKlama ngobuchwepheshe kanye nokuhlaziya. Ulwazi loCwaningo kanye noPhuhliso. Ulwazi lwezinhlelo zobuchwepheshe ezisebenzisana noku-computer. Ulwazi lokuziphatha ngokomthetho. Ulwazi lokuBhala ingxelo ngobuchwepheshe. Ulwazi lokuQondisa ngobuchwepheshe. Amakhono okuBumba inkinga noxazulule kanye nohlaziyo. Amakhono okuThatha izinqumo. Amakhono okuSebenza isiqhingi. Amakhono okuQamba. Amakhono okuBheka iklayenti kanye nokuphendula ngokushesha. Amakhono okuThintana. Amakhono okuSebenzela ku-computer. Amakhono okuPhatha abantu. Amakhono okuHlela kokuHlelela. Amakhono okuPhatha ushintsho. Umuntu othintekayo kufanele abe nokuphuma izimiso, azwela izindingiso nezinkingiso, enesimilo, ethembekile, enobungcweti, futhi abe novulekile nesibonakaliso. Yena kufanele futhi abe nokuthembeka, asebenze kahle nabanye, ahlonipheke, abe nobungcweti, abe nomoya ohle kwaye akwazi ukusebenza esiqhingini.
zu.duties: Nika izinkonzo zobuchwepheshe. Yenza imisebenzi yesikhungo nezinye ezihlobene nayo. Cwaningo kanye noPhuhliso. Qapha kanye nokuLawula abantu bobuchwepheshe nabanye abahlobene nabo kanye nezimpahla.

jobs.title: Senior Provincial Inspector
jobs.centre: Durban Region (X6 Posts): Road Traffic Inspectorate, Umdloti Ref No: DOT 162/2026 (X3 Posts) Road Traffic Inspectorate, Pinetown Ref No: DOT 163/2026 (X2 Posts) Road Traffic Inspectorate, Park Rynie Ref No: DOT 164/2026 (X1 Post) Ladysmith Region (X2 Posts): Road Traffic Inspectorate, Nqutu Ref No. DOT 165/2026 (X2 Posts)
jobs.closing_date_text: 28 August 2026 (at 16h00). Applications received after the closing date and time will not be considered.
jobs.summary: Senior Provincial Inspectors are sought across KwaZulu-Natal to enforce road traffic legislation, supervise subordinates, and monitor compliance at testing centres.
jobs.requirements: A Senior Certificate; plus Basic Traffic Officer’s Diploma; plus Registered as a Traffic Officer; plus A minimum of 3 - 5 years practical experience as a Provincial Inspector; plus A valid driving licence (minimum code B); plus Applicants must possess no criminal record. Knowledge, Skills and Competencies Required: Knowledge and understanding of road traffic and Public Transport legislation, policies and regulations. Knowledge of vehicle inspections, vehicle impoundment and completion of Law Enforcement documents. Knowledge of Firearm and Ammunition Act 60/2000, code of conduct, dangerous goods and Departmental policies. Knowledge of guidelines from Director of Public Prosecutions, departmental guidelines on overload control and escort duties Transport Handbook (TRH) 11. Knowledge of operational guidelines on law enforcement equipment. Records, resource and customer relationship management skills. Literacy skills (written and verbal communication skills in at least two of the provincial languages). Conflict resolution and driving skills. Negotiation, interpretation and legal evidential skills. Observation skills (moving violations/defects). Ability to work under pressure. Mentoring and coaching skills.
jobs.duties: Management and supervision of subordinates (people management). Enforce Road Traffic, Public Passenger, Transport and other relevant legislation. Examine Driver’s Licences and Motor Vehicles and monitor compliance at Driver Licence Testing Centres (DLTC) and Vehicle Testing Stations (VTS). Provide visible Traffic Control/Policing and promote/ensure crime prevention activities. Perform all administrative activities and related duties. Assess road conditions. Mentor and coach Provincial Inspectors (PIs) on probation and appointed PIs.
jobs.applications: Applications/Address: Applicants are encouraged to apply for posts through the KZN online e-Recruitment system at www.kznonline.gov.za/kznjobs Applicants may also visit any one of our Designated Online Application Centres (DOACs) where our friendly staff will assist you with applying for jobs on the KZN online e-Recruitment system or receiving your hardcopy application. You can find the list of Designated Online Application Centres (DOACS) at www.kznonline.gov.za/kznjobs. Applications may alternatively be hand-delivered to the Office of the Department of Transport, Inkosi Mhlabunzima Maphumulo House, 172 Burger Street, Pietermaritzburg. FOR ATTENTION : Mr B Hornsby
jobs.notes: It is the intention of this Department to consider equity targets when filling these positions. Kindly note that the 24/7 Shift System will be applicable. Applications must be submitted on the NEW Application for Employment Form, Z83 (obtainable on the internet at www.dpsa.gov.za-vacancies). The Z83 form must be completed in terms of DPSA circular 03 of 2025. The completed and signed Z83 must be accompanied by a detailed CV. Dates of starting and leaving employment must be given as DD/MM/YYYY. Kindly take note that only shortlisted candidates will be required to provide certified copies of required documents (Where a Senior Certificate is a requirement for the post, kindly note that a statement of results will not be accepted. Where a tertiary qualification is required, kindly note that certificates are required, however, if a certificate is only to be issued at a graduation in the future, the statement of results, together with a letter from the educational institution, indicating the date of the graduation, will be accepted) on or before the date of the interviews following communication from Human Resources. Failure to comply with these instructions will lead to applications being disqualified. hould an applicant wish to apply for more than one post, separate applications must be submitted for each post applied for. Non-RSA Citizens/Permanent Resident Permit holders must provide a copy of their Permanent Residence Permits if shortlisted for an interview. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) and to provide proof of such if shortlisted for an interview. Under no circumstances will faxed applications be accepted. Receipt of applications will not be acknowledged due to the volume of applications, and should you not receive an invitation to attend an interview within three (3) months of the closing date applicants should assume that their application was unsuccessful. Please note that where experience is a requirement for the post, the successful candidate will be required to submit documentary proof of such work experience prior to assuming duty. A personnel suitability check (criminal record, citizenship, credit record checks, qualification verification and employment verification) will be conducted prior to employment. Prior to appointment being made to an SMS post, the appointee must have completed the pre-entry certificate and must be in possession of such prior to taking up the post. The Senior Management Pre- Entry Programme, which is a public service specific training programme applicable to all applicants who aspire to join the SMS, is to ensure that potential SMS members have a background on processes and procedures linked to the SMS. The duration of the online Pre-Entry Programme is 120 notional hours. Full details may be sourced by the following link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entryprogramme/.                 All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise that intends to test relevant technical elements of the job, the logistics of which will be communicated by the department. Following the interview and technical exercise, the selection panel will recommend candidates to attend a generic managerial competency assessment (in compliance with the DPSA Directive on the implementation of competency-based assessments). The competency assessment will be testing generic managerial competencies using the mandated DPSA SMS competency assessment tools. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. The Department of Transport reserves the right not to fill the advertised post(s) at any stage of the recruitment process. Persons with Disabilities (PWDs) and other designated groups are encouraged to apply. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. zu.title: Umhloli Omkhulu Wezwe
zu.summary: Kufunwa Abahloli Abakhulu Bezwe kulo lonke iKwaZulu-Natal ukuze bagcine umthetho wezokuhamba ezindleleni, baqonde abangabo ngaphansi kwabo, futhi balawule ukuthobekela kwemithetho ezikhungweni zokuhlola.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi se-Senior; kanye ne-Diploma Yesisekelo Yephoyisa Lokuhamba Ezindleleni; kanye nokuba ubhaliswe njengephoyisa lokuhamba ezindleleni; kanye nokuba namava okusebenza okungu-3 - 5 eminyakeni njengomhloli wezwe; kanye nelayisensi yokushayela evumelekile (ikhodi engu-B kuphela); kanye nokuthi abafake izicelo kungame boshwe. Ulwazi, Amakhono namandla Adingekayo: Ulwazi nokuqonda umthetho wezokuhamba ezindleleni nowohamba ngabantu, kanye nezinqubomgomo nemithetho. Ulwazi ngokuhlola izimoto, ukuboshwa kwezimoto nokugcwaliswa kwamadokhumenti eMgomweni Womthetho. Ulwazi ngomthetho Wemikhumbi namabala i-Act 60/2000, ikhodi yezimiso, izimpahla ezicolisayo kanye nezinqubomgomo zomnyango. Ulwazi ngokuqondiswa kwabongameli bobumelwane bomphakathi, izinqubomgomo zomnyango ezokulawula ukugqamisa kwezimoto kanye nemisebenzi yokuqondisa incwadi yokuHamba (TRH) 11. Ulwazi ngokuqondiswa okusebenzayo ngempahla yokuphoqa umthetho. Amakhono okulawula amarekhodi, izinsiza nokuhlobana nabathengi. Amakhono okufunda nokubhala (amakhono okuxhumana okubhalwayo noku khulunyayo kolimi abalulinganiselwe olungenani olubili bantlu zolimi zesifundazwe). Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga nokushayela. Amakhono okucashunana, ukuhumusha nokuhlinzeka ngobufakazi bomthetho. Amakhono okubuka (ukuphula umthetho ngenkathi kuhamba izimoto/iziphazamisi). Ikono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwengcindezelo. Amakhono okumfundisa nokuhlakanipha abanye abahloli bezwe.
zu.duties: Ukulawula nokulawula abangaba ngaphansi kwabo (ulawulo lwabantu). Ukuqamba umthetho Wokuhamba Ezindleleni, Wezokuhamba Ngabashayeli Bakhethiwe, Wezokuhamba Omunye Nomthetho Ohlobene. Ukuhlola Amalayisensi Abashayeli Nezimoto Eziphathwa Ngesandla kanye nokulawula ukuthobekela ema-Centers Okuhlola Amaalayisensi Abashayeli (DLTC) Nasemasiteshini Okuhlola Izimoto (VTS). Ukuze kuphumelele ukulawula/Ukuphatha Okubonakalayo Kokuhamba Ezindleleni futhi kukhuthaze/kuqinisekise izinhlelo zokuthwesa amacala bonke. Ukwenza yonke imisebenzi yokuqamba nemisebenzi ehlotshanayo. Ukuhlola izimo zezindlela. Ukumfundisa nokuhlakanipha Abahloli Bezwe (PIs) abakulesimo sokuqeqeshwa nabo beve abafakiwe.

xh.title: Umhloli Wezulu oPhakamileyo
xh.summary: Kufunekwe abahloli bezulu abaphakamileyo kulo lonke iKwaZulu-Natal ukugcinwa kwemithetho yegqitha lomgama, ukulawula abangaphansi, nokuqaphela ukuthobela imithetho kumaziko ovavayo.
xh.requirements: Isetifikazi seKumatikulum; noku Isidanga sokuba Ngumlawuli weNqanaba lokuQala; noku Ubulungiseleli njengomlawuli wegqitha lomgama; noku Isipili sangoku esingaphantsi kweminyaka elingama 3 - 5 esiphiwo ngokomsebenzi njengomhloli wezulu; noku Ilayisensi yokuqesha esebenzayo (ikhowudi engu B ubuncinane); noku Abafakeli akufuneki babe negunya lezono. Ulwazi, Amapqwathi namandla afunekayo: Ulwazi nokuqonda kwemithetho yegqitha lomgama nezoThutho ezikuZezomntu wonke, iinkqubo nemithetho. Ulwazi ngokuvavwa kwezithuthi, ukuboshwa kwezithuthi nokuqwalasela amaxwebhu oMthetho. Ulwazi ngomthetho weMfuyo namaphawu onke oMthetho ka 60/2000, ikhowudi yokuziphatha, izinto ezinobungozi neenkqubo zesebe. Ulwazi malunga neenqobo ezivela kumLawuli weZigwebo, iinqobo zesebe malunga nolawulo lokuqithisela nakuqhuba imisebenzi yokukhusela Incwadi yesiNqanaba sokuThutha (TRH) 11. Ulwazi ngeenqobo ngokusebenza ngezixhobo zomthetho. Amapqwathi okulawula iirekhodi, izixhobo nobunye bobudlelwane namaxhasi. Amapqwathi okubhala (amapqwathi okunxibelelwana ngokubhala nangokuthetha kwiilwimi ezibini ngokubanzi). Amapqwathi okuziphendulela ngemincintiswano nakokuqesha. Amapqwathi axoxisana, acazisa nokuqinisekisa ngokomthetho. Amapqwathi okuqaphela (ukungaboni okuhamayo/iingxaki). Ulwazi ukwazi ukusebenza ngocinakalo. Amapqwathi okukhokela nokuqeqesha.
xh.duties: Ukulawula nokuqonda abangaphansi (ulawulo lwabantu). Ukugcina imithetho yegqitha lomgama, iindwendwe eziBhayibhileyo, ezithuthayo neminye imithetho engumda. Ukuvavanya iilayisensi zoQhubo neziThuthi kwaye ulawule ukuthobela imithetho kumaziko oVavayo iilayisensi zoQhubo (DLTC) nasemagumbini oVavayo iziThuthi (VTS). Ukubonelela nolawulo olubonakalayo lweGqitha lomgama kwaye uqinisekise imisebenzi yokuthintela okwebapha. Ukwenza yonke imisebenzi yophalathi nakunye enxulumene nayo. Ukuvavanya iimeko zomgama. Ukukhokela nokuqeqesha abaHloli beZulu (PIs) abakuluhlu lokungenisa abanjalo nabafakelweyo.

Bestuur en beheer alle skuld-wagrekeninge. Fasiliteer die indiening van oninbare skuldgevalle by die Hoof Finansiële Beampte vir goedkeuring van afskrywing. Bestuur van menslike hulpbronne en ontwikkeling van personeel.

zu.title: Inkantsho Yomphathi: Izinhlelo Zezimali Nenzuzo
zu.summary: Inkantsho yomphathi ephatha izikweletu zomnyango kanye nezinhlelo ezimali eKhomishani Yezokuthutha ePietermaritzburg.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi Samatungulu / Isitifikati SikaZwelonke (Ezemisebenzi) NQF Level 4); kanye nokuthi, Kubekho okungenani eminyaka eyi-3 'emisebenzi ehambisanayo EkuPhathweni Kwezikweletu; kanye nokuthi, Kubekho ilayiseni yomshayeli esemthethweni (Code B noma ephezulu). Ulwazi, Amakhono Nomehluko Odingekayo: Ukuqonda umthetho, izinqubomgomo, imiyalo, amandla okwenza izinqumo, imithetho kanye namaphrosedha. Ukuqonda isibono somnyango, izinhloso, izakhiwo, imisebenzi, izindlela zokuxhumana kanye namaphrosedha okubika. Ulwazi ngokuqonda i-SCOA. Ulwazi ngamahlelo: PERSAL and BAS systems. Ulwazi ngemithetho yokuziphatha yangaphakathi nangaphandle. Ulwazi ngabalingano Bemisebenzi / Amaprosedha Ezikhalazo. Ulwazi ngamaphrosedha kanye namaphrosedha ezimali. Ulwazi nge-PFMA, Imithetho Yesikhwama, Okubhaliwe Komsebenzi, Umthetho Wentela, Izinqubomgomo Namaphrosedha. Ikhono lokutolikwa nokusebenzisa umthetho nenyqubomgomo. Amakhono okucabanga okuhlukanisayo nokususwa iqhaza. Amakhono okuxhumana (Okubhaliwe nokuveza). Ukuba nekhono lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha (Microsoft Excel and Word). Amakhono obudlelwano obungemuntsha. Amakhono okuhlela nokuqamba. Amakhono ebhalansi. Ikhandidithi ejuquzelwayo kufanele ibe nthofu, iqinisekile, isuswa iqhaza, ithathe izinqumo, ibe nomuzwa ngenhlalo, kufanele ibe nokwethembeka futhi igcine okuyimfihlo.
zu.duties: Nikela ngokuqondiswa kwezikweletu ezimfunwe yinkantsho. Yigcine ibhalwe ngokushesha futhi isebenze kalula ezikweletu ezimfunwe yinkantsho. Phatha futhi ulawule konke ama-akhawundi wezikweletu. Yenza kube lula ukuthunyelwa kwamacala ezikweletu ezingabuyiswaku kumPhathi Wezimali ukuze avume ukusetshenziswa. Yigcine ilunga iNzuzo Yabantu nokuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi.

xh.title: Isikhulu Sezolawulo: Iinkqubo Zezimali & Ngeniso
xh.summary: Isikhulu sezolawulo esilawula amatyala esebe nize iinkqubo rezimali kwiSebe Lezothutho ePietermaritzburg.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi sePhakamileyo / Isatifikethi seSizwe (iVocational) NQF Level 4); kunye ne, elinganiselwe kwiminyaka eyi-3 ‘yolwazi olufanelekileyo kwilawulo lwamatyala; kunye ne, ilayisenisi esebenzayo (iCode B okanye ephezulu). Ulwazi, Amandla namakhono Afunekayo: Ukuqonda komthetho, iinkqubo, iimiyalelo, izabelo, iimigaqo nendlela zokwenza izinto. Ukuqonda iimbono, iinjongo, iinkqubo, imisebenzi, iindlela zokunxibelela nendlela zokubika zebe. Ulwazi ngeSCOA. Ulwazi ngeenkcuba: iinkqubo zePERSAL neBAS. Ulwazi lwemigaqo yangaphakathi nangaphandle yokuziphatha. Ulwazi ngeQumrhu Lomsebenzi / Iinkqubo Zezityholo. Ulwazi ngeenkqubo nendlela zokwenza izinto zemali. Ulwazi ngePFMA, Iimigaqo yeQele leMali, Iincwadana zokusebenza, umthetho weVatsho leNgeniso, Iinkqubo namagaqo. Ikhono lokuchaza nokusebenzisa umthetho nenkqubo. Amandla okucinga ngokuhlalutyo nokuba novakalayo. Amandla okunxibelela (okubaliweyo nokuThethwa). Ulwazi lokusebenza ngekhompyutha (iMicrosoft Excel neWord). Amandla abakho ubudlelwane nabantu. Failure to comply with these instructions will lead to applications being disqualified. hould an applicant wish to apply for more than one post, separate applications must be submitted for each post applied for. Kufuneka akwazi ukusebenza ngendlela efunekayo.

Phatha ngakwayo unike inkonzo yezicelo ngaphakathi kwesiqu.

zu.requirements: A Senior Certificate/National Certificate (Vocational) NQF Level 4; kanye nokuhlale okungu-3 kweminyaka ekusebenzeni ngezindaba zemoto yabaholi; kanye nesiqu semoto esivunyelwe (elinganiselwe ku-code B). Ulwazi olungenhla olujwayelekile ngomthetho we-PFMA. Ulwazi olujwayelekile ngomthetho wabasebenzi nangesivumelwano sabasebenzi. Ikono lokusebenzisa Inqubomgomo noMthetho. Ikono lokusebenza ngokunembile. Amakhono angaphezulu okwokubhaliwe nokuvela ngomlomo. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ikono lokuhlela imibiko enomthelela wokuyiqonda kanye nemizuzu yokuhlangana. Umuntu ofanelekile kufanele abe nomthelela wokuhlaziya nokuba nokuhlakula emsebenzini, akwazi ukusebenza ngaphakathi kweqembu nangabadwa, abe nesibindi futhi azithembe ekwenzeni imisebenzi nabantu abalinganayo, abaphezulu nalomphakathi, kufanele aze ahloniphe izikhathi ezimisiwe (izinsuku eziyisibopho), aze asike izinqumo ngaphansi kwezinkinga, abe nesothando esingapheli futhi aze azibophezele ekulethweni kwenkonzo. Kufanele futhi azibophezele, aze abe nenkathalo futhi akwazi ukuzivumelanisa nezimo ezishintshiwe.
zu.duties: Ukuhlola izingozi ezivamile eziba khona ohlelweni olusebenza ngemoto kanye nabasebenzi ngeze-mali, ukulungiswa nokwesulela kwezimoto ezinikwa izibonelelo. Ukulungiselela izinkulumo ezinobungozi kakhulu nemibhalo efanayo mayelana nezinto ezihlobene nemoto. Ukubambisana emisebenzini ebandakanya ukuqapha ukungahambisani nomthetho (ukuphathwa kabi kwezimoto) kulezi zimoto ezingeni lezwe kanye ne-RTI. Ukubambisana kwemihlangano / izinkomba zobuchwepheshe phakathi kwe-MTS, Kwezinye Izingxenye Ezisebenzisa Lezo Zinto, Nezinkampani Ezinikeza Izinsizakalo.

Ulwazi olungaphezu kwesiqingatha malunga ne-PFMA. Ulwazi jikelele malunga nomthetho wabasebenzi namagqabantshintshi. Ulwazi jikelele malunga nemiyalelo yamathambo abantu kuLuntu luHulumende. Amakhona obhalo nokuthetha angaphezu kwesiqingatha. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amandla okulungelelanisa iingxelo ebanzi negqiba lemfumba. Umzobhalo ofanelekelayo kufuneka abe nendlela yokuhlalutya nentsha ekwenzeni imisebenzi, amandla okusebenza kwiiqela nakodwa, ukuzimisela nokuzigqaja kwakhe ekuphatheni abalingane, abaphezulu noluntu, kufuneka abe nobandlulo okumaxesha (iindlela zokuvala), athathe isigqibo ngaphantsi koxinzelelo, abe nolungileyo olungenakulinganiswa aze azinikezele ekunikeni iinkonzo. Ye/ye kufuneka abe nenxaxheba, anamandla okunganyamezeli aze abe namandla okuziqhelanisa nezimo ezitshintshileyo.
xh.duties: Ukuqonda iingozi ezinokubakho jikelele kuLawulo nakulabo abasebenzayo ngeemali, ukugcinwa nokhuselo lezithuthi ezinga nxaxheba. Ukulungelelanisa imibhalo engundoqo neendibano ngokwalawulo lwamaxhesho. Ukuququzelela imisebenzi ethatha inxaxheba ekujongeni ukungalaleli kwemigaqo (ukurhoxiswa kwezithuthi) ngaphakathi koLawulo lweMaxhesho oMmandla ngokubambisana ne-RTI. Ukuququzelela iindibano/amanqanaba wokusebenza phakathi kwe-MTS, kwiizebe Zabasebenzisi kubaniki beZinkonzo.

zu.summary: Inkulu Yesikhungo ehlinzeka ngamasevisi okusekela akhensi okuhlanganisa uqeqesho lwe-NaTIS nokuphathwa kohlelo lokuthola amalayisense ezimoto kuMotor Transport Services ePietermaritzburg.
zu.requirements: Umfakadi wesiNganga samabanga aphezulu/Isitifikedi Sezwe (Umsebenzi we-Vocational) NQF level 4; kanye nobuncwane beminyaka eyi-3 ekuqhubeni izindaba zesikhungo. Ulwazi nokuba ikhono lokusebenzisa imithetho entsha ye-Public Services Regulations Labour Relations Act. Amakhono okwenza izinqumo. Amakhono okuhlela futhi uhlele. Amakhono okusebenza njengesiqhwaga. Amakhono okuxhumana nabantu. Amakhono okuba ngumbhikudi. Amakhono okukhuthaza. Hlinzeka ukwaziswa okuhle kanye nokusetshenziswa kwemithetho yezokuhamba zezimoto, kanye nokuqinisekiswa kwezinhlelo ezintsha ze-NaTIS. Hlinzeka ngokwesekela ngokwezinsiza kanye nokwenza amasevisi okweseka. Qapha izinsiza zokuqasha/abasebenzi.

Lawula umthombo wabantu/abasebenzi.

zu.duties: Yenza izinkalo zezezimali. Lwiza ukuthengwa kwezimpahla nangensebenzo kwiChief Directorate. Yiza ngezinsiza ezisekela okwezabelomali. Yenza izinsiza zokugcina iziqikizi kanye nokulungiselela izibika nangemibhalwano. Qapha abantu/izisebenzi.

Amandla aphathelelo ekuthetheni nakubhaleni. Amandla okubakho kubantu. Amandla okuguquguquka. Ukusebenza njengelungu. Ukusebenza ngekhompyutha. Amandla enkunzi kunye nokuhlelwa. Amandla eelwimi. af.requirements: NQF Vlak 6 in Graphic Design/Art and Design; plus 1 jaar ervaring in 'n Graphic Design-omgewing of verwante veld; plus 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie (minimum kode B). af.title: Persoonlike Assistent
af.summary: Verskaf sekretariële, receptions- en administratiewe ondersteuning aan senior bestuur binne die Department of Transport in KwaZulu-Natal.
af.requirements: A Sekretariële Diploma of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie verwant aan sekretariaat; plus 'n minimum van 3 years' ervaring in die lewer van 'n ondersteuningsdiens aan senior bestuur. zu.title: Umcebisi Omuntu Siqu
zu.summary: Nikela ngokusekela okuphathelene nokubhalisa kwemibhalo, ukwamukela izivakashi kanye nokuphatha izindaba zomnyango abaphezulu ngaphakathi koMnyango Wezokuthutha eKwaZulu-Natali.
zu.requirements: I-Diploma Yokubhalisa Izindaba noma izifundo ezingangaleyo ezihlobene nokubhalisa; okuhlanganise nosuku olungenaphansi ko-3 lweminyaka okuhlola kunikeza insiza yokuqinisekisa ukwesekwa abaphezulu bokuphatha. Ulwazi, Amafundo namakhono Afunwayo: Ulwazi ngomthetho/inqubo/emigomopho kanye nezinqubo ezithinta le minyakazo. Ulwazi oluyisisekelo ngokuphatha izimali. Amafundo wakhona kanye nethuba lokuxhumana kahle nabantu abangamazinga ahlukene kanye nalabo abavela kwezinye izindawo. Inqubo elungile yokukhuluma ecingweni. Ukusebenzisana kwakhona. Amakhono aphumelelayo okulungiselela izindaba. Amakhono aphumelelayo okuphatha. Izinga eliphezulu lokuzethemba. Amakhono okubhala obekela ngokudlulisa ulwazi. Isiqu sokuphatha ngokucophelela kanye nokungakhombisi okuphathelene nezindaba ezimfihlo. Isiqu sokwenza uphenyo kanye nokuhlaziya amadokhumenti izimo. Ukuzilungisa kahle kanye namakhono okubukeka kahle. Amakhono okuzilawula nokuzikhandla. Ithemba lokusebenza ngaphansi kokucindezeleka.
zu.duties: Nikela ngesisekelo sokubhalisa okwemibhalo/ukwamukela izivakashi kuMqondisi/Umqondisi Omkhulu. Nikeza izinsiza zokusekela ngokuphathwa. Yeka isisekelo kuMqondisi/UmQondisi Omkhulu mayelana nezinkomfa. Sekela uMqondisi/UmQondisi Omkhulu ngokuphathwa kwebhajethi. Funda imigomo noma izinqubo ezithinta Isevisi Yomphakathi noma koMnyango namadokhumenti okunye uqinisekise ukuthi ukuqonda kwakho kokuqonda kokuqondwa ngokufanele. Hlola futhi uhlaziye izincomo noma amadokhumenti uphendule kuMqondisi noma uMqondisi Omkhulu ngokufanele.

xh.duties: Nikeza inkonzo yosexeshari/omamkeli kwi-Director/Chief Director. Zisa inkonzo yolawulo. Nikeza inkxaso ku-Director/Chief Director malunga nemihlangano. Examine Drivers’ Licences and Motor Vehicles and monitor compliance at Driver Licence Testing Centres (DLTC) and Vehicle Testing Stations (VTS). zu.title: Isiphuleli Sesifunda
zu.summary: Oziphuleli Besifunda baphatha imithetho yegciwane zokuhamba kwegwegwi nezokuthutha emikhakheni eminingi yase KwaZulu-Natal, kudingeka ikhitheshane ephezulu, ilayisensi evumelekile nesidiploma Sabaholi Boxhaliswa.
zu.requirements: Ikhitheshane ephezulu; kanye nelayisensi yokushayela evumelekile (okungu-Code B okuncane); kanye nesidiploma esiyisisekelo Sabaholi Boxhaliswa; kanye nenyanga eyodwa yokuhlolwa okwenziwayo kokuphoqwa kwemithetho; kanye nokuthi abafaka izicelo kungekho rekhothi yobugebengu. Izindingo sezaziso, amakhono namandla okwenza imisebenzi: Ulwazi nokuqonda imithetho yegciwane zokuhamba kwegwegwi nezokuthutha kwabantu, izinkambiso nemithetho. Ulwazi lokuvivinywa kwemoto nokuthwengwa kwebhalansi. Ulwazi lokugcwalisa amafayela okuphoqwa kwemithetho. Ulwazi lomthetho wamasotsha namathambo Act 60/2000. Ulwazi lwenkambiso yokuziphatha. Ulwazi lwezinto eziyingozi. Ulwazi lwenkambiso zomnyango. Ulwazi lezinhlelo zokweluleka ezivela kwaDirektha Wokubeka Icala Esidlangaleni. Ulwazi lezinkambiso zomnyango ngokulawula ukudonswa ngokweqile kanye nemisebenzi yokuqeqesha Transport Handbook (TRH) 11. Ulwazi lezinkambiso zokuqhuba ngemishini yokuphoqwa kwemithetho. Amakhono okulawula amarekhodi namadatha. Amakhono okuphathisana nabalaleli. Amakhono okubhala nokuqhuba (amakhono okuxhumana okubhaliwe nasokukhulunywa ngokungenangqondo kolimi olungezansi ezibongeni ezimbili zesifunda). Amakhono okucinga nokuxazulula izinkinga. Amakhono okushayela. Amakhono okuhumusha. Amakhono okusebenza ngokwemithetho. Amakhono okubheka (ukunqamula amalawu / ukungahambisani). Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwengcindezi.
zu.duties: Phatha imithetho yegciwane yokuhamba kwegwegwi, yolwelwesiwe Bantu nezokuthutha. Hlola amalayisensi Abashayeli namimoto bese ulawula ukuzinza emaphoyintini Okuhlola Amalayisensi Abashayeli (DLTC) nasemasiteshini Okuhlola Amimoto (VTS). Nikeza ukulawula ukuthutha / ukuphatha ngokubonakalayo futhi wkuthuthukise / qinisekise izinkalo zokuvikela ubugebengu. Yenza yonke imisebenzi yolawulo nemisebenzi ephathelene nayo.

xh.title: Umphandi woMmandla
xh.summary: AbaPhandi boMmandla bayaphonononga kwaye basebenzisa imithetho yeqela lamatyala nezithuthi kwiiZiko ezininzi zeKwaZulu-Natal, kufuneka abe neSatifikathi seKholishi Ephakamileyo, ilayisenisi esebenzayo nesiDiploma samaPhathi weeQela laMatyala.
xh.requirements: Isatifikathi seKholishi Ephakamileyo; kanjalo Ilayisenisi yoKushayela esebenzayo (ikhowudi encinane i-B); kanjalo iDiploma yamaPhathi beeQela laMatyala esiseko; kanjalo Unyaka omnye wolwazi lomsebenzi ekusebenziseni umthetho; kanjalo Abakhangeli bengaphandle kubekho irekhodi yokwenzakalisa umthetho. Ulwazi, Amandla namakhono aFunekayo: Ulwazi nokuqonda koMthetho weeQela laMatyala nezoThutho zikaRhulumente, iinkqubo nemithetho. Ulwazi ngokuphonononga izithuthi nokuthathwa kwazo ngamandla. Ulwazi ngokugqiba amaFomu oMthetho. Ulwazi ngoMthetho weMapetshe neMbanje 60/2000. Ulwazi ngokuza kolwabiwo-mthetho. Ulwazi ngeempahla ezayingozeki. Ulwazi lweenkqubo zeSabe. Ulwazi lweenkqubo zikaMlawuli weeQela laMatyala. Ulwazi lweenkqubo zeSabe ngokulawula ukugqithisa umthwalo nemisebenzi yoQhankqalazo incwadi yoThutho (TRH) 11. Ulwazi ngemila yokuqhuba imisebenzi ngaphezulu ngezixhobo zokusebenzisa umthetho. Amandla okulawula iirekhodi namaphakathi. Amandla okulawula ubudlelwane namaxhasi. Amandla okufunda nokuqamba (Amandla okuxela nokuqamba ngenani elinguzwi nengolwazi kwiilwimi ezimbini zommandla). Amandla okuxoxa nokuxazula iingxabano. Amandla okuqhuba. Amandla okutolika. Amandla eMthetho. Amandla okubona (iziphithiphithi ekuthwini/kuswipho). Amandla okusebenza ngaphantsi komthwalo.
xh.duties: Baphonononge kuQhagamshelwano ngokusebenzisa umthetho weQela laMatyala, nezoThutho. Baphephe iilayisenisi zoBashayeli neziThuthi eziNjengamashishini baze bajonge ukuthobela kuQhagamshelwano kwiZiko eLingcali yokuPhepha ukuXilixa iLayisenisi (DLTC) naseNtethweni yokuXilixa iziThuthi (VTS). Babone nokuQhankqalaza iQela laMatyala ngokusesikweni / baQhankqalaze baze baQinise ukuthintwa kwezenzo ezingamthetho. Bawenze onke amashishini olawulo nemisebenzi eehambayo.

Knowledge of production process and skills. Knowledge of technical consulting. Problem solving and analysis skills. Decision making skills. Teamwork skills. Creativity skills. Self – management skills. Customer focus and responsiveness skills. Communication skills. Computer skills. Planning and organising skills. The ideal candidate must be analytical, reliable, accurate, open, transparent, innovative and have integrity.
jobs.duties: Design: Produce designs according to client specifications and within limits of production capability. Production: Produce objects with material and equipment according to job specifications and recognised standards. Quality assurance of produced objects. Maintenance: Inspect equipment and plant for technical faults. Repair equipment and facilities according to standards. Test repaired equipment and plant against specifications. Service equipment and plant according to schedule. Quality assure serviced and maintained equipment and/or facilities. Perform administrative and related functions: Compile and submit reports. Provide inputs to the operational plan. Keep and maintain job record/register, and supervise and mentor staff. Maintain and advance expertise: Continuous individual development to keep up with new technologies and procedures. Research/literature studies on technical /engineering technology to improve expertise.

af.summary: Ambagsman Produksie posisies vir meganiese handelslange oor verskeie KwaZulu-Natal streke, wat 'n Handelsonderwyssertifikaat en 'n geldige bestuurslisensie vereis, met salaris gegradeer volgens ervaring.
af.requirements: Graad A: Geen ervaring vereis Graad B: Ten minste 18 jaar se ervaring Graad C: Ten minste 34 jaar se ervaring 'n Toepaslike Handelsonderwyssertifikaat in Aardbewegingsuitrustingsmegnikus/Konstruksie-aanlegmegnikus/Trekkermegnikus/Dieselmegnikus; plus 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie (minimum kode C1). Selfbestuursvaardighede. Kliëntfokus en reaksievermoë-vaardighede. Kommunikasievaardighede. Rekenaarvaardighede. Beplannings- en organiseervaardighede. Die ideale kandidaat moet analities, betroubaar, akkuraat, oop, deursigtig, innoverend en van onkreukbaarheid wees.
af.duties: Ontwerp: Produeer ontwerpe volgens kliëntspesifikasies en binne die perke van produksievermoë. Produksie: Produeer voorwerpe met materiaal en toerusting volgens werkspecifikasies en erkende standaarde. Kwaliteitsversekering van geproduseerde voorwerpe. Amakhono okusebenza njengenhlangano. Amakhono obuqandisi. Amakhono okuzilawula. Amakhono okugxila kumthengi nokuphendula. Amakhono okuthintana. Amakhono ekhompyutha. Amakhono okucubungula futhi ahenyuse. Ofanele kumele abe ukhona ongumhlaziya, ethembekayo, onesiqinisekiso, ovulekile, ocacile, ongumbono omtsha futhi abe nentlalo.

Ukugcina: Hlola izinsiza nomqondo wesikhungo ngamaphutha ezobuchwepheshe. Lungisa izinsiza kanye namakhaya abantu ngokuvumelana namazinga. Hlola izinsiza ezilungisiwe nomqondo wesikhungo ngokumelana namazinga. Ukuphatha umqondo wesikhungo namakhaya abantu ngokuhlelele. Gcina futhi ulondoloze irekhodi lesibalo semisebenzi, futhi wahlule futhi uthuse abantu abafunda. Ulwazi lwenkqubo yokukhiqiza namakhono. Ulwazi locebiso lommandla wenzululwazi. Amakhono okusombulula iingxaki nokuhlalutya. Amakhono okuthabatha izigqibo. Amakhono okusebenza njengesithyembu. Amakhono okudala. Amakhono oziqhelaniso. Amakhono okugxila kumthengi nokuphendula. Amakhono encokolishi. Amakhono ekompyutha. Amakhono okuceba nokuhlela. Umzobi ofanelekayo kufuneka abe ngumhlalutyi, ethembekile, onechibi, evulekileyo, etyhila, enolwazi oluqhuba phambili enobuzigqibo.

Ukukhiqiza: Ukukhiqiza izinto ngesixhobo nengqalelo ngokwesiganeki somsebenzi nangokwezilinganisi ezamkelweyo. Ukuqinisekisa inqanaba lemveliso evelisiweyo. Ukulungisa: Ukuphefa iidrayivhazi ngesixhobo ukujonga iziphako zobuchwepheshe. Ukulungisa iidrayivhazi nezibako ngokwezilinganiso. Ukuvavanya iidrayivhazi ezilungiweyo nangokuhamba nengqalelo. Ukunika inkonzo ngesixhobo nakumashishini ngokweluhlu. Ukuqinisekisa inqanaba lemveliso ekunikiweyo inkonzo kwiidrayivhazi kwaye nangokwemiba. Ukwenza imisebenzi yoburhulumente naphina: Ukudidiyelwa nokungenisa iingxelo. Ukuhlinzeka ngeengxelo zeplani yokusebenza. Ukugcina nokulondoloza irekhodi lesiganeki, nokuqondisa ne ukukhokela abasebenzi. Ukulondoloza nokuqhubela phambili ulwazi: Ukuphuhlisa ngokuqhubekayo umntu ngamnye ukugcina ukukwazi iindlela ezintsha zokusebenza. Iingxelo zophando/ncwadi ezifundwa ngobuchwepheshe ube ngokwemfundo ukuze uphucule ulwazi.

Isitifikedi esifanele senhlololwle yokuhlolwa kobuchwepheshe ohlalweni oluhlobene nokuakhiwa; kanye Nelayisensi evumelekile yokushayela (okuncane ikhodi C1). Ulwazi, amakhono namandla adingekayo: Ulwazi loluhlengahlengiso lwobuchwepheshe. Ulwazi lokubhala umbhalo obhaliwe ngobuchwepheshe. Ulwazi ngosizo lwekhompyutha kwezinhlelo zolwazi zobuchwepheshe. Ulwazi ngokuzelelana ngemithetho. Ulwazi ngokuqhuba imikhiqizo nokwazi ukuzihlanganisa. Ulwazi ngokweluleka ngobuchwepheshe. Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlengahlengisa. Amakhono okwenza izinqumo. Amakhono okusebenza ngokuhlangana. Amakhono okudala okusha. Amakhono okuzilawela. Amakhono okugqamisa umthengi futhi uphendule ngokushesha. Amakhono okuthintana nabantu. Amakhono ekompyutha. Amakhono okucubungula futhi uhlele. Umuntu oseqhingqweni kumele abe nomqondo oqondo, ethembekile, eqinisekile, ovulekile, ocacile, oqambe izinkumbulo futhi oneqiniso.
zu.duties: Ukuqamba: Kukhiqize izinhlela ngokwezidingo zikamthengi futhi ngaphakathi kwezikhulu zomthamo wokukhiqiza. Ukukhiqiza: Kukhiqize izinto ngokweminikelo namathuluzi ngokwezidingo zemisebenzi nangokwezilinganiso ezivunyelwe. Ukuqinisekisa ubuhle bokukhiqizwa kwezinto. Ukugcinwa: Hlolela amathuluzi nesitshalo iziphako zobuchwepheshe. Londola amathuluzi nemisebenzi ngokwezilinganiso. Hlolisisa amathuluzi alondolozwe nesitshalo ngokumelana nezidingo. Phathela amathuluzi nesitshalo ngokwaluhlelo. Qinisekisa ubuhle kwamathuluzi aphetshuliwe futhi agcinwe kanye nemisebenzi. Yenza imisebenzi yobulungiswa nokuhlobene nayo: Hlela futhi uhambise umbhalo obhaliwe. Nikeza okungenayo ekuhlelweni kokusebenza. Gcina futhi ulondoloze ibhalo lesikhathi /umlando, futhi qaphise futhi umfundise izisebenzi. Gcina futhi thuthukisa ukwazi: Ukuthuthuka ngokuqhubekayo komuntu ngamunye ukuze ukwazi ukulandelana netheknoloji entsha namasu. Izifundo zocwaningo /okubhaliwe kobuchwepheshe /isitsha sobuchwepheshe ukuthuthukisa ukwazi.

xh.requirements: Inqanaba A: Akukho mkhwa wamava ufunekayo Inqanaba B: Ubuncinane leminyaka elingama-18 yamava Inqanaba C: Ubuncinane leminyaka engama-34 yamava. Isatifikethi esifanelekileo senkcubeko yomsebenzi kummando onxulunyaniswe nokwakhiwa; kananjalo Ilayisenisi esisebenzayo (ikhowedi engu-C1 ubuncinane). Ulwazi, Amakhono namakhono afunekayo: Ulwazi lokuhlalutya ngobuchwepheshe. Ulwazi lokubhala iingxelo zobuchwepheshe. Ulwazi lwezicelo zobuchwepheshe ezisebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulwazi ngokuthobela umthetho. Ulwazi lwemigaqo yokukhiqiza namakhono. Ulwazi lokubonelela ngecebiso zobuchwepheshe. Amakhono okusombulula iingxaki nohlalutyo. Amakhono okwenza izigqibo. Amakhono okusebenza njengethim. Amakhono okuba nobusunguli. Amakhono okuzilawula. Amakhono okugxila kumthengi nokubaphendula. Amakhono ebonakalisa ulwazi oluthethwayo. Amakhono ekhompyutheni. Amakhono okucwangcisa nokuhlela. Umphathi ofanelekayo kufuneka abe ngumhlalutyi, athembekile, achaneke, avulekile, abengantlanzi, anamagqabantshintshi ajolise kuwo, anecepiso ezingcinga ngokusela ngqo kwaye anobungcali.
xh.duties: Ukulungiselela nokwakha: Ukukhiqiza ukwakhiwa ngokwemimiselo yomthengi nangaphakathi kwemida yamandla okukhiqiza. Ukukhiqiza: Ukukhiqiza izinto ngezinto zokwakhiwa noloncedo ngokwemimiselo yomsebenzi namagqabantshintshi aqatshulweyo. uQinisekiso lwezinga lemveliso ekhiqizwayo. Ukulungiselela nokulondoloza: Ukuhlola ukhoncedo kunye nendalo yeempahla iindlela zobuchwepheshe ngokubakho kweziphene nobugxa. Ukulungisa ukhoncedo neendawo ngokwemigaqo. Ukuhlola nokuvavanya ukhoncedo oluqhotyosiweyo nendalo yeempahla. Ukukhonceda ukhoncedo nendalo yeempahla ngokwemijahazo. Ukulungisa izinto ezikhonziweyo nokhoncedo olulungiweyo kwaye iindawo ezilondolozwayo zibe zicwangciswe ngokwemigaqo echanekileyo. Ukwenza imisebenzi yabaphathi iyonke: Ukuqamba nokuthumela iingxelo. Ukubonelela izigqibo emngenweni wokusebenza. Ukugcina ukurekhoda nenzame yokugcina imisebenzi, ngokunjalo ukulawula ngokwakho abo basalayo kunye nokubafundisa. Ukulondoloza nokuphucula isiphiwo: Imfundo eyaholwayo ngayinye ngokokuqhubela phambili ukugcina isikhundla eksantasi yokutsha kwamachasi obuchwepheshe kunye nemigaqo ekuqhubekayo. Ukuphanda iintlobo zolwazi ngakwiyure zesifundo kunjalo nommandaraba obuchwepheshe phantsi kokuphuhca izicwangciso zesiphene zobugcisa ukuphucula amandla ekufundeni izinto ezintsha.

Ukuqonda umbono womnyango, izinhloso, izakhiwo, izikhulu zokuxhumana kanye nomaqondiso wokubika. Ulwazi ngemiyalo mayelana nokuphathwa komhlahlandlela jikelele. Ulwazi ngamaqondiso wokubika kanye nendawo yokusebenza. Ulwazi ngomthetho weziqu mayelana nokuxhumana komsebenzi/inqubo yokuphathwa kwezikhalazo. Ulwazi lwekhodi yokuziphatha. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amakhono wezimali kanye nezindaba ezihlobene. Amakhono wamasistimu wezolawulo kanye nokuqhuba. Noma yiluphi ulwazi ohlobene lomthetho osebenzayo. Amakhono abhalwe isibongo samatikulo. Amakhono okuxhumana. Amakhono okubhala umbiko. Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga, ahlukanise bese ehumusha. Amakhono ahle kahle abantu. Amakhono wokuhlela, ukuhlanganisa nokuhlela umsebenzi. Umuntu ofanelekayo kufanele anikeze inkinga ngezinhloso zendawokusebenza, alandele isivumelwano sokusebenza, ukulethwa kwensiza kanye nenhlonipho yemali, futhi kufanele abe ngumuntu ocinga ngosuku entsha, akhulume kakhulu kumsebenzi ohlangene kwaye akwazi ukusebenza eyedwa, futhi kufanele abe nomdlandla ekukhuleni, abe ngumuntu oqhakambisa, onesiklidi, agcine imfihlo, kufune athweswe isikhathi, ahloniphekwe kwaye namandla. Kufanele abe ngumuntu othathwa njengomphathi ozinikele, ozimotivela, ethembekayo, qotho, onganuki, ethembeka, onobuhlakani kwezombangazwe kwaye anesithunzi.
zu.duties: Nika insiza yohlelo lokubhaliswa kwemoto kanye nemvume yokushayela indawo yemali yasemabhange ngokuvumelana nomthetho we National Road traffic Act. Yenza imisebenzi yamabhange nsuku zonke kanye nezohwebo ezihlobene nemali kwaye ulinganise imali etholwe mayelana ne PFMA kanye Nezimiso ze Treasury. Yenza wonke amasevisi eNatis/cashier ahlobene ne Taxi Recap kwaye uqinisekise imibhalo kanye nezicelo ezitholwe kwaye ubambe izohwebo. Phendula imibuzo yomphakathi jikelele mayelana nokubhaliswa kwemoto kanye nemvume yokushayela. Nikeza insiza yocwaningo lwe Supply Chain ngaphakathi kwesiqu.

xh.title: Inkukhetha Yolawulo (PRODUCTION): Ikhawuntara Yoluntu
xh.summary: Kufuneka inkukhetha yolawulo kwi-Motor Transport Services e-Pietermaritzburg ukunika iinkonzo zebhanki yemali yobhaliso nephawulelo kwezithuthi.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethhi se-Senior/ Isatifikethhi seSizwe (i-Vocational) NQF inqanaba 4: Ulwazi, amakhono namabala afunekayo: Ulwazi olusisigwegwe ngamacebo othutha nendlela zonke ebalulekileyo namacebo amaninzi. Ulwazi lwe-National Road Traffic Act 93 ka-1966. Ulwazi lwe-Public Finance Management Act ka-1999, i-Provincial Practice Notes ne-Treasury Instructions. Ulwazi lwe-Public Service Act namacebo ka-1999, i-Labour Relations Act ka-1995, i-Employment Equity Act ka-1998, i-Basic Conditions of Employment Act ka-1997 ne-Skills Development Act ka-1997. Ulwazi lokuLawula Abasebenzi Bantu neemvisiswelo zalo, iimvisiswelo zoBukhosi buleungileyo, ukuHlinzekwa kweenkonzo, iimvisiswelo ze-Batho Pele nekhowudi yomvuzo (CORE). Ulwazi lwe-National Road Traffic Information System (NaTIS) nokusetyenziswa kwayo. Ulwazi lokuNikwa amandla okuLawula neendlela zoKuhlola ezeMali. Ukuqonda kubono kwisebe, iinjongo, iindaba, iindlela zoxhumo neendlela zokubika. Ulwazi lwendlela ngokulawulo jikelele kweofisi. Ulwazi lweendlela zokubiza nokusingqongileyo okusebenzela kuko. Ulwazi lweendlela ze-labour relations/izingelo. Ulwazi lekhowudi yokuziphatha. Ulwazi ngakumbi ngalo. Amakhono eeMali nendaba ezinxulumene nayo. Amakhono kwindlela zeNkqubo yolawulo. Amakhona kuyo nayiphi na imigaqo ephilayo nokuqeqeshwa. Amakhona ebala ngokubhala. Amakhona okuThetha. Amakhona okubhala iNgxelo. Amakhona okuSombulula iingxaki, ukuQonda nokuhlalutya iingxaki. Amakhona okwenza ubudlelwane namathandathu namadoda. Amakhona oKuyilwa, ukuNgenelela nokuHlelwa. Umzekelo ongumntu ofanelekileyo kufuneka aqiniswe ngokwemigqala yoluntu, aze achonge kwinkxaso-mvuzo, ukuletha iinkonzo ngokusebenzisa imali, maba ngumntu ogqamayo ekwenzeni, abe ngumsebenzisi oqeqesha abantu bakhe, abe nako ukwenza ngokuphela kwakhe mntu, kube nomdla wakhe ekuqeqeshweni, ngumsebenzi, ngokuchanekileyo, agcine iimfihlo, aze achaneke, abe noNika mthondo, abe nolwazi. Yena kufuneka abeni xanduva, azikhusele, aze axakeke, aze angathembeki, angazi ukuthembeka, azinike kwindlela axe ethembekileyo, athe ngcono anobuzwe ngokubakhe.
xh.duties: Kunika iinkonzo zebhanki yemali yobhaliso nephawulelo kwezithuthi ngokwemigaqo ye-National Road traffic Act. Yenza iinkonzo zebhanki yemihla leyo kunye nendaba ezinxulumene nemali, kwaye ulinganise imali ehamba ngokwe-PFMA nendlela ze-Treasury Regulations. Zama iimibuzo yoluntu jikelele ehlobene nobhaliso nephawulelo kwezithuthi. Zeza inkxaso-msebenzi ye-Supply Chain enkqabeni ekule nxalenye.

jobs.title: Administrative Clerk (PRODUCTION)
jobs.closing_date_text: 28 August 2026 (at 16h00). Applications received after the closing date and time will not be considered.
jobs.summary: Administrative clerk sought at the Road Traffic Inspectorate in Pietermaritzburg to provide customer service and ensure correct monies under PFMA regulations.
jobs.requirements: A Senior Certificate / National Certificate (Vocational) NQF Level 4. Knowledge, Skills and Competencies Required: Knowledge of eNaTIS. Knowledge of Road Traffic Act 93 of 1996. Knowledge of Public Finance Management Act. Knowledge of Provincial Treasury Practice Notes. Knowledge of Public Service Act. Knowledge of Public Service Code of Conduct. Knowledge of Departmental vision, objectives, commitment charters. Knowledge of good governance principles, service delivery, Batho Pele principles. Knowledge of policies and procedures. Knowledge of administrative office practices. Good communication skills (verbal and written). Computer literacy. Ability to comprehend. Good human relations skills. Skills in eNaTIS procedures. Ability to accurately handle cash and other methods of payment. Basic accounting skills. The ideal candidate should be committed to organizational goals, comply with performance agreement, believe in service delivery, be an innovative thicker, teamwork-orientated and able to work independently. He/she should show interest in development, be accurate, confident, punctual, courteous, have tact, be responsible, self-motivated, reliable, honest, loyal, trustworthy, diplomatic, have integrity, adhere to rules and regulations and have the ability to comprehend.
jobs.duties: Provide an effective and efficient customer service to the public. Ensure correct monies in keeping with PFMA Regulations. Provide accurate information at all times to the public. Timeous delivery to the public.

af.title: Administratiewe Klerk (PRODUKSIE)
af.summary: Administratiewe klerk gesoek by die Road Traffic Inspectorate in Pietermaritzburg om kliëntediens te lewer en te verseker dat geld korrek ingevolge PFMA-regulasies hanteer word.
af.requirements: 'n Senior Sertifikaat / Nasionale Sertifikaat (Vokasioneel) NQF Level 4. Kennis, vaardighede en bevoegdhede vereis: Kennis van eNaTIS. Kennis van Road Traffic Act 93 of 1996. Kennis van Public Finance Management Act. Kennis van Provincial Treasury Practice Notes. Kennis van Public Service Act. Kennis van Public Service Code of Conduct. Kennis van departementele visie, doelwitte, verbintenisverklarings. Kennis van beginsels van goeie bestuur, dienslewering, Batho Pele-beginsels. Kennis van beleide en prosedures. Kennis van administratiewe kantoorpraktyke. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede (mondelings en skriftelik). Rekenaarvaardigheid. Vermoë om te begryp. Goeie menslike verhoudingsvaardighede. Vaardighede in eNaTIS-prosedures. Vermoë om kontant en ander betaalmetodes akkuraat te hanteer. Basiese rekenkundige vaardighede. Die ideale kandidaat moet toegewyd wees aan organisatoriese doelwitte, voldoen aan prestasie-ooreenkoms, glo in dienslewering, 'n innoverende denker wees, spanwerk-georiënteerd wees en in staat wees om onafhanklik te werk. Hy/sy moet belangstelling toon in ontwikkeling, akkuraat wees, selfversekerd wees, stip wees, hoflik wees, taktvol wees, verantwoordelik wees, selfgemotiveerd wees, betroubaar wees, eerlik wees, lojaal wees, vertrouenswaardig wees, diplomatiek wees, integriteit hê, aan reëls en regulasies voldoen en die vermoë hê om te begryp.
af.duties: Lwer doeltreffende en effektiewe kliëntediens aan die publiek. Verseker dat geld korrek ingevolge PFMA-regulasies hanteer word. Verskaf te alle tye akkurate inligting aan die publiek. Tydige aflewering aan die publiek.

zu.title: ISikhulu SoMqulu Wezokuphatha (UKUKHIQIZA)
zu.summary: Kudingeka isikhulu somqulu wezokuphatha ku-Road Traffic Inspectorate e-Pietermaritzburg ukunikeza inkonzo yabathengi futhi kuqiniseke imali efanele ngaphansi komthetho we-PFMA.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi Samatungulu / Isitifikedi Sikazwelonke (Umsebenzi) NQF Level 4. Ulwazi, Amandla Namakhono Adayiswe: Ulwazi nge-eNaTIS. Ulwazi ngomthetho we-Road Traffic Act 93 of 1996. Ulwazi ngomthetho we-Public Finance Management Act. Ulwazi nge-Provincial Treasury Practice Notes. Ulwazi ngomthetho we-Public Service Act. Ulwazi nge-Public Service Code of Conduct. Ulwazi ngesibono somnyango, izinjongo, namakhasimende okuzibophezela. Ulwazi ngezimiso ezinhle zokuphatha, ukulethwa kwenkonzo, nezimiso ze-Batho Pele. Ulwazi ngezinqubomgomo namagepha. Ulwazi ngezokuphatha kohlelo lwezohlelo. Amandla okuxhumana ahle (okukhulunywayo nokubhaliwayo). Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukukwazi ukuqonda. Amandla ahle abantu abahlobene naye. Amandla kumagepha we-eNaTIS. Ukukwazi ukuphatha ngokunembile imali neminye imikhondo yokuhalakahela. Amandla abalulekile ezezimali. Umphakethi oyingqayi kumele azibophezele ezinjungweni zentShaywebo, ahambisane nesivumelwano sokusebenza, akholelwe ekuveleni kwenkonzo, abe umsinsi ongcono, oqhivelele kubantu futhi akwazi ukusebenza eyedwa. Yena kumele abonise ukwaziswa kokuthuthukiswa, abe unembile, aqinise, ahambisane nesikhathi, abe nomzwisa, abe nokuhlakanipha, abe nomthwalo oyingqayi, aziphelezela, aqiniseke, angaqambeki, aqiniswe, athembekile, athembisa, aholwayo, alalele, ahambisane nemithetho namagepha futhi anamandla okuqonda.
zu.duties: Nikeza abantu inkonzo esebenzayo futhi enokusebenza kahle. Qiniseka imali efanele ngokuhambisana nemithetho ye-PFMA. Nikeza ulwazi olunembile noma kunini wonke abantu. Ukuveliswa kwenkonzo esikhathini esifanele kubantu.

xh.title: Clerk wezeNgqungqutha (ENZO)
xh.summary: Kufunwa i-clerk wezengqungquthela kwi-Road Traffic Inspectorate e-Pietermaritzburg ukunika inkonzo yabathengi kunye nokwenzela okokuba imali ichanekile ngokwemigaqo ye-PFMA.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi samabanga aphezulu / Isatifikethi leSizwe (Umsebenzi) NQF Level 4. Ulwazi, amakhono namandla afunekayo: Ulwazi nge-eNaTIS. Ulwazi nge-Road Traffic Act 93 of 1996. Ulwazi nge-Public Finance Management Act. Ulwazi nge-Provincial Treasury Practice Notes. Ulwazi nge-Public Service Act. Ulwazi nge-Public Service Code of Conduct. Ulwazi ngabom bhono lwebhulorho, iinjongo, namagunya okuzinikela kwisebe. Ulwazi ngemigaqo yolawulo olulungileyo, ukulelwa kwenkonzo, namagunya e-Batho Pele. Ulwazi ngemigaqo nendlela yokwenza izinto. Ulwazi ngenkqubo yolawulo kwindlu yolawulo. Amakhono amable womxhaso (olwandle nolubhalwayo). Ukuba nalwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ikhono elokuziphatha. Amakhono amable omtshato wabantu. Amakhono kwinkqubo ye-eNaTIS. Ikhono elokuphatha imali ngezinye iindlela zokuhlawulela ngokuchanekileyo. Amakhono abakhwesi ebhalwe namanani. Ongammiselo kufuneka azinikzele kwiinjongo zhapo, athobelele kwinkundane yokusebenza, akholwe kuluntu lwenkonzo, abe ngumntu obakhwa iinkqango zitsha, akhuthaze umsebenzi wobunye angakwazi ukusebenza yedwa. Makabe nolwazi lophuhliso, achaneke, aqinisekile, aze kwindlela, abe nothelelwano, abe namanyathelo, azibe neluleko, athobe, zimisele ngokwakhe, ethembekile, qaqileli, inyanisekile, ethembekile, aziphethe kakuhle, athobelele kumagunya nemigaqo alikhono elokuziphatha.
xh.duties: Nika inkonzo yabathengi echanekileyo neseziko nakuluntu. Qinisekisa ukuba imali ichaneke ngokwemigaqo ye-PFMA. Nika iinkcukacha ezichanekileyo ngamaxa onke nakuluntu. Ukulelwa kwexesha elifanelekileyo nakuluntu.

zu.title: Iklekidi Ezonqweni (UKUKHIQIZA): Ukutholakala Kwemoto
zu.summary: Kudingeka iklekidi ezenqweni e-Motor Transport Services e-Pietermaritzburg ukunikeza inkxaso ezenqweni nokucubungula izenzo ze-NaTIS.
zu.requirements: Isitifikadi Samabanga Aphezulu/ Isitifikadi Sezwe (Umsebenzi) NQF izinga 4. Ulwazi, Amakhono Namakhono Adingekayo: Ukuqonda okuyisisekelo kwezenzo ze-NaTIS. Ukuqonda okuyisisekelo koMthetho Wezomgwaqo Wezwe (NRTA) nemithetho yawo. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yeklekidi, izindlela kanye nethuba lokuthola imininingwane nokutholakala kwezibalo. Ulwazi nokuqoda esimisweni somthetho silawula Isevisi Yomphakathi. Ulwazi lwezindlela zokusebenza ngokohlelo lwendawo yokusebenza. Ulwazi lwezomsebenzi. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa Ikhompyutha (Excel, Word ne-Outlook). Amakhono okuhlela nokuhlela. Amakhono amahle okuxoxa nokubhala. Amakhono.olimi. Amakhono obudlelwano nabantu. Amakhono okuguquguquka. Amakhono okusebenza njengohlelo. Omaluleki kumele abe nokwethembeka, ahlale ethembekile, ethembakale futhi aloye. Yena kumele abe nethuba lokwamukela umyezo, abe nethuba lokusebenza ngaphansi kwegcindezi, akhiqize umsebenzi wohlelo, abe nethuba lokugcina imfihlo futhi abe nolwazi lomsebenzi.
zu.duties: Ukunikeza inkxaso ezenqweni evamile. Ukugcina uhlelo lolawulo lwemisebenzi mayelana nezicelo ezitholiwe. Ukucubungula izenzo ze-NaTIS 121 ezinzima ngokuhambisana nezidingo zomthetho nohlelo. Ukuhlela izinhlela zokuhamba okuhlanganisa izinhlela zezindiza, izindawo zokuhlala nokuhirelwa kwezimoto.

xh.title: Ngquleli yolawulo (PRODUCTION): Ulawulo-lweZithuthi
xh.summary: Kufuneka Ngquleli yolawulo kumathunyelo we Moto-Pietermaritzburg, enika inkxaso yolawulo kwaye iphatha iinkqubo ze-NaTIS.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seniors / Isatifikethi lesizwe (Umsebenzi wemisebenzi) NQF level 4. Ulwazi, Amakhono namandla afunekayo: Qonda okomlinganiselo okusesikweni kwemizi ye-NaTIS. Qonda okomlinganiselo okusesikweni koMthetho weZithuthi zeSiqithi (NRTA) nemiqathango yaso. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yokubhalisa, iinkqubo kunye nolwandalo lokuthatha ulwazi nokuqokelela izibalo. Ulwazi nokuqonda inkqubo yomthetho ehola imeko yoMsebenzi woLuntu. Ulwazi lweenkqubo zomsebenzi ngokwemeko yendawo yokusebenza. Ulwazi ngamava. Ulwazi lokusingatha ikhompyutha (Excel, Word and Outlook).
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso yolawulo jikelele. Gcina inkqubo yolawulo lomsebenzi ngokubhekisele kumagama aphefumlelweyo. Phenela iinkqubo ze-NaTIS 121 ezinzima ngokwemigaqo nezidingo zenkqubo. Lawula izicwangciso zohambo kuquka izicwangciso zeenqwelo moya, indawo yokuhlala nokuqeshwa kwezithuthi.

af.requirements: 'n Senior Certificate/National Certificate (Vocational) NQF vlak 4. Kennis, Vaardighede en Bevoegdhede Vereis: Kennis van klerklike pligte, praktyke asook die vermoë om data vas te lê en statistieke te versamel. Voer eNaTIS-administrasie uit en handhaaf akkurate rekordhoudingstelsels, insluitend werkvloeiregisters en alle verwante dokumentasie.

zu.title: Ikhomishana Elokuphatha (UKUKHIQIZA): Elokuphatha
zu.summary: Ikhomishana elokuphatha elinikeza inkxaso yonke yemisebenzi yempilo, yohwebo,abantu nemitfhalo emtjhini we Motor Transport Services e Pietermaritzburg.
zu.requirements: Isitifikadi se Senior Certificate/ National Certificate (Vocational) NQF level 4. Ukuze kutholwe ulwazi, amakhono namandla: Ukuba nalwazi kwemisebenzi yegumbi lokusebenzela, amasiko nokusebenza isibali somfutho wokuthola imininingwane kanye nokusiza ukuthola izibalo. Ulwazi lokuqonda umthetho ophatha umphakathi. Ulwazi lomsebenzi ohlelwe ngaphandle komnyango. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (Excel, Word ne PowerPoint). Amakhono we plan nokuhlela. Amakhono amahle okukhuluma nokubhala. Amakhono welimi. Amakhono okuxhumanisa notho. Amakhono wokuba nelunga. Amakhono wokuba nesibali sokuzimisela. Amakhono wokusebenza ngenjongo ethize. Isiqalisi esidingekile kumelwe sibe nesibindi, sithembekile, sibe nelunga. Simele sibe namandla okuzibophezela, sibe namandla okusebenza ngaphansi kwemithwalo, sibe namandla okusebenza kahle, sibe namandla okulondoloza imfihlo kanye nalwazi ngokusebenza.
zu.duties: Nikela inkxaso yonke yemisebenzi yengxenyeko. Nikela inkxaso yohwebo ngenhlangano nangendlela ethize. Nikela inkxaso yabantu kanye nemisebenzi yesibali sangaphakathi kwengxenyeko. Nikela inkxaso yemitfhalo yegumbi lokuphatha imali kanye nemisebenzi yegumbi lokusebenzela kwengxenyeko.enza imisebenzi ye eNaTIS kanye nokugcina imibhalo ethembekile, okuhlanganisa amarejista omsebenzi namanye amaphepha ahlobene nawo.

Ulwazi ngendlela zokusebenza ngokwemeko yendawo yokusebenza. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngakompyutha (Excel, Word and PowerPoint). Amakhono okucinga phambili nokuqamba. Amakhono amabalwa ebhalwe nakuthethwa aphambili. Amakhono eelwimi. Amakhono obudlelwane nabantu. Amakhono okuguquguquka. Amakhono okusebenza njengeqela. Umamkeli ongcono kufuneka abe nyani, athembekile, ethembeke kwaye enesithembiso. Makabe nokwamo lokwamkela iriponsibhiliti, akwazi ukusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo, avelise umsebenzi womgangatho ophezulu, agcine iimfihlo kwaye anolwazi ngomsebenzi.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso yemisebenzi yolawulo jikelele. Nika iinkonzo zocwetyana kumazomxho wokusetyenziswa kwempahla ngaphakathi kwecandelo. Nika inkxaso yolawulo lwabasebenzi ngaphakathi kwecandelo. Nika inkxaso yocwetyana yolawulo lwemali ngaphakathi kwecandelo. Yenza ulawulo lwe-eNaTIS kwaye ugcine iinkqubo ezichanekileyo zokugcina irekhodi, kuquka amarejista amazomxho namaxwebhu onke ahambelanayo.

jobs.closing_date_text: 28 August 2026 (at 16h00). Applications received after the closing date and time will not be considered.
jobs.summary: Administrative clerk providing agency support and telephonic guidance on eNaTIS and road traffic legislation at Motor Transport Services in Pietermaritzburg.
jobs.requirements: A Senior Certificate/ National Certificate (Vocational) NQF level 4. Knowledge of the National Road Traffic Act (Act No 93 of 1996) and its relevant regulations and all amended regulations. Knowledge and the ability to apply the new Public Services Regulations and Labour Relations Act. Extensive knowledge of the eNaTIS and its application in terms of the National Road Traffic Act. Knowledge of internal and external codes of conduct. Knowledge of Public Service reporting procedures. Knowledge of internal procedures (Circulars). Problem solving skills. Interpersonal skills. Time management skills. Good written and verbal communication skills. Computer literacy. NaTIS skills. Communication skills in both IsiZulu and English. Organising and planning skills. The ideal candidate must be reliable, honest, innovative, decisive, culturally sensitive and have Integrity. He/ she must have the ability to work independently, maintain confidentiality, be conscientious, innovative, committed in promoting service delivery, team orientated and accurate. He/she must have the ability to interpret and apply legislation and policy, be analytical and innovative thinker and have the ability to deal with a variation of functions at any given time without losing control.
jobs.duties: Provide extensive and in-depth telephonic guidance to provide office assistance to Provincial offices, Agencies/Post Offices throughout KZN in respect of legislation, procedures, eNaTIS, new software releases etc. Perform Auxiliary duties in respect of preparing and typing of official correspondence. Distribution of Circulars and Maintenance of Filing System. Perform general admin duties e.g. Stationery requisition and submit S&T and sub vehicle claims. Keep record & open files for each individual at Agencies throughout KZN.

Hy/sy moet die vermoë hê om onafhanklik te werk, vertroulikheid te handhaaf, pligsgetrou, innoverend, toegewyd aan die bevordering van dienslewering, spanngerig en akkuraat te wees. Hy/sy moet die vermoë hê om wetgewing en beleid te interpreteer en toe te pas, analitiese en innoverende denker wees en die vermoë hê om met 'n verskeidenheid funksies op enige gegewe tyd om te gaan sonder om beheer te verloor.
af.duties: Verskaf uitgebreide en diepgaande telefoonleiding om kantoor bystand aan Provinciale kantore, Agentskappe/Poskantore regdeur KZN te bied ten opsigte van wetgewing, prosedures, eNaTIS, nuwe sagtewarevrystellings ens. Voer hulppligte uit ten opsigte van die voorbereiding en tik van amptelike korrespondensie. Verspreiding van Sirkulaires en instandhouding van liasseringsstelsel. Voer algemene adminpligte uit bv. Skryfbehoefterekwisisies en dien S&T- en subvoertuigvorderings in. Hou rekord en open lêers vir elke individu by Agentskappe regdeur KZN.

zu.title: Umlweli Wezokuphathwa Kwemibhalo (UKUKHIQIZA): Ukusekelwa Kwezinsiza
zu.summary: Umlweli wezokuphathwa kwemibhalo onikeza ukusekelwa kwezinsiza nolwazi ngocingo mayelana ne-eNaTIS nemithetho yegciwane lokuhashaza emigwaqeni eMotor Transport Services ePietermaritzburg.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi samabanga aphakeme/ Isitifiketi Sembango (Umsebenzi) izinga le-NQF 4. Ukwazi ngoMthetho Wokuhashaza Emigwaqeni Kazwelonke (Umthetho No. 93 ka-1996) nemithetho yakhe edingekayo kanye nazo zonke izichibiyelo zemithetho. Ulwazi nethuba lokusebenzisa imithetho entsha Yesevisi Yomphakathi kanye noMthetho Wamabandla Emisebenzi. Ulwazi olubanzi nge-eNaTIS nokusetshenziswa kwayo ngokukaMthetho Wokuhashaza Emigwaqeni Kazwelonke. Ulwazi ngamakhodi okuziphatha angaphakathi nangaphandle. Ulwazi ngemikhakha yokusikika imibiko Yesevisi Yomphakathi. Ulwazi ngemikhakha yangaphakathi (Izikhashana). Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga. Amakhono okuxhumana nabantu. Amakhono okuphatha isikhathi. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana okubhalwayo nokuKHULUMAYO. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amakhono e-NaTIS. Amakhono okuxhumana ngolimi lwesiZulu nesiNgisi. Amakhono okuhlela uhlelo. Umuntu oyifanele kufanele athembekile, aque, ethule izinqubomgomo, athathe izinqumo, azwisisi izinkolo ezahlukene futhi abe nokuzithiba. Yena kufanele akwazi ukusebenza eyedwa, agcine imfihlo, ahlale ejabule ngomsebenzi, athuthukise izinhlelo ezintsha, ahlale ezibuza ukuthuthukiswa kokwethulwa kwenkonzo, asebenze kahle nqembuni futhi abe nocophelelo. Kufanele akwazi ukuhlathulula futhi asebenzise umthetho nemithetho, abe yindondabathakathi futhi ethule izinqubo ezintsha anamandla okubhekana nemisebenzi ehlukahlukene noma kunini nganoma yisiphi isikhathi engalahleki ulawula.
zu.duties: Nika ulwazi olubanzi nolujulile ngocingo ukunikeza usizo kohlelo izikhungo ezidabuko, Izinsiza/Izikhungo Zeposi kulo lonke i-KZN ngokomthetho, imikhakha, i-eNaTIS, ukukhishwa kwe-software entsha njll. Yenza imisebenzi elandelayo yokubhala nokulungiselela imibhalo emthethweni. Ukusabalalisa izikhashana nokugcina uhlelo Lwamafayela. Yenza imisebenzi ejwayelekile yezokuphathwa kwemibhalo ngokwesib. Ukucela impahla yokubhala kanye ukufaka izimango ze-S&T nezimoto. Gcina irekhodi and vula amafayela ngamunye umuntu kuzo zonke Izinsiza kulo lonke i-KZN.

xh.title: Clerk wezolonikezelo lwezabaphathi (PRODUCTION): Inkxaso yezi-Ajentsi
xh.summary: Clerk wezolonikezelo lwezabaphathi onikeza inkxaso yezi-ajentsi nokuxeba ngocalu olunxulumene ne-eNaTIS nemicimbi yethrafiki yezithuthi kumsebenzi wezithuthi zemoto ePietermaritzburg.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi samabanga aphezulu/ Isatifikethi lesizwe (i-Vocational) NQF level 4. Ulwazi ngoMthetho weNational Road Traffic (uMthetho uNo 93 ka-1996) nemigaqo yawo edibana nayo nayo yonke imigaqo elungisiweyo. Ulwazi nokwakha ukusebenzisa imigaqo entsha yePublic Services nakuMthetho weLabour Relations. Ulwazi olubanzi nge-eNaTIS nendlela yokusetyenziswa kwawo ngokukaMthetho weNational Road Traffic. Ulwazi lwemithetho yomzado yangaphakathi nangaphandle. Ulwazi lweenkqubo zokubika kwi-Public Service. Ulwazi lweenkqubo zangaphakathi (i-Circulars). Amapwoina okusombulula iingxaki. Amapwoina abantu. Amapwoina olawulo ixesha. Amapwoina amnandi ebhalweni nakuthethweni. Ukuzazi ikhompyutha. Amapwoina eNaTIS. Amapwoina kokwazisa ngesiZulu nangesiNgesi zombini. Amapwoina okuqamba ngokulungiselela. Umsebenzisi ofunekayo kufuneka abe ngowothembekileyo, onesithembile, onamagqabantshintshi, othatha izigqibo, ohlonipha amasiko onobuzigqina. Yena kufuneka akwazi ukusebenza eyedwa, agcine imfihlelo, abe ngomntu onobuchule, onamagqabantshintshi, ezigqime ekukhuthazeni ukunikwa kweenkonzo, anqwenwele qhela ebuhlalweni abe ngowuchanekileyo. Kufuneka akwazi ukucazulula asebenzise umthetho namapolisi, abe ngumntu onguchryantalithi unamagqabantshintshi nokuqamba, akwazi ukujongana nemithelela yemisebenzi ehlukileyo nganoma ithiphi ixesha ngaphandle kokulahlekelwa lolawulo.
xh.duties: Nika ulwazi olubanzi nolunjongo lokuxeba ukunika inkxaso kwindawo zebhodi kwindawo zeProvincial, kwezi-Ajentsi/ii-Post Offices kulo lonke elaseKZN malunga nomthetho, iinkqubo, i-eNaTIS, ukukhululwa kwesoftware entsha njl njl. Yenza imisebenzi yoxhaso malunga nokuqamba nokuthayipha ukubhalelana kwamthetho. Ukwabelwa kweekhathirkhulire nokuGcina iNkqubo yokuGcina iFayile. Yenza imisebenzi eqhelekileyo yodomo njl. Ukucela izixhobo zokubhala nokunikezela nge-S&T neendyikimba ze-sub vehicle. Gcina irekhodi and uvule iifayile zomntu ngamnye kwi-Ajentsi kulo lonke elaseKZN.

jobs.applications: Applications/Address: Applicants are encouraged to apply for posts through the KZN online e-Recruitment system at www.kznonline.gov.za/kznjobs Applicants may also visit any one of our Designated Online Application Centres (DOACs) where our friendly staff will assist you with applying for jobs on the KZN online e-Recruitment system or receiving your hardcopy application. af.title: Senior Personeelbeampte: Vestigingsbeheer
af.summary: Senior Personeelbeampte vir vestigingsbeheer in Pietermaritzburg, wat 'n Senior Sertifikaat en kennis van HR-bestuur vereis, teen R237453 per jaar.
af.requirements: 'n Senior Sertifikaat/ Nasionale Sertifikaat (Vokasioneel) NQF vlak 4. Kennis, Vaardighede en Bevoegdhede Vereis: Breë kennis van Wetgewing, beleide en prosedures rakende Menslike Hulpbronbestuur, spesifiek dié wat verband hou met vestigingsbeheer. Kennis van verslagdoeningsprosedures en werksomgewing van die Openbare Diens. Kennis van rekenaargebaseerde inligtingstelsel (bv. PERSAL, MS Office, ens.). Kennis van navorsing, inligtingversameling en koördinering. Goed ontwikkelde mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Die ideale kandidaat moet analities, logies en waarnemend, oplettend, betroubaar, toegewyd, toeganklik, klintvriendelik en verantwoordelik wees. Hy/sy moet die vermoë hê om beleid te leer, te interpreteer en toe te pas, 'n getoonde belangstelling in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur en verwante velde hê, en die vermoë hê om individueel of as deel van die span te werk.
af.duties: Ontleed, implementeer en registreer posvestigingsvariasies. Skepping en instandhouding van 'n handmatige rekorddatabasis. Behandel bykomende funksies wat verband hou met posvestigingsake. Oudit en reconcilieer vestigingsrekords. Verskaf advies, leiding, inligting en statistieke wat verband hou met posvestigingsake.

zu.title: Iofisa Oyisikhulu Basebenzi: Ukulawula Isimilo Sesevisi
zu.summary: Iofisa Oyisikhulu Basebenzi wokulawula isimilo sesevisi ePietermaritzburg, ofuna Isitifikedi Ephakeme nolwazi lokuphathwa kwezinsiza zabantu, ohola R237453 ngonyaka.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi Ephakeme/ Isitifikedi Sezwe (Ubuchwepheshe) NQF level 4. Ulwazi, Amakhono namandla adingekayo: Ulwazi olubanzi ngomthetho, izinqubo namapholisi okuphathwa kwezinsiza zabantu, ikakhulukizi lawo ahlobene nokulawula isimilo sesevisi. Ulwazi ngemiyalezo yokubika kwezinsiza zikahulumeni nendawo yokusebenza. Ulwazi lwesistimu yolwazi esebenzisa ikhompuyutha (isb. PERSAL, MS Office njll). Ulwazi lococingo, ukuqoqolwa kolwazi nokuhlanganisa. Amakhono okuxoxa nokubhala aphehle kakhulu. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha. Umqashi oyingqayizivele kufanele abe ngumuntu onohlangothi, onengqondo eqinile futhi ohlakaniphile, oqaphayo, othembekile, ozinikele ekusebenzeni, ongafinyeleleka kalula, ongaphephile kubathengi futhi onobuhlakani. Yena kufanele akwazi ukufunda, ukuhumusha futhi asebenzise ipholisi, abe nomdlandla obonakalayo kokuqashwa kwabantu nasezinkundleni ezihlobene nazo, nokuthi akwazi ukusebenza njengomuntu oyedwa noma njengengxenye yeqembu.
zu.duties: Cocingo, phumeza futhi urekhode izinguquko kusimilo sesevisi. Ukudala futhi ukugcina idatha yamanuali. Ukunakekela imisebenzi eyengeziwe ehlobene nezindaba zesimilo sesevisi. Ukuhlola futhi uhambisanise amarekhodi esimilo sesevisi. Nikela ngeluleko, incazelo, ulwazi nezibalo ezihlobene nezindaba zesimilo sesevisi.

xh.requirements: ISenior Certificate/ iNational Certificate (Vocational) NQF level 4. Exercise control over tools, supplies and other equipment. Allocate tasks and oversee work performance. Maintenance of equipment. Co- ordinate the blading program. Exercise control over traffic accommodation.

af.title: Padwerkvoorman
af.summary: Padwerkvoorman-posisies in KwaZulu-Natal wat padkonstruksie en -instandhouding oorsien, met vereistes van NQF Level 3, 3 jaar ervaring en 'n Code B-bestuurderslisensie.
af.requirements: NQF Level 3 (Grade 11) / 'n Nasionale Sertifikaat in Konstruksie; plus 'n Minimum van 3 jaar padwerk-instandhoudingservaring, plus 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie (Minimum Code B). Kennis, vaardighede en bevoegdhede vereis: Kennis van instandhoudingshandleidings, veiligheidsregulasies en die kostestelsel. Kennis van algemene prosedures. Kennis van weeklikse werk- en masjinerie-returns. Kennis van die diensleweringsprogram. Kennis van die departementele verslagdoeningsstruktuur insluitend vervoerkomitees. Kennis van wetgewing/beleide en prosedures rakende die Publieke Sektor. Kennis van dissiplinêre prosedures. Kennis van EPMDS. Beplannings- en organisatoriese vaardighede. Vermoë om te leer, te verstaan en toe te pas. Probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Toesigvaardighede. Kommunikasievaardighede. Syferkundigheid. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Die ideale kandidaat moet verantwoordelik, stiptelik, pligsgetrou en ontvanklik vir voorstelle en idees wees. Hy/sy moet doeltreffend wees, empatie en kulturele bewustheid hê en ook in staat wees om aan die gedragskode te voldoen en as deel van 'n span te werk.
af.duties: Ondersteun padkonstruksie en/of -instandhoudingswerk deur, onder andere, die volgende: Konstruksie van kulp- en sydrainering. Oprig en onderhou staal-re relings en gabions. Konstruksie van padgrond- en laagwerke. Skoonmaak en onderhou paaie, sypaadjies en rusplekke (walsonderhoud). Oppervlakkig en potgate toemaak. Padomheining en pyplegging. Plas van stokmerke/tekens. Installeer padtekens en versper die werksarea. Toesig hou oor aktiwiteite ten opsigte van padkonstruksie en/of -instandhoudingswerk deur onder andere die volgende: Toepassing van veiligheids- en voorsorgmaatreëls. Voer inspeksies uit. Oefen beheer uit oor gereedskap, voorrade en ander toerusting. Wys take toe en hou toesig oor werkprestasie. Instandhouding van toerusting. Koördineer die skraapprogram. Oefen beheer uit oor verkeergeriewe.

zu.title: Umphathi Womsebenzi Wezindlela
zu.summary: Izikhundla zomphathi womsebenzi wezindlela KwaZulu-Natal okubukele phezukuqakwa nokugcinwa kwezindlela, kudinga NQF Level 3, iminyaka engu-3 yohlelo kanye nelayisensi yomshayeli ye-Code B.
zu.requirements: NQF Level 3 (Grade 11) / Isitifikedi Sezwe Sokwakha; kanye nokubamba iqhaza unyakeni ongangu-3 wokugcina umsebenzi wezindlela, kanye nelayisensi yomshayeli evumelekile (Umbhalo ongaphansi kwe-Code B). Ulwazi, amakhono namandla adingekayo: Ulwazi ngemagazini ezingcolo, imithetho yezokuphepha kanye nendlela yokubala izindleko. Ulwazi ngenqubo ejwayelekile. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yamasonto zonke kanye nokuvela kwemishini. Ulwazi ngenqubo yokuletha izinsiza. Ulwazi ngohlelo lokubika lomnyango lokuhlanganisa amakomidi ezokuthutha. Ulwazi ngemithetho/inqubo kanye nokuqondene neNingizimu Kahulumeni. Ulwazi ngenqubo yesigwebo. Ulwazi nge-EPMDS. Amakhono okuhlela futhi uhlele. Ukukwazi ukufunda, ukuqonda nokusebenzisa. Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga. Amakhono okuphatha. Amakhono okuthintana. Amakhono okubala. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Omululeki ofanele kufanele abe nomthwalo wemfanelo, agcweme isikhathi, abe nokunaka futhi avulekele imibono neminqumo. Kufanele asebenze ngokushesha anuzwane, aqonde amasiko futhi akwazi ukuziphatha ngokusho komthethosisekelo wesimiso nokusebenza njengesinye isici sethimu.
zu.duties: Yukusekela ukwakhiwa kanye nokugcinwa kwezindlela phakathi kwezinye izinto okulandelayo: Ukwakha izitshudeni kanye namasokhodi. Ukumisa nokugcina izinqamuleli zensimbi kanye namagobho. Ukulunga umhlabathi wezindlela nemisebenzi yamalayeri. Ukucisha ukugcina izindlela, izihamba-hamba nabawonke baleyo indawo (ukugcina onke). Ukwaleka nokunakwa kolwangu amasongo wezindhela. Ukulungiselela amabhawodi nobulumuko ophezu komgwaqo. Ukwenza amabhawodi omgwaqo nokubhalisa isikhathi sokusebenza emgodini. Ukwenza iziqondiso ezithinteka ezindaweni ezithile nokubhucule olunye ukuhamba. Ukuphatha imigqa eminye ngenkathi ekhombisa imigwaqo esanda kwenziwa efanayo: Kudingwa imikhuba efanayo yokuqakwa kokuvela kwezindlela ukuqakwa nokugcinwa okungaphakathi kwezinye izindlela ezindwendwe kwaye kungena ngaphakathi kwalezozinye izinkinga zokuthi ngokwezimiso ekhethwe kummandla: Isiciko sokwaziswa kwengozi. Ukuphatha kwiinkqubo ezingezizo ezolawula isinkqubo. Iinkqubo zokuphatha ekuphathweni kwamathuluzi, izibonelelo nezinye izixhobo. Ukukhetha izabelo kumathuluzi nobuncwane bezinto ezichaziweyo.

xh.summary: Izithuba zeentsalu ze-Road Work Foreman e-KwaZulu-Natal ukulawula ukwalwa nokulondolozwa kwezithuba, kufuneka kuye kubekho NQF Level 3, 3 years experience kwaye unelayisensi ye-Code B driver's licence.
xh.requirements: I-NQF Level 3 (Grade 11) / Inqanaba le-3 (Grade 11) / Isatifikethi sikaZiko kwiZakhiwo; Ngesixa esingaphantsi kweminyaka engu-3 yamava wokulondolozwa kwezithuba zeentsalu, kwaye unelayisensi yokushuka (Ukungaphantsi kwe-Code B). Ulwazi, Amandla, namava afunekayo: Ulwazi ngokulondolozwa kwezithuba zeentsalu, iingqikitha zokhuseleko, iindawo ezichanekileyo namava ohlelo lwentengiso. Ulwazi ngokuhamba. Ulwazi malunga nemisebenzi yamadoda ngeminyaka. Ulwazi ngokulawula izinto ezininzi. Ulwazi ngokulawula iindawo ezahlukeneyo ezikumgama wentsikelelo yokulawula imisebenzi yakho, amava amakhulu ngokulawula imisebenzi yakho kwaye ulwazi ngokulondolozwa kwezinto ezahlukeneyo. Ulwazi ngokulawula umsebenzi wakho.
xh.duties: Xhasa umsebenzi wokwakhiwa nokt/ilondolozo kwezithuba zeentsalu ngonqla, phakathi kwezinye: Ukwalwa kwe-culvert nama-drainages ecaleni. Ukwakhiwa nokulondolozwa kwe-steel guardrails namagabions. Ukwalwa kwezithuba zeentsalu. Ukucocwa nokulondolozwa kwezithuba zeentsalu, iindawo zokuqhubela kamo phambili, nezithuba zokuphumla (verge maintenance). Ukubeka i-surface nokulungisa amathafa. Ukuvela kweentsalu kwaye kubekwe iintsimbintsimbini. Ukuhlelwa kwe-rod markings/iintsu. Ukuhlelwa kwesikhokelo seemisebenzi yasekudleni na kweyakho ukwenza umsebenzi ngokusembeseleni.

af.title: Data Capturer: Social Development
af.summary: Die Department of Transport soek 'n datakaptuurder in Pietermaritzburg om datakaptuurdienste te lewer, registers op te dateer en rekords te handhaaf op salarisvlak 4.
af.requirements: 'n Senior Certificate / National Certificate (Vocational) NQF Level 4. Kennis, vaardighede en bevoegdhede vereis: Vermoë om data vas te lê. Kennis van die insamel van statistiek. Begrip van klienversorgingsbasis. Kennis en begrip van die wetgewende raamwerk wat die Openbare Diens regeer. Kennis van werksprosedures ten opsigte van die werksomgewing. Begrip van administratiewe kantoorpraktyke. Kennis van kantoorpligte en -praktyke. Rekenaarvaardigheid (Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint). Beplanningvaardighede. Kommunikasievaardighede (mondelings en skriftelik). Organisasievaardighede. Interpretasievaardighede. Tydbestuursvaardighede. Die ideale kandidaat moet in 'n span kan werk, diplomaties, innoverend, kreatief, veerkragtig en betroubaar wees.
