zu.title: Umcambi Wedatha: Inhlalo Nentuthuko
zu.summary: I-Department of Transport ifuna umcambi wedatha e-Pietermaritzburg ukunikeza izinsiza zokubamba idatha, ukubuyekeza imibhalo nokugcina amarekhodi eholo izinga 4.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi Sezinqopa eziphezulu / Isitifiketi Sezwe (Amsebenzi) NQF Level 4. Ulwazi, Amakhono namandla adingekayo: Ikhono lokubamba idatha. Ulwazi ngokuqoqa izibalo. Ukuqonda ukwakheka kolunakekelwa lwabathengi. Ulwazi nokuqoda uhlelo lomthetho lolawula  Imphilo Yomphakathi. Ulwazi lwezinqubo zokusebenza ngokohlelo lokuqashwa komsebenzi. Ukuqonda izindlela zokuphatha ofisi ezibhalweni. Ulwazi lwemisebenzi yenhlinzsho nezindlela zayo. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha (Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint). Amakhono okuhlela. Amakhono okuxhumana (okwenkomishi nokubhaliwe). Amakhono ohlelo. Amakhono okuhumusha. Amakhono okuphatha isikhathi. Umuntu oyedwa ofanele kufanele akwazi ukusebenza esiqhingini, abe nodiplomatic, ahlebe, aqambe, asuseme futhi athembekile.
zu.duties: Nikeza izinsiza zokubamba idatha ku-Development Directorate. Buyekeza imibhalo nezibalo. Gcina futhi ugcinise amarekhodi namafayela. Nikeza ulwazi iziqhingini.

xh.title: Umcathi Weemininjongo: Ezinconywa Nentlalo
xh.summary: Isebe leZothutho lifuna umcathi wemininjongo ePietermaritzburg ukunika iinkonzo zokubamba imininjongo, ukuvuvza izibhalo nokugcina iirekhodi kwinqanaba lesixa 4.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi Esiphakamileyo / Isatifikethi samazwe (Ezemisebenzi) NQF Level 4. Ulwazi, Amakhono namandla afunekayo: Ulwazi lokubamba imininjongo. Ulwazi lokuqokelela izibalo. Ukuqonda iziseko zokunakekelwa kwasemakhasini. Ulwazi nokuqonda inkqubo yomthetho elawula inkonzo kaWalo. Ulwazi lweenkqubo zokusebenza ngokommandla wokusebenza. Ukuqonda iinkqubo zolawulo zofiso. Ulwazi lwemisebenzi yohlelo namakhono ayo. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha (Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint). Amakhono okucwangcisa. Amakhono ekuthetha (ngomlomo nasembhalweni). Amakhono okuqamba. Amakhono okutolika. Amakhono olawulo lwexesha. Omele waye afunekele kakhulu kufuneka akwazi ukusebenza ngenqeqesho, abe nomthetho wokuziphatha, anamandla okudala, abe ngumntu ongaziva ethandabuzweni, angabakhathali kwaye athembekile.
xh.duties: Kunika iinkonzo zokubamba imininjongo kwiSebe leNtshukumo. Vuvula izibhalo nezibalo. Gcina ukuqhubela phambili iirekhodi neefayile. Zekelele inkcazelo kumacandelo.

jobs.closing_date_text: 28 August 2026 (at 16h00). Applications received after the closing date and time will not be considered.
jobs.summary: The Department of Transport seeks driver operators for earthmoving and non-earthmoving equipment across multiple KwaZulu-Natal centres, requiring a Grade 10 certificate, Code EC licence with PrDP, and five years' experience.
jobs.requirements: Grade 10 certificate (NQF level 2); plus a valid Driver’s Licence Code EC with PrDP and Operating Certificate / Departmental Competency Pink card for specialised equipment; plus Five (5) years’ driving and operating specialized equipment experience. Knowledge, Skills and Competencies Required: Communication skills. Ability to read and write. Good eyesight. Teamwork. Skills in the operation of the equipment. Physical inspection of vehicles and the ability to interpret instructions for proper use of all controls for safe operation of vehicles. Interpret and follow operating manuals, maintenance manuals and service charts.
jobs.duties: Perform activities in respect of operation through inter alia the following: Operating specialized equipment; Load and offload goods/ equipment; Inspection and maintenance of equipment and report defects; Keep log sheets of vehicles and machineries; Application of safety and precautionary measures; Cleaning and lubrication of machinery equipment; Grading of gravel roads and re-ravelling/ shoulder maintenance. Render driving services, perform activities in respect of operation through inter alia the following: Transportation of work teams and materials / equipment; Detect and repair minor mechanical problems on the vehicles and take steps to have it repaired (check level and condition of oil, fuel, tyres and water); Inspection of the vehicle/ equipment and report defects; Complete vehicle logbook, trip authorization for the vehicle.
jobs.enquiries: Ms T Nkosi (Ladysmith) Tel No: (036) 638 4400 Ms G Hlabisa (Pietermaritzburg) Tel No: (033) 392 6600 Ms S Mthethwa (Durban) Tel No: (031) 700 2222
jobs.applications: Applications/Address: Applicants are encouraged to apply for posts through the KZN online e-Recruitment system at www.kznonline.gov.za/kznjobs Applicants may also visit any one of our Designated Online Application Centres (DOACs) where our friendly staff will assist you with applying for jobs on the KZN online e-Recruitment system or receiving your hardcopy application. You can find the list of Designated Online Application Centres (DOACS) at www.kznonline.gov.za/kznjobs. Please note that applicants should only use one of the following methods when applying for a post: either through the online e-Recruitment system or submit a hardcopy application as directed. Forward your application, quoting the relevant reference number to: Recruitment & Selection Section, Human Resource Administration Directorate, Private Bag X9043, Pietermaritzburg, 3200. Applications may alternatively be hand-delivered to the Office of the Department of Transport, Inkosi Mhlabunzima Maphumulo House, 172 Burger Street, Pietermaritzburg. FOR ATTENTION : Mr B Hornsby
jobs.notes: It is the intention of this Department to consider equity targets when filling these positions. Candidates will be subjected to practical assessment. Applications must be submitted on the NEW Application for Employment Form, Z83 (obtainable on the internet at www.dpsa.gov.za-vacancies). The Z83 form must be completed in terms of DPSA circular 03 of 2025. The completed and signed Z83 must be accompanied by a detailed CV. Dates of starting and leaving employment must be given as DD/MM/YYYY. Kindly take note that only shortlisted candidates will be required to provide certified copies of required documents (Where a Senior Certificate is a requirement for the post, kindly note that a statement of results will not be accepted. Where a tertiary qualification is required, kindly note that certificates are required, however, if a certificate is only to be issued at a graduation in the future, the statement of results, together with a letter from the educational institution, indicating the date of the graduation, will be accepted) on or before the date of the interviews following communication from Human Resources. Failure to comply with these instructions will lead to applications being disqualified. hould an applicant wish to apply for more than one post, separate applications must be submitted for each post applied for. Non-RSA Citizens/Permanent Resident Permit holders must provide a copy of their Permanent Residence Permits if shortlisted for an interview. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) and to provide proof of such if shortlisted for an interview. Under no circumstances will faxed applications be accepted. Receipt of applications will not be acknowledged due to the volume of applications, and should you not receive an invitation to attend an interview within three (3) months of the closing date applicants should assume that their application was unsuccessful. Please note that where experience is a requirement for the post, the successful candidate will be required to submit documentary proof of such work experience prior to assuming duty. A personnel suitability check (criminal record, citizenship, credit record checks, qualification verification and employment verification) will be conducted prior to employment. Prior to appointment being made to an SMS post, the appointee must have completed the pre-entry certificate and must be in possession of such prior to taking up the post. The Senior Management Pre- Entry Programme, which is a public service specific training programme applicable to all applicants who aspire to join the SMS, is to ensure that potential SMS members have a background on processes and procedures linked to the SMS. The duration of the online Pre-Entry Programme is 120 notional hours. Full details may be sourced by the following link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entryprogramme/.                 All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise that intends to test relevant technical elements of the job, the logistics of which will be communicated by the department. Following the interview and technical exercise, the selection panel will recommend candidates to attend a generic managerial competency assessment (in compliance with the DPSA Directive on the implementation of competency-based assessments). The competency assessment will be testing generic managerial competencies using the mandated DPSA SMS competency assessment tools. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. The Department of Transport reserves the right not to fill the advertised post(s) at any stage of the recruitment process. Persons with Disabilities (PWDs) and other designated groups are encouraged to apply. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Bestuurder-operateur (AARDWERK- en nie-aardwerktoerusting)
af.summary: Die Department of Transport soek bestuurder-operateurs vir aardwerk- en nie-aardwerktoerusting by verskeie KwaZulu-Natal sentrums, met 'n Graad 10-sertifikaat, Code EC-licensie met PrDP, en vyf jaar se ervaring as vereistes.
af.requirements: Graad 10-sertifikaat (NQF vlak 2); plus 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie Code EC met PrDP en bedryfsertifikaat / departementele bevoegdheid pienk kaart vir gespesialiseerde toerusting; plus Vyf (5) jaar se bestuurs- en bedryfservaring van gespesialiseerde toerusting. Kennis, vaardighede en bevoegdhede vereis: Kommunikasievaardighede. Vermoë om te lees en te skryf. Goeie gesigskerpsel. Spanwerk. Vaardighede in die bedryf van die toerusting. Fisiese inspeksie van voertuie en die vermoë om instruksies te interpreteer vir behoorlike gebruik van alle kontroles vir veilige bedryf van voertuie. Interpreteer en volg bedryfshandleidings, onderhoudshandleidings en dienskaarte.
af.duties: Voer aktiwiteite uit ten opsigte van bedryf onder andere die volgende: Bedryf van gespesialiseerde toerusting; Laai en aflaai van goedere/toerusting; Inspeksie en onderhoud van toerusting en rapporteer gebreke; Hou logblaaie van voertuie en masjiene aan; Toepassing van veiligheids- en voorsorgmaatreëls; Skoonmaak en smeerdien van masjienertoerusting; Gradering van gruspaaie en her-grintelering/skoueronderhoud. Verskaf bestuursdienste, voer aktiwiteite uit ten opsigte van bedryf onder andere die volgende: Vervoer van werkspanne en materiaal/toerusting; Ontdek en herstel klein meganiese probleme op die voertuie en tree toe om dit te laat herstel (kontroleer vlak en toestand van olie, brandstof, bande en water); Inspeksie van die voertuie/toerusting en rapporteer gebreke; Voltooi voertuiglogboek, ritmagtiging vir die voertuig.

Render driving services, perform activities in respect of operation through inter alia the following: Transportation of work teams and materials / equipment; Detect and repair minor mechanical problems on the vehicles and take steps to have it repaired (check level and condition of oil, fuel, tyres and water); Inspection of the vehicle/ equipment and report defects; Complete vehicle logbook, trip authorization for the vehicle.

xh.title: Umqhubi-Operator (EARTHMOVING and Non-earthmoving
xh.summary: Isebe lezothutho lifuna abaqhubi-operator bemiselwa yomhlaba kwayo nangaphandle kwawo kumaziko amaninzi eKwaZulu-Natal, kufuneka isatifikethi seGrade 10, ilayisenisi yekhodi EC ngePrDP, namashumi eminyaka emihlanu yamava.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seGrade 10 (inqanaba leNQF 2); kanjalo nelayisenisi elisebenzayo yomqhubi yekhodi EC ngePrDP nesatifikethi sokusebenza / ikhadi elibomvu lesiseko sekomkhulu lempahla ekhethekileyo; kanjalo namashumi amahlanu (5) eminyaka yokuqhuba nokusebenza nempahla ekhethekileyo. Ulwazi, amakhono namandla afunekayo: Amakhono okunxibelelwana. Ikhono lokufunda nokubhala. Ukubona kakuhle. Ukusebenza njengesebe. Amakhono okusebenzisa imiselwa. Ukuhlola ngokomzimba izithuthi nekhono lokutolika imiyalelo yokusebenzisa ngokuchanekileyo zonke izilawuli ukuze kuqhutywe ngokhuseleko izithuthi. Kutolike landele iimanuali zokusebenza, iimanuali zokulungisa namashedi zokwenza inkonzo.
xh.duties: Yenza imisebenzi ngokwokusebenza nokusebenzisa ngaphakathi kokunye oku landelayo: Ukusebenzisa imiselwa ekhethekileyo; Layisha huye ukhulule impahla/ imiselwa; Ukuhlola nolungisa imiselwa uze uxele ngamaphunga; Gcina amashedi okuloga ezithuthi nasemishini; Ukusebenzisa izinto zokhuseleko nezigqibo zokuqhopha; Ukucoxa nokugcoba imiselwa yemishini; Ukulinganisa iindlela ezityhola huye ulungise imigangatho/ ukugcinwa kwemihlathi. Yazi inkonzo yokuqhuba, yenza imisebenzi ngokwokusebenza nokusebenzisa ngaphakathi kokunye oku landelayo: Ukuthutha amaqela umsebenzi nempahla/ imiselwa; Phawula ulungise iziphengo ezincinci zomzimba wemishini kwizithuthi uze uthathe izigqibo zokuza zilungiswe (hlola inqanaba nobume begcobilinwe, imafutha, iithaya namanzi); Ukuhlola izithuthi/ imiselwa uze uxele ngamaphunga; Qedela incwadi yokuloga yezithuthi, igunya lolu hambelo lwezithuthi.

af.title: Padwerker
af.summary: Die Department of Transport soek padwerkers regoor KwaZulu-Natal om roetinepadonderhoud- en konstruksiepligte te verrig op salarisvlak 3.
af.requirements: NQF-vlak 1 of 2 (Abet-vlak 2-sertifikaat of gelykwaardig). Kennis, vaardighede en bevoegdhede vereis: Werkkennis. Kommunikasievaardighede. Tussensydige verhoudingsvaardighede. Buigsaamheid. Spanwerk. Akkuraatheid. Vaardighede in die aanleg vir syfers. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Beplannings- en organisasievaardighede. Goeie mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede.
af.duties: Verrig roetine-aktiwiteite ten opsigte van padonderhoud en/of konstruksie deur onder andere die volgende: Konstruksie van duikers en sydreine. Rig op en onderhou staalrelings en gabions. Konstruksie van padgrond en laagwerke. Skoon en onderhou paaie, sypaadjies en rusareas. Oppervlakte- en putgatopvulling. Lê heining en pyplyne. Opstel van padmerke en stutte. Installeer padbordjies, afstandmerkers en versper die werksarea. Verklowing van padmateriaal. Bosse skoonmaak en grassny.

zu.title: Umsebenzi Womgwaqo
zu.summary: UMnyango Wezokuthutha ufuna abasebenzi bomgwaqo kulo lonke iKwaZulu-Natal ukuba benze imisebenzi ejwayelekile yokugcinwa kanye nokwakhiwa kwezindlela ezingeni le-3 leholo.
zu.requirements: NQF Level 1 noma 2 (Isitifikedi se-Abet level 2 noma esilinganayo). Ulwazi, Amakhono kanye Namasethingi Adingekayo: Ulwazi lomsebenzi. Amakhono okuxhumana. Amakhano obudlelwano babantu. Ukuguquguquka. Ukusebenza njengqembu. Ukuqinisekisa. Amakhano ezibalo. Ukuhlakanipha ekusebenzeni ngekhompyutha. Amakhono okuhlela kanye nokuqamba. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana ngokubhala nangokukhuluma.
zu.duties: Yenza imisebenzi ejwayelekile ehlobene nokugcinwa kanye nokuba nokwakhiwa kwezindlela phakathi kwabanye ngezindlela ezilandelayo: Ukwakhiwa kwezindhókhwana kanye namathafa okuthela. Ukumisa kanye nokugcina izihlenga zensimbi kanye namagabions. Ukwakhiwa kwenhlabathi yomgwaqo kanye nemisebenzi yamalayer. Ukucwafa kanye nokugcina imigwaqo, izihamba-hamba ezibusuku kanye nezindawo zokuphumula. Ukubekela phezulu kanye nokugcina izikhala ezithule. Ukuhlunga okufakiwe kanye nokubeka izimpayipli. Ukumisa izimpawu zomgwaqo kanye neestadi. Ukufaka izimpawu zomgwaqo, izimpawu zomgwaqo, kanye nokubeka izibhakede endaweni yokusebenza. Ukuphahlaza izinto zokwakha umgwaqo. Ukucwafa izinti kanye nokusika udaka.

xh.title: Umsebenzi weZindlela
xh.summary: Isebe lezoZiwo lufuna abasebenzi bezindlela kulo lonke iKwaZulu-Natal ukuze benze imisebenzi eqhelekileyo yokuhlola kunye nokwakha iindlela kwinqanaba lesixa le-3.
xh.requirements: NQF Level 1 okanye 2 (Abet level 2 certificate okanye into ezingaleyo). Ulwazi, amakhono nemigaqo efunekayo: Ulwazi ngomsebenzi. Amakhono okunxibelelana. Amakhono obudlelwane nabantu. Ukuguquguquka. Ukusebenza njengelqa. Ukuchaneka. Amakhono kwikhono lemanani. Ulwazi lokusebenzela ikhompyutha. Amakhono okuceba nokuhlela. Amakhono amabhala athetha kakuhle okuthethwayo nakubhalwayo.
xh.duties: Yenza imisebenzi eqhelekileyo malunga nokuhlola iindlela nakho nokwakha iindlela ngokudibana nemizekelo elandelayo: Ukwakhiwa kwezithuba ezisiya ngaphantsi kunye neendonga ezingasentlhangothini. Misela kwaye ugcine iindonga zentsimbi kunye neegabhoni. Ukwakhiwa kwenhlamvu yendlela kunye namagqabi ezindlela. Ukucotha kunye nokugcina iindlela, iindawo zokuhamba ngeenyawo kunye neendawo zokuphumla. Ukuqhomfa kunye nokuxhelwa kwezityobo eziphakathi kwindlela. Ukuhola iindonga kunye nokubeka iindonga ngeepayipi. Ukuqwalasela okubhalwe kwindlela kunye neendonga eziluhlobo. Faka iimpawu zokukhokela iindlela, izalathiso zomgama kwindlela, kwaye uvale indawo yokusebenza. Ukuketsha izinto zokwakha iindlela. Ukusika iintsaro kunye nokucheba inqwaba.

jobs.summary: The Department of Transport seeks cleaners across multiple KwaZulu-Natal centres to maintain offices, clean facilities and prepare refreshments.
jobs.requirements: AET Level 4 / Grade 9. Knowledge, Skills and Competencies Required: Knowledge of cleaning procedures. Knowledge of refreshment provision. Knowledge of safety requirements attached to the duties of the post. Knowledge of service delivery programs. Knowledge of operating appliances. Ability to interpret and act on instructions. Ability to perform routine tasks. Ability to operate domestic appliances. Basic literacy and numeracy skills. jobs.summary: Director of Risk Based and Information System Audit at Limpopo Provincial Treasury, requiring an NQF Level 7 qualification and five years of managerial auditing experience.
jobs.requirements: NQF Level 7 qualification in Auditing / Accounting or related field as recognized by the SAQA. PIA / CIA / CISA / AGA (SA) / Government Auditors / RA / CA(SA) will be an added advantage. 5 years’ working experience at a middle / senior managerial level in Auditing. Experience in Information Systems Audits will be an added advantage. Valid vehicle driver’s license (with exception of persons with disabilities). Core & Processes Competencies: Strategic Capability and Leadership. People Management and Empowerment. Programme and Project Management. Financial Management. Change Management. Knowledge Management. Service Delivery Innovation (SDI). Problem-solving and Analysis. Client orientation and Customer focus. Communication. Honesty and Integrity. Ability to Manage and oversee project implementation processes and activities. Knowledge of variety of work ranges and procedures: Managerial functions. Finance. Human Resource matters. Planning and organizing. Compilation of reports. Research \ analysing. Computer Technical / standards / procedures. Needs and priorities of the Department. Ability to interpret and apply policy. Analytical and innovative thinking. Research. Report writing Workshop presentation and facilitation. Ability to operate computer. Stakeholder relationship and management.
jobs.duties: Manage Information Systems and Cluster 4 (ARD, EDET & TCS) directorate of the Shared Internal Audit Function efficiently and effectively, including ensuring that there is effective financial management and risk management. Manage the implementation of Combined Assurance Plans of Governance, Risk, Control and Compliance of processes in the Cluster 4 Provincial Departments. Ensure delivery of efficient and value adding assurance services in the Directorate. Manage Cluster 4 to foster continuous improvement, innovation, and adherence to the Institute of Internal Auditor’s International Professional Practice Framework. Manage ethical conduct and anti-fraud practices on the staff allocated to Cluster 4 in Shared Internal Audit.

Shortlisted applicants will be required to provide their original qualification certificates and ID on the day of the interview for other relevant verification purposes. The recommended candidate will further be subjected to Personnel Suitability Checks, including financial disclosure requirements, social media screening, and other relevant verification processes. All successful candidates will be subjected to the applicable security clearance processes. All shortlisted candidates will be subjected to pre-entry assessments prior to the interview process. Kern- & Prosesbevoegdhede: Strategiese vermoë en leierskap. Mensebestuur en bemagtiging. Program- en projekbestuur. Finansiële bestuur. Veranderingsbestuur. Kennisbestuur. Dienslewering-innovasie (SDI). Probleemoplossing en analise. Kliëntoriëntasie en kliëntfokus. Kommunikasie. Eerlikheid en integriteit. Vermoë om projekimplementeringsprosesse en -aktiwiteite te bestuur en toesig te hou. Kennis van 'n verskeidenheid werksektore en prosedures: Bestuursfunksies. Finansies. Menslike hulpbronaangeleenthede. Beplanning en organisering. Samestelling van verslae. Navorsing \ ontleding. Rekenaartegniese / standaarde / prosedures. Behoeftes en prioriteite van die Departement. Vermoë om beleid te interpreteer en toe te pas. Analitiese en innoverende denke. Navorsing. Verslagskrywing. Werkswinkelaanbieding en fasilitering. Vermoë om 'n rekenaar te bedryf. Belanghebbende-verhoudings en bestuur.
af.duties: Bestuur die Inligtingstelsel- en Cluster 4 (ARD, EDET & TCS) direktoraat van die Gedeelde Interne Oudit-funksie doeltreffend en effektief, insluitend om te verseker dat daar effektiewe finansiële bestuur en risikobestuur is. Bestuur die implementering van Gekombineerde Versekeringsplanne van Bestuur, Risiko, Beheer en Nakoming van prosesse in die Cluster 4 Provinsiale Departemente. Verseker die levering van doeltreffende en waarde-toevoegende versekeringsdienste in die Direktoraat. Bestuur Cluster 4 om deurlopende verbetering, innovasie en nakoming van die Institute of Internal Auditor's International Professional Practice Framework te bevorder. Bestuur etiese gedrag en bedrogvoorkomingspraktyke onder die personeel wat aan Cluster 4 in Gedeelde Interne Oudit toegewys is.

zu.title: Umphathi: Ukuhlola Ngokusekelwe Ezingozini Nohlelo Lolwazi
zu.summary: Umphathi Wekuhlola Ngokusekelwe Ezingozini Nohlelo Lolwazi e-Limpopo Provincial Treasury, ofuna iziqu ze-NQF Level 7 namava eminyaka emihlanu yokuba ngumphathi ohlelweni lokuhlola.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-NQF Level 7 kokuHola / UkuBhalisa noma indawo ehlobene njengokuqashwa yi-SAQA. I-PIA / CIA / CISA / AGA (SA) / Government Auditors / RA / CA(SA) kuzoba yinzuzoengeziwe. 5 iminyaka yamava asebenze izinga lomphathi ophakathi / ophakeme kokuHola. Amava kokuHola Kohlelo Lolwazi kuzoba yinzuzoengeziwe. Ilayisensi evumelekileyo yokushayela ibhasi (ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubazekile). Amandla Okuyisisekelo & Izinqubo: Amandla Okubeka Ithonya Nokubusa. Ukugcinwa kwabantu nokuBanika amandla. Ukugcinwa kwezinhlelo namaphrojekthi. Ukugcinwa kwezimali. Ukugcinwa koshintsho. Ukugcinwa kolwazi. Intshiselo Yokuletha izinsizakalo (SDI). Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuHlaziya. Ukugxila kumthengi nokugxile kumakhasimende. Ukuxhumana. Ukuqiniseka nokuba nokuziphatha okuhle. Amandla okuQamba nokubuka phambili. Ulwazi ngohlobo lwezinqubo: Imisebenzi yokubusa. Imali. Izindaba zezisebenzi. Ukuhlela nokuhlela. Ukuhlanganisa imibhalo. Ukusesha \ ukuhlaziya. Ikhompyutha Technical / standards / procedures. Izidingo namaphambili e-Department. Amandla okuhumusha nokusebenzisa inqubomgomo. Ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya nokuyinnovative. Ukusesha. Ukubhala imibhalo. Ukwenza nezinkundla zokusebenza. Amandla okusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuxhumana nokugcina ubuhlobo namaphathi abahlanganyeli.
zu.duties: Phatha uhlelo lolwazi nesikhundla se-Cluster 4 (ARD, EDET & TCS) koshini lohlelo lokuhola internal kahle nangempumelelo. Qiniseka ukuthi imali izolawulwa kahle kanye nokuqasha, ukuphatha nokuhlela imisebenzi kanye nokuqinisekisa ukuthi kukhona ukuqashwa komsebenzi ohlelwe kahle; Loisa ngempumelelo amaphrojekthi ohlelo lokuhola e-Cluster 4, okuhlanganisa ukugcina ukubambezeleka kwemisebenzi; Qinisekisa ukuthi uhlelo lokuhola internal lusebenza kahle, lusebenzisa izinsiza ezidingekayo ngokusemthethweni; Hlola ngokuphelele imisebenzi yokulawula imali kanye nokulawula amaphrojekthi ohlelo lokuhola internal; Qinisekisa ukuthi imisebenzi yonke ehlelwe ngaphansi kwesikhundla sakho ihlolwa ngokujulile ngokomthetho; Sebenzela ukuqinisekisa ukuthi i-Cluster 4 inamandla okusebenza kahle ngokuhlangabezana nemithetho yesikhungo sokuhola internal ngokomthethonqumula we-International Professional Practice Framework; Hlola konke okuhambisana nokusebenza kwemisebenzi e-Cluster 4 ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ihlelo lokuhola internal liyabonakala; Qaphela ukubukeka kokuziphatha okungalungile noma ngaphansi kwezinga e-Cluster 4 bese uthumela imibiko e-Shared Internal Audit; Qinisekisa ukuthi konke okwenziwa e-Cluster 4 kuhambisana nomthetho we-Limpopo Provincial Treasury; Hlola imibiko yonke yamaphrojekthi ohlelo lokuhola internal e-Cluster 4 bese unikeza izincomo; Hlola nokuqinisekisa ukuthi imisebenzi e-Cluster 4 ihlolwa ngokomthetho osetshenziswa ngisho namaphathi e-Cluster 4 e-Shared Internal Audit; Cwasha izinsizakalo ohlelweni lokuhola internal e-Cluster 4 ngokusekelwe kumthetho wokuqinisekisa; Hlola konke okwenziwa e-Cluster 4 ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kuhanjiswa umthetho we-anti-fraud; Sebenzisa izindlela ezihle zokuqinisekisa ukuthi imisebenzi e-Cluster 4 iyaxazululwa ngokushesha bese uhlela izindlela ezinhle zokuze kwenzeke; Hlola imisebenzi ehlelekile ohlelweni lokuhola internal e-Cluster 4 ngokomthetho wokuqinisekisa; Hlola konke okuhlelekile mayelana nemisebenzi ehleleni lokuhola internal e-Cluster 4 ukuze kuhlolwe ngokwemithetho yesikhungo; Beka izincomo mayelana nenhlanhla yokuhlela kwemisebenzi e-Cluster 4 ngaphansi kwesikhundla sakho.

xh.summary: Umlawuli weZiko lokuQwalasela ngokuseMalunga ziwoMngcipheko kunye neNkqubo yeNgcombolo kwi Limpopo Provincial Treasury, ifuna iNQF Level 7 kunye neminye emihlanu yamava obulungisa ngowomlawuli.

IPIA / CIA / CISA / AGA (SA) / Government Auditors / RA / CA(SA) kuya kuba ngaphezulu kwezona nzuzo. Iiminye elishumi elihlanu yamava emsebenzini kwinqanaba lomlawuli ophakathi / omphezulu kwi Auditing. Amava kwii Information Systems Audits kuya kuba ngaphezulu kwezona nzuzo. Ilayisensi evumelekileyo yokushayela izithuthi (ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubekileyo). Amandla kumsebenzi oPhakathi woBunchonxulunye nameNkqubo: Amandla eNqanaba nobuBomi. ULawuloabantu nobuKhululeko. ULawulo lweNkqubo neeProjekthi. ULawulo lweMali. ULawulo lokuTshintsha. ULawulo loLwazi. InzovolokuYila iNkonzo (SDI). Ixazululo lweziNgxaki nokuCuLa iNgcaca. IMoyikile kuBomi kumXhaswa. Unxibelelwano. Inyaniso noQiniso. Amandla oKuLawula nokujongeela inkqubo yokuQaliiswa kweprojekthi. Ulwazi lobukhali be mbali nzima. IiMisebenzi yoLawulo. Imali. Izinto zokuSebenzela abaNtu. UkuCwangcisa nokuQamba. UkuQeNgwa kweeNgxelo. UPhandlo \ ukuNika ingcaca. IKhompyutha ngeSayensi / iziNgqinisekiso / iinkqubo nezithetho. Iimfuno neenkxalabo zeSebe. xh.duties: Lawula iiNkqubo zeNgcombolo kunye ne Cluster 4 (ARD, EDET & TCS) ngokusebenzisa ngokuchanekileyo nangokulula i Shared Internal Audit Function, kuquka nokuqinisekisa ukuba kukho uLawulo olusebenzayo lweMali kunye noLawulo lweengozi. Lawula ukuQaliiswa kwe Combined Assurance Plans zokuLawula, iNgxaki, uLawulo nokuzithoba kweenkqubo kwi Cluster 4 Provincial Departments. Qinisekisa ukunikezelwa kweenkonzo ezisebenzayo ezongeza ixabiso kwiDirectorate. Lawula i Cluster 4 ukuyigcina ihlala iqamba, idalwe izinto ezintsha nokuzithoba iinkqubo zoBuchwepheshe be Institute of Internal Auditors International Professional Practice Framework. Lawula indlela yokwenza izinto ngobugqwala nokulwa nokubakelwa kwamaxoki kubasebenzi ababelwe i Cluster 4 kwi Shared Internal Audit.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Employee Health & Wellness
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 per annum (Level 11), (all-inclusive package which can be structured according to the individual’s needs as guided by the Department of Public Service and Administration (DPSA) prescripts)
jobs.closing_date_text: 18 September 2026 @ 16H00. Late applications will not be considered. Failure to comply with the above requirements will result in the disqualification of the application.
jobs.summary: Deputy Director for Employee Health and Wellness at Limpopo Provincial Treasury in Polokwane, managing HAST programmes and wellness initiatives.
jobs.requirements: NQF level 6 qualification in Social Work / Psychology or related field as recognized by SAQA. Registration with HPCSA will be an added advantage. Five (5) years’ experience within the field of which three (3) years’ functional experience at junior managerial level / Assistant Director level in Employee Health and Wellness Programme. Valid vehicle driver’s license (with exception of persons with disabilities). Knowledge & Skills: Sound and in-depth knowledge of relevant prescripts, and applications of DPSA EHW Strategic Framework, 2008 as amended as well as understanding of the legislative framework governing the Public Service such as; Children’s Act no 38 of 2005. Skills Development Act. Basic Conditions of Employment Act. Labour Relations Act. Public Service Act. Administrative Justice Act. Promotion of Access of Information Act. Promotion of Access of Information Act. Public Service Regulations and various Bargaining Council Resolutions. National Strategic Plan on HIV, STIs and TB. Mental Health Act, OHS Act. Negotiation skills. Report writing skills. People management. Financial solving. Planning & organizing. Time management. Strategic planning. Policy analysis and development. Good communication skills. Group dynamics. Facilitation skills. Co-ordination skills. Leadership skills. Conflict Management.
jobs.duties: Manage and monitor the implementation of HIV AND AIDS, STI’s and TB (HAST) Progamme. Ensure the maximation of opportunities for all employees to participate in HIV testing services. Manage and monitor the implementation of HIV, STI’s and TB prevention to reduce new infections in the department. Ensure the provision of educational sessions to protect and promote the human rights and access to Justine of all employees. Develop, monitor and evaluate the implementation of peer educator’s programme. Develop and monitor HAST costed operational plans. Manage and monitor the implementation of health and productivity management (HPM) program. Manage communicable and non-communicable diseases. Manage and monitor the provision of wellness screening. Manage and monitor the provision of disease management activities. Analyse, interpret, report chronic disease and related health risk in the department. Management the provision of mental health programmes. Develop and monitor HPM costed operational plan. Manage and monitor the implementation of safety health environment risk and Quality (SHERQ) assurance in line with the Occupational Health & Safety Act. Ensure the provision and promotion of occupational health and safety educational sessions. Ensure Occupational Health Safety administrative compliance. Manage and monitor the implementation of SHERQ risk assessment. Manage and monitor OHS Audits. Analyse workplace reports and advise management. Manage and monitor Occupational Injuries and Diseases in line with Compensation of Occupational Injuries and Diseases Act (COIDA). Manage and monitor the implementation of wellness management programmes. Manage and monitor the implementation of individual wellness physical interventions. Analyse the utilization of physical wellness activities. Manage and provide supervision on individual wellness psychosocial interventions. Manage implementation of organisational wellness. Manage and monitor the implementation of work-life balance programmes. Co-ordinate the implementation of spiritual wellness. Develop, implement, and monitor the EH&W policies. Develop / review policies, systems operating procedures and strategies related to EH&W. Coordinate consultative processes on the development and review of EH&W policies. Manage and monitor implement and monitor policies, procedures, systems and strategies related to EHW. Manage and utilise resources (Human, Physical and Financial) in accordance with relevant directives and legislation. Provide effective supervision and mentorship to the EH&W coordinators. Manage performance and appraisal of the staff as required by regulations. Consolidate and conduct quality assurance of EH&W monthly, quarterly and annual evaluation reports. Ensure capacity and development of staff. Enhance and maintain employee motivation and cultivate a culture of performance management. Manage allocated budget for implementation of EH&W programmes. Executive administrative functions (attend stakeholders engagement meetings and ensure DPSA compliance reports are compiled and submitted timeously).
jobs.enquiries: Mesdames Elizba Kotze / B.P. Chaka / Conny Kgadima / K.H. Moremi / Mr. J.S. Nduli Tel No: (015) 298 7000
jobs.applications: Applicants may apply through the following website: https://erecruitment.limpopo.gov.za or Applicants should be submitted to: Director: Human Resource Management, Private Bag X 9486, Polokwane, 0700 OR Hand delivered to: ISMINI Towers Building, Office No. GOO2 (Ground Floor) Registry, 46 Hans van Ransburg Street, Polokwane, 0700. All General enquiries should be directed to Mesdames, Kotze Elizba, Chaka Pearl, Kgadima Conny, Moremi Hilda & Mr. Nduli J.S. Tel No: (015) 298 7000.
jobs.notes: The advert will be posted on the following websites www.limtreasury.gov.za / www.limpopo.gov.za and www.dpsa.gov.za and Provincial Departments social media Applications must be submitted on new Z83 forms obtainable from all Government Departments or can be downloaded from www.dpsa.gov.za or www.gov.za. The new Z83 form must be completed in manner that provides sufficient information about the candidate and the post he or she applies for by completing all relevant fields. The following must be considered in relation to the completion of the Z83 by applicants. All the fields in Part A, Part C and Part D should be completed. In Part B, all fields should be completed in full except the following: South African applicants need not to provide passport numbers. If an applicant responds “no” to the question “Are you conducting business with the State or are you a Director of a Public or Private Company conducting business with the State?” then the answer to the next question “In the event that you are employed in the Public Service, you immediately relinquish such business interests?” can be left blank or indicated as not applicable. A “not applicable” or blank response will be allowed on the question “If your profession or occupation requires official registration, provide date and particulars of registration”; if you are not in possession of such registration. Noting there is limited space provided for Part E, F & G, applicants often indicate “refer to Curriculum Vitae (CV) or see attached”, this is acceptable as long as the CV has been attached and provides the required information. If the information is not provided in the CV, the applicant may be disqualified. It must be noted that a CV is an extension of the application of employment Z83, and applicants are accountable for the information that is provided therein. Applicants currently employed by the public service do not need to complete Part F as the section is intended for those seeking re-employment, as their prior employment can be verified through their CV. The declaration should be completed and signed. Applicants must utilize the most recent Z83 application for employment form as issued by the Minister of Public Service and Administration in line with Regulation 10 of the Public Service Regulations, 2016, failure to do so results in disqualifications. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application but must submit the Z83 and detailed Curriculum Vitae. It must be noted that the CV is an extension of an application of an employment Z83, and applicants are accountable for the information that is provided therein. The Z83 form must be completed in the manner that allows the selection committee to assess the quality of the candidate based on the information that is contained in the form. The Department will require shortlisted candidates to provide certified copies of their qualifications and any other relevant document, which must be submitted to HR on or before the interview date. A specific reference number for the post applied for must be quoted in the space provided on the new form Z83. Applicants with foreign qualifications remain responsible for ensuring that their qualifications are evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) and therefore must submit the copies of certificates and evidence of evaluation by the SAQA for foreign qualification if they are invited to attend interviews. Successful incumbents will be expected to sign a performance agreement within one month after assumption of duty. All shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a security clearance and verification of qualifications. Shortlisted applicants will be required to provide their original qualification certificates and ID on the day of the interview for other relevant verification purposes. The recommended candidate will further be subjected to Personnel Suitability Checks, including financial disclosure requirements, social media screening, and other relevant verification processes. All successful candidates will be subjected to the applicable security clearance processes. All shortlisted candidates will be subjected to pre-entry assessments prior to the interview process. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts, will be subjected to a technical exercise and Interview. Following technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. To ensure that potential SMS members have a background on processes and procedures linked to the SMS, a further requirement for appointment at SMS level will be the successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-entry Programme (Nyukela) as endorsed by the National School of Government with effect from 1st April 2020. This is a Public Service specific training programme which will be applicable for appointments at SMS level. The link for the completion of the pre-entry certificate is as follows: www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme.           Individuals who have completed the course already, and who are therefore in possession of a certificate are welcome to submit such. However, all SMS short-listed candidates will be required to have completed certificate and submit such upon appointment. All shortlisted candidates for other posts shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only, due to the large number of applications we envisage to receive and if you have not heard from the Department within 90 days of the closing date, please accept that your application has been unsuccessful. However, should there be any dissatisfaction, applicants are hereby advised to, within 90 days, request reasons from the Department for any administrative action which has adversely affected them in terms of section 5, sub-section 1 and 2 of the Promotion of Administrative Justice Act 3 of 2000. The Department reserves the right not to make any appointment to the post advertised. The employment decision shall be informed by the Employment Equity Plan of the Department. NB! Candidates who applied before for the re-advertised vacant post are encouraged to re-apply. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Werknemergesondheid en Welstand
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur vir Werknemergesondheid en Welstand by Limpopo Provincial Treasury in Polokwane, wat HAST-programme en welstandsinitiatiewe bestuur.
af.requirements: NQF vlak 6-kwalifikasie in Maatskaplike Werk / Sielkunde of verwante veld soos erken deur SAQA. Registrasie by HPCSA sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Vyf (5) jaar se ervaring binne die veld waarvan drie (3) jaar se funksionele ervaring op junior bestuursvlak / Assistent-direkteursvlak in Werknemergesondheid en Welstandsprogram. Geldige bestuurderlisensie (met uitsondering van persone met gestremdhede). Kennis & Vaardighede: Deeglike en diepgaande kennis van relevante voorskifte, en toepassings van DPSA EHW Strategiese Raamwerk, 2008 soos gewysig asook begrip van die wetgewende raamwerk wat die Openbare Diens beheer soos; Kinderwet no 38 van 2005. Vaardigheidsonwikkelingswet. Basiese Diensvoorwaardes-wet. Arbeidsverhoudingswet. Openbare Dienswet. Administratiewe Geregtigheidswet. Bevordering van Toegang tot Inligting-wet. Bevordering van Toegang tot Inligting-wet. Openbare Diensregulasies en verskeie Bedingingsraad-besluite. Nasionale Strategiese Plan oor MIV, SOI's en TB. Geestesgesondheidswet, OHS-wet. Onderhandelingsvaardighede. Verslagdoeningsvaardighede. Mensebestuur. Finansiële oplossing. Beplanning & organisering. Tydbestuur. Strategiese beplanning. Beleidontleding en -ontwikkeling. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede. Groepsdinamika. Fasiliteringsvaardighede. Koördineringsvaardighede. Leierskapsvaardighede. Konflikbestuur.
af.duties: Bestuur en monitor die implementering van MIV en VIGS, SOI's en TB (HAST) Program. Verseker die maksimering van geleenthede vir alle werknemers om aan MIV-toetsdienste deel te neem. Bestuur en monitor die implementering van MIV, SOI's en TB-voorkoming om nuwe infeksies in die departement te verminder. Verseker die voorsiening van opvoedkundige sessies om die menseregte en toegang tot geregtigheid van alle werknemers te beskerm en te bevorder. Ontwikkel, monitor en evalueer die implementering van portuurg opvoeder-program. Ontwikkel en monitor HAST-gekoste operasionele planne. Bestuur en monitor die implementering van gesondheids- en produktiwiteitsbestuurs- (HPM) program. Bestuur oordraagbare en nie-oordraagbare siektes. Bestuur en monitor die voorsiening van welstandskeuring. Bestuur en monitor die voorsiening van siektebestuursaktiwiteite. Analiseer, interpreteer en rapporteer chroniese siekte en verwante gesondheidsrisiko in die departement. Bestuur die voorsiening van geestesgesondheidsprogramme. Ontwikkel en monitor HPM-gekoste operasionele plan. Bestuur en monitor die implementering van veiligheid, gesondheid, omgewingsrisiko en kwaliteit (SHERQ) versekering in ooreenstemming met die Beroepsgesondheid en -veiligheidswet. Verseker die voorsiening en bevordering van beroepsgesondheids- en -veiligheidsopvoedkundige sessies. Verseker Beroepsgesondheids- en -veiligheidsadministratiewe nakoming. Bestuur en monitor die implementering van SHERQ-risiko-assesserings. Bestuur en monitor OHS-oudits. Analiseer werksplekverslae en adviseer bestuur. Bestuur en monitor Beroepsbeserings en -siektes in ooreenstemming met Wet op Vergoeding vir Beroepsbeserings en -siektes (COIDA). Bestuur en monitor die implementering van welstandsbestuursprogramme. Bestuur en monitor die implementering van individuele welstands-fisiese ingrypings. Analiseer die benutting van fisiese welstandsaktiwiteite. Bestuur en verskaf toesig oor individuele welstands-psigososiale ingrypings. Bestuur implementering van organisatoriese welstand. Bestuur en monitor die implementering van werk-lewensbalans-programme. Koördineer die implementering van geestelike welstand. Ontwikkel, implementeer en monitor die EH&W-beleid. Ontwikkel / hersien beleid, stelsels, bedryfsprosedures en strategieë rakende EH&W. Koördineer konsultatiewe prosesse oor die ontwikkeling en hersiening van EH&W-beleid. Bestuur en monitor implementering en monitor beleid, prosedures, stelsels en strategieë rakende EHW. Bestuur en benut hulpbronne (Menslike, Fisiese en Finansiële) in ooreenstemming met relevante riglyne en wetgewing. Verskaf effektiewe toesig en mentorskap aan die EH&W-koördineerders. Bestuur prestasie en beoordeling van die personeel soos vereis deur regulasies. Konsolideer en voer gehalteversekering uit van EH&W-maandelikse, kwartallikse en jaarlikse evalueringsverslae. Verseker kapasiteit en ontwikkeling van personeel. Verbeter en handhaaf werknemermotivering en kweek 'n kultuur van prestasiebestuur. Bestuur toegewysde begroting vir implementering van EH&W-programme. Voer administratiewe funksies uit (woon belanghebbende-betrokkenheidsvergaderings by en verseker DPSA-nakomingsverslae word opgestel en betyds ingedien).

Ilayisensi evumelekile yokushayela izimoto (ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubazekile). Skills Development Act. Basic Conditions of Employment Act. Labour Relations Act. Public Service Act. Administrative Justice Act. Promotion of Access of Information Act. Promotion of Access of Information Act. Public Service Regulations nezinqumo ezahlukene zeBargaining Council. National Strategic Plan on HIV, STIs and TB. Mental Health Act, OHS Act. Amakhono okuxoxisana. Amakhono okubhala imibiko. Abaphathi abantu. Ukuxazulula izimali. Ukuphathwa nokuhlelwa. Ukuphathwa isikhathi. Ukuhlelwa ngokusobala. Ukuhlaziya nokuqamba imithetho. Amakhono okuxhumana ahle. Ukunyakaza kwamaqembu. Amakhono okukhuthaza. Amakhono okuhlanganisa. Amakhono okubusa. Amakhono okuphatha izinkinga.
zu.duties: Phatha futhi ulinde isisetshenzwa senkqubo yeHIV AND AIDS, STI's and TB (HAST). Qinisekisa ukwandiswa kwamathuba bonke abasebenzi ukuthi bahlanganye kule nhlelo yokuhlola iHIV. Phatha futhi ulinde isisetshenzwa sokuthwalela iHIV, iSTI's neTB ukunciphisa izifo ezintsha kumnyango. Qinisekisa ukunikelwa kwezinkomfa zemfundo ukuze kuqatshwe futhi kukhuthazwe amalungelo abantu nokufinyelela kukaJustine bonke abasebenzi. Qamba, ulinde futhi uhlolye isisetshenzwa senkqubo yabaqeqeshi abalinganayo. Qamba futhi ulinde amaphulani abahlinzeki weHAST anezindleko. Phatha futhi ulinde isisetshenzwa senkqubo yophathwa lwezempilo nokukhiqiza (HPM). Phatha izifo ezeluliswayo nangezingezi. Phatha futhi ulinde ukunikelwa kokuqashwa kwamaphiliko. Phatha futhi ulinde ukunikelwa kwezindlela zokuphatha izifo. Hlaziya, humusha, futhi uthumele umbiko ngegula ehlala isikhathi eside kanye nezengo eziphathelene nezempilo kumnyango. Phatha ukunikelwa kwezinhlelo zezempilo yengqondo. Qamba futhi ulinde uhlelo lokusebenza lweHPM olunamaphulani ezindleko. Phatha futhi ulinde isisetshenzwa soqiniseko lokuphepha kwezempilo, ibanga, ingozi nengqondo (SHERQ) ngokuhambisana neOccupational Health & Safety Act. Qinisekisa ukunikelwa kwezinkomfa zemfundo ngokuphepha kwezempilo nokukhiqiza. Qinisekisa ukuthobela izidingo zokuphepha kwezempilo ngokuphathwa kwesiphakamiso. Phatha futhi ulinde isisetshenzwa sokuhlola ingozi yeSHERQ. Phatha futhi ulinde ukuphenya iOHS. Hlaziya imibiko yasezindaweni zokusebenza futhi unikeze injabulo abaphathi. Phatha futhi ulinde Izingozi Nezifo Ezingabaphathi ngokuhambisana neCompensation of Occupational Injuries and Diseases Act (COIDA). Phatha futhi ulinde isisetshenzwa sezinhlelo zokuphathwa kwamaphiliko. Phatha futhi ulinde isisetshenzwa sezinye izindlela zomzimba zokuphathwa kwamaphiliko komuntu. Hlaziya ukusetshenziswa kwezindlela zomzimba zokuphathwa kwamaphiliko. Phatha futhi unikeze ulawulo ezindaweni eziphathekayo zengqondo zokuphathwa kwamaphiliko. Phatha isisetshenzwa sokuphathwa kwamaphiliko kweqembu. Phatha futhi ulinde isisetshenzwa sezinhlelo zokusabalalisa isikhathi somsebenzi. Hlanganisa isisetshenzwa kwamaphiliko omdabu. Qamba, sethenzeze, futhi ulinde imithetho yeEH&W. Qamba / buyekeze imithetho, izinhlelo zokusebenza kanye nezindlela zokuhlela ezingana neH&W. Hlanganisa izinkomba zokubonisana ekwakheni futhi kubuyekeze imithetho yeH&W. Phatha futhi ulinde ukusetshenziswa nokulandelwa kwemithetho, izindlela, izinhlelo kanye nezindlela ezingana neEHW. Phatha futhi usebenzise izinsiza (Abantu, Izinto nangezimali) ngokuhambisana nezinkomba ezithintekayo nangomthetho. Nikeza ulawulo olusebenzayo kanye nenkamiso kubahleli beEH&W. Phatha ukusebenza kahle kanye nokuhlola abasebenzi njengoba kudingwa imithetho. Hlanganisa futhi wenze ukulandelwa kwemigomo yamakhondo weH&W nyanga zonke,nyanga ngamunye kanye namathambo wonyaka. Qinisekisa amandla nokuqeqesha abasebenzi. Khuphula futhi ulondoloze ukukhuthazwa kwabasebenzi futhi uqoke izinto ezinhle zokuphatha ukusebenza. Phatha umthamo onikeziwe wemali yokwakha izinhlelo zokusebenza. Yenza imisebenzi yalawulo (ukuya emihlanganweni ngokuthintana namaphathi futhi uqinisekise ukuthi imibiko yokulalela imithetho yeDPSA ihlanganisiwe futhi ithunyelwe ngesikhathi).

xh.title: Isekela Mongameli: Impilo Yabasebenzi & Imo Yomzimba
xh.summary: Isekela Mongameli weMpilo yabaSebenzi nokokuKhetha kwiLimpopo Provincial Treasury ePolokwane, uphatha amaqonga eHAST nemiqathango yokukhetha impilo.
xh.requirements: Isethengiso samabanga eNQF 6 kuZomsebenzi weNtlalo / iPsychology okanye inkalo eqhotyoshelwayo njengokuqatshelwa yiSAQA. Ubulungu kwiHPCSA kuya kuba ngaphezulu kwexabiso. Imimiselo yeminyaka elishanu (5) yamava kwinkalo ekuqatshelwa kuyo apho kulula iminyaka emithathu (3) yamava oqobo obusebenzayo kwinqanaba lophatha / kwinqanaba loMncedisi weNqanaba kwiNkqubo yeMpilo yabaSebenzi nokuKhetha. Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba eduze esemthethweni (ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubazekileyo). ULwazi & Amandla: Ulwazi olujulileyo noluchanekileyo ngemigqatho ephathelwe nayo, nokuyicwangcisa kwiDPSA EHW Strategic Framework, 2008 njengoko ibukunokubukwa nakho ukuqonda ingxoxo yomthetho ephatha abaSebenzi bakuRhuwa njengoko; iChildren's Act no 38 ka 2005. ISkills Development Act. iBasic Conditions of Employment Act. iLabour Relations Act. iPublic Service Act. iAdministrative Justice Act. ukuzincedisa ngoMthetho wokuFikelela ulwazi. ukuzincedisa ngoMthetho wokuFikelela ulwazi. iPublic Service Regulations nemiQathango ehlukileyo yeBargaining Council Resolutions. iNational Strategic Plan kwiHIV, iSTIs neTB. iMental Health Act, iOHS Act. Amandla okucinga. Amandla okubhala iingxelo. Ukulawula abantu. Ukuqondisa imali. Ukuqamba nokuqumba. Ukulawula ixesha. Ukuqamba iNdabamphico. Ukuqamba nokuphuhlisa iNqumla. Amandla ancomezelayo ekuNyanzelisana. Amandla okuQondisa. Amandla okuBumba. Amandla okuLawula. Amandla okuQonda kwaye uKhokele.
xh.duties: Qamba ukuqonda nokulawula ukusebenza kweNkqubo yeHIV AND AIDS, iSTI's neTB (HAST). Qinisekisa ukwandiswa kwamathuba kuwo onke abasebenzi ukuba bathathe inxaxheba kwiinkonzo zovavanyo lweHIV. Qamba ukuqonda nokulawula ukusebenza kokuThintela iHIV, iSTI's neTB ukunciphisa iinfeksiyo ezintsha kwisebe. Qinisekisa ukubonelelwa kwezigqibo zemfundo ukukhusela nokukhuthaza amalungelo abantu kuwo onke abasebenzi. Phuhlisa, qonda vavanya ukusebenza kwenkqubo yabaQeqeshi bempilo. Phuhlisa ukuqonda iinkqubo zeHAST ezithengwayo. Qamba ukuqonda nokulawula ukusebenza kwenkqubo yokulawula impilo nokuSebenza (HPM). Lawula iigulo ezelanayo nongazelanayo. Qamba ukuqonda nokulawula ukubonelelwa ngokuHlolwa kweMo yomzimba. Qamba ukuqonda nokulawula ukubonelelwa ngemiQathazo yokulawula iigulo. Chaza, qonda nika ingxelo ngegulo esingekhoyo kwaye nexesha elingalinganiyo nesiya empilweni kwisebe. Lawula ukubonelelwa ngeenkqubo zempiloengqondweni. Phuhlisa ukuqonda iinkqubo zeHPM ezibhaliweyo. Qamba ukuqonda nokulawula ukusebenza kokuQinisekisa uKhuseleko lweNdalo yempilo nokuQamba (SHERQ) ngokwemigaqo yomThetho woKhuseleko lweMpilo. Qinisekisa ukubonelela nokukhuthaza iinkqubo zemfundo zoKhuseleko lweMpilo. Qinisekisa ukuzaliseka kokuQamba oko kuThintela iNgxaki zoBuse beMpo. Qamba ukuqonda nokulawula ukusebenza kokuqonda imiba yeSHERQ. Qamba ukuqonda nokulawula ukuHlolwa kweOHS. Chaza iingxelo zendawo yakusebenza uze uncede ngokulawula. Qamba ukuqonda nokulawula iNgxaki noKhuseleko lweMpono ngokomThetho wokuQondisa iNgxaki zoKhuseleko lweMpono (COIDA). Qamba ukuqonda nokulawula ukusebenza kweenkqubo zokuLawula impilo. Qamba ukuqonda nokulawula ukusebenza kwezenzo zoMzimba ngabanye. Chaza ukusetyenziswa kwezenzo zomzimba ngabanye. Qamba uncedise ngokulawula iinkqubo zengqondo ngabanye. Qamba ukuqonda nokusebenza kwempilo koluntu. Qamba ukuqonda nokulawula iinkqubo zokusiba nokuzalisekisa imisebenzi. Lawula ukusebenza kwempilo yangokomoya. Phuhlisa, qamba uze ulawule imigaqo yeEH&W. Phuhlisa / hlola imigaqo, iinkqubo neenkqubo zokuqamba ezixhomekeke kwiEH&W. Lawula iinkqubo zokucebisana ngokuphuhlisa nokuhlola imigaqo yeEH&W. Qamba ulawula ukusebenza nokulawula imigaqo, iinkqubo, iinkqubo neenkqubo ezinxulumene neEHW. Qamba usebenzise izibonelelo (abantu, izinto neziQinisekiso ngokweemvakalelo nemigaqo). Qinisekisa ulawulo oluncomezelayo nokuyala abaQambi beEH&W. Qamba ulawulo olulinganayo lwabasebenzi njengoko kufunwa. Hlanganisa uze uqinisekise ukhuseleko kwingxelo yeEH&W yamavesi, amarhoqhwo neminyaka. Qinisekisa amandla nokuqhuba abasebenzi. Phucula ulondolozo komdla kubasebenzi uze wakhe inkqubo yokulawula ukusebenza. Lawula imali echaziweyo ngokuqamba iinkqubo zeEH&W. Qamba imisebenzi yolawulo (uzibandakanye kwiindibano zabahluleli uze uqinisekise ukuba iingxelo zokuzaliseka kweDPSA zihlelwe zize zithunyelwe ngesixa esifanelekileyo).

jobs.title: Deputy Director’s: SCM Governance & Compliance
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 per annum (Level 11), (all-inclusive package which can be structured according to the individual’s needs as guided by the Department of Public Service and Administration (DPSA) prescripts)
jobs.closing_date_text: 18 September 2026 @ 16H00. Late applications will not be considered. Failure to comply with the above requirements will result in the disqualification of the application.
jobs.summary: Deputy Director for SCM Governance and Compliance at Limpopo Provincial Treasury, requiring an NQF 7 qualification and five years' SCM experience.
jobs.requirements: NQF level 7 qualification in Supply Chain Management / Financial Management / Accounting or related as recognized by SAQA. Certificate in Supply Chain Management will be an added advantage. Five (5) years’ experience within the field of which three (3) years’ experience at junior managerial level / Assistant Director level in the broader Supply Chain Management Environment. Valid vehicle driver’s license (with exception of persons with disabilities). Knowledge & Skills: Knowledge of the Public Finance Management Act, (PFMA). PPPFA. Treasury Regulations. National & Provincial SCM Policies. Relevant case law. Knowledge of Public sector Fraud &Corruption prevention frameworks. Skills. Leadership. Ability to translate legislative requirements into practical, risk-based compliance strategies. Analytical Thinking. High proficiency in data analysis, identifying red flags and interpreting complex procurement scenarios. Legal drafting. Skill in drafting policies circulars and legal opinions on SCM matters. Stakeholder Management. Excellent ability to engage and influence Senior Officials and Auditors.
jobs.duties: Manage the implementation of SCM Compliance monitoring systems. Conduct sample-based reviews or assessment of bid committees (specifications, evaluation adjudication), contract awards, deviations, expansions, and emergency procurements. Monitor the assigned departments to ensure that SCM processes (planning, procurement, contract management, and disposal) adhere to the Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). Treasury Regulations, PPPFA, and other relevant prescripts. Review and validate compliance reports, ensuring accuracy, evidence-based findings and alignment with Treasury Regulations and relevant case law. Monitor and evaluate the performance of the SCM monitoring system. Implement a system for the monitoring and evaluation of the performance of the SCM monitoring framework. Monitor the implementation and progress of the SCM monitoring framework through site visits to the assigned institutions. Analyse data and compile reports on the analysis of compliance with established SCM measured and prescribed parameters for: procurement plans quarterly and annually), bid processes specifications and tender procedures, contract terms, supplier / service provider delivery standards, procurement by other means and changes to procurement standards. Propose updates to provincial SCM policies, standards operating procedures, (SOPs) and checklist based recurring compliance gaps identified during monitoring activities. Manage the implementation of SCM Capacity Building programmes / initiatives. Develop and deliver targeted training sessions for SCM Practitioners and Bid Committee Members within the assigned departments. Monitor and support the implementation of the CSD RFQ Functionality within the institutions assigned. Assist assigned departments with Root Cause Analysis for their SCM Audit Findings and monitor the implementation of their Audit Action Plans. Coordinate the implementation of the SCM Compliance Risk Assessment and Monitoring (SCM CRAM). Evaluate the current Provincial SCM Compliance Risk environment maturity levels and risks. Identify areas for improvement. Develop improvement plans and ensure the implementation of these plans.
jobs.enquiries: Mesdames Elizba Kotze / B.P. Chaka / Conny Kgadima / K.H. Moremi / Mr. J.S. Nduli Tel No: (015) 298 7000
jobs.applications: Applicants may apply through the following website: https://erecruitment.limpopo.gov.za or Applicants should be submitted to: Director: Human Resource Management, Private Bag X 9486, Polokwane, 0700 OR Hand delivered to: ISMINI Towers Building, Office No. GOO2 (Ground Floor) Registry, 46 Hans van Ransburg Street, Polokwane, 0700. All General enquiries should be directed to Mesdames, Kotze Elizba, Chaka Pearl, Kgadima Conny, Moremi Hilda & Mr. Nduli J.S. Tel No: (015) 298 7000.
jobs.notes: The advert will be posted on the following websites www.limtreasury.gov.za / www.limpopo.gov.za and www.dpsa.gov.za and Provincial Departments social media Applications must be submitted on new Z83 forms obtainable from all Government Departments or can be downloaded from www.dpsa.gov.za or www.gov.za. The new Z83 form must be completed in manner that provides sufficient information about the candidate and the post he or she applies for by completing all relevant fields. The following must be considered in relation to the completion of the Z83 by applicants. All the fields in Part A, Part C and Part D should be completed. In Part B, all fields should be completed in full except the following: South African applicants need not to provide passport numbers. If an applicant responds “no” to the question “Are you conducting business with the State or are you a Director of a Public or Private Company conducting business with the State?” then the answer to the next question “In the event that you are employed in the Public Service, you immediately relinquish such business interests?” can be left blank or indicated as not applicable. A “not applicable” or blank response will be allowed on the question “If your profession or occupation requires official registration, provide date and particulars of registration”; if you are not in possession of such registration. Noting there is limited space provided for Part E, F & G, applicants often indicate “refer to Curriculum Vitae (CV) or see attached”, this is acceptable as long as the CV has been attached and provides the required information. If the information is not provided in the CV, the applicant may be disqualified. It must be noted that a CV is an extension of the application of employment Z83, and applicants are accountable for the information that is provided therein. Applicants currently employed by the public service do not need to complete Part F as the section is intended for those seeking re-employment, as their prior employment can be verified through their CV. The declaration should be completed and signed. Applicants must utilize the most recent Z83 application for employment form as issued by the Minister of Public Service and Administration in line with Regulation 10 of the Public Service Regulations, 2016, failure to do so results in disqualifications. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application but must submit the Z83 and detailed Curriculum Vitae. It must be noted that the CV is an extension of an application of an employment Z83, and applicants are accountable for the information that is provided therein. The Z83 form must be completed in the manner that allows the selection committee to assess the quality of the candidate based on the information that is contained in the form. The Department will require shortlisted candidates to provide certified copies of their qualifications and any other relevant document, which must be submitted to HR on or before the interview date. A specific reference number for the post applied for must be quoted in the space provided on the new form Z83. Applicants with foreign qualifications remain responsible for ensuring that their qualifications are evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) and therefore must submit the copies of certificates and evidence of evaluation by the SAQA for foreign qualification if they are invited to attend interviews. Successful incumbents will be expected to sign a performance agreement within one month after assumption of duty. All shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a security clearance and verification of qualifications. Shortlisted applicants will be required to provide their original qualification certificates and ID on the day of the interview for other relevant verification purposes. The recommended candidate will further be subjected to Personnel Suitability Checks, including financial disclosure requirements, social media screening, and other relevant verification processes. All successful candidates will be subjected to the applicable security clearance processes. All shortlisted candidates will be subjected to pre-entry assessments prior to the interview process. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts, will be subjected to a technical exercise and Interview. Following technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. To ensure that potential SMS members have a background on processes and procedures linked to the SMS, a further requirement for appointment at SMS level will be the successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-entry Programme (Nyukela) as endorsed by the National School of Government with effect from 1st April 2020. This is a Public Service specific training programme which will be applicable for appointments at SMS level. The link for the completion of the pre-entry certificate is as follows: www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme.           Individuals who have completed the course already, and who are therefore in possession of a certificate are welcome to submit such. However, all SMS short-listed candidates will be required to have completed certificate and submit such upon appointment. All shortlisted candidates for other posts shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only, due to the large number of applications we envisage to receive and if you have not heard from the Department within 90 days of the closing date, please accept that your application has been unsuccessful. However, should there be any dissatisfaction, applicants are hereby advised to, within 90 days, request reasons from the Department for any administrative action which has adversely affected them in terms of section 5, sub-section 1 and 2 of the Promotion of Administrative Justice Act 3 of 2000. The Department reserves the right not to make any appointment to the post advertised. The employment decision shall be informed by the Employment Equity Plan of the Department. NB! Candidates who applied before for the re-advertised vacant post are encouraged to re-apply. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: SCM Bestuursreëls en Nakoming
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur vir SCM Bestuursreëls en Nakoming by Limpopo Provincial Treasury, wat 'n NQF 7-kwalifikasie en vyf jaar se SCM-ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: NQF vlak 7-kwalifikasie in Supply Chain Management / Financial Management / Rekeningkunde of verwante velde soos erken deur SAQA. 'n Sertifikaat in Supply Chain Management sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Vyf (5) jaar se ervaring binne die veld waarvan drie (3) jaar se ervaring op junior bestuursvlak / Assistentdirekteursvlak in die breër Supply Chain Management-omgewing. Geldige bestuurslisensie (met uitsondering van persone met gestremdhede). Kennis & Vaardighede: Kennis van die Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). PPPFA. Treasury Regulations. Nasionale & Provinciale SCM-beleide. Toepaslike case law. Kennis van Openbare sektor bedrog en korrupsievoorkoming-raamwerke. Vaardighede. Leierskap. Vermoë om wetgewende vereistes in praktiese, risiko-gebaseerde nakomingsstrategieë te vertaal. Analitiese denke. Hoë vaardigheid in data-analise, die identifisering van waarskuwingstekens en die interpretering van komplekse verkrygingscenarios. Regsopstel. Vaardigheid in die opstel van beleide, sirkulêre en regsmenings oor SCM-aangeleenthede. Belanghebbende-bestuur. Uitstekende vermoë om Senior Amptenare en Ouditeure te betrek en te beïnvloed.
af.duties: Bestuur die implementering van SCM-nakomingsmoniteringstelsels. Voer steekproefgebaseerde hersienings of assesserings van bodkomitees (spesifikasies, evaluering, toekenning), kontraktetoekennings, afwykings, uitbreidings en noodverkrygings uit. Monitor die toegekenide departemente om te verseker dat SCM-prosesse (beplanning, verkryging, kontrakbestuur en beskikking) voldoen aan die Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). Treasury Regulations, PPPFA en ander relevante voorskrifte. Hersien en valideer nakomingsverslae en verseker akkuratheid, bewysgebaseerde bevindings en ooreenstemming met Treasury Regulations en toepaslike case law. Monitor en evalueer die prestasie van die SCM-moniteringstelsel. Implementeer 'n stelsel vir die monitering en evaluering van die prestasie van die SCM-moniteringsraamwerk. Monitor die implementering en vordering van die SCM-moniteringsraamwerk deur middel van werksbesoeke aan die toegekenide instellings. Analiseer data en stel verslae op oor die analise van nakoming van gevestigde SCM-bepaalde en voorgeskrewe parameters vir: verkrygingsplanne (kwartaalliks en jaarliks), bodprosesse (spesifikasies en tenderprosedures), kontrakbepalings, verskaffer / diensverskaffer afleweringsstandaarde, verkryging deur ander middele en veranderinge aan verkrygingsstandaarde. Stel opdaterings voor aan provinsiale SCM-beleide, standaard bedryfsprosedures (SOP's) en kontrolelyste gebaseer op herhalende nakomingsgapings wat tydens moniteringsaktiwiteite geïdentifiseer is. Bestuur die implementering van SCM Kapasiteitsbou-programme / inisiatiewe. Ontwikkel en bied geteikende opleidingsessies aan vir SCM-praktisyne en Bodkomiteelede binne die toegekenide departemente. Monitor en ondersteun die implementering van die CSD RFQ-funksionaliteit binne die toegekenide instellings. Help toegekenide departemente met Oorsaakanalise vir hul SCM-ouditbevindings en monitor die implementering van hul Ouditaksieplanne. Koördineer die implementering van die SCM Nakomingsrisiko-assessering en Monitering (SCM CRAM). Evalueer die huidige Provinsiale SCM Nakomingsrisiko-omgewing se volwassenheidsvlakke en risiko's. Identifiseer areas vir verbetering. Ontwikkel verbeteringsplanne en verseker die implementering van hierdie planne.

zu.title: Isikhundla sikaSekela Nduna: Ukuphathwa kwe-SCM Nokuhambisana Nomthetho
zu.summary: Sekela Nduna woKuphathwa kwe-SCM Nokuhambisana Nomthetho e-Limpopo Provincial Treasury, kudingeka iziqu ze-NQF 7 futhi kube nokuhlolwa okuneminyaka eyi-5 kwi-SCM.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zazinga le-NQF 7 eNqubweni yokuphathwa kwezinto ezihamba phambili / Ukuphathwa kwezimali / Ezimali noma okuhlobene nayo njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA. Isitifiketi sokuphathwa kwezinto ezihamba phambili kuzoba yinzuza. Umphumela weminyaka eyihlanu (5) ngaphakathi kulesi sikhathi, okuyiminyaka emithathu (3) ilinga lokuphatha okuncane / izinga lomsizi weNduna kumazinga obanzi okuphathwa kwezinto ezihamba phambili. Ilayisensi yekhadi yokushayela (ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubazekile). Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi ngePublic Finance Management Act, (PFMA). I-PPPFA. Izimiso ze-Treasury. Amapholisi we-SCM e-Wumbili nakwisifunda. Umthetho ohlobene nedatha. Ulwazi lweziteshi zikahulumeni ezinqabelayo nokuvikela ukwenza amashwa. Amandla. Ukuba ngumholi. Ukukwazi ukuhumusha izidingo zomthetho zibe izindlela ezisebenzayo zokuhambisana nomthetho ezisekelwe kubungozi. Ukucabanga ngokuhlola. Ukukhomba kakhulu ekuloleni idatha, ukuhlolelwa izimpawu eziyingozi nokuhumusha izimo ezibucayi zokuthenga. Ukuloba ngokomthetho. Ukukwazi ukuloba amapholisi namaphuzu abhalwe phansi nemiazbo yomthetho mayelana ne-SCM. Ukuphathwa kwabahlanganyeli. Amandla amakhulu yokuthi umane uxhume nabanjiniyunu bokhulu ukuze ukwazi ukucikiza ecaleni kwabaphathi emkhakheni nakabahloli.
zu.duties: Phatha ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zokuqinisekiswa kokuhambisana kwe-SCM. Yenza ukubuyekeza okusekelwe kwisampula noma ukuhlola okwaleli qembu (okuhlelela, okuhlolwayo, okuphoqelelekile), okuhlobene nokunikwa kwamakontrakhi okudlule, okuphambene nomgqoqo, okukhululekileyo futhi esikhundleni secala eliphuthumayo. Hlola iminyango ehlanganyele ukuze uqinisekis ukuthi inqubo ye-SCM (okulungiselelayo, okuthengwayo, ukuphathwa kwamakontrakhi, nokulahlekelwa) ihambisana ne-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). Izimiso ze-Treasury, i-PPPFA, nezinye iziyalezo ezibalulekile. Buyekeza futhi ukuqinisekisa imibiko yokuhambisana, ukuze aqinisekise inani, iziphetho ezisekelwe kubufakazi nokuhambisana nezimiso ze-Treasury nomthetho ofanele. Hlola futhi uhlolisise ukusebenza kohlangothi olungeni lokuqinisekiswa kokuhambisana kwe-SCM. Misela inkqubo yokulandela nokuhlolwa kokusebenza kommandla wokuqinisekiswa kokuhambisana kwe-SCM. Hlola isethulo nokuqhuba kohlelo lokuqinisekiswa kokuhambisana kwe-SCM ngokuvakashela izikhungo ezahlanganyeleko. Hlola idatha uze uhlele imibiko ngokuhlaziya ukuthi kuhambisana yini ne-SCM ngokulinganisela nokuhlelelwa kwezindlela ezimisiwe nongqimba: amaphulani okuthengisa ngamakhulu ngonyaka), inqubo yokuthenga izinto eziphathelene nohlelo lokuthenga nokuhlinzekwa, izinkulumo zamakontrakhi, izitolo eziya kwabahlinzekiyo, ngendlela yezidingo nezinye izinsiza ezahluke kwezokuthenga noshintsho kwezinkqubo zokuthenga. Phakamisa ukuvuselelwa kwamapholisi we-SCM wesifunda, izinqubo ezijwayelekile zokusebenza, (SOPs) noluhlu lwezinto okubhekwa kuwo njengenhlayiya eyisibalo sokuhambisana okungalungile. Lawula inqubo yokwakhiwa ngokobungako be-SCM. Buka, hlela futhi unikeze ukulolongo olujwayelekileyo mayelana ne-SCM. Lawula futhi uxhase ukusetshenziswa kwe-CSD RFQ ezwakalayo ukulondolozwa ngamandla akhulu emisedari e-SCM. Siza iminyango eyibekile ukuqonda izinto ezingukhiqiza isidingo kanti futhi ulawule ukusetshenziswa ohlelweni oluwo bona kubonakala izindawo zokuthi kungenzeka ngani. Hlela inqubo yokusebenzisa i-SCM Compliance Risk Assessment and Monitoring (SCM CRAM). Hlola ukubukeka kwesigungu nokuqina kwemisebenzi yohlelo lokuphathwa kolaka. Bona izindawo ezingashintshwa. Hlela amaphulani okushintsha bese uqinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwalezo zindlela.

xh.title: Isikhulu esiPhakamileyo: Ulawulo nokuzithoba kwi-SCM
xh.summary: Isikhulu esiPhakamileyo soLawulo nokuzithoba kwi-SCM kwi-Limpopo Provincial Treasury, sifuna isemfundo ye-NQF 7 namava eminyaka emihlanu kwi-SCM.
xh.requirements: Isemfundo esingangoqeqesho le-NQF level 7 kwinkqubo ye-Supply Chain Management / Financial Management / Accounting okanye into echanekileyo njengokuqatshwa yi-SAQA. Iqinisekiso kwi-Supply Chain Management luya kuba lulunga olongezelelekileyo. Imihla yamava emihlanu (5) ngaphakathi kule ndawo apho kuneminyaka mithathu (3) yamava kwinqanaba elingoyena uphatha / kwinqanaba lomncedisi we Direktha kwimeko ibanzi ye-Supply Chain Management. Ilayisenisi esemtsetweni yokushayela imoto (ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubazekileyo). Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi ngoMthetho woLawulo lweMali kaRhulumente, (PFMA). I-PPPFA. Iirhulimenda zeTreasury. IiNgqinqo ze-SCM zeNasional nesiPhondo. Umthetho ophathwayo ofanelekileyo. Ulwazi lweenkqubo zokuQinisekisa ukuqhathwa nokurhweba ngcolu kwisebe likarhulumente. Amandla. Ukuba nokhondo lokulatha. Ikhono elokuguqula iimfuno zomthetho zibe ziinkqubo ezisebenzayo naziingozi ezibalulekileyo. Ukucinga ngeenkcukacha. Ukuba bulele kakhulu kwahlalutyo lwedata, ukuqaphela iimfuzisela ezibomvu nokutolika iimeko ezinzima zemigqabiso. Ukubhala imithetho. Ikhono lokubhala iingqinqo, iindaba ezijikelezayo nezimvo zomthetho kumacala e-SCM. Ulawulo lweentatho-nxaxheba. Ikhono elikhulu elokuzibandakanya nokuqonde uxineni kweengqukuva ezingaphezulu nabaphangi.
xh.duties: Phatha ukusebenza kweenkqubo zokuQaphela ukuzithoba kwi-SCM. Qhuba iinhlolozo ngeqaphelo ngezixhobo okanye ulinganise ikomiti yemigqabiso (iinkcukacha, ukulinganisa ukugqiba kwemigqabiso), ukunikezelwa kweentengiselwano, iindlela ezikro-ukutyhila, iindlela zokwandisa, kunye nemigqabiso yexeshu. Qaphela amasebe anikiwe ukuqinisekisa ukuba iinkqubo ze-SCM (uqeqesho, ukurhweba, ulawulo lweenkonzo, kunye nokulahla) zithobela uMthetho woLawulo lweMali kaRhulumente (PFMA). Iirhulimenda zeTreasury, i-PPPFA, nezinye izikhokelo ezifanelekileyo. Jonga ukuqinisekisa iingxelo zokuzithoba, ukuqinisekisa ukuchanekileyo, iimpawu ezingowamabali kwaye zihambelana neeRhulimenda zeTreasury nomthetho ofanelekileyo ophathwayo. Qaphela ukuze ulinganise inkqubo yokusebenza kwesixhobo sokuqaphela i-SCM. Fakela inkqubo yokuqaphela nokuhlalutya inkqubo yokusebenza kohlulo loLawulo lwe-SCM. Qaphela ukusebenza kunye nokuqhubela phambili kohlulo loLawulo lwe-SCM ngendwendwelo kweziko eznikiwe. Hlalutya idata uze uqokelele iingxelo ngohlalutyo lwesithobelo kumilinganiselo obekelwe i-SCM ebhalwe ngomthetho kwi: iinkquncede zemigqabiso ngenyanga kwaye ngamnyaka), iinkqubo zemigqabiso (iinkcukacha nendlela zemigqabiso), iimiqathango yeenkonzo, iinkalo zokulethwa kweziboneleli / abanikezeli besebenza, ukurhweba ngezinye iindlela kunye noshintsho kumazinga okurhweba. Phakamisa izihlaziyo kwiingqinqo ze-SCM zesiPhondo, iinkqubo ezisebenzayo (SOPs) neludwe lwezinto ezifanelekileyo eziboniswe ngezikhishi ezihlala kubakho izikhewu zokuzithoba ekuqaphelweni. Phatha ukusebenza kweenkqubo zokuYila amandla e-SCM / iinkqubo. Yakha uze unikeze iindululo ezichanekileyo zemfundo kwabaPraktisi be-SCM namaLungu eKomiti yeMigqabiso ngaphakathi kwamasebe anikiweyo. Qaphela uze uxhase ukusebenza kwe-CSD RFQ Functionality ngaphakathi kweziko ezinikiwe. Nceda amasebe anikiweyo ngeHlalutyo leziMbangi eziPhantsi zeMiba yamava e-SCM abo uze uqaphela ukusebenza kweNkqubo yoThyxoLwa lweMiba yawo. Lungqamanisa ukusebenza kokuLinganisa Iingozi ekuZithobeni kwi-SCM kwaye uqaphele (SCM CRAM). Linganisa iinqanaba ezixhaphakileyo nobungozi kwimeko yangoku yeNgozi ye-SCM yoZithobo esiPhondo. Qaphela iindawo ezingafuneka ziphuculwe. Yakha iinkquncede zokuphucula uze uqinisekise ukuba ziyasebenza ezi nkquncede.

jobs.reference_number: LPT/394 Directorate: Governance Monitoring and Compliance
jobs.title: Deputy Director: Governance Monitoring and Compliance
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 per annum (Level 11), (all-inclusive package which can be structured according to the individual’s needs as guided by the Department of Public Service and Administration (DPSA) prescripts)
jobs.closing_date_text: 18 September 2026 @ 16H00. Late applications will not be considered. Failure to comply with the above requirements will result in the disqualification of the application.
jobs.summary: Deputy Director for Governance Monitoring and Compliance at Limpopo Provincial Treasury, requiring an NQF 7 commerce qualification and five years relevant experience.
jobs.requirements: NQF level 7 qualification in Commerce / Accounting / Financial Management / Internal Auditing as recognized by SAQA. Five (5) years’ experience within the field of which three (3) years’ functional experience at junior managerial level / Assistant Director level in Governance, Monitoring & Compliance, or related field. Valid vehicle driver’s license (with exception of persons with disabilities). Knowledge & Skills: Planning, Coordinating, and organizing, Managerial functions, Secretarial functions, Projects Coordination. Finance. Compilation of reports. Research / analysing. Ability to operate Computer Software Programs (Word, Excel and PowerPoint). Standards/procedures. Needs and priorities of the Department. Competencies: Ability to interpret and apply Treasury Directives, PFMA and Treasury Regulations. Analytical and innovative thinking. Report writing and presentation. Leadership. Organizing. Project Management. Conflict Management. Financial Management. Strategic Management. Policy formulation. Adaptability during changes to meet the goals. Diversity Management. Minutes taking. Meeting Coordination. Communication Skills.
jobs.duties: Manage the implementation of compliance to norms, standards, policies and guideline. Facilitate the research and quality assure the drafted policies and guidelines for the province. Facilitate the process of drafting new policies and guidelines in terms of Section 18 of the PFMA. Identify cutting edge monitoring and evaluation methodologies to ensure effective monitoring of financial management. Manage compliance with the applicable legislation. Coordinate the process of issuing directives on the management of unwanted expenditure (irregular, fruitless and wasteful and unauthorized expenditures). Develop a reporting template, evaluation, advising and ensuring correct disclosure of the unwanted expenditure in the Financial Statement. Review audited AFS to confirm the unwanted expenditure identified by Audit General. Review irregular expenditure applications for condonement by IECC. Do follow ups on unwanted expenditures on quarterly. Draft IECC minutes and resolutions. Draft feedback letters to departments as per IECC recommendations. Facilitate listing/delisting of public entities (including subsidiaries) to National Treasury. Facilitate the review of governance compliance (Companies Act and King V) by Provincial Public Entities (including subsidiaries). Manage the attendance of Audit Steering Committees’ meetings to provide technical assistant to both Office of the Auditor General, Departments and Public Entities (including Subsidiaries).
