Assess 30 days payments in line with NT Instruction Note number 34. Provide support to governance and oversight structure. Audit Committees: Facilitate the appointment of Provincial Audit Committee by Provincial Executive Committee in terms of section 3.1 and 27.1 of Treasury Regulations. Facilitate logistical arrangements for Audit Committee and Provincial Technical Committee. Manage the availability of secretariat functions for governance forums. Receive and analyse reports from Provincial Legislature. SCOPA: Conduct monthly follow up with departments and public entities on the implementation of Scopa resolutions. Set up the meetings with the various stakeholders. Visits departments and public entities monthly to ensure the implementation of the resolutions. Provide assistance / technical advice on how to resolve some of the resolutions. Prepare the register for all the resolutions taken to be signed by both the departments and public entities and Treasury. Attend all SCOPA public hearings. Take minutes during the public hearings for support of draft resolutions. Review audited AFS of departments for correct disclosure of unauthorised expenditure. Motivate to Legislature whether identified unauthorised expenditure should be approved with funding or not. Upon the receipt of SCOPA resolutions inform the Legal Services (OTP) to draft Finance Bill. Manage provincial internal control framework. Develop and amend Provincial Internal Control Framework. Develop monitoring tool to monitor implementation of the Framework by Institutions. Facilitate review and amendment of the Provincial Internal Control Framework. Produce Provincial Report to inform Oversight structures about the status of Internal Control in the Institutions. Coordinate provincial forensic investigations in the province. Develop and amend Provincial Investigation Steering Framework for approval by the Committee. Serve as a Secretariat for the Provincial Investigation Steering Committee. Develop Terms of References as requested by the Investigation Steering Committee for Investigations. Liaise and provide support to Forensic Investigation Firms appointed. Follow-up with Institutions on implementation of Forensic Investigations Recommendations. Manage the sub-directorate’s resources in line with application legislation. Develop and review the Sub-Directorate’s plans. Manage performance of employees within the Sub-Directorate. Develop MOUS for supervisees and monitor implementation throughout the year. Motivate employees and ensure discipline within the Sub-Directorate. Ensure capacity and development of staff. Participate in the directorate’s budget planning processes and ensure proper utilization of resources in accordance with applicable prescripts. Ensure proper management and accountability for assets within the Sub-Directorate.
jobs.enquiries: Mesdames Elizba Kotze / B.P. Chaka / Conny Kgadima / K.H. Moremi / Mr. J.S. Nduli Tel No: (015) 298 7000
jobs.applications: Applicants may apply through the following website: https://erecruitment.limpopo.gov.za or Applicants should be submitted to: Director: Human Resource Management, Private Bag X 9486, Polokwane, 0700 OR Hand delivered to: ISMINI Towers Building, Office No. GOO2 (Ground Floor) Registry, 46 Hans van Ransburg Street, Polokwane, 0700. All General enquiries should be directed to Mesdames, Kotze Elizba, Chaka Pearl, Kgadima Conny, Moremi Hilda & Mr. Nduli J.S. Tel No: (015) 298 7000.
jobs.notes: The advert will be posted on the following websites www.limtreasury.gov.za / www.limpopo.gov.za and www.dpsa.gov.za and Provincial Departments social media Applications must be submitted on new Z83 forms obtainable from all Government Departments or can be downloaded from www.dpsa.gov.za or www.gov.za. The new Z83 form must be completed in manner that provides sufficient information about the candidate and the post he or she applies for by completing all relevant fields. The following must be considered in relation to the completion of the Z83 by applicants. All the fields in Part A, Part C and Part D should be completed. In Part B, all fields should be completed in full except the following: South African applicants need not to provide passport numbers. If an applicant responds “no” to the question “Are you conducting business with the State or are you a Director of a Public or Private Company conducting business with the State?” then the answer to the next question “In the event that you are employed in the Public Service, you immediately relinquish such business interests?” can be left blank or indicated as not applicable. A “not applicable” or blank response will be allowed on the question “If your profession or occupation requires official registration, provide date and particulars of registration”; if you are not in possession of such registration. Noting there is limited space provided for Part E, F & G, applicants often indicate “refer to Curriculum Vitae (CV) or see attached”, this is acceptable as long as the CV has been attached and provides the required information. If the information is not provided in the CV, the applicant may be disqualified. It must be noted that a CV is an extension of the application of employment Z83, and applicants are accountable for the information that is provided therein. Applicants currently employed by the public service do not need to complete Part F as the section is intended for those seeking re-employment, as their prior employment can be verified through their CV. The declaration should be completed and signed. Applicants must utilize the most recent Z83 application for employment form as issued by the Minister of Public Service and Administration in line with Regulation 10 of the Public Service Regulations, 2016, failure to do so results in disqualifications. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application but must submit the Z83 and detailed Curriculum Vitae. It must be noted that the CV is an extension of an application of an employment Z83, and applicants are accountable for the information that is provided therein. The Z83 form must be completed in the manner that allows the selection committee to assess the quality of the candidate based on the information that is contained in the form. The Department will require shortlisted candidates to provide certified copies of their qualifications and any other relevant document, which must be submitted to HR on or before the interview date. A specific reference number for the post applied for must be quoted in the space provided on the new form Z83. Applicants with foreign qualifications remain responsible for ensuring that their qualifications are evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) and therefore must submit the copies of certificates and evidence of evaluation by the SAQA for foreign qualification if they are invited to attend interviews. Successful incumbents will be expected to sign a performance agreement within one month after assumption of duty. All shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a security clearance and verification of qualifications. Shortlisted applicants will be required to provide their original qualification certificates and ID on the day of the interview for other relevant verification purposes. The recommended candidate will further be subjected to Personnel Suitability Checks, including financial disclosure requirements, social media screening, and other relevant verification processes. All successful candidates will be subjected to the applicable security clearance processes. All shortlisted candidates will be subjected to pre-entry assessments prior to the interview process. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts, will be subjected to a technical exercise and Interview. Following technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. To ensure that potential SMS members have a background on processes and procedures linked to the SMS, a further requirement for appointment at SMS level will be the successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-entry Programme (Nyukela) as endorsed by the National School of Government with effect from 1st April 2020. This is a Public Service specific training programme which will be applicable for appointments at SMS level. The link for the completion of the pre-entry certificate is as follows: www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme.           Individuals who have completed the course already, and who are therefore in possession of a certificate are welcome to submit such. However, all SMS short-listed candidates will be required to have completed certificate and submit such upon appointment. All shortlisted candidates for other posts shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only, due to the large number of applications we envisage to receive and if you have not heard from the Department within 90 days of the closing date, please accept that your application has been unsuccessful. However, should there be any dissatisfaction, applicants are hereby advised to, within 90 days, request reasons from the Department for any administrative action which has adversely affected them in terms of section 5, sub-section 1 and 2 of the Promotion of Administrative Justice Act 3 of 2000. The Department reserves the right not to make any appointment to the post advertised. The employment decision shall be informed by the Employment Equity Plan of the Department. NB! Candidates who applied before for the re-advertised vacant post are encouraged to re-apply. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Bestuursmonitering en Nakoming
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur vir Bestuursmonitering en Nakoming by Limpopo Provincial Treasury, wat 'n NQF 7 handelskwalifikasie en vyf jaar se relevante ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: NQF level 7 kwalifikasie in Handel / Rekeningkunde / Finansiële Bestuur / Interne Oudit soos erken deur SAQA. Five (5) jaar se ervaring binne die veld waarvan drie (3) jaar se funksionele ervaring op junior bestuursvlak / Assistentdirekteursvlak in Bestuur, Monitering en Nakoming, of verwante veld. Geldige bestuurslisensie vir voertuie (met uitsondering van persone met gestremdhede). Kennis en vaardighede: Beplanning, koördinering en organisering, bestuursfunksies, sekretariële funksies, projekkoördinatie. Finansies. Opstel van verslae. Navorsing / ontleding. Vermoë om rekenaarsagtewareprogramme te bedryf (Word, Excel en PowerPoint). Standaarde/prosedures. Behoeftes en prioriteite van die departement. Bevoegdhede: Vermoë om Tesourie-riglyne, PFMA en Tesourie-regulasies te interpreteer en toe te pas. Analitiese en innoverende denke. Verslagskrywing en voorlegging. Leierskap. Organisering. Projektebestuur. Konflikbestuur. Finansiële bestuur. Strategiese bestuur. Beleidformulering. Aanpasbaarheid tydens veranderinge om die doelwitte te bereik. Diversiteitsbestuur. Notule neem. Vergaderingkoördinatie. Kommunikasievaardighede.
af.duties: Bestuur die implementering van nakoming aan norme, standaarde, beleide en riglyne. Fasiliteer die navorsing en kwaliteitsversekering van die opgestelde beleide en riglyne vir die provinsie. Fasiliteer die proses van die opstel van nuwe beleide en riglyne ooreenkomstig Artikel 18 van die PFMA. Identifiseer ervaringsmonitering- en evaluasie-metodologieë om effektiewe monitering van finansiële bestuur te verseker. Bestuur nakoming met die toepaslike wetgewing. Koördineer die proses van die uitreik van riglyne oor die bestuur van ongewenste uitgawes (onreëlmatige, vrugtelose en vermorsende en ongemagtigde uitgawes). Ontwikkel 'n verslagsjabloon, evaluering, advies en verseker korrekte openbaarmaking van die ongewenste uitgawes in die Finansiële Staatsverslag. Hersien oudit-AFS om die ongewenste uitgawes wat deur die Ouditeur-Generaal geïdentifiseer is, te bevestig. Hersien onreëlmatige uitgawes-aansoeke omgoedkeuring deur IECC. Doen opvolgwerk oor ongewenste uitgawes op 'n kwartaallikse basis. Stel IECC-notule en besluite op. Stel terugvoerbriefies aan departemente op ooreenkomstig IECC-aanbevelings. Fasiliteer die lys/ontlys van openbare entiteite (insluitend filiale) by National Treasury. Fasiliteer die hersiening van bestuursnakoming (Companies Act en King V) deur Provinciale Openbare Entiteite (insluitend filiale). Bestuur die bywoning van Oudit-stuurgroepvergaderings om tegniese bystand te verskaf aan beide die Kantoor van die Ouditeur-Generaal, departemente en Openbare Entiteite (insluitend filiale). Assesseer 30-dae betalings in ooreenstemming met NT Instruksienota nommer 34. Verskaf ondersteuning aan bestuurs- en toesigstrukture. Ouditeerkomitees: Fasiliteer die aanstelling van die Provinciale Ouditeerkomitee deur die Provinciale Uitvoerende Komitee ooreenkomstig artikels 3.1 en 27.1 van die Tesourie-regulasies. Fasiliteer logistieke reëlings vir die Ouditeerkomitee en die Provinciale Tegniese Komitee. Bestuur die beskikbaarheid van sekretariële funksies vir bestuursforums. Ontvang en ontleed verslae van die Provinciale Wetgewer. SCOPA: Doen maandelikse opvolg met departemente en openbare entiteite oor die implementering van Scopa-besluite. Reël vergaderings met die verskeie belanghebbendes. Besoek departemente en openbare entiteite maandeliks om die implementering van die besluite te verseker. Verskaf bystand / tegniese advies oor hoe om sommige van die besluite op te los. Berei die register voor vir al die besluite wat geneem is om deur beide die departemente en openbare entiteite en Tesourie onderteken te word. Woon alle SCOPA-openbare verhore by. Neem notule tydens die openbare verhore ter ondersteuning van konsepsbesluite. Hersien oudit-AFS van departemente vir korrekte openbaarmaking van ongemagtigde uitgawes. Motiveer aan die Wetgewer of geïdentifiseerde ongemagtigde uitgawes met befondsing goedgekeur moet word of nie. Na ontvangs van SCOPA-besluite, stel die Regsdiens (OTP) in kennis om 'n Finansies-wetsontwerp op te stel. Bestuur die provinsiale interne beheerraamwerk. Ontwikkel en wysig die Provinciale Interne Beheerraamwerk. Ontwikkel 'n moniteringsinstrument om die implementering van die Raamwerk deur Instellings te monitor. Fasiliteer hersiening en wysiging van die Provinciale Interne Beheerraamwerk. Produseer 'n Provinciale Verslag om Toesigstrukture in te lig oor die status van Interne Beheer in die Instellings. Koördineer provinsiale forensiese ondersoeke in die provinsie. Ontwikkel en wysig die Provinciale Raamwerk vir Ondersoekstuurgroep vir goedkeuring deur die Komitee. Dien as Sekretariaat vir die Provinciale Ondersoekstuurgroepkomitee. Ontwikkel Terms of References soos versoek deur die Ondersoekstuurgroepkomitee vir Ondersoeke. Skakel en verskaf ondersteuning aan aangestelde Forensiese Ondersoekfirmas. Doen opvolg met Instellings oor die implementering van Forensiese Ondersoekaanbevelings. Bestuur die sub-direktoraat se hulpbronne in ooreenstemming met toepaslike wetgewing. Ontwikkel en hersien die sub-direktoraat se planne. Bestuur die prestasie van werknemers binne die sub-direktoraat. Ontwikkel MOUS vir toesighouers en monitor implementering deur die jaar. Motiveer werknemers en verseker dissipline binne die sub-direktoraat. Verseker kapasiteit en ontwikkeling van personeel. Neem deel aan die direktoraat se begrotingsbeplanningsprosesse en verseker behoorlike benutting van hulpbronne ooreenkomstig toepaslike voorskrifte. Verseker behoorlike bestuur en verantwoording vir bates binne die sub-direktoraat.

zu.title: Isikhulu Esiphezulu: Okuhloliwe Kokuphathwa Nokuhambisana Nemithetho
zu.summary: Isikhulu Esiphezulu Okuhloliwe Kokuphathwa Nokuhambisana Nemithetho e Limpopo Provincial Treasury, esidinga izifundo ze NQF 7 ezenzima kwezomnotho kanye neminyaka emihlanu yohluholelo oluhambisana nalokho.
zu.requirements: Isifundo sezinga le NQF 7 ezenzimboni / Ezezimali / Eziphathweni Kwezimali / Ekuhlolweni Kwangaphakathi njengokuqashelwa yi SAQA. Iminyaka emihlanu (5) yohluholelo enkombweni lapho kuthathwa iminyaka emithathu (3) yohluholelo olusebenzayo ezingeni lobaphathi abancane / izinga lomkhandlu ongumsizezela ekuphathweni, ekuhlolweni nasekuhambisweni nemithetho, noma enkombeni ehlobene. Ilayisensi evumelekile yokushayela isithuthi (ngaphandle kweziqu zezithandazana ezingenawo amandla). Ulwazi Namakhono: Ukulungiselela, Ukuhlanganisa, nokuhlela, Imisebenzi yobaphathi, Imisebenzi yomabhalane, Ukuhlanganiswa Kwemisebenzi. Izimali. Ukuhlanganiswa kwemibiko. Ukuphenya / ukuhlaziya. Ikhono lokusebenzisa izinhlelo zekhompyutha (Word, Excel kanye ne PowerPoint). Izindinganiso/izinqubo. Izidingo nezinto ebalulekile zoMnyango. Amakhono: Ikhono lokuhumusha nokusebenzisa Imiyalo ye Treasury, i PFMA kanye Nemithetho Yezimali. Ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya nokuba novusilela. Ukubhala imibiko nokuhethisa. Ukubusa. Ukuhlela. Ukuphathwa Kwemisebenzi. Ukuphathwa Kwezinkinga. Ukuphathwa Kwezimali. Ukuphathwa Ngokwenza izinqubo. Ukwenza inqubo. Ukuziqhelanisa ngesikhathi sezinguquko ukuze kufinyelelwe emigqeni. Ukuphathwa Kobunyuku. Ukubhala imizuzu. Ukuhlanganiswa kwemihlangano. Amakhono Okuxhumana.
zu.duties: Phatha ukusetshenziswa kokuhambisana nezindinganiso, izindlela, izinqobo nokuqondisa. Siza ukuphenya futhi uhlole izinga lemithetho nokuqondisa okubhaliwe esifundeni. Siza inqubo yokubhala imithetho nokuqondisa emisha ngokusho kwe Section 18 ye PFMA. Hlola izindlela ezingokwamanje zekuqaphela nokuhlola ukuze kuqiniseke ukuthi kugqamiswa ngokushesha ukuphathwa kwezimali. Phatha ukuhambisana nemithetho ephathwayo. Hlanganisa inqubo yokukhipha imiyalo ekuphathweni kwezimali ezingafuneki (ezingahambisana nemithetho, ezingatholi ntho, eziyihlazo kanye nezingagunyaziwe). Hlola izifaniso zemibiko, ukuhlola, ukweluleka futhi uqiniseke ukusabalalisa ngendlela efanele imali ezingafuneki esitatshini sezimali. Buyekeza i AFS ekuqoshiwe ukuze uqiniseke imali ezingafuneki etholiwe uMqashi Jikelele. Buyekeza izicelo zezimali ezingahambisana nemithetho zogunyazwe yi IECC. Landela imali ezingafuneki kwikota ngayinye. Bhala imizuzu kanye nezinqumogcwezo ze IECC. Bhala izikhalo zempendulo kumayunivesithi njengoba kunconyiwe yi IECC. Siza ukubhalisa/ukususa ebhalisini izikhungo zomphakathi (okuhlanganisa izinkampani ezincane) ku National Treasury. Siza ukubuyekeza ukuhambisana nokuphathwa (Companies Act kanye ne King V) kwezikhungo Zomphakathi Esifundeni (okuhlanganisa izinkampani ezincane). Phatha ukubakhona kwezikhungo Komhloli emphakathini ukuze kunikezwe usizo lwezobuchwepheshe kuwo womabili ihhovisi likaMqashi Jikelele, Omnyango nezikhungo Zomphakathi (okuhlanganisa izinkampani ezincane). Hlola ukukhokhwa kwamasuku angu 30 ngokusho komyalo we NT wonamba 34. Nikeza usizo ezakhiwo zokuphathwa nokuqaphela. Amakomidi Okuqapha: Siza ukubekwa kwebhodi yokuhlola esifundeni ngamakhomidi ePhethimndeni Esifundeni ngokusho kwezigaba 3.1 kanye ne 27.1 zemithetho Yezimali. Sela izinhlelo zokuhambisa izinto kumakomidi Okuhlola kanye nebhodi Yezobuchwepheshe Esifundeni. Phatha ukutholakala kwezinsiza zomabhalane kumafomumu okuphathwa. Thola futhi uhlaziye imibiko evela ePhikhamente Esifundeni. SCOPA: Yenza ukulandela nsuku zonke nangomnyaka nomaphakathi emnyangweni nasezikhungweni zomphakathi ekusetshenzisweni kwezinqumogcwezo ze Scopa. Hlela imihlangano nabaphikisana abahlukene. Vakasha emanyangweni nasezikhungweni zomphakathi njalo ngenyanga ukuze uqiniseke ukusetshenziswa kwezinqumogcwezo. Nikeza usizo / luleko lezobuchwepheshe ukuthi ungaxazulula kanjani ezinye zezinqumogcwezo. Lungiselela irejista yazo zonke izinqumogcwezo ezithathiwe ukuze zisayinwe womabili omnyango nezikhungo zomphakathi kanye ne Treasury. Hlanganyela kulo onke izinkululeko zomphakathi ze SCOPA. Bala imizuzu ngesikhathi kwezinkululeko zomphakathi ukuze useke izinqumogcwezo. Buyekeza i AFS ekuqoshiwe emanyangweni ngesabelo esifanele semali ezingagunyaziwe. Phakamisa ePhikhamente ukuthi imali ezingagunyaziwe ebonwayo idinga ukugunyazwa ngemali noma cha. Esikhathini sokwamukela izinqumogcwezo ze SCOPA yezwi kumasevisi Omutjhonjalo (OTP) ukuba abhale i Finance Bill. Phatha uhlaka lokulawula ngaphakathi esifundeni. Hlala futhi ulungise uhlaka Lokulawula Ngaphakathi Esifundeni. Hlala futhi ulungise isixhobo sokuqaphela ukuze sibe khona ukulawula ukusetshenziswa kohlaka Izikhungweni. Siza ukubuyekeza nokulungisa uhlaka Lokulawula Ngaphakathi Esifundeni. Hlola imibiko yesifunda ukwazisa izakhiwo Zokuqaphela ngesimo sokulawula ngaphakathi Ezikhungweni. Hlanganisa ukuphenya okujulile ngaphakathi esifundeni. Hlala futhi ulungise uhlaka Lokuqondisa Ukuphenya Esifundeni ukuze igunyazwe yikhomidi. Igcine njengomabhalane wekhomidi Lokuqondisa Ukuphenya Esifundeni. Hlala futhi ulungise izigaba Zokuqondisayo njengoba kuceliwe yikhomidi Lokuqondisana ezimphenyweni. Xhumana futhi unikeze usizo emakampanini Okuphenya okunjulile ababeke. Landela nezikhungo ngokusetshenziswa kwezinto eziconyiwe zeziphenyo. Phatha izinsiza zesibophana ngokusho kwemithetho ephathwayo. Hlala futhi ubuyekeze iplani zesibophana. Phatha ukusebenza kwabasebenzi ngaphakathi kwesibophana. Hlala imemorandamu yokuqondisana nabasizayo futhi ulawule ukusetshenziswa konyaka wonke. Khuthaza abasebenzi futhi uqiniseke inqubo esibopheni. Qinisekisa amandla kanye nentuthuko yabasebenzi. Hlanganyela ekwenzeni iplana zebhajethi Eqophelweni futhi uqiniseke ukusetshenziswa okufanele kwezinsiza ngokusho kwemiyalo ephathwayo. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa okufanele kanye nobuncwazi ngezimpahla ngaphakathi kwesibophana.

xh.title: Isekela Mongameli: Ukulawula ukuze kuhambelane noMthetho nokuqinisekisa
xh.summary: Isekela Mongameli woKulawula ukuze kuhambelane noMthetho nokuqinisekisa kwi-Limpopo Provincial Treasury, kufuneka afumane izifundo ze-NQF 7 kuno-Nkcitho kwaye aneminyaka emihlanu yamava ahambelana nesiithuba.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esingngowe-NQF level 7 kwi-Commerce / Accounting / Financial Management / Internal Audiding njengoko kubalwa yi-SAQA. Iimava zeminyaka emihlanu (5) kule ndawo, kwelipha elinye leminyaka emithathu (3) yemava esebenzayo kwinqanaba lokulawula elinganantsundi / elinganabini ko-Mongameli oNcedisayo ku-Governance, Monitoring & Compliance, okanye kwindawo enxulumene naleyondawo. Ilayiseni yokushayela (ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubazekileyo). Ulwazi & Amandla: Ulwakhiwo lomsebenzi, Ulungelelwaniso, kunye nokuhlela imisebenzi, Imisebenzi yabaphathi, Imisebenzi yomabhalane, Ulungelelwaniso lweephrojekthi. Izimali. Ukulungiselela iingxelo. Uphononongo / ukuhlalutya. Amandla okusebenzisa iinkqubo zeComputer Software Programs (Word, Excel, kunye ne-PowerPoint). Iziqendu / iinkqubo. Iimfuno noluhlu lokuqasha lwe-Department. Amandla: Amandla okutolika nokuqamba okutsha ngokuchanekileyo ngokweenkqubo zemali, ukuhombisa iingxelo nokuzibonakalisa. Ulawulo. Ukulungiselela. Ulawulo lweephrojekthi. Ulawulo looyakho. Ulawulo lwemali. Ulawulo olubanzi. Ukwenza iinkqubo nentsika. Ulungelelwaniso phakathi kweenkoloyi. Ulawulo lweentlanga. Ukubala ngamafutshane.
xh.duties: Lawula ukusebenza kolungelelwaniso noMthetho, iinkqubo nendlela ekulawulwa ngayo. Yenza iphononongo kwaye uqinisekise ulwazi kwinkqubo nengqiqo yesebe. Yaza kolwazi lwesiqu ulwazi lwe-Department kwilungu lesi-18 le-PFMA. Bala izinto ezincinci ezikulawula ukubakho kwemali ecaleni kolwazi lwe-Department. Lawula ukwenza kolungelelwaniso noMthetho. Lungiselela inkqubo yokubakho kolungelelwaniso phakathi kwabo bangesinye isigaba ngakumbi ngexesha elifutshane nengachanekanga. Hlela inkqubo yemali ekulawulwa ngayo i-Department ngokutshintsha imali kwixesha elithile. Balisisa i-Department ngezinto ezifunwa kubakho kolungelelwaniso phakathi kwabangasentla kunye nabalawuli besiqu sokubakho kolungelelwaniso. Bala inqobo efuna iimfuno ezahlukeneyo kwindawo yokulawula i-Department ekulawulweni kolungelelwaniso phakathi kwabangasentla. Qinisekisa ukuba ngokulungelelwanise ulungelelwaniso lomsebenzi wamagumbi baphila ebesakulungelelwanisa. Lawula ukusebenza kwe-Department kwaye uqinisekise ukuba zingangeni kwiinkqubo zokulungelelwanisa i-Department ngenxa yokungabi nakwamandla okulungelelwanisa ngokupheleleyo. Lungiselela inkqubo nentsika ngokulungelelwanisa iphulo elifuna amagunya abakho kulungelelwanisa i-Department. Yenza inkqubo yokulungelelwanisa imisebenzi ekulungelelwanise i-Department. Qinisekisa ukulungelelwanisa imisebenzi ekulungelelwanise i-Department ngendlela nentsika yokwenza kolungelelwanisa kwakhona. Qinisekisa ukuba inkqubo yokulungelelwanisa i-Department isebenza njengoko kuqinisekiswa yi-Department yokuLungelelwanisa i-Department. Yenza iindlela ezahlukeneyo ezikulungelelwanisa i-Department ngenkqubo nentsika. Balisisa ulungelelwaniso lwe-Department nentsika yoLungelelwaniso kwindawo nentsika esemazantsi e-Department. Beka imisebenzi kwinkqubo nentsika yokulungelelwanisa i-Department ukulungelelwanisa imisebenzi yamagumbi ayo ngokusemthethweni. Yenza inkqubo yokuqinisekisa ukulungelelwanisa i-Department. Qinisekisa ukuba ngokulungelelwanise ulungelelwaniso lomsebenzi wamagumbi baphila ebesakulungelelwanisa.

jobs.reference_number: LPT/395 Directorate: Governance Monitoring and Compliance
jobs.title: Deputy Director: Governance Monitoring and Compliance
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 per annum (Level 11), (all-inclusive package which can be structured according to the individual’s needs as guided by the Department of Public Service and Administration (DPSA) prescripts)
jobs.closing_date_text: 18 September 2026 @ 16H00. Late applications will not be considered. Failure to comply with the above requirements will result in the disqualification of the application.
jobs.summary: Deputy Director: Governance Monitoring and Compliance at Limpopo Provincial Treasury, requiring an NQF 7 qualification and five years of relevant finance or auditing experience.
jobs.requirements: NQF level 7 qualification in Commerce / Accounting / Financial Management / Internal Auditing or related field as recognized by SAQA. Five (5) years’ experience within the field of which three (3) years’ functional experience at junior managerial level / Assistant Director level in Governance / Compliance / Internal Control / Finance / Auditing Environment (External & Internal Audit) or related field. Valid vehicle driver’s license (with exception of persons with disabilities). Knowledge & Skills: Planning, Coordinating, and organizing, Managerial functions, Secretarial functions, Projects Coordination. Finance. Compilation of reports. Research / analysing. Computer software programs (word, excel and power point). Standards/procedures. Needs and priorities of the Department. Competencies: Ability to interpret and apply Treasury Directives, PFMA and Treasury Regulations. Analytical and innovative thinking. Report writing. Workshop presentation and facilitation. Ability to operate computer. Leadership. Organizing. Project Management. Conflict Management. Financial Management. Strategic Management. Policy formulation. Adaptability during changes to meet the goals. Diversity Management. Minutes taking. Meeting Coordination. Communication Skills.
jobs.duties: Monitor implementation of action plan on auditor general audit findings by public entities. Coordinate and monitor consistent application of the Action Plan Template by Public Entities. Coordinate workshops and information sharing session with all Public Entities to ensure common understanding of the Action Plan Template on the implementation of Auditor General Audit Findings. Coordinate and monitor implementation of AG Audit findings through Action Plan by Public Entities. Analyse progress report for oversight structures on the implementation of AG Action Plans, House or SCOPA Resolutions, Unwanted Expenditures and Internal audit Findings. Analyse the Action Plan populated template with AG Audit findings from Public Entities and recommend corrective measures where necessary. Meet with Public Entities Action Plan Coordinators on a quarterly basis to discuss compliance outcomes. Attend Audit Committees and Audit Steering Committee meetings to discuss audit issues and other transversal matters. Identify innovative monitoring and evaluation methodologies to ensure effective monitoring of financial management. Manage compliance with the applicable legislation. Analyse and monitor the application of the PFMA and Treasury Regulations Compliance checklists / Template. Attend Audit and Risk Committee Meetings of Public Entities to track compliance universe. Coordinate workshops and information sharing session with all public entities to ensure common understanding of the PFMA compliance template, companies ACT, King III and other relevant policies. Coordinate and monitor PFMA compliance by public entities through sending compliance template and receive feedback from entities on a quarterly basis. Analyse PFMA populated template with information from public entities and recommend corrective measures where necessary. Meet with entities PFMA compliance coordinators on a quarterly basis to discuss compliance outcomes. Develop a reporting template, evaluation, advising and ensuring correct disclosure of the unwanted expenditure in the financial statements. Facilitate listing/delisting of public entities (including subsidiaries) to National Treasury. Facilitate the review of governance compliance (Companies Act and King V) by Provincial Public Entities (including Subsidiaries). Manage the attendance of Audit Steering Committees’ meetings to provide technical assistant to both Office of the Auditor General, Departments and Public Entities (including Subsidiaries). Develop template for reporting on implementation of corrective action emanating from exceptions reported by Office of the Auditor General. Provide support to governance and oversight structure. Coordinate and monitor the functioning of oversight structures such as Audit & Risk Committees and Audit Steering Committees within Public Entities. Ensure the existence of the Central Inter-Departmental Remunerative Committee for Public Entities. Coordinate and monitor the development of Annual Schedule for Central Inter Departmental Remunerative Committee and make sure it is aligned with the Provincial Corporate Calendar. Obtain annual schedules for Audit Committees and Audit Steering Committee meetings for Public Entities. Attend and provide support to Public Entities Audit Committee as well as Audit Steering Committee meetings. Provide secretariat services to the Central Inter- Departmental Remunerative Committee. Facilitate the appointment of Provincial Audit Committee by Provincial Executive Committee in terms of section 3.1 of Treasury Regulations. Conduct analysis on delegation of authority. Coordinate and monitor the implementation of SCOPA or House Resolutions. Attend SCOPA meetings with the relevant Public Entity as and when required. Coordinate and monitor the implementation of all investigations including Forensic Investigation and report to Oversight Structures. Coordinate and monitor the delegation of authority template by public entities. Coordinate and monitor implementation delegation of authority by Public Entities. Analyse progress report for oversight structures on the implementation of delegation of authority by Public Entities. Meet with Public Entities Action Plan Coordinators on a quarterly basis to discuss compliance outcomes.
jobs.enquiries: Mesdames Elizba Kotze / B.P. Chaka / Conny Kgadima / K.H. Moremi / Mr. J.S. Nduli Tel No: (015) 298 7000
jobs.applications: Applicants may apply through the following website: https://erecruitment.limpopo.gov.za or Applicants should be submitted to: Director: Human Resource Management, Private Bag X 9486, Polokwane, 0700 OR Hand delivered to: ISMINI Towers Building, Office No. GOO2 (Ground Floor) Registry, 46 Hans van Ransburg Street, Polokwane, 0700. All General enquiries should be directed to Mesdames, Kotze Elizba, Chaka Pearl, Kgadima Conny, Moremi Hilda & Mr. Nduli J.S. Tel No: (015) 298 7000.
jobs.notes: The advert will be posted on the following websites www.limtreasury.gov.za / www.limpopo.gov.za and www.dpsa.gov.za and Provincial Departments social media Applications must be submitted on new Z83 forms obtainable from all Government Departments or can be downloaded from www.dpsa.gov.za or www.gov.za. The new Z83 form must be completed in manner that provides sufficient information about the candidate and the post he or she applies for by completing all relevant fields. The following must be considered in relation to the completion of the Z83 by applicants. All the fields in Part A, Part C and Part D should be completed. In Part B, all fields should be completed in full except the following: South African applicants need not to provide passport numbers. If an applicant responds “no” to the question “Are you conducting business with the State or are you a Director of a Public or Private Company conducting business with the State?” then the answer to the next question “In the event that you are employed in the Public Service, you immediately relinquish such business interests?” can be left blank or indicated as not applicable. A “not applicable” or blank response will be allowed on the question “If your profession or occupation requires official registration, provide date and particulars of registration”; if you are not in possession of such registration. Noting there is limited space provided for Part E, F & G, applicants often indicate “refer to Curriculum Vitae (CV) or see attached”, this is acceptable as long as the CV has been attached and provides the required information. If the information is not provided in the CV, the applicant may be disqualified. It must be noted that a CV is an extension of the application of employment Z83, and applicants are accountable for the information that is provided therein. Applicants currently employed by the public service do not need to complete Part F as the section is intended for those seeking re-employment, as their prior employment can be verified through their CV. The declaration should be completed and signed. Applicants must utilize the most recent Z83 application for employment form as issued by the Minister of Public Service and Administration in line with Regulation 10 of the Public Service Regulations, 2016, failure to do so results in disqualifications. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application but must submit the Z83 and detailed Curriculum Vitae. It must be noted that the CV is an extension of an application of an employment Z83, and applicants are accountable for the information that is provided therein. The Z83 form must be completed in the manner that allows the selection committee to assess the quality of the candidate based on the information that is contained in the form. The Department will require shortlisted candidates to provide certified copies of their qualifications and any other relevant document, which must be submitted to HR on or before the interview date. A specific reference number for the post applied for must be quoted in the space provided on the new form Z83. Applicants with foreign qualifications remain responsible for ensuring that their qualifications are evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) and therefore must submit the copies of certificates and evidence of evaluation by the SAQA for foreign qualification if they are invited to attend interviews. Successful incumbents will be expected to sign a performance agreement within one month after assumption of duty. All shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a security clearance and verification of qualifications. Shortlisted applicants will be required to provide their original qualification certificates and ID on the day of the interview for other relevant verification purposes. The recommended candidate will further be subjected to Personnel Suitability Checks, including financial disclosure requirements, social media screening, and other relevant verification processes. All successful candidates will be subjected to the applicable security clearance processes. All shortlisted candidates will be subjected to pre-entry assessments prior to the interview process. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts, will be subjected to a technical exercise and Interview. Following technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. To ensure that potential SMS members have a background on processes and procedures linked to the SMS, a further requirement for appointment at SMS level will be the successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-entry Programme (Nyukela) as endorsed by the National School of Government with effect from 1st April 2020. This is a Public Service specific training programme which will be applicable for appointments at SMS level. The link for the completion of the pre-entry certificate is as follows: www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme.           Individuals who have completed the course already, and who are therefore in possession of a certificate are welcome to submit such. However, all SMS short-listed candidates will be required to have completed certificate and submit such upon appointment. All shortlisted candidates for other posts shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only, due to the large number of applications we envisage to receive and if you have not heard from the Department within 90 days of the closing date, please accept that your application has been unsuccessful. However, should there be any dissatisfaction, applicants are hereby advised to, within 90 days, request reasons from the Department for any administrative action which has adversely affected them in terms of section 5, sub-section 1 and 2 of the Promotion of Administrative Justice Act 3 of 2000. The Department reserves the right not to make any appointment to the post advertised. The employment decision shall be informed by the Employment Equity Plan of the Department. NB! Candidates who applied before for the re-advertised vacant post are encouraged to re-apply. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Bestuursmonitering en Nakoming
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur: Bestuursmonitering en Nakoming by Limpopo Provincial Treasury, wat 'n NQF 7-kwalifikasie en vyf jaar se relevante ervaring in finansies of ouditering vereis.
af.requirements: NQF vlak 7 kwalifikasie in Handel / Rekenkunde / Finansiële Bestuur / Interne Ouditering of verwante veld soos deur SAQA erken. Vyf (5) jaar se ervaring binne die veld waarvan drie (3) jaar se funksionele ervaring op junior bestuursvlak / Assistentdirekteursvlak in Bestuursmonitering / Nakoming / Interne Beheer / Finansies / Ouditeeromgewing (Eksterne & Interne Oudit) of verwante veld. Geldige bestuurslisensie vir voertuie (met uitsondering van persone met gestremdhede). Kennis & Vaardighede: Beplanning, koördinering en organisering, bestuursfunksies, sekretariële funksies, projekkoördinering. Finansies. Opstel van verslae. Navorsing / analise. Rekenaarsagtewareprogramme (word, excel en power point). Standaarde/prosedures. Behoeftes en prioriteite van die departement. Bevoegdhede: Vermoë om Tesourie-riglyne, PFMA en Tesourie-regulasies te interpreteer en toe te pas. Analitiese en innoverende denke. Verslagskrywing. Werkswinkel-aanbieding en fasilitering. Vermoë om rekenaar te bedien. Leierskap. Organisering. Projektebestuur. Konflikbestuur. Finansiële bestuur. Strategiese bestuur. Beleidsformulering. Aanpasbaarheid tydens veranderinge om doelwitte te bereik. Diversiteitsbestuur. Notule neem. Vergaderingskoördinering. Kommunikasievaardighede.
af.duties: Monitor implementering van aksieplan oor ouditeur-generaal se ouditbevindings deur publieke entiteite. Koördineer en monitor konsekwente toepassing van die Aksieplan-sjabloon deur Publieke Entiteite. Koördineer werkswinkels en inligtingsdelingsessies met alle Publieke Entiteite om algemene begrip van die Aksieplan-sjabloon oor die implementering van Ouditeur-generaal se Ouditbevindings te verseker. Koördineer en monitor implementering van OG-ouditbevindings deur Aksieplan deur Publieke Entiteite. Analiseer vorderingsverslag vir toesigstrukture oor die implementering van OG-aksieplanne, Huis- of SCOPA-resolusies, ongewenste uitgawes en interne ouditbevindings. Analiseer die Aksieplan ingevulde sjabloon met OG-ouditbevindings van Publieke Entiteite en beveel korrektiewe maatreëls aan waar nodig. Ontmoet Publieke Entiteite se Aksieplan-koördineerders op 'n kwartaallikse basis om nakomingsuitkomste te bespreek. Woon Ouditkomitees en Ouditstuurkomitee-vergaderings by om ouditkwessies en ander dwarslopende aangeleenthede te bespreek. Identifiseer innoverende moniterings- en evalueringsmetodologieë om effektiewe monitering van finansiële bestuur te verseker. Bestuur nakoming met die toepaslike wetgewing. Analiseer en monitor die toepassing van die PFMA en Tesourie-regulasies se nakomingskontrolelyste / sjabloon. Woon Oudit- en Risikokomitee-vergaderings van Publieke Entiteite by om nakomingsheelal na te spoor. Koördineer werkswinkels en inligtingsdelingsessies met alle publieke entiteite om algemene begrip van die PFMA-nakomingsjabloon, Maatskappye-wet, King III en ander relevante beleide te verseker. Koördineer en monitor PFMA-nakoming deur publieke entiteite deur stuur van nakomingsjabloon en ontvang terugvoer van entiteite op 'n kwartaallikse basis. Analiseer PFMA ingevulde sjabloon met inligting van publieke entiteite en beveel korrektiewe maatreëls aan waar nodig. Ontmoet entiteite se PFMA-nakomingskoördineerders op 'n kwartaallikse basis om nakomingsuitkomste te bespreek. Ontwikkel 'n verslagsjabloon, evaluering, advisering en verseker korrekte bekendmaking van die ongewenste uitgawe in die finansiële state. Fasiliteer lysing/ontlysing van publieke entiteite (insluitend filiale) by Nasionale Tesourie. Fasiliteer die hersiening van bestuursnakoming (Maatskappye-wet en King V) deur Provinciale Publieke Entiteite (insluitend Filiale). Bestuur bywoning van Ouditstuurkomitee-vergaderings om tegniese bystand te verleen aan beide die Kantoor van die Ouditeur-generaal, departemente en Publieke Entiteite (insluitend Filiale). Ontwikkel sjabloon vir verslagdoening oor implementering van korrektiewe aksie voortspruitend uit uitsonderings gerapporteer deur die Kantoor van die Ouditeur-generaal. Verskaf ondersteuning aan bestuurs- en toesigstruktuur. Koördineer en monitor die funksionering van toesigstrukture soos Oudit- & Risikokomitees en Ouditstuurkomitees binne Publieke Entiteite. Verseker die bestaan van die Sentrale Interdepartementale Remuneratiewe Komitee vir Publieke Entiteite. Koördineer en monitor die ontwikkeling van Jaarlikse Skedule vir Sentrale Interdepartementale Remuneratiewe Komitee en maak seker dit is in lyn met die Provinciale Korporatiewe Kalender. Verkry jaarlikse skedules vir Ouditkomitees en Ouditstuurkomitee-vergaderings vir Publieke Entiteite. Woon by en verskaf ondersteuning aan Publieke Entiteite se Ouditkomitee asook Ouditstuurkomitee-vergaderings. Verskaf sekretariaatsdienste aan die Sentrale Interdepartementale Remuneratiewe Komitee. Fasiliteer die aanstelling van Provinciale Ouditkomitee deur Provinciale Uitvoerende Komitee ooreenkomstig artikel 3.1 van Tesourie-regulasies. Voer analise uit oor delegasie van gesag. Koördineer en monitor die implementering van SCOPA- of Huis-resolusies. Woon SCOPA-vergaderings by met die relevante Publieke Entiteit soos wanneer nodig. Koördineer en monitor die implementering van alle ondersoeke insluitend Forensiese Ondersoek en rapporteer aan Toesigstrukture. Koördineer en monitor die delegasie van gesag-sjabloon deur publieke entiteite. Koördineer en monitor implementering van delegasie van gesag deur Publieke Entiteite. Analiseer vorderingsverslag vir toesigstrukture oor die implementering van delegasie van gesag deur Publieke Entiteite. Ontmoet Publieke Entiteite se Aksieplan-koördineerders op 'n kwartaallikse basis om nakomingsuitkomste te bespreek.

zu.title: Onxandeleli Wezinja: Ukubukwa Komthelela Wokuphathwa Nokuziphendisela
zu.summary: Onxandeleli Wezinja: Ukubukwa Komthelela Wokuphathwa Nokuziphendisela eLimpopo Provincial Treasury, edinga izifundo ze-NQF 7 nanamuhla eminye emihlanu yemisebenzi ehambisana nezimali noma ukuhlola.
zu.requirements: Isifundo esingalinyanga i-NQF level 7 ku-Commerce / Accounting / Financial Management / Internal Auditing noma enye indawo ehambisanayo njengokuqashwa yi-SAQA. Five (5) years’ experience within the field of which three (3) years’ functional experience at junior managerial level / Assistant Director level in Governance / Compliance / Internal Control / Finance / Auditing Environment (External & Internal Audit) or related field. Valid vehicle driver’s license (with exception of persons with disabilities). Knowledge & Skills: Planning, Coordinating, and organizing, Managerial functions, Secretarial functions, Projects Coordination. Finance. Compilation of reports. Research / analysing. Computer software programs (word, excel and power point). Standards/procedures. Needs and priorities of the Department. Competencies: Ability to interpret and apply Treasury Directives, PFMA and Treasury Regulations. Analytical and innovative thinking. Report writing. Workshop presentation and facilitation. Ability to operate computer. Leadership. Organizing. Project Management. Conflict Management. Financial Management. Strategic Management. Policy formulation. Adaptability during changes to meet the goals. Diversity Management. Minutes taking. Meeting Coordination. Communication Skills.
zu.duties: Monitor implementation of action plan on auditor general audit findings by public entities. Coordinate and monitor consistent application of the Action Plan Template by Public Entities. Coordinate workshops and information sharing session with all Public Entities to ensure common understanding of the Action Plan Template on the implementation of Auditor General Audit Findings. Coordinate and monitor implementation of AG Audit findings through Action Plan by Public Entities. Analyse progress report for oversight structures on the implementation of AG Action Plans, House or SCOPA Resolutions, Unwanted Expenditures and Internal audit Findings. Analyse the Action Plan populated template with AG Audit findings from Public Entities and recommend corrective measures where necessary. Meet with Public Entities Action Plan Coordinators on a quarterly basis to discuss compliance outcomes. Attend Audit Committees and Audit Steering Committee meetings to discuss audit issues and other transversal matters. Identify innovative monitoring and evaluation methodologies to ensure effective monitoring of financial management. Manage compliance with the applicable legislation. Analyse and monitor the application of the PFMA and Treasury Regulations Compliance checklists / Template. Attend Audit and Risk Committee Meetings of Public Entities to track compliance universe. Coordinate workshops and information sharing session with all public entities to ensure common understanding of the PFMA compliance template, companies ACT, King III and other relevant policies. Coordinate and monitor PFMA compliance by public entities through sending compliance template and receive feedback from entities on a quarterly basis. Analyse PFMA populated template with information from public entities and recommend corrective measures where necessary. Meet with entities PFMA compliance coordinators on a quarterly basis to discuss compliance outcomes. Develop a reporting template, evaluation, advising and ensuring correct disclosure of the unwanted expenditure in the financial statements. Facilitate listing/delisting of public entities (including subsidiaries) to National Treasury. Facilitate the review of governance compliance (Companies Act and King V) by Provincial Public Entities (including Subsidiaries). Manage the attendance of Audit Steering Committees’ meetings to provide technical assistant to both Office of the Auditor General, Departments and Public Entities (including Subsidiaries). Develop template for reporting on implementation of corrective action emanating from exceptions reported by Office of the Auditor General. Provide support to governance and oversight structure. Coordinate and monitor the functioning of oversight structures such as Audit & Risk Committees and Audit Steering Committees within Public Entities. Ensure the existence of the Central Inter-Departmental Remunerative Committee for Public Entities. Coordinate and monitor the development of Annual Schedule for Central Inter Departmental Remunerative Committee and make sure it is aligned with the Provincial Corporate Calendar. Obtain annual schedules for Audit Committees and Audit Steering Committee meetings for Public Entities. Attend and provide support to Public Entities Audit Committee as well as Audit Steering Committee meetings. Provide secretariat services to the Central Inter- Departmental Remunerative Committee. Facilitate the appointment of Provincial Audit Committee by Provincial Executive Committee in terms of section 3.1 of Treasury Regulations. Conduct analysis on delegation of authority. Coordinate and monitor the implementation of SCOPA or House Resolutions. Attend SCOPA meetings with the relevant Public Entity as and when required. Coordinate and monitor the implementation of all investigations including Forensic Investigation and report to Oversight Structures. Coordinate and monitor the delegation of authority template by public entities. Coordinate and monitor implementation delegation of authority by Public Entities. Analyse progress report for oversight structures on the implementation of delegation of authority by Public Entities. Meet with Public Entities Action Plan Coordinators on a quarterly basis to discuss compliance outcomes.

xh.title: Isekela Mongameli: Ukumila kokuLawula nokuLandelana
xh.summary: Isekela Mongameli: Ukumila kokuLawula nokuLandelana kwiLiphalantshe leMali yaseLimpopo, lifuna izifundo zeNQF 7 kwaye liphangale iminyaka emihlanu yamava ohambweni lwezimali okanye uluvo lwezimali.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esingangunqamlezo weNQF level 7 kwiNtengiso / ukuBalwa kwezimali / ukuLawulwa kwezimali / ukuQwalasela ngaphakathi okanye indawo enxulumene nayo njengokuqatshelwa yiSAQA. Iiminyaka elishumi (5) hamva ngaphakathi kwendawo leyo, apho kwakukho iminyaka emithathu (3) yamava asebenzayo kwinqanaba lobaphathi abasezantsi / inqanaba loMphathi oNcedisayo kokuLawula / ukuLandelana / ukuLawulwa ngaphakathi / iMali / uluvo lwezimali (oluNgaphandle & oluNgaphakathi) okanye indawo enxulumene nayo. Ilayisenisi yomqhubi wesithuthi esiyasebenza (ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubekile). Ulwazi & amakhono: uCocozo, ukuHlanganisa, nokuCwangcisa, imisebenzi yabalawuli, imisebenzi yababhalisi bahlela amagama, ukuHlanganisa iiprojekthi. iMali. ukuHlelwa kweengxelo. uPhando / ukuhlaziya. Iinkqubo zesoftware zekhompyutha (word, excel and power point). Izingqikelelo/iindlela zokuZenzisa. Iimfuno neenqanaba ezibalulekileyo zesebe. Ikhono: Ikhono lokutolika nokuSebenzisa iNgqungquthela zeNdlu yeeMali, iPFMA neMithetho yeNdlu yeeMali. Ukucinga okuhlaziyiweyo nokutsha. ukuBhala iingxelo. ukubonisa kwaye kuqokelelwe iindibaniselo. Ikhono lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. ukuBusa. ukuCwangcisa. ukuLawula iiprojekthi. ukuLawula iingxabano. ukuLawulwa kweMali. ukuLawulwa ngokutsha. ukuMiselwa kwezithetho. ukuzigqatsa ngexesha lezatshintsho ukuze kugqitywe iinjongo. ukuLawulwa kobuninzi. ukuthabatha imizuzu yemiQqubo. ukuHlanganisa iindibano. amakhono oNxibelelwano.
xh.duties: Qwalasela ukuSetenziswa kwejongo lokwenza izinto ngokusetyenziswa kwemiQqubo ngokwemiba eluvwe ngumMeli jikelele wokuQwalasela ngamagatya abantu balawula. Hlanganisa uze uqwalasele ukusetyenziswa ngokungatshintshiyo kwesakhelo seJongo lokwenza izinto ngumuntu ogunyaziweyo. Hlanganisa iindibano zokuqeqesha nokuvelana nolwazi nabo bonke abantu abalawula ukuze kuqikelelwe ngokufanayisana kokusetyenziswa kwesakhelo seJongo lokwenza izinto ekusebenziseni imiba eluvwe ngumMeli jikelele wokuQwalasela. Hlanganisa uze uqwalasele ukusetenziswa kwemiba eluvwe ngumMeli jikelele wokuQwalasela ngokwejongo lokwenza izinto ngabantu abalawula. Hlaziya ingxelo yaphambili yezakhiwo ezijonge ekusetenzisweni kweejongo zokuSetenziswa ezisetyenziswe ngumMeli jikelele wokuQwalasela, iNgqungquthela okanye izigqibo zeSCOPA, iindleko ezingafunekiyo nokuQwalasela imiba engaphakathi. Hlaziya isakhelo seJongo lokwenza izinto esigqitywe ngemiba eluvwe ngumMeli jikelele wokuQwalasela ethunyelwa ngabantu abalawula uze ucele ukulungiswa apho kunesidingeko. Qhube imini yonke unyaka iindibano namaqela ejongo lokwenza izinto ngabantu abalawula ukuxoxwa ngemveliso yolandelano. Zibophelele kwindibano yeKomiti yokuQwalasela neluQokelelo lokuQwalasela ukuxoxwa ngemiba yokuqwalasela nolunye ulwazi oluvela kuzo zonke iindawo. Balula iindlela ezitsha zokuqwalasela nokuqokelela ulwazi ukuze kuqiniseke ukumila okusebenzayo kokulawulwa kwezimali. Lawula ukulandelana ngemithetho esetyenziswayo. Hlaziya uze uqwalasele ukusetenziswa kwePFMA neMithetho yeNdlu yeeMali ekulandelweni koluhlu lwemiba / isakhelo. Zibophelele kwindibano yeKomiti yokuQwalasela nengozi zabantu abalawula ukulandela ulawu lolandelano. Hlanganisa iindibano zokuqeqesha nokuvelana nolwazi nabantu bonke abalawula ukuze kuqikelelwe ngokufanayisana kwesakhelo solandelano lwePFMA, umThetho weeKampani, iKing III nolunye ulwazi olubalulekileyo. Hlanganisa uze uqwalasele ukulandelana kwePFMA ngabantu abalawula ngokuthumela isakhelo solandelano nokuRhuncwa ulwazi kumagatya ngemini zonke unyaka. Hlaziya isakhelo sePFMA esigqitywe ngolwazi oluthunyelwe ngabantu abalawula uze ucele ukulungiswa apho kunesidingeko. Qhube imini yonke unyaka iindibano namaqela alawula ukulandelana kwePFMA ukuxoxwa ngemveliso yolandelano. Yakha isakhelo singxelo, ukuqokelela ulwazi, ukwelisa nokuqinisekisa ukuchazwa ngokuchanekileyo kwendleko ezingafunekiyo kwizatamenti zezimali. Khokelisa ukubhalwa / ukususwa kwabagunyaziswa kuluhlu (kuquka nengxenye) kwiNdlu yeeMali yeSizwe. Khokelisa ukuhlaziywa kokulandelana kolawu (umThetho weeKampani neKing V) ngamagatya angunyaziweyo okuLawula (kuquka nezinxulumene nabo). Lawula ukuzibophelela kwabagunyaziweyo windibano zeKomiti yokuQwalasela yokunika uncedo ongummandla kuwo omnye iOfisi yomMeli jikelele wokuQwalasela, oonCamu nabantu abalawula (kuquka nezinxulumene nabo). Yakha isakhelo sokuvakalisa ngokusetyenziswa kolungiso olusuka kwimiba evakalishiwe yiOfisi yomMeli jikelele wokuQwalasela. Nikeza inkxaso ezakhiweni zolawu noqondiso. Hlanganisa uze uqwalasele ukusebenza kwakho konke okuqondisayo njengeKomiti yokuQwalasela nengozi kumagatya abantu abalawula. Qinisekisa ukuba khona koKomiti yokuLawula ngokuhlawula abantu boNqanaba ePhakathi phakathi kwamaSebe abantu abalawula. Hlanganisa uze uqwalasele ukwakhiwa kwejongo lemihla yonke unyaka leKomiti yokuLawula ngokuhlawula abantu abanqamla phakathi kwamaSebe uze uqinisekise ukuba ihambisana neKhalenda yeKampani yasePhondo. Thatha iindlela zemihla yonke unyaka zindibano zeKomiti yokuQwalasela nengozi yamagatya abantu abalawula. Zibophelele uze unike inkxabo kumagatya eKomiti yokuQwalasela yalawu kwaye indibano zeKomiti yokunika isikhokelo. Nikeza iinkonzo zababhalisi bahlela amagama koKomiti yokuLawula ngokuhlawula abantu abanqamla phakathi kwamaSebe. Khokelisa ukubekwa koKomiti yokuQwalasela yasePhondo nguKomiti yokuQaliswa yasePhondo njengoko kuchazwe kumGqatswana 3.1 weMithetho yeNdlu yeeMali. Yenza uhlalutyo kwimandla anikiweyo. Hlanganisa uze uqwalasele ukusetenziswa kwezigqibo zeSCOPA okanye iNgqungquthela. Zibophelele kwindibano zeSCOPA nelinye igatya elithile lawulo xa kunesidingeko. Hlanganisa uze uqwalasele ukusetenziswa kwesiphithiphithi konke uphando kuquka noPhando lwezifundo ezingakanani kwaye uvakalise ezakhiweni eziphila ngokulawula nokuqondisa. Hlanganisa uze uqwalasele isakhelo samandla anikiweyo ngabagunyaziweyo. Hlanganisa uze uqwalasele ukusetyenziswa kwamandla anikiweyo ngabagunyaziweyo. Hlaziya ingxelo yaphambili yezakhiwo ezijonge ekusetenzisweni kwamandla anikiweyo ngabagunyaziweyo. Qhube imini yonke unyaka iindibano namaqela abalawula ngeejonga zokubakho ukulandelana ngemigaqo ekulandelweni kokwenza izinto.

jobs.reference_number: LPT/424 Directorate: Financial Management Capacity Building
jobs.title: Deputy Director: Financial Management Capacity Building
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 per annum (Level 11), (all-inclusive package which can be structured according to the individual’s needs as guided by the Department of Public Service and Administration (DPSA) prescripts)
jobs.closing_date_text: 18 September 2026 @ 16H00. Late applications will not be considered. Failure to comply with the above requirements will result in the disqualification of the application.
jobs.summary: Deputy Director for Financial Management Capacity Building at Limpopo Provincial Treasury, responsible for conducting and managing PERSAL training across the province.
jobs.requirements: NQF level 7 qualification in Financial Management / Public Finance as recognized by SAQA. Five (5) years’ experience within the field of which three (3) years’ experience at junior managerial level / Assistant Director level in Financial Management / Financial Systems Training Environment. Valid vehicle driver’s license (with exception of persons with disabilities). Knowledge & Skills: Knowledge of variety of work ranges, procedures, and legislative frameworks as, Public Finance Management Act, (PFMA). Treasury Regulations. Public Service Act. Public Service Regulations. Batho Pele Principles. Personnel and Salary Administration System (PERSAL). Ability to operate a computer. Organising. Adaptability during changes to meet the goals. Innovation and problem solving.
jobs.duties: Conduct and manage PERSAL Training in Limpopo Province. Conduct Quality assurance during Regional Training. Report back on training observations. Analyse and evaluate questionnaires (course and trainer), compile course reports and submit to Director: Financial Management Capacity Building. Compile reports (course, monthly, quarterly) and submit to Director. Clarify Financial systems training related information with subordinates as and when needed. Manage financial systems training at National Treasury for courses not offered in Limpopo Province. Attend various Financial Management System forums. Develop PERSAL Provincial Training Schedules in consultation with stakeholders and trainer’s as per the APP. Submit training schedules to the HoD for approval via the Director’s Office. Distribute provincial training schedules to all departmental CFO's and system controllers as well as upload on TMS. Monitor training centres. Visit training centres at Head Office and the regions as and when required. Report any challenges / problems at the training centres to the relevant Directorates for resolution. Monitor trainers for the contents taught. Moderation of scripts. Supervise subordinate’s (Assistant Directors and Trainers). Oversee that trainers train as per approved provincial training schedules. Monitor the marking and assessment done by trainers. Consolidate trainers reports as after each course. Supervise Assistant Directors performance as per job description to meet the given targets. Manage Leave. Database management and reports. Import data file to the training database on TMS. Extract reports in MS-Excel format as required. Monitor the regular updating of the systems training database on TMS and the printing of certificates. Customise excel reports as and when required. Submit reports as and when required.
jobs.enquiries: Mesdames Elizba Kotze / B.P. Chaka / Conny Kgadima / K.H. Moremi / Mr. J.S. Nduli Tel No: (015) 298 7000
jobs.applications: Applicants may apply through the following website: https://erecruitment.limpopo.gov.za or Applicants should be submitted to: Director: Human Resource Management, Private Bag X 9486, Polokwane, 0700 OR Hand delivered to: ISMINI Towers Building, Office No. GOO2 (Ground Floor) Registry, 46 Hans van Ransburg Street, Polokwane, 0700. All General enquiries should be directed to Mesdames, Kotze Elizba, Chaka Pearl, Kgadima Conny, Moremi Hilda & Mr. Nduli J.S. Tel No: (015) 298 7000.
jobs.notes: The advert will be posted on the following websites www.limtreasury.gov.za / www.limpopo.gov.za and www.dpsa.gov.za and Provincial Departments social media Applications must be submitted on new Z83 forms obtainable from all Government Departments or can be downloaded from www.dpsa.gov.za or www.gov.za. The new Z83 form must be completed in manner that provides sufficient information about the candidate and the post he or she applies for by completing all relevant fields. The following must be considered in relation to the completion of the Z83 by applicants. All the fields in Part A, Part C and Part D should be completed. In Part B, all fields should be completed in full except the following: South African applicants need not to provide passport numbers. If an applicant responds “no” to the question “Are you conducting business with the State or are you a Director of a Public or Private Company conducting business with the State?” then the answer to the next question “In the event that you are employed in the Public Service, you immediately relinquish such business interests?” can be left blank or indicated as not applicable. A “not applicable” or blank response will be allowed on the question “If your profession or occupation requires official registration, provide date and particulars of registration”; if you are not in possession of such registration. Noting there is limited space provided for Part E, F & G, applicants often indicate “refer to Curriculum Vitae (CV) or see attached”, this is acceptable as long as the CV has been attached and provides the required information. If the information is not provided in the CV, the applicant may be disqualified. It must be noted that a CV is an extension of the application of employment Z83, and applicants are accountable for the information that is provided therein. Applicants currently employed by the public service do not need to complete Part F as the section is intended for those seeking re-employment, as their prior employment can be verified through their CV. The declaration should be completed and signed. Applicants must utilize the most recent Z83 application for employment form as issued by the Minister of Public Service and Administration in line with Regulation 10 of the Public Service Regulations, 2016, failure to do so results in disqualifications. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application but must submit the Z83 and detailed Curriculum Vitae. It must be noted that the CV is an extension of an application of an employment Z83, and applicants are accountable for the information that is provided therein. The Z83 form must be completed in the manner that allows the selection committee to assess the quality of the candidate based on the information that is contained in the form. The Department will require shortlisted candidates to provide certified copies of their qualifications and any other relevant document, which must be submitted to HR on or before the interview date. A specific reference number for the post applied for must be quoted in the space provided on the new form Z83. Applicants with foreign qualifications remain responsible for ensuring that their qualifications are evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) and therefore must submit the copies of certificates and evidence of evaluation by the SAQA for foreign qualification if they are invited to attend interviews. Successful incumbents will be expected to sign a performance agreement within one month after assumption of duty. All shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a security clearance and verification of qualifications. Shortlisted applicants will be required to provide their original qualification certificates and ID on the day of the interview for other relevant verification purposes. The recommended candidate will further be subjected to Personnel Suitability Checks, including financial disclosure requirements, social media screening, and other relevant verification processes. All successful candidates will be subjected to the applicable security clearance processes. All shortlisted candidates will be subjected to pre-entry assessments prior to the interview process. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts, will be subjected to a technical exercise and Interview. Following technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. To ensure that potential SMS members have a background on processes and procedures linked to the SMS, a further requirement for appointment at SMS level will be the successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-entry Programme (Nyukela) as endorsed by the National School of Government with effect from 1st April 2020. This is a Public Service specific training programme which will be applicable for appointments at SMS level. The link for the completion of the pre-entry certificate is as follows: www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme.           Individuals who have completed the course already, and who are therefore in possession of a certificate are welcome to submit such. However, all SMS short-listed candidates will be required to have completed certificate and submit such upon appointment. All shortlisted candidates for other posts shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only, due to the large number of applications we envisage to receive and if you have not heard from the Department within 90 days of the closing date, please accept that your application has been unsuccessful. However, should there be any dissatisfaction, applicants are hereby advised to, within 90 days, request reasons from the Department for any administrative action which has adversely affected them in terms of section 5, sub-section 1 and 2 of the Promotion of Administrative Justice Act 3 of 2000. The Department reserves the right not to make any appointment to the post advertised. The employment decision shall be informed by the Employment Equity Plan of the Department. NB! Candidates who applied before for the re-advertised vacant post are encouraged to re-apply. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Onderdirekteur: Finansiële Bestuurskapasiteitsbou
af.summary: Onderdirekteur vir Finansiële Bestuurskapasiteitsbou by Limpopo Provincial Treasury, verantwoordelik vir die uitvoer en bestuur van PERSAL-opleiding dwarsoor die provinsie.
af.requirements: NQF vlak 7-kwalifikasie in Finansiële Bestuur / Openbare Finansies soos deur SAQA erken. Vyf (5) jaar se ervaring binne die veld waarvan drie (3) jaar se ervaring op junior bestuursvlak / Assistentdirekteursvlak in Finansiële Bestuur / Finansiële Stelsels-opleidingsomgewing. Geldige voertuigbestuurderslisensie (met uitsondering van persone met gestremdhede). Kennis & Vaardighede: Kennis van 'n verskeidenheid werksreekse, prosedures en wetgewende raamwerke soos die Public Finance Management Act, (PFMA). Treasury Regulations. Public Service Act. Public Service Regulations. Batho Pele-beginsels. Personnel and Salary Administration System (PERSAL). Vermoë om 'n rekenaar te bedryf. Organisering. Aanpasbaarheid gedurende veranderinge om die doelwitte te bereik. Innovasie en probleemoplossing.
af.duties: Voer PERSAL-opleiding in Limpopo Province uit en bestuur dit. Voer gehursekering uit gedurende streeksopleiding. Rapporteer terug oor opleidingswaarnemings. Analiseer en evalueer vraelyste (kursus en afrigter), stel kursusverslae op en dien dit in by Direkteur: Finansiële Bestuurskapasiteitsbou. Stel verslae op (kursus, maandeliks, kwartaalliks) en dien dit in by Direkteur. Verduidelik finansiële stelsels-opleidingverwante inligting met ondergeskiktes soos wanneer nodig. Bestuur finansiële stelsels-opleiding by National Treasury vir kursusse wat nie in Limpopo Province aangebied word nie. Woon verskeie Financial Management System-forums by. Ontwikkel PERSAL Provinsiale Opleidingskedules in oorleg met belanghebbendes en afrigters soos per die APP. Dien opleidingskedules by die HoD in vir goedkeuring via die Direkteur se kantoor. Verspreid provinsiale opleidingskedules aan alle departementele CFO's en stelselbeheerders asook laai dit op TMS op. Monitor opleidingsentrums. Besoek opleidingsentrums by Hoofkantoor en die streke soos en wanneer nodig. Rapporteer enige uitdagings / probleme by die opleidingsentrums aan die betrokke Direktoraat vir oplossing. Monitor afrigters vir die inhoud wat onderrig word. Moderering van skrifte. Superviseer ondergeskiktes (Assistentdirekteurs en Afrigters). Hou toesig dat afrigters oplei soos per goedgekeurde provinsiale opleidingskedules. Monitor die nasien en assessering wat deur afrigters gedoen word. Konsolideer afrigtersverslae na elke kursus. Superviseer Assistentdirekteurs se prestasie soos per posbeskrywing om die gegewe teikens te bereik. Bestuur verlof. Databasisbestuur en verslae. Voer data-lêer na die opleidingsdatabasis op TMS in. Trek verslae in MS-Excel-formaat uit soos vereis. Monitor die gereelde opdatering van die stelsels-opleidingsdatabasis op TMS en die druk van sertifikate. Pasmaak Excel-verslae soos en wanneer vereis. Dien verslae in soos en wanneer vereis.

zu.title: Osobala Ohlangothini: Ukwakhiwa Kwamandla Okuphathwa Kwezimali
zu.summary: Osobala Ohlangothini Okwakhiwa Kwamandla Okuphathwa Kwezimali e-Limpopo Provincial Treasury, onethezekile ngokuqhuba nokuphatha uqeqesho lwe-PERSAL kulo lonke isifundazwe.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezinga le-NQF 7 kuPhathwa Kwezimali / Izimali Zomphakathi njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA. Udhalazu (5) weminyaka yohlelo ngaphakathi kwensimu, lapho kuyithathu (3) iminyaka yohlelo ezingeni lokuqondiswa kwabashayiphela / ezingeni loSobala Ohlangothini ekuphathweni kwezimali / esimeni sokuqeqeshwa kwamasistimu ezezimali. Ilayisensi evumelekile yokushayela (ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubeleki). Ulwazi & Amakhono: Ulwazi ngobunjalo bobunjalo bezinhlobonhlobo, izinqubo, namashekhalo ezenziwa umthetho njengoMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwamali Yamaphakathi, (PFMA). Izimiso Zezimali. Umthetho Womphakathi. Izimiso Zomphakathi. Izimiso Ze-Batho Pele. Iphasela lokuphathwa Kwabasebenzi Nenkohlakalo yabakamakamiso (PERSAL). Indlela yokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. ukuhlelwa kwezinto. ukuzivumelanisa futhi ushintsho ukuhlangabezana nemigomo. ukudalwa futhi ukuxazulula izinkinga.
zu.duties: Qeqesha futhi ulawule uqeqesho lwabaphathi e-Limpopo Provincial Treasury. Qeqesha umngcolo wasemikhakheni e-Limpopo Provincial Treasury. Batha abaphathi abangakhishwa ngaphakathi kobuchwepheshe e-Limpopo Provincial Treasury abakuyo. Qaphela futhi ulawule abaqeqeshi abasemikhakheni. Hlola izingemuva zokusebenza okukhulu kwabantu ababhalise kalula. Hlola izingqondo zokusebenza zabafundi kanye namaphoyisa. Hola okuhlangenwe nakho. Bingelela futhi uhlele abaqeqeshi abavela kolunye uhlangothi lwezifundazwe. Hlola isimo sabaqeqeshi futhi ulawule amandla okuqeqesha kwezimali e-NTI ePitoli. Hlola izingqondo zokusebenza zabasebenzi abangaqeqeshiwe baze bathole iziqu ezingamashumi amathathu nasikhombisa (37) zezimali ezisusela kumnyango wezimali we-NTI. Hlola abaqeqeshi abaningi abayisikhombisa (7) kumnyango we-NTI futhi uthumele i-NTI iminikelo yebhajethi ehlanganisiwe ehleli phakathi kwamacashishi amathathu amahle kakhulu. Hlola amaphoyisa e-NTI namakhodi ahleziwe kalula wemisebenzi. Hlola izinhlobo ezinhlu kubasebenzi abangakhishwanga esimeni sokuqeqeshwa i-PERSAL e-Limpopo Provincial Treasury. Hlola ukuthi abaqeqeshi bakhuluma ngemisebenzi nangemikhakha engu-37. Hlola abaqeqeshi bethula izingqondo ekuphathwa kwezimali kahulumeni.

xh.title: I-Sekela-Mlawuli: Ukwakhiwa Kwamandla Kwalawulo Yezimali
xh.summary: I-Sekela-Mlawuli wokuKwakhiwa kwamandla kwalawulo yezimali e Limpopo Provincial Treasury, unoxanduva lokwenza nokulawula uqeqesho lwe-PERSAL kwiphondo lonke.
xh.requirements: Ifomali yeqadi kwinqanaba le-NQF level 7 kwi-Financial Management / Public Finance njengokuqatyiweyo yi-SAQA. Iimvelo ze-Five (5) years ngaphakathi kwindawo yoko kwaye kuzo iithatu (3) years zanamava kwinqanaba lokulawula elincinci / inqanaba loka-Ncedwa-Mlawuli kwi-Financial Management / Financial Systems Training Environment. Ilayisensi yemodeli yedriver eyi-valid (ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubazekileyo). Ulwazi & Amaphuhliso: Ulwazi ngobuntatheli bamagosa omsebenzi, iinkqubo, namakhowudi aselizwizwe njengase, Public Finance Management Act, (PFMA). Treasury Regulations. Public Service Act. Public Service Regulations. Batho Pele Principles. Personnel and Salary Administration System (PERSAL). Isakhono sokuqhuba ikhompyutha. Ukulungelelanisa. Ukuziqhelanisa ngexesha looshintsho ukufezisa iinjongo. Uqobo nokusombulula iingxaki.
xh.duties: Yenza ulawule uqeqesho lwe-PERSAL kwi-Limpopo Province. Yiza nemvume yekhwalithi ngeli xesha leqeqesho leSithili. Phinda ubike ngezinto ezibukwe eqeqeshweni. Hlaziya aze acocoe iincwadi zemibuzo (isifundo nomqeqeshi), adede iingxelo zesifundo aze azinikele ku-Director: Financial Management Capacity Building. Deda iingxelo (zesifundo, zenyanga, zethatyathanga) aze azinikele ku-Director. Cacisa iinkcukacha ezidityaniswe nokuqeqeshwa kwamakhadi ezimali nabangaphansi kwakho njengoko kudingeka. Lawula uqeqesho lwamakhadi ezimali kwi-National Treasury masifundo enganikezelwa kwi-Limpopo Province. Zithobe kumabala amaninzi e-Financial Management System. Phehla iindululo ze-PERSAL Provincial Training Schedules ngemvumelano namahlathi nabaqeqeshi njengoko kuchaziwe kwi-APP. Nikela iindululo zeqeqesho ku-HoD zenziwe mvume ngapha kwe-Office ka-Director. Sazisa iindululo zeqeqesho ngaphakathi iphondo kubo bonke aba-CFO basebe kunonotshaba amakhadi njengokuniniza ukuba zagcinwe kwi-TMS. Lilise iindawo zeqeqesho. Tyelela iindawo zeqeqesho e-Head Office naseembindini njengoko kubekwa linye. Xela naziphi na iingxaki ezibonwayo eendawweni zeqeqesho kumagunya alawulo alo khona ukuba zisombululwe. Lilise abaqeqeshi ngeemixholo efunqenweyo. Ulawulo lwe-scripti. Qeqesha abangaphansi (aba-Ncedwa-Mlawuli nabaqeqeshi). Qinisekisa ukuba abaqeqeshi beqeqesha njengoko kuvunyiwe kwindululo yephondo. Lilisa ukuqamba nokulinganisa okwenziwa ngabaqeqeshi. Hlanganisa iingxelo zabaqeqeshi emva kwesifundo ngasinye. Qaphela inkqubo yaba-Ncedwa-Mlawuli njengoko kubhalwe kumsebenzi wabo ukuba bafezise iinjongo ezibekiweyo. Lawula i-Leave. Ulawulo lwesiseko sedatha neengxelo. Faka isifaki sedatha kwisiseko sedatha yeqeqesho se-TMS. Khupha iingxelo ngokulungiselelwa kwe-MS-Excel njengoko kubekiweyo. Lilisa ukuhlaziywa rhoqo kwesiseko sedatha yamakhadi e-TMS nokushicilelwa kwamastshatile. Didiyela iingxelo ze-MS-Excel njengoko zibekwe linye. Yiza neengxelo njengoko zibekwe linye.
