jobs.notes: The advert will be posted on the following websites www.limtreasury.gov.za / www.limpopo.gov.za and www.dpsa.gov.za and Provincial Departments social media Applications must be submitted on new Z83 forms obtainable from all Government Departments or can be downloaded from www.dpsa.gov.za or www.gov.za. The new Z83 form must be completed in manner that provides sufficient information about the candidate and the post he or she applies for by completing all relevant fields. The following must be considered in relation to the completion of the Z83 by applicants. All the fields in Part A, Part C and Part D should be completed. In Part B, all fields should be completed in full except the following: South African applicants need not to provide passport numbers. If an applicant responds “no” to the question “Are you conducting business with the State or are you a Director of a Public or Private Company conducting business with the State?” then the answer to the next question “In the event that you are employed in the Public Service, you immediately relinquish such business interests?” can be left blank or indicated as not applicable. A “not applicable” or blank response will be allowed on the question “If your profession or occupation requires official registration, provide date and particulars of registration”; if you are not in possession of such registration. Noting there is limited space provided for Part E, F & G, applicants often indicate “refer to Curriculum Vitae (CV) or see attached”, this is acceptable as long as the CV has been attached and provides the required information. If the information is not provided in the CV, the applicant may be disqualified. It must be noted that a CV is an extension of the application of employment Z83, and applicants are accountable for the information that is provided therein. Applicants currently employed by the public service do not need to complete Part F as the section is intended for those seeking re-employment, as their prior employment can be verified through their CV. The declaration should be completed and signed. Applicants must utilize the most recent Z83 application for employment form as issued by the Minister of Public Service and Administration in line with Regulation 10 of the Public Service Regulations, 2016, failure to do so results in disqualifications. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application but must submit the Z83 and detailed Curriculum Vitae. It must be noted that the CV is an extension of an application of an employment Z83, and applicants are accountable for the information that is provided therein. The Z83 form must be completed in the manner that allows the selection committee to assess the quality of the candidate based on the information that is contained in the form. The Department will require shortlisted candidates to provide certified copies of their qualifications and any other relevant document, which must be submitted to HR on or before the interview date. A specific reference number for the post applied for must be quoted in the space provided on the new form Z83. Applicants with foreign qualifications remain responsible for ensuring that their qualifications are evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) and therefore must submit the copies of certificates and evidence of evaluation by the SAQA for foreign qualification if they are invited to attend interviews. Successful incumbents will be expected to sign a performance agreement within one month after assumption of duty. All shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a security clearance and verification of qualifications. Shortlisted applicants will be required to provide their original qualification certificates and ID on the day of the interview for other relevant verification purposes. The recommended candidate will further be subjected to Personnel Suitability Checks, including financial disclosure requirements, social media screening, and other relevant verification processes. All successful candidates will be subjected to the applicable security clearance processes. All shortlisted candidates will be subjected to pre-entry assessments prior to the interview process. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts, will be subjected to a technical exercise and Interview. Following technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. To ensure that potential SMS members have a background on processes and procedures linked to the SMS, a further requirement for appointment at SMS level will be the successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-entry Programme (Nyukela) as endorsed by the National School of Government with effect from 1st April 2020. This is a Public Service specific training programme which will be applicable for appointments at SMS level. The link for the completion of the pre-entry certificate is as follows: www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme.           Individuals who have completed the course already, and who are therefore in possession of a certificate are welcome to submit such. However, all SMS short-listed candidates will be required to have completed certificate and submit such upon appointment. All shortlisted candidates for other posts shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only, due to the large number of applications we envisage to receive and if you have not heard from the Department within 90 days of the closing date, please accept that your application has been unsuccessful. However, should there be any dissatisfaction, applicants are hereby advised to, within 90 days, request reasons from the Department for any administrative action which has adversely affected them in terms of section 5, sub-section 1 and 2 of the Promotion of Administrative Justice Act 3 of 2000. The Department reserves the right not to make any appointment to the post advertised. The employment decision shall be informed by the Employment Equity Plan of the Department. NB! Candidates who applied before for the re-advertised vacant post are encouraged to re-apply. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Kapasiteitsbou vir Finansiële Bestuur
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur vir Kapasiteitsbou vir Finansiële Bestuur by Limpopo Provincial Treasury, verantwoordelik vir BAS- en LOGIS-opleiding, waarvoor 'n NQF-vlak 7-kwalifikasie en vyf jaar se relevante ervaring vereis word.
af.requirements: NQF level 7-kwalifikasie in Finansiële Bestuur / Openbare Finansies soos deur SAQA erken. Vyf (5) jaar se ervaring binne die veld waarvan drie (3) jaar se ervaring op junior bestuursvlak / Assistentdirekteurvlak in Finansiële Bestuur / Opleidingsomgewing vir Finansiële Stelsels. Geldige bestuurderslisensie vir voertuie (met uitsondering van persone met gestremdhede). KENNIS & VAARDIGHEDE: - Kennis van 'n verskeidenheid werkareas, prosedures en wetgewende raamwerke soos die Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). Treasury Regulations. Public Service Act. Public Service Regulations. Batho Pele-beginsels. Basic Accounting System (BAS) en Logistical Information System (LOGIS). Vermoë om 'n rekenaar te bedryf. Organisering. Aanpasbaarheid tydens veranderinge om die doelwitte te bereik. Innovasie en probleemoplossing.
af.duties: BAS- en LOGIS-opleiding in Limpopo-provinsie uitvoer en bestuur. Kwaliteitsversekering tydens streeksopleiding uitvoer. Terugvoer gee oor opleidingswaarnemings. Vraelyste (kursus en afrigter) ontleed en evalueer, kursusverslae opstel en aan Direkteur: Kapasiteitsbou vir Finansiële Bestuur voorlê. Verslae (kursus, maandeliks, kwartaalliks) opstel en aan Direkteur voorlê. Inligting rakende finansiële stelselsopleiding met ondergeskiktes verduidelik soos en wanneer nodig. Finansiële stelselsopleiding by National Treasury bestuur vir kursusse wat nie in Limpopo-provinsie aangebied word nie. Verskeie forums vir Finansiële Bestuurstelsels bywoon. BAS- en LOGIS-provinsiale opleidingskedules in oorleg met belanghebbendes en afrigters opstel soos per die APP. Opleidingskedules aan die HoD vir goedkeuring voorlê via die Direkteur se kantoor. Provinsiale opleidingskedules aan alle departementele CFO's en stelselbeheerders versprei asook op TMS oplaai. Opleidingsentrums monitor. Opleidingsentrums by Hoofkantoor en die streke besoek soos en wanneer nodig. Enige uitdagings / probleme by die opleidingsentrums aan die betrokke Direktoraat rapporteer vir oplossing. Afrigters vir die inhoud wat onderrig word monitor. Skrifte moderate. Ondergeskiktes (Assistentdirekteurs en Afrigters) toesighou. Daarop toesien dat afrigters oplei soos per goedgekeurde provinsiale opleidingskedules. Die merk en assessering deur afrigters monitor. Afrigters se verslae na elke kursus konsolideer. Assistentdirekteurs se prestasie volgens posbeskrywing toesien om die gegewe doelwitte te bereik. Verlof bestuur. Databasisbestuur en verslae. Dataleer na die opleidingsdatabasis op TMS invoer. Verslae in MS-Excel-formaat onttrek soos vereis. Die gereelde opdatering van die stelselsopleidingsdatabasis op TMS en die druk van sertifikate monitor. Excel-verslae soos en wanneer vereis pas. Verslae soos en wanneer vereis voorlê.

xh.summary: Isebe leLonda likaLelo lase-Limpopo Provincial Treasury, lipandi elibiza abo bafuna ukubambe isithuba soMlawuli oPheleleyo ukwazi umsebenzi weendlebe ezimali / umvuzo kwe-BAS and LOGIS, ngokufunwa kwegqabi elinamalinga abafundi abangama-5.
xh.requirements: Isidanga se-NQF level 7 kwilIso sezeMali / ilIso lezeMali lokuMmandla njengoko kunikwa isiphakamiso yile-SAQA. Iimvlama zenyanga ezingama-five (5) njengoko ngaphakathi kwalo msebenzi, apho kuthathwa iinyanga ezithathu (3) ngaphakathi kwendima yomlawuli ongumdato / umlawuli oncedisi ngaphakathi kwelIso lezeMali / Isiqhobo seMfundo zamajelo ezimali. Ibanda zamaltha kathathuzi. Umthetho waRuzulu. Iimfuno zomthetho womsebenzi ka-Manyano. Iindibano ezisebenzisekileyo kwinkqubo kaBatho Pele. I-Ngqeqesho ye-Basic Accounting System (BAS) kwanye I-Nologisiziko lolwazi (LOGIS). Ukubonakala ngokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukubumba. Ukuziqhelanisa ekuguquleni ukuze kugqityelwe iinjongo. Inovatho nokusombulula iingxaki.
xh.duties: Qhuba kulawule imfundo ye-BAS & LOGIS kwi-Limpopo Province. Qhuba iqiniso lelisoqulatho ngexesha lemfundiso yemimandla. Icathula ngemiba efunyanwe kumfundiso. Hlalutya nokuqonda iinqobo ezingabuzwayo (umgaqo nomfundisi), qumba iiripoti zemigangatho kwaye uzidlawulele kuMlawuli: Ukwakhiwa Kolwazi kuLawulo lwezeMali. Qumba iiripoti (umgqa, nyanga, ithuba) kwaye uzidlawulele kuMlawuli. Qaqambisa ulwazi ngemfundiso yamajelo ezimali nabangaphansi kwakho njengoko kufuneka. Lawula imfundiso yamajelo ezimali kwi-National Treasury kumagqabi akawafunyanwa kwi-Limpopo Province. Zimase kumabali ahlukeneyo eLawulo lwezeMali neJelo. Phepha iSikedyuli yoMbindi yemfundiso ye-BAS & LOGIS ngokuvumelana namalungu abathathi-ngqondo nababalisi njengoko kuchazwe kwi-APP. Thumela iisikedyuli zemfundiso kuHlobo ukufumana isigunyaziso ngendlela leKamva kaMlawuli. Sabalisa iisikedyuli zemfundiso koluntu kuwo onke aBaphathi beeFinanci ezisebe nakubaluli bojelo, nakulayishweni kwi-TMS. Qhobosha iindawo zemfundiso. Tyelela iindawo zemfundiso eNtlanganisweni eNkululo nakumimandla njengoko kufuneka. Cathula nayiphi na imiba ezinobunzima kwiziko lemfundiso kumLawulo ohambelanayo naye ngenjongo yokuzisombulula. Qhobosha abalisi malunga nokuqulunywa. Umdibaniso wamanqaku. Tyhala abangaphansi (AbaLawuli abaNcedisi nabaLisi). Qinisekisa ukuba abalisi bayafundisa ngokweesikedyuli zemfundiso ezivunyelweyo koluntu. Qhobosha uphawulo lweenqaku nokuhlolwa okwenziwa ngabalisi. Qamba iiripoti zabalisi emva kwamagqabo. Tyhala inkqubo yabaLawuli abaNcedisi ngokuchazwa kwemisebenzi ukuze bagqibe ngokwe target. Lawula iRheme. ULawulo lwe-database nokuvela iiripoti. Rhwebisa ifayile yolwazi kwi-database yolwazi lwe-TMS. Khupha iiripoti ngesimo se-MS-Excel njengoko kufuneka. Qhobosha ukuhlaziywa rhoqo kwe database yemfundiso yamajelo kwi-TMS kwaye uqwalasele ukuqhotshwa kwezatifikethi. Qwalasela iiripoti ze-excel njengoko kufuneka. Thumela iiripoti njengoko kuthethwa.

If the information is not provided in the CV, the applicant may be disqualified. It must be noted that a CV is an extension of the application of employment Z83, and applicants are accountable for the information that is provided therein. af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Finansiële Rekeningkunde en Verslagdoening
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur vir Finansiële Rekeningkunde en Verslagdoening by Limpopo Provincial Treasury, wat 'n NQF vlak 7 kwalifikasie en vyf jaar se relevante ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: NQF vlak 7 kwalifikasie in Finansiële Rekeningkunde of verwante veld soos erken deur SAQA. Vyf (5) jaar se ervaring binne die veld waarvan drie (3) jaar se funksionele ervaring op junior bestuursvlak / Adjunkdirekteurvlak in Finansiële Rekeningkunde of verwante veld. Geldige bestuurderslisensie (met uitsondering van persone met gestremdhede). Kennis & Vaardighede: Kennis van 'n verskeidenheid werksreekse en prosedures soos Bestuurshfunksies; Finansies. Beplanning en organisering. Samestelling van verslae. Navorsing / ontleding. Rekenaar. Vermoë om Tesourie-riglyne te vertolk en toe te pas. PFMA. GAAP & GRAP. Tesourie-regulasies. Behoeftes en prioriteite van die Departemente en Publieke Entiteite. Vaardighede: Vertolking van rekenings. Analitiese en innoverende denke. Finansiële rekeningkundige vaardighede. Verslagskryfvaardighede. Gevorderde Excel. Leierskap. Organisering & Beplanning. Konflikbestuur. Finansiële bestuur. Strategiese bestuur. Beleidsformulering.
af.duties: Ontwikkel en implementeer stelsels en prosesse om gesonde finansiële bestuur en ouditsultate te verbeter. Stel provinsiale standaard bedryfsprosedures op om implementering en nakoming deur alle publieke entiteite en filiale te verseker. Implementeer National Treasury voorskrifte en goedgekeurde rekeningkundige standaarde. Hersien en rapporteer oor die gehalte van tussentydse en jaarlikse finansiële state. Bestuur die verrekening van maandelikse tydelike rekeninge vir publieke entiteite en filiale. Bestuur die verrekening van maandelikse interdepartementele rekeninge vir publieke entiteite en filiale. Hersien die implementering van National Treasury-instruksienotas deur publieke entiteite en filiale. Bestuur gekonsolideerde jaarlikse finansiële state. Hersien die gekonsolideerde jaarlikse finansiële state. Hersien die rekeninguittrekkersverslag. Hersien 'n ouditlêer om die gekonsolideerde jaarlikse finansiële state (AFS) te steun. Skakeling met eksterne belanghebbendes. Bestuur die komponent. Voer strategiese en operasionele beplanning uit. Bestuur belanghebbenderelationships. Hou toesig oor die administratiewe ondersteuningsfunksies. Voer menslike bestuurs- en finansiële bestuursfunksies uit.

zu.title: Onozimele: Ezokubhala ama-Akhawunti Ezezimali NokuBika
zu.summary: Onozimele wezokubhala ama-akhawunti ezezimali nokubika eLimpopo Provincial Treasury, ofuna iziqu ze-NQF level 7 nokuhlol okuhlobene okungeminyaka emihlanu.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-NQF level 7 kwezokubhala ama-akhawunti ezezimali noma inkambu ehlobene njengokuqashelwa ngu-SAQA. Ukuhlol okweminyaka emihlanu (5) ngaphakathi kwale nkambu lapho kungekhulu yeminyaka emithathu (3) ukuhlol okusebenzayo ezingeni lokuphatha elincane / izinga likaNonduna oKeto ekuBhaleni ama-Akhawunti Ezezimali noma inkambu ehlobene. Ilayisensi evakalayo yokushayela ithilathi (ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubazekile). Ulwazi nobuchwepheshe: Ulwazi ngehlu lemisebenzi eyahlukene nemikhakha efana nemisebenzi yokuphatha; Ezezimali. Ukucubungula nokuHlela. UkuHlela imibiko. UkuFunda / ukuHlaziya. Ikhompyutha. Ikhono lokuchaza nokusebenzisa Imlando kaHlengikazi. PFMA. GAAP & GRAP. Izimiso zokuHlengikazi. Izidingo nezincoma ezibalulekile zakuMnyango namasikhungo Abarlanga. Amakhono: UkuChaza ama-akhawunti. Ukucabanga ngokuHlaziya nokubaBungama. Amakhono ezoBhala ama-akhawunti ezezimali. Amakhono ezoBhala imibiko. I-Excel ebucbzulu. UkuBusa. UkuHlela & ukuCubungula. UkuPhatha iziphixano. UkuPhatha imali. UkuPhatha ngokuBuka. UkuHlela inqubomgomo.
zu.duties: Yakha futhi usebenzise izimiso nemikhakha ukuthuthukisa ukuphatha kwezimali okuhle nemiphumela yoKuhlola. Hlela imikhakha yokusebenza evakalayo yonke yonke ukuthi iqiniseke ukusetshenziswa nokulandelwa yibo bonke amasikhungo abarlanga nasemaphephandaba. Sebenzisa imiyalo yoHlengikazi lesiNunzi nezinkambiso ezemukelwe zokubhala ama-akhawunti. Buya futhi ubike ngokwemiphumela yamaphasenti kanye nemibiko yezimali yonyaka neminyakazo. Phatha ukusula kwezakhwiwo ezibhokelayo zanyanga zonke amasikhungo abarlanga nasemaphephandaba. Phatha ukusula kwezakhwiwo ezingaphakathi komnyango ezibhokelayo zanyanga zonke amasikhungo abarlanga nasemaphephandaba. Buya ukusetshenziswa kwemiyalo yeHlengikazi lesiNunzi emasikhungweni abarlanga nasemaphephandaben. Phatha imibiko yezimali ehlanganisiwe yonyaka. Buya imibiko yezimali ehlanganisiwe yonyaka. Buya imibiko kaBhala ama-Akhawunti. Buya ifayela lokuhlola ukuxhasa imibiko yezimali ehlanganisiwe yonke yonyaka (AFS). Xhumanisa namabalangwe bangaphandle. Phatha ingxenye. Yenza ukucubungula nokuhlela okubuka. Phatha ubudlelwano namabalangwe. Lawula imisebenzi yokuxhasa yolawulo. Yenza imisebenzi yokuphatha abantu nokuphatha imali.

xh.title: Menjingqi Mqulu: Ubuhlengo bentlupelo malungelo neNxulumaniso
xh.summary: iNkokeliMqulu yeBhali leMali kunye neNxulumaniso kwiLimpopo Provincial Treasury, ifuna izifundo zeNQF level 7 kunye nolwazi loveminyaka emihlanu kumsebenzi ohambelana nalo.
xh.requirements: Isifundo seNQF level 7 kwibhali leMali okanye indlela ephathelene nayo njengokuvunywa yiSAQA. Ulwazi lweminyaka emihlanu (5) kule ndlela apho kuneeminyaka emithathu (3) yolwazi lomsebenzi kwinqanaba lesonxibelelwano / kwinqanaba leNkokeli encedisayo kwibhali leMali okanye indlela ephathelene nayo. Ilayiseni elisebenzayo yomqhubi wekhithi (ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubekileyo). Ulwazi & Amakhono: Ulwazi ngeendlela ezahlukeneyo zomsebenzi kunye nenkqubo njengoko kusetyenziswa kumisebenzi yolawulo; iMali. Uceba & uqamba. Ukuqamba iingxelo. Uphando / ukuhlalutya. Ikhompyutha. Amandla okutolika nokusebenzisa iimiyalelo zeTreasury. IPFMA. IGAAP & IGRAP. Iimigaqo yeTreasury. Iimfuno ngokubaluleka kumaSebe kunye nokuQuqumbela iNgcali kaRhulumente. Amakhono: Ukuqonda iikalama. Ukucinga ngokuhlalutya nokuyila. Amakhono abhali lemali. Amakhono ebala iingxelo. I-Excel ephambili. Ukulawula. Uqamba & uCeba. UkuLawula ingxaki. UkuLawula iMali. UkuLawula ngokuQamba. UkuQamba iNgqongo.
xh.duties: Phuhca uze usebenzise iinkqubo neenkqubo zokuphucula ulawulo oluhlelwanga ngokuphela kwemali kunye neziphumo zeAudit. Qamba iinkqubo ezisemgangathweni zesifunda ukwenza isiqinisekiso sokusebenza nokuthobela ngawo onke amaqela karhulumente nezinye iindikimba. Sebenzisa imiyalelo yeNational Treasury nemigaqo evunyiweyo yentlupelo. Phinda uqwalasele ize uxelele ngekhwalithi yezitatimende ezixutyiweyo negqibi zonyaka zentlupelo. Lawula ukucoca i-akhawunti ze-suspense zenyanga zonke kwiiqela karhulumente nakumanye amaqela. Lawula ukucoca i-akhawunti phakathi kwamasebe zenyanga zonke kwiiqela karhulumente nakumanye amaqela. Qwalasela ukusebenza kweMiyalelo yeNqondo zeNational Tribunal kwiiqela karhulumente nakumanye amaqela. Lawula iNqanaba elixutyiweyo lemali elihlangene. Qwalasela iNqanaba elixutyiweyo lemali elihlangene. Qwalasela iNgxelo kaLawuli we-Akhawunti. Qwalasela ifayile ye-audit ukuxhasa iMali eliXutyiweyo eliQingqiweyo lesiNgqigi (AFS). Unxibelelwano neentshaba ezingengomaphakathi. Lawula iNtsika. Yenza uqhelaniso ngokwemigaqo nemigaqo yensebenzo. Lawula iintsingiswano neentshaba. Qwalasela imisebenzi yenccedo yolawulo. Yenza imisebenzi yolawulo abantu kunye nolawulo lwemali.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Enterprise Risk Management
jobs.closing_date_text: 18 September 2026 @ 16H00. Late applications will not be considered. Failure to comply with the above requirements will result in the disqualification of the application.
jobs.summary: Assistant Director for Enterprise Risk Management at Limpopo Provincial Treasury, requiring an NQF level 7 qualification and three years supervisory risk management experience.
jobs.requirements: NQF level 7 qualification in Risk Management or related field as recognized by SAQA. Three (3) years’ functional experience at supervisory level / Senior /Risk Officer/ Senior / Risk Practitioner within Risk Management. Valid vehicle driver’s license (with exception of persons with disabilities). Knowledge & Skills: Knowledge of variety of work ranges and procedures such as: Planning & Organising. Public Administration knowledge and experience. Risk Management and Audit knowledge and experience. Effective presentation and reporting skills. Research / analysing. Ability to operate computer. Ability to interpret and apply policy. Problem solving. Analytical and innovative thinking. Research. Report writing and workshop presentation and facilitation. Ability to operate Risk Management Software. Organising. Project Management. Conflict Management.
jobs.duties: Assist with the development and implementation of the Enterprise Risk Management strategy. Assist the Deputy Director to initiate, coordinate and implement an Enterprise Risk Management Strategy and plan within the department. Initiate and implement an Enterprise Risk Management strategy and plan within the department. Ensure implementation appropriate risk responses. Implement the Risk Register for the department. Implement education and awareness on risk management within the department. Examine prompt implementation of the developed risk responses to remedy any significant weaknesses. Examine the effectiveness of risk management within the department. Integrate Risk Management with all management activities at all levels. Implement functioning of Risk Committee’s for the branches. Identifying of risks on an ongoing basis. Assist the Deputy Director to advise executive management on the alignment of the departmental strategy and budget to provincial and national objectives. Assist branches within the department in managing their risks. Continuously monitor and review risks and controls to cater for internal and external changes. Provide guidelines on risk management methodology and reporting channels. Apply the responsibility of physical management of risks at the most appropriate level as well as accountability for achieving positive results. Assess compliance with related Risk Management matters as contained in the applicable Legislation. Assist in conducting yearly risk assessments according to the PFMA.

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Ondernemingsrisikobestuur
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur vir Ondernemingsrisikobestuur by Limpopo Provincial Treasury, wat 'n NQF level 7-kwalifikasie en drie jaar se toesighoudende risikobestuurservaring vereis.
af.requirements: NQF level 7-kwalifikasie in Risikobestuur of verwante veld soos deur SAQA erken. Drie (3) jaar se funksionele ervaring op toesighoudende vlak / Senior /Risk Officer/ Senior / Risk Practitioner binne Risikobestuur. Geldige bestuurderslisensie vir voertuie (met uitsondering van persone met gestremdhede). Kennis & Vaardighede: Kennis van 'n verskeidenheid werksomvang en prosedures soos: Beplanning & Organisering. Kennis en ervaring van Openbare Administrasie. Kennis en ervaring van Risikobestuur en Oudit. Effektiewe voorlegging en verslagdoeningsvaardighede. Navorsing / ontleding. Vermoë om rekenaar te bedryf. Vermoë om beleid te interpreteer en toe te pas. Probleemoplossing. Analitiese en innoverende denke. Navorsing. Verslagskrywing en werkswinkelveorlegging en fasilitering. Vermoë om Risikobestuurssagteware te bedryf. Organisering. Projekbestuur. Konflikbestuur.
af.duties: Bystand verleen met die ontwikkeling en implementering van die Ondernemingsrisikobestuurstrategie. Bystand verleen aan die Adjunk-direkteur om 'n Ondernemingsrisikobestuurstrategie en -plan binne die departement te inisieer, te koördineer en te implementeer. Inisieer en implementeer 'n Ondernemingsrisikobestuurstrategie en -plan binne die departement. Verseker implementering van toepaslike risiko-reaksies. Implementeer die Risikoregister vir die departement. Implementeer opvoeding en bewustheid oor risikobestuur binne die departement. Ondersoek die onmiddellike implementering van die ontwikkelde risiko-reaksies om enige noemenswaardige swakhede te verhelp. Ondersoek die doeltreffendheid van risikobestuur binne die departement. Integreer Risikobestuur met alle bestuursaktiwiteite op alle vlakke. Implementeer die funksionering van Risikokomitees vir die takke. Identifisering van risiko's op 'n deurlopende grondslag. Bystand verleen aan die Adjunk-direkteur om uitvoerende bestuur te adviseer oor die belyning van die departementele strategie en begroting met provinsiale en nasionale doelwitte. Bystand verleen aan takke binne die departement in die bestuur van hul risiko's. Monitor en hersien deurlopend risiko's en kontroles om vir interne en eksterne veranderinge voorsiening te maak. Verskaf riglyne oor risikobestuurmetodologie en verslagdoeningskanale. Pas die verantwoordelikheid van fisiese bestuur van risiko's op die mees toepaslike vlak toe asook verantwoordelikheid vir die bereiking van positiewe resultate. Asseseer nakoming van verwante Risikobestuursaangeleenthede soos vervat in die toepaslike Wetgewing. Bystand verleen met die uitvoer van jaarlikse risiko-assesserings volgens die PFMA.

zu.title: Umncedi weNduna: Ezingcolweni Eziyingozi Ezenkampani
zu.summary: Umncedi weNduna wezingcolweni eziyingozi ezenkampani eLimpopo Provincial Treasury, ofuna izifundo ezingazinga le-NQF 7 nokuhlola iminyaka emithathu ukuqeqesha abantu ekuphathweni kwezingozi.
zu.requirements: Isifundo esingazinga le-NQF 7 kokuqashwa kwezingozi noma ohlobeni lwayo njengokuqashwa yi-SAQA. Thathu (3) iminyaka yamava womsebenzi ezingeni lokubuka / esikhundleni sobukhulu / Umphathi Wezingozi / Umuntu Osebenza Ngozingozi kokuqashwa kwezingozi. Ilayisense elivumelekile lokushayela izimoto (ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubazekile). Ulwazi nezikhathi: Ulwazi ngohlobo oluhlukene bemisebenzi nendlela yokwenza okunjengokuhlunga nokuhlela. Ulwazi namava embusweni kazwelonke. Ulwazi namava ekuqashweni kwezingozi nokuhlola izibalo. Amakhono okwethula ngokusebenzisa nokubika. Ucwaningo / ukuhlaziya. Ikhono lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ikhono lokuquketha nokusebenzisa izinqubomgomo. Ukuxazulula izinkinga. Ukucabanga ngezinhlangothi ezimbili ngezinto ezintsha. Ucwaningo. Ukubhala imibiko nokwethula kumhlangano wezinkampani nokuyiqondisa. Ikhono lokusebenzisa isoftware ekuqashweni kwezingozi. Ukuhlela. Ukuqashwa kwezindaba. Ukuqashwa kwezinkulumo.
zu.duties: Siza ekwakheni nokusebenzisa isu lekuqashwa kwezingozi eziyingozi ezenkampani. Sisa iNduna enguni ukuqala, ukuhlanganisa nokusebenzisa isu nokuhlela ikuqashwa kwezingozi eziyingozi ezenkampani kuleminyango. Qala futhi usebenzise isu nokuhlela ikuqashwa kwezingozi eziyingozi ezenkampani kuleminyango. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwezimpendulo ezifanele ngezokulinga. Sebenzisa irejista yezokulinga kuleminyango. Sebenzisa imfundo nokwazisa ngezingozi ekuphathweni kwezingozi kuleminyango. Hlola ukusetshenziswa okusheshayo kwezimpendulo ezakhiwe ukulungisa izikhondo eziyinhloko ezingaphili. Hlola ukusebenza kokuqashwa kwezingozi kuleminyango. Hlanganisa ukuqashwa kwezingozi nazo zonke izindlela zokuqashwa izindawa emazingeni onke. Sebenzisa ukusebenza kwekomidi yezokulinga kumhlahlandlela. Ukubona izikhondo ngokuqhubeka. Sisa iNduna enguni ukweluleka abaphathi abakhulu ngokuqondana kwesulu seminyango nesabelo nezinhloso zesifundazwe nasenkundleni. Sisa imihlahlandlela yaleminyango ekuphathweni kwezingozi zabo. Qapha futhi uhlole izikhondo nokulawula njalo ukuze ukwazi ukushintshwa okwangaphakathi nokwangaphandle. Nikezela ngemikhakha equkethwe indlela yokuqashwa kwezingozi nasezindlela zokubika. Sebenzisa umthwalo wezinkinga ekuqashweni kwezingozi ohlelweni olufanele kakhulu nokuziphathe ngemiphumela emihle. Hlola ukulandelana nemikhakha ekuqashweni kwezingozi njengoba kushiwo emthethweni ophathelene. Sisa ekwenzeni izibikezelo zezokulinga minyaka yonke ngohlelo lwe-PFMA.

xh.title: Umkekeli woBaphathwa: iYunithi yokuLawula iingozi zeShishini
xh.summary: Umkekeli weYunithi yokuLawula iingozi zeShishini kwiLimpopo Provincial Treasury, efunayo isidanga seNQF 7 neminye emithathu yamava onke ekulawulweni iingozi.
xh.requirements: Isidanga seNQF 7 kulawulo leeNgozi okanye ndawo ephathelene nayo njengokoqatyiweyo nguSAQA. Iminye emithathu (3) yamava osebenzayo kwinqanaba lolawulo / oMphathi / iNkulumba yeengozi / oMphathi / oQeqeshi weengozi ngaphakathi kolawulo leeNgozi. Ilayisenisi esemthethweni yokushayelaimoto (ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubazekileyo). ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi ngehobo eyahlukileyo yomsebenzi neendlela ezinjengokuCwangcisa nokuhlela. Ulwazi namava kuDweliso lwaRhamentabuso. Ulwazi namava kuLawulo leeNgozi nokulungiselela izikhuselo. Amakhono anamandla okubonakalisa nokubika. Ukuphonononga / ukuhlola. Amandla okusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amandla okutolika nokusebenzisa iinkqubo. Ukuxazula iingxaki. Ukucinga ngokuhlola nokusungula izinto ezintsha. Ukuphonononga. ukubhaliweyo kweekhondo neenkcazelo ezidityanisiweyo nobugcisa bokuthetha phambi komntu nokukhokeza. Amandla okusebenzisa iSoftware yolawulo leeNgozi. ukuHlela. ulawulo lweeProjekthi. ulawulo lweengxaki.
xh.duties: Nceda ekuphuhliseni nokuqwalaselwa kwenkqubo yokuLawula iingozi zeShishini. Nceda uMphathi woMbane osemva kuwo kokuqala, ukuqamba urhwebo nokuqwalasela inkqubo nolungiselwe lokuLawula iingozi zeShishini kwisebe. Qala uze uqwalasele inkqubo nolungiselwe lokuLawula iingozi zeShishini kwisebe. Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa kweendlela ezifanelekileyo zokuphendula iingozi. Qwalasela ukuqwalaselwa kwegeBhuku leeNgozi kwisebe. Qwalasela imfundo nolwazi malunga nolawulo leeNgozi kwisebe. Phepha kuqwalaselwa okusheshiseyo kweendlela ezinjengamagosa oluveliweyo zokulungisa naziphi na iintshaba ezingundoqo. Phepha ukusebenza kokuqwalaselwa kolawulo leeNgozi kwisebe. Dibanisa ulawulo leeNgozi zonke izicwangciso zolawulo kuzo zonke iinqanaba. Qwalasela ukusebenza kweeKomiti zeeNgozi kumagatya. Ukuqaphela iingozi ngokurhuqelela phambili. Nceda uMphathi woMbane osemva kuwo kwiingcebiso zorhulumente onqamlezileyo malunga nokuhambelanisa iinkqubo zesebe nobhetshwa namagqabantshintshi obuzwe namazwe. Nceda amagatya angaphakathi kwesebe ekulawuleni iingozi zabo. Qaphela ngokungqubana uze uphononge iingozi nolawulo ukuze ulawule iinguqu zangaphakathi nangaphandle. Nikezela ngemigaqo yendlela yolawulo leeNgozi neendlela zokubika. Sebenzisa ixanduva lolawulo ngokwenyani leeNgozi kwelona qanaba elifanelekileyo nelinesindima ekufikeleleni kwimizimba egqithisayo. Linganisa ukuthobela iinkqubo ezinxulumene neeNgxam zokuLawula iingozi ezikumthetho osebenzayo. Nceda ekwenzeni iingqikithi zokulinganisa iingozi ngomnyaka ngokwePFMA.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Training & Development
jobs.closing_date_text: 18 September 2026 @ 16H00. Late applications will not be considered. Failure to comply with the above requirements will result in the disqualification of the application.
jobs.summary: Assistant Director for Training and Development at Limpopo Provincial Treasury in Polokwane, requiring an NQF level 6 qualification and three years supervisory experience in human resource development.
jobs.requirements: NQF level 6 qualification in Human Resource Management / Public Administration / Public Management as recognized by SAQA. Three (3) years’ functional experience at Supervisory level / Senior / Training Officer / Senior / Training Practitioner in Human Resource Development. Valid vehicle driver’s license (with exception of persons with disabilities). Knowledge & Skills: Sound and in-depth knowledge of relevant prescripts, application of human resources as well as understanding of the legislative framework governing the Public Service such as: Employment Equity Act, Skills Development Act, Basic Conditions of Employment Act, Labour Relations Act, Public Service Act, Administrative Justice Act, Promotion of Access of Information Act, Public Service Regulations, and various Bargaining Council Resolutions. Negotiation skills. People management. Financial solving. Planning & organizing. Time management. Strategic planning. Policy analysis and development. Good communication skills. Group dynamics. Diversity management. Facilitation skills. Co-ordination skills. Leadership skills. Change and knowledge.
jobs.duties: Coordinate workshop learning programs. Ensure that Performance Plan, Key Performance Areas of staff to be incorporated in WSP. Ensure that training provided to be in line with the WSP. Determine training needs, opportunities and requests from staff and management and make recommendations. Coordinate development of programs in the department. Compile an Annual Training Report according to the SETA required standards. Facilitate administration of bursaries. Identify bursary needs in consultation with line managers. Coordinate awarding of full-time and part-time bursaries. Oversee payment of study fees to academic institutions. Develop and ensure implementation of bursary strategy. Monitor bursary contractual obligations. Monitor progress and compliance. Implement leadership strategy. Monitor the HR strategy in relation to the HR planning process. Provide leadership courses, workshops, and educational programs to build specific skills. Regular monitoring and assessing the impact of training and development initiatives within the department with the support of the line manager/reports. Coordinate workshop skills. A summary of all training and development initiatives as well as institutions required for the development of competencies are detailed. Revise training and development requirements are linked to change in service delivery. Use the current Skill Audit Information as part of the gap identification process. Supervise employees and undertake administrative functions in the unit. General supervision of employees. Allocate duties and perform quality control on the work delivered by supervisees. Advice and lead supervisees regarding all aspects of the work. Manage performance, conduct and discipline of supervisees. Ensure supervisees receive the relevant training to perform their duties effectively and efficiently.
jobs.enquiries: Mesdames Elizba Kotze / B.P. Chaka / Conny Kgadima / K.H. Moremi / Mr. J.S. Nduli Tel No: (015) 298 7000
jobs.applications: Applicants may apply through the following website: https://erecruitment.limpopo.gov.za or Applicants should be submitted to: Director: Human Resource Management, Private Bag X 9486, Polokwane, 0700 OR Hand delivered to: ISMINI Towers Building, Office No. GOO2 (Ground Floor) Registry, 46 Hans van Ransburg Street, Polokwane, 0700. All General enquiries should be directed to Mesdames, Kotze Elizba, Chaka Pearl, Kgadima Conny, Moremi Hilda & Mr. Nduli J.S. Tel No: (015) 298 7000.
jobs.notes: The advert will be posted on the following websites www.limtreasury.gov.za / www.limpopo.gov.za and www.dpsa.gov.za and Provincial Departments social media Applications must be submitted on new Z83 forms obtainable from all Government Departments or can be downloaded from www.dpsa.gov.za or www.gov.za. The new Z83 form must be completed in manner that provides sufficient information about the candidate and the post he or she applies for by completing all relevant fields. The following must be considered in relation to the completion of the Z83 by applicants. All the fields in Part A, Part C and Part D should be completed. In Part B, all fields should be completed in full except the following: South African applicants need not to provide passport numbers. If an applicant responds “no” to the question “Are you conducting business with the State or are you a Director of a Public or Private Company conducting business with the State?” then the answer to the next question “In the event that you are employed in the Public Service, you immediately relinquish such business interests?” can be left blank or indicated as not applicable. A “not applicable” or blank response will be allowed on the question “If your profession or occupation requires official registration, provide date and particulars of registration”; if you are not in possession of such registration. Noting there is limited space provided for Part E, F & G, applicants often indicate “refer to Curriculum Vitae (CV) or see attached”, this is acceptable as long as the CV has been attached and provides the required information. If the information is not provided in the CV, the applicant may be disqualified. It must be noted that a CV is an extension of the application of employment Z83, and applicants are accountable for the information that is provided therein. Applicants currently employed by the public service do not need to complete Part F as the section is intended for those seeking re-employment, as their prior employment can be verified through their CV. The declaration should be completed and signed. Applicants must utilize the most recent Z83 application for employment form as issued by the Minister of Public Service and Administration in line with Regulation 10 of the Public Service Regulations, 2016, failure to do so results in disqualifications. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application but must submit the Z83 and detailed Curriculum Vitae. It must be noted that the CV is an extension of an application of an employment Z83, and applicants are accountable for the information that is provided therein. The Z83 form must be completed in the manner that allows the selection committee to assess the quality of the candidate based on the information that is contained in the form. The Department will require shortlisted candidates to provide certified copies of their qualifications and any other relevant document, which must be submitted to HR on or before the interview date. A specific reference number for the post applied for must be quoted in the space provided on the new form Z83. Applicants with foreign qualifications remain responsible for ensuring that their qualifications are evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) and therefore must submit the copies of certificates and evidence of evaluation by the SAQA for foreign qualification if they are invited to attend interviews. Successful incumbents will be expected to sign a performance agreement within one month after assumption of duty. All shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a security clearance and verification of qualifications. Shortlisted applicants will be required to provide their original qualification certificates and ID on the day of the interview for other relevant verification purposes. The recommended candidate will further be subjected to Personnel Suitability Checks, including financial disclosure requirements, social media screening, and other relevant verification processes. All successful candidates will be subjected to the applicable security clearance processes. All shortlisted candidates will be subjected to pre-entry assessments prior to the interview process. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts, will be subjected to a technical exercise and Interview. Following technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. To ensure that potential SMS members have a background on processes and procedures linked to the SMS, a further requirement for appointment at SMS level will be the successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-entry Programme (Nyukela) as endorsed by the National School of Government with effect from 1st April 2020. This is a Public Service specific training programme which will be applicable for appointments at SMS level. The link for the completion of the pre-entry certificate is as follows: www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme.           Individuals who have completed the course already, and who are therefore in possession of a certificate are welcome to submit such. However, all SMS short-listed candidates will be required to have completed certificate and submit such upon appointment. All shortlisted candidates for other posts shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only, due to the large number of applications we envisage to receive and if you have not heard from the Department within 90 days of the closing date, please accept that your application has been unsuccessful. However, should there be any dissatisfaction, applicants are hereby advised to, within 90 days, request reasons from the Department for any administrative action which has adversely affected them in terms of section 5, sub-section 1 and 2 of the Promotion of Administrative Justice Act 3 of 2000. The Department reserves the right not to make any appointment to the post advertised. The employment decision shall be informed by the Employment Equity Plan of the Department. NB! Candidates who applied before for the re-advertised vacant post are encouraged to re-apply. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Opleiding en Ontwikkeling
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur vir Opleiding en Ontwikkeling by Limpopo Provincial Treasury in Polokwane, wat 'n NQF level 6-kwalifikasie en drie jaar se toesigervaring in menslike hulpbronontwikkeling vereis.
af.requirements: NQF level 6-kwalifikasie in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur / Openbare Administrasie / Openbare Bestuur soos deur SAQA erken. Drie (3) jaar se funksionele ervaring op Toesigvlak / Senior / Opleidingsbeampte / Senior / Opleidingspraktisyn in Menslike Hulpbronontwikkeling. Geldige bestuurslisensie vir voertuie (met uitsondering van persone met gestremdhede). Kennis & Vaardighede: Deeglike en diepgaande kennis van relevante voorskrifte, toepassing van menslike hulpbronne asook begrip van die wetgewende raamwerk wat die Openbare Diens beheer soos: Employment Equity Act, Skills Development Act, Basic Conditions of Employment Act, Labour Relations Act, Public Service Act, Administrative Justice Act, Promotion of Access of Information Act, Public Service Regulations, en verskeie Bargaining Council Resolutions. Onderhandelingsvaardighede. Mensebestuur. Finansiële probleemoplossing. Beplanning & organisering. Tydbestuur. Strategiese beplanning. Beleidsontleding en -ontwikkeling. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede. Groepdinamika. Diversiteitsbestuur. Fasiliteringsvaardighede. Koördineringsvaardighede. Leierskapsvaardighede. Verandering en kennis.
af.duties: Koördineer werkswinkel-leerprogramme. Verseker dat Prestasieplan, Sleutelprestasiegebiede van personeel in die WSP ingesluit word. Verseker dat opleiding wat verskaf word in ooreenstemming met die WSP is. Bepaal opleidingsbehoeftes, geleenthede en versoeke van personeel en bestuur en doen aanbevelings. Koördineer ontwikkeling van programme in die departement. Stel 'n Jaarlikse Opleidingsverslag op volgens die SETA-vereiste standaarde. Fasiliteer administrasie van beurse. Identifiseer beursbehoeftes in oorleg met lynbestuurders. Koördineer toekenning van voltydse en deeltydse beurse. Hou toesig oor betaling van studiegelde aan akademiese instellings. Ontwikkel en verseker implementering van beursstrategie. Monitor beurskontraktuele verpligtinge. Monitor vordering en nakoming. Implementeer leierskapstrategie. Monitor die HR-strategie in verband met die HR-beplanningsproses. Verskaf leierskapskursusse, werkswinkels en opvoedkundige programme om spesifieke vaardighede te bou. Gereelde monitering en assessering van die impak van opleidings- en ontwikkelingsinisiatiewe binne die departement met die ondersteuning van die lynbestuurder/verslae. Koördineer werkswinkelvaardighede. 'n Opsomming van alle opleidings- en ontwikkelingsinisiatiewe asook instellings wat vereis word vir die ontwikkeling van bevoegdhede word in detail uiteengesit. Hersiene opleidings- en ontwikkelingsvereistes word gekoppel aan verandering in dienslewering. Gebruik die huidige Skill Audit Information as deel van die gapingidentifikasieproses. Hou toesig oor werknemers en onderneem administratiewe funksies in die eenheid. Algemene toesig oor werknemers. Ken pligte toe en voer gehaltebeheer uit op die werk wat deur toesigtendes gelewer word. Adviseer en lei toesigtendes rakende alle aspekte van die werk. Bestuur prestasie, gedrag en dissipline van toesigtendes. Verseker dat toesigtendes die tersaaklike opleiding ontvang om hul pligte doeltreffend en doeltreffend uit te voer.

zu.title: Umqondisi Onconyiwe: Ukuqeqesha Nokuthuthukisa
zu.summary: Umqondisi Onconyiwe woKuqeqesha Nokuthuthukisa eLimpopo Provincial Treasury ePolokwane, ofuna iziqu ze-NQF level 6 namava eminyaka emithathu yolawuleko ekuthuthukisweni kwemithombo yabasebenzi.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-NQF level 6 ku-Human Resource Management / Public Administration / Public Management njengoba zivunywa yi-SAQA. Eminyakeni emithathu (3) yamava asebenzayo ezingeni Lolawuleko / Ngumaphephandaba / Umqeqeshi / Ophakeme / Umkhandiqeqeshi ekuthuthukisweni kwemithombo yabasebenzi. Ilayisensi evumelekileyo yokushayela (ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubazekile). Ulwazi Namakhono: Ulwazi olujulileyo ngemithetho ehambelanayo nokuyisebenzisa kwimithombo yabasebenzi nakho konwaba ngohlelo lomthetho oluphethe Inkonzo Yoluntu njengalawo: Employment Equity Act, Skills Development Act, Basic Conditions of Employment Act, Labour Relations Act, Public Service Act, Administrative Justice Act, Promotion of Access of Information Act, Public Service Regulations, nezinqumo ezahlukene zikaBargaining Council. Amakhono anxibelelwano. Ulawulo lwabantu. Ukuxazulula izimali. Ukucwangciswa nokuhlelwa. Ulawulo lwesikhathi. Ukucwangciswa ngokohlelo. Ukuhlaziya nokuthuthukiswa kwemigomo. Amakhono okunxibelelwana amahle. Ukuzipatha kweqembu. Ulawulo lwebahlalazeyi. Amakhono okuqhuba. Amakhono okulungiselelana. Amakhono obuholi. Ulwazi nokuguqulwa.
zu.duties: Lungiselelanisa izinhlelo zokufunda zomsebenzi wendawo. Qinisekisa ukuthi iNqubo Yokusebenza, Izindawo Eziphambili Zokusebenza zabasebenzi zingeniswa ku-WSP. Qinisekisa ukuthi ukuqeqesha okunikezwa kuhambisana ne-WSP. Hunyuswa izidingo zokuqeqesha, ithuba nezicelo zabasebenzi nabalawuli bese unikeza izincomo. Lungiselelanisa ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo kumnyango. Hlela umbiko wokuqeqesha wonyaka ngokwezinga ezifunwa yi-SETA. Phatha ukuphathwa kwebursary. Hlonza izidingo zebursary ngokubonisana nabaphathi bexesha. Lungiselelanisa ukwamukelwa kwebursary yesikhathi esigcwele nesesikhathi esingagcwele. Qapha ukukhokhelwa kwezimali zokufunda kuzikhungo zemfundo. Thuthukisa futhi uqinisekise ukusetshenziswa kwenqubo yebursary. Qapha izibopho zebursary. Qapha inqubo nokuhambisana nemithetho. Sebenzisa inqubo yobuholi. Qapha inqubo ye-HR mayelana nenqubo yokucwangcisa i-HR. Nikeza amakilasi obuholi, imisebenzi yendawo, nezinhlelo zemfundo ukuze akhe amakhono athile. Ukuphatha njalo nokuhlola umthelela wokuqeqesha nokuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo ngaphakathi kumnyango ngosizo lomphathi bexesha / amabhiko. Lungiselelanisa amakhono omsebenzi wendawo. Isifinyezo sezinhlelo zonke zokuqeqesha nokuthuthukiswa kanye nezikhungo ezidingekayo ekuthuthukisweni kwamakhono sichazwe ngokwenza. Ukuthuthukiswa kwezidingo zokuqeqesha kuhlotshaniswa noguqulo ekulethweni kwenkonzo. Sebenzisa ulwazi lwesikhathi sangalesi lokuqeqeswa njengengxenye yenqubo yokuhlonza ithuba. Lawula abasebenzi futhi uthathe imisebenzi yolawulo kwilunga. Ulawulo jambalo labasebenzi. Abela imisebenzi futhi wenze ukulawula ngemigomo emisebenzini okhiqizwe ngabaphathi baphansi. Nikela izeluleko futhi uholele abaphathi baphansi ngakho konke ngomsebenzi. Lawula ukusebenza, ukuziphatha nendatshiso yabaphathi baphansi. Qinisekisa ukuthi abaphathi baphanzi bayathola ukuqeqesha okuhambisanayo ukuze benze imisebenzi yabo ngempumelelo nangokusebenza.

xh.title: Um lawuli oncedisayo: Uqeqesho nokuPhuhlisa
xh.summary: Umlawuli oncedisayo woQeqesho nokuPhuhlisa e Limpopo Provincial Treasury e Polokwane, efuna izifundo ezikumqango NQF level 6 kunye neminyaka emithathu yamava obunkokeli kumphuhlisa wamathambo abantu.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esikumqango NQF level 6 kwi Human Resource Management / Public Administration / Public Management njengokuvunywa yi SAQA. Iminyaka emithathu (3) yamava obusebenzi kwinqanaba lobunkokeli / Okumandla / Iofisi yoQeqesho / Umqeqeshi oMdala / Oqeqesho kwiPhuhlisa loWamathambo abantu. Ilayisenise yomqhubi wesithuthi esisebenzayo (ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubazekile). Ulwazi nobuchule: Ulwazi olujulile nolululo lwemithetho echazweyo, nokusebenzisa amathambo abantu kunye nokuqonda kwesakhiwo somthetho esilawula iNkonzo zoLuntu elinjengale: Employment Equity Act, Skills Development Act, Basic Conditions of Employment Act, Labour Relations Act, Public Service Act, Administrative Justice Act, Promotion of Access of Information Act, Public Service Regulations, kunye neziGqibo ezahlukahlukene zeBargaining Council. Amandla okuxhenga. Ukuqonda abantu. Ukuxela iimali. Ukucazululiswa nokuqamba. Ukuqonda ixesha. Uplani ezingqiqo. Uhlalutyo nokuphuhlisa iindlela zokwenza izinto. Amandla okuxelelana. Iintsana zamaqela. Ukuqonda ukwahluka. Amandla okukhuthaza. Amandla okuhlanganisa. Amandla okukhokela. Utshintsho nolwazi.
xh.duties: Hlanganisa iinkqubo zokuqeqesha kumashishini. Qinisekisa ukuba iPlani yokusebenza, iindlela eziphambili zokusebenza zabasebenzi zifakwe kwi WSP. Qinisekisa ukuba uqeqesho lunikwa ngokulandela i WSP. Misela iimfuno zoqeqesho, ithuba kunye neemfuno zabasebenzi nobuphathi uze wenze izindululo. Hlanganisa ukuphuhlisa iinkqubo kwisebe. Hlengahlengisa iNgxelo yeQeqesho leNyaka ngokumagqiba e SETQA. Phuhlisa ulawulo lobursari. Chaza iimfuno zobursari kwindlela yokuxoxa nabaphathi. Hlanganisa ukunikwa kobursari yexesha elize ngesiqingatha sesixa. Qaphela ukuhlawulwa kwemfundo kumaziko emfundo. Phuhlisa uze uqinisekise ukusetyenziswa kwendlela yokwenzayo yobursari. Qaphela iinkinga zesivumelwano sobursari. Qaphela inkqubela nokuvunyelwa kwemithetho. Sebenzisa iindlela zokukhokela. Qaphela i ndlela yokusebenza ye HR ngokwale ndlela yokucwangcisa i HR. Nikela iinkqubo zokukhokela, amashishini, nenkqubo zemfundo ukuze akhe amandla athile. Ukuqapha rhoqo nokuhlolwa kwempembelelo yoqeqesho nokuphuhlisa iindaba ngaphakathi kwesebe ngosizo lomphathi oqondile /iingxelo. Hlanganisa amandla omashishini. Isishwankathelo sezo zindaba zonke zoqeqesho nokuqeqesha kunye namaziko afunekayo ukuphuhlisa amandla achaziwe. Phinda uqeqeshe kwaye uqinisekise ukuba iimfuno zisabela kwitshintsho ekuletweni inkonzo. Sebenzisa iNkcazalo yokuHlolwa kwamaNdlu yangoku njengesigaba senkqubo yokuqonda iindlela. Lawula abasebenzi uze uzenze imisebenzi yolawulo kwicandelo. Ukuqondisa ngokubanzi abasebenzi. Aba imisebenzi uze wenze ulawulo lolungile kumsebenzi onikwe abantu abaqondiswa. Cedisa uze ubakhokela aboqondiswa ngayo yonke iindawo zomsebenzi. Lawula ukusebenza, ukuziphatha nolawulo babo bonke abaqondiswa. Qinisekisa ukuba abaqondiswa bafumana uqeqesho oluchaziweyo ukwenza imisebenzi yabo ngokusebenza kakuhle nangempumelelo.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Gender Focal Point & Diversity
jobs.closing_date_text: 18 September 2026 @ 16H00. Late applications will not be considered. Failure to comply with the above requirements will result in the disqualification of the application.
jobs.summary: Coordinate diversity management and Employment Equity compliance at the Limpopo Provincial Treasury Head Office in Polokwane.
jobs.requirements: NQF level 6 qualification in Public Administration / Human Resource Management / Public Management as recognized by SAQA. Three (3) years’ functional experience at Supervisory level / Senior / Admin Officer within Special Programmes / Employment Equity or related field. Valid vehicle driver’s license (with exception of persons with disabilities). Knowledge & Skills: Sound and in-depth knowledge of relevant prescripts, application of human resources as well as understanding of the legislative framework governing the Public Services. Children’s Act no 38 of 2005. Technical Assistance guidelines on the employment of people with disabilities. Job Access Implementation guidelines and plan on the recruitment, Empowerment and Retention of persons with disabilities. Code of practice of managing disability in the workplace. Gender Equality Strategic Framework for the Public Service. NYDA Act 2008. African Youth Charter. Employment Equity Act. Skills Development Act. Basic Conditions of Employment Act. Labour Relations Act. Public Service Act. Administrative Justice Act. Promotion of Access of Information Act. Public Service Regulations and various Bargaining Council Resolutions. Negotiation skills. Report writing skills. People management. Financial solving. Planning & organizing. Time management. Strategic planning. Policy analysis and development. Good communication skills. Group dynamics. Diversity management. Facilitation skills. Co-ordination skills. Leadership skills. Change and knowledge management.
jobs.duties: Coordinate diversity management. Facilitate the identification of barriers to Employment Equity. Conduct information and sharing sessions. Coordinate the compilation of Employment and Equity targets and ensure incorporation into the equity plan. Manage compliance prevails to Employment Equity Acts in the department. Facilitate the completion declaration form by employees and ensure exit interviews. Provide secretarial services to the employment equity forums. Monitor commitment register. Control capturing of data on the system. Monitor popularization of employment equity plan in the department. Ensure mainstreaming of programmes pertaining to gender and woman, disability, youth, and older person as well as human rights. Ensure the establishment of Special Program Forums. Coordinate meetings of the different forums namely youth, disability, women, men, and gender forums. Facilitate the forums dialogue sessions, information sharing sessions and workshops. Monitor the participation of youth in all departmental projects. Monitor and evaluate adherence to mainstream and policy prescripts (tendering process, employment). Conducting of workshops / awareness programmes. Co- ordinate annual internal and external stakeholders performing various ministerial activities / events. Facilitate the development of employment equity plan. Manage circulation of the draft on Employment Equity Annual report in the department for inputs. Coordinate consolidation of the Employment Equity inputs. Coordinate development of Employment Equity Annual report and submission for approval. Coordinate submission of Employment Equity reports to the Office of the Premier and Department of Labour. Drafts of reference for Employment Equity consultative forum. Request and receive inputs from stakeholders. Facilitation and consolidation of the received inputs and submit for decision making. Coordinate the establishment of Employment Equity committee. Perform duties of scriber during EE committee meetings. Coordinate monitoring of the implementation to international and national instruments for women development and gender equality. Ensure the coordination, planning, development, and implementation of EE plan. Coordinate the establishment or functioning of EE forum. Coordinate the development of equity plan for all Branches. Provide guidelines and support to line managers in drafting their EE plans. Coordinate diversity management programmes. Conduct the annual EE review and reporting processes. Coordinate the compilation of the departmental EE profile. Render EE advisory role and coordinate approved recommendations. Coordinate research and analysis of the Departmental Policies and procedures on EE. Coordinate the evaluation of impact on the implementation of EE Plans. Coordinate and monitor the alignment of National framework on gender with EE plans. Analyse trend, challenges and gaps identified on various gender audit process. Manage the coordination of annual internal and external stakeholders performing various ministerial activities / events. Compile monitoring of the gender equality issues within the departmental strategies. Coordinate the development of action plan for gender mainstreaming. Compile qualitative and quantitative reports for the Head of the Department and Office of the Premier.
jobs.enquiries: Mesdames Elizba Kotze / B.P. Chaka / Conny Kgadima / K.H. Moremi / Mr. J.S. Nduli Tel No: (015) 298 7000
jobs.applications: Applicants may apply through the following website: https://erecruitment.limpopo.gov.za or Applicants should be submitted to: Director: Human Resource Management, Private Bag X 9486, Polokwane, 0700 OR Hand delivered to: ISMINI Towers Building, Office No. GOO2 (Ground Floor) Registry, 46 Hans van Ransburg Street, Polokwane, 0700. All General enquiries should be directed to Mesdames, Kotze Elizba, Chaka Pearl, Kgadima Conny, Moremi Hilda & Mr. Nduli J.S. Tel No: (015) 298 7000.
jobs.notes: The advert will be posted on the following websites www.limtreasury.gov.za / www.limpopo.gov.za and www.dpsa.gov.za and Provincial Departments social media Applications must be submitted on new Z83 forms obtainable from all Government Departments or can be downloaded from www.dpsa.gov.za or www.gov.za. The new Z83 form must be completed in manner that provides sufficient information about the candidate and the post he or she applies for by completing all relevant fields. The following must be considered in relation to the completion of the Z83 by applicants. All the fields in Part A, Part C and Part D should be completed. In Part B, all fields should be completed in full except the following: South African applicants need not to provide passport numbers. If an applicant responds “no” to the question “Are you conducting business with the State or are you a Director of a Public or Private Company conducting business with the State?” then the answer to the next question “In the event that you are employed in the Public Service, you immediately relinquish such business interests?” can be left blank or indicated as not applicable. A “not applicable” or blank response will be allowed on the question “If your profession or occupation requires official registration, provide date and particulars of registration”; if you are not in possession of such registration. Noting there is limited space provided for Part E, F & G, applicants often indicate “refer to Curriculum Vitae (CV) or see attached”, this is acceptable as long as the CV has been attached and provides the required information. If the information is not provided in the CV, the applicant may be disqualified. It must be noted that a CV is an extension of the application of employment Z83, and applicants are accountable for the information that is provided therein. Applicants currently employed by the public service do not need to complete Part F as the section is intended for those seeking re-employment, as their prior employment can be verified through their CV. The declaration should be completed and signed. Applicants must utilize the most recent Z83 application for employment form as issued by the Minister of Public Service and Administration in line with Regulation 10 of the Public Service Regulations, 2016, failure to do so results in disqualifications. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application but must submit the Z83 and detailed Curriculum Vitae. It must be noted that the CV is an extension of an application of an employment Z83, and applicants are accountable for the information that is provided therein. The Z83 form must be completed in the manner that allows the selection committee to assess the quality of the candidate based on the information that is contained in the form. The Department will require shortlisted candidates to provide certified copies of their qualifications and any other relevant document, which must be submitted to HR on or before the interview date. A specific reference number for the post applied for must be quoted in the space provided on the new form Z83. Applicants with foreign qualifications remain responsible for ensuring that their qualifications are evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) and therefore must submit the copies of certificates and evidence of evaluation by the SAQA for foreign qualification if they are invited to attend interviews. Successful incumbents will be expected to sign a performance agreement within one month after assumption of duty. All shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a security clearance and verification of qualifications. Shortlisted applicants will be required to provide their original qualification certificates and ID on the day of the interview for other relevant verification purposes. The recommended candidate will further be subjected to Personnel Suitability Checks, including financial disclosure requirements, social media screening, and other relevant verification processes. All successful candidates will be subjected to the applicable security clearance processes. All shortlisted candidates will be subjected to pre-entry assessments prior to the interview process. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts, will be subjected to a technical exercise and Interview. Following technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. To ensure that potential SMS members have a background on processes and procedures linked to the SMS, a further requirement for appointment at SMS level will be the successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-entry Programme (Nyukela) as endorsed by the National School of Government with effect from 1st April 2020. This is a Public Service specific training programme which will be applicable for appointments at SMS level. The link for the completion of the pre-entry certificate is as follows: www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme.           Individuals who have completed the course already, and who are therefore in possession of a certificate are welcome to submit such. However, all SMS short-listed candidates will be required to have completed certificate and submit such upon appointment. All shortlisted candidates for other posts shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only, due to the large number of applications we envisage to receive and if you have not heard from the Department within 90 days of the closing date, please accept that your application has been unsuccessful. However, should there be any dissatisfaction, applicants are hereby advised to, within 90 days, request reasons from the Department for any administrative action which has adversely affected them in terms of section 5, sub-section 1 and 2 of the Promotion of Administrative Justice Act 3 of 2000. The Department reserves the right not to make any appointment to the post advertised. The employment decision shall be informed by the Employment Equity Plan of the Department. NB! Candidates who applied before for the re-advertised vacant post are encouraged to re-apply. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Gesigspunt vir Geslag en Diversiteit
af.summary: Koördineer diversiteitsbestuur en nakoming van Indienstnemingsgelykheid by die Limpopo Provinsiale Tesourie-hoofkantoor in Polokwane.
af.requirements: NQF vlak 6-kwalifikasie in Openbare Administrasie / Menslike Hulpbronbestuur / Openbare Bestuur soos deur SAQA erken. Drie (3) jaar se funksionele ervaring op Toesighoudende vlak / Senior / Admin Offisier binne Spiale Programme / Indienstnemingsgelykheid of verwante veld. Geldige bestuurslisensie (met uitsondering van persone met gestremdhede). Kennis & Vaardighede: Deeglike en diepgaande kennis van toepaslike voorskrifte, toepassing van menslike hulpbronne asook begrip van die wetgewende raamwerk wat die Openbare Dienste regeer. Kinderwet no 38 van 2005. Riglyne vir tegniese bystand rakende die indiensneming van persone met gestremdhede. Job Access-implementeringsriglyne en -plan oor die werwing, bemagtiging en behoud van persone met gestremdhede. Kode van praktyk vir die bestuur van gestremdheid in die werkplek. Strategiese raamwerk vir geslagsgelykheid vir die Openbare Diens. NYDA-wet 2008. Afrika-handves vir die Jeug. Indienstnemingsgelykheidswet. Vaardigheidsontwikkelingswet. Basiese Voorwaardes van Dienswet. Arbeidsverhoudingswet. Openbare Dienswet. Administratiewe Geregtigheidswet. Bevordering van Toegang tot Inligtingwet. Openbare Diensregulasies en verskeie Bedingingsraadsbesluite. Onderhandelingsvaardighede. Verslagdoeningsvaardighede. Mensebestuur. Finansiële oplossing. Beplanning en organisering. Tydbestuur. Strategiese beplanning. Beleidsontleding en -ontwikkeling. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede. Groepdinamika. Diversiteitsbestuur. Fasiliteringsvaardighede. Koördinasievaardighede. Leierskapsvaardighede. Veranderings- en kennisbestuur.
af.duties: Koördineer diversiteitsbestuur. Fasiliteer die identifisering van struikelblokke tot Indienstnemingsgelykheid. Voer inligtings- en deelssessies uit. Koördineer die samestelling van Indienstnemings- en Gelykheids-teikens en verseker inlywing in die gelykheidsplan. Bestuur dat nakoming van Indienstnemingsgelykheidswette in die departement gehandhaaf word. Fasiliteer die voltooiing van verklaringsvorms deur werknemers en verseker uit diens-tre-onderhoude. Verskaf sekretariële dienste aan die indienstnemingsgelykheidsforums. Monitor toewydingsregister. Beheer vaslegging van data op die stelsel. Monitor popularisering van indienstnemingsgelykheidsplan in die departement. Verseker hoofstrooming van programme rakende geslag en vroue, gestremdheid, jeug, en ouer persone asook menseregte. Verseker die vestiging van Spiale Programforums. Koördineer vergaderings van die verskillende forums naamlik jeug, gestremdheid, vroue, mans, en geslagforums. Fasiliteer die forums se dialoogsessies, inligtingssessies en werkswinkels. Monitor die deelname van jeug in alle departementele projekte. Monitor en evalueer nakoming van hoofstroom- en beleidsvoorskrifte (aanbiedingsproses, indienstneming). Voer werkswinkels / bewustheidsprogramme uit. Koördineer jaarlikse interne en eksterne belanghebbendes wat verskeie ministeriële aktiwiteite / geleenthede uitvoer. Fasiliteer die ontwikkeling van indienstnemingsgelykheidsplan. Bestuur sirkulasie van die konsep oor die Indienstnemingsgelykheid-jaarrapport in die departement vir insette. Koördineer konsolidasie van die Indienstnemingsgelykheid-insette. Koördineer ontwikkeling van Indienstnemingsgelykheid-jaarrapport en indiening vir goedkeuring. Koördineer indiening van Indienstnemingsgelykheid-rapporte aan die Kantoor van die Premier en Departement van Arbeid. Konsepte van verwysing vir Indienstnemingsgelykheid-raadplegende forum. Versoek en ontvang insette van belanghebbendes. Fasilitering en konsolidasie van die ontvangde insette en voorlegging vir besluitneming. Koördineer die vestiging van die Indienstnemingsgelykheidskomitee. Verrig pligte as skrywer tydens EE-komiteevergaderings. Koördineer monitering van die implementering tot internasionale en nasionale instrumente vir vroue-ontwikkeling en geslagsgelykheid. Verseker die koördinering, beplanning, ontwikkeling en implementering van EE-plan. Koördineer die vestiging of funksionering van EE-forum. Koördineer die ontwikkeling van gelykheidsplan vir alle Takke. Verskaf riglyne en ondersteuning aan lynbestuurders met die opstel van hul EE-planne. Koördineer diversiteitsbestuursprogramme. Voer die jaarlikse EE-hersiening en verslagdoeningsprosesse uit. Koördineer die samestelling van die departementele EE-profiel. Lewer EE-adviesrol en koördineer goedgekeurde aanbevelings. Koördineer navorsing en ontleding van die Departementele Beleide en prosedures oor EE. Koördineer die evaluering van impak op die implementering van EE-planne. Koördineer en monitor die belyning van Nasionale raamwerk oor geslag met EE-planne. Analiseer tendense, uitdagings en gapings geïdentifiseer tydens verskeie geslagsondersoekprosesse. Bestuur die koördinering van jaarlikse interne en eksterne belanghebbendes wat verskeie ministeriële aktiwiteite / geleenthede uitvoer. Stel monitering op van die geslagsgelykheidsake binne die departementele strategieë. Koördineer die ontwikkeling van aksieplan vir geslagshoofstrooming. Stel kwalitatiewe en kwantitatiewe verslae op vir die Hoof van die Departement en Kantoor van die Premier.

zu.title: Onozane weNkundla: Gender Focal Point & Diversity
zu.summary: Qondanisa ukuphathwa kweyahlukahlukene kanye nokuhambisana nomthetho we-Employment Equity eLimpopo Provincial Treasury Head Office ePolokwane.
zu.requirements: Ifashini le-NQF level 6 e-Public Administration / Human Resource Management / Public Management njengoba kuqashwa yi-SAQA. Iminyaka emithathu (3) yokuxakeka kwabaphathi / Senior / Admin Officer ngaphakathi kwe-Special Programmes / Employment Equity noma endaweni ehlobene. Ilayisensi yokushayela ehambisana (ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubazekile). Ulwazi nezikhathi ezinhle: Ulwazi olujulile kanye nemithetho ehambisana nanoma yisiphi isikhathi, ukusetshenziswa kwemithetho yabasebenzi njengoba kuhambisana nokuqonda kwesikhashana. IChildren’s Act no 38 of 2005. Imiqulu yeseluleko emayelana nokubhaqabhaqa kwabantu abakhubazekile. Imiqulu nokuhleleka kokubhaqabhaqa kokubhaqabhaqa nokubhaqabhaqa kwabantu abakhubazekile.
zu.duties: Qondanisa ukuphathwa kweyahlukahlukene. Siza ekubhaleni phansi izithiyo ezibeka i-Employment Equity. Qhuba izikhathi zenhloliyano nokwabelana ngolwazi. Qondanisa ukuqoqa okujoliswe kwi-Employment Equity futhi qinisekisa ukufakwa kohlelo lwe-equity. Phatha ukuthi kuhlonishwa imithetho ye-Employment Equity emnyangweni. Siza ekugcwaliseni amafomu okumemezela abasebenzi bese uqinisekisa izingxoxo zokuhamba. Nikeza izinsizakalo zokuba ngumlobi kumafaramu we-employment equity. Qapha irekhodi lokuzibophezela. Lawula ukufakwa kwemininingwane esistimeni. Qapha ukwandiswa kohlelo lwe-employment equity emnyangweni. Qinisekisa ukufakwa kwezinhlelo mayelana nogogo kanye nabesifazane, abakhokhelwa ukukhushalelwa, abasha, nabadala kanye namalungelo abantu. Qinisekisa ukusungulwa kwezikhungo ezikhethekile. Qondanla izingxoxo zohlangothi oluhlukene okuyi-abasha, abakhokhelwa ukukhushalelwa, abesifazane, abesilisa, namafaramu angogogo. Siza ekubeni nengxoxo kumafaramu, ukwabelana ngolwazi, kanye namakilasi. Qapha ukubamba kwabasha kuyo yonke imiklamo yomnyango. Qapha futhi uhlole ukulandelwa kwemithetho mayelana nezinhlelo kanye nezinqumo (inkambu yokuqashwa). Qhuba amakilasi / amaphrokharamu okudlulisa ulwazi. Qondanisa ukwenziwa kwemisebenzi yabahlanganyeli banga ndlini nangaphandle ngokwemisebenzi / imikhakhasi yamikhulu. Siza ekwakhiweni kohlelo lwe-employment equity. Phatha ukusatshaliswa kokubhalwa kohlelo lwe-Employment Equity emnyangweni ukuze kutholakale imibono. Qondanisa ukuhlanganiswa kwemibono ye-Employment Equity. Qondanisa ukwakhiwa kwe-Employment Equity futhi kuthunyelwe ukuze kuvunyelwe. Qondanisa ukuthunyelwa kwezimelo ze-Employment Equity eNkundleni kaNdunankulu naseMnyangweni wezokuSebenza. Bhala amanothi omtsombo we-Employment Equity. Cela futhi wamukele imibono kubahlanganyeli. Siza futhi uhlanganise imibono etholiwe bese uyithumela ukuze kwenziwe izinqumo. Qondanisa ukusungulwa kophiko lokuqasha ngokulingana. Yenza umsebenzi wokubhala ngesikhathi kuhlangana i-Employment Equity. Qondanisa ukuqapha ukuqashwa kwezinkambiso zangaphakathi kanye namazwe ngamawo ngokuqashwa kwabesifazane kanye nokulingana. Qinisekisa ukuqondiswa, ukuhlela, ukwakha, futhi kuqashwe uhlelo lwe-Employment Equity. Qondanisa ukusungulwa koma kusebenza i-Employment Equity. Qondanisa ukwakhiwa kohlelo lwe-Employment Equity kuzo zonke izigaba. Nikeza imiqulu nezinkuleko kubaphathi bezigaba ekubhaleni amaphulenji wabo. Qondanisa izinhlelo zokuphathwa kweyahlukahlukene. Qhuba ukubuyekea unyaka wokuqashwa ngokulingana kanye nokuqashwa ngokulingana. Qondanisa ukuqoqa incazelo ye-Employment Equity. Nikeza izeluleko ngokuqashwa ngokulingana futhi qondanisa izincomo ezamukelwe. Qondanisa ucwaningo kanye nokuqoqa imibono yomnyango ngokuqashwa ngokulingana. Qondanisa ukuhlola umphumela wokuqashwa kohlelo lwe-Employment Equity. Qondanisa bese uqapha ukuhambisana kwezimiso ezikazwelonke ngenduna kanye namaphulani. Hlaziya isimo, izinselelo, kanye nezikhala ezitholiwe kumaprocessi ahlukene. Phatha ukuqondiswa kwemisebenzi yabahlanganyeli banga ndlini nangaphandle. Hlela ukulandwa kwezindaba zokuqashwa ngokulingana kumaphulani. Qondanisa ukwakhiwa kohlelo lokusebenzisa. Qopha izimelo ezibanzi nezibali ezibekiwe kuso isikhulu esikhulu kanye nenhloko yomnyango.

xh.title: uMqeqi oPhakamileyo: iNdawo yoGender noLwahlwahluko lweenKunzi
xh.summary: Balisa ulawulo lweenkunzi ezahlukeneyo nokuthobela imithetho yoLinganiso lwaBantu basebenzayo eLimpopo Provincial Treasury Head Office ePolokwane.
xh.requirements: Isidanga seNQF level 6 kwiNkululeko kaRhulumente / uLawulo lwAbantu / uLawulo kaRhulumente njengoko sivunywa yiSAQA. Iiminyaka elithathu (3) yamava okusebenza kwinqanaba lokulawula / umSebenzi oPhakamileyo / umLawuli weNgqungqutha ngaphakathi kweNkqubo eZikhethekileyo / uLinganiso lwaBantu basebenzayo okanye indawo enxulumene nayo. Ilayisenisi yokushayela esemthethweni (ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubazekileyo). Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi olujulileyo olunamava amaninzi malunga neemila ezithintekileyo, ukusetyenziswa kolwazi ngabasebenzi, kunye nokuqonda kwesiseko somthetho esilawula iinkonzo kaRhulumente. uMthetho weNtsha no 38 ka 2005. Iinkqubo zokuqondisa ngomsebenzi wabantu abakhubazekileyo. Iinkqubo zeNkqubo yokuQalisa uMsebenzi kunye neplani yokuphuhliswa, ukulungiselelwa, nokugcina abantu abakhubazekileyo. Umthetho wokuLawula iNkungu kwindawo yokusebenza. uPhawu loQhagamshelo lokuLinganisa koGender kwiNkonzo kaRhulumente. uMthetho weNYDA ka 2008. iSivumelwano seNtsa yaseAfrika. uMthetho woLinganiso lwaBantu basebenzayo. uMthetho woPhuhliswa lwaKhono. uMthetho weMigaqo eMiselweyo yoMsebenzi. uMthetho woQhagamshelo lwaBantu basebenzayo. uMthetho weNkonzo kaRhulumente. uMthetho woBulumko bukaRhulumente. uMthetho woPhakamiso lokuFikelela kuLwazi. iMigaqo yeNkonzo kaRhulumente kunye neSivumelwano seBhunga eliBuyisana ngayo. Amakhono okuxoxa. Amakhono okubhala iingxelo. uLawulo lwabantu. Ukusombulula iimali. Uqwalaselo nolungelelwaniso. uLawulo lwexesha. Uqwalaselo oluchanekileyo. Uqwalaselo kunye nokuphuhliswa komgaqo-nkqubo. Amakhono abalulekileyo okunxibelelanisa. Iinkqubo zoqoqosho. uLawulo lweenkunzi ezahlukeneyo. Amakhono oQhuba. Amakhono oQondisa. Amakhono oBuzwa. uLawulo oluGuqukayo nolwazi.
xh.duties: Balisa ulawulo lweenkunzi ezahlukeneyo. Qhuba iinkqubo zokuqondisa iintlobo ezingqamana nokulinganiswa kwabasebenzi. Qhuba iinyani ezimalunga nokulinganiswa kwabasebenzi kwaye wenze iinkqubo zokwabelana ngolwazi. Balisa ukuqokelelwa kweenjongo ezimalunga nokulinganiswa kwabasebenzi ukuze zingeniswe kwicebo lokulinganisa. Qinisekisa ukuthobela imithetho yokulinganiswa kwabasebenzi kwisebe. Qhuba ukugcwaliswa kwamafomu esivumelwano ngabasebenzi ukuze bagcine konke ukuxoxwa okuthintelwe ukusuka emsebenzini. Zeza iinkonzo zokubhala iingqwalasela kwindawo yokulinganiswa kwabasebenzi. Qwalasela irejista yemiselwe. Lawula ukuqokelelwa kolwazi kwinkqubo. Qwalasela ukusasazwa kwecebo lokulinganiswa kwabasebenzi kwisebe. Qinisekisa ukuzanywa kweenkqubo ezimalunga nogender nabantu basebesini, abakhubazekileyo, intsha, nabaphakamileyo ubudala, nakumalungelo abantu. Qinisekisa ukusekwa kweNkundla yeNkqubo eZikhethekileyo. Balisa iintlanganiso zendawo ezahlukeneyo zokulinganisa ngokwendalo, isimo somzimba, abantu basetyhini, abantu basebesini, nogender. Qhuba iinkqubo zoxhumano-lwazi nendawo yokulinganiswa kwabasebenzi, amaxoxo olwazi, ngeendaba, nakumaziko olwazi. Qwalasela ukuthatho kwaba kwentsha kuyo yonke imisebenzi yesebe. Qwalasela ukuqwalasela ukulandelelwa kweenkqubo ezibalulekileyo nomgaqo-nkqubo (inkqubo yokwenzisa iinkonzo, ukusebenza). Yenza iindaba zamaza olwazi nolwazi. Balisa abantu balaphakathi ngaphakathi nangaphandle abenza imisebenzi eyahlukeneyo / iinkqubo. Qhuba ukulungiselelwa kwecebo lokulinganiswa kwabasebenzi. Lawula ukusasazwa kokuqulunqwa kwesimo sengqiqo sokulinganiswa kwabasebenzi kwisebe ukuze kufunyanwe imibono. Balisa ukuqokelelwa kolwazi malunga nokulinganiswa kwabasebenzi. Balisa ukulungiselelwa kwesimo sengqiqo sokulinganiswa kwabasebenzi kunye nokunikelwa ukuvunywa. Balisa ukunikezela iingxelo zokulinganiswa kwabasebenzi kwiOfisi kaPremier nakwiSebe lezeMisebenzi. Qumba amagama okubeka iingxelo ezahlukeneyo. Celа kwaye ufumane imibono evela kubantu balaphakathi. Qhuba kunye nokuqokelelwa kolwazi olufunyenwe uze unikezele nakuwo oluwo uphoqo lwesigqibo. Balisa ukusekwa kweKomiti yokuLinganiswa kwabasebenzi. Yenza imisebenzi yokubhala phantsi ngeengxelo ngekomiti yokuLinganiswa kwabasebenzi. Balisa ukuqwalasela kokusebenza kweekhonthlankthi zebhanganа namaziko ngokuphuhliswa kwabasetyhini nokulinganiswa kwabasetyhini. Qinisekisa ulungelelwaniso, uqwalaselo, ukuphuhliswa, nokusebenza kwecebo lokulinganiswa kwabasebenzi. Balisa ukusekwa okanye ukusebenza kweNdawo yokulinganiswa kwabasebenzi. Balisa ukuphuhliswa kweeplani zokulinganiswa kwabasebenzi kuzo zonke iindawo. Zeza iinkqubo zokuqondisa nokuxhasa abaphathi bezigaba ekubhaleni iiplani zabo zokulinganiswa kwabasebenzi. Balisa iinkqubo zolawulo lweenkunzi ezahlukeneyo. Yenza ukuphonononga kwonyaka kweeplani zokulinganiswa kwabasebenzi kwaye uze wenze iingxelo zokuqhuba inkqubo. Balisa ukuqokelelwa kolwazi olumalunga nolwazi lwesebe ngokulinganiswa kwabasebenzi. Zeza iingcebiso malunga nokulinganiswa kwabasebenzi ukuze zixhaswe iimiso ezamkelweyo. Balisa uphando kunye noqwalaselo lomgaqo-nkqubo wesebe kunye neenqobo ezimalunga nokulinganiswa kwabasebenzi. Balisa ukuqwalaselwa kokusebenza kweeplani zokulinganiswa kwabasebenzi. Balisa ukuqwalasela ukuqwalaselwa kwesiseko seNqunqunqulu sizwe esimalunga nogender kunye neeplani zokulinganiswa kwabasebenzi. Qwalasela iintlobo, iingxaki, kunye nezikhewu eziyahlukaniswa kwiinkqubo zokuqwalasela. Lawula ulungelelwaniso lwabasebenzi basekhaya nangaphandle ukwenza imisebenzi eyahlukeneyo / iinkqubo. Qamba ukubeka iingxelo ezimalunga nokulinganiswa kwabantu basebesini kumagqabantshintshi esebso. Balisa ukulungiselelwa kweplani yokusebenza ngokulinganiswa kwabasetyhini.
