jobs.reference_number: LPT/267 Directorate: Municipal Infrastructure Performance & Public Private & Partnership
jobs.title: Assistant Director: Municipal Infrastructure
jobs.closing_date_text: 18 September 2026 @ 16H00. Late applications will not be considered. Failure to comply with the above requirements will result in the disqualification of the application.
jobs.summary: Assistant Director needed at Limpopo Provincial Treasury to manage municipal infrastructure funding frameworks, budgets, and planning.
jobs.requirements: NQF level 7 qualification in Public Administration / Finance / Economics / Infrastructure Planning / Civil Engineering / Build Environment / Development Studies / Commerce or related field as recognized by SAQA. Three (3) years’ functional experience at Supervisory level / Senior / Admin Officer within Monitoring Infrastructure Projects / Programmes. Experience in Budget processes will be an added advantage. Valid vehicle driver’s license (with exception of persons with disabilities). Knowledge & Skills: Knowledge of MFMA and PFMA. Municipal Infrastructure Grant (MIG) PPP Regulations and Treasury Guidelines. Infrastructure delivery management systems. Government planning & reporting processes. Project Management skills. Financial analysis and reporting. Stakeholder management. Communication and presentation skills. Policy analysis and interpretation. Research and analytical skills. Computer literacy (MS Office.
jobs.duties: Provide assistance to infrastructure funding frameworks, long term planning & expenditure in the province. Develop the infrastructure budget against work in progress, commitments, and cost norms if applicable. Develop the pre- feasibility studies. Develop the business plans for municipal Infrastructure Grands in collaboration with National Treasury and relevant National Sector Departments. Develop the financial roll in line with sector specific criteria. Facilitate the review of a minimum of 50% of all Infrastructure projects where spending exceeded 20% of the contract value and express on option on whether the spending was justified. Assess Provincial Infrastructure plans, budgets and provide expects inputs to Provincial Departments and Public Entities. Develop the integrated development and sector plans. Develop the infrastructure procurement strategies / plans prepared by Municipalities Public Entities. Develop the infrastructure procurement delivery management arrangement including capacity of implementing agents, contracts, professional service providers and municipalities to implement their own projects and make recommendation. Consolidate the proof projects / programmes of Infrastructure Plans, SDBIPs and related information sources. Provide support to enforce the optimal utilization and maintenance of Infrastructure by Provincial and Municipal custodians. Develop the maintenance plans and budget for immovable assets by Municipalities in collaboration with Provincial Local Government Departments. Assess the immovable assets transferred to Municipalities are budgeted for and operated effect and efficiently. Provide promotion of alternative services delivery options for Infrastructure for Provincial Departments generic objectives. Conduct studies / research benchmark of service delivery with other institution within the public and private sector. Conduct preliminary evaluations on models to identify the most suitable model for Limpopo Provincial Government. Provide support on projects. Provide assistance with projects inception register. Assess capacity at institutions. Identify develop OOO’s projects. Develop the procurement documents of RFQ’s, RFP’s and PPP’s agreements. Provide assistance in line with Departments and Municipalities regarding implementation of contract management.
jobs.enquiries: Mesdames Elizba Kotze / B.P. Chaka / Conny Kgadima / K.H. Moremi / Mr. J.S. Nduli Tel No: (015) 298 7000
jobs.applications: Applicants may apply through the following website: https://erecruitment.limpopo.gov.za or Applicants should be submitted to: Director: Human Resource Management, Private Bag X 9486, Polokwane, 0700 OR Hand delivered to: ISMINI Towers Building, Office No. GOO2 (Ground Floor) Registry, 46 Hans van Ransburg Street, Polokwane, 0700. All General enquiries should be directed to Mesdames, Kotze Elizba, Chaka Pearl, Kgadima Conny, Moremi Hilda & Mr. Nduli J.S. Tel No: (015) 298 7000.
jobs.notes: The advert will be posted on the following websites www.limtreasury.gov.za / www.limpopo.gov.za and www.dpsa.gov.za and Provincial Departments social media Applications must be submitted on new Z83 forms obtainable from all Government Departments or can be downloaded from www.dpsa.gov.za or www.gov.za. The new Z83 form must be completed in manner that provides sufficient information about the candidate and the post he or she applies for by completing all relevant fields. The following must be considered in relation to the completion of the Z83 by applicants. All the fields in Part A, Part C and Part D should be completed. In Part B, all fields should be completed in full except the following: South African applicants need not to provide passport numbers. If an applicant responds “no” to the question “Are you conducting business with the State or are you a Director of a Public or Private Company conducting business with the State?” then the answer to the next question “In the event that you are employed in the Public Service, you immediately relinquish such business interests?” can be left blank or indicated as not applicable. A “not applicable” or blank response will be allowed on the question “If your profession or occupation requires official registration, provide date and particulars of registration”; if you are not in possession of such registration. Noting there is limited space provided for Part E, F & G, applicants often indicate “refer to Curriculum Vitae (CV) or see attached”, this is acceptable as long as the CV has been attached and provides the required information. If the information is not provided in the CV, the applicant may be disqualified. It must be noted that a CV is an extension of the application of employment Z83, and applicants are accountable for the information that is provided therein. Applicants currently employed by the public service do not need to complete Part F as the section is intended for those seeking re-employment, as their prior employment can be verified through their CV. The declaration should be completed and signed. Applicants must utilize the most recent Z83 application for employment form as issued by the Minister of Public Service and Administration in line with Regulation 10 of the Public Service Regulations, 2016, failure to do so results in disqualifications. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application but must submit the Z83 and detailed Curriculum Vitae. It must be noted that the CV is an extension of an application of an employment Z83, and applicants are accountable for the information that is provided therein. The Z83 form must be completed in the manner that allows the selection committee to assess the quality of the candidate based on the information that is contained in the form. The Department will require shortlisted candidates to provide certified copies of their qualifications and any other relevant document, which must be submitted to HR on or before the interview date. A specific reference number for the post applied for must be quoted in the space provided on the new form Z83. Applicants with foreign qualifications remain responsible for ensuring that their qualifications are evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) and therefore must submit the copies of certificates and evidence of evaluation by the SAQA for foreign qualification if they are invited to attend interviews. Successful incumbents will be expected to sign a performance agreement within one month after assumption of duty. All shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a security clearance and verification of qualifications. Shortlisted applicants will be required to provide their original qualification certificates and ID on the day of the interview for other relevant verification purposes. The recommended candidate will further be subjected to Personnel Suitability Checks, including financial disclosure requirements, social media screening, and other relevant verification processes. All successful candidates will be subjected to the applicable security clearance processes. All shortlisted candidates will be subjected to pre-entry assessments prior to the interview process. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts, will be subjected to a technical exercise and Interview. Following technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. To ensure that potential SMS members have a background on processes and procedures linked to the SMS, a further requirement for appointment at SMS level will be the successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-entry Programme (Nyukela) as endorsed by the National School of Government with effect from 1st April 2020. This is a Public Service specific training programme which will be applicable for appointments at SMS level. The link for the completion of the pre-entry certificate is as follows: www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme.           Individuals who have completed the course already, and who are therefore in possession of a certificate are welcome to submit such. However, all SMS short-listed candidates will be required to have completed certificate and submit such upon appointment. All shortlisted candidates for other posts shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only, due to the large number of applications we envisage to receive and if you have not heard from the Department within 90 days of the closing date, please accept that your application has been unsuccessful. However, should there be any dissatisfaction, applicants are hereby advised to, within 90 days, request reasons from the Department for any administrative action which has adversely affected them in terms of section 5, sub-section 1 and 2 of the Promotion of Administrative Justice Act 3 of 2000. The Department reserves the right not to make any appointment to the post advertised. The employment decision shall be informed by the Employment Equity Plan of the Department. NB! Candidates who applied before for the re-advertised vacant post are encouraged to re-apply. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Munisipale Infrastruktuur
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur benodig by Limpopo Provincial Treasury om munisipale infrastruktuur befondsingsraamwerke, begrotings en beplanning te bestuur.
af.requirements: NQF vlak 7-kwalifikasie in Openbare Administrasie / Finansies / Ekonomie / Infrastruktuurbeplanning / Siviele Ingenieurswese / Bou-omgewing / Ontwikkelingsstudies / Handel of verwante veld soos deur SAQA erken. Drie (3) jaar se funksionele ervaring op Toesighoudende vlak / Senior / Administratiewe beampte binne Monitering van Infrastruktuurprojekte / Programme. Ervaring in begrotingsprosesse sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Geldige bestuurslisensie (met uitsondering van persone met gestremdhede). Kennis & Vaardighede: Kennis van MFMA en PFMA. Municipal Infrastructure Grant (MIG) PPP Regulasies en Tesourie Riglyne. Infrastruktuurleweringsbestuurstelsels. Regeringsbeplanning en verslagdoeningsprosesse. Projekbestuursvaardighede. Finansiële analise en verslagdoening. Belanghebbende bestuur. Kommunikasie en voorleggingsvaardighede. Beleidsontleding en interpretasie. Navorsing en analitiese vaardighede. Rekenaargeletterdheid (MS Office.
af.duties: Verskaf bystand aan infrastruktuur befondsingsraamwerke, langtermynbeplanning en besteding in die provinsie. Ontwikkel die infrastruktuurbegroting teenoor werk in uitvoering, toewysings en kostenorme waar van toepassing. Ontwikkel die voor-leesbaarheidstudies. Ontwikkel die besigheidsplanne vir munisipale infrastruktuurtoekennings in samewerking met National Treasury en relevante Nasionale Sektordepartemente. Ontwikkel die finansiele rol in ooreenstemming met sektor-spesifieke kriteria. Fasiliteer die hersiening van 'n minimum van 50% van alle Infrastruktuurprojekte waar besteding 20% van die kontrakwaarde oorskry het en lig 'n mening uit oor of die besteding geregverdig was. Evalueer Provinsiale Infrastruktuurplanne, begrotings en verskaf kundige insette tot Provinsiale Departemente en Openbare Entiteite. Ontwikkel die geïntegreerde ontwikkelings- en sektorplanne. Ontwikkel die infrastruktuurverkrygingsstrategieë / planne wat deur Munisipaliteite Openbare Entiteite voorberei is. Ontwikkel die infrastruktuurverkrygingsleweringsbestuursreëlings insluitend kapasiteit van implementerende agente, kontrakte, professionele diensverskaffers en munisipaliteite om hul eie projekte te implementeer en doen aanbeveling. Konsolideer die bewys projekte / programme van Infrastruktuurplanne, SDBIP's en verwante inligtingsbronne. Verskaf ondersteuning om die optimale benutting en instandhouding van Infrastruktuur deur Provinsiale en Munisipale bewaarders af te dwing. Ontwikkel die instandhoudingsplanne en begroting vir onroerende bates deur Munisipaliteite in samewerking met Provinsiale Plaaslike Regeringsdepartemente. Evalueer of die onroerende bates wat na Munisipaliteite oorgeplaas is, begroot is en doeltreffend en effektief bedryf word. Bevorder alternatiewe diensleweringsopsies vir Infrastruktuur vir Provinsiale Departemente generiese doelwitte. Voer studies / navorsing verwysingsraamwerk van dienslewering met ander instellings binne die publieke en privaatsektor uit. Voer voorlopige evaluasies op modelle uit om die mees geskikte model vir Limpopo Provincial Government te identifiseer. Verskaf ondersteuning aan projekte. Verskaf bystand met projekte inisieëringregister. Evalueer kapasiteit by instellings. Identifiseer ontwikkel OOO se projekte. Ontwikkel die verkrygingsdokumente van RFQ's, RFP's en PPP's ooreenkomste. Verskaf bystand in ooreenstemming met Departemente en Munisipaliteite rakende implementering van kontrakbestuur.

zu.title: Umphathi Ophethe Kahle: Izinsimbi Zomphakathi zasipala
zu.summary: Kudingeka umphathi ophethe kahle (Assistant Director) e-Limpopo Provincial Treasury ukuphatha imikhakha yokuxhaswa kwezinsimbi zomphakathi, izinqubomgomo ezimali, kanye nokuqamba amaphuzu.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-NQF level 7 ezenza ngonqamba zobuholi bomphakathi / izimali / izehlakalo / ukuhlela izinsimbi zomphakathi / ubunjiniyela bezakhiwo / indawo edakiwe / izifundo zentuthuko / ukuhweba noma imikhakha ehlobene njengoba kuqashelwe i-SAQA. Iminyaka emithathu (3) yokuhlolwa emsebenzini ezingeni lomphathi / ephakeme / nhloko yogunyathiwe ngaphakathi kokulawula amaphrojekthi / amaphrogremu wemiyo yesibili yokwakha. Uphijana emphakathini wezimali kuyoba yinzuzo. Amalayisense asebenzayo ohlaza wesimoto (ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubazekile). Ulwazi kanye namakhono: Ulwazi nge-MFMA kanye ne-PFMA. I-Municipal Infrastructure Grant (MIG) imithetho ye-PPP kanye nemigado yeTreasury. Izindlela zokulawula ukulethwa kwemiyalo. Izindlela zokuqamba amaphuzu kanye nokubika kahulumeni. Amakhono okuphatha amaphrojekthi. Ukuhlaziya imali kanye nokubika. Ukuphatha abahlanganyeli. Amakhono okuxhumana kanye nokubukusa. Ukuhlaziya kanye noku humusha umgomo. Ucwaningo kanye namakhono okuhlaziya. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (i-MS Office.
zu.duties: Nikeza usizo emikhakheni yokuxhaswa kwezinsimbi zomphakathi, ukuhlela kwesikhathi eside nokusebenzisa imali esifundazweni. Hlela inzuzomali yezinsimbi zomphakathi ebhekene nomsebenzi ohamba phambili, izibambiso, kanye namaxabiso alelwe uma kunesidingo. Hlela ucwaningo lokuqala lokufaneleka. Hlela amaphuzu wezobucwelwense mayelana nezibonelelo zezinsimbi zomphakathi ngokubambisana ne-National Treasury kanye neminyango ehlobene nomphakathi kazwelonke. Hlela ukugcotshwa kwezimali ngokuhambisana nemigomo ethize yomkhakha. Siza ukubuyekeza okungenani ngamaphesenti angu-50% yawo wonke amaphrojekthi wezinsimbi zomphakathi lapho ukusebenzisa imali kudlule amaphesenti angu-20% enani yekhontathi bese ukhipha umbono ngokuthi ukusebenzisa imali kwakufanelekile yini. Hlola amaphuzu wezinsimbi zomphakathi esifundazweni, izinzuzomali bese unikeza okufakwayo kwabahlezi beminyango yesifundazwe kanye nezinhlangano zomphakathi. Hlela ukuthuthukiswa okuhlanganisiwe kanye namaphuzu womkhakha. Hlela izindlela / amaphuzu okuthenga izinsimbi zomphakathi alungiselelwa ngamasipala nezinhlangano zomphakathi. Hlela izindlela zokuphathwa kokulethwa kokuthenga izinsimbi zomphakathi kufaka phakathi amandla abenzi abaqashisiwe, amakhontathi, abahlinzeki bezinsiza ezingcweti namasipala ukuba basuse amaphrojekthi abo bese benikeza izincomo. Qoqa ubufakazi bamaphrojekthi / amaphrogremu wezinhlelo zezinsimbi zomphakathi, i-SDBIPs kanye namathuluzi olwazi ahlobene. Nikeza usizo ukuze kuqiniswe ukusetshenziswa okuhle kanye nokugcinwa kwezinsimbi zomphakathi ngabagcini besifundazwe nabasipala. Hlela amaphuzu okugcinwa kanye nenzuzomali yezimpahla ezinganyakazi ngamasipala ngokubambisana neminyango kahulumeni wendawo yesifundazwe. Hlola ukuthi izimpahla ezinganyakazi ezinikelwe amasipala zinenzuzomali futhi zisetshenziswa ngempumelelo nangokusebenza kahle. Khuthaza izinketho ezithize zokuletha izinsiza ezinkundleni zezinsimbi zomphakathi mayelana nemigomo evamile yeminyango yesifundazwe. Yenza izifundo / ucwaningo lokulinganisa ngokuletha izinsiza nabanye ezinhlanganweni ngaphakathi komkhakha womphakathi nowangasese. Yenza iziluleko zokuqala kumamodeli ukuze kutholwe imodeli efaneleka kakhulu kahulumeni wesifundazwe sase-Limpopo. Nikeza usizo kumaphrojekthi. Nikeza usizo ngokubhaliswa kokuqala kwamaphrojekthi. Hlola amandla ezinhlanganweni. Hlonza bese ukuthuthukisa amaphrojekthi i-OOO's. Hlela amafayela okuthenga i-RFQ's, i-RFP's kanye nezivumelwano ze-PPP's. Nikeza usizo ngokuhambisana neminyango namasipala mayelana nokuphathwa kwamakhontathi.

xh.title: Umncedisi weNkulumbuso: Urhwebo lweziNgeno zaseKhomishini
xh.summary: Kufuneka ngumncedisi weNkulumbuso kwi Limpopo Provincial Treasury ukulawula iindlela zexabiso lerhwebo lwezingeniso zasekhomishini, amabhajeti, nokuqwalasela.
xh.requirements: Isifundo seNQF level 7 kuPublic Administration / Finance / Economics / Infrastructure Planning / Civil Engineering / Build Environment / Development Studies / Commerce okanye indawo enxulumene nayo njengoko kwenziwa kwaziwa yiSAQA. Iminyaka emithathu (3) yamava wemisebenzi kwinqanaba labaBalawuli / abaPhakamileyo / noMlawuli woMsebenzi ongaphakathi kwokuQwalasela imaPhejethi / Inkqubo zorhwebo lwezingeniso. Amaxhathwa amabhajeti kuya kuba lusondezo oluluncedo. Ilayisenishi esemthethweni yomqhubi wesithuthu (ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubekileyo). ULwazi noBuchule: Ulwazi ngeMFMA nePFMA. IiMigaqo yeMunicipal Infrastructure Grant (MIG) PPP neziNxibelelanisi zeTreasury. Iindlela zolawulo lokuhambisa iinfrastructure. Iinkqubo zocwangqiso nokunika iingxelo karhulumente. Amaxhathwa oLawulo lwePhejethi. Uhlalutyo lweemali nokunika iingxelo. Ulawulo lwabathinti-nxaxheba. Amaxhathwa oThungelwano nokubonisa. Uhlalutyo lotsiko lweenq kunokutolika. Uphononongo namaxhathwa uhlalutyo. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngakomputha (MS Office.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso kwiindlela zexabiso lerhwebo lwezingeniso, uqwalaselo olude nentlawulo kweliphondo. Phuhlisa ibhajeti yerhwebo lwezingeniso ngokomsebenzi oqhubekayo, izithembiso, nemiqathango yexabiso apho kusemthethweni. Phuhlisa izifundo zokuqala-kuqwalasela. Phuhlisa iinkqubo zorhwebo zeMunicipal Infrastructure Grants ngokusebenzisana neNational Treasury namaphandle eNational Sector Departments. Phuhlisa uluhlu lweemali ngokweemilinganiselo yommandla ocwangiselweyo. Qhubeza ukuqwalaselwa kwesiphelo se-50% yonke imaPhejethi zorhwebo lwezingeniso apho kuchithwe ngaphezulu kuka-20% kwexabiso lesivumelwano yonike inkcazelo yokuba ngaba ukuchithwa kwakuluzizo na. Qwalasela iinkqubo, amabhajeti orhwebo lwezingeniso kweliphondo unike izimvo zabantu abangochwepheshe kumaphando aPhondo kumagunyazwe eRiphabliki. Phuhlisa uqwalaselo olunyibilikileyo nendlela wommandla. Phuhlisa iindlela / iinkqubo zokuthenga zorhwebo lwezingeniso ezilungiselelwe ngamaphandle ezeMunicipalities namaphandle ePublic Entities. Phuhlisa endlela yolawulo lokuhambisa ukuthengwa kwamaphandle korhwebo lwezingeniso kuquka namandla abasebenzisi, iinkqubo, iinkonzo zabachwepheshe ngeemvume kunye namaphandle okuzimela iiprojekthi zazo nokunika izindululo. Qhudelisa isiqiniseko samaphando / iinkqubo zeendlela zorhwebo lwezingeniso, SDBIPs nendalo yolwazi. Nika inkxaso ekugxininiseni ukusetyenziswa okulunge nolondolozo lwamaphandle eInfrastructure ngamagcini kaPhondo nakwaMunicipalities. Phuhlisa iinkqubo zolondolozo namabhajeti ezinto ezingatshintshiyo zamaphandle kwaMunicipalities ngokusebenzisana namaphando kaProvincial Local Government Departments. Qwalasela ukuba izinto ezingatshintshiyo ezidluliselwe kwaMunicipalities zithathwa kwindawo yamabhajeti zize zisetyenziswe ngemigaqo etafileni nasebenza kakuhle. Phuhlisa inkxaso yonike amathuba okuhambisa iinkonzo ngenye indlela yorhwebo lwezingeniso kumaphando kaRiphabhliki izinjongo ezisisiseko. Yenza izifundo / uphando ngenqanaba lenkonzo kunye namanye amashishini angaphakathi karhulumente nangasese. Qhuba uqwalaselo lokuqala kwemodeli kuze kufunyanwe imodeli efaneleka kakhulu kwiLimpopo Provincial Government. Nika inkxaso kwimaphejethi. Nika inkxaso ngenkqubo yokuqala yamaphando ePhejethi. Qwalasela isakhono kumashishini. Phuma uqaphele phuhlisa iiprojekthi ze-OOO's. Phuhlisa amaxwebhu okuthenga iRFQ's, iRFP's nePPP's. Nika inkxaso ngokwamaphando ezeMunicipalities kumakhulu ekuphumeznweni kwenkqubo yolawulo yesivumelwano.

jobs.title: Assistant Directors: Provincial Asset Management
jobs.closing_date_text: 18 September 2026 @ 16H00. Late applications will not be considered. Failure to comply with the above requirements will result in the disqualification of the application.
jobs.summary: Assistant Director for Provincial Asset Management at Limpopo Provincial Treasury requiring an NQF 7 qualification and three years supervisory experience in asset management.
jobs.requirements: NQF level 7 qualification in Financial Management / Supply Chain Management or related field as recognized by SAQA. Three (3) years’ functional experience at supervisory level / Senior / Admin Officer within Assets Management. Valid vehicle driver’s license (with exception of persons with disabilities). Knowledge & Skills: Knowledge of variety of work ranges; procedures and legislative frameworks such as, Knowledge and experience of LOGIS and BAS. Knowledge of government policies, procurement, expenditure and budget practices and related Acts and regulations such as PFMA. Good communication skill. Liaison skill. Networking. Interpersonal skill. Analytical skills. Planning and organizing skill. Change and knowledge management.
jobs.duties: Conduct assessment on maintenance of assets register. Draw the monitoring scheduled of visits. Communicate the schedule. Request reconciliation packs. Analyse reconciliations. Verify in verification of supporting documents. Compile the maintenance of Asset Register Assessment Tool. Submission of maintenance of Asset Register Assessment Tool to the Deputy Director. Conduct Assessment on Asset Verification. Request asset verification plan. Receive the asset verification plan. Monitor the progress of asset verification. Verify the supporting documents. Compile Asset verification assessment Tool. Submission of the Asset verification assessment Tool to the Deputy Director. Conduct assessments on Disposal of Assets. Request asset disposal plan. It must be noted that a CV is an extension of the application of employment Z83, and applicants are accountable for the information that is provided therein. It must be noted that the CV is an extension of an application of an employment Z83, and applicants are accountable for the information that is provided therein. Stel die Batebeskikkingstellingsassesseringsinstrument op. Voorlegging van die Batebeskikkingstellingsassesseringsinstrument aan die Adjunkdirekteur. Voorlegging van beveiliging van bate-assesseringsinstrument aan die Adjunkdirekteur. Voer assessering uit op voorraadbestuur. Trek die moniteringskedule van besoeke. Kommunikeer die skedule. Hlela ithuluzi lesilinganiselo sokulahla amafa. Thumela ithuluzi lesilinganiselo sokulahla amafa ku-Deputy Director. Yenza izilinganiselo ekuvikelelweni kwamafa. Bhala isikhombi sokubuka esihleliwe. Hlola ukulinganiswa kwemali etholwe kokulahla. Qamba iSixhobo soKulinganisela soKulahla kweziAsethi. Ngenisa iSixhobo soKulinganisela soKulahwa kweziAsethi kumlawuli oMkhulu. Yenza amasilinganiselo phezu kokhuseleko lweziAsethi. Zoba iqedelelo lokuloliswa ziindwendwe. Yenza isaziso ngeqedelelo. Yenda ukhangelo. Qamba iSixhobo soKulinganisela soKhuseleko lweziAsethi. Ngenisa isixhobo soKulinganisela soKhuseleko lwezi asethi kumlawuli oMkhulu. Yenza amasilinganiselo phezu kolawulo lwezinto ezikhoyo. Zoba iqedelelo lokuloliswa ziindwendwe. Ngenisa iSixhobo soKulinganisela soLawulo lweZinto ezikhoyo kumlawuli oMkhulu.

jobs.closing_date_text: 18 September 2026 @ 16H00. Late applications will not be considered. Failure to comply with the above requirements will result in the disqualification of the application.
jobs.summary: Assistant Director for SCM Client Support in Vhembe, requiring an NQF 7 qualification and three years' supervisory SCM experience in the public sector.
jobs.requirements: NQF level 7 qualification in Supply Chain Management / Commerce as recognized by SAQA. Three (3) years’ functional experience at Supervisory level / Senior / Admin Officer / SCM Practitioner in Public Sector Supply Chain Management. Valid vehicle driver’s license (with exception of persons with disabilities). Knowledge & Skills: Knowledge of variety of work ranges and procedures such as: Knowledge of public sector SCM policies and procedures. Technical/standards/procedures. Finance. Planning and organising. Computer. Needs and priorities of the department. Legal background. and apply policy. Analytical and communication. Ability to operate computer. Adaptability during changes to meet the goals. Financial Management. Policy formulation. Leadership. Research. Strategic Management.
jobs.duties: Provide SCM capacity building for suppliers. Participate in the development of SMME Capacity Building Programme for SMMEs on public sector procurement for the district. Mobilization of SMMEs for the Capacity Building workshops / roadshows. Conduct workshops and awareness roadshow with suppliers and communities on public sector SCM policies and procedures updates. Provide support to suppliers on completion of Standard Bidding Documents. Provide support to supplier on access to central supplier database and other procurement platforms (SCM ICT). Provide walk-ins and online support to suppliers on new registration into the National Central Supplier database. Provide walk-ins and online support to suppliers on update of their information into the CSD. Provide support and capacitate suppliers on accessing government tender opportunities on e-tender Portal. Provide support and capacitate suppliers on accessing SCM Policy information from government departments and OCPO website. Provide capacity to suppliers on state procurement systems (CSD RFQ Functionality, E- Submissions). Provide walk- in and online support to suppliers with uploading of quotation submissions through the CSD RFQ Functionality. Capacitate suppliers through workshops on the process of the CSD RFQ to upload and check progress on the system. Provide walk-in and online support to suppliers for the e-submissions of tenders. Capacitate suppliers through workshops on the process of e- submissions. Manage resources allocated including HRM within the sub- directorate. Sign performance agreements with the subordinates. Assess the bi-annual and annual performance of the sub-ordinates. Manage the leaves of staff members. Transport management – usage of GG vehicles allocated to the district. Stores management issues.
jobs.enquiries: Mesdames Elizba Kotze / B.P. Chaka / Conny Kgadima / K.H. Moremi / Mr. J.S. Nduli Tel No: (015) 298 7000
jobs.applications: Applicants may apply through the following website: https://erecruitment.limpopo.gov.za or Applicants should be submitted to: Director: Human Resource Management, Private Bag X 9486, Polokwane, 0700 OR Hand delivered to: ISMINI Towers Building, Office No. GOO2 (Ground Floor) Registry, 46 Hans van Ransburg Street, Polokwane, 0700. All General enquiries should be directed to Mesdames, Kotze Elizba, Chaka Pearl, Kgadima Conny, Moremi Hilda & Mr. Nduli J.S. Tel No: (015) 298 7000.
jobs.notes: The advert will be posted on the following websites www.limtreasury.gov.za / www.limpopo.gov.za and www.dpsa.gov.za and Provincial Departments social media Applications must be submitted on new Z83 forms obtainable from all Government Departments or can be downloaded from www.dpsa.gov.za or www.gov.za. The new Z83 form must be completed in manner that provides sufficient information about the candidate and the post he or she applies for by completing all relevant fields. The following must be considered in relation to the completion of the Z83 by applicants. All the fields in Part A, Part C and Part D should be completed. In Part B, all fields should be completed in full except the following: South African applicants need not to provide passport numbers. If an applicant responds “no” to the question “Are you conducting business with the State or are you a Director of a Public or Private Company conducting business with the State?” then the answer to the next question “In the event that you are employed in the Public Service, you immediately relinquish such business interests?” can be left blank or indicated as not applicable. A “not applicable” or blank response will be allowed on the question “If your profession or occupation requires official registration, provide date and particulars of registration”; if you are not in possession of such registration. Noting there is limited space provided for Part E, F & G, applicants often indicate “refer to Curriculum Vitae (CV) or see attached”, this is acceptable as long as the CV has been attached and provides the required information. If the information is not provided in the CV, the applicant may be disqualified. It must be noted that a CV is an extension of the application of employment Z83, and applicants are accountable for the information that is provided therein. Applicants currently employed by the public service do not need to complete Part F as the section is intended for those seeking re-employment, as their prior employment can be verified through their CV. The declaration should be completed and signed. Applicants must utilize the most recent Z83 application for employment form as issued by the Minister of Public Service and Administration in line with Regulation 10 of the Public Service Regulations, 2016, failure to do so results in disqualifications. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application but must submit the Z83 and detailed Curriculum Vitae. It must be noted that the CV is an extension of an application of an employment Z83, and applicants are accountable for the information that is provided therein. The Z83 form must be completed in the manner that allows the selection committee to assess the quality of the candidate based on the information that is contained in the form. The Department will require shortlisted candidates to provide certified copies of their qualifications and any other relevant document, which must be submitted to HR on or before the interview date. A specific reference number for the post applied for must be quoted in the space provided on the new form Z83. Applicants with foreign qualifications remain responsible for ensuring that their qualifications are evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) and therefore must submit the copies of certificates and evidence of evaluation by the SAQA for foreign qualification if they are invited to attend interviews. Successful incumbents will be expected to sign a performance agreement within one month after assumption of duty. All shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a security clearance and verification of qualifications. Shortlisted applicants will be required to provide their original qualification certificates and ID on the day of the interview for other relevant verification purposes. The recommended candidate will further be subjected to Personnel Suitability Checks, including financial disclosure requirements, social media screening, and other relevant verification processes. All successful candidates will be subjected to the applicable security clearance processes. All shortlisted candidates will be subjected to pre-entry assessments prior to the interview process. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts, will be subjected to a technical exercise and Interview. Following technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. To ensure that potential SMS members have a background on processes and procedures linked to the SMS, a further requirement for appointment at SMS level will be the successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-entry Programme (Nyukela) as endorsed by the National School of Government with effect from 1st April 2020. This is a Public Service specific training programme which will be applicable for appointments at SMS level. The link for the completion of the pre-entry certificate is as follows: www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme.           Individuals who have completed the course already, and who are therefore in possession of a certificate are welcome to submit such. However, all SMS short-listed candidates will be required to have completed certificate and submit such upon appointment. All shortlisted candidates for other posts shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only, due to the large number of applications we envisage to receive and if you have not heard from the Department within 90 days of the closing date, please accept that your application has been unsuccessful. However, should there be any dissatisfaction, applicants are hereby advised to, within 90 days, request reasons from the Department for any administrative action which has adversely affected them in terms of section 5, sub-section 1 and 2 of the Promotion of Administrative Justice Act 3 of 2000. The Department reserves the right not to make any appointment to the post advertised. The employment decision shall be informed by the Employment Equity Plan of the Department. NB! Candidates who applied before for the re-advertised vacant post are encouraged to re-apply. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Assistentdirekteur: SCM Kliëntondersteuning (VHEMBE)
af.summary: Assistentdirekteur vir SCM Kliëntondersteuning in Vhembe, wat 'n NQF 7-kwalifikasie en drie jaar se toesighoudende SCM-ervaring in die publieke sektor vereis.
af.requirements: NQF vlak 7-kwalifikasie in Voorsieningskettingbestuur / Handel soos deur SAQA erken. Drie (3) jaar se funksionele ervaring op Toesighoudende vlak / Senior / Administratiewe beampte / SCM-Praktisyn in Publieke Sektor Voorsieningskettingbestuur. Geldige bestuurslisensie (met uitsondering van persone met gestremdhede). Kennis & Vaardighede: Kennis van 'n verskeidenheid werkbestekke en prosedures soos: Kennis van publieke sektor SCM-beleide en prosedures. Tegniese standaarde/prosedures. Finansies. Beplanning en organisering. Rekenaar. Behoeftes en prioriteite van die departement. Regterlike agtergrond. en pas beleid toe. Analitiese en kommunikasievaardighede. Vermoë om rekenaar te bedryf. Aanpasbaarheid gedurende veranderinge om die doelwitte te bereik. Finansiële bestuur. Beleidsformulering. Leierskap. Navorsing. Strategiese bestuur.
af.duties: Verskaf SCM-kapasiteitsbou aan verskaffers. Neem deel aan die ontwikkeling van SMME-kapasiteitsbouprogram vir SMME's oor publieke sektor verkryging vir die distrik. Mobilisering van SMME's vir die kapasiteitsbouwerkswinkels / padvertonings. Voer werkswinkels en bewustheidspadvertoning met verskaffers en gemeenskappe uit oor bywerkings van publieke sektor SCM-beleide en prosedures. Verskaf ondersteuning aan verskaffers met die voltooiing van Standaard Bieddokumente. Verskaf ondersteuning aan verskaffers met toegang tot die sentrale verskaffer databasis en ander verkrygingsplatforms (SCM ICT). Verskaf inloop- en aanlynondersteuning aan verskaffers met nuwe registrasie in die Nasionale Sentrale Verskaffer databasis. Verskaf inloop- en aanlynondersteuning aan verskaffers met bywerking van hul inligting in die CSD. Verskaf ondersteuning en bekwaam verskaffers met toegang tot regeringsaanbiedgeleenthede op die e-tender Portaal. Verskaf ondersteuning en bekwaam verskaffers met toegang tot SCM-beleidsinligting van regeringsdepartemente en die OCPO-webwerf. Verskaf kapasiteit aan verskaffers oor staatsverkrygingstelsels (CSD RFQ-funksionaliteit, E-voorleggings). Verskaf inloop- en aanlynondersteuning aan verskaffers met die oplaai van kwotasie-voorleggings deur die CSD RFQ-funksionaliteit. Bekwaam verskaffers deur werkswinkels oor die proses van die CSD RFQ om vordering op die stelsel op te laai en na te gaan. Verskaf inloop- en aanlynondersteuning aan verskaffers vir die e-voorleggings van tenders. Bekwaam verskaffers deur werkswinkels oor die proses van e-voorleggings. Bestuur hulpbronne toegewys insluitend HRM binne die subdirektoraat. Teken prestasieooreenkomste met ondergeskiktes. Assesser die halfjaarlikse en jaarlikse prestasie van die ondergeskiktes. Bestuur die verlof van personeellede. Vervoerbestuur – gebruik van GG-voertuie toegewys aan die distrik. Bergbestuursake.

jobs.requirements: NQF level 7 qualification in Commerce / Accounting / Financial Management / Internal Auditing as recognized by SAQA. Three (3) years’ functional experience at Supervisory level / Senior / Admin Officer within Internal Control or related field. Valid vehicle driver’s license (with exception of persons with disabilities). Knowledge & Skills: Knowledge of variety of work ranges and procedures such as: - Planning, Coordinating and Organizing. Managerial functions. Secretarial Function. Ability to interpret Treasury Directives / PFMA and Treasury Regulations. Compilation of reports. Analysing / Research. Computer Literacy. Standards/procedures. Needs and priorities of the Department. Ability to interpret and apply policy. Analytical and innovative thinking. Report writing. Workshop presentation and facilitation. Leadership. Project Management. Conflict Management. Financial Management. Strategic Management. Policy formulation. Adaptability during changes to meet the goals. Change / diversity.
jobs.duties: Coordinate implementation of compliance to norms, standards, policies and guidelines in provincial departments. Draft new policies and guidelines in terms of Section 18 of the PFMA. Coordinate PFMA and Treasury Regulations Compliance checklist or template. Facilitate the financial management capacity maturity model in the departments and ensure that an action plan is developed to address all the gaps identified. Facilitate and support departments and the IECC to address the unwanted expenditures (irregular, fruitless and wasteful and unauthorized expenditures). Monitor implementation and draft reports on the Provincial Audit Steering Committee’s framework. Support departments in the development of AGSA audit action plans, monitor and report on implementation of the plan. Analyse and report on 30 days payments compliance in line with NT Instruction Note number 34. Analyse and report on the implementation of resolutions of oversight structures (Audit Committees, SCOPA, etc). Monitor implementation and draft reports Provincial Internal Control Framework. Monitor and draft reports on implementation delegation of authority in departments. Coordinate the process of registration and de- registration of public entities and subsidiaries. Analyse and draft reports on section 54 applications. Prepare and submit consolidated monthly and quarterly reports. Provide support to departments on implementation of house (SCOPA) Resolutions. Visits departments and public entities monthly to ensure the implementation of the resolutions. Provide technical advice on how to resolve some of the resolutions. Prepare and submit monthly & quarterly reports on progress of resolving resolutions by relevant departments. Assist in coordination of PAG’s Bilateral sessions with departments in terms of all logistics i.e., issuing meetings invites, agenda, minute, resolutions drafting and attending for engagement.

jobs.notes: The advert will be posted on the following websites www.limtreasury.gov.za / www.limpopo.gov.za and www.dpsa.gov.za and Provincial Departments social media Applications must be submitted on new Z83 forms obtainable from all Government Departments or can be downloaded from www.dpsa.gov.za or www.gov.za. The new Z83 form must be completed in manner that provides sufficient information about the candidate and the post he or she applies for by completing all relevant fields. The following must be considered in relation to the completion of the Z83 by applicants. All the fields in Part A, Part C and Part D should be completed. In Part B, all fields should be completed in full except the following: South African applicants need not to provide passport numbers. If an applicant responds “no” to the question “Are you conducting business with the State or are you a Director of a Public or Private Company conducting business with the State?” then the answer to the next question “In the event that you are employed in the Public Service, you immediately relinquish such business interests?” can be left blank or indicated as not applicable. A “not applicable” or blank response will be allowed on the question “If your profession or occupation requires official registration, provide date and particulars of registration”; if you are not in possession of such registration. Noting there is limited space provided for Part E, F & G, applicants often indicate “refer to Curriculum Vitae (CV) or see attached”, this is acceptable as long as the CV has been attached and provides the required information. If the information is not provided in the CV, the applicant may be disqualified. It must be noted that a CV is an extension of the application of employment Z83, and applicants are accountable for the information that is provided therein. Applicants currently employed by the public service do not need to complete Part F as the section is intended for those seeking re-employment, as their prior employment can be verified through their CV. The declaration should be completed and signed. Applicants must utilize the most recent Z83 application for employment form as issued by the Minister of Public Service and Administration in line with Regulation 10 of the Public Service Regulations, 2016, failure to do so results in disqualifications. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application but must submit the Z83 and detailed Curriculum Vitae. It must be noted that the CV is an extension of an application of an employment Z83, and applicants are accountable for the information that is provided therein. The Z83 form must be completed in the manner that allows the selection committee to assess the quality of the candidate based on the information that is contained in the form. The Department will require shortlisted candidates to provide certified copies of their qualifications and any other relevant document, which must be submitted to HR on or before the interview date. A specific reference number for the post applied for must be quoted in the space provided on the new form Z83. Applicants with foreign qualifications remain responsible for ensuring that their qualifications are evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) and therefore must submit the copies of certificates and evidence of evaluation by the SAQA for foreign qualification if they are invited to attend interviews. Successful incumbents will be expected to sign a performance agreement within one month after assumption of duty. All shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a security clearance and verification of qualifications. Shortlisted applicants will be required to provide their original qualification certificates and ID on the day of the interview for other relevant verification purposes. The recommended candidate will further be subjected to Personnel Suitability Checks, including financial disclosure requirements, social media screening, and other relevant verification processes. All successful candidates will be subjected to the applicable security clearance processes. All shortlisted candidates will be subjected to pre-entry assessments prior to the interview process. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts, will be subjected to a technical exercise and Interview. Following technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. To ensure that potential SMS members have a background on processes and procedures linked to the SMS, a further requirement for appointment at SMS level will be the successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-entry Programme (Nyukela) as endorsed by the National School of Government with effect from 1st April 2020. This is a Public Service specific training programme which will be applicable for appointments at SMS level. The link for the completion of the pre-entry certificate is as follows: www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme.           Individuals who have completed the course already, and who are therefore in possession of a certificate are welcome to submit such. However, all SMS short-listed candidates will be required to have completed certificate and submit such upon appointment. All shortlisted candidates for other posts shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only, due to the large number of applications we envisage to receive and if you have not heard from the Department within 90 days of the closing date, please accept that your application has been unsuccessful. However, should there be any dissatisfaction, applicants are hereby advised to, within 90 days, request reasons from the Department for any administrative action which has adversely affected them in terms of section 5, sub-section 1 and 2 of the Promotion of Administrative Justice Act 3 of 2000. The Department reserves the right not to make any appointment to the post advertised. The employment decision shall be informed by the Employment Equity Plan of the Department. NB! Candidates who applied before for the re-advertised vacant post are encouraged to re-apply. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Assistentdirekteurs: Bestuur, Monitering en Nakoming
af.summary: Assistentdirekteur verantwoordelik vir bestuur, monitering en nakoming by Limpopo Provincial Treasury, wat 'n NQF 7-kwalifikasie in Handel of 'n verwante veld vereis, asook drie jaar se toesigervaring.
af.requirements: NQF level 7-kwalifikasie in Handel / Rekeningkunde / Finansiële Bestuur / Interne Oudit soos erken deur SAQA. Drie (3) jaar se funksionele ervaring op Toesigvlak / Senior / Admin offisier binne Interne Beheer of verwante veld. Geldige bestuurslisensie vir voertuie (met uitsondering van persone met gestremdhede). Kennis & Vaardighede: Kennis van 'n verskeidenheid werkvelde en prosedures soos: - Beplanning, Koördinering en Organisering. Bestuursfunksies. Sekretariële funksie. Vermoë om Tesourie-riglyne / PFMA en Tesourieverordeninge te interpreteer. Opstel van verslae. Analisering / Navorsing. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Standaarde/prosedures. Behoeftes en prioriteite van die Departement. Vermoë om beleid te interpreteer en toe te pas. Analitiese en innoverende denke. Verslagskrywing. Werkswinkelaanbieding en fasilitering. Leierskap. Projektebestuur. Konflikbestuur. Finansiële Bestuur. Strategiese Bestuur. Beleidsformulering. Aanpasbaarheid gedurende veranderinge om die doelwitte te bereik. Verandering / diversiteit.
af.duties: Koördineer implementering van nakoming van norme, standaarde, beleide en riglyne in provinsiale departemente. Ontwerp nuwe beleide en riglyne ooreenkomstig Artikel 18 van die PFMA. Koördineer PFMA en Tesourieverordening-nakomingskontrolelys of sjabloon. Fasiliteer die volwassenheidsmodel vir finansiële bestuurskapasiteit in die departemente en verseker dat 'n aksieplan ontwikkel word om al die geïdentifiseerde gapings aan te spreek. Fasiliteer en ondersteun departemente en die IECC om die ongewenste uitgawes aan te spreek (onreëlmatige, vrugtelose en vermorsende en ongemagtigde uitgawes). Moniteer implementering en ontwerp verslae oor die raamwerk van die Provinciale Ouditstuurkomitee. Ondersteun departemente by die ontwikkeling van AGSA-ouditaksieplanne, moniteer en rapporteer oor implementering van die plan. Analiseer en rapporteer oor 30 dae-betalingsnakoming in ooreenstemming met NT Instruksienota nommer 34. Analiseer en rapporteer oor die implementering van besluite van toesighoudende strukture (Ouditkomitees, SCOPA, ens). Moniteer implementering en ontwerp verslae oor die Provinciale Interne Beheerraamwerk. Moniteer en ontwerp verslae oor die implementering van bevoegdheidsdelegering in departemente. Koördineer die proses van registrasie en deregistrasie van openbare entiteite en filiale. Analiseer en ontwerp verslae oor artikel 54-aansoeke. Berei voor en dien gekonsolideerde maandelikse en kwartaalverslae in. Verskaf ondersteunung aan departemente oor implementering van huis (SCOPA) besluite. Besoek departemente en openbare entiteite maandeliks om die implementering van die besluite te verseker. Verskaf tegniese advies oor hoe om sommige van die beslute op te los. Berei voor en dien maandelikse en kwartaalverslae in oor vordering met die oplossing van besluite deur die betrokke departemente. Bystand verleen met die koördinering van PAG se bilaterale sessies met departemente ten opsigte van alle logistiek, d.w.s. uitstuur van vergaderingsuitnodigings, agenda, notule, opstel van besluite en bywoon van die sessies vir betrokkenheid.

zu.title: Abasizi Abaphathi: Ukuphathwa, Ukuqapha Nokuhambisana Nemithetho
zu.summary: Umsizi Omphathi ongene emzimbeni wokuphathwa, ukuqapha nokuhambisana nemithetho e-Limpopo Provincial Treasury, ofuna izifundo ze-NQF 7 kwezohwebo noma esikhundleni esihlotshaniswa kanye namava eminyaka emithathu okuba ngumlawuli.
zu.requirements: Isifundo se-NQF level 7 kwezohwebo / ekuwushweni imali / ekuphathweni kwezimali / ekuphenyweni ngaphakathi njengoba kuhlonishwa yi-SAQA. Iminyaka emithathu (3) yamava asebenzayo ezingeni Lokuphatha / esiphakeme / njengenkokheli kuleso sikhundla sokulawula ngaphakathi noma esikhundleni esihlotshaniswa. Ilayisensi evumelekile yokushayela imoto (ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubazekile). Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi ngezinhlobonhlobo zemisebenzi namayathu okwenza njengalezi: - Ukubeka ihlelo, ukuhlanganisa futhi kuqhelwe. Imisebenzi yabaphathi. Umsebenzi wabahlikihliki bokubhala. Ikhono lokuhumusha Imlando weTreasury / i-PFMA Nemithetho yeTreasury. Ukuhlanganisa imibiko. Ukuhlaziya / ukuphenya. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompuyutha. Amagugu / iyathu ezidingekayo kanye nezinto ezibalulekileko ze-Department. Ikhono lokuhumusha nokusebenzisa izinqulumo. Ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya nangobusiza. Ukubhala imibiko. Inkingezelwa kumhlangano nokwenza kube lula ukuhlanganyela. Ukuba ngumholi. Ukuphatha iphrojekthi. Ukulawula izinkinga. Ukuphathwa kwezimali. Ukuphathwa okuhlelehle. Ukwenza izinqumo. Ukuzikhubeza ekuguqukeni ukuze kufinyelelwe emigqeni. Ukushintsha / ukwahlukahluka.
zu.duties: Hlanganisa ukuphatha ukuhambisana kwemithetho, amagugu, izinqumo kanye nezinkomba kumnyango esifundazweni. Bhala izinqumo ezintsha nezinkomba ngokwesigaba se-18 se-PFMA. Hlanganisa i-PFMA nokuhambisana nemithetho yeTreasury uhlu lokuhlolisisa noma ithempleyithi. Yenza kube lula ukuphathwa kwezimali isilinganiso sokukhula esifundazweni ukuze umnyango ukwazi ukubeka uhlelo lokusebenza ukuze alungize konke okutholakele okungalungile. Yenza kube lula kanye nokusekela iminyango kanye ne-IECC ukulungisa izindleko ezingafuneki (ezingahambisani nalutho, ezinganxityiswa kanti zikhiswe bese kusetshenziswa ezingavunyelwe). Qapha inqubo yokuphathwa ibhalwe kuhlu lokuhluza i-Provincial Audit Steering Committee. Sekela iminyango ekubhaleni amapulani okusebenza o-AGSA, qapha ubike ngomphumela wokuqhuba lolu hlelo. Hlaziya ubike ngokuhambisana nokukhokhelwa kwezimali emasontweni angama-30 ngokwe-NT Instruction Note number 34. Hlaziya futhi uthole imibiko mayelana nokuqhuba izinqumo zezinhlangano eziqaphayo (Ikomidi Lokuhlolisisa, i-SCOPA, njll). Qapha ngokuphathwa ubhale imibiko mayelana ne-Provincial Internal Control Framework. Qapha ubhale imibiko mayelana nothishe lokusebenza kwamandla omlawuli kumnyango. Hlanganisa inqubo yokubhalisa kanye nokukhipha ebhalweni izinhlangano zomphakathi kanye nezinkampani ezingaphansi kwazo. Hlaziya ubhale imibiko mayelana nezicelo zesigaba 54. Hlela futhi unikeze imibiko ebalulekile njalo ngenyanga kanye nakho ngaphakathi kwesikhathi. Tsekela iminyango ekugcwaliseni izinqumo zepalamente (SCOPA). Vakashela iminyango kanye nezinhlangano zomphakathi njalo ngenyanga ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi izinqumo ziyaphathwa. Nikeza izeluleko ezinobuchule ngendlela yokulungisa izinye zalezozinqumo. Hlela futhi unikeze imibiko yakuqhuba nokuhamba kwezinyanga futhi ngaphakathi kwesikhathi eminyangweni ekudzingene ngokumayo. Siza ekubumbaniseni izinkulumo ezinkulu ze-PAG kanye neminyango emayelana nezidingo zonke ukulandelwa njengokuthumela izimemo zomhlangano, inqubo yomhlangano, ukubhala imibhalo egcinayo, ukubhalwa kwezinqumo nokuhlanganyela.

xh.title: Abaqhwebekeli abayiBadi: Urhulumente, Uqwalaselo kunye nokuhambelana Nemigaqo
xh.summary: Umqhwebeleli ojikeleze urhulumente, uqwalaselo nokuhambelana nemigaqo kwiLaji yaseLimpopo, efuna isifundo seNQF 7 kwisoNzulu samaHlengwinqe okunye namabala ahambelana nalo, kunye neminyaka mitathu yamava okulawula.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esisingatha kwinqanaba le-7 le-NQF kwiNrhwebo / Ukuqamba amanani / ukuLawula iMali / uQwalaselo langaphakathi njengokuqatshelwa yi-SAQA. Iminyaka emithathu (3) yamava osebenzayo kwinqanaba lokulawula / umSebenzi oMkhulu / uMphathi kwoQwalaselo langaphakathi okunye namabala ahambelana nalo. Ilayisense yokushayela ngemoto (ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubazekileyo). Ulwazi namaqhinga: Ulwazi ngeentlobo ezahlukeneyo zemisebenzi nendlela zokusebenza ezinje: - uCwangciso, uQhwebano nokulungelelanisa. Imisebenzi yabalawuli. Imisebenzi yababhali. Ikhono lokuchaza iMiyalelo yeTreasury / i-PFMA nemiQathango yeTreasury. Ukwakhiwa kwemibongo. Uhlalutyo / uphononongo. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngekhompyutha. Izinga / iindlela zokwenza izinto. Iimfuno nezinto eziphambili zeSebe. Ikhono lokuchaza nokusebenzisa iMigaqo. Ukucinga ngokuhlalutyo nangokubakwa ngamasiko. Ukwakha imibongo. Ibonakalisa kwakhona amacebo okuqeqesha. Intsalasela. uLawulo lweProjekthi. uLawulo lweNgxabano. uLawulo lweMali. uLawulo lokuQamba. Ukwenza imigaqo. Ukuzonakalisa ngexesha leentshintsho ukuze kufikelelwe kwiinjongo. Ushintsho / ukwahlukana.
xh.duties: Qhwebanisa ukusebenzisa ukuhambelana nemigaqo, izigaba, iinkqubo nendlela ezingamaphephandaba amakhulu kwiiLaji. Qamba iinkqubo nendlela ezintsha ngokwesigaba se-18 se-PFMA. Qhwebanisa iNqangaliselo yokuHambelana neMigaqo i-PFMA nemiQathango yeTreasury. Yenza amacebo okuqinisekisa ukuba ngokwaneleyo obukhali kwikhowudi yokuLawula iMali maSebe, nokuqinisekisa ukuba isicwangciso senziwa ukuyilungisa onke amathuba atholakele. Hlala nceda amasebe kunye ne-IECC ukunyanga iindleko ezingafunekiyo (ezingaqhakamthetho, ezinganaso isiqhamo nokuzitshabalalisa kunye nezo kunikwe isigqibo kungenangonyaka). Qwalasela ukusebenza kwaye uqambe iimbongo ngendlela yeNkomfa yePalo ye-Audit yoMmandla. Nxiba amasebe ngokuqamba amacebo okuhamba kwesityalo se-AGSA audit, qwalasela nokuqamba iimbango ngokusetyenziswa kweso sicwangciso. Hlalutya nokuqamba iimbango ngokuHambelana nokuhlawulela iintsuku ze-30 ngokomBhalo wokuQaphela we-NT othi ngowama-34. Hlalutya nokuqamba iimbango ngokuSebenzisa izigqibo zeemiLumbo yoQwalaselo (iNkomfa yePalu, i-SCOPA, njl). Qwalasela ukusebenza uze uqambe iimbango ngeNkqubo yeNdawo yoQwalaselo yoMmandla. Qwalasela ukuqamba iimbango ngokusetyenziswa kokunika amagunya kwamasebe. Qhwebanisa inkqubo yokubhalisa nokususwa kwesigqibo kwiziko kahulumente kunye namaziko athe ngqo nawo. Hlalutya uze uqambe iimbango ngezigqibo zesicelo sezicelo se-54. Lungiselela kunye nokugqithisa iimbango ezididiyelweyo ngeenyanga nazihle kho kwartya. Nceda amasebe ngokusetyenziswa kwezigqibo zendlu (i-SCOPA). Tyelela amasebe nentaba ngamnye ukuqinisekisa ukusetyenziswa kwezigqibo. Nika ingcebiso ngendlela yokunyanga ezinye izigqibo. Lungiselela kunye nokugqithisa iimbango ngeenyanga nazihle kho malunga nentsingiselo yokusetyenziswa kwezigqibo ngamasebe afanelekileyo. Nceda ekujongeni iNkomfa ebezimeleyo beBilateral be-PAG namasebe ngokwemisebenzi yonke njengokuthumela imibuzo yokubiza, ukudwelisa amagqabantshintshi, ukubhala iNqangaliselo, ukuyilo izigqibo nokuzihlanganisela kuqeqesho.

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Bestuur, Monitering en Nakoming
af.summary: Koördineer PFMA-nakoming en beleidsopstelling vir Limpopo provinsiale openbare entiteite, wat 'n NQF 7 finanskwalifikasie en drie jaar se toesigervaring vereis.
af.requirements: NQF vlak 7 kwalifikasie in Handel / Rekeningkunde / Finansiële Bestuur / Interne Oudit soos deur SAQA erken. Drie (3) jaar funksionele ervaring op toesigvlak / Senior / Administrobeampte binne Interne Beheer of verwante veld. Geldige bestuurderslisensie (met uitsondering van persone met gestremdhede). Kennis & Vaardighede: Kennis van 'n verskeidenheid werksvlakke en prosedures soos: Beplanning, Koördinering en Organisering. Bestuursfunksies. Sekretariële funksie. Vermoë om Tesourie-riglyne / PFMA en Tesourie-regulasies te interpreteer. Samestelling van verslae. Ontleding / Navorsing. Rekenaargeletterdheid. Standaarde/prosedures. Behoeftes en prioriteite van die Departement. Vermoë om beleid te interpreteer en toe te pas. Analitiese en innoverende denke. Verslagskrywing. Werkswinkelaanbieding en fasilitering. Leierskap. Projekbestuur. Konflikbestuur. Finansiële bestuur. Strategiese bestuur. Beleidsformulering. Aanpasbaarheid tydens veranderinge om die doelwitte te bereik. Verandering / diversiteit.
af.duties: Koördineer implementering van nakoming aan norme, standaarde, beleide en riglyne in provinsiale openbare entiteite insluitend filiale. Ontwerp nuwe beleide en riglyne in terme van Artikel 18 van die PFMA. Koördineer PFMA en Tesourie-regulasies nakomingskontroollys of sjabloon. Fasiliteer die volwassenheidsmodel vir finansiële bestuurskapasiteit in provinsiale openbare entiteite insluitend filiale en verseker dat 'n aksieplan ontwikkel word om al die geïdentifiseerde leemtes aan te spreek. Fasiliteer en ondersteun provinsiale openbare entiteite insluitend filiale en die IECC om die ongewenste uitgawes (onreëlmatige, vrugtelose en wyse en ongemagtigde uitgawes) aan te spreek. Ondersteun en monitor bestuursnakoming deur provinsiale openbare entiteite (insluitend filiale). Monitor implementering en opstel van verslae oor die raamwerk van die Provinsiale Ouditstuurkomitee. Ondersteun provinsiale openbare entiteite insluitend filiale in die ontwikkeling van AGSA-ouditaksieplanne, monitor en rapporteer oor implementering van die plan. Ontleed en rapporteer oor 30 dae betalingsnakoming in ooreenstemming met NT-instruksienota nommer 34. Ontleed en rapporteer oor die implementering van besluite van toesigstrukture (Oudit- en Risikokomitees, SCOPA, ens.). Monitor implementering en stel verslae op oor die Provinsiale Interne Beheerraamwerk. Monitor en stel verslae op oor implementering van delegasie van gesag in openbare entiteite insluitend filiale. Monitor die implementering van delegasie van gesag deur Openbare Entiteite. Berei voor en dien maandelikse en kwartaalverslae in. Monitor implementering van ongewenste uitgawes binne departemente en openbare entiteite. Koördineer en fasiliteer hersiening van maandelikse en kwartaalregisters oor ongemagtigde onreëlmatige, vrugtelose en wyse uitgawes deur alle openbare entiteite. Koördineer Onreëlmatige Ugawe Vergoedingskomitee (IECC) vergaderings in terme van Logistiek d.w.s. bywoningsregisters, voorbereiding en versending van pakkette, opstel van notules, en uitreiking van uitnodigings. Ontvang aansoeke om vergoeding van openbare entiteite en voer assessering uit en adviseer die komitee in terme van nakoming aan die PFMA-nakomings- en verslagdoeningsraamwerk.

zu.title: Umsekeli Wezokuqondisa: Ukolulwa, Ukugcinwa Komthetho Nokuqaphela
zu.summary: Ukuhlanganisa ukugcinwa komthetho kwe-PFMA kanye nokubhalwa kwenqubomgomo kubuhle bomphakathi bendawo kule Limpopo, okudinga isitifikedi se-NQF 7 sezimali kanye namakhulu eminyaka emithathu yokuhlola abantu.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi se-NQF level 7 kwizwe le-Commerce / Accounting / Financial Management / Internal Auditing njengoba sethwa u-SAQA. Three (3) years’ functional experience at Supervisory level / Senior / Admin Officer within Internal Control or related field. Valid vehicle driver’s license (with exception of persons with disabilities). Knowledge & Skills: Knowledge of variety of work ranges and procedures such as: Planning, Coordinating and Organizing. Managerial functions. Secretarial Function. Ability to interpret Treasury Directives / PFMA and Treasury Regulations. Compilation of reports. Analysing / Research. Computer Literacy. Standards/procedures. Needs and priorities of the Department. Ability to interpret and apply policy. Analytical and innovative thinking. Report writing. Workshop presentation and facilitation. Leadership. Project Management. Conflict Management. Financial Management. Strategic Management. Policy formulation. Adaptability during changes to meet the goals. Change / diversity.
zu.duties: Coordinate implementation of compliance to norms, standards, policies and guidelines in provincial public entities including subsidiaries. Draft new policies and guidelines in terms of Section 18 of the PFMA. Coordinate PFMA and Treasury Regulations Compliance checklist or template. Facilitate the financial management capacity maturity model in provincial public entities including subsidiaries and ensure that an action plan is developed to address all the gaps identified. Facilitate and support provincial public entities including subsidiaries and the IECC to address the unwanted expenditures (irregular, fruitless and wasteful and unauthorized expenditures). Support and monitor governance compliance by provincial public entities (including subsidiaries). Monitor implementation and draft reports on the Provincial Audit Steering Committee’s framework. Support provincial public entities including subsidiaries in the development of AGSA audit action plans, monitor and report on implementation of the plan. Analyse and report on 30 days payments compliance in line with NT Instruction Note number 34. Analyse and report on the implementation of resolutions of oversight structures (Audit and Risk Committees, SCOPA, etc). Monitor implementation and draft reports Provincial Internal Control Framework. Monitor and draft reports on implementation delegation of authority in public entities including subsidiaries. Monitor the implementation of delegation of authority by Public Entities. Prepare and submit monthly and quarterly reports. Monitor implementation of unwanted expenditures within departments and public entities. Coordinate and facilitate review of monthly and quarterly registers on unauthorised irregular, fruitless and wasteful expenditures by all public entities. Coordinate Irregular Expenditure Condonement Committee (IECC) meetings in terms of Logistics i.e., attendance registers, preparation and sending of packs, drafting of minutes, and issuing out invites. Receive applications for condonement from public entities and conduct assessment and advise the committee in terms of compliance to PFMA compliance and reporting framework.

xh.title: Umphathi oNcedisayo: Ulawulo,okuQwalaselayo nokwamkelwa koMthetho
xh.summary: Qhubele inqanaba lokwamkelwa koMthetho kwe-PFMA nokubhalwa kweenkqubo kumacandelo karhulumente wesifunda iLimpopo, elifuna izifiqo zegunya le-NQF 7 kwezimali neminyaka emithathu yamava okusebenza njengesikhokelo.
xh.requirements: Isifiqo sika-NQF level 7 kwizezimali nentengiso / ekubaleni / ekulawulweni kwemali / ekuphononxongeni ngaphakathi njengoko kubhalwe ngayo i-SAQA. Iiminyaka emithathu (3) yamava okusebenza kwinqanaba lokubekwa njengesikhokelo / eliphezulu / njengokhulu bezolawulo ngaphakathi kwesiphithiphithi sokulawula ngaphakathi nasembindini wenkqubo efanayo. Ilayisenisi yomqhubi wesithuthi eseyinyaniso (ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubekileyo). ULwazi neNdlela: Ulwazi lohlobo olubalulekileyo lomzila wenkqubo njengakuqaliswe ngaphakathi: uQhelaniso, ukwenza ngoluvo, neNkqubo ekuhleliweyo yokuba yintoni na into. Imisebenzi yolawulo. Imisebenzi yesikhokeli. Isakhono esinamandla lokuphononxa iMatshini olawulwa liqela elibhekisa kwimali / i-PFMA neMiyalelo yamathrejhari. Ulungiselelo lweNgxelo. Isikhokelo sokuzibandakanya kwamava amakhulu aphathwayo. Isakhono sokubhalwa nokuqondwa kwesikrini, esilula kakhulu. Iindlela ezimiselweyo/nendlela eqhelanisiweyo nemfuneko. Iimfuno neenkqubo ezibalulekileyo eziqhelanisiweyo kunye nasekelo lweSebe. Isakhono sokuchaza nokubeka inkqubo yomthetho. Iingcinga ezilula. Isakhono sokubhala iingxelo. Isakhono esi: Isakhono sokukhokela iNkqubo. Isakhono seNkqubo yokulawula. Isakhono sokusebenzela iinkxwaleko. Isakhono sokulawula imali. Isakhono sokulawula iNdlela ekuqaliswa ngayo umthetho weNkqubo. Ukuzinza ngokuchanabusuku kusetyenziswa kwemisebenzi ebalulekileyo. Ulawulo lweNkqubo. Ulawulo lokuvela kolunye uhlangothi. Ukuguquguqeka kwemisebenzi ngokomthetho wefuthe.
xh.duties: Lungelelanisa ukusebenza okuhambelana nemigangatho, iinkqubo ezimiselweyo, iinkqubo zolawulo kunye nemikhawulo encedisayo kumacandelo karhulumente wesifunda kuquka neziko eliyinkampani. Bhalu iinkqubo nendlela entsha ngokomthetho wesiKhuluma 18 se-PFMA. Lungelanisa uhlu lwe-PFMA nemila yeMatshini yolawulo. Qedelela inkqubo yesakhono sokulawula imali kwintengiso enkulu karhulumente wesifunda iphela, kuqulathe imisebenzi engalinganisela kwiNkqubo yokuqhubeleka kwemigangatho yemveliso eqeshisayo namakhusela. Qedelela ukusekela kwizithuthi, kubandakanye amathuba okubonelela amanye amathuba okukhethwa kwakutsha, kwaye iqinisekise ukubonelelwa ngesikhalazo ngobudlova obungalunganga. Hlola ukwenza kweenkqubo zamagunyaziso omthetho karhulumente ngokubonelela ngeenkqubo zolawulo ezifanelekileyo kwabasebenzi kunye nemiQathango yendalo yembali yemisebenzi. Zama ukusebenzisa inkqubo yolawulo ekulinganisweni kolunye uhlangothi lokuqala kwamathuba alo neziko eliqhutywa ziRhulumente. Bhalu inkqubo entsha phakathi kweziko elingawo nalawo makhaya welungelo lokuqonda ukuba ngoluvo luhamba phambili na. Lungelanisa ukumiselwa kolunye uhlangothi lokuqalisa amathuba ngokubonelela ngeNkqubo yolawulo olwaziwayo kwisiko elisebenzela iNkqubo yolawulo ngokuphathelele ekusingathweni kolunye uhlangothi. Tyhila inkqubo yamakhadi weNkqubo yokuqhubeleka kwamathuba ngokulinganisela isigqibo sokuqhubeleka komatshini welibandla neenkqubo ezichanabusayo. Sebenzisa inkqubo ngokuchumisa amaxesha amathathu angenamsebenzi njengoko kubalulekile kwiNkqubo yokulawula imali ichazwe ngoluvo lolunye uhlangothi lokuqhuba amathuba amakhulu. Bhalu iNgxelo yamathuba amathathu qho ekuboneleleni ngexesha elithathu kwexesha elifanelekileyo lokuqhubeleka kolunye uhlangothi. Tyhila nokubonelela ngenkqubo yolawulo oluphathwayo lweziko elenze ngenkqubo yokubonelela ngokumelana nokuqhubeleka kolunye uhlangothi. Lungelanisa inkqubo ekupheleni kolunye uhlangothi lokuqhubeleka kwamathuba, kwaye iqinisekise ukumiselwa kolunye uhlangothi ngexesha elifanelekileyo kwinkqubo eyiNqanaba lokulawula ezizezatshwa. Bhalu inkqubo yamathuba amathathu ngo-30 yemihla kuqhubeleka ekusingathweni kolunye uhlangothi. Bhalu inkqubo eqondene nokusingathwa kolunye uhlangothi lokuqhubeleka kwamathuba ngokulinganisela isigqibo sokuqhubeleka komthetho weNkqubo yolawulo. Bhalu inkqubo yokusingatha amathuba amathathu njengoko kubonelelwa ngokumiselwa kolunye uhlangothi lokuqhubeleka kwamathuba. Yenza iNgxelo yamathuba athathu ngenkqubo yokulungisa nokubonelela ngeenkqubo ezifanelekileyo zeNkqubo yokulawula. Bhalu inkqubo yamathuba athathu ngokumiselwa kolunye uhlangothi ekuqhubelekeni kolunye uhlangothi. Bhalu inkqubo yokusingathwa kolunye uhlangothi ngenkqubo yokubonelela ngexesha elithathu kwixesha elifanelekileyo lokuqhubeleka kolunye uhlangothi. Bhalu inkqubo yokubonelela ngenkqubo yamathuba amathathu ekuqhubelekeni kolunye uhlangothi. Lungelanisa nokubonelela ngemigaqo yokubonelela ngeenkqubo ezifanelekileyo zeNkqubo yolawulo ngamathuba amathathu njengoko kuchaziwe kumthetho wokuqhubeleka. Hlola nokubonelela ngeenkqubo zolawulo zomthetho weNkqubo yolawulo njengoko kuchazwe kumthetho weNkqubo yolawulo. Sebenzisa nokubonelela ngeenkqubo ezifanelekileyo zokuqhubeleka kolunye uhlangothi ekuqhubelekeni kolunye uhlangothi. Bhalu iNgxelo yamathuba amathathu eqondene nokuqhubeleka kolunye uhlangothi ekuqhubelekeni kolunye uhlangothi. Bhalu iNgxelo yamathuba amathathu ngokubonelela ngeenkqubo ezifanelekileyo zokuqhubeleka kolunye uhlangothi. Lungelanisa nokubonelela ngeenkqubo ezifanelekileyo zokuqhubeleka kolunye uhlangothi. Bhalu inkqubo yokusingathwa kolunye uhlangothi ekuqhubelekeni kolunye uhlangothi. Lungelanisa nokubonelela ngeenkqubo ezifanelekileyo zokuqhubeleka kolunye uhlangothi.

jobs.summary: Assistant Director needed at Limpopo Provincial Treasury to implement financial systems, map business processes and manage BPM projects.

Three (3) years’ functional experience at Supervisory level / Senior / State Accountant in Business Analysis / Financial Information Systems / System Development. Valid vehicle driver’s license (with exception of persons with disabilities). Knowledge & Skills: Sound and in-depth knowledge of ICT operations, Systems development, ICT Governance and Programme / Project Management and relevant ICT regulations and Prescripts. Ability to convert business requirements into ICT technical requirements as well as system development using relevant technology, Promotion of Access of Information Act, Negotiation skills. People Management. Financial solving. Planning & organising. Time management. Strategic Planning. Policy analysis and development. Good communication skills. Computer software programs (Word, Excel and PowerPoint). Facilitation skills. Co-ordination skills. Leadership skills. Change and Knowledge Management. Group dynamics. Diversity Management.
jobs.duties: Mapping of business processes to maximise effectiveness and efficiencies in the province. Lay BPM foundation engage on stakeholder analysis and manage BPM projects and formulate future shaping force. Compile process inventory. Establish performance measures, measure process performance, analyse performance gaps, determine process vision and design principle for new processes. Determine improvement approach. Develop high level process alternative and conduct details process design. Develop implementation plan. Monitor process performance. Document all necessary documents. Implement new financial systems and enhance existing. Assess new system requests. Conduct research and benchmark on financial systems. Develop an assessment report. Develop a business case. Prepare / develop implementation plan. Conduct post implementation analysis and support on newly implemented systems. Draft a post implementation and support report. Review and improve on current business processes. Consult with clients (Government Departments) management and personnel to identify, define, and document business needs and objectives, current operational procedures, problems, input requirements, and levels of systems access. Identify opportunities for improving business process through information systems and / or non-system driver changes. Assist in the preparation of proposals to develop new systems and / or operational changes. Identify and document gaps between current and desired state for systems and process. Develop and maintain project documentation including business requirements, functional specification, and test plans. Participate in project planning and estimation activities. Serve as liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams to ensure that business requirements are accurately translated into technical solutions. Conduct user acceptance testing (UAT) and ensure that solutions meet business requirements. Conduct on job training for end-users. Improve and reengineer existing business processes. Map current business that incorporates financial systems according to Toolkit on Public Service Business Process Mapping. Assist with the development of a business case, scope and requirements documents. Conduct research on implementation approached strategies. Develop assessment reports. Prepare / develop implementation plans. Conduct benchmark exercise on financial systems. Ensure effective participation in administering specific ADHOC projects. Organize meetings with implementing Departments. Scribe meeting discussions. Document minutes and resolution registers. Analyse and document business processes. Conduct readiness assessment for implementation of new systems. Develop assessment reports with recommendation. Develop implementation plans.
