af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Implementering van Finansiële Stelsels
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur benodig by Limpopo Provincial Treasury om finansiële stelsels te implementeer, besigheidsprosesse in kaart te bring en BPM-projekte te bestuur.
af.requirements: NQF-vlak 6-kwalifikasie in Finansiële Inligtingstelsels / Besigheidsontleding / Stelselontwikkeling / Inligtingstegnologie (IT) of verwante veld soos erken deur SAQA. Drie (3) jaar se funksionele ervaring op Toesighoudende vlak / Senior / Staat-rekenmeester in Besigheidsontleding / Finansiële Inligtingstelsels / Stelselontwikkeling. Geldige bestuurslisensie vir voertuie (met uitsondering van persone met gestremdhede). Kennis & Vaardighede: Deeglike en diepgaande kennis van ICT-bedrywighede, stelselontwikkeling, ICT-bestuur en Program-/Projekbestuur en tersaaklike ICT-regulasies en Voorskrifte. Vermoë om besigheidsvereistes om te sit in ICT-tegniese vereistes asook stelselontwikkeling deur gebruik te maak van tersaaklike tegnologie, Bevordering van Toegang tot Inligting-wet, Onderhandelingsvaardighede. Mensebestuur. Finansiële oplossing. Beplanning & organiserende. Tydbestuur. Strategiese beplanning. Beleidsontleding en -ontwikkeling. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede. Rekenaar sagtewareprogramme (Word, Excel en PowerPoint). Fasiliteringsvaardighede. Koördineringsvaardighede. Leierskapsvaardighede. Veranderings- en Kennisbestuur. Groepsdinamika. Diversiteitsbestuur.
af.duties: In kaart bring van besigheidsprosesse om doeltreffendheid en effektiwiteit in die provinsie te maksimeer. Lê BPM-grondslag, skakel in op belanghebbende-ontleding en bestuur BPM-projekte en formuleer toekomstige vormkrag. Stel proses-inventaris op. Vestig prestasiemaatstawwe, meet prosesprestasie, ontleed prestasieklowe, bepaal prosesvisie en ontwerpbeginsel vir nuwe prosesse. Bepalingsverbeteringsbenadering. Ontwikkel hoëvlak-prosesalternatief en voer gedetailleerde prosesontwerp uit. Ontwikkel implementeringsplan. Monitor prosesprestasie. Dokumenteer alle noodsaaklike dokumente. Implementeer nuwe finansiële stelsels en verbeter bestaande. Evalueer nuwe stelselversoeke. Voer navorsing en vergelyking uit op finansiële stelsels. Ontwikkel 'n assesseringsverslag. Ontwikkel 'n besigheidsgeval. Berei / ontwikkel implementeringsplan voor. Voer na-implementering-ontleding uit en gee ondersteuning op nuut geïmplementeerde stelsels. Stel 'n na-implementering- en ondersteuningsverslag op. Hersien en verbeter huidige besigheidsprosesse. Raadpleeg kliënte (Regeringsdepartemente) se bestuur en personeel om besigheidsbehoeftes en -doelwitte, huidige operasionele prosedures, probleme, invoereistes en vlakke van stelseltoegang te identifiseer, te definieer en te dokumenteer. Identifiseer geleenthede om besigheidsprosesse te verbeter deur inligtingstelsels en / of nie-stelsel-aandrywer-veranderinge. Bied hulp by die voorbereiding van voorstelle om nuwe stelsels en / of operasionele veranderings te ontwikkel. Identifiseer en dokumenteer kloof tussen huidige en verlangde toestand vir stelsels en prosesse. Ontwikkel en onderhou projekdokumentasie insluitend besigheidsvereistes, funksionele spesifikasie en toetsplanne. Neem deel aan projekbeplanning en skattingsaktiwiteite. Tree op as skakel tussen besigheidsbelanghebbendes en tegniese spanne om te verseker dat besigheidsvereistes akkuraat vertaal word in tegniese oplossings. Voer gebruikersaanvaardingtoetsing (UAT) uit en verseker dat oplossings aan besigheidsvereistes voldoen. Voer op-die-werk opleiding vir eindgebruikers uit. Verbeter en herontwerp bestaande besigheidsprosesse. Bring huidige besigheid wat finansiële stelsels inkorporeer in kaart volgens Toolkit on Public Service Business Process Mapping. Bied hulp met die ontwikkeling van 'n besigheidsgeval, omvang en vereistedokumente. Voer navorsing uit oor implementeringsbenaderingstrategieë. Ontwikkel assesseringsverslae. Berei / ontwikkel implementeringsplanne voor. Voer vergelykings-oefening op finansiële stelsels uit. Verseker effektiewe deelname aan die administrering van spesifieke ADHOC-projekte. Reël vergaderings met implementerende Departemente. Skryf vergaderingsbesprekings neer. Dokumenteer notules en besluite-registers. Ontleed en dokumenteer besigheidsprosesse. Voer gereedheidsassessering uit vir implementering van nuwe stelsels. Ontwikkel assesseringsverslae met aanbeveling. Ontwikkel implementeringsplanne.

zu.title: Onozanele: Ukusebenza Kwezinhlelo Zezimali
zu.summary: Kudingeka Onozanele e-Limpopo Provincial Treasury ukuphatha izinhlelo ezimali, ukwabalaza inqubo yezoshintsho kanye nokuphatha amaphrojekthi e-BPM.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezinga le-NQF 6 kwi-Financial Information Systems / Business Analysis / System Development / Information Technology (IT) noma esimweni ohlobene njengoba kuqashelwe yi-SAQA. Eminyakeni amathathu (3) okuhlangenwe nakho okusebenzayo ezingeni labagqogi / ebakhe / e-State Accountant kwi-Business Analysis / Financial Information Systems / System Development. Ilayisense yokushayela isithuthi esivunyelwe (ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubazekile). Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi olujulile nolukumoyo ngokusebenza kwe-ICT, intuthuko yezinhlelo, i-ICT Governance kanye noPhathi Wezinhlelo / Amaphrojekthi kanye nomthetho ohlobene newaka. Isikhono sokuguqula izidingo zeshintsho zaba zezidingo ezingamandla e-ICT kanye nentuthuko yezinhlelo ngobuchwepheshe obuhlobene, Promotion of Access of Information Act, izikhono zoxhumano nabantu. Uphathiwezabantu. Ukuxazulula izinkinga ezingezimali. Ukucubungula nokuqamba. Ukuphatha isikhathi. Ukucubungula okuhlelekile. Ukuhlazulwa nentuthuko yomthethosisekelo. Amakhono okuxhumana ohlelo. Izinhlelo zesoftware (Word, Excel kanye nePowerPoint). Amakhono okukhuthaza abanye. Amakhono okuqinisekisa ukuthi kuhamba kahle konke. Amakhono okubusa. Ukuphatha ulwazi noshintsho. Ukujwayelana kweqembu. Ukuphatha okuhlukene.
zu.duties: Ukwabalaza inqubo yoshintsho ukuze kugcine isigaba esiphezulu ngamandla. Ukumisa umqondo ophezu kwakho konke okushintshayo, ukuxhumana nabo bonke abahlobene kwaye uphathe imibhalo ephathwa ngaphakathi kwezinhlelo. Ukuqamba uhlu lwezinhlelo. Ukumisa izindlela zokuqinisekisa amandla, ukulinganisa amandla ohlelo, ukuqonda izikhungo ezingenawo, bese ucacisa umqondo wakho nendlela ozodinga ukuze uhlele izinhlelo ezisha. Ukucacisaindlela yokuphucula. Ukuphucula izindlela ezinkulu ezihlukene bese uhlela kahle inqubo yezinhlelo. Ukumisa isu sokusetshenziswa. Ukulandela isikhathi esihle ohlelweni. Ukugcina imibalo yonke imibhalo edingekayo. Ukusebenzisa izinhlelo zezimali ezisha bese uphucula ezeledlule. Ukulinganisa izicelo ezizohlela. Ukuphenya futhi ulinganiselle ezinye izindlela zezimali ezingasebenza. Ukuphucula isibali. Ukuphucula isibali senhlangano. Ukuqamba / ukuphucula isu sokusetshenziswa. Ukuphenya ngemva kokusebenzisa izinhlelo bese unikeza inkosazo ngehlelo elitsha. Ukuphatha umbhalo ngemva kokusebenzisa nokunika isibali sokuphathwa kwesinxaxiwe. Ukucubungula futhi uphucule ezinye izindlela zenhlangano. Ukubonisana nabantu abangamagunyazi eminyango yahulumeni nabanasebenzayo ukuze bakwazi ukuqonda, ukubeka futhi baphefumule ngemigomo esesikhundleni, baphinde bajwayelane nezinkinga, baze bacacise izidingo abanazo. Ukufuna izikhundla ezingaba ngendlela yokuphucula izinto. Ukusiza ukulungiselela iziphakamiso zenhlangano. Ukucacisa izikhundla ezingezile. Ukuhlinzeka ngemibhalo ngenhloso yokuphathwa ngaphakathi kwezinhlelo. Ukusebenzisana ezinhlelweni zezezimali nasezinhlelo zokwenza izinto. Ukuxhumanisa izinhlelo kwezinsizakalo namaphoyisa ukuze kuqiniseke ukuthi izinhlelo zibekwe ngqo.

xh.title: Umncedisi weNkulumbuso: Ukusebenzisa iinkqubo zeMali
xh.summary: Kufuneka umncedisi weNkulumbuso kwi-Limpopo Provincial Treasury ukusebenzisa iinkqubo zemali, ukumisela iinkqubo zeshishini nokulawula amaprojekthi e-BPM.
xh.requirements: Ilanga lesi-6 le-NQF kwi-Financial Information Systems / Business Analysis / System Development / Information Technology (IT) okanye kwinto ekwanjalo njengoko kubonwa yi-SAQA. Iinyanga ezintathu (3) zemfundo yokusebenza kwinqanaba labaphathi / abaphezulu / ababali beSizwe kwi-Business Analysis / Financial Information Systems / System Development. Ilayiseni yokuqamba ibhenti esemthethweni (ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubazekileyo). Ulwazi & Amandla: Ulwazi olujulileyo nolungileyo ngemisebenzi ye-ICT, inkqubo yophuhliso, i-ICT Governance noLawulo lweNkqubo / Amaprojekthi nemigaqo ye-ICT edibene nayo. Imandla lokuguqula iimfuno zeshishini zibe yiimfuno ze-ICT ezobuchwephetshe kunye nophuhliso wenkqubo usebenzisa itekhnoloji edibene nayo, i-Promotion of Access of Information Act, amandla okuxoxisana. Ulawulo lwabantu. Ukusombulula imali. Uplani & ukuqamba. Ulawulo lwexesha. Uplani oqhubela phambili. Ukuhlalutya nokuphuhlisa iinkqubo. Amandla alo ngxoxo abalulekileyo. Iinkqubo zesoftware yekhompyutha (Word, Excel kunye ne-PowerPoint). Amandla okunceda. Amandla okulawula. Amandla okukhokela. Ulawulo Lotshintsho nolwazi. Iqela lendalo. Ulawulo lobuninzi.
xh.duties: Ukumisela iinkqubo zeshishini ukwandisa amandla nokusebenza kakuhle kwiphondo. Misela isiseko se-BPM, thabatha inxaxheba kukuqwalasela babambe elimanda ulawule amaprojekthi e-BPM uze udibe indawo ekwakha ixesha elizayo. Hlanganisa uluhlu lweenkqubo. Misela iziphumo zemisebenzi, linganisa iziphumo zeenkqubo, hlalutya iindlela ezingekoyo kwiziphumo, qamba ngcamango leenkqubo uyimisele inkqubo entsha. Qamba indlela yokuphucula. Phuhlisa iinkqubo ezinobumba osezantsi uze wenze ulwazi lweenkqubo. Phuhlisa indlela yokusebenzisa. Qwalasela iziphumo zeenkqubo. Bhala yonke imibhali efunekayo. Sebenzisa iinkqubo zemali ezintsha uze uzifunde ezingekhoyo. Qwalasela iimfuno zeenkqubo ezintsha. Yenza uphando ulinganise iinkqubo zemali. Hlaziya indawo yokulinganisa. Yeza ishishini. Lungelelisa / phuhlisa indlela yokusebenzisa. Yenza ukuhlalutya emva kokusebenzisa uze uxhase iinkqubo ezisetyenziswa kutsha. Bhala indawo yokusebenzisa nexhaso. Phucula iinkqubo zangoku zeshishini. Phangela nomphathiswa nakubasebenzi bakhamela (Iisebe zikaRhulumente) ukuze ubone, uchaze, uthi ubhale iimfuno neenjongo zeshishini, iinkqubo zangoku zokusebenza, iingxaki, iimfuno zolwazi, kunye namazinga okufikelela kwiinkqubo. Bona ithuba lokuphucula inkqubo yeshishini ngeenkqubo zolwazi kwaye okanye ngokuguqula izinto ezingezozenkqubo. Seda kulungiselelo lweenkqubo ezintsha kwaye okanye ulwazi lwezoshishino olutshintshiweyo. Bona uthi ubhale iindlela ezingekoyo phakathi kwendawo ekhoyo nendawo efunekayo kwiinkqubo neseenkqubo. Phuhlisa ugcine ulwazi lweprojekthi kuquka iimfuno zeshishini, inkqubo yemisebenzi, iinkqubo zovavanyo. Thabatha inxaxheba kuyilo lwerejekthi nakulinganiseni. Ziba ngxoxo phakathi kwabakhululekileyo beshishini namaqela obuchwephetshe ukuqinisekisa ukuba iimfuno zeshishini zigqithiswa ngokuchanekileyo kwizisombululo ezobuchwephetshe. Yenza uvavanyo lokwamkela (UAT) uze uqinisekise ukuba izisombululo zihlangabezana neemfuno zeshishini. Yenza ukhetho ngomsebenzi kubasebenzisi ekupheleni. Phucula uze wakhe ngokutsha iinkqubo zangoku zeshishini. Misela inkqubo yeshishini equlathe iinkqubo zemali ngokwe-Toolkit on Public Service Business Process Mapping. Seda ekuyilweni ishishini, ubungakanani nemibhali yokuqamba. Yenza uphando ngeendlela zokusebenzisa. Yeza iindawo zokuqwalasela. Lungiselela / yila indlela yokusebenzisa. Yenza uvavanyo lokulinganisa iinkqubo zemali. Qinisekisa ukuthatha inxaxheba ekulawuleni amaprojekthi athile e-ADHOC. Lungela iindibano nase-Departments ezisebenzisayo. Mbala iindlela zeendibano. Bhala emizuzwini naseerekhodi zesigqibo. Hlalutya uthi ubhale iinkqubo zeshishini. Yenza ukulinganisa ukulungelelanisa ukusebenzisa iinkqubo ezintsha. Phuhlisa iindawo zokuqwalasela ezinokuqulatha kumbono. Phuhlisa iindlela zokusebenzisa.

jobs.title: Network Controller
jobs.closing_date_text: 18 September 2026 @ 16H00. Late applications will not be considered. Failure to comply with the above requirements will result in the disqualification of the application.
jobs.summary: Network Controller providing end-user technical support at Limpopo Provincial Treasury Head Office, requiring an NQF level 6 IT qualification and two years' experience.
jobs.requirements: NQF level 6 qualification in Information Technology (IT) or related field as recognized by SAQA. Two (2) years’ functional experience in Information Technology or related field. Valid vehicle driver’s license (with exception of persons with disabilities). Knowledge & Skills: Sound and in-depth knowledge of relevant prescripts, and application of human resources as well as understanding of the legislative framework governing the Public Service. Managerial Functions. Finance. Human Resources Matters. Planning and organizing. Compilation of reports. Research/ Analysing. Computer Literate. Negotiation skills; People Management. Financial Management. Problem Solving. Planning & organizing. Time Management. Strategic Planning. Policy analysis and development. Good Communication skills. Group dynamic. Diversity management. Facilitation skills. Co-ordination skills. Leadership skills. Change and knowledge management. Planning and organization skills.
jobs.duties: Provide end user technical support. Provide first- and second-line technical support to end users by diagnosing and resolving hardware, software, network, and application-related issues. Assist users with the installation, configuration, and troubleshooting of ICT equipment and standard business applications to ensure effective system usage. Offer guidance, and user assistance to improve ICT literacy and ensure efficient and productive use of organisational systems and services. Administer a secure windows domain and server application environment infrastructure. Manage and maintain the Windows domain environment, including Active Directory, Group Policy, user accounts, and access controls to ensure secure and efficient identity and access management. Administer Windows Server infrastructure and related services, including configuration, patching, performance monitoring, and backup and recovery to ensure system availability and stability. Implement and enforce security controls across the server and domain environment, including access permissions, audit policies, antivirus/endpoint protection integration, and compliance with ICT security standards. Provide and manage LAN services. Design, configure, and maintain Local Area Network (LAN) infrastructure, including switches, routers, cabling, and wireless access points to ensure reliable connectivity. Monitor LAN performance and availability, troubleshoot network issues, and implement corrective actions to minimise downtime and ensure optimal network performance. Implement and enforce network security controls, including VLAN configuration, access control lists, and segmentation to protect organisational data and resources. Provide capacity monitor and planning. Monitor ICT infrastructure and application resource usage (including servers, storage, and network) to identify performance trends and potential capacity constraints. Analyse system performance data and generate capacity reports to support proactive planning and informed decision-making for future ICT requirements. Develop and implement capacity planning strategies to ensure scalable, efficient, and cost-effective ICT infrastructure aligned with organisational growth and service demand. Implement ICT infrastructure change request. Receive, log, and assess ICT infrastructure change requests to determine impact, feasibility, risks, and alignment with organisational standards and architecture. Plan, schedule, and coordinate the implementation of approved changes to ICT infrastructure, ensuring minimal disruption to operational services. Test, document, and validate implemented changes, including updating configuration records and ensuring successful handover into the production.
jobs.enquiries: Mesdames Elizba Kotze / B.P. Chaka / Conny Kgadima / K.H. Moremi / Mr. J.S. Nduli Tel No: (015) 298 7000
jobs.applications: Applicants may apply through the following website: https://erecruitment.limpopo.gov.za or Applicants should be submitted to: Director: Human Resource Management, Private Bag X 9486, Polokwane, 0700 OR Hand delivered to: ISMINI Towers Building, Office No. GOO2 (Ground Floor) Registry, 46 Hans van Ransburg Street, Polokwane, 0700. All General enquiries should be directed to Mesdames, Kotze Elizba, Chaka Pearl, Kgadima Conny, Moremi Hilda & Mr. Nduli J.S. Tel No: (015) 298 7000.
jobs.notes: The advert will be posted on the following websites www.limtreasury.gov.za / www.limpopo.gov.za and www.dpsa.gov.za and Provincial Departments social media Applications must be submitted on new Z83 forms obtainable from all Government Departments or can be downloaded from www.dpsa.gov.za or www.gov.za. The new Z83 form must be completed in manner that provides sufficient information about the candidate and the post he or she applies for by completing all relevant fields. The following must be considered in relation to the completion of the Z83 by applicants. All the fields in Part A, Part C and Part D should be completed. In Part B, all fields should be completed in full except the following: South African applicants need not to provide passport numbers. If an applicant responds “no” to the question “Are you conducting business with the State or are you a Director of a Public or Private Company conducting business with the State?” then the answer to the next question “In the event that you are employed in the Public Service, you immediately relinquish such business interests?” can be left blank or indicated as not applicable. A “not applicable” or blank response will be allowed on the question “If your profession or occupation requires official registration, provide date and particulars of registration”; if you are not in possession of such registration. Noting there is limited space provided for Part E, F & G, applicants often indicate “refer to Curriculum Vitae (CV) or see attached”, this is acceptable as long as the CV has been attached and provides the required information. If the information is not provided in the CV, the applicant may be disqualified. It must be noted that a CV is an extension of the application of employment Z83, and applicants are accountable for the information that is provided therein. Applicants currently employed by the public service do not need to complete Part F as the section is intended for those seeking re-employment, as their prior employment can be verified through their CV. The declaration should be completed and signed. Applicants must utilize the most recent Z83 application for employment form as issued by the Minister of Public Service and Administration in line with Regulation 10 of the Public Service Regulations, 2016, failure to do so results in disqualifications. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application but must submit the Z83 and detailed Curriculum Vitae. It must be noted that the CV is an extension of an application of an employment Z83, and applicants are accountable for the information that is provided therein. The Z83 form must be completed in the manner that allows the selection committee to assess the quality of the candidate based on the information that is contained in the form. The Department will require shortlisted candidates to provide certified copies of their qualifications and any other relevant document, which must be submitted to HR on or before the interview date. A specific reference number for the post applied for must be quoted in the space provided on the new form Z83. Applicants with foreign qualifications remain responsible for ensuring that their qualifications are evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) and therefore must submit the copies of certificates and evidence of evaluation by the SAQA for foreign qualification if they are invited to attend interviews. Successful incumbents will be expected to sign a performance agreement within one month after assumption of duty. All shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a security clearance and verification of qualifications. Shortlisted applicants will be required to provide their original qualification certificates and ID on the day of the interview for other relevant verification purposes. The recommended candidate will further be subjected to Personnel Suitability Checks, including financial disclosure requirements, social media screening, and other relevant verification processes. All successful candidates will be subjected to the applicable security clearance processes. All shortlisted candidates will be subjected to pre-entry assessments prior to the interview process. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts, will be subjected to a technical exercise and Interview. Following technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. To ensure that potential SMS members have a background on processes and procedures linked to the SMS, a further requirement for appointment at SMS level will be the successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-entry Programme (Nyukela) as endorsed by the National School of Government with effect from 1st April 2020. This is a Public Service specific training programme which will be applicable for appointments at SMS level. The link for the completion of the pre-entry certificate is as follows: www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme.           Individuals who have completed the course already, and who are therefore in possession of a certificate are welcome to submit such. However, all SMS short-listed candidates will be required to have completed certificate and submit such upon appointment. All shortlisted candidates for other posts shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only, due to the large number of applications we envisage to receive and if you have not heard from the Department within 90 days of the closing date, please accept that your application has been unsuccessful. However, should there be any dissatisfaction, applicants are hereby advised to, within 90 days, request reasons from the Department for any administrative action which has adversely affected them in terms of section 5, sub-section 1 and 2 of the Promotion of Administrative Justice Act 3 of 2000. The Department reserves the right not to make any appointment to the post advertised. The employment decision shall be informed by the Employment Equity Plan of the Department. NB! Candidates who applied before for the re-advertised vacant post are encouraged to re-apply. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Netwerkbeheerder
af.summary: Netwerkbeheerder wat tegniese ondersteuning aan eindgebruikers by Limpopo Provinsiale Tesour-hoofkantoor bied, wat 'n NQF-vlak 6 IT-kwalifikasie en twee jaar se ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: NQF level 6 kwalifikasie in Inligtingstegnologie (IT) of verwante veld soos deur SAQA erken. Twee (2) jaar se funksionele ervaring in Inligtingstegnologie of verwante veld. Geldige bestuurderslisensie (met uitsondering van persone met gestremdhede). Kennis & Vaardighede: Deeglike en diepgaande kennis van relevante voorskrifte, en toepassing van menslike hulpbronne asook begrip van die wetgewende raamwerk wat die Openbare Diens regeer. Bestuursfunksies. Finansies. Menslike hulpbron-sake. Beplanning en organisering. Opstel van verslae. Navorsing/Analise. Rekenaargeletterd. Onderhandelingsvaardighede; Mensebestuur. Finansiële bestuur. Probleemoplossing. Beplanning & organisering. Tydsbestuur. Strategiese beplanning. Beleidsanalise en -ontwikkeling. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede. Groepdinamika. Diversiteitsbestuur. Fasiliteringsvaardighede. Koördinasievaardighede. Leierskapsvaardighede. Veranderings- en kennisbestuur. Beplannings- en organisasievaardighede.
af.duties: Verskaf tegniese ondersteuning aan eindgebruikers. Verskaf eerste- en tweedelyn-tegniese ondersteuning aan eindgebruikers deur hardeware-, sagteware-, netwerk- en toepassingsverwante probleme te diagnostiseer en op te los. Bied gebruikers bystand met die installasie, konfigurasie en probleemoplossing van ICT-toerusting en standaard besigheidstoepassings om doeltreffende stelselgebruik te verseker. Bied leiding en gebruikersbystand om ICT-geletterdheid te verbeter en doeltreffende en produktiewe gebruik van organisatoriese stelsels en dienste te verseker. Administreer 'n veilige Windows-domein en bediener-toepassingsomgewing-infrastruktuur. Bestuur en onderhou die Windows-domeinomgewing, insluitend Active Directory, Group Policy, gebruikersrekeninge en toegangsbeheer om veilige en doeltreffende identiteits- en toegangsbestuur te verseker. Administreer Windows-bediener-infrastruktuur en verwante dienste, insluitend konfigurasie, Herstel van foute, prestasie-monitering en rugsteun en herstel om stelselbeskikbaarheid en stabiliteit te verseker. Implementeer en handhaaf sekuriteitsbeheer oor die bediener- en domeinomgewing, insluitend toegangsregte, ouditbeleid, antivirus/eindpuntbeskermings-integrasie en voldoening aan ICT-sekuriteitsstandaarde. Verskaf en bestuur LAN-dienste. Ontwerp, konfigureer en onderhou Local Area Network (LAN)-infrastruktuur, insluitend skakelaars, roeteerders, kabels en draadlose toegangspunte om betroubare konnektiwiteit te verseker. Monitor LAN-prestasie en -beskikbaarheid, los netwerkprobleme op en implementeer regstellende maatreëls om uittyd te verminder en optimale netwerkprestasie te verseker. Implementeer en handhaaf netwerksekuriteitsbeheer, insluitend VLAN-konfigurasie, toegangsbeheerlyste en segmentering om organisatoriese data en hulpbronne te beskerm. Verskaf kapasiteitsmonitering en -beplanning. Monitor ICT-infrastruktuur en toepassingshulpbron-gebruik (insluitend bedienaars, berging en netwerk) om prestasietendense en potensiële kapasiteitsbeperkings te identifiseer. Analiseer stelselprestasiedata en genereer kapasiteitsverslae om proaktiewe beplanning en ingeligte besluitneming vir toekomstige ICT-vereistes te ondersteun. Ontwikkel en implementeer kapasiteitsbeplanningsstrategieë om skaalbare, doeltreffende en kostedoeltreffende ICT-infrastruktuur te verseker wat op organisatoriese groei en diensvraag afgestem is. Implementeer ICT-infrastruktuur-veranderingsversoeke. Ontvang, boek en evalueer ICT-infrastruktuur-veranderingsversoeke om impak, haalbaarheid, risiko's en ooreenstemming met organisatoriese standaarde en argitektuur te bepaal. Beplan, skeduleer en koördineer die implementering van goedgekeurde veranderinge aan ICT-infrastruktuur en verseker minimale ontwrigting van operasionele dienste. Toets, dokumenteer en valigeer geïmplementeerde veranderinge, insluitend die opdatering van konfigurasierekords en die versekering van suksesvolle oorhandiging na produksie.

zu.title: UmLawuli Wethuluzi
zu.summary: UmLawuli Wethuluzi onikeza inkxaso yobuchwepheshe kubasebenzisi abaphela eLimpopo Provincial Treasury Head Office, ofuna isiqui se-NQF level 6 kuleyo ithuluzi nobangalo weminyaka emibili.
zu.requirements: Isiqui se-NQF level 6 kwi-Information Technology (IT) noma inkundla ephathelene nayo njengokuvunyelwe yi-SAQA. Iminyaka emi(2) yokuxhathisa kwi-Information Technology noma inkundla ephathelene nayo. Ilayisensi evunyelweyo yokushayela ibhasi (ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubazelekile). Ulwazi nothotho & Ozwela: Ulwazi olubhetyebe obunzulu ngokumila okufanelekileyo, nokusetyenziswa kweemisebenzi yezemveliso njengoko ukuqonda ingqungquthela yomthetho ohlala ngenkululeko yekomkhulu yemisebenzi kahulumeni. Iinkqubo zobukhosi. Iimali. Izinto ezimalini nabantu. Ulawulo lweplani nokubumba. Ukulungiselela iingxelo. Ulwazi/ ukuhlaziywa. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuxoxisana ngeemvisiswano; Ukulawula abantu. Ulawulo lwemali. Isisombululo sezixhobo. Ulawulo nokubumba. Ulawulo lwexesha. Ulawulo lwebhizinisi elibhetyebe. Ukuhlaziywa nokusungula iinkqubo zomthetho. Ulwazi oluhle lokunxibelelanayo. Ukuzonkelelana kweqela. Ulawulo lwezinto ezahlukeneyo. Amakhono okunika isikhokelo. Amakhono oqoqosho. Amakhono obunkokheli. Ulawulo lokuqonda nokutshintsha. Amakhono olawulo lokubumba nokuhlela.
zu.duties: Nikeza inkxaso yobuchwepheshe kumsebenzisi ophela. Nikeza inkxaso yobuchwepheshe yokuqala neyesibini kubasebenzisi abaphela ngokwahlula nangokumisela izixhobo, izixhobo zesoftware, inethiwekhi, neengoqo ezinxulumene noyilo. Nceda abasebenzisi ngokufakela, ukuqwalasela, nokumisela iingoqo ze-ICT nezicelo zabakboni ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusetyenziswa kwezi ngqangqo. Nikeza isikhokelo, noncedo kumsebenzisi ukuphusa ulwazi lwe-ICT ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusetyenziswa ngempumelelo nokuzithoba kweekqubo zezenkampani neemveliso. Lawula indawo yekhompyutha ekhuselekileyo yamaserver namakhonkco we-ICT. Lawula ngokugcinwa indawo yekhompyutha yamawindows, kuquka i-Active Directory, i-Group Policy, ama-akhawunti abasebenzisi, nolawulo lokungena ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuzibeka ngokukhuselekileyo nangempumelelo nokungena. Lawula i-ICT yamawindows server ngeemveliso eziphathelene nayo, kuquka ukuqwalasela, ukulungisa, ukuphatha ukusebenza, nokugcina nokubuyisa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukubakho nokuzinza kwenkqubo. Seka ukuze uqalise iinkqubo zolawulo lokhuseleko kwindawo yamaserver nakwindawo yamawindows, kuquka iimvume zokungena, iinkqubo zokuqwalasela, i-antivirus/endpoint protection nokudibanisa nokuhambelana neendidi zolawulo lokhuseleko le-ICT. Nikeza nolawulo iinkonzo ze-LAN. Yila, qwalasela, ugcine i-ICT yendawo ye-LAN, kuquka i-switch, i-router, i-cabling, namachapha ongenisa ukuxhumana ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuxhumana okuzinileyo. Qwalasela ukusebenza kokubakho kwe-LAN, misela iinkinga zenethiwekhi, seka iinyathelo zokuqwalasela ukuze kunciphiswe isixa sokuqhwesha kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza okuhle kwenethiwekhi. Seka ukuze uqalise iinkqubo zolawulo lokhuseleko i-LAN, kuquka ukuqwalasela i-VLAN, ooludwe bolawulo lokungena, nokwahlula ukuze kukhuselwe i-data namaphulo enkampani. Nikeza ukuphatha i-LAN ulwazi. Qwalasela i-ICT nokusetyenziswa kweemveliso zayo, (kuquka amaserver, i-storage, inethiwekhi) ukuze kubonakale iindidi zokusebenza neemfihlelo ezingase zibe khona. Hlaziya idata yokusebenza kwenkqubo uze udale iingxelo ze-LAN ukuze uxhase ulwazi oluzinileyo nezigqibo ezilungileyo iimfuno ze-ICT eziyakwenzeka. Yila uze useke iinkqubo zobuLawuli be-LAN, ukuze kuqinisekiswe i-ICT ezikwazi ukwanda, ngokusebenza ngokuzinileyo nangokuhambelana namaphulo enkampani nokufuna iinkonzo. Seka inkqubo ye-ICT yokutshintsha i-ICT. Amukela, bhala, qwalasela izicelo zokutshintsha i-ICT ukuze kumiswe ukumilisela, ukwenzeka, iingozi, nokuhambelana neendidi zamasiko nenyolo yenkampani. Hlela, cwangcisa, nqamanisa ukuqalisa okuvunyelwe kokutshintsha i-ICT, kuqinisekisa ukusilela okuncinciweyo kumasebenzi ekhompyutha. Vavanya, bhala, qinisekisa okuqalisiweyo, kuquka ukuvuselela iirekhodi zokuqwalasela nokuqinisekisa ukudluliselwa okuphumeleleyo kumveliso.

xh.title: Umlawuli wothungelwano
xh.summary: UmLawuli wothungelwano onika inkxaso yobuchwepheshe kubasebenzisi abagqithisileyo kwiNtaba leNgqikithi yePhando loMnga weLimpopo, efunayo izifundo ze-IT zendqanaba le-6 le-NQF kunye neminyaka emibini yamava.
xh.requirements: Isifundo sendqanaba le-6 le-NQF kwi-Information Technology (IT) okwele ndalo echongekayo ku-SAQA. Iminyaka emibini (2) yamava osebenzayo kwi-Information Technology okwele ndalo. Ilayiseni esemthethweni yokuqhuba ivehikile (ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubekileyo). Ulwazi & Amakhono: Ulwazi olunjalo nolujulileyo lwezaziso ezithintelweyo, nokusetyenziswa kwezabaluwa kunye nokuqonda kwesiseko somthetho esilawula iNkonzo kaRhament. Iimisebenzi yoBaphathi. IzeMali. Iindaba zezaBalUlu. Ucoco nolungiselelO. Ukuqulunqa iingxelo. Uphononongo/ Ukuqhelanisa. Ukusebenzisa iKhompyutha. Amakhono omboniswano; uLawulo lwabantu. uLawulo lwezeMali. Ukusombulula iingxaki. Ucoco & ulungiselelO. uLawulo lwexesha. Ucoco lwezQhiso. Ukuhlaziya nokuphepha iinqobo. Amakhono oThetho alungileyo. Ingcengwa yamaqela. uLawulo lweahlukahlukene. Amakhono oSika. Amakhono oQhelaniso. Amakhono eNkokeli. uLawulo lotshintsho nolwazi. Amakhono ococo nolungiselelo.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso yobuchwepheshe kumsebenzisi. Nika inkxaso yobuchwepheshe yomgca wokuqala nowesibini kubasebenzisi ngokutsha kunye nokusombulula iingxaki ezinxulumene ne-hardware, isoftware, uthungelwano, nakwizicelo. Nceda abasebenzisi ngokufakela, uqwalaselo, nokusombulula iingxaki zempahlo ye-ICT nakwezicelo zeshishini ezinqamlezileyo ukuze kuqiniseke isetyenziso sefundo esebenzayo. Nika inkqokelela, nenkxaso kumsebenzisi ukuze kuphuculwe ulwazi lwe-ICT ukuze kuqiniseke isetyenziso esebenzayo nevela nzuzo kwindalo nezinkonzo zoluntu. Lawula indalo egqithisileyo yedomeyini ye-windows kunye neendawo zesicelo seseva. Lawula zigcinile udimeyini yendalo ye-Windows, kuquka i-Active Directory, i-Group Policy, iakhawunti zabasebenzisi, kunye noLawulo lokufikelela ukuze kuqiniseke uLawulo olukhuselekileyo nolusebenzayo lobuni nokufikelela. Lawula i-Windows Server kunye neendawo zendalo nezinkonzo eziphantsi kwayo, kuquka uqwalaselo, ukulungisa, ukuqwalasela ukusebenza, kunye negcino nokuBuyisela ukuze kuqiniseke ukufumaneka nokuzinza kofundo. Fakela uLawulo ngokhuselO esiweni sedomeyini nakwiseva, kuquka iimvume zokufikelela, iinqobo zokuqwalasela, intsingiselo ye-antivirus/ukhuselo lwegqitha-nqanaba, nokuzinza kumagatya okuKhuseleka kwe-ICT. Nika ulawule iinkonzo ze-LAN. Yila, qwalasele, zigcine iNhlonipho yomSebenzi wothungelwano i-LAN, kuquka izinto zokutshintsha, abaqhubi bezithuba, izintambo, kunye neendawo zokufikelela ezingenamva ukuze kuqiniseke ukudibanisa okuqinileyo. Qwalasela ukusebenza nokufumaneka kwe-LAN, sombula iingxaki zothungelwano, uze ufake izenzo zokulungisa ukuze kunciphiswe ixesha elingasebenziyo ukuze kuqiniseke ukusebenza okuqiqiweyo kolwazi oluya kothungelwano. Fakela uLawulo ngokhuselO kothungelwano, kuquka uqwalaselo lwe-VLAN, uludwe lokuLawula ukufikelela, nokwahlukanisa ukuze kukhuselwe iingcaciso nezibonelelo zoluntu. Nika uLawulo wokulinganisa amandla, ucoco. Qwalasela ukusetyenziswa kweNtaba yamandla e-ICT kwizicelo (kuquuka iinkonzo, iNgcino, kunye noThungelwano) ukuze kuqatshulwe iqhingqa lokusebenza iingqiqo ezinokubakho kwingqinaniso amandla. Qwalasela iNgcaciso yokusebenza sefundo uze uqulunxe iingxelo zamandla ukuze ixhase ucoco olusandayo nokuThatha iNgqina kwimfuno ye-ICT yesi nakunAla. Phepha fAKELA iNdaba zoCoco lolungiselelo lamandLa ukuze kuqiniseke iNtaba yamandLa e-ICT egqwagqwayo, esebenzayo, nengena nzuzo eNgqamanisiyo nentAnyo ngenkqubela yalUluntu iFundo imfuno. FAKELA iSicelo sokuTshintsha iNtaba yamandLa e-ICT. Amkele, qhube, qwalasele iSicelo sokuTshintsha iNtaba yamandLa e-ICT ukuze kuqatshulwe umPhumo, ukwenzeka, iingozi, noDibaniso nemigaqo yoluntu nendalo. Coco, Lungiselela, uze uQwalasele ukufakela oko guquliweyo kwiNtaba yamandLa e-ICT, kuqinise isiphithiphithi esincinyane kwiNkonzo eziphilayo. Vavanya, qamba, qiniseKe iinguTshintsho ezingenwe ngaphakathi, kuquka ukuNcedisa iinguCaciso zoQwalaselo nokuQinisekisa ukudluliselwa okupumeleleyo kwaba kwindalo yokwenziwa.

jobs.title: Logistic Practitioner’s
jobs.closing_date_text: 18 September 2026 @ 16H00. Late applications will not be considered. Failure to comply with the above requirements will result in the disqualification of the application.
jobs.summary: Logistics practitioner sought at Limpopo Provincial Treasury in Polokwane to capture and verify memorandum of goods and services documentation.
jobs.requirements: NQF level 6 qualification in Supply Chain Management / Financial Management / Logistics Management or related field as recognised by SAQA. Two (2) years’ working experience in Logistics / Supply Chain Management or related field. LOGIS Certificate / Results. Knowledge & Skills: Knowledge of variety of work ranges and procedures such as, Managerial functions. Finance. Human Resource matters; Planning and organizing. Compilation of reports. Research \ analysing. Technical / standards / procedures. Needs and priorities of the Department. Ability to interpret and apply policy. Analytical and innovative thinking. Ability to operate computer. Conflict Management. Financial Management. Adaptability during changes to meet the goals. Change / diversity management.
jobs.duties: Capture information on the memorandum of goods and services. Check three quotations or letter of award attached to the memorandum of goods and services. Check supporting documents attached to the memorandum before capturing. Check budget allocation. Check specimen signatures. Capturing and committing orders on the LOGIS and BAS systems. Capturing of orders. Capture information from the requisition on the LOGIS system. Verify captured information and modify quotation. Link quotation on the LOGIS system. Capture procurements advise. Approve procurements advise. Administrative duties, Fax entity forms to suppliers, Fax orders to service providers and ensure that they been received. Confirm services with the service providers. Enter accounts copies in the prescribed register and submit to accounts division. File copies of orders in the relevant files. Clearing of outstanding commitments. Cancel orders. Modify orders. Make enquires on outstanding orders.
jobs.enquiries: Mesdames Elizba Kotze / B.P. Chaka / Conny Kgadima / K.H. Moremi / Mr. J.S. Nduli Tel No: (015) 298 7000
jobs.applications: Applicants may apply through the following website: https://erecruitment.limpopo.gov.za or Applicants should be submitted to: Director: Human Resource Management, Private Bag X 9486, Polokwane, 0700 OR Hand delivered to: ISMINI Towers Building, Office No. GOO2 (Ground Floor) Registry, 46 Hans van Ransburg Street, Polokwane, 0700. All General enquiries should be directed to Mesdames, Kotze Elizba, Chaka Pearl, Kgadima Conny, Moremi Hilda & Mr. Nduli J.S. Tel No: (015) 298 7000.
jobs.notes: The advert will be posted on the following websites www.limtreasury.gov.za / www.limpopo.gov.za and www.dpsa.gov.za and Provincial Departments social media Applications must be submitted on new Z83 forms obtainable from all Government Departments or can be downloaded from www.dpsa.gov.za or www.gov.za. The new Z83 form must be completed in manner that provides sufficient information about the candidate and the post he or she applies for by completing all relevant fields. The following must be considered in relation to the completion of the Z83 by applicants. All the fields in Part A, Part C and Part D should be completed. In Part B, all fields should be completed in full except the following: South African applicants need not to provide passport numbers. If an applicant responds “no” to the question “Are you conducting business with the State or are you a Director of a Public or Private Company conducting business with the State?” then the answer to the next question “In the event that you are employed in the Public Service, you immediately relinquish such business interests?” can be left blank or indicated as not applicable. A “not applicable” or blank response will be allowed on the question “If your profession or occupation requires official registration, provide date and particulars of registration”; if you are not in possession of such registration. Noting there is limited space provided for Part E, F & G, applicants often indicate “refer to Curriculum Vitae (CV) or see attached”, this is acceptable as long as the CV has been attached and provides the required information. If the information is not provided in the CV, the applicant may be disqualified. It must be noted that a CV is an extension of the application of employment Z83, and applicants are accountable for the information that is provided therein. Applicants currently employed by the public service do not need to complete Part F as the section is intended for those seeking re-employment, as their prior employment can be verified through their CV. The declaration should be completed and signed. Applicants must utilize the most recent Z83 application for employment form as issued by the Minister of Public Service and Administration in line with Regulation 10 of the Public Service Regulations, 2016, failure to do so results in disqualifications. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application but must submit the Z83 and detailed Curriculum Vitae. It must be noted that the CV is an extension of an application of an employment Z83, and applicants are accountable for the information that is provided therein. The Z83 form must be completed in the manner that allows the selection committee to assess the quality of the candidate based on the information that is contained in the form. The Department will require shortlisted candidates to provide certified copies of their qualifications and any other relevant document, which must be submitted to HR on or before the interview date. A specific reference number for the post applied for must be quoted in the space provided on the new form Z83. Applicants with foreign qualifications remain responsible for ensuring that their qualifications are evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) and therefore must submit the copies of certificates and evidence of evaluation by the SAQA for foreign qualification if they are invited to attend interviews. Successful incumbents will be expected to sign a performance agreement within one month after assumption of duty. All shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a security clearance and verification of qualifications. Shortlisted applicants will be required to provide their original qualification certificates and ID on the day of the interview for other relevant verification purposes. The recommended candidate will further be subjected to Personnel Suitability Checks, including financial disclosure requirements, social media screening, and other relevant verification processes. All successful candidates will be subjected to the applicable security clearance processes. All shortlisted candidates will be subjected to pre-entry assessments prior to the interview process. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts, will be subjected to a technical exercise and Interview. Following technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. To ensure that potential SMS members have a background on processes and procedures linked to the SMS, a further requirement for appointment at SMS level will be the successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-entry Programme (Nyukela) as endorsed by the National School of Government with effect from 1st April 2020. This is a Public Service specific training programme which will be applicable for appointments at SMS level. The link for the completion of the pre-entry certificate is as follows: www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme.           Individuals who have completed the course already, and who are therefore in possession of a certificate are welcome to submit such. However, all SMS short-listed candidates will be required to have completed certificate and submit such upon appointment. All shortlisted candidates for other posts shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only, due to the large number of applications we envisage to receive and if you have not heard from the Department within 90 days of the closing date, please accept that your application has been unsuccessful. However, should there be any dissatisfaction, applicants are hereby advised to, within 90 days, request reasons from the Department for any administrative action which has adversely affected them in terms of section 5, sub-section 1 and 2 of the Promotion of Administrative Justice Act 3 of 2000. The Department reserves the right not to make any appointment to the post advertised. The employment decision shall be informed by the Employment Equity Plan of the Department. NB! Candidates who applied before for the re-advertised vacant post are encouraged to re-apply. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

zu.title: Isikhundla Somuntu Osebenza Ngemikhankaso Yokuhamba Kwemikhiqizo
zu.summary: Kufunwa umuntu osebenza ngemikhankaso yokuhamba kwemikhiqizo eLimpopo Provincial Treasury ePolokwane ukuthi abhale futhi aqinisekise imibhalo yememo yamaphuzu nemisebenzi.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-NQF level 6 kwi-Supply Chain Management / Financial Management / Logistics Management noma ezinye izinkambu ezihlobene njengoba kuthathwa ngqa i-SAQA. Iminyaka emibili (2) yokusebenza ngokuhamba kwemikhiqizo / i-Supply Chain Management noma enye indawo ehlobene. Isitifikedi / imiphumela ye-LOGIS. Ulwazi nomandla: Ulwazi ngezinhlobo zemisebenzi kanye nemithetho yokwenza, njengakumisebenzi ephethwe abaphathi. Izimali. Izindaba zabantu; Ukuhlela nokuhlela. Ukulungisa imibiko. Ukuhlola / ukuhlaziya. Izindlela / izindinganiso / imithetho yokuqondiswa. Izidingo kanye nezinto ezibalulekile kweMnyango. Ikhono lokuhlola nokusebenzisa izinqubomgomo. Ukucabanga ngekhono nokuba nobuntu obusha. Ikhono lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuphatha ukungahambelani. Ukuphatha Izimali. Ukuzidinganisa ngaphakathi koshintsho ukuze kufezeke imigomo. Ukuphatha ushintsho / ukwehlukana kwabantu.
zu.duties: Ukubhala ulwazi ememweni wamaphuzu nemisebenzi. Ukukwenza ukuthola izincomolo ezintathu noma incwadi yokwamukela esinamathiselwe ememweni wamaphuzu nemisebenzi. Ukukwenza ukuthola eminye imibhalo esinamathiselwe ememweni ngaphambi kokubhala. Ukukwenza ukuthola ukusatshaliswa kwekhadi lesabelo semali. Ukukwenza ukuthola izibhalo ezingasezandleni ezivezwayo. Ukubhala nokuthembisa imi-oda kumshini we-LOGIS ne-BAS. Ukubhala kwezimi-oda. Ukubhala ulwazi esicelweni emshinini we-LOGIS. Ukuqinisekisa ulwazi olubhaliwe bese ulungisa isincomolo. Ukuxhumanisa isincomolo emshinini we-LOGIS. Ukubhala izeluleko zemikhiqizo. Ukuvumela izeluleko zemikhiqizo. Imisebenzi yemibhalo, Ukuthumela ngamafeksi amafomu emikhozi, Ukuthumela ngamafeksi imi-oda kubakhiqizi bese kuqinisekiswa ukuthi bayitholile. Ukuqinisekisa imisebenzi nothi bavele bayingxenye yabaqhashi. Ukubhalisa izikweletu ezibhaliwe esibukwini esinikwe umthetho bese zithunyelwa kwesigaba sezimali. Ukucrejwa izikopi zemioda kumafayela ahambisana nazo. Ukuqeda izehluleka ezisezikhathini. Ukuqothula imi-oda. Ukulungiseka kwemioda. Ukwenza imibuzo ngemi-oda engakuqedwa.

xh.title: Yomsebenzi we-Logistics
xh.summary: Kufuneki umntu ozenzelela izindaba ze-logistics kwi-Limpopo Provincial Treasury ePolokwane ukuba abambe iqondo aveze uxwebhu lwemorandum yamagama nemisebenzi.
xh.requirements: Isemazi sezimo se-NQF level 6 kwi-Supply Chain Management / Financial Management / Logistics Management okanye indawo enxulumene nayo njengokubonwa yi-SAQA. Iimvela zemyaka emibini (2) zokusebenza kwi-Logistics / Supply Chain Management okanye indawo enxulumene nayo. Isatifikethi / Iziphumo ze-LOGIS. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi ngohlobo-lwesini bemisebenzi neenkqubo ezinjengokuba, iimisebenzi yolawulo. Izezo mali. Izinto ezimalana nemitsetfo yabantu; ucocwa lolungiselelwe. Udweliso lwemibhalo. Uphononongo / uhlalutyo. Iinkqubo / iinkalo / iinkqubo ezisesikweni. Iimfuno nezinto ezibalulekileyo kwisebe. Amandla okutolika nokusebenzisa umthetho-mthetho. Ukucinga ngokuhlalutyo nangokwenza izinto ngendlela entsha. Amandla okusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulawulo lweengxabano. Ulawulo lwezezo. Ukuzinza ngokuguquka ukuze kufezwe iinjongo. Ulawulo lwezinto ezintsha / lolwahluko.
xh.duties: Bamba iqondo ulwazi kumorandum wamagama nemisebenzi. Tshola izindulamthetho ezintathu okanye ileta yokuqwalaselwa eqhotyoshelwe kumorandum wamagama nemisebenzi. Tshola amaxwebhu axhasiweyo aneqhotyoshelo kumorandum phambi kokubamba iqondo. Tshola isabelo sezimali. Tshola iisayini zemizekelo. Ukubamba iqondo kwaye uqinisekise iiodolo kwiinkqubo ze-LOGIS kunye ne-BAS. Ukubamba iqondo iiodolo. Bamba iqondo ulwazi olusuka kwi-requisition kwindlela ye-LOGIS. Qinisekisa ulwazi olubekiweyo ulungise intengo. Qhagamshela intengo kwindlela ye-LOGIS. Bamba iqondo iingcebiso zokuthenga. Vuma iingcebiso zokuthenga. Imisebenzi yolawulo, thumela nge-fax iifomu zebhisi kubathengisi, thumela nge-fax iiodolo kubaphathi bemisebenzi ukuqinisekisa ukuba zifunyenwe. Qinisekisa imisebenzi nabaphathi bemisebenzi. Faka ikhophi ze-akhawunti kwirejista ecetyiweyo uze uzinike isigaba se-akhawunti. Gcina iikhophi ze-odolo kwiifayile ezithintelayo. Kucocwa izithembiso ezingazalisekanga. Rhqoda iiodolo. Lungisa iiodolo. Buza nge-odolo ezingazalisekanga.

af.title: Logistieke Praktisyn
af.summary: Logistieke praktisyn gesoek by Limpopo Provincial Treasury in Polokwane om notule van goedere- en dienstedokumentasie vas te lê en te verifieer.
af.requirements: NQF-vlak 6-kwalifikasie in Voorsieningskettingbestuur / Finansiële Bestuur / Logistieke Bestuur of 'n verwante veld soos deur SAQA erken. Twee (2) jaar se werkservaring in Logistiek / Voorsieningskettingbestuur of 'n verwante veld. LOGIS-sertifikaat / resultate. Kennis & vaardighede: Kennis van 'n verskeidenheid van werksreekse en prosedures soos bestuursfunksies. Finansies. Menslikehulpbron-aangeleenthede; Beplanning en organisering. Samestelling van verslae. Navorsing \ ontleding. Tegnies / standaarde / prosedures. Behoeftes en prioriteite van die departement. Vermoë om beleid te interpreteer en toe te pas. Analitiese en innoverende denke. Vermoë om rekenaar te bedryf. Konflikbestuur. Finansiële bestuur. Aanpasbaarheid tydens veranderinge om die doelwitte te bereik. Verandering / diversiteitsbestuur.
af.duties: Lê inligting op die notule van goedere en dienste vas. Kontroleer drie kwotasies of toekeningsbrief wat aan die notule van goedere en dienste geheg is. Kontroleer ondersteunende dokumente wat voor vastlegging aan die notule geheg is. Kontroleer begrotings-toewysing. Kontroleer handtekeningmonsters. Vaslegging en verbind van bestellings op die LOGIS- en BAS-stelsels. Vaslegging van bestellings. Lê inligting vanaf die rekwisisie op die LOGIS-stelsel vas. Verifieer vasgelêde inligting en wysig kwotasie. Skakel kwotasie op die LOGIS-stelsel. Lê verkrygingsadvies vas. Keur verkrygingsadvys goed. jobs.summary: Senior Admin Officer providing SCM client support and tender advisory services to suppliers in the Mopani district.

Two (2) years’ functional experience in Supply Chain Management or related field. Knowledge & Skills: Knowledge of variety of work ranges and procedures such as knowledge of public sector. Communication skill. Adaptability during changes to meet the goals. Financial management. Policy formulation. Leadership. Research. Strategic Management.

Facilitation of business information access to suppliers with other government institutions for supplier’s empowerment purposes in the district. Assist in walk-ins’ with completion of tender documents on daily basis. Mobilize stakeholders for community outreach tendering workshops and roadshows. Assist with logistical during tendering workshop. Record keeping. Provide support on on-line registration of suppliers on the NCSD. Assist walk – ins suppliers with new online registration onto the National Central Supplier Database (NCSD). Assist walk – in suppliers with the update of their profile on NCSD. Handling of CSD registration queries from suppliers through the District NCSD Call Centre. Keep and maintain internal controls registers. Keep and maintain stores control registers. Keep and maintain equipment’s usage control registers. Maintain registry control filing system. Keep and maintain transport control registry. Implement the departmental PMDS. Signing of MOU with supervisor. Quarterly and annual performance reviews with supervisor.

af.title: Senior Admin Offisier: SCM Kliëntondersteuning (MOPANI)
af.summary: Senior Admin Offisier wat SCM kliëntondersteuning en tenderadviesdienste aan verskaffers in die Mopani-distrik verleen.
af.requirements: NQF vlak 6 kwalifikasie in Finansiële Bestuur / Voorsieningskettingbestuur of verwante veld soos deur SAQA erken. Twee (2) se jaar funksionele ervaring in Voorsieningskettingbestuur of verwante veld. Kennis & Vaardighede: Kennis van 'n verskeidenheid werkvelde en prosedures soos kennis van die openbare sektor. SCM Beleide en prosedures. Tegniese / standaarde / prosedures. Finansies. Beplanning & organiseer. Rekenaar. Behoeftes en prioriteite van die departement. Regterlike agtergrond. Vermoë om beleid te interpreteer en toe te pas. Kommunikasievaardigheid. Aanpasbaarheid tydens veranderinge om die doelwitte te bereik. Finansiële bestuur. Beleidsformulering. Leierskap. Navorsing. Strategiese Bestuur.
af.duties: Verskaf tenderadviesondersteuningsdienste aan KMO's. Verskaffing van inligting, advies, opleiding en bystand aan alle verskaffers oor CSD tydens Provinsiale Geleenthede. Fasilitering van toegang tot besigheidsinligting vir verskaffers by ander regeringsinstellings vir die bemagtiging van verskaffers in die distrik. Bied hulp aan loop-kliënte met die voltooiing van tenderdokumente op 'n daaglikse basis. Mobiliseer belanghebbendes vir gemeenskapsuitreik tenderingswerkswinkels en padvertoonings. Bied hulp met logistiek tydens tenderingswerkswinkels. Rekordhouding. Verskaf ondersteuning met aanlyn registrasie van verskaffers op die NCSD. Bied hulp aan loop-kliënt verskaffers met nuwe aanlyn registrasie op die Nasionale Sentrale Verskaffer Databasis (NCSD). Bied hulp aan loop-kliënt verskaffers met die opdatering van hul profiel op NCSD. Hantering van CSD registrasie-navrae van verskaffers deur die Distrik NCSD Oproepsentrum. Hou en onderhou interne kontroleregisters. Hou en onderhou winkelkontroleregisters. Hou en onderhou toerusting se gebruikkontroleregisters. Onderhou registerbeheer indienstelsel. Hou en onderhou vervoerbeheerregister. Implementeer die departementele PMDS. Ondertekening van MOU met toesighouer. Kwartaallikse en jaarlikse prestasie-evaluerings met toesighouer.

zu.title: Offisa Ophakeme Woqeqesho: Isekelo Labathengi be-SCM (MOPANI)
zu.summary: Offisa Ophakeme Woqeqesho ohlinzeka ngesekelo labathengi be-SCM namasevisi okweluleka ngemiklamo kubahlinzeki besifundazweni i-Mopani.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zesikhathi se-NQF level 6 ezenzululwaziyezimali / Ezenza inkqubo yohlinzeko noma inkundla ehlobene njengoba kuqashelwe yi-SAQA. Iminyaka emibili (2) yohlu lwemisebenzi kwenza inkqubo yohlinzeko noma inkundla ehlobene. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi ngohlu oluhlukile lomkhawulo womsebenzi nemisumo efana nolwazi ngohulumeni kahulumeni. Amapholisi namaphothokholo e-SCM. Amanani / amaphawu / imisumo. Izimali. Ukucubungula nokuhlela. Ikhompyutha. Izidingo nezinhloso zomnyango. Isizinda sezomthetho. Ikhono lokuhumusha nokusebenzisa ipholisi. Ikhono lokuthintana. Ukuzenzela ekushintsheni izinto ukuze kufezeke izinhloso. Ezenzululwaziyezimali. Ukwakheka kopholisi. Ubuholi. Ukuqeqesha. Ezenkomba eziyinhloko.
zu.duties: Nikeza amasevisi okweluleka ngemiklamo abakwa-SMME's. Niketha ulwazi, weluleke ukholise usize bonke abahlinzeki kwi-CSD ngesikhathi semikhosi yezifundazwe. Yisa isikhundla sokutholakala kolwazi ngoshishino kubahlinzeki nakunye izikhungo zahulumeni ngenjongo yokunikela amandla abahlinzeki esifundeni. Siza ababheke phambili ngegesikati ngegesi lokuthi bengasebenzisa amaphepha okwenza imiklamo nsuku zonke. Hlanganisa abahlanganyeli baphulame imiklamo yokuthumela emphakathini imikhosi yemiklamo. Siza ngamaphlanda ngesikhathi semiklamo yokwenza imiklamo. Ugogo olungenzi lutho. Nikeza isekelo ukubhalisa abahlinzeki kwi-NCSD. Siza abahlinzeki abafike ngaphambili ngesikhathi sokubhalisa kabusha kwentazinga ezintsha kwi-National Central Supplier Database (NCSD). Siza abahlinzeki abafike ngaphambili ukuthi babhalise kabusha ulwazi lwabo kwi-NCSD. Siza ngemibuzo yokubhalisa kwi-CSD kubahlinzeki ngenkomba yekholo le-District NCSD Call Centre. Gcina ulawulo lwegumbi lokugcina. Gcina ulawulo lwegumbi lokugcina izinto. Gcina ulawulo lwegumbi lokugcina izinto ezisetshenziswa. Gcina ulawulo lwendlela yokulondolozwa kwemibhalo. Gcina ulawulo lwegumbi lokuhamba nezithuthi. Yenza i-departmental PMDS. Phawula inkontileka nomqashi. Ukubuyiswa kabusha ngeminyaka yonke namakhota nomqashi.

xh.title: Ofiser Mkhulu: Inkxaso kubathengi be-SCM (MOPANI)
xh.summary: Ofiser: inkonzo ngenkxaso kubathengi be-SCM kunye nemiqathango yokubonelela ngolwazi malunga neenthengiso kubaboneleli kwisebe iMopani.
xh.requirements: Isitifikedi senqanaba le-NQF 6 kwizophulo Imanathi yemali / uLawulo lwesikabhalo sezibonelelo okanye indawo ephathelene nayo njengoko evunywe yi-SAQA. Iminyaka mibini (2) yamava wokusebenza kwiNkonzo ekuLawulweni kwesikabhalo sezibonelelo okanye indawo ephathelene nayo. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi ngeendlela ezahlukeneyo zemisebenzi nemigaqo njengokuba lulwazi lwezorhwebo karhulumente. Iimigaqo nemiqathango ye-SCM. Iindlela ezilula / amagama / imigaqo. Imali. Ukuhlela nokuhlela. Ikhompyutha. Iimfuno nokubaluleka kwesebe. Isiseko somthetho. Isakhono sokuphonononga nokusebenzisa umgaqo. Isakhono sokunxibelelanana. Ukuziqhelanisa ngexesha leeziinguquko ukuze kufezelwe iinjongo. Ulawulo lweemali. Ukwenza umgaqo. Ukulawula. Uphando. Ulawulo olubonisayo.
xh.duties: Nika iinkonzo zokuvelisa iingcebiso malunga neenthengiso kwi-SMME. Nikela ngolwazi, ngemibuzo, ngolwazi lolusetyenziso nonguncedo kuwo onke ababoneleli kwi-CSD ngexesha lemihla yamabhaso ePhondo. Yenza kuqondeka ukufikelela kolwazi ngeeshishini kubaboneleli kunye nezinye iindlu zorhwebo karhulumente ukuze kuqinisiswe amandla ababoneleli kwisiqithi. Nceda abaya ngesondlo ngokubhala amaxwebhu eenthengiso yonke imihla. Qokelela ndawonye abathathi nxaxheba ukwenza iinkalo zolwazi malunga neenthengiso kuluntu kunye neenkalo zokuziphatha. Nceda ngoluhlelo olusemthethweni ngexesha lenkalo yolwazi malunga neenthengiso. Ugcino lwamagama. Nika inkxaso ekubhaliseni ababoneleli kwi-NCSD. Nceda ababoneleli abaya ngesondlo ngobhaliso elitsha kwi-National Central Supplier Database (NCSD). Nceda ababoneleli abaya ngesondlo ngokuhlaziula inkangeleko yabo kwi-NCSD. Ukuphatha imibuzo ngobhaliso kwi-CSD evela kubaboneleli ngokusebenzisa iCall Centre ye-NCSD yesiqithi. Gcina ulawulo lwangaphakathi kwaye ulondoloze iirejista. Gcina ulawulo lwesitokhwe kwaye ulondoloze iirejista. Gcina ulawulo lolusettyenziso kolunngakiho kwaye ulondoloze iirejista. Yenza ulawulo lweyurejista kwindlela yokugcina amaxwebhu. Gcina ulawulo lweerejista zorhwebo kwaye ulondoloze. Zisa isebenza i-PMS yesebe. Tyikitya isivumelwano ne-National Central Supplier Database (NCSD). Izihlandlo ezithathu ngonyaka kunye nokuqwalaselwa ngomnye wonyaka.

af.title: Algemene Werker
af.summary: Algemene Werker wat skoonmaak-, huishoudelike-, tuinmaak- en laaidienste by die Provinciale Tesourie Hoofkantoor in Polokwane lewer.
af.requirements: AET /ABET of Graad 10. Kennis & Vaardighede: Deeglike en diepgaande kennis van huishoudelike dienste.
af.duties: Lewering van algemene werkerdienste in die Departement. Snoei en onderhou bome. Onderhou die departementele werf. Voer skoonmaaktake van die buitekant van die gebou / omgewing uit. Verseker behoorlike hantering van tuimgereedskap en -produkte. Laai en laai af meubels, toerusting en enige ander goedere na die tersaaklike bestemming. Verskuif materiaal vanaf bergareas na aangewese werkareas. Etiketteer en berg materiaal soos opdrag gegee. Voer algemene pligte soos deur die toesighouer toegeken uit. Administreer doeltreffende werking van alle industriële vragmotors en elektriese hyser om te help met die laai en verskuif van alle materiaal.

zu.title: Umsebenzi Ohlukahlukeneyi
zu.summary: Umsebenzi ohlukahlukeneyi wokunikeza izinsiza zokulondolozwa kwendlu, ukugeza, ukulima bese kuthi kugcinwe izinto ePhifikholini leNhlangano yesifundazwe ePolokwane.
zu.requirements: I-AET/ABET noma i-Grade 10. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi olujulile nolusimile lokunikeza izinsiza zokulondolozwa kwendlu.
zu.duties: Ukunikezwa kwezinsiza zomsebenzi ohlukahlukeneyi kuMnyango. Ukusika nokugcina izihlahla. Ukugcina iyadi yomnyango. Ukwenza umsebenzi wokugeza ingaphandle lebhaluni nendawo ezungezile.okuqinisekiswa ukuphathwa okulungele amathuluzi okulima nemikhiqizo. Ukufaka nokukhipha ifenisha, izinto, kanye nanoma yimiphi eminye imikhiqizo esikhungweni esifanele. Ukushintsha izinto ezisendaweni zokugcina ziya kumawokhafesi abekiwe. Ukubhalisa futhi kugcinwe imaterial njengakuwe. Ukwenza imisebenzi evehlakalwe umphathi.

xh.title: Umsebenzi Jikelele
xh.summary: Umsebenzi Jikelele onika iinkonzo zokugcina endlwini, ukucocwa, ukulima indawo yasemadolobheni nokulayisha kwiNtloko eNkulu yeSikolo seMali ePolokwane.
xh.requirements: AET /ABET okanye Grade 10. Ulwazi & Amaphawu: Ulwazi olunzulu noluchanekileyo lokugcina endlwini.
xh.duties: Ukunika iinkonzo zemisebenzi jikelele kwisebe. Ukusika kunye nogcino lwemithi. Ukugcina iyebo lesebe. Ukwenza umsebenzi wokucoca ingaphandle kwakho / endaweni ejikeleze kwesakhiwo. Kuqinisekiswe ukuphathwa kakuhle kwezixhobo zemisebenzi yasendlini nemveliso. Ukulayisha nokukhuphela ifenitshala, izixhobo, nayo yonke enye impahmo endaweni efanelekileyo. Ukushenxisa impahmo kwindawo zokugcina kwiindawo ezagqitywe zomsebenzi. Ukubhalisa nokugcina impahmo njengoko kuyalelwe. Ukwenza imisebenzi jikelele njengoko eqabelwe ngumlawuli. Ukusebenzisa ngokusebenza kakuhle konke ugaraji namashishini abambe izixhobo ukuncedisa ukulayisha nokushenxisa yonke impahmo.

jobs.summary: Communication graduate internship at Head Office in Mbombela offering structured work exposure and training for holders of a relevant three-year diploma or degree.

jobs.title: Medical Specialist Grade 1 - 3: Obstetric & Gynaecology
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R1 395 528 - R1 479 723 per annum Grade 2: R1 592 274 - R1 688 553 per annum Grade 3: R1 844 151 - R2 301 186 per annum
jobs.summary: Medical Specialist in Obstetrics and Gynaecology sought for Witbank Hospital in Mpumalanga, with HPCSA registration and relevant qualifications.
jobs.requirements: Appropriate qualifications that allows registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Medical Specialist in Anesthesiology (2026). A valid work permit will be required from non-South Africans. Sound knowledge of medical ethics. Multidisciplinary management and teamwork and experience in the respective medical discipline. Knowledge of current Health and Public Service regulations and policies. Skills in terms of consultations, history taking, examination, clinical assessment and clinical management. Grade 1: None after registration with the HPCSA as Medical Specialist (Independent Practice). Minimum of one 1-year relevant experience after registration with a recognized Foreign Professions and / or the HPCSA as a Medical Specialist (Anesthesiology) for foreign qualified employees. Grade: 2: A minimum of five (5) years’ experience after registration with the HPCSA as Medical Specialist (Independent Practice). A minimum of six (6) years’ relevant experience after registration with a recognized foreign health profession council and / or the HPCSA as a Medical Specialist (Anesthesiology) for qualified foreign employees. Grade 3: A minimum of ten (10) years’ experience after registration with the HPCSA as Medical Specialist (Independent Practice). Minimum of eleven (11) years’ relevant experience after registration with a recognized foreign health profession council and / or the HPCSA as a Medical Specialist (Anesthesiology) for qualified foreign employees. Knowledge, skills, Training and Competences required. Sound knowledge of medical ethics. Multidisciplinary management and teamwork and experience in the respective medical discipline. Sound clinical knowledge. Competency and skills in general clinical domains. The ability to work independently and under pressure and beyond normal working hours and work with diverse team. Good communication, leadership, interpersonal, and engage when necessary. Knowledge of current health policies, legislation, programs and priorities within the domain. Ability to teach and guide junior staff within the department. Behavioural Attributes: Stress tolerance, to work within a team, self-confidence and the ability to build and maintain good relationship.
jobs.duties: Supervising the management of and managing Anesthesiology and coordinate services. To execute duties and functions with proficiency, to support the aims and objectives of the institution that consistent with standards of patient care. Accept responsibility for the management of patients admitted in a level 2/3 package of service facility. Assist in the preparation and implementation of guidelines and protocols. Participate in academic and training programs. Assist with clinical audits actively participate in continuous professional development. Provide support to hospital management towards an efficient standard of patient care and services maintained. Comply with the performance Management and Development System (conducting quarterly reviews and final assessment).

af.summary: Mediese Spesialis in Verloskunde en Ginekologie gesoek vir Witbank Hospital in Mpumalanga, met HPCSA-registrasie en tersaaklike kwalifikasies.
af.requirements: Toepaslike kwalifikasies wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Anesthesiology (2026) moontlik maak. 'n Geldige werkpermit sal van nie-Suid-Afrikaners vereis word. Deeglike kennis van mediese etiek. Multidissiplinêre bestuur en spanwerk en ervaring in die onderskeie mediese dissipline. Kennis van huidige Health and Public Service-regulasies en -beleid. Vaardighede ten opsigte van konsultasies, anamnese, ondersoek, kliniese assessering en kliniese bestuur. Grade 1: Geen na registrasie by die HPCSA as Mediese Spesialis (Independent Practice). Minimum van een 1 jaar tersaaklike ervaring na registrasie by 'n erkende Foreign Professions en / of die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis (Anesthesiology) vir buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemers. Grade: 2: 'n Minimum van vyf (5) jaar se ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA as Mediese Spesialis (Independent Practice). 'n Minimum van ses (6) jaar se tersaaklike ervaring na registrasie by 'n erkende buitelandse gesondheidsprofessieraad en / of die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis (Anesthesiology) vir gekwalifiseerde buitelandse werknemers. Grade 3: 'n Minimum van tien (10) jaar se ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA as Mediese Spesialis (Independent Practice). Minimum van elf (11) jaar se tersaaklike ervaring na registrasie by 'n erkende buitelandse gesondheidsprofessieraad en / of die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis (Anesthesiology) vir gekwalifiseerde buitelandse werknemers. Kennis, vaardighede, opleiding en bevoegdhede vereis. Deeglike kennis van mediese etiek. Multidissiplinêre bestuur en spanwerk en ervaring in die onderskeie mediese dissipline. Deeglike kliniese kennis. Bevoegdheid en vaardighede in algemene kliniese domeine. Die vermoë om onafhanklik en onder druk te werk en buite normale werksure en met 'n diverse span te werk. Goeie kommunikasie, leierskap, interpersoonlike vaardighede en om betrokke te raak wanneer nodig. Kennis van huidige gesondheidsbeleid, -wetgewing, -programme en -prioriteite binne die domein. Vermoë om junior personeel binne die departement te onderrig en te lei. Gedragskenmerke: Stresverdraagsaamheid, om binne 'n span te werk, selfvertroue en die vermoë om goeie verhoudings te bou en te handhaaf.
af.duties: Oultoes hou oor die bestuur van en die bestuur van Anesthesiology en die koördineer van dienste. Om pligte en funksies met bekwaamheid uit te voer, om die doelwitte en oogmerke van die instelling te ondersteun wat in ooreenstemming is met standaarde van pasiëntsorg. Verantwoordelikheid aanvaar vir die bestuur van pasiënte wat in 'n vlak 2/3 dienspakket-fasiliteit opgeneem is. Bystand verleen by die voorbereiding en implementering van riglyne en protokolle. Deelneem aan akademiese en opleidingsprogramme. Bystand verleen met kliniese oudits en aktief deelneem aan deurlopende professionele ontwikkeling. Ondersteuning bied aan hospitaalbestuur tot 'n doeltreffende standaard van pasiëntsorg en gehandhaafde dienste. Voldoen aan die prestasiebestuur- en -ontwikkelingstelsel (die voer van kwartaallikse hersienings en finale assessering).

zu.title: Iqhawe leMITHI IsiKhundla 1 - 3: i-Obstetric & Gynaecology
zu.summary: Kufunwa Iqhawe leMITHI e-Obstetrics and Gynaecology esibhedlela i-Witbank Hospital eMpumalanga, ngobhalo lwe-HPCSA neziqu ezifanele.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanele ezivumela ukubhalisa kwi-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengeqhawe leMITHI kwi-Anesthesiology (2026). I-permit evumelekile yokusebenza iyodingeka kubantu abangeyona izakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika. Ukuqonda okuhle ngokuziphatha kwemithi. Ukuphathwa kwe-multidisciplinary nokusebenza njengeqembu nolwazi emkhakheni wezempilo ohambisanayo. Ulwazi ngemithetho nezinqumo zamanje zezezeMpilo nesezempumalanga. Amakhono okubonisana, ukuthatha umlando, ukuhlola, ukulinganisa ngokwesekhliniki nokuphathwa kwezokwesekhliniki. IsiKhundla 1: Akukho okudingekile emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengeqhawe leMITHI (okuzimele). Okuncane okungenani unyaka o-1 wolwazi ohambisanayo emva kokubhalisa kwi-recognized Foreign Professions kanye noma i-HPCSA njengeqhawe leMITHI (i-Anesthesiology) kumbasebenzi abathole iziqu kwamanye amazwe. IsiKhundla 2: Okungenani iminyaka emihlanu (5) yelwazi emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengeqhawe leMITHI (okuzimele). Okungenani iminyaka eyisithupha (6) yelwazi ohambisanayo emva kokubhalisa kwi-recognized foreign health profession council kanye noma i-HPCSA njengeqhawe leMITHI (i-Anesthesiology) kumbasebenzi abathole iziqu kwamanye amazwe. IsiKhundla 3: Okungenani iminyaka eyishumi (10) yelwazi emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengeqhawe leMITHI (okuzimele). Okungenani iminyaka eyishumi nanye (11) yelwazi ohambisanayo emva kokubhalisa kwi-recognized foreign health profession council kanye noma i-HPCSA njengeqhawe leMITHI (i-Anesthesiology) kumbasebenzi abathole iziqu kwamanye amazwe. Ulwazi, amakhono, ukuqeqeshwa kanye namakhono adingekayo. Ukuqonda okuhle ngokuziphatha kwemithi. Ukuphathwa kwe-multidisciplinary nokusebenza njengeqembu nolwazi emkhakheni wezempilo ohambisanayo. Ulwazi oluhle lwezokwesekhliniki. Ikhono namakhano kumagunya jikelele wezokwesekhliniki. Ikhono lokusebenza nokuzimele nangaphansi kwengcindezi nangaphandle kwezihora ezijwayelekile zokusebenza kanye nokusebenza neqembu elihlukahlukene. Ukuxhumana okuhle, ukuba ihamba phambili, ubudlelwano obuhle nabantu, nokuthatha inxaxhe lapho kudingeka khona. Ulwazi ngemithetho, izinqumo, izinhlelo kanye nezinhlaka zezempilo zamanzi emkhakheni. Ikhono lokufundisa nokuhola abasebenzi abasha emnyangweni. Izici zenkolo: Ukubekezela engcindezini, ukusebenza eqenjini, ukuzethemba kanye nakhono lokwakha noku gcina ubudlelwane obuhle.
zu.duties: Ukuqapha ukuphatwa nokuphatha i-Anesthesiology kanye nokucofa izinsizakalo. Ukwenza imisebenzi nemisebenzi ngokukhombisa ubuchule, ukuze usekele izinhloso nezinhloso esimemezweni ezihambisana nezizinga zenakekelwa yigciwane. Ukwenza ibheke phambili ngeziphathwa zigciwane ezingeniswe esikhungweni se-2/3 senani lesiphekthi senkonzo. Ukusiza ekulungiseleleni nokuphothulweni iziqondiso kanye namaphrothokholu. Ukubamba inxaxhe kuhlelo lokufunda nokuqeqesha. Ukusiza ukubhalwa kwemibhalo yesekhliniki futhi ukubambe inxaxhe ngokusebenza ukuthuthukiswa okuqhubekayo komsebenzi. Ukunika inkhaselo abaphathi besibhedlela ngokuqondene nokuqinisekiswa kwezinga eliphezulu lenakekelwa kanye nenkonzo igciwane. Ukuhambisana nohlelo lokuphathwa kwayiphathiwe nokuthuthukiswa kokusebenza kokwenza ulawulo lwesikhathi (isikhathi esingaba sikhulu ngaso sonke isikhathi nokuqinisekiswa kokugcina).

xh.title: Isebe lezokwelapha.elikumGqobo 1 - 3: I-Obstetrics & Gynaecology
xh.summary: Kufunekiwo ngumchweli wezokwelapha kwiziObstetrics neGynaecology esibhedlele iWitbank eMpumalanga, anobhaliso kwi-HPCSA nangemviqeqesho efaneleyo.
xh.requirements: Izifundo ezifaneleyo ezikuvumela ubhaliso kolawulo lwezamaphrofesheni zezempilo eMzantsi Afrika (HPCSA) njengomchweli wezokwelapha kwi-Anesthesiology (2026). I-permit esebenzayo yomsebenzi iya kufuneka kubantu abangeyo Mzantsi Afrika. Ulwazi oluhle ngezemigaqo yezokwelapha. Ulawulo olunamasandla amaninzi nokusebenza njengodibada nolugqaliseko kwisoqonga sezokwelapha esithile. Ulwazi lwemigaqo namapolisi azamanzi ezempilo nolonikezelo lwenkonzo yoluntu. Amakhono ohlelwaniso ngolwabiwo, ukuthatha imbali, ukuhlola, ukulinganisa ngokweklinikhi nolawulo lweklinikhi. Inqanaba 1: Akukho nto emva kobhaliso kwi-HPCSA njengomchweli wezokwelapha (Ukuzilawula). Ubuncinane olulinye unyaka weminyaka elil-1 (1) yamava afaneleyo emva kobhaliso kolawula olwaziweyo lwamaphrofesheni zangaphandle nakanye i-HPCSA njengomchweli wezokwelapha (I-Anesthesiology) kubasebenzi abafunde ngaphandle. Inqanaba: 2: Ubuncinane beminyaka emihlanu (5) yamava emva kobhaliso kwi-HPCSA njengomchweli wezokwelapha (Ukuzilawula). Ubuncinane beminyaka esithandathu (6) yamava afaneleyo emva kobhaliso kolawula olwaziweyo lwamaphrofesheni ezempilo zangaphandle nakanye i-HPCSA njengomchweli wezokwelapha (I-Anesthesiology) kubasebenzi abafunde ngaphandle. Inqanaba 3: Ubuncinane beminyaka elishumi (10) yamava emva kobhaliso kwi-HPCSA njengomchweli wezokwelapha (Ukuzilawula). Ubuncinane beminyaka elishumi elinanye (11) yamava afaneleyo emva kobhaliso kolawula olwaziweyo lwamaphrofesheni ezempilo zangaphandle nakanye i-HPCSA njengomchweli wezokwelapha (I-Anesthesiology) kubasebenzi abafunde ngaphandle. Ulwazi, amakhono, uqeqesho namakhono afunekayo. Ulwazi oluhle ngezemigaqo yezokwelapha. Ulawulo olunamasandla amaninzi nokusebenza njengodibada nolugqaliseko kwisoqonga sezokwelapha esithile. Ulwazi oluhle lweklinikhi. Ulawula nakhono kumacandu ejikeleziwe ezokwelapha. Ikhono lokusebenza kodwa nakugcinwa ngaphantsi koxinzelelo nangaphaya kweyure ezisezantsi zomsebenzi nokusebenza nodibada ohlukeneyo. Izixhobo ezinzima, izimvo, ukuhamba, zoluntu, nokuzibandakanya xa kuyimfuneko. Ulwazi ngemigaqo nangomthetho, izixhobo ezinzima, izicwangciso zoqeqesho, namaphrofesheni ohlukeneyo kulo lonke ulwimi. Ikhono lokufundisa nokuqonda abasebenzi abasesantsi kwisebe lwezokwelapha. Izimilo zokuziphatha: Ukuhanahaniswa ngokomqondo, ukusebenza kwidibada, ukuzithemba nokuqonda nokunxibelelana nabantu.
xh.duties: Ukuqonda ulawulo nokuqonda i-Anesthesiology nokuqondisa iinkonzo. Ukwenza imisebenzi nemisebenzi ngokuchaneka, ukuxhasa iinjongo nangamaphupha elaliseko, ngokuqondanisayo namazinga onke ezokusetyenziswa kumagama abantu. Ukubeka isibophelelo sokulawula amagama abanikwe igumbi lokusebenzela ithanga le-2/3. Ukunceda kwizixhobo zokuqondisa namaphrofethi. Ukubamba iqhaza kwiinkonzo zokufundisa noqeqesho. Ukunceda ngeenkqubo zokulawula ngokweklinikhi, ukubamba iqhaza ngokuzimisela kukulawula nangokuqhuba okuzenzekileyo. Ukunika inkxaso kulawulo lesibhedlele kumazinga asezantsi okusebenzisa kumagama abantu nasekugcinweni kweenkonzo. Ukuzibandakanya kwisixokelelwano sokulawula nangokuqhuba iNkqubo (ukwenza ukuhlolwa kwetembe nokuqendiswa kokugqibelela).

jobs.title: Operational Manager Nursing (PN-B3): PHC
jobs.summary: Operational Manager Nursing (PN-B3) at Nelspruit CHC in Ehlanzeni District, requiring a Professional Nurse qualification with post-basic training and SANC registration.
jobs.requirements: Senior Certificate / Grade 12 or equivalent qualification plus Basic qualification accredited with the South African Nursing Council in Terms of Government Notice 425, (i.e. Diploma / Degree in Nursing) that allows registration with the SANC as a Professional Nurse (2026) plus a post basic nursing qualification, with duration of at least 1 year, accredited with the SANC in terms of Government Notice No R212 in Primary Health Care. A minimum of nine (09) years appropriate/recognizable experience in nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse with South African Nursing Council (SANC) in General Nursing. At least five (05) years of period referred to above must be appropriate/recognizable in the specific specialty after obtaining the one (01) year post basic qualification in Primary Health Care Nursing Science. A post basic qualification in Nursing Administration/Health service management. Experience and knowledge of the District Health System. Demonstrate an in- depth understanding of nursing legislation and related legal and ethical nursing practices and how these impact on service delivery. Demonstrate a basic understanding of HR and finance and practices. Knowledge of relevant legal framework such as Nursing Act, Health Occupational and Safety Act, Patients Right Charter, Batho Pele Principles, Operational Management Skills. Problem Solving, planning and Organizing Skills. Expected to work under pressure and on night duty. Leadership. Supervisory, problem-solving, conflict resolution, inter-personal and communication and communication skills. Demonstrate an in-depth understanding of legislation and related ethical nursing practices and how this impact on service delivery. Computer literacy will be an added advantage (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook). Computer literacy.
jobs.duties: Manage and provide PHC facility supervisory in line with the PHC Supervision Guideline. Ensure clinical nursing practice by the nursing team in the facility in accordance with the scope and practice and nursing standard as determined by the relevant health facility. Promote quality nursing care as directed by the professional scope of practice and standard in accordance with the PHC delivery package. Ensure the implementation on National Core Norms and Standards including Six Priority Areas. Advocate for patients through ensuring adherence to Batho Pele Principles. Coordinate community involvement and participation. Manage and monitor effective use and maintenance of assets and infrastructure of the facility. Monitor information management and documentation.
