af.title: Operasionele Bestuurder Verpleegkunde (PN-B3): PHC
af.summary: Operasionele Bestuurder Verpleegkunde (PN-B3) by Nelspruit CHC in Ehlanzeni-distrik, wat 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige-kwalifikasie met post-basiese opleiding en SANC-registrasie vereis.
af.requirements: Senior Sertifikaat / Graad 12 of ekwivalente kwalifikasie plus basiese kwalifikasie geakkrediteer by die South African Nursing Council ingevolge Regeringskennisgewing 425, (d.w.s. Diploma / Graad in Verpleegkunde) wat registrasie by die SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige (2026) moontlik maak, plus 'n post-basiese verpleegkwalifikasie, met 'n duur van ten minste 1 jaar, geakkrediteer by die SANC ingevolge Regeringskennisgewing No R212 in Primêre Gesondheidsorg. 'n Minimum van nege (09) jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Ten minste vyf (05) jaar van die bogenoemde periode moet toepaslik/erkenbaar wees in die spesifieke spesialiteit na verkryging van die een (01) jaar post-basiese kwalifikasie in Primêre Gesondheidsorg-verpleegkunde. 'n Post-basiese kwalifikasie in Verpleegadministrasie/Gesondheidsdienstebestuur. Ervaring en kennis van die Distrik-Gesondheidstelsel. Toon 'n diepgaande begrip van verpleegwetgewing en verwante wettige en etiese verpleegpraktyke en hoe dit op dienslewering impakteer. Toon 'n basiese begrip van HR en finansies en praktyke. Kennis van die relevante regsraamwerk soos die Nursing Act, Health Occupational and Safety Act, Patients Right Charter, Batho Pele-beginsels, Operasionele bestuursvaardighede. Probleemoplossing, beplanning en organisatoriese vaardighede. Verwag om onder druk en op nagdiens te werk. Leierskap. Toesighoudende, probleemoplossing, konflikoplossing, interpersoonlike en kommunikasie- en kommunikasievaardighede. Toon 'n diepgaande begrip van wetgewing en verwante etiese verpleegpraktyke en hoe dit op dienslewering impakteer. Rekenaarvaardigheid sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint en Outlook). Rekenaarvaardigheid.
af.duties: Bestuur en verskaf PHC-fasiliteittoesig in ooreenstemming met die PHC-toesighoudende riglyn. Verseker kliniese verpleegpraktyk deur die verpleegspan in die fasiliteit in ooreenstemming met die omvang en praktyk en verpleegstandaard soos bepaal deur die betrokke gesondheidsfasiliteit. Bevorder gehalte-verpleegsorg soos gerig deur die professionele omvang van praktyk en standaard in ooreenstemming met die PHC-leweringspakket. Verseker die implementering van Nasionale Kernnorme en -standaarde, insluitend Ses Prioriteitsgebiede. Pleitbesorg wees vir pasiënte deur te verseker dat daar aan die Batho Pele-beginsels voldoen word. Koördineer gemeenskapsbetrokkenheid en -deelname. Bestuur en monitor die effektiewe gebruik en onderhoud van bates en infrastruktuur van die fasiliteit. Monitor inligtingsbestuur en dokumentasie.

zu.title: Umphathi Wemisebenzi Yokunakekelwa Kwezokwelapha (PN-B3): PHC
zu.summary: Umphathi Wemisebenzi Yokunakekelwa Kwezokwelapha (PN-B3) e-Nelspruit CHC kwi-District Ehlanzeni, ofuna iziqu zesiGqizi Sokunakekelwa Kwezokwelapha nokufundela ngemva kweziqu ezisisekelo nokubhalisa ku-SANC.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi samabanga aphezulu / Isigaba se-12 noma iziqu ezingaqondana nalokho okuzayo kanye neziqu eziyisisekelo ezivunyiwe yi-South African Nursing Council ngokomthetho wesiGqembu sikaHulumeni 425, (okungukuthi i-Diploma / i-Degree eNokunakekelwa Kwezokwelapha) esivumela ukubhalisa ku-SANC njengesiGqizi Sokunakekelwa Kwezokwelapha (2026) kanye nokufundela ngemva kweziqu ezisisekelo ezezokunakekelwa kwezokwelapha, okuthatha isikhathi esingaphezulu konyaka owodwa, okuvunyiwe yi-SANC ngokomthetho wesiGqembu sikaHulumeni uNo R212 kwe-PHC. Ukuze ube nomuzwa osuka kumnyaka owodwa (1) ngemva kokubhaliswa njengesiGqizi Sokunakekelwa Kwezokwelapha se-South African Nursing Council (SANC) kwe-Nursing General, umuntu kufanele abe nobuncwazi obungaphezulu konyaka owodwa (1) efunwa kumsebenzi othize noma eqondana nawo eminyakeni eyisikhombisa (09). Kuleso sikhathi esingaphezu konyaka owodwa (1) esibhalwe ngemuva kokufunda iziqu ezingaphezulu konyaka owodwa (1) e-PHC, kubalulekile ukuthi kubekhona isikhathi esingaphezulu konyaka owodwa (1) lapho kubekhona ulwazi oluthize noma oluqondene nalokho okuthile eminyakeni eyihlanu (05) ngemuva kokuthola iziqu ezilandela ezenziwe ngemva kweziqu ezisisekelo ezingaphezulu konyaka owodwa (1) ngaphakathi kwe-Primary Health Care Nursing Science. Isitifiketi se-Basic Life Support. A post basic qualification in Nursing Administration/Health service management. Ukuqonda kwe-District Health System. Kubalulekile ukuba nomuzwa osukuqonda kahle ngemithetho yezokunakekelwa kwezokwelapha kanye nemigomo nenhlahla yobuzwe yemithetho yezokwelapha kanye nendlela okuphuma kuyo ukulekelela abantu. Kubalulekile ukuba nomuzwa oqondene ngemithetho yezokwelapha nezinye izinhlelo ezihlobene nokunakekelwa kwezokwelapha kanye nendlela okuphuma kuyo ukulekelela abantu. Kubalulekile ukuba nokwaziswa kwemithetho efanayo, njenge-Nursing Act, Health Occupational and Safety Act, Patients Right Charter, Batho Pele Principles, Operational Management Skills. Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga, ukulungelelanisa nokuhlela. Kulindeleke ukusebenza ngaphansi kwezinga eliphezulu kanye nokusebenza ebusuku. Ukuba nguMholi. Amakhono okuqonda izinkinga, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuxazulula ukungahambelani, ukuxhumana nabanye nokuthintana nabanye. Kubalulekile ukuba nomuzwa osukqonda kahle ngemithetho kanye nendlela okufanele igxile kuyo izenzakalo ezingezwa kahle zezokunakekelwa kwezokwelapha kanye nendlela eziphuma kuyo ezokulekelela abantu. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha kuzoba yinzuzo (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint kanye ne-Outlook). Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha.
zu.duties: Qondisa futhi unikeze ulwazi oluphezulu ngemisebenzi ye-PHC ngokuya ngomthetho ophathe ngokulawula izikhungo ze-PHC. Qinisekisa ukunakekelwa kwezokwelapha okwenziwa iqembu lezigqizi zezokunakekelwa esikhungweni ngokuya ngomkhakha kanye nemigiqelo yezokunakekelwa njengoba kumiswe isikhungo sezokunakekelwa. Khuthaza ukunakekelwa kwesimo esiphezulu njengoba kuqondiswa yimikhakha yezokwelapha kanye nemigiqelo yayo ngokuhambisana namaphakheji e-PHC. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwezinto ezifana ne-National Core Norms and Standards okuhlanganisa i-Six Priority Areas. Khuluma ngalezo zinto ezisebenza njengoba kulindeleke ngaphakathi kwemithetho ye-Batho Pele. Hlela ukubandakanywa kwabahelebezikho emphakathini. Lawula futhi ulolisise ukusetshenziswa nokugcina izimpahla zesikhungo ngendlela efanele. Hlola ukuphathwa kolwazi nokubhalwa kwemibhalo.

xh.title: Umphathi weMisebenzi eYomthetho weMongezi (PN-B3): PHC
xh.summary: Umphathi weMisebenzi eYomthetho weMongezi (PN-B3) eNelspruit CHC kwisebe le-Ehlanzeni District, efuna isiqinisekiso seMongezi ochungechunge nokuqeqeselwa emva kwesiqinisekiso nokubhaliswa kwi-SANC.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi samabanga aphezulu / IGrade 12 okanye isiqinisekiso esilinganayo ngenye nesesinye isiqinisekiso esiqinisekisiweyo neSouth African Nursing Council ngokomthetho kaRhumente 425, (kuxh. Isidiploma / Isidanga kwiNursing) esivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengoMongezi oQinisekisiweyo (2026) ngenye ngesiphongo seemfuno somongezi emva kwesimisiso, ngobungakanani bonyaka ubuncinane 1 unyaka, esiqinisekisiweyo kwi-SANC ngokomthetho kaRhumente 425. A minimum of nine (09) years appropriate/recognizable experience in nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse with South African Nursing Council (SANC) in General Nursing. At least five (05) years of period referred to above must be appropriate/recognizable in the specific specialty after obtaining the one (01) year post basic qualification in Primary Health Care Nursing Science. Isidiploma sokongeza ngesiqu semfundo kwiNursing Administration/Health service management. A (2026) nangaphezulu kwesidiploma emva kokuqeqesha okwesithuba kweNyanga ekuphela kwenyanga (01). Isidiploma sokongeza esisesantlula sesiNursing Administration/Health service management. Ekhoyo noluqondisisa ukusetyenziswa koolwazi lweNkqubo ye District Health System. Iminikelo yokuzibonakalisa ngolwazi olujulile ngomthetho weNursing nolunye ukuziphatha komthetho nokuziphatha okuhambelana nokuqeqeswa kokwenzeka kolwazi lweNursing ukuba lonwabisele kule nkqubo yemisebenzi. Iminikelo yokuzibonakalisa ngokuqonda okubuhlungwana nokuziphatha ngokubeka ngaphambili ukusebenziseka kweemfuno ezahlukeneyo kunye nokwamkela iinkqubo ezingamkelekanga kuluntu olusebenziswayo naye. Iminikelo ngokubonelela ukuba azuule ngokudunyiswa ngokubonelela ukuba alwazi ngokuphakamisa ingqondo kwiinkqubo ezahlukeneyo ezifana ne Nursing Act, Health Occupational and Safety Act, Patients Right Charter, Batho Pele Principles, Operational Management Skills. Ikhono lokusombulula iingxaki, ukulungisa iindlela zokuqhuba nokuhlela. Kulindelekile ukuba akwazi ukusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo nakumashiftiabusuku. Kukhokelo. Ikhono lokuyalela, ukusombulula iingxaki, ukusombulula iingxaki ngokuchasene, ukunxibelelana nabantu neNkqubo yokuNxibelelana. Iminikelo yokuzibonakalisa ngokuqonda okujulile ngomthetho nolunye ukuziphatha okuhambelana nokuziphatha okuhambelana naloo mthetho nendlela ekuqhubekayo nayiphelelanga imisebenzi yemiphathi eNkqubo yokuNxibelelana nokwamkela kwindlela yokwenza imisebenzi. Ukuba ngummandla wolwazi lwekhompyutha kuya kuba lusango olungangenwa (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook). Ulwazi lweHompyutha.
xh.duties: Yiba nabaphathi ekutyiniweni nasekuboneleleni ngamandla okuyala okusetyenziswa kwindlela yokusetyenziswa kwemiQathango yesiNxibo EsiyiQondo kwindlela ekumgangatho ekubonelelweyo. Qinisekisa ekubeni ukusetyenziswa komthetho wokunyanga kwinkqubo yokuNyanga iqondo emgangathweni oqinisekisiweyo. Nceda ngokubonelela ngamandla amanene ekusingathweni ngokukhangela ngokucwangciswa kwesinxibo ekunyathelweni lokuNyanga iNkosi yeSizwe. Qinisekisa ukuba kusebenza ngokomthetho weNkqubo eNqamlezile nezinye iNkqubo ezahlukeneyo ekunyuzelelweni kweziNdawo ezilawulwayo ngokusebenzisa imiQathango yokuSebenza ekunxibelelanweni lweNkosi ezahlukeneyo. Qinisekisa ukuba abantu baphakathi babambe iqhaza kwaye bathathe inxaxheba kumsebenzi wokulungiselela iNdawo yokuSebenza ngokupheleleyo. Lawula ukusetyenziswa kwezinto ezahlukeneyo ezakhiwayo ezilungiselela ukusetyenziswa kwemiQathango ekulungiselelweni lweNkosi ngokusebenzisa imiQathango yeSizwe. zu.title: Umphathi ongumsizi: Eziphathwa ngenzuzo
zu.summary: Eziphathwa ngenzuzo kuhlanganise intengo kanye nokuqoqa izimali kumahospithala kuzigaba ezintathu zase Mpumalanga.
zu.requirements: Ithifikheleti yesib-phakamile / Igreyidi 12 kanye neDiploma / I-degree (NQF Level 6/7) kwezama-Akhawuntu, Eziphathwa ngezimali, Izimali zomphakathi, Iakhawuntu yezindleko kanye nezokuphathwa, i-Commerce njengoba kuqashelwa yi-SAQA. Ukuze ube nobuncwethe ongufushane beminyaka emithathu (3) ungumuntu oqeqeshiwe kwizinto eziphathwa ngenzuzo, kubalulekile ukuphathwa kweguli, ukuphathwa kwezimali kubantu abamehle abangabaphathi/abalawuli kwizinga (Level 7/8). Ulwazi lomthetho wokuphathwa kwezimali zomphakathi (PFMA), Izilawuli zokuqashwa, izinqubomgomo zezinto eziphathwa nenzuzo, umthetho weZempilo Kazwelonke, kanye namaphethini ohulumeni ohlobene noma. Ulwazi nge-BAS, PEIS kanye namanye amasistimu ahlobene noma. Ukusebenzisa ikhomphyutha kwiMicrosoft Office (Excel, Word kanye ne-PowerPoint). Ilayisensi yokuqasha ehambisana nezimo izoba yinzuzo.
zu.duties: Ephathe futhi uhlanganise noma yimiphi imisebenzi ephathwa nenzuzo esikhungweni. Qaphela ukubhaliswa kwabaguli, ukuhlelwa ngohlobo kanye nenkqubo yokubhiza ngenjongo yokuba izimali ezibizayo zibe zalulo. Qinisekisa ukulandelwa kwesikhathi ekwenzeni ukutholwa kwemali engenalulungele kubaguli, amasensi wezokwelapha, i-Fundi yezikhashana zomgwaqo (RAF) kanye nabanye abantu abakufanelekile. Qaphela ukuhlaziywa kweminyaka yabantu abangenamali bese uthatha izinqumo zokuqoqa imali ngenjongo yokukhulisa inzuzo etholwayo. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okululo kohlu lokubiza abaguli (UPFS) kanye nezinkqubo ezihambisana nezohlelo lokubhiza. Qaphela futhi ukhulise izinga lemininingo ehlobene nokuphathwa kwezabaguli nasekubhizeni. Buka ngaphezulu futhiuthuthurise abasebenzi abaphatha izinto eziphathwa nenzuzo. Hlanganisa izikhashana zokukhulisa izimali ezibizayo bese uthola amathuba okukhulisa izimali eziqoqiwe. Yenza ukubuza eminyuzi ngokuzimela emalini ebizekayo futhi usebenzise izindlela zokulungisa ezinto ezingalungile. Phenya izinto ezingatholakali emalini, iziphetho ezingalungile ekubhizeni kanye nobungebengi. Hlanganisa imibiko yamaliliyana, njalo kwezinyanga ezintathu kanye newonyaka. Qaphela ukuzigcina ngokumthetho i-PFMA, izinqubo zeNqobo yezimali kanye nezinkqubo zikahulumeni. Xhumana nabantu abangaphakathi kanye nabangaphandle, kubandakanya ukuphathwa kwezabaguli, ukuhlola ngaphakathi, izinkqubo zokwelapha, i-RAF njll. Nikeza isiququlo kanye nokuqeqesha abasebenzi abangaphansi kwakho. Yenza imisebenzi enjalo enjalo oyitholayo ovela kubaphathi.

xh.title: Umphathi ongumncedi: ulawulo lemali engenayo
xh.summary: Lawula imisebenzi engenzayo ngemali kuquka ukubhala nasekuqokeleleni kwemali kumazibula ekuMpalanga kumathanga amathathu.
xh.requirements: Isebe seSenior Certificate / Grade 12 kwaye usize isidanga somatikuletsheni ngesiNgesi kwiiNqanaba ezikwiNQF Level 6/7 ukuya kwesFundo ekuqinisekiswa yiSAQA. Iminyaka yamava emizekelweni ye-(3) ethatha kwangaphambili ngokubambelela kwimali, kwabathengi basezibuleni kwakunye nokubala namagama abathengi njengoko kubalulekile ngoko. Ulwazi ngomthetho wePublic Finance Management Act (PFMA), iTreasury Regulations, ngokusetyenziswa koluhlu lwezinto ezifanelekileyo, nomthetho wezempilo, nemimiselo yelungiselelo lephondo. Ulwazi ngokusebenzisa isixhobo seBAS, iPEIS nananye ezinye iinkqubo ezifanelekileyo. Ukuba nakho ukusebenzisa iMicrosoft Office (Excel, Word nePowerPoint). Ukuba nelayisensi yomqhubi ekhoyo kuya kubakho nzuzo.
xh.duties: Lawula ubunye wasebenzela ngokugqithiselelo kwabathengi kwiiSebe ngokubakho kwenzuzo yokubhalisa abathengi kwakunye nokubalwa kwemali. Qinisekisa ukuba kukho nimalini engenileyo kwabathengi, iindulamthetho zezamakaladi ze-area yoluntu kunye nomthetho wokuba kube nenzuzo yemali ngokuphantse. Qinisekisa into yokuxhamla kwaye ulawule ngokuqinisekiswa kwesicelo samathuba abathengi abaya kuxhomekeka kwiinkqubo ezahlukeneyo. Lawula imisebenzi kwaye uzinike isikhokelo abasebenzi abasetyenziswa kummandla wokulawula abathengi. Yenza amacebiso ngokwandiswa kwamva ngokulawula nemali evela ngokubala abathengi. Zama ukujonga ngokukhulu ukuba zikho iziphene ezifana nokulawulwa kwemali, iziphene ezifana nokulawulwa kwabathengi nokulawulwa kwabathengi abangavunyelwanga. Hlaziya ukubhaliswa kwabathengi xa kusenziwa izibuko kwakhona ukuqinisekisa ukulungelelana kolwazi ngokulawulwa kwabathengi. Lawula abasebenzi abalawulayo kwakunye nokutsha kwemali ethathwa kubathengi abangenanga kwiinkalo ezingeyiyo. Hlola kwaye ugqibe ukulandelwa kwemigaqo ebalulekileyo kwaye wenze ulungelelwaniso neSebe ngemali engenayo kwakunye nophando lokuba ibone kakade.

zu.summary: Qapha abasebenzi besitodo kanye nokubuka imisebenzi yokugcina esibhedlela i-Mapulaneng Hospital e-Mpumalanga, kudingeka isitifikedi sesivivinyo sokuhweba kanye neminyaka emihlanu yohlelo lokuba ngumsebenzi kanye nokuba ngumlingiswa emva kokuthola iziqu njengengcweti.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi esifanele Sokuvivinya Ukwakha kanye neminyaka emihlanu (5) yokuhlela emva kokuthola iziqu njengengcweti nganoma yisiphi kulezi: ukudala / ukwakha izindlu / ukupenda / ukupayipa / ukunyakaza ngesiko kanye nobuchwepheshe bomabangazele. Ukwazi ngemithi yokuhlela nokugcina. Ukuzwana nge-PFMA ne-OHSA. Ukukhombisa abantu ukuthi bangaba ngabaholi abakhulu futhi bakhombise ukuthi bangaphatha. Isipho sokuba ukhulume ngokuthinta abantu ngokusebenza. Kudingeka ukuba ukwazi ukusebenzisa iKhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokushayela egunyaziwe.
zu.duties: Ukuqapha ngokusebenzisekayo nokuphatha imisebenzi yansuku zonke yabasebenzi besitodo esikhundleni sokwakha, ukwenza ukubukwa kweminyakazo yonke emiholweni futhi uqiniseke ukuthi wonke amahola ahambisana nemithetho ephathelene nalokho. Ukuthola, ukunika ukunakekelwa nokulandela imibhalo yokusebenza engakapelwa, ukuphatha ukulondolozwa kwakho konke okwakha urhulumende, ukulondoloza futhi ulawule imisebenzi yokulondolozwa yamathuluzi okusetshenziswa esitodweni, ukugcina ukukhishwa kwezinto ezingafunekiwe namafensiture ohlelweni lwezindlu zikarhulumende, ukuya emihlanganweni ephathelene nokugcina izinto kanye nemicimbe nezindlu ezingeni elifanayo. Ukusiza ngemali nezidingo ezidingekayo ezitholakala ngokuthenga izinto, kanye nokuqashwa kwemisebenzi yesitodo. Ukuphatha abasebenzi namabhajethi abekwe unyaka ngamunye ngokuhambisana ne-PMDS kanye ne-PFMA. Ukwazi ukuthi kufuneka ukugcwaliswa okufundwayo. Ukuphatha ukushiya kwabasebenzi nokuphatha abantu basebenzayo. Ukwakha imibhalo engakwazi ukunikeza umbiko wemisebenzi yokwakhiwa kanye nezinye izinto ezitholakalayo uma kudingeka.

jobs.requirements: Senior Certificate / Grade 12 or equivalent qualification. Diploma / Degree (NQF Level 6/7) in Accounting / Finance / Financial Management / Management Accounting as recognised by SAQA. Knowledge and experience of provisioning administration, focus in the following areas: Public Finance Management Act (PFMA) and Treasury Regulations. Computer literacy. Sound interpersonal and communication skills (written and verbal). Good management and supervisory skills. Ability to work independently and tight deadlines. Valid driver’s license will be an added advantage.
jobs.duties: Capturing of receipts and journals on BAS. Process debtor’s accounts. Monitoring of PEIS accounts. Billing of PAIA accounts. Administer sectional logistics. Collect cash and deposit. Prepare reconciliation and financial reports. Request reports on BAS for submission to Treasury. Consolidate revenue information as received from various facilities.

af.title: Staatshoudkundige: Inkomstebestuur
af.summary: Staatshoudkundige in Inkomstebestuur by die Department of Health Provinsiale Kantoor in Mbombela, waarvoor 'n diploma of graad in rekenkunde of finansies vereis word.
af.requirements: Senior Certificate / Grade 12 of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie. Diploma / Graad (NQF Level 6/7) in Accounting / Finance / Financial Management / Management Accounting soos deur SAQA erken. Kennis en ervaring van voorsieningsadministrasie, met die fokus op die volgende areas: Public Finance Management Act (PFMA) en Treasury Regulations. Rekenaargeletterdheid. Sterk interpersoonlike en kommunikasievaardighede (skriftelik en mondeling). Goeie bestuurs- en toesighoudingsvaardighede. Vermoë om onafhanklik en binne streng sperdatums te werk. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie sal 'n voordeel wees.
af.duties: Vaslegging van kwitansies en joernale op BAS. Verwerk van debiteurrekeninge. Monitering van PEIS-rekeninge. Fakturering van PAIA-rekeninge. Administreer van afdelingslogistiek. Versamel kontant en deponeer dit. Voorberei van afstemming en finansiële verslae. Verslae op BAS aanvra vir voorlegging aan Treasury. Konsolideer inkomsteinligting soos ontvang van verskeie fasiliteite.

zu.title: Isikhwama sezimali sesifunda: Ukuphathwa kwezimali ezingenayo
zu.summary: Isikhwama sezimali sesifunda ekuphathweni kwezimali ezingenayo ehhovisi lesifunda le Department of Health e Mbombela, sidinga idiploma noma iziqu zesibili noma zezezimali.
zu.requirements: Ithifikhethi yesibili / Ithifikasi le Grade 12 noma iziqu ezilinganayo. Idiploma / Iziqu (NQF Level 6/7) kwi-Accounting / Finance / Financial Management / Management Accounting njengoba kuhlonzwa yi-SAQA. Ulwazi noluhlu kokusebenza ekuphathweni kokuhanjiswa kwezinsiza, kugxile kule minxhambela elandelayo: Public Finance Management Act (PFMA) kanye Nemithetho ye-Treasury. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha. Amakhono amahle abantu nokuxhumana (okushiwo nokuqoshwe). Amakhono amahle okuphatha nokuhlola. Ikono lokusebenza ngabodwa nangemikhawulo yensuku eqondile. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile izoba yinqwaba.
zu.duties: Ukuqophisa kokwamukelwa kwezimali namajenali kwi-BAS. Ukucubungula ama-akhawunti abanikazi zikweletela. Ukuqapha ama-akhawunti e-PEIS. Ukuvela kwamabili ase-PAIA. Ukuphathwa kwezidingo zezigaba. Ukuqoqa imali yemali eshandayo nokuYinikela. Ukulungiselela ukuhambisana nemibiko yezimali. Ukucela imibiko kwi-BAS yokuhambisela i-Treasury. Ukuhlanganisa ulwazi lwemali ezingayo njengoba kutholakala kuzikhungo eziphuma kwindawo ehlukene.

xh.title: IsiNgqamlili seLizwe: ulawulo lweNgeniso
xh.summary: IsiNgqamlili seLizwe kulawulo lweNgeniso kwiSebe lezeMpilo eNdiro yasePhondo eMbombela, lifuna idiploma okanye isidanga kwakuwo nama-finansisi.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi samabanga aPhezulu / ibanga lesi-12 okanye isifanekiso esilinganayo. Idiploma / isidanga (iNqanaba le-NQF 6/7) kwi-Akawonting /Ama-finansisi / ulawulo lweFinansisi / ukuLwa ama-akhawunti njengoko kunjengokwamkelwa yi-SAQA. Ulwazi namava okwenza ulawulo, ngenxaxheba kule minxaka ilandelayo: uMthetho wokuLawula iFinansisi kaRhulumente (PFMA) nemiQathango yeTreasury. Ukuzazi ikhompyutha. Amaxabiso amanye namakhono okupezulu (okubhaliweyo noku-thethwa). Amakhono amaninzi okulawula nokulawula abanye. Isakhono sokusebenza izimeleyo nangemigibezo emxinileyo yexesha. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba evakalayo iya kuba lusazo olongezelelweyo.
xh.duties: Ukuqhoboshela kwinani lemali efakiweyo namajenali kwi-BAS. Ukuqhubeka nama-akhawunti abanikazi. Ukuqaphela i-akhawunti ze-PEIS. Ukubhala ii-akhawunti ze-PAIA. Ukulawula iindaba zokuhanjiswa. Ukuqokelela imali yentsasa nokuyifaka. Ukuqulunqa ulungelelwaniso neentsingiselo ze-finansisi. Ukucaela iintsingiselo kwi-BAS ngokuze zithunyelwe kwiTreasury. Ukuqokelela iindaba zefuthe njengoko zifunyanwa kumaziko amaninzi.

zu.title: Isiphathimandla Sikahulumini: Ukuphathwa Kwezimali Ezivela Kwiklayenti
zu.summary: Isiphathimandla Sikahulumini sokuPhatha Iminyuzo emiHlinzeki eKliniko eminingi Ehlanzeni District, sidinga ithuzwi noma iziqu kwezezimali kanye naloluvo lwe-BAS.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi Samabanga Aphakeme / Ikhredithi 12 noma iziqu ezilinganayo. Ithuzwi / Iziqu (izinga 6/7) kwezezimali / ezezimali / ukuphathwa kwezimali / ukuphathwa kwezimali njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA. Ulwazi naloluvo ekuphathweni kokuheni, kugxilwe kule minyuzo elandelayo: Umthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezimali Zikahulumeni (PFMA) kanye Nolawulo Lwezimali Zolundi. Ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha. Amakhono apheleleyo wokuxhumana nabantu nokuthintana (okulotshiwe nokuvezwa ngesandaso). Amakhono apheleleyo okuphatha nokuhola. Ukusebenza wedwa kanye nemiqingo eminye. Ilayisensi yokushayela ebhalwe ngokusemthethweni izongeza inzuzo.
zu.duties: Ukungena kwezimali ezivela kubathintana kanye nezinkomba kwi-BAS. Ukucubungula amakhaphili aba thintana. Ukuqaphela izinkaphili ze-PEIS. Ukuphathwa kwamakhaphili e-PAIA. Ukulawula ingqikithi yamawa eminyuzo. Ukuqoqa imali kanye nokuze. Ukulungiselela ukulinganisa kanye nezibikelelo zezimali. Ukucela izibikelelo kwi-BAS ukuba zithunyelwe kuMnyango wezezimali. Ukuhlanganisa ukwaziswa kwemali etholwe emahhovisi amaningi.

xh.title: IsiNtwala sikarhulumente: Ukulawula Imali engenayo
xh.summary: IsiNtwala sikarhulumente sokulawula imali engenayo kumaziko emitholampilo amaninzi kwisebe le-Ehlanzeni District, efuna idiploma okanye isidanga kubuchwephesha bamali okanye ezimali kunye nolwazi ngokusebenza kwi-BAS.
xh.requirements: Isetifikathi samabanga aphezulu / Grade 12 okanye isiqinisekiso esilinganayo. Idiploma / Isidanga (NQF Level 6/7) kubuchwephesha bamali / ezimali / ekulawulweni kwezimali / ekubalweni kwezimali njengokubonwa yi-SAQA. Ulwazi nolugqitho lokwenza izinto kwi-intetho yokulawula, ukugqitha kwimisebenzi elandelayo: I-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA) kunye neemigaqo ze-Treasury. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngakomphe. Amakhono amabaliseleyo wokuchazana nabantu nokuqhanga (okubhalwayo nokuqhelanayo). Amakhono amnandi okulawula nokuqhuba. Amandla okusebenza lodwa nasekuhambeleni nemihla yokugqiba emiselweyo. Ileyisensi yokuqhayisha esemthethweni iya kuba lusizo olongezelelekileyo.
xh.duties: Ukungena kwemali engenayo kunye namajurnali kwi-BAS. Ukuqhubekeka kweekhawunti zabatyali-mali. Ukulandela iikhawunti ze-PEIS. Ukubhala iikhawunti ze-PAIA. Ukuphatha i-logistics yamacandelo. Ukuyigcina nokuqulatha imali. Ukulungiselela ukulinganisa nokuvelisa iinkcazelo ngezimali. Ukufuna iinkcazelo kwi-BAS eziza kuthunyelwa kwi-Treasury. Ukuqokelela ndawonye iinkcazelo zemali engenayo enjengoko efumaniswa kumaziko ahlukeneyo.

zu.title: Isikhulu sezimali sesifunda: Ukuphathwa kwenzuzo
zu.summary: Umnyango wezempilo ufuna abalulele abasilumbu sezimali bezifunda abayisishiyagalombili bokuphathwa kwenzuzo kulo lonke ezibhedlela ezahlukene esifundeni iNkangala, eMpumalanga, kudingeka iziqu zezezimali namava kubuhle obungu-BAS.
zu.requirements: Isiqinisekiso samabanga aphezulu / IGrade 12 noma iziqu ezingalinganiselwa. Idiploma / I-degree (Inqubo level 6/7) kwezimali / Ezezimali / Ukuphathwa kwezimali / Ukuphathwa kwezimali njengokuqashelwa u-SAQA. Ulwazi namava okuphathwa kwezinsiza, kugxilwe kule minyaka elandelayo: umthetho wokuphathwa kwemali kahulumeni (PFMA) kanye nemithetho yokuphathwa kwesikhwama. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amakhono ahle okuhlobana nokuxhumana (okubhaliwe nokuvezwa ngesikhulumi). Amakhono ahle okuphatha nokubusa. Ukukwazi ukusebenza ngokuzimela futhi kumikhawu yesikhathi eqinile. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile izoba yinuzuzo.
zu.duties: Ukungena kwamasheya namajinali kubuhle obungu-BAS. Ukucubungula ama-akhawunti abanikazi. Ukuqapha ama-akhawunti e-PEIS. Ukubhala izikweletu kuma-akhawunti e-PAIA. Ukuphathwa kokuhanisa kwesigaba. Ukuqoqa imali nediphozithi. Ukuhlezisa imibiko yokubambisana kwezimali. Ukucela imibiko kubuhle obungu-BAS ukuyinika u-Treasury. Ukuhlanganisa ulwazi lwenzuzo njengoba lutholakala kulezi zikhungo ezahlukene.

xh.title: Isikhalazi sezethu: Ulawulo Lemali Engenayo
xh.summary: Isebe lezeMpilo lifuna abasikhalazi bezethu abasibhozo bokulawula imali engenayo kumaziko amaninzi ohlwini laseNkangala, eMpumalanga, kwaye kufuneka nabho na isidanga kwezimali nolwazi kwiBAS.
xh.requirements: Isetifikethi ePhakamileyo / Ireyithi 12 okwesidanga esilinganayo. Isidiploma / Isidanga (NQF Level 6/7) kwi-Akhawunti / Imali / Ulawulo Lwezimali / Ulawulo Lwe-Akhawunti njengokuvunywa yiSAQA. Ulwazi namava kolawulo lwenkonzo, egxile kummandala olandelayo: uMthetho woLawulo lweMali yoLuntu (PFMA) nemiQathango yeTreasury. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ikhono elizayo lokuziphatha nokuchazwa koluntu (elibhalwayo noluthethwayo). Iikhono ezilungileyo lokulawula nokubeka ihlo. Ikhono lokusebenza nokuzimeleyo namaxesha axhomekeke kakhulu. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni iya kuba nzuzo.
xh.duties: Ukufaka iinkokhelo namajenal kwiBAS. Ukucubungula i-akhawunti zesikwere. Ukulawula i-akhawunti ze-PEIS. Ukubhala i-akhawunti ze-PAIA. Ukulawula izixhobo zendawo. Ukujongana nemali nokuze yomhlala. Ulungiselelo ukuvumelanisa iinkcazelo zemali. Ukucela iinkcazelo kwiBAS zokuhambisela kwiTreasury. Ukudibanisa iinkcukacha zemali ezingenayo ezitholwe kumaziko ahlukene.

af.title: Staatsrekenmeester: Inkomstebestuur
af.summary: Die Department of Health soek 'n Staatsrekenmeester vir inkomstebestuur by hospitale in die Gert Sibande Distrik, Mpumalanga.
af.requirements: Senior Certificate / Grade 12 of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie. Diploma / Degree (NQF Level 6/7) in Accounting / Finance / Financial Management / Management Accounting soos deur SAQA erken. Kennis en ervaring van voorraadadministrasie, met fokus op die volgende areas: Public Finance Management Act (PFMA) en Treasury Regulations. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Goeie interpersoonlike en kommunikasievaardighede (skriftelik en mondelings). Goeie bestuurs- en toesighoudende vaardighede. Vermoë om onafhanklik en binne styf sperdatums te werk. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie sal 'n voordeel wees.
af.duties: Vaslegging van kwitansies en joernale op BAS. Verwerk skuldenaarsrekeninge. Monitor PEIS-rekeninge. Fakturering van PAIA-rekeninge. Administereer afdelingslogistiek. Verwerk kontant en deponeer dit. Berei afstemmings- en finansiële verslae voor. Versoeke verslae op BAS vir voorlegging aan Treasury. Konsolideer inkomsteinligting soos ontvang van verskeie fasiliteite.

zu.summary: Umnyango Wezempilo ufuna isiBali sombuso sokuphathwa kwezimali ezingenayo kulo lonke izibhedlela e-Gert Sibande District, e-Mpumalanga.
zu.requirements: Ithifikheti ye-Senior / i-Grade 12 noma izifundo ezilinganayo. I-Diploma / I-Degree (NQF Level 6/7) ku-Accounting / Finance / Financial Management / Management Accounting njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA. Ulwazi namava okuphathwa kwezinsizakalo, kugxilwe kule minyakazoilandelayo: Public Finance Management Act (PFMA) kanye nemithetho ye-Treasury. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amakhono amahle okuxhumanana nokuchaza (okubhalwayo nokuvezwayo). Amakhono amahle okuphatha nokuhlola. Ikhono lokusebenza kedwa futhi ukuhlangabezane nesikhathi esibekiwe. Ilayisensi yokuqasha ezohamba izoholela enye udumo.
zu.duties: Ukufaka izitifikedi namajenali ku-BAS. Ukucubungula ama-akhawunti abanikazi. Ukuqaphela ama-akhawunti e-PEIS. Ukubhala ama-akhawunti e-PAIA. Ukuphathwa kwezimpahla ezihlotshaniswayo. Ukuyixa imali yethenga kwayibhake. Ukulungiselela ukubuyekeza okanye nemibiko yezimali. Ukucela imibiko ku-BAS ukuyethunyelwa ku-Treasury. Ukuhlanganisa imininingwane yezimali ezingenayo njengoba etholakale kuzo zonke izikhungo ezahlukene.

xh.title: UmGcini weLizwe: ulawulo lweNgeniso
xh.summary: Isebe lezeMpilo lifuna uMgCini weLizwe kulawulo lwengeniso kumazibutsha kuGert Sibande District, Mpumalanga.
xh.requirements: I-Certificate yesiNgangeziqu / i-Grade 12 okanye isiqinisekiso esilinganayo. I-Diploma / i-Degree (NQF Level 6/7) kwi-Accounting / i-Finance / i-Financial Management / i-Management Accounting njengokuqatshwa yi-SAQA. Ulwazi nolwazi lokusebenza kolawulo lwezenzo, kunxulumene nendawo ezingezelayo: i-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA) neTreasury Regulations. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amakhono amaninzi okuzincedisana nabantu nokuqhubekekana (okubhaliweyo nokuthethwayo). Amakhono alungeleleneyo okulawula nokuqonda abanye. Ukuba nakho ukusebenza ngokwakho nangamaxesha asondeleyo. I-License yokushayela evakalayo iya kuba ngaphezulu.
xh.duties: Ukufaka izitiya nokubhala kwi-BAS. Ukucwangcisa i-accounts zabo bafuna imali. Ukujonga amanye ama-PEIS accounts. Ukubhala ama-PAIA accounts. Ulawulo lwezihlabathi. Ukuqokelela imali yamakhadi nokuyifaka. Ukwazisa nokulungelelanisa iinkcazelo zemali. Ukucela iinkcazelo kwi-BAS eziza kuqatshelwa kuTreasury. Ukufaka ndawonye iinkcazelo ngenkcazelo efunyanwa kumaziko amaninzi.

jobs.summary: Professional Nurse Grade 1 positions at Witbank and Mapulaneng Hospitals in Mpumalanga, requiring SANC-registered nursing qualification.

Ability to function independently and to prioritize work. Leadership and sound interpersonal skills, problem solving and decision- making skills.

Promote quality of nursing care as directed by the professional scope of practice and standards. Participate in the implementation of the National Core Standards and Ideal Hospital Realization Framework. Demonstrate effective communication with patients, supervisors and other clinicians, including report writing when required. Work as part of the multi-disciplinary team to ensure quality nursing care. Work effectively, co-operatively amicably with persons of diverse intellectual, cultural, racial or religious differences. Able to plan and organize own work and that of support personnel to ensure proper nursing care. Display a concern for patients, promoting and advocating proper treatment and care including awareness and willingness to respond to patient needs, requirements and expectations (Batho- Pele). Effectively manage resources allocated in your unit.

af.title: Professionele Verpleegkundige Vlak 1 (PN-A2): Algemene Verpleging
af.summary: Professionele Verpleegkundige Vlak 1-posisies by Witbank- en Mapulaneng-hospitale in Mpumalanga, vereis 'n by SANC geregistreerde verpleegkwalifikasie.
af.requirements: Senior Certificate / Grade 12 plus basiese kwalifikasie geakkrediteer by die SANC volgens Regeringskennisgewing (d.w.s. Diploma / Graad in Algemene Verpleging) of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat (2026). Vermoë om onafhanklik te funksioneer en werk te prioritiseer. Leierskap en goeie interpersoonlike vaardighede, probleemoplossing- en besluitnemingsvaardighede.
af.duties: Voer kliniese verpleegpraktyk uit ooreenkomstig die omvang van praktyk en verpleegstandaarde soos bepaal deur die gesondheidsfasiliteit. Bevorder gehalte van verpleegsorg soos bepaal deur die professionele omvang van praktyk en standaarde. Neem deel aan die implementering van die National Core Standards en Ideal Hospital Realization Framework. Toon effektiewe kommunikasie met pasiënte, toesighouers en ander klinici, insluitend verslagskrywing wanneer vereis. Werk as deel van die multidissiplinêre span om gehalteverpleegsorg te verseker. Werk effektief, saamwerkend en vriendelik met persone van uiteenlopende intellektuele, kulturele, rasse- of godsdienstige verskille. In staat om eie werk en dié van ondersteuningspersoneel te beplan en te organiseer om behoorlike verpleegsorg te verseker. Toon besorgdheid vir pasiënte, bevorder en beywer vir behoorlike behandeling en sorg insluitend bewustheid en bereidwilligheid om op pasiënte se behoeftes, vereistes en verwagtings te reageer (Batho-Pele). Bestuur effektief die hulpbronne wat aan jou eenheid toegewys is.

zu.title: Umongikazi Othwetshuliwe Izinga 1 (PN-A2): Ukunakekelwa Okujwayelekile
zu.summary: Izikhundla zomongikazi othwetshuliwe Izinga 1 ezisibhedlela i-Witbank nase-Mapulaneng e-Mpumalanga, ezidinga izifundo zokunakekela ezibhalisiwe kwi-SANC.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi som aphakeme / Izinga 12 kanye nesifundo esiyisisekelo esamukelekwe ne-SANC ngokwesaziso kahulumeni (okungukuthi i-Diploma / i-Degree ekuNakekelweni Okujwayelekile) noma isifundo esilinganayo esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-SANC njengomongikazi othwetshuliwe (2026). Ukukwazi ukusebenza nokubeka izinto ezibalulekile phambili. Amakhono obuholo nokuhana kahle nabantu, ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuthatha izinqumo.
zu.duties: Yenza umsebenzi wezokunakekelwa kwezempilo ngokwezimo nomuhla wokusebenza nemigomo yokunakekela njengokunqunywe isikhungo sezempilo. Khuthaza izinga eliphezulu lokunakekelwa njengokuqondiswa ngomkhondo wemisebenzi nemigomo. Thatha inxaxheba ekusetshenzisweni kweZindinganiso Eziyisiseko Zwezwe kanye ne-Ideal Hospital Realization Framework. Khombisa ukuxhumana okuphumelelayo nabaguli, abaphathi nabanye ochwepheshe bezokwelapha, kubandakanya ukubhala imibiko lapho kudingeka khona. Sebenza njengengxenye yethimhi elihlangene nezinhlanga ezahlukene ukuze kuqiniseke izinga eliphezulu lokunakekelwa. Sebenza ngokuphumelelayo, ngokubambisana ngokwamahle nabantu abanobunikelo obuhlukile emqondweni, esikweni, ebalweni noma enkolo. Ukwazi ukucubungula futhi uhlele umsebenzi wakho nalawo abasekelayo ukuze kuqiniseke ukunakekelwa okufanele. Khombisa ukukhathalela abaguli, ukukhuthaza nokusabalalisa ukwelashwa nokuNakekelwa okufanele kubandakanya ukuzwa nokuba buthaka ekuphendulweni izidingo, izidingo neziphephelo zabaguli (Batho-Pele). Phatha ngokuphumelelayo izinsiza ezinikiwe ohlelweni lwakho.

xh.title: Umongikazi weNgango lokuqama 1 (PN-A2): Ukuqonda Ngokubanzi
xh.summary: Izithuba zomongikazi weNgango lokuqama 1 kwiZibhedlele zaseWitbank naseMapulaneng eMpumalanga, zifuna isifundo sokongikwa esibhaliswe kwiSANC.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi esiphakamileyo / Isigaba sesi-12 kunye nesifundo esisisoko esamkelwe yiSANC ngokwesaziso likaRhulumente (oko kukuthi iDiploma / iDegree ekuQondweni ngokubanzi) okanye isifundo esilinganayo esivumela ukubhalisa kwiSANC njengomongikazi weNgango (2026). Ikhono lokusebenza kodwa nokubeka izinto ngokwambukela. Amakhono okukhokela nokuhamba kahle nabantu, ukusombulula iingxaki nokwenza izigqibo.
xh.duties: Yenza isabelo sokongikwa sezilonda ngokwemigama yomsebenzi nemizingqongo yokongikwa njengoko kumiswe sisisibhedlele. Khuthaza ngobuchule kunyuka kwengangatho yokongikwa njengoko kukhokelelwa ngummandla weNgango ogqwesileyo nemilinganisyo. Thatha inxaxheba kwentsebenzo yamagosa ampatho esizwe kunye neSiseko sokubonisela iZibhedlele eziPhilileyo. Bonisa ukunxibelelana ngokuchanekileyo nabagulayo, oogqwesa nabanye oogqirha bezilonda, kuquka nokubhala iingxelo xa kufuneka. Sebenza njengesicwingo sexesha elinamasebe amanin ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukongikwa ngobuchule. Sebenza ngokusebenza kakuhle, ngokusebenzisana ngokuhamba kakuhle nabantu abahlukene ngengqondo, inkonzo, isini okanye inkolo. Makakwazi ukucwangcisa nokuhlela umsebenzi wakhe nawalabo abancedisayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukongikwa ngokufanelekileyo. Bonisa inkathalo ngabagulayo, ukukhuthaza nokukhusela unyango nokongwa ngokufanelekileyo kuquka nokuziphendula kwiimfuno, iimfuno nokulindileyo kwabagulayo (Batho-Pele). Lawula ngokusebenzayo izixhobo ezabeliweyo kwiyunithi yakho.

jobs.title: Artisan (PRODUCTION) Grade A: Plumber
jobs.summary: The Department of Health in Ermelo seeks a Grade A Plumber to maintain water and sewer pipelines, monitor reservoir levels, and perform installations and repairs across the Gert Sibande District.
jobs.requirements: Minimum of Grade 10-12 or equivalent qualifications plus an appropriate completed apprenticeship and trade test certificate in Plumbing. Must have basic computer knowledge for time entry, preventative maintenance and work orders. Valid driver’s Licence. Willingness to work irregular hours and attend to emergencies when required. Ability to communicate in two of the three official languages of the Mpumalanga Province (read & write) Ability to work under pressure Must be willing to work in adverse weather conditions In physical sound and healthy condition Prepared to perform overtime and standby duties, including weekends and public as well as over peak periods, as and when needed.
jobs.duties: Responsible to monitor reservoir levels and sewer pumps Responsible for repairs and maintenance of water & sewer pipelines (mains) and fittings. Installation and maintenance of sewer connections and new mains. Responsible for materials and sores requisitions. Recordkeeping of daily work. Responsible for on-site Occupational Health & Safety. Responsible for Municipal assets and equipment. Responsible for supervision of staff.

af.title: Ambagsman (PRODUKSIE) Graad A: Loodgieter
af.summary: Die Department of Health in Ermelo soek 'n Graad A Loodgieter om water- en rioolpyplyne te onderhou, reservoirvlakke te monitor, en installasies en herstelwerk regdeur die Gert Sibande Distrik uit te voer.
af.requirements: Minimum van Graad 10-12 of gelykwaardige kwalifikasies plus 'n toepaslike voltooide vakleerlingskap en ambagsertifikaat in Loodgieterswerk. Basiese rekenaarkennis vir tydinskrywings, voorkomende onderhoud en werkorders. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Bereidwilligheid om onreëlmatige ure te werk en noodgevalle by te woon wanneer vereis. Vermoë om in twee van die drie amptelike tale van die Mpumalanga Provinsie te kommunikeer (lees en skryf) Vermoë om onder druk te werk Moet bereid wees om in ongunstige weersomstandighede te werk Fisiek gesond en gesond Veronderstel om oortyd en wagdienstpligte uit te voer, insluitend naweke en openbare sowel as tydens spitstye, soos en wanneer benodig.
af.duties: Verantwoordelik om reservoirvlakke en rioolpompe te monitor. Verantwoordelik vir herstelwerk en onderhoud van water- en rioolpyplyne (hooflyne) en passtukke. Installasie en onderhoud van rioolverbindingen en nuwe hooflyne. Verantwoordelik vir materiaal- en sore-aanvrae. Rekordhouding van daaglikse werk. Verantwoordelik vir ter plaatse Beroepsveiligheid en Gesondheid. Verantwoordelik vir munisipale bates en toerusting. Verantwoordelik vir toesig oor personeel.

zu.title: Umsebenzi wezandla (Ukukhiqiza) Isigaba A: Umshayelibhodi
zu.summary: UMnyango Wezempilo e-Ermelo ufuna uMshayelibhodi weSigaba A ukuze agcine uhide lokumanzi nolokuchago, abheke izinga lamanzi esigcini, futhi enze ukufakwa nokulungiswa kulo lonke i-Gert Sibande District.
zu.requirements: Ubuncane be-Grade 10-12 noma izifundo ezilinganayo kanye nokugcina isikhathi esifanele sokufundela umsebenzi nesitifikedi sokuhlola umsebenzi kwi-Plumbing. Kumele ube nolwazi oluyisisekelo lwekhompyutha lokufaka isikhathi, ukulondolozwa okuvikelwayo nemiyalo yomsebenzi. Ilayisensi yokuqasha esemthethweni. Ukuzithoba ukusebenza emahoreni angajwayelekile nokuvala izimo ezibucayi lapho kudingwa khona. Ikono lokukhuluma ngolimi abathathu ababhalwe njengezamaphakathi e-Mpumalanga Province (ukufunda nokubhala). Ikono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwengcindezi. Kumele uzithobe ukusebenza ngezimo zezulu ezingezinhle. Ubufitshana bezomzimba nokuphila kahle. Ukuzibalaza ukwenza amahora amaningi nemisebenzi yokulalela, okuhlanganisa amasonto nezikhathi ezibucayi njengoba kudingwa.
zu.duties: UNikezwe ngemithwalo yokubheka izinga lamanzi esigcini namaphayiphu okuchago. UNikezwe ngemithwalo yokulungisa nokugcina uhide lokumanzi nolokuchago (izinduku ezinkulu) nezinhlayiya. Ukufakwa nokugcina izinxibelela zokuchago nezinduku ezinkulu ezintsha. UNikezwe ngemithwalo yokucela izinto ezenziwayo. Ukugcina irekhodi lomsebenzi wansuku zonke. UNikezwe ngemithwalo ye-Occupational Health & Safety esiteshini senza. UNikezwe ngemithwalo yezimpahla zaseMunicipality nezithaya. UNikezwe ngemithwalo yokuqapha abasebenzi.

xh.title: Umsebenzisi wezandla (PRODUCTION) Inqanaba A: Indluluthi
xh.summary: Isebe lezeMpilo eErmelo lifuna indluluthi yeNqanaba A ukugcina amangcwele amanzi namasixhobo okutsala inkunkuma, ukulawula amanqanaba esixhobo esigcinela amanzi, nokuqamba nokulungisa kwindawo yonke yeGert Sibande District.
xh.requirements: U kufuneka ube neGrade 10-12 okanye izifundo ezalinganayo nayo nayiphi na i-apprenticeship egqityiweyo nesatifikethi senkqubo yovavho lwehlabathi kwiPlumbing. Kufuneka ube nolwazi olusisiseko lokusebenza kakhompyutha ukuze ungenise ixesha, ukulondolozo ngaphambi kokonakala nalothweni lomsebenzi. Kufuneka ube namalayisenseokushayela asebenzayo. Kufuneka uzimisele ukusebenza ngamaxesha angajelo kwaye uphendule kwezimo eziphuthumayo xa kufuneka. Ukwazi ukuxhumana ngeelwimi ezimbini kwezintathu ezisemthethweni eMpumalanga Province (ukufunda nokubhala) Ukwazi ukusebenza ngoxinezeleko Kufuneka uzimisele ukusebenza kwiimeko zezixhobo ezingathandekiyo Kufuneka ube nesimo somzimba esiphephile nesempilweni Kufuneka uzimisele ukusebenza ngaphezulu kwamaxesha aqediweyo nakumiselwe kumagqabhukadu, kuquka iintsuku zokuphumla namaxesha aphakamileyo, njengoko kudingeka.
xh.duties: Uyakuphatha ukulawula amanqanaba esixhobo esigcinela amanzi namapampu zesixhobo sokutsala inkunkuma Uphathe ukulungisa noku gcina amangcwela amanzi & amasixhobo okutsala inkunkuma (eyona magqabhukadu) nezixhobo ezidityaniswe kuyo. Ukuqamba noku gcina iindawo ezidityanisa isixhobo sokutsala inkunkuma namagqabhukadu amatsha. Uphathe izicelo zezinto nentsimbi. Ugcinelo lemisebenzi yemihla ngemihla. Uphathe ukuqinisekiswa kwezomculo kunye nokuqinisekiswa kwempilo nakwindawo yomsebenzi. Uphathe izixhobo namacebo kaMasipala. Uphathe ukulawula abasebenzi.

jobs.title: Head of Department (SUPERINTENDENT-GENERAL): CO
jobs.salary_text: R2 446 749 per annum (Level 16), (all-inclusive package). In addition, a 10% Allowance is payable as Head of Department
jobs.summary: Lead the Department of Co-operative Governance, Human Settlements and Traditional Affairs in Mpumalanga as Accounting Officer, requiring a postgraduate qualification and 10 years' senior management experience.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate postgraduate qualification (NQF level 8), as recognised by SAQA. 10 years’ experience at a senior management level. Core and Process Competencies include: Strategic Capability and Leadership, People Management and Empowerment, Programme Management and Empowerment, Financial Management, Change Management, Knowledge Management, Service Delivery Innovations, Client Orientation and Customer Focus and Communication. In addition, the incumbent will have to be sensitive to the political and strategic objectives of government. The ideal candidate should have the following qualities: Strong thinking capability. Ability to lead and align teams of senior professionals and analysts. Strong research, sound networking and interpersonal skills. Sound people management capabilities. Good exposure to knowledge management ethos and practices. Proven record of honesty and integrity as a professional/ manager. Good exposure to project management practices and systems. Sensitivity to the political-administrative interface, and appreciation of the policy support role within a politically led executive decision-making process.
jobs.duties: As an Accounting Officer for the Department of Co-operative Governance, Human Settlements and Traditional Affairs, the incumbent will be responsible to perform the following functions: Ensuring the efficient and effective management of co-operative governance, human settlements and traditional affairs matters. Providing strategic leadership to the delivery of co-operative governance, human settlements and traditional affairs programmes in the province. Facilitate all tasks related to the development, stability and viability of local government as well as the housing sector in the Province. Promote effective and mutually beneficial intergovernmental relations in the Province. Promote integrated development planning by local government. Co-ordinate disaster management support and disaster-related relief. Managing the provision of internal audit services. Ensuring compliance with the provisions of the Public Service Act and Regulations, collective agreements and other statutory obligations by the staff of the Department. Managing the financial, human and physical resources of the Department efficiently and in accordance with government policies. This is a contract post and the successful candidate will be required to enter into a five-years’ employment contract and a performance agreement with the Executive Authority. Short-listed candidates will be subjected to a competency assessment and security clearance.
jobs.enquiries: should be directed to the Deputy Director: Internal HRM & D: Ms. SS Monareng Tel No: (013) 766 2004.
jobs.applications: applications should only be submitted online through the link: erecruitment.mpg.gov.za
jobs.notes: Please forward your applications, quoting the relevant reference number to: E- recruitment Mpumalanga If no correspondence is received within two months of the closing date, applicants must accept that their applications have been unsuccessful. The Office of the Premier is an equal opportunity employer. It is our intention to promote representativity in respect of race, youth, gender and disability through the filling of this position and that the candidature of persons, whose transfer/promotion/appointment will promote representativeness, will receive preference. The minimum entry requirement for this post, i.e. Senior Management Services (SMS) posts is a Pre-entry Certificate that is obtainable through a course named Certificate for entry into SMS to be submitted to the Internal HRM and Development before appointment, and the full details can be sourced by following the link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms- pre-entry-programme on the new Z83 form and should be accompanied by a comprehensive CV. Only short-listed candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. The appointment is subject to security clearance, security vetting, employment reference checks, qualifications’ verification and signing of an employment contract and a performance agreement. The successful candidate will be required to disclose his/her financial interests. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Hoof van Departement (SUPERINTENDENT-GENERAL): CO
af.summary: Loods die Department of Co-operative Governance, Human Settlements and Traditional Affairs in Mpumalanga as Rekenaambeampte, wat 'n nagraadse kwalifikasie en 10 jaar se seniorbestuurservaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike nagraadse kwalifikasie (NQF vlak 8), soos deur SAQA erken. 10 jaar se ervaring op 'n seniorbestuursvlak. Kern- en prosesbevoegdhede sluit in: Strategiese vermoë en leierskap, mensebestuur en bemagtiging, programbestuur en bemagtiging, finansiële bestuur, veranderingbestuur, kennisbestuur, diensleweringinnoviasies, kliëntgerigtheid en klantefokus en kommunikasie. Dabenewens sal die ampsdraer sensitief moet wees vir die politieke en strategiese doelwitte van die regering. Die ideale kandidaat behoort die volgende eienskappe te hê: Sterk denkvermoë. Vermoë om spanne van senior professioneles en ontleders te lei en in lyn te bring. Sterk navorsing, goeie netwerk- en interpersoonlike vaardighede. Sterk mensebestuursbevoegdhede. Goeie blootstelling aan kennisbestuurseos en -gebruike. Bewese rekord van eerlikheid en integriteit as 'n professionele/ bestuurder. Goeie blootstelling aan projekbestuurgebruike en -stelsels. Sensitiwiteit vir die politiek-administratiewe koppelvlak, en waardering van die beleidsondersteuningsrol binne 'n politiek geleide uitvoerende besluitnemingsproses.
af.duties: As 'n Rekenaambeampte vir die Department of Co-operative Governance, Human Settlements and Traditional Affairs, sal die ampsdraer verantwoordelik wees om die volgende funksies uit te voer: Verseker die doeltreffende en effektiewe bestuur van samewerkende bestuur, menslike nedersettings en tradisionele sake-aangeleenthede. Verskaf strategiese leierskap aan die lewering van samewerkende bestuur, menslike nedersettings en tradisionele sake-programme in die provinsie. Fasiliteer alle take wat verband hou met die ontwikkeling, stabiliteit en lewensvatbaarheid van plaaslike regering asook die behuisingsektor in die Provinsie. Bevorder effektiewe en wedersyds voordelige interregeringsverhoudinge in die Provinsie. Bevorder geïntegreerde ontwikkelingsbeplanning deur plaaslike regering. Koördineer rampbestuursondersteuning en rampverwante verligting. Bestuur die verskaffing van interne ouditdienste. Verseker nakoming van die bepalings van die Public Service Act en Regulasies, kollektiewe ooreenkomste en ander statutêre verpligtinge deur die personeel van die Departement. Bestuur die finansiële, menslike en fisieke hulpbronne van die Departement doeltreffend en in ooreenstemming met regeringsbeleide. Dit is 'n kontrakpos en die suksesvolle kandidaat sal vereis word om 'n vyfjaar- indiensnemingskontrak en 'n prestasie-ooreenkoms met die Uitvoerende Gesag aan te gaan. Kandidate wat op die kortlys geplaas is, sal aan 'n bevoegdheidsassessering en veiligheidsklarering onderwerp word.

zu.title: Umhola WeNyango (UMPHATHI-JENERALE): CO
zu.summary: Mkhokhela iNyango ye-Co-operative Governance, Human Settlements kanye ne-Traditional Affairs eMpumalanga njengoOfisa Wezimali, okudinga iziqu ze-postgraduate kanye neminyaka eyi-10 yohlelo lokusebenza oluphezulu.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanele ze-postgraduate (NQF level 8), njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA. Unyaka lwe-10 lokusebenza ezingeni eliphezulu lokuphathwa. Amakhono abalulekile nokuqhuba amaphathiswa ahlanganisa: Amakhono okubhekise phambili nokuqamba izinqumo kanye noBuciko bokuhola, Ukuphathwa kwabantu nokubusiswa, Ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo nokuBusiswa, Ukuphathwa kwezimali, Ukuphathwa izeguvu, Ukulawula ulwazi, Amasu amtsha okuhlinzeka ngezenzo eziphumelelisayo, Ukuqondiswe kumthengi nokugxila kumthengi kanye nokuxhumana. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lowo okhethiwe kuzofanele azibe elungele imigomo yezombusazwe nokuqonda amagadu aphambili ohulumeni. Othile okumele abe nezimpawu ezilandelayo: Isipilipli esinamandla sokucabanga. Isipilipli sokuba uholele futhi uhlanganise amaqembu abangcweti nabahloli abaphezulu. Amakhono amahle okucwaninga, ukuxhumana futhi ahlonitshwe, kanye namakhono okuziphatha kahle. Ukubekezela kolwazi oluphathelene nezimo zabantu. Amakhono aphezulu emisebenzi yokulawula abantu. Isigameko esihle kumazinga okwazi nokusebenza emkhakheni wokulondoloza ulwazi. Umlando oqinisekisiwe wokuqotho nokuthembeka njengongcweti noma njengomphathi. Isigameko esihle kumasebhensi wokulawula izinhlelo nemithetho yokusebenza. Ukuzwela isixhumi esibukeka ngasese phakathi kokuphathwa kwezombusazwe, nokubuka kahle indima eseka imigomo ngenkathi kuthathwa izinqumo abaholi bezombusazwe abazimele.
zu.duties: NjengoOfisa Wezimali weNyango ye-Co-operative Governance, Human Settlements kanye ne-Traditional Affairs, lowo okhethiwe uzofanele athwale imithwalo yokwenza imisebenzi elandelayo: Ukuqinisekisa ukuphathwa kwezindaba ezenzeka kahle kanye nokusebenza kahle kwezindaba ze-co-operative governance, human settlements kanye netraditional affairs. Ukunikeza inkundla eya phambili ekulethweni kwezinhlelo eziphathelene ne-co-operative governance, human settlements kanye netraditional affairs esifundazweni. Ukuholela yonke imisebenzi ephathelene nokuqashwa komphakathi kwesifundazwe ngokuthuthukiswa, ukuzinza, nangokuphumelela kahle, kanti ngaphezu kwalokho nakumkhakha wezindlu esifundazweni. Ukukhuthaza okusebenza kahle futhi okuhle abe nomthelela omuhle ekuxhumiseni kobuhulumeni esifundazweni. Ukukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo ngokuhlangana komphakathi esifundazweni. Ukulungiselela ukwesekwa kwemiphumela yezimpisi nokulekelela okuphathelene nezimpisi. Ukuphatha ukunikezwa kohlulo abaningi bangaphakathi abahlola imisebenzi yangaphakathi. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu baphakathi kweNyango bahlala benza umthetho kanye nezezimali zomphakathi namazinga okulinganiselwa nemigomo yokuhlelekana eminye yomthetho. Ukuphatha ngokusebenza kahle ngokokwezimali, ngabantu, nangokwesakhiwo esenyangweni, ngendlela efunwa yizinkambiso kahulumeni. Lesi yisikhundla esibopha isikhathi futhi lowo ophumelelayo uzodinga asayine isivumelwano seminyaka esi-5 sokusebenza kanye nesivumelwano sokusebenza kahle nomphathi oyedwa. Abathunywa ababhaliwe bazobe bethola ulwazi ngezinkomba abakho, kanye nokuhlola ngokuvikelwa komkhakha wangasese.

xh.title: Umphathi weSebe (UMGQIBELI-NGAMBI): CO
xh.summary: Qhatha iSebe loBuhlobo phakathi koManyano, Izindlu zabantu neMicimbo yoMthetho wesiko eMpumalanga njengengozi mali, kufuneka nesiqinisekiso se-degree ephezulu kwaye unamava eminyaka eli-10 ekwisingqwebu sokulawula.
xh.requirements: Isiqinisekiso esifanelekileyo se-degree ephezulu (NQF level 8), njengokuqatshwa yiSAQA. Iminyaka eli-10 yamava kwinqanaba eliphezulu lolawulo. Amandla abakho nokuLawula iinkqubo aquka: Amandla okuzama kwezomnotho nokuLawula, uLawulo lwabantu nokuBa mandla, uLawulo lweenkqubo nokuBa mandla, uLawulo lwemali, uLawulo lokuTshintsha, uLawulo lolwazi, iindlela ezitsha zokuNika abantu iinkonzo, uMthetho wabaKhameli nokuQwalasela ngabathengi nokuThetha. Ngaphezu koko, lowo uzakuba kulesi sikhundla kuya kufuneka aziva neenjongo zolawulo ngezopolitiko zorhulumente. Umkhathi weziqinisekiso kufuneka abe nelishwa elilandelayo: Amandla amakhulu okucinga. Amandla okuba ngumlawuli yokulungelelanisa amaqela abantu abaphakamileyo nabahlalutyi. Amandla amakhulu ephando, ubudlelwane obuhle nabantu nendlela yokuziphatha. Amandla amakhulu ekuLawulweni kwabantu. Isiphelo eshle kwindlela nolwazi lokuLawula ulwazi. Irekhodi echazekileyo yinyaniso nokuZinikela njengomsebenzisi/ ngurhulumente. Isiphelo eshle kwindlela nolwazi lokuLawula iiprojekthi. Ukuva ngokubamba kwamandla ezopolitiko nolawulo, kwaye ukwazi ngomsebenzi ophethe iinkqubo kwigqiza elilawulwa ngabaphathi abaphathiswa ngamagqwetha.
xh.duties: NjengoNgcali yeMali kwiSebe loBuhlobo phakathi koManyano, Izindlu zabantu neMicimbo yoMthetho wesiko, lowo uzakuba kulesi sikhundla uzakuba nomsebenzi wokuZenza oku kulandelayo: Ukuqinisekisa ukulawula ngokuphumelelayo nangokusebenzisekayo izinto ezihlobene nobuhlobo phakathi komanyano, izindlu zabantu nemicimbo yomthetho wesiko. UkuNika urhulumente oyedwa isikhokelo sokuphumeza iinkqubo zombuhlobo phakathi komanyano, izindlu zabantu nemicimbo yomthetho wesiko esifundweni. UkuLawula yonke imisebenzi ehlobene nokuphuhlisa, ukuZinza nokuQina kurhulumente wasekhaya njengoko kukwayindlu esifundweni. UkuKhuthaza ubuhlobo obuphumelelayo nobusiswana phakathi kurhulumente esifundweni. UkuKhuthaza ulwabiwo-msebenzi oluqhubela phambili ngurhulumente wasekhaya. UkuHlanganisa inkxaso yokulawula iingozi nenceda kwiingozi. UkuLawula ukunikwa kweenkonzo zokuqinisekisa iinkqubo zangaphakathi. UkuQinisekisa ukuzithoba kwemigaqo yoMthetho woLuntu kunye neziQinisekiso, isivumelwano ngokubanzi nezinye iinkxaso ezikumthetho ngabasebenzi beSebe. UkuLawula iindlela zemali, abantu namandla okwenza izinto zeSebe ngokuphumelelayo nangokulandela iinkqubo zorhulumente. Olu lusebenzi olusayinwayo ngomqonthe lowo uzakuphumelela kuya kufuneka asayine isivumelwano seminyaka emihlanu yokusebenza nesivumelwano sokuphumeza nengozi eLawulayo. Abathunyelwe kumqondiso baya kuba sityhingi sokulinga namandla kwaye bahlolwe ngokukhuseleka.

af.title: Provinciale Inspekteurs
af.summary: Provinciale Inspekteurs word in verskeie Northern Cape dorpe benodig om padverkeerswetgewing toe te pas en voertuigondersoeke uit te voer.
af.requirements: Matrikulasiesertifikaat of Graad 12. Geldige kode B-bestuurslisensie met handratkas. Verkeersbeampte-diploma geakkrediteer deur 'n Verkeersopleidingsinstelling wat deur die Road Traffic Management Corporation goedgekeur is. Rekenaargeletterd. Wees medies geskik en in staat wees om onder strawwe toestande te werk. SAPS-oorblyfselsertifikaat - Geen strafrekord of hangende saak nie. Bereid wees om getoets te word. Kennis en vaardighede: Goedehuis en hulpbronbestuur. Goedehuis klanteverhoudingsbestuursvaardighede. Voltooiing van regstoepasingsdokumente. Kennis en begrip van padverkeers- en openbare vervoerwetgewing, beleide en riglyne. Kennis van voertuigondersoeke en voertuigbeslaglegging. Kennis van die Vuurwapen- en Ammunisiewet 60/2000. Gedragskode binne die Publieke Diens. Kennis van oorlaadbeheer en eskortepligte. Kennis van operasionele riglyne oor regstoepasingstoerusting. Vermoë om onder druk te werk. Goeie waarnemingsvaardighede (bewegende oortredings/defekte). Goeie bestuurs- en onderhandelingvaardighede. Soliede interpersoonlike en konflikoplossingsvaardighede. Goeie skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasievaardighede in ten minste twee van die provinsiale amptelike tale.

zu.title: Abaqaphi Besifundazwe

I-Diploma yephoyisa lezokuthutha evunyiwe isikhungo sokuthutha sokuthutha esivunyelwe yi-Road Traffic Management Corporation. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuqiniswe ukuba ngempilo futhi ukwazi ukusebenza ngezimo ezinzima. Isitifikedi sokucaciswa se-SAPS - Akukho rekhothi yokwenza icala noma icala eliqhubekayo. Volonti kokutholwa. Ulwazi nobuso: Uphathe kahle irekhodi nezinsiza. Ukuphatha abathengi ngamandla okuhlobana kahle. Ukuqedwa kwamadokhumenti wokuphoqa umthetho. Ulwazi nekuqonda umthetho wezokuthutha komgwaqo kanye nowohwebo wabantu bomphakathi, izinqubomgomo kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza. Ulwazi lokuhlolwa kwezimoto nokuboshwa kwezimoto. Ulwazi ngoMthetho Wamaphoyisa Namasotsha Amakhulu 60/2000. Ikhodi yokuziphatha ngaphakathi Kwesevisi Yomphakathi. Ulwazi ngokulawula ukugqitha isisindo nemisebenzi yokuqapha. Ulwazi lwemihlahlandlela yokusebenza ngokuphoqa umthetho. Ukusebenza ngokucindezeliwe. Ukubuka kahle (ukuphula umthetho ngesikhathi kuhamba / iziphazamiso). Amakhono okushayela nokuxoxisana kahle. Amakhono okuhlobana nabantu nokuxazulula izinkundla. Amakhono okubhala nokuqamba kahle okubhaliwe okungenamaphutha: Kungenani ngezilimi ezimbili ezisemthethweni wesifundazwe.
zu.duties: Phoqa kumthetho wezokuthutha komgwaqo, wabagibeli bomphakathi kanye nohwebo. Hlola amalayisense abashayeli, izimoto kanye nemithelela yokuhola izimoto. Inikeze ukulawula / ukuqapha kokuthutha okubonakalayo futhi ukhuthaze izinkunchaza zokuvimbela ubugebengu. Wenze wonke amasevisi okuphathwayo nemisebenzi ehlobene nawo

Ulwazi ngoMthetho wamasela nelungelo loqhakamshelwano wama-60/2000. Ikhodi yokuziphatha ngaphakathi koKonzo kaZwelonke. Ulwazi ngokuqhwesha isisindo namashwamshelo. jobs.title: State Accountant: Management Accounting
jobs.department: Department of Economic Development and Tourism
jobs.centre: Department of Economic Development and Tourism, Western Cape Government.
jobs.summary: State accountant sought for management accounting duties including budgeting, revenue and expenditure co-ordination, and reporting at the Western Cape Department of Economic Development and Tourism.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate 3-year National Diploma/B-Degree (equivalent or higher qualification) with Accounting or Economics as majors; A minimum of 1-year relevant experience in a financial management or similar environment; A valid (Code B or higher) driving licence. NB: People with disabilities that restrict driving abilities, but who have reasonable access to transport, may also apply. Competencies: Knowledge of the following: Management; Customer service; Project Management; Accounting Finance and Audit; Information Technology; Financial analysis; People Management. Skills in the following: Numeracy; Computer Literacy in MS Office; Language skills; Presentation; Research; Excellent verbal and written communication skills; Interpersonal relations; Flexibility; Innovation; Organising; Delivering Results and Meeting Customer Expectations; Adhering to Principles and Values; Writing and Reporting; Presenting and Communicating Information; Working with People; Ability to work under pressure.
jobs.duties: Assist in the co-ordination of the Budgeting and Planning portfolio; Assist in the co-ordination Revenue and Expenditure Portfolio; Assist in the co-ordination of the Reporting portfolio.
jobs.enquiries: Mr R Le Breton at Robert.lebreton@westerncape.gov.za or Tel No: (021) 829
jobs.applications: Only applications submitted online will be accepted. To apply submit your application online only: via http://www.westerncape.gov.za/jobs or https://westerncapegov.erecruit.co
jobs.notes: Shortlisted candidates will be required to attend interviews on a date and time determined by the department and submit documentation for verification purposes and criminal record vetting. All shortlisted candidates shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The selection process will be guided by the EE targets of the employing department. By applying for this position, you are consenting to the Western Cape Government contacting your previous employers/managers for an employment reference. Reference checks will include enquiries relating to your disciplinary records and reasons for leaving. Should you experience difficulties with your online application, technical support is available from Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 16.00. Contact the helpline at 086 137 0214. For all other queries relating to the position, kindly contact the enquiries person as indicated in the advert. Please ensure that you submit your application before the closing date as no late applications will be considered. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Staatrekenmeester: Bestuursrekenkunde

af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike 3-jaar Nasionale Diploma/B-Degree (ekwivalent of hoër kwalifikasie) met Rekenkunde of Ekonomie as hoofvakke; 'n Minimum van 1-jaar relevante ervaring in 'n finansiële bestuurs- of soortgelyke omgewing; 'n Geldige (Kode B of hoër) bestuurslisensie. NB: Mense met gestremdhede wat bestuursvermoë beperk, maar wat redelike toegang tot vervoer het, mag ook aansoek doen. Bevoegdhede: Kennis van die volgende: Bestuur; Kliëntediens; Projektbestuur; Rekenkunde Finansies en Oudit; Inligtingstegnologie; Finansiële ontleding; Personeelbestuur. Vaardighede in die volgende: Syferkundigheid; Rekenaargeletterdheid in MS Office; Taalvaardighede; Voorlegging; Navorsing; Uitstekende mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede; Interpersoonlike verhoudings; Buigsaamheid; Innovasie; Organisering; Lewering van resultate en die vervulling van kliënteverwagtinge; Die handhaving van beginsels en waardes; Skryf en rapportering; Voorlegging en kommunikering van inligting; Werk met mense; Vermoë om onder druk te werk.
af.duties: Help met die koördinering van die Begrotings- en Beplanningsportfolio; Help met die koördinering van die Inkomste- en Uitgawesportfolio; Help met die koördinering van die Rapporteringsportfolio.

zu.title: Um Accountant Kazwelonke: I-Management Accounting
zu.summary: Kufunwa um Accountant kazwelonke wemisebenzi ye-Management Accounting ehlanganisa ukwezimali, ukuhlanganisa imali engenayo nokuchithwa, kanye nokubika e-Western Cape Department of Economic Development and Tourism.
zu.requirements: I-National Diploma/B-Degree eneminyaka eyi-3 efanelekayo (iziqu ezilinganayo noma eziphezulu) ne-ne-Accounting noma i-Economics njenge-major; Okungenani unyaka oyi-1 wokuhlola okuhambisana kwindawo ye-financial management noma efanayo; Ilayisensi yokushayela (Code B noma iphezulu) evumelekile. NB: Abantu abakhubazekile abanokuqinisekiswa ukukwazi ukushayela, kodwa abanokufinyelela okuhambisana kwendawo yokuhamba, bangafaka futhi isicelo. Izikhokelo: Ulwazi ngalokhu: Ukuphathwa; Inkonzo yamakhasimende; Ukuphatha Imisebenzi; I-Accounting Finance kanye ne-Audit; I-Information Technology; Ukuhlaziya izimali; Ukuphathwa kwabantu. Amakhono ngalokhu: Ukubala; Ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha kwi-MS Office; Amakhono olimi; Okubhaliwe; Ukuphenya; Amakhono okukhuluma nokubhala okuhle; Ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu; Ukuguquka; Isimo sokuzangeza; Ukuhlela; Ukuletha imiphumela nokuhambisa okulindele amakhasimende; Ukuzinza ngemigomo nangamagugu; Ukubhala nokubika; Ukubhikisha nokwazisa ulwazi; Ukusebenza ngabantu; Isikhathi sokusebenza ngenkuthazo.
zu.duties: Lusiza ekuhlanganiseni i-Budgeting kanye ne-Planning; Lusiza ekuhlanganiseni i-Revenue kanye ne-Expenditure; Lusiza ekuhlanganiseni i-Reporting.

Qaphela: Abantu abanokukhawuleza ukukhawulezisa ukushayela kodwa abanendlela ezicwangqisiweyo yokufumana izithuthi banokwenza isicelo. Amandla kwimisebenzi elandelayo: Ukubala; Ulwazi lwesikhompyutha kwi-MS Office; Amandla kolwimi; Okokubonisa; Uphenyo; Amandla amabalide abhalwayo nethethwayo; Ubudlelwane nabantu; Ukuguquguquka; Izinto ezitsha; Ukulungiselela; Ukuphumisa iziphumo nokuzalisa iilwazi zabathengi; Ukuzinikela kumimiselo namaxabiso; Okubhaliweyo nokubikwayo; Okuboniswa nokuvelisa inkcazelo; Ukusebenza nabantu; Amandla okusebenza ngoxinzelelo.
