jobs.title: Clinical Manager (MEDICAL) Grade 1
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R1 479 723 per annum, (A portion of the package can be structured according to the individual's personal needs).
jobs.summary: Clinical Manager Grade 1 overseeing clinical services and medico-legal matters at the Northern/Tygerberg Sub-Structure Office in the Western Cape.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate Qualification that allows for registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa as a Medical Practitioner. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Practitioner. Experience: Minimum of 3 years appropriate experience as Medical Officer after registration with the HPCSA as Medical Practitioner. Inherent requirements of the job: Valid driver’s licence (Code B/EB) and willingness to travel. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Strong leadership, organisational operational and contingency planning skills. Independent decision-making and problem-solving skills. Good knowledge of applicable legislation, regulations and provincial policies. Proven management competencies in a public health environment. Appropriate experience of managing health services. Supervisory experience and experience in dealing with different stakeholders.
jobs.duties: Develop and nurture stakeholder relations in the Metro East Ecosystem. Oversee all clinical services within Northern Tygerberg Substructure. Ensure Quality Assurance and Medico Legal services for the Sub-structure. Clinical Governance systems design to support service improvement initiatives/innovation. Ensure implementation of service re-design and support within the Metro East Ecosystem. Ensure compliance with finance and supply chain processes with a focus on efficient service provision. Training/tutoring of junior Medical Officers. Act as custodian of the clinical governance (internal and external) and mentoring of clinical staff in the Sub-structure. Co-ordinate and facilitate outreach and support within the ecosystem.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. ERRATUM: Kindly note that the advert for the Post 28/215: Assistant Director: Expenditure Analysis and Management Reporting, Salary R487 197 per annum, Centre: Head Office (Cape Town) advertised in the Public Service Vacancy 28 dated 07 August 2026 with Ref No: 28/215. Kindly note that the post has been cancelled. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Klinieke Bestuurder (MEDIES) Graad 1
af.summary: Klinieke Bestuurder Graad 1 wat toesig hou oor kliniese dienste en medies-regtelike aangeleenthede by die Northern/Tygerberg Sub-Struktuur Kantoor in die Western Cape.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa as 'n Mediese Praktisyn toelaat. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Praktisyn. Ervaring: Minimum van 3 jaar toepaslike ervaring as Mediese Beampte na registrasie by die HPCSA as Mediese Praktisyn. Inherente vereistes van die werk: Geldige bestuurslisensie (Code B/EB) en bereidwilligheid om te reis. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Sterke leierskap, organisatoriese operasionele en noodbeplanningsvaardighede. Onafhanklike besluitneming en probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Goeie kennis van toepaslike wetgewing, regulasies en provinsiale beleide. Bewese bestuursbevoegdhede in 'n openbare gesondheidsomgewing. Toepaslike ervaring van die bestuur van gesondheidsdienste. Toesighoudende ervaring en ervaring in die hantering van verskillende belanghebbendes.
af.duties: Ontwikkel en koester belanghebbende verhoudings in die Metro East Ecosystem. Hou toesig oor alle kliniese dienste binne Northern Tygerberg Substructure. Verseker Kwaliteitsversekering en Medico Legal dienste vir die Sub-structure. Kliniese Regeringstelsels ontwerp om diensverbeteringsinisiatiewe/innovasie te ondersteun. Verseker implementering van diensherontwerp en ondersteuning binne die Metro East Ecosystem. Verseker nakoming van finansies en voorsieningskettingprosesse met 'n fokus op doeltreffende dienslewering. Opleiding/onderrig van junior Mediese Beamptes. Tree as bewaarder van die kliniese regering (intern en ekstern) en mentorskap van kliniese personeel in die Sub-structure. Koördineer en fasiliteer uitreik en ondersteuning binne die ecosystem.

zu.title: Umphathi Wezokwelapha (EZOKUHLOLA) Isigaba 1
zu.summary: Umphathi Wezokwelapha Isigaba 1 oqapha izinsiza zokwelapha nezindaba ezihlotshaniswa nemithetho yokwelapha ehhovisi le-Northern/Tygerberg Sub-Structure Office e-Western Cape.
zu.requirements: Isidingo semfundo esingaphansi kwesilinganiso: Isiqu esifanele esivumela ukubhalisa ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa njengomunyenti wezokwelapha. Ukuze kubhaliswe ebhungweni lobuchwepheshe: Ukubhaliswa ku-HPCSA njengomunyenti wezokwelapha. Isiphalaphala: Ukuncikelela okungu-3 iminyaka kokuhloniphekileyo njengoMphathi Wezokwelapha emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengoMunyenti Wezokwelapha. Izidingo ezingaphakathi zomsebenzi: Ileyisensi yokushayela evumelekile (Code B/EB) nokulungele ukuhamba. Amandla (ulwazi/izakhono): Amandla amakhulu okuhola, ukuhlela izindlela zokusebenza kanye nokuqamba izindlela zokumelana nezimo. Amandla okuthatha izinqumo ngokuzimela nokuxazulula izinkinga. Ulwazi oluhle ngemithetho, imithethonqubo kanye namapholisi abezifunda. Amandla obuqu obuqinisekisiwe bokuphatha kummandla wezempilo yomphakathi. Isiphalaphala esifanele ekuphatheni izinsiza zezempilo. Isiphalaphala sokubukeka kanye nokuqapha okuhambisana nabalingani abahlukene.
zu.duties: Yakha futhi uxhase izindlela ezihlotshaniswa nabalingani kwisimiso se-Metro East Ecosystem. Qapha yonke imisebenzi yokwelapha engaphansi kwe-Northern Tygerberg Substructure. Qinisekisa Ikhwalithi Yokweseka nokuxhasa imisebenzi ehlotshaniswa nemithetho yokwelapha kule nyanga. Yiliza amasistimu okuqonda kokwelapha ukuze uxhase izinhloso zokuthuthukisa insiza/ukubumbulwa. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kabusha kwenqubo yohlelo kanye nokuxhasa ngaphakathi kwesimiso se-Metro East Ecosystem. Qinisekisa ukuhambisana kwezimali nokuqhubwa kwezinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngokugxila ekunikezeni insiza efanele. Ukwethuta/ukufundisa abaphathi abasha bezokwelapha. Yiba ngumnikazi wobuqu bokwelapha (ngaphakathi nangaphandle) kanye nokulekelela abasebenzi bezokwelapha kwesiyingozi. Hlela futhi uxhase ukufinyelela kanye nokuxhasa ngaphakathi kwesimiso.

xh.title: Umphathi Wezempilo (EZONYEZELO) Inqanaba 1
xh.summary: Umphathi Wezempilo Inqanaba 1 oqhuba iinkonzo zempilo nezindaba zomthetho wezempilo kwi-Office ye-Northern/Tygerberg Sub-Structure kwi-Western Cape.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esingaphantsi: Isifundo esifanelekileyo esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengompraktisi wezonyezelo. Ubulungu bebhodi yabaphathi: Ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengompraktisi wezonyezelo. Isiphiwo: Incwadana yeminyaka elingaphantsi kwe-3 yamava afanelekileyo njengeMedical Officer emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengompraktisi wezonyezelo. Iimfuno ezibangelwa yisebenzi: Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba esemthethweni (Code B/EB) nolungelelwaniso ukuhamba. Iakhono (ulwazi/izakhono): Amandla okuhlala, ulwazi olusebenzayo lokuqwalasela nokucinga. Amandla okwenza izigqibo ngokuzimela nokuzeziphatha iingxaki. Ulwazi oluhle ngomthetho osebenzayo, iimigaqo namagunya obuzwe. Ulwazi olubonwayo lokuphatha kwindawo yempilo koluntu. Amava afanelekileyo okuphatha iinkonzo zempilo. Amava okuhlola nokusingathwa kwabo bakwamagumbi abahlukahlukeneyo.
xh.duties: Yakha kwaye ukhulise iziqu ezahlukeneyo kwisebe le-Metro East Ecosystem. Qwalasela zonke iinkonzo zempilo ngaphakathi kwase-Northern Tygerberg Substructure. Qinisekisa iinkonzo zeQuality Assurance nze-Medico Legal kulo lonke i-Sub-structure. Yila iinkqubo zomthetho wezempilo ukuze zixhasa izikhokelo zokuphucula iinkonzo/okutsha. Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa kwesicwangciso esitsha seenkonzo nokuxhasa kwisebe le-Metro East Ecosystem. Qinisekisa ukuthobela iinkqubo zemali netseko kwaye ugqamise ekubeni kuxhase ngokukhawuleza. Ukufundisa/ukuyalela ooMedical Officer abasezantsi. Ziba njengogcini womthetho wezempilo (ongaphakathi nangaphandle) nokuyala abasebenzi bempiIgcibini ngokuhamba kwexesha. Qhantsa kwaye ulawule iinkonzo zangaphandle nokuNxulumanisa kwi-Metro East Ecosystem.

jobs.title: Medical Officer Grade 1 to 3 (EMERGENCY Medicine)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R1 041 402 per annum Grade 2: R1 188 255 per annum Grade 3: R1 375 245 per annum (A portion of the package can be structured according to the individual's personal needs). (It will be expected of the successful candidate to participate in a system of remunerated commuted overtime)
jobs.summary: Medical Officer Grade 1 to 3 in Emergency Medicine at Groote Schuur Hospital, requiring HPCSA registration as a Medical Practitioner.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Medical Practitioner. Registration with the Professional Council: Registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Practitioner. Experience: Grade 1: None after registration as Medical Practitioner with the HPCSA in respect of SA qualified employees. 1-year relevant experience after registration as Medical Practitioner with a recognized foreign Health Professional Council in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service as required in South Africa. Grade 2: A minimum of 5 years’ appropriate experience as Medical Practitioner after registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Practitioner in respect of SA qualified employees. A minimum of 6 years’ relevant experience after registration as Medical Practitioner with a recognised foreign Health Professional Council in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service as required in South Africa. Grade 3: A minimum of 10 years’ appropriate experience as a Medical Practitioner after registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Practitioner in respect of SA qualified employees. A minimum of 11 years’ relevant experience after registration as Medical Practitioner with a recognized foreign Health Professional Council in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service as required in South Africa. Inherent requirements of the job: Commuted overtime is compulsory. Advanced Cardiac Life Support (ACLS) certified. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Ability to communicate effectively (verbal and written). Desire to conduct research. Completion of Community Service and prior Emergency Centre experience. Appropriate and sufficient clinical experience in the emergency environment seeing trauma and non-trauma patients. Additional course, ultrasound. Ability to work as part of a multidisciplinary team.
jobs.duties: Contribute to the teaching sessions for the department. Partake in the clinical governance for the department including medicolegal matters. Provision of quality clinical and non-clinical patient care in the trauma and non-trauma environment. Involvement in innovation projects and research activities within the department.
jobs.enquiries: Ms S Ndwebi Tel No: (021) 404-4157 or email: sinazo.ndwebi@westerncape.gov.za
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Please ensure that you attached an updated CV. Groote Schuur Hospital has adopted the department’s ecosystem framing of its training platform. Accordingly, all Medical Officer appointments may be called upon to work across this platform and may include rotations at Metro West and Rural East hospitals. This includes Red Cross War Memorial Children's Hospital, New Somerset Hospital, Mitchells Plein District Hospital, Victoria Hospital and George Provincial Hospital. Candidates will be subjected to a practical test. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements, may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration to register with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable on health professionals who apply for the first time for registration in a specific category with the relevant council (including individuals who must apply for change in registration status). It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. ERRATUM: Kindly note that the advert for the Post 28/215: Assistant Director: Expenditure Analysis and Management Reporting, Salary R487 197 per annum, Centre: Head Office (Cape Town) advertised in the Public Service Vacancy 28 dated 07 August 2026 with Ref No: 28/215. Kindly note that the post has been cancelled. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Mediese Beampte Vlak 1 tot 3 (EMERGENCY Medicine)
af.summary: Mediese Beampte Vlak 1 tot 3 in Emergency Medicine by Groote Schuur Hospital, wat HPCSA-registrasie as 'n Mediese Praktisyn vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n Mediese Praktisyn toelaat. Registrasie by die Professionele Raad: Registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Praktisyn. Ervaring: Vlak 1: Geen na registrasie as Mediese Praktisyn by die HPCSA ten opsigte van SA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 1-jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie as Mediese Praktisyn by 'n erkende buitelandse Health Professional Council ten opsigte van buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemers wat nie verplig is om Gemeenskapsdiens te verrig soos in Suid-Afrika vereis nie. Vlak 2: 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se toepaslike ervaring as Mediese Praktisyn na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Praktisyn ten opsigte van SA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 'n Minimum van 6 jaar se relevante ervaring na registrasie as Mediese Praktisyn by 'n erkende buitelandse Health Professional Council ten opsigte van buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemers wat nie verplig is om Gemeenskapsdiens te verrig soos in Suid-Afrika vereis nie. Vlak 3: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar se toepaslike ervaring as 'n Mediese Praktisyn na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Praktisyn ten opsigte van SA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 'n Minimum van 11 jaar se relevante ervaring na registrasie as Mediese Praktisyn by 'n erkende buitelandse Health Professional Council ten opsigte van buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemers wat nie verplig is om Gemeenskapsdiens te verrig soos in Suid-Afrika vereis nie. Inherente vereistes van die werk: Gependerde oortyd is verpligtend. Advanced Cardiac Life Support (ACLS) gesertifiseerd. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Vermoë om doeltreffend te kommunikeer (mondelings en skriftelik). Begeerte om navorsing te doen. Voltooiing van Gemeenskapsdiens en voorafgenoemde Noodsentrum-ervaring. Toepaslike en voldoende kliniese ervaring in die noodomgewing waar traumapasiënte en nie-traumapasiënte gesien word. Bykomende kursus, ultraklank. Vermoë om as deel van 'n multidissiplinêre span te werk.
af.duties: Dra by tot die opleidsessies vir die departement. Neem deel aan die kliniese bestuur vir die departement insluitend mediese regsake. Voorsiening van gehalte kliniese en nie-kliniese pasiëntsorg in die trauma- en nie-trauma-omgewing. Betrokkenheid by innoveringsprojekte en navorsingsaktiwiteite binne die departement.

zu.title: Dokotela Wezokwelapha Isizinga 1 kuya ku-3 (I-EMERGENCY Medicine)
zu.summary: Dokotela Wezokwelapha Isizinga 1 kuya ku-3 kwi-EMERGENCY Medicine esibhedlela i-Groote Schuur, edinga ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengenkulisi yezokwelapha.
zu.requirements: Isidingo semfundo esingaphansi kwesilinganiso: Isidingo esifanele esivumela ukubhaliswa ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengenkulisi yezokwelapha. Ukubhaliswa ku-Professional Council: Ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengenkulisi yezokwelapha. Isiphefundo: Isizinga 1: Akukho okudingekile emva kokuvela kokubhalisa njengenkulisi yezokwelapha kwi-HPCSA mayelana nabasebenzi abaneziqu eNingizimu Afrika. Unyaka we-1 wokuhlolwa okufanele emva kokuvela kokubhalisa njengenkulisi yezokwelapha ku-Health Professional Council yangamazwe ngamazwe evunyiwe mayelana nabasebenzi abaneziqu kwamanye amazwe, abangekesudingwa ukwenza I-Community Service njengoba kudingeka eNingizimu Afrika. Isizinga 2: Okungenani eminyaka engu-5 yokuhlolwa okufanele njengenkulisi yezokwelapha emva kokuvela kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengenkulisi yezokwelapha mayelana nabasebenzi abaneziqu eNingizimu Afrika. Okungenani eminyaka engu-6 yokuhlolwa okufanele emva kokuvela kokubhalisa njengenkulisi yezokwelapha ku-Health Professional Council yangamazwe ngamazwe evunyiwe mayelana nabasebenzi abaneziqu kwamanye amazwe, abangekesudingwa ukwenza I-Community Service njengoba kudingeka eNingizimu Afrika. Isizinga 3: Okungenani eminyaka engu-10 yokuhlolwa okufanele njengenkulisi yezokwelapha emva kokuvela kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengenkulisi yezokwelapha mayelana nabasebenzi abaneziqu eNingizimu Afrika. Okungenani eminyaka engu-11 yokuhlolwa okufanele emva kokuvela kokubhalisa njengenkulisi yezokwelapha ku-Health Professional Council yangamazwe ngamazwe evunyiwe mayelana nabasebenzi abaneziqu kwamanye amazwe, abangekesudingwa ukwenza I-Community Service njengoba kudingeka eNingizimu Afrika. Izidingo ezingokoqobo zomsebenzi: I-commuted overtime iyisidingo esiphikiselwayo. Ukuqinisekisiwe ngokwazi i-Advanced Cardiac Life Support (ACLS). Amakhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Ikhono lokuxhumana ngokusebenzayo (ngomlomo nangesibhalo). Ifiso yokwenza ucwaningo. Ukuqedwa kwe-Community Service nokuqashelwa ngaphambilini kokusebenza kwi-Emergency Centre. Isiphefundo esifanele nesanele sokuhlolwa kwezokwelapha esimweni sezesikhashana ukubona abaguliswa be-trauma kanye nalabo abangeyona i-trauma. Isifundo esingeziwe, i-ultrasound. Ikhono lokusebenza njengengxenye yethimba elinabanye abochwepheshe abahlukene.
zu.duties: Konkeleza kumahlela okufundisa ayohlela womnyango. Thatha inxaxheba kule-governance yezokwelapha yomnyango kuhlanganise izindaba ezimali nezemthetho yezokwelapha. Ukunikezwa kokunakekelwa kwezokwelapha okuningiliziwe nokungewona ezokwelapha kubaguliswa kwindawo ye-trauma nengewona i-trauma. Ukubandakanyeka kwamaphrojekthi wokuba ngokoqobo kanye nemisebenzi yokucwaninga ngaphakathi komnyango.

xh.title: Isebe lemisebenzi yamagosa ezempilo inqanaba 1 ukuya ku-3 (i-EMERGENCY Medicine)
xh.summary: Isebe lemisebenzi yamagosa ezempilo inqanaba 1 ukuya ku-3 kwi-EMERGENCY Medicine eGroote Schuur Hospital, lifuna ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengompraktisi wezempilo.
xh.requirements: Izifundo ezingcono kwindima: Isifundo esifanelekileyo esivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengompraktisi wezempilo. Ukubhaliswa kwi-Bhungo elisebenzayo: Ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengompraktisi wezempilo. Ulwazi: Inqanaba 1: Akukho nto emva kokubhaliswa njengompraktisi wezempilo kwi-HPCSA ngokuphathelele kwi basebenzi abaqeqeshiweyo eSouth Africa. Unyaka o-1 wolwazi oluhambelana nendima emva kokubhaliswa njengompraktisi wezempilo kwi-Bhungo elibonakalayo lezempilo elaziwayo lommandla ngokuphathelele kwi basebenzi abaqeqeshiweyo kwamanye amazwe, abangafunekiyo ukwenza iinkonzo zomphakathi njengoko kufuneka eSouth Africa. Inqanaba 2: Ubuncinane leminyaka eli-5 yolwazi elifanelekileyo njengompraktisi wezempilo emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengompraktisi wezempilo ngokuphathelele kwi basebenzi abaqeqeshiweyo eSouth Africa. Ubuncinane leminyaka eli-6 yolwazi oluhambelana nendima emva kokubhaliswa njengompraktisi wezempilo kwi-Bhungo elibonakalayo lezempilo elaziwayo lommandla ngokuphathelele kwi basebenzi abaqeqeshiweyo kwamanye amazwe, abangafunekiyo ukwenza iinkonzo zomphakathi njengoko kufuneka eSouth Africa. Inqanaba 3: Ubuncinane leminyaka eli-10 yolwazi elifanelekileyo njengompraktisi wezempilo emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengompraktisi wezempilo ngokuphathelele kwi basebenzi abaqeqeshiweyo eSouth Africa. Ubuncinane leminyaka eli-11 yolwazi oluhambelana nendima emva kokubhaliswa njengompraktisi wezempilo kwi-Bhungo elibonakalayo lezempilo elaziwayo lommandla ngokuphathelele kwi basebenzi abaqeqeshiweyo kwamanye amazwe, abangafunekiyo ukwenza iinkonzo zomphakathi njengoko kufuneka eSouth Africa. Iimfuno ezibekiweyo zomsebenzi: I-overtime ekuqwalaselwayo iyabhokhiswa ngamanyathelo. Ugqatso lwe-Advanced Cardiac Life Support (ACLS) olugqithisiweyo. Ikhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Ikono lokunxibelelana ngokusebenzayo (ngomlomo nangokubhalayo). Isifiso sokwenza uphando. Ukuqwalaselwa kweziGqibo zoMphakathi nokuba nolwazi kwiziko leNcedo yangaphambili. Ulwazi lokwelapha olufanelekileyo nolwaneleyo kwindawo yesimo esiphuthumayo ibona abaguli be-trauma nabanjengabo. Isifundo esongezelelweyo, i-ultrasound. Ikono lokusebenza njengenxenye yeqela elinezinto ezahlukeneyo.
xh.duties: Nika isandla kwiiqondo zokufundisa ze sehbe. Thatha inxaxheba kolawulo lwekliniki lwesebe kubandakanya izinto ezithintelwe ngokomthetho wezempilo. Ukunikwa ngokwakhona kwinkathalo yamagosa ezempilo nangaphandle kwindawo ye-trauma nangaphandle kwayo. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kumaprojekthi ezinto ezitsha nasekwenzeni uphando ngaphakathi kwesebe.

jobs.title: Registrar (MEDICAL)
jobs.salary_text: R1 041 402 per annum, (A portion of the package can be structured according to the individual's personal needs.)
jobs.summary: Registrar sought for Forensic Pathology Service in the Western Cape, requiring HPCSA registration as an Independent Medical Practitioner and a valid driver's licence.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as an Independent Medical Practitioner. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the HPCSA as an Independent Medical Practitioner. Inherent requirement of the job: Valid Code B/EB driver's license. Willingness to perform work outside normal working hours and away from base of employment according to an after hours duty roster. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Display knowledge and all other prescripts that concerns the functioning of a Forensic Medicine Department and continuous learning and improvement of knowledge and skills. Willingness to complete the Diploma in Forensic Pathology with the CMSA within 12 months of employment of this post. Ability to adhere to health and safety standards. Ability to adhere to requests, follow advice and instructions from consultants and conform to divisional protocols and professional ethical and behavioural code. Problem solving abilities, as can be expected from a Registrar in FPS. Continuous academic input and contribution, including case and topic presentations, conference participation, research and participation in all academic activities in the Division. Ability to successfully complete at least one research project and submit such research manuscript for publication in a peer-reviewed journal. Above-average ability to communicate clearly and discreetly in person and in writing. Ability to travel to peripheral FPS facilities should it be required to render a supportive function at other facilities in terms of service delivery requirements. Ability to work well within a group at all levels of authority. Ability to consult with the responsible consultant, HCU or HOD when unsure of how to proceed with a case or related problem and inform a consultant whenever any work-related complication arises. Ability to work under pressure. Organisational skills and ability to plan. Rendering effective and efficient service under consultant supervision. Above- average computer and software literacy. Medical Research capabilities. Ability to contribute to the Division's teaching program by assisting in the instruction of Medical, Biomedical Science and Law students, Forensic Pathology Officers and Medical staff. Ability to perform medicolegal autopsies in the examination of unnatural death admissions. Exposure to Post-mortems, autopsy work and dissection. -Good interpersonal skills including effective service delivery within a group situation at all levels of authority.
jobs.duties: To render effective and efficient service delivery to all stakeholders as per the standard of the Division. To compile reports as per the standards of the UCT Forensic Medicine and Toxicology. OFPI Division and Courts. Learning, Teaching and Training. To provide after- hour Forensic Medicine Service.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration to register with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. Candidates who are deemed "registrable" may also apply. The appointment of successful applicants will only be effected once proof of application for registration or the proof of registration is provided. Other: Registrars will be required to register as post-graduate students with the University of Cape Town of the Western Cape as applicable according to the requirements for the discipline in the yearbook and guidelines. All applicants must be South African citizens or permanent residents. It will be expected of the successful candidate to participate in a system of Remunerated Commuted Overtime. Employees in service who opt to continue with their pension benefits as Registrar, will be required to resign after completion of their Registrarship should they not be successful for advertised Specialist positions. Appointment conditions and rotation: Appointment of Registrars will be for a maximum contract period of 4 years (or 5 years dependent on the minimum requirements of the post). It may become necessary to second/ transfer staff to another hospital/ institution during their period of training, in which case affected staff will be consulted prior to any decision being implemented. -Registrars will function across health facilities, as per an agreed programme. Should the registration with the HEI as a student be discontinued for any reason, the appointment as Registrar also discontinues. Consideration will be given to existing employees who are already on higher salary packages to retain their existing salary position, as personal. As such they are entitled to receive pay progression. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. ERRATUM: Kindly note that the advert for the Post 28/215: Assistant Director: Expenditure Analysis and Management Reporting, Salary R487 197 per annum, Centre: Head Office (Cape Town) advertised in the Public Service Vacancy 28 dated 07 August 2026 with Ref No: 28/215. Kindly note that the post has been cancelled. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Registrateur (MEDIES)
af.summary: Registrateur gesoek vir Forensic Pathology Service in die Western Cape, wat HPCSA-registrasie as 'n Onafhanklike Mediese Praktisyn en 'n geldige bestuurslisensie vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie met die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n Onafhanklike Mediese Praktisyn toelaat. Registrasie met 'n professionele raad: Registrasie met die HPCSA as 'n Onafhanklike Mediese Praktisyn. Inherent vereiste van die werk: Geldige Code B/EB-bestuurslisensie. Bereidwilligheid om werk buite normale werkure en weg vanaf die basis van indiensneming volgens 'n buite-ure diensrooster te verrig. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Toon kennis van alle ander voorskrifte wat betrekking het op die funksionering van 'n Forensic Medicine Department asook deurlopende leer en verbetering van kennis en vaardighede. Bereidwilligheid om die Diploma in Forensic Pathology by die CMSA binne 12 maande na indiensneming van hierdie pos te voltooi. Vermoë om aan gesondheids- en veiligheidsstandaarde te voldoen. Vermoë om versoekte na te kom, advies en instruksies van konsultante te volg en aan afdelingsprotokolle asook professionele etiese en gedragskodes te voldoen. Probleemoplossingsvermoë, soos van 'n Registrateur in FPS verwag kan word. Deurlopende akademiese insette en bydraes, insluitend geval- en onderwerpaanbiedings, konferensiedeelname, navorsing en deelname aan alle akademiese aktiwiteite in die Afdeling. Vermoë om ten minste een navorsingsprojek suksesvol te voltooi en sodanige navorsingsmanuskrip vir publikasie in 'n geresenseerde joernaal voor te lê. Boon gemiddelde vermoë om duidelik en diskreet persoonlik en skriftelik te kommunikeer. Vermoë om na perifere FPS-fasiliteite te reis indien dit vereis word om 'n ondersteuningsfunksie by ander fasiliteite ter wille van diensleweringvereistes te lewer. Vermoë om goed binne 'n groep op alle vlakke van gesag te werk. Vermoë om met die verantwoordelike konsultant, HCU of HOD te oorleg wanneer onseker is oor hoe om met 'n geval of verwante probleem voort te gaan en 'n konsultant in te lig wanneer enige werkverwante komplikasie ontstaan. Vermoë om onder druk te werk. Organisatoriese vaardighede en vermoë om te beplan. Lewering van effektiewe en doeltreffende diens onder konsultant toesig. Bo-gemiddelde rekenaar- en sagtewarevaardigheid. Mediese navorsingsvermoë. Vermoë om by te dra tot die Afdeling se onderrigprogram deur te help met die onderrig van Mediese, Biomedical Science en Regstudente, Forensic Pathology Officers en Mediese personeel. Vermoë om mediesregtelike outopsies by die ondersoek van onnatuurlike sterfgeval-toelatings te verrig. Blootstelling aan post-mortems, outopsiewerk en disseksie. -Goeie interpersoonlike vaardighede insluitend effektiewe dienslewering binne 'n groepsituasie op alle vlakke van gesag.
af.duties: Om effektiewe en doeltreffende dienslewering aan alle belanghebbendes volgens die standaard van die Afdeling te lewer. Om verslae volgens die standaarde van die UCT Forensic Medicine and Toxicology op te stel. OFPI Division en Howe. Leer, Onderrig en Opleiding. Om buite-ure Forensic Medicine-diens te verskaf.

zu.title: Umbhali wesikhungo (EZOKWELAPHA)
zu.summary: Kufunwa umbhali wesikhungo wesevisi Yezosifo Ezingokwesabekayo Ezingokwezomthetho eWestern Cape, ofuna ukubhaliswa kuHPCSA njengodokotela Oziphexele kanye nesilayisense esivumelekile sokushayela.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zemfundo ezingaphansi kwemigomo: Iziqu ezifanele ezivumela ukubhaliswa kuHealth Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengodokotela Oziphexele. Ukubhaliswa enkundleni yezeprofeshane: Ukubhaliswa kuHPCSA njengodokotela Oziphexele. Isidingo esingokwemvelo somsebenzi: Isilayisense se-Code B/EB esivumelekile sokushayela. Ukuzithoba ekwenzeni umsebenzi ngaphandle kwezikhathi ezijwayelekile zokusebenza nangezindawo eziye kude nendawo yokusebenza ngokohlu lokusebenza emva kwezikhathi. Amakhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Ukubonisa ulwazi kanye nezinye izibhalo ezithintela ukusebenza kwesikhungo Sezokwelapha Ezingokwesabekayo Ezingokwezomthetho kanye nokufunda ngokuqhubekayo nokuthuthukisa ulwazi namakhono. Ukuzithoba ekugcineni i-Diploma in Forensic Pathology ne-CMSA phakathi kwezinyanga eziyi-12 zokusebenza kulesi sikhundla. Ikhono lokulandela izimiso ezingezempilo nokuqinisekisa ukuphepha. Ikhono lokuhambisana nezicelo, ukulandela izeluleko nezimiyalelo ezivela kobuchwepheshe kanye nokuzethoba emigomeni yeseqheme kanye nemikhuba yezokuziphatha nomumo wokuziphatha okungokweprofeshane. Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga, njengoba kujwayelekile kumbhali wesikhungo kwi-FPS. Ukuzibandakanya ngokwezemfundo ngokuqhubekayo nokuhlangabezana, okuhlanganisa ukwethula icala kanye nethonyo, ukubamba iqhaza emhlanganweni, ucwaningo kanye nokubamba iqhaza kuyo yonke imisebenzi yezemfundo kuSeqheme. Ikhono lokuphumelela ukugqama okingitisayo okuncane ngesiphiwo ucwaningo kanye nokuhambisa lolu cwaningo kumagazini ovunyiwe ngabanye ochwepheshe. Ikhono elingaphezulu kwelinganiselo lokuthinta ngocacile nangasese ngokomuntu nakubhalwe. Ikhono lokuhamba ezikhungweni ezingasenkabeni ze-FPS uma kudingeka ukuze kunikezwe ukusekelwa kwezinye izikhungo ngokwezidingo zokulethwa kwenkonzo. Ikhono lokusebenza kahle ngaphakathi kweqembu kuzo zonke izinga zobugunya. Ikhono lokubuzana nochwepheshe onobunikati, i-HCU noma i-HOD uma ungaboni qonda ukuthi kufanele kwenzeke nini ngocala noma inkinga ehlobene nalo kanye nokumazisa ochwepheshe noma kunikezwa noma yisiphi isimo esinzima esihlobene nomsebenzi. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwengcindezi. Amakhono abhekisisa nokuhlela. Ukuletha inkonzo ekhono nokuqhube kakhulu ngaphansi kokulawula kuchwepheshe. Ulwazi olungaphezulu kwelinganiselo lwekhompyutha kanye nohlelo. Amakhono ocwaningo Okwelapha. Ikhono lokuveza ohlelweni lokufundisa lweSeqheme ngokusize ekufundiseni abafundi beZokwelapha, Ezesayensi Eziphilayo kwe-Biomedical kanye Nezomthetho, Abasebenzi Befulawa Ezingokwesabekayo Ezingokwezomthetho kanye nabasebenzi Bezokwelapha. Ikhono lokwenza ukuhlolwa kwamadumbu okufa ngezizathu zomthetho ekuhenyweni kokwamukelwa kwengculaza. Ukuvezwa ekwenzeni ukuhlola emva kokufa, umsebenzi wokuqamba amadumbu nokuhlukanisa. -Amakhono amahle okuxhumana nabantu okuhlanganisa nokulethwa kwenkonzo esebenzayo ngaphakathi kwesimo seqembu kuzo zonke izinga zobugunya.
zu.duties: Ukuletha inkonzo ekhono nokuqhube kakhulu kubo bonke abahlanganyeli ngokomgomo weSeqheme. Ukuqamba imibiko ngokomgomo we-UCT Forensic Medicine and Toxicology. ISeqheme se-OFPI kanye Nenkantolo. Ukufunda, Ukufundisa Nokuqeqesha. Ukuletha inkonzo Yezokwelapha Ezingokwesabekayo Ezingokwezomthetho emva kwezikhathi.

xh.title: UmBhalisi (WEEZEMEZIMOTO)
xh.summary: Kufunwa umbalisi kwiNkonzo ye-Pathology ye-Forensic kwi-Western Cape, ofuna ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengomenzi weezenkolo ezizimeleyo kunye nelayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni.
xh.requirements: Imininzi yemfundo efunekayo: Isiqu esifanelekileyo esivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-Khonsele yooNgcali beeZempilo eMzantsi Afrika (HPCSA) njengomenzi weezenkolo ezizimeleyo. Ukubhaliswa nakononophelo lwezomsebenzi: Ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengomenzi weezenkolo ezizimeleyo. Imfuno enganisele yomsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokushayela ye-Code B/EB esemthethweni. Ukuzimisela ukwenza umsebenzi ngaphandle kweeyure zomsebenzi eziqhelekileyo kunye nakude nendawo yokusebenza ngokweshejuli yomsebenzi wemigexo yemiyalelo. Ikhompetensi (ulwazi/amakhono): Ukubonisa ulwazi kunye nayo yonke imiyo yomthetho ethe ngqo kumsebenzi wesebe le-Forensic Medicine nokuphucula ngokuhamba kwexesha ulwazi namakhono. Ukuzimisela ukugqiba i-Diploma kwi-Forensic Pathology nge-CMSA kwangelo xesha leenyanga ezili-12 zokuqeshwa kule sithuba. Ikhono lokuzinikela kwemigagu yempilo nakho kusingathi kwangoku. Ikhono elokulandela iimfuno, ukulandela ingcebiso nemiqalelo kubangcali nabaphathi ngokwemigaqo yesebe kunye nekhowudi yamagugu ezenkolo. Ikhono lokusombulula iingxaki njengoko kulindelwe kumbalisi kwi-FPS. Iinkqubo ezizezifundo nizinxenye zazo zokufaka umbono ophilayo, eziquka iinkcazelo zeemeko nezihloko, ukuthatha inxaxheba kumanyano, uphando nokuthatha inxaxheba kuzo zonke izenzo zezifundo kwiSebe. Ikhono lokugqiba ngempumelelo ubuncinane iphando elinye kunye nokunikezela elo phando lokushicilelwa kwincwadi ephathwayo. Ikhono elingentla lokuchaza ngokucacileyo ngokucothayo phambi kwabantu nakubhalwe. Ikhono lokuhamba kumaziko aqhelekileyo e-FPS xa kusingqongwe ngokunika inkxaso kwezinye iindawo ngenxa yemfuneko yonikezelo lweenkonzo. Ikhono lokusebenza kakuhle qembu kwazo zonke iinqanaba zobukhosi. Ikhono lokucinga umbuzo nogqirha ophathekayo, i-HCU okanye i-HOD xa ungagqinanga ngendlela yokuhamba ngenxaxheba yomsebenzi okanye ingxaki exhulene nayo ize axele ogqirha ophathekayo naxa kunokubakho naziphi na iingxaki ezinxulumene nomsebenzi. Ikhono lokusebenza ngocinezelo. Ikhono lokuhlela kunye nokuqamba. Ukunikela ngenkonzo efanelekileyo nesebenzayo ngaphantsi kolawulo logqirha. Ukuzoba ngaphantsi kokuqina kwalo xesha nakwishishini lekhompyutha nesoftware. Ikhono lophando lwezona zempilo. Ikhono lokufaka isandla kwinkqubo yokufundisa kwesebe ngokuncedisa ukufundisa abaFundisi bokuGqirha, beSayensi yemithambo yegazi ephilayo nabaFundisi bemithetho, oogqirha be-Forensic Pathology kunye nabasebenzi bezoGqirha. Ikhono lokwenza ukutolikwa kwe-autopsies ezesigqibo somthetho kuphononongo lokuqunjelwa kwangaphandle kwemithambo yegazi. Intshukumo evela kwi-post-mortems, umsebenzi we-autopsy nokuhlukaniswa. -Amakhono abantu amakhulu aquka ukunikela ngenkonzo ephumelelayo ekubeni qembu nakuzo zonke iinqanaba zobukhosi.
xh.duties: Ukunikezela ngenkonzo ephumelelayo nesebenzayo kubo bonke abathathi-nxaxheba ngokwemilinganiselo yeSebe. Ukuqamba iingxelo ngokwemilinganiselo ye-UCT Forensic Medicine and Toxicology. I-OFPI Division kunye neNkundla. Ukufunda, ukufundisa nokuzilolonga. Ukunikela ngenkonzo ye-Forensic Medicine ngemigexo yemiyalelo.

jobs.title: Medical Officer Grade 1 to 3 (CARDIOTHORACIC Surgery)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R1 041 402 per annum Grade 2: R1 188 255 per annum Grade 3: R1 375 245 per annum A portion of the package can be structured according to the individual's personal needs). (It will be expected of the successful candidate to participate in a system of remunerated commuted overtime)
jobs.summary: Medical Officer Grade 1 to 3 in Cardiothoracic Surgery at Groote Schuur Hospital, Observatory, requiring HPCSA registration as a Medical Practitioner.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Medical Practitioner. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Practitioner. Experience: Grade 1: None after registration as Medical Practitioner with the HPCSA in respect of SA qualified employees. 1-year relevant experience after registration as Medical Practitioner with a recognized foreign Health Professional Council in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service as required in South Africa. Grade 2: A minimum of 5 years’ appropriate experience as Medical Practitioner after registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Practitioner in respect of SA qualified employees. A minimum of 6 years’ relevant experience after registration as Medical Practitioner with a recognised foreign Health Professional Council in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service as required in South Africa. Grade 3: A minimum of 10 years’ appropriate experience as a Medical Practitioner after registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Practitioner in respect of SA qualified employees. A minimum of 11 years’ relevant experience after registration as Medical Practitioner with a recognized foreign Health Professional Council in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service as required in South Africa. Inherent requirements of the job: Commuted overtime is compulsory. Participate in after-hours call roster for the general cardiothoracic surgery service. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Proven ability to manage cardiothoracic surgical patients. Sound clinical judgement in the peri operative and post-operative management of adult cardiac and thoracic surgery patients. Competence in ward-based patient care, emergency assessment, escalation of care, and coordination with ICU and theatre teams. Ability to work independently under senior supervision and to contribute effectively to a consultant led service. Capacity to manage service demands, including after hours emergencies and time critical referrals. Computer literacy, with the ability to maintain accurate clinical records and contribute to service audits. Understanding of the operational challenges of public health care delivery, transformation, equity, and service sustainability. Ability to function effectively in a high-pressure clinical environment is essential. Completion of Internship and Community Service. Previous experience in General Surgery and ICU.
jobs.duties: Delivery of day to day clinical services within the Cardiothoracic Surgery service of the Chris Barnard Division of Cardiothoracic Surgery. Comprehensive inpatient ward management, including admissions, daily reviews, discharges, and coordination of care. Participation in theatre lists and assistance with operative procedures as required by service demands. Management of emergency cardiothoracic referrals and after hours clinical responsibilities. Participation in outpatient clinics and pre operative patient assessment. Contribution to morbidity and mortality meetings and service audits as required. Upholding professional, ethical, and patient centered standards of care. Clinical workload includes ward management, peri operative care, emergency consultations, outpatient clinics, and assistance in theatre. High service burden with exposure to complex adult cardiac and thoracic pathology typical of a tertiary referral centre.

af.title: Mediese Offisier Graad 1 tot 3 (Kardiovorale Chirurgie)
af.summary: Mediese Offisier Graad 1 tot 3 in Kardiovorale Chirurgie by Groote Schuur Hospitaal, Observatory, wat HPCSA-registrasie as 'n Mediese Praktisyn vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n Mediese Praktisyn toelaat. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Praktisyn. Ervaring: Graad 1: Geen na registrasie as Mediese Praktisyn by die HPCSA ten opsigte van SA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 1 jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie as Mediese Praktisyn by 'n erkende buitelandse Health Professional Council ten opsigte van buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemers, van wie dit nie vereis is om Gemeenskapsdiens soos in Suid-Afrika vereis te verrig nie. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se toepaslike ervaring as Mediese Praktisyn na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Praktisyn ten opsigte van SA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 'n Minimum van 6 jaar se relevante ervaring na registrasie as Mediese Praktisyn by 'n erkende buitelandse Health Professional Council ten opsigte van buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemers, van wie dit nie vereis is om Gemeenskapsdiens soos in Suid-Afrika vereis te verrig nie. Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar se toepaslike ervaring as 'n Mediese Praktisyn na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Praktisyn ten opsigte van SA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 'n Minimum van 11 jaar se relevante ervaring na registrasie as Mediese Praktisyn by 'n erkende buitelandse Health Professional Council ten opsigte van buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemers, van wie dit nie vereis is om Gemeenskapsdiens soos in Suid-Afrika vereis te verrig nie. Inherente vereistes van die werk: Geryde oortyd is verpligtend. Deelname aan buite-ure oproeprooster vir die algemene kardiovorale chirurgiediens. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Bewese vermoë om kardiovorale chirurgiese pasiënte te bestuur. Solide kliniese oordeel in die peri-operatiewe en post-operatiewe bestuur van volwasse hart- en torakale chirurgie pasiënte. Bevoegdheid in saal-gebaseerde pasiëntsorg, noodgevalbeoordeling, eskalasie van sorg, en koördinasie met ICU en teaterspanne. Vermoë om onafhanklik onder senior toesig te werk en effektief by te dra tot 'n konsultant-geleide diens. Vermoë om dienseise te bestuur, insluitend buite-ure noodgevalle en tydkritieke verwysings. Rekenaarvaardigheid, met die vermoë om akkurate kliniese rekords te hou en by te dra tot diensoudiete. Begrip van die operasionele uitdagings van openbare gesondheidsorglewering, transformasie, billikheid, en diensvolhoubaarheid. Vermoë om effektief in 'n hoëdruk kliniese omgewing te funksioneer is essensieel. Voltooiing van Internskap en Gemeenskapsdiens. Voorheense ervaring in Algemene Chirurgie en ICU.
af.duties: Lewering van daagse kliniese dienste binne die Kardiovorale Chirurgiediens van die Chris Barnard Afdeling van Kardiovorale Chirurgie. Omvattende inpatient-saalbestuur, insluitend toelatings, daagse hersienings, ontslae, en koördinasie van sorg. Deelname aan teaterlyste en bystand met operatiewe prosedures soos deur diensbehoeftes vereis. Bestuur van noodgeval kardiovorale verwysings en buite-ure kliniese verantwoordelikhede. Deelname aan buitepasiëntklinieke en pre-operatiewe pasiëntbeoordeling. Bydrae tot morbiditeit- en mortaliteitsvergaderings en diensoudite soos vereis. Handhaaf van professionele, etiese, en pasiëntgesentreerde standaarde van sorg. Kliniese werklas sluit in saalbestuur, peri-operatiewe sorg, noodgevalkonsultasies, buitepasiëntklinieke, en bystand in die teater. Hoë dienslas met blootstelling aan komplekse volwasse hart- en torakale patologie tipies van 'n tersiêre verwysingsentrum.

zu.title: Isikhundla Solunyazi Wezokwelapha Izinga 1 kuya ku-3 (Ukuhlinzwa Kwezifo Zenhliziyo Nefuba)
zu.summary: Isikhundla solunyazi Wezokwelapha Izinga 1 kuya ku-3 Kuhlinzwa kwezifo zenhliziyo nefuba eGroote Schuur Hospital, Observatory, esidinga ukubhalisa kuHPCSA njengomunyazi Wezokwelapha.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ephansi kunazo zonke: Itholakala elifanele elivumela ukubhalisa kuHealth Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengomunyazi Wezokwelapha. Ukubhalisa kubuhlakani obqashiwe: Ukubhalisa kuHPCSA njengomunyazi Wezokwelapha. Isiphephelo: Izinga 1: Akukho okudingekayo emva kokubhalisa njengomunyazi Wezokwelapha kuHPCSA kubasebenzi abafunde eNingizimu Afrika. Isiphephelo esifanele seminyaka engu-1 emva kokubhalisa njengomunyazi Wezokwelapha kubuhlakani obaziwayo bezempilo obusentshonalanga ngokubalulelayo kubasebenzi abafunde emazwe angaphandle, okuyizingozi ezingadingeki ukuba benze isevisi yomphakathi njengoba kudingwa eNingizimu Afrika. Izinga 2: Isiphephelo esifanele seminyaka engu-5 njengomunyazi Wezokwelapha emva kokubhalisa kuHPCSA njengomunyazi Wezokwelapha kubasebenzi abafunde eNingizimu Afrika. Isiphephelo esifanele seminyaka engu-6 emva kokubhalisa njengomunyazi Wezokwelapha kubuhlakani obaziwayo bezempilo obusentshonalanga ngokubalulelayo kubasebenzi abafunde emazwe angaphandle, okuyizingozi ezingadingeki ukuba benze isevisi yomphakathi njengoba kudingwa eNingizimu Afrika. Izinga 3: Isiphephelo esifanele seminyaka engu-10 njengomunyazi Wezokwelapha emva kokubhalisa kuHPCSA njengomunyazi Wezokwelapha kubasebenzi abafunde eNingizimu Afrika. Isiphephelo esifanele seminyaka engu-11 emva kokubhalisa njengomunyazi Wezokwelapha kubuhlakani obaziwayo bezempilo obusentshonalanga ngokubalulelayo kubasebenzi abafunde emazwe angaphandle, okuyizingozi ezingadingeki ukuba benze isevisi yomphakathi njengoba kudingwa eNingizimu Afrika. Izidingo ezitholakala emsebenzini: Ukusebenza ngemahora engeziwe kuyadingeka. Ukuthatha inxaxheba ohlwini lokubiza ngeyure ezingasemva kweyure zokusebenza ezisukela ekuseni kwesevisi jikelele yokuhlinza kwezifo zenhliziyo nefuba. Izikhwephi (ulwazi/amasu): Ikhono elivezwe lokuphatha abaguli abahlinzwa ngaphakathi kwendawo yezifo zenhliziyo nefuba. Isibindi sokubuka izifo ngezinhlangothi zansuku zonke ekuphathweni kwezinsuku ezungezile ukuhlinza nokuphatha inqanaba eliphansi kunokuhlinza abaguli abadala bamasundle asesiswini nasezifubeni. Ikhono ekuphathweni kwezinsuku zomguli ohambisana nendawo ezahlukaniswa, kwesisetshenzwa sesisisekelo sokuhlola inqanaba lezingozi, ukuphakamisa inqanaba lokunakekelwa, nasekuqoqeni ngezinsuku ezinde zokusiza ukuphila nokuba wumunyazi wethiyatha ekuphathweni kwemisebenzi. Ikhono lokusebenza kodwa ngaphansi kokuhlola kwezinsuku ezinde kanye nenhlokomo yomsebenzi jikelele ephethe kakhulu inqanaba eliphezulu lesiphephelo. Ikhono elivumela ukuphathwa kwezidingo zesevisi, okuhlanganisa izimo ezibuthaka ngezinsuku ezifakiwe kwesisetshenzwa sokunika isikhathi esinqamule izinsuku ezinde kanye nezigqibo ezinkulu ngokunakekelwa okuphelele okungenisa incazelo ekuqoqweni kwemininingwane yezifo. Ukwaziswa okufundwayo ngokuhlela ukubeka izincazelo ngokulandela imithetho ekuphathweni kwempilo, ukuguqula ukuhamba kwezinsuku zokunikezwa ezifanele ukuba zibe ngokulingana, kanye nokubeka izinsuku zokusekela imisebenzi ngendlela efanayo. Ikhono eliyisimangaliso lokusebenza kahle kwindawo ekhululekile okungalindelekwa izinsuku ezinentshisekelo ngokwelapha eziphephela njengesimangaliso. Ukubekezela ngokuphelele ukwamukelwa kwesibhedlela kwezinkinga nangaphandle kwezinsuku zomphakathi. Ukuba nolwazi lwangaphambilini Ekuphathweni kwesibhedlela nasekuhlukaniseni izinsuku eziningi zokuhlinza kwezinsuku ezihlukene zokuhlinza noma ukwamukela izinsuku zomphakathi.
zu.duties: Ukunikeza izinsiza zokwelapha zansuku zonke ngaphakathi kwesevisi Yokuhlinzwa Kwezifo Zenhliziyo Nefuba kweChris Barnard Division of Cardiothoracic Surgery. Ukuqashwa okuphelele kwabaguli abasisewardi, okuhlanganisa ukwamukelwa, ukuhlola nsuku zonke, ukukhipha abaguli, nokuhlela ukunakekelwa. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kuluhlu lwezinhlela zokuhlinza kanye nokusiza ngezinqubo zokuhlinza njengoko kudingwa izidingo zesevisi. Ukuphatha izinhlelo zokweluleka ngezingozi zezifo zenhliziyo nefuba kanye nemithwalo yemisebenzi yamasikhathi phakathi kweviki nangaphandle kweyure zokusebenza. Ukuthatha inxaxheba emakliniki zabaguli abangangeni esibhedlela nasekuhloleni abaguli ngaphambi kokuhlinzwa. Ukufaka isandla emihlanganweni yezifo kanye nokufa kanye nokuhlola izinkinga zesevisi njengoba kudingeka. Ukugcina amazinga okunakekelwa okungochwawunyeliwe, okuzwelayo, okugxile kumuntu ofuna ukunakekelwa. Umthwalo wokusebenza ngokwelapha uhlanganisa ukuphathwa kwezinto esisewardi, ukunakekelwa ngaphambi nangemuva kokuhlinza, izinkampani zezingozi, amakliniki abaguli abangangeni esibhedlela, nokusiza esidlweni sokuhlinza. Umthwalo omkhulu wesevisi onokuthinta izifo ezijulile zenhliziyo nefuba zabantu abadala ezitholakala njalo esikhungweni sokweluleka esingenela inqanaba eliphezulu.

xh.title: IOfisi yamayeza Inqanaba 1 ukuya ku-3 (Ungono lwe-Cardiothoracic Surgery)
xh.summary: IOfisi yamayeza Inqanaba 1 ukuya ku-3 kwi-Cardiothoracic Surgery eGroote Schuur Hospital, Observatory, ifuna ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengoGqirha.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esuncedo sokuqala: Isifundo esifanelekileyo esivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengoGqirha. Ukubhaliswa koluntu olungamagqirha: Ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengoGqirha. Isiphiwo: Inqanaba 1: Akukho nto emva kokubhaliswa njengoGqirha kwi-HPCSA malunga nabasebenzi abafunde eSouth Africa. Unyaka oyi-1 wamava afanelekileyo emva kokubhaliswa njengoGqirha koluntu olwaziyo lwamagqirha basemazwe ngokomthetho malunga nabasebenzi abafunde kwamanye amazwe, abangafuneki ukwenza iinkonzo zoluntu njengoko kufuneka eSouth Africa. Inqanaba 2: Amava afanelekileyo angu-5 ubuncinane njengoGqirha emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengoGqirha malunga nabasebenzi abafunde eSouth Africa. Amava afanelekileyo angu-6 ubuncinane emva kokubhaliswa njengoGqirha koluntu olwaziyo lwamagqirha basemazwe ngokomthetho malunga nabasebenzi abafunde kwamanye amazwe, abangafuneki ukwenza iinkonzo zoluntu njengoko kufuneka eSouth Africa. Inqanaba 3: Amava afanelekileyo angu-10 ubuncinane njengoGqirha emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengoGqirha malunga nabasebenzi abafunde eSouth Africa. Amava afanelekileyo angu-11 ubuncinane emva kokubhaliswa njengoGqirha koluntu olwaziyo lwamagqirha basemazwe ngokomthetho malunga nabasebenzi abafunde kwamanye amazwe, abangafuneki ukwenza iinkonzo zoluntu njengoko kufuneka eSouth Africa. Iimfuno ezilula zomsebenzi: Ukusebenza ngokugqithiswa kwexesha kuyaphoqo. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwizazisi zokubizwa emva kweyure yomsebenzi zenkonzo jikelele ye-cardiothoracic surgery. Ikhono (ulwazi/izakhono): Ukukwazi ukubonakalisa ukuphatha abaguli bokugonywa kwentsimbi yentliziyo nefuba. Isigqibo esilulu sokugqiba ngokwezempilo ekuphathweni kwexesha eliphakathi kokugonywa nangemva kokugonywa kwabaguli abadala bokugonywa kwentliziyo nefuba. Ulwazi ekunyulelweni kwabaguli kwigumbi lokulala, ekuqwalaselweni kwezimo eziphuthumayo, ekwenzeni isigqibo sokuphakamisa inqanaba lonakele, nakwintsebenziswano neqela labasebenzi be-ICU nabo bakwibala lokugonywa. Ikhono lokusebenza ngodakada phantsi kolawulo lwabantu abamhlophe beyayi kwaye uncede ngempumelelo kwinkonzo ethothwe ngugqirha omkhulu. Ikhono lokuphatha iimfuno zenkonzo, kuquka iimeko eziphuthumayo emva kweeyure zomsebenzi nokuthunyelwa okuyimfuneko ngokwexesha. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngekhompyutha, ngekhono lokugcina amagama ezigqibo zokugonywa achanekileyo nokuvela kwizisombululo zenkonzo. Ukuqonda iingozi ezikwindalo yokunikela iinkonzo ezizezempilo zoluntu, uguqulo, ukulingana, nokuqhubekayo kwenkonzo. Ikhono lokusebenza ngempumelelo kwindawo ethintela ngentlinge yokugonywa kuyimfuneko. Ukugqibezela iMfundo yokuqala yamagqirha nayiNkonzo yoluntu. Amaxa angaphambili kwi-Surgery jikeleyo nakwi-ICU.
xh.duties: Ukunikezwa kweenkonzo zokugonywa zemihla yonke ngaphakathi kwenkonzo ye-Cardiothoracic Surgery kwisebe leChris Barnard Division of Cardiothoracic Surgery. Ukuphatha ngokupheleleyo abaguli abangenwe ezigwardi, kuquka ukungeniswa, ukuqwalasela yonke imihla, ukuphuma, nolawulo lwemisebenzi. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kuluhlu lwebala lokugonywa kwaye uncedise kwindlela zokugonywa njengoko kufunwa zinkonzo. Ukuphatha abaguli abathunyelwe kwi-cardiothoracic kwaye kubekho iimvisiswano zokwenza iinkonzo ezizezempilo emva kweyure yomsebenzi. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwiikliniki zabaguli baphandle nakuqwalaseleni abaguli phambi kokugonywa. Ukunika isandla kwimitingana yokuwa nokufa nakwisombululo seenkonzo njengoko kufunwa. Ukugcina amanqanaba ogqirha obume, obuzingca obukhathalela abaguli. Ukusebenza okubandakanya ukuphatha abaguli kwigwardi, ukukhathalela abaguli ngexesha eliphakathi lokugonywa, iingxoxo ezingxamisekileyo, iikliniki zangaphandle, nancedo kwinxaxheba yegumbi lokugonywa. Urhwebo olunzima lwenkonzo nokuvezwa kwezifo ezinzima zentliziyo nefuba ezindala ezinqamlezileyo kwiziko esithumela izigqibo ngamaxesha amaninzi.

Amava afanele ekuphathweni kwe-Finance Management. Amava afanele ekulungiseni nokubika izitatimende zezimali. Amava afanele abonakalayo ekuphathweni, abonisa izikhombi ezinamandla ekuholweni, ekuhlakaniphileni nasekuphathweni kwemisebenzi yansuku zonke. Amava afanele ekuphathweni kwe-Contract Management. Ukuyimba, ukuyixela nokuba ngamachokoza ixelo elifanele nemeko yemisebenzi ehlotshwa ngomsebenzi wakwabakho. Ukulawula imeko yamagunya ngokulungiselela ukungagumbi, ukuqwalasela iindawo, ukulawula iingxwega ezingathinteki kumntu ofayo nengxwabo, ukubumba nokukhokela imisebenzi yokuzilolonga kumsebenzi wakwabakho. Ukusebenzisa iinkqubo zolwazi ukuphucula imeko yomuntu ofayo nukhuleleka kwakho.

jobs.title: Radiographer Grade 1 to 3 (NUCLEAR Medicine)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R510 906 per annum Grade 2: R598 260 per annum Grade 3: R703 785 per annum
jobs.summary: Radiographer Grade 1 to 3 in Nuclear Medicine at Groote Schuur Hospital, requiring HPCSA registration and offering a salary between R510906 and R703785 per annum.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Radiographer in Nuclear Medicine. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the HPCSA as a Radiographer in Nuclear Medicine. Experience: Grade 1: None after registration with the HPCSA in Radiography (Nuclear Medicine) in respect of RSA qualified employees. One-year relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA in Radiography (Nuclear Medicine) in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service, as required in South Africa. Grade 2: Minimum of 10 years relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA in Radiography (Nuclear Medicine) in respect of RSA qualified employees. 11 years relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA in Radiography (Nuclear Medicine) in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service, as required in South Africa. Grade 3: Minimum of 20 years relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA in Radiography (Nuclear Medicine) in respect of RSA qualified employees. 21 years relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA in Radiography (Nuclear Medicine) in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service, as required in South Africa. Inherent requirements of the job: Will be required to be on standby and work overtime when required. Must be able to lift, move and assist patients when required. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Appropriate experience in a general department with knowledge of radiation protection, quality assurance and equipment safety pertaining to Nuclear Medicine radiography. Strong interpersonal and communication skills. Knowledge and skills required to perform various Nuclear Medicine investigations. Ability to work effectively in a team environment and independently.
jobs.duties: Be responsible for the provision of a patient-centred radiographic imaging service. Performing high-quality nuclear medicine imaging procedures using advanced imaging equipment. Preparing, dispensing, and administering radiopharmaceuticals in accordance with clinical protocols and regulatory requirements. Ensuring patient safety, comfort, and care by effectively communicating with and preparing patients for all procedures performed. Conducting daily quality control checks on nuclear medicine equipment to ensure optimal performance and compliance. Maintaining accurate patient records, imaging data, and procedural documentation. Adhering to radiation protection principles, safety protocols, and all relevant legislative and organizational requirements. Collaborating effectively with Nuclear Medicine Physicians and the multidisciplinary healthcare team to deliver high-quality patient care. Supporting the education and development of radiography students, Community Service Radiographers, and other healthcare students, registrars, and interns through in-service training and mentorship. Should be willing to participate in research initiatives and continuous quality improvement activities within the department.
jobs.enquiries: Mr L Africa Tel No: (021) 404-4022 or Mr G Malan Tel No: (021) 404-4103
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable on health professionals who apply for the first time for registration in a specific category with the relevant council (including individuals who must apply for change in registration status)”. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. af.title: Radiograaf Graad 1 tot 3 (Nukleere Geneeskunde)
af.summary: Radiograaf Graad 1 tot 3 in Nukleere Geneeskunde by Groote Schuur Hospital, waarvoor HPCSA-registrasie vereis word en 'n salaris tussen R510906 en R703785 per jaar aangebied word.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n Radiograaf in Nukleere Geneeskunde toelaat. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Radiograaf in Nukleere Geneeskunde. Ervaring: Graad 1: Geen na registrasie by die HPCSA in Radiografie (Nukleere Geneeskunde) ten opsigte van RSA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers nie. Een jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA in Radiografie (Nukleere Geneeskunde) ten opsigte van buitelandse gekwalifiseerde werknemers van wie dit nie vereis word om Gemeenskapsdiens te verrig soos in Suid-Afrika vereis nie. Graad 2: Minimum van 10 jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA in Radiografie (Nukleere Geneeskunde) ten opsigte van RSA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 11 jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA in Radiografie (Nukleere Geneeskunde) ten opsigte van buitelandse gekwalifiseerde werknemers van wie dit nie vereis word om Gemeenskapsdiens te verrig soos in Suid-Afrika vereis nie. Graad 3: Minimum van 20 jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA in Radiografie (Nukleere Geneeskunde) ten opsigte van RSA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 21 jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA in Radiografie (Nukleere Geneeskunde) ten opsigte van buitelandse gekwalifiseerde werknemers van wie dit nie vereis word om Gemeenskapsdiens te verrig soos in Suid-Afrika vereis nie. Inherente vereistes van die werk: Sal vereis word om bystand te staan en oortyd te werk wanneer vereis. Moet pasiënte kan lig, beweeg en bystaan wanneer vereis. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Toepaslike ervaring in 'n algemene departement met kennis van stralingsbeskerming, gehalteversekering en toerustingveiligheid met betrekking tot Nukleere Geneeskunde-radiografie. Sterke interpersoonlike en kommunikasievaardighede. Kennis en vaardighede vereis om verskeie Nukleere Geneeskunde-ondersoeke uit te voer. Vermoë om doeltreffend in 'n spanomgewing en onafhanklik te werk.
af.duties: Verantwoordelik wees vir die voorsiening van 'n pasiëntgesentreerde radiografiese beeldingsdiens. Uitvoer van hoëgehalte nukleere geneeskunde-beeldingsprosedures met behulp van gevorderde beeldingstoerusting. Voorbereiding, afmeting en toediening van radiofarmaseutiese middels in ooreenstemming met kliniese protokolle en regulasievereistes. Verseker van pasiëntveiligheid, gemak en sorg deur doeltreffende kommunikasie met en voorbereiding van pasiënte vir alle uitgevoerde prosedures. Uitvoer van daaglikse gehaltebeheerkontroles op nukleere geneeskunde-toerusting om optimale werkverrigting en nakoming te verseker. Onderhou van akkurate pasiëntrekords, beeldingsdata en prosedurele dokumentasie. Voldoen aan stralingsbeskermingsbeginsels, veiligheidsprotokolle en alle tersaaklike wetgewende en organisatoriese vereistes. Doeltreffende samewerking met Nukleere Geneeskunde-arts en die multidissiplinêre gesondheidsorgspan om hoëgehalte pasiëntsorg te lewer. Ondersteun die opvoeding en ontwikkeling van radiografiestudente, Gemeenskapsdiens-Radiograwe en ander gesondheidsorgstudente, registrateurs en interniste deur in-diensopleiding en mentorskap. Sal bereid moet wees om aan navorsingsinisiatiewe en deurlopende gehalteverbeteringsaktiwiteite binne die departement deel te neem.

zu.title: Usomagaladi wezinga 1 kuya ku-3 (I-Nuclear Medicine)
zu.summary: Usomagaladi wezinga 1 kuya ku-3 ku-Nuclear Medicine esibhedlela i-Groote Schuur, ofuna ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA futhi unikeza iholo elingaphakathi kuka-R510906 no-R703785 ngonyaka.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ephansi kakhulu: Itholakalaelifanele elivumela ukubhalisa ne-HPCSA njengesomagaladi ku-Nuclear Medicine. Ukubhaliswa komkhandlu ochwepheshe: Ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengesomagaladi ku-Nuclear Medicine. Isiphephelo: Izinga 1: Akukho okudingekayo emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA ku-Radiography (I-Nuclear Medicine) maqondana nabasebenzi abathole izifundo eRSA. Unyaka owodwa woluhlu loluholo emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA ku-Radiography (I-Nuclear Medicine) maqondana nabasebenzi abathole izifundo kwezinye izwe, abadingwa ukwenza Isevisi Yomphakathi, njengoba kudingekwa eNingizimu Afrika. Izinga 2: Okungenani eminyaka engu-10 yoluhlu loluholo emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA ku-Radiography (I-Nuclear Medicine) maqondana nabasebenzi abathole izifundo eRSA. Iminyaka engu-11 yoluhlu loluholo emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA ku-Radiography (I-Nuclear Medicine) maqondana nabasebenzi abathole izifundo kwezinye izwe, abadingwa ukwenza Isevisi Yomphakathi, njengoba kudingekwa eNingizimu Afrika. Izinga 3: Okungenani eminyaka engu-20 yoluhlu loluholo emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA ku-Radiography (I-Nuclear Medicine) maqondana nabasebenzi abathole izifundo eRSA. Iminyaka engu-21 yoluhlu loluholo emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA ku-Radiography (I-Nuclear Medicine) maqondana nabasebenzi abathole izifundo kwezinye izwe, abadingwa ukwenza Isevisi Yomphakathi, njengoba kudingekwa eNingizimu Afrika. Izidingo ezingaphakathi komsebenzi: Kuzodingeka ube kolindayo futhi usebenze ngale kwesikhathi esivaliwe uma kudingeka. Kumele ukwazi ukuphakamisa, ukuhambisa futhi usize abagulayo uma kudingeka. Amandla (ulwazi/amakhono): Isiphephelo esifanele kumnyango jikelele olunolwazi ngokuvinjelwa kokushisa, ukuqinisekiswa ikhwalithi nephepha kwezobuciko ezithinta isomagaladi se-Nuclear Medicine. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana nabantu nokucommunicate. Ulwazi namakhono adingekayo ukwenza izivivinyo ezahlukene ze-Nuclear Medicine. Ikhono lokusebenza ngempumelelo eqenjini nangodwa.
zu.duties: Ukube ngumuntu ohlola nenze izinkonzo zamagaladi ezibhekise kumuntu ngamunye. Ukwenza izinqubo zamagaladi e-Nuclear Medicine ezinga eliphezulu kusetshanziwa amathuluzi ethuthukisiwe. Ukulungisa, ukwabanisa, nokuphatha amafamasi amajezi we-radiopharmaceuticals ngokulandela imithetho yezokwelapha nezidingo ezimiswe umthetho. Ukuqinisekisa ukuphepha, ukuzola, nokunakekelwa kwemikhumba ngokucommunicizeka ngempumelelo ngakho nabalungiselela abagulayo zonke izinkomba ezenziwayo. Ukwenza ukuhlola ngempilo ngosuku emthuluzi we-nuclear medicine ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza okuhle nokuhambisana nomthetho. Ukugcina okuqinisekileyo ngeznkomba abagulayo, idatha zamajaji, nokukhombisa imibhalo. Ukulandela imigomo yokuvinjelwa kokushisa, imithetho yokuphepha, kanye nazo zonke izidingo ezibalulekile zobumethetho nenhlangano. Ukusebenzisana ngempumelelo kubuciko be-Nuclear Medicine netimu yokunakekelwa kwemikhumba eminingi yokuzelela ukunika ukunakekelwa kwemikhumba ngezinga eliphakeme. Ukusekela imfundo nentuthuko kwabafundi besomagaladi, Abasomagaladi Be-HPCSA, nabanye abafundi bokuzelela, ababhalise kumkhandlu, nabafundi abasha ngokuqeqesheka ngaphakathi kwemisebenzi futhi. Kumele uzitshise ukuthi uthanda ukungenxa kumatholide wezobulungisa futhi uphile ngemikhobo yokukhulisa izinga ngaphakathi komnyango.

xh.title: Umzobi weXhayi Isidanga 1 ukuya ku-3 (iNUCLEAR Medicine)
xh.summary: Umzobi weXhayi Isidanga 1 ukuya ku-3 kwiNuclear Medicine eGroote Schuur Hospital, ifuna ukubhaliswa kwiHPCSA kwaye inika umvuzo ophakathi kweR510906 nagerho, kunye neR703785 ngonyaka.
xh.requirements: Isimemo sokuqala semfundo: Isimemo esifanelekileyo esivumela ukubhaliswa kwiHealth Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengomzobi weXhayi kwiNuclear Medicine. Ukubhaliswa koluntu olungcaliyo: Ukubhaliswa kwiHPCSA njengomzobi weXhayi kwiNuclear Medicine. Isiphiwo: Isidanga 1: Akukho nanye emva kokubhaliswa kwiHPCSA kwiRadiography (Nuclear Medicine) malunga nabasebenzi abaqeqeshiweyo eRSA. Unyaka omnye wamava ahambelana nomsebenzi emva kokubhaliswa kwiHPCSA kwiRadiography (Nuclear Medicine) malunga nabasebenzi abaqeqeshiweyo kumazwe ngaphandle, abangekho mfuneko ukuba benze iinkonzo zoManyano, njengoko kufuneka eSouth Africa. Isidanga 2: Ubuncinane beminyaka elishumi yamava ahambelana nomsebenzi emva kokubhaliswa kwiHPCSA kwiRadiography (Nuclear Medicine) malunga nabasebenzi abaqeqeshiweyo eRSA. Iminyaka elishumi nanye yamava ahambelana nomsebenzi emva kokubhaliswa kwiHPCSA kwiRadiography (Nuclear Medicine) malunga nabasebenzi abaqeqeshiweyo kumazwe ngaphandle, abangekho mfuneko ukuba benze iinkonzo zoManyano, njengoko kufuneka eSouth Africa. Isidanga 3: Ubuncinane beminyaka elishumi yamava ahambelana nomsebenzi emva kokubhaliswa kwiHPCSA kwiRadiography (Nuclear Medicine) malunga nabasebenzi abaqeqeshiweyo eRSA. Iminyaka elishumi nanye yamava ahambelana nomsebenzi emva kokubhaliswa kwiHPCSA kwiRadiography (Nuclear Medicine) malunga nabasebenzi abaqeqeshiweyo kumazwe ngaphandle, abangekho mfuneko ukuba benze iinkonzo zoManyano, njengoko kufuneka eSouth Africa. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi zomsebenzi: Kuya kufuneka ube kwindlela yokuqwalasela ukusebenza ngapha kwesigqebelo xa kufuneka. Kuya kufuneka ukwazi ukuziphakamisa, ukushukuma kunye nokunceda abaguli xa kufuneka. Amakhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Amava afanelekileyo kwisebe jikelele nolwazi ngokhuselo lomthunzi, uqinisekiso lomgangatho nokhuseleko lweqonga elithinta umzobi weXhayi weNuclear Medicine. Amakhono amaninzi okuzonxibelelana kunye nokuququzelela. Ulwazi namakhono afunekayo ukuze kwenzike iindibano ezahlukeneyo zeNuclear Medicine. Ikhono lokusebenza kakuhle kwindawo yeqela kunye nokuzimela.
xh.duties: Kuya kufuneka ube nomyalelo wokuvelisa inkonzo yokuzoba iinthombe ezigqithiswa kumguli. Ukwenziwa kweendlela ezikumgangatho ophezulu zokuzoba iinthombe zeNuclear Medicine ngokusebenzisa iinqobo zokuzoba ezithuthukileyo. Ulungiselelo, ukwaba, nokunikela iiradyophamaseyutiki ngokulandela iinkqubo zeklinikhi neemfuno zolawulo. Ukuqinisekisa ukhuseleko, intlalontle, kunye nenkathalo yomguli ngokunxibelelana kakuhle kwaye ulungiselele abaguli yonke iindlela ezenziwayo. Ukuqwalasela ngemini ngemini ukulawula umgangatho kwiqonga leNuclear Medicine ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza okulungileyo nokuzithoba. Ukugcina irekhodi eqinisekileyo yomguli, iinkcukacha zokuzoba iinthombe, nolwazi olubhaliweyo lweendlela. Ukuzithoba ngemigaqo yokukhusela umthunzi, iinkqubo zokhuseleko, nazo zonke iimfuno zomthetho nezoluntu ezihambelana nayo. Ukusebenzisana kakuhle neDyakthatha zeNuclear Medicine neqela lezempilo elinabasebenzi abanomsebenzi ongaphezu kwamagatya ukunika inkonzo yomgangatho ophezulu kumaguli. Ukuxhasa imfundo nophuhliso kwabafundi bomzobo weXhayi, Abazobi beXhayi beeNkonzo zoManyano, kunye nabafundi abanye basezempilo, ababhalisiweyo, nabafundi abangenayo isiphiwo ngokuqeqesha nokuqeqesha ngaphakathi kwenkqubo kunye nokuqinisekisa ukuguquguquka. Kufuneka ube ngumthandi wokuthatha inxaxheba kumashishini okuphandayo kunye nemisebenzi yokuqwalasela nokuphucula umgangatho ngokuqhubekayo kwisebe.

jobs.title: Professional Nurse Grade 1 to 2 (SPECIALTY: High Care)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R495 423 per annum Grade 2: R607 350 per annum
jobs.summary: Professional Nurse (Grade 1 to 2) specialising in High Care at Victoria Hospital, requiring SANC registration and a critical care post-basic qualification.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Basic R425 qualification (i.e. diploma/degree in nursing) or equivalent qualification (R683 plus R254) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. A post-basic nursing qualification, with duration of at least 1 year accredited with the SANC in Medical and Surgical Nursing Science: Critical Care Nursing: General. Or 4 year Bachelor Degree in Nursing (R174) or equivalent qualification (R683 plus R1497 or R171 plus R1497) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. A post graduate diploma (R635) accredited with the SANC in Critical Care Nursing (Adult). Registration with a professional council: Registration with the SANC as a Professional Nurse. Experience: Grade 1: A minimum of 4 years’ appropriate/recognizable experience in nursing after registration as professional Nurse with SANC in General Nursing. Grade 2: A minimum of 14 years’ appropriate/recognizable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. At least 10 years of this period referred to above must be appropriate/recognizable experience in the specific specialty after obtaining the one-year post-basic qualification or post- graduate diploma in the relevant specialty. Inherent requirements of the job: Willingness to work shifts, overtime, day and night duty, weekends and public holidays to meet the operational requirements. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Ability to maintain professionalism and the display of core values of the Department of Health WCG in the execution of duties, while practising within the legislation, regulations and protocols applicable to the public service. Skills to plan, organise & coordinate the service by analysing, problem solving & decision making. Leadership towards the realisation of strategic goals and objectives of the Intensive and High care unit. Knowledge of practices or regimes within the relevant disciplines. Ability to work effectively within a multi-disciplinary team.
jobs.duties: Provide an optimal, holistic, specialised Nursing Care within set standards and within a professional, legal framework as a Professional Nurse in an Intensive and High care unit. Effective utilisation of Human and Material Resources. Participate in training, development and research. Supervise and assist Staff Nurses & Nursing Assistants. Deliver a support service to the Nursing Service and the institution. Practice Nursing and health care in accordance with the laws and regulations relevant to nursing and health care. Order medication and stock control.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for the appointment on condition that proof of application for registration to register with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable to candidates who apply for the first time for registration in the post basic qualification or post-graduate diploma in the relevant specialty. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment.
