af.title: Professionele Verpleegkundige Vlak 1 tot 2 (SPESIALITEIT: Hoësorg)
af.summary: Professionele Verpleegkundige (Vlak 1 tot 2) wat spesialiseer in Hoësorg by Victoria Hospital, wat SANC-registrasie en 'n postbasiese kwalifikasie in kritieke sorg vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.w.s. diploma/graad in verpleegkunde) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie (R683 plus R254) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige moontlik maak. 'n Postbasiese verpleegkwalifikasie, met 'n duur van ten minste 1 jaar wat by die SANC geakkrediteer is in Medical and Surgical Nursing Science: Critical Care Nursing: General. Of 'n 4 jaar Bachelorgaad in Verpleegkunde (R174) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie (R683 plus R1497 of R171 plus R1497) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige moontlik maak. 'n Nagraadse diploma (R635) wat by die SANC geakkrediteer is in Critical Care Nursing (Adult). Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige. Ervaring: Vlak 1: 'n Minimum van 4 jaar se toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleging. Vlak 2: 'n Minimum van 14 jaar se toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleging. Ten minste 10 jaar van bogenoemde tydperk moet toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in die spesifieke spesialiteitsrigting wees na verkryging van die eenjarige postbasiese kwalifikasie of nagraadse diploma in die tersaaklike spesialiteitsrigting. Inherente vereistes van die pos: Bereidwilligheid om skofte, oortyd, dag- en nagdiens, naweke en openbare vakansiedae te werk om aan die operasionele vereistes te voldoen. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Vermoë om professionaliteit te handhaaf en die kernwaardes van die Department of Health WCG te toon in die uitvoering van pligte, terwyl daar binne die wetgewing, regulasies en protokolle van toepassing op die openbare diens gepraktiseer word. Vaardighede om die diens te beplan, te organiseer en te koördineer deur te analiseer, probleme op te los en besluite te neem. Leierskap ter verwesenliking van strategiese doelwitte en oogmerke van die Intensive and High care unit. Kennis van praktyke of regimes binne die tersaaklike dissiplines. Vermoë om doeltreffend binne 'n multidissiplinêre span te werk.
af.duties: Verskaf optimale, holistiese, gespesialiseerde verpleegsorg binne vasgestelde standaarde en binne 'n professionele, regsraamwerk as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige in 'n Intensive and High care unit. Doeltreffende benutting van menslike en materiaalhulpbronne. Neem deel aan opleiding, ontwikkeling en navorsing. Onderrig en help Stafoonpleegkundiges en Verpleegassistente. Lewer 'n ondersteuningsdiens aan die Verpleegdiens en die instelling. Beoefen verpleging en gesondheidsorg in ooreenstemming met die wette en regulasies wat op verpleging en gesondheidsorg van toepassing is. Bestel medikasie en beheer voorrade.

zu.title: Umongikazi Ongamakhono Izinga 1 kuya ku-2 (ISIKHUNZI: Ukunakekelwa Okuphezulu)
zu.summary: Umongikazi Ongamakhono (Izinga 1 kuya ku-2) ohlinzeka ngokunakekelwa okuphezulu esibhedlela i-Victoria Hospital, efuna ukubhaliswa ku-SANC nendima yesikuqala emfundweni yokunakekelwa okubalulekile.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zemfundo ezingaphansi: Indima yesisekelo i-R425 (okungukuthi idiploma/iziqu kwisoqoqo) noma endima elinganayo (i-R683 kanye ne-R254) evumela ukubhalisa ku-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengomongikazi Ongamakhono. Indima yasoqoqo ekunakekelwa, nogo lwezinyanga ezingu-1 nangaphezulu evunyiwe yi-SANC kusoQoqo Sokunakekelwa Kwezifo Nokuhlinzwa: Ukunakekelwa Okubalulekile: Okujwayelekile. Noma idiploma yezingu emnyama (i-R174) noma endima elinganayo (i-R683 kanye ne-R1497 noma i-R171 kanye ne-R1497) evumela ukubhalisa ku-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengomongikazi Ongamakhono. Idiploma yasemva kweziqu (i-R635) evunyiwe yi-SANC ekunakekelweni Okubalulekile (Abadala). Ukubhaliswa kubhalwe labongikazi: Ukubhaliswa ku-SANC njengomongikazi Ongamakhono. Isipiliyoni: Izinga 1: Ugo oluncane ezingu-4 loluhlelolunye noma olubonakalayo ekunakekelweni ngemva kokubhaliswa njengomongikazi Ongamakhono ku-SANC ekunakekelweni Okujwayelekile. Izinga 2: Ugo oluncane ezingu-14 loluhlelolunye noma olubonakalayo ekunakekelweni ngemva kokubhaliswa njengomongikazi Ongamakhono ku-SANC ekunakekelweni Okujwayelekile. Okungenani eminyakeni engu-10 kulengo elishiwo ngenhla kumele kube isipiliyoni esihlelolunye noma esibonakalayo kwesikhungo esithize ngemva kokuthola indima yesoqoqo engu-1 yamuhla noma idiploma yasemva kwezigu kwesikhungo esihlelolunye. Izidingo ezingaphakathi komsebenzi: ukuzithoba ukusebenza ngokushintshashintsha, ngaphezu kogo oqokiwe, umsebenzi wemini nobusuku, amasonto nezinsuku zeloluhlelo zokuhlangabezana nezidingo zokusebenza. Amakhono okwenza umsebenzi (ulwazi/amakhono): Ikono lokugcina ukuziphatha komsebenzi nokubonisa izigaba eziyisisekelo zomnyango Wezempi lo WG ekwenzeni imisebenzi, ngenkathi ukwenza umsebenzi ngaphakathi kwemithetho, imigoqo nendlela ezifanele kumsebenzi kahulumeni. Amakhono okucubungula, ukulunga futhi ukuhlanganisa inkonzo ngokuhlaziya, ukuxazulula izinkinga nokwenza izinqumo. Ukukhokha iqhaza ekufezeni amagungqo eziMiso nemiMinikelo yesikhungo sokunakekelwa okuphezulu nokubalulekile. Ulwazi ngeminyakazo noma imithetho yohlelo ezinhlelweni ezihlelolunye. Ikono lokusebenza ngempumelelo ngaphakathi kwethimba elinabantu abanamakhono ahlukene.
zu.duties: Hlinzeka ngokunakekelwa okuphezulu okuyisisondelo ngaphakathi kwemilinganiselo elicishiwe nangaphakathi kohlelo olusemthethweni njengomongikazi Ongamakhono esikhungweni sokunakekelwa okuphezulu nokubalulekile. Ukusetshenziswa okuphumelelayo kwezinsiza zabantu nezinto. Ukuthatha inxaxheba ekufundeni, ekuthuthukiseni nasekuhlaziyeni. Qapha futhi usize abongikazi basesiqhingini nabasiza kuso. Hlinzeka ngenkonzo yesekelo kwiNkonzo Yabongikazi nesikhungo. Yenza ukunakekelwa nokunakekelwa kwezempi ngokuhambisana nemithetho nemithelela ephathelene nokunakekelwa nokunakekelwa kwezempi. Faka imithi futhi ulawule izinto.

xh.title: Unesi Yobungcali Inqanaba 1 ukuya ku-2 (ISEBELO: Ukunakekelwa Okuphezulu)
xh.summary: Unesi Yobungcali (Inqanaba 1 ukuya ku-2) egxile ekunakekelweni okuphezulu eVictoria Hospital, efunayo ukubhalisa kwi-SANC nesiqinisekiso sokunakekelwa okubalulekileyo sokuya phambili emva kwesiseko.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esingowesiseko se-R425 (okt ithamba/igqetho ekunokesi) okt isiqinisekiso esilinganayo (R683 plus R254) esivumela ukubhalisa kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengonnesia Yobungcali. Isiqinisekiso sokunakekelwa okuya phambili, ngexesha elingangaphezu kwamnyaka ongama-1 esemthethweni kwi-SANC kwiMedical and Surgical Nursing Science: Critical Care Nursing: General. Okt igqetho leminyaka eli-4 eNursing (R174) okt isiqinisekiso esilinganayo (R683 plus R1497 or R171 plus R1497) esivumela ukubhalisa kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengonnesia Yobungcali. Ithamba lokuya phambili (R635) esemthethweni kwi-SANC kwiCritical Care Nursing (Adult). Ukubhalisa kwikomkhulu lobungcali: Ukubhalisa kwi-SANC njengonnesia Yobungcali. Ikwaziseko: Inqanaba 1: Okungenani iminyaka engama-4 yokwazisa/ukwazika kweso isemthethweni kokunakesela emva kokubhalisa njengonnesia Yobungcali kwi-SANC kwiGeneral Nursing. Inqanaba 2: Okungenani iminyaka engama-14 yokwazisa/ukwazika kweso isemthethweni kokunakesela emva kokubhalisa njengonnesia Yobungcali kwi-SANC kwiGeneral Nursing. Okungenani iminyaka engama-10 kule minyaka elitshiwo ngasentla kufuneka ibe ngowokwazisa/ukwazika kweso isemthethweni kwelo celo elithe ngqo emva kokufumana isiqinisekiso sokuya phambili kwamnyaka omnye okt ithamba lokuya phambili kwelo celo. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi zomsebenzi: Ukulungele ukusebenza ngokutshintshwa koshishino, ngaphezu kwexesha eliqhelekileyo, umsebenzi wemini n Webster wabusuku, iintsuku zeeveki ngeentsuku zemihla yokuphumla zolawulo ukuphelelisa iimfuno zoshishino. Ikhono (ulwazi/izakhono): Ukuba nokwazi ukuhlonipha ubungcali nokubonisa amaxabiso ayimisiwe eDepartment of Health WCG ekuphumezeni imisebenzi, ngelixa ulisebenzisa ngaphakathi kwemithetho, iimigaqo neenkqubo ezisebenza kundlalo yoluntu. Izakhono zokucinga, zokuqamba n zokugqiba isigqibo ngokuhlaziywa, ukusombulula iingxaki n zokwenza isigqibo. Ukuziphatha njengento eqhuba ekubeni kubhekisele kwiinjongo zamasu nezityhingelo zeIntensive and High care unit. Ulwazi ngendlela okt amacebo alo ngaphakathi kweendalo ezithintekayo. Ukuba n ikhono lokusebenza ngokuchanekileyo kwiqela labasebenzi banjineli.
xh.duties: Nika unakekelwa olukhululekileyo, olubandakanya yonke into, oluqwalaselweyo eNursing ngaphakathi kweemigangatho emiselweyo n kwindlalo yoluntu ngokomthetho njengonnesia Yobungcali kwicandelo leIntensive and High care unit. Ukusetyenziswa ngokuchanekileyo kwezempilo nabantu kunye nezinto ezifana nokulawula izinto. Thatha inxaxheba kwikholeji n ikhuthazo. Phatha n kunceda aba Noki basebenzayo n aba Noki abancedisayo. Nikeza inkonzo yoxhaso kwiNursing Service n kule ndlu yokunakesela. Sebenzisa uNursing n unakekelwa lolwemi ngokuthobela imithetho n iimigaqo ngokwaso ezinxulumene noNursing n unakekelwa lolwemi. Odola iziyobisi n ukulawula izinto.

jobs.title: Radiographer Grade 1 to 3 (DIAGNOSTIC)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R413 121 per annum Grade 2: R482 499 per annum Grade 3: R564 822 per annum
jobs.summary: Diagnostic radiographer position at Tygerberg Hospital in Parow Valley, offering salaries from R413,121 to R564,822 per annum depending on grade.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate qualification that allows for registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Radiographer in Diagnostic Radiography. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the HPCSA as a Diagnostic Radiographer. Experience: Grade 1: None after registration with the HPCSA as Diagnostic Radiographer in respect of RSA-qualified employees. 1-year relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA as Diagnostic Radiographer in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service, as required in South Africa. Grade 2: A minimum of 10 years relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA as Diagnostic Radiographer in respect of RSA-qualified employees. A Minimum of 11 years relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA as Diagnostic Radiographer in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service, as required in South Africa. -Grade 3: A minimum of 20 years relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA as Diagnostic Radiographer in respect of RSA-qualified employees. A minimum of 21 years relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA as Diagnostic Radiographer in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service, as required in South Africa. Inherent requirement of the job: Render an after-hour service as part of your 40- hour work week as determined by the department. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Knowledge of protocols, radiation protection, quality assurance and equipment safety. Good interpersonal skills and perform effectively as part of a multidisciplinary team. Knowledge of Patient Archiving and Communication Systems and Radiology Information Systems. Good communication skills.
jobs.duties: Provide a Radiographic service. Produce diagnostic images of high quality. Optimal patient care. Safe use and care of equipment. Accurate record keeping. Assist with training of community service Radiographers and students. Participate in continuing professional development activities.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. “Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable on health professionals who apply for the first time for registration as Diagnostic Radiographer with the relevant council (including individuals who must apply for change in registration status)”. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Uitstekende kommunikasievaardighede (mondeling en skriftelik). Vermoë om in geïntegreerde multidissiplinêre spanne oor alle platforms te werk. Deeglike kennis van ergoterapiesorg en -behandeling.
af.duties: Verskaffing van ergoterapiedienste in die spesialiteitsveld van beroepsgebaseerde groepe, gemeenskapsontwikkeling-rehabilitering, gesondheidsbevordering en voorkomingsdienste. Skepping en ondersteuning van toesigstrukture en bemagtigingsplatforms vir studente se praktiese leer. Deelneem aan opleiding en ontwikkeling.

zu.title: UmPhathi wezokwelapha ngokusebenza izinga 1 kuya ku 3
zu.summary: Nikela izinsiza zokwelapha ngokusebenza e-Vredenburg Hospital kwisifunda esincane se-Saldanha Bay kuyo yonke imikhakha yokulungisa umphakathi, ukuthuthukisa impilo nokuvikela izinhlelo.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ezingaphansi kwesigaba: Izifundo ezifanele ezivumela ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengomPhathi wezokwelapha ngokusebenza. Ukubhalisa komkhandlu wezobungcweti: Ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengomPhathi wezokwelapha ngokusebenza. Isiphiwo: Izinga 1: Akukho okudingekayo ngemuva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengomPhathi wezokwelapha ngokusebenza. Unyaka o-1 wokuhlangabezana nomsebenzi ofanele ngemuva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengomPhathi wezokwelapha ngokusebenza mayelana nabasebenzi abaqeqeshiwe kwamanye amazwe, okungenadingeki ukuba benze inkonzo yomphakathi njengoba kudingeka eNingizimu Afrika. Izinga 2: Okungenani eminyakeni engu-10 yokuhlangabezana nomsebenzi ofanele ngemuva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengomPhathi wezokwelapha ngokusebenza. Okungenani eminyakeni engu-11 yokuhlangabezana nomsebenzi ofanele ngemuva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengomPhathi wezokwelapha ngokusebenza mayelana nabasebenzi abaqeqeshiwe kwamanye amazwe, okungenadingeki ukuba benze inkonzo yomphakathi njengoba kudingeka eNingizimu Afrika. Izinga 3: Okungenani eminyakeni engu-20 yokuhlangabezana nomsebenzi ofanele ngemuva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengomPhathi wezokwelapha ngokusebenza. Okungenani eminyakeni engu-21 yokuhlangabezana nomsebenzi ofanele ngemuva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengomPhathi wezokwelapha ngokusebenza mayelana nabasebenzi abaqeqeshiwe kwamanye amazwe, okungenadingeki ukuba benze inkonzo yomphakathi njengoba kudingeka eNingizimu Afrika. Izidingo ezingokwemvelo zomsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokuqasha ehambisana (Code B/EB). Ukuzithoba ukuhletha. Amandla okwenza izinto (ulwazi/amaswikipi): Amandla aphumelelayo okuxhumana (okushiwo nokuqoshiwe). Amandla okusebenza kumaqembu ahlukene ahashaziwe kuyo yonke izinkomba. Ulwazi olujulile lokunakekelwa nokwelapha ngokusebenza.
zu.duties: Inikela ngezinsiza zokwelapha ngokusebenza esikhundleni sobungcweti sezigaba ezisekelwe kumsebenzi, ekuthuthukisweni komphakathi-ukulungisa, ekuthuthukisweni kwempilo nasezinsizini zokuvikela. Ukusebenza ngaphakathi kwenkondlo yokunakekelwa kokuqala evumelana nomphakathi ukuthuthukisa amandla omphakathi okunakekela bonke abantu ngaphakathi kwesifunda. Ukudalwa nokusekela izakhiwo zokuqapha nokuvumela izinkundla zofundo lwezokwenza abafundi. Ukubamba iqhaza eqeqeshweni nasekuthuthukiseni.

Ukubhalisa kwikomiti yabaprofeshonali: Ukubhalisa kwiHealth Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengengconelwano yeMisebenzi. Imfundo-mveliso: Inqanaba 1: Akukho nto emva kokuqesheka kwinkonzo yomphakathi njengoko kufuneka eSouth Africa. Unyaka oyi-1 wamava ahambelana nendawo emva kokuqesheka kwinkonzo yomphakathi njengoko kufuneka eSouth Africa malunga namaphakathi namagosa akhuphiswe ngaphandle, akafuneki kwazi ukwenza inkonzo yomphakathi njengoko kufuneka eSouth Africa. Inqanaba 2: Amava afanelekile akwiminyaka eli-10 nangaphezulu emva kokuqesheka kwinkonzo yomphakathi njengoko kufuneka eSouth Africa malunga namaphakathi namagosa akhuphiswe ngaphandle, akafuneki kwazi ukwenza inkonzo yomphakathi njengoko kufuneka eSouth Africa. Inqanaba 3: Amava afanelekile akwiminyaka eli-20 nangaphezulu emva kokuqesheka kwinkonzo yomphakathi njengoko kufuneka eSouth Africa malunga namaphakathi namagosa akhuphiswe ngaphandle, akafuneki kwazi ukwenza inkonzo yomphakathi njengoko kufuneka eSouth Africa. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi kumsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokuqhuba (Code B/EB) esemthethweni. Okulungele ukuhamba. Ukuzinza (ulwazi/amakhono): Amakhono okuthetha athile (okubalulwayo nokubhalwayo). Isakhono sokusebenza kwiqela elidibana namazwi amaninzi kuzo zonke iindawo. Ulwazi olululo ngokunika inkonzo yengconelwano yeMisebenzi kunye nonyango.
xh.duties: Ukubonelela ngamacebo onke eNkonzo yengconelwano yeMisebenzi kwindawo ekhethekileyo yamaqela asekelwe kumsebenzi, uphuhliso lomphakathi-phakamisa, ukhuthazo lwempilo kunye namacebo okuthintela iimpilo. Ukusebenza ngaphakathi kwindlela yokuqala ekujoliswe kumphakathi ukuphucula amandla omphakathi okunika inkonzo kubo bonke abantu kwindawo eSaldanha Bay sub-district. Ukuyila nokuxhasa iindlela zolawulo nemimandla ekuvumela abafundi ukuba bafunde ngokwenza. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kumfundiso nokusombulula iindlela ezahlukeneyo.

jobs.title: Case Manager
jobs.summary: Case Manager needed at Khayelitsha District Hospital to perform pre-authorisation, benefit verification and discharge planning functions.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate three-year health related National Diploma/ Degree registrable with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) or South African Nursing Council (SANC). Experience: Appropriate experience in the Managed Health Care sector i.e. Case Management or Medical Aid environment and Revenue Generation. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Knowledge of the Medical Schemes Act 131 of 1998, regulations and annexures as amended. Knowledge of prescribed minimum benefits i.e. the chronic disease list and diagnostic treatment pairs. Basic knowledge of the uniform patient fees schedule and patient billing. Knowledge of and experience in ICD 10 Codes assignment and the ability to link patient diagnosis with procedure codes. Knowledge of Clinicom and EDI (Electronic Data Interchange). Ability to work with Excel spread sheets, Microsoft Word and web based programs (medical aids). Excellent communication, conflict management, interpersonal and leadership skills. Excellent written and verbal communication in at least two of the three official languages of the western cape.
jobs.duties: Perform Case Management functions, i.e. obtaining pre-authorization and verification of benefits as needed, concurrent, retrospective review, discharge planning and provide quotations to H2, H3 and foreign patients. Assist with Medikredit EDI rejection reports and ensure corrections are completed timeously and resubmitted to Medikredit. Liaise with the various role-players e.g. clinicians, managed care organizations and medical scheme case managers to monitor utilisation and update patient’s clinical information while in hospital. Manage and implement case management policies, protocols and procedures in the hospital. Conduct clinical audits of patient accounts inclusive of medical aids, state departments e.g. RAF and COIDA to ensure accuracy of invoices with regard to ICD 10 codes, UPFS procedure codes and resource utilization. Manage and supervise Case Management and Revenue departments.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. af.title: Sakebestuurder
af.summary: Sakebestuurder benodig by Khayelitsha District Hospital om voorafmagtiging, voordeleverifikasie en ontslagbeplikingsfunksies uit te voer.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike drie-jaar gesondheidsverwante Nasionale Diploma/ Graad registreerbaar met die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) of South African Nursing Council (SANC). Ervaring: Toepaslike ervaring in die bestuurde gesondheidsorgsektor d.w.s. Sakebestuur of Mediese Hulp-omgewing en Inkomste-generering. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Kennis van die Medical Schemes Act 131 of 1998, regulasies en bylaes soos gewysig. Kennis van voorgeskrewe minimum voordele d.w.s. die chroniese siektelys en diagnostiese behandelingspare. Basiese kennis van die uniforme pasiëntfooidlys en pasiëtfakturering. Kennis van en ervaring in ICD 10-kode-toewysing en die vermoë om pasiëntdiagnose met prosedurekodes te koppel. Kennis van Clinicom en EDI (Electronic Data Interchange). Vermoë om met Excel-sigblaaie, Microsoft Word en webgebaseerde programme (mediese hulpe) te werk. Uitstekende kommunikasie, konflikbestuur, interpersoonlike en leierskapsvaardighede. Uitstekende skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasie in ten minste twee van die drie amptelike tale van die westelike kaap.
af.duties: Voer Sakebestuur-funksies uit, d.w.s. verkryging van voorafmagtiging en verifikasie van voordele soos nodig, gelyktydige, retrospektiewe hersiening, ontslagbepliking en verskaffing van kwotasies aan H2-, H3- en buitelandse pasiënte. Bystand met Medikredit EDI-afwysingsverslae en verseker dat korreksies tydig voltooi en by Medikredit ingedien word. Skakel met die verskeie rolspelers bv. klinici, bestuurde sorgorganisasies en mediese skema-sakebestuurders om benutting te monitor en pasiënt se kliniese inligting op datum te hou terwyl in die hospitaal. Bestuur en implementeer sakebestuurbeleide, protokolle en prosedures in die hospitaal. Voer kliniese oudits van pasiëntrekeninge insluitend mediese hulpe, staatsdepartemente bv. RAF en COIDA uit om akkuraatheid van fakture ten opsigte van ICD 10-kodes, UPFS-prosedurekodes en hulpbronbenutting te verseker. Bestuur en bestuursuperviseer Sakebestuur- en Inkomste-departemente.

zu.title: Umenzi wezimo
zu.summary: Umenzi wezimo udingeka e-Khayelitsha District Hospital ukwenza imisebenzi yokuqinisekisa ngaphambili, ukuqinisekisa izinzuzo nokuhlela ukuphuma.
zu.requirements: Izindingo ezingaphansi kwemfundo: I-National Diploma/ Degree ehambisana nemfundo yezempilo yeminyaka emithathu ebingatshwatshulwa kwi-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) noma i-South African Nursing Council (SANC). Isipiliyoni: Isipiliyoni esihambisana nendawo ye-Managed Health Care okungukuthi i-Case Management noma i-Medical Aid kanye nokuKhiqiza Imali. Ikhono (ulwazi/izikhombi): Ulwazi nge-Medical Schemes Act 131 of 1998, izimiso kanye namafayela anezibhalo njengokuqediswe. Ulwazi ngezinzuzo ezingaphansi kwemitheshwa okungukuthi uhlu lwesifo sasenkathi kanye namaphuzu okwelapha nokuhlonza. Ulwazi oluyisisekelo ngesheduli yamafomu amalunga ohulumeni kanye nokuthumela izikhwama kumalunga. Ulwazi kanye nesipiliyoni ekubekweni kwamakhodi e-ICD 10 kanye nethuba lokuxhuma ukuhlonza kwesiguli namakhodi ezindlela. Ulwazi nge-Clinicom kanye ne-EDI (Electronic Data Interchange). Ikhono lokusebenza nge-Excel spread sheets, i-Microsoft Word kanye namaphrogremu asuka kwinthanethi (medical aids). Ikhono elihle lokuxhumana, lokuphatha izinkinga, lokuxhumana nabantu kanye nokuholisa. Ukubhala nokukhuluma okuhle ngezinye zezilimi ezisemthethweni ezintathu zesifundazwe se-western cape.
zu.duties: Yenza imisebenzi ye-Case Management, okungukuthi ukuthola ukuqinisekisa ngaphambili kanye nokuqinisekisa izinzuzo njengoba kudingeka, ukubuyekeza ngasikhathi sinye, ngemva kwesikhathi, ukuhlela ukuphuma kwaye unikeze izikote ku-H2, H3 kanye namalunga angakwazi uLwandle. Siza ngeziphika zokuqediswa ze-Medikredit EDI futhi uqiniseke ukuthi izilungiso ziqediwe ngokushesha futhi zithunyelwe kabusha ku-Medikredit. Xhumana nabalingisi abahlukene isibonelo ojoyingwini, izinhlangano eziphatha ukunakekelwa kanye nabaphathi bezimo bezinhlelo zokwelapha ukugada ukusetshenziswa futhi ubuyekeze ulwazi olungokwelapha olwesiguli ngesikhathi sisibedlhe. Phatha futhi usebenzise izinqubomgomo, izivumelwano kanye namasu e-Case Management esibhedlela. Yenza ukubuyekeza kokwelapha kwama-akhawunti wesiguli ahlanganisa izinhlelo zokwelapha, izikhulu zikahulumeni isb. I-RAF kanye ne-COIDA ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukulunga kwamabhilomu ngokuqondene namakhodi e-ICD 10, amakhodi we-UPFS kanye nokusetshenziswa kwezinsiza. Phatha futhi uqaphele iminyango ye-Case Management kanye ne-Revenue.

xh.title: Umphathi weMimeko
xh.summary: Kufuneka abe nguMphathi weMimeko eKhayelitsha District Hospital ukwenza imisebenzi yokuvunywa kwangaphambili, ukuqinisekisa izibonelelo nokucwangcisa ukuphuma kwesibhedlele.
xh.requirements: Iziqinisekiso ezincinane zemfundo: I-Diploma/ Degree yezwe yeminyaka emithathu ehambelana nezempilo egunyaziswa kwi-HPCSA okanye i-SANC. Isipili: Isipili esifanelekileyo kwicandelo le-Managed Health Care oko kukuthi i-Case Management okanye indawo ye-Medical Aid nokwenza ingeniso. Ikhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi nge-Medical Schemes Act 131 ka-1998, iimithetho nezihlomelo njengoko zilungisiwe. Ulwazi ngeziyalezelo ezincinane zeempilo oko kukuthi uluhlu lwezifo ezingapheliyo kunye neqela lokwelapha izifo. Ulwazi olusentlwelo loluhlu lweemvisiswano zexabiso labagula kunye nenkqubo yokufaka iimali kubagula. Ulwazi noluphelo kwindawo yamaxesi e-ICD 10 Codes kunye nokuqamba ukudibanisa isifo somagula ngeekhowudi zezenzo. Ulwazi nge-Clinicom ne-EDI (Electronic Data Interchange). Ikhono lokusebenza ngee-Excel spread sheets, i-Microsoft Word kunye nenkqubo ezisekwe kwi-intanethi (medical aids). Ikhono elihle lokunxibelelwana, lokulawula iingxabano, lobuntu bomntu nobukhosi. Isibheno esihle nokuthetha kolunye lulwimi kwezintathu ezisemthethweni ze-western cape.
xh.duties: Yenza imisebenzi ye-Case Management, oko kukuthi ukufumana isivumelwano sangaphambili nokuqinisekisa izibonelelo njengoko kudingeka, ukuhlola ngexesha elinye nangemva kwexesha, ukucwangcisa ukuphuma nokunika iintsimbi kubagula be-H2, be-H3 namakhandlela. Nceda ngeengxelo zokwalatshwa kwi-Medikredit EDi ukuqinisekisa ukuba izilungiso zenzelwa ngexesha lokuzalisekisa kwaye zithunyelwe kwakhona kwi-Medikredit. Dixon nxibelelane nabanye abadlali bemidlalo njengabaguli, iimveliso ezilawulwayo kunye nababengi bemidlalo yamakherekho aphethe imidlalo yabaguli ukuze ubukele ukusetyenziswa kwaye uhlaziye iinkcukacha zomagula ngelixa esesibhedlele. Lawula ungenise iimphatho, iinkqubo neendlela zokuphatha imimeko kwisibhedlele. Yenza ukuhlola imidlalo yamaxesi oomagula ngokubandakanya amakherekho, amasebe karhulumente njengakwi-RAF naku-COIDA ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuchaneka kwezityalo malunga neekhowudi ze-ICD 10, iikhowudi zezenzo ze-UPFS nokusetyenziswa kwamacebo. Lawula uze ulawule iimicimbi ye-Case Management ne-Departments yokwenza ingeniso.

Ulwazi nge-Medical Schemes Act 131 ka-1998 nokusetyenziswa kwezintlawulo ze-Prescribed Minimum Benefit (PMB) ezithi yi-Chronic Disease List (CDL) ne-Diagnostic Treatment Pairs (DTP). Ukuba nokhono ukusebenza nge-Excel spread sheets, i-Microsoft Word ngeenkqubo zokusebenza kwiiwebhu (medical aids).
zu.duties: Nsiza izikhungo ezahlukene ekususeni izikweletu ezeqile zemali engenayo ephethwe ngaphandle ezihlobene nokwabelwa amakhodi ICD-10, ukwabelwa i-UPFS nokuphathwa kwezimo ze-PMB.Nsiza Abarhwebele Bezimali Ezigunjwelwe Ezahlukene ekulandeleni izikweletu ezeqile zamashemu okwesikhashana namaphoyili ahlongeze ndawonye nezinto ezingomlibo angaphandle kwahulumdwa kwilizwe lonke.

xh.title: Mphathi weeNyani
xh.summary: Kufunekwa umphathiweenyani kwiNtloko yeSebe leMpilo yeWestern Cape ukunceda iisebe nokupeywa kweekhowudi ze-ICD-10 nokuulandela ingeniso yamashishini ezobulawa.
xh.requirements: Isimfuno esincinane semfundo: iDiploma/YiNqanaba leNyanga emfutshane eliqhotselwe kwiDipathmentshi yobuNtu naye yoRhulumente weMfundo kaSewula Afrika (HPCSA) okanye iBhunga labaNongjiniyela beseBenza iMfundo (SANC). Isipili: Isipili esifanelekileyo ekulawulweni kweekhosí naseKondaveni yeNkxaso yeGazethe okanye eKondaveni yeNgigniso. Isipili esifanelekileyo ekudiniweni kweekhowudi ze-ICD-10 nendlela yokudibanisa isiphnongo somguli neekhowudi zokwenza imisebenzi. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi: Ukuzimisela ukuhamba nokuithuba ixesha elide kude nendlini. Ilayisensi yokushayela yeKhowudi 08. Amakhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi oluhle ngeSheduli yemali ezihlo wabaGuli (UPFS) noma ezinye iindlela zamaxesha, ulwazi lokulawulwa koGazi okanye iindlela zeNkcazobo yeSibhededu nokuqonda ii-EDI (uKutshintshwa koGazi eNdiscothongotho). Ulwazi ngoMthetho wokuLawula amashishini obuLawa i-131 ka-1998 nokuqinisekisa iMithetho yamaphakbha amuncu (PMB) njengeNkcanchasho yeziKhrobari (CDL) neQhagamshelo lokuxilongo nakwelapha (DTP). Ukuba nakhono ukusebenza ngeShethi eziscript kwiExcel, iMicrosoft Word, namaphrogram ewebhu (amancedo azelitye).
xh.duties: Nceda iisebe ezahlukeneyo ekuycleeni iinkgxaso zengigniso ezixhaswa ngaphandle ezingathunyelwanga ezinxulumene nokumiselwa kweekhowudi ze-ICD-10, ukumiselwa kwe-UPFS, nolawulo lweemeko ze-PMB. Nceda amasebe ahlukeneyo eMali eZibhedlela ekulandeleni amaxesha angahlawulanga kumashishini ezesempilo kwanamasebe abulungo alo emanyulwe kumaphuphuimbulula nokunxulumene neakhawunti. Yenza upando lwemibuzo yee-akhawunti zabaguli ukuqinisekisa ukululeka kweefaktisi ezizakuhtyunyazwa kumancedo aselitye naseMasebe. Phefisa imisebenzi yokulawula iNyali kwisebe ezihlukeneyo, kuquka nemvume ngaphakathi kobulingo bokuqinisekiswa okungqongqo ukulungisa inyathelo nemiThetho yokulawula iiNyali. Nceda ekushenxeni iintleko ze-EDI ukuqinisekisa isithunyelo selifane ngexesha elifanelekileyo leefaktisi zamashishini obulawa. Zinkele amaxabiso abaguli be-H2, be-H3, nabenjingxwango. Nceda ekusekweni kumgaqo-nkqubo nemithetho yesebe yokulawula iiNyali ngokunika uPhuhliso lwekhono emmoweni nakwiLiso kubachaphudele abaluseleyo kumadanga aXa amathbella alwulwa. Ulawulo noPhuhliso abasebenzi ukunika isiqinisekiso soBuchule bokuSebenza ukufikelela kwiiNqanaba zokuPhefumla.

jobs.title: Professional Nurse Grade 1 to 3 (GENERAL) (VARIOUS

Computer literacy in MS Office and Outlook. Knowledge of the Mental Health Care Act, Child Care Act, Nursing Act and other relevant legislation.

Maintain professional growth/ethical standards and self-development. Provision of Support to Nursing Services. Participation in training and research.

zu.summary: Badinga onesi abochwepheshe eValkenberg Hospital ukunikeza ukunakekelwa kwezempilo kwengqondo okuphelele; kudingeka ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC ngediploma noma iziqu zokweseka.

Ukuhambisana nokusebenza kuzo zonke izingxenye/izigaba ngokwezidingo zokusebenza zesibhedlela. Izindlela zokusebenza (ulwazi/iziklidi): Amakhono amahle okuxhumana, ohlelo, nenhlelo. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhaya lekhompyutha e-MS Office ne-Outlook. Ulwazi nge-Mental Health Care Act, Child Care Act, Nursing Act kanye nezinye izigaba ezihlobene.
zu.duties: Ukunikeza ukunakekelwa okuhamba kahle kakhulu, okuphelele kubasebenzisi bengqondo ngamazinga abekiwe ngaphakathi kohlelo lweziqu/omthetho. Ukusetshenziswa kwezinsiza ngempumelelo. Ukugcina ukukhula kweziqu/izinga zokuziphatha nokuzethuthukisa komuntu siqu. Ukunikeza ukwesekwa kumasevisi eNesi. Ukuthathana nokuhlanganyela ekuqeqeshweni nasekuhloleni.

Inqanaba 2: Inkcubelo embalwa yeminyaka engama-10 yokwaziswa/okumkelwa emsebenzini wokongaka emva kokubhalisa njengoMongikazi oGcweleyo kwi-SANC ekongakeni jikelele. Inqanaba 3: Inkcubelo embalwa yeminyaka engama-20 yokwaziswa/okumkelwa emsebenzini wokongaka emva kokubhalisa njengoMongikazi oGcweleyo kwi-SANC ekongakeni jikelele. Iimfuno zangaphakathi zomsebenzi: Ukulungele ukuvela emsebenzini weshedyula, ukujikeleza kumsebenzi wabasuku nangapheza kwamaviki/ngeyhanga likawonke-wonke. Ukulungele ukusebenza kuzo zonke iindawo/izigodi ngokweemfuno zomsebenzi wesibhedlele. Ikhono (ulwazi/izakhono): Izakhono ezilungile zomanyano, ulwakho, nelungiselelo. Ulwazi ngeMthetho woNakekelo lweMpilo, uMthetho woNakekelo lweNgqondo, uMthetho woNakekelo lwaBantwana, uMthetho wokuNgaka, neminye imithetho engummiselo.

Ukusebenzisa isixhobo ngokuchanekileyo. Ukugcina ukukhula komzobu/okumiyo ngokuyimfihlo nokuziphucela. Unikezelo lwoXhavo kumNgambo wokuNakekela. Ukuthatha inxaxheba eqeqeshweni nasekuPhandweni.

jobs.title: Senior Emergency Control Centre Agent (DISPATCHER) (X14
jobs.centre: Emergency Communication Centre, Metropole and Rural
jobs.summary: The Western Cape Department of Health seeks 14 senior emergency control centre agents to handle medical dispatch operations across metro and rural areas.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Senior certificate (Grade 12 or equivalent). Experience: Appropriate Emergency/ Medical Call-Centre experience. Inherent requirement of the job: Ability to work shifts as per roster. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Basic knowledge of the topographical layout of the Western Cape. Good listening, work organization and prioritization skills. Computer literacy (MS office).

Alert supervisors to recurrent incidents, as well as exceptional incidents of a critical life threatening in nature, particularly in the mass casualty context. Mobilise vehicle resources, control the deployment of resources and react to delays in the individual status of the deployed vehicles. Training and supervision of Emergency Communications students during their elective. Implement any instructions as per the identified medical dispatch protocol reference system (MDPRS). Manage Major Incidents according to plan Delta and MIMMS, and mobilize other emergency services incl. Traffic, Fire SAPS and Disaster Management when required. Manage caller anxiety and stress and provide life-saving telephonic interventions.
jobs.enquiries: Ms P Masitho Tel No: (021) 932-1966 (Metropole) Ms B Dees Tel No: (023) 346-6032 (Cape Winelands/Overberg) Ms M Arries Tel No: (044) 805-5070 (Garden Route/Central Karoo) Mr A Titus Tel No: (022) 433- 8700 (West Coast)

af.title: Senior Noodbeheersentrumagent (DISPATCHER) (X14)
af.summary: Die Western Cape Department of Health soek 14 senior noodbeheersentrumagente om mediese versendingsbedrywighede oor metro- en landelike gebiede te hanteer.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Senior sertifikaat (Graad 12 of gelykwaardig). Ervaring: Toepaslike nood-/mediese oproepsentrum-ervaring. Inherente vereiste van die werk: Vermoë om skofte volgens rooster te werk. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Basiese kennis van die topografiese uitleg van die Western Cape. Goeie luister-, werkorganisasie- en prioriteitsvaardighede. Rekenaarvaardigheid (MS office).
af.duties: Neem inligting akkuraat op om data-integriteit en daaropvolgende toepaslike bestuursintervensie te verseker. Stel toesighouers in kennis van terugkerende voorvalle, asook uitsonderlike voorvalle van 'n kritieke lewensbedreigende aard, veral in die massaslagofferkonteks. Mobiliseer voertuighulpbronne, beheer die ontplooiing van hulpbronne en reageer op vertragings in die individuele status van ontplooide voertuie. Opleiding en toesig van Noodkommunikasie-studente gedurende hulle keusevak. Implementeer enige instruksies volgens die geïdentifiseerde mediese versendingsprotokol-verwysingstelsel (MDPRS). Bestuur groot voorvalle volgens plan Delta en MIMMS, en mobiliseer ander nooddienste insluitend Verkeer, Brandweer, SAPS en Rampbestuur wanneer nodig. Bestuur oproeper-angs en stres en verskaf lewensreddende telefooniese ingrypings.

zu.title: Umphaseli Ohlezi weSikhungo Sokulawula Izimpi Zephutha (DISPATCHER) (X14)
zu.summary: IGatsha lemaphakathi leNyanga yezeZempilo lifuna abaphaseli abakhulu aba-14 abazobamba imisebenzi yokulawula ukuthumela izinsiza zezokwelapha kulo lonke izindawo zasemadolobheni nasemaphandleni.
zu.requirements: Isidingo sokuqasha ezemfundo: Isitifikedi se-Senior certificate (Grade 12 noma okulinganayo). Isipiliyoni: Isipiliyono esifanele sokusebenza kwiCall-Centre yeZezempi/Zokwelapha. Isidingo esifakwele emsebenzini: Ikono lokusebenza ngokushintshana njengoba kubhalwe ohlwaneni. Amakhono (ulwazi/ikono): Ulwazi oluyisisekelo ngohlelo lwendawo logatsha lemaphakathi. Amakhono ahle ogokuzwa, ukuhlelwa komsebenzi nokubeka okubaluleke kungenisa. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (i-MS Office).
zu.duties: Bhala ulwazi ngokunembile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba kokuhamba kahle kwedatha nokungenelela okufanele kokuphathwa okulandelayo. Yezisa abaphathi ezimeni eziphinda zenzeke, kanye nezimo ezingajwayelekile ezibangelwa ukuswela impilo, ikakhulukazi kulesimo seziguli eziningi. Hambisa izinsiza kwezimoto, lawula ukusetshenziswa kwamandla wezinsiza futhi uphendulele ekulibazayweni ohlelweni kwemoto elisetshenzisiwe. Ukugadama nokuphatha abafundi bezokuxhumana kwezinsiza zezempi ngexesha abakhetha kuso. Qamba imiyalo yonke njengohlelo lokuthumela ukwelashwa ngokomthetho (MDPRS). Phatha izimpi ezinkulu ngokwe-Delta no-MIMMS, ukuze ushintshele kwezinye izinhlelo ezingenele ukwelashwa okuyimaphutha nxa kunesidingo. Phatha ukukhathazeka nokuphephukela komnikazi weselfoni nokunikeza ukwelashwa ngocingo olusindisa.

xh.title: Umjini oMkhulu weNkonzo yeNdzuzamo yeQele leSiphithiphithi (DISPATCHER) (X14
xh.summary: Isebe lezeMpilo loMntla-Koloni lifuna aba-14 abajini abakhulu benkonzo yendzuzamo yeqele le siphithiphithi ukuba bagcibe imisebenzi yokuthumela iindwendwe zezosize Medical kwimimandla yasezidlavela naseemaphandleni.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esingagqibekanga: Isetifikathi samabanga aphezulu (iBanga le-12 okanye esalinganayo). Isipili: Isipili esifanelekileyo sokusebenza kwiCall-Centre yezeZigulo/ ezoBunyulu. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi kwomsebenzi: Ulawulo lokusebenza ngokutshatshalisayo njengakumshini wokusebenza. Iikhompetensi (ulwazi/ amakhono): Ulwazi olusesantlweni malunga nendlela okumiselwe ngayo iindawo zoMntla-Koloni. Amakhono amabaluhlaza, amakhona amaninzi wokuhlela umsebenzi kwaye abe liliso lokubeka izinto ezibalulekileyo zibe phambili. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngekhompyutha (MS office).
xh.duties: Iloophe ngokuchanekileyo iinkcazelo ngenjongo yokulondoloza ukusebenza kolwazi nemisebenzi efunekayo ekukelwe intlalweni. Yazise abalawuli ngokuvela kweziganeko ezihlala ezivele zehla, kunye neziganeko ezingezo ezedolo ezibangela isiphithiphithi sokulahlekelwa ubomi ikakhulu kwimeko yohlaselo oluninzi. Khokelela iithrekhi kwaye ulawule ukubekwa kolwazi bese uzabela kwiingcakaza kummandla othe ngqo wezo threkhi ezize zi za kuthunyelwa. Ukuzala kunye noyilo lwafotho lwazo zonke iingxoxo zokufundisa abafundi ngesiPhithiphithi esibangele ukungabilikwa kwamaza ombane kwiSebe ekukhethwa kuyo iindwendwe zokuzibangela izigulo. Zonke izalathiso zifunekayo kwiSebe zikwindlela kaMthetho wokuthumela oBhalwe ngokuthi yi-Reference System (MDPRS) kwindawo esemthethweni ngowona mthetho ufuna IsiTyhala esinzima ngokumda iziganeko ezahluwenyo kwindlela efana nePlan Delta, kwaye ngoko kwakho ke noko ithe ngokomfuziselo iinkonzo ezilawulwayo nokuzinikela iinkonzo zokuphepha kunye nokuzinikela iinkonzo ezingabango imimandla ngokubanzi. Lawula iingxaki zabafowuni nokusinda okubangelwa kukhathazeko olukhulu nokunika izisombululo ezingagcina ubomi ngomnxeba.

jobs.title: Pharmacist Assistant Grade 1 to 3 (POST-BASIC)

jobs.city: Medicine Management, Laboratory and Bloods Services Support
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R275 340 per annum Grade 2: R318 666 per annum Grade 3: R343 761 per annum
jobs.summary: Pharmacist Assistant Grade 1 to 3 (Post-Basic) needed at Cape Medical Depot to assist with receiving, storing and issuing pharmaceutical stock.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: As required by the training facility and the South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) plus Post-Basic Pharmacist Assistant qualification that allows registration with SAPC as a Pharmacist Assistant (Post-Basic). Registration with a professional council: Registration with the SAPC as a Pharmacist Assistant Post Basic or Pharmacist Assistant Post Basic (Warehousing). Experience: Grade 1: None after registration with the SAPC as Pharmacist Assistant (Post-Basic). Grade 2: A minimum of 5 years appropriate experience as Pharmacist Assistant after registration as a Pharmacist Assistant (Post-Basic) with the SAPC. Grade 3: A minimum of 13 years appropriate experience as Pharmacist Assistant after registration as a Pharmacist Assistant (Post-Basic) with the SAPC. Inherent requirement of the job: Willingness to undergo competency training to operate a hyster/ forklift. Willingness to work overtime when required. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Knowledge and/or experience in handling pharmaceutical supplies particularly in a warehouse environment, including Cold Chain Practices. Knowledge of Drug Supply Management Principles. Good knowledge of wholesale warehouse practices and procedures. Good literacy and numeric skills. The ability to work in a warehouse type situation and have the physical dexterity. Computer literacy (MS Word, Excel, Outlook, and Teams). Ability to lift heavy objects and operate heavy machinery- stackers, pallet jacks, Hyster/ Forklift. Good interpersonal and communication skills. Ability to work independently as well as in a team. Ability to comply with applicable legislation. Ability to work accurately under pressure and maintain a high work ethic.
jobs.duties: Assist with the receiving and storage of pharmaceutical products from suppliers. Assist with the control of pharmaceutical stock. Assist with the Issuing of stock against orders from health facilities within the scope of practice of a Post Basic Pharmacist Assistant. Assist with the efficient and secure packaging of pharmaceutical products for delivery. Assist with the effective control and distribution of completed pharmaceutical orders to facilities. Compliance with good pharmacy practice and good warehouse practice. Support and assist the Pharmacy Supervisor with collating statistics.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates will be subjected to a written/practical and oral assessment. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment, on condition that proof of application for registration with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable on health professionals who apply for the first time for registration in a specific category with the relevant council (including individuals who must apply for change in registration status)”. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. af.title: Apteekassistent Graad 1 tot 3 (POST-BASIC)
af.summary: Apteekassistent Graad 1 tot 3 (Post-Basic) benodig by Cape Medical Depot om te help met die ontvangs, berging en uitreiking van farmaseutiese voorraad.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Soos vereis deur die opleidingsfasiliteit en die South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) plus Post-Basic Pharmacist Assistant-kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die SAPC as 'n Pharmacist Assistant (Post-Basic) moontlik maak. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die SAPC as 'n Pharmacist Assistant Post Basic of Pharmacist Assistant Post Basic (Warehousing). Ervaring: Graad 1: Geen na registrasie by die SAPC as Pharmacist Assistant (Post-Basic) nie. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 5 jaar toepaslike ervaring as Pharmacist Assistant na registrasie as 'n Pharmacist Assistant (Post-Basic) by die SAPC. Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 13 jaar toepaslike ervaring as Pharmacist Assistant na registrasie as 'n Pharmacist Assistant (Post-Basic) by die SAPC. Inherente vereiste van die werk: Bereidwilligheid om bevoegdheidsopleiding te ondergaan om 'n hyster/vurkheftruck te bedryf. Bereidwilligheid om oortyd te werk wanneer vereis. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Kennis en/of ervaring in die hantering van farmaseutiese voorrade, veral in 'n pakhuisomgewing, insluitend Cold Chain Practices. Kennis van Drug Supply Management Principles. Goeie kennis van groothandelpakhuispraktyke en -prosedures. Goeie geletterdheid en numeriese vaardighede. Die vermoë om in 'n pakkhuistipe situasie te werk en die nodige fisieke behendigheid te besit. Rekenaargeletterdheid (MS Word, Excel, Outlook en Teams). Vermoë om swaar voorwerpe op te lig en swaar masjinerie te bedryf - stapelaars, palletvurke, Hyster/vurkheftruck. Goeie interpersoonlike en kommunikasievaardighede. Vermoë om onafhanklik sowel as in 'n span te werk. Vermoë om met toepaslike wetgewing te voldoen. Vermoë om akkuraat onder druk te werk en 'n hoë werksetiek te handhaaf.
af.duties: Help met die ontvangs en berging van farmaseutiese produkte van verskaffers. Help met die beheer van farmaseutiese voorraad. Help met die uitreiking van voorraad teen bestellings van gesondheidsfasiliteite binne die werksbestek van 'n Post Basic Pharmacist Assistant. Help met die doeltreffende en veilige verpakking van farmaseutiese produkte vir aflewering. Help met die effektiewe beheer en verspreiding van voltooide farmaseutiese bestellings aan fasiliteite. Nakoming van goeie apteekpraktyk en goeie pakhuispraktyk. Ondersteun en help die Pharmacy Supervisor met die saamstel van statistieke.

zu.title: Osiza-Ethi izinga 1 kuya ku-3 (POST-BASIC)
zu.summary: Osiza-Ethi izinga 1 kuya ku-3 (Post-Basic) udingwa e-Cape Medical Depot ukusize ngokwamukela, ukugcina nokukhipha izitokhu zezemithi.
zu.requirements: Isidingo semfundo esingaphansi: Snjengoba kudingwa isikhungo sokuhlinzeka nqeqesho kanye ne-South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) kanye nokuqeqeshwa okuyisifundo se-Post-Basic Pharmacist Assistant esivumela ukubhalisa ku-SAPC njengo-Pharmacist Assistant (Post-Basic). Ukubhalisa ekhelwe ukubungela obuyiswazi: Ukubhalisa ku-SAPC njengo-Pharmacist Assistant Post Basic noma njengo-Pharmacist Assistant Post Basic (Warehousing). Isipiliyoni: Izinga 1: Asikho ngemva kokubhalisa ku-SAPC njengo-Pharmacist Assistant (Post-Basic). Izinga 2: Isipiliyoni esifanele sonyaka osingu-5 njengo-Pharmacist Assistant ngemva kokubhalisa njengo-Pharmacist Assistant (Post-Basic) ku-SAPC. Izinga 3: Isipiliyoni esifanele sonyaka osingu-13 njengo-Pharmacist Assistant ngemva kokubhalisa njengo-Pharmacist Assistant (Post-Basic) ku-SAPC. Isidingo esifanekeliswe emsebenzini: Ukuqinisekela ukuthatha ukuqeqeshwa kolwazi ukusebenzisa i-hyster/ forklift. Ukuqinisekela ukusebenza amahora engeziwe uma kudingeka. Izindlela eziyinguo (ulwazi/ amakhono): Ulwazi kanye/noma isipiliyoni ekuphatheni izinsiza zemithi ikakhulukazi emhlabeni wesitoreji, okuhlanganisa izindlela ze-Cold Chain Practices. Ulwazi lwe-Drug Supply Management Principles. Ulwazi oluhle olwamaphakethe amakhulu nokulandela izinqubo zesitoreji. Amakhono ahle okufunda nokubala. Ikhono lokusebenza endaweni efana n-esitoreji kanye nobuchophha bezandla. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha (MS Word, Excel, Outlook, kanye ne-Teams). Ikhono lokuphakamisa izinto ezisindayo nokusebenzisa izimoto ezisindayo- izi-stackers, ama-pallet jacks, i-Hyster/ Forklift. Amakhono ahle okuxhumanisa nabantu. Ikhono lokusebenza kodwa kanye nokuqoqana kwel iqembu. Ikhono lokulandela umthetho ophathekayo. Ikhono lokusebenza ngokunembile phansi kwegxabo futhi ugcine izinga eliphezulu lokusebenza.
zu.duties: Usiza ekwamukeleni nasekugcineni izimengamengi zemithi eziyavela kubaphakeli. Usiza ekulawuleni izitokhu zemithi. Usiza ekukhipheni izitokhu ngokusho izinto ezitholwayo ezivela emitholampilo kanye namakhemikhali ngaphakathi kwesibawo somsebenzi wo-Post Basic Pharmacist Assistant. Usiza ekubekenzeni izimengamengi zemithi kabanzi nangokuphepha ukuthunyelwa. Usiza ekulawuleni nasekusatshalalisweni izinto ezitholwayo zemithi ezifezekile emitholampilo nasekutholeni. Ukulandela izinqubo ezinhle zokwenza umsebenzi weli-pharmacy kanye neqhaza elifanekeliswe emsebenzini. Ukusekela kanye nokusiza oMphathi be-pharmacy ngokuqoqa izibalo.

xh.title: Umncedi wePharmacist Grade 1 to 3 (POST-BASIC)
xh.summary: Kufuneka abe kho Umncedi wePharmacist Grade 1 to 3 (Post-Basic) kwiCape Medical Depot ukunceda nokwamkela, ukugcina kunye nokuphepha izinto zekhemikhali.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno zemfundo ezingowona aphantsi: Njengoko kufunwa sisebe soqeqesho kunye neSouth African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) kwaye ngaphezu koko kufuneka abe nelayisense yePost-Basic Pharmacist Assistant evumela ukubhalisa kwiSAPC njengengcali yamayeza (Post-Basic). Ukubhalisa koluntu lwabangcali: Ukubhalisa kwiSAPC njengengcali yamayeza (Post-Basic) okanye njengengcali yamayeza (Post-Basic) (Warehousing). Isipili: Grade 1: Akukho mfuno yisipili emva kokubhalisa kwiSAPC njengengcali yamayeza (Post-Basic). Grade 2: Iminyaka engu-5 ubuncinane yesipili esifanelekileyo njengengcali yamayeza emva kokubhalisa njengengcali yamayeza (Post-Basic) kwiSAPC. Grade 3: Iminyaka engu-13 ubuncinane yesipili esifanelekileyo njengengcali yamayeza emva kokubhalisa njengengcali yamayeza (Post-Basic) kwiSAPC. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi koludwe lomsebenzi: Ukuzimisela ukwenza uqeqesho lwamakhono okusebenzisa i-hyster/ forklift. Ukuzimisela ukusebenza ngexesha elongezelelweyo xa kufuneka. Amakhono (ulwazi/izakhono): Ulwazi okanye isipili ekuphateni izinto zekhemikhali ngokukodwa kwendawo yokugcina izinto, kuquka nokusebenza ngamayeza afuna ubanda. Ulwazi ngamagama aseMthethweni woLawulo loKwangcolwa woMthumbo. Ulwazi oluhle ngokwenza izinto ngendlela eqotho ekugcineni nokusasaza izinto. Ulwazi oluhle lokufunda nokubala. Ikhono lokusebenza kwimeko yokugcina izinto kwaye ukhulelwe ngokomzimba. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha (MS Word, Excel, Outlook, kunye neTeams). Ikhono lokuphakamisa izinto ezinzima kwaye usebenze nemishini enzima- stackers, pallet jacks, Hyster/ Forklift. Amakhono amahle okusebenza nabantu nokunxibelelana. Ikhono lokusebenza lodwa nangokwakho njengoko nakwindima. Ikhono lokuzinza ngokomthetho osebenzayo. Ikhono lokusebenza ngokuchanekileyo ngaphantsi koxinzelelo kwaye ulondoloze inqanaba eliphezulu lokuziphatha emsebenzini.
xh.duties: Unceda ekwamkelweni nasekugcineni iimveliso zamayeza ezivela kubathengisi. Unceda ekulawuleni isitokhwe samayeza. Unceda ekuphepheni isitokhwe ngokomyalelo ovela kumaziko empilo ngaphakathi kwemida yomsebenzi wePost Basic Pharmacist Assistant. Unceda ekupakishweni okusebenzayo nokuqinisekileyo kweemveliso zamayeza eza kuthunyelwa. Unceda ekulawuleni okusebenzayo nasekusasazeni iiodolo zamayeza ezigqityiweyo kumaziko. Imisebenzi yokwamkela ibonelela ngemibuzo yompati nolawulo lweefolda. Imisebenzi yeerekhedi zezigulo: Gcina irekhodi, yifake kwifayile, khupha iifolda, landela iifolda ezindala, tshabhisa iifolda udala iifolda ezintsha. Inheemse vereistes van die werk: 'n Geldige (Code B/EB) bestuurslisensie (persone met 'n geldige leerderlisensie mag ook aansoek doen). Bereidwilligheid om te reis en lang periodes weg van die kantoor deur te bring. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Kennis van in-hospitaal-pasiëntfooie of in 'n gesondheidsverwante eis-omgewing, mediese hulp/skema-eise, HIS (Health Information System)/Debiteurstelsel. Kennis van die hospitaalfooie-beleide en prosedures. Kennis van UPFS-tariefstrukture. Vermoë om mediese hulp/EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) verwante transaksies in die faktureringstelsels uit te voer. Vermoë om faktureringverwante transaksies vir staatsdepartemente uit te voer d.w.s. RAF (Road Accident Fund), SANDF (South African National Defence Force), SAPS (South African Police Services), DCS (Department of Correctional Services) en COID (Compensation for Occupational Injury on Duty). Rekenaarvaardigheid in Microsoft Office-toepassings (Word en Excel).
af.duties: Ondersteun verskeie fasiliteite met fakturering van agterstande, opstel en vrystelling van fakture en debitering van koste-inskrywings aan fakture volgens UPFS (Uniformed Patient Fee Schedule) faktureringsprosedures. Ondersteun fasiliteite se fooiedepartemente met toepaslike verslae vir opvolg van uitstaande pasiëntrekeninge en fakture. Ondersteun met indiening van EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) eise, afwysings en herindienings. Skakel met debiteure, mediese hulpe en ander toepaslike belanghebbendes rakende navrae; verjaarde eise en uitstaande balanse. Verseker indiening van fakture aan staatsdepartemente en ondersteun hospitale om agterstande ten opsigte van uitstaande fakture uit te ruim. Ondersteun met die skoonmaak van uitstaande mediese hulpbalanse deur die voorsiening van ondersteuning d.w.s. ondersoek en opvolg, of eskalering, van uitstaande rekeninge. Ondersteun met die skoonmaak van uitstaande mediese hulpbalanse deur die toepaslike verslae te verskaf d.w.s. versprei verslae (BD006) aan hospitale, of soortgelyke verslae aan mediese skemas.

zu.title: Umlobi Womphatho: Izimali/Umphatho
zu.summary: Kudingeka umlobi womphatho eDepartment of Health and Wellness eCape Town ukuphatha izimali zabakhungi, ukwenza izinhlayiya kanye nokulandela izikweletu eStikland Hospital.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ubuncane: Senior Certificate (noma okulinganayo) okuqukethe uMathematics futhi/noma i-Accounting njengesifundo esidlulisiwe futhi/noma Senior Certificate (noma okulinganayo) okune-expiriyensi/ukukwensa okugxila kumakhulu Amaphoyinti Asebenzayo (KPA's) esikhundleni. I-expiriyensi: I-expiriyensi efanelekile kwezimali zabakhugi besibhedlela noma indawo yezimangalo ezihlobene nezempilo. I-expiriyensi efanelekile ngezimangalo zesixhaso sezempilo/esikimu. I-expiriyensi yomsebenzi efanelekile kuHIS (Health Information system)/I-System Yokuthola Izimali Ezifakiwe. Izidingo ezibangelwa umsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokuqasha ehambisana namaphasi (Code B/EB) (abantu abanelayisensi yokufunda abangase futhi bafake isicelo). Ukuzithoba ukuhamba kude futhi uchithe izikhathi ezinde kunye lelikhaya. Ukusebenza kahle (ulwazi/izikhali): Ulwazi ngamafu wabakhungi besibhedlela noma endaweni yezimangalo ezihlobene nezempilo, izimangalo zesixhaso sezempilo/esikimu, HIS (Health Information system)/I-System Yokuthola Izimali Ezifakiwe. Ulwazi ngezinqubomgomo nezinqubo Zamafu Wesibhedlela. Ulwazi ngezakhiwo zamafu e-UPFS. Ikono lokwenza iziphakamiso ezihlobene nesixhaso sezempilo/EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) kumasistimu wokubala amafu. Ikono lokwenza iziphakamiso ezihlobene nokubala amafu emaphahla karhu abala kuwo ombuzo: i-RAF (Road Accident Fund), i-SANDF (South African National Defence Force), i-SAPS (South African Police Services), i-DCS (Department of Correctional Services) kanye ne-COID (Compensation for Occupational Injury on Duty). Ulwazi lwekhompyutha kumapolikayshini eMicrosoft Office (Word kanye ne-Excel).
zu.duties: Siza izinto eziningi ngenkathi ubala amafu okubuyela emuva kwama-akhawundi, ukwenza kanye nokukhulula izinhlayiya kanye nokufaka izibhalo zezimali kuzinhlayiya njengoba kuhlongozwe yizinhlaka zamafu e-UPFS (Uniformed Patient Fee Schedule). Siza amaphahla ezimali ngezibiko ezifanele zokulandela ama-akhawundi nabakhungi abangakhokhiwe kanye nezinhlayiya. Siza ngokusithumela izimangalo ze-EDI (Electronic Data Interchange), ukwenqatwa kanye nokuthumela kabusha. Xhumana nabakhokhi, abaxhasi beNhlangano Yezempilo, kanye nabanye abahwebisana abahambisanayo ngemibuzo; izimangalo ezindala kanye nezibalanisi ezingakhokhiwe. Qinisekisa ukuthunyelwa kwezinhlayiya emaphahla karhu futhi usize izibhedlela zokuqeda ukubuyela emuva kwezinhlayiya ezingakhokhiwe. Siza ukulungisa izibalanisi zesixhaso sezempilo ezingakhokhiwe ngokunika inkuxazo okuyikuphenya nokulandela, noma ukwenyusela, kwama-akhawundi angakhokhiwe. Siza ukulungisa izibalanisi zesixhaso sezempilo ezingakhokhiwe ngokunika izibiko ezifanele okuyikwaba izibiko (BD006) izibhedlela, noma izibiko ezifanayo abaxhasi besikimu.

xh.title: Mlawuli woLawulo: Izimali/ulawulo
xh.summary: Kufuneka umlawuli wolawulo kwi Sebe lezeMpilo neMphilo eCape Town ukuphatha u-rhwebo lwabaguli, ukwenza i-invoyisi nokuqhubela phambili iinkarha ezingaxhelwayo eStikland Hospital.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esingowasemva: Isatifikethi esiPhezulu (okwa silinganayo) ngeMathematics nakwanga i-Accounting njengesihloko esidlulileyo nakho naxa isatifikethi esiPhezulu (okwa silinganayo) sinamava/amandla agqithiswa kwii-Key Performance Areas (KPA’s) zesithuba. Amava: Amava afanelekileyo kwiimali zabaguli eSibhedlele okwa kwindalo yokuza kwezinto ezinxulumene nezeMpilo. Amava afanelekileyo ngenkcitha yamaklamsi esixhobo sokuncedana kwezonyango. Amava wokusebenza afanelekileyo kwi-HIS (Health Information system)/Accounts Receivable System. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi zomsebenzi: Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba (Code B/EB) esebenzayo (abantu benelayisenisi yokuFunda nabo banako ukungena). Ukulungele ukuhamba nokuhlula ixesha elide kude nenoqweqwa. Amandla (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi ngeemali zabaguli esibhedlele okwa kwinkalo yokuza kwezinto ezinxulumene nezeMpilo, iinklaimi zesixhobo sokuncedana kwezonyango, i-HIS (Health Information system)/Accounts Receivable System. Ulwazi ngeendlela nemigaqo yeemali zeSibhedlele. Ulwazi ngezakhiwo zexabiso le-UPFS. Amandla okwenza izinto ezinxulumene neMedical Aid/EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) kwizixokelelwana zokuthengisa. Amandla okwenza izinto ezinxulumene nokuthengisa kumasebe kaRhuluse i.e. RAF (Road Accident Fund), SANDF (South African National Defence Force), SAPS (South African Police Services), DCS (Department of Correctional Services) nakwi-COID (Compensation for Occupational Injury on Duty). Ulwazi lokusebenza ngakwikhompyutha kwiinkqubo zikaMicrosoft Office (Word, ne-Excel).
xh.duties: Nceda izinto ezahlukeneyo ngenkcitha yokubeka iirekhodi ezikhangelayo, ukuvakalisa nokukhulula iinvoyisi nokufaka iintshutshiso kwiinvoyisi njengoko kumiselwe yindlela yokuthengisa i-UPFS (Uniformed Patient Fee Schedule). Nceda iindawo zemali kwimisebenzi ngeendulululo ezifanelekileyo zokuqhubelela phambili ii-akhawunti zabaguli nemiqulu ezingaxhelwayo. Nceda nokungenisa iinklaimi ze-EDI (Electronic Data Interchange), eziyaliwa nokuzibuyela kwindalo. Thethathani nabatyali, nama-Medical Aids, nabanxulumene nayo nayiphi na into ngemibuzo; iinklaimi ezigqithiswe lixesha namanxulumela anjalo. Qinisekisa ukungeniswa kweenvoyisi kumasebe kaRhuluse unceda amasibhedlele ukuba ahlambulule okukhoyo ngokuphathelele iinvoyisi ezingaxhelwayo. Nceda nokucoca amanxulumela angaxheliweyo esixhobo sokuncedana ngokunika inkxaso nangezipo nkqubo iphononongo nokuqhubelela phambili, okwa kwisiphakamiso, sezo akhawunti ezingaxhelwayo. Nceda nokucoca amanxulumela angaxheliweyo ngokunika iindulululo ezifanelekileyo nankqubo yokusasaza iindulululo (BD006) kwisibhedlele, okwa iindulululo ezifanayo kumaxhwebo ezonyango.

jobs.title: Staff Nurse Grade 1 to 3 (CHILDREN’S Ward)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R229 440 per annum Grade 2: R272 778 per annum Grade 3: R319 071 per annum
jobs.summary: Staff Nurse positions at Grades 1 to 3 in the Children's Ward at Oudtshoorn Hospital, requiring SANC registration as a Staff Nurse.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Qualification that allows registration with the SANC as a Staff Nurse. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the SANC as a Staff Nurse. Experience: Grade 1: None Grade 2: A minimum of 10 years’ appropriate/recognisable experience in nursing after registration as Staff Nurse with the SANC. Grade 3: A minimum of 20 years’ appropriate/recognisable experience in nursing after registration as Staff Nurse with the SANC. Inherent requirement of the job: Willingness to work shifts, night duty, including weekends, public holidays as well as overtime. Willingness to assists in the other wards in the hospital and at the clinics in the Sub-district when needed. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Good communication and interpersonal relationships. Self- discipline and motivation. Ability to work in a team across the service platforms.
jobs.duties: Development and implementation of basic patient care plans. Provide basic clinical nursing care. Effective utilization of physical and financial resources. Maintain professional growth/ethical standards and self- development. Take actions to improve quality of nursing care. Participate in infection prevention and control.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates will be required to undergo a practical assessment. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements, may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration to register with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable to health professionals who apply for the first time for registration in a specific category with the relevant council (including individuals who must apply for change in registration status). It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. ERRATUM: Kindly note that the advert for the Post 28/215: Assistant Director: Expenditure Analysis and Management Reporting, Salary R487 197 per annum, Centre: Head Office (Cape Town) advertised in the Public Service Vacancy 28 dated 07 August 2026 with Ref No: 28/215. Kindly note that the post has been cancelled. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Verpleegster Vlak 1 tot 3 (KINDERafdeling)
af.summary: Verpleegsterposisie op Vlak 1 tot 3 in die Kinderafdeling by Oudtshoorn Hospitaal, wat SANC-registrasie as 'n Verpleegster vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die SANC as 'n Verpleegster moontlik maak. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die SANC as 'n Verpleegster. Ervaring: Vlak 1: Geen Vlak 2: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar se toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as Verpleegster by die SANC. Vlak 3: 'n Minimum van 20 jaar se toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as Verpleegster by die SANC. Inherente vereiste van die pos: Bereidwilligheid om skofte te werk, nagskof, insluitend naweke, openbare vakansiedae asook oortyd. Bereidwilligheid om behulpzaam te wees in die ander afdelings in die hospitaal en by die klinieke in die Sub-distrik wanneer nodig. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Goeie kommunikasie en interpersoonlike verhoudings. Selfdissipline en motivering. Vermoë om in 'n span dwarsoor die diensplatforms te werk.
af.duties: Ontwikkeling en implementering van basiese pasiëntsorgplanne. Verskaf basiese kliniese verpleegsorg. Effektiewe benutting van fisiese en finansiële hulpbronne. Handhaaf professionele groei/etiese standaarde en selfontwikkeling. Neem stappe om die gehalte van verpleegsorg te verbeter. Neem deel aan infeksievoorkoming en -beheer.

zu.title: Unesi wezinga 1 kuya ku- 3 (Ekwendlela labantwana)
zu.summary: Izikhundla z Onesı ezizingeni 1 kuya ku-3 Ekwendlela labantwana e Oudtshoorn Hospital, kudingeka ubhalise kwi SANC njengonesi.
zu.requirements: Isidingo semfundo esingaphansi kolwazi oluncane: Isifundo esivumela ukubhalisa ku SANC njengonesi. Ukubhalisa kwi nhlangano yeminyango: Ukubhalisa ku SANC njengonesi. Okuhlangenwe nakho: Izinga 1: Akukho Izinga 2: Umlinganiselo ongaphansi kweminyaka engu-10 okuhlangenwe nakho okuhambisana/okuqashelwa kwezokunakekela kwezempilo emva kokubhalisa njengonesi ku SANC. Izinga 3: Umlinganiselo ongaphansi kweminyaka engu-20 okuhlangenwe nakho okuhambisana/okuqashelwa kwezokunakekela kwezempilo emva kokubhalisa njengonesi ku SANC. Isidingo esingokwalo msebenzi: Ukuzikhethela ukusebenza ngokushintshiswa, umsebenzi wabusuku, okubandakanya amasonto, iholide zomphakathi kanye nesoledlakusebenza ngaphezu kwesikhathi. Ukuzikhethela ukusiza emawendleleni amanye esibhedlela nakumahlinzeki enkalo enkahle ezingeni elingaphansi kwesifunda uma kudingeka. Amakhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Unxibelelwano oluhle nobudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu. Ukuzethemba nokuzikhangisa. Ikhono lokusebenza ohlakeni oluhlanganayo, etahlehlakeni kwezinsiza zakho konke ukwakhiwa kolwazi oluncane ekusizakulawula ukudlulisela nokutshala izifo ukungcola nezifo ezibangele ubuhlungu ukungcola kanye nokubeka inqubo, nokukhuluma ngokukhanya ekwakheni inhlalo ekusingathweni kwesibhedlela.
zu.duties: Ukuthuthukisa nokuphepha izindaba ezisukela ekugcineni nasekuqaleni ukulandelwa kwephulo elisisisekelo mayelana nenakekelwa. Kugqamisa ngemvelo ukunakekela isilwelwe, kuncibilikiswa ekugqameni okungalungiswa emzimba. Ukuqinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okunempilo okusuka ekubuyeketheni izinsiza zezimali. Kusebenzisa izinhlelo ezinhle, ekwakhiweni kwemikhandlu elondolozekako, ukuba ngokukhanya ngokucwaningwa imikhakha ehambisana nendawo, nokuqinisekisa isithunywa esisukela esinconcolweni, ngokubandakanya nabezindaba abatholwa kubantu kubandakanya ekunakekelweni komphakathi ukusebenzisa izinhlelo zokubuyeketha imikhando eminye yezokunakekela ukuba inothile ekunakekelweni komphakathi. Ukusebenzisa ukubekwa kwesikhathi ngemikhathi ekunakekelweni kwamaphulo ukunakekelwa ekubuyeketheni iziguli. Ukuba khona ekuphepheni, ekunakekelweni komphakathi kanye nokuxhasa ekulawulweni kokutshala izifo.

xh.title: Umongikazi ongenaziqu iQela 1 ukuya kwiQela 3 (IWard yeABANTWANA)
xh.summary: Izithuba zobongikazi abangenaziqu kwiiQela 1 ukuya kwiQela 3 kwiWard yabaBantwana eOudtshoorn Hospital, efunla ubhaliso kwiSANC njengomongikazi ongenaziqu.
xh.requirements: Isiqu emfundo esingaphantsi: Isiqu esivumela ubhaliso kwiSANC njengomongikazi ongenaziqu. Ubhaliso koluntu lwezomsebenzi: Ubhaliso kwiSANC njengomongikazi ongenaziqu. Impilo yomsebenzi: IQela 1: Akukho IQela 2: Ubuncinane eminyaka eli-10 yamava afanelekileyo/eqondekeleyo kokongikwa emva kobhaliso njengomongikazi ongenaziqu kwiSANC. IQela 3: Ubuncinane eminyaka engama-20 yamava afanelekileyo/eqondekeleyo kokongikwa emva kobhaliso njengomongikazi ongenaziqu kwiSANC. Iimfuno ezipheleleyo zomsebenzi: Ukuzithanda ukusebenza ngokutshintsha-ntshafa, umsebenzi wasebusuku, kuquka iimpelaveki, iintsuku ziholide zikarhulumente nakaninzi ixesha elongeziweyo. Ukuzithanda ukuncedisa kwezinye iiward esibhedlele nakwiikliniki kwiSithili esingaphantsi xa kufuneka. Ikhono (ulwazi/amazimonti): Isazindi ngokuchanekileyo kunye nobuhlobo obuhle nomntu ongummntu. Isiyalathla-nqwena nosuku nokuzinikela. Ikhono lokusebenza kwicandelo eliqhagamshelana nezinye iinkonzo.
xh.duties: Ukuphuhliswa nokusebenzisa ipele lezokusengwa lezigulana. Ukunika isixhobo sokongikwa esilula nesoqobo. Ikhono lokuphatha ngokusebenzisa ngokufanelekileyo izixhobo nemali. Ukugcina izitifiketi zobugcisa/bomgxenyankathazo nokuziphucula. Ukuthatha amanyathelo ngokuphucula izinga lezokusengwa kokongikwa. Ukubamba iqhaza ekuthinteni iinfeksiyon nokuzilawula.

jobs.title: Laundry Supervisor (FOLDERS/IRONING)
jobs.centre: Head Office, Cape Town (Tygerberg and Lentegeur Central Laundry)
jobs.summary: Laundry Supervisor position at the Department of Health and Wellness in Cape Town, requiring Grade 9 and laundry experience.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: General education and Training Certificate (GETC) Grade 9 (Std 7). Experience: Appropriate experience in laundry and linen environment. Inherent requirement of the job: The ability to work public holidays and overtime when required. The ability to deal with diversity in culture and attitudes. Ability to work under pressure, perform physically demanding tasks and to handle heavy objects. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Good numerical skills. Knowledge of and the ability to interpret the Western Cape Government Linen Management Policy. Ability to maintain confidentiality. Knowledge and understanding of laundry and linen policies and Hygiene and Safety standards. Good communication skills.
jobs.duties: Supervision and control of the daily operations of the laundry section. Supervise and record of dispatched linen from the linen bank to the hospital wards. Supervision of laundry processing and maintenance services. Check and monitor condition of laundry machine equipment. Supervise and monitor cleaning of laundry equipment in line with environmental health and safety standards. Supervision of human and physical resources. Guide and mentor staff on the provision of laundry services. Conduct performance reviews of staff on the Staff Performance system (PERMIS). Assist with in service training of staff. Effective quality control and supervision of the laundry services. Perform pre-condemning of linen and report irregularities to the Line Manager. Implementation of infection control and waste management in the laundry unit. Ensure effective control and effective management of data/stats in the laundry unit. Ensuring high standards of cleanliness and- proper linen handling.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. ERRATUM: Kindly note that the advert for the Post 28/215: Assistant Director: Expenditure Analysis and Management Reporting, Salary R487 197 per annum, Centre: Head Office (Cape Town) advertised in the Public Service Vacancy 28 dated 07 August 2026 with Ref No: 28/215. Kindly note that the post has been cancelled. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Wasserysopsiener (VOUERS/STRYK)
af.summary: Wasserysopsienerpos by die Department of Health and Wellness in Cape Town, vereis Graad 9 en wasgoedervaring.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Algemene Onderwys- en Opleidingsertifikaat (GETC) Graad 9 (Std 7). Ervaring: Toepaslike ervaring in 'n wassery- en linne-omgewing. Inherente vereiste van die werk: Die vermoë om openbare vakansiedae en oortyd te werk wanneer vereis. Die vermoë om met diversiteit in kultuur en houdings om te gaan. Vermoë om onder druk te werk, fisies veeleisende take uit te voer en swaar voorwerpe te hanteer. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Goeie numeriese vaardighede. Kennis van en die vermoë om die Western Cape Government Linen Management Policy te interpreteer. Vermoë om vertroulikheid te handhaaf. Kennis en begrip van wassery- en linnebeleide en higiëne- en veiligheidsstandaarde. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede.
af.duties: Toesig en beheer oor die daaglikse bedrywighede van die wassery-afdeling. Toesig hou oor en registrasie van linne wat vanaf die linnebank na die hospitalafdelings gestuur word. Toesig oor wasseryverwerking en instandhoudingsdienste. Kontroleer en monitor die toestand van wasserymasjien-toerusting. Toesig hou oor en monitor die skoonmaak van wasserytoerusting in ooreenstemming met omgewingsgesondheids- en veiligheidsstandaarde. Toesig oor menslike en fisiese hulpbronne. Personeel lei en mentorskap verleen rakende die voorsiening van wasserydienste. Voer prestasiebeoordeeling van personeel uit op die Staff Performance system (PERMIS). Bystand verleen met in-diensopleiding van personeel. Effektiewe gehaltebeheer en toesig oor die wasserydienste. Voer voor-veroordeling van linne uit en rapporteer onreëlmatighede aan die lynbestuurder. Implementering van infeksiebeheer en afvalbestuur in die wassery-eenheid. Verseker effektiewe beheer en effektiewe bestuur van data/statistieke in die wassery-eenheid. Verseker hoë standaarde van netheid en behoorlike hantering van linne.

zu.title: Umphathi Wokuhlamba Izingubo (OKUBHUKUDA/UKUPEMBA)
zu.summary: Isikhundla somphathi wokuhlamba izingubo e Department of Health and Wellness e Cape Town, esidinga i Grade 9 naluhlelo lokuhlamba izingubo.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ephansi: Isitifikedi sehlelo lemfundo ejwayelekile nesokuqasha (GETC) i Grade 9 (Std 7). Luhlelo: Luhlebo oluhlelekile emkhakheni wokuhlamba izingubo nensimu zokulala. Isidingo esingokwakhekelwe emsebenzini: Ikono lokusebenza ngezikhathi zeholide zomphakathi nangaphezu kwesikhathi esihlelekile uma kudingeka. Ikono lokusebenza nabantu abehlukene ngemasiko nanangemigwaqo. Ikono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwengcindezi, ukwenza imisebenzi edinga amandla emzimba kanye nokuphatha izinto ezisindayo. Amakhono (ulwazi/iziklidi): Amandla ahle emibalabala. Ulwazi nekono lokuhumusha i Western Cape Government Linen Management Policy. Ikono lokugcina imfihlo. Ulwazi nokuqonda ngemigomo yokuhlamba izingubo nensimu zokulala kanye nezindinganiso zokuhlanzeka nokuphepha. Amakhono ahle okuxhumana.
zu.duties: Ukuqapha nokulawula imisebenzi yansuku zonke ysigaba sokuqamba izingubo. Ukuqapha nokugcina irekhodi lezinsimu zokulala ezithunyelwe esikhungweni sezinsimu zokulala ziya emagumbini esibhedlela. Ukuqapha inqubo yokuqamba izingubo kanye namasevisi okugcina. Hlola futhi uqaphe isimo sezimoto zokuqamba izingubo. Ukuqapha nokubuka ukuhlanzeka kwezimoto zokuqamba izingubo ngokulandelwa kwesimo sokuhlanzeka komphakathi nokuphepha. Ukuqapha abantu kanye nezinsiza ezingokwakho. Hola futhi ulule abasebenzi ngokuqasha amasevisi wokuqamba izingubo. Yenza okubukeka kumaphuzu abasebenzi kwisistimu yokusebenza kwabasebenzi (PERMIS). Siza nokwazisa abasebenzi ngaphakathi kwesikhathi. Ukuqapha ngempumelelo ikhwalithi kanye nokuqasha amasevisi wokuqamba izingubo. Yenza ukubuyekeza kwangaphambi kokunika ukudlula izinsimu zokulala uluze imiphumela engajwayelekile kumphathi womugqa. Ukufakwa kokulawula ukutheleleka kanye nokuphathwa kwezinq废物 kundlu yokuqamba izingubo. Qinisekisa ukulawula ngempumelelo nokuphathwa ngempumelelo kwedatha/izibalo endlini yokuqamba izingubo. Ukuqinisekisa izindinganiso eziphezulu zokuhlanzeka nokuphathwa kahle kwezinsimu zokulala.

xh.title: Mphathi wePhondo leTyumzelo (UKUFAFANZA/UKUPEYINTA)
xh.summary: Isithuba somphathi wephondo letyumzelo kwiSebe lezeMpilo nezeNtlekwakuhle eCape Town, sifuna ibanga le-9 namava kutyumzelo.
xh.requirements: Iziqu zemfundo ezingaphantsi: Isatifikethi seQeliselo lemfundo jikelele neQeqesho (GETC) Grade 9 (Std 7). Amava: Amava afanelekileyo kwimojwa yetyumzelo netyani. Iimfuno ezelwe sisithuba: Ukuba nakho ukusebenza ngeentsuku zelikhaya lamaphakathi nakuxa kufunwa amaveyili ongezelelweyo. Ukuba nakho ukupatha ubudlelwaneobuchasene nentswela-ngqondo kunye nemiqondogama. Ukuba nakho ukusebenza ngaphantsi kwengcindezelo, ukwenza imisebenzi ematasa ngokomzimba nakukuphatha izinto ezisindayo. Iikhwalithi (ulwazi/amakhono): Amakhono amanani alungileyo. Ulwazi nokuba nakho ukucekelisa iNkqubo yeNdululo koTyani karhulumwe waseWestern Cape. Ukuba nakho ukugcina iimfihlelo. Ulwile nokuqonda iinkqubo zetyumzelo netyani namazinga okoKhathuleko nezoKhuseleko. Amakhono abalulekileyo ekunxibelelaneni.
xh.duties: Ukuqonda nolawulo lweentlalo zemisebenzi yosuku kwicandelo letyumzelo. Ukuqonda nokubhala ityani elitunyelwe kwibhanki yetyani eliya kumagumbi esibhedlele. Ukuqonda ukucwangciswa kwetyumzelo nezenzo zonkeondlo. Ikhola nokujonga imeko yemishini yetyumzelo. Ukuqonda nokujonga ukucocekiswa kwezixhobo zetyumzelo ngokulandela amzinga okhuseleko loBomi bemvela. Ukuqonda kwimithombo yabantu nezinto ezibonakalayo. Ukukhokela nokulunga abasebenzi malunga nanikezelo lonkeondlo lwezinsimbi. Ukwenza iingqinamba zokusetyenziswa kwabasebenzi kwinkqubo yoQeqesho basebenzi (PERMIS). Ukuncedisa ngokulungiselela inkqubo yokusebenza kwabasebenzi. Ulawulo olusebenzayo lkhwalithi nokuqonda iinkonzo zetyumzelo. Ukwenza ukugqiba kwangaphambili kutyani nokubika into ezingaqondanga kumlawuli welayini. Ukusebenzisa ulawulo lotyhefu nolawulo ntsawulo kwiyunithi yetyumzelo. Ukuqinisekisa ulawulo olusebenzayo nokulawulo olusebenzayo lwedata/izibalo kwiyunithi yetyumzelo. Ukuqinisekisa amazinga aphezulu okucocekisa nokuphatha ngokufanelekileyo ityani.

jobs.title: Porter
jobs.summary: Porter needed at Tygerberg Hospital to transport patients, corpses and specimens, working shifts including weekends.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirement: Basic numeracy and literacy. Experience: Appropriate experience in a healthcare environment. Inherent requirement of the job: Willingness to work shifts and ability to report for duty at 6:30 (weekends included). Willingness to handle bodies (corpses). Ability to handle heavy objects. Willingness to work irregular hours as required. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Good communication skills. Ability to adhere to safety standards, infection control, prevention of cross contamination.
jobs.duties: Transport patients and corpses. Transport blood specimens from various wards to various laboratories and vice versa. Assist with loading of patients in and out of ambulances, vehicles, to & from, beds, trolleys, or wheelchairs and vice versa. Responsible for collecting and cleaning of wheelchairs, trolleys and blood hampers.
