af.title: Portier
af.summary: Portier benodig by Tygerberg Hospital vir die vervoer van pasiënte, lyke en monsters, met skofwerk wat naweke ingesluit is.
af.requirements: Minimum vereiste: Basiese syfer- en geletterdheidsvaardighede. Ervaring: Toepaslike ervaring in 'n gesondheidsorgomgewing. Inheemse vereiste van die werk: Bereidwilligheid om skofte te werk en vermoë om om 6:30 vir diens te meld (naweke ingesluit). Bereidwilligheid om lyke (lyke) te hanteer. Vermoë om swaar voorwerpe te hanteer. Bereidwilligheid om onreëlmatige ure te werk soos vereis. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Goeie kommunikasievaardighede. Vermoë om by veiligheidsstandaarde, infeksiebeheer en die voorkoming van kruisbesmetting te hou.
af.duties: Vervoer pasiënte en lyke. Vervoer bloedmonsters vanaf verskeie sale na verskeie laboratoriums en omgekeerd. Help met die laai van pasiënte in en uit ambulansse, voertuie, na en van beddens, trollies of rolstoele en omgekeerd. Verantwoordelik vir die versameling en skoonmaak van rolstoele, trollies en bloedmandjies.

zu.title: Isiphathisi
zu.summary: Kudingeka isiphathisi esibhungweni i-Tygerberg Hospital ukuthi sithuthise iziguli, izidumbu kanye nezampula, sisebenze ngokushintshanisa izikhathi okuhlanganisa namaphelmgomusi.
zu.requirements: Isidingo sokuqala: Ulwazi oluyisisekelo lokubala nokufunda. Isiphalazvo: Isiphalazvo esifanele endaweni yezempilo. Isidingo esingokwemvelo komsebenzi: Ukuzithoba ukusebenza ngokushintshanisa izikhathi nendlela yokubika emsebenzini ngo-6:30 (okuhlanganisa namaphelmgomusi). Ukuzithoba ukuphatha izidumbu. Ikhono lokuphatha izinto ezisindako. Ukuzithoba ukusebenza amahora angajwayelekile njengoba kudingeka. Ikhono (ulwazi/amaswele): Amaswele amahle okuxoxisana. Ikhono lokulandela izinga lokuphepha, okulawula ukutheleleka, nokuvikela ukutheleleka okuwela kulelo nalabo.
zu.duties: Thutha iziguli noma izidumbu. Thutha izampula zegazi ezivela kumawadihlukene ziyasekelabhuhlukene besezinkinga. Siza ngokulayisha izigulu nangaphandle kwezihlahla zeziguli, izimoto, kuya naphuma, emihlathini, ngamathrola, nangamawhulezihola abakhwamakhulu ngokuphathwa nokuhlolwa kwamawhulezi, amathrola, nezobuqotho.

xh.title: Umhambi
xh.summary: Kufunekwa umntu ongayi kuyihamba ihospitha ekuthiwa kuye Tygerberg Hospital aze ahambise abagulayo, amathambo nezinto ezithunyelwa ukuba zihlolwe, aze ahlale athatha amaxesha okusebenza, kuqala nangamaweekends.
xh.requirements: Iminfano: Ulwazi olusisiseko lwemathematics nokuqonda ukufunda nokubhala. Iintsingiselo: Imisebenzi ekahle kwakhona kwendawo yokwamkela abagulayo. Iintsingiselo ezisesikweni: Ukuzimisela ukusebenza ngokutshintsha umzila wokusebenza kwaye ukwazi ukubika emsebenzini ngo-6:30 (ntanga zakuqnelwa). Ukuzimisela ukusebenza ngamathambo (amathumbu). Ulwazi lokunyusa izinto ezinzima. Ukuzimisela ukusebenza ngeeyure ezingaqhelanga njengoko kudingeka. Iimpawu (ulwazi/amakhono): Amakhono amahle onxibelelwano. Ulwazi lokuzigcinisa ngokumthetho wokhuseleko, ukulawula ukutshatyalaliswa kwezifo, nokuqhubela phambili ukungathambathambi kokosuleleka.
xh.duties: Hambela abantu abagulayo nangamathumbu. Hambela iisampulu zegazi kwiindawo ezahlukeneyo zokwamkela abagulayo ziye kumalabhu ahlukeneyo nasaphela. Nceda ngokuqlayisha abagulayo kwaye ubakhuphe kwi-ambulensi, kwiimoto, ukuya nakuphuma, kumyede, kwiitrolley, okanye kwi-wheelchairs nasaphela. Uxanduva lokuthatha nokucoca i-wheelchairs, iitrolley kunye neebhedi ezithwala igazi.

jobs.title: General Worker: Stores
jobs.summary: Stores general worker needed at Paarl Hospital to deliver stock, assist with receiving and packing, and maintain equipment safekeeping.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirement: Basic literacy and numeracy skills. Experience: Appropriate experience in a stores/warehouse environment. Inherent requirements of the job: Incumbent must be able and strong enough to lift heavy boxes. Do filing and general assisting in other departments. Work after hours and weekends when required. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Ability to communicate effectively (verbal and written). Ability to work independently and in a team. Good interpersonal and communication skills.
jobs.duties: Deliver stock to wards, theatres, administration building and any other department. Ensure issue vouchers are returned to relevant clerk to capture and file. Assist clerk with checking, receiving, packing, unpacking, storage and issuing of stock according to standards. Safe keeping of equipment and stock (consumables and inventory) in the stores. Assist to ensure effective Stock Control procedures are maintained and enforced. Assist clerk with stock take and general duties. Keep the store neat, tidy and clean in order to comply with safety regulations. Perform other duties as assigned by the supervisor.

af.title: Algemene Werkers: Stores
af.summary: Algemene werker vir stores benodig by Paarl Hospital om voorraad te lewer, te help met ontvangs en verpakking, en om toerusting veilig te bewaar.
af.requirements: Minimum vereiste: Basiese geletterdheids- en syfervaardighede. Ervaring: Toepaslike ervaring in 'n stores/pendopslag-omgewing. Inhaerente vereistes van die werk: Die ampsebenaar moet in staat wees en sterk genoeg wees om swaar bokse te lig. Doen lêwerk en algemene hulpverlening in ander departemente. Werk buite kantoorure en naweke wanneer vereis. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Vermoë om doeltreffend te kommunikeer (mondelings en skriftelik). Vermoë om onafhanklik en in 'n span te werk. Goeie interpersoonlike en kommunikasievaardighede.
af.duties: Lewer voorraad aan sale, teaters, administrasiegebou en enige ander departement. Sorg dat uitreikbonne na die betrokke klerk teruggestuur word vir vaslegging en lêwerk. Help klerk met die nagaan, ontvangs, verpakking, uitpak, berging en uitreik van voorraad volgens standaarde. Veilige bewaring van toerusting en voorraad (verbruiksgoedere en inventaris) in die stores. Help om te verseker dat doeltreffende voorraadbeheerprosedures gehandhaaf en afgedwing word. Help klerk met voorraadopname en algemene pligte. Hou die store netjies, ordelik en skoon om aan veiligheidsregulasies te voldoen. Voer ander pligte uit soos deur die toesighouer toegewys.

zu.title: Umsebenzi Ojwayelekile: Isitolo
zu.summary: Kudingeka umsebenzi ojwayelekile wesitolo e-Paarl Hospital ukuletha impahla, ukusiza ekwamukeleni nasekupakeni, kanye nogcingo lwezimpahla.
zu.requirements: Isidingo esincane: Amakhono okufunda nokubala abalinganiselweyo. Isipiliyoni: Isipiliyoni esifanele endaweni yesitolo noma esikhundleni sezimpahla. Izidingo ezingaphakathi komsebenzi: Kumele lowo othathwa esikhundleni akwazi futhi anamandla okuphakamisa amabhokisi anesisindo. Enza ukulondoloza kwegqalo kanye nokusiza ngokujwayelekileko eminye iminyango. Ukusebenza ngemva kwalawo mahora nangamasonto njengoba kudingeka. Amakhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Ikono lokuxhumana kalula (ngomlomo nakubhalwe). Ikono lokusebenza ngabanye nangenani iqembu. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana nabantu nokuvela kolwazi.
zu.duties: Letha impahla kumawadi, kumabhishi, esakhiweni sobuhalazi nako kunoma imuphi umnyango. Qiniseka ukuthi ama-vawusha okukhiqiza abuyiselwa kumkhiqizi ofanele ukuba abhale aze alondoloze. Siza umkhiqizi ngokuqinisa, ukwamukela, ukupaka, ukuphakamisa, ukulondoloza nokuqashwa kwempahla njengoba kumisiwe. Ukugcina kusibopho izimpahla nokulondoloza ezimpahleni (okusetshenziswa nokuqhathaniswa) esitolo. Siza ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinqubo eziyinhloko Zokulawula Izitolo zigcinwa futhi zisetshenziswa ngokwezimiso. Siza umkhiqizi ngesibalo esiphelele kanye nemisebenzi yonke. Gcina isitolo sicocekile sicebe nokuhlanzekile ukuze kuhambisana nemithetho yokuvikela. Yenza omunye umsebenzi njengoba omlawuli abekile.

xh.title: Umsebenzi oZigugu: Izitolo
xh.summary: Kufuneka umsebenzi ozigugu wesitolo ePaarl Hospital ukuya kuletha izinto, ukunceda ekwamkeleni nasekugqumeni, nasekulondolozeni izixhobo ngokhuseleko.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingaphantsi kwesigqibo: Amafom athambile okuqonda nokubala. Esiphiwo: Esiphiwo esifanelekileyo kwendawo yesitolo/indlu yokugcina izinto. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi zomsebenzi: Umntu othatywe lomsebenzi kufuneka akwazi ukuziphatha kwaye enamandla okusingatha iibokisi ezisindayo. Yenza uluhlu lweefayile kwaye uze uncede ngokubanzi kumanye amasebe. Sebenza emva kwamaxesha okusebenza nangamaveiki xa kufuneka. Iindlela zokwenza umsebenzi (ulwazi/amakhono): Ukuba nakho ukunxibelelana kakuhle (ngokuthetha nangokubhala). Ukuba nakho ukusebenza ngokwakho nakwinqanaba lenqela. Amakhono amahle okunxibelelana nabantu nokuqhathanisa ulwazi.
xh.duties: Lahla izitoku kwawonke amagumbi, kwindlu yokuqhuba iimveliso, kwakwelakhiwo lolawulo nakulo nayiphi na enye isebe. Qinisekisa ukuba amaqebuza okuphefumla abuyiswa kumgcini wezincwadi ezifanelekileyo ukuze awabhale ezincwadini kwaye awafake kwindawo egcinwe kuyo iincwadi ezifunwayo. Nceda umgcini wezincwadi ekuqwalaseleni, ekuqwalaselweni, ekugqumeni, ekuvuleni iibokisi, egcineni nasekunikeni izitoku ngokwemigaqo yokwenza umsebenzi. Gcina ngokhuseleko izixhobo nezitoku (ezisetyenziswa nasezingenanto) ezisitolo. Nceda ukuqinisekisa ukuba iinkqubo zokuLawula izitoku zisebenza ngokufanelekileyo kwaye ziyagcinwa. Nceda umgcini wezincwadi ekubaleni izitoku nakumsebenzi ngokubanzi. Hlala ugcina isitolo ngendlela elungileyo, licoce kwaye licoce ukuze uhambelane nemiqathango yokhuseleko. Yenza omnye umsebenzi njengoko umiselwe ngumlawuli wakho.

jobs.title: Household AID
jobs.summary: Household aid needed at Radie Kotze Hospital to provide cleaning, waste and linen management services, with shift and weekend work required.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirement: Basic literacy and numeracy. Experience: Appropriate cleaning experience in a hospital environment. Inherent requirements of the job: Willingness to work overtime, shifts including night shift, weekends and on public holidays. Willingness to handle buff machine, etc. Ability to handle heavy objects. Willingness to work in a team and rotate around the hospital. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Good interpersonal skills. Good verbal, as well as written communication skills. Appropriate knowledge with the use of the cleaning equipment, cleaning materials and cleaning detergents and stock.
jobs.duties: Deliver an effective, efficient and safe hygiene and domestic services in a hospital environment. Contribute to effective management of domestic responsibilities. Effective and efficient Waste Management. Participates in linen management. Contributes to effective utilization and functioning of consumables, apparatus and equipment. Renders optimal support service to Household supervisor.

Kindly note that the post has been cancelled. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Huishoudelike hulp
af.summary: Huishoudelike hulp benodig by Radie Kotze Hospital om skoonmaak-, afval- en linnebestuursdienste te verskaf, met skof- en naweekwerk vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum vereiste: Basiese geletterdheid en syferkundigheid. Ervaring: Toepaslike skoonmaakervaring in 'n hospitaalomgewing. inherente vereistes van die werk: Bereidwilligheid om oortyd te werk, skofte insluitend nag skof, naweke en openbare vakansiedae. Bereidwilligheid om buffmasjien te hanteer, ens. Vermoë om swaar voorwerpe te hanteer. Bereidwilligheid om in 'n span te werk en in die hospitaal te roteer. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Goeie interpersoonlike vaardighede. Goeie verbale, asook skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Toepaslike kennis met die gebruik van skoonmaaktoerusting, skoonmaakmateriaal en skoonmaakmiddels en voorraad.
af.duties: Lewer 'n effektiewe, doeltreffende en veilige higiëne- en huishoudelike dienste in 'n hospitaalomgewing. Dra by tot effektiewe bestuur van huishoudelike verantwoordelikhede. Effektiewe en doeltreffende afvalbestuur. Neem deel aan linnebestuur. Dra by tot effektiewe benutting en funksionering van verbruiksgoedere, apparaat en toerusting. Lewer optimale ondersteuningsdiens aan huishoudelike toesighouer.

zu.title: umsizi wekhaya
zu.summary: Kudingeka umsizi wekhaya e-Radie Kotze Hospital ukunikeza izinsiza zokuhlanzwa, ukuphathwa kwezinkohlak nezempahla ezincwadiwe, okuphathelene nokusebenza ngokuguqulwa kwebanga kanye nasemgqibelo.
zu.requirements: Isidingo esiphansi: Ukubhalahlaza nokubala okuyisisekelo. Isiphefundo: Isiphefundo esifanele sokuhlanza endaweni yasesibhedlela. Izidingo ezidalwa umsebenzi: Ukuzithoba ukusebenza ngaphezulu kwesikhathi, ukuguqulwa kwezinga kuhlanganise isikhathi esabusuku, amavgcwebo nasemihlanganweni yomphakathi. Ukuzithoba ukuphatha imishini yokubhada, njll. Ikhono lokuphatha izinto ezisindayo. Ukuzithoba ukusebenza eqenjini futhi uguqulele ezindaweni ezahlukene zesibhedlela. Izindlebe (ulwazi/izikhali): Ikhono elihle lokuxhumana nabantu. Ikhono elihle lokukhuluma, kanye nokubhali kwemilayezo. Ulwazi olufanele ngokusetshenziswa kwemishini yokuhlanza, izinto zokuhlanza futhi izipesheli zokuhlanza nemibhalo.
zu.duties: Nikeza insiza ezokusiza, ehlelekile kakhulu nezokuphepha kwezinga lobuhle ezindaweni zokuhlala ezesibhedlela. Singenele ekuphathweni okusiza kwezibhekele zokuhlala. Ukuphathwa kwezinsiza ezokusiza kwezinkohlak. Ehlanganyela ekuphathweni kwempahla encwadiwe. Siza ekusetshenzisweni okusiza kanye nokusebenza kwezinto ezibhalisayo, izilekeleli nemishini. Nikeza insiza eyisisekelo ebalulekile kumlawuli wekhaya.

xh.title: Umntu oNcedisayo eKhaya
xh.summary: Kufuneka umntu oncedisayo ekhaya eRadie Kotze Hospital ukunika iinkonzo zokucofa indlu, ukulawula imfuculo nezicwangciso zamaphaphu, ngenkathi kusebenza ngokutshintshana kwaye kusetyenzwa iiveki zokuqhuba.
xh.requirements: Isiqu esingaphantsi: Ulwazi olusisiseko lokufunda nokubala. Isiphiwo: Isiphiwo esifanelekileyo sokucoca endaweni yesibhedlele. Iimfuno ezizalithiyo zomsebenzi: Ukuzithanda ukusebenza ngaphezu kwexesha, iishifti eziquka ishifti yasebusuku, iiveki zokuphela nangemihla yamaphumo. Ukuzithanda ukuphatha imishini yokucofa, njl. Ukuba nesakhono sokuphatha izinto ezisindayo. Ukuzithanda ukusebenza kwiqela nokujikeleza esibhedlele. Iimfuno (ulwazi/isakhono): Isakhono esihle sokwenzelana nabantu. Isakhono esihle sokuthetha, nakwisakhono sokubhala. Ulwazi olufanelekileyo malunga nokusebenzisa imishini yokucoca, izinto zokucoca nama-detergent okucoca kunye nemitsha.
xh.duties: Ukunikela ngenkonzo ehle, esebenzayo nekhuselayo yokucoca nokucofela indlu endaweni yesibhedlele. Ukwenza isigqibo sokulawula ngokufanelekileyo iimviswano zokucoca. Ukulawula imfuculo ngokusebenzayo nangempumelelo. Ukuthatha inxaxheba ekulawulweni kwamaphaphu. Ukufaka isandla ekusebenziseni nasekusebenzeni okusebenzayo okutyalwayo, izixhobo nangemishini. Ukunika inkonzo yokuxhasa egqithisileyo kumlawuli wekhaya.

jobs.title: Cleaner
jobs.centre: Bothasig CDC (X1 Post) Elsies River CHC (X1 Post)
jobs.summary: Cleaner positions at Western Cape health facilities in Bothasig and Elsies River requiring basic literacy and cleaning experience, with 12-hour shift work.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirement: Basic reading and writing skills. Experience: Appropriate cleaning experience in a Health Facility. af.title: Skoonmaker
af.summary: Skoonmakerposte by Western Cape gesondheidsfasiliteite in Bothasig en Elsies River wat basiese geletterdheid en skoonmaakervaring vereis, met 12-uur skofwerk.
af.requirements: Minimum vereiste: Basiese lees- en skryfvaardighede. Ervaring: Toepaslike skoonmaakervaring in 'n gesondheidsfasiliteit. Inherente vereistes van die werk: Bereidwilligheid om 12-uur skofte en buite-ure (nagdienst, naweke en openbare vakansiedae) te werk. Bereidwilligheid om kort kennisgewing oortyd te werk wanneer vereis. Vermoë om fisiese take uit te voer bv. gebruik van skoonmaaktoerusting ens. Bereidwilligheid om in die geografiese PHC-fasiliteite binne die Northern/Tygerberg Sub-Struktuur te werk wanneer operasioneel vereis. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Goeie interpersoonlike vaardighede. Toepaslike kennis rakende die gebruik van skoonmaaktoerusting en skoonmaakmateriaal.
af.duties: Verskaf 'n skoon en higiëniese omgewing om die verspreiding van infeksie te voorkom. Algemene skoonmaak en onderhoud (afstof, vee, stofsuig, polering, skrobb en mop). Doeltreffende gebruik van skoonmaakmateriaal en -toerusting. Verseker dat skoonmaaktoerusting na gebruik skoon gemaak en veilig gestoor word. Doeltreffende gebruik van skoonmaakmiddels en voorraad asook elementêre voorraadbeheer. Verantwoordelik vir algemene higiëne en 'n veilige omgewing volgens standaarde en prosedures. Optimale ondersteuning aan toesighouer en kollegas.

zu.title: Umenshi
zu.summary: Izikhundla zabamenshi ezindaweni zezempilo eWestern Cape eBothasig naseElsies River ezidinga ukwazi ukufunda nokubhala kanye nohlobo lokumensa, okusebenza ngamashifu awamahora angu-12.
zu.requirements: Isidingo esingaphansi: Amakhono okubhala nokufunda ngokuyisisekelo. Isipiliyoni: Isipiliyoni esifanele somensi endaweni yezempilo. Izidingo ezingaphakathi komsebenzi: Ukuzithoba ekusebenzeni amashifu awamahora angu-12 nangemva kwamahora okuvamile (ukusebenza ebusuku, ngezikwere nangamaholide asemphakathi). Ukuzithoba ekusebenzenini ihora elengeziwe ngosuku olufushane lapho kudingeka khona. Ikhono lokwenza imisebenzi edinga amandla emzimbeni njengokusebenzisa izinsiza zokumensa nokunye. Ukuzithoba ekusebenzeni ezindaweni ze-PHC eNtacenti/Tygerberg Sub-Structure lapho kudingwa ngokwezomsebenzi. Amakhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Amakhono ahle abantu. Ulwazi olufanele ngokusebenzisa izinsiza zokumensa kanye nematiriyeli okumensa.
zu.duties: Hlinzeka ngenkundla ehlanzekile nenhle ngokwemfuyo ukuze kwenziwe ukuthi kungaluletbeki ukutheleleka. Ukumensa okuvamile kanye nokugcinwa kwendawo (ukusula uthuli, ukushaqa, ukugcwala ngesidlule, ukwenza kunkunkumba, ukushaba, ukugeza ngamabhuloshi nokuhlamba ngamopu). Ukusebenzisisa kahle imatiriyeli nezinsiza zokumensa. Qinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza zokumensa zihlanzekile ngemva kokusebenzisa futhi zigcinwe ngokuphepha. Ukusebenzisisa kahle ama-agents wokumensa kanye nesitokwe kanye nolawulo lwesitokwe ngokuyisisekelo. Ubumyakelele ngenhlanzekile na kohlelo olupephile ngokusho kwezilinganiso kanye nokuqondiswa kwezomsebenzi. Ukusekela ngokugcwele umphathi nabasebenzi bake.

xh.title: Umcoci
xh.summary: Izithuba zokucoca ezisezigeni ezizezempilo kwi-Western Cape e-Bothasig nase-Elsies River ezifuna ulwazi olusentlalweni lokufunda nokubhala namava okucoca, nomsebenzi weeshift zamanze e-12.
xh.requirements: Isimfuno esincinci: Amakhono abhalwe ngokwesiseko ngokufunda nokubhala. Amava: Amava afanelekileyo okucoca kwiSiseko sezeMpilo. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi komsebenzi: Ukuzithoba ukusebenza iishift zamanze e-12 nangemva yeeyure (umsebenzi wasebusuku, iintsuku zekendi namaphuma ahlonitshwayo). Ukuzithoba ukusebenza ixesha elongeziweyo ngenotulo elifutshane xa kufuneka. Amandla okwenza imisebenzi emzimba umzekelo ukusetyenziswa kwezixhobo zokucoca njl. Ukuzithoba ukusebenza kwiigeni ze-PHC ebandakanya i-Northern/Tygerberg Sub-Structure xa kufuneka ngokusebenzayo. Iimpawu zokwazi (ulwazi/amakhono): Amakhono amabalwe kakuhle nabantu. Ulwazi olufanelekileyo ngokusetyenziswa kwezixhobo zokucoca nezinto zokucoca.
xh.duties: Kubonelele ngemvelo ecocekileyo nangcono yokuziphatha ukuthintela ukusasazeka kokutshatyalaliswa. Ukucoca ngokubanzi nokuqhuba (ukucima umthunzi, ukuqhatha, ukutyhaza, ukucwina, ukushoba nokuqhaqha). Ukusetyenziswa kakuhle kwezinto nezixhobo zokucoca. Qinisekisa ukuba izixhobo zokucoca zicocekile emva kokusetyenziswa zigcinwe ngokukhuselekileyo. Ukusetyenziswa kakuhle kwezichazi zokucoca nesitokhwe njengoko nokulawula isitokhwe ngokwesiseko. Uxanduva loyilo olubanzi nemvelo ekhuselekileyo ngokwemigaqo nakuqeqesho. Inkxaso efanelekileyo kumlawuli nakwabanye abasebenzi.

Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar se toepaslike ervaring as Mediese Spesialis in Interne Geneeskunde, na registrasie by die HPCSA (of 'n erkende buitelandse Health Professional Council ten opsigte van 'n buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemer). Inherente vereistes van die werk: Geldige bestuurslisensie en bereidwilligheid om te reis. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Kliniese ervaring in Interne Geneeskunde met bevoegdheid in egokardiografie. Vermoë om hoë gehalte kliniese sorg in die in- en buitepasient-omgewing te lewer, insluitend uitstekende mediese rekordhouding. Vermoë om die uitsette van 'n groot kliniese werklading te balanseer met die onderrig- en toesigvereistes van die pos. zu.title: Isikhundla Sokwelapha Esigaba 1 kuya ku-3 (INTERNAL Medicine) (20
zu.summary: Kufunwa i-Medical Specialist ku-Internal Medicine ye-Karl Bremer Hospital e-Western Cape ukuze inikeze izinkonzo zokwelapha ezisemqoka kuzigodla, kubaningi abaphathekayo nasesikhungweni sezimo eziphuthumayo.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ezingaphansi kwesilinganiso: Ithifikheti elifanele elivumela ukubhalisa ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa njengoba ngu-Medical Specialist ku-Internal Medicine. Ukubhalisa enkundleni yabaphathi: Ukubhalisa ku-Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengoba ngu-Medical Specialist ku-Internal Medicine. Isipiliyoni: Isigaba 1: Akukho okudingekile ngemuva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengoba ngu-Medical Specialist ku-Internal Medicine. Isigaba 2: Okungenani iminyaka eyi-5 yesipiliyoni esifanele njengoba ngu-Medical Specialist ku-Internal Medicine, ngemuva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA (noma enkundleni yabaphathi bezempilo yamanye amazanga evunyiwe mayelana nesisebenzi sikazwelonke). Isigaba 3: Okungenani iminyaka eyi-10 yesipiliyoni esifanele njengoba ngu-Medical Specialist ku-Internal Medicine, ngemuva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA (noma enkundleni yabaphathi bezempilo yamanye amazanga evunyiwe mayelana nesisebenzi sikazwelonke). Izidingo ezingaphakathi zomsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile nokulungele ukuhamba. Amakhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Isipiliyoni sokwelapha ku-Internal Medicine ngolwazi lokusebenza nge-echocardiography. Ikono lokunikeza ukunakekelwa okwelinganiselo eliphezulu kubaphathi abasogodlweni nangesikhathi sokuhamba, okuhlanganisa ukugcina imibhalu yokwelapha ngokuphelele. Ikono lokulinganisa imiphumela yomsebenzi omningi wokwelapha nezidingo zokufundisa nokuhlola esikhundleni. Ukuba nobuchule bokusebenza ngokwemishini, ukuba namakhono amakhulu okuphatha, okulawula, okuxhumana nokuxazulula izinkinga.
zu.duties: Ukunikezwa kwesevisi yokwelapha esigabeni somchweshi kulo lonke iqoqo lezenkonzo ze-Internal Medicine, okuhlanganisa izigodla, abaphathi bangesikhathi, isikhungu sezimo eziphuthumayo namakiliniki akhethekile. I-Administrative & clinical governance okuhlanganisa ukuphathwa kwe-OPD, ukugcina imibhalu yezokwelapha, ukuhlaziya idatha, ukuthuthukiswa kwekhwalithi nokuphathwa kweqembu. Ukufundisa, ukuqeqesha nokuhlola abasebenzi baphakathi bezokwelapha nabafundi ngokubamba iqhaza ohlelweni lwezemfundo lesibhedlela. Imiphumela ekhethekile yendawo nokubamba iqhaza ngaphakathi kwesimo se-Metro East, okuhlanganisa ukuqondana nazo zonke izici ze-Internal / General Medicine esigabeni sesibhedlela somphakathi – kokubili ngaphakathi kwesibhedlela nangesimweni se-Metro East.

IGrade 3: Iminyaka engu-10 esincinci yesiphiro esifanelekileyo njenge-Medical Specialist kwiMedicine yangaphakathi, emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA (okanye kunqwanunyu wamazwe ngamazwe weHealth Professional ongaziwa ngokumalunga nomsebenzisi oqeqeshiweyo kwamanye amazwe). Iimfuno zomsebenzi ngokwemvelo: Ilayisensi yokuqeshela efanelekileyo nolungelelaniso lokuhamba. Amandla okulinganisa okuphumayo komsebenzi omkhulu we-clinical neemfuno zokufundisa nokuqeqesha kwesithuba. Ukuba nobuchwepheshe bekhompyutha, ukuba nolawulo, olubhekisa kumsebenzi, uluntu nokusombulula iingxabano ezomelezileyo.
xh.duties: Ukunika inkonzo kwindawo yabakhedini ngokwemilinganiselo yespecialist kuyo yonke imida yeMedicine yangaphakathi, kuquka amagumbi, abanjwayo, iziko longxwangu neeklinikhi ezikhethekileyo. Ulawulo nokulawula i-clinical kuquka nokulawula i-OPD, ukugcina iirekhodi zokhathaleko, ukuhlaziya idatha, ukuphucula ulwakhiwo loluntu nolawulo lwesixhobo. Ukufundisa, ukuqeqesha nokuqeqesha oorhwebo abasezantsi bemiziyo kubafundi ngokuthatha inxaxheba kwinkqubo yokufunda yamagumbi okhathaleko. Okukhoyo ngokwemida yomsebenzi nokuthatha inxaxheba kwindawo yokuhlala kweMetro East, kuquka nokuqwalasela yonke imiba yeMedice yangaphakathi / yoMbindi kwamagumbi okhathaleko – kokubha okungaphakathi kwamagumbi nakwindawo yokuhlala kweMetro East.

Lewering van kliniese dienslewering op spesialisvlak van keuse-Ortopediese Chirurgie (distrikvlak). Deelname aan toepaslike uitreikprogramme. Toesig oor kliniese en operatiewe aktiwiteite van ortopediese chirurge-in-opleiding. Aktiewe deelname aan die nagraadse en voorgraadse onderrigprogramme van die Departement. Effektiewe bestuur en administrasie van 'n wye reeks "Portefeuljes" en die ontwikkel, uitvoer en toesig hou van navorsingsprojekte. Opleiding en Onderrig van mediese beamptes en ortopediese registrateurs en tersaaklike las van siekte-navorsing en Oudite.

zu.title: Ithisha Lezokwelapha Elingokoqobo Izinga 1 kuya Ku-3 (I-ORTHOPAEDICS) (I-SESSIONAL) (5
zu.summary: Kudingeka ithisha lezokwelapha elingokoqobo ngasesikhungweni samaseshini ku-orthopaedics e-New Somerset Hospital, e-Western Cape, ukunikeza izinsizakusebenzo zokwelapha ezisemthethweni zomonzomzimba kanye nezomzimba eziphuthumayo.
zu.requirements: Izindingo zemininingwane yemfundo: Ithuba lemfuno elifanele elivumela ukubhalisa ku-Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengenthisha lezokwelapha elingokoqobo ku-Orthopaedics. Ukubhalisa komkhandlu wezobungcweti: Ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengenthisha lezokwelapha elingokoqobo ku-Orthopaedics. Isipiliyoni: Izinga 1: Akukho okudingekile emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengenthisha lezokwelapha elingokoqobo ku-Orthopaedics. Izinga 2: Okuncane kweminyaka eyi-5 yisipiliyoni esifanele njengenthisha lezokwelapha elingokoqobo emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA (noma komkhandlu wezokwelapha wamazwe ngaphandle ovunyelwe mayelana nomsebenzi oqashwe kunoma yiliphi ilungu elithole iziqu emazweni angaphandle) njengenthisha lezokwelapha elingokoqobo ku-Orthopaedics. Izinga 3: Okuncane kweminyaka eyi-10 yisipiliyoni esifanele njengenthisha lezokwelapha elingokoqobo emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA (noma komkhandlu wezokwelapha wamazwe ngaphandle ovunyelwe mayelana nomsebenzi oqashwe kunoma yiliphi ilungu elithole iziqu emazweni angaphandle) njengenthisha lezokwelapha elingokoqobo ku-Orthopaedics. Izidingo ezibangelwa umsebenzi: Ilayisense yokushayela esevumelekile. Ukuzithoba ekwenzeni amafoni ngemva kwezinsuku zokusebenza uma kudingeka. Izikhono (ulwazi/iziqombulula): Ukukwazi ukubamba iqhaza ngempumelelo kusebenzo olubusy kakhulu lwe-orthopaedics emazingeni esifunda. Izimiso zokuziphatha ezinamandla kanye nolwazi oluhlobene nezokwelapha nezobuhlakaniphila nokweluleka. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha. Iziqu bokubusa, zabantu nabahlele. Ulwazi lobuchwepheshe nezikhono emkhakheni we-Trauma kanye ne-Emergency Orthopaedic Surgery kanye ne-orthopaedics ekhethekile emazingeni esifunda. Isipiliyoni esifanele esihlobene ne-orthopaedics njengenthisha lezokwelapha elingokoqobo. Isipiliyoni esifanele kumonzomzimba kanye nochocochopho oluphuthumayo lwe-orthopaedics njengesinja esiyinhloko. Isipiliyoni esifanele ku-hip arthroplasty njengesinja esiyinhloko emazingeni esifunda.
zu.duties: Inikeza isisebenzo sezokwelapha esisemthethweni emazingeni abuchwepheshe kuso sonke isibalo se-General Orthopaedic Surgery. Iphuzu elikhulu lokwenzela okuzobe ukuba yimonzomzimba kanye ne-orthopaedics ephuthumayo emazingeni esifunda. Imonzomzimba kanye namafoni we-orthopaedics ngemva kwezinsuku zokusebenza ezibhedlela ezisesigabeni njengoba kushiwo umqashi. Inikeza isisebenzo sezokwelapha esisemthethweni emazingeni abuchwepheshe se-Elective Orthopaedic Surgery (izinga lesifunda). Ukubamba iqhaza kuhlelo lokufikelela oluhlelekileyo. Ukuqapha izikhundla zokwelapha nangokwenza ukubuyelela izinkinga ezigula ngokuhlinzwa kubahlinzi be-orthopaedics-abafundela ukuba ngabo. Ukubamba iqhaza okusebenzayo kuhlelo lokufundisa labafundi abaphakathi nabasemva kwabaphakathi lomnyango. Ukuqhuba okusebenzayo nokuphatha nokubuyekeza isibalo esibanzi se-“Portfolios” futhi wakhe, uqhube futhi uqaphe izindlu zocwaningo. Ukuqeqesha nokufundisa abahlinzi baphezulu kanye nabaqaphi be-orthopaedics kanye nocwaningo mayelana neziguli ezingamangingo zokuqhuba futhi kwenziwe izivivinyo.

xh.title: Igcisa lezamayeza esigaba se-1 ukuya kwi-3 (I-ORTHOPAEDICS) (I-SESSIONAL) (5
xh.summary: Kufuneka igcisa lezamayeza leseshoni kwizifo zezamathambo kwiNew Somerset Hospital, eWestern Cape, linika iinkonzo zezamathambo zohlolo lokuzonda kwaye eziphuthumayo.
xh.requirements: Izinga lokugqiba imfundo: Isigqibo esifanelekileyo esivumela ukubhalisa kwiHealth Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengogcisa wezamayeza kwezamathambo. Ukubhalisa kunombutho wemisebenzi: Ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengogcisa wezamayeza kwezamathambo. Ulwazi: Isigaba se-1: Akukho nto emva kokuqwalaselwa kwi-HPCSA njengogcisa wezamayeza kwezamathambo. Isigaba se-2: Amava amaminitha we-5 okungeniso kwizigaba ezingathathi hlangothi njengogcisa wezamayeza emva kokuqwalaselwa kwi-HPCSA (okanye kwiqumrhu elamkelekileyo lezempilo lezamanye amazwe ngokomsebenzi oqwalaselwe kwamanye amazwe) njengogcisa wezamayeza kwezamathambo. Isigaba se-3: Amava amaminitha we-10 okungeniso kwizigaba ezingathathi hlangothi njengogcisa wezamayeza emva kokuqwalaselwa kwi-HPCSA (okanye kwiqumrhu elamkelekileyo lezempilo lezamanye amazwe ngokumsebenzi oqwalaselwe kwamanye amazwe) njengogcisa wezamayeza kwezamathambo. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi zomsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokushayela eseleyo. Ukulungelelanisa ukwenza amacala emva kweyure xa kuyimfuneko. Ikhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Ukuba nakho ukuthatha inxaxheba ngempumelelo kkonzo ebusiselekileyo kakhulu yezamathambo kwinqanaba lesithili. Iimp VISIo eqinileyo nolwazi olubalulekileyo lokwelapha nokuqonda nzincdinane. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amakhono okukhokela, okubonisana nabantu nokuhlela. Ulwazi nemakhono ezinga eliphezulu kwinkundla yohlolo lokuzonda ukwenza uqhweshezelo kwiSurgery kwi-Trauma and Emergency Orthopaedic Surgery kwaye nokhetho lwezamathambo kwinqanaba lesithili. Amavo akheyo kakhulu nawafanelekileyo kwezamathambo njengogcisa wezamayeza. Amavo akheyo ekqalatheni ukwenza i-surgery yohlolo lokuzonda okanye yesiphithiphuthu njengomqambi webhodi. Amavo akheyo ekwenzeni i-hip arthroplasty njengomqambi webhodi kwinqanaba lesithili.
xh.duties: Ukuqokelelwa kweenkonzo zokwelapha kwisigaba sesigcisa kulo lonke uhlu loqhweshezelo olubalulekileyo. Iqhosa elingundoqo kuye kuba luhlolo lokuzonda ukwenza i-surgery kwezamathambo eziphuthumayo kwinqanaba lesithili. Amacala wezamathambo nangemva kweeyure kwiibhedi zamashishini kummandla njengoko kuchaziwe ngumqeshi. Inkonzo ekwelapheni kwisigaba sesigcisa esikhethekileyo kokuqhweshezelwa iSurgery kubakho khetho (kwinqanaba lesithili). Ukuthatha inxaxheba kumacandelo alungele ukwandisa ulwazi. Ukulawula imisebenzi yokwelapha nokwenza i-surgery kwezamathambo kwiqela lezamathambo abasebenza ngamaxesha athile. Ukuthatha inxaxheba ngokuzimisela kumacandelo okufundisa kwabangesemva kwesidanga esihle kwaye kwabangaphambi kwesidanga esihle. Ukuqhuba ngokusebenziseka nokulawula ukulawula izinto ngokwentshukumbo yeenkonzo "Portfolios" kwaye uqambe, wenze kwaye ulawule amacandelo ophononongo. Ukufundisa nokufundisa abagcisa bezamayeza abanjini baye bagcise i-orthopaedic kwaye abafundi abayibekiyo nabaphengululeyo kwiResearch and Audits ngokwezinga lezifo eziphathwayo.

jobs.title: Medical Specialist Grade 1 to 3 (PAEDIATRICS and Child
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R671 per hour Grade 2: R766 per hour Grade 3: R887 per hour
jobs.summary: Medical Specialist in Paediatrics and Child Health sought for Karl Bremer Hospital in the Western Cape, requiring HPCSA registration as a Medical Specialist.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa as Medical Specialist in Paediatrics. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Medical Specialist in Paediatrics. Experience: Grade 1: None after registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Specialist in Paediatrics. Grade 2: A minimum of 5 years’ appropriate experience as Medical Specialist in Paecdiatrics, after registration with the HPCSA (or a recognized foreign Health Professional Council in respect of a foreign qualified employee). Grade 3: A minimum of 10 years’ appropriate experience as Medical Specialist in Paediatrics, after registration with the HPCSA (or a recognized foreign Health Professional Council in respect of a foreign qualified employee). Inherent requirements of the job: Valid driver’s licence. Willingness to travel. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Ability to render high quality clinical care in the in- and out-patient setting, including excellent medical record keeping. Ability to balance the outputs of a large clinical workload with the teaching and supervisory requirements of the position. Be computer literate, have strong administrative, managerial, communication and conflict resolution skills.
jobs.duties: Clinical service delivery at specialist level across the full spectrum of Paediatrics / Child Health services, focused on OPD & specialised clinics but including wards and emergency centre. Administrative & clinical governance including oversight and management in OPD, medical record keeping, data analysis, quality improvement and equipment management. Teaching, training and supervision of junior medical staff and students with participation in the hospital academic program. Domain specific outputs and participation within the Metro East ecosystem, including promotion of child health and alignment with all aspects of district-level Child Health – within the hospital and the Metro East ecosystem.
jobs.enquiries: Dr S le Roux Tel No: (021) 918-1990
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration with their relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable to health professionals who apply for the first time for registration in a specific category with the relevant council (including individuals who must apply for change in registration status). It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Kindly note that the post has been cancelled. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Mediese Spesialis Graad 1 tot 3 (PEDIATRIE en Kind
af.summary: Mediese Spesialis in Pediatrie en Kindergesondheid gesoek vir Karl Bremer Hospital in die Western Cape, wat HPCSA-registrasie as 'n Mediese Spesialis vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa as Mediese Spesialis in Pediatrie moontlik maak. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Pediatrie. Ervaring: Graad 1: Geen na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Pediatrie. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se toepaslike ervaring as Mediese Spesialis in Pediatrie, na registrasie by die HPCSA (of 'n erkende buitelandse Health Professional Council ten opsigte van 'n buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemer). Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar se toepaslike ervaring as Mediese Spesialis in Pediatrie, na registrasie by die HPCSA (of 'n erkende buitelandse Health Professional Council ten opsigte van 'n buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemer). Inherente vereistes van die werk: Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Bereidwilligheid om te reis. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Vermoë om hoë gehalte kliniese sorg in die in- en buitepasiëntomgewing te lewer, insluitend uitstekende mediese rekordhouding. Vermoë om die uitsette van 'n groot kliniese werklading te balanseer met die onderrig- en toesigvereistes van die pos. Wees rekenaarvaardig, besit sterk administratiewe, bestuurlike, kommunikasie- en konflikoplossingsvaardighede.
af.duties: Kliniese dienslewering op spesialisvlak oor die volle spektrum van Pediatrie / Kindergesondheidsdienste, gefokus OPD & gespesialiseerde klinieke maar insluitend saale en noodsentrum. Administratiewe & kliniese bestuur insluitend toesig en bestuur in OPD, mediese rekordhouding, data-ontleding, gehalteverbetering en toerustingbestuur. Onderrig, opleiding en toesig van junior mediese personeel en studente met deelname aan die hospitaal se akademiese program. Domein-spesifieke uitsette en deelname binne die Metro East-ekosisteem, insluitend die bevordering van kindergesondheid en belyning met alle aspekte van distrikvlak-Kindergesondheid – binne die hospitaal en die Metro East-ekosisteem.

zu.title: Ithisha Elikhulu Lemitsi Elinga 1 kuye Ku-3 (I-PAEDIATRICS Nempi
zu.summary: Kufunwa Ithisha Elikhulu Lemitsi ku-PAEDIATRICS nase Empilweni Yabantwana e-Karl Bremer Hospital e-Western Cape, kudingeka ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengoThisha Elikhulu Lemitsi.
zu.requirements: Isidingo semfundo esincane: Ithifikheyiti elifanele elivumela ukubhalisa ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa njengoThisha Elikhulu Lemitsi kwi-PAEDIATRICS. Ukubhalisa kubhalwe lomkhandlu wezempilo: Ukubhalisa ku-Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengoThisha Elikhulu Lemitsi kwi-PAEDIATRICS. Isipiliyoni: Izinga 1: Akukho okudingekile emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengoThisha Elikhulu Lemitsi kwi-PAEDIATRICS. Izinga 2: Isilinganiso esincane seminyaka eyi-5 yesipiliyoni esifanele njengoThisha Elikhulu Lemitsi kwi-PAEDIATRICS, emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA (noma kumkhandlu wezempivo ochazwe wesinye isizwe ngokuqondisa nomuntu othunyelwe wayo evela kwezinye izwe). Izinga 3: Isilinganiso esincane seminyaka eyi-10 yesipiliyoni esifanele njengoThisha Elikhulu Lemitsi kwi-PAEDIATRICS, emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA (noma kumkhandlu wezempivo ochazwe wesinye isizwe ngokuqondisa nomuntu othunyelwe wayo evela kwezinye izwe). Izidingo ezingokwemisebenzi: Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ukuzikhululela ukuhamba. Amakhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Ikhono lokunika ukunakekelwa okuphezulu ngesikhathi esiphezulu kwabagula bahlala isibhedlela noma baphuma, okuhlanganisa ukuphatha umbhalo wezempilo ngendlela ehle. Ikhono lokulinganisa imisebenzi eningi yokunakekela abagula nezidingo zokufundisa nokubeka abafundi isikhundla salesi sikhundla. Ukuba nokwazi ngokusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ukuba namakhono aphakeme okuphatha, okwenza izinto, okuxoxa nokuxazulula izinkinga.
zu.duties: Ukunika inkonzo yezempilo esibhedlela ngesikhundla seThisha Elikhulu Limezinyanga kuyo yonke imisebenzi ye-PAEDIATRICS / Empilweni Yabantwana, egqamisa i-OPD namakliniki okwesono kodwa ehlanganisa izingosi nendawo yokwelashwa kulesosikhathi. Ukuphathwa kwezomphathi nokuqondiswa kwemisebenzi yezempilo okuhlanganisa ukubuka nokuphatha i-OPD, ukuphatha umbhalo wezempilo, ukuhlaziya idatha, ukuphucula izinga nokuphatha izinto zokusebenza. Ukufundisa, ukuqeqesha nokubeka abasebenzi abasha bazofile namafundi isikhundla, kubandakanya ukuthatha inxaxheba ohlelweni lwesibhedlela ngesikhathi somcimbi wesifundo. Imikhiqizo ehambisana nomkhakha nokuthatha inxaxheba ekugcineni ekologu lokuxhumana kwamanye amabanga aphansi kanye nokulondolozwa kwempilo yabantwana nokuhambisana nazo zonke izinkimbinkimbi zobulili ezingeni lesifunda – ngaphakathi kwesibhedlela nakwindawo yokuhlala kwamanye amabanga aphansi.

xh.summary: Kufuneka iSekela lezonyango leNgqi kwiPedhiyathriki naseNxesha lonyuso lweMpilo eKarl Bremer Hospital eWestern Cape, lifuna ukubhaliswa kwiHPCSA njengeseKela lezonyango leNgqi.

Inqanaba 3: Ubuncinane leminyaka engu-10 yamava afanelekileyo njengeseKela lezonyango leNgqi kwiPedhiyathriki, emva kokubhaliswa kwiHPCSA (okanye uluntu lwezempilo olusolulwazi lwamanye amazwe ngokumsebenzi oqeqeshiweyo kwamanye amazwe). Iimfuno ezingeyoyo zomsebenzi: Ilayisenisi yokushayela ngokusesikweni. Ukuzimisela ukuhamba. Ikhono (ulwazi/izakhono): Ikakhono lokunika ukhatho yezonyango ezingangqinelanga nayo kwindawo yabaguli bangaphakathi nangaphandle, kuquka nokugcina irekhodi yezonyango ngendlela esemgangathweni ophezulu. Izinto zolawulo & ulawulo lwezonyango kuquka nokuqonda nolawulo kwiOPD, ukugcina irekhodi yezonyango, ukuhlaziya idatha, ukuphucula umgangatho nolawulo lwemishini yokuhlinza. Ukufundisa, ukuqeqesha nokuqonda oogqirha abasezantsi nabafundi ngokuthatha inxaxheba kwinkqubo yezemfundo yesibhedlele. Iziphumo ezithile zendawo nokuqhubekeka kwinkqubo yeMetro East, kuquka nokukhuthaza impilo yabantwana nokuqamanisa nazo zonke iindawo zempilo yabantwana kwinqanaba lesithili – ngaphakathi kwesibhedlele nasekwindawo yeMetro East.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Budget Immovable Asset
jobs.centre: Department of Infrastructure, Western Cape Government
jobs.summary: Deputy Director needed to manage budgeting and immovable asset reporting for the Western Cape Department of Infrastructure, requiring a finance degree and three years management experience.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate 3-year B-Degree (equivalent or higher qualification) in Financial Management; A minimum of 3 years relevant experience in management accounting at supervisory/management level (Assistant Director). Competencies: Knowledge of the following: Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Treasury Regulations, NT Instructions/Practice Notes applicable to budgeting and financial management; Provincial budgeting processes (MTEF, ENE/AENE, Rollovers, virements, shifting of funds); Management accounting principles, cash-flow planning, expenditure analysis, and cost-driver modelling; Revenue and expenditure control processes within the public sector; Public finance, human resources (HR) and records management processes; Functioning of the province and the activities of sister departments/related functional areas; Government policies; Labour Relations legislation and regulations; Performance management in general. Skills in the following: Advanced numeracy, analytical and financial modelling skills; Strong report- writing, presentation and communication skills; Computer literacy (Advanced Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Word (report writing), Presentation tools); Project management, problem-solving, and stakeholder engagement; Accounting/Finance skills relating to budgeting and in-year financial reporting; Team leadership & people management; Problem solving & decision-making; Planning & organising; Attention to detail.
jobs.duties: Undertake financial planning, budgeting processes by analysing project lists for infrastructure programmes; Manage the roll-over, Adjustment Estimates of National Expenditure (AENE), and virement process; Manage reporting of Immovable Assets sub-directorate including inputs to the Infrastructure Reporting Model (IRM); Manage administrative and operational functions of the Immovable Asset Sub-directorate.
jobs.applications: Only applications submitted online will be accepted. To apply submit your application online only: via http://www.westerncape.gov.za/jobs or https://westerncapegov.erecruit.co
jobs.notes: Shortlisted candidates will be required to attend interviews on a date and time determined by the department and submit documentation for verification purposes and criminal record vetting. All shortlisted candidates shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The selection process will be guided by the EE targets of the employing department. By applying for this position, you are consenting to the Western Cape Government contacting your previous employers/managers for an employment reference. Reference checks will include enquiries relating to your disciplinary records and reasons for leaving. Should you experience difficulties with your online application, technical support is available from Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 16.00. Contact the helpline at 086 137 0214. For all other queries relating to the position, kindly contact the enquiries person as indicated in the advert. Please ensure that you submit your application before the closing date as no late applications will be considered. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Begroting Onroerende Bate
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur benodig om begroting en onroerende bate-verslagdoening vir die Western Cape Department of Infrastructure te bestuur, met die vereiste van 'n finansieële graad en drie jaar bestuurservaring.
af.requirements: 'n Geskikte 3-jaar B-graad (ekwivalent of hoër kwalifikasie) in Finansiële Bestuur; 'n Minimum van 3 jaar relevante ervaring in bestuursrekenkunde op toesiglike/bestuursvlak (Assistentdirekteur). Bevoegdhede: Kennis van die volgende: Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Treasury Regulations, NT Instructions/Practice Notes van toepassing op begroting en finansiële bestuur; Provinciale begrotingsprosesse (MTEF, ENE/AENE, Rollovers, virements, shifting of funds); Bestuursrekenkundige beginsels, kontantvloei-beplanning, uitgawe-analise, en kostebepaler-modellering; Inkomste- en uitgawebeheerprosesse binne die openbare sektor; Openbare finansies, menslike hulpbronne (HR) en rekordbestuursprosesse; Funksionering van die provinsie en die aktiwiteite van susterdepartemente/verwante funksionele areas; Regeringsbeleid; Arbeidsverhoudingswetgewing en regulasies; Prestasiebestuur in die algemeen. Vaardighede in die volgende: Gevorderde syferkundigheid, analitiese en finansiële modelleringsvaardighede; Sterk verslagskryf-, voorleggings- en kommunikasievaardighede; Rekenaargeletterdheid (Advanced Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Word (verslagskryf), Presentation tools); Projekbestuur, probleemoplossing, en belanghebbende-betrokkenheid; Rekenkunde/Finansieële vaardighede rakende begroting en finansiële verslagdoening binne die jaar; Spanleierskap en mensebestuur; Probleemoplossing en besluitneming; Beplanning en organisering; Aandag aan detail.
af.duties: Onderneem finansiële beplanning en begrotingsprosesse deur projeklyste vir infrastruktuurprogramme te ontleed; Bestuur die oorpligtings-, Aanpassingsberaming van Nasionale Uitgawes (AENE)- en virementsproses; Bestuur verslagdoening van die Subdirektoraat Onroerende Bates, insluitend bydraes tot die Infrastruktuurverslagmodel (IRM); Bestuur administratiewe en operasionele funksies van die Subdirektoraat Onroerende Bates.

zu.title: ONgqongqoshe Onyango: Izimpahla Ezingahambahamba Zezimali
zu.summary: Kudingeka uNgqongqoshe Onyango olawule ukwakheka kwabezimali nokubika kwezimpahla ezingahambahamba koMnyango wezokuXhakaxholo eNtshona Koloni, okudinga idiploma ezimalini eminyakeni emithathu futhi namava eminyakeni emithathu okuba ngumphathi.
zu.requirements: I-B-Degree eminyakeni emithathu efanelekile (iziqu ezingabalwa noma eziphezudayo) kokuLawula Izimali; Okuncane eminyakeni emithathu wamava afanele ekuweni izimali ezinkundleni zokuqaphela kumazinga okuba ngumlawuli/umphathi (Ngqongqoshe Omdere). Ikhono: Ulwazi ngokuLandelayo: i-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), imithetho yeTreasury, imiyalo/iyunifomu ye-NT ebuyela ekwakhekeni kwabezimali nasekulawuleni izimali; Izinqubo zokuakheka kwabezimali ezifundazweni (MTEF, ENE/AENE, ukuguqulwa kwabezimali, okunye ukushintshwa kwemali, ukudluliswa kwemali); Imininingwane yokuLawula izimali ezinkundla zokusebenza, ukuhlelwa kwemali exhuma, ukuhlaziwa kokusebenza, kanye neklayithi lokwakheka izindleko; Izinqubo zokuLawula ingeniso nasezimalini ezichithwa kumkhakha kahulumeni; Izimali zikahulumeni, izinsizakusebenza abantu (HR) kanye nokuLawula amarekhodi; Ukusebenza kwesifundazwe nemisebenzi yeminyango ohlobene nayo/nawo onke amakhanda; Izinqubo kahulumeni; umthetho nemithetho yamabandla emisebenzi; UkuLawula imisebenzi ngokuvamile. Amakhono okuLandelayo: Amafunde amakhulu, okuhlaziya kanye namakhono abakheka izimali; Amafunde amakhulu ekuqamba amabali, ekubekiweyo, kanye nokuqhuba imiyalo; Ukusebenza ngamakhompyutha (iMicrosoft Excel evela phambili, iMicrosoft Word (ukuqamba amabali), ukusebenzisa izinkalo ezivezwayo); Ukulawula umkhakha wokusebenza, ukusombulula izinkinga, kanye nokuxhumana nabanjiniyeli bamaphojekthi; Amakhono abantu/baphathi ababhekene nokwakheka kwabezimali nangokubika ngemali yonyaka; Ukuphatha amandla nokulawula abantu; Ukusombulula izinkinga nokwenza izinqumo; Ukuhlela nokuhlela; Ukuqaphela imininingwane.
zu.duties: Kwenze ukuhlelwa kwezimali, izinqubo zokuakheka ibhajethi ngokuhlaziya uhlu lwamaphojekthi ezinhlelo zokuxhakaxholo; Alawule ukudluliswa kwemali, ukuhla kwemali ehambayo (AENE), kanye nokuqhuba imali uguqule; Alawule ukubika kwesikhundla esincane sezimpahla ezingahambahamba okuhlanganisa imininingwane evela kumakheli e-Infrastructure Reporting Model (IRM); Alawule imisebenzi yokuphatha nokuhamba kwesikhundla esincane sezimpahla ezingahambahamba.

xh.title: Isekela Mongameli: Ialiyethi Ezingahoyekiyo Yesicwangciso seMali
xh.summary: Kufuneka iSekela Mongameli elingathathi cala ukulawula isicwangciso semali nokubika kwezaliyethi ezingahoyekiyo kwisebe leZenzo eZikwizinga eliphezulu eWestern Cape, elifuna isidanga kwezezezimali kunye neminyaka emithatu yamava okulawula.
xh.requirements: Isidanga se-B seminyaka emithatu esifanelekileyo (noma isiqinisekiso esilinganayo noma esiphezulu) ekulawulweni kwezezezimali; Ubuncinane kwiminyaka engama-3 yamava ahambelanayo kwikhowudi yokulawula kwinqanaba lokugada/lokulawula (iSekela Mlawuli). Ikhono: Ulwazi ngoku landelayo: Umthetho wokuLawula iMali eKawulezani kuRhulumente (PFMA), Izikhululo zeQela leNgeniso, iMiyalelo yeNT/Amagazini okuZisebenzisa asebenza kwisicwangciso semali nokulawula kwezezimali; Iinkqubo zocwangciso lwemali kwiphondo (MTEF, ENE/AENE, Ukuphinda kusetyenziswe, ukudluliswa kwemali, ukushitya kwemali); Iingcali zokulawula kwikhowudi, uqeqesho lokucwangcisa ukuthelekisa kwemali, ukuhlalutya ukuchithwa kwemali, kunye nokumakanatha kwezinto ezibangela iindleko; Iinkqubo zolawulo lwemali engeniswa nokujiya kurhulumente; Izezezimali zorhulumente, amabele abantu (HR) kunye neenkqubo zolawulo lweerekhodi; Ukusebenza kwephondo nemiSebenzi yamanye amasebe angamakhulu/indawo ezingqamana nayo; Iinkqubo zorhulumente; Umthetho nemiQathango yokuLawula uBasebenzi; Ukulawula inkqubo yokusebenza ngokubanzi. Amapolanya kulandelayo: Amanani aphezulu okufunda, ukwahlula-hlula nokumakanatha kwezezimali; Ukubhala iingxelo ezomeleleyo, ukuyalela kwaye nokuqhathanisa amava okunxibelelwana; Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha (iMicrosoft Excel Esinganga eliphezulu, iMicrosoft Word (ukubhala iingxelo), izixhobo zokuqhatha); Ukulawula iiprojekthi, ukuxazulula iingxaki, nokudibanisa nabathathi nxaxheba; Amapolanya ezezezimali/ekubaleni ahambelana nocwangciso lwemali nokubika iinkcukacha ekuqhubekayo ngonyaka kwezezimali; Ukulawula iqela kunye nokulawula abantu; Ukuxazulula iingxaki noku thatha iigqibo; Ucwangciso nokuqamba; Inkomasa kwiinkcukacha.
xh.duties: Yenza ucwangciso lwezezimali, iinkqubo zocwangciso ngokuhlalutya uludwe lweeprojekthi kwiinkqubo ezenza iziseko; Lawula inkqubo yokuphinda kusetyenziswe, uqikelelo olusengozini lokuChithwa kwemali kaZwelonke (AENE), noku dluliswa kwemali; Lawula ukubika kwengcinee yeeliyethi ezingahoyekiyo kuquka nezinto ezifakwayo kwiModeli yokuBika ngeZiseko (IRM); Lawula imisebenzi yolawulo nokuqhuba kwingcinee yeeliyethi ezingahoyekiyo.

jobs.title: Professional Engineer (PRODUCTION Level): Regional Roads
jobs.centre: Department of Infrastructure, Western Cape Government.
jobs.salary_text: Grade A: R914 517 - Grade C: R1 376 199 per annum, (Salary will be determined based on post registration experience as per OSD prescript)
jobs.summary: Professional engineer needed for regional roads in the Western Cape to manage road safety, development applications and construction oversight.
jobs.requirements: Civil Engineering Degree (B Eng/ BSC(Eng)) or relevant qualification; Three years post-qualification engineering experience required; Compulsory registration with ECSA as a Professional Engineer; A valid code B or higher driving licence. Competencies: Knowledge of the following: Land use planning, economics, relevant legislation, regulations, policies and acts; Road design and construction; Project management; Strategic capability and leadership; Professional judgement; Networking. Skills needed: Financial management; Written and verbal communication; Analytical; Computer-aided engineering applications; Research and development; Technical report writing; Problem solving.
jobs.duties: Provide comment and recommendations on development applications affecting the proclaimed road network; Develop mechanisms and procedures to counteract illegal activity effecting the proclaimed road network; Identify road safety problems, develop and implement remedial measures; Coordinate and manage in-house road construction, reseal, regravel and specialised routine road maintenance activities conducted at the Regional Office and District Municipalities; Develop procedures and methods to improve on productivity and quality of inhouse projects; Manage acceptance and quality control procedures and compile design standard specifications for inhouse projects; Compile tender documentation and technical specifications for the acquisition of road building and maintenance material as well as other road services; Undertake other duties in support of the District Road Engineer; Extensive relevant experience and working knowledge of the following will be advantageous: Road-built environment; Management of road construction and maintenance projects; Road planning, design and financial management; Project management; Construction equipment and effective implementation thereof; Supply chain and procurement processes, Environmental legislation and Occupational Health and Safety regulations.
jobs.applications: Only applications submitted online will be accepted. To apply submit your application online only: via http://www.westerncape.gov.za/jobs or https://westerncapegov.erecruit.co
jobs.notes: Shortlisted candidates will be required to attend interviews on a date and time determined by the department and submit documentation for verification purposes and criminal record vetting. All shortlisted candidates shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The selection process will be guided by the EE targets of the employing department. By applying for this position, you are consenting to the Western Cape Government contacting your previous employers/managers for an employment reference. Reference checks will include enquiries relating to your disciplinary records and reasons for leaving. Should you experience difficulties with your online application, technical support is available from Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 16.00. Contact the helpline at 086 137 0214. For all other queries relating to the position, kindly contact the enquiries person as indicated in the advert. Please ensure that you submit your application before the closing date as no late applications will be considered. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Professionele Ingenieur (PRODUKSIE Vlak): Streekspaaie
af.summary: Professionele ingenieur benodig vir streekspaaie in die Western Cape om padveiligheid, ontwikkelingsaansoeke en konstruksietoesig te bestuur.
af.requirements: Siviele Ingenieursgraad (B Eng/ BSC(Eng)) of tersaaklike kwalifikasie; Drie jaar se ingenieurservaring na kwalifikasie word vereis; Verpligte registrasie by ECSA as 'n Professionele Ingenieur; 'n Geldige kode B of hoër bestuurslisensie. Bevoegdhede: Kennis van die volgende: Grondgebruikbeplanning, ekonomie, tersaaklike wetgewing, regulasies, beleide en wette; Padontwerp en -konstruksie; Projektebestuur; Strategiese vermoë en leierskap; Professionele oordeel; Netwerk bou. Vaardighede benodig: Finansiële bestuur; Skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasie; Analities; Rekenaargesteunde ingenieurstoepassings; Navorsing en ontwikkeling; Tegniese verslagskrywing; Probleemoplossing.
af.duties: Verskaf kommentaar en aanbevelings oor ontwikkelingsaansoeke wat die geproklameerde padnetwerk beïnvloed; Ontwikkel meganismes en prosedures om onwettige aktiwiteite wat die geproklameerde padnetwerk beïnvloed, teen te werk; Identifiseer padveiligheidsprobleme, ontwikkel en implementeer regstellende maatreëls; Koördineer en bestuur interne padkonstruksie-, herseel-, gruis hernuwing- en gespesialiseerde roetine padonderhoudaktiwiteite wat by die Streekskantoor en Distriksmunisipaliteite uitgevoer word; Ontwikkel prosedures en metodes om produktiwiteit en gehalte van interne projekte te verbeter; Bestuur aanvaarding en gehaltebeheerprosedures en stel ontwerpstandaardspesifikasies vir interne projekte op; Stel tenderdokumentasie en tegniese spesifikasies op vir die verkryging van padbou- en onderhoudsmateriaal asook ander pad Dienste; Onderneem ander pligte ter ondersteuning van die Distrikspadingenieur; Uitgebreide tersaaklike ervaring en werkende kennis van die volgende sal voordelig wees: Padbou-omgewing; Bestuur van padkonstruksie- en onderhoudsprojekte; Padbeplanning, -ontwerp en finansiële bestuur; Projektebestuur; Konstruksietoerusting en effektiewe implementering daarvan; Voorsieningsketting en verkrygings prosesse; Omgewingswetgewing en Beroepsgezondheids- en Veiligheidsregulasies.

zu.title: Injiniyahole Kunobhala Weziqu (izinga LEQUMBU): Izindlela Zesifunda
zu.summary: Kudingeka injiniyahole kunobhala weziqu yezindlela zesifunda kule Western Cape ukuphathwa kwezokuphepha kwezindlela, izicelo zentuthuko kanye nokubukeka kokwakhiwa.
zu.requirements: I-Degree ye-Civil Engineering (B Eng/ BSC(Eng)) noma isefikiso esihambisana nalokho; Kudingeka kubeminyaka emithathu yeminyaka yokuqashwa komsebenzi we-injiniya ngemva kweziqu; Ukuqashwa kweqinisekiswe kule ECSA njengenjiniyahole; Ilayisensi yokushayela ye-code B noma ephezulu enesiya. Ikhono: Ulwazi ngalokhu okulandelayo: Ukucubungula ukusetshenziswa koluhlelo bendawo, izomnotho, umthetho ohambisanayo, izimiso, izinqubomgomo kanye namabalule; Ukuklama nokwakha izindlela; Ukuphathwa kwephrojekthi; Ikhono lokuhola; Ukuhlulela ngobuchwepheshe; Ukuxhumana. Amakhono adingekayo: Ukuphathwa kwezezimali; Ukuthumela imiyalezo ebhaliwe nangomlomo; Ukuhlaziya; Izinhlelo zokusebenza ngekhompyutha ezisediwe ekuqashweni komsebenzi wezobuchwepheshe; Ucwaningo nentuthuko; Ukubhala izibalo zobuchwepheshe; Ukuxazulula izinkinga.
zu.duties: Nikeza izincomo kanye nezimpendulo kuzicelo zentuthuko ezithinta inethiwekhi yezindlela ezimenyiwe; Cabangela izindlela kanye namasu ukuze kuqedwe noma kuthintelwe izenzo ezingekho emthethweni ezithinta inethiwekhi yezindlela ezimenyiwe; Hlola izinkinga zezokuphepha kwezindlela, wenze ubeke izinyathelo zokulungisa; Hleze uphathe ukwakhiwa kwezindlela ngaphakathi komnyango, ukuqinisa kabusha, ukubeka udoti kabusha kanye nezinye izinhlela ezithize zokulungisa izindlela ngokujwayelekilewen ezenziwa esikhungweni sesifunda nasezikhundweni ze-District Municipalities; Cabangela izindlela namasu okwenza ukuba kube khona isivuselelo ekwenzeni umsebenzi ngokushesha kway kube nengcono nangomgangatho kwamaphrojekthi angaphakathi; Phatha ukwamukelwa kwayahlathwa iinkqubo zolawulo kway uqulunqe izimiso ezizesikweni zokuklanywa kwamaphrojekthi angaphakathi; Qulunqa imibhalo yetender kway izicatshulwa zobuchwepheshe zokuthengwa kwesakhiwo nezinto zokwakhiwa kwezindlela nangokulungiswa kwezinye izinsiza zezindlela; Zenze eminye imisebenzi kuxhasa u-District Road Engineer; Okunye okuhlelokho okuningi kway ulwazi lokusebenza ngakho okulandelayo kuzoba luncedo: Indlela yomzila oqokiweyo; Ukulawula amaphrojekthi wokwakhiwa nokulungiswa kwezindlela; Ukucwangcisa iindlela, ukuyila kukqala kuphathwa kweemali; Ukuphathwa kwephrojekthi; Iinkqubo zokwakha nokusebenzisa iinkqubo ezizezinyanga; Iinkqubo zokusetyenziswa kwaye nalwazi lweemveliso kwaye ngezinqubo zokuthengisa, umthetho weendalo nakwezoKhathaloze Nephepha kwaye Nemigaqo yeKhathazo ngokumisela kwemiba.

xh.title: Injineli yeNyaniso (iNqanaba loYILISO): IiNdulu Zommandla
xh.summary: Kufuneka injineli yenyaniso yeenkululeko zommandla kwi-Western Cape ukulawula ukhuseleko lweenkululeko, iingeniselo zophuhliso nokwengqinisela kolwakhiwo.
xh.requirements: Isidanga se-Njineli yeZakhiwo (B Eng/BSC(Eng)) okanye izifundo ezifanelekileyo; Kufuneka kube nokuba namashumi amathathu eminyaka yamava injineli emva kokugqiba izifundo; Ubulungu obuyiNyaniso kwi-ECSA njengenjineli yenyaniso obuyimfuno; Ilayisenisi yokushayela ye-code B okanye ephezulu esebenzayo. Ikhono: Ulwazi ngeminye yale: Ulwakhiwo lomhlaba osetyiweyo, ezomnoto, urhulumente namagunya axelwayo, iinkqubo namagunya; Ulwakhiwo nokwakhiwa kweenkululeko; Ulawulo lweprojekthi; Ikhono lokubumba iindlela nokuba ngumlawuli; Isigqibo senyaniso; Uqhagamshelo. Ikhono efunekayo: Ulawulo lweemali; Unxibelelwano ngokubhalayo nangolwimi; Uhlalutyo; Izicelo zokwakha ngekhompyutha; Uphuhliso nolwazi; Ukubhala iingxelo zobuchwepheshe; Ukuxazulula iingxaki.
xh.duties: Nika izimvo neengcengcelo kwiingeniselo zophuhliso ezichaphazela inethiwekhi yeenkululeko ezesisemthethweni; Phuhliza iindlela neenkqubo zokuchasana nokusetyenziswa ngokungalunganga iinkqubo ezichaphazela inethiwekhi yeenkululeko ezisisemthethweni; Phawula iingxaki zokhuseleko lweenkululeko, phuhliza uze usebenzise iindlela zokuzilungisa; Lungisanisa uze ulawule ukwakhiwa kweenkululeko ngaphakathi, ukubuyela kunxwama, ukubuyela kwigravu kunye nokunyamezela iindlela ezize ngokwenene zezenkululeko ezenziwa kwiOfisi yommandla nakumasipala weentshintsha; Phuhliza iindlela neendlela zokuphucula ukusebenza nobulungisa beprojekthi ezingaphakathi; Lawula ukwamkelwa neenkqubo zolawulo lobungakanani uze uqoke iinkqubo zolwakhiwo ezingagqibekanga kumapjekthi angaphakathi; Qamba ixesha lombutho wamanqanaba obuchwepheshe nokukhethwa kwemisobo yamapjekthi angaphakathi; Qamba amaxwebhu okuthengisa iinkqubo nobuchwepheshe bokufumana izinto zokwakhiwa nokunyamezela iinkululeko nakwezinye iinkonzo zeendulul; Yenza omnye umsebenzi ongxamiselelo kuka-Injineli weNduli yeenkululeko; Ulwazi olubanzi ngokwakhiwa kweenkululeko nakusebenza olu kuya kuluncedo: Ulwakhiwo lweenkululeko; Ulawulo lokwakhiwa nokunyamezela iiprojekthi zeendulul; Ulwakhiwo lweplani, ukuyila nolawulo lwemali; Ulawulo lweprojekthi; Izixhobo zolwakhiwo nolwakhiwo oluqhutywa kakuhle; Iinkqubo zokusetyenziswa koluhlu lokuthengisa nemveliso, Urhulumente wasemoyeni namagunya eMpilo yoMsebenzi noKhuseleko.

jobs.title: Architectural Technologist (PRODUCTION): Architectural
jobs.centre: Department of Infrastructure, Western Cape Government.
jobs.salary_text: Grade A: R471 720 - Grade C: R717 846 per annum, (Salary will be determined based on post registration experience as per OSD prescript)
jobs.summary: Architectural technologist needed by the Western Cape Department of Infrastructure to provide technical advisory and production support on architectural projects.
jobs.requirements: Bachelor of Technology in Architecture (B. Tech) or relevant qualification; Three years post qualification Senior Architectural Technologist experience required; Compulsory registration with SACAP as a Senior Architectural Technologist; A valid driving licence. Competencies: Knowledge of the following: Technical: Project management; Architectural planning; Research and development; Computer-aided architectural applications; Knowledge of legal compliance; Technical report writing; Networking; Professional judgement. Generic: Problem solving and analysis; Decision making; Team leadership; Creativity; Self-management; Customer focus and responsiveness; Communication; Computer skills; Planning and organising; People management.

af.title: Argitekturele Tegnoloog (PRODUKSIE): Argitektuur
af.summary: Die Western Cape Department of Infrastructure benodig 'n argitekturele tegnoloog om tegniese advies en produksiesteun vir argitekturele projekte te verskaf.
af.requirements: Bachelor of Technology in Architecture (B. Tech) of tersaaklike kwalifikasie; Drie jaar na kwalifikasie Senior Architectural Technologis ervarings vereis; Verpligte registrasie by SACAP as 'n Senior Architectural Technologist; 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Bevoegdhede: Kennis van die volgende: Tegnies: Projekbestuur; Argitekturele beplanning; Navorsing en ontwikkeling; Rekenaargesteunde argitekturele toepassings; Kennis van regsveoldoening; Tegniese verslagskrywing; Netwerking; Professionele oordeel. Generies: Probleemoplossing en ontleding; Besluitneming; Spanleierskap; Skeppendheid; Selfbestuur; Kliëntefokus en tnlpsluitendheid; Kommunikasie; Rekenaarvaardighede; Beplanning en organisering; Personeelbestuur.
af.duties: Verskaf tegnologieke adviesdienste: Ondersteun Argitekte en vennote in terreinopmetings, die opstel van gemete tekeninge van bestaande geboue, die inwin van praktiese inligting met betrekking tot die voorgestelde projek en berei voorleggingstekeninge en modelle van die ontwerp voor; Detailontwerp, landskapsontwerp en voorbereiding van werktekeninge wat as wetlike instruksies aan die boukontrakteur sal dien en in die proses toesig hou oor bouwerk om te verseker dat die gebou ooreenkomstig die werktekeninge en ander wetlike dokumente gebou word; Evalueer bestaande tegniese handleidings, standaardtekeninge en prosedures om nuwe tegnologie te inkorporeer; Los breed gedefinieerde tegnologiese uitdagings op deur die toepassing van bewese tegnieke en prosedures; Ontwikkel, onderhou en bestuur huidige tegnologieë; en Identifiseer en optimaliseer tegniese oplossings deur argitekturele beginsels toe te pas; Voer administratiewe en verwante funksies uit: Stel maandelikse en kwartaalverslae op en dien dit in; Verskaf insette tot die bedryfsplan; en Ontwikkel, implementeer en onderhou databasisse; Navorsing en ontwikkeling: Hou treden met nuwe tegnologieë en prosedures; Doen navorsing/literatuurstudies oor tegniese argitekturele tegnologie om kundigheid te verbeter en skakel met tersaaklike rade/raade oor argitektuurverwante aangeleenthede.

zu.title: Usosayensi bokwakha (UKUQHASHA): Bukwakha
zu.summary: Kudingeka usosayensi bokwakha ophethwe umnyango we-Infrastructure wase-Western Cape ukuze anikeze inkomba yobuchwepheshe nenkxaso ekukhiqizeni kumaprojekthi bokwakha.
zu.requirements: I-Bachelor of Technology ku-Architecture (B. Tech) noma izifundo ezifanelekile; Kudingeka abeze iminyaka emithathu eyisikhathi eside somuhloli wezokwakha esebense emva kokuthola izifundo; Ukubhaliswa ngokuphoqelekile ku-SACAP njengoba kunesikhathi eside somuhloli wezokwakha; Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Amakhono: Ulwazi ngalokhu okulandelayo: Okobuchwepheshe: Ukuphathwa kweprojekthi; Ukucwangciswa kokwakha; Into yokuphanda nentuthuko; Izinhlelo zekhompyutha eziyisizo ekuqashweni kwezokwakha; Ulwazi ngokuhambisana nomthetho; Ukubhala imibiko yobuchwepheshe; Ukuhlanganisa nabantu; Ukwahlulela ngobuchwepheshe. Okuvamile: Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuqonda; Ukwenza izinqumo; Ukuba ngumholi wesiqu; Ubuciko; Ukuzilawula; Ukuqasela abathengi kanye nokuwabela imibuzo; Ukuxhumana; Amakhono ekhompyutha; Ukucwangciswa kokuqoqwa kwemisebenzi; Ukuphatha abantu.
zu.duties: Nika inkomba mayelana nezinsizakalo zobuchwepheshe: Yeka abakwakha nabahlobene ekuphenyeni indawo, ekulungiseni izithombe ezilungisiweyo ezakhiwo ezikhona, ekuqoqeni ulwazi olufanele mayelana neprojekthi ephakanyisiwe futhi ulungise izithombe eziboniswa kanye nama-model wokwakhiwa; Ukucwangcisa iminikelo yokwakha kanye nokuhlobisa futhi ulungise izithombe zomsebenzi ezizoba yizinkomba zomthetho kumakhiwo ukwakhiwayo futhi kulolu hlelo ulawule ukuqakuliswa kwakhiwo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukhiwa ngokwezithombe zomsebenzi nezinye izixhumanisi zomthetho; Hlola imibiko yobuchwepheshe ekhona, izithombe ezivamile kanye nokuqoqwa kwemisebenzi ukuthi uhlanganise nobuchwepheshe obusha; Xazulula izinkinga zobuchwepheshe ezichazwe ngokubanzi ngokusebenzisa izindlela nekuqoqwa kwemisebenze ezelwe ukusebenza; Buka, ulondoloze ulawule izinto zobuchwepheshe ezikhona; futhi Ubone ulungisele izixazululo zobuchwepheshe ngokusebenzisa izinhlobo ezimayelana nokwakha; Yenza imisebenzi yokuqoqwa kanye nezinye eziphathelene nakho: Qamba futhi uthumele imibiko yanyanga zonke nenyanga ngayinye; Nikeza okungenayo ekuhleni kwemisebenzi; futhi Buka, ufake futhi ulondoloze okuqukathi kwedata; Ulwazi nentuthuko: Gcina ulwazi ngalokusha ezobuchwepheshe nokuqoqwa kwemisebenzi; Yophenyo kanye nezifundo zokubhaliwe ngobuchwepheshe bokwakha ukuzeuthuthakwisise ulwazi futhi ugxile ngabaphathelene nabaholi ngemibuzo ephathelene nokwakha.

xh.title: INkqubo yokuLunga ngokweMigaqo ye-Scientific Production Controller eNqanabeni le-7 (Inkundla yeNqanaba le-7 eRanchito)
xh.summary: Kufuneka umphathi wamagcisa wolwazi obuchwephesha ozele ngolwazi ongayalela ngokobugcisa obuchwephesha kuNjineli weNqanaba le-7 eRanchito ukuba ancede ekubeni abeke iinkonzo zobugcisa obuchwephesha nobugcisa abugcwayo.

Tech) okanye isidanga esihambelanayo; Kufuneka nabani na onamava emva kokufumana isidanga njengomsebenzi oqeqeshiweyo onamava kwakhona kwakhona kwiindlela ezihamba phambili zokusungula iinkqubo ezinkonkotha ezinamava amathathu emva kwesidanga; Ukubhalisa njengomsebenzi oqeqeshiweyo ongqongqoshe kwi-SACAP njengomsebenzi oqeqeshiweyo osemqoka; Ilayisenisi yokushayela enemigangatho. Iinkqubo ezikwizinga lonke: Ukusombulula iingxaki nokuhanjiswa kwazo; ukuThatha iziGqibo; ukuLawula iqela; ukuDala izinto ngokutsha; ukuZilawula; ukuNxibelelana noBakhweli nokuba sabela kumagunya abo; uNxibelelwano; amakhono eKhompyutha; uCwangcisa nokuBumba; uLawuloabantu.
xh.duties: Nika iinkonzo zelizwe lonke ngolwazi lwesayansi: Nceda abaBakhi bezakhiwo nabahlobo bayo kwimizamo yokulinganisa indawo yokwakhiwa, ukulungiselela iimbalo ezilinganisiweyo zezakhiwo ezikhoyo, ukuqokelela ulwazi lokwenza ngokomsebenzi oceliweyo kwaye ulungiselele iimbalo ezibonwayo nemodeli yomgca wokwakha; Imigca ecocekileyo yokwakha, umgca wokwakha indawo yemifuni nokulungiselela imigca yokwakha esebenzayo eza kusebenza njengemiyalelo yomthetho kumakhiwe, kananjalo kuloo ndlela qhubele phambili ulawulo lokwakhiwa kuqinisekise ukuba into e yakhiwe ngokomgca wokwakha osebenzayo namaxwebhu amnye omthetho; Hlola iincwadana ezikwizinga lonke lobugcisa ezikhoyo, imigca ecocekileyo yomgca wokwakhiwo iinkqubo zokuzelelisa iimpawu zentsha yolwazi lwekhompyutha; Solula iingxaki ezinchazwe ngokubanzi zolwazi lwekhompyutha ngokusetyenziswa kweendlela eziphindaphindiweyo neenkqubo ezichaziweyo; Phuhlisa, zigcine uze uzilawule iinkqubo zamagcisa obugcisa akhoyo; kananjalo Zibuze uze unqumlise iindlela ezikwizinga lonke lobugcisa ngokusetyenziswa kweengcamango ezisekelwe kumagcisa obugcisa; Yenza imisebenzi yolawulo nemisebenzi ehambisana nayo: Hlela uze ugcwalise iingxelo zenyanga zanyanga nezo ngenyangana ezintathu; Nikela izimvo kwicebo lomsebenzi wemihla ngemihla; Hlaza, ukwazi ukusebenzisa uze ugcine iinkqubo zokulawula ulwazi; Uphando nokuzelelisa: Gcina ulungelelwaniso nolwazi olutsha olwenzekayo iinkqubo ezintsha; Uphando/ifundo ngemibhalo ngolwazi lwekhompyutha kwizinga lonke lobugcisa ukuphucula ulwazi lotyalo-mali uze unxibelelane namanqanaba amagunya ehlabathi/iindibano ngemiba ehambelana noBakhiwe.

jobs.title: Administrative Officer: Economic HUB
jobs.centre: Department of Infrastructure, Western Cape Government.
jobs.summary: Administrative Officer providing support services for the Economic HUB within the Western Cape Department of Infrastructure, requiring a three-year diploma or degree and one year of experience.

Competencies: Knowledge of the following: Legislation, regulatory frameworks, policies and best practices that have a bearing on the line functions; Record management; Information systems that aid in the management of knowledge and information pertaining to the line function; Project management; Operational management practices; Procurement and tendering processes; Modern systems of governance and administration; Public service procedures, processes and systems; Constitutional, legal and institutional arrangements governing the South African public sector; Public finance, human resources and discourse management processes; Public Finance Management Act, National and Provincial Treasury Regulations, other financial policies, prescripts, directives and collective agreements; Functioning of the Province and the activities of sister departments/related functional areas; Policies of the government of the day; Labour Relations legislation and regulations; Performance management in general. xh.summary: Iofisa Ololawulo elibonelela ngesevisi yenkxaso kwi-Economic HUB ngaphakathi kwiWestern Cape Department of Infrastructure,elifuna idiploma yeminyaka emithathu okanye isidanga kunye nenyaka elilodwa loluhlu lolunako.

af.title: Rekenklerk: Bankwese en Kontant
af.summary: Rekenklerk benodig deur die Western Cape Department of Infrastructure om finansiële eise te verwerk, rekeningboekrekeninge te onderhou en boekhoudingsondersteuning te bied.

zu.summary: Kudingeka umuntu ozobe esikhundleni sokubhala izibalo ku Western Cape Department of Infrastructure ukuletha imali efunwayo, ukugcina izikhwama zemali nokunikeza usizo ekubhala izibalo.
