jobs.title: Director: Policy Research and Analysis
jobs.centre: Department of the Premier, Western Cape Government.
jobs.summary: Director of Policy Research and Analysis for the Western Cape Government, requiring an NQF 7 qualification and five years of senior managerial experience.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate qualification at NQF level 7 as recognised by SAQA; A minimum of 5 years’ experience at a middle/senior managerial level. Competencies: Knowledge of the following: Proven senior management expertise and practical experience in: Legislation and Governance: Deep understanding of modern systems of governance and public administration, including a thorough understanding of the constitutional, legal and institutional frameworks governing the South African public sector, and the application thereof in the Western Cape Government spatial information priorities; Regulatory Frameworks: The Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), National and Provincial Treasury Regulations, Labour Relations legislation, and related financial prescripts, directives and collective agreements, with demonstrated ability to ensure compliance, risk management, and sound governance and Data Governance Frameworks; Strategic Management: Policy development, strategic planning, monitoring, and evaluation and review of processes aligned with provincial priorities and government outcomes; Financial Management: Public finance management, procurement and tendering processes, and human resource and discourse management; People and Performance Management: Comprehensive experience in human resource management, team leadership and performance systems to drive accountability and results; Operational Systems: Public service procedures, performance management systems, and information and knowledge management systems, enabling efficient operations, evidence-based decision-making and continuous improvement; Programme and Project Management: End-to-end programme and project management, including planning, implementation, oversight, reporting and risk mitigation to achieve strategic and operational targets; Contextual Awareness: Strong understanding of global, regional and local political, socio-economic and political dynamics, impacting the functioning of Western Cape and activities of provincial government departments, translating insights into informed strategic advice; Service Delivery and Innovation: Skilled in operational and knowledge management systems supporting evidence- based decision-making, efficient operations, and continuous improvement. Skills in the following: Effective communication skills; Strong ability to conceptualise, formulate and demonstrate thought leadership in complex applications; Persuasion and influencing abilities; Leadership, team-building and interpersonal skills; Planning, organising, and people management skills; Proven ability to multi-task, manage ambiguity, and perform efficiently in rapidly changing environments.
jobs.duties: Line Management: Lead, transform, and manage the Western Cape Government’s transversal policy, strategy and strategic planning functional areas. Lead research, analysis, and monitoring of the provincial policy environment to identify “whole of government and whole of society interventions” and drive a transversal response that is reflected in departments’ policy, strategy, and strategic plans; Analyse the three spheres of government’s policies, strategies, and laws (e.g., regulation, legislation, and bylaws) to evaluate their implications for the strategic agenda, operations, and service delivery models of the WCG and transversal structures, such as Portfolios; Analyse on-going national policy and strategy developments, and sensitise Cabinet, Sector Committees and departments on its implications for the province; Facilitate the development of transversal provincial policies as may be required (including stakeholder consultation as required); Ensure that WCG legislation, policies and strategies align with the Provincial Strategic Plan and long-term plans; Facilitate the periodic review of the Provincial Strategic Plan in line with prescribed strategic planning and budgetary processes; Institutionalise foresight (e.g. environmental scanning and scenario planning) in the development of strategy, policy, and strategic planning at various levels within the organisation (i.e., WCG, Portfolios, and departments) to ensure strategic decisions are calibrated against current and emerging external factors; Lead the development of transversal strategy, policy, and strategic planning processes and deliverables to generate intelligence that informs executive decisions and feeds into performance management systems; Ensure that WCG legislation, policies and strategies align and comply with human rights principles and with international, constitutional and national human rights obligations, policies and strategies; Provide thought leadership and engage in cross-cutting innovation initiatives that fall under the work of the Innovation, Culture, and Governance Portfolio, as well as Policy and Strategy-led innovation initiatives. Strategic Management (including change management): Define and review on a continual basis the purpose, objectives, priorities and activities of the Directorate; Drive the Directorate’s strategic planning process; Drive the development and management of the strategic and business plans for the Directorate; Continuously evaluate the Directorate's performance, proactively report on delivery and emerging risks, adapt plans, and reallocate resources; Report to the Chief Director on a regular basis on the activities of the Directorate and on matters of substantial importance relating to operational management support; Monitor and ensure compliance with relevant legislation and prescripts in respect of adequate and appropriate record keeping of the activities of the Directorate, and of the resources (people, finances and assets) employed by it; Foster and promote a culture of innovation within the Directorate, and the Department; Diligently perform all duties assigned to the post of Director. People Management and Empowerment: Recruit, develop, and retain staff in appropriate numbers and grades to achieve the Directorate’s objectives; Motivate, train, and guide employees to achieve excellence in service delivery; Manage performance, evaluation, and development of staff; Oversee workforce planning, capacity building, and service delivery improvement initiatives; Promote sound labour relations and maintain discipline within the Directorate. Financial Management: Manage participation in the Directorate budgeting process, including Annual and Adjustment Budgets; Assume accountability for efficient, economic, and effective management of the Directorate’s budget and expenditure; Ensure adherence to procurement, tender, and contract management requirements; Ensure alignment of expenditure with departmental and strategic objectives; Report on financial matters to the Chief Director and relevant oversight structures; Ensure appropriate risk management controls, asset management, and record- keeping are in place and adhered to.
jobs.enquiries: Ms. A Goldstuck; Alison.Goldstuck@westerncape.gov.za OTHER POSTS
jobs.applications: Only applications submitted online will be accepted. To apply submit your application online only: via http://www.westerncape.gov.za/jobs or https://westerncapegov.erecruit.co
jobs.notes: Only applications submitted online will be submitted. Kindly note that technical support is only available from Monday to Friday from 8:00 to 16:00. Should you experience any difficulties with your online application you may contact the helpline on 0861 370 214. Please ensure that you submit your application on or before the closing date as no late applications will be considered. The selection process will be guided by the EE targets of the employing department. By applying for this post, you are consenting to the Western Cape Government contacting your previous employers/managers for an employment reference. Reference checks will include enquiries relating to your disciplinary records and reasons for leaving. All shortlisted candidates must make themselves available to be interviewed at a date, time and place as decided by the selection panel. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise that intends to assess relevant functional elements of the job and an interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. The successful candidate will be required to complete the Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme (Nyukela) and submit the certificate before he/she can be appointed to this post. The purpose of the Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme, which is a public service specific training programme applicable to all applicants who aspire to join the SMS, is to ensure that the potential SMS members have a background in process and procedures linked to the SMS. The duration of the online Pre-Entry Programme is 120 national hours (15 days). Full details may be sourced by the following link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-preentryprogramme.            The successful candidate shall be subjected to a leadership assessment, within on (1) month of appointment, to assess the managerial competencies required for SMS members in the Public Service as specified under Chapter Five (5) of the SMS handbook. This assessment shall be conducted to determine an individual’s ability to lead, manage, and direct others and to identify development gaps in core generic leadership and management competencies. The successful candidate will be required to enter into an employment contact and performance agreement. The successful candidate will be subject to security vetting; and the candidate will have to disclose her/his financial interest. Furthermore, thank you, to the huge public interest, we receive many applications for our posts, and as such will not be able to respond personally to all applications. Therefore, should you no hear from us within 10 weeks from close of the advert please consider your application unsuccessful. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Direkteur: Beleidsnavorsing en -analise
af.summary: Direkteur van Beleidsnavorsing en -analise vir die Western Cape Government, wat 'n NQF 7-kwalifikasie en vyf jaar se senior bestuurservaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike kwalifikasie op NQF vlak 7 soos deur SAQA erken; 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se ervaring op 'n middel-/senior bestuursvlak. Bevoegdhede: Kennis van die volgende: Bewese senior bestuurskundigheid en praktiese ervaring in: Wetgewing en Bestuur: Diepgaande begrip van moderne stelsels van bestuur en openbare administrasie, insluitend 'n deeglike begrip van die konstitusionele, regtelike en institusionele raamwerke wat die Suid-Afrikaanse openbare sektor regeer, en die toepassing daarvan in die Western Cape Government se ruimtelike inligtingsprioriteite; Regulerende Raamwerke: The Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), National and Provincial Treasury Regulations, arbeidsverhoudingswetgewing, en verwante finansiële voorskrifte, riglyne en kollektiewe ooreenkomste, met 'n getoonvermoë om nakoming, risikobestuur en goeie bestuur en Data Governance Frameworks te verseker; Strategiese Bestuur: Beleidsontwikkeling, strategiese beplanning, monitering, en evaluering en hersiening van prosesse wat in lyn gebring is met provinsiale prioriteite en regeringsuitkomste; Finansiële Bestuur: Openbare finansiële bestuur, verkrygings- en tenderprosesse, en menslike hulpbron- en diskoersbestuur; Mense- en Prestasiebestuur: Omvattende ervaring in menslike hulpbronbestuur, spanleiding en prestasiestelsels om verantwoordelikheid en resultate te dryf; Operasionele Stelsels: Openbare diensprosedures, prestasiebestuurstelsels, en inligtings- en kennisbestuurstelsels, wat doeltreffende bedrywighede, bewysgebaseerde besluitneming en deurlopende verbetering moontlik maak; Programme- en Projektebestuur: End-tot-end programme- en projektebestuur, insluitend beplanning, implementering, toesig, verslagdoening en risikobeperking om strategiese en operasionele teikens te bereik; Kontekstuele Bewustheid: Sterk begrip van globale, streeks- en plaaslike politieke, sosio-ekonomiese en politieke dinamika, wat die funksionering van die Wes-Kaap en die bedrywighede van provinsiale regeringsdepartemente beïnvloed, wat insigte in ingeligte strategiese advies vertaal; Dienslewering en Innovasie: Bedrewe in operasionele en kennisbestuurstelsels wat bewysgebaseerde besluitneming, doeltreffende bedrywighede en deurlopende verbetering ondersteun. Vaardighede in die volgende: Effektiewe kommunikasievaardighede; Sterk vermoë om te konseptualiseer, formuleer en denkleiding in komplekse toepassings te demonstreer; Oortuiging en beïnvloedingsvermoëns; Leierskap, spanbou en interpersoonlike vaardighede; Beplannings-, organisasie- en mensebestuursvaardighede; Bewese vermoë om veelvuldige take te hanteer, dubbelzinnigheid te bestuur, en doeltreffend te presteer in vinnig veranderende omgewings.
af.duties: Lynbestuur: Lei, transformeer en bestuur die Western Cape Government se transversale beleids-, strategie- en strategiese beplannings funksionele areas. Lei navorsing, analise en monitering van die provinsiale beleidsomgewing om "regering as geheel en samelewing as geheel tussenvensies" te identifiseer en 'n transversale reaksie dryf wat in departemente se beleid, strategie en strategiese planne weerspieël word; Analiseer die drie sfere van regering se beleide, strategieë en wette (bv., regulasie, wetgewing en verordeninge) om hul implikasies vir die strategiese agenda, bedrywighede en diensleweringsmodelle van die WCG en transversale strukture, soos Portfolios, te evalueer; Analiseer deurlopende nasionale beleids- en strategieontwikkelings, en sensibiliseer Cabinet, Sector Committees en departemente oor die implikasies daarvan vir die provinsie; Fasiliteer die ontwikkeling van transversale provinsiale beleide soos benodig (insluitend belanghebbende raadpleging soos benodig); Verseker dat WCG-wetgewing, beleide en strategieë met die Provincial Strategic Plan en langtermynplanne in lyn gebring word; Fasiliteer die periodieke hersiening van die Provincial Strategic Plan in ooreenstemming met voorgeskryfde strategiese beplannings- en begrotingsprosesse; Institutionaliseer vooruitsig (bv. omgewingsskandering en scenario-beplanning) in die ontwikkeling van strategie, beleid en strategiese beplanning op verskeie vlakke binne die organisasie (d.w.s., WCG, Portfolios en departemente) om te verseker dat strategiese besluite teen huidige en ontluikende eksterne faktore gekalibreer word; Lei die ontwikkeling van transversale strategie-, beleids- en strategiese beplanningsprosesse en lewerings om inligting te genereer wat uitvoerende besluite inlig en in prestasiebestuurstelsels vloei; Verseker dat WCG-wetgewing, beleide en strategieë in lyn is en voldoen aan menseregte-beginsels en aan internasionale, konstitusionele en nasionale menseregte-verpligtinge, beleide en strategieë; Verskaf denkleiding en neem deel aan deursnit-inovasie-inisiatiewe wat onder die werk van die Innovation, Culture, and Governance Portfolio val, asook Beleid en Strategie-geleide innovasie-inisiatiewe. Strategiese Bestuur (insluitend veranderingbestuur): Definieer en hersien voortdurend die doel, doelwitte, prioriteite en bedrywighede van die Direktoraat; Dryf die Direktoraat se strategiese beplanningsproses; Dryf die ontwikkeling en bestuur van die strategiese en besigheidsplanne vir die Direktoraat; Evalueer voortdurend die Direktoraat se prestasie, rapporteer proaktief oor lewering en ontluikende risiko's, pas planne aan en herallokeer hulpbronne; Rapporteer op 'n gereelde basis aan die Hoofdirekteur oor die bedrywighede van die Direktoraat en oor sake van wesenlike belang rakende operasionele bestuurstoondersteuning; Monitor en verseker nakoming van toepaslike wetgewing en voorskrifte ten opsigte van voldoende en toepaslike rekordhouding van die bedrywighede van die Direktoraat, en van die hulpbronne (mense, finansies en bates) wat daardeur aangewend word; Bevorder en ondersteun 'n kultuur van innovasie binne die Direktoraat en die Departement; Voer getrou alle pligte uit wat aan die pos van Direkteur opgedra word. Mensebestuur en Bemagtiging: Werf, ontwikkel en behou personeel in toepaslike getalle en vlakke om die Direktoraat se doelwitte te bereik; Motiveer, lei en begeleid werknemers om uitmuntendheid in dienslewering te bereik; Bestuur prestasie, evaluering en ontwikkeling van personeel; Hou toezig op arbeidsmagbeplanning, kapasiteitsbou en dienslewering-verbeteringsinisiatiewe; Bevorder goeie arbeidsverhoudinge en handhaaf dissipline binne die Direktoraat. Finansiële Bestuur: Bestuur deelname aan die Direktoraat se begrotingsproses, insluitend Annual and Adjustment Budgets; Neem verantwoordelikheid vir doeltreffende, ekonomiese en effektiewe bestuur van die Direktoraat se begroting en besteding; Verseker nakoming van verkrygings-, tender- en kontrakbestuursvereistes; Verseker belyning van besteding met departementele en strategiese doelwitte; Rapporteer oor finansiële aangeleenthede aan die Hoofdirekteur en relevante toesigstrukture; Verseker dat toepaslike risikobestuurkontroles, batebestuur en rekordhouding in plek is en nagekom word.

zu.title: Umphathi: ucwaningo lwemibhalo yesigaba namahluko
zu.summary: Umphathi weCwaningo lwemibhalo yesigaba namahluko ohlelweni lukahulumende waseWestern Cape, ofuna iziqu zeNQF 7 kanye namafive eminyaka yokuqeqeshewa enkabeni yomphathi ophakeme.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanele ezingeni leNQF 7 njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA; Okungenani 5 iminyaka yokuqeqeshewa enkabeni yomphathi ophakathi noma ophakeme. Izakhono: Ulwazi ngaleyo: Inobungcweti obubonakalayo bokuphatha abantu bomkhakha obuphezulu kanye nokuqashelwa komzamo ezindaweni ezilandelayo: Nemithetho nokuLawulwa: Ukuqonda okujulile kwemisitho yanamuhla yokulawula nokuphatha imicimbi yomphakathi, okuhlanganisa ukuqonda okujulile kwemisimba yomthethosisekelo, yomthetho nezinhlelo ezingahleliwe ezilawula umkhakha kahulumende waseNingizimu Afrika, kanye nokusebenzisa lokho ezinhlelweni zokuqasha izindatshana zesikhungoakahulumende waseWestern Cape mayelana izinhlelo zolwazi; Izinhlelo zokuLawula: uMthetho wokuLawula Imali yomphakathi (PFMA), imithetho yokulawula yesiNqanga namaphrovinsi, umthetho wezibopho zomsebenzi, nezimiso ezihlobene nemali, imiyalo kanye nezivumelwano ngokuhlanganyela, ngenkono yokukhombisa ikhono lokuqinisekisa ukuhambisana, ukuphatha ubungozi, nokulawula kahle kwemisitho yokuLawula imisindana weSikhungo sezindatshana; ukuphatha nokuHlela: ukwakhiwa kwemibhalo yesigaba, ukuhlelwa kwezinhlelo, ukuphenya, kanye nokuqashelwa kabusha kanye nokubuyekezwa kwemikhuba ekubambe kuhambisana nezinhloso zamaphrovinsi nangemiphumela kahulumende; ukuphatha iMali: ukuphatha imali yomphakathi, imikhuba yokuthenga kanye nokuqashwa kwezitende, kanye nokuphatha abantu kanye nokuphatha imicimbi; ukuphatha abaNtu kanye noMsebenzi: Inkonzo yokugqamile yokuphatha abantu, ukukhokhela amandla kanye nezinhlelo zomsebenzi ukuze kuqashwe isibopho kanye nemiphumela; izimiso zokuSebenza: izimiso zomsebenzi womphakathi, izinhlelo zokuphatha umsebenzi, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphatha imisindana yolwazi kanye nolwazi, okunikeza ikhono lokusebenza ngempumelelo, ukwenza izinqumo ngokusekelwe ebufakazini kanye nentuthuko ephilayo; ukuphatha uhlelo namaphrojekthi: ukuphatha uhlelo namaphrojekthi ngokuphelele, kuhlanganise ukuhlela, ukwakheka, ukulawula, ukubika nokunciphisa ubungozi ukuze kuzuze izinhloso ezibekiwe zomkhakha namaphrojekthi; ukuQonda izimo: ukuqonda okuqinile kwezombusela, izimo zomhlaba, isifunda nakomasipala ezithinta ukusebenza kwaseWestern Cape kanye nemisebenzi yeminyango kahulumende wamaphrovinsi, ukuguqula ukuqonda kube ngumnikelo wokuxoxa ngezinhlelo; ukuNikela inkonzo kanye noBungqanduli: ikhono lokusebenzisa izimiso zolwazi nokwazi, okusekela ukwenza izinqumo ngakho okukhona iziqinisekiso, ukusebenza ngempumelelo, kanye nentuthuko ephilayo. Amakhono ezindaweni ezilandelayo: amakhono okuxhumana asagxile; ikhono elikhulu lokuhlela imikhuba, ukuyakha futhi kube khona ubuholi bokucabanga kwezinhlelo ezindida; ikhono lokuthumba nokukhokha; ubuholi, ukwakha amandla kanye namakhono okuhlobana; ukuhlela, ukuhluza, namakhono okuphatha abantu; ikhono elivezwa lokwenza imisebenzi eminingi ngesikhathi esisodwa, ukuphatha izimo ezingaqondakali kalula, nokusebenza ngempumelelo ezimweni ezentuka ngokushesha.
zu.duties: Ukuphatha uMgodla: Ukukhokhela, ukuguqula, nokuphatha izindawo zomkhakha kahulumende waseWestern Cape ezingagqamisa imibhalo yesigaba, inkinga kanye nohlelo lokuhlelwa kokuhlela amandla. Ukukhokhela ucwaningo, ukuhlaziya, kanye nokuqapha kwezomkhakha wemibhalo yesigaba kahulumende wamaphrovinsi ukuze kutholakale okungenwa yikhono lokuthi ukuthi wonke uhulumende nohlelo lomphakathi kanye namaphrojekthi ahle phansi ukuze kuqashwe ukuthi imibhalo yesigaba, inkinga nokuhlelwa kwemibhalo yebaradisi ukuqashwe ngendlela efanayo; ukuhlaziya izinhlelo zemibhalo yesigaba, inkinga, nomthetho wezindawo eziyikhombe (isb. umthetho wesigaba, umthetho, kanye nemithetho yomphakathi) ukuze kuhlolwe imiphumela yezinhlelo ze-WCG kanye nemisitho eveiswe ekubeni kwe-WCG kanye namaphrojekthi; ukuhlaziya ngokujulile izinhlelo zomkhakaba kanye nentuthuko ezijwayelekileyo; ukuhlaziya ngokuqhubekayo izinhlelo zomkhakha kahulumende nezindlela ezinkulu, kanye nokwazisa iKhabinephi, amakomidi nezinhlelo ngemiphumela yezindawo ezilandelayo; ukukhokhela ukwakhiwa kwemibhalo yesigaba kahulumende ngokomthetho njengoba kudingeka (kuhlanganise ukubonisana neziqukathi ezithintekile njengoba kudingeka); ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umthetho we-WCG, imibhalo kanye nezinhlelo zahambisana nohlelo lwe-Provincial Strategic Plan kanye namaphrojekthi amakhulu; ukukhokhela ukubuyekeza i-Provincial Strategic Plan ngesikhathi esibekiwe ngokuhambisana nezinhlelo zokuqashwa kwemali nezinqubo; ukwakha inkathi yesikhathi esizayo (isb. ukuskena kwendawo kanye nohlelo lwezimo) ekwakheni isu, imibhalo yesigaba, nokuhlela izinhlelo emazingeni ahlukene ngaphakathi komkhakha (okungukuthi, WCG, amaphothifoliyo, kanye namaphothifoliyo kanye namaphrojekthi) ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinqumo zokuqashwa zilinganiselwa ngokwezimo ezingaphandle ezezikho njengamanje nezedlule; ukukhokhela ukwakhiwa kwemibhalo yesigaba, izinhlelo kanye nezinhlelo zokuqashwa nokulethwa kwemisindana ukuze kuqashwe imisindana enezinsumu nokuqondisa izinqumo zokulawula nokungeniswa ezinhlelweni zokuphatha umsebenzi; ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umthetho we-WCG, imibhalo kanye nezinhlelo zahambisana nezimiso zamalungelo abantu kanye nezibopho zamalungelo abantu emhlabeni, ngomthethosisekelo kanye nangumthetho wezwe namalungelo abantu, imibhalo kanye nezinhlelo; ukunika ubuholi bokucabanga kanye nokuthamba ekuthomeni ngesikhathi sokudlula izinhlelo ezingangenwa yilabo abenza umsebenzi wezinhlelo, inkolo, nokulawula inkonzo yama-Portfolios, kanye nezenzelo ezisetshenziswa yiNkinga kanye nezinhlelo ezaholelwa. ukuphatha nokuHlela (kuhlanganise ukuphatha ushintsho): ukubeka ngokusobala nokubuyekeza njalo ngokwemisinga ukuthi kuqanjwe ngokokuqondisisa ukuze kuholele ekwenzeni imicimbi nangokuzenzakalela, ukuthi kwenziwe ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esibekiwe; ukuqondisisa kokuqanjwa kwemisebenzi ngokuhlela amandla nangokuhlela izinhlelo ekwakheni izinhlelo ngokomthetho; ukukhokhela ukwakhiwa nokuphathwa kwezinhlelo ezinkulu kanye nezinhlela ze-Directorate ngokuhlela izinhlelo ze-Directorate ngokuhlela izinhlelo; ukuhlaziya ngokuqhubekayo imisebenzi ye-Directorate ngokwenza izinhlela ngokuhamba kwesikhathi futhi ngokubika ngokuhamba kwesikhathi mayelana nezinswelo ezivezwe njengoba kudingeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imisebenzi ingabaliwa ngokuphelele ngokuhlela kabanzi imicimbi ehlezi iyisibopho kakhulu; ukubika ngokuvamile kuChief Director mayelana nemisebenzi ye-Directorate kanye nangemibuzo ebalulekile mayelana nokusekelwa kokuphatha imicimbi; ukuqapha futhi ukuqinisekisa ukuhambisana nomthetho kanye nezimiso ngokugqamisa imibhalo esebenzayo neefayela ezihlobene nemisebenzi ye-Directorate, kanye nezinsiza (abantu, imali, nezimpahla) ezisetshenziswa kuyo; ukukhulisa futhi ukukhuthaza inkholo yobuntu emphakathini we-Directorate, kanye neminyango; ukwenza ngokuyikho konke imisebenzi enikeziwe esikhundleni sikaDirektha. ukuphatha abaNtu kanye nokunikeza amandla: ukuthunga, ukukhulisa, nokugcina izisebenzi ngenombolo namazinga afanele ukuze kuzuze izinhloso ze-Directorate; ukukhuthaza,okuqeqesha, kanye nokuqondisa abasebenzi ukuze baqophelele emndenini wokuletha inkonzo; ukuphatha umsebenzi, ukuhlola, kanye nentuthuko yabasebenzi; ukuqapha ukuhlela amandla abasebenzi, ukwakhiwa kwamandla, kanye nokuqashwa kwezinhlelo zokwenza inkonzo; ukukhuthaza izibopho zomsebenzi ezinhle kanye nokugcina isiyalo ngaphakathi kwe-Directorate. ukuphatha iMali: ukuphatha ukuthatha inhlathi enkabeni yokuqashwa imali ye-Directorate, kuhlanganise ne-Bajeti yomnyaka kanye ne-Bajeti yokulungiselela; ukuthatha isibopho sokuphatha ngokusebenza kahle, ngokwezimali, nangokwemiphumela iholo le-Directorate kanye nemali ephuma kuyo; ukuqinisekisa ukuhambisana nezidingo zokuqashwa kwezinkomba ze-tender kanye nezinkomba zokuqashwa kwezinkomba; ukuqinisekisa ukuhambelana kwemali ephuma kwemibhalo ye-Directorate; ukubika ngemicimbi yemali kuChief Director kanye nezinhlelo ezithintekile; ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kulawulo lokuphatha ubungozi, ukuphatha izimpahla, kanye nokugcina imibhalo sekukona futhi kulandelwa.

xh.title: UmLawuli: Uphononongo lweNqulamba zeMigaqo kunye noNlwanjisio
xh.summary: UmLawuli woPhononongo lweNqulamba zeMigaqo kunye noNlwanjisio hleze iNkqubo yeNgaba seWestern Cape, efunwa ngemfuno NQF 7 unyaka woMfuno onganga kweminyaka emihlanu ezingeni eliphezulu lolawulo.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esifanelekileyo esezingeni le-NQF 7 njengakunqunywa yi-SAQA; Okungenani 5 iminyaka yamava ezingeni eliphakathi eliphezulu lolawulo. Ikhono: Ulwazi ngaloku kulandelayo: Inqanaba eliphezulu eliqinisekisiweyo lolawulo namava okwenza: uMthetho nokuLawula: Ukuqonda ngokujulile iinkqubo zanamhlanje zolawulo lokurhulumente koluntu, kuquka ukuqonda okupheleleyo ngamakhosi omthetho, esiseko-mthetho kunye namakhosi omanyano e-lawula ngqo urhulumente wesijam sesiNtshi saseSouth Africa, ngenkqubo yalo kumaphuzu abaluleke kakhulu kwiNkqubo yeNgaba seWestern Cape kwizixhobo zolwazi ibekwe kwindawo ekuyo; Amakhosi oLawulo: umThetho woLawulo lweMali zeRhulumente (PFMA), iMigaqo yoQoqosho lweSizwe nakwiPhondo, umThetho woBudlelwano beBasebenzi, namagqabantshintshi ngemali, namanye amagqabantshintshi omlawulo, imiyalelo namanyaniso esigqeba, enza ubungqina bokugcina ukuze kuqhubeke, ulawulo lwengozi, nalolawulo olulungileyo ngokwenza konke oku goodishone noQoqosho loLwazi; uLawulo oluQhuba phambili: Ukuluntu koluhlu lomthetho, ukucwangcisa amabalana, ukwenzisa ukuqatshulwa, nokuphonononga iinkqubo ezisisa iziphakamiso zophando nemigqisio karhulamente; uLawulo lweMali: ulawulo lwemali karhulumente, iinkqubo zokuThenga nokuHamba nemigqisio yolawulo koluntu nakunxibelelwano; uLawulo lweSizwe nakwamava: Amapaki azo nazoni zonke ukuba namava ekulawulweni koluntu, ekuhaniseni iqela nakwiinkqubo zokuZenza iziphumo ukuze kuqhubeke kubekho inqanaba nokuze kubeke iimpumelelo; Amacebo oLawulo neenkqubo: iinkqubo karhulumente, iinkqubo zolawulo lweziphumo, kunye neenkqubo zolwazi nolwazi osekwe kuzo, ukugcina ukuze kusebenze ngokuchanekileyo, ukwenza izigqibo ezisekelwe kubungqina nokuqhubekezela phambili ngokungadingiyo; uLawulo lweenkqubo namaPhojekthi: uLawulo lwangaphambili nangasese lweekqubo namaphojekthi, kuquka ukucwangcisa, ukwenza, ukulawula, ukubika nokuqonda iingozi ukuze kufikelelwe kumaphuzu abaluleke kakhulu ekwenzeni iziphakamiso nasekuLawulweni; Ukuqonda imeko ephilwa kuyo: Ukuqonda ngokunyuka ngamandla iimeko ezingamazwe ngamazwe, ngasemazantsi nakwezinye iindawo, ezenza ngokutsha iWestern Cape nangokusebenza koluntu kwamasebe karhulumente weephondo, luguqule ibe ngolwazi osekwe kulo lwalamano oluncedo; ukuZekelela nokuQamba: ukuba namandla ekulawulweni nasekuLawulweni kolwazi ekusekweni kwezigqibo ezisekelwe kubungqina, ekusebenzeni ngokuchanekileyo, nakokuQhuba phambili ngokungadingiyo. Amandla ngalawa: Amandla okuluma okusebenzayo; Amandla amakhulu okuqumba, ukwakha nokubonisa inqanaba eliphezulu lokucinga kwindawo ezinzima kakhulu ezisetyenziswayo; Amandla okuthembisa nokunika amandla; Amandla okulawula, ukuqamba iqela nokuba nolwazi oluncedo nabantu; Amandla okucwangcisa, ukuqamba nokuLawula abantu; Amandla aqinisekisiweyo okwenza izinto ezininzi, ukulawula iimeko ezingaqondiyo, nokusebenza ngokuchanekileyo kwindawo ezingatshintsha ngokukhawuleza.
xh.duties: ULawulo ngomgca: ukulawula, luguqule, ulawule amaphuzu obugcisa bomthetho, isicwangciso nakunxibelelwano ngokubeka izicwangciso phambili eNkqubweni yeNgaba seWestern Cape. Lulule uphononongo, uNlwanjisio, nokuhlola imeko yomthetho weephondo ukuze kwazwe

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Skills Development Facilitation
jobs.centre: Department of the Premier, Western Cape Government.
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 - R1 098 195 per annum (Level 11), (all-inclusive salary package)
jobs.summary: Deputy Director role in the Western Cape Government managing skills development facilitation across 11 departments, including skills analysis and SETA liaison.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate 3-year National Diploma/B-Degree (equivalent or higher qualification); A minimum of 3 years middle management experience. Competencies: Knowledge of the following: Policy development and implementation; National and Provincial legislation and instruments pertaining to human resource management; Human Resource Development Legislation, prescripts and directives. Skills in the following: Computer literacy in MS Office Package (Word, Excel, PowerPoint); Ability to work independently and as part of a team; Communication skills (written and verbal); Analytical skills; Strategic thinking; Ability to analyse, conceptualise and implement policy; Monitoring, evaluation and reporting; Presentation skills; Problem solving; Research; Conflict resolution.
jobs.duties: Manage the sub-directorate responsible for the following for 11 WCG departments: Skills needs analysis, human resource development compliance reports (e.g. the Workplace Skills Plans), liaison with SETA’s and other statutory agencies, facilitation and establishment of Skills Development and Bursary committees (HRD Committees), assess the impact of skills development interventions, fostering of people development partnerships and the administration of the Provincial Human Resource Development Forum; Perform managerial functions regarding the sub-directorate e.g. recruitment and selection of employees, motivate, train and guide employees, performance management of employees, monitor information capacity building, promote sound labour practices; Operational management of team – allocate duties, monitor outcomes and institute corrective measures to address deviations from standards and determine workflow; Give strategic direction to and manage policy issues.

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Fasilitering van Vaardigheidsonwikkeling
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur-pos by die Western Cape Government wat die fasilitering van vaardigheidsonwikkeling oor 11 departemente bestuur, insluitend vaardighedsontleding en SETA-liaison.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike 3-jaar Nasionale Diploma/B-Degree (ekwivalent of hoër kwalifikasie); 'n Minimum van 3 jaar bestuurservaring op middelvlak. Bevoegdhede: Kennis van die volgende: Beleidsonwikkeling en -implementering; Nasionale en Provinsiale wetgewing en instrumente met betrekking tot menslike hulpbronbestuur; Menslike Hulpbronontwikkelingswetgewing, voorskrifte en richtlyne. Vaardighede in die volgende: Rekenaarvaardigheid in MS Office Package (Word, Excel, PowerPoint); Vermoë om onafhanklik en as deel van 'n span te werk; Kommunikasievaardighede (skriftelik en mondelings); Analitiese vaardighede; Strategiese denke; Vermoë om beleid te ontleed, te konseptualiseer en te implementeer; Monitering, evaluering en verslagdoening; Voorleggingsvaardighede; Probleemoplossing; Navorsing; Konflikoplossing.
af.duties: Bestuur die sub-direktoraat wat verantwoordelik is vir die volgende vir 11 WCG-departeente: Vaardigheidsbehoeftesontleding, nakomingsverslae oor menslike hulpbronontwikkeling (bv. die Workplace Skills Plans), skakeling met SETA's en ander statutêre agentskappe, fasilitering en instelling van Vaardigheidsonwikkelings- en Beurskomitees (HRD-komitees), assessering van die impak van vaardigheidsonwikkelingsintervensies, bevordering van vennootskappe vir mense-ontwikkeling en die administrasie van die Provinsiale Menslike Hulpbronontwikkelingsforum; Verrig bestuursfunksies met betrekking tot die sub-direktoraat, bv. werwing en keuring van werknemers, motivering, opleiding en begeleiding van werknemers, prestasiebestuur van werknemers, monitering van inligtingskapasiteitsbou, bevordering van gesonde arbeidspraktyke; Operasionele bestuur van die span – wys take toe, monitor uitkomste en instelle korrektiewe maatreëls om afwykings van standaarde aan te spreek en bepaal werksvloei; Verskaf strategiese rigting en bestuur beleidsake.

Amakhono alandelayo: Ukusebenza ngekhompyuthha kwinkqubo ye-MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint); Amandla okusebenza kodwa nakwinqanaba leqela; Amakhono okunxibelelana (okubhaliweyo nokuThethwa); Amakhono oLwaziLwimiso; Ukucinga ngokwezimiso; Amandla okuhlalutya, okuqamba ngokucinga nokusebenzisa iinkqubo; Okwexhala, isiqendu samagunya neemvume; amakhono okubonisa ngesiphithiphithi; Ukusombulula iingxaki; uphando; ukusombulula iingxaki.

jobs.summary: Social worker needed to provide care, support, protection and development services to older persons across multiple salary grades within the Western Cape.
jobs.requirements: A relevant tertiary qualification in Social Work (Bachelor of Social Work) that allows professional registration with the South African Council for Social Service Professions as Social Worker; Registration with the South African Council for Social Service Professions as a Social Worker; Grade 1: No experience; Grade 2: A minimum of 10 years appropriate experience in Social Work after registration as a Social Worker with the South African Council for Social Service Professions; Grade 3: A minimum of 20 years appropriate experience in Social Work after registration as a Social Worker with the South African Council for Social Service Professions; Grade 4: A minimum of 30 years appropriate experience in Social Work after registration as a Social Worker with the South African Council for Social Service Professions. Competencies: Knowledge of the following: Supervision Framework for Social Workers; Human behaviour and social systems and skills to intervene at the points where people interact with their environments in order to promote social well-being; Social work theory and interventions; Information and Knowledge Management; Protocol and professional ethics; Relevant legislations, policies and prescripts (norms and standards); Social dynamics, work values and principles; Developing and empowering others. af.title: Maatskaplike Werker: Bejaardes
af.summary: Maatskaplike werker benodig om sorg-, ondersteunings-, beskermings- en ontwikkelingsdienste aan bejaardes oor verskeie salarisklasse binne die Western Cape te bied.
af.requirements: 'n Tersiêre kwalifikasie in Maatskaplike Werk (Baccalaureus in Maatskaplike Werk) wat professionele registrasie by die Suid-Afrikaanse Raad vir Maatskaplike Diensprofessies as Maatskaplike Werker moontlik maak; Registrasie by die Suid-Afrikaanse Raad vir Maatskaplike Diensprofessies as Maatskaplike Werker; Graad 1: Geen ervaring nie; Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar toepaslike ervaring in Maatskaplike Werk na registrasie as Maatskaplike Werker by die Suid-Afrikaanse Raad vir Maatskaplike Diensprofessies; Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 20 jaar toepaslike ervaring in Maatskaplike Werk na registrasie as Maatskaplike Werker by die Suid-Afrikaanse Raad vir Maatskaplike Diensprofessies; Graad 4: 'n Minimum van 30 jaar toepaslike ervaring in Maatskaplike Werk na registrasie as Maatskaplike Werker by die Suid-Afrikaanse Raad vir Maatskaplike Diensprofessies. Bevoegdhede: Kennis van die volgende: Toesighoudende Raamwerk vir Maatskaplike Werkers; Menslike gedrag en sosiale stelsels en vaardighede om in te gryp by die punte waar mense met hul omgewings in wisselwerking tree om sosiale welsyn te bevorder; Maatskaplike werksteorie en ingrypings; Inligting- en kennisbestuur; Protokol en professionele etiek; Ter sake wetgewing, beleide en voorskrifte (norme en standaarde); Sosiale dinamika, werkswaardes en beginsels; Ontwikkeling en bemagtiging van ander. Vaardighede in die volgende: Daag strukturele bronne van armoede, ongelykheid, onderdrukking, diskriminasie en uitsluiting uit; Geskrewe en mondelinge kommunikasie; Verslagskrywing; Selfbestuur; Motivering; Goed beplanning en organisering; Probleemoplossing en analities; Rekenaarvaardigheid; Voorlegging en fasilitering; Kliëntgerigtheid en kledifokus; Vermoe en bevoegdheid om individue, gesinne, groepe, organisasies en gemeenskappe by te staan, te ontwikkel, vir hulle op te tree en hulle te bemagtig om hul sosiale funksionering en probleemoplossingsvermoëns te verbeter; Vermoe om die funksionering van individue, gesinne, groepe en gemeenskappe te bevorder, te herstel, te handhaaf, daarvoor op te tree en te verbeter deur hulle in staat te stel om take te voltooi, lyding te voorkom en te verlig en hulpbronne doeltreffend te gebruik; Begrip en vermoe om maatskaplike werkdienste te lewer ter beskerming van mense wat kwesbaar, in gevaar en nie in staat is om hulself te beskerm nie; Vermoe om Maatskaplike Werkers Graad 1 te mentor en af te rig; 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie (Kode B of hoër). af.duties: Lewer 'n maatskaplike werkdiens ten opsigte van die sorg, ondersteuning, beskerming en ontwikkeling van kwesbare individue, groepe, gesinne, gemeenskappe en organisasies deur middel van die tersaaklike programme; Woon enige ander aangeleenthede by wat tot, of voortspruit uit, sosiale onstabiliteit in enige vorm kan lei; Dit sal die volgende aksies insluit; Nuwe aansoek (Voor befondsing): Terreine-monitering; Monitering van NPO's nakoming teen ondertekende Oordragsbetalings-ooreenkoms (TPA); Evalueer NPO's nakoming teen Wetgewende, Programspesifieke en Generiese Norme en Standaarde; Gevallewes, Telefonies, Ministeriële klagteproses (Nie van toepassing op ECD nie); Groepwerk (Nie van toepassing op ECD nie); Gemeenskapswerk, Organisasie; Monitering van die implementering van die Dienslewering Verbeteringsplan waar vordering onbevredigend is (insluitend Pleegsorgbestuur); Vinnige reaksie na klagte/navrae oor NPO's, of 'n bekommernis deur 'n program uitgespreek (insluitend Pleegsorgbestuur); Verseker nakoming van registrasievereistes van NPO's (regulerende raamwerke); Deurlopende Professionele Ontwikkeling; Bly op hoogte van nuwe ontwikkelings in die velde van maatskaplike werk en sosiale welsyn; Voer al die administratiewe funksies uit wat die werk vereis.

zu.title: Umsebenzi Wezomphakathi: Abantu Abadala
zu.summary: Kudingeka umsebenzi wezomphakathi ukunikeza izinsiza zokunakekela, ukusekela, ukuvikela kanye nentuthuko kubantu abadala kuzo zonke izinga zeholo ngaphakathi kwe-Western Cape.

zu.duties: Nikela insiza yezomphakathi mayelana nokunakekela, ukusekela, ukuvikela kanye nentuthuko yabantu abasengozini, amaqembu, izindlu, imiphakathi kanye nezinhlangano ngohlelo olufanelekile; Ukunakela noma yikuphi okunye okungaholela, okuholelwe yikho, noma okuvela kuyo ukungalunga kwempilo yomphakathi nanoma isiphi isimo; Lokhu kuhambisana nezinyathelo ezilandelayo; Isicelo esisha (Pre funding): Ukulawula kwesikhungo; Ukulawula ukuziphatha kwe-NPOs okuhambisana nesivumelwanookuKhushulwa kweHhovisi (TPA) esisayiniwe; Ukukalisisa ukuziphatha kwe-NPOs okuhambisana nomthetho, ohlelo olukhethekile kanye namazinga angaphelele; Ukusebenza ngamacala, ngocingo, inqubo yokudlulisa izikhalazo kuMinista (Ayifakiwe kwi-ECD); Ukusebenza ngamaqembu (Ayifakiwe kwi-ECD); Ukusebenza komphakathi, inhlangano; Ukulawula ukuqashwa kohlelo lwe-Service Delivery Improvement Plan lapho inqubo ihamba kabi (kuhlanganise nokuphathwa kwe-Foster Care); Ukuphendula ngokushesha emva kwesikhalazo/imibuzo mayelana ne-NPOs, noma inkombiso etholakala kuhlelo (kuhlanganise nokuphathwa kwe-Foster Care); Qinisekisa ukuziphatha kwezidingo zokubhalisa kwe-NPO (izinsiza zokulawula); Ukuthuthukiswa kobungcali ngokupheleleyo; Hlala uphaduze ngentuthuko entsha ezinkundleni zomphakathi nokuzelelwa kwempilo yomphakathi; Wenze yonke imisebenzi yokuqasha edingekile kulesi sikhundla.

af.duties: : Lewer 'n maatskaplikewerkdiens met betrekking tot die sorg, ondersteuning, beskerming en ontwikkeling van kwesbare individue, groepe, gesinne, gemeenskappe en organisasies deur middel van die relevante programme; Woon enige ander aangeleenthede by wat tot, of voortspruit uit, sosiale onstabiliteit in enige vorm kan lei; Dit sal die volgende aksies insluit; Nuwe aansoek (Voor-finansiering): Terreinmonitering; Monitering van NPO's se nakoming teen ondertekende Transfer Payment Agreement (TPA); Evalueer NPO's se nakoming teen Wetgewende, Programspesifieke en Generiese Norme en Standaarde; Gevallew werk, Telefonies, Ministeriële klagteproses (Nie van toepassing op ECD nie); Groepwerk (Nie van toepassing op ECD nie); Gemeenskapswerk, Organisasie; Monitering van die implementering van die Diensleweringverbeteringsplan waar vorderings onbevredigend is (insluitend Pleegsorgbestuur); Vinnige reaksie na afloop van 'n klagte/navrae oor NPO's, of 'n bekommernis wat deur 'n program geopper is (insluitend Pleegsorgbestuur); Verseker nakoming van registrasievereistes van NPO's (regulerende raamwerke); Deurlopende Professionele Ontwikkeling; Hou tredend met nuwe ontwikkelings in die maatskaplikewerk- en maatskaplike welsynsvelde; Voer al die administratiewe funksies uit wat vir die werk vereis word.

zu.title: Umsebenzi Wabezomphakathi: Amathuluzi Abantu Abakhubazekile
zu.summary: Kudingeka umsebenzi wabezomphakathi ukuze anikeze ukunakekelwa, ukusekela kanye namathuluzi okuvikela abantu abaswela inkinga ngaphakathi kwe-Western Cape Government.
zu.requirements: Itholakala kule mininingwane eqinisekisiwe yokuthuthuka emkhakheni Womsebenzi Wabezomphakathi (Bachelor of Social Work) evumela ukubhalisa njengomsebenzi wabezomphakathi kwi-South African Council for Social Service Professions njengomsebenzi wabezomphakathi; Ukubhaliswa kwi-South African Council for Social Service Professions njengomsebenzi wabezomphakathi; Isibalo 1: Asikho isiphephelo; Isibalo 2: Isiphephelo esincane seminyaka eyi-10 kule mininingwane efanele yokuthuthuka emkhakheni Womsebenzi Wabezomphakathi emva kokubhaliswa njengomsebenzi wabezomphakathi kwi-South African Council for Social Service Professions; Isibalo 3: Isiphephelo esincane seminyaka eyi-20 kule mininingwane efanele yokuthuthuka emkhakheni Womsebenzi Wabezomphakathi emva kokubhaliswa njengomsebenzi wabezomphakathi kwi-South African Council for Social Service Professions; Isibalo 4: Isiphephelo esincane seminyaka eyi-30 kule mininingwane efanele yokuthuthuka emkhakheni Womsebenzi Wabezomphakathi emva kokubhaliswa njengomsebenzi wabezomphakathi kwi-South African Council for Social Service Professions. Iziqu eziyisidingo: Ulwazi ngokulandelayo: Umqondo wokulawula iwebhusayithi yomsebenzi wabezomphakathi; Ukuziphatha kwabantu kanye nesimo somphakathi, kanye nezakhono zokungena emabalabathini abahlangana nezimo zabo ukuze bathuthukise impilo yomphakathi; Ithiyori yomsebenzi wabezomphakathi kanye nokuqashwa kokuthuthukiswa kolwazi; Ithiyori yomsebenzi wabezomphakathi; Ulwazi kanye nokuphathwa kolwazi; Umthetho wokuziphatha nobungcweti; Umthetho othintekayo, izinqubomgomo namaphuzu; Isimo somphakathi, amagugu nomqondo wokusebenza; Ukuthuthukisa kanye nokunyusa amandla abanye. Izakhono ezilandelayo: Ukuphikisana nezimbangela ezingumthetho zenkinga yenkimbo, ezingalingani, ezingacinywa ngokulinganisa amandla, eziqashwa nasekuqashweni kolimi; Isikhala kanye nentuthuko kolwazi; Ulwazi kolwazi kanye nokuqashwa kolwazi; Isibonakaliso ngokusho kwesibonakaliso; Isibonakaliso ngokusho kwamandla; Ukuzibusa; Ukuzikhandla; Uhlelo oluhle nemibuzo ehle; Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya; Ukufunda ngokusebenzisa ikhompyutha; Isibonakaliso nokudluliswa kolwazi; Ukumisela umthombo wamatholana abathengi ukubakhuthaza; Ulwazi nokusebenzisa amandla okusiza, ukuthuthukisa, ukumela, kanye nokunyusa amandla abantu, imindeni, amaqembu, izinhlangano kanye nemiphakathi ukuba bakwazi ukusebenza kahle kakhulu kanye nokuxazulula izinkinga; Ukusebenzisa ulwazi, ukuletha, ukugcina, ukumela nokunyusa amandla okusebenza komuntu, imindeni, amaqembu kanye nemiphakathi ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi bakwazi ukufeza imisebenzi, ukuvikela nokunciphisa inkinga nokusebenzisa izinsiza ngokusebenzisa ulwazi; Ukuziswa kokuthi abantu abasengozini, abasengozini, abangenakho amandla okuzivikela baye kwezinsiza ezingezona ngokomthetho; Isibonakaliso ngokusho kwamandla; Isibonakaliso ngokusho kwesibonakaliso; Ukuba nesibonakaliso ngokusho kwesibonakaliso; Ukuba nokuqinisekiswa kwamathuluzi afanele ukusiza, ukuthuthukisa, ukumela kanye nokunyusa amandla kwabanye; Ulwazi kanye nokusebenzisa amandla okusiza, ukuthuthukisa, ukumela kanye nokunyusa amandla abantu, imindeni, amaqembu, izinhlangano nemiphakathi ukuthuthukisa ukusebenza kwabo komphakathi kanye namandla okuxazulula izinkinga; Isibonakaliso sokuqashwa kwamathuluzi afanele ukuba ngumphathi wokudlulisela amakhono omsebenzi wabezomphakathi Wezinga 1; Isibonakaliso esiqinisekile (Code B noma ngaphezulu) sokushayela. ABAHLALEKI: Abantu abaswela inkinga yokushayela, kodwa abakwazi ukuthola izinsiza ezifanele zokuhamba, banganako futhi ukufaka isicelo.
zu.duties: Nikeza isevisi yomsebenzi wabezomphakathi mayelana nokunakekelwa, ukusekela, ukuvikela kanye nentuthuko yabantu abasengozini, amaqembu, imindeni, imiphakathi kanye nenhlangano ngokusebenzisa izinhlela ezifanele; Nxanela nanoma yisiphi isimo esingabanga noma esiholela ekungazinzeni kwesimo somphakathi nganoma yisiphi isimo; Lokhu kuzohlanganisa izenzo ezilandelayo; Isicelo esisha (Ngaphambi kokuxhaswa): Okwelulekwa okwenziwa embonweni; Ukubheka ukuzinza kwezinhlangano ezingekho ngaphansi kuhulumeni (NPO) ngokumelene nesivumelwano esibhalwe ngokushintshanisa imali (TPA); Hlola ukuzinza kwe-NPO ngokumelene nemithetho, izinhlela ezithile kanye namaphuzu njalo namazinga; Umsebenzi wezimo, ngocingo, inqubo yokuphathwa kwezikhalazo eziya kungeNduna (Akusebenzi ku-ECD); Umsebenzi weqembu (Akusebenzi ku-ECD); Umsebenzi womphakathi, inhlangano; Ukubheka ukuqashwa kwenqubo yeSicelo Sokuthuthukiswa Kokulethwa Kwezenkonzela lapho inqubo ihamba kancane (kuhlanganise Nokuphathwa Kwezingane Eziyisolwa); Ukusabela ngokushesha ngemuva kwesikhalazo/imibuzo ngama-NPO, noma inkathazo ethuliswe uhlelo (kuhlanganise Nokuphathwa Kwezingane Eziyisolwa); Qinisekisa ukuzinza nezidingo zokubhaliswa kwezinhlangano ezingekho ngaphansi kuhulumeni (NPO) (izakhiwo zomthetho); Ukuthuthukiswa kobungcweti ngokuqhubekayo; Gcina uthotho kanye nentuthuko entsha emkhakheni womsebenzi wabezomphakathi kanye nenzelomphakathi; Yenza yonke imisebenzi yolawulo edingiwe umsebenzi.

xh.title: Umsebenzi Wokwuncedwa: Iinkonzo Kubantu Abanokuphazamiseka komzimba
xh.summary: Kufuneka kubekho umsebenzi wokwuncedwa ukubonelela ngeenkonzo zokukhathalela, ukuxhasa nokukhusla abantu abanokuphazamiseka komzimba ngaphakathi kurhulumente we Western Cape.
xh.requirements: Iziqu ezifanelekileyo ezisezinqanaba eliphezulu kumsebenzi wokwuncedwa (Bachelor of Social Work) ezivumela ukuqeshwa njengomsebenzi wokwuncedwa kwi South African Council for Social Service Professions; Ukuqeshwa kwi South African Council for Social Service Professions njengomsebenzi wokwuncedwa; Inqanaba 1: Akukho nalunye uhloliso; Inqanaba 2: Ubuncinane beminyaka elingu-10 yohloliso olufanelekileyo kumsebenzi wokwuncedwa emva kokuqeshwa njengomsebenzi wokwuncedwa kwi South African Council for Social Service Professions; Inqanaba 3: Ubuncinane beminyaka elingu-20 yohloliso olufanelekileyo kumsebenzi wokwuncedwa emva kokuqeshwa njengomsebenzi wokwuncedwa kwi South African Council for Social Service Professions; Inqanaba 4: Ubuncinane beminyaka elingu-30 yohloliso olufanelekileyo kumsebenzi wokwuncedwa emva kokuqeshwa njengomsebenzi wokwuncedwa kwi South African Council for Social Service Professions. Ikhono: Ulwazi ngokuqonda kwemizekelo: Framework for Social Workers; Ukuziphatha kwabantu neendlela zentlalo kunye nemisebenzi yokungenelela kwindawo abantu abasebenzelana nemvelo apho ukuze bagqithise impilo entle; Itheory nomsebenzi wokwuncedwa; Ulawulo lolwazi nolwazi; Protokholi neziga ezisemthethweni; Imithetho, iinkqubo nemigaqo; Iintshukumo zentlalo, amaxabiso nomisebenzi; Ukuphucula nokuqeqesha abanye. Ulwazi lokwenza: Ukujonga iindonga ezibangela ubuswelwana, ukungalingani, ukucindzela, ukwahlukanisa nokwahlula; Unxibelelwano ngesibheno nangolwimi; Ukubhala iingxelo; Ukuzilawula; Ukuzimisela; Ukucwangcisa nokuhlela; Ukusombulula iingxaki; Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha; Okubekwe kumngenelo; Ukuqonda abathengi; Ikhono lokunceda, ukuphucula, ukhululeke nokuqinisa abantu, usapho, amaqela, iintlanganiso namasango ukuze kuphuculwe iinkonzo zentlalo; Ikhono lokugqithisa, ukubuyisa, ukugcina, nokukhusla ukusebenza kweziko nomasango; Ukusiya kwangaphambili ekukhusleni abantu abasengozini; Ikhono lokukhokela nokuqeqesha i Grade 1; Ilayisensi yokushqa (Code B nangaphezulu).
xh.duties: Bonezela iinkonzo zokwuncedwa mayela nokukhathalela, ukuxhasa, ukukhusla nokuqhuba abantu abasengozini, amaqela, usapho, iintlanganiso namasango; Jonga nayiphi na enye into engayiveza, okanye evela kwindida yentlalo; Oku kuya kuqulatha iintshukumo ezilandelayo; Isicelo esitsha (Pre funding): On-Site Monitoring; Ukujonga ukuziphatha kwamagatya eNPO (TPA); Ukujonga ukuziphatha kweNPO ngokomthetho, iinkqubo namagatya; Iinkonzo, iingxelo, iingxelo zomphathi (Akubandelexi kwi ECD); Umsebenzi weqela (Abuyileli kwi ECD); Umsebenzi wentsapho, intlanganiso; Ukujonga ukuphumeza iNkqubo yokuphucula iinkonzo (kuqulathe iFoster Care); Impendulo ekhawulezayo ngemibuzo nangengxaki yeNPO (kuqulathe iFoster Care); Qinisekisa ukuziphatha ngokwemigaqo yokubhalisa iNPO; Ukuphucula ulwazi lwemisebenzi; Hlala uvuselela ulwazi ngemisebenzi yamva nje; Yenza yonke imisebenzi yokulawula edingekayo.

jobs.title: Administration Clerk: Children and Families
jobs.centre: Department of Social Development, Western Cape Government.
jobs.summary: Administration clerk needed to provide general clerical support services, including data capture, record management and handling routine enquiries for the Department of Social Development.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 (Senior Certificate or equivalent qualification). Competencies: Knowledge of the following: Clerical duties, practices as well as the ability to capture data, operate computer and collecting statistics; Understanding of the legislative framework governing the Public Service; Working procedures in terms of the working environment. Skills in the following: Numeracy; Literacy; Presentation; Decision-Making; Computer Literacy; Good written and communication; Interpersonal; Flexibility; Planning and Organising.
jobs.duties: Render general administration support services: Record, organise, store, capture and retrieve correspondence and data(Line function); Update registers and statistics; Handle routine enquiries; Make photocopies and receive or send correspondence; Distribute documents/packages to various stakeholders as required; Keep and maintain the filing system for the component; Type letters and/or other correspondence when required; Keep and maintain the incoming and outgoing document register of the component; Receive, document and distribute of all incoming mail and documents. Provide supply chain clerical support services within the Chief Directorate: Liaise with internal and external stakeholders in relation to procurement of goods and service; Obtain quotations, complete procurement forms for the purchasing of standard office items; Stock control of office stationery; Keep and maintain the asset register of the component. Provide personnel administration clerical support services: Maintain a leave register for the Chief Directorate; Keep and maintain personnel records in the Chief Directorate; Keep and maintain the attendance register of the Chief Directorate; Arrange travel and accommodation. Provide financial administration support service in the Component: Capture and update expenditure; Check correctness of subsistence and travel claims of the officials and submit to the management for approval; Handle telephone accounts and petty cash for the component.
jobs.applications: Only applications submitted online will be accepted. To apply submit your application online only: via http://www.westerncape.gov.za/jobs or https://westerncapegov.erecruit.co
jobs.notes: Shortlisted candidates will be required to attend interviews on a date and time determined by the department and submit documentation for verification purposes and criminal record vetting. All shortlisted candidates shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The selection process will be guided by the EE targets of the employing department. By applying for this position, you are consenting to the Western Cape Government contacting your previous employers/managers for an employment reference. Reference checks will include enquiries relating to your disciplinary records and reasons for leaving. Should you experience difficulties with your online application, technical support is available from Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 16.00. Contact the helpline at 086 137 0214. For all other queries relating to the position, kindly contact the enquiries person as indicated in the advert. Please ensure that you submit your application before the closing date as no late applications will be considered. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Administrasieklerk: Kinder en Gesinne
af.summary: Administrasieklerk benodig om algemene klerklike ondersteuningsdienste te verskaf, insluitend data vaslegging, rekordbestuur en die hantering van roetine-navrae vir die Department of Social Development.
af.requirements: Graad 12 (Senior Certificate of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie). Bevoegdhede: Kennis van die volgende: Klerklike pligte, praktyke asook die vermoë om data vas te lê, 'n rekenaar te bedryf en statistieke te versamel; Begrip van die wetgewende raamwerk wat die Openbare Diens regeer; Werkprosedures ten opsigte van die werksomgewing. Vaardighede in die volgende: Geletterdheid in wiskunde; Geletterdheid; Voorlegging; Besluitneming; Rekenaarvaardigheid; Goed skriftelik en kommunikasie; Tussenumtelik; Buigsaamheid; Beplanning en Organisering.
af.duties: Lewer algemene administratiewe ondersteuningsdienste: Rekord, organiseer, berg, vang vas en onttrek korrespondensie en data(Lynfunksie); Werk registers en statistieke by; Hanteer roetine-navrae; Maak fotostate en ontvang of stuur korrespondensie; Versprei dokumente/pakkies aan verskeie belanghebbendes soos vereis; Hou en onderhou die lêerstelsel vir die komponent; Tik briewe en/of ander korrespondensie wanneer vereis; Hou en onderhou die inkomende en uitgaande dokumentregister van die komponent; Ontvang, dokumenteer en versprei alle inkomende pos en dokumente. Verskaf toeleweringsketting klerklike ondersteuningsdienste binne die Hoofdirektoraat: Skakel met interne en eksterne belanghebbendes i.v.m. die verkryging van goedere en dienste; Verkry kwotasies, voltooi verkrygingsvorms vir die aankoop van standaard kantooritems; Voorraadbeheer van kantoorstasie; Hou en onderhou die bate-register van die komponent. Verskaf personeeladministrasie klerklike ondersteuningsdienste: Onderhou 'n verlofregister vir die Hoofdirektoraat; Hou en onderhou personeelrekords in die Hoofdirektoraat; Hou en onderhou die bywoningsregister van die Hoofdirektoraat; Rël reis en akkommodasie. Verskaf finansiële administrasie ondersteuningsdienste in die Komponent: Vang vas en werk besteding by; Kontroleer die korrektheid van bestuurs- en reistoeval van die amptenare en dien in by bestuur vir goedkeuring; Hanteer telefoonrekeninge en kleingeld vir die komponent.

zu.title: Ikhilikhi Lokuphathwa Kwezindaba: Abantwana Nemindeni
zu.summary: Kudingeka ikhilikhi lokuphathwa kwezindaba ezinikeza izinsizakusebenza ezijwayelekile zokuphathwa kwezindaba, okuhlanganisa ukungenisa idatha, ukuphathwa kwegumbi lokulondoloza amarekhodi nokuphatha imibuzo evamile kumnyango weSocial Development.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 (Isitifiketi Samabanga Aphakeme noma iziqu ezilinganayo). Ikhono: Ulwazi ngalokhu okulandelayo: Imisebenzi yokuphathwa kwezindaba, izindlela zokwenza umsebenzi kanye nenhlelo yokungenisa idatha, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuqoqa izibalo; Ukuqonda uhlelo lokusebenza olulawula Imphakathi; Izindlela zokusebenza ngokomthetho wendawo yokusebenza. Amakhono okulandelayo: Ukubala; Ukuqamba; Okubonwayo; Ukuthatha Izinqumo; Ukwazi Ukusebenzisa Ikhompyutha; Okuhle okubhaliwe nokuthintana; Ukuhlobana; Ukuhlukana nokuhambisana; Ukucubungula nokuhlela.
zu.duties: Nikela izinsizakusebenza ezijwayelekile zokuphathwa kwezindaba: Qamba, hlela, gcina, faka futhi uthole okubhaliwe nedayitha(Inkokhiso); Buyekeza amarejista nezibalo; Phatha imibuzo evamile; Yenza amakhophi wokwenzelela futhi wamukele noma uthumela okubhaliwe; Yabelana amadokhumenti/amaphakheji kubahlaleni bezingxenye ezahlukene njengoko kudingekile; Gcina futhi ulondoloze uhlelo lokufaka amafayela elenyeni; Bhala amagama neminye imibhalo lapho kudingeka khona; Gcina futhi ulondoloze ukubhalisa kwamafayela angena futhi aphuma alenyeni; Thola, bhala futhi wahlukanisela yonke imeyili namadokhumenti angene. Nikeza izinsizakusebenza zokuphathwa kwentengiselwano mhlangothi ohlelwe ngaphakathi: Xhumana nabahlali bangekhaya nangaphandle mayelana nokuthenga impahla kanye nezinsizakulo; Thola izinkokhelo, gcwalisa amafomu okuthenga impahla evamise kwofisi; Lawula isitokhwe sempahla yofisi; Gcina futhi ulondoloze ukubhalisa kwempahla elenyeni. Nikeza izinsizakusebenza zokuphathwa kwezomphathi: Gcina irejista lokuhamba kwabasebenzi ohlelweni oluphethwe yikhandela elikhulu; Gcina futhi ulondoloze amarekhodi abasebenzi ohlelweni oluphethwe yikhandela elikhulu; Gcina futhi ulondoloze irejista lokubakhona ohlelweni oluphethwe yikhandela elikhulu; Hlela ukuhamba nokuhlala. Nikeza izinsizakusebenza zokuphathwa kwezimali Lenyeni: Faka futhi buyekeza izimali ezikhishiwe; Hlola ukuthi yini okulungile emasweni okuhamba nokuhlala abasebenzi bese ethunyelwa ebulungweni ukuba athumele; Phatha amakhonti efoni natholakala okuncane lenyeni.

xh.title: Ikhlerk Lolawulo: Abantwana Neentsapho
xh.summary: Kufuneka ikhlerk wolawulo onikeze iinkonzo ezixhaswayo jikelele zolawulo, kuquka ukuthatha iingcombolo, ulawulo lwerekhodi nokuphathwa kwemibuzo eqhelekileyo kwiSebe leZentlalo Zacho.
xh.requirements: Isiqulatho samabanga si-12 (Isetifiketi esiphezulu okanye isigaba esilinganayo). Ikhono: Ulwazi ngokuqonda: Imisebenzi yolawulo, iindlela zokwenza umsebenzi nakanjani n amandla okuthatha iingcombolo, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuqokelela izibalo; Ukuqonda kwesakhokelo sezomthetho esilawula Inkonzo kaRhulumente; Iindlela zokusebenza ngokommandla wokusebenza. Amakhono aqhubekayo: Ukubala; Ukufunda nokubhala; Okubonwayo; Ukwenza iigqibo; Ulwazi lwekhompyutha; Ukubhala nokunxibelelwana okulungileyo; Unxibelelwano nabantu; Ukuzeleka; Ukuqamba nokuqamba.
xh.duties: Nika iinkonzo ezixhaswayo zolawulo jikelele: Qamba, hlela, gcina, thata kwaye ulande unxibelelwano nangcombolo(umsebenzi womgca); Hlaziya izibuki nezibalo; Phatha imibuzo eqhelekileyo; Yenza ikopi kwaye wamkele okanye uthumele unxibelelwano; Sabelisa amaxwebhu/amasheya kubaphathi abahlukeneyo njengoko kufuneka; Gcina ulawulo lohlelo lwefayile kule sebe; Thayipha iileta kunye/nanye unxibelelwano xa kufuneka; Gcina ulawulo yesibuki samaxwebhu angena naphezu kule sebe; Yamkela, qamba futhi usabelise lonke iposi namaxwebhu angena. Yonke iinkonzo zolawulo ezixhasa iNkonzo yeNtengiso kwiSebe: Xhumana namaphakathi angaphakathi nangaphandle ngokuthengiswa kwemihla nemisebenzi; Fumana amaxabiso, gcwalisa iifomu zomthengiso wokuthenga izinto zeqelo lehofisi; Lawulo kwetyhagi yofisi; Gcina ulawulo wesibuki sezinto kule sebe. Yonke iinkonzo zolawulo ezixhasa abantu: Gcina isibuki somhlala-ntsapho kwiSebe; Gcina ulawulo lwarekhodi zabantu kwiSebe; Gcina ulawulo lwesibuki sabakhoyo kwiSebe; Lungiselela ukuhamba nendawo yokuhlala. Yonke iinkonzo zolawulo ezixhasa zimali kule sebe: Thatha kwaye uhlaziye iindleko; Hlola ukuqonda kwamagama abantu abakha isiseko esingahoyiyo nokuhamba baze bawudlulise kulawulo ukuba ayamkele; Phatha i-akhawunti yefowuni netyhagi encinci kule sebe.

jobs.title: Social Auxiliary Worker: Social Work Services (ATHLONE
jobs.centre: Department of Social Development, Western Cape Government.
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R200 691 – R227 145 per annum, (as prescribed by OSD) Grade 2: R236 385 – R269 742 per annum, (as prescribed by OSD) Grade 3: R280 809 – R353 016 per annum, (as prescribed by OSD)
jobs.summary: Social Auxiliary Worker supporting social workers in providing care, protection and development of vulnerable individuals, families and communities in Athlone.
jobs.requirements: Grade 1: Grade 10 plus completion of the learnership to allow registration with the South African Council for Social Service Professions (SACSSP) as Social Auxiliary Worker; Registration with the SACSSP as Social Auxiliary Worker; A valid code B driving licence. Competencies: Knowledge and basic understanding of the following: Human behaviour, relationship system and social issues; South African social welfare context: the policy and practice of developmental social welfare services; South African judicial system and the legislation governing and impacting of social auxiliary work; Basic knowledge of financial matters related to social auxiliary work; Uses appropriate resources in service delivery to client systems; Implement appropriate social auxiliary work methods and techniques to address the social needs of client systems; Information and knowledge management: keep precise records and compile accurate reports on social needs and social auxiliary work activities and file them appropriately; protocol and professional ethics. af.summary: Sosiale Hulpwerker wat sosiale werkers ondersteun in die verskaffing van sorg, beskerming en ontwikkeling van kwesbare individue, gesinne en gemeenskappe in Athlone.
af.requirements: Graad 1: Graad 10 plus voltooiing van die leerderskap om registrasie by die South African Council for Social Service Professions (SACSSP) as Sosiale Hulpwerker moontlik te maak; Registrasie by die SACSSP as Sosiale Hulpwerker; 'n Geldige kode B bestuurslisensie. Bevoegdhede: Kennis en basiese begrip van die volgende: Menslike gedrag, verhoudingstelsel en sosiale vraagstukke; Suid-Afrikaanse sosiale welsynskonteks: die beleid en praktyk van ontwikkelende sosiale welsynsdienste; Suid-Afrikaanse regstelsel en die wetgewing wat sosiale hulpwerk regeer en beïnvloed; Basiese kennis van finansiële aangeleenthede wat verband hou met sosiale hulpwerk; Gebruik toepaslike hulpbronne in dienslewering aan kliëntstelsels; Implementeer toepaslike sosiale hulpwerkmetodes en -tegnieke om die sosiale behoeftes van kliëntstelsels aan te spreek; Inligting- en kennisbestuur: hou akkurate rekords en stel akkurate verslae op oor sosiale behoeftes en sosiale hulpwerkaktiwiteite en lê dit toepaslik weg; protokol en professionele etiek. af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Maritieme en Intermodale Logistiek
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur vir maritieme en intermodale logistiek in die Western Cape Mobility Department, wat portstrategie, belanghebbendesamewerking en prestasiedatustelsels bestuur.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike 3-jaar Nasionale Diploma (ekwivalente of hoër kwalifikasie); 'n Minimum van 3 jaar bestuurservaring in Vrag, logistiek of Maritieme Beplanning of Bedrywighede. Bevoegdhede: Kennis van en werkervaring met die wetgewing, regulatoriese raamwerke, beleid en beste praktyke wat op die lynfunksies betrekking het; Multimodale vrag, vervoerlogistiek, of subsektor-spesifieke kennis; inligtingstelsels wat help met die bestuur van kennis en inligting rakende die lynfunksie; projekbestuur; operasionele bestuurspraktyke; verkryging en tenderprosesse; beleidsontwikkeling, en operasionele bestuur, monitering en hersieningsprosesse; moderne stelsels van bestuur en administrasie; openbare diensprosedures, prosesse en stelsels. Vaardighede: Geletterdheid en syfervaardigheid, Rekenvaardigheid, Taal, Projekbestuur, Begroting en Finansiële Bestuur, Interregeringsamewerking, en Belanghebbende-betrokking.
af.duties: Ontwikkel en implementeer maritieme en hawe strategiese raamwerke en projekte; Bestuur samewerking en vennootskap met vragbelanghebendes; Bestuur hawe-prestasiedata, inligtingstelsels en digitale gereedskap; Beplan en bestuur die werk van en reken vir die algehele prestasie van die Sub-direktoraat; Personeelbestuur; Finansiële Bestuur.

zu.title: I-Sekela Mongamqangi: Ukuhamba kolwandle namalogiweyizi aphakathi kwezinhlobo
zu.summary: I-Sekela Mongamqangi wokuhamba kolwandle namalogiweyizi aphakathi kwezinhlobo e-Western Cape Mobility Department, ephatha inqubomgomo yezikhungazokuhamba kwemikhumbi, ukuhlelwa kwezamacala abathintekayo kanye namasistimu wedatha yokusebenza.
zu.requirements: I-National Diploma yeminyaka eyi-3 efanelekile (iziqu ezingaphezulu noma ezilinganayo); Uphawu oluncane lweminyaka engu-3 loluhlu lokuhamba kwemikhumbi, amalogiweyizi noma ukulungelelanisa noma ukusebenza kolwandle. Ikhono: Ulwazi nokusebenza ngomthetho, izinhlaka zolawulo, amapholisi namasu ahamba phambili aneqhaza emisebenzini yemigqa; Ulwazi lwe-multimodal freight, transport logistics, noma ulwazi oluthize ohlotsheni oluncane; amasistimu wolwazi asiza ekuphathweni kolwazi nolwazi oluphathelene nomsebenzi womugqa; ukuphathwa kweziprojekthi; amasu okuphatha okusebenzayo; inqubo yokuthenga nokuqashwa kwemithengo; ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo zokusebenza, ukuphathwa okusebenzayo, ukubukwa kanye nezinqubo zokuhlola; amasistimu anamuhla okubusa nolawulo; izinqobo, izinqubo namasistimu abantu abasebenzela abantu. Amandla: Ukubala, Ukwazi ukufunda nokubhala, Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, Ulimi, Ukuphathwa kweziprojekthi, Ukulinganisa imali nokuphatha imali, Ukuhlelana phakathi kahulumeni, kanye nokuxhumana nabanikabelo.
zu.duties: Ukuthuthukisa futhi ukuphumeza izinhlaka zokuqondiswa neziprojekthi zokuhamba kolwandle nezindawo zokuqasha izikhombazokuhamba kwemikhumbi; Ukuphatha ukuhlelana nokusebenza ndawonye nezindawo zokuqashwa kwemikhumbi; Ukuphatha idatha yokusebenza yezikhombazokuhamba kwemikhumbi, amasistimu wolwazi namathuluzi asebenzisa ibhalansi; Ukucubungula futhi ukuphatha umsebenzi kanye nokubala ngokusebenza okujwayelekile kwe-Sub-Directorate; Ukuphathwa kwabantu; Ukuphathwa kwemali.

xh.title: Umthunywa kaMongameli: Uqoqosho Lolwandle kunye noQhatho lwezohambo ezininzi
xh.summary: Umthunywa kaMongameli wobulungu bolwandle nokuqhathwa kwezohambo ezininzi kwiSebe loNyuso leNtshona Koloni, eliphatha iindlela zeendawo zokungenisa nokuphumela iindwane, uqhagamshelwano nabathathi ngqayana kwezicwangciso, kunye neendlela zolwazi lomlinganiselo wemisebenzi.
xh.requirements: I-National Diploma yeminyaka eli-3 esemthethweni (okulingana nayo okanye ngaphezulu); Uphando olungaphantsi kweminyaka eli-3 lobugcisa bolawulo kukuQhuba izinto, ukwenza amacebo okuqhuba iindwane, nolwandle, okanye iinkqubo zokusebenza. Iikhompathensi: Ulwazi nolugcino lokusebenza ngemithetho, iindlela zolawulo eziyimithetho, iinkqubo zengcamango nangamanye amasiko amagqwesayo ezithintela imisebenzi yesiphakathi; Ulwazi olusemmandleni weendwane ezihamba ngeendlela ezahlukeneyo, uqoqosho oluhambisa izinto, okanye ulwazi oluthile ngesiqwenga; iinkqubo zemvunjulwazi ezisiza ekulawuleni ulwazi nolwazi olumayela nomsebenzi osesiqwenga; ukulawula amacebo amancinci; iindlela zokulawula imisebenzi yendalo; iinkqubo zokuthenga nokwenza izicelo; ukwakha iinkqubo zengcamango, kunye nokulawula, okuqwalasela nokubuyekeza imisebenzi yendalo; iinkqubo zanamhlanje zobulungu kwaye zolawulo lwangaphakathi; iinkqubo, iindlela nendlela zokusebenza zophuhliso. Ukuzinza: Umdla wokubala, ukubhala nokuqonda, ulwazi lokusebenza ngesixhobo esikwamkela ikhompyutha, Ulwimi, UkuLawulaAmaPhulo, Ukuqwalasela iNkcitho nokuLawula Imali, Ukuqhagamshelana phakathi kweeHulumathi, nokuNxibelelana nabathathi-ngqayana.
xh.duties: Ukuyila nokusebenzisa iindlela zengcamango ezibeka iindawo zolwandle nakwindawo yokungenisa nokuphumela iindwane nangamanye amacebo; Ukulawula uqhagamshelwano nokusebenzisana nabathathi ngqayana kubanini iindwane; Ukulawula ulwazi ngemilinganiselo yendawo yokungenisa nokuphumela iindwane, iinkqubo zemvunjulwazi ngezixhobo ezingakalulu; Ukucwangcisa nokulawula umsebenzi kwaye ube nayo nayiphi na imbuyiso ngokubanzi ngemisebenzi ye-Sbu-Directorate; Ulawulo lwabantu; Ulawulo lweMali.

jobs.title: Administrative Officer: Freight and Logistics
jobs.centre: Western Cape Mobility Department, Western Cape Government.
jobs.salary_text: R338 106 - R398 277 per annum (Level 07), plus 37% in lieu of service benefits.
jobs.summary: Administrative Officer providing project support, data management and staff supervision in freight and logistics for the Western Cape Mobility Department.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate NQF level 6 qualification (equivalent or higher); A minimum of 1–year Project Administration experience. A valid (Code B or higher) driving licence. NB: People with disabilities that restrict driving abilities, but who have reasonable access to transport, may also apply. Competencies: Knowledge of the following: experience with the legislation, regulatory frameworks, policies and best practices that have a bearing on the line functions; information systems that aid in the management of knowledge and information pertaining to the line function; project management; operational management practices; procurement and tendering processes; modern systems of governance and administration; public service procedures, processes and systems; Public Finance Management Act, 1999, National Treasury Regulations, Provincial Treasury Instructions, other financial policies, prescripts, directives and collective agreements; of the functioning of the Province and the activities of sister departments/related functional areas; Labour Relations legislation and regulations; performance management in general. Skills: Numeracy; Literacy; Computer Literacy; Language; Data Analysis. Other: Supervisory; Research and Report Writing; Presentation; Creative Thinking; Applying Technology.
jobs.duties: Project support; high-level administrative support; Data and information management; Staff supervision; Research.
jobs.applications: Only applications submitted online will be accepted. To apply submit your application online only: via http://www.westerncape.gov.za/jobs or https://westerncapegov.erecruit.co
jobs.notes: Shortlisted candidates will be required to attend interviews on a date and time determined by the department and submit documentation for verification purposes and criminal record vetting. All shortlisted candidates shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The selection process will be guided by the EE targets of the employing department. By applying for this position, you are consenting to the Western Cape Government contacting your previous employers/managers for an employment reference. Reference checks will include enquiries relating to your disciplinary records and reasons for leaving. Should you experience difficulties with your online application, technical support is available from Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 16.00. Contact the helpline at 086 137 0214. For all other queries relating to the position, kindly contact the enquiries person as indicated in the advert. Please ensure that you submit your application before the closing date as no late applications will be considered. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Administratiewe Beampte: Vrag en Logistiek
af.summary: Administratiewe Beampte wat projekondersteuning, databestuur en personeelhoofstad in vrag en logistiek vir die Western Cape Mobility Department verskaf.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike NQF vlak 6 kwalifikasie (gelykwaardig of hoër); 'n Minimum van 1–jaar Projekadministrasie-ervaring. 'n Geldige (Kode B of hoër) bestuurslisensie. NB: Mense met gestremdhede wat bestuursvermoëns beperk, maar wat redelike toegang tot vervoer het, mag ook aansoek doen. Bevoegdhede: Kennis van die volgende: ervaring met die wetgewing, regulatoriese raamwerke, beleide en beste praktyke wat 'n uitwerking het op die lynfunksies; inligtingstelsels wat help met die bestuur van kennis en inligting met betrekking tot die lynfunksie; projektebestuur; operasionele bestuurspraktyke; prosesse vir verkryging en aanbesteding; moderne stelsels van goewerance en administrasie; openbare diens prosedures, prosesse en stelsels; Public Finance Management Act, 1999, National Treasury Regulations, Provincial Treasury Instructions, ander finansiële beleide, voorskrifte, richtlyne en kollektiewe ooreenkomste; van die funksionering van die Provinsie en die aktiwiteite van susterdepartemente/verwante funksionele areas; Arbeidsverhoudinge-wetgewing en -regulasies; prestasiebestuur in die algemeen. Vaardighede: Syferkundigheid; Geletterdheid; Rekenaargeletterdheid; Taal; Data-analise. Ander: Toesighoudend; Navorsing en verslagskrywing; Voorlegging; Kreatiewe denke; Toepassing van tegnologie.
af.duties: Projekondersteuning; hoëvlak administratiewe ondersteuning; Data- en inligtingbestuur; Personeeltoesig; Navorsing.

zu.title: ISikhulu Sokuphatha Iziphathamthetha: Ukuthutha Izimpahla Nokuqondisa Ukunyakaziswa Kwemikhakha
zu.summary: Isikhulu Sokuphatha Iziphathamthetha esinika inkxaso yephrojekthi, ephatha idatha futhi eqondisa abasebenzi endaweni yokuthutha izimpahla nokuqondisa ukunyakaziswa kwemikhakha ku Western Cape Mobility Department.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanele ezingazinga le-NQF level 6 (okulingana noma okuphezulu); Okungehlise phansi ukube namava eminyakeni engu-1 yokuqondisa iziphathamthetha zephrojekthi. Ilayisensi yokushayela (Code B noma okuphezulu) esebenzayo. NB: Abantu abakhubazekile abasashayela kahle, kodwa abanendlela engcono yokufinyelela ezokuthutha, bangangena futhi. Ikhono: Ulwazi ngale mikhipha: amava emthethweni, izakhiwo zokubusa ezilawula imisebenzi, amaphulasidi nezindlela ezinhle ezithinta imisebenzi yomkhakha; izinhlelo zolwazi ezisiza ekuphathweni kolwazi nolwazi oluhlobene nomkhakha; ukuphatha amaphrojekthi; izindlela zokuphatha izindlela zokusebenza; izinqubo zokuthenga nokwenza izitende; izinhlelo zanamuhla zokubusa nokuphatha iziphathamthetha; izinqubo, izindlela nezinhlelo zenkonzo kazwelonke; Public Finance Management Act, 1999, National Treasury Regulations, Provincial Treasury Instructions, eminye imithetho yezimali, imiyalo, iziqondiso noma izivumelwano; ukusebenza kwePhrovinsi nemisebenzi yeminyango ehlobene/nawo wonke amakhakha ahlobene; imithetho nemiyalo yeLabour Relations; ukuphatha ukusebenza ngokuvamile. Amakhono: Ukuqonda izibalo; Ukufunda nokubhala; Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha; Ulimi; Ukuhlaziya idatha. Okunye: Ukugcina ilungelo lokulawula; Ukuhlola nokubhala umbiko; Ukubonisa; Ukucabanga ngokuvusa ingqondo; Ukusebenzisa Itoloji.
zu.duties: Ukusekela iphrojekthi; ukusekela okuphezulu ekuphathweni kwezinto; Ukuphatha idatha nolwazi; Ukuqondisa abasebenzi; Ukuhlola.

xh.title: Iofisa olungumlawuli: Freight and Logistics
xh.summary: Iofisa olungumlawuli elinika inkxaso kumaprojekthi, ulawulo lwedata nolawulo labasebenzi kumazwe e-freight and logistics kwi-Western Cape Mobility Department.
xh.requirements: Izidanga ezifanelekileyo ze-NQF level 6 (ezilinganayo okanye ngaphezulu); Uphononongo lwamava obungaphezulu kwe-1–year kwentengiselwano yeprojekthi. Ilayisenisi yokushayela esemthethweni (Code B okanye ngaphezulu). NB: Abantu abanokuwukrofuko ababeka miriwo kubakho ukushayela, kodwa abanalo ukufikelela okulingene kwesithuthi, banako nayabo ukusebenzisa. Amandla okusebenza: Ulwazi ngokuqukeleyo kwesixungo: amava ngemithetho, iindlela ezilawulayo, iinkqubela namacebo amagqibela anomtsalane kumsebenzi ophuma kwisixungo; iinkqubela zolwazi ezenza inkxaso kulawulo lolwazi nolwazi oluhambelana nomsebenzi ophuma kwisixungo; ulawulo lweprojekthi; iindlela zolawulo lomsebenzi wansuku zonke; iinkqubo zokuthenga nokubhida; iinkqubo zamagazini nezakho zamagazini asuselo kakhulu nolawulo; iinkqubo, iinkqubela nolawulo ebuswa ngumthetho wembekakrusi, 1999, iNgqungquthela yeSizwe, iNgqungquthela yePhondo, ezinye iinkqubela zamagazini, iinkqubela, iimfanelo neenkqubo; ngokusebenza kwePhondo nemisebenzi yamaphondo ahlobene/ngeendawo ezihlobene; imithetho yolawulo lwabasebenzi namagazini; ulawulo lokuvela. Amandla: Ukukwazi ukubala; Ukufunda nokubhala; Ukukwazi ukuqhuba ikhompyutha; Ulwimi; Ukuhlalutya idata. Okunye: Ukulawula; Uphononongo nokubhala iingxelo; Ukuyalela; Ukucinga ngeendlela ezintsha; Ukusebenzisa iinthakabhulo.
xh.duties: Inkxaso yeprojekthi; inkxaso yolawulo olungaphezulu; Ulawulo lwedata nolwazi; Ulawulo labasebenzi; Uphononongo.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Management Clerk: Acquisition and Contract
jobs.centre: Western Cape Mobility Department, Western Cape Government.
jobs.summary: Supply Chain Management Clerk providing acquisition and contract clerical support services for the Western Cape Mobility Department.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 (Senior Certificate or equivalent qualification). Skills in the following: Good Verbal and Written Communication; Planning and Organising; Customer Care; Reporting; Problem-solving; Creative Thinking; Decision Making; Willingness to work irregular hours and meet tight deadlines; Ability to work under pressure.

By applying for this position, you are consenting to the Western Cape Government contacting your previous employers/managers for an employment reference. Reference checks will include enquiries relating to your disciplinary records and reasons for leaving. For all other queries relating to the position, kindly contact the enquiries person as indicated in the advert.
